## File: docs/SUPPORTED_FILES_BY_VIEWER.md
`````markdown
# Viewer Support - Selected Formats

## Font Viewer

Font files are previewed directly in-app with a dedicated font surface. The viewer renders sample text, multilingual glyph rows, and basic file metadata.

Supported detection:
- By extension: TTF, TTC, OTF, OTC, WOFF, WOFF2, EOT
- By MIME: font/* plus common legacy font MIME types

This also covers extensionless web-font cache files when the backend probe resolves them as font MIME types.

## Image Viewer

## Browser-Native Formats
These formats are rendered directly by the browser without conversion:
- PNG (including Apple CgBI)
- JPEG
- GIF
- SVG
- WebP
- BMP
- ICO
- AVIF
- TIFF

## Convertible Formats (with Backend Processing)
The following formats are converted to PNG for preview via libvips. **libvips must be installed** for extended format support; without it, only basic formats can be used.

### With libvips Installed:
- JPEG 2000 (JP2, J2K)
- OpenEXR (EXR)
- HEIF/HEIC (Apple High Efficiency)
- AVIF
- TIFF
- WebP
- JPEG XL (JXL)
- FITS / HDR / PFM
- Exact coverage still depends on how the bundled libvips build was compiled

### Without libvips (Go Fallback):
- PNG
- JPEG
- GIF
- BMP

## Architecture

The image viewer uses a two-tier approach:

1. **Tier 1 (Native):** Browser directly renders supported formats
2. **Tier 2 (Conversion):** For unsupported formats, backend converts to PNG via libvips

Converted previews are not sent through the Wails bridge as base64 payloads. They are served from the local preview stream as regular image URLs, which keeps transport overhead lower and lets the browser load them normally.

See [IMAGE_CONVERTER_PIPELINE.md](IMAGE_CONVERTER_PIPELINE.md) for detailed architecture and setup instructions.

## Installation

To enable full format support, install libvips:

**Windows:**
```powershell
choco install vips
# or download a Windows build from https://www.libvips.org/
```

**macOS:**
```bash
brew install vips
```

**Linux:**
```bash
sudo apt-get install libvips-tools
```

## Format Categories

### Original Supported
PNG (including Apple CgBI), JPEG, GIF, SVG, TIFF, ICO, BMP, WebP, AVIF, HEIF/HEIC, JPEG 2000, OpenEXR, JPEG XL, FITS, HDR, PFM, and browser-native formats.

### Notes
- Archive images (inside ZIP, RAR, etc.) cannot be converted yet
- Very large images may take time to convert on first load
- Converted images are served from the local preview stream as regular image URLs
`````

## File: docs/SYSTEM_SURFACES.md
`````markdown
# System Surfaces

System resources use the same provider and panel presentation model as files, archives, remote stores, and result collections. They are not implemented as mode switches inside a large system-management component.

## Built-in system providers

The built-in set is:

- `registry://` — Windows Registry
- `autorun://` — startup entries
- `tasks://` — scheduled tasks
- `services://` — Windows services
- `processes://` — running processes
- `devices://` — Plug and Play devices
- `network://` — adapters and TCP connections
- `environment://` — process, user, and machine environment variables
- `shell-extensions://` — registered Explorer context-menu handlers

Registry and Autorun retain their specialized backend semantics, but both already enter the UI through `PanelSource`. The remaining domains use `SystemSurfacePanelSource`, parameterized by a descriptor that owns the scheme, title, and contributed columns.

## Presentation contract

A provider returns ordinary `FileInfo`-shaped rows with provider metadata attached as `systemFields`. The directory pane does not know the system resource type. Sorting, filtering, selection, keyboard input, context menus, configurable columns, and virtual collection rendering therefore remain shared.

Synthetic system rows explicitly opt out of generic file preview. Operations on them belong to contributed commands/context-menu items rather than fake filesystem paths.

## Scale

System providers deliberately do not introduce a second list renderer. Large directories, Registry collections, process tables, and result sets all pass through the same pane projection and virtual collection machinery. Provider-specific paging/streaming can be added behind the `PanelSource` boundary without changing row components or surface components.

## Backend boundary

`SystemSurfaceList(kind)` is one generic Wails binding returning `{ id, name, fields }` records. The wire contract is intentionally open-ended so a new provider can add columns without extending the core file protocol. On Windows the initial collectors use PowerShell/CIM/Windows cmdlets; non-Windows builds expose an empty collection rather than leaking Windows-specific behavior into the frontend.
`````

## File: docs/THEME_COLOR_SYSTEM.md
`````markdown
# Theme Color System

The UI uses semantic VS Code-style tokens from `frontend/src/vscode-theme.scss`. Components should express **intent**, not theme-specific colors.

## Control tokens

- `--vsc-button-background` / `--vsc-button-foreground`
- `--vsc-button-hover`
- `--vsc-button-secondary` / `--vsc-button-secondary-foreground`
- `--vsc-button-disabled-background` / `--vsc-button-disabled-foreground`
- `--vsc-button-danger-background` / `--vsc-button-danger-foreground`
- `--vsc-input-background` / `--vsc-input-foreground`
- `--vsc-focus-ring`

Primary button text must never use `--vsc-foreground-bright`: that token describes text on the current surface, not text on a primary button.

## Surface tokens

- `--vsc-window-background`
- `--vsc-dialog-background` / `--vsc-dialog-foreground`
- `--vsc-menu-background` / `--vsc-menu-foreground`
- `--vsc-popover-background`
- `--vsc-toolbar-background`
- `--vsc-control-background` / `--vsc-control-foreground`
- `--vsc-scrim` / `--vsc-scrim-soft`

Dialogs, menus, overlays and controls should use these instead of dark-only `#1e1e1e`, `#252526`, white translucent hover fills, or literal black scrims.

## Status colors

Use `--vsc-error`, `--vsc-warning`, `--vsc-info`, `--vsc-success`, and the accent tokens. Their light-theme variants are deliberately darker so text remains legible on white/light surfaces.

## Intentional dark surfaces

Media content is an exception. Video stages, image transparency/checkerboard areas, waveform/canvas content and similar viewer media may intentionally remain black or dark when that improves the content itself. The surrounding chrome must still use semantic tokens.

## Contrast targets

The palette is tuned around WCAG-style text contrast as a practical floor:

- normal text: approximately 4.5:1 or better
- large/decorative UI text: approximately 3:1 or better
- primary button: white on `#007acc` is approximately 4.51:1
- light foreground `#3b3b3b` on white is approximately 11.2:1
- light muted foreground `#737373` on white is approximately 4.74:1

Disabled controls are not communicated by opacity alone; they get explicit disabled foreground/background colors so their labels remain readable.

## Component rule

Before adding a new literal color, ask whether it describes a semantic role already represented by a token. Literal colors are appropriate for content visualization (charts, media, syntax samples) but generally not for window chrome, dialog surfaces, controls, menus, actions or status text.

## Repository-wide invariant

Every visual component is theme-owned, including viewers, diagrams, badges, native-looking controls, document canvases, plugin surfaces, and media controls.

Raw `#hex`, `rgb()/rgba()`, `hsl()/hsla()`, and named presentation colors such as `white` or `black` belong only in `frontend/src/vscode-theme.scss`. Components may not embed them directly. Content-specific visuals use semantic families such as `--vsc-chart-*`, `--vsc-media-*`, and `--vsc-document-canvas-*` rather than opting out of theming.

Canvas code cannot use CSS `var(...)` strings directly. It must resolve the desired theme token with `getComputedStyle()` before assigning `fillStyle`, `strokeStyle`, or related Canvas properties.

Run the invariant check with:

```bash
npm run audit:theme
```

The audit also rejects unresolved non-local theme variables, preventing a component from silently falling back to browser defaults.
`````

## File: docs/VIDEO_PLAYER_OPTIONS.md
`````markdown
# Video Player Implementation Options

## Current Direction

The codebase has already committed to a canvas-only playback surface for video preview. The main architectural question is no longer whether to use HTML5 video, but how to transport media in a way that preserves reliable seeking.

The current conclusion is:


## Comparison Matrix

### Option 1: **Stick with HTML5 Video (Baseline)**
Pros:

Cons:

**Effort**: Zero  
**Format Support**: ~60% (mp4, webm, mov)  
**Perf**: Best  
**User Experience**: Common formats work, exotic formats fail


### Option 2: **Canvas + WebCodecs (Current Baseline)**
Pros:

Cons:

**Effort**: 2-4 weeks  
**Format Support**: ~95% (everything with modern browser)  
**Perf**: Good (hardware accelerated most of the time)  
**User Experience**: Broad format support, but seek quality depends on transport mode


### Option 2A: **Canvas + WebCodecs + Seekable File Transport**

Pros:

Cons:

**Effort**: Low incremental effort  
**Format Support**: High, bounded by WebCodecs and demux support  
**Perf**: Best within the current architecture  
**User Experience**: Good scrubbing and stable decode recovery


### Option 2B: **Canvas + WebCodecs + Restart-On-Seek Transcoding**

Pros:

Cons:

**Effort**: Moderate  
**Format Support**: High for transcoded content  
**Perf**: Good for playback, acceptable for discrete seeks  
**User Experience**: Predictable seek behavior instead of partial/random success


### Option 3: **Canvas + FFmpeg.wasm (Maximum Compatibility)**
Pros:

Cons:

**Effort**: 1-2 weeks (simpler demuxing)  
**Format Support**: 100%  
**Perf**: Poor (software decoding)  
**User Experience**: Works everywhere but might be laggy


### Option 4: **Hybrid (WebCodecs + FFmpeg.wasm Fallback)**
Pros:

Cons:

**Effort**: 3-5 weeks  
**Format Support**: 100%  
**Perf**: Good (hybrid strategy)  
**User Experience**: Excellent, but heavy


## Recommendation: **Hybrid by Source Seekability**

### Why?
1. **Root cause fit**: The current seek issues are transport-related, not just decoder-related.
2. **Direct files already have the right shape**: HTTP range requests map naturally to demuxer seeking.
3. **Sequential transcodes do not**: A single ffmpeg pipe cannot reliably support arbitrary back-and-forth seeking.
4. **Smaller change surface**: Restart-on-seek is much simpler than inventing a chunk protocol or moving immediately to HLS/DASH.
5. **Clear UX contract**: Sources can advertise whether they support full scrubbing or restart-based seeking.

### Decision Tree

```
User opens video file
  ├─ Source is byte-seekable?
  │   └─ Use canvas player with range-backed transport
  │
  ├─ Source requires live transcode?
  │   ├─ Initial playback → sequential transcode stream
  │   └─ Seek → restart transcode near requested timestamp
  │
  └─ Source is neither seekable nor restartable?
    └─ Offer limited preview semantics or disable scrubbing
```


## Implementation Checklist for Option 2

### Stage 1: Infrastructure (1 week)

### Stage 2: Core Playback (1 week)

### Stage 3: Playback Controls (1 week)

### Stage 4: Transport Semantics (1 week)


## Code Structure for Option 2

```
frontend/src/app/services/
├── video-decoder/
│   ├── codec-detector.service.ts
│   ├── canvas-video-player.ts
│   ├── frame-buffer.ts
│   ├── audio-sync.ts
│   └── demuxer-adapter.ts
└── video-player.service.ts (orchestrator)

frontend/src/app/components/
├── canvas-video-player/
│   ├── canvas-video-player.component.ts
│   ├── playback-controls.component.ts
│   └── canvas-video-player.component.scss
```


## Library Recommendations for Option 2

### Primary Dependencies
```json
{
  "dependencies": {
    "@vscode/webdemuxer": "^0.1.0",
    "tsdemux": "^2.0.0"  // Alternative
  }
}
```

### No Heavy Downloads Needed


## Risk Analysis

### High Risk Items
| Risk | Mitigation |
|------|-----------|
| Audio sync drift | Timestamp-based sync, periodic resync |
| Seeking precision | Use range-backed demuxing for seekable sources; restart transcode for sequential sources |
| Codec not available | Check MediaCapabilities before init |
| Container parsing fails | Validate file format, show error |
| Sequential stream scrub instability | Do not promise full random seek inside one ffmpeg pipe |

### Testing Strategy
1. Test each format category (MP4, WebM, MKV, AVI, etc.)
2. Seek forward/backward randomly
3. Pause/Resume cycles
4. Long files (>1 hour)
5. High bitrate (4K)
6. Edge cases (corrupted files, truncated)


## Timeline Estimate

| Phase | Duration | Milestone |
|-------|----------|-----------|
| Research & Proto | 3-5 days | Proof of concept with one format |
| Core Impl | 5-7 days | Play any WebCodecs format |
| UI & Controls | 5-7 days | Polished playback experience |
| Testing & Polish | 3-5 days | Error handling, edge cases |
| **Total** | **2-3 weeks** | Production ready |


## File Manager Integration Points

### 1. Format Detection (in `viewer-surface.component.ts`)
```typescript
// Current
if (ext === 'mkv') this.kind = 'unsupported';

// New
if (ext === 'mkv' && this.hasWebCodecsSupport()) {
  this.kind = 'video';
  this.useCanvasPlayer = true;  // Signal to use Canvas player
} else if (ext === 'mkv') {
  this.kind = 'unsupported';  // Fallback
}
```

### 2. Mime Type Expansion
```typescript
private inferVideoMime(ext: string): string | null {
  // Existing logic handles mp4, webm, mov
  // Add new codecs for WebCodecs usage
  return { /* current */ ...{
    mkv: 'video/x-matroska',
    avi: 'video/x-msvideo',
    ts: 'video/mp2t',
    mxf: 'application/mxf',
    // Add dynamically based on detected codecs inside
  }}[ext] ?? null;
}
```

### 3. Streaming URL Logic
```typescript
async getRawStreamUrl(path: string): Promise<string> {
  // Existing: /wails-stream URL for direct seekable playback
  return `${API_BASE}/wails-stream?path=${path}`;
}
```

For transcoded playback, the URL shape needs to express playback mode explicitly:

```typescript
// Initial playback
`${API_BASE}/wails-stream?path=${path}&transcode=mp4&mode=transcode`

// Restart-based seek
`${API_BASE}/wails-stream?path=${path}&transcode=mp4&mode=transcode&start=${seconds}`
```


## Go Backend Changes

The backend already supports both of the transport classes the frontend needs, but they should be treated differently:


That means the main change is not low-level chunk formatting. The main change is making seek behavior mode-aware.

```go
// Direct file path: true byte-range seek support
// Transcode path: sequential output, optional restart with ?start=<seconds>
```

### Optional Enhancement
```go
// Add metadata endpoint for quick format detection
GET /api/video-metadata/{path}
└─ Returns: { format: "mkv", width: 1920, height: 1080, duration: 120000, codec: "h264" }
```


## Next Steps

### Immediate
1. Review @vscode/webdemuxer or tsdemux APIs
2. Create proof-of-concept with MKV file
3. Benchmark WebCodecs decode time
4. Estimate final effort

### This Week

### Implementation
`````

## File: manager/frontend/scripts/audit-theme-colors.mjs
`````javascript
import { readFileSync, readdirSync, statSync } from 'node:fs';
import { extname, join, relative } from 'node:path';

const root = new URL('../src/', import.meta.url).pathname;
const themeFile = join(root, 'vscode-theme.scss');
const extensions = new Set(['.ts', '.scss', '.css', '.html']);
const rawColor = /(?<![\w-])(#[0-9a-fA-F]{3,8}\b|rgba?\([^)]*\)|hsla?\([^)]*\))/g;
const namedColor = /(?:color|background|border(?:-color)?|fill|stroke|shadow)[^;\n]*:\s*(white|black|red|green|blue|yellow|orange|purple|gray|grey)(?=[; ,}\)])/gi;
const variableRef = /var\((--[\w-]+)/g;
const variableDef = /(--[\w-]+)\s*:/g;
const localVariables = new Set(['--tx', '--ty', '--workspace-ratio', '--cols']);

function filesUnder(directory) {
  const result = [];
  for (const name of readdirSync(directory)) {
    const path = join(directory, name);
    const stat = statSync(path);
    if (stat.isDirectory()) result.push(...filesUnder(path));
    else if (extensions.has(extname(path))) result.push(path);
  }
  return result;
}

const files = filesUnder(root);
const definitions = new Set();
const references = new Map();
const violations = [];

for (const path of files) {
  const text = readFileSync(path, 'utf8');
  for (const match of text.matchAll(variableDef)) definitions.add(match[1]);
  for (const match of text.matchAll(variableRef)) {
    const sites = references.get(match[1]) ?? [];
    sites.push(relative(root, path));
    references.set(match[1], sites);
  }

  if (path === themeFile) continue;
  for (const match of text.matchAll(rawColor)) {
    violations.push(`${relative(root, path)}: raw color ${match[1]}`);
  }
  for (const match of text.matchAll(namedColor)) {
    violations.push(`${relative(root, path)}: named presentation color ${match[1]}`);
  }
}

for (const [token, sites] of references) {
  if (definitions.has(token) || localVariables.has(token)) continue;
  violations.push(`${sites[0]}: unresolved theme token ${token}`);
}

if (violations.length) {
  console.error('Theme audit failed:');
  for (const violation of violations) console.error(`  - ${violation}`);
  process.exit(1);
}

console.log(`Theme audit passed: ${files.length - 1} visual source files use theme-owned colors only.`);
`````

## File: manager/frontend/src/app/components/accessibility.audit.ts
`````typescript
export interface AccessibilityTarget {
  readonly name: string;
  readonly modal: boolean;
  readonly hasAccessibleName: boolean;
  readonly hasListbox: boolean;
  readonly optionsHaveSelectedState: boolean;
  readonly optionsHavePosition: boolean;
}
export interface AccessibilityAuditResult {
  readonly unnamedModals: readonly string[];
  readonly incompleteListboxes: readonly string[];
}
export function auditReassemblyAccessibility(
  targets: readonly AccessibilityTarget[],
): AccessibilityAuditResult {
  return {
    unnamedModals: targets.filter(target => target.modal && !target.hasAccessibleName).map(target => target.name),
    incompleteListboxes: targets
      .filter(target => target.hasListbox && (!target.optionsHaveSelectedState || !target.optionsHavePosition))
      .map(target => target.name),
  };
}
`````

`````typescript
  `,
  styles: [`
    :host{

      bottom:10px;
      z-index:8450;
      pointer-events:none;
    }
    .feedback-stack{
      display:flex;
      width:min(390px,calc(100vw - 20px));
      flex-direction:column;

      grid-template-columns:3px minmax(0,1fr) auto;
      align-items:stretch;
      overflow:hidden;
      border:1px solid var(--vsc-border,var(--vsc-border));
      border-radius:6px;
      background:var(--vsc-popover-background,var(--vsc-dialog-background));
      color:var(--vsc-dialog-foreground,var(--vsc-foreground));
      box-shadow:0 6px 22px var(--vsc-scrim-soft);
      font:11px/1.35 var(--vsc-font-family,system-ui,sans-serif);
    }
    .indicator{background:var(--vsc-info,var(--vsc-accent-blue))}
    .success .indicator{background:var(--vsc-success)}
    .warning .indicator{background:var(--vsc-warning)}
    .error .indicator{background:var(--vsc-error)}
    .copy{
      display:grid;
      min-width:0;
      gap:2px;
      padding:7px 8px;
    }
    .copy strong,.copy span{
      overflow:hidden;
      text-overflow:ellipsis;
      white-space:nowrap;
    }
    .copy span{color:var(--vsc-description-foreground,var(--vsc-foreground-dim))}
    button{
      width:28px;
      border:0;
      background:transparent;
      color:inherit;
      cursor:pointer;
      font:16px/1 system-ui,sans-serif;
    }
    button:hover{background:var(--vsc-list-hover-background)}
  `],
})
export class ActionFeedbackComponent implements OnInit, OnDestroy {
  items: readonly FeedbackItem[] = [];
  private readonly destroy$ = createSubject<void>();

  constructor(
    public readonly feedback: ActionFeedbackService,
    private readonly cdr: ChangeDetectorRef,
  ) {}

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.feedback.items$
      .pipe(takeUntil(this.destroy$))
      .subscribe(items => {
        this.items = items;
        this.cdr.markForCheck();
      });
  }

  ngOnDestroy(): void {
    this.destroy$.next();
    this.destroy$.complete();
  }

  track(_index: number, item: FeedbackItem): string {
    return item.id;
  }
}
`````

`````typescript
import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';

const edit = readFileSync(new URL('./address-bar-edit.component.ts', import.meta.url), 'utf8');

describe('address bar progressive forced autocomplete', () => {
  it('publishes filesystem autocomplete batches during Ctrl+Space', () => {
    expect(edit).toContain('const publish = (children: PathSuggestion[]) =>');
    expect(edit).toContain('await this.streamDirChildren(dirPath, prefix, publish)');
  });

  it('does not wait for the whole drive listing before opening suggestions', () => {
    const forceStart = edit.indexOf('private async forceShowSuggestions');
    const forceEnd = edit.indexOf('private async moveSuggestionSelectionWithFallback', forceStart);
    const force = edit.slice(forceStart, forceEnd);
    expect(force).not.toContain('const suggestions = await this.fetchChildren(query)');
  });

  it('keeps root aliases for the no-source case', () => {
    expect(edit).toContain('if (!dirPath) {');
    expect(edit).toContain('this.setSuggestions(aliasRoots)');
  });
});
`````

`````typescript
  @Input() pinnedLocations: PinnedLocation[] = [];
  @Input() preferredSectionTitle: string | null = null;
  @Output() navigate = new EventEmitter<string>();
  @Output() openPin = new EventEmitter<PinnedLocation>();
  @Output() removePin = new EventEmitter<PinnedLocation>();
  @Output() renamePin = new EventEmitter<PinnedLocation>();
  @Output() closeRequested = new EventEmitter<void>();

  allSections: QuickAccessSection[] = [];
  sections: QuickAccessSection[] = [];
  activeTabIdx = 0;
  filterQuery = '';
  tabSpinDirection: TabSpinDirection = null;
  tabTransitionActive = false;
  animationFromSections: OrderedQuickAccessSection[] = [];
  animationToSections: OrderedQuickAccessSection[] = [];
  highlightedItem: { sectionIdx: number; itemIdx: number } | null = null;
  private tabSpinTimer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null = null;
  private readonly commandOwner = `overlay.quickAccess:${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8)}`;
  private releaseOverlayContext: (() => void) | null = null;

  constructor(
    private pathHistoryService: PathHistoryService,
    private cdr: ChangeDetectorRef,
    private hostEl: ElementRef<HTMLElement>,
    private inputContexts: InputContextService,
    private inputEngine: InputEngineService,
    private pinnedLocationService: PinnedLocationService,
    private relatedLocations: RelatedLocationService,
  ) {}

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.registerInputCommands();
    this.releaseOverlayContext ??= this.inputContexts.acquire('overlay.quickAccess');
    this.buildSections();
    this.focusFilterField();
  }

  ngOnChanges(changes: SimpleChanges): void {
    if (changes['specialFolders'] || changes['pinnedLocations'] || changes['currentPath']) {
      this.buildSections();
    }
    if (changes['preferredSectionTitle'] && !changes['preferredSectionTitle'].firstChange) {
      this.applyPreferredSection();
    }
  }

  ngOnDestroy(): void {
    if (this.tabSpinTimer) clearTimeout(this.tabSpinTimer);
    this.releaseOverlayContext?.();
    this.releaseOverlayContext = null;
    this.unregisterInputCommands();
  }

  // no-op if no items
  private buildSections(): void {
    const previousSectionTitle = this.sections[this.activeTabIdx]?.title ?? this.preferredSectionTitle;
    this.allSections = [];

    // System Folders
    if (this.specialFolders.length > 0) {
      this.allSections.push({
        title: 'System',
        items: this.specialFolders.map(f => ({
          name: f.name,
          path: f.path,
          icon: this.resolveQuickAccessIcon(f.icon),
        }))
      });
    }

    const relatedPins = this.relatedLocations.resolve(this.pinnedLocations, this.currentPath, this.currentSurfaceId);

    if (relatedPins.length > 0) {
      this.allSections.push({
        title: 'Related',
        items: relatedPins.map(pin => this.pinItem(pin)),
      });
    }

    this.allSections.push({
      title: 'Pinned',
      items: this.pinnedLocations.map(pin => this.pinItem(pin)),
    });

    // Frequent Folders (top 5 by access count)
    const frequentItems = this.getFrequentLocations(5);
    if (frequentItems.length > 0) {
      this.allSections.push({
        title: 'Frequent',
        items: frequentItems
      });
    }

    // Recent Folders (last 5)
    const recentItems = this.getRecentLocations(5);
    if (recentItems.length > 0) {
      this.allSections.push({
        title: 'Recent',
        items: recentItems
      });
    }

    this.applyFilterQuery(this.filterQuery, previousSectionTitle ?? null);
  }

  private applyPreferredSection(): void {
    const preferred = (this.preferredSectionTitle || '').trim().toLowerCase();
    if (!preferred || this.sections.length === 0) return;

    const preferredIdx = this.sections.findIndex(section => section.title.toLowerCase() === preferred);
    if (preferredIdx >= 0) {
      this.activeTabIdx = preferredIdx;
      this.updateHighlightForNewTab();
      this.cdr.markForCheck();
    }
  }

  setActiveTab(idx: number): void {
    if (idx < 0 || idx >= this.sections.length) return;
    if (this.activeTabIdx === idx) return;
    const previousIdx = this.activeTabIdx;
    this.animationFromSections = this.orderedSectionsFor(previousIdx);
    this.animationToSections = this.orderedSectionsFor(idx);
    this.activeTabIdx = idx;
    this.startTabSpin(this.getSpinDirection(previousIdx, idx));
    this.updateHighlightForNewTab();
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
  }

  activeSectionEntry(): OrderedQuickAccessSection | null {
    const section = this.sections[this.activeTabIdx];
    if (!section) return null;
    return { section, originalIndex: this.activeTabIdx };
  }

  trailingSections(): OrderedQuickAccessSection[] {
    return this.trailingSectionsFrom(this.orderedSectionsFor(this.activeTabIdx));
  }

  leadingSection(sections: OrderedQuickAccessSection[]): OrderedQuickAccessSection | null {
    return sections[0] ?? null;
  }

  trailingSectionsFrom(sections: OrderedQuickAccessSection[]): OrderedQuickAccessSection[] {
    return sections.slice(1);
  }

  private orderedSectionsFor(startIdx: number): OrderedQuickAccessSection[] {
    if (this.sections.length === 0) return [];

    const ordered = this.sections.map((section, originalIndex) => ({ section, originalIndex }));
    return ordered.slice(startIdx).concat(ordered.slice(0, startIdx));
  }

  trackByOrderedSection(_index: number, orderedSection: OrderedQuickAccessSection): number {
    return orderedSection.originalIndex;
  }

  private getSpinDirection(_previousIdx: number, _nextIdx: number): TabSpinDirection {
    return 'left';
  }

  private startTabSpin(direction: TabSpinDirection): void {
    if (this.tabSpinTimer) clearTimeout(this.tabSpinTimer);
    this.tabSpinDirection = direction;
    this.tabTransitionActive = true;
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
    this.focusFilterField();

    this.tabSpinTimer = setTimeout(() => {
      this.tabSpinDirection = null;
      this.tabTransitionActive = false;
      this.animationFromSections = [];
      this.animationToSections = [];
      this.tabSpinTimer = null;
      this.cdr.markForCheck();
      this.focusFilterField();
    }, 260);
  }

  onFilterChange(query: string): void {
    this.applyFilterQuery(query, this.sections[this.activeTabIdx]?.title ?? null);
  }

  clearFilter(): void {
    this.applyFilterQuery('', this.sections[this.activeTabIdx]?.title ?? null);
    this.focusFilterField();
  }

  private focusFilterField(): void {
    requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      const input = this.filterInput?.nativeElement;
      if (input) {
        input.focus({ preventScroll: true });
        input.select();
        return;
      }

      const menu = this.hostEl.nativeElement.querySelector<HTMLElement>('.ab-quick-access-drop');
      menu?.focus({ preventScroll: true });
    });
  }

  private applyFilterQuery(query: string, preferredTitle: string | null): void {
    this.filterQuery = query;
    const normalized = query.trim().toLowerCase();
    const nextSections = normalized
      ? this.allSections
          .map(section => ({
            title: section.title,
            items: this.rankItemsForQuery(section.items, normalized),
          }))
          .filter(section => section.items.length > 0)
      : this.allSections.map(section => ({ title: section.title, items: [...section.items] }));

    this.sections = nextSections;

    if (this.sections.length === 0) {
      this.activeTabIdx = 0;
      this.highlightedItem = null;
      this.cdr.markForCheck();
      return;
    }

    const preferred = (preferredTitle || this.preferredSectionTitle || '').trim().toLowerCase();
    const preferredIdx = preferred
      ? this.sections.findIndex(section => section.title.toLowerCase() === preferred)
      : -1;

    if (preferredIdx >= 0) {
      this.activeTabIdx = preferredIdx;
    } else if (this.activeTabIdx >= this.sections.length) {
      this.activeTabIdx = this.sections.length - 1;
    }

    this.updateHighlightForNewTab();
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
  }

  private rankItemsForQuery(items: QuickAccessItem[], query: string): QuickAccessItem[] {
    const ranked = items
      .map((item, originalIndex): RankedQuickAccessItem => ({
        item,
        score: this.rankItemForQuery(item, query),
        originalIndex,
      }))
      .filter(entry => entry.score > 0)
      .sort((left, right) => right.score - left.score || left.originalIndex - right.originalIndex);

    return ranked.map(entry => entry.item);
  }

  private rankItemForQuery(item: QuickAccessItem, query: string): number {
    const tokens = query.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
    if (tokens.length === 0) {
      return 1;
    }

    const fields = [
      { text: item.name, weight: 8 },
      { text: item.pin?.label, weight: 7 },
      { text: item.path, weight: 4 },
      { text: item.pin?.location, weight: 3 },
    ];

    let total = 0;
    for (const token of tokens) {
      let bestScore = 0;
      for (const field of fields) {
        bestScore = Math.max(bestScore, this.fuzzyFieldScore(field.text, token, field.weight));
      }

      if (bestScore <= 0) {
        return 0;
      }

      total += bestScore;
    }

    total += Math.min(item.accessCount ?? 0, 25);
    if (item.pin) {
      total += 10;
    }

    return total;
  }

  private fuzzyFieldScore(value: string | undefined, query: string, weight: number): number {
    if (!value) {
      return 0;
    }

    const text = value.toLowerCase();
    if (text === query) {
      return 320 * weight;
    }

    if (text.startsWith(query)) {
      return (220 - Math.min(text.length - query.length, 40)) * weight;
    }

    const containsIndex = text.indexOf(query);
    if (containsIndex >= 0) {
      const boundaryBonus = containsIndex === 0 || this.isBoundaryChar(text[containsIndex - 1]) ? 18 : 0;
      return (150 - Math.min(containsIndex, 40) + boundaryBonus) * weight;
    }

    let queryIndex = 0;
    let score = 0;
    let contiguousRun = 0;

    for (let textIndex = 0; textIndex < text.length && queryIndex < query.length; textIndex++) {
      if (text[textIndex] !== query[queryIndex]) {
        contiguousRun = 0;
        continue;
      }

      const atBoundary = textIndex === 0 || this.isBoundaryChar(text[textIndex - 1]);
      contiguousRun += 1;
      score += 14;
      score += contiguousRun * 10;
      if (atBoundary) {
        score += 18;
      }
      if (textIndex === queryIndex) {
        score += 6;
      }

      queryIndex += 1;
    }

    if (queryIndex !== query.length) {
      return 0;
    }

    return score * weight;
  }

  private isBoundaryChar(char: string | undefined): boolean {
    return !char || char === '/' || char === '\\' || char === '-' || char === '_' || char === ' ' || char === '.';
  }

  private updateHighlightForNewTab(): void {
    if (this.sections.length > 0 && this.sections[this.activeTabIdx].items.length > 0) {
      this.highlightedItem = { sectionIdx: this.activeTabIdx, itemIdx: 0 };
    } else {
      this.highlightedItem = null;
    }
  }

  isHighlighted(itemIdx: number): boolean {
    return this.highlightedItem?.sectionIdx === this.activeTabIdx && this.highlightedItem?.itemIdx === itemIdx;
  }

  highlightItem(sectionIdx: number, itemIdx: number): void {
    this.highlightedItem = { sectionIdx, itemIdx };
  }

  selectItem(sectionIdx: number, itemIdx: number): void {
    if (sectionIdx < this.sections.length && itemIdx < this.sections[sectionIdx].items.length) {
      const item = this.sections[sectionIdx].items[itemIdx];
      if (item.pin) this.openPin.emit(item.pin);
      else this.navigate.emit(item.path);
    }
  }

  private selectActiveSlot(slotIndex: number): void {
    const activeSection = this.sections[this.activeTabIdx];
    const item = activeSection?.items[slotIndex];
    if (!item) return;
    this.highlightedItem = { sectionIdx: this.activeTabIdx, itemIdx: slotIndex };
    this.selectItem(this.activeTabIdx, slotIndex);
  }


  renamePinnedItem(item: QuickAccessItem, event: MouseEvent): void {
    event.preventDefault();
    event.stopPropagation();
    if (item.pin) this.renamePin.emit(item.pin);
  }

  removePinnedItem(item: QuickAccessItem, event: MouseEvent): void {
    event.preventDefault();
    event.stopPropagation();
    if (item.pin) this.removePin.emit(item.pin);
  }

  private moveDown(): void {
    if (!this.highlightedItem) return;
    const { sectionIdx, itemIdx } = this.highlightedItem;
    const currentSection = this.sections[sectionIdx];

    if (itemIdx < currentSection.items.length - 1) {
      this.highlightedItem = { sectionIdx, itemIdx: itemIdx + 1 };
    }
    // No wrapping to next section; just stop at bottom of list
  }

  private moveUp(): void {
    if (!this.highlightedItem) return;
    const { sectionIdx, itemIdx } = this.highlightedItem;

    if (itemIdx > 0) {
      this.highlightedItem = { sectionIdx, itemIdx: itemIdx - 1 };
    }
    // No wrapping to prev section; just stop at top of list
  }

  private registerInputCommands(): void {
    this.inputEngine.registerCommand('overlay.quickAccess.close', () => {
      this.closeRequested.emit();
    }, this.commandOwner);

    this.inputEngine.registerCommand('overlay.quickAccess.nextSection', () => {
      const len = this.sections.length;
      if (len <= 1) return;
      const next = (this.activeTabIdx + 1) % len;
      this.setActiveTab(next);
    }, this.commandOwner);

    this.inputEngine.registerCommand('overlay.quickAccess.prevSection', () => {
      const len = this.sections.length;
      if (len <= 1) return;
      const next = (this.activeTabIdx - 1 + len) % len;
      this.setActiveTab(next);
    }, this.commandOwner);

    this.inputEngine.registerCommand('overlay.quickAccess.prevItem', () => {
      this.moveUp();
      this.cdr.markForCheck();
    }, this.commandOwner);

    this.inputEngine.registerCommand('overlay.quickAccess.nextItem', () => {
      this.moveDown();
      this.cdr.markForCheck();
    }, this.commandOwner);

    this.inputEngine.registerCommand('overlay.quickAccess.openSelected', () => {
      if (!this.highlightedItem) return;
      this.selectItem(this.highlightedItem.sectionIdx, this.highlightedItem.itemIdx);
    }, this.commandOwner);

    this.inputEngine.registerCommand('overlay.quickAccess.focusFilter', () => {
      this.focusFilterField();
    }, this.commandOwner);

    this.inputEngine.registerCommand('overlay.quickAccess.removeSelected', () => {
      if (!this.highlightedItem) return;
      const activeSection = this.sections[this.highlightedItem.sectionIdx];
      const item = activeSection?.items[this.highlightedItem.itemIdx];
      if (!item?.pin) return;
      this.removePin.emit(item.pin);
    }, this.commandOwner);

    for (let slot = 1; slot <= 9; slot++) {
      this.inputEngine.registerCommand(`overlay.quickAccess.openSlot${slot}`, () => {
        this.selectActiveSlot(slot - 1);
      }, this.commandOwner);
    }
  }

  private unregisterInputCommands(): void {
    this.inputEngine.unregisterCommand('overlay.quickAccess.close', this.commandOwner);
    this.inputEngine.unregisterCommand('overlay.quickAccess.nextSection', this.commandOwner);
    this.inputEngine.unregisterCommand('overlay.quickAccess.prevSection', this.commandOwner);
    this.inputEngine.unregisterCommand('overlay.quickAccess.prevItem', this.commandOwner);
    this.inputEngine.unregisterCommand('overlay.quickAccess.nextItem', this.commandOwner);
    this.inputEngine.unregisterCommand('overlay.quickAccess.openSelected', this.commandOwner);
    this.inputEngine.unregisterCommand('overlay.quickAccess.focusFilter', this.commandOwner);
    this.inputEngine.unregisterCommand('overlay.quickAccess.removeSelected', this.commandOwner);
    for (let slot = 1; slot <= 9; slot++) {
      this.inputEngine.unregisterCommand(`overlay.quickAccess.openSlot${slot}`, this.commandOwner);
    }
  }

  private getFrequentLocations(limit: number): QuickAccessItem[] {
    return this.pathHistoryService.getFrequentLocations(limit).map(entry => ({
      name: locationLabel(entry.location),
      path: entry.location,
      icon: locationIcon(entry.scheme),
      accessCount: entry.accessCount,
      timestamp: entry.timestamp,
    }));
  }

  private getRecentLocations(limit: number): QuickAccessItem[] {
    return this.pathHistoryService.getRecentLocations(limit).map(entry => ({
      name: locationLabel(entry.location),
      path: entry.location,
      icon: entry.scheme === 'filesystem' ? QUICK_ACCESS_RECENT_ICON : locationIcon(entry.scheme),
      accessCount: entry.accessCount,
      timestamp: entry.timestamp,
    }));
  }

  private resolveQuickAccessIcon(icon: string | undefined): string {
    if (!icon) {
      return QUICK_ACCESS_FOLDER_ICON;
    }

    const normalized = icon.trim();
    if (!normalized) {
      return QUICK_ACCESS_FOLDER_ICON;
    }

    const normalizedKey = normalized.toLowerCase();
    if (SPECIAL_FOLDER_ICONS[normalizedKey]) {
      return SPECIAL_FOLDER_ICONS[normalizedKey];
    }

    if (normalized === QUICK_ACCESS_FOLDER_ICON || normalized === '\u{1F4C1}\uFE0F') {
      return QUICK_ACCESS_FOLDER_ICON;
    }
    if (normalized === QUICK_ACCESS_RECENT_ICON || normalized === '\u23F2') {
      return QUICK_ACCESS_RECENT_ICON;
    }
    if (normalized === QUICK_ACCESS_PIN_ICON || normalized === '\u{1F4CC}\uFE0F') {
      return QUICK_ACCESS_PIN_ICON;
    }

    if (/[ĐđŃ]/.test(normalized)) {
      if (/downloads|download/i.test(normalizedKey)) return SPECIAL_FOLDER_ICONS['downloads'];
      if (/desktop/i.test(normalizedKey)) return SPECIAL_FOLDER_ICONS['desktop'];
      if (/document/i.test(normalizedKey)) return SPECIAL_FOLDER_ICONS['documents'];
      if (/picture|photo|image/i.test(normalizedKey)) return SPECIAL_FOLDER_ICONS['pictures'];
      if (/video|movie/i.test(normalizedKey)) return SPECIAL_FOLDER_ICONS['videos'];
      if (/music|audio/i.test(normalizedKey)) return SPECIAL_FOLDER_ICONS['music'];
      if (/home|user/i.test(normalizedKey)) return SPECIAL_FOLDER_ICONS['home'];
      return QUICK_ACCESS_FOLDER_ICON;
    }

    return normalized;
  }
  private pinItem(pin: PinnedLocation): QuickAccessItem {
    return {
      name: pin.label,
      path: pin.location,
      icon: this.resolveQuickAccessIcon(pin.icon),
      pin,
    };
  }


}
`````

`````typescript
    .ab-scheme-space-fill { height: 100%; background: var(--vsc-accent-blue); border-radius: 2px; transition: width var(--vsc-transition-normal); }

      display: flex; align-items: center; gap: var(--vsc-padding-sm);
      height: 28px; padding: 0 var(--vsc-padding-lg);
      background-color: var(--vsc-panel-background, var(--vsc-panel-background)) !important;
      border-top: 1px solid var(--vsc-border-subtle);
      font-size: 11px; color: var(--vsc-foreground-dim);

      kbd {
        display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
        min-width: 18px; height: 18px; padding: 0 3px;
        background: var(--vsc-input-background); border: 1px solid var(--vsc-border);
        border-bottom-width: 2px; border-radius: var(--vsc-border-radius-sm);
        font-family: var(--vsc-font-family-mono); font-size: 10px;
        color: var(--vsc-foreground); margin: 0 var(--vsc-padding-xs);
      }
    }

    .ab-drop-loading {
      display: flex; align-items: center; gap: var(--vsc-padding-sm);
      padding: var(--vsc-padding-lg); background-color: var(--vsc-panel-background, var(--vsc-panel-background)) !important;
    }

    .ab-spinner {
      display: inline-block; width: 14px; height: 14px;
      border: 2px solid var(--vsc-border); border-top-color: var(--vsc-accent-blue);
      border-radius: 50%; animation: ab-spin 0.7s linear infinite;

      display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center;
      padding: var(--vsc-padding-xl); text-align: center;

      font-size: var(--vsc-font-size-small); color: var(--vsc-foreground-dim);

export class AddressBarSchemeDropdownComponent {
  @ViewChild('rootEl') rootElRef?: ElementRef<HTMLElement>;

  @Input() schemes: DriveInfo[] = [];
  @Input() loading = false;
  @Input() currentPath = '';
  @Output() schemeClick = new EventEmitter<DriveInfo>();
  @Output() closeRequested = new EventEmitter<void>();

  selectedIndex = -1;

  private readonly commandOwner = `overlay.addressBar.schemes:${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8)}`;
  private releaseOverlayContext: (() => void) | null = null;

  constructor(
    private inputContexts: InputContextService,
    private inputEngine: InputEngineService,
    private cdr: ChangeDetectorRef,
  ) {}

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.registerInputCommands();
    this.releaseOverlayContext ??= this.inputContexts.acquire('overlay.addressBar.schemes');
    this.syncSelection();
  }

  ngOnChanges(_changes: SimpleChanges): void {
    this.syncSelection();
  }

  ngOnDestroy(): void {
    this.releaseOverlayContext?.();
    this.releaseOverlayContext = null;
    this.unregisterInputCommands();
  }

  private normalizePath(path: string): string {
    return normalizeAddressBarPath(path || '');
  }

  isActive(d: DriveInfo): boolean {
    const current = this.normalizePath(this.currentPath).toLowerCase();
    const root = this.normalizePath(d.path).toLowerCase();
    if (/^[a-z][a-z0-9+.-]*:\/\//.test(root)) {
      return current === root || current.startsWith(root);
    }
    return current === root || current.startsWith(`${root}/`);
  }

  isSelected(d: DriveInfo): boolean {
    return this.isActive(d) || (this.selectedIndex >= 0 && this.schemes[this.selectedIndex]?.path === d.path);
  }

  getSchemeRootLabel(d: DriveInfo): string {
    const path = this.normalizePath(d.path || '');
    const match = /^([a-z][a-z0-9+.-]*):\/\//i.exec(path);
    if (match && match[1].toLowerCase() !== 'drive') {
      return `${match[1].toLowerCase()}:`;
    }
    return d.name;
  }

  getSchemeTypeLabel(d: DriveInfo): string {
    if (d.schemeType?.startsWith('cloud-')) {
      return 'Cloud Storage';
    }
    if (d.schemeType === 'memory') {
      return 'In-Memory FS';
    }
    if (d.schemeType === 'registry') {
      return 'Registry';
    }
    if (d.schemeType === 'bin') {
      return 'System Bin';
    }
    if (d.schemeType === 'search') {
      return 'Search FS';
    }
    if (d.schemeType === 'http') {
      return 'HTTP';
    }
    if (d.schemeType === 'https') {
      return 'HTTPS';
    }
    if (d.schemeType === 'smb') {
      return 'SMB Share';
    }
    if (d.schemeType === 's3') {
      return 'S3-Compatible Storage';
    }
    if (d.schemeType === 'network') {
      return 'Network Drive';
    }
    return 'Local Drive';
  }

  getDisplayPath(path: string): string {
    return this.normalizePath(path || '');
  }

  getIcon(d: DriveInfo): string {
    if (d.schemeType === 'cloud-onedrive') return '☁️';
    if (d.schemeType === 'cloud-google')   return '🗂️';
    if (d.schemeType === 'cloud-dropbox')  return '📦';
    if (d.schemeType === 'memory')         return '🧠';
    if (d.schemeType === 'registry')       return '🧩';
    if (d.schemeType === 'bin')            return '🗑️';
    if (d.schemeType === 'search')         return '🔎';
    if (d.schemeType === 'http')           return '🌐';
    if (d.schemeType === 'https')          return '🔒';
    if (d.schemeType === 'smb')            return '🖧';
    if (d.schemeType === 's3')             return '🪣';
    if (d.schemeType === 'fixed')          return '💽';
    if (d.schemeType === 'removable')      return '💾';
    if (d.schemeType === 'cdrom')          return '💿';
    if (d.schemeType === 'network')        return '🌐';
    if (d.schemeType === 'ramdisk')        return '⚡';
    return '💽';
  }
  
  formatSize(bytes: number): string {
    if (bytes === 0) return '0 B';
    const units = ['B', 'KB', 'MB', 'GB', 'TB'];
    const i = Math.floor(Math.log(bytes) / Math.log(1024));
    return (bytes / Math.pow(1024, i)).toFixed(1) + ' ' + units[i];
  }

  setSelectedIndex(index: number): void {
    if (index < 0 || index >= this.schemes.length) return;
    this.selectedIndex = index;
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
    this.focusSelectedItem();
  }

  openSelected(): void {
    const selected = this.schemes[this.selectedIndex];
    if (!selected) return;
    this.schemeClick.emit(selected);
  }

  private syncSelection(): void {
    if (this.schemes.length === 0) {
      this.selectedIndex = -1;
      this.cdr.markForCheck();
      return;
    }

    const activeIndex = this.schemes.findIndex(drive => this.isActive(drive));
    this.selectedIndex = activeIndex >= 0 ? activeIndex : 0;
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
    this.focusSelectedItem();
  }

  private moveSelection(delta: number): void {
    if (this.schemes.length === 0) return;
    const baseIndex = this.selectedIndex >= 0 ? this.selectedIndex : 0;
    const next = Math.max(0, Math.min(this.schemes.length - 1, baseIndex + delta));
    this.selectedIndex = next;
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
    this.focusSelectedItem();
  }

  private focusSelectedItem(): void {
    requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      const item = this.rootElRef?.nativeElement.querySelector<HTMLElement>('.ab-scheme-item--selected');
      item?.focus({ preventScroll: true });
    });
  }

  private registerInputCommands(): void {
    this.inputEngine.registerCommand('overlay.addressBar.schemes.close', () => {
      this.closeRequested.emit();
    }, this.commandOwner);

    this.inputEngine.registerCommand('overlay.addressBar.schemes.prevItem', () => {
      this.moveSelection(-1);
    }, this.commandOwner);

    this.inputEngine.registerCommand('overlay.addressBar.schemes.nextItem', () => {
      this.moveSelection(1);
    }, this.commandOwner);

    this.inputEngine.registerCommand('overlay.addressBar.schemes.prevColumn', () => {
      this.moveSelection(-1);
    }, this.commandOwner);

    this.inputEngine.registerCommand('overlay.addressBar.schemes.nextColumn', () => {
      this.moveSelection(1);
    }, this.commandOwner);

    this.inputEngine.registerCommand('overlay.addressBar.schemes.openSelected', () => {
      this.openSelected();
    }, this.commandOwner);
  }

  private unregisterInputCommands(): void {
    this.inputEngine.unregisterCommand('overlay.addressBar.schemes.close', this.commandOwner);
    this.inputEngine.unregisterCommand('overlay.addressBar.schemes.prevItem', this.commandOwner);
    this.inputEngine.unregisterCommand('overlay.addressBar.schemes.nextItem', this.commandOwner);
    this.inputEngine.unregisterCommand('overlay.addressBar.schemes.prevColumn', this.commandOwner);
    this.inputEngine.unregisterCommand('overlay.addressBar.schemes.nextColumn', this.commandOwner);
    this.inputEngine.unregisterCommand('overlay.addressBar.schemes.openSelected', this.commandOwner);
  }
}
`````

`````typescript
export class AddressBarSiblingDropdownComponent implements OnInit, OnDestroy {
  @ViewChild('rootEl') rootElRef?: ElementRef<HTMLElement>;
  @ViewChild('scrollEl') scrollElRef?: ElementRef<HTMLElement>;

  private readonly ROW_H = 28;
  private readonly MAX_H = 300;

  @Input()
  set entries(val: SiblingEntry[]) {
    this._entries = val || [];
    this.totalCount = this._entries.length;
    this.resetVS();
    this.selectedIndex = this._entries.findIndex(entry => entry.isCurrent);
    if (this.selectedIndex < 0 && this._entries.length > 0) {
      this.selectedIndex = 0;
    }
    // Re-attach scroll listener after Angular renders the scroll div
    setTimeout(() => {
      this.attachScrollListener();
      this.scrollSelectedIntoView();
      this.cdr.markForCheck();
      this.focusSelectedItem();
    }, 0);
  }
  get entries(): SiblingEntry[] { return this._entries; }

  @Input() loading = false;
  @Input() headLabel = '';
  @Output() entryClick = new EventEmitter<SiblingEntry>();
  @Output() closeRequested = new EventEmitter<void>();

  constructor(
    private cdr: ChangeDetectorRef,
    private inputContexts: InputContextService,
    private inputEngine: InputEngineService,
  ) {}

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.registerInputCommands();
    this.releaseOverlayContext ??= this.inputContexts.acquire('overlay.addressBar.siblings');
  }

  ngOnDestroy(): void {
    this.detachScrollListener();
    if (this.scrollRAF) cancelAnimationFrame(this.scrollRAF);
    this.releaseOverlayContext?.();
    this.releaseOverlayContext = null;
    this.unregisterInputCommands();
  }

  onScroll(): void {
    if (this.scrollRAF) return;
    this.scrollRAF = requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      this.scrollRAF = null;
      this.updateVS();
      this.cdr.detectChanges();
    });
  }

  private resetVS(): void {
    const visCount = Math.ceil(this.MAX_H / this.ROW_H);
    this.vsStart = 0;
    this.vsEnd = Math.min(this._entries.length, visCount + this.OVERSCAN * 2);
    const el = this.scrollElRef?.nativeElement;
    if (el) el.scrollTop = 0;
  }

  private updateVS(): void {
    const el = this.scrollElRef?.nativeElement;
    const scrollTop = el?.scrollTop ?? 0;
    const visCount = Math.ceil(this.MAX_H / this.ROW_H);
    const start = Math.max(0, Math.floor(scrollTop / this.ROW_H) - this.OVERSCAN);
    const end   = Math.min(this._entries.length, start + visCount + this.OVERSCAN * 2);
    this.vsStart = start;
    this.vsEnd   = end;
  }

  private attachScrollListener(): void {
    const el = this.scrollElRef?.nativeElement;
    if (!el || this.scrollListener) return;
    this.scrollListener = () => this.onScroll();
    el.addEventListener('scroll', this.scrollListener, { passive: true });
  }

  private detachScrollListener(): void {
    const el = this.scrollElRef?.nativeElement;
    if (el && this.scrollListener) el.removeEventListener('scroll', this.scrollListener);
    this.scrollListener = undefined;
  }

  setSelectedIndex(index: number): void {
    if (index < 0 || index >= this._entries.length) return;
    this.selectedIndex = index;
    this.scrollSelectedIntoView();
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
    this.focusSelectedItem();
  }

  private moveSelection(delta: number): void {
    if (this._entries.length === 0) return;

    const baseIndex = this.selectedIndex >= 0 ? this.selectedIndex : 0;
    this.selectedIndex = Math.max(0, Math.min(this._entries.length - 1, baseIndex + delta));
    this.scrollSelectedIntoView();
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
    this.focusSelectedItem();
  }

  private openSelected(): void {
    const selected = this._entries[this.selectedIndex];
    if (!selected) return;
    this.entryClick.emit(selected);
  }

  private scrollSelectedIntoView(): void {
    const el = this.scrollElRef?.nativeElement;
    if (!el || this.selectedIndex < 0) return;

    const itemTop = this.selectedIndex * this.ROW_H;
    const itemBottom = itemTop + this.ROW_H;
    if (itemTop < el.scrollTop) {
      el.scrollTop = itemTop;
    } else if (itemBottom > el.scrollTop + this.MAX_H) {
      el.scrollTop = itemBottom - this.MAX_H;
    }

    this.updateVS();
  }

  private focusSelectedItem(): void {
    requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      const item = this.rootElRef?.nativeElement.querySelector<HTMLElement>('.ab-drop-item--selected');
      item?.focus({ preventScroll: true });
    });
  }

  private registerInputCommands(): void {
    this.inputEngine.registerCommand('overlay.addressBar.siblings.close', () => {
      this.closeRequested.emit();
    }, this.commandOwner);

    this.inputEngine.registerCommand('overlay.addressBar.siblings.prevItem', () => {
      this.moveSelection(-1);
    }, this.commandOwner);

    this.inputEngine.registerCommand('overlay.addressBar.siblings.nextItem', () => {
      this.moveSelection(1);
    }, this.commandOwner);

    this.inputEngine.registerCommand('overlay.addressBar.siblings.openSelected', () => {
      this.openSelected();
    }, this.commandOwner);
  }

  private unregisterInputCommands(): void {
    this.inputEngine.unregisterCommand('overlay.addressBar.siblings.close', this.commandOwner);
    this.inputEngine.unregisterCommand('overlay.addressBar.siblings.prevItem', this.commandOwner);
    this.inputEngine.unregisterCommand('overlay.addressBar.siblings.nextItem', this.commandOwner);
    this.inputEngine.unregisterCommand('overlay.addressBar.siblings.openSelected', this.commandOwner);
  }
}
`````

`````typescript
describe('address-bar alias normalization', () => {
  it('keeps s3 aliases in alias form', () => {
    expect(canonicalizePathReference('s3://minio-dev/photos/2026')).toBe('s3://minio-dev/photos/2026');
    expect(normalizePath('s3://minio-dev/photos/2026')).toBe('s3://minio-dev/photos/2026');
  });

    expect(normalizePath('smb://fileserver/share/docs')).toBe('smb://fileserver/share/docs');
  });

  it('keeps cloud aliases in alias form', () => {
    expect(canonicalizePathReference('onedrive://Projects/2026')).toBe('onedrive://Projects/2026');
    expect(normalizePath('gdrive://Shared/team')).toBe('gdrive://Shared/team');
    expect(normalizePath('dropbox://Photos/raw')).toBe('dropbox://Photos/raw');
  });

  it('keeps web aliases in alias form', () => {
    expect(canonicalizePathReference('https://example.com/assets/main.js')).toBe('https://example.com/assets/main.js');
    expect(normalizePath('https://example.com/assets/main.js')).toBe('https://example.com/assets/main.js');
  });

  it('converts unc paths to smb aliases without collapsing the scheme', () => {
    const uncPath = String.raw`\\fileserver\share\docs`;

    expect(canonicalizePathReference(uncPath)).toBe('smb://fileserver/share/docs');
    expect(normalizePath(uncPath)).toBe('smb://fileserver/share/docs');
  });

  it('repairs a bare registry scheme back to the registry root', () => {
    expect(canonicalizePathReference('registry:')).toBe('registry://');
    expect(normalizePath('registry:')).toBe('registry://');
  });
`````

`````typescript
import { PathSegment } from './address-bar.types';
import { ArchiveFrame, buildArchiveDisplayPath, isArchive } from '../services/archive.service';
import { REGISTRY_ROOT } from '../services/registry.service';

// ─── Path utilities ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export interface SearchAliasQuery {
  path: string;
  pattern: string;
  recursive: boolean;
}

const SEARCH_SCHEME = 'search://';

function canonicalDriveReference(p: string): string | null {
  const normalized = (p || '').trim().replace(/\\/g, '/');
  const driveRef = /^filesystem:\/\/([a-z])(\/.*)?$/i.exec(normalized);
  if (driveRef) {
    const drive = driveRef[1].toLowerCase();
    const rest = (driveRef[2] || '').replace(/^\/+/, '').replace(/\/+/, '/');
    return rest ? `filesystem://${drive}/${rest}` : `filesystem://${drive}`;
  }
  const windowsRef = /^([a-z]):(\/.*)?$/i.exec(normalized);
  if (windowsRef) {
    const drive = windowsRef[1].toLowerCase();
    const rest = (windowsRef[2] || '').replace(/^\/+/, '').replace(/\/+/g, '/');
    return rest ? `filesystem://${drive}/${rest}` : `filesystem://${drive}`;
  }
  return null;
}

function isDriveReference(p: string): boolean {
  return canonicalDriveReference(p) !== null;
}

function toShortDriveDisplayPath(p: string): string {
  const canonical = canonicalDriveReference(p);
  if (!canonical) return p;
  const rest = canonical.slice('filesystem://'.length);
  const drive = rest.slice(0, 1).toUpperCase();
  const suffix = rest.slice(1).replace(/^\/+/, '');
  return suffix ? `${drive}:/${suffix}` : `${drive}:/`;
}

function aliasSchemeFor(p: string): string | null {
  const normalized = (p || '').trim().replace(/\\/g, '/').toLowerCase();
  const match = /^([a-z][a-z0-9+.-]*):\/\//i.exec(normalized);
  if (!match) return null;
  const scheme = `${match[1].toLowerCase()}://`;
  if (scheme === 'filesystem://') return null;
  return scheme;
}

function webHostRootFor(p: string): string | null {
  const normalized = (p || '').trim();
  try {
    const parsed = new URL(normalized);
    const scheme = parsed.protocol.toLowerCase();
    if (scheme !== 'http:' && scheme !== 'https:') {
      return null;
    }
    return `${scheme}//${parsed.host.toLowerCase()}`;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

function normalizeAliasReference(p: string, scheme: string): string {
  const normalized = (p || '').trim().replace(/\\/g, '/');
  if (scheme === SEARCH_SCHEME && normalized.slice(scheme.length).startsWith('?')) {
    return normalizeSearchAliasReference(normalized);
  }
  const rest = normalized.slice(scheme.length).replace(/^\/+/, '').replace(/\/+/g, '/').replace(/\/+$/, '');
  return rest ? `${scheme}${rest}` : scheme;
}

function normalizeSearchAliasReference(p: string): string {
  const normalized = (p || '').trim().replace(/\\/g, '/');
  const raw = normalized.slice(SEARCH_SCHEME.length);
  if (!raw || raw === '?') return SEARCH_SCHEME;
  if (!raw.startsWith('?')) return normalized;

  const params = new URLSearchParams(raw.slice(1));
  const path = normalizePath(params.get('path') || '/');
  const pattern = (params.get('pattern') || '').trim();
  const recursiveRaw = (params.get('recursive') || '').trim().toLowerCase();
  const recursive = recursiveRaw === '' || recursiveRaw === '1' || recursiveRaw === 'true';

  if (!pattern) {
    return SEARCH_SCHEME;
  }

  return buildReadableSearchAlias(path, pattern, recursive);
}

function buildReadableSearchAlias(path: string, pattern: string, recursive: boolean): string {
  const parts = [
    `path=${readableSearchValue(path)}`,
    `pattern=${readableSearchValue(pattern)}`,
    `recursive=${recursive ? 'true' : 'false'}`,
  ];
  return `search://?${parts.join('&')}`;
}

function readableSearchValue(value: string): string {
  return encodeURIComponent(value)
    .replace(/%2F/gi, '/')
    .replace(/%3A/gi, ':')
    .replace(/%2A/gi, '*');
}

function unquoteSearchToken(value: string): string {
  const trimmed = (value || '').trim();
  if (trimmed.length >= 2) {
    const first = trimmed[0];
    const last = trimmed[trimmed.length - 1];
    if ((first === '"' || first === "'") && first === last) {
      return trimmed.slice(1, -1).trim();
    }
  }
  return trimmed;
}

function parseSearchAddressBody(rawBody: string, fallbackPath?: string): SearchAliasQuery | null {
  const body = (rawBody || '').trim();
  if (!body) return null;

  if (body.startsWith('?')) {
    const params = new URLSearchParams(body.slice(1));
    const pattern = unquoteSearchToken(params.get('pattern') || '');
    const rawPath = unquoteSearchToken(params.get('path') || fallbackPath || '');
    const recursiveRaw = (params.get('recursive') || '').trim().toLowerCase();
    const recursive = recursiveRaw === '' || recursiveRaw === '1' || recursiveRaw === 'true';
    if (!pattern || !rawPath) return null;
    return {
      path: normalizePath(rawPath),
      pattern,
      recursive,
    };
  }

  const explicitNonRecursiveIndex = body.lastIndexOf(' @@ ');
  const explicitRecursiveIndex = body.lastIndexOf(' @ ');
  let separatorIndex = -1;
  let separatorLength = 0;
  let recursive = true;

  if (explicitNonRecursiveIndex >= 0 && explicitNonRecursiveIndex >= explicitRecursiveIndex) {
    separatorIndex = explicitNonRecursiveIndex;
    separatorLength = 4;
    recursive = false;
  } else if (explicitRecursiveIndex >= 0) {
    separatorIndex = explicitRecursiveIndex;
    separatorLength = 3;
    recursive = true;
  }

  let pattern = body;
  let rawPath = fallbackPath || '';
  if (separatorIndex >= 0) {
    pattern = body.slice(0, separatorIndex);
    rawPath = body.slice(separatorIndex + separatorLength);
  }

  pattern = unquoteSearchToken(pattern);
  rawPath = unquoteSearchToken(rawPath);
  if (!pattern || !rawPath) return null;

  return {
    path: normalizePath(rawPath),
    pattern,
    recursive,
  };
}

export function parseSearchAddressInput(input: string, fallbackPath?: string): SearchAliasQuery | null {
  const normalized = (input || '').trim().replace(/\\/g, '/');
  if (!normalized.toLowerCase().startsWith(SEARCH_SCHEME)) {
    return null;
  }

  const fallbackQuery = fallbackPath ? parseSearchAliasQuery(fallbackPath) : null;
  const resolvedFallback = fallbackQuery?.path ?? fallbackPath;
  return parseSearchAddressBody(normalized.slice(SEARCH_SCHEME.length), resolvedFallback);
}

export function normalizeAddressBarPathInput(input: string, fallbackPath?: string): string {
  const searchQuery = parseSearchAddressInput(input, fallbackPath);
  if (searchQuery) {
    return buildReadableSearchAlias(searchQuery.path, searchQuery.pattern, searchQuery.recursive);
  }
  return normalizePath(input);
}

export function formatSearchAliasForEdit(path: string): string | null {
  const query = parseSearchAliasQuery(path);
  if (!query) return null;
  const separator = query.recursive ? ' @ ' : ' @@ ';
  return `${SEARCH_SCHEME}${query.pattern}${separator}${formatPathForDisplay(query.path)}`;
}

export function parseSearchAliasQuery(p: string): SearchAliasQuery | null {
  const normalized = normalizePath(p);
  if (!normalized.toLowerCase().startsWith(`${SEARCH_SCHEME}?`)) {
    return null;
  }

  const params = new URLSearchParams(normalized.slice(`${SEARCH_SCHEME}?`.length));
  const path = params.get('path');
  const pattern = params.get('pattern');
  if (!path || !pattern) {
    return null;
  }

  const recursiveRaw = (params.get('recursive') || '').trim().toLowerCase();
  return {
    path: normalizePath(path),
    pattern,
    recursive: recursiveRaw === '' || recursiveRaw === '1' || recursiveRaw === 'true',
  };
}

export function isAliasPath(p: string): boolean {
  return aliasSchemeFor(p) !== null;
}

function isRegistryReference(p: string): boolean {
  return /^registry:\/\//i.test((p || '').trim().replace(/\\/g, '/'));
}

function normalizeRegistryReference(p: string): string {
  const normalized = (p || '').trim().replace(/\\/g, '/');
  if (/^registry:$/i.test(normalized)) {
    return REGISTRY_ROOT;
  }
  const match = /^registry:\/\/(.*)?$/i.exec(normalized);
  if (!match) return normalized;
  const rest = (match[1] || '').replace(/^\/+/, '').replace(/\/+/g, '/').replace(/\/+$/, '');
  return rest ? `${REGISTRY_ROOT}${rest}` : REGISTRY_ROOT;
}

export function canonicalizePathReference(p: string): string {
  if (!p) return p;

  const driveReference = canonicalDriveReference(p);
  if (driveReference) {
    return driveReference;
  }

  let n = p.replace(/\\/g, '/');

  if (/^registry:$/i.test(n.trim())) {
    return REGISTRY_ROOT;
  }

  // Convert UNC paths (//host/share/...) to smb:// scheme
  const uncMatch = /^\/\/([^/]+)(\/.*)?$/.exec(n);
  if (uncMatch) {
    const host = uncMatch[1];
    const rest = uncMatch[2] || '';
    n = `smb://${host}${rest}`;
  }

  const registryMatch = /^registry:\/\/(.*)?$/i.exec(n);
  if (registryMatch) {
    const rest = (registryMatch[1] || '').replace(/^\/+/, '').replace(/\/+/g, '/').replace(/\/+$/, '');
    return rest ? `${REGISTRY_ROOT}${rest}` : REGISTRY_ROOT;
  }

  const aliasScheme = aliasSchemeFor(n);
  if (aliasScheme) {
    return normalizeAliasReference(n, aliasScheme);
  }

  return n;
}

export function isWindowsPath(p: string): boolean {
  return isDriveReference(canonicalizePathReference(p));
}

export function normalizePath(p: string): string {
  if (!p) return '/';
  let n = canonicalizePathReference(p);
  if (isRegistryReference(n)) {
    return normalizeRegistryReference(n);
  }
  const aliasScheme = aliasSchemeFor(n);
  if (aliasScheme) {
    return normalizeAliasReference(n, aliasScheme);
  }
  if (isDriveReference(n)) {
    return canonicalDriveReference(n) || n;
  } else {
    n = n.replace(/\/+/g, '/');
  }
  if (n.length > 1 && n.endsWith('/')) {
    n = n.slice(0, -1);
  }
  return n || '/';
}

export function pathIdentityKey(p: string): string {
  const normalized = normalizePath(p);
  const searchQuery = parseSearchAliasQuery(normalized);
  if (searchQuery) {
    return buildReadableSearchAlias(pathIdentityKey(searchQuery.path), searchQuery.pattern, searchQuery.recursive);
  }
  if (isRegistryReference(normalized)) {
    return normalized.toLowerCase();
  }
  if (isDriveReference(normalized) || normalized.startsWith('//')) {
    return normalized.toLowerCase();
  }
  return normalized;
}

export function samePath(left: string | null | undefined, right: string | null | undefined): boolean {
  if (!left && !right) {
    return true;
  }
  if (!left || !right) {
    return false;
  }
  return pathIdentityKey(left) === pathIdentityKey(right);
}

export function parentPath(p: string): string {
  const n = normalizePath(p);
  const searchQuery = parseSearchAliasQuery(n);
  if (searchQuery) {
    return searchQuery.path;
  }
  if (isRegistryReference(n)) {
    if (n === REGISTRY_ROOT) return n;
    const rel = n.slice(REGISTRY_ROOT.length);
    const idx = rel.lastIndexOf('/');
    return idx < 0 ? REGISTRY_ROOT : `${REGISTRY_ROOT}${rel.slice(0, idx)}`;
  }
  const aliasScheme = aliasSchemeFor(n);
  if (aliasScheme) {
    const webRoot = webHostRootFor(n);
    if (webRoot) {
      if (n === webRoot) return webRoot;
      const remainder = n.slice(webRoot.length).replace(/^\/+/, '');
      if (!remainder) return webRoot;
      const idx = remainder.lastIndexOf('/');
      return idx < 0 ? webRoot : `${webRoot}/${remainder.slice(0, idx)}`;
    }
    const rel = n.slice(aliasScheme.length);
    if (!rel) return aliasScheme;
    const idx = rel.lastIndexOf('/');
    return idx < 0 ? aliasScheme : `${aliasScheme}${rel.slice(0, idx)}`;
  }
  const driveReference = canonicalDriveReference(n);
  if (driveReference) {
    const rest = driveReference.slice('filesystem://'.length);
    const drive = rest.slice(0, 1).toLowerCase();
    const rel = rest.slice(1).replace(/^\/+/, '');
    if (!rel) return `filesystem://${drive}`;
    const idx = rel.lastIndexOf('/');
    return idx < 0 ? `filesystem://${drive}` : `filesystem://${drive}/${rel.slice(0, idx)}`;
  }
  if (n === '/') return '/';
  const parts = n.split('/').filter(Boolean);
  if (parts.length <= 1) {
    return isWindowsPath(n) ? parts[0] + '/' : '/';
  }
  parts.pop();
  if (isWindowsPath(n)) {
    const drive = parts[0];
    const rest = parts.slice(1);
    return rest.length ? drive + '/' + rest.join('/') : drive + '/';
  }
  return '/' + parts.join('/');
}

export function shortenPath(p: string): string {
  p = normalizePath(p);
  const searchQuery = parseSearchAliasQuery(p);
  if (searchQuery) {
    return `search://${searchQuery.pattern} @ ${shortenPath(searchQuery.path)}`;
  }
  if (isRegistryReference(p)) {
    const rel = p.slice(REGISTRY_ROOT.length);
    if (!rel) return 'registry:';
    if (rel.length <= 28) return rel;
    const parts = rel.split('/').filter(Boolean);
    if (parts.length <= 2) return rel;
    return '…/' + parts.slice(-2).join('/');
  }
  const aliasScheme = aliasSchemeFor(p);
  if (aliasScheme) {
    const rel = p.slice(aliasScheme.length);
    if (!rel) return aliasScheme.slice(0, -2);
    if (rel.length <= 28) return `${aliasScheme}${rel}`;
    const parts = rel.split('/').filter(Boolean);
    if (parts.length <= 2) return `${aliasScheme}${rel}`;
    return `${aliasScheme}…/${parts.slice(-2).join('/')}`;
  }
  const driveReference = canonicalDriveReference(p);
  if (driveReference) {
    return toShortDriveDisplayPath(driveReference);
  }
  if (p.length <= 28) return p;
  const parts = p.split('/').filter(Boolean);
  if (parts.length <= 2) return p;
  return '…/' + parts.slice(-2).join('/');
}

export function formatPathForDisplay(path: string): string {
  const normalized = normalizePath(path);
  const driveReference = canonicalDriveReference(normalized);
  if (driveReference) {
    return toShortDriveDisplayPath(driveReference);
  }
  return normalized;
}

export function formatPathsInText(text: string): string {
  if (!text) return text;

  return text.replace(/filesystem:\/\/[a-z](?:\/[^:\n\r]*)?/gi, (match) => formatPathForDisplay(match));
}

// ─── Segment builders ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export function buildSegments(p: string): PathSegment[] {
  p = normalizePath(p);
  if (!p) return [];

  const searchQuery = parseSearchAliasQuery(p);
  if (searchQuery) {
    return [
      {
        label: 'search:',
        fullPath: 'search://',
        isRoot: true,
        rootLabel: 'search:',
      },
      {
        label: searchQuery.pattern,
        fullPath: p,
        isRoot: false,
      },
    ];
  }

  if (isRegistryReference(p)) {
    const rel = p.slice(REGISTRY_ROOT.length);
    const parts = rel ? rel.split('/').filter(Boolean) : [];
    const segs: PathSegment[] = [{
      label: 'registry:',
      fullPath: REGISTRY_ROOT,
      isRoot: true,
      rootLabel: 'registry:',
    }];

    parts.forEach((part, i) => {
      segs.push({
        label: part,
        fullPath: `${REGISTRY_ROOT}${parts.slice(0, i + 1).join('/')}`,
        isRoot: false,
      });
    });
    return segs;
  }

  const aliasScheme = aliasSchemeFor(p);
  if (aliasScheme) {
    const rel = p.slice(aliasScheme.length);
    const parts = rel ? rel.split('/').filter(Boolean) : [];
    const rootLabel = aliasScheme.slice(0, -2);
    const segs: PathSegment[] = [{
      label: rootLabel,
      fullPath: aliasScheme,
      isRoot: true,
      rootLabel,
    }];

    parts.forEach((part, i) => {
      segs.push({
        label: part,
        fullPath: `${aliasScheme}${parts.slice(0, i + 1).join('/')}`,
        isRoot: false,
      });
    });
    return segs;
  }

  // Generic contributed URI scheme. Specialized schemes above keep their
  // own presentation; other plugin schemes still render as a semantic root.
  const genericScheme = /^([a-z][a-z0-9+.-]*):\/\/(.*)$/i.exec(p);
  if (genericScheme && genericScheme[1].toLowerCase() !== 'filesystem') {
    const scheme = genericScheme[1];
    const rel = genericScheme[2] ?? '';
    const parts = rel ? rel.split('/').filter(Boolean) : [];
    const rootLabel = `${scheme}:`;
    const rootPath = `${scheme}://`;

    const segs: PathSegment[] = [{
      label: rootLabel,
      fullPath: rootPath,
      isRoot: true,
      rootLabel,
    }];

    parts.forEach((part, i) => {
      segs.push({
        // Presentation preserves source-provided casing. Case folding belongs
        // only in comparison/identity code, never breadcrumb labels.
        label: part,
        fullPath: `${rootPath}${parts.slice(0, i + 1).join('/')}`,
        isRoot: false,
      });
    });
    return segs;
  }

  const driveReference = canonicalDriveReference(p);
  if (driveReference) {
    const rest = driveReference.slice('filesystem://'.length);
    const drive = rest.slice(0, 1).toUpperCase() + ':';
    const rel = rest.slice(1).replace(/^\/+/, '');
    const parts = rel ? rel.split('/').filter(Boolean) : [];

    const segs: PathSegment[] = [{
      label: drive,
      fullPath: `filesystem://${drive[0].toLowerCase()}`,
      isRoot: true,
      rootLabel: drive,
    }];

    parts.forEach((part, i) => {
      segs.push({
        label: part,
        fullPath: `filesystem://${drive[0].toLowerCase()}/${parts.slice(0, i + 1).join('/')}`,
        isRoot: false,
      });
    });
    return segs;
  }

  if (isWindowsPath(p)) {
    const drive = p.slice(0, 2).toUpperCase();
    const rest = p.slice(3);
    const parts = rest ? rest.split('/').filter(Boolean) : [];

    const segs: PathSegment[] = [{
      label: drive,
      fullPath: drive + '/',
      isRoot: true,
      rootLabel: drive,
    }];

    parts.forEach((part, i) => {
      segs.push({
        label: part,
        fullPath: drive + '/' + parts.slice(0, i + 1).join('/'),
        isRoot: false,
      });
    });
    return segs;
  }

  const parts = p.split('/').filter(Boolean);
  const segs: PathSegment[] = [{
    label: '/',
    fullPath: '/',
    isRoot: true,
    rootLabel: '/',
  }];
  parts.forEach((part, i) => {
    segs.push({
      label: part,
      fullPath: '/' + parts.slice(0, i + 1).join('/'),
      isRoot: false,
    });
  });
  return segs;
}

export function buildArchiveSegments(fsDirPath: string, stack: ArchiveFrame[]): PathSegment[] {
  if (stack.length === 0) return buildSegments(fsDirPath);

  const virtualPath = buildArchiveDisplayPath(fsDirPath, stack);
  const allSegs = buildSegments(virtualPath);
  const fsDepth = buildSegments(fsDirPath).length;

  allSegs.forEach((seg, i) => {
    if (i === fsDepth) {
      // This is the archive file segment itself
      seg.isArchiveRoot = true;
    } else if (i > fsDepth) {
    const label = seg.label.toLowerCase();
    if (label.endsWith('.zip') || label.endsWith('.tar') || label.endsWith('.tgz') ||
        label.endsWith('.tar.gz') || label.endsWith('.tar.bz2') || label.endsWith('.tar.xz') ||
        label.endsWith('.rar') || label.endsWith('.7z')) {
      seg.isArchiveRoot = true;
      seg.isArchiveInner = true;
    } else {
        seg.isArchiveInner = true;
      }
    }
    // i < fsDepth → plain FS segment, no archive flags
  });

  return allSegs;
}

// ─── Highlight match for autocomplete ────────────────────────────────────────

export function highlightMatch(text: string, query: string): string {
  const t = text ?? '';
  const q = query ?? '';
  if (!q) return escapeHtml(t);

  const idx = t.toLowerCase().indexOf(q.toLowerCase());
  if (idx < 0) return escapeHtml(t);

  const before = escapeHtml(t.slice(0, idx));
  const match = escapeHtml(t.slice(idx, idx + q.length));
  const after = escapeHtml(t.slice(idx + q.length));
  return before + '<span class="ab-ac-match">' + match + '</span>' + after;
}

function escapeHtml(s: string): string {
  return (s ?? '')
    .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
    .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
    .replace(/>/g, '&gt;')
    .replace(/"/g, '&quot;')
    .replace(/'/g, '&#39;');
}

/**
 * Splits a path into (fsDirPath, archiveSegments) by detecting the first
 * archive extension boundary, enabling the address bar to self-parse any
 * virtual path without needing an externally-provided archiveStack.
 *
 * Examples:
 *   /home/user/archive.zip/folder/nested.tar/deep
 *   → { fsDirPath: '/home/user/archive.zip', archiveInnerParts: ['folder','nested.tar','deep'] }
 *
 *   /home/user/docs
 *   → { fsDirPath: '/home/user/docs', archiveInnerParts: [] }
 */
export function parsePathWithArchives(path: string): {
  fsDirPath: string;
  archiveInnerParts: string[];
} {
  path = normalizePath(path);
  const ARCHIVE_RE = /\.(zip|tar|tgz|tar\.gz|tar\.bz2|tar\.xz|gz|bz2|xz|rar|7z)$/i;
  const driveReference = canonicalDriveReference(path);
  const withoutDrive = driveReference ? driveReference.slice('filesystem://'.length) : '';
  const driveLetter = driveReference ? withoutDrive.slice(0, 1).toLowerCase() : '';
  const driveRemainder = driveReference ? withoutDrive.slice(1).replace(/^\/+/, '') : '';
  const parts = driveReference
    ? (driveRemainder ? driveRemainder.split('/').filter(Boolean) : [])
    : path.replace(/\\/g, '/').split('/').filter(Boolean);

  const isWin = !!driveReference || path.startsWith('//') || path.startsWith('\\');

  let archiveBoundary = -1;
  for (let i = 0; i < parts.length; i++) {
    if (ARCHIVE_RE.test(parts[i])) { archiveBoundary = i; break; }
  }

  if (archiveBoundary === -1) {
    return { fsDirPath: path, archiveInnerParts: [] };
  }

  const fsParts = parts.slice(0, archiveBoundary + 1);
  const innerParts = parts.slice(archiveBoundary + 1);

  // Reconstruct the FS prefix correctly for Windows vs POSIX
  let fsDirPath: string;
  if (driveReference) {
    fsDirPath = `filesystem://${driveLetter}` + (fsParts.length ? `/${fsParts.join('/')}` : '');
  } else if (isWin && /^[A-Za-z]:/.test(parts[0])) {
    fsDirPath = fsParts.join('/');
  } else if (path.startsWith('//') || path.startsWith('\\\\')) {
    fsDirPath = '//' + fsParts.join('/');
  } else {
    fsDirPath = '/' + fsParts.join('/');
  }

  return { fsDirPath, archiveInnerParts: innerParts };
}

/**
 * Builds PathSegment[] for any path, archive-aware, without needing
 * an ArchiveFrame stack. Used as fallback in address-bar when no
 * external archiveStack is provided but the path itself contains archives.
 */
export function buildSegmentsFromParsedPath(
  fsDirPath: string,
  archiveInnerParts: string[]
): PathSegment[] {
  const segments: PathSegment[] = [];
  
  // Build the filesystem path segments first
  const fsSegments = buildSegments(fsDirPath);
  segments.push(...fsSegments);
  
  // Track the cumulative path
  let cumulativePath = fsDirPath;
  
  // Add archive inner parts, marking EVERY archive file in the path
  for (let i = 0; i < archiveInnerParts.length; i++) {
    const part = archiveInnerParts[i];
    cumulativePath += '/' + part;
    
    // Check if this part is an archive file
    const isArchiveFile = isArchive(part);
    const isLast = i === archiveInnerParts.length - 1;
    
    segments.push({
      label: part,
      fullPath: cumulativePath,
      isRoot: false,
      isLast,
      // Mark as archive root if it's an archive file
      isArchiveRoot: isArchiveFile,
      // Mark as archive inner only if it's NOT an archive file AND we're inside an archive
      isArchiveInner: !isArchiveFile
    });
  }
  
  return segments;
}
`````

## File: manager/frontend/src/app/components/context-menu-layout.ts
`````typescript
export interface ContextMenuPlacementInput {
  anchorX: number;
  anchorY: number;
  menuWidth: number;
  menuHeight: number;
  viewportWidth: number;
  viewportHeight: number;
  margin?: number;
  gap?: number;
}

export interface ContextMenuPoint {
  x: number;
  y: number;
}

export function contextMenuColumnCount(
  naturalHeight: number,
  availableHeight: number,
  viewportWidth: number,
  preferredColumnWidth = 286,
): number {
  const required = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(naturalHeight / Math.max(1, availableHeight)));
  const horizontal = Math.max(1, Math.floor(viewportWidth / preferredColumnWidth));
  return Math.min(required, horizontal);
}

export function placeContextMenu(input: ContextMenuPlacementInput): ContextMenuPoint {
  const margin = input.margin ?? 8;
  const gap = input.gap ?? 4;

  let x = input.anchorX + gap;
  let y = input.anchorY + gap;

  if (x + input.menuWidth > input.viewportWidth - margin) {
    x = input.anchorX - input.menuWidth - gap;
  }
  if (y + input.menuHeight > input.viewportHeight - margin) {
    y = input.anchorY - input.menuHeight - gap;
  }

  return {
    x: Math.max(margin, Math.min(x, input.viewportWidth - input.menuWidth - margin)),
    y: Math.max(margin, Math.min(y, input.viewportHeight - input.menuHeight - margin)),
  };
}
`````
