## File: manager/frontend/src/app/components/context-menu-policy.ts
`````typescript
import type { ContextMenuItem } from './context-menu.component';

/**
 * Removes duplicate commands and normalizes separators after conditional menu
 * construction/plugin contribution. First occurrence wins so built-in placement
 * remains deterministic.
 */
export function normalizeContextMenuItems(
  items: readonly ContextMenuItem[],
): ContextMenuItem[] {
  const result: ContextMenuItem[] = [];
  const commands = new Set<string>();
  let pendingSeparator = false;

  for (const item of items) {
    if (item.separator) {
      if (result.length) pendingSeparator = true;
      continue;
    }

    if (!item.commandId || !item.label) continue;
    if (commands.has(item.commandId)) continue;

    if (pendingSeparator && result.length) {
      result.push({ separator: true });
    }
    pendingSeparator = false;
    commands.add(item.commandId);
    result.push(item);
  }

  return result;
}
`````

`````typescript
import {
  ChangeDetectionStrategy,
  ChangeDetectorRef,
  Component,
  ElementRef,
  EventEmitter,
  Input,
  OnChanges,
  Output,
  SimpleChanges,
  ViewChild,
} from '@angular/core';
import { CommonModule } from '@angular/common';

export interface ContextMenuItem {
  commandId?: string;
  label?: string;
  shortcut?: string;
  enabled?: boolean;
  separator?: boolean;
}

export interface ContextMenuState {
  x: number;
  y: number;
  title?: string;
  items: ContextMenuItem[];
}

@Component({
  selector: 'app-context-menu',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [CommonModule],
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
  template: `
    <div
      *ngIf="state"
      class="backdrop"
      (mousedown)="closed.emit()"
      (contextmenu)="$event.preventDefault(); closed.emit()">

      <section
        #menu
        class="menu"
        role="menu"
        tabindex="-1"
        aria-label="Context menu"
        [style.left.px]="menuLeft"
        [style.top.px]="menuTop"
        [style.width.px]="menuWidth"
        [style.height.px]="menuHeight"
        [style.columnCount]="columnCount"
        (keydown)="onMenuKeyDown($event)"
        (mousedown)="$event.stopPropagation()"
        (contextmenu)="$event.preventDefault(); $event.stopPropagation()">

        <div class="title" *ngIf="state.title" [title]="state.title">
          {{ state.title }}
        </div>

        <ng-container *ngFor="let item of state.items">
          <div
            *ngIf="item.separator"
            class="separator"
            role="separator">
          </div>

          <button
            *ngIf="!item.separator"
            type="button"
            role="menuitem"
            data-context-menu-item
            [disabled]="item.enabled === false"
            (click)="choose(item)">
            <span class="label">{{ item.label }}</span>
            <span class="shortcut" *ngIf="item.shortcut">{{ item.shortcut }}</span>
          </button>
        </ng-container>
      </section>
    </div>
  `,
  styles: [`
    :host {
      position: fixed;
      inset: 0;
      z-index: 20000;
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .backdrop {
      position: fixed;
      inset: 0;
      pointer-events: auto;
    }

    .menu {
      position: fixed;
      box-sizing: border-box;

      min-width: min(230px, calc(100vw - 16px));
      max-width: calc(100vw - 16px);
      max-height: calc(100vh - 16px);

      column-width: 230px;
      column-gap: 4px;
      column-fill: auto;

      overflow: hidden;
      padding: 4px;
      border: 1px solid var(--vsc-border, var(--vsc-border));
      border-radius: 6px;
      background: var(--vsc-menu-background, var(--vsc-panel-background));
      color: var(--vsc-menu-foreground, var(--vsc-foreground));
      box-shadow: 0 8px 30px var(--vsc-scrim);
      font: 12px/1.35 var(--vsc-font-family, system-ui, sans-serif);
    }

    .title {
      column-span: all;
      padding: 5px 8px 6px;
      overflow: hidden;
      text-overflow: ellipsis;
      white-space: nowrap;
      color: var(--vsc-description-foreground, var(--vsc-foreground-dim));
      font-size: 10px;
    }

    button {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto;
      gap: 16px;
      align-items: center;
      width: 100%;
      min-height: 28px;
      padding: 4px 8px;
      border: 0;
      border-radius: 3px;
      background: transparent;
      color: inherit;
      text-align: left;
      cursor: pointer;
      font: inherit;
      break-inside: avoid;
    }

    button:hover:not(:disabled),
    button:focus:not(:disabled),
    button:focus-visible:not(:disabled) {
      outline: none;
      background: var(--vsc-list-hover-background, var(--vsc-list-hover-background));
    }

    button:focus:not(:focus-visible) {
      outline: none;
    }

    button:disabled {
      opacity: .38;
      cursor: default;
    }

    .label {
      min-width: 0;
      overflow: hidden;
      text-overflow: ellipsis;
      white-space: nowrap;
    }

    .shortcut {
      color: var(--vsc-description-foreground, var(--vsc-foreground-dim));
      font-size: 10px;
      white-space: nowrap;
    }

    .separator {
      break-inside: avoid;
      height: 1px;
      margin: 4px 5px;
      background: var(--vsc-border, var(--vsc-border));
    }
  `],
})
export class ContextMenuComponent implements OnChanges {
  @Input() state: ContextMenuState | null = null;
  @Output() command = new EventEmitter<string>();
  @Output() closed = new EventEmitter<void>();
  @ViewChild('menu') menu?: ElementRef<HTMLElement>;

  menuLeft = 8;
  menuTop = 8;
  menuWidth = 230;
  menuHeight = 0;
  columnCount = 1;

  private typeahead = '';
  private typeaheadTimer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null = null;

  private readonly viewportMargin = 8;
  private readonly columnWidth = 230;
  private readonly columnGap = 4;
  private readonly itemHeight = 36;
  private readonly separatorHeight = 9;
  private readonly titleHeight = 28;
  private readonly menuPadding = 8;

  constructor(private readonly cdr: ChangeDetectorRef) {}

  ngOnChanges(changes: SimpleChanges): void {
    if (!changes['state']) return;

    this.clearTypeahead();

    if (!this.state) return;

    this.menuLeft = Math.max(this.viewportMargin, this.state.x);
    this.menuTop = Math.max(this.viewportMargin, this.state.y);
    this.layoutMenu();
    this.cdr.markForCheck();

    queueMicrotask(() => {
      this.fitToViewport();
      this.menu?.nativeElement.focus({ preventScroll: true });
      this.focusItem(0, 1);
    });
  }

  choose(item: ContextMenuItem): void {
    if (!item.commandId || item.enabled === false) return;
    this.command.emit(item.commandId);
  }

  onMenuKeyDown(event: KeyboardEvent): void {
    const items = this.items();
    if (!items.length) return;

    const active = document.activeElement as HTMLButtonElement | null;
    const current = Math.max(0, items.indexOf(active as HTMLButtonElement));

    if (event.key === 'Escape') {
      event.preventDefault();
      event.stopPropagation();
      this.closed.emit();
      return;
    }

    if (event.key === 'ArrowDown') {
      event.preventDefault();
      this.focusItem(current + 1, 1);
      return;
    }

    if (event.key === 'ArrowUp') {
      event.preventDefault();
      this.focusItem(current - 1, -1);
      return;
    }

    if (event.key === 'Home') {
      event.preventDefault();
      this.focusItem(0, 1);
      return;
    }

    if (event.key === 'End') {
      event.preventDefault();
      this.focusItem(items.length - 1, -1);
      return;
    }

    if (
      event.key.length === 1 &&
      !event.ctrlKey &&
      !event.altKey &&
      !event.metaKey
    ) {
      this.typeahead += event.key.toLocaleLowerCase();

      if (this.typeaheadTimer) clearTimeout(this.typeaheadTimer);
      this.typeaheadTimer = setTimeout(() => this.clearTypeahead(), 650);

      const match = items.find(item =>
        !item.disabled &&
        (item.textContent ?? '')
          .trim()
          .toLocaleLowerCase()
          .startsWith(this.typeahead)
      );

      if (match) {
        event.preventDefault();
        match.focus({ preventScroll: true });
      }
    }
  }

  private layoutMenu(): void {
    const state = this.state;
    if (!state || typeof window === 'undefined') return;

    const commandCount = state.items.reduce(
      (count, item) => count + (item.separator ? 0 : 1),
      0,
    );
    const separatorCount = state.items.length - commandCount;

    const availableHeight = Math.max(
      120,
      window.innerHeight - this.viewportMargin * 2,
    );
    const availableWidth = Math.max(
      this.columnWidth,
      window.innerWidth - this.viewportMargin * 2,
    );

    const fixedHeight =
      this.menuPadding +
      (state.title ? this.titleHeight : 0);

    const contentHeight =
      commandCount * this.itemHeight +
      separatorCount * this.separatorHeight;

    const usableColumnHeight = Math.max(
      this.itemHeight,
      availableHeight - fixedHeight,
    );

    const neededColumns = Math.max(
      1,
      Math.ceil(contentHeight / usableColumnHeight),
    );

    const maxColumns = Math.max(
      1,
      Math.floor(
        (availableWidth + this.columnGap) /
        (this.columnWidth + this.columnGap),
      ),
    );

    this.columnCount = Math.min(neededColumns, maxColumns);

    const estimatedColumnContentHeight = Math.ceil(
      contentHeight / this.columnCount,
    );

    this.menuHeight = Math.min(
      availableHeight,
      fixedHeight + estimatedColumnContentHeight,
    );

    this.menuWidth = Math.min(
      availableWidth,
      this.columnCount * this.columnWidth +
        (this.columnCount - 1) * this.columnGap +
        this.menuPadding,
    );
  }

  private items(): HTMLButtonElement[] {
    return Array.from(
      this.menu?.nativeElement.querySelectorAll<HTMLButtonElement>(
        'button[data-context-menu-item]',
      ) ?? [],
    );
  }

  private focusItem(requested: number, direction: 1 | -1): void {
    const items = this.items();
    if (!items.length) return;

    let index = ((requested % items.length) + items.length) % items.length;
    for (let attempts = 0; attempts < items.length; attempts += 1) {
      const item = items[index];
      if (!item.disabled) {
        item.focus({ preventScroll: true });
        return;
      }
      index = ((index + direction) % items.length + items.length) % items.length;
    }
  }

  private fitToViewport(): void {
    const menu = this.menu?.nativeElement;
    const state = this.state;
    if (!menu || !state || typeof window === 'undefined') return;

    const margin = this.viewportMargin;
    const rect = menu.getBoundingClientRect();

    const maxLeft = Math.max(
      margin,
      window.innerWidth - rect.width - margin,
    );
    const maxTop = Math.max(
      margin,
      window.innerHeight - rect.height - margin,
    );

    this.menuLeft = Math.min(Math.max(margin, state.x), maxLeft);
    this.menuTop = Math.min(Math.max(margin, state.y), maxTop);
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
  }

  private clearTypeahead(): void {
    this.typeahead = '';
    if (this.typeaheadTimer) {
      clearTimeout(this.typeaheadTimer);
      this.typeaheadTimer = null;
    }
  }
}
`````

`````typescript
import { markerForSide, nextDifferenceIndex } from './correspondence-policy';

describe('Reassembly correspondence policy', () => {
  it('maps newer/older per side', () => {
    expect(markerForSide('left-newer','left')).toBe('newer');
    expect(markerForSide('left-newer','right')).toBe('older');
  });

  it('marks missing items only on the owning side', () => {
    expect(markerForSide('only-left','left')).toBe('only-here');
    expect(markerForSide('only-right','right')).toBe('only-here');
  });

  it('wraps difference navigation', () => {
    expect(nextDifferenceIndex(-1,3,1)).toBe(0);
    expect(nextDifferenceIndex(-1,3,-1)).toBe(2);
    expect(nextDifferenceIndex(2,3,1)).toBe(0);
  });
});
`````

## File: manager/frontend/src/app/components/correspondence-policy.ts
`````typescript
export type CorrespondenceStatus =
  | 'equal'|'only-left'|'only-right'|'different'|'left-newer'|'right-newer'|'type-mismatch';

export function markerForSide(
  status: CorrespondenceStatus,
  side: 'left'|'right',
): 'equal'|'only-here'|'different'|'newer'|'older'|'type-mismatch' {
  switch (status) {
    case 'only-left': return side === 'left' ? 'only-here' : 'equal';
    case 'only-right': return side === 'right' ? 'only-here' : 'equal';
    case 'different': return 'different';
    case 'left-newer': return side === 'left' ? 'newer' : 'older';
    case 'right-newer': return side === 'right' ? 'newer' : 'older';
    case 'type-mismatch': return 'type-mismatch';
    default: return 'equal';
  }
}

export function nextDifferenceIndex(current:number,count:number,delta:-1|1):number {
  if (count <= 0) return -1;
  if (current < 0) return delta > 0 ? 0 : count - 1;
  return (current + delta + count) % count;
}
`````

`````typescript
        source: readFileSync(new URL(path, import.meta.url), 'utf8'),
      })),

    expect(result.freezingDialogs).toEqual([]);
  });

  it('keeps the shared modal surface free of native-overlay freezing', () => {

    );

    expect(source).not.toContain('.acquire(');
    expect(source).not.toContain('.release(');
  });
});
`````

## File: manager/frontend/src/app/components/dialog-freeze.audit.ts
`````typescript
export interface DialogFreezeAuditTarget {
  readonly path: string;
  readonly source: string;
}

export interface DialogFreezeAuditResult {
  readonly freezingDialogs: readonly string[];
}

export function auditDialogFreeze(
  targets: readonly DialogFreezeAuditTarget[],
): DialogFreezeAuditResult {
  const freezingDialogs = targets
    .filter(target =>
      /role=["'](?:dialog|alertdialog)["']/.test(target.source) &&
      (
        target.source.includes('NativeOverlayFreezeService') ||
        /(?:overlayFreeze|freeze)\.(?:acquire|release)\(/.test(target.source)
      ),
    )
    .map(target => target.path);

  return { freezingDialogs };
}
`````

## File: manager/frontend/src/app/components/discovery.ts
`````typescript
export interface DiscoveryField {
  value: string | null | undefined;
  weight?: number;
}

export function discoveryTokens(query: string): string[] {
  return normalize(query).split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
}

export function discoveryScore(
  query: string,
  fields: readonly DiscoveryField[],
): number {
  const tokens = discoveryTokens(query);
  if (tokens.length === 0) return 0;

  let total = 0;

  for (const token of tokens) {
    let best = -1;

    for (const field of fields) {
      const value = normalize(field.value);
      if (!value) continue;

      const score = tokenScore(value, token) * (field.weight ?? 1);
      if (score > best) best = score;
    }

    if (best < 0) return -1;
    total += best;
  }

  return total;
}

function tokenScore(value: string, token: string): number {
  if (value === token) return 120;
  if (value.startsWith(token)) return 100 - lengthPenalty(value, token);

  const wordIndex = value.search(
    new RegExp(`(?:^|[\\s/_\\\\.-])${escapeRegExp(token)}`),
  );
  if (wordIndex >= 0) return 85 - Math.min(20, wordIndex);

  const includes = value.indexOf(token);
  if (includes >= 0) return 65 - Math.min(25, includes);

  let cursor = 0;
  let gaps = 0;
  for (const character of token) {
    const next = value.indexOf(character, cursor);
    if (next < 0) return -1;
    gaps += next - cursor;
    cursor = next + 1;
  }

  return Math.max(1, 35 - Math.min(30, gaps));
}

function lengthPenalty(value: string, token: string): number {
  return Math.min(20, Math.max(0, value.length - token.length) / 3);
}

function normalize(value: string | null | undefined): string {
  return String(value ?? '').trim().toLocaleLowerCase();
}

function escapeRegExp(value: string): string {
  return value.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&');
}
`````

`````typescript
import {

  ChangeDetectorRef,

  /** -1 = "Other" bucket */
  index: number;
  startAngle: number;
  endAngle: number;
  midAngle: number;
  /** unit vector components for radial hover translate */
  tx: number;
  ty: number;
  color: string;
}

interface TooltipState {
  visible: boolean;
  x: number; // SVG-space
  y: number;
  name: string;
  size: string;
  pct: string;
  side: number; // 1 = open right, -1 = open left
}

const PIE_DISTRIBUTION_FALLBACK_VISIBLE_LIMIT = 3;
const OTHER_BUCKET_SELECTION_KEY = '__other__';

/**
 * Pure display component — renders a donut chart for a flat list of entries.
 *
 * Navigation / drill logic is intentionally NOT here.
 * The parent (SizeManagerSurfaceComponent) owns the nav stack and passes
 * the current level's entries + totalSize down as inputs.
 *
 * Outputs:
 *   (select)     — user clicked a file slice/row
 *   (activate)   — user explicitly activated a file slice/row
 *   (otherDrill) — user clicked the "Other" slice/row; parent should push a
 *                  new nav frame containing the bucketed entries
 *   (drillDown)  — user clicked a folder slice/row; parent navigates into it
 */
@Component({
  selector: 'app-disk-pie-chart',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [CommonModule],
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
  template: `
    <!-- ── Top row: donut (+ spotlight when selected) ───────── -->
    <div class="pie-top">

        class="pie-svg"
        viewBox="-120 -120 240 240"
        (mousemove)="onSvgMouseMove($event)"
        (mouseleave)="onSvgMouseLeave()"
        (click)="onSvgClick($event)">

        <g
          *ngFor="let s of slices; trackBy: trackSlice"

          [class.pie-slice-g--hovered]="hoveredIndex === s.index"
          [class.pie-slice-g--selected]="selectedIndex === s.index"
          [class.pie-slice-g--other]="s.index === -1"
          [style.--tx]="s.tx"

      transform: translateX(calc(var(--tx) * 5px))
                 translateY(calc(var(--ty) * 5px));

    .pie-slice-g--selected.pie-slice-g--hovered {
      transform: translateX(calc(var(--tx) * var(--lift)))
                 translateY(calc(var(--ty) * var(--lift)));
    }

    .pie-path {
      stroke: var(--vsc-panel-background, #252526);
      stroke-width: 2;
      stroke-linejoin: round;
      transition: stroke-width 0.15s ease, stroke 0.15s ease;

    .pie-path--inner-mask { stroke: none !important; pointer-events: none; }
    .pie-slice-g--selected .pie-path:not(.pie-path--inner-mask) {
      stroke: var(--vsc-focus-border, #007acc);
      stroke-width: 2.5;
    }

    /* ── Donut hole + center ──────────────────────────────── */

    .pie-hole { fill: var(--vsc-panel-background, #252526); }
    .pie-center { pointer-events: none; }
    .pie-center-name  { font-size: 10px; fill: var(--vsc-foreground-dim, #888); }
    .pie-center-pct   { font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; fill: var(--vsc-foreground, #ccc); }
    .pie-center-other1 { font-size: 11px; fill: var(--vsc-foreground-dim, #888); }
    .pie-center-other2 { font-size: 9px;  fill: var(--vsc-foreground-dim, #666); }

    /* ── SVG tooltip ──────────────────────────────────────── */

    .pie-tip-bg   { fill: var(--vsc-editor-background, #1e1e1e); stroke: var(--vsc-border, #454545); stroke-width: 0.75; }
    .pie-tip-name { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; fill: var(--vsc-foreground, #ccc); }
    .pie-tip-meta { font-size: 10px; fill: var(--vsc-foreground-dim, #888); }

    /* ── Legend ───────────────────────────────────────────── */

    .pie-legend {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 2px;
      min-width: 0;
    }

    .pie-legend-item {
      appearance: none;
      border: 1px solid transparent;
      border-radius: var(--vsc-border-radius, 3px);
      padding: 5px 8px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      cursor: pointer;
      background: transparent;
      color: inherit;
      font-family: inherit;
      font-size: 12px;
      text-align: left;
      transition: background 0.12s;
      min-width: 0;
      width: 100%;
    }
    .pie-legend-item:hover,
    .pie-legend-item--hovered { background: var(--vsc-list-hover-background, #2a2d2e); }
    .pie-legend-item--active {
      background: color-mix(in srgb,
        var(--vsc-focus-border, #007acc) 10%,
        var(--vsc-list-hover-background, #2a2d2e) 90%) !important;
      border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--vsc-focus-border, #007acc) 40%, transparent);
    }
    .pie-legend-item--other {
      border-style: solid;
      border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--vsc-foreground-dim, #888) 30%, transparent);
    }
    .pie-legend-item--other:hover,
    .pie-legend-item--other.pie-legend-item--hovered {
      border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--vsc-foreground-dim, #888) 60%, transparent);
    }

    .pie-swatch {
      width: 9px; height: 9px;
      border-radius: 2px;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }
    .pie-swatch--other {
      border: 1px solid transparent;
    }
    .pie-legend-name {
      flex: 1 1 0%;
      min-width: 0;
      white-space: nowrap;
      overflow: hidden;
      text-overflow: ellipsis;
      font-weight: 500;
    }
    .pie-other-count { font-weight: 400; color: var(--vsc-foreground-dim, #888); margin-left: 2px; }
    .pie-legend-size { font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; white-space: nowrap; font-size: 11px; color: var(--vsc-foreground-dim, #888); }
    .pie-legend-pct  { font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; white-space: nowrap; font-size: 11px; color: var(--vsc-foreground-dim, #888); min-width: 42px; text-align: right; }
    .pie-drill-arrow { font-size: 14px; color: var(--vsc-foreground-dim, #888); flex-shrink: 0; transition: transform 0.12s, color 0.12s; }
    .pie-legend-item--other:hover .pie-drill-arrow,
    .pie-legend-item--other.pie-legend-item--hovered .pie-drill-arrow { transform: translateX(2px); color: var(--vsc-foreground, #ccc); }

    /* Light theme */
    :host-context(.vscode-light) .pie-hole  { fill: var(--vsc-panel-background, #f3f3f3); }
    :host-context(.vscode-light) .pie-path  { stroke: var(--vsc-panel-background, #f3f3f3); }
    :host-context(.vscode-light) .pie-pill  { background: rgba(10,93,143,.12); color: #0a5d8f; }
    :host-context(.vscode-light) .pie-pill--dir { background: rgba(90,110,0,.12); color: #5a6e00; }
    :host-context(.vscode-light) .pie-spotlight { background: var(--vsc-input-background, #ffffff); }
    :host-context(.vscode-light) .pie-tip-bg { fill: var(--vsc-input-background, #ffffff); stroke: var(--vsc-border, #c4c4c4); }
    :host-context(.vscode-light) .pie-tip-name { fill: var(--vsc-foreground, #3b3b3b); }
    :host-context(.vscode-light) .pie-tip-meta { fill: var(--vsc-foreground-dim, #737373); }
    :host-context(.vscode-light) .pie-legend-item:hover,
    :host-context(.vscode-light) .pie-legend-item--hovered { background: var(--vsc-list-hover-background, #e4e6f1); color: var(--vsc-foreground, #3b3b3b); }
    :host-context(.vscode-light) .pie-legend-item--active {
      background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--vsc-list-active-background, #cce0f5) 82%, white 18%) !important;
      border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--vsc-focus-border, #007acc) 28%, var(--vsc-border, #c4c4c4));
      color: var(--vsc-foreground, #3b3b3b);
    }
    :host-context(.vscode-light) .pie-legend-item--other { border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--vsc-foreground-dim, #737373) 34%, transparent); }
    :host-context(.vscode-light) .pie-legend-size,
    :host-context(.vscode-light) .pie-legend-pct,
    :host-context(.vscode-light) .pie-other-count,
    :host-context(.vscode-light) .pie-drill-arrow,
    :host-context(.vscode-light) .pie-spot-share,
    :host-context(.vscode-light) .pie-stat-lbl,
    :host-context(.vscode-light) .pie-spot-path { color: var(--vsc-foreground-dim, #737373); }
  `],
})
export class DiskPieChartComponent implements OnChanges, OnDestroy {
  /** Entries for the CURRENT level — parent controls which level this is. */
  @Input({ required: true }) entries: DiskUsageEntry[] = [];
  /**
   * Total size denominator for percentages.
   * At root level: the directory total.
   * At sub-levels: parent passes the sum of the Other bucket it drilled into.
   */
  @Input({ required: true }) totalSize = 0;
  @Input() innerR  = 42;
  @Input() outerR  = 100;
  /** Entries below this % of totalSize are grouped into the Other bucket. */
  @Input() minPct  = 10;
  @Input() isTraversing = false;
  @Input() selectedPath: string | null = null;
  @Output() select     = new EventEmitter<DiskUsageEntry | null>();
  @Output() activate   = new EventEmitter<DiskUsageEntry>();
  /** Emits the bucketed "Other" entries — parent pushes a new nav frame. */
  @Output() otherDrill = new EventEmitter<DiskUsageEntry[]>();
  @Output() drillDown  = new EventEmitter<DiskUsageEntry>();

  // ── Derived state (rebuilt whenever inputs change) ────────────────────────

  displayEntries: DiskUsageEntry[] = [];
  otherEntries:   DiskUsageEntry[] = [];
  otherSize = 0;
  otherPct  = '';
  readonly otherColor = '#555566';
  readonly folderBarColor = '#7fba7a';

  slices: PieSlice[]   = [];
  selectedIndex: number | null = null;
  hoveredIndex:  number | null = null;
  private selectedKey: string | null = null;

  tooltip: TooltipState = { visible: false, x: 0, y: 0, name: '', size: '', pct: '', side: 1 };
  tooltipWidth = 120;

  animatedBarPct = 0;
  barTransition  = 'none';

  readonly palette = [
    '#3794ff', '#4ec9b0', '#ce9178', '#c586c0',
    '#dcdcaa', '#569cd6', '#b5cea8', '#d7ba7d',
  ];

  private destroyed = false;

  constructor(readonly cdr: ChangeDetectorRef) {}

  // ── Lifecycle ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  ngOnChanges(changes: SimpleChanges): void {
    if (changes['entries'] || changes['totalSize'] || changes['minPct'] || changes['isTraversing']) {
      this.hoveredIndex   = null;
      this.tooltip        = { ...this.tooltip, visible: false };
      this.animatedBarPct = 0;
      this.barTransition  = 'none';
      this.partition();
      this.buildSlices();
      this.reconcileSelection();
      return;
    }

    if (changes['selectedPath']) {
      this.applyExternalSelection();
    }
  }

  ngOnDestroy(): void { this.destroyed = true; }

  // ── Computed getters ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  get selectedEntry(): DiskUsageEntry | null {
    return this.selectedIndex !== null ? (this.displayEntries[this.selectedIndex] ?? null) : null;
  }

  get folderSummaryLabel(): string {
    const childCount = this.entries.length;
    const label = childCount === 1 ? '1 child in this view' : `${childCount} children in this view`;
    if (this.otherEntries.length === 0) {
      return label;
    }
    const hiddenLabel = this.otherEntries.length === 1
      ? '1 child grouped into Other'
      : `${this.otherEntries.length} children grouped into Other`;
    return `${label} • ${hiddenLabel}`;
  }

  get centerName(): string {
    if (this.selectedIndex === null) return '';
    const e = this.displayEntries[this.selectedIndex];
    return e ? (e.name.length > 10 ? e.name.slice(0, 9) + '…' : e.name) : '';
  }

  get centerPct(): string {
    if (this.selectedIndex === null) return '';
    return this.pctStr(this.displayEntries[this.selectedIndex]);
  }

  get tooltipTransform(): string {
    const PAD = 8;
    const x = this.tooltip.side === 1
      ? this.tooltip.x + PAD
      : this.tooltip.x - this.tooltipWidth - PAD;
    return `translate(${x.toFixed(1)},${(this.tooltip.y - 16).toFixed(1)})`;
  }

  // ── Helpers ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  getColor(i: number): string { return this.palette[i % this.palette.length]; }

  pctStr(e: DiskUsageEntry): string {
    if (!this.totalSize) return '—';
    const p = (e.size / this.totalSize) * 100;
    return p < 0.1 ? '<0.1%' : p.toFixed(1) + '%';
  }

  formatBytes(bytes: number): string {
    if (!bytes) return '0 B';
    const units = ['B', 'KB', 'MB', 'GB', 'TB'];
    const i = Math.min(Math.floor(Math.log(bytes) / Math.log(1024)), 4);
    const v = bytes / Math.pow(1024, i);
    return (i === 0 ? v : v.toFixed(1)) + ' ' + units[i];
  }

  trackSlice(_: number, s: PieSlice): number { return s.index; }

  trackLegendEntry(_: number, entry: DiskUsageEntry): string {
    return entry.path || entry.name;
  }

  isFullCircle(s: PieSlice): boolean {
    return s.endAngle - s.startAngle >= Math.PI * 2 - 0.001;
  }

  // ── Slice path ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  getSlicePath(s: PieSlice): string {
    if (this.isFullCircle(s)) return '';
    const o = this.outerR, ir = this.innerR;
    const pt = (a: number, r: number) =>
      ({ x: +(r * Math.cos(a)).toFixed(3), y: +(r * Math.sin(a)).toFixed(3) });
    const os = pt(s.startAngle, o), oe = pt(s.endAngle, o);
    const is_ = pt(s.startAngle, ir), ie = pt(s.endAngle, ir);
    const large = s.endAngle - s.startAngle > Math.PI ? 1 : 0;
    return [
      `M ${os.x} ${os.y}`,
      `A ${o} ${o} 0 ${large} 1 ${oe.x} ${oe.y}`,
      `L ${ie.x} ${ie.y}`,
      `A ${ir} ${ir} 0 ${large} 0 ${is_.x} ${is_.y}`,
      'Z',
    ].join(' ');
  }

  // ── Event handlers ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  onSvgMouseMove(event: MouseEvent): void {
    const svgP = this.toSvgCoords(event);
    if (!svgP) return;
    const idx = this.hitTest(svgP.x, svgP.y);
    if (idx !== this.hoveredIndex) this.hoveredIndex = idx;

    if (idx !== null) {
      const isOther = idx === -1;
      const name  = isOther ? `Other (${this.otherEntries.length})` : (this.displayEntries[idx]?.name ?? '');
      const size  = isOther ? this.formatBytes(this.otherSize) : this.formatBytes(this.displayEntries[idx]?.size ?? 0);
      const pct   = isOther ? this.otherPct : this.pctStr(this.displayEntries[idx]);
      this.tooltipWidth = Math.ceil(Math.max(name.length * 6.5 + 18, (size.length + pct.length + 3) * 6 + 18, 90));
      this.tooltip = { visible: true, x: +svgP.x.toFixed(1), y: +svgP.y.toFixed(1), name, size, pct, side: svgP.x < 0 ? 1 : -1 };
    } else {
      this.tooltip = { ...this.tooltip, visible: false };
    }
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
  }

  onSvgMouseLeave(): void {
    this.hoveredIndex = null;
    this.tooltip = { ...this.tooltip, visible: false };
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
  }

  onSvgClick(event: MouseEvent): void {
    const svgP = this.toSvgCoords(event);
    if (!svgP) return;
    const idx = this.hitTest(svgP.x, svgP.y);
    if (idx === -1)             { this.onOtherClick(); return; }
    if (idx !== null && idx >= 0) {
      const e = this.displayEntries[idx];
      if (this.selectedIndex === idx && !e?.isDir) {
        this.clearSelection();
        return;
      }
      if (e?.isDir) {
        if (this.selectedIndex === idx) {
          this.drillDown.emit(e);
        } else {
          this.selectSlice(idx, false);
        }
        return;
      }
      this.selectSlice(idx, true);
    }
  }

  selectSlice(i: number, activate: boolean = false): void {
    this.selectedIndex = i;
    this.selectedKey = this.displayEntries[i]?.path ?? null;
    this.triggerBarAnimation();
    const e = this.displayEntries[i];
    if (e) {
      this.select.emit(e);
      if (activate) {
        this.activate.emit(e);
      }
    }
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
  }

  clearSelection(): void {
    this.selectedIndex = null;
    this.selectedKey = null;
    this.animatedBarPct = 100;
    this.barTransition = 'none';
    this.select.emit(null);
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
  }

  private selectOtherBucket(): void {
    this.selectedIndex = -1;
    this.selectedKey = OTHER_BUCKET_SELECTION_KEY;
    this.triggerBarAnimation();
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
  }

  onOtherClick(): void {
    if (!this.otherEntries.length) return;
    if (this.selectedIndex === -1) {
      this.otherDrill.emit(this.otherEntries);
      return;
    }
    this.selectOtherBucket();
  }

  onLegendClick(e: DiskUsageEntry, index: number): void {
    if (this.selectedIndex === index) {
      if (e.isDir) {
        this.drillDown.emit(e);
      }
    } else {
      this.selectSlice(index, false);
    }
  }

  // ── Private ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  /**
   * Split entries into displayEntries (≥ minPct) and otherEntries (< minPct).
   * If nothing clears the threshold, show only the largest few items and bucket the rest.
   */
  private partition(): void {
    const total = this.totalSize;
    const sortedEntries = [...this.entries].sort((left, right) => right.size - left.size);

    if (!sortedEntries.length || !total) {
      this.displayEntries = sortedEntries.slice(0, PIE_DISTRIBUTION_VISIBLE_LIMIT);
      this.otherEntries   = sortedEntries.slice(PIE_DISTRIBUTION_VISIBLE_LIMIT);
      this.otherSize      = this.otherEntries.reduce((s, e) => s + e.size, 0);
      this.otherPct       = '';
      return;
    }

    const threshold = this.minPct / 100;
    const main: DiskUsageEntry[] = [];
    const rest: DiskUsageEntry[] = [];
    for (const e of sortedEntries) {
      (e.size / total >= threshold ? main : rest).push(e);
    }

    const visible = main.length > 0
      ? main
      : sortedEntries.slice(0, PIE_DISTRIBUTION_FALLBACK_VISIBLE_LIMIT);
    const leftover = main.length > 0
      ? rest
      : sortedEntries.slice(PIE_DISTRIBUTION_FALLBACK_VISIBLE_LIMIT);

    this.displayEntries = visible.slice(0, PIE_DISTRIBUTION_VISIBLE_LIMIT);
    const overflow      = visible.slice(PIE_DISTRIBUTION_VISIBLE_LIMIT);
    this.otherEntries   = [...overflow, ...leftover];

    this.otherSize = this.otherEntries.reduce((s, e) => s + e.size, 0);
    this.otherPct  = this.otherSize
      ? ((this.otherSize / total) * 100).toFixed(1) + '%'
      : '';
  }

  private applyExternalSelection(): void {
    if (!this.selectedPath) {
      this.selectedKey = null;
      this.selectedIndex = null;
      this.animatedBarPct = 100;
      this.barTransition = 'none';
      this.cdr.markForCheck();
      return;
    }

    const selectedIndex = this.displayEntries.findIndex((entry) => entry.path === this.selectedPath);
    if (selectedIndex === -1) {
      this.selectedKey = null;
      this.selectedIndex = null;
      this.animatedBarPct = 100;
      this.barTransition = 'none';
      this.cdr.markForCheck();
      return;
    }

    this.selectedKey = this.selectedPath;
    this.selectedIndex = selectedIndex;
    this.triggerBarAnimation();
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
  }

  private reconcileSelection(): void {
    if (this.selectedPath !== null) {
      this.applyExternalSelection();
      return;
    }

    if (this.selectedKey === OTHER_BUCKET_SELECTION_KEY) {
      if (this.otherEntries.length > 0) {
        this.selectedIndex = -1;
        this.triggerBarAnimation();
      } else {
        this.selectedKey = null;
        this.selectedIndex = null;
        this.animatedBarPct = 100;
        this.barTransition = 'none';
      }
      this.cdr.markForCheck();
      return;
    }

    if (!this.selectedKey) {
      this.selectedIndex = null;
      this.animatedBarPct = 100;
      this.barTransition = 'none';
      this.cdr.markForCheck();
      return;
    }

    const selectedIndex = this.displayEntries.findIndex((entry) => entry.path === this.selectedKey);
    if (selectedIndex === -1) {
      this.selectedKey = null;
      this.selectedIndex = null;
      this.animatedBarPct = 100;
      this.barTransition = 'none';
      this.cdr.markForCheck();
      return;
    }

    this.selectedIndex = selectedIndex;
    this.triggerBarAnimation();
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
  }

  private buildSlices(): void {
    this.slices = [];
    const drawnTotal = this.displayEntries.reduce((s, e) => s + e.size, 0) + this.otherSize;
    if (!drawnTotal) return;

    let angle = -Math.PI / 2;
    const push = (index: number, size: number, color: string) => {
      const sweep = (size / drawnTotal) * Math.PI * 2;
      const start = angle, end = angle + sweep, mid = start + sweep / 2;
      angle = end;
      this.slices.push({
        index, startAngle: start, endAngle: end, midAngle: mid,
        tx: +Math.cos(mid).toFixed(4),
        ty: +Math.sin(mid).toFixed(4),
        color,
      });
    };

    this.displayEntries.forEach((e, i) => push(i, e.size, this.getColor(i)));
    if (this.otherSize > 0) push(-1, this.otherSize, this.otherColor);
  }

  private hitTest(x: number, y: number): number | null {
    const dist = Math.sqrt(x * x + y * y);
    if (dist < this.innerR || dist > this.outerR + 8) return null;
    let a = Math.atan2(y, x);
    if (a < -Math.PI / 2) a += Math.PI * 2;
    for (const s of this.slices) {
      let sa = s.startAngle, ea = s.endAngle;
      if (sa < -Math.PI / 2) sa += Math.PI * 2;
      if (ea < -Math.PI / 2) ea += Math.PI * 2;
      if (ea < sa) ea += Math.PI * 2;
      const norm = a < sa ? a + Math.PI * 2 : a;
      if (norm >= sa && norm <= ea) return s.index;
    }
    return null;
  }

  private toSvgCoords(event: MouseEvent): { x: number; y: number } | null {
    const svg = event.currentTarget as SVGSVGElement;
    const pt  = svg.createSVGPoint();
    pt.x = event.clientX; pt.y = event.clientY;
    const inv = svg.getScreenCTM()?.inverse();
    if (!inv) return null;
    const r = pt.matrixTransform(inv);
    return { x: r.x, y: r.y };
  }

  private triggerBarAnimation(): void {
    if (this.isTraversing) {
      this.barTransition = 'none';
      if (this.selectedIndex === -1 && this.totalSize) {
        this.animatedBarPct = (this.otherSize / this.totalSize) * 100;
      } else if (this.selectedIndex !== null && this.totalSize) {
        this.animatedBarPct = (this.displayEntries[this.selectedIndex].size / this.totalSize) * 100;
      } else {
        this.animatedBarPct = 0;
      }
      this.cdr.markForCheck();
      return;
    }

    this.barTransition = 'none'; this.animatedBarPct = 0;
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
    requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      if (this.destroyed) return;
      this.barTransition = 'width 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1)';
      if (this.selectedIndex === -1 && this.totalSize) {
        this.animatedBarPct = (this.otherSize / this.totalSize) * 100;
      } else if (this.selectedIndex !== null && this.totalSize) {
        this.animatedBarPct = (this.displayEntries[this.selectedIndex].size / this.totalSize) * 100;
      }
      this.cdr.markForCheck();
    });
  }
}
`````

`````typescript
  });
});
`````

`````typescript
import {
  collapseNestedDragEntries,
  decideInternalDrop,
  dragOperationFromModifiers,
  isDescendantResourcePath,
} from './drag-drop-policy';

describe('reassembly drag/drop policy', () => {
  it('uses copy by default and Shift for move', () => {
    expect(dragOperationFromModifiers({ shiftKey: false, ctrlKey: false } as DragEvent)).toBe('copy');
    expect(dragOperationFromModifiers({ shiftKey: true, ctrlKey: false } as DragEvent)).toBe('move');
    expect(dragOperationFromModifiers({ shiftKey: false, ctrlKey: true } as DragEvent)).toBe('copy');
  });

  it('recognizes normalized descendants', () => {
    expect(isDescendantResourcePath('C:\\Work\\Project\\src', 'C:/Work/Project')).toBeTrue();
    expect(isDescendantResourcePath('C:/Work/Project2', 'C:/Work/Project')).toBeFalse();
  });

  it('collapses descendants when their selected parent is transferred', () => {
    const entries = collapseNestedDragEntries([
      { path: 'C:/Work/Project' },
      { path: 'C:/Work/Project/src/a.ts' },
      { path: 'C:/Other/readme.txt' },
    ]);
    expect(entries.map(item => item.path)).toEqual([
      'C:/Work/Project',
      'C:/Other/readme.txt',
    ]);
  });

  it('collapses children encountered before their selected parent', () => {
    const entries = collapseNestedDragEntries([
      { path: 'C:/Work/Project/src/a.ts' },
      { path: 'C:/Work/Project' },
    ]);
    expect(entries.map(item => item.path)).toEqual(['C:/Work/Project']);
  });

  it('rejects same underlying source/destination folder across panes', () => {
    expect(decideInternalDrop({
      entries: [{ path: 'C:/Work/a.txt' }],
      sourceDirectory: 'C:/Work',
      targetDirectory: 'c:\\work\\',
      operation: 'copy',
    }).validity).toBe('same-location');
  });

  it('rejects self-target and descendant-target drops', () => {
    expect(decideInternalDrop({
`````

## File: manager/frontend/src/app/components/drag-drop-policy.ts
`````typescript
export type DragOperation = 'copy' | 'move';
export type DragDropValidity =
  | 'allowed'
  | 'same-location'
  | 'self-target'
  | 'descendant-target'
  | 'empty';

export interface DragEntryRef {
  path: string;
  type?: unknown;
}

export interface DragDropDecision {
  operation: DragOperation;
  validity: DragDropValidity;
  reason: string;
}

function normalize(value: string): string {
  return (value ?? '')
    .replace(/\\/g, '/')
    .replace(/\/+/g, '/')
    .replace(/\/$/, '')
    .toLocaleLowerCase();
}

export function sameResourcePath(left: string, right: string): boolean {
  return normalize(left) === normalize(right);
}

export function isDescendantResourcePath(candidate: string, ancestor: string): boolean {
  const child = normalize(candidate);
  const parent = normalize(ancestor);
  if (!child || !parent || child === parent) return false;
  return child.startsWith(`${parent}/`);
}

export function dragOperationFromModifiers(
  event: Pick<DragEvent, 'shiftKey' | 'ctrlKey'>,
): DragOperation {
  return event.shiftKey ? 'move' : 'copy';
}

export function collapseNestedDragEntries<T extends DragEntryRef>(
  entries: readonly T[],
): T[] {
  const result: T[] = [];

  for (const entry of entries) {
    if (!entry?.path) continue;
    if (result.some(existing => sameResourcePath(existing.path, entry.path))) continue;
    if (result.some(existing => isDescendantResourcePath(entry.path, existing.path))) continue;

    for (let index = result.length - 1; index >= 0; index -= 1) {
      if (isDescendantResourcePath(result[index].path, entry.path)) {
        result.splice(index, 1);
      }
    }
    result.push(entry);
  }

  return result;
}

export function decideInternalDrop(input: {
  entries: readonly DragEntryRef[];
  sourceDirectory: string;
  targetDirectory: string;
  operation: DragOperation;
}): DragDropDecision {
  const entries = collapseNestedDragEntries(input.entries);

  if (entries.length === 0 || !input.targetDirectory) {
    return { operation: input.operation, validity: 'empty', reason: 'Nothing to drop' };
  }

  if (sameResourcePath(input.sourceDirectory, input.targetDirectory)) {
    return { operation: input.operation, validity: 'same-location', reason: 'Already in this folder' };
  }

  for (const entry of entries) {
    if (sameResourcePath(entry.path, input.targetDirectory)) {
      return { operation: input.operation, validity: 'self-target', reason: 'Cannot drop an item onto itself' };
    }
    if (isDescendantResourcePath(input.targetDirectory, entry.path)) {
      return { operation: input.operation, validity: 'descendant-target', reason: 'Cannot drop a folder inside itself' };
    }
  }

  return {
    operation: input.operation,
    validity: 'allowed',
    reason: input.operation === 'move' ? 'Move here' : 'Copy here',
  };
}
`````

`````typescript
// elevation-status-pill.component.ts
// Status-bar pill that surfaces the persistent elevated service session.
// Shows whether the helper process is: not started, starting, active, or failed.
// Clicking the pill starts or stops the session.
import {
  Component,
  OnInit,
  OnDestroy,
  ChangeDetectionStrategy,
  ChangeDetectorRef,
  Input,
  signal,
  computed,
} from '@angular/core';
import { CommonModule } from '@angular/common';
import { EventsOn, EventsOff } from 'wailsjs/runtime';
import { ApiService, ElevatedSessionStatus } from '../services/api.service';

type PillState = 'idle' | 'starting' | 'active' | 'stopping' | 'error';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-elevation-status-pill',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [CommonModule],
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
  template: `
    <div class="elev-pill-host">
      <!-- Only render when there is something worth showing -->
      <button
        class="elev-pill"
        [class.idle]="pillState() === 'idle'"
        [class.starting]="pillState() === 'starting'"
        [class.active]="pillState() === 'active'"
        [class.stopping]="pillState() === 'stopping'"
        [class.error]="pillState() === 'error'"
        [class.flash-ok]="flashOk()"
        [class.flash-err]="flashErr()"
        [class.blink-op]="blinkOp() && pillState() === 'active'"
        [disabled]="monitorOnly || pillState() === 'starting' || pillState() === 'stopping'"
        (click)="onClick()"
        [title]="tooltip()"
      >
        <!-- Shield icon -->
        <svg class="icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="13" height="13"
             stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" fill="none"
             stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
          <path d="M12 22s8-4 8-10V5l-8-3-8 3v7c0 6 8 10 8 10z"/>
        </svg>

        <span class="label">{{ label() }}</span>

        <!-- Op-count badge, visible only when active -->
        <span class="badge" *ngIf="pillState() === 'active' && opCount() > 0">
          {{ opCount() }}
        </span>

        <!-- Spinner while starting / stopping -->
        <span class="spinner" *ngIf="pillState() === 'starting' || pillState() === 'stopping'"></span>
      </button>
    </div>
  `,
  styles: [`
    :host { display: block; }

    .elev-pill-host { display: flex; align-items: center; }

    .elev-pill {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 4px;
      position: relative;
      isolation: isolate;
      overflow: hidden;
      height: calc(var(--vsc-statusbar-height, 22px) - 4px);
      padding: 0 8px;
      border: 1px solid var(--vsc-neutral-overlay-soft);
      border-radius: 3px;
      cursor: pointer;
      font-size: 11px;
      font-family: var(--vsc-font-family, inherit);
      transition: background 150ms ease, color 150ms ease, box-shadow 150ms ease, transform 120ms ease;
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--vsc-neutral-overlay-soft), var(--vsc-neutral-overlay-subtle));
      color: var(--vsc-statusbar-foreground, var(--vsc-on-accent));
      box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 var(--vsc-neutral-overlay-subtle);
    }
    .elev-pill::after {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      inset: -1px;
      border-radius: inherit;
      pointer-events: none;
      opacity: 0;
      background: linear-gradient(110deg, transparent 0%, var(--vsc-neutral-overlay-soft) 45%, var(--vsc-media-control-muted) 50%, var(--vsc-neutral-overlay-soft) 55%, transparent 100%);
      transform: translateX(-120%);
      z-index: 0;
    }
    .elev-pill > * {
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
    }

    .elev-pill:hover:not([disabled]) {
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--vsc-neutral-overlay-medium), var(--vsc-neutral-overlay-subtle));
      transform: translateY(-0.5px);
    }

    .elev-pill[disabled] { cursor: default; opacity: 0.7; }

    /* State colours */
    .elev-pill.active {
      background:
        radial-gradient(120% 130% at 20% 10%, var(--vsc-accent-selection), transparent 45%),
        linear-gradient(135deg, var(--vsc-button-background) 0%, var(--vsc-accent-blue) 55%, var(--vsc-button-background) 100%);
      color: var(--vsc-list-active-foreground, var(--vsc-on-accent));
      border-color: var(--vsc-accent-border);
      box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--vsc-accent-selection), 0 0 12px var(--vsc-accent-border);
    }
    @keyframes blink-op {
      0%, 10%, 33%, 56%, 79%, 100% {
        background:
          radial-gradient(120% 130% at 20% 10%, var(--vsc-accent-border), transparent 45%),
          linear-gradient(135deg, var(--vsc-button-background) 0%, var(--vsc-accent-blue) 55%, var(--vsc-button-background) 100%);
        color: var(--vsc-list-active-foreground, var(--vsc-on-accent));
        box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--vsc-accent-selection), 0 0 12px var(--vsc-accent-border);
        transform: translateY(0) scale(1);

      22%, 45%, 68% {

        transform: translateY(-0.5px) scale(1.02);

    @keyframes blink-sweep {
      0%   { opacity: 0; transform: translateX(-120%); }
      8%   { opacity: 0.85; }
      38%  { opacity: 0.55; }
      72%  { opacity: 0.35; }
      100% { opacity: 0; transform: translateX(120%); }
    }
    .elev-pill.blink-op {
      animation: blink-op 900ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) 1;
    }
    .elev-pill.blink-op .icon {
      animation: icon-pulse 900ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) 1;
    }
    .elev-pill.blink-op::after {
      animation: blink-sweep 900ms ease-out 1;
    }
    .elev-pill.error {
      background: var(--vsc-input-validation-error-background, var(--vsc-danger-surface));
      color: var(--vsc-error-foreground, var(--vsc-error));
    }
    .elev-pill.starting, .elev-pill.stopping {
      opacity: 0.75;
    }

    /* Flash animations */
    @keyframes flash-ok {
      0%   { background: var(--vsc-charts-yellow, var(--vsc-accent-yellow)); color: var(--vsc-media-foreground-strong); }
      25%  { background: var(--vsc-charts-orange, var(--vsc-chart-6)); color: var(--vsc-media-foreground-strong); }
      50%  { background: var(--vsc-charts-yellow, var(--vsc-accent-yellow)); color: var(--vsc-media-foreground-strong); }
      75%  { background: var(--vsc-charts-orange, var(--vsc-chart-6)); color: var(--vsc-media-foreground-strong); }
      100% { background: var(--vsc-badge-background, var(--vsc-button-background)); color: var(--vsc-list-active-foreground, var(--vsc-on-accent)); }
    }
    @keyframes flash-err {
      0%   { background: var(--vsc-charts-red, var(--vsc-error)); }
      100% { background: transparent; }
    }
    .elev-pill.flash-ok { animation: flash-ok 1.5s ease-in-out; }
    .elev-pill.flash-err { animation: flash-err 500ms ease-out; }

    /* Op-count badge */
    .badge {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      min-width: 14px;
      height: 14px;
      padding: 0 3px;
      border-radius: 8px;
      font-size: 9px;
      background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--vsc-foreground) 25%, transparent);
      line-height: 1;
    }

    /* Spinner */
    .spinner {
      width: 10px; height: 10px;
      border: 1.5px solid currentColor;
      border-top-color: transparent;
      border-radius: 50%;
      animation: spin 600ms linear infinite;
    }
    @keyframes icon-pulse {
      0%, 10%, 33%, 56%, 79%, 100% { transform: scale(1); }
      22%, 45%, 68% { transform: scale(1.16); }
    }
    @keyframes spin { to { transform: rotate(360deg); } }

    .icon { flex-shrink: 0; }
    .label { white-space: nowrap; }
  `],
})
export class ElevationStatusPillComponent implements OnInit, OnDestroy {
  @Input() monitorOnly = false;
  // Reactive state (Angular signals)
  private _state = signal<PillState>('idle');
  private _opCount = signal(0);
  private _errorMsg = signal('');
  private _flashOk = signal(false);
  private _flashErr = signal(false);
  private _blinkOp  = signal(false);

  readonly pillState = computed(() => this._state());
  readonly opCount   = computed(() => this._opCount());
  readonly flashOk   = computed(() => this._flashOk());
  readonly flashErr  = computed(() => this._flashErr());
  readonly blinkOp   = computed(() => this._blinkOp());

  readonly label = computed(() => {
    switch (this._state()) {
      case 'starting':  return 'Starting...';
      case 'stopping':  return 'Stopping...';
      case 'active':    return 'Elevated';
      case 'error':     return 'Elev. Error';
      default:          return 'Elevate';
    }
  });

  readonly tooltip = computed(() => {
    switch (this._state()) {
      case 'active':
        return this.monitorOnly
          ? `Elevated session active (${this._opCount()} ops dispatched).`
          : `Elevated session active (${this._opCount()} ops dispatched). Click to stop.`;
      case 'error':
        return this.monitorOnly
          ? `Elevated session error: ${this._errorMsg()}.`
          : `Elevated session error: ${this._errorMsg()}. Click to retry.`;
      case 'starting':
        return 'Starting elevated session...';
      case 'stopping':
        return 'Stopping elevated session...';
      default:
        return this.monitorOnly ? 'Monitors hidden elevated helper activity.' : 'Start an elevated service session (one UAC/sudo prompt, then reuse).';
    }
  });

  constructor(private api: ApiService, private cdr: ChangeDetectorRef) {}

  // Lifecycle

  ngOnInit(): void {
    // Sync initial state from backend safely, in case the Wails runtime
    // hasn't registered the method yet (stale bindings before wails dev restart).
    this.api.getElevatedSessionStatus()
      .then(s => { this.applyStatus(s); this.cdr.markForCheck(); })
      .catch(() => { /* method not yet available in runtime - ignore */ });

    // Backend events
    EventsOn('elevation:uac-requested', () => {
      this._errorMsg.set('');
      this._state.set('starting');
      this.cdr.markForCheck();
    });
    EventsOn('elevation:session-starting', () => {
      // Auto-start triggered by a permission-denied operation; show UAC is pending.
      this._errorMsg.set('');
      this._state.set('starting');
      this.cdr.markForCheck();
    });
    EventsOn('elevation:session-started', (status: ElevatedSessionStatus) => {
      this.applyStatus(status);
      this.cdr.markForCheck();
    });
    EventsOn('elevation:session-stopped', () => {
      this._state.set('idle');
      this._opCount.set(0);
      this.cdr.markForCheck();
    });
    EventsOn('elevation:auto-started', () => {
      this._opCount.update(n => n + 1);
      if (this._state() !== 'active') {
        this._state.set('idle');
        this.triggerFlash('ok');
      }
      this.triggerBlinkOp();
      this.cdr.markForCheck();
    });
    EventsOn('elevation:auto-failed', (ev: { error?: string }) => {
      this._errorMsg.set(ev?.error ?? 'Unknown error');
      this._state.set('error');
      this.triggerFlash('err');
      this.cdr.markForCheck();
    });
  }

  ngOnDestroy(): void {
    EventsOff(
      'elevation:uac-requested',
      'elevation:session-starting',
      'elevation:session-started',
      'elevation:session-stopped',
      'elevation:auto-started',
      'elevation:auto-failed',
    );
  }

  // User interaction

  async toggle(): Promise<void> {
    const current = this._state();

    if (current === 'active') {
      this._state.set('stopping');
      this.cdr.markForCheck();
      await this.api.stopElevatedSession().catch(() => {});
      this._state.set('idle');
      this._opCount.set(0);
      this.cdr.markForCheck();
      return;
    }

    // idle / error -> start session
    this._state.set('starting');
    this._errorMsg.set('');
    this.cdr.markForCheck();

    try {
      const status = await this.api.startElevatedSession();
      this.applyStatus(status);
    } catch (err: any) {
      this._state.set('error');
      this._errorMsg.set(err?.message ?? String(err));
      this.triggerFlash('err');
    }
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
  }

  onClick(): void {
    if (this.monitorOnly) return;
    void this.toggle();
  }

  // Helpers

  private applyStatus(s: ElevatedSessionStatus): void {
    if (!s) {
      this._state.set('idle');
      return;
    }
    this._opCount.set(s.opCount ?? 0);
    if (s.active) {
      this._state.set('active');
      this._errorMsg.set('');
    } else if (s.error) {
      this._state.set('error');
      this._errorMsg.set(s.error);
    } else {
      this._state.set('idle');
    }
  }

  private triggerBlinkOp(): void {
    this._blinkOp.set(false);
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
    // force reflow so animation restarts
    setTimeout(() => {
      this._blinkOp.set(true);
      this.cdr.markForCheck();
      // 3 cycles x 300ms = 900ms
      setTimeout(() => { this._blinkOp.set(false); this.cdr.markForCheck(); }, 950);
    }, 16);
  }

  private triggerFlash(kind: 'ok' | 'err'): void {
    if (kind === 'ok') {
      this._flashOk.set(true);
      this.cdr.markForCheck();
      setTimeout(() => { this._flashOk.set(false); this.cdr.markForCheck(); }, 450);
    } else {
      this._flashErr.set(true);
      this.cdr.markForCheck();
      setTimeout(() => { this._flashErr.set(false); this.cdr.markForCheck(); }, 550);
    }
  }
}
`````

`````typescript
import { FileInfo, FileType } from '../shared/protocol';

export type EntrySortField = 'name' | 'size' | 'modified' | 'type';
export type EntrySortDirection = 'asc' | 'desc';

export interface EntryProjectionOptions {
  sortField: EntrySortField;
  sortDirection: EntrySortDirection;
  directoriesFirst: boolean;
  filterText: string;
}

export function projectEntries(
  entries: readonly FileInfo[],
  options: EntryProjectionOptions,
): FileInfo[] {
  const query = normalizeSearchText(options.filterText);
  // Filtering first cuts the expensive locale-aware sort down to only the
  // entries that can be rendered. This is the fallback path for providers
  // which cannot apply the projection in their own backend.
  const filtered = !query ? entries : entries.filter(entry =>
    normalizeSearchText(entry.name).includes(query) ||
    normalizeSearchText(entry.path).includes(query),
  );

  return [...filtered].sort((left, right) =>
    compareEntries(left, right, options),
  );
}

export function sortEntries(
  entries: readonly FileInfo[],
  options: Omit<EntryProjectionOptions, 'filterText'>,
): FileInfo[] {
  return [...entries].sort((left, right) =>
    compareEntries(left, right, { ...options, filterText: '' }),
  );
}

export function createFilenameMaskMatcher(
  mask: string,
): (name: string) => boolean {
  const escaped = (mask ?? '')
    .replace(/[.+^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&')
    .replace(/\*/g, '.*')
    .replace(/\?/g, '.');

  const expression = new RegExp(`^${escaped}$`, 'i');
  return name => expression.test(name ?? '');
}

export function fileExtension(name: string): string {
  const value = name ?? '';
  const index = value.lastIndexOf('.');
  if (index <= 0 || index === value.length - 1) return '';
  return value.slice(index + 1).toLocaleLowerCase();
}

export function entryTypeLabel(entry: FileInfo): string {
  if (entry.type === FileType.DIRECTORY) return 'folder';
  if (entry.type === FileType.ARCHIVE) return 'archive';
  if (entry.type === FileType.SYMLINK) return 'symbolic link';
  return 'file';
}

function compareEntries(
  left: FileInfo,
  right: FileInfo,
  options: EntryProjectionOptions,
): number {
  // Synthetic parent navigation is structural UI, not sortable content.
  // It must remain the first row regardless of field/direction/folder policy.
  const leftParent = left.path === '__parent__';
  const rightParent = right.path === '__parent__';

  if (leftParent !== rightParent) {
    return leftParent ? -1 : 1;
  }

  if (options.directoriesFirst) {
    const leftDirectory = left.type === FileType.DIRECTORY;
    const rightDirectory = right.type === FileType.DIRECTORY;
    if (leftDirectory !== rightDirectory) {
      return leftDirectory ? -1 : 1;
    }
  }

  const direction = options.sortDirection === 'desc' ? -1 : 1;
  let result = 0;

  if (options.sortField === 'size') {
    result = numeric(left.size) - numeric(right.size);
  } else if (options.sortField === 'modified') {
    result = numeric(left.modified) - numeric(right.modified);
  } else if (options.sortField === 'type') {
    result = String(left.type ?? '').localeCompare(String(right.type ?? ''));
  } else {
    result = compareNames(left.name, right.name);
  }

  if (result === 0 && options.sortField !== 'name') {
    result = compareNames(left.name, right.name);
  }

  return result * direction;
}

function numeric(value: unknown): number {
  const number = Number(value);
  return Number.isFinite(number) ? number : 0;
}

function compareNames(left: unknown, right: unknown): number {
  return String(left ?? '').localeCompare(
    String(right ?? ''),
    undefined,
    { numeric: true, sensitivity: 'base' },
  );
}

function normalizeSearchText(value: unknown): string {
  return String(value ?? '').trim().toLocaleLowerCase();
}
`````

`````typescript
import type { FileInfo } from '../shared/protocol';
import { sortEntries } from './entry-model';

export function parentEntryStaysFirst(
  entries: readonly FileInfo[],
): boolean {
  const parent = entries.find(entry => entry.path === '__parent__');
  if (!parent) return true;

  const fields = ['name', 'size', 'modified', 'type'] as const;
  const directions = ['asc', 'desc'] as const;

  return fields.every(sortField =>
    directions.every(sortDirection =>
      [true, false].every(directoriesFirst =>
        sortEntries(entries, {
          sortField,
          sortDirection,
          directoriesFirst,
        })[0]?.path === '__parent__',
      ),
    ),
  );
}
`````

`````typescript
      tabindex="-1"
      #menu
      [style.left.px]="state.x"
      [style.top.px]="state.y"
      (keydown)="onMenuKeyDown($event)"
      (mousedown)="$event.stopPropagation()"
      (contextmenu)="$event.preventDefault(); $event.stopPropagation()">
      <ng-container *ngFor="let item of state.items; trackBy: trackItem">
        <div *ngIf="item.separatorBefore" class="context-menu-separator" role="separator"></div>

          type="button"

          <span class="context-menu-label">{{ item.label }}</span>
          <span *ngIf="item.shortcut" class="context-menu-shortcut">{{ item.shortcut }}</span>

export class FileContextMenuComponent {
  @Input() state: FileContextMenuState | null = null;
  @Output() closed = new EventEmitter<void>();
  @ViewChild('menu') menu?: ElementRef<HTMLElement>;

  private typeahead = '';
  private typeaheadTimer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null = null;

  ngOnChanges(changes: SimpleChanges): void {
    if (!changes['state'] || !this.state) return;

    this.clearTypeahead();
    queueMicrotask(() => {
      this.menu?.nativeElement.focus({ preventScroll: true });
      this.focusItem(0, 1);
    });
  }

  trackItem(_index: number, item: PresentedCommand): string {
    return item.id;
  }

  run(item: PresentedCommand): void {
    if (!item.enabled) return;
    this.closed.emit();
    Promise.resolve(item.execute()).catch(error => {
      console.error(`Context menu action ${item.id} failed:`, error);
    });
  }

  onMenuKeyDown(event: KeyboardEvent): void {
    const items = this.items();
    if (!items.length) return;

    const active = document.activeElement as HTMLButtonElement | null;
    const current = Math.max(0, items.indexOf(active as HTMLButtonElement));

    if (event.key === 'Escape') {
      event.preventDefault();
      event.stopPropagation();
      this.closed.emit();
      return;
    }

    if (event.key === 'ArrowDown') {
      event.preventDefault();
      this.focusItem(current + 1, 1);
      return;
    }

    if (event.key === 'ArrowUp') {
      event.preventDefault();
      this.focusItem(current - 1, -1);
      return;
    }

    if (event.key === 'Home') {
      event.preventDefault();
      this.focusItem(0, 1);
      return;
    }

    if (event.key === 'End') {
      event.preventDefault();
      this.focusItem(items.length - 1, -1);
      return;
    }

    if (
      event.key.length === 1 &&
      !event.ctrlKey &&
      !event.altKey &&
      !event.metaKey
    ) {
      this.typeahead += event.key.toLocaleLowerCase();

      if (this.typeaheadTimer) clearTimeout(this.typeaheadTimer);
      this.typeaheadTimer = setTimeout(() => this.clearTypeahead(), 650);

      const match = items.find(item =>
        !item.disabled &&
        (item.textContent ?? '')
          .trim()
          .toLocaleLowerCase()
          .startsWith(this.typeahead)
      );

      if (match) {
        event.preventDefault();
        match.focus({ preventScroll: true });
      }
    }
  }

  @HostListener('document:mousedown')
  onDocumentMouseDown(): void {
    if (this.state) this.closed.emit();
  }

  @HostListener('document:keydown.escape')
  onEscape(): void {
    if (this.state) this.closed.emit();
  }

  @HostListener('window:blur')
  onWindowBlur(): void {
    if (this.state) this.closed.emit();
  }

  private items(): HTMLButtonElement[] {
    return Array.from(
      this.menu?.nativeElement.querySelectorAll<HTMLButtonElement>(
        'button[role="menuitem"]',
      ) ?? [],
    );
  }

  private focusItem(requested: number, direction: 1 | -1): void {
    const items = this.items();
    if (!items.length) return;

    let index = ((requested % items.length) + items.length) % items.length;
    for (let attempts = 0; attempts < items.length; attempts += 1) {
      const item = items[index];
      if (!item.disabled) {
        item.focus({ preventScroll: true });
        return;
      }
      index = ((index + direction) % items.length + items.length) % items.length;
    }
  }

  private clearTypeahead(): void {
    this.typeahead = '';
    if (this.typeaheadTimer) {
      clearTimeout(this.typeaheadTimer);
      this.typeaheadTimer = null;
    }
  }
}
`````

`````typescript
import type { ActionAvailability } from '../services/action-availability';
import type { CommandPresentation } from './presented-command';

export type BuiltinFileContextAction =
  | 'open'
  | 'quickView'
  | 'openInNewTab'
  | 'copyPath'
  | 'openWithExternal'
  | 'copy'
  | 'cut'
  | 'delete'
  | 'rename'
  | 'copyToOther'
  | 'moveToOther';

export type FileContextMenuDescriptor = CommandPresentation<BuiltinFileContextAction>;

export function buildBuiltinFileContextMenu(input: {
  availability: ActionAvailability;
  selectedCount: number;
  isDirectory: boolean;
}): FileContextMenuDescriptor[] {
  const a = input.availability;
  return [
    { id: 'open', label: 'Open', shortcut: 'Enter', enabled: true, source: 'builtin', commandId: 'pane.files.open' },
    { id: 'quickView', label: 'Quick View', shortcut: 'F3', enabled: !input.isDirectory, source: 'builtin', commandId: 'pane.files.quickView' },
    { id: 'openInNewTab', label: 'Open in New Tab', enabled: true, source: 'builtin' },
    { id: 'openWithExternal', label: 'Open with External App', enabled: !input.isDirectory, source: 'builtin', commandId: 'pane.files.openWithExternal' },
    { id: 'copyPath', label: 'Copy Path', shortcut: 'Ctrl+Shift+Enter', enabled: true, source: 'builtin', commandId: 'pane.files.copyCursorPath' },
    { id: 'copy', label: 'Copy', shortcut: 'Ctrl+C', enabled: a.copySelected, separatorBefore: true, source: 'builtin', commandId: 'pane.files.copy' },
    { id: 'cut', label: 'Cut', shortcut: 'Ctrl+X', enabled: a.cutSelected, source: 'builtin', commandId: 'pane.files.cut' },
    { id: 'delete', label: 'Delete', shortcut: 'Del', enabled: a.deleteSelected, source: 'builtin', commandId: 'pane.files.delete' },
    { id: 'rename', label: 'Rename', shortcut: 'F2', enabled: input.selectedCount === 1 && a.rename, source: 'builtin', commandId: 'pane.files.rename' },
    { id: 'copyToOther', label: 'Copy to Other Pane', shortcut: 'F5', enabled: a.copyToOther, separatorBefore: true, source: 'builtin', commandId: 'pane.ctrl.copyToOther' },
    { id: 'moveToOther', label: 'Move to Other Pane', shortcut: 'F6', enabled: a.moveToOther, source: 'builtin', commandId: 'pane.ctrl.moveToOther' },
  ];
}

export type BackgroundFileContextAction = 'newFolder' | 'paste' | 'refresh';

export function buildBackgroundFileContextMenu(
  availability: ActionAvailability,
): CommandPresentation<BackgroundFileContextAction>[] {
  return [
    { id: 'newFolder', label: 'New Folder', shortcut: 'F7', enabled: availability.createFolder, source: 'builtin', commandId: 'pane.files.newFolder' },
    { id: 'paste', label: 'Paste', shortcut: 'Ctrl+V', enabled: availability.paste, source: 'builtin', commandId: 'pane.files.paste' },
    { id: 'refresh', label: 'Refresh', shortcut: 'Ctrl+R', enabled: true, separatorBefore: true, source: 'builtin', commandId: 'pane.nav.refresh' },
  ];
}
`````

## File: manager/frontend/src/app/components/file-entry-color.util.ts
`````typescript
import { FileType, type FileInfo } from '../shared/protocol';
import { getPrimaryFileCategoryForExtension } from '../shared/file-categories';

export type FileMimeColorKind =
  | 'default'
  | 'directory'
  | 'archive'
  | 'symlink'
  | 'executable'
  | 'images'
  | 'documents'
  | 'spreadsheets'
  | 'presentations'
  | 'code'
  | 'web'
  | 'data'
  | 'archives'
  | 'audio'
  | 'video'
  | 'fonts'
  | 'markdown'
  | 'scripts'
  | '3d'
  | 'design';

const EXECUTABLE_EXT_SET = new Set([
  'apk', 'appimage', 'bat', 'cmd', 'com', 'dll', 'exe', 'jar', 'msi', 'scr',
]);

function getNormalizedExtension(name: string | null | undefined): string {
  const value = (name ?? '').trim().toLowerCase();
  const lastDot = value.lastIndexOf('.');
  return lastDot >= 0 ? value.slice(lastDot + 1) : '';
}

function getCategoryFromExtension(name: string | null | undefined): FileMimeColorKind | null {
  const ext = getNormalizedExtension(name);
  if (!ext) return null;
  if (EXECUTABLE_EXT_SET.has(ext)) return 'executable';
  return (getPrimaryFileCategoryForExtension(ext)?.id as FileMimeColorKind | undefined) ?? null;
}

export function getResolvedCategory(entry: FileInfo, resolvedCategoryId?: string | null): FileMimeColorKind | null {
  if (resolvedCategoryId) {
    return resolvedCategoryId as FileMimeColorKind;
  }

  const extKind = getCategoryFromExtension(entry.name);
  return extKind;
}

export function getFileMimeColorKind(entry: FileInfo, colorizeByMime: boolean, resolvedCategoryId?: string | null): FileMimeColorKind {
  if (!entry) return 'default';
  if (!colorizeByMime) return 'default';
  if (entry.type === FileType.SYMLINK || entry.isSymlink) return 'symlink';
  if (entry.type === FileType.DIRECTORY) return 'directory';
  if (entry.type === FileType.ARCHIVE) return 'archive';

  const kind = getResolvedCategory(entry, resolvedCategoryId);
  if (kind) return kind;

  return 'default';
}
`````

`````typescript
export class FileEntryInlineComponent implements OnChanges, OnDestroy {
  @Input({ required: true }) entry!: FileInfo;
  @Input() displayNameOverride: string | null = null;
  @Input() colorizeByMime = false;
  @Input() directorySizePending = false;
  @Input() showDirectorySizeSpinnerInName = false;
  @Input() showIcon = true;

  private resolvedCategoryId: string | null | undefined;
  private unwatchResolvedCategory: (() => void) | null = null;

  constructor(
    private readonly categoryResolver: FileCategoryResolverService,
    private readonly cdr: ChangeDetectorRef,
  ) {}

  ngOnChanges(_changes: SimpleChanges): void {
    this.bindResolvedCategory();
  }

  ngOnDestroy(): void {
    this.unwatchResolvedCategory?.();
  }

  get isParent(): boolean {
    return getFileEntryPresentation(this.entry, this.colorizeByMime, this.resolvedCategoryId ?? null).isParent;
  }

  get isSymlink(): boolean {
    return getFileEntryPresentation(this.entry, this.colorizeByMime, this.resolvedCategoryId ?? null).isSymlink;
  }

  get displayName(): string {
    return this.displayNameOverride?.trim() || this.entry?.name || '';
  }

  get fullName(): string {
    return this.displayNameOverride?.trim() || this.entry?.name || '';
  }

  get mimeColorKind(): string {
    return getFileEntryPresentation(this.entry, this.colorizeByMime, this.resolvedCategoryId ?? null).mimeColorKind;
  }

  get showDirectorySizeSpinner(): boolean {
    return this.directorySizePending && !this.isParent && this.entry?.type === FileType.DIRECTORY;
  }

  get iconEmoji(): string {
    return getFileEntryPresentation(this.entry, this.colorizeByMime, this.resolvedCategoryId ?? null).iconEmoji;
  }

  private bindResolvedCategory(): void {
    this.unwatchResolvedCategory?.();
    this.unwatchResolvedCategory = null;
    this.resolvedCategoryId = undefined;

    const path = this.entry?.path;
    if (!path || !this.colorizeByMime) {
      return;
    }

    this.resolvedCategoryId = this.categoryResolver.getResolvedCategory(path);
    this.unwatchResolvedCategory = this.categoryResolver.watch(path, () => {
      this.resolvedCategoryId = this.categoryResolver.getResolvedCategory(path);
      this.cdr.markForCheck();
    });
    this.categoryResolver.ensureResolved(this.entry);
  }
}
`````

`````typescript
import { FileType, type FileInfo } from '../shared/protocol';
import { getFileMimeColorKind, type FileMimeColorKind } from './file-entry-color.util';
import { FILE_CATEGORY_BY_ID, getPrimaryFileCategoryForExtension } from '../shared/file-categories';

export interface FileEntryPresentation {
  iconEmoji: string;
  mimeColorKind: FileMimeColorKind;
  isSymlink: boolean;
  isParent: boolean;
}

const presentationCache = new Map<string, FileEntryPresentation>();

export function getFileEntryPresentation(
  entry: FileInfo | undefined,
  colorizeByMime: boolean,
  resolvedCategoryId?: string | null,
): FileEntryPresentation {
  if (!entry) {
    return {
      iconEmoji: '📄',
      mimeColorKind: 'default',
      isSymlink: false,
      isParent: false,
    };
  }

  const isParent = entry.path === '__parent__';
  const isSymlink = entry.type === FileType.SYMLINK || !!entry.isSymlink;
  const cacheKey = [
    colorizeByMime ? '1' : '0',
    isParent ? '1' : '0',
    isSymlink ? '1' : '0',
    entry.type,
    entry.name ?? '',
    resolvedCategoryId ?? '',
    entry.registryKind ?? '',
    entry.path.startsWith('registry://') ? 'registry' : '',
    entry.path === 'registry://' ? 'root' : '',
  ].join('|');

  const cached = presentationCache.get(cacheKey);
  if (cached) return cached;

  const presentation: FileEntryPresentation = {
    iconEmoji: resolveIconEmoji(entry, isParent, resolvedCategoryId),
    mimeColorKind: getFileMimeColorKind(entry, colorizeByMime, resolvedCategoryId),
    isSymlink,
    isParent,
  };
  presentationCache.set(cacheKey, presentation);
  return presentation;
}

function resolveIconEmoji(entry: FileInfo, isParent: boolean, resolvedCategoryId?: string | null): string {
  if (isParent) return '📄';
  if (entry.path.startsWith('registry://')) {
    const kind = (entry.registryKind || '').toLowerCase();
    if (entry.path === 'registry://' || kind === 'registry') return '🧭';
    if (kind === 'key' || entry.type === FileType.DIRECTORY) return '🗂️';
    return '📝';
  }

  switch (entry.type) {
    case FileType.DIRECTORY:
      return '📁';
    case FileType.SYMLINK:
      return '📄';
    default:
      return fileIcon(entry, resolvedCategoryId);
  }
}

function extIcon(name: string): string {
  const ext = name.split('.').pop()?.toLowerCase();
  if (!ext) return '📄';
  const category = getPrimaryFileCategoryForExtension(ext);
  return category?.icon || '📄';
}

function fileIcon(entry: FileInfo, resolvedCategoryId?: string | null): string {
  const ext = entry.name.split('.').pop()?.toLowerCase();
  if (!ext) return '📄';

  if (resolvedCategoryId) {
    return FILE_CATEGORY_BY_ID.get(resolvedCategoryId)?.icon ?? extIcon(entry.name);
  }

  return extIcon(entry.name);
}
`````
