export class FilterBarComponent implements OnInit, OnDestroy, OnChanges {

  @ViewChild('searchInput') searchInput?: ElementRef<HTMLInputElement>;
  @ViewChild('categoryBtn') categoryBtnRef?: ElementRef<HTMLElement>;
  @ViewChild('presetBtn')   presetBtnRef?: ElementRef<HTMLElement>;

  // ── Inputs ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  @Input() dataset:           FileInfo[] = [];
  @Input() placeholder        = 'Search files…';
  @Input() compact            = false;
  @Input() initialSearch      = '';
  @Input() initialCategories: string[] = [];

  // ── Outputs ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  @Output() filterChange = new EventEmitter<FilterQuery & { groups: CriteriaGroup[] }>();

  // ── State ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  allPresets:      FilterPreset[] = [];
  selectedPresets: FilterPreset[] = [];
  searchText       = '';

  showCategoryDropdown = false;
  showPresetDropdown   = false;
  selectedPresetIndex = -1;

  savedPresets: { id: string; name: string; presetIds: string[] }[] = [];

  showCustomDialog  = false;
  editingCategory: FilterCategory | null = null;

  private groupModes = new Map<string, 'AND' | 'OR'>();
  private destroy$   = createSubject<void>();
  private search$    = createSubject<string>();
  private readonly presetCommandOwner = `overlay.filter.presets:${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8)}`;
  private releasePresetOverlayContext: (() => void) | null = null;

  // Groups that combine with OR (any one match is enough)
  private readonly orGroups  = new Set(['Basic', 'Extensions', 'Other']);
  // Groups that combine with AND (all must match)
  private readonly andGroups = new Set(['Date', 'Size', 'Special']);

  // ── Computed ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  get hasDynamic():    boolean { return this.allPresets.some(p => p.isDynamic); }
  get hasAnyFilter():  boolean { return this.selectedPresets.length > 0 || !!this.searchText; }
  get canSavePreset(): boolean { return this.selectedPresets.length > 0 && this.savedPresets.length < 20; }
  get filteredCount(): number {
    if (!this.dataset.length) return 0;
    
    // Build a filter query from current state
    let query: FilterQuery & { groups: CriteriaGroup[] };
    
    if (!this.hasAnyFilter) {
      query = this.filterService.parseFilterText('');
    } else if (this.selectedPresets.length === 0) {
      query = this.filterService.parseFilterText(this.searchText);
    } else {
      // Build the query from selected presets
      const groupMap = new Map<string, FilterPreset[]>();
      for (const p of this.selectedPresets) {
        const g = p.group || 'Other';
        if (!groupMap.has(g)) groupMap.set(g, []);
        groupMap.get(g)!.push(p);
      }

      const segments: string[] = [];
      for (const [groupName, presets] of groupMap) {
        const mode = this.groupModes.get(groupName) ?? 'OR';
        const filters = presets.map(p => (p as any).filter).filter(Boolean) as string[];
        if (filters.length === 1) {
          segments.push(filters[0]);
        } else if (mode === 'OR') {
          segments.push(filters.join(' OR '));
        } else {
          segments.push(filters.join(' '));
        }
      }
      
      query = this.filterService.parseFilterText(segments.join(' OR '));
      query.text = this.searchText;
    }
    
    // Use filterEntries to get the filtered count
    return this.filterService.filterEntries(this.dataset, query).length;
  }

  private getGroupCounts(): Map<string, number> {
    const counts = new Map<string, number>();
    for (const p of this.selectedPresets) {
      const g = p.group || 'Other';
      counts.set(g, (counts.get(g) || 0) + 1);
    }
    return counts;
  }

  get orPresets(): FilterPreset[] {
    return this.selectedPresets.filter(p =>
      this.orGroups.has(p.group || 'Other')
    );
  }

  get andPresets(): FilterPreset[] {
    return this.selectedPresets.filter(p =>
      this.andGroups.has(p.group || 'Other')
    );
  }

  // ── Constructor ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  constructor(
    private filterService: FilterService,
    private elRef: ElementRef,
    private cdr: ChangeDetectorRef,
    private confirmDialog: ConfirmDialogService,
    private inputContexts: InputContextService,
    private inputEngine: InputEngineService,
  ) {}

  // ── Lifecycle ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.searchText = this.initialSearch;
    this.loadSavedPresets();
    this.rebuildPresets();
    this.registerPresetOverlayCommands();

    this.search$
      .pipe(debounce(200), distinctUntilChanged(), takeUntil(this.destroy$))
      .subscribe(() => this.emitFilterChange());
  }

  ngOnChanges(changes: SimpleChanges): void {
    if (changes['dataset'] && !changes['dataset'].firstChange) {
      this.rebuildPresets();
    }
  }

  ngOnDestroy(): void {
    this.releasePresetOverlayContext?.();
    this.releasePresetOverlayContext = null;
    this.unregisterPresetOverlayCommands();
    this.destroy$.next();
    this.destroy$.complete();
  }

  // ── Preset generation ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  rebuildPresets(): void {
    this.allPresets = buildPresetsFromDataset(this.dataset);

    const ids = new Set(this.allPresets.map(p => p.id));
    this.selectedPresets = this.selectedPresets.filter(p => ids.has(p.id));
    this.selectedPresets = this.selectedPresets.map(sel =>
      this.allPresets.find(p => p.id === sel.id) ?? sel,
    );

    this.cdr.detectChanges();
    if (this.hasAnyFilter) this.emitFilterChange();
  }

  refreshPresets(): void { this.rebuildPresets(); }

  // ── Dropdown ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  toggleCategoryDropdown(): void {
    this.onCategoryDropdownStateChange(!this.showCategoryDropdown);
  }

  onCategoryDropdownStateChange(show: boolean): void {
    this.showCategoryDropdown = show;
  }

  togglePresetDropdown(): void {
    this.onPresetDropdownStateChange(!this.showPresetDropdown);
  }

  onPresetDropdownStateChange(show: boolean): void {
    this.showPresetDropdown = show;
    if (show) {
      this.selectedPresetIndex = this.savedPresets.length > 0 ? 0 : -1;
      this.releasePresetOverlayContext ??= this.inputContexts.acquire('overlay.filter.presets');
      return;
    }

    this.releasePresetOverlayContext?.();
    this.releasePresetOverlayContext = null;
  }

  // ── Preset selection ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  onPresetToggle(preset: FilterPreset): void {
    const idx = this.selectedPresets.findIndex(p => p.id === preset.id);
    this.selectedPresets = idx >= 0
      ? this.selectedPresets.filter(p => p.id !== preset.id)
      : [...this.selectedPresets, preset];
    this.emitFilterChange();
    this.cdr.detectChanges();
  }

  clearPresets(): void {
    this.selectedPresets = [];
    this.emitFilterChange();
    this.cdr.detectChanges();
  }

  onGroupModeChange(ev: { group: string; mode: 'AND' | 'OR' }): void {
    this.groupModes.set(ev.group, ev.mode);
    if (this.selectedPresets.length > 0) this.emitFilterChange();
  }

  // ── Search ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  onSearchChange(value: string): void { this.searchText = value; this.search$.next(value); }
  onSearchKeyDown(e: KeyboardEvent): void { if (e.key === 'Escape') this.clearSearch(); }

  clearSearch(): void {
    this.searchText = '';
    this.emitFilterChange();
    this.cdr.detectChanges();
  }

  clearAllFilters(): void {
    this.selectedPresets = [];
    this.searchText = '';
    this.emitFilterChange();
    this.cdr.detectChanges();
  }

  // ── Saved presets ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  loadSavedPresets(): void {
    try { this.savedPresets = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(FILTER_PRESETS_KEY) || '[]'); }
    catch { this.savedPresets = []; }
  }

  persistSavedPresets(): void {
    try { localStorage.setItem(FILTER_PRESETS_KEY, JSON.stringify(this.savedPresets)); } catch {}
  }

  async onSavePreset(): Promise<void> {
    const name = (await this.confirmDialog.prompt({
      title: 'Save Preset',
      message: 'Enter preset name.',
      confirmText: 'Save',
      cancelText: 'Cancel',
      placeholder: 'Preset name',
      defaultValue: '',
      historyKey: 'filter.presetName',
    }))?.trim();
    if (!name) return;
    this.savedPresets = [...this.savedPresets, {
      id: `preset-${Date.now()}`,
      name,
      presetIds: this.selectedPresets.map(p => p.id),
    }];
    this.persistSavedPresets();
    this.onPresetDropdownStateChange(false);
  }

  applyPreset(saved: { id: string; name: string; presetIds: string[] }): void {
    this.selectedPresets = saved.presetIds
      .map(id => this.allPresets.find(p => p.id === id))
      .filter(Boolean) as FilterPreset[];
    this.onPresetDropdownStateChange(false);
    this.emitFilterChange();
    this.cdr.detectChanges();
  }

  deletePreset(saved: { id: string; name: string; presetIds: string[] }): void {
    this.savedPresets = this.savedPresets.filter(p => p.id !== saved.id);
    this.persistSavedPresets();
  }

  // ── Custom categories ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  onCustomCategorySave(_data: CustomCategoryData): void { this.closeCustomDialog(); }
  closeCustomDialog(): void { this.showCustomDialog = false; this.editingCategory = null; }

  // ── Keyboard ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  onHostKeyDown(e: KeyboardEvent): void {
    if ((e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey) && e.key === 'f') {
      e.preventDefault();
      this.searchInput?.nativeElement.focus();
    }
  }

  onDocKey(e: KeyboardEvent): void {
    if (e.key === 'Escape') {
      if (this.showCategoryDropdown) { this.onCategoryDropdownStateChange(false); e.preventDefault(); }
      if (this.showPresetDropdown)   { this.onPresetDropdownStateChange(false); e.preventDefault(); }
      if (this.showCustomDialog)     { this.closeCustomDialog();          e.preventDefault(); }
    }
  }

  setSelectedPresetIndex(index: number): void {
    if (index < 0 || index >= this.savedPresets.length) return;
    this.selectedPresetIndex = index;
  }

  private movePresetSelection(delta: number): void {
    if (this.savedPresets.length === 0) return;
    const baseIndex = this.selectedPresetIndex >= 0 ? this.selectedPresetIndex : 0;
    this.selectedPresetIndex = Math.max(0, Math.min(this.savedPresets.length - 1, baseIndex + delta));
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
  }

  private applySelectedPreset(): void {
    const preset = this.savedPresets[this.selectedPresetIndex];
    if (!preset) return;
    this.applyPreset(preset);
  }

  private registerPresetOverlayCommands(): void {
    this.inputEngine.registerCommand('overlay.filter.presets.close', () => {
      if (!this.showPresetDropdown) return;
      this.onPresetDropdownStateChange(false);
    }, this.presetCommandOwner);

    this.inputEngine.registerCommand('overlay.filter.presets.prevItem', () => {
      if (!this.showPresetDropdown) return;
      this.movePresetSelection(-1);
    }, this.presetCommandOwner);

    this.inputEngine.registerCommand('overlay.filter.presets.nextItem', () => {
      if (!this.showPresetDropdown) return;
      this.movePresetSelection(1);
    }, this.presetCommandOwner);

    this.inputEngine.registerCommand('overlay.filter.presets.select', () => {
      if (!this.showPresetDropdown) return;
      this.applySelectedPreset();
    }, this.presetCommandOwner);
  }

  private unregisterPresetOverlayCommands(): void {
    this.inputEngine.unregisterCommand('overlay.filter.presets.close', this.presetCommandOwner);
    this.inputEngine.unregisterCommand('overlay.filter.presets.prevItem', this.presetCommandOwner);
    this.inputEngine.unregisterCommand('overlay.filter.presets.nextItem', this.presetCommandOwner);
    this.inputEngine.unregisterCommand('overlay.filter.presets.select', this.presetCommandOwner);
  }

  // ── Emit ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  private emitFilterChange(): void {
    if (!this.hasAnyFilter) {
      this.filterChange.emit(this.filterService.parseFilterText(''));
      return;
    }
    if (this.selectedPresets.length === 0) {
      this.filterChange.emit(this.filterService.parseFilterText(this.searchText));
      return;
    }

    // Group presets → build combined filter string
    const groupMap = new Map<string, FilterPreset[]>();
    for (const p of this.selectedPresets) {
      const g = p.group || 'Other';
      if (!groupMap.has(g)) groupMap.set(g, []);
      groupMap.get(g)!.push(p);
    }

    const segments: string[] = [];
    for (const [groupName, presets] of groupMap) {
      const mode    = this.groupModes.get(groupName) ?? 'OR';
      const filters = presets.map(p => (p as any).filter).filter(Boolean) as string[];
      if (filters.length === 1) {
        segments.push(filters[0]);
      } else if (mode === 'OR') {
        segments.push(filters.join(' OR '));
      } else {
        segments.push(filters.join(' '));
      }
    }

    const query    = this.filterService.parseFilterText(segments.join(' OR '));
    query.text     = this.searchText;
    this.filterChange.emit(query);
  }
}

import { DEFAULT_FILE_CATEGORIES, FILE_CATEGORY_EXTENSIONS, type FileCategory } from '../shared/file-categories';
import { FileInfo, FileType } from '../shared/protocol';

export { DEFAULT_FILE_CATEGORIES, type FileCategory } from '../shared/file-categories';

export interface FilterPreset {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  /** Filter string understood by FilterService.parseFilterText() */
  filter: string;
  icon?: string;
  description?: string;
  group?: string;
  isDynamic?: boolean;
  /** Real match count from the current dataset */
  count?: number;
}

export interface FilterGroup {
  name: string;
  presets: FilterPreset[];
}

export interface FilterCategory {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  icon?: string;
  pattern?: string;
  isCustom?: boolean;
  predicate?: (entry: FileInfo) => boolean;
}

export interface CustomCategoryData {
  label: string;
  icon: string;
  pattern: string;
}

export const FILTER_PRESETS_KEY = 'filter-bar-presets';
export const GROUP_ORDER = ['Basic', 'Extensions', 'Special', 'Date', 'Size', 'Other'];

export const GROUP_MODES: Record<string, 'AND' | 'OR'> = {
  Basic: 'OR',
  Extensions: 'OR',
  Other: 'OR',
  Special: 'AND',
  Date: 'AND',
  Size: 'AND',
};

// Kept for any legacy imports.
export const BUILT_IN_CATEGORIES: FilterCategory[] = [];

/**
 * Analyze a dataset and return FilterPresets with real match counts.
 * Presets with count === 0 are omitted so only categories present in the folder are shown.
 *
 * Filter strings are compatible with FilterService.parseFilterText().
 */
export function buildPresetsFromDataset(dataset: FileInfo[]): FilterPreset[] {
  if (!dataset?.length) return [];

  const now = Date.now();
  const DAY = 86_400_000;

  let files = 0;
  let dirs = 0;
  let symlinks = 0;
  let hidden = 0;
  const dateCounts = { today: 0, thisWeek: 0, thisMonth: 0 };
  const sizeCounts = { small: 0, medium: 0, large: 0, huge: 0 };
  const extMap = new Map<string, number>();

  for (const f of dataset) {
    if (f.type === FileType.FILE) {
      files++;
    } else if (f.type === FileType.DIRECTORY) {
      dirs++;
    }

    if (f.type === FileType.SYMLINK || (f as any).isSymlink) symlinks++;
    if (f.name.startsWith('.')) hidden++;

    const age = now - f.modified * 1000;
    if (age < DAY) dateCounts.today++;
    if (age < 7 * DAY) dateCounts.thisWeek++;
    if (age < 30 * DAY) dateCounts.thisMonth++;

    if (f.type !== FileType.FILE) continue;

    const sz = f.size ?? 0;
    if (sz < 102_400) {
      sizeCounts.small++;
    } else if (sz < 10_485_760) {
      sizeCounts.medium++;
    } else if (sz < 1_073_741_824) {
      sizeCounts.large++;
    } else {
      sizeCounts.huge++;
    }

    const dot = f.name.lastIndexOf('.');
    if (dot > 0) {
      const ext = f.name.slice(dot + 1).toLowerCase();
      extMap.set(ext, (extMap.get(ext) ?? 0) + 1);
    }
  }

  const catCounts = new Map<string, number>();
  for (const cat of DEFAULT_FILE_CATEGORIES) {
    let count = 0;
    for (const ext of cat.extensions) count += extMap.get(ext) ?? 0;
    if (count > 0) catCounts.set(cat.id, count);
  }

  const out: FilterPreset[] = [];

  if (files) {
    out.push({ id: 'files', name: 'Files', filter: 'type:file', icon: '📄', group: 'Basic', count: files });
  }
  if (dirs) {
    out.push({ id: 'dirs', name: 'Folders', filter: 'type:dir', icon: '📁', group: 'Basic', count: dirs });
  }
  if (symlinks) {
    out.push({ id: 'symlinks', name: 'Symlinks', filter: 'type:symlink', icon: '🔗', group: 'Basic', count: symlinks });
  }

  for (const cat of DEFAULT_FILE_CATEGORIES) {
    const count = catCounts.get(cat.id);
    if (!count) continue;

    out.push({
      id: `ext-${cat.id}`,
      name: cat.name,
      filter: cat.extensions.map((ext) => `ext:${ext}`).join(' '),
      icon: cat.icon,
      group: 'Extensions',
      isDynamic: true,
      count,
    });
  }

  Array.from(extMap.entries())
    .filter(([ext, count]) => count >= 2 && !FILE_CATEGORY_EXTENSIONS.has(ext))
    .sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1])
    .slice(0, 5)
    .forEach(([ext, count]) => {
      out.push({
        id: `ext-raw-${ext}`,
        name: `.${ext}`,
        filter: `ext:${ext}`,
        icon: '📎',
        group: 'Extensions',
        isDynamic: true,
        count,
      });
    });

  if (hidden) {
    out.push({ id: 'hidden', name: 'Hidden', filter: 'hidden:true', icon: '👻', group: 'Special', count: hidden });
  }

  if (dateCounts.today) {
    out.push({ id: 'today', name: 'Today', filter: 'modified:today', icon: '⚡', group: 'Date', isDynamic: true, count: dateCounts.today });
  }
  if (dateCounts.thisWeek) {
    out.push({ id: 'this-week', name: 'This week', filter: 'modified:week', icon: '🗓', group: 'Date', isDynamic: true, count: dateCounts.thisWeek });
  }
  if (dateCounts.thisMonth) {
    out.push({ id: 'this-month', name: 'This month', filter: 'modified:month', icon: '🗓️', group: 'Date', isDynamic: true, count: dateCounts.thisMonth });
  }

  if (sizeCounts.small) {
    out.push({ id: 'size-small', name: '< 100 KB', filter: 'size<102400', icon: '🔹', group: 'Size', count: sizeCounts.small });
  }
  if (sizeCounts.medium) {
    out.push({ id: 'size-medium', name: '100 KB – 10 MB', filter: 'size>102400 size<10485760', icon: '🔸', group: 'Size', count: sizeCounts.medium });
  }
  if (sizeCounts.large) {
    out.push({ id: 'size-large', name: '> 10 MB', filter: 'size>10485760', icon: '🔶', group: 'Size', count: sizeCounts.large });
  }
  if (sizeCounts.huge) {
    out.push({ id: 'size-huge', name: '> 1 GB', filter: 'size>1073741824', icon: '🔴', group: 'Size', count: sizeCounts.huge });
  }

  return out;
}

export class FindWidgetComponent implements OnDestroy {

  @ViewChild('inputEl') inputEl?: ElementRef<HTMLInputElement>;

  @Output() stateChange = new EventEmitter<FindWidgetState | null>();
  @Output() nextMatch   = new EventEmitter<void>();
  @Output() prevMatch   = new EventEmitter<void>();

  visible     = false;
  searchText  = '';
  matchCase   = false;
  wholeWord   = false;
  useRegex    = false;
  matchCount: number | null = null;
  currentMatch = 0;
  hasRegexError = false;

  private _focusTimer: any;
  private readonly commandOwner = `widget.filterInline:${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8)}`;
  private releaseWidgetContext: (() => void) | null = null;

  constructor(
    private cdr: ChangeDetectorRef,
    private inputContexts: InputContextService,
    private inputEngine: InputEngineService,
    private overlayFreeze: NativeOverlayFreezeService,
  ) {
    this.registerInputCommands();
  }

  ngOnDestroy(): void {
    clearTimeout(this._focusTimer);
    this.releaseWidgetContext?.();
    this.releaseWidgetContext = null;
    this.overlayFreeze.release('filter-widget');
    this.unregisterInputCommands();
  }

  // ── Open / close ──────────────────────────────────────────────

  open(): void {
    this.visible = true;
    this.hasRegexError = false;
    this.overlayFreeze.acquire('filter-widget');
    this.releaseWidgetContext ??= this.inputContexts.acquire('widget.filterInline');
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
    // Defer focus so the CSS transition has started
    clearTimeout(this._focusTimer);
    this._focusTimer = setTimeout(() => {
      this.inputEl?.nativeElement.focus();
      this.inputEl?.nativeElement.select();
    }, 60);
    this.emit();
  }

  close(): void {
    this.visible = false;
    this.searchText = '';
    this.matchCount = null;
    this.currentMatch = 0;
    this.hasRegexError = false;
    this.overlayFreeze.release('filter-widget');
    this.releaseWidgetContext?.();
    this.releaseWidgetContext = null;
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
    this.stateChange.emit(null);  // null = no filter
  }

  toggle(): void { this.visible ? this.close() : this.open(); }

  // ── Input events ──────────────────────────────────────────────

  onTextChange(): void {
    this.hasRegexError = false;
    if (this.useRegex && this.searchText) {
      try { new RegExp(this.searchText); } catch { this.hasRegexError = true; }
    }
    this.currentMatch = 1;
    this.emit();
  }

  onInputKeyDown(e: KeyboardEvent): void {
    switch (e.key) {
      case 'Escape':    e.preventDefault(); this.close(); break;
      case 'Enter':     e.preventDefault(); e.shiftKey ? this.onPrev() : this.onNext(); break;
      case 'F3':        e.preventDefault(); e.shiftKey ? this.onPrev() : this.onNext(); break;
    }
  }

  onNext(): void { if (this.matchCount) { this.currentMatch = (this.currentMatch % this.matchCount) + 1; this.nextMatch.emit(); this.cdr.markForCheck(); } }
  onPrev(): void { if (this.matchCount) { this.currentMatch = ((this.currentMatch - 2 + this.matchCount) % this.matchCount) + 1; this.prevMatch.emit(); this.cdr.markForCheck(); } }

  /** Called by the parent to update the match count badge. */
  setMatchCount(count: number): void {
    this.matchCount = count;
    if (this.currentMatch > count) this.currentMatch = count || 0;
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
  }

  // ── Emit state ────────────────────────────────────────────────

  private emit(): void {
    if (!this.visible || !this.searchText || this.hasRegexError) {
      this.stateChange.emit(null);
      return;
    }
    this.stateChange.emit({
      text:      this.searchText,
      matchCase: this.matchCase,
      wholeWord: this.wholeWord,
      useRegex:  this.useRegex,
    });
  }

  private registerInputCommands(): void {
    this.inputEngine.registerCommand('widget.filterInline.close', () => {
      if (!this.visible) return;
      this.close();
    }, this.commandOwner);

    this.inputEngine.registerCommand('widget.filterInline.nextMatch', () => {
      if (!this.visible) return;
      this.onNext();
    }, this.commandOwner);

    this.inputEngine.registerCommand('widget.filterInline.prevMatch', () => {
      if (!this.visible) return;
      this.onPrev();
    }, this.commandOwner);
  }

  private unregisterInputCommands(): void {
    this.inputEngine.unregisterCommand('widget.filterInline.close', this.commandOwner);
    this.inputEngine.unregisterCommand('widget.filterInline.nextMatch', this.commandOwner);
    this.inputEngine.unregisterCommand('widget.filterInline.prevMatch', this.commandOwner);
  }
}

import {
  ChangeDetectionStrategy,
  ChangeDetectorRef,
  Component,
  ElementRef,

  Input,
  OnDestroy,
  OnInit,

import { CommonModule } from '@angular/common';

import { InputEngineService } from '../services/input-engine.service';
import type { InputBindingDefinition } from '../services/input-system.types';

const COMMAND = {
  close: 'close',
  next: 'next',
  previous: 'previous',
} as const;

function bindings(
  paneId: string,
  contextId: string,
): readonly InputBindingDefinition[] {
  const base = `reassembly.filter.${paneId}`;
  return [
    {
      id: `${base}.close.escape`,
      commandId: `${base}.${COMMAND.close}`,
      contextId,
      source: 'default',
      description: 'Close filter',
      category: 'Search & Filter',
      when: 'typing',
      trigger: { device: 'keyboard', chord: { steps: [{ key: 'escape' }] } },
    },
    {
      id: `${base}.next.enter`,
      commandId: `${base}.${COMMAND.next}`,
      contextId,
      source: 'default',
      description: 'Next filter match',
      category: 'Search & Filter',
      when: 'typing',
      trigger: { device: 'keyboard', chord: { steps: [{ key: 'enter' }] } },
    },
    {
      id: `${base}.next.f3`,
      commandId: `${base}.${COMMAND.next}`,
      contextId,
      source: 'default',
      description: 'Next filter match',
      category: 'Search & Filter',
      when: 'typing',
      trigger: { device: 'keyboard', chord: { steps: [{ key: 'f3' }] } },
    },
    {
      id: `${base}.previous.shiftF3`,
      commandId: `${base}.${COMMAND.previous}`,
      contextId,
      source: 'default',
      description: 'Previous filter match',
      category: 'Search & Filter',
      when: 'typing',
      trigger: {
        device: 'keyboard',
        chord: { steps: [{ key: 'f3', modifiers: ['shift'] }] },
      },
    },
    {
      id: `${base}.previous.shiftEnter`,
      commandId: `${base}.${COMMAND.previous}`,
      contextId,
      source: 'default',
      description: 'Previous filter match',
      category: 'Search & Filter',
      when: 'typing',
      trigger: {
        device: 'keyboard',
        chord: { steps: [{ key: 'enter', modifiers: ['shift'] }] },
      },
    },
  ];
}

@Component({
  selector: 'app-filter',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [CommonModule, FormsModule],
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
  template: `
    <div class="filter" *ngIf="visible">
      <span class="glyph" aria-hidden="true">⌕</span>

      <input
        #input
        [(ngModel)]="value"
        (ngModelChange)="valueChange.emit($event)"
        (focus)="activateContext()"
        placeholder="Filter current folder"
        autocomplete="off"
        spellcheck="false"
        aria-label="Filter current folder" />

      <span class="count">

      </span>

  styles: [`

export class FilterComponent implements OnInit, OnDestroy {
  @ViewChild('input') input?: ElementRef<HTMLInputElement>;

  @Input() paneId: 'left' | 'right' = 'left';
  @Input() visible = false;
  @Input() value = '';
  @Input() matchCount = 0;
  @Input() totalCount = -1;

  @Output() valueChange = new EventEmitter<string>();
  @Output() close = new EventEmitter<void>();
  @Output() next = new EventEmitter<void>();
  @Output() previous = new EventEmitter<void>();

  private registeredBindings: readonly InputBindingDefinition[] = [];

  constructor(
    private readonly inputEngine: InputEngineService,
    private readonly cdr: ChangeDetectorRef,
  ) {}

  private get contextId(): string {
    return `reassembly.filter.${this.paneId}`;
  }

  private commandId(name: string): string {
    return `reassembly.filter.${this.paneId}.${name}`;
  }

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.inputEngine.registerContext({
      id: this.contextId,
      kind: 'overlay',
      priority: 240,
      parentId: 'reassembly.manager',
      exclusive: true,
      description: `Inline folder filter (${this.paneId})`,
    });

    this.inputEngine.registerCommandDescriptor({
      id: this.commandId(COMMAND.close),
      title: 'Close Filter',
      category: 'Search & Filter',
      execute: () => this.close.emit(),
    }, this.contextId);

    this.inputEngine.registerCommandDescriptor({
      id: this.commandId(COMMAND.next),
      title: 'Next Filter Match',
      category: 'Search & Filter',
      execute: () => this.next.emit(),
    }, this.contextId);

    this.inputEngine.registerCommandDescriptor({
      id: this.commandId(COMMAND.previous),
      title: 'Previous Filter Match',
      category: 'Search & Filter',
      execute: () => this.previous.emit(),
    }, this.contextId);

    this.registeredBindings = bindings(this.paneId, this.contextId);
    for (const binding of this.registeredBindings) {
      this.inputEngine.registerBinding(binding);
    }
  }

  ngOnDestroy(): void {
    this.inputEngine.deactivateContext(this.contextId);

    for (const binding of this.registeredBindings) {
      this.inputEngine.unregisterBinding(binding.id);
    }

    for (const name of Object.values(COMMAND)) {
      this.inputEngine.unregisterCommandDescriptor(
        this.commandId(name),
        this.contextId,
      );
    }
  }

  focus(select = false): void {
    if (!this.visible) return;

    queueMicrotask(() => {
      const input = this.input?.nativeElement;
      if (!input) return;
      input.focus();
      if (select) input.select();
      this.activateContext();
    });
  }

  activateContext(): void {
    if (!this.visible) return;
    this.inputEngine.activateContext(this.contextId);
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
  }

  deactivateContext(): void {
    this.inputEngine.deactivateContext(this.contextId);
  }
}
`````

export function rememberFocusedElement(): HTMLElement | null {
  const active = document.activeElement;
  return active instanceof HTMLElement ? active : null;
}

export function restoreFocusedElement(element: HTMLElement | null): void {
  queueMicrotask(() => {
    if (element?.isConnected) {
      element.focus({ preventScroll: true });
    }
  });
}

import { SimpleChange } from '@angular/core';
import { fn } from '../testing/jasmine-test-helpers';
import { InputCenterComponent } from './input-center.component';
import type { InputBindingConflict, InputBindingDefinition } from '../services/input-system.types';

function binding(id: string, key: string): InputBindingDefinition {
  return {
    id,
    commandId: `command.${id}`,
    contextId: 'global',
    source: 'default',
    description: id,
    category: 'Test',
    enabled: true,
    trigger: { device: 'keyboard', chord: { steps: [{ key }] } },
  };
}

describe('InputCenterComponent presentation cache', () => {
  it('builds bindings and conflicts once when opened and reuses the conflict index per row', () => {
    const bindings = [binding('one', 'a'), binding('two', 'a')];
    const conflicts: InputBindingConflict[] = [{
      bindingId: 'one',
      conflictingBindingId: 'two',
      winnerBindingId: 'one',
      loserBindingId: 'two',
      reason: 'same-context',
    }];
    const customization = {
      bindings: fn(() => bindings),
      conflicts: fn(() => conflicts),
      hasOverride: fn(() => false),
    } as any;
    const subscription = { unsubscribe: fn() };
    const engine = {
      bindings$: { subscribe: fn(() => subscription) },
      formatInputTrigger: fn(() => 'A'),
      getBinding: fn(),
    } as any;
    const component = new InputCenterComponent(
      customization,
      engine,
      {} as any,
      { markForCheck: fn() } as any,
    );

    component.visible = true;
    component.ngOnChanges({ visible: new SimpleChange(false, true, false) });

    expect(customization.bindings).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    expect(customization.conflicts).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    expect(component.visibleBindings.length).toBe(2);

    for (let i = 0; i < 20; i += 1) {
      expect(component.conflictsFor('one').length).toBe(1);
    }

    expect(customization.conflicts).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    component.ngOnDestroy();
    expect(subscription.unsubscribe).toHaveBeenCalled();
  });
});

## File: manager/frontend/src/app/components/input.audit.ts
`````typescript
// Lightweight structural audit for reassembly input wiring.
// This intentionally has no Angular dependency and can be copied into a test
// or build script. It documents invariants the reassembly must preserve.

export interface AuditableBinding {
  id: string;
  commandId: string;
}

export interface InputAuditResult {
  duplicateBindingIds: string[];
  bindingsWithoutCommands: string[];
  commandsWithoutDescriptors: string[];
}

export function auditInputCatalog(
  bindings: readonly AuditableBinding[],
  commandIds: readonly string[],
  descriptorIds: readonly string[],
): InputAuditResult {
  const duplicateBindingIds = duplicates(bindings.map(binding => binding.id));
  const commandSet = new Set(commandIds);
  const descriptorSet = new Set(descriptorIds);

  return {
    duplicateBindingIds,
    bindingsWithoutCommands: unique(
      bindings
        .map(binding => binding.commandId)
        .filter(commandId => !commandSet.has(commandId)),
    ),
    commandsWithoutDescriptors: unique(
      commandIds.filter(commandId => !descriptorSet.has(commandId)),
    ),
  };
}

function duplicates(values: readonly string[]): string[] {
  const counts = new Map<string, number>();
  for (const value of values) {
    counts.set(value, (counts.get(value) ?? 0) + 1);
  }
  return [...counts]
    .filter(([, count]) => count > 1)
    .map(([value]) => value)
    .sort();
}

function unique(values: readonly string[]): string[] {
  return [...new Set(values)].sort();
}

import {

  SimpleChanges, ViewChild, ElementRef, NgZone, HostBinding,
  ChangeDetectionStrategy,
} from '@angular/core';
import { NativeBrowserPaneService } from '../services/native-browser-pane.service';
import { NativeOverlayFreezeService } from '../services/native-overlay-freeze.service';

/**
 * Manages a native Win32 browser overlay that tracks its host element position.
 *
 * The overlay is automatically replaced with a canvas screenshot when:
 *  - The split-divider is hovered / dragged (`divider-hover`, `divider-dragging`)
 *  - A modal session is active (`native-overlay-frozen` on body)
 *
 * Usage:
 * ```html
 * <app-native-overlay
 *   [surfaceId]="surfaceId"
 *   [url]="currentPath"
 *   [active]="surfaceActive">
 * </app-native-overlay>
 * ```
 */
@Component({
  selector: 'app-native-overlay',
  standalone: true,
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
  template: `
    <div #host class="native-overlay-host">
      <div #backdrop class="native-overlay-backdrop"></div>
      <canvas #screenshotCanvas class="native-overlay-canvas"></canvas>
    </div>
  `,
  styles: [`
    :host {
      display: block;
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      position: relative;
      flex: 1 1 auto;
      min-width: 0;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .native-overlay-host {
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      position: relative;
      z-index: var(--vsc-z-native-overlay);
    }

    .native-overlay-backdrop {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
    }

    .native-overlay-canvas {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      display: none;
      z-index: 1;
      pointer-events: none;
      image-rendering: auto;
    }
  `],
})
export class NativeOverlayComponent implements OnChanges, OnDestroy, AfterViewInit {
  @HostBinding('style.backgroundColor') hostBackgroundColor = 'var(--vsc-on-accent)';
  @ViewChild('host') private hostEl?: ElementRef<HTMLElement>;
  @ViewChild('backdrop') private backdropEl?: ElementRef<HTMLElement>;
  @ViewChild('screenshotCanvas') private canvasEl?: ElementRef<HTMLCanvasElement>;

  @Input() surfaceId = '';
  @Input() url = '';
  @Input() active = true;

  // ── Sync state ──────────────────────────────────────────────

  private syncTimer: ReturnType<typeof setInterval> | null = null;
  private syncFrame: number | null = null;
  private syncInFlight = false;
  private syncQueued = false;
  private lastSyncKey = '';

  // ── Screenshot / freeze state ───────────────────────────────

  private wasFrozen = false;
  private capturingScreenshot = false;
  private screenshotVisible = false;
  private screenshotRequestId = 0;
  private lastScreenshotWidth = 0;
  private lastScreenshotHeight = 0;
  private lastScreenshotURL = '';
  private subpixelOffsetX = 0;
  private subpixelOffsetY = 0;
  private hoverFreezeActive = false;
  private documentBackgroundColor: string | null = null;
  private documentBackgroundRequestInFlight = false;
  private lastDocumentBackgroundURL = '';
  private lastDocumentBackgroundRequestAt = 0;
  private screenshotPending = false;
  private forceFreshScreenshot = false;
  private screenshotCooldownTimer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null = null;
  private lastScreenshotStartedAt = 0;
  private readonly screenshotMinInterval = 50;
  private readonly screenshotPrewarmDelayMs = 16;
  private readonly documentBackgroundRetryMs = 350;
  private readonly documentBackgroundRefreshMs = 2000;
  private readonly frozenCanvasBackgroundToken = '--vsc-on-accent';

  private get frozenCanvasBackground(): string {
    return getComputedStyle(this.hostEl?.nativeElement ?? document.documentElement)
      .getPropertyValue(this.frozenCanvasBackgroundToken)
      .trim();
  }
  private liveBackgroundColor = 'var(--vsc-on-accent)';
  private documentBackgroundRequestToken = 0;
  private screenshotPrewarmTimer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null = null;

  private measureHostBounds(host: HTMLElement): {
    rect: DOMRect;
    scale: number;
    x: number;
    y: number;
    width: number;
    height: number;
    cssWidth: number;
    cssHeight: number;
    subpixelOffsetX: number;
    subpixelOffsetY: number;
  } {
    const rect = host.getBoundingClientRect();
    const scale = (typeof window !== 'undefined' && Number.isFinite(window.devicePixelRatio) && window.devicePixelRatio > 0)
      ? window.devicePixelRatio
      : 1;
    const left = Math.round(rect.left * scale);
    const top = Math.round(rect.top * scale);
    const right = Math.round(rect.right * scale);
    const bottom = Math.round(rect.bottom * scale);
    const width = Math.max(0, right - left);
    const height = Math.max(0, bottom - top);

    return {
      rect,
      scale,
      x: left,
      y: top,
      width,
      height,

      // To make the captured image perfectly align back into CSS DOM space:
      cssWidth: width / scale,
      cssHeight: height / scale,
      subpixelOffsetX: (rect.left * scale - left) / scale,
      subpixelOffsetY: (rect.top * scale - top) / scale,
    };
  }

  // ── Event handlers ──────────────────────────────────────────

  private readonly onDividerStateChange = () => {
    this.updateHoverFreezeState();
    if (this.active && this.isFreezeRequested()) {
      this.revealCachedCanvasIfAvailable();
    }
    this.refreshTracking();
    this.requestSync();
  };

  private readonly onFreezeChange = () => {
    this.refreshTracking();
    this.requestSync();
  };

  private readonly onDividerMove = () => {
    if (!this.active || !document.body.classList.contains('divider-dragging')) {
      return;
    }
    this.scheduleFrameSync();
    this.requestScreenshotRefresh();
  };

  constructor(
    private nativeBrowserPane: NativeBrowserPaneService,
    private zone: NgZone,
    private overlayFreeze: NativeOverlayFreezeService,
  ) {}

  // ── Lifecycle ───────────────────────────────────────────────

  ngAfterViewInit(): void {
    window.addEventListener('file-manager-divider-statechange', this.onDividerStateChange);
    window.addEventListener('file-manager-divider-move', this.onDividerMove);
    window.addEventListener('native-overlay-freeze-change', this.onFreezeChange);
    this.refresh();
  }

  ngOnChanges(changes: SimpleChanges): void {
    const urlChanged = !!changes['url'];
    const surfaceChanged = !!changes['surfaceId'];

    if (urlChanged || surfaceChanged) {
      this.documentBackgroundRequestToken++;
      this.screenshotRequestId++;
      this.lastSyncKey = '';
      this.documentBackgroundColor = null;
      this.documentBackgroundRequestInFlight = false;
      this.lastDocumentBackgroundURL = '';
      this.lastDocumentBackgroundRequestAt = 0;

      const hasCachedScreenshot = this.screenshotVisible || this.hasCachedCanvas();
      const preserveScreenshotDuringSwap = urlChanged && !surfaceChanged && hasCachedScreenshot;

      if (preserveScreenshotDuringSwap) {
        this.wasFrozen = this.isFreezeRequested();
        this.revealCachedCanvasIfAvailable();
        this.screenshotPending = true;
        this.forceFreshScreenshot = true;
        this.lastScreenshotStartedAt = 0;
      } else {
        this.wasFrozen = false;
        this.hoverFreezeActive = false;
        this.hideCanvas(true);
      }
    }
    if (changes['active'] && this.active) {
      this.lastSyncKey = '';
      this.lastDocumentBackgroundRequestAt = 0;
    }
    if (urlChanged || changes['active'] || surfaceChanged) {
      this.refresh();
    }
  }

  ngOnDestroy(): void {
    window.removeEventListener('file-manager-divider-statechange', this.onDividerStateChange);
    window.removeEventListener('file-manager-divider-move', this.onDividerMove);
    window.removeEventListener('native-overlay-freeze-change', this.onFreezeChange);
    this.stopTracking();
    void this.nativeBrowserPane.dispose(this.surfaceId);
  }

  // ── Public ──────────────────────────────────────────────────

  /** The underlying host element (for external getBoundingClientRect, etc.). */
  get hostElement(): HTMLElement | undefined {
    return this.hostEl?.nativeElement;
  }

  // ── Internal: refresh / tracking ────────────────────────────

  private refresh(): void {
    if (!this.active) {
      this.documentBackgroundRequestToken++;
      this.screenshotRequestId++;
      this.wasFrozen = false;
      this.hoverFreezeActive = false;
      this.lastSyncKey = '';
      this.hideCanvas(true);
      this.stopTracking();
      this.requestSync();
      return;
    }
    this.refreshTracking();
    this.requestSync();
  }

  private refreshTracking(): void {
    if (!this.active) {
      this.stopTracking();
      return;
    }
    if (document.body.classList.contains('divider-dragging')) {
      this.stopTimer();
      return;
    }
    this.startTimer();
  }

  private startTimer(): void {
    if (this.syncTimer) {
      return;
    }
    this.zone.runOutsideAngular(() => {
      this.syncTimer = setInterval(() => {
        this.requestSync();
      }, 100);
    });
  }

  private stopTracking(): void {
    this.stopTimer();
    this.clearScreenshotCooldown();
    this.clearScreenshotPrewarm();
    if (this.syncFrame !== null) {
      cancelAnimationFrame(this.syncFrame);
      this.syncFrame = null;
    }
    this.syncQueued = false;
  }

  private stopTimer(): void {
    if (!this.syncTimer) {
      return;
    }
    clearInterval(this.syncTimer);
    this.syncTimer = null;
  }

  private scheduleFrameSync(): void {
    if (this.syncFrame !== null) {
      return;
    }
    this.syncFrame = requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      this.syncFrame = null;
      this.requestSync();
    });
  }

  // ── Internal: sync loop ─────────────────────────────────────

  private requestSync(): void {
    if (this.syncInFlight) {
      this.syncQueued = true;
      return;
    }
    this.syncInFlight = true;
    void this.sync()
      .finally(() => {
        this.syncInFlight = false;
        if (this.syncQueued) {
          this.syncQueued = false;
          this.requestSync();
          return;
        }
        if (this.screenshotPending && this.isFreezeRequested()) {
          this.scheduleScreenshotCooldown(16);
        }
      });
  }

  private async sync(): Promise<void> {
    if (!this.surfaceId) {
      return;
    }

    const theme = this.resolveTheme();
    const backgroundColor = this.documentBackgroundColor ?? this.resolveBackgroundColor(theme);
    this.liveBackgroundColor = backgroundColor;
    this.applyBackgroundColor(this.screenshotVisible ? this.frozenCanvasBackground : backgroundColor);

    // ── Freeze transitions ────────────────────────────────────
    const frozen = this.isFreezeRequested();

    if (frozen && !this.wasFrozen && this.active) {
      this.wasFrozen = true;
      void this.prepareScreenshot();
    }

    if (!frozen && this.wasFrozen) {
      this.wasFrozen = false;
      this.hoverFreezeActive = false;
      
      const expectedId = ++this.screenshotRequestId;
      // Delay hiding the canvas slightly so the native Win32 window has time
      // to paint on screen, eliminating the transparent flicker during unfreeze.
      setTimeout(() => {
        if (this.screenshotRequestId === expectedId && !this.wasFrozen) {
          this.hideCanvas(false);
        }
      }, 100);
    }

    // Hide native pane only after we have a screenshot to replace it.
    const freezeNativePane = this.shouldFreezeNativePane()
      && this.screenshotVisible;

    // ── Hidden ────────────────────────────────────────────────
    if (!this.active) {
      this.lastSyncKey = '';
      await this.nativeBrowserPane.sync({
        surfaceId: this.surfaceId,
        url: this.url,
        theme,
        backgroundColor,
        visible: false,
        x: 0, y: 0, width: 0, height: 0,
      });
      return;
    }

    // ── Measure host element ──────────────────────────────────
    const host = this.hostEl?.nativeElement;
    if (!host) {
      return;
    }

    const bounds = this.measureHostBounds(host);

    // Track sub-pixel offset between Win32 integer position and CSS element edge.
    this.subpixelOffsetX = bounds.subpixelOffsetX;
    this.subpixelOffsetY = bounds.subpixelOffsetY;
    if (bounds.width <= 0 || bounds.height <= 0) {
      return;
    }

    const request = {
      surfaceId: this.surfaceId,
      url: this.url,
      theme,
      backgroundColor,
      visible: !freezeNativePane,
      x: bounds.x,
      y: bounds.y,
      width: bounds.width,
      height: bounds.height,
    };
    const syncKey = JSON.stringify(request);
    if (syncKey === this.lastSyncKey) {
      this.scheduleScreenshotPrewarm();
      if (!frozen) {
        this.requestDocumentBackground(false, theme);
      }
      return;
    }

    try {
      if (await this.nativeBrowserPane.sync(request)) {
        this.lastSyncKey = syncKey;
        this.scheduleScreenshotPrewarm();
        if (!frozen) {
          this.requestDocumentBackground(false, theme);
        }
      }
    } catch (error) {
      void error;
    }
  }

  // ── Internal: freeze detection ──────────────────────────────

  private isDividerInteracting(): boolean {
    return document.body.classList.contains('divider-hover')
      || document.body.classList.contains('divider-dragging');
  }

  private isFreezeRequested(): boolean {
    return this.isDividerInteracting()
      || this.overlayFreeze.frozen;
  }

  private shouldFreezeNativePane(): boolean {
    return this.isFreezeRequested()
      || this.hoverFreezeActive;
  }

  private updateHoverFreezeState(): void {
    if (document.body.classList.contains('divider-dragging')) {
      this.hoverFreezeActive = true;
      return;
    }
    if (document.body.classList.contains('divider-hover')) {
      return;
    }
    this.hoverFreezeActive = false;
  }

  // ── Internal: screenshot capture ────────────────────────────

  private async prepareScreenshot(): Promise<void> {
    this.screenshotPending = true;
    this.forceFreshScreenshot = true;
    if (this.isFreezeRequested()) {
      this.revealCachedCanvasIfAvailable();
    }
    if (this.syncInFlight) {
      this.scheduleScreenshotCooldown(16);
      return;
    }
    this.maybeStartScreenshotCapture();
  }

  private async captureScreenshot(forceRefresh: boolean, allowWithoutFreeze = false, reveal = true): Promise<void> {
    if (!this.surfaceId || !this.active || this.capturingScreenshot || (!forceRefresh && this.screenshotVisible)) {
      return;
    }

    const requestId = ++this.screenshotRequestId;
    this.capturingScreenshot = true;
    try {
      const data = await this.nativeBrowserPane.captureScreenshot(this.surfaceId);
      if (!data || requestId !== this.screenshotRequestId || (!allowWithoutFreeze && !this.isFreezeRequested())) {
        return;
      }
      const drawn = await this.drawOnCanvas(data, requestId, reveal, allowWithoutFreeze);
      if (!drawn || requestId !== this.screenshotRequestId || (!allowWithoutFreeze && !this.isFreezeRequested())) {
        return;
      }
      if (reveal && !document.body.classList.contains('divider-dragging') && document.body.classList.contains('divider-hover')) {
        this.hoverFreezeActive = true;
      }
      this.lastSyncKey = '';
      if (reveal) {
        this.requestSync();
      }
    } catch (e) {
      void e;
    } finally {
      this.capturingScreenshot = false;
      if (this.isFreezeRequested() && (this.screenshotPending || this.shouldRefreshScreenshot())) {
        this.requestScreenshotRefresh();
      }
    }
  }

  private requestScreenshotRefresh(): void {
    if (!this.isFreezeRequested()) {
      return;
    }
    this.clearScreenshotPrewarm();
    this.screenshotPending = true;
    this.maybeStartScreenshotCapture();
  }

  private scheduleScreenshotPrewarm(): void {
    if (!this.active || !this.surfaceId || !this.url || this.isFreezeRequested() || this.capturingScreenshot) {
      this.clearScreenshotPrewarm();
      return;
    }
    if (this.lastScreenshotURL === this.url && this.hasCachedCanvas()) {
      this.clearScreenshotPrewarm();
      return;
    }
    if (this.screenshotPrewarmTimer !== null) {
      return;
    }
    this.screenshotPrewarmTimer = setTimeout(() => {
      this.screenshotPrewarmTimer = null;
      if (!this.active || !this.surfaceId || !this.url || this.isFreezeRequested() || this.capturingScreenshot) {
        return;
      }
      void this.captureScreenshot(true, true, false);
    }, this.screenshotPrewarmDelayMs);
  }

  private clearScreenshotPrewarm(): void {
    if (this.screenshotPrewarmTimer === null) {
      return;
    }
    clearTimeout(this.screenshotPrewarmTimer);
    this.screenshotPrewarmTimer = null;
  }

  private maybeStartScreenshotCapture(): void {
    if (!this.screenshotPending || !this.isFreezeRequested() || this.capturingScreenshot) {
      return;
    }
    if (this.syncInFlight) {
      this.scheduleScreenshotCooldown(16);
      return;
    }
    const elapsed = Date.now() - this.lastScreenshotStartedAt;
    if (elapsed < this.screenshotMinInterval) {
      this.scheduleScreenshotCooldown(this.screenshotMinInterval - elapsed);
      return;
    }
    if (this.screenshotVisible && !this.forceFreshScreenshot && !this.shouldRefreshScreenshot()) {
      this.screenshotPending = false;
      return;
    }
    this.clearScreenshotCooldown();
    this.screenshotPending = false;
    this.forceFreshScreenshot = false;
    this.lastScreenshotStartedAt = Date.now();
    void this.captureScreenshot(true);
  }

  private scheduleScreenshotCooldown(delay: number): void {
    if (this.screenshotCooldownTimer !== null) {
      return;
    }
    this.screenshotCooldownTimer = setTimeout(() => {
      this.screenshotCooldownTimer = null;
      this.maybeStartScreenshotCapture();
    }, Math.max(0, delay));
  }

  private clearScreenshotCooldown(): void {
    if (this.screenshotCooldownTimer === null) {
      return;
    }
    clearTimeout(this.screenshotCooldownTimer);
    this.screenshotCooldownTimer = null;
  }

  private shouldRefreshScreenshot(): boolean {
    if (!document.body.classList.contains('divider-dragging')) {
      return false;
    }
    const host = this.hostEl?.nativeElement;
    if (!host) {
      return false;
    }
    const rect = host.getBoundingClientRect();
    return Math.abs(rect.width - this.lastScreenshotWidth) >= 8
      || Math.abs(rect.height - this.lastScreenshotHeight) >= 8;
  }

  // ── Internal: canvas rendering ──────────────────────────────

  private drawOnCanvas(base64Data: string, requestId: number, reveal: boolean, allowWithoutFreeze: boolean): Promise<boolean> {
    const host = this.hostEl?.nativeElement;
    const canvas = this.canvasEl?.nativeElement;
    if (!canvas || !host) {
      return Promise.resolve(false);
    }
    const bounds = this.measureHostBounds(host);
    return this.decodeBitmap(base64Data).then((bitmap) => {
      if (!bitmap) {
        return false;
      }
      return new Promise<boolean>((resolve) => {
        if (requestId !== this.screenshotRequestId || (!allowWithoutFreeze && !this.isFreezeRequested())) {
          if ('close' in bitmap) {
            (bitmap as ImageBitmap).close();
          }
          resolve(false);
          return;
        }

        // Set backing-store to match the screenshot's native resolution.
        canvas.width = bitmap.width;
        canvas.height = bitmap.height;
        canvas.style.width = `${bounds.cssWidth}px`;
        canvas.style.height = `${bounds.cssHeight}px`;

        const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d', { alpha: false });
        if (!ctx) {
          if ('close' in bitmap) {
            (bitmap as ImageBitmap).close();
          }
          resolve(false);
          return;
        }
        ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'source-over';
        ctx.fillStyle = this.frozenCanvasBackground;
        ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
        ctx.drawImage(bitmap, 0, 0);

        if ('close' in bitmap) {
          (bitmap as ImageBitmap).close();
        }

        if (reveal) {
          this.showCanvas();
          this.lastScreenshotWidth = bounds.rect.width;
          this.lastScreenshotHeight = bounds.rect.height;
          this.lastScreenshotURL = this.url;

          if (document.body.classList.contains('divider-dragging')) {
            this.screenshotVisible = true;
            resolve(true);
            return;
          }
          
          requestAnimationFrame(() => {
            requestAnimationFrame(() => {
              if (requestId === this.screenshotRequestId) {
                this.screenshotVisible = true;
                resolve(true);
              } else {
                resolve(false);
              }
            });
          });
        } else {
          this.hideCanvasElement(canvas);
          this.lastScreenshotWidth = bounds.rect.width;
          this.lastScreenshotHeight = bounds.rect.height;
          this.lastScreenshotURL = this.url;
          this.screenshotVisible = false;
          resolve(true);
        }
      });
    });
  }

  private hideCanvas(clearCache: boolean): void {
    this.screenshotVisible = false;
    this.lastScreenshotWidth = 0;
    this.lastScreenshotHeight = 0;
    this.screenshotPending = false;
    this.forceFreshScreenshot = false;
    this.lastScreenshotStartedAt = 0;
    this.clearScreenshotCooldown();
    const canvas = this.canvasEl?.nativeElement ?? null;
    if (canvas) {
      this.hideCanvasElement(canvas);
    }
    this.applyBackgroundColor(this.liveBackgroundColor);
    if (clearCache) {
      this.lastScreenshotURL = '';
      this.clearCanvasBitmap(canvas);
    }
  }

  private showCanvas(): void {
    const canvas = this.canvasEl?.nativeElement;
    if (!canvas) {
      return;
    }
    // Shift canvas by the sub-pixel offset so the screenshot content
    // aligns with the exact physical pixel position of the Win32 window.
    if (this.subpixelOffsetX !== 0 || this.subpixelOffsetY !== 0) {
      canvas.style.transform = `translate(${-this.subpixelOffsetX}px, ${-this.subpixelOffsetY}px)`;
    } else {
      canvas.style.transform = '';
    }
    // Use page background color so an empty canvas (before screenshot arrives)
    // matches the page rather than flashing white.
    const bg = this.documentBackgroundColor || this.liveBackgroundColor;
    canvas.style.background = bg;
    this.applyBackgroundColor(bg);
    canvas.style.zIndex = '2';
    canvas.style.display = 'block';
  }

  private hideCanvasElement(canvas: HTMLCanvasElement): void {
    canvas.style.display = 'none';
    canvas.style.transform = '';
    canvas.style.zIndex = '1';
    canvas.style.background = '';
  }

  private clearCanvasBitmap(canvas: HTMLCanvasElement | null): void {
    if (!canvas) {
      return;
    }
    canvas.width = 0;
    canvas.height = 0;
    canvas.style.width = '';
    canvas.style.height = '';
  }

  private revealCachedCanvasIfAvailable(): void {
    if (this.screenshotVisible) {
      return;
    }
    if (this.lastScreenshotURL !== this.url) {
      return;
    }
    if (!this.hasCachedCanvas()) {
      return;
    }
    this.showCanvas();
    if (document.body.classList.contains('divider-hover')) {
      this.hoverFreezeActive = true;
    }
    this.screenshotVisible = true;
    this.lastSyncKey = '';
    this.requestSync();
  }

  private hasCachedCanvas(): boolean {
    const canvas = this.canvasEl?.nativeElement;
    return !!canvas && canvas.width > 0 && canvas.height > 0;
  }

  private async decodeBitmap(base64Data: string): Promise<ImageBitmap | HTMLImageElement | null> {
    const dataUrl = `data:image/png;base64,${base64Data}`;
    if (typeof createImageBitmap === 'function') {
      try {
        const response = await fetch(dataUrl);
        const blob = await response.blob();
        return await createImageBitmap(blob);
      } catch {
        // Fall through to HTMLImageElement
      }
    }
    return await new Promise<HTMLImageElement | null>((resolve) => {
      const img = new Image();
      img.onload = () => resolve(img);
      img.onerror = () => resolve(null);
      img.src = dataUrl;
    });
  }

  // ── Internal: color helpers ─────────────────────────────────

  private resolveTheme(): 'dark' | 'light' {
    return document.documentElement.classList.contains('vscode-light') ? 'light' : 'dark';
  }

  private resolveBackgroundColor(_theme: 'dark' | 'light'): string {
    return 'var(--vsc-on-accent)';
  }

  private parseColor(value: string): { r: number; g: number; b: number; a: number } | null {
    const normalized = (value ?? '').trim().toLowerCase();
    if (!normalized || normalized === 'transparent') {
      return null;
    }

    const clampByte = (input: number): number => Math.max(0, Math.min(255, Math.round(input)));
    const clampAlpha = (input: number): number => Math.max(0, Math.min(1, input));

    const hex6 = normalized.match(/^#([0-9a-f]{6})$/i);
    if (hex6) {
      return {
        r: parseInt(hex6[1].slice(0, 2), 16),
        g: parseInt(hex6[1].slice(2, 4), 16),
        b: parseInt(hex6[1].slice(4, 6), 16),
        a: 1,
      };
    }

    const hex3 = normalized.match(/^#([0-9a-f]{3})$/i);
    if (hex3) {
      return {
        r: parseInt(`${hex3[1][0]}${hex3[1][0]}`, 16),
        g: parseInt(`${hex3[1][1]}${hex3[1][1]}`, 16),
        b: parseInt(`${hex3[1][2]}${hex3[1][2]}`, 16),
        a: 1,
      };
    }

    const hex8 = normalized.match(/^#([0-9a-f]{8})$/i);
    if (hex8) {
      return {
        r: parseInt(hex8[1].slice(0, 2), 16),
        g: parseInt(hex8[1].slice(2, 4), 16),
        b: parseInt(hex8[1].slice(4, 6), 16),
        a: parseInt(hex8[1].slice(6, 8), 16) / 255,
      };
    }

    const hex4 = normalized.match(/^#([0-9a-f]{4})$/i);
    if (hex4) {
      return {
        r: parseInt(`${hex4[1][0]}${hex4[1][0]}`, 16),
        g: parseInt(`${hex4[1][1]}${hex4[1][1]}`, 16),
        b: parseInt(`${hex4[1][2]}${hex4[1][2]}`, 16),
        a: parseInt(`${hex4[1][3]}${hex4[1][3]}`, 16) / 255,
      };
    }

    const rgb = normalized.match(/^rgba?\(\s*(\d{1,3})\s*,\s*(\d{1,3})\s*,\s*(\d{1,3})(?:\s*,\s*([\d.]+)\s*)?\)$/i);
    if (rgb) {
      return {
        r: clampByte(Number(rgb[1])),
        g: clampByte(Number(rgb[2])),
        b: clampByte(Number(rgb[3])),
        a: clampAlpha(rgb[4] !== undefined ? Number(rgb[4]) : 1),
      };
    }

    return null;
  }

  private toHex(color: { r: number; g: number; b: number }): string {
    const hex = (c: number) => Math.max(0, Math.min(255, Math.round(c))).toString(16).padStart(2, '0');
    return `#${hex(color.r)}${hex(color.g)}${hex(color.b)}`;
  }

  private compositeColor(
    foreground: { r: number; g: number; b: number; a: number },
    background: { r: number; g: number; b: number; a: number },
  ): { r: number; g: number; b: number } {
    const alpha = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, foreground.a));
    return {
      r: foreground.r * alpha + background.r * (1 - alpha),
      g: foreground.g * alpha + background.g * (1 - alpha),
      b: foreground.b * alpha + background.b * (1 - alpha),
    };
  }

  private normalizeColorToHex(value: string, fallback: string): string {
    const color = this.parseColor(value);
    if (!color) {
      return fallback;
    }
    if (color.a <= 0) {
      return fallback;
    }
    if (color.a >= 1) {
      return this.toHex(color);
    }
    const background = this.parseColor(fallback);
    if (!background) {
      return fallback;
    }
    return this.toHex(this.compositeColor(color, background));
  }

  private applyBackgroundColor(color: string): void {
    this.hostBackgroundColor = color;
    const host = this.hostEl?.nativeElement;
    if (host) {
      host.style.backgroundColor = color;
    }

    const backdrop = this.backdropEl?.nativeElement;
    if (backdrop) {
      backdrop.style.backgroundColor = color;
    }
  }

  private requestDocumentBackground(force: boolean, theme: 'dark' | 'light'): void {
    if (!this.active || !this.surfaceId || !this.url || this.documentBackgroundRequestInFlight) {
      return;
    }

    const now = Date.now();
    const sameURL = this.lastDocumentBackgroundURL === this.url;
    if (!force) {
      if (sameURL && this.documentBackgroundColor && (now - this.lastDocumentBackgroundRequestAt) < this.documentBackgroundRefreshMs) {
        return;
      }
      if (sameURL && (now - this.lastDocumentBackgroundRequestAt) < this.documentBackgroundRetryMs) {
        return;
      }
    }

    this.documentBackgroundRequestInFlight = true;
    const requestURL = this.url;
    const requestToken = ++this.documentBackgroundRequestToken;
    this.lastDocumentBackgroundURL = requestURL;
    this.lastDocumentBackgroundRequestAt = now;
    const fallback = this.resolveBackgroundColor(theme);

    void this.nativeBrowserPane.getDocumentBackground(this.surfaceId)
      .then((value) => {
        if (requestToken !== this.documentBackgroundRequestToken || requestURL !== this.url || !this.active) {
          return;
        }
        const normalized = this.normalizeColorToHex(value, fallback);
        if (!normalized || normalized === this.documentBackgroundColor) {
          return;
        }
        this.documentBackgroundColor = normalized;
        this.applyBackgroundColor(normalized);
        this.lastSyncKey = '';
        this.requestSync();
      })
      .catch(() => {
        if (requestToken === this.documentBackgroundRequestToken && requestURL === this.url && this.active && !this.documentBackgroundColor) {
          this.applyBackgroundColor(fallback);
        }
      })
      .finally(() => {
        this.documentBackgroundRequestInFlight = false;
      });
  }

}
`````

## File: manager/frontend/src/app/components/navigation.controller.ts
`````typescript
export interface NavigationState {
  entries: string[];
  index: number;
}

export class NavigationController {
  private readonly maxEntries = 200;
  private entries: string[] = [];
  private index = -1;

  constructor(
    private readonly normalizer: (path: string) => string =
      path => path.trim(),
  ) {}


  get canBack(): boolean {
    return this.index > 0;
  }

  get canForward(): boolean {
    return this.index >= 0 && this.index < this.entries.length - 1;
  }

  get current(): string | null {
    return this.index >= 0 ? this.entries[this.index] ?? null : null;
  }

  record(path: string): void {
    const value = this.normalizer(path);
    if (!value) return;

    if (
      this.current !== null &&
      this.normalizer(this.current) === value
    ) return;

    if (this.canForward) {
      this.entries = this.entries.slice(0, this.index + 1);
    }

    this.entries.push(value);

    if (this.entries.length > this.maxEntries) {
      const overflow = this.entries.length - this.maxEntries;
      this.entries = this.entries.slice(overflow);
    }

    this.index = this.entries.length - 1;
  }

  backTarget(): string | null {
    return this.canBack ? this.entries[this.index - 1] ?? null : null;
  }

  forwardTarget(): string | null {
    return this.canForward ? this.entries[this.index + 1] ?? null : null;
  }

  commitBack(path: string): void {
    if (
      this.canBack &&
      this.normalizer(this.entries[this.index - 1] ?? '') ===
        this.normalizer(path)
    ) {
      this.index -= 1;
    }
  }

  commitForward(path: string): void {
    if (
      this.canForward &&
      this.normalizer(this.entries[this.index + 1] ?? '') ===
        this.normalizer(path)
    ) {
      this.index += 1;
    }
  }

  backTrail(limit = 12): readonly string[] {
    if (!this.canBack) return [];
    return this.entries.slice(Math.max(0, this.index - Math.max(1, limit)), this.index).reverse();
  }

  forwardTrail(limit = 12): readonly string[] {
    if (!this.canForward) return [];
    return this.entries.slice(this.index + 1, this.index + 1 + Math.max(1, limit));
  }

  indexOfTrailTarget(path: string): number {
    const value = this.normalizer(path);
    if (!value) return -1;
    let best = -1;
    let distance = Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY;
    for (let i = 0; i < this.entries.length; i += 1) {
      if (this.normalizer(this.entries[i] ?? '') !== value) continue;
      const nextDistance = Math.abs(i - this.index);
      if (nextDistance < distance) {
        best = i;
        distance = nextDistance;
      }
    }
    return best;
  }

  commitIndex(index: number, path: string): boolean {
    if (
      index < 0 ||
      index >= this.entries.length ||
      this.normalizer(this.entries[index] ?? '') !== this.normalizer(path)
    ) return false;
    this.index = index;
    return true;
  }

  snapshot(): readonly string[] {
    return this.entries.slice();
  }

  snapshotState(): NavigationState {
    return {
      entries: this.entries.slice(),
      index: this.index,
    };
  }

  restore(state: NavigationState | null | undefined): void {
    if (!state || !Array.isArray(state.entries)) {
      this.entries = [];
      this.index = -1;
      return;
    }

    const entries = state.entries
      .filter(
        (entry): entry is string =>
          typeof entry === 'string' && !!entry.trim(),
      )
      .map(entry => this.normalizer(entry))
      .filter(Boolean)
      .filter(
        (entry, index, all) =>
          index === 0 || entry !== all[index - 1],
      )
      .slice(-this.maxEntries);

    this.entries = entries;
    this.index = entries.length === 0
      ? -1
      : Math.max(0, Math.min(entries.length - 1, Number(state.index) || 0));
  }

  reset(path?: string): void {
    this.entries = [];
    this.index = -1;
    if (path?.trim()) this.record(path);
  }
}
`````

import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';

const directory = readFileSync(
  new URL('./directory-pane.component.ts', import.meta.url),

  new URL('./network-pane.component.ts', import.meta.url),
  'utf8',
);

function block(source: string, start: string, end: string): string {
  const from = source.indexOf(start);
  if (from < 0) throw new Error(`Missing ${start}`);
  const to = source.indexOf(end, from);
  if (to < 0) throw new Error(`Missing ${end}`);
  return source.slice(from, to + end.length);
}

describe('Network pane Directory clone', () => {
  it('keeps Directory styles byte-for-byte identical', () => {
    expect(block(network, '  styles: [`', '  `]'))
      .toBe(block(directory, '  styles: [`', '  `]'));
  });

  it('keeps Directory Details DOM classes', () => {
    for (const token of [
      'class="details-header"',
      'class="list"',
      'class="entry"',
      'class="icon"',
      'class="name"',
      'class="kind"',
      'class="size"',
      'class="modified"',
      'class="pane-footer"',
    ]) {
      expect(network).toContain(token);
    }
  });

  it('adapts the Directory cells to Network semantics', () => {
    expect(network).toContain("networkField(entry, 'kind')");
    expect(network).toContain("networkField(entry, 'status')");
    expect(network).toContain('networkEndpoints(entry)');
    expect(network).toContain('systemFields?: Record<string, unknown>');
  });

  it('is user-facing Details only', () => {
    expect(network).toContain("viewMode: DirectoryView = 'details';");
    expect(network).not.toContain("setViewMode('list')");
    expect(network).not.toContain("setViewMode('grid')");
    expect(network).not.toContain("setViewMode('tree')");
  });

  it('activates Network entries through the active panel source', () => {
    const method = network.slice(
      network.indexOf('openEntry(entry: FileInfo): void'),
      network.indexOf('onEntryDragStart(', network.indexOf('openEntry(entry: FileInfo): void')),
    );
    expect(method).toContain('activePanelSource.source.activateEntry?.(');
    expect(method).not.toContain('openViewer');
  });
});

import { Component, OnInit, OnDestroy, Input, ElementRef } from '@angular/core';
import { CommonModule } from '@angular/common';
import { OperationService, OperationState } from '../services/operation.service';
import { OperationToastComponent } from './operation-toast.component';
import { createSubject, takeUntil } from '@epikodelabs/streamix';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-operation-toast-stack',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [CommonModule, OperationToastComponent],
  template: `
<div class="stack" *ngIf="!collapsed && ops.length">
<app-operation-toast
*ngFor="let op of ops;trackBy:track"
[operation]="op"
(cancel)="svc.cancel($event)"
(dismiss)="svc.dismiss($event)"
(resolve)="svc.resolveConflict($event.conflictId,$event.resolution,$event.applyToAll)">
</app-operation-toast>
</div>
`,
  styles: [`
:host{
position:fixed;
right:16px;
bottom:30px;
z-index:1000;
}

.stack{
display:flex;
flex-direction:column;
gap:8px;
}
`]
})
export class OperationToastStackComponent implements OnInit, OnDestroy {

  @Input() collapsed = false;
  ops: OperationState[] = [];
  destroy$ = createSubject<void>();

  constructor(public svc: OperationService, public elementRef: ElementRef) { }

  ngOnInit() {
    this.svc.visibleOperations$
      .pipe(takeUntil(this.destroy$))
      .subscribe(o => this.ops = o);
  }

  ngOnDestroy() {
    this.destroy$.next();
    this.destroy$.complete();
  }

  track(_: number, o: OperationState) { return o.id; }
}
`````

import { Component, OnInit, OnDestroy, Input, Output, EventEmitter } from '@angular/core';

  template: `
    <div class="status-operations" *ngIf="hasOperations">
      <div 
        class="status-pill"
        [class.has-active]="hasActive"
        [class.has-conflict]="hasConflict"
        [class.is-expanded]="!toastCollapsed"
        (click)="onPillClick()"

        <span class="pill-label">{{ count }} operation{{ count !== 1 ? 's' : '' }}</span>
        
        <div class="pill-progress" *ngIf="hasActive && !hasConflict && overallProgress > 0">
          <div class="pill-progress-fill" [style.width.%]="overallProgress"></div>
        </div>

        <span class="conflict-badge" *ngIf="hasConflict">⚠️ Conflict</span>

        <svg 
          class="expand-icon"
          [class.expanded]="!toastCollapsed"
          viewBox="0 0 24 24" 
          width="12" 
          height="12" 
          stroke="currentColor"

export class OperationStatusBarComponent implements OnInit, OnDestroy {
  @Input() toastCollapsed = false;
  @Input() stackElement?: Element;
  @Output() toastCollapsedChange = new EventEmitter<boolean>();
  
  operations: OperationState[] = [];
  hasOperations = false;
  hasActive = false;
  hasConflict = false;
  count = 0;
  overallProgress = 0;

  private destroy$ = createSubject<void>();
  private _hideTimer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null = null;
  private _toastDismissTimer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null = null;
  private _mutationSub: { unsubscribe(): void } | null = null;

  constructor(private operationService: OperationService) {}

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.operationService.operations$.pipe(
      takeUntil(this.destroy$)
    ).subscribe(ops => {
      this.operations = Array.from(ops.values());
      this.hasOperations = this.operations.length > 0;
      this.count = this.operations.length;
      
      const activeOps = this.operations.filter(op => op.status === 'running');
      this.hasActive = activeOps.length > 0;
      
      if (activeOps.length > 0) {
        const sum = activeOps.reduce((acc, op) => acc + op.percentComplete, 0);
        this.overallProgress = sum / activeOps.length;
      } else {
        this.overallProgress = 0;
      }

      const conflictOp = this.operations.find(
        op => op.status === 'paused' && !!op.conflictData
      );
      const newHasConflict = !!conflictOp;
      
      if (newHasConflict && !this.hasConflict && this.toastCollapsed) {
        this.toastCollapsed = false;
        this.toastCollapsedChange.emit(false);
      }
      
      this.hasConflict = newHasConflict;
    });
  }

  ngOnDestroy(): void {
    this.destroy$.next();
    this.destroy$.complete();
  }

  onPillClick(): void {
    this.toastCollapsed = !this.toastCollapsed;
    this.toastCollapsedChange.emit(this.toastCollapsed);
  }
}

export class OperationSurfaceComponent implements OnInit, OnDestroy {
  @Output() openDetails = new EventEmitter<void>();

  operations: OperationState[] = [];
  queueJobs: readonly PowerTransferJob[] = [];
  readonly cancelling = new Set<string>();
  readonly applyToAll = new Set<string>();

  private readonly destroy$ = createSubject<void>();

  constructor(
    public readonly operationService: OperationService,
    public readonly powerQueue: PowerFileOperationsService,
    private readonly cdr: ChangeDetectorRef,
  ) {}

  get activeCount(): number {
    return this.operations.filter(operation => this.isActive(operation)).length;
  }

  get pausedCount(): number {
    return this.operations.filter(operation => operation.status === 'paused').length;
  }

  get failedCount(): number {
    return this.operations.filter(operation => operation.status === 'error').length;
  }

  get finishedCount(): number {
    return this.operations.filter(operation => this.canDismiss(operation)).length;
  }

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.powerQueue.jobs$
      .pipe(takeUntil(this.destroy$))
      .subscribe(jobs => {
        this.queueJobs = jobs.filter(job =>
          job.status !== 'completed' || Date.now() - job.createdAt < 15_000
        );
        this.cdr.markForCheck();
      });

    this.operationService.visibleOperations$
      .pipe(takeUntil(this.destroy$))
      .subscribe(operations => {
        this.operations = operations;

        for (const id of Array.from(this.cancelling)) {
          const operation = operations.find(item => item.id === id);
          if (!operation || operation.status === 'cancelled' || operation.status === 'error' || operation.status === 'completed') {
            this.cancelling.delete(id);
          }
        }

        this.cdr.markForCheck();
      });
  }

  ngOnDestroy(): void {
    this.destroy$.next();
    this.destroy$.complete();
  }

  isActive(operation: OperationState): boolean {
    return operation.status === 'running' || operation.status === 'pending';
  }

  canCancel(operation: OperationState): boolean {
    return operation.config.cancellable &&
      (operation.status === 'running' || operation.status === 'pending' || operation.status === 'paused');
  }

  canDismiss(operation: OperationState): boolean {
    return operation.status === 'completed' ||
      operation.status === 'error' ||
      operation.status === 'cancelled';
  }

  statusLabel(operation: OperationState): string {
    if (operation.status === 'paused' && operation.conflictData) {
      return 'waiting for decision';
    }
    return operation.status;
  }

  async cancel(operation: OperationState): Promise<void> {
    if (!this.canCancel(operation) || this.cancelling.has(operation.id)) return;

    this.cancelling.add(operation.id);
    this.cdr.markForCheck();

    await this.operationService.cancel(operation.id);
  }

  dismiss(operation: OperationState): void {
    this.applyToAll.delete(operation.id);
    this.cancelling.delete(operation.id);
    this.operationService.dismiss(operation.id);
  }

  dismissFinished(): void {
    this.operationService.dismissFinished();
  }

  setApplyToAll(operationId: string, event: Event): void {
    const checked = (event.target as HTMLInputElement | null)?.checked ?? false;
    if (checked) {
      this.applyToAll.add(operationId);
    } else {
      this.applyToAll.delete(operationId);
    }
  }

  async resolveConflict(
    operation: OperationState,
    resolution: ConflictResolution,
  ): Promise<void> {
    const conflictId = operation.conflictData?.conflictId;
    if (!conflictId) return;

    const resolved = await this.operationService.resolveConflict(
      conflictId,
      resolution,
      this.applyToAll.has(operation.id),
    );

    if (resolved && (resolution === 'skip' || resolution === 'cancel')) {
      this.applyToAll.delete(operation.id);
    }
  }

  setCollisionPolicy(event: Event): void {
    const value = (event.target as HTMLSelectElement | null)?.value ?? 'ask';
    if (
      value === 'ask' ||
      value === 'overwrite' ||
      value === 'rename' ||
      value === 'skip'
    ) {
      this.operationService.setCollisionPolicy(value);
    }
  }

  toggleQueuePause(): void {
    if (this.powerQueue.isPaused) this.powerQueue.resumeQueue();
    else this.powerQueue.pauseQueue();
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
  }

  retryQueued(job: PowerTransferJob): void {
    this.powerQueue.retry(job.id);
  }

  cancelQueued(job: PowerTransferJob): void {
    this.powerQueue.cancelQueued(job.id);
  }

  dismissQueued(job: PowerTransferJob): void {
    this.powerQueue.dismiss(job.id);
  }

  trackQueueJob(_index: number, job: PowerTransferJob): string {
    return job.id;
  }

  trackOperation(_index: number, operation: OperationState): string {
    return operation.id;
  }

  leafName(path: string): string {
    const normalized = (path ?? '').replace(/\\/g, '/').replace(/\/+$/, '');
    const index = normalized.lastIndexOf('/');
    return index >= 0 ? normalized.slice(index + 1) : normalized;
  }
}

import { FormsModule } from '@angular/forms';

            [style.stroke-dashoffset]="0"/>

            <svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="currentColor"><path d="M8 1a7 7 0 1 0 0 14A7 7 0 0 0 8 1zm3.5 9.1-1.4 1.4L8 9.4l-2.1 2.1-1.4-1.4L6.6 8 4.5 5.9l1.4-1.4L8 6.6l2.1-2.1 1.4 1.4L9.4 8l2.1 2.1z"/></svg>
          </button>
          <button class="icon-btn" *ngIf="isCompleted" (click)="onDismiss($event)" title="Dismiss">
            <svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="currentColor"><path d="M9.41 8 12 5.41 10.59 4 8 6.59 5.41 4 4 5.41 6.59 8 4 10.59 5.41 12 8 9.41 10.59 12 12 10.59 9.41 8z"/></svg>
          </button>
        </div>

        </div>

          <span class="eta">{{svc.formatDuration(operation.timing.estimatedRemainingMs)}}</span>

          </svg>

        <div class="resolution-btns">
          <button class="res-btn" (click)="resolveConflict('skip')">Skip</button>
          <button class="res-btn primary" (click)="resolveConflict('overwrite')">Replace</button>
          <button class="res-btn" *ngIf="canKeepBoth" (click)="resolveConflict('rename')">Keep Both</button>
          <button class="res-btn danger" (click)="resolveConflict('cancel')">Cancel All</button>
        </div>

        <label class="apply-all">
          <input type="checkbox" [(ngModel)]="applyToAll">
          <span>Apply to all conflicts</span>
        </label>

      </div>
    </ng-container>

  </div>
