`````typescript
export class OperationToastComponent implements OnChanges, OnInit, OnDestroy {
  @Input() operation!: OperationState;

  @Output() cancel  = new EventEmitter<string>();
  @Output() dismiss = new EventEmitter<string>();
  @Output() resolve = new EventEmitter<{ conflictId: string; resolution: ConflictResolution; applyToAll: boolean }>();

  applyToAll  = false;
  isResolving = false;

  private destroy$ = createSubject<void>();
  private timer: any;

  constructor(public svc: OperationService) {}

  ngOnInit()    { this.setupAutoDismiss(); }
  ngOnChanges() { this.setupAutoDismiss(); }

  ngOnDestroy() {
    this.clearTimer();
    this.destroy$.next();
    this.destroy$.complete();
  }

  private setupAutoDismiss() {
    this.clearTimer();
    if (this.isCompleted && !this.hasConflict) {
      this.timer = setTimeout(() => this.dismiss.emit(this.operation.id), 800);
    }
  }

  private clearTimer() {
    if (this.timer) { clearTimeout(this.timer); this.timer = null; }
  }

  get hasConflict() {
    return this.operation.status === 'paused' && !!this.operation.conflictData;
  }

  get isCompleted() {
    return ['completed', 'error', 'cancelled'].includes(this.operation.status);
  }

  get canKeepBoth() {
    if (this.operation?.config?.kind !== 'move') return true;

    const src = this.operation.conflictData?.sourcePath;
    const dst = this.operation.conflictData?.destPath;
    if (!src || !dst) return true; // fallback: allow if uncertain

    const srcDir = this.parentDir(src);
    const dstDir = this.parentDir(dst);
    return srcDir !== dstDir; // allow keep-both when moving into a different folder
  }

  get currentFileName() {
    const p = this.operation.metrics.currentFile || '';
    return p.split(/[\\/]/).pop() || p;
  }

  conflictTitle(): string {
    return this.operation.conflictData?.isDirectory ? 'Folder already exists' : 'File already exists';
  }

  conflictSourceFileName(): string {
    if (this.isSameDirectoryRenameConflict()) {
      return this.conflictFileName(this.operation.conflictData?.destPath);
    }
    return this.conflictFileName(this.operation.conflictData?.sourcePath);
  }

  conflictFileName(path?: string): string {
    if (!path) return '';
    return path.split(/[\\/]/).pop() || path;
  }

  conflictDir(path?: string): string {
    if (!path) return '';
    const parts = path.split(/[\\/]/);
    return parts.slice(0, -1).join('/') || '/';
  }

  private parentDir(path: string): string {
    const parts = path.split(/[\\/]/);
    parts.pop();
    return parts.join('/') || '/';
  }

  private isSameDirectoryRenameConflict(): boolean {
    if (this.operation?.config?.kind !== 'move') return false;

    const src = this.operation.conflictData?.sourcePath;
    const dst = this.operation.conflictData?.destPath;
    if (!src || !dst) return false;

    return this.parentDir(src) === this.parentDir(dst);
  }

  onCancel(e: Event)  { e.stopPropagation(); this.cancel.emit(this.operation.id); }
  onDismiss(e: Event) { e.stopPropagation(); this.clearTimer(); this.dismiss.emit(this.operation.id); }

  async resolveConflict(resolution: ConflictResolution) {
    if (this.isResolving) return;
    if (resolution === 'rename' && !this.canKeepBoth) return;
    this.isResolving = true;
    this.resolve.emit({
      conflictId: this.operation.conflictData?.conflictId || this.operation.id,
      resolution,
      applyToAll: this.applyToAll,
    });
    setTimeout(() => this.isResolving = false, 400);
  }
}
`````

`````typescript
import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';

describe('pane background selection UX', () => {
  const read = (name: string) =>
    readFileSync(new URL(name, import.meta.url), 'utf8');

  const directory = read('./directory-pane.component.ts');
  const registry = read('./registry-pane.component.ts');
  const autorun = read('./autorun-pane.component.ts');
  const network = read('./network-pane.component.ts');
  const environment = read('./environment-pane.component.ts');
  const paneHost = read('./pane-host.component.ts');
  const fileEntry = read('./file-entry.component.ts');

  function backgroundMethod(source: string): string {
    const start = source.indexOf('onBackgroundClick(event: MouseEvent)');
    const end = source.indexOf('\n  }', start) + 4;
    return source.slice(start, end);
  }

  for (const [name, source] of [
    ['directory', directory],
    ['registry', registry],
    ['autorun', autorun],
    ['network', network],
    ['environment', environment],
  ] as const) {
    it(`${name} pane activates on empty space without losing cursor/selection`, () => {
      const method = backgroundMethod(source);

      expect(method).not.toContain('this.selectedPaths = new Set()');
      expect(method).not.toContain('this.cursorPath = null');
      expect(method).not.toContain('this.anchorPath = null');
      expect(method).not.toContain('this.cursorChange.emit(null)');
      expect(method).not.toContain('selection cleared');
      expect(method).toContain("this.lastAction = 'pane focused'");
      expect(method).toContain('this.activateRequested.emit()');
      expect(method).toContain('focus({ preventScroll: true })');
    });
  }

  it('provider/system-table background activation preserves provider selection', () => {
    const start = paneHost.indexOf('onProviderBackgroundClick(event: MouseEvent)');
    const end = paneHost.indexOf('\n  }', start) + 4;
    const method = paneHost.slice(start, end);

    expect(method).not.toContain('clearSelection');
    expect(method).toContain('this.activateRequested.emit()');
    expect(method).toContain('focus({ preventScroll: true })');
  });

  it('only recovers a cursor for an inactive pane with no existing selection state', () => {
    expect(directory).toContain('if (!this.cursorPath && this.selectedPaths.size === 0)');
    expect(directory).toContain('this.recoverVisibleCursor()');
  });

  it('declares and captures inactive-pane recovery state', () => {
    expect(directory).toContain('private restoreCursorOnBackgroundClick = false;');
    expect(directory).toContain('onPaneMouseDown(event: MouseEvent)');
    expect(directory).toContain('this.restoreCursorOnBackgroundClick = !this.active;');
  });

  it('keeps shared file entries transparent until hover or selection state applies', () => {
    expect(fileEntry).toContain('.file-entry {');
    expect(fileEntry).toContain('background: transparent;');
    expect(fileEntry).toContain('&:hover {');
    expect(fileEntry).toContain('&.selected {');
  });
});
`````

`````typescript
import { ChangeDetectionStrategy, Component, EventEmitter, Input, OnChanges, Output } from '@angular/core';

export class PaneComparisonBarComponent implements OnChanges {
  @Input() visible = false;
  @Input() leftEntries: readonly FileInfo[] = [];
  @Input() rightEntries: readonly FileInfo[] = [];
  @Input() leftPath = '';
  @Input() rightPath = '';
  @Input() recursive = false;
  @Input() scanning = false;
  @Input() error = '';
  @Input() comparisonResult: PaneComparisonResult | null = null;
  @Input() policy: PaneComparisonPolicy = 'size-date';

  @Output() policyChange = new EventEmitter<PaneComparisonPolicy>();
  @Output() toggleRecursive = new EventEmitter<void>();
  @Output() refreshRecursive = new EventEmitter<void>();
  @Output() selectLeft = new EventEmitter<void>();
  @Output() selectRight = new EventEmitter<void>();
  @Output() copyMissingLeftToRight = new EventEmitter<void>();
  @Output() copyMissingRightToLeft = new EventEmitter<void>();
  @Output() review = new EventEmitter<void>();
  @Output() close = new EventEmitter<void>();

  result: PaneComparisonResult = this.comparison.compare([], []);

  constructor(private readonly comparison: PaneComparisonService) {}

  ngOnChanges(): void {
    this.result = this.comparisonResult ?? this.comparison.compare(this.leftEntries, this.rightEntries, { policy: this.policy });
  }

  get leftDifferenceCount(): number {
    return this.comparison.leftDifferencePaths(this.result).length;
  }

  get rightDifferenceCount(): number {
    return this.comparison.rightDifferencePaths(this.result).length;
  }
}
`````

`````typescript
import { DirectoryPaneComponent } from './directory-pane.component';
import { markerForSide } from './correspondence-policy';

describe('DirectoryPane comparison markers', () => {
  function component(side: 'left' | 'right'): DirectoryPaneComponent {
    const value = Object.create(DirectoryPaneComponent.prototype) as DirectoryPaneComponent;
    value.paneId = side;
    return value;
  }

  it('maps newer status relative to the current pane side', () => {
    const left = component('left');
    left.comparisonStatuses = new Map([['L/a', 'left-newer'] as const]);

    const right = component('right');
    right.comparisonStatuses = new Map([['R/a', 'left-newer'] as const]);

    expect(markerForSide(left.comparisonStatus('L/a')!, left.paneId)).toBe('newer');
    expect(markerForSide(right.comparisonStatus('R/a')!, right.paneId)).toBe('older');
  });

  it('marks only-here entries on the side where they exist', () => {
    const left = component('left');
    left.comparisonStatuses = new Map([['L/a', 'only-left'] as const]);
    expect(markerForSide(left.comparisonStatus('L/a')!, left.paneId)).toBe('only-here');
  });

  it('distinguishes type mismatch from ordinary difference', () => {
    const pane = component('left');
    pane.comparisonStatuses = new Map([
      ['L/type', 'type-different'],
      ['L/size', 'size-different'],
    ] as const);

    expect(pane.comparisonStatus('L/type')).toBe('type-different');
    expect(pane.comparisonStatus('L/size')).toBe('size-different');
    expect(pane.isComparisonDifferent('L/type')).toBe(true);
    expect(pane.isComparisonDifferent('L/size')).toBe(true);
  });
});
`````

`````typescript
      keepFollow: true,
      keepScroll: true,

    });

      .not.toBe(comparisonSignature('C:/a', 'D:/b', 11, 10));

  });
});
`````

## File: manager/frontend/src/app/components/pane-intelligence-robustness.ts
`````typescript
export interface PaneHealthInput {
  readonly leftAvailable: boolean;
  readonly rightAvailable: boolean;
  readonly leftRootAvailable: boolean;
  readonly rightRootAvailable: boolean;
  readonly linkedNavigation: boolean;
}

export interface PaneHealthDecision {
  readonly keepLink: boolean;
  readonly keepFollow: boolean;
  readonly keepScroll: boolean;
  readonly message: string;
}

export function decidePaneHealth(
  input: PaneHealthInput,
): PaneHealthDecision {
  if (!input.leftAvailable && !input.rightAvailable) {
    return {
      keepLink: false,
      keepFollow: false,
      keepScroll: false,
      message: 'both pane locations unavailable',
    };
  }

  if (!input.leftAvailable) {
    return {
      keepLink: false,
      keepFollow: false,
      keepScroll: false,
      message: 'left pane location unavailable',
    };
  }

  if (!input.rightAvailable) {
    return {
      keepLink: false,
      keepFollow: false,
      keepScroll: false,
      message: 'right pane location unavailable',
    };
  }

  if (
    input.linkedNavigation &&
    (!input.leftRootAvailable || !input.rightRootAvailable)
  ) {
    return {
      keepLink: false,
      keepFollow: true,
      keepScroll: true,
      message: !input.leftRootAvailable && !input.rightRootAvailable
        ? 'both linked roots unavailable'
        : !input.leftRootAvailable
          ? 'left linked root unavailable'
          : 'right linked root unavailable',
    };
  }

  return {
    keepLink: input.linkedNavigation,
    keepFollow: true,
    keepScroll: true,
    message: 'healthy',
  };
}

export function comparisonSignature(
  leftPath: string,
  rightPath: string,
  leftCount: number,
  rightCount: number,
): string {
  return [
    leftPath,
    rightPath,
    Math.max(0, leftCount),
    Math.max(0, rightCount),
  ].join('|');
}
`````

## File: manager/frontend/src/app/components/pane-link-policy.ts
`````typescript
export type PaneLocationRelation = 'same'|'left-inside-right'|'right-inside-left'|'different';

export interface PaneLocationAnalysis {
  readonly relation: PaneLocationRelation;
  readonly depthDelta: number;
}

function slash(value: string): string {
  return (value ?? '').trim().replace(/\\/g, '/').replace(/\/+/g, '/');
}

function split(value: string): { prefix: string; segments: string[] } {
  const normalized = slash(value).replace(/\/$/, '');
  const scheme = /^([a-z][a-z0-9+.-]*:\/\/[^/]*)(?:\/(.*))?$/i.exec(normalized);
  if (scheme) return { prefix: scheme[1].toLowerCase(), segments: (scheme[2] ?? '').split('/').filter(Boolean) };

  const drive = /^([a-z]:)(?:\/(.*))?$/i.exec(normalized);
  if (drive) return { prefix: drive[1].toLowerCase(), segments: (drive[2] ?? '').split('/').filter(Boolean) };

  return { prefix: normalized.startsWith('/') ? '/' : '', segments: normalized.split('/').filter(Boolean) };
}

const sameSegment = (a: string, b: string) => a.toLowerCase() === b.toLowerCase();

export function samePaneLocation(left: string, right: string): boolean {
  const a = split(left), b = split(right);
  return a.prefix === b.prefix &&
    a.segments.length === b.segments.length &&
    a.segments.every((x, i) => sameSegment(x, b.segments[i]));
}

export function analyzePaneLocations(left: string, right: string): PaneLocationAnalysis {
  const a = split(left), b = split(right);
  if (samePaneLocation(left, right)) return { relation:'same', depthDelta:0 };
  if (a.prefix !== b.prefix) return { relation:'different', depthDelta:0 };

  const common = Math.min(a.segments.length, b.segments.length);
  let i = 0;
  while (i < common && sameSegment(a.segments[i], b.segments[i])) i++;
  if (i !== common) return { relation:'different', depthDelta:0 };

  if (a.segments.length > b.segments.length) {
    return { relation:'left-inside-right', depthDelta:a.segments.length - b.segments.length };
  }
  if (b.segments.length > a.segments.length) {
    return { relation:'right-inside-left', depthDelta:b.segments.length - a.segments.length };
  }
  return { relation:'different', depthDelta:0 };
}

export function relativePaneLocation(location: string, root: string): string[] | null {
  const target = split(location), base = split(root);
  if (target.prefix !== base.prefix || target.segments.length < base.segments.length) return null;
  for (let i = 0; i < base.segments.length; i++) {
    if (!sameSegment(target.segments[i], base.segments[i])) return null;
  }
  return target.segments.slice(base.segments.length);
}

export function mirrorPaneLocation(sourceLocation: string, sourceRoot: string, targetRoot: string): string | null {
  const relative = relativePaneLocation(sourceLocation, sourceRoot);
  if (!relative) return null;
  const target = targetRoot.replace(/[\\/]+$/, '');
  if (!relative.length) return targetRoot;
  const separator = targetRoot.includes('\\') && !targetRoot.includes('://') ? '\\' : '/';
  return `${target}${separator}${relative.join(separator)}`;
}


export function mirroredPeerCandidates(
  sourceLocation: string,
  sourceRoot: string,
  targetRoot: string,
): string[] {
  const relative = relativePaneLocation(sourceLocation, sourceRoot);
  if (!relative) return [];

  const target = targetRoot.replace(/[\\/]+$/, '');
  const separator = targetRoot.includes('\\') && !targetRoot.includes('://') ? '\\' : '/';
  const candidates: string[] = [];

  for (let length = relative.length; length >= 0; length -= 1) {
    const suffix = relative.slice(0, length);
    candidates.push(
      suffix.length ? `${target}${separator}${suffix.join(separator)}` : targetRoot,
    );
  }

  return Array.from(new Set(candidates));
}
`````

## File: manager/frontend/src/app/components/pane-relationship-policy.ts
`````typescript
export interface PaneRelationshipActionState {
  readonly matchOther: boolean;
  readonly swapRoots: boolean;
  readonly openPeer: boolean;
  readonly copyToPeer: boolean;
  readonly moveToPeer: boolean;
}

export function paneRelationshipActions(input: {
  activeDirectory: boolean;
  peerDirectory: boolean;
  activePath: string;
  hasCursor: boolean;
  hasPeer: boolean;
  linkedRoots: boolean;
  sourceReadable: boolean;
  sourceRemovable: boolean;
  peerWritable: boolean;
}): PaneRelationshipActionState {
  const usablePanes =
    input.activeDirectory &&
    input.peerDirectory &&
    !!input.activePath;

  return {
    matchOther: usablePanes,
    swapRoots: input.linkedRoots,
    openPeer: usablePanes && input.hasPeer,
    copyToPeer:
      usablePanes &&
      input.hasCursor &&
      input.sourceReadable &&
      input.peerWritable,
    moveToPeer:
      usablePanes &&
      input.hasCursor &&
      input.sourceReadable &&
      input.sourceRemovable &&
      input.peerWritable,
  };
}
`````

`````typescript
import { Injectable } from '@angular/core';
import {
  PaneRendererRegistry,
  schemeOf,
  type PaneRendererContribution as CorePaneRendererContribution,
  type PaneRendererMatch,
} from '@reassembly/core/runtime/panes';

export type PaneRendererKind =
  | 'directory'
  | 'bin'
  | 'registry'
  | 'autorun'
  | 'network'
  | 'environment'
  | 'system-table';

export type PaneRendererContribution = CorePaneRendererContribution<
  Exclude<PaneRendererKind, 'directory'>
>;

export type { PaneRendererMatch };

export const SYSTEM_TABLE_SCHEMES = new Set([
  'tasks',
  'services',
  'processes',
  'devices',
  'shell-extensions',
]);

@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })
export class PaneRendererRegistryService {
  private readonly registry = new PaneRendererRegistry<PaneRendererKind>('directory');

  constructor() {
    this.register({
      id: 'builtin.bin-pane',
      kind: 'bin',
      score: scheme => scheme === 'bin' ? 100 : 0,
    });
    this.register({
      id: 'builtin.registry-pane',
      kind: 'registry',
      score: scheme => scheme === 'registry' ? 100 : 0,
    });
    this.register({
      id: 'builtin.autorun-pane',
      kind: 'autorun',
      score: scheme => scheme === 'autorun' ? 100 : 0,
    });
    this.register({
      id: 'builtin.network-pane',
      kind: 'network',
      score: scheme => scheme === 'network' ? 100 : 0,
    });
    this.register({
      id: 'builtin.environment-pane',
      kind: 'environment',
      score: scheme => scheme === 'environment' ? 100 : 0,
    });
    this.register({
      id: 'builtin.system-table-pane',
      kind: 'system-table',
      score: scheme => SYSTEM_TABLE_SCHEMES.has(scheme) ? 100 : 0,
    });
  }

  register(contribution: PaneRendererContribution): () => void {
    return this.registry.register(contribution);
  }

  resolve(path: string): PaneRendererMatch<PaneRendererKind> {
    return this.registry.resolve(path);
  }
}

export { schemeOf };
`````

## File: manager/frontend/src/app/components/pane-scroll-policy.ts
`````typescript
export interface ScrollPeerSnapshot {
  readonly topName: string | null;
  readonly ratio: number;
}

export function normalizeScrollRatio(value: number): number {
  if (!Number.isFinite(value)) return 0;
  return Math.max(0, Math.min(1, value));
}

export function chooseScrollAlignment(
  snapshot: ScrollPeerSnapshot,
  peerNames: readonly string[],
): { mode:'name';name:string } | { mode:'ratio';ratio:number } {
  if (snapshot.topName) {
    const folded = snapshot.topName.toLowerCase();
    const match = peerNames.find(name => name.toLowerCase() === folded);
    if (match) return { mode:'name', name:match };
  }
  return { mode:'ratio', ratio:normalizeScrollRatio(snapshot.ratio) };
}
`````

`````typescript
import { fn, spyOnFn, stubGlobal, restoreGlobals } from '../testing/jasmine-test-helpers';
import { FileType } from '../shared/protocol';
import type { PaneComparisonResult } from '../services/pane-comparison.service';
import { PaneSyncReviewComponent } from './pane-sync-review.component';

function result(): PaneComparisonResult {
  const file = (name: string, path: string) => ({
    name, path, type: FileType.FILE, size: 1, modified: 1, created: 1, accessed: 1, permissions: '', isHidden: false,
  });
  return {
    items: [
      { key: 'a', name: 'a.txt', status: 'only-left', left: file('a.txt', '/left/a.txt'), right: null },
      { key: 'b', name: 'b.txt', status: 'only-right', left: null, right: file('b.txt', '/right/b.txt') },
      { key: 'c', name: 'c.txt', status: 'left-newer', left: file('c.txt', '/left/c.txt'), right: file('c.txt', '/right/c.txt') },
    ],
    summary: { total: 3, same: 0, onlyLeft: 1, onlyRight: 1, leftNewer: 1, rightNewer: 0, sizeDifferent: 0, hashDifferent: 0, contentDifferent: 0, typeDifferent: 0, different: 3 },
  };
}

describe('PaneSyncReviewComponent plan defaults', () => {
  it('auto-approves missing items but skips overwrite candidates', () => {
    const component = new PaneSyncReviewComponent();
    component.result = result();
    component.ngOnChanges();

    expect(component.items.map(item => item.direction)).toEqual(['left-to-right', 'right-to-left', 'skip']);
  });

  it('emits only explicitly approved directions', () => {
    const component = new PaneSyncReviewComponent();
    component.result = result();
    component.ngOnChanges();
    component.setDirection(component.items[2], 'left-to-right');
    const emit = spyOnFn(component.execute, 'emit');

    component.executePlan();

    expect(emit).toHaveBeenCalledWith(jasmine.objectContaining({
      leftToRight: ['/left/a.txt', '/left/c.txt'],
      rightToLeft: ['/right/b.txt'],
      preset: 'custom',
    }));
  });
});

  it('builds an explicit bidirectional plan from one-sided and newer-side differences', () => {
    const component = new PaneSyncReviewComponent();
    component.result = result();
    component.ngOnChanges();

    component.applyPreset('bidirectional');

    expect(component.items.map(item => item.direction)).toEqual(['left-to-right', 'right-to-left', 'left-to-right']);
    expect(component.preset).toBe('bidirectional');
  });

  it('keeps ambiguous content differences as conflicts in bidirectional mode', () => {
    const component = new PaneSyncReviewComponent();
    const base = result();
    const left = base.items[2].left!;
    const right = base.items[2].right!;
    component.result = {
      items: [{ key: 'c', name: 'c.txt', status: 'content-different', left, right }],
      summary: { total: 1, same: 0, onlyLeft: 0, onlyRight: 0, leftNewer: 0, rightNewer: 0, sizeDifferent: 0, hashDifferent: 0, contentDifferent: 1, typeDifferent: 0, different: 1 },
    };
    component.ngOnChanges();

    component.applyPreset('bidirectional');

    expect(component.conflictCount).toBe(1);
    expect(component.items[0].direction).toBe('skip');
  });
`````

`````typescript
import type { ActionAvailability } from '../services/action-availability';
import type { ToolbarActionContribution, ToolbarContext } from '../plugin/plugin-registry-api';
import type { PresentedCommand } from './presented-command';
import { presentPluginCommand, type PluginCommandPresentationHost } from './plugin-command-presentation';

export interface BuiltinPaneToolbarHandlers {
  createFolder(): void;
  deleteSelected(): void;
  copyToOther(): void;
  moveToOther(): void;
  refresh(): void;
}

export function buildBuiltinPaneToolbarActions(
  availability: ActionAvailability,
  handlers: BuiltinPaneToolbarHandlers,
): PresentedCommand[] {
  return [
    {
      id: 'new-folder',
      label: 'New folder',
      icon: 'new-folder',
      enabled: availability.createFolder,
      source: 'builtin',
      commandId: 'pane.files.newFolder',
      execute: handlers.createFolder,
    },
    {
      id: 'delete',
      label: 'Delete',
      icon: 'delete',
      enabled: availability.deleteSelected,
      source: 'builtin',
      commandId: 'pane.files.delete',
      execute: handlers.deleteSelected,
    },
    {
      id: 'copy-to-other',
      label: 'Copy to other pane',
      icon: 'copy',
      shortcut: 'F5',
      enabled: availability.copyToOther,
      source: 'builtin',
      commandId: 'pane.ctrl.copyToOther',
      execute: handlers.copyToOther,
    },
    {
      id: 'move-to-other',
      label: 'Move to other pane',
      icon: 'move',
      shortcut: 'F6',
      enabled: availability.moveToOther,
      source: 'builtin',
      commandId: 'pane.ctrl.moveToOther',
      execute: handlers.moveToOther,
    },
    {
      id: 'refresh',
      label: 'Refresh',
      icon: 'refresh',
      shortcut: 'Ctrl+R',
      enabled: true,
      source: 'builtin',
      commandId: 'pane.nav.refresh',
      execute: handlers.refresh,
    },
  ];
}

export function adaptPluginToolbarActions(
  contributions: readonly ToolbarActionContribution[],
  context: ToolbarContext,
  commands: PluginCommandPresentationHost,
): PresentedCommand[] {
  return contributions.map(contribution => presentPluginCommand(contribution, context, commands, { source: 'toolbar' }));
}
`````

## File: manager/frontend/src/app/components/panel-presentation-outlet.component.ts
`````typescript
import { CommonModule } from '@angular/common';
import {
  ChangeDetectionStrategy,
  ChangeDetectorRef,
  Component,
  Input,
  OnChanges,
  Type,
} from '@angular/core';
import type {
  PanelPresentationContribution,
  PanelPresentationModel,
} from '../plugin/plugin-registry-api';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-panel-presentation-outlet',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [CommonModule],
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
  template: `
    <ng-container
      *ngIf="component"
      [ngComponentOutlet]="component"
      [ngComponentOutletInputs]="{ model: model }">
    </ng-container>
  `,
  styles: [`
    :host {
      display: flex;
      flex: 1 1 0%;
      min-width: 0;
      min-height: 0;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    :host > * {
      display: flex;
      flex: 1 1 0%;
      min-width: 0;
      min-height: 0;
    }
  `],
})
export class PanelPresentationOutletComponent implements OnChanges {
  @Input({ required: true }) presentation!: PanelPresentationContribution;
  @Input({ required: true }) model!: PanelPresentationModel;

  component: Type<unknown> | null = null;
  private resolveSeq = 0;
  private loadedId = '';

  constructor(private readonly cdr: ChangeDetectorRef) {}

  ngOnChanges(): void {
    if (!this.presentation) {
      this.component = null;
      this.loadedId = '';
      return;
    }

    if (this.loadedId === this.presentation.id && this.component) {
      this.cdr.markForCheck();
      return;
    }

    const seq = ++this.resolveSeq;
    const presentation = this.presentation;
    Promise.resolve(presentation.load()).then(component => {
      if (seq !== this.resolveSeq) return;
      this.component = component;
      this.loadedId = presentation.id;
      this.cdr.markForCheck();
    }).catch(() => {
      if (seq !== this.resolveSeq) return;
      this.component = null;
      this.loadedId = '';
      this.cdr.markForCheck();
    });
  }
}
`````

`````typescript
import { fn, spyOnFn, stubGlobal, restoreGlobals } from '../testing/jasmine-test-helpers';
import type { CommandState } from '../services/input-system.types';
import { presentPluginCommand, type PluginCommandPresentationHost } from './plugin-command-presentation';

function host(state?: CommandState): PluginCommandPresentationHost & { dispatch: ReturnType<typeof fn> } {
  const dispatch = fn(() => true);
  return {
    dispatch,
    getCommandState: () => state,
    dispatchCommandById: dispatch,
  };
}

describe('presentPluginCommand', () => {
  it('inherits title and availability from a registered command', async () => {
    const commandHost = host({
      id: 'plugin.demo.compress',
      title: 'Compress Selection',
      category: 'Plugins',
      registered: true,
      enabled: true,
    });

    const item = presentPluginCommand({
      id: 'compress-toolbar',
      commandId: 'plugin.demo.compress',
    }, {}, commandHost);

    expect(item.label).toBe('Compress Selection');
    expect(item.enabled).toBe(true);
    expect(item.commandId).toBe('plugin.demo.compress');

    await item.execute();
    expect(commandHost.dispatch).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
      'plugin.demo.compress',
      jasmine.objectContaining({ source: 'context-menu' }),
    );
  });

  it('disables a contribution whose command is missing or disabled', async () => {
    const missingHost = host(undefined);
    const missing = presentPluginCommand({ id: 'missing', commandId: 'plugin.demo.missing' }, {}, missingHost);
    expect(missing.enabled).toBe(false);
    await missing.execute();
    expect(missingHost.dispatch).not.toHaveBeenCalled();

    const disabledHost = host({
      id: 'plugin.demo.disabled',
      title: 'Disabled Command',
      registered: true,
      enabled: false,
    });
    const disabled = presentPluginCommand({ id: 'disabled', commandId: 'plugin.demo.disabled' }, {}, disabledHost);
    expect(disabled.enabled).toBe(false);
  });

  it('keeps legacy callback contributions working', async () => {
    const execute = fn();
    const item = presentPluginCommand({ id: 'legacy', label: 'Legacy Action', execute }, { selected: 1 }, host());

    expect(item.label).toBe('Legacy Action');
    expect(item.enabled).toBe(true);
    expect(item.commandId).toBeUndefined();

    await item.execute();
    expect(execute).toHaveBeenCalledWith({ selected: 1 });
  });
});
`````

## File: manager/frontend/src/app/components/plugin-command-presentation.ts
`````typescript
import type { CommandInvocation, CommandInvocationSource, CommandState } from '../services/input-system.types';
import type { PresentedCommand } from './presented-command';

export interface PluginCommandPresentationHost {
  getCommandState(commandId: string, invocation?: CommandInvocation): CommandState | undefined;
  dispatchCommandById(commandId: string, invocation?: CommandInvocation): boolean;
}

export interface PluginCommandPresentationContribution<TContext> {
  id: string;
  label?: string;
  icon?: string;
  shortcut?: string;
  commandId?: string;
  execute?: (context: TContext) => void | Promise<void>;
}

export function presentPluginCommand<TContext>(
  contribution: PluginCommandPresentationContribution<TContext>,
  context: TContext,
  host: PluginCommandPresentationHost,
  options: { separatorBefore?: boolean; source?: CommandInvocationSource } = {},
): PresentedCommand {
  const commandId = contribution.commandId?.trim() || undefined;
  const invocation: CommandInvocation = {
    source: options.source ?? 'context-menu',
    context: context as unknown as Readonly<Record<string, unknown>>,
  };
  const state = commandId ? host.getCommandState(commandId, invocation) : undefined;
  const enabled = commandId ? !!state?.registered && state.enabled : !!contribution.execute;

  return {
    id: `plugin:${contribution.id}`,
    label: contribution.label?.trim() || state?.title || contribution.id,
    icon: 'plugin',
    iconText: contribution.icon,
    shortcut: contribution.shortcut,
    enabled,
    source: 'plugin',
    commandId,
    separatorBefore: options.separatorBefore,
    execute: async () => {
      if (!enabled) return;
      if (commandId) {
        host.dispatchCommandById(commandId, invocation);
        return;
      }
      await contribution.execute?.(context);
    },
  };
}
`````

## File: manager/frontend/src/app/components/presented-command.ts
`````typescript
/**
 * Renderer-agnostic command presentation.
 *
 * Command metadata is intentionally separate from execution so the same
 * presentation vocabulary can be used by toolbars, menus, palettes and future
 * surfaces such as Console without coupling those renderers to one another.
 */
export type CommandPresentationSource = 'builtin' | 'plugin' | 'registry';

export interface CommandPresentation<TId extends string = string> {
  readonly id: TId;
  readonly label: string;
  readonly icon?: string;
  readonly iconText?: string;
  readonly shortcut?: string;
  readonly enabled: boolean;
  readonly separatorBefore?: boolean;
  readonly source: CommandPresentationSource;
  /** Stable application command ID when this presentation maps to one. */
  readonly commandId?: string;
  /** Canonical human-facing command name, when the command exposes one. */
  readonly commandName?: string;
  /** Additional human-facing names used by discovery surfaces. */
  readonly aliases?: readonly string[];
}

export interface PresentedCommand<TId extends string = string> extends CommandPresentation<TId> {
  execute(): void | Promise<void>;
}

export function bindCommandPresentation<TId extends string>(
  presentation: CommandPresentation<TId>,
  execute: () => void | Promise<void>,
): PresentedCommand<TId> {
  return { ...presentation, execute };
}
`````

`````typescript
function block(source: string, start: string, end: string): string {
  const from = source.indexOf(start);
  if (from < 0) throw new Error(`Missing block start: ${start}`);
  const to = source.indexOf(end, from);
  if (to < 0) throw new Error(`Missing block end: ${end}`);
  return source.slice(from, to + end.length);
}

describe('Registry pane Directory visual parity', () => {
  it('keeps Directory styles byte-for-byte identical', () => {
    const directoryStyles = block(directory, '  styles: [`', '  `]');
    const registryStyles = block(registry, '  styles: [`', '  `]');

    expect(registryStyles).toBe(directoryStyles);
  });

  it('keeps the same Directory row/cell structure and classes', () => {
    for (const token of [
      'class="content"',

      'class="size"',
      'class="modified"',
      '[style.grid-template-columns]="viewMode === \'details\' ? detailsGridTemplate : null"',
`````

## File: manager/frontend/src/app/components/rename-policy.ts
`````typescript
import { FileType } from '../shared/protocol';

export function renameSelectionEnd(
  name: string,
  type: FileType,
): number {
  if (type === FileType.DIRECTORY) return name.length;
  const lastDot = name.lastIndexOf('.');
  return lastDot > 0 ? lastDot : name.length;
}

export function isInlineRenameNoop(
  original: string,
  requested: string,
): boolean {
  return requested.trim() === original;
}
`````

`````typescript
import {
  reconcileVisibleSelection,
  selectPathRange,
  togglePathSelection,
} from './selection-policy';

describe('reassembly selection policy', () => {
  it('preserves the Shift anchor across Ctrl toggles', () => {
    const first = togglePathSelection(new Set(['a']), 'c', 'a');
    expect([...first.selected]).toEqual(['a', 'c']);
    expect(first.anchor).toBe('a');

    const second = togglePathSelection(first.selected, 'c', first.anchor);
    expect([...second.selected]).toEqual(['a']);
    expect(second.anchor).toBe('a');
  });

  it('creates an anchor when Ctrl selection starts without one', () => {
    const result = togglePathSelection(new Set(), 'b', null);
    expect([...result.selected]).toEqual(['b']);
    expect(result.anchor).toBe('b');
  });

  it('selects a deterministic range in projected order', () => {
    expect([...selectPathRange(['a', 'b', 'c', 'd'], 'b', 'd')!])
      .toEqual(['b', 'c', 'd']);
    expect([...selectPathRange(['a', 'b', 'c', 'd'], 'd', 'b')!])
      .toEqual(['b', 'c', 'd']);
  });

  it('drops invisible selections so operations cannot target filtered items', () => {
    const result = reconcileVisibleSelection({
      selected: new Set(['a', 'hidden', 'c']),
      cursor: 'hidden',
      anchor: 'hidden',
      visiblePaths: ['a', 'b', 'c'],
    });

    expect([...result.selected]).toEqual(['a', 'c']);
    expect(result.cursor).toBe('a');
    expect(result.anchor).toBe('a');
  });

  it('clears cursor and anchor for an empty projection', () => {
    const result = reconcileVisibleSelection({
      selected: new Set(['a']),
      cursor: 'a',
      anchor: 'a',
      visiblePaths: [],
    });

    expect(result.selected.size).toBe(0);
    expect(result.cursor).toBeNull();
    expect(result.anchor).toBeNull();
  });
});
`````

## File: manager/frontend/src/app/components/selection-policy.ts
`````typescript
export interface ReconciledSelection {
  selected: Set<string>;
  cursor: string | null;
  anchor: string | null;
}

export interface ReconcileVisibleSelectionInput {
  selected: ReadonlySet<string>;
  cursor: string | null;
  anchor: string | null;
  visiblePaths: readonly string[];
}

export function togglePathSelection(
  selected: ReadonlySet<string>,
  path: string,
  anchor: string | null,
): { selected: Set<string>; anchor: string } {
  const next = new Set(selected);
  if (next.has(path)) next.delete(path);
  else next.add(path);

  return {
    selected: next,
    anchor: anchor ?? path,
  };
}

export function selectPathRange(
  visiblePaths: readonly string[],
  anchor: string,
  target: string,
): Set<string> | null {
  const start = visiblePaths.indexOf(anchor);
  const end = visiblePaths.indexOf(target);
  if (start < 0 || end < 0) return null;

  const from = Math.min(start, end);
  const to = Math.max(start, end);
  return new Set(visiblePaths.slice(from, to + 1));
}

export function reconcileVisibleSelection(
  input: ReconcileVisibleSelectionInput,
): ReconciledSelection {
  const visible = input.visiblePaths;
  const visibleSet = new Set(visible);
  const selected = new Set(
    Array.from(input.selected).filter(path => visibleSet.has(path)),
  );

  if (visible.length === 0) {
    return { selected, cursor: null, anchor: null };
  }

  const cursor =
    input.cursor && visibleSet.has(input.cursor)
      ? input.cursor
      : Array.from(selected)[0] ?? visible[0];

  const anchor =
    input.anchor && visibleSet.has(input.anchor)
      ? input.anchor
      : cursor;

  return { selected, cursor, anchor };
}
`````

`````typescript
export class SplitDividerComponent implements OnDestroy {
    private readonly hoverEnterDelayMs = 0;
    private readonly hoverLeaveDelayMs = 120;
    private readonly hoverOutsetPx = 12;
    private hoverEnterTimer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null = null;
    private hoverLeaveTimer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null = null;
    private lastPointerX = 0;
    private lastPointerY = 0;
    private activePointerId: number | null = null;
    /* ---------------- INPUTS ---------------- */

    @Input() position = 50;
    @Output() positionChange = new EventEmitter<number>();

    @Input() orientation: 'vertical' | 'horizontal' = 'vertical';
    @Input() resetPosition = 50;

    @Input() min = 20;
    @Input() max = 80;

    @Input() snapPoints: number[] = [20, 25, 33.333, 50, 66.666, 75, 80];

    /* ---------------- STATE ---------------- */

    dragging = false;
    hovering = false;
    snapPreview = 50;
    private startPointerPosition = 0;
    private startPos = 50;

    /** Base snap threshold in %. Actual threshold per point is scaled by proximity to center. */
    readonly SNAP_THRESHOLD_MIN = 2;  // threshold at the edges (20%, 80%)
    readonly SNAP_THRESHOLD_MAX = 8;  // threshold at dead center (50%)

    constructor(private el: ElementRef<HTMLElement>) { }

    ngOnDestroy(): void {
        this.clearHoverTimers();
        this.hovering = false;
        this.setBodyInteractionClass('divider-hover', false);
        this.setBodyInteractionClass('divider-dragging', false);
    }

    /* ---------------- DRAG ---------------- */

    @HostListener('pointerdown', ['$event'])
    startDrag(e: PointerEvent) {
        e.preventDefault();

        this.clearHoverTimers();
        this.dragging = true;
        this.hovering = true;
        this.startPointerPosition = this.isHorizontal ? e.clientY : e.clientX;
        this.startPos = this.position;
        this.activePointerId = e.pointerId;

        try {
            this.el.nativeElement.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);
        } catch {
            this.activePointerId = null;
        }

        this.setBodyInteractionClass('divider-hover', true);
        this.setBodyInteractionClass('divider-dragging', true);
    }

    @HostListener('pointerenter', ['$event'])
    onPointerEnter(event: PointerEvent) {
        this.lastPointerX = event.clientX;
        this.lastPointerY = event.clientY;
        if (this.hoverLeaveTimer !== null) {
            clearTimeout(this.hoverLeaveTimer);
            this.hoverLeaveTimer = null;
        }
        if (this.dragging || document.body.classList.contains('divider-hover')) {
            this.activateHover();
            return;
        }
        if (this.hoverEnterTimer !== null) {
            return;
        }
        this.hoverEnterTimer = setTimeout(() => {
            this.hoverEnterTimer = null;
            this.activateHover();
        }, this.hoverEnterDelayMs);
    }

    @HostListener('pointerleave', ['$event'])
    onPointerLeave(event?: PointerEvent) {
        if (event) {
            this.lastPointerX = event.clientX;
            this.lastPointerY = event.clientY;
        }
        if (this.hoverEnterTimer !== null) {
            clearTimeout(this.hoverEnterTimer);
            this.hoverEnterTimer = null;
        }
        if (this.dragging) {
            return;
        }
        if (this.isPointerWithinHoverZone(this.lastPointerX, this.lastPointerY)) {
            return;
        }
        if (this.hoverLeaveTimer !== null) {
            return;
        }
        this.hoverLeaveTimer = setTimeout(() => {
            this.hoverLeaveTimer = null;
            if (!this.el.nativeElement.matches(':hover') && !this.isPointerWithinHoverZone(this.lastPointerX, this.lastPointerY)) {
                this.deactivateHover();
            }
        }, this.hoverLeaveDelayMs);
    }

    @HostListener('document:pointermove', ['$event'])
    onMove(e: PointerEvent) {
        this.lastPointerX = e.clientX;
        this.lastPointerY = e.clientY;

        if (!this.dragging) {
            if (this.isPointerWithinHoverZone(e.clientX, e.clientY)) {
                if (this.hoverLeaveTimer !== null) {
                    clearTimeout(this.hoverLeaveTimer);
                    this.hoverLeaveTimer = null;
                }
                if (this.hovering) {
                    this.setBodyInteractionClass('divider-hover', true);
                }
            } else if (this.hovering && !this.el.nativeElement.matches(':hover')) {
                this.onPointerLeave(e);
            }
            return;
        }

        const container = this.el.nativeElement.parentElement!;
        const rect = container.getBoundingClientRect();
        const axisSize = this.isHorizontal ? rect.height : rect.width;
        if (axisSize <= 0) {
            return;
        }

        const pointerPosition = this.isHorizontal ? e.clientY : e.clientX;
        const delta = pointerPosition - this.startPointerPosition;
        const percent = Math.max(
            this.min,
            Math.min(this.max, this.startPos + (delta / axisSize) * 100),
        );

        // Raw 1:1 tracking during drag — no magnet, no pull.
        // Snapping only happens on release so the divider follows the cursor exactly.
        this.position = percent;
        this.snapPreview = this.snapToNearest(percent);
        this.positionChange.emit(percent);
        window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('file-manager-divider-move'));
    }

    @HostListener('document:pointerup')
    stopDrag() {
        if (!this.dragging) return;

        this.dragging = false;
        if (this.activePointerId !== null) {
            try {
                this.el.nativeElement.releasePointerCapture(this.activePointerId);
            } catch {
                // Ignore stale pointer capture state.
            }
            this.activePointerId = null;
        }
        this.setBodyInteractionClass('divider-dragging', false);
        if (this.el.nativeElement.matches(':hover')) {
            this.activateHover();
        } else {
            this.onPointerLeave();
        }

        const final = this.snapToNearest(this.position);
        this.position = final;
        this.positionChange.emit(final);
    }

    private clearHoverTimers(): void {
        if (this.hoverEnterTimer !== null) {
            clearTimeout(this.hoverEnterTimer);
            this.hoverEnterTimer = null;
        }
        if (this.hoverLeaveTimer !== null) {
            clearTimeout(this.hoverLeaveTimer);
            this.hoverLeaveTimer = null;
        }
    }

    private activateHover(): void {
        this.hovering = true;
        this.setBodyInteractionClass('divider-hover', true);
    }

    private deactivateHover(): void {
        this.hovering = false;
        this.setBodyInteractionClass('divider-hover', false);
    }

    private isPointerWithinHoverZone(clientX: number, clientY: number): boolean {
        const rect = this.el.nativeElement.getBoundingClientRect();
        if (this.isHorizontal) {
            return clientX >= rect.left
                && clientX <= rect.right
                && clientY >= rect.top - this.hoverOutsetPx
                && clientY <= rect.bottom + this.hoverOutsetPx;
        }

        return clientX >= rect.left - this.hoverOutsetPx
            && clientX <= rect.right + this.hoverOutsetPx
            && clientY >= rect.top
            && clientY <= rect.bottom;
    }

    private setBodyInteractionClass(className: string, active: boolean): void {
        const classList = document.body.classList;
        const scopedClassName = `${className}-${this.orientation}`;
        const changed = (active ? !classList.contains(className) : classList.contains(className))
            || (active ? !classList.contains(scopedClassName) : classList.contains(scopedClassName));
        classList.toggle(className, active);
        classList.toggle(scopedClassName, active);
        if (changed) {
            window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('file-manager-divider-statechange'));
        }
    }

    /* ---------------- DOUBLE CLICK RESET ---------------- */

    @HostListener('dblclick')
    reset() {
        const resetPosition = this.clampPosition(this.resetPosition);
        this.position = resetPosition;
        this.positionChange.emit(resetPosition);
    }

    /* ---------------- SNAP ENGINE ---------------- */

    /**
     * Returns the nearest snap point if the release falls within that point's
     * threshold, otherwise returns the value unchanged.
     *
     * Each snap point gets its own threshold that scales linearly with how
     * close the point is to the center (50%): center snaps are wider/more
     * magnetic, edge snaps are narrower/more precise.
     */
    private snapToNearest(value: number): number {
        let bestCandidate = value;
        let bestMargin = 0; // how far inside the threshold we are (higher = better)

        for (const p of this.snapPoints) {
            const threshold = this.thresholdForPoint(p);
            const dist = Math.abs(p - value);
            const margin = threshold - dist; // positive means we're inside the zone

            if (margin > 0 && margin > bestMargin) {
                bestMargin = margin;
                bestCandidate = p;
            }
        }

        return bestCandidate;
    }

    /**
     * Threshold for a given snap point, interpolated between MIN (at the
     * allowed edges) and MAX (at 50% center). Uses a smooth curve so the
     * transition doesn't feel abrupt.
     */
    private thresholdForPoint(point: number): number {
        const center = 50;
        const edgeDist = Math.max(Math.abs(this.min - center), Math.abs(this.max - center));
        const distFromCenter = Math.abs(point - center);
        // t = 0 at center, 1 at edge
        const t = Math.min(distFromCenter / edgeDist, 1);
        // ease-out curve so center zone feels noticeably wider
        const eased = t * t;
        return this.SNAP_THRESHOLD_MAX - eased * (this.SNAP_THRESHOLD_MAX - this.SNAP_THRESHOLD_MIN);
    }

    private clampPosition(value: number): number {
        return Math.max(this.min, Math.min(this.max, value));
    }

    /* ---------------- CLASS ---------------- */

    @HostBinding('class.dragging')
    get isDragging() {
        return this.dragging;
    }

    @HostBinding('class.hovering')
    get isHovering() {
        return this.hovering;
    }

    @HostBinding('class.horizontal')
    get isHorizontal(): boolean {
        return this.orientation === 'horizontal';
    }

    @HostBinding('class.vertical')
    get isVertical(): boolean {
        return !this.isHorizontal;
    }
}
`````

`````typescript
          <span class="status-dim">{{ fileCount + dirCount }} total</span>
        </ng-container>

        <!-- No selection -->
        <ng-container *ngIf="selectedCount === 0">
          <ng-container *ngIf="fileCount > 0 || dirCount > 0; else emptyDir">
            <span class="status-text" *ngIf="fileCount > 0">
              {{ fileCount }} file{{ fileCount !== 1 ? 's' : '' }}
            </span>
            <span class="status-sep" *ngIf="fileCount > 0 && dirCount > 0">·</span>
            <span class="status-text" *ngIf="dirCount > 0">
              {{ dirCount }} folder{{ dirCount !== 1 ? 's' : '' }}
            </span>
            <span class="status-sep status-sep-pipe"></span>
            <span class="status-dim">{{ formatSize(dirTotalSize) }}</span>
          </ng-container>
          <ng-template #emptyDir>
            <span class="status-dim">Empty folder</span>
          </ng-template>
        </ng-container>

      </div>

      <div class="status-center"></div>

      <div class="status-right">
        <ng-content></ng-content>
      </div>
    </div>
  `,
  styles: [`

      display: block;
      height: var(--vsc-statusbar-height, 22px);

      justify-content: space-between;
      height: 100%;
      padding: 0 8px;
      font-size: 11px;
      color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--vsc-statusbar-foreground) 85%, transparent);
      font-family: var(--vsc-font-family, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif);
    }

    .status-left, .status-right {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;

    }

      position: absolute;

      transform: translateX(-50%);

      white-space: nowrap;

      white-space: nowrap;
    }

    .status-sep {
      color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--vsc-statusbar-foreground) 35%, transparent);
      margin: 0 1px;
    }

    .status-sep-pipe {
      display: inline-block;
      width: 1px;
      height: 10px;
      background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--vsc-foreground) 25%, transparent);

      vertical-align: middle;
    }

})
export class StatusBarComponent {
  @Input() filteredEntries: FileInfo[] = [];
  @Input() selectedPaths: Set<string> = new Set();
  @Input() allEntries: FileInfo[] = [];

  get selectedCount(): number { return this.selectedPaths.size; }

  get fileCount(): number {
    return this.filteredEntries.filter(e => e.type === FileType.FILE || e.type === FileType.SYMLINK).length;
  }

  get dirCount(): number {
    return this.filteredEntries.filter(e => e.type === FileType.DIRECTORY).length;
  }

  /** Sum of sizes of selected entries (files only — dirs typically report 0) */
  get selectionSize(): number {
    if (this.selectedCount === 0) return 0;
    return this.allEntries
      .filter(e => this.selectedPaths.has(e.path))
      .reduce((sum, e) => sum + (e.size ?? 0), 0);
  }

  /** Sum of all file sizes in the filtered listing */
  get dirTotalSize(): number {
    return this.filteredEntries
      .filter(e => e.type === FileType.FILE || e.type === FileType.SYMLINK)
      .reduce((sum, e) => sum + (e.size ?? 0), 0);
  }

  formatSize(bytes: number): string {
    if (bytes === 0) return '0 B';
    if (bytes < 1024) return `${bytes} B`;
    if (bytes < 1024 * 1024) return `${(bytes / 1024).toFixed(1)} KB`;
    if (bytes < 1024 * 1024 * 1024) return `${(bytes / (1024 * 1024)).toFixed(1)} MB`;
    return `${(bytes / (1024 * 1024 * 1024)).toFixed(2)} GB`;
  }
}
`````

`````typescript
import { Component, EventEmitter, Input, Output } from "@angular/core";
import { TabInfo } from "../shared/protocol-enhanced";

@Component({
  selector: 'app-tab',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [CommonModule],
  template: `
    <div class="tab"
         [class.active]="isActive"
         [class.pinned]="tab.isPinned"
         [class.in-archive]="isArchiveTab"
          [title]="tab.kind === 'size-manager' ? 'Storage Footprint' : tab.title"
          draggable="true"
         (click)="onClick()"
         (auxclick)="onMouseUp($event)"
         (mouseenter)="isHovered = true"
         (mouseleave)="isHovered = false">

      <!-- Icon: per-tab — archive icon if this tab's path is inside an archive, folder otherwise -->

      </svg>

      <svg *ngIf="tab.kind === 'size-manager'" width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="currentColor" aria-label="Disk Usage" class="tab-icon tab-icon--disk-usage">
        <rect x="1" y="9" width="3" height="5" rx="0.5"/>
        <rect x="6" y="5" width="3" height="9" rx="0.5"/>
        <rect x="11" y="1" width="3" height="13" rx="0.5"/>
      </svg>

      <svg *ngIf="tab.kind !== 'viewer' && tab.kind !== 'size-manager' && !isArchiveTab" width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="currentColor" aria-label="Folder" class="tab-icon tab-icon--folder">
        <path d="M1 3.5A1.5 1.5 0 0 1 2.5 2h3.086a1.5 1.5 0 0 1 1.06.44l.915.914A.5.5 0 0 0 7.914 3.5H13.5A1.5 1.5 0 0 1 15 5v7.5a1.5 1.5 0 0 1-1.5 1.5h-11A1.5 1.5 0 0 1 1 12.5v-9Z"/>
      </svg>

      <svg *ngIf="tab.kind !== 'viewer' && tab.kind !== 'size-manager' && isArchiveTab" width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="currentColor" aria-label="Archive" class="tab-icon tab-icon--archive">
        <path d="M2 1a1 1 0 0 0-1 1v1a1 1 0 0 0 1 1h12a1 1 0 0 0 1-1V2a1 1 0 0 0-1-1H2Z"/>
        <path d="M2 5v8a2 2 0 0 0 2 2h8a2 2 0 0 0 2-2V5H2Zm4 2.5h4a.5.5 0 0 1 0 1H8.5v1a.5.5 0 0 1-1 0v-1H6a.5.5 0 0 1 0-1Z"/>
      </svg>

      background: var(--vsc-tab-background);
      border-right: 1px solid var(--vsc-tab-border);

        background var(--vsc-transition-fast),

      background: var(--vsc-tab-hover-background);
      color: var(--vsc-tab-hover-foreground);

      flex-shrink: 0;
      font-size: 9px;
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: 0.4px;
      padding: 1px 4px;
      border-radius: 3px;
      background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--vsc-accent-orange) 22%, transparent);
      border: 1px solid var(--vsc-warning-border);
      color: var(--vsc-accent-orange);
      line-height: 14px;
    }

    /* Action buttons */
    .tab-action {
      width: 18px;
      height: 18px;
      border: none;
      background: transparent;
      color: inherit;
      opacity: 0;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;

    /* Soften the tab icon when the tab is active to reduce perceived brightness */
    .tab.active .tab-icon {
      opacity: 0.82;
      filter: saturate(0.94) brightness(0.95);
    }
    }

    .tab:hover .tab-action {
      opacity: .7;
    }

    .tab-action:hover {
      opacity: 1 !important;

    }

    .tab.active .tab-action {

    }

    /* Close icon */
    .tab-action.close::before {
      content: "✕";
      font-size: 13px;
    }

    /* Pin action stays visible so pinning is discoverable without a shortcut. */
    .tab-action.pin {
      opacity: .42;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }

    .tab-action.pin:hover,
    .tab-action.pin.pinned-state,
    .tab.active .tab-action.pin {
      opacity: 1;
    }

    .tab-action.pin:not(.pinned-state) .pin-icon {
      filter: grayscale(1);
      opacity: .72;
    }

    .tab-action.pin.pinned-state .pin-icon {
      filter: none;
      opacity: 1;
    }

    /* Dirty dot */
    .dirty-dot {
      width: 7px;
      height: 7px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: var(--vsc-tab-foreground);
    }

    .dirty-dot.active-dirty {
      background: var(--vsc-accent-blue);
    }

    /* Compact */
    :host-context(.compact-mode) .tab {
      height: 100%;
      padding: 0 10px;
    }


    /* Focus */
    .tab:focus-visible {
      outline: 1px solid var(--vsc-accent-blue);
      outline-offset: -1px;
    }
  `]
})
export class TabComponent {
  @Input() tab!: TabInfo;
  @Input() isActive = false;
  /** Set to true when this tab is currently browsing inside an archive. */
  /** True when this specific tab's saved path is inside an archive virtual path.
   *  Derived from tab.path so each tab carries its own icon independently. */
  get isArchiveTab(): boolean {
    const p = this.tab?.path ?? '';
    // Archive virtual paths contain a known archive extension followed by a slash.
    // e.g. "filesystem://c/foo/bar.zip/src" or "/home/user/backup.tar.gz/etc"
    return /\.(zip|tar|gz|bz2|xz|7z|rar|iso|dmg|tgz|tbz2)([\/\\]|$)/i.test(p);
  }

  @Output() tabClick = new EventEmitter<TabInfo>();
  @Output() tabClose = new EventEmitter<TabInfo>();
  @Output() tabPin = new EventEmitter<TabInfo>();

  isHovered = false;

  get isClosable(): boolean {
    return this.tab?.isClosable !== false;
  }

  onClick(): void { this.tabClick.emit(this.tab); }

  onMouseUp(event: MouseEvent): void {
    if (event.button === 1) {
      this.onClose(event);
    }
  }

  onClose(event: Event): void {
    event.stopPropagation();
    this.tabClose.emit(this.tab);
  }

  onPin(event: Event): void {
    event.stopPropagation();
    this.tabPin.emit(this.tab);
  }
  
  get shortTitle(): string {
    const t = this.tab?.title ?? '';
    if (!t) return '';
    if ((this.tab?.kind ?? 'dir') === 'size-manager') return 'Storage Footprint';
    const parts = t.replace(/\\/g, '/').split('/').filter(Boolean);
    if (parts.length === 0) return t;
    // Drive root: "C:" or "/"
    if (parts.length === 1) return t;
    return parts[parts.length - 1];
  }
}
`````

import {
  Directive,
  ElementRef,
  Input,
  OnDestroy,
  OnInit,
  Output,
  EventEmitter,
  ContentChild,
  AfterContentInit,
  AfterContentChecked,
} from '@angular/core';
import { DropdownService } from '../services/dropdown.service';

/**
 * DropdownTriggerDirective — marks the trigger element of a dropdown.
 *
 * Usage:
 *   <button appDropdownTrigger>Open</button>
 */
@Directive({ selector: '[appDropdownTrigger]', standalone: true })
export class DropdownTriggerDirective {
  constructor(public el: ElementRef<HTMLElement>) {}
}

/**
 * DropdownMenuDirective — marks the menu panel of a dropdown.
 * Works with *ngIf — the directive re-registers whenever the element
 * appears or disappears in the DOM.
 *
 * Usage:
 *   <div appDropdownMenu *ngIf="isOpen">...</div>
 */
@Directive({ selector: '[appDropdownMenu]', standalone: true })
export class DropdownMenuDirective {
  constructor(public el: ElementRef<HTMLElement>) {}
}

/**
 * DropdownDirective — the host directive that wires everything together.
 *
 * USAGE:
 *
 * ```html
 * <div appDropdown [(isOpen)]="menuOpen">
 *   <button appDropdownTrigger (click)="menuOpen = !menuOpen">Filter ▾</button>
 *   <div appDropdownMenu *ngIf="menuOpen">
 *     <div class="item" (click)="selectItem(x)">Item</div>
 *   </div>
 * </div>
 * ```
 *
 * Handles:
 *  - Registering/updating with DropdownService (including after *ngIf re-creates the menu)
 *  - Closing on outside click (via DropdownService)
 *  - NOT closing when clicking inside — no race conditions
 *  - Closing other open dropdowns when this one opens
 *  - Escape key closes
 *  - Cleanup on destroy
 */
@Directive({
  selector: '[appDropdown]',
  standalone: true,
  host: {
    '(keydown.escape)': 'close()',
  },
  exportAs: 'appDropdown',
})
export class DropdownDirective implements OnInit, AfterContentInit, AfterContentChecked, OnDestroy {
  // Bind to the host attribute name so templates can use `[appDropdown]`.
  @Input('appDropdown') isOpen = false;
  @Output() isOpenChange = new EventEmitter<boolean>();
  @Output() closed = new EventEmitter<void>();

  @ContentChild(DropdownTriggerDirective) triggerDir?: DropdownTriggerDirective;
  @ContentChild(DropdownMenuDirective) menuDir?: DropdownMenuDirective;

  private dropdownId!: string;
  private lastMenuEl: HTMLElement | null = null;

  constructor(
    private el: ElementRef<HTMLElement>,
    private dropdownService: DropdownService,
  ) {}

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.dropdownId = this.dropdownService.register(
      this.el.nativeElement,
      this.el.nativeElement,
      () => this.close(),
    );
  }

  ngAfterContentInit(): void {
    this.syncRegistration();
  }

  ngAfterContentChecked(): void {
    // Re-sync whenever *ngIf creates or destroys the menu element
    const currentMenuEl = this.menuDir?.el.nativeElement ?? null;
    if (currentMenuEl !== this.lastMenuEl) {
      this.syncRegistration();
      this.lastMenuEl = currentMenuEl;
    }
  }

  private syncRegistration(): void {
    const trigger = this.triggerDir?.el.nativeElement ?? this.el.nativeElement;
    const menu    = this.menuDir?.el.nativeElement    ?? this.el.nativeElement;
    this.dropdownService.update(this.dropdownId, trigger, menu);
  }

  open(): void {
    this.dropdownService.closeOthers(this.dropdownId);
    this.isOpen = true;
    this.isOpenChange.emit(true);
  }

  close(): void {
    if (!this.isOpen) return;
    if (this.dropdownService.isInteractionPending(this.dropdownId)) return;
    this.isOpen = false;
    this.isOpenChange.emit(false);
    this.closed.emit();
  }

  toggle(): void {
    this.isOpen ? this.close() : this.open();
  }

  ngOnDestroy(): void {
    this.dropdownService.unregister(this.dropdownId);
  }
}

`````typescript
import {
  Directive,
  ElementRef,
  HostListener,
  Inject,
  Input,
  NgZone,
  OnChanges,
  OnDestroy,
  OnInit,
  Optional,
  Renderer2,
  SimpleChanges,
} from '@angular/core';
import { NgForm } from '@angular/forms';
import { InputHistoryService } from '../services/input-history.service';

let datalistCounter = 0;

/**
 * Wires a text input to the InputHistoryService so that previously entered
 * values are offered as a native `<datalist>` autocomplete and the most
 * recent value is committed to history when the field is committed
 * (blur / Enter / form submit).
 *
 * Usage:
 *   <input type="text" [appInputHistory]="'remote.host'" [(ngModel)]="host" />
 *
 * If no key is provided, the input's `name` or `id` attribute is used.
 */
@Directive({
  selector: 'input[appInputHistory], textarea[appInputHistory]',
  standalone: true,
  exportAs: 'inputHistory',
})
export class InputHistoryDirective implements OnInit, OnChanges, OnDestroy {
  @Input('appInputHistory') key: string | null | undefined = null;

  /** When false the directive becomes a no-op without un-mounting it. */
  @Input() appInputHistoryEnabled = true;

  /** Minimum trimmed length required before a value is recorded. */
  @Input() appInputHistoryMinLength = 1;

  private readonly host: HTMLInputElement | HTMLTextAreaElement;
  private datalistEl: HTMLDataListElement | null = null;
  private datalistId = '';
  private formSubmitUnsubscribe: { unsubscribe(): void } | null = null;

  constructor(
    elementRef: ElementRef<HTMLInputElement | HTMLTextAreaElement>,
    private readonly renderer: Renderer2,
    private readonly history: InputHistoryService,
    private readonly ngZone: NgZone,
    @Optional() @Inject(NgForm) private readonly parentForm: NgForm | null,
  ) {
    this.host = elementRef.nativeElement;
  }

  ngOnInit(): void {
    if (!this.host.hasAttribute('autocomplete')) {
      this.renderer.setAttribute(this.host, 'autocomplete', 'off');
    }
    this.ensureDatalist();
    this.refreshOptions();

    if (this.parentForm) {
      this.formSubmitUnsubscribe = this.parentForm.ngSubmit.subscribe(() => this.commit());
    }
  }

  ngOnChanges(changes: SimpleChanges): void {
    if (changes['key'] || changes['appInputHistoryEnabled']) {
      this.refreshOptions();
    }
  }

  ngOnDestroy(): void {
    this.formSubmitUnsubscribe?.unsubscribe();
    this.formSubmitUnsubscribe = null;
    if (this.datalistEl?.parentNode) {
      this.datalistEl.parentNode.removeChild(this.datalistEl);
    }
    this.datalistEl = null;
  }

  /** Re-reads the stored values and rebuilds the datalist options. */
  refresh(): void {
    this.refreshOptions();
  }

  /** Manually push the current value to history (e.g. before programmatic submit). */
  commit(): void {
    const resolved = this.resolveKey();
    if (!resolved || !this.appInputHistoryEnabled) return;
    const value = (this.host.value ?? '').trim();
    if (value.length < this.appInputHistoryMinLength) return;
    this.history.push(resolved, value);
    this.refreshOptions();
  }

  @HostListener('change')
  onChange(): void {
    this.commit();
  }

  @HostListener('blur')
  onBlur(): void {
    this.commit();
  }

  @HostListener('keydown.enter')
  onEnter(): void {
    this.commit();
  }

  @HostListener('focus')
  onFocus(): void {
    this.refreshOptions();
  }

  private resolveKey(): string {
    if (this.key && this.key.trim()) return this.key.trim();
    return this.host.getAttribute('name') || this.host.id || '';
  }

  private ensureDatalist(): void {
    if (this.datalistEl) return;
    this.datalistId = `app-input-history-${++datalistCounter}`;
    const datalist = this.renderer.createElement('datalist') as HTMLDataListElement;
    datalist.id = this.datalistId;
    if (this.host.parentNode) {
      this.renderer.insertBefore(this.host.parentNode, datalist, this.host.nextSibling);
    } else {
      this.renderer.appendChild(document.body, datalist);
    }
    this.renderer.setAttribute(this.host, 'list', this.datalistId);
    this.datalistEl = datalist;
  }

  private refreshOptions(): void {
    if (!this.datalistEl) return;
    const resolved = this.resolveKey();
    const items = this.appInputHistoryEnabled && resolved ? this.history.get(resolved) : [];

    while (this.datalistEl.firstChild) {
      this.renderer.removeChild(this.datalistEl, this.datalistEl.firstChild);
    }
    this.ngZone.runOutsideAngular(() => {
      for (const item of items) {
        const option = this.renderer.createElement('option') as HTMLOptionElement;
        option.value = item;
        this.renderer.appendChild(this.datalistEl!, option);
      }
    });
  }
}
`````

`````typescript
import { Type } from '@angular/core';

/**
 * Generic contribution registry used by ViewerRegistryService,
 * SurfaceRegistryService, and future plugin-provided registries.
 *
 * T is the specific contribution type (e.g., ViewerContribution).
 */
export interface Contribution<TReq> {
  id: string;
  score(req: TReq): number;
  load(): Promise<Type<unknown>> | Type<unknown>;
}

export class ContributionRegistry<TContrib extends Contribution<TReq>, TReq> {
  private readonly contributions: TContrib[] = [];
  private readonly loaded = new Map<string, Type<unknown>>();

  register(c: TContrib): void {
    const i = this.contributions.findIndex(x => x.id === c.id);
    if (i >= 0) {
      this.contributions.splice(i, 1, c);
    } else {
      this.contributions.push(c);
    }
  }

  unregister(id: string): void {
    const i = this.contributions.findIndex(x => x.id === id);
    if (i >= 0) {
      this.contributions.splice(i, 1);
    }
    this.loaded.delete(id);
  }

  async resolve(req: TReq, forcedId?: string | null): Promise<{ id: string; component: Type<unknown> }> {
    const best = this.pick(req, forcedId);
    const component = await this.load(best);
    return { id: best.id, component };
  }

  pick(req: TReq, forcedId?: string | null): TContrib {
    const forced = (forcedId ?? '').trim();
    if (forced) {
      const c = this.contributions.find(x => x.id === forced);
      if (c) return c;
    }

    let best: TContrib | null = null;
    let bestScore = 0;
    for (const c of this.contributions) {
      const s = c.score(req);
      if (s > bestScore) {
        bestScore = s;
        best = c;
      }
    }
    if (!best) {
      // Should be unreachable when a fallback is registered.
      best = this.contributions[0];
    }
    return best!;
  }

  list(): readonly TContrib[] {
    return this.contributions;
  }

  private load(c: TContrib): Promise<Type<unknown>> {
    const cached = this.loaded.get(c.id);
    if (cached) {
      return Promise.resolve(cached);
    }
    const loaded = Promise.resolve(c.load()) as Promise<Type<unknown>>;
    return loaded.then(component => {
      this.loaded.set(c.id, component);
      return component;
    });
  }
}
`````

`````typescript
export const PLUGIN_API_VERSION = '2.0.0';
export const PLUGIN_MANIFEST_SCHEMA_VERSION = 2 as const;
export type PluginManifestSchemaVersion = 1 | 2;

export type PluginPermission =
  | 'commands'
  | 'keybindings'
  | 'viewers'
  | 'surfaces'
  | 'toolbar'
  | 'contextMenu'
  | 'fileCategories'
  | 'relatedLocations'
  | 'collections'
  | 'panelSources'
  | 'columns'
  | 'filesystem.read'
  | 'filesystem.write'
  | 'network'
  | 'process'
  | 'clipboard'
  | 'backend.execute';

export type PluginActivationEvent =
  | 'onStartup'
  | 'onDemand'
  | `onCommand:${string}`
  | `onScheme:${string}`
  | `onSurface:${string}`;

export interface PluginTarget {
  os: 'windows' | 'linux' | 'darwin';
  arch: 'x64' | 'arm64';
}

export interface PluginFrontendEntry {
  entry: string;
}

export type PluginBackendPrivilege = 'normal' | 'elevated';

export interface PluginBackendEntry {
  entry: string;
  protocol: number;
  /**
   * Process privilege requested by the backend.
   * Omitted is equivalent to `normal`.
   */
  privilege?: PluginBackendPrivilege;
}

export interface PluginManifest {
  schemaVersion: PluginManifestSchemaVersion;
  id: string;
  name: string;
  version: string;
  description?: string;
  author?: string;
  homepage?: string;
  license?: string;
  /** Compatibility range for the host plugin API, e.g. ^1.0.0 or 1.x. */
  apiVersion?: string;
  target?: PluginTarget;
  frontend?: PluginFrontendEntry;
  backend?: PluginBackendEntry;
  permissions?: readonly PluginPermission[];
  activationEvents?: readonly PluginActivationEvent[];
  contributes?: {
    schemes?: readonly string[];
    extensions?: readonly string[];
    commands?: readonly string[];
    surfaces?: readonly string[];
    viewers?: readonly string[];
    relatedLocations?: readonly string[];
  };
}

export interface PluginManifestValidationResult {
  valid: boolean;
  errors: string[];
  warnings: string[];
}

const PLUGIN_ID = /^[a-z0-9](?:[a-z0-9._-]*[a-z0-9])?$/;
const SEMVER = /^(\d+)(?:\.(\d+))?(?:\.(\d+))?(?:-[0-9A-Za-z.-]+)?$/;

export function validatePluginManifest(
  manifest: PluginManifest,
  hostApiVersion = PLUGIN_API_VERSION,
): PluginManifestValidationResult {
  const errors: string[] = [];
  const warnings: string[] = [];

  if (manifest.schemaVersion !== 1 && manifest.schemaVersion !== 2) {
    errors.push(`Unsupported plugin manifest schema ${manifest.schemaVersion}.`);
  }
  if (manifest.schemaVersion === 2) {
    if (!manifest.target?.os || !manifest.target?.arch) {
      errors.push('Universal plugin target is required.');
    }
    if (!manifest.frontend?.entry?.trim()) {
      errors.push('Universal plugin frontend entry is required.');
    }
    if (!manifest.backend?.entry?.trim() || !Number.isInteger(manifest.backend.protocol) || manifest.backend.protocol <= 0) {
      errors.push('Universal plugin backend entry and positive protocol are required.');
    }
    if (manifest.backend?.privilege && manifest.backend.privilege !== 'normal' && manifest.backend.privilege !== 'elevated') {
      errors.push('Universal plugin backend privilege must be "normal" or "elevated".');
    }
  }
  if (!manifest.id?.trim() || !PLUGIN_ID.test(manifest.id)) {
    errors.push('Plugin id must be a lowercase identifier containing letters, digits, dot, dash, or underscore.');
  }
  if (!manifest.name?.trim()) errors.push('Plugin name is required.');
  if (!manifest.version?.trim() || !SEMVER.test(manifest.version)) {
    errors.push(`Plugin ${manifest.id || '<unknown>'} has an invalid semantic version.`);
  }
  const compatibilityHostVersion = manifest.schemaVersion === 1 ? '1.0.0' : hostApiVersion;
  if (manifest.apiVersion && !isPluginApiCompatible(manifest.apiVersion, compatibilityHostVersion)) {
    errors.push(
      `Plugin ${manifest.id || '<unknown>'} requires plugin API ${manifest.apiVersion}, host provides ${hostApiVersion}.`,
    );
  }

  const permissions = manifest.permissions ?? [];
  if (new Set(permissions).size !== permissions.length) {
    warnings.push('Plugin manifest contains duplicate permissions.');
  }

  return { valid: errors.length === 0, errors, warnings };
}

/**
 * Intentionally small compatibility matcher for the plugin API contract.
 * Supported forms: *, 1, 1.x, 1.2, 1.2.x, 1.2.3, ^1.2.3.
 * We can swap this for a full semver implementation later without changing manifests.
 */
export function isPluginApiCompatible(range: string, current: string): boolean {
  const wanted = range.trim();
  if (!wanted || wanted === '*') return true;

  const currentVersion = parseVersion(current);
  if (!currentVersion) return false;

  if (wanted.startsWith('^')) {
    const base = parseVersion(wanted.slice(1));
    if (!base) return false;
    if (base.major !== currentVersion.major) return false;
    return compareVersion(currentVersion, base) >= 0;
  }

  const wildcard = wanted.match(/^(\d+)(?:\.(\d+|x|\*))?(?:\.(\d+|x|\*))?$/i);
  if (wildcard) {
    const major = Number(wildcard[1]);
    if (currentVersion.major !== major) return false;
    const minor = wildcard[2];
    if (minor && minor !== 'x' && minor !== '*' && currentVersion.minor !== Number(minor)) return false;
    const patch = wildcard[3];
    if (patch && patch !== 'x' && patch !== '*' && currentVersion.patch !== Number(patch)) return false;
    return true;
  }

  const exact = parseVersion(wanted);
  return !!exact && compareVersion(currentVersion, exact) === 0;
}

interface ParsedVersion { major: number; minor: number; patch: number }

function parseVersion(value: string): ParsedVersion | null {
  const match = value.trim().match(SEMVER);
  if (!match) return null;
  return {
    major: Number(match[1]),
    minor: Number(match[2] ?? 0),
    patch: Number(match[3] ?? 0),
  };
}

function compareVersion(a: ParsedVersion, b: ParsedVersion): number {
  return a.major - b.major || a.minor - b.minor || a.patch - b.patch;
}
`````
