`````typescript
import type { ResultsPanelMetadata } from '../services/results-panel.service';
import type { PanelSource, PanelSourceKind } from '../services/panel-source';
import type {
  ThemeContribution,
  ColumnProfileContribution,
  LayoutPresetContribution,
  WorkspaceTemplateContribution,
} from '../services/customization-registry.service';

export interface PluginDescriptor {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  version: string;
  description?: string;
  author?: string;
  schemes?: string[];
  extensions?: string[];
  commands?: PluginCommandInfo[];
}


export interface PluginResultsCollection {
  /** Host-owned when called through a ScopedPluginRegistry. */
  ownerPluginId?: string;
  id: string;
  title: string;
  entries: readonly FileInfo[];
  metadata?: ResultsPanelMetadata;
  /**
   * Optional live refresh callback. It remains runtime-only; the host never
   * serializes executable plugin code into persisted collection snapshots.
   */
  refresh?: () => Promise<readonly FileInfo[]>;
}

export interface PanelColumnContext {
  readonly currentDirectory: string;
  readonly sourceId: string;
  readonly sourceKind: PanelSourceKind;
}

export interface PanelColumnContribution {
  readonly id: string;
  readonly label: string;
  readonly width?: string;
  /**
   * Render this provider field inline with the entry name in compact list
   * presentation. Details view still renders the column normally.
   */
  readonly inline?: boolean;
  score(context: PanelColumnContext): number;
  value(entry: FileInfo, context: PanelColumnContext): string | number | null | undefined;
}

export type PanelPresentationViewMode = 'list' | 'grid' | 'details' | 'tree';

export interface PanelPresentationContext extends PanelColumnContext {
  readonly viewMode: PanelPresentationViewMode;
}

export interface PanelPresentationHost {
  scroll(event: Event): void;
  backgroundClick(event: MouseEvent): void;
  backgroundContextMenu(event: MouseEvent): void;
  backgroundDragOver(event: DragEvent): void;
  backgroundDragLeave(event: DragEvent): void;
  backgroundDrop(event: DragEvent): void;
  select(entry: FileInfo, event: MouseEvent): void;
  open(entry: FileInfo): void;
  contextMenu(entry: FileInfo, event: MouseEvent): void;
  dragStart(entry: FileInfo, event: DragEvent): void;
  dragEnd(): void;
  dragOver(entry: FileInfo, event: DragEvent): void;
  dragLeave(entry: FileInfo): void;
  drop(entry: FileInfo, event: DragEvent): void;
}

export interface PanelPresentationModel {
  readonly paneId: 'left' | 'right';
  readonly path: string;
  readonly viewMode: PanelPresentationViewMode;
  readonly entries: readonly FileInfo[];
  readonly selectedPaths: ReadonlySet<string>;
  readonly cursorPath: string | null;
  readonly visibleEntryCount: number;
  readonly renderedStart: number;
  readonly virtualEnabled: boolean;
  readonly beforePx: number;
  readonly afterPx: number;
  readonly loading: boolean;
  readonly filterText: string;
  readonly dragOverPath: string | null;
  readonly dropIntent: 'copy' | 'move' | 'invalid' | null;
  readonly backgroundDropActive: boolean;
  readonly host: PanelPresentationHost;
}

export interface PanelPresentationContribution {
  readonly id: string;
  score(context: PanelPresentationContext): number;
  load(): Promise<Type<unknown>> | Type<unknown>;
}

export interface PluginCommandInfo {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  icon?: string;
  hotkey?: string;
  appliesTo?: string[];
}

export interface ToolbarActionContribution {
  id: string;
  /** Optional when commandId points at a registered command descriptor. */
  label?: string;
  icon?: string;
  shortcut?: string;
  /** Preferred execution path. Command metadata and enabled state come from the command registry. */
  commandId?: string;
  /** Compatibility path for existing plugins that have not registered a command descriptor yet. */
  execute?(context: ToolbarContext): void | Promise<void>;
  /** Score: 0 = not applicable; higher wins. */
  score(context: ToolbarContext): number;
}

export interface ToolbarContext {
  selectedPaths: string[];
  currentDirectory: string;
}

export interface ContextMenuContribution {
  id: string;
  /** Optional when commandId points at a registered command descriptor. */
  label?: string;
  icon?: string;
  shortcut?: string;
  /** Preferred execution path. Command metadata and enabled state come from the command registry. */
  commandId?: string;
  /** Compatibility path for existing callback-based contributions. */
  execute?(context: MenuContext): void | Promise<void>;
  /** Score: 0 = not applicable; higher wins. */
  score(context: MenuContext): number;
}

export interface MenuContext {
  targetPath: string;
  selectedPaths: string[];
  currentDirectory: string;
}


export interface FileCategoryResolver {
  id: string;
  resolve(path: string, mimeType?: string | null): FileCategory | null;
}

export interface FileCategory {
  category: string;
  icon?: string;
  color?: string;
}

export interface PluginRegistryAPI {
  /** Preferred: register commands, contexts, and default bindings as one owned unit. */
  registerInput(contribution: PluginInputContribution): void;
  unregisterInput(pluginId: string): void;

  /** Compatibility for command-only plugins. Prefer registerInput for new plugins. */
  registerCommand(command: CommandDescriptor): void;
  unregisterCommand(id: string): void;

  registerViewer(contribution: ViewerContribution): void;
  unregisterViewer(id: string): void;

  registerSurface(contribution: SurfaceContribution): void;
  unregisterSurface(id: string): void;

  registerWorkspaceSurfaceAction(
    contribution: WorkspaceSurfaceActionContribution,
  ): void;
  unregisterWorkspaceSurfaceAction(id: string): void;

  registerToolbarAction(action: ToolbarActionContribution): void;
  unregisterToolbarAction(id: string): void;

  registerContextMenuItem(item: ContextMenuContribution): void;
  unregisterContextMenuItem(id: string): void;

  registerFileCategory(resolver: FileCategoryResolver): void;
  unregisterFileCategory(id: string): void;

  registerRelatedLocation(contribution: RelatedLocationContribution): void;
  unregisterRelatedLocation(id: string): void;

  registerPanelSource(source: PanelSource): void;
  unregisterPanelSource(id: string): void;

  registerPanelColumn(column: PanelColumnContribution): void;
  unregisterPanelColumn(id: string): void;

  registerPanelPresentation(presentation: PanelPresentationContribution): void;
  unregisterPanelPresentation(id: string): void;

  registerTheme(theme: ThemeContribution): void;
  unregisterTheme(id: string): void;

  registerColumnProfile(profile: ColumnProfileContribution): void;
  unregisterColumnProfile(id: string): void;

  registerLayoutPreset(preset: LayoutPresetContribution): void;
  unregisterLayoutPreset(id: string): void;

  registerWorkspaceTemplate(template: WorkspaceTemplateContribution): void;
  unregisterWorkspaceTemplate(id: string): void;

  createResultsCollection(collection: PluginResultsCollection): string;
  removeResultsCollection(path: string): void;
}
`````

`````typescript
import { fn, spyOnFn, stubGlobal, restoreGlobals } from '../testing/jasmine-test-helpers';
import { ScopedPluginRegistry } from './scoped-plugin-registry';
import type { PluginRegistryAPI } from './plugin-registry-api';

function host(): PluginRegistryAPI {
  return {
    registerInput: fn(), unregisterInput: fn(),
    registerCommand: fn(), unregisterCommand: fn(),
    registerViewer: fn(), unregisterViewer: fn(),
    registerSurface: fn(), unregisterSurface: fn(),
    registerWorkspaceSurfaceAction: fn(), unregisterWorkspaceSurfaceAction: fn(),
    registerToolbarAction: fn(), unregisterToolbarAction: fn(),
    registerContextMenuItem: fn(), unregisterContextMenuItem: fn(),
    registerFileCategory: fn(), unregisterFileCategory: fn(),
    registerRelatedLocation: fn(), unregisterRelatedLocation: fn(),
    registerPanelSource: fn(), unregisterPanelSource: fn(),
    registerPanelColumn: fn(), unregisterPanelColumn: fn(),
    registerPanelPresentation: fn(), unregisterPanelPresentation: fn(),
    registerTheme: fn(), unregisterTheme: fn(),
    registerColumnProfile: fn(), unregisterColumnProfile: fn(),
    registerLayoutPreset: fn(), unregisterLayoutPreset: fn(),
    registerWorkspaceTemplate: fn(), unregisterWorkspaceTemplate: fn(),
    createResultsCollection: fn(() => 'results://plugin-collection'), removeResultsCollection: fn(),
  };
}

describe('ScopedPluginRegistry', () => {
  it('automatically unwinds registered contributions', () => {
    const target = host();
    const scope = new ScopedPluginRegistry('demo', target, new Set(['commands', 'toolbar']));
    scope.registerCommand({ id: 'plugin.demo.run', title: 'Run', execute: () => undefined });
    scope.registerToolbarAction({ id: 'run', commandId: 'plugin.demo.run', score: () => 1 });

    scope.dispose();

    expect(target.unregisterToolbarAction).toHaveBeenCalledWith('run');
    expect(target.unregisterCommand).toHaveBeenCalledWith('plugin.demo.run');
  });

  it('blocks undeclared contribution permissions', () => {
    const scope = new ScopedPluginRegistry('demo', host(), new Set(['commands']));
    expect(() => scope.registerToolbarAction({ id: 'run', score: () => 1 })).toThrowError(/toolbar/);
  });

  it('owns related-location contributions and requires explicit permission', () => {
    const target = host();
    const scope = new ScopedPluginRegistry('demo', target, new Set(['relatedLocations']));
    scope.registerRelatedLocation({ id: 'demo.related', score: () => 42 });

    scope.dispose();

    expect(target.registerRelatedLocation).toHaveBeenCalledWith(jasmine.objectContaining({ id: 'demo.related' }));
    expect(target.unregisterRelatedLocation).toHaveBeenCalledWith('demo.related');
  });

  it('blocks related-location contributions without permission', () => {
    const scope = new ScopedPluginRegistry('demo', host(), new Set([]));
    expect(() => scope.registerRelatedLocation({ id: 'demo.related', score: () => 1 })).toThrowError(/relatedLocations/);
  });


  it('creates plugin-owned result collections and removes them with the scope', () => {
    const target = host();
    const scope = new ScopedPluginRegistry('demo', target, new Set(['collections']));

    const path = scope.createResultsCollection({
      id: 'reports',
      title: 'Reports',
      entries: [],
    });

    expect(path).toBe('results://plugin-collection');
    expect(target.createResultsCollection).toHaveBeenCalledWith(jasmine.objectContaining({ id: 'reports', ownerPluginId: 'demo' }));

    scope.dispose();
    expect(target.removeResultsCollection).toHaveBeenCalledWith('results://plugin-collection');
  });

  it('blocks result collections without collections permission', () => {
    const scope = new ScopedPluginRegistry('demo', host(), new Set([]));
    expect(() => scope.createResultsCollection({ id: 'x', title: 'X', entries: [] })).toThrowError(/collections/);
  });


  it('owns panel sources and columns and cleans both up', () => {
    const target = host();
    const scope = new ScopedPluginRegistry('demo', target, new Set(['panelSources', 'columns']));
    const source = {
      id: 'demo.source', kind: 'virtual' as const, title: 'Demo',
      canHandle: () => true, capabilities: () => ({ read: true, create: false, delete: false, rename: false, trash: false }),
      list: async () => ({ location: { path: 'demo://', sourceId: 'demo.source', sourceKind: 'virtual' as const }, entries: [] }),
      getRootPath: () => 'demo://', getParentPath: () => 'demo://', joinChildPath: () => 'demo://', supportsStreaming: () => false,
    };
    const column = { id: 'demo.owner', label: 'Owner', score: () => 1, value: () => 'demo' };

    scope.registerPanelColumn(column);
    scope.dispose();

    expect(target.unregisterPanelColumn).toHaveBeenCalledWith('demo.owner');
    expect(target.unregisterPanelSource).toHaveBeenCalledWith('demo.source');
  });

  it('requires explicit panel source and column permissions', () => {
    const scope = new ScopedPluginRegistry('demo', host(), new Set([]));
    expect(() => scope.registerPanelColumn({ id: 'x', label: 'X', score: () => 1, value: () => '' })).toThrowError(/columns/);
  });

  it('forces input ownership to the active plugin', () => {
    const target = host();
    const scope = new ScopedPluginRegistry('demo', target, new Set(['commands', 'keybindings']));
    scope.registerInput({ pluginId: 'somebody-else', commands: [], bindings: [] });
    expect(target.registerInput).toHaveBeenCalledWith(jasmine.objectContaining({ pluginId: 'demo' }));

    scope.registerTheme({ id: 'demo.theme', label: 'Demo', kind: 'dark', variables: {} });

    expect(target.unregisterTheme).toHaveBeenCalledWith('demo.theme');
`````

`````typescript
import type {
  ContextMenuContribution,
  FileCategoryResolver,
  PluginRegistryAPI,
  ToolbarActionContribution,
  PluginResultsCollection,
  PanelColumnContribution,
  PanelPresentationContribution,
} from './plugin-registry-api';
import type { PluginPermission } from './plugin-manifest';
import type { CommandDescriptor, PluginInputContribution } from '../services/input-system.types';
import type { ViewerContribution } from '../viewers/viewer-contribution';
import type { SurfaceContribution } from '../surfaces/surface-contribution';
import type { RelatedLocationContribution } from '../services/related-location.types';
import type { WorkspaceSurfaceActionContribution } from '../services/workspace-surface-action.types';
import type { PanelSource } from '../services/panel-source';
import type {
  ThemeContribution,
  ColumnProfileContribution,
  LayoutPresetContribution,
  WorkspaceTemplateContribution,
} from '../services/customization-registry.service';

/**
 * Plugin-facing registry wrapper. Every successful contribution is recorded and
 * removed in reverse order when the scope is disposed.
 */
export class ScopedPluginRegistry implements PluginRegistryAPI {
  private readonly cleanups: Array<() => void> = [];
  private disposed = false;

  constructor(
    private readonly pluginId: string,
    private readonly host: PluginRegistryAPI,
    private readonly permissions: ReadonlySet<PluginPermission>,
  ) {}

  dispose(): void {
    if (this.disposed) return;
    this.disposed = true;
    for (let i = this.cleanups.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      try { this.cleanups[i](); } catch (error) { console.error(`Plugin ${this.pluginId} cleanup failed:`, error); }
    }
    this.cleanups.length = 0;
  }

  registerInput(contribution: PluginInputContribution): void {
    this.assertActive();
    this.require('commands');
    if ((contribution.bindings?.length ?? 0) > 0 ||
        (contribution.contexts?.length ?? 0) > 0) {
      this.require('keybindings');
    }
    const owned = { ...contribution, pluginId: this.pluginId };
    this.host.registerInput(owned);
    this.cleanups.push(() => this.host.unregisterInput(this.pluginId));
  }

  unregisterInput(pluginId: string): void {
    this.assertOwnId(pluginId);
    this.host.unregisterInput(pluginId);
  }

  registerCommand(command: CommandDescriptor): void {
    this.assertActive(); this.require('commands');
    this.host.registerCommand(command);
    this.cleanups.push(() => this.host.unregisterCommand(command.id));
  }
  unregisterCommand(id: string): void { this.host.unregisterCommand(id); }

  registerViewer(contribution: ViewerContribution): void {
    this.assertActive(); this.require('viewers');
    this.host.registerViewer(contribution);
    this.cleanups.push(() => this.host.unregisterViewer(contribution.id));
  }
  unregisterViewer(id: string): void { this.host.unregisterViewer(id); }

  registerSurface(contribution: SurfaceContribution): void {
    this.assertActive(); this.require('surfaces');
    this.host.registerSurface(contribution);
    this.cleanups.push(() => this.host.unregisterSurface(contribution.id));
  }
  unregisterSurface(id: string): void { this.host.unregisterSurface(id); }

  registerWorkspaceSurfaceAction(
    contribution: WorkspaceSurfaceActionContribution,
  ): void {
    this.assertActive();
    this.require('surfaces');
    this.host.registerWorkspaceSurfaceAction(contribution);
    this.cleanups.push(
      () => this.host.unregisterWorkspaceSurfaceAction(contribution.id),
    );
  }

  unregisterWorkspaceSurfaceAction(id: string): void {
    this.host.unregisterWorkspaceSurfaceAction(id);
  }

  registerToolbarAction(action: ToolbarActionContribution): void {
    this.assertActive(); this.require('toolbar');
    this.host.registerToolbarAction(action);
    this.cleanups.push(() => this.host.unregisterToolbarAction(action.id));
  }
  unregisterToolbarAction(id: string): void { this.host.unregisterToolbarAction(id); }

  registerContextMenuItem(item: ContextMenuContribution): void {
    this.assertActive(); this.require('contextMenu');
    this.host.registerContextMenuItem(item);
    this.cleanups.push(() => this.host.unregisterContextMenuItem(item.id));
  }
  unregisterContextMenuItem(id: string): void { this.host.unregisterContextMenuItem(id); }


  registerFileCategory(resolver: FileCategoryResolver): void {
    this.assertActive(); this.require('fileCategories');
    this.host.registerFileCategory(resolver);
    this.cleanups.push(() => this.host.unregisterFileCategory(resolver.id));
  }
  unregisterFileCategory(id: string): void { this.host.unregisterFileCategory(id); }

  registerRelatedLocation(contribution: RelatedLocationContribution): void {
    this.assertActive(); this.require('relatedLocations');
    this.host.registerRelatedLocation(contribution);
    this.cleanups.push(() => this.host.unregisterRelatedLocation(contribution.id));
  }
  unregisterRelatedLocation(id: string): void { this.host.unregisterRelatedLocation(id); }

  registerPanelSource(source: PanelSource): void {
    this.assertActive(); this.require('panelSources');
    this.host.registerPanelSource(source);
    this.cleanups.push(() => this.host.unregisterPanelSource(source.id));
  }
  unregisterPanelSource(id: string): void { this.host.unregisterPanelSource(id); }

  registerPanelColumn(column: PanelColumnContribution): void {
    this.assertActive(); this.require('columns');
    this.host.registerPanelColumn(column);
    this.cleanups.push(() => this.host.unregisterPanelColumn(column.id));
  }
  unregisterPanelColumn(id: string): void { this.host.unregisterPanelColumn(id); }

  registerPanelPresentation(presentation: PanelPresentationContribution): void {
    this.assertActive(); this.require('panelSources');
    this.host.registerPanelPresentation(presentation);
    this.cleanups.push(() => this.host.unregisterPanelPresentation(presentation.id));
  }
  unregisterPanelPresentation(id: string): void { this.host.unregisterPanelPresentation(id); }

  registerTheme(theme: ThemeContribution): void {
    this.assertActive(); this.require('surfaces');
    this.host.registerTheme(theme);
    this.cleanups.push(() => this.host.unregisterTheme(theme.id));
  }
  unregisterTheme(id: string): void { this.host.unregisterTheme(id); }

  registerColumnProfile(profile: ColumnProfileContribution): void {
    this.assertActive(); this.require('columns');
    this.host.registerColumnProfile(profile);
    this.cleanups.push(() => this.host.unregisterColumnProfile(profile.id));
  }
  unregisterColumnProfile(id: string): void { this.host.unregisterColumnProfile(id); }

  registerLayoutPreset(preset: LayoutPresetContribution): void {
    this.assertActive(); this.require('surfaces');
    this.host.registerLayoutPreset(preset);
    this.cleanups.push(() => this.host.unregisterLayoutPreset(preset.id));
  }
  unregisterLayoutPreset(id: string): void { this.host.unregisterLayoutPreset(id); }

  registerWorkspaceTemplate(template: WorkspaceTemplateContribution): void {
    this.assertActive(); this.require('surfaces');
    this.host.registerWorkspaceTemplate(template);
    this.cleanups.push(() => this.host.unregisterWorkspaceTemplate(template.id));
  }
  unregisterWorkspaceTemplate(id: string): void { this.host.unregisterWorkspaceTemplate(id); }

  createResultsCollection(collection: PluginResultsCollection): string {
    this.assertActive();
    this.require('collections');
    const path = this.host.createResultsCollection({
      ...collection,
      ownerPluginId: this.pluginId,
    });
    this.cleanups.push(() => this.host.removeResultsCollection(path));
    return path;
  }

  removeResultsCollection(path: string): void {
    this.assertActive();
    this.require('collections');
    this.host.removeResultsCollection(path);
  }

  private require(permission: PluginPermission): void {
    if (!this.permissions.has(permission)) {
      throw new Error(`Plugin ${this.pluginId} is not granted permission ${permission}.`);
    }
  }

  private assertActive(): void {
    if (this.disposed) throw new Error(`Plugin ${this.pluginId} contribution scope is already disposed.`);
  }

  private assertOwnId(pluginId: string): void {
    if (pluginId !== this.pluginId) {
      throw new Error(`Plugin ${this.pluginId} cannot unregister input owned by ${pluginId}.`);
    }
  }
}
`````

`````typescript
import { buildActionAvailability } from './action-availability';
import type { SourceCapabilities } from './source-capabilities';
const rw: SourceCapabilities = { read:true, create:true, delete:true, rename:true, trash:true };
const ro: SourceCapabilities = { read:true, create:false, delete:false, rename:false, trash:false };
describe('buildActionAvailability', () => {
  it('enables full file actions for writable source and destination', () => {
    const a=buildActionAvailability({source:rw,destination:rw,selectedCount:1,hasClipboard:true,clipboardOperation:'copy'});
    expect(a.copyToOther).toBe(true); expect(a.moveToOther).toBe(true); expect(a.paste).toBe(true); expect(a.rename).toBe(true);
  });
  it('keeps copy-out but blocks move-out from read-only sources', () => {
    const a=buildActionAvailability({source:ro,destination:rw,selectedCount:1,hasClipboard:false});
    expect(a.copyToOther).toBe(true); expect(a.moveToOther).toBe(false); expect(a.deleteSelected).toBe(false);
  });
  it('blocks transfers into read-only destinations', () => {
    const a=buildActionAvailability({source:rw,destination:ro,selectedCount:1,hasClipboard:false});
    expect(a.copyToOther).toBe(false); expect(a.moveToOther).toBe(false);
  });
});
`````

`````typescript
import type { SourceCapabilities } from './source-capabilities';

export interface ActionAvailability {
  readonly createFolder: boolean;
  readonly deleteSelected: boolean;
  readonly copySelected: boolean;
  readonly cutSelected: boolean;
  readonly paste: boolean;
  readonly rename: boolean;
  readonly copyToOther: boolean;
  readonly moveToOther: boolean;
}

export function buildActionAvailability(input: {
  source: SourceCapabilities;
  destination?: SourceCapabilities | null;
  selectedCount: number;
  hasClipboard: boolean;
  clipboardOperation?: 'copy' | 'cut' | null;
}): ActionAvailability {
  const hasSelection = input.selectedCount > 0;
  const destinationWritable = !!input.destination?.create;
  return Object.freeze({
    createFolder: input.source.create,
    deleteSelected: hasSelection && input.source.delete,
    copySelected: hasSelection && input.source.read,
    cutSelected: hasSelection && input.source.read && input.source.delete,
    paste: input.hasClipboard && input.source.create,
    rename: hasSelection && input.source.rename,
    copyToOther: hasSelection && input.source.read && destinationWritable,
    moveToOther: hasSelection && input.source.read && input.source.delete && destinationWritable,
  });
}

export const NO_ACTIONS: ActionAvailability = Object.freeze({
  createFolder: false, deleteSelected: false, copySelected: false, cutSelected: false,
  paste: false, rename: false, copyToOther: false, moveToOther: false,
});
`````

`````typescript
import { ActionFeedbackService } from './action-feedback.service';

describe('ActionFeedbackService', () => {
  it('keeps errors persistent until dismissed', () => {
    const service = new ActionFeedbackService();
    const id = service.error('Delete failed', 'Access denied');

    expect(service.items$.value).toEqual([
      jasmine.objectContaining({
        id,
        kind: 'error',
        persistent: true,
        title: 'Delete failed',
      }),
    ]);

    service.dismiss(id);
    expect(service.items$.value).toEqual([]);
  });

  it('caps visible feedback so fast operations cannot flood the UI', () => {
    const service = new ActionFeedbackService();

    for (let i = 0; i < 10; i += 1) {
      service.show('info', `Operation ${i}`, undefined, { persistent: true });
    }

    expect(service.items$.value.length).toBe(6);
    expect(service.items$.value[0].title).toBe('Operation 4');
  });
});
`````

`````typescript
import { Injectable } from '@angular/core';
import { createBehaviorSubject } from '@epikodelabs/streamix';

export type FeedbackKind = 'success' | 'warning' | 'error' | 'info';

export interface FeedbackItem {
  readonly id: string;
  readonly kind: FeedbackKind;
  readonly title: string;
  readonly message?: string;
  readonly createdAt: number;
  readonly persistent: boolean;
}

@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })
export class ActionFeedbackService {
  private readonly itemsSubject =
    createBehaviorSubject<readonly FeedbackItem[]>([]);
  readonly items$ = this.itemsSubject;

  private readonly timers = new Map<string, ReturnType<typeof setTimeout>>();
  private sequence = 0;

  show(
    kind: FeedbackKind,
    title: string,
    message?: string,
    options: { persistent?: boolean; timeoutMs?: number } = {},
  ): string {
    const id = `feedback-${Date.now()}-${++this.sequence}`;
    const persistent = options.persistent ?? kind === 'error';
    const item: FeedbackItem = {
      id,
      kind,
      title,
      message,
      createdAt: Date.now(),
      persistent,
    };

    this.itemsSubject.next([...this.itemsSubject.value, item].slice(-6));

    if (!persistent) {
      const timeoutMs = Math.max(1800, options.timeoutMs ?? 4200);
      const timer = setTimeout(() => this.dismiss(id), timeoutMs);
      this.timers.set(id, timer);
    }

    return id;
  }

  success(title: string, message?: string): string {
    return this.show('success', title, message);
  }

  warning(title: string, message?: string): string {
    return this.show('warning', title, message, { timeoutMs: 6000 });
  }

  error(title: string, message?: string): string {
    return this.show('error', title, message, { persistent: true });
  }

  dismiss(id: string): void {
    const timer = this.timers.get(id);
    if (timer) clearTimeout(timer);
    this.timers.delete(id);
    this.itemsSubject.next(this.itemsSubject.value.filter(item => item.id !== id));
  }

  clear(): void {
    for (const timer of this.timers.values()) clearTimeout(timer);
    this.timers.clear();
    this.itemsSubject.next([]);
  }
}
`````

`````typescript
import {
  buildArchivePath,
  normalizeArchiveLocation,
  parseArchivePath,
} from './archive.service';

export interface ArchiveNavigationAuditResult {
  readonly canonical: string;
  readonly roundTrips: boolean;
  readonly schemePreserved: boolean;
}

export function auditArchiveNavigation(
  location: string,
): ArchiveNavigationAuditResult {
  const canonical = normalizeArchiveLocation(location);
  const parsed = parseArchivePath(canonical);
  const rebuilt = buildArchivePath(
    parsed.fsPath,
    parsed.nestedChain,
    parsed.innerPath,
  );

  const scheme = /^([a-z][a-z0-9+.-]*):\/\//i.exec(canonical)?.[1];

  return {
    canonical,
    roundTrips: normalizeArchiveLocation(rebuilt) === canonical,
    schemePreserved: !scheme || rebuilt.startsWith(`${scheme}://`),
  };
}
`````

`````typescript
import type { ArchiveTabState } from './workspace.service';
import {
  parseArchivePath,
  sameArchiveLocation,
} from './archive.service';

export interface ArchiveTabStateAuditResult {
  readonly hasFrames: boolean;
  readonly rootMatchesLocation: boolean;
  readonly nestedChainMatchesLocation: boolean;
}

export function auditArchiveTabState(
  location: string,
  state: ArchiveTabState | null,
): ArchiveTabStateAuditResult {
  if (!state || state.archiveStack.length === 0) {
    return {
      hasFrames: false,
      rootMatchesLocation: false,
      nestedChainMatchesLocation: false,
    };
  }

  const parsed = parseArchivePath(location);
  const root = state.archiveStack[0];
  const current = state.archiveStack[state.archiveStack.length - 1];

  return {
    hasFrames: true,
    rootMatchesLocation:
      !!root && sameArchiveLocation(root.fsPath, parsed.fsPath),
    nestedChainMatchesLocation:
      !!current &&
      current.nestedChain.length === parsed.nestedChain.length &&
      current.nestedChain.every(
        (segment, index) => segment === parsed.nestedChain[index],
      ),
  };
}
`````

`````typescript
import type { ViewerFileListItem } from '../shared/protocol-enhanced';

export function archiveViewerSibling(
  fileList: readonly ViewerFileListItem[],
  currentPath: string,
  delta: -1 | 1,
): ViewerFileListItem | null {
  const normalize = (value: string) =>
    (value ?? '').replace(/\\/g, '/').replace(/^\/+|\/+$/g, '');

  const current = normalize(currentPath);
  const index = fileList.findIndex(item =>
    normalize(item.path) === current,
  );

  if (index < 0) return null;
  return fileList[index + delta] ?? null;
}
`````

`````typescript
import { Injectable } from '@angular/core';

import { FileType, type FileInfo } from '../shared/protocol';
import type { PanelSource, PanelSourceContext, PanelSourceListing } from './panel-source';
import type { SourceCapabilities } from './source-capabilities';

export type AutorunScope = 'user' | 'machine';
export type AutorunOrigin = 'registry-run' | 'registry-run-once' | 'startup-folder';

export interface AutorunRecord {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  command: string;
  executable?: string;
  sourcePath: string;
  scope: AutorunScope;
  origin: AutorunOrigin;
  enabled: boolean;
}

type AutorunFileInfo = FileInfo & {
  autorunId?: string;
  autorunCommand?: string;
  autorunExecutable?: string;
  autorunSourcePath?: string;
  autorunScope?: AutorunScope;
  autorunOrigin?: AutorunOrigin;
  autorunEnabled?: boolean;
};

const READ_ONLY: SourceCapabilities = { read: true, create: false, delete: false, rename: false, trash: false };
const ROOT = 'autorun://';

function normalize(path: string): string {
  return (path || ROOT).replace(/\/+$/, '').toLowerCase() || 'autorun:';
}

function fileInfo(name: string, path: string, type: FileType): FileInfo {
  return {
    name, path, type, size: 0, created: 0, modified: 0, accessed: 0,
    permissions: 'r--', isHidden: false,
  };
}

@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })
export class AutorunPanelSource implements PanelSource {
  readonly id = 'builtin.autorun';
  readonly kind = 'virtual' as const;
  readonly title = 'Autorun';

  canHandle(context: PanelSourceContext): boolean {
    return /^autorun:\/\//i.test(context.path);
  }

  capabilities(): SourceCapabilities { return READ_ONLY; }
  supportsStreaming(): boolean { return false; }
  getRootPath(): string { return ROOT; }

  getParentPath(context: PanelSourceContext): string {
    const p = normalize(context.path);
    if (p === 'autorun:' || p === 'autorun://') return ROOT;
    const rest = context.path.replace(/^autorun:\/\//i, '').replace(/\/+$/, '');
    const cut = rest.lastIndexOf('/');
    return cut < 0 ? ROOT : `autorun://${rest.slice(0, cut)}`;
  }

  joinChildPath(context: PanelSourceContext, childName: string): string {
    return `${context.path.replace(/\/+$/, '')}/${encodeURIComponent(childName)}`;
  }

  async list(context: PanelSourceContext): Promise<PanelSourceListing> {
    const path = normalize(context.path);
    let entries: FileInfo[];

    if (path === 'autorun:' || path === 'autorun://') {
      entries = [
        fileInfo('Current User', 'autorun://user', FileType.DIRECTORY),
        fileInfo('All Users', 'autorun://machine', FileType.DIRECTORY),
      ];
    } else if (path === 'autorun://user' || path === 'autorun://machine') {
      const scope = path.endsWith('user') ? 'user' : 'machine';
      entries = [
        fileInfo('Registry Run', `autorun://${scope}/registry-run`, FileType.DIRECTORY),
        fileInfo('Registry RunOnce', `autorun://${scope}/registry-run-once`, FileType.DIRECTORY),
        fileInfo('Startup Folder', `autorun://${scope}/startup-folder`, FileType.DIRECTORY),
      ];
    } else {
      const records = await this.records();
      const [scope, origin] = this.parseLeaf(path);
      entries = records
        .filter(record => record.scope === scope && record.origin === origin)
        .map(record => this.toFileInfo(record));
    }

    return {
      location: { path: context.path || ROOT, sourceId: this.id, sourceKind: this.kind },
      entries,
    };
  }

  canPreviewEntry(_context: PanelSourceContext, entry: FileInfo): boolean {
    return !this.decodeEntryPath(entry.path);
  }

  activateEntry(_context: PanelSourceContext, entry: FileInfo): boolean {
    const id = this.decodeEntryPath(entry.path);
    if (!id) return false;

    // Autorun records are synthetic resources, not files at autorun://entry/....
    // Opening them through the generic viewer would make ApiService try to create/read
    // a Windows path with an invalid URI. Provider activation owns this leaf instead.
    void this.records().then(records => {
      const record = records.find(candidate => candidate.id === id);
      if (record?.executable) {
        return (window as any)?.go?.app?.App?.OpenFile?.(record.executable);
      }
      return undefined;
    }).catch(error => console.warn('Failed to activate autorun entry:', error));
    return true;
  }

  async records(): Promise<AutorunRecord[]> {
    const app = (window as any)?.go?.app?.App;
    if (!app?.AutorunList) return [];
    const result = await app.AutorunList();
    return Array.isArray(result) ? result : [];
  }

  async setEnabled(id: string, enabled: boolean): Promise<void> {
    const app = (window as any)?.go?.app?.App;
    if (!app?.AutorunSetEnabled) throw new Error('Autorun backend is not available on this platform.');
    await app.AutorunSetEnabled(id, enabled);
  }

  async delete(id: string): Promise<void> {
    const app = (window as any)?.go?.app?.App;
    if (!app?.AutorunDelete) throw new Error('Autorun backend is not available on this platform.');
    await app.AutorunDelete(id);
  }

  decodeEntryPath(path: string): string | null {
    const match = /^autorun:\/\/entry\/(.+)$/i.exec(path ?? '');
    if (!match?.[1]) return null;
    try { return decodeURIComponent(match[1]); } catch { return null; }
  }

  private parseLeaf(path: string): [AutorunScope, AutorunOrigin] {
    const match = /^autorun:\/\/(user|machine)\/(registry-run|registry-run-once|startup-folder)$/i.exec(path);
    if (!match) return ['user', 'registry-run'];
    return [match[1].toLowerCase() as AutorunScope, match[2].toLowerCase() as AutorunOrigin];
  }

  private toFileInfo(record: AutorunRecord): FileInfo {
    return {
      ...fileInfo(record.name, `autorun://entry/${encodeURIComponent(record.id)}`, FileType.FILE),
      size: record.command.length,
      permissions: record.enabled ? 'r-x' : 'r--',
      autorunId: record.id,
      autorunCommand: record.command,
      autorunExecutable: record.executable ?? '',
      autorunSourcePath: record.sourcePath,
      autorunScope: record.scope,
      autorunOrigin: record.origin,
      autorunEnabled: record.enabled,
    } as AutorunFileInfo;
  }
}
`````

## File: manager/frontend/src/app/services/backend-plugin-command-bridge.service.ts
`````typescript
import { Injectable } from '@angular/core';
import type { plugin } from '../../../wailsjs/go/models';
import type { CommandDescriptor, CommandInvocation, InputBindingDefinition, KeyStroke, PluginInputContribution } from './input-system.types';
import { ApiService } from './api.service';
import { InputEngineService } from './input-engine.service';

export type PluginSelectionProvider = () => readonly string[];

const OWNER_PREFIX = 'backend-plugin:';

export function backendPluginCommandId(pluginId: string, commandId: string): string {
  return `plugin.backend.${pluginId}.${commandId}`;
}

export function backendPluginCommandName(pluginId: string, commandId: string): string {
  return `${pluginId}.${commandId}`.toLowerCase();
}

function ownedPluginId(pluginId: string): string {
  return `${OWNER_PREFIX}${pluginId}`;
}

type KeyModifier = NonNullable<KeyStroke['modifiers']>[number];

function normalizeModifier(token: string): KeyModifier | null {
  switch (token.trim().toLowerCase()) {
    case 'ctrl':
    case 'control': return 'ctrl';
    case 'shift': return 'shift';
    case 'alt':
    case 'option': return 'alt';
    case 'cmd':
    case 'command':
    case 'meta':
    case 'win':
    case 'windows': return 'meta';
    default: return null;
  }
}

export function parsePluginHotkey(hotkey: string | null | undefined): KeyStroke | null {
  const raw = (hotkey ?? '').trim();
  if (!raw || /\s/.test(raw)) return null; // Multi-stroke chords are not encoded by backend metadata yet.

  const parts = raw.split('+').map(part => part.trim()).filter(Boolean);
  if (parts.length === 0) return null;

  const key = parts.pop()!.toLowerCase();
  if (!key) return null;

  const modifiers: KeyModifier[] = [];
  for (const part of parts) {
    const modifier = normalizeModifier(part);
    if (!modifier) return null;
    if (!modifiers.includes(modifier)) modifiers.push(modifier);
  }

  return { key, modifiers };
}

function commandNeedsSelection(command: plugin.CommandInfo): boolean {
  return !!command.appliesTo?.length;
}

function invocationPaths(invocation: CommandInvocation | undefined, fallback: readonly string[]): string[] {
  const candidate = invocation?.args?.['paths'];
  if (Array.isArray(candidate) && candidate.every(path => typeof path === 'string')) {
    return [...candidate];
  }
  return [...fallback];
}

@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })
export class BackendPluginCommandBridgeService {
  private readonly registeredPluginIds = new Set<string>();
  private selectionProvider: PluginSelectionProvider = () => [];

  constructor(
    private readonly api: ApiService,
    private readonly inputEngine: InputEngineService,
  ) {}

  async start(selectionProvider: PluginSelectionProvider): Promise<void> {
    this.selectionProvider = selectionProvider;
    await this.refresh();
  }

  setSelectionProvider(selectionProvider: PluginSelectionProvider): void {
    this.selectionProvider = selectionProvider;
  }

  async refresh(): Promise<void> {
    const plugins = await this.api.listBackendPlugins();
    this.clearRegisteredCommands();

    try {
      for (const info of plugins ?? []) {
        const contribution = this.toInputContribution(info);
        if (contribution.commands.length === 0) continue;

        this.inputEngine.registerPluginInput(contribution);
        this.registeredPluginIds.add(contribution.pluginId);
      }
    } catch (error) {
      this.clearRegisteredCommands();
      throw error;
    }
  }

  stop(): void {
    this.clearRegisteredCommands();
    this.selectionProvider = () => [];
  }

  private toInputContribution(info: plugin.Info): PluginInputContribution {
    const pluginId = ownedPluginId(info.id);
    const commands: CommandDescriptor[] = [];
    const bindings: InputBindingDefinition[] = [];

    for (const command of info.commands ?? []) {
      const id = backendPluginCommandId(info.id, command.id);
      commands.push({
        id,
        title: command.label || command.id,
        description: info.name ? `${info.name} plugin command` : 'Backend plugin command',
        category: 'Plugins',
        icon: command.icon,
        name: backendPluginCommandName(info.id, command.id),
        execute: (invocation) => this.api.invokeBackendPluginCommand(
          info.id,
          command.id,
          invocationPaths(invocation, this.selectionProvider()),
        ),
        isEnabled: (invocation) => !commandNeedsSelection(command)
          || invocationPaths(invocation, this.selectionProvider()).length > 0,
      });

      const stroke = parsePluginHotkey(command.hotkey);
      if (stroke) {
        bindings.push({
          id: `${id}.defaultHotkey`,
          commandId: id,
          contextId: 'global',
          source: 'plugin',
          description: command.label || command.id,
          category: 'Plugins',
          when: '!typing && !quickAccess && hasActivePane',
          preventDefault: true,
          trigger: { device: 'keyboard', chord: { steps: [stroke] } },
        });
      }
    }

    return { pluginId, commands, bindings };
  }

  private clearRegisteredCommands(): void {
    for (const pluginId of this.registeredPluginIds) {
      this.inputEngine.unregisterPluginInput(pluginId);
    }
    this.registeredPluginIds.clear();
  }
}
`````

`````typescript
export type BasicFileManagerFeature =
  | 'navigation' | 'backForward' | 'refresh'
  | 'copyCutPaste' | 'copyMoveOtherPane'
  | 'rename' | 'newFileFolder'
  | 'trashDelete' | 'permanentDelete' | 'undoRedo'
  | 'properties' | 'checksum' | 'folderSize'
  | 'openWithPreview' | 'searchFilter' | 'sortViews'
  | 'hiddenFiles' | 'selection' | 'tabs'
  | 'pinsHistory' | 'dragDrop'

export const BASIC_FILE_MANAGER_FEATURES: readonly BasicFileManagerFeature[] = [
  'navigation','backForward','refresh','copyCutPaste','copyMoveOtherPane',
  'rename','newFileFolder','trashDelete','permanentDelete','undoRedo',
  'properties','checksum','folderSize','openWithPreview','searchFilter',
  'sortViews','hiddenFiles','selection','tabs','pinsHistory','dragDrop',
  'archiveBrowseExtract','archiveCreate','rootsDrives','attributesPermissions','trashBrowseRestore','openWithChooser','driveLifecycle','transferUndo','copyPathName','duplicate','links','terminalHere','reveal','relativePath','timestamps','multiProperties','driveCapacity','newTemplates','shortcuts','multiChecksum','fileUri','sameTypeSelection','moveSelectionFolder','nameSafety',
];

export function missingBasicFileManagerFeatures(
  implemented: ReadonlySet<BasicFileManagerFeature>,
): BasicFileManagerFeature[] {
  return BASIC_FILE_MANAGER_FEATURES.filter(feature => !implemented.has(feature));
}


export const BASIC_FILE_MANAGER_BASELINE_VERSION = 1 as const;

/**
 * The Phase 63 audit verified that every feature in BASIC_FILE_MANAGER_FEATURES
 * has a concrete implementation in the reassembly shell. Advanced plugin,
 * compare/sync, remote-provider and viewer-specific features remain outside this
`````

`````typescript
export interface BatchRenameTemplateContext {
  readonly originalName: string;
  readonly index: number;
  readonly counter: number;
  readonly counterWidth: number;
  readonly date?: Date;
}

export interface BatchRenameParts {
  readonly stem: string;
  readonly ext: string;
}

export function splitBatchRenameName(name: string): BatchRenameParts {
  if (name.startsWith('.')) {
    const dot = name.indexOf('.', 1);
    if (dot < 0) return { stem: name, ext: '' };
    return { stem: name.slice(0, dot), ext: name.slice(dot) };
  }

  const dot = name.lastIndexOf('.');
  if (dot < 0) return { stem: name, ext: '' };
  return { stem: name.slice(0, dot), ext: name.slice(dot) };
}

function pad(value: number, width: number): string {
  return String(value).padStart(Math.max(1, width), '0');
}

function isoDate(date: Date): string {
  const y = date.getFullYear();
  const m = String(date.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0');
  const d = String(date.getDate()).padStart(2, '0');
  return `${y}-${m}-${d}`;
}

function applyToken(token: string, context: BatchRenameTemplateContext): string | null {
  const { stem, ext } = splitBatchRenameName(context.originalName);
  const normalized = token.trim();

  if (normalized === 'name') return stem;
  if (normalized === 'ext') return ext.replace(/^\./, '');
  if (normalized === '.ext') return ext;
  if (normalized === 'index') return String(context.index + 1);
  if (normalized === 'date') return isoDate(context.date ?? new Date());

  if (normalized === 'upper:name') return stem.toLocaleUpperCase();
  if (normalized === 'lower:name') return stem.toLocaleLowerCase();

  const counter = /^n(?::(\d+))?$/.exec(normalized);
  if (counter) {
    return pad(context.counter, Number(counter[1]) || context.counterWidth);
  }

  const replace = /^replace:(.*?)=>(.*)$/.exec(normalized);
  if (replace) {
    const from = replace[1];
    const to = replace[2];
    return from ? stem.split(from).join(to) : stem;
  }

  return null;
}

export function applyBatchRenameTemplate(
  pattern: string,
  context: BatchRenameTemplateContext,
): string {
  const { stem, ext } = splitBatchRenameName(context.originalName);

  // Keep the original compact syntax fully compatible.
  let result = '';
  for (let i = 0; i < pattern.length; i += 1) {
    const char = pattern[i];

    if (char === '*') {
      result += stem;
      continue;
    }

    if (char === '&') {
      result += ext;
      continue;
    }

    if (char === '#') {
      let width = 1;
      while (pattern[i + width] === '#') width += 1;
      result += pad(context.counter, Math.max(width, context.counterWidth));
      i += width - 1;
      continue;
    }

    if (char === '{') {
      const end = pattern.indexOf('}', i + 1);
      if (end >= 0) {
        const raw = pattern.slice(i + 1, end);
        const token = applyToken(raw, context);
        if (token !== null) {
          result += token;
          i = end;
          continue;
        }
      }
    }

    result += char;
  }

  return result;
}
`````

`````typescript
/**
 * Canvas video player backward seek tests
 * 
 * Tests to ensure:
 * 1. Buffered frame detection works properly for backward seeks
 * 2. Frame tolerance is correctly applied
 * 3. No discrepancies in decoded frames vs buffered frames
 */

interface MockDecodedFrame {
  timestampMs: number;
  frameId: string;
}

/**
 * Test: buffered frame detection tolerance for backward seeks
 */
describe('Buffered frame detection for backward seeks', () => {
  const decodedFrames: MockDecodedFrame[] = [
    { timestampMs: 1000, frameId: 'f1' },
    { timestampMs: 1033, frameId: 'f2' },
    { timestampMs: 1066, frameId: 'f3' },
    { timestampMs: 1099, frameId: 'f4' },
  ];

  function getFrameIntervalEstimateMs(): number {
    if (decodedFrames.length > 1) {
      const delta = decodedFrames[1].timestampMs - decodedFrames[0].timestampMs;
      if (delta > 0) {
        return Math.min(250, Math.max(16, delta));
      }
    }
    return 33.33;
  }

  function getPresentationToleranceMs(): number {
    return Math.min(12, getFrameIntervalEstimateMs() * 0.25);
  }

  function findBufferedFrameForTime(targetTimeMs: number, isSeekingBackward: boolean): MockDecodedFrame | undefined {
    if (decodedFrames.length === 0) {
      return undefined;
    }

    const presentationToleranceMs = getPresentationToleranceMs();
    const firstFrame = decodedFrames[0];
    const lastFrame = decodedFrames[decodedFrames.length - 1];
    const frameIntervalMs = getFrameIntervalEstimateMs();

    // Both backward and forward seeks use standard tolerance
    const effectiveTolerance = presentationToleranceMs;

    if (targetTimeMs < firstFrame.timestampMs - effectiveTolerance) {
      return undefined;
    }

    if (targetTimeMs > lastFrame.timestampMs + (frameIntervalMs * 0.25)) {
      return undefined;
    }

    // Find frame with timestamp closest to but not exceeding target
    let selectedFrame = firstFrame;
    for (const frame of decodedFrames) {
      if (frame.timestampMs <= targetTimeMs + effectiveTolerance) {
        selectedFrame = frame;
      } else {
        break;
      }
    }

    return selectedFrame;
  }

  it('should find buffered frame for backward seek within decoded range', () => {
    const frame = findBufferedFrameForTime(1050, true);
    expect(frame).toBeDefined();
    expect(frame?.frameId).toBe('f2');
  });

  it('should not find frame before decoded range', () => {
    const frame = findBufferedFrameForTime(500, true);
    expect(frame).toBeUndefined();
  });

  it('should find buffered frames for backward and forward seeks', () => {
    // Both backward and forward seeks use the same tolerance logic
    const presentationToleranceMs = getPresentationToleranceMs();
    
    // Tolerance should be applied consistently
    expect(presentationToleranceMs).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    
    // Both should find valid frames at same target time
    const backwardFrame = findBufferedFrameForTime(1050, true);
    const forwardFrame = findBufferedFrameForTime(1050, false);
    
    expect(backwardFrame).toBeDefined();
    expect(forwardFrame).toBeDefined();
    // Since we removed the tolerance multiplier, both should find the same frame
    expect(backwardFrame?.frameId).toBe(forwardFrame?.frameId);
  });

  it('should return last decoded frame when target is near last', () => {
    const frameIntervalMs = getFrameIntervalEstimateMs();
    const lastFrame = decodedFrames[decodedFrames.length - 1];
    // Target within tolerance of last frame
    const targetTime = lastFrame.timestampMs + 5;

    const frame = findBufferedFrameForTime(targetTime, true);
    expect(frame?.frameId).toBe('f4');
  });
});

describe('Audio-clock playback sync', () => {
  type ScheduledAudioEntry = {
    startTime: number;
    endTime: number;
    mediaStartSec: number;
  };

  function getScheduledAudioPlaybackTimeMs(
    scheduledAudioNodes: ScheduledAudioEntry[],
    nowSec: number,
    playbackBaseMs: number,
  ): number | null {
    if (scheduledAudioNodes.length === 0) {
      return null;
    }

    const firstScheduledNode = scheduledAudioNodes[0];
    if (nowSec < firstScheduledNode.startTime) {
      return playbackBaseMs;
    }

    let anchor = firstScheduledNode;
    for (const entry of scheduledAudioNodes) {
      if (entry.startTime > nowSec) {
        break;
      }
      anchor = entry;
    }

    const elapsedSec = Math.max(0, Math.min(nowSec, anchor.endTime) - anchor.startTime);
    return (anchor.mediaStartSec + elapsedSec) * 1000;
  }

    const scheduled = [
      { startTime: 10.05, endTime: 10.15, mediaStartSec: 5.0 },
      { startTime: 10.15, endTime: 10.25, mediaStartSec: 5.1 },
    ];

    expect(getScheduledAudioPlaybackTimeMs(scheduled, 10.20, 5000)).toBeCloseTo(5150, 6);
  });

describe('Segment window management consistency', () => {
  const SEGMENT_RETENTION_BEHIND = 6;
  const SEGMENT_RETENTION_AHEAD = 6;
  const SEGMENT_PREFETCH_AHEAD = 3;

  function calculateSegmentWindow(anchorIndex: number) {
    const minIndex = Math.max(0, anchorIndex - SEGMENT_RETENTION_BEHIND);
    const maxIndex = anchorIndex + SEGMENT_RETENTION_AHEAD;
    const maxPrefetch = anchorIndex + SEGMENT_RETENTION_AHEAD + SEGMENT_PREFETCH_AHEAD;
    return { minIndex, maxIndex, maxPrefetch };
  }

  it('should calculate symmetric window for mid-video anchor', () => {
    const totalSegments = 100;
    const anchor = 50;
    const window = calculateSegmentWindow(anchor);

    expect(window.minIndex).toBe(44);
    expect(window.maxIndex).toBe(56);
    expect(window.maxPrefetch).toBe(59);
  });

  it('should clamp window at start of video', () => {
    const window = calculateSegmentWindow(0);
    expect(window.minIndex).toBe(0);
    expect(window.maxIndex).toBe(6);
  });

  it('should maintain same prefetch ahead for backward and forward seek', () => {
    const anchor1 = 50;
    const anchor2 = 100;

    const window1 = calculateSegmentWindow(anchor1);
    const window2 = calculateSegmentWindow(anchor2);

    // Prefetch ahead should be consistent relative to anchor
    expect(window1.maxPrefetch - window1.maxIndex).toBe(window2.maxPrefetch - window2.maxIndex);
    expect(window1.maxPrefetch - anchor1).toBe(window2.maxPrefetch - anchor2);
  });

  it('should have equal retention behind and ahead', () => {
    const anchor = 50;
    const window = calculateSegmentWindow(anchor);
    
    const retentionBehind = anchor - window.minIndex;
    const retentionAhead = window.maxIndex - anchor;
    
    expect(retentionBehind).toBe(SEGMENT_RETENTION_BEHIND);
    expect(retentionAhead).toBe(SEGMENT_RETENTION_AHEAD);
  });

  const SEGMENT_FAILURE_COOLDOWN_MS = 5000;

  function isSegmentRecentlyFailed(failedAt: number | undefined, now: number): boolean {
    if (failedAt === undefined) return false;
    return now - failedAt < SEGMENT_FAILURE_COOLDOWN_MS;
  }

  it('should block recently failed segments', () => {
    const failedAt = 1000;
    const now1 = 2000;  // 1000ms later
    const now2 = 6500;  // 5500ms later

    expect(isSegmentRecentlyFailed(failedAt, now1)).toBe(true);
    expect(isSegmentRecentlyFailed(failedAt, now2)).toBe(false);
  });

  it('should allow retry after cooldown', () => {
    const failedAt = 1000;
    const exactCooldown = 1000 + SEGMENT_FAILURE_COOLDOWN_MS;
    const afterCooldown = exactCooldown + 1;

    expect(isSegmentRecentlyFailed(failedAt, exactCooldown)).toBe(false);
    expect(isSegmentRecentlyFailed(failedAt, afterCooldown)).toBe(false);

    const seekGeneration2 = 2;

    function isCurrentSeek(generation: number, currentGeneration: number): boolean {
      return generation === currentGeneration;
    }

    // Seek 1 starts
    expect(isCurrentSeek(seekGeneration1, 1)).toBe(true);
    
    // Seek 2 starts (increments generation)
    expect(isCurrentSeek(seekGeneration1, 2)).toBe(false);
    expect(isCurrentSeek(seekGeneration2, 2)).toBe(true);
`````
