`````typescript
import { Injectable } from '@angular/core';
import { createBehaviorSubject } from '@epikodelabs/streamix';
import type { WorkspaceLayout, WorkspacePresentation } from './workspace-surface.model';

export interface ThemeContribution {
  readonly id: string;
  readonly label: string;
  readonly kind: 'light' | 'dark';
  readonly variables: Readonly<Record<string, string>>;
}

export interface ColumnProfileContribution {
  readonly id: string;
  readonly label: string;
  readonly columnIds: readonly string[];
  readonly widths?: Readonly<Record<string, string>>;
}

export interface LayoutPresetContribution {
  readonly id: string;
  readonly label: string;
  readonly description?: string;
  createLayout(workspaceId: string): WorkspaceLayout;
}

export interface WorkspaceTemplateContext {
  readonly workspaceId: string;
  readonly title?: string;
}

export interface WorkspaceTemplateContribution {
  readonly id: string;
  readonly label: string;
  readonly description?: string;
  create(context: WorkspaceTemplateContext): WorkspacePresentation;
}

interface OwnedContribution<T> {
  readonly ownerId: string;
  readonly value: T;
  readonly order: number;
}

/** Runtime registry for user-facing customization assets and plugin contributions. */
@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })
export class CustomizationRegistryService {
  private readonly themes = new Map<string, Map<string, OwnedContribution<ThemeContribution>>>();
  private readonly columnProfiles = new Map<string, Map<string, OwnedContribution<ColumnProfileContribution>>>();
  private readonly layouts = new Map<string, Map<string, OwnedContribution<LayoutPresetContribution>>>();
  private readonly templates = new Map<string, Map<string, OwnedContribution<WorkspaceTemplateContribution>>>();
  private order = 0;

  readonly themes$ = createBehaviorSubject<ThemeContribution[]>([]);
  readonly columnProfiles$ = createBehaviorSubject<ColumnProfileContribution[]>([]);
  readonly layoutPresets$ = createBehaviorSubject<LayoutPresetContribution[]>([]);
  readonly workspaceTemplates$ = createBehaviorSubject<WorkspaceTemplateContribution[]>([]);

  registerTheme(value: ThemeContribution, ownerId = 'default'): void {
    this.register(this.themes, value.id, ownerId, value);
    this.emitThemes();
  }

  unregisterTheme(id: string, ownerId = 'default'): void {
    this.unregister(this.themes, id, ownerId);
    this.emitThemes();
  }

  registerColumnProfile(value: ColumnProfileContribution, ownerId = 'default'): void {
    this.register(this.columnProfiles, value.id, ownerId, value);
    this.emitColumnProfiles();
  }

  unregisterColumnProfile(id: string, ownerId = 'default'): void {
    this.unregister(this.columnProfiles, id, ownerId);
    this.emitColumnProfiles();
  }

  registerLayoutPreset(value: LayoutPresetContribution, ownerId = 'default'): void {
    this.register(this.layouts, value.id, ownerId, value);
    this.emitLayouts();
  }

  unregisterLayoutPreset(id: string, ownerId = 'default'): void {
    this.unregister(this.layouts, id, ownerId);
    this.emitLayouts();
  }

  registerWorkspaceTemplate(value: WorkspaceTemplateContribution, ownerId = 'default'): void {
    this.register(this.templates, value.id, ownerId, value);
    this.emitTemplates();
  }

  unregisterWorkspaceTemplate(id: string, ownerId = 'default'): void {
    this.unregister(this.templates, id, ownerId);
    this.emitTemplates();
  }

  getTheme(id: string): ThemeContribution | undefined { return this.active(this.themes.get(id))?.value; }
  getColumnProfile(id: string): ColumnProfileContribution | undefined { return this.active(this.columnProfiles.get(id))?.value; }
  getLayoutPreset(id: string): LayoutPresetContribution | undefined { return this.active(this.layouts.get(id))?.value; }
  getWorkspaceTemplate(id: string): WorkspaceTemplateContribution | undefined { return this.active(this.templates.get(id))?.value; }

  applyTheme(id: string, target: HTMLElement = document.documentElement): boolean {
    const theme = this.getTheme(id);
    if (!theme) return false;
    target.dataset['themeId'] = theme.id;
    target.dataset['themeKind'] = theme.kind;
    for (const [name, value] of Object.entries(theme.variables)) {
      target.style.setProperty(name.startsWith('--') ? name : `--${name}`, value);
    }
    return true;
  }

  unregisterOwner(ownerId: string): void {
    for (const registry of [this.themes, this.columnProfiles, this.layouts, this.templates]) {
      for (const [id, registrations] of registry) {
        registrations.delete(ownerId);
        if (registrations.size === 0) registry.delete(id);
      }
    }
    this.emitAll();
  }

  private register<T>(registry: Map<string, Map<string, OwnedContribution<T>>>, id: string, ownerId: string, value: T): void {
    const registrations = registry.get(id) ?? new Map<string, OwnedContribution<T>>();
    registrations.set(ownerId, { ownerId, value, order: ++this.order });
    registry.set(id, registrations);
  }

  private unregister<T>(registry: Map<string, Map<string, OwnedContribution<T>>>, id: string, ownerId: string): void {
    const registrations = registry.get(id);
    if (!registrations) return;
    registrations.delete(ownerId);
    if (registrations.size === 0) registry.delete(id);
  }

  private active<T>(registrations: Map<string, OwnedContribution<T>> | undefined): OwnedContribution<T> | undefined {
    if (!registrations?.size) return undefined;
    let active: OwnedContribution<T> | undefined;
    for (const registration of registrations.values()) {
      if (!active || registration.order > active.order) active = registration;
    }
    return active;
  }

  private values<T>(registry: Map<string, Map<string, OwnedContribution<T>>>): T[] {
    return Array.from(registry.values())
      .map(registrations => this.active(registrations))
      .filter((entry): entry is OwnedContribution<T> => !!entry)
      .sort((left, right) => left.order - right.order)
      .map(entry => entry.value);
  }

  private emitThemes(): void { this.themes$.next(this.values(this.themes)); }
  private emitColumnProfiles(): void { this.columnProfiles$.next(this.values(this.columnProfiles)); }
  private emitLayouts(): void { this.layoutPresets$.next(this.values(this.layouts)); }
  private emitTemplates(): void { this.workspaceTemplates$.next(this.values(this.templates)); }
  private emitAll(): void { this.emitThemes(); this.emitColumnProfiles(); this.emitLayouts(); this.emitTemplates(); }
}
`````

## File: manager/frontend/src/app/services/directory-plugin-package-loader.service.ts
`````typescript
import { Injectable } from '@angular/core';
import type { ToolbarContext, MenuContext } from '../plugin/plugin-registry-api';
import type { DeclarativePluginBinding, DeclarativePluginModule, DeclarativePluginPlacement } from '../plugin/declarative-plugin-module';
import type { PluginPackage, PluginPackageLoader, PluginPackageSource } from '../plugin/plugin-package';
import type { PluginManifest } from '../plugin/plugin-manifest';
import { InputEngineService } from './input-engine.service';
import type { CommandDescriptor, InputBindingDefinition } from './input-system.types';

interface DirectoryPluginBindings {
  ReadPluginFrontendModule(pluginId: string): Promise<unknown>;
  DiscoverPluginPackages(): Promise<unknown[]>;
}

function appBindings(): DirectoryPluginBindings {
  const bindings = (window as any)?.go?.app?.App as DirectoryPluginBindings | undefined;
  if (!bindings?.ReadPluginFrontendModule || !bindings?.DiscoverPluginPackages) {
    throw new Error('Directory plugin loader bindings are unavailable. Regenerate Wails bindings and restart the application.');
  }
  return bindings;
}

@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })
export class DirectoryPluginPackageLoaderService implements PluginPackageLoader {
  readonly kind = 'directory';

  constructor(private readonly inputEngine: InputEngineService) {}

  async load(source: PluginPackageSource): Promise<PluginPackage> {
    const pluginId = source.metadata?.['pluginId'];
    if (typeof pluginId !== 'string' || !pluginId) {
      throw new Error('Managed directory plugin source is missing pluginId metadata.');
    }

    const manifest = await this.loadManifest(pluginId);
    const module = normalizeModule(await appBindings().ReadPluginFrontendModule(pluginId));
    return this.buildPackage(manifest, module);
  }

  private async loadManifest(pluginId: string): Promise<PluginManifest> {
    const packages = await appBindings().DiscoverPluginPackages();
    for (const value of packages ?? []) {
      const raw = (value ?? {}) as Record<string, unknown>;
      const manifest = (raw['manifest'] ?? {}) as PluginManifest;
      if (manifest.id === pluginId && raw['valid'] === true) return manifest;
    }
    throw new Error(`Plugin ${pluginId} is not a valid discovered directory package.`);
  }

  private buildPackage(manifest: PluginManifest, module: DeclarativePluginModule): PluginPackage {
    return {
      manifest,
      activate: context => {
        const commandIds = new Map<string, string>();
        const commands: CommandDescriptor[] = [];

        for (const command of module.commands ?? []) {
          const id = `plugin.directory.${manifest.id}.${command.id}`;
          commandIds.set(command.id, id);
          commands.push({
            id,
            title: command.title?.trim() || command.id,
            category: manifest.name || 'Plugins',
            name: `${manifest.id}.${command.name?.trim() || command.id}`,
            aliases: command.aliases,
            execute: invocation => {
              const dispatched = this.inputEngine.dispatchCommandById(
                command.targetCommandId,
                invocation,
              );
              if (!dispatched) {
                throw new Error(
                  `Target command ${command.targetCommandId} is unavailable.`,
                );
              }
            },
            isEnabled: invocation =>
              this.inputEngine.isCommandEnabled(
                command.targetCommandId,
                invocation,
              ),
          });
        }

        const bindings: InputBindingDefinition[] =
          (module.bindings ?? []).map((binding: DeclarativePluginBinding) => {
            const commandId = commandIds.get(binding.commandId);
            if (!commandId) {
              throw new Error(
                `Plugin binding ${binding.id} references unknown command ${binding.commandId}.`,
              );
            }

            return {
              id: `plugin.directory.${manifest.id}.binding.${binding.id}`,
              commandId,
              trigger: binding.trigger,
              contextId: binding.contextId?.trim() || 'global',
              source: 'plugin',
              priority: binding.priority,
              when: binding.when,
              description:
                binding.description?.trim() ||
                commands.find(command => command.id === commandId)?.title ||
                binding.id,
              category: binding.category?.trim() || manifest.name || 'Plugins',
              preventDefault: true,
            };
          });

        if (commands.length || bindings.length) {
          context.api.registerInput({
            pluginId: manifest.id,
            commands,
            bindings,
          });
        }

        for (const placement of module.toolbar ?? []) {
          context.api.registerToolbarAction({
            id: `${manifest.id}.toolbar.${placement.id}`,
            commandId: mustResolveCommand(commandIds, placement),
            score: toolbarScore(placement),
          });
        }

        for (const placement of module.contextMenu ?? []) {
          context.api.registerContextMenuItem({
            id: `${manifest.id}.contextMenu.${placement.id}`,
            commandId: mustResolveCommand(commandIds, placement),
            score: menuScore(placement),
          });
        }
      },
    };
  }
}

function normalizeModule(value: unknown): DeclarativePluginModule {
  const raw = (value ?? {}) as Record<string, unknown>;
  if (raw['schemaVersion'] !== 1) throw new Error(`Unsupported declarative plugin module schema ${String(raw['schemaVersion'])}.`);
  return raw as unknown as DeclarativePluginModule;
}

function mustResolveCommand(commands: ReadonlyMap<string, string>, placement: DeclarativePluginPlacement): string {
  const id = commands.get(placement.commandId);
  if (!id) throw new Error(`Plugin placement ${placement.id} references unknown command ${placement.commandId}.`);
  return id;
}

function placementMatches(when: DeclarativePluginPlacement['when'], selectedCount: number): boolean {
  switch (when ?? 'always') {
    case 'always': return true;
    case 'selection': return selectedCount > 0;
    case 'single-selection': return selectedCount === 1;
  }
}

function toolbarScore(placement: DeclarativePluginPlacement): (context: ToolbarContext) => number {
  return context => placementMatches(placement.when, context.selectedPaths.length) ? 100 : 0;
}

function menuScore(placement: DeclarativePluginPlacement): (context: MenuContext) => number {
  return context => placementMatches(placement.when, context.selectedPaths.length) ? 100 : 0;
}
`````

`````typescript
import { Injectable } from '@angular/core';

export type DiscoverySearchType = 'all' | 'files' | 'folders' | 'archives';
export type DiscoverySearchSort = 'relevance' | 'name' | 'path' | 'type';

export interface DiscoverySearchSpec {
  readonly rootPath: string;
  readonly query: string;
  readonly recursive: boolean;
  readonly type: DiscoverySearchType;
  readonly sort: DiscoverySearchSort;
}

export interface DiscoverySearchHistoryEntry extends DiscoverySearchSpec {
  readonly id: string;
  readonly searchedAt: number;
  readonly resultCount: number;
}

export interface SavedDiscoverySearch extends DiscoverySearchSpec {
  readonly id: string;
  readonly name: string;
  readonly createdAt: number;
  readonly updatedAt: number;
}

interface DiscoveryState {
  readonly version: 1;
  history: DiscoverySearchHistoryEntry[];
  saved: SavedDiscoverySearch[];
}

const STORAGE_KEY = 'reassembly.discovery.v1';
const MAX_HISTORY = 80;
const MAX_SAVED = 80;

@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })
export class DiscoveryHistoryService {
  history(): readonly DiscoverySearchHistoryEntry[] {
    return this.read().history.map(entry => ({ ...entry }));
  }

  saved(): readonly SavedDiscoverySearch[] {
    return this.read().saved
      .map(entry => ({ ...entry }))
      .sort((a,b) => a.name.localeCompare(b.name, undefined, {
        numeric: true,
        sensitivity: 'base',
      }));
  }

  record(spec: DiscoverySearchSpec, resultCount: number): void {
    if (!spec.query.trim() || !spec.rootPath.trim()) return;

    const state = this.read();
    const key = this.specKey(spec);
    const existing = state.history.find(entry => this.specKey(entry) === key);

    state.history = [
      {
        ...spec,
        id: existing?.id ?? this.id('history'),
        searchedAt: Date.now(),
        resultCount: Math.max(0, resultCount),
      },
      ...state.history.filter(entry => this.specKey(entry) !== key),
    ].slice(0, MAX_HISTORY);

    this.write(state);
  }

  save(name: string, spec: DiscoverySearchSpec, id?: string): SavedDiscoverySearch {
    const title = name.trim();
    if (!title) throw new Error('Saved search name is required.');

    const state = this.read();
    const now = Date.now();
    const existing =
      (id ? state.saved.find(entry => entry.id === id) : undefined) ??
      state.saved.find(entry =>
        entry.name.localeCompare(title, undefined, { sensitivity: 'base' }) === 0
      );

    const saved: SavedDiscoverySearch = {
      ...spec,
      id: existing?.id ?? this.id('saved'),
      name: title,
      createdAt: existing?.createdAt ?? now,
      updatedAt: now,
    };

    state.saved = [
      ...state.saved.filter(entry => entry.id !== saved.id),
      saved,
    ].slice(0, MAX_SAVED);

    this.write(state);
    return saved;
  }

  removeSaved(id: string): void {
    const state = this.read();
    state.saved = state.saved.filter(entry => entry.id !== id);
    this.write(state);
  }

  removeHistory(id: string): void {
    const state = this.read();
    state.history = state.history.filter(entry => entry.id !== id);
    this.write(state);
  }

  clearHistory(): void {
    const state = this.read();
    state.history = [];
    this.write(state);
  }

  private read(): DiscoveryState {
    try {
      const raw = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
      if (!raw) return this.empty();

      const value = JSON.parse(raw) as Partial<DiscoveryState>;
      return {
        version: 1,
        history: Array.isArray(value.history)
          ? value.history.filter(entry => this.validSpec(entry)).slice(0, MAX_HISTORY)
          : [],
        saved: Array.isArray(value.saved)
          ? value.saved.filter(entry => this.validSpec(entry) && !!entry?.name).slice(0, MAX_SAVED)
          : [],
      };
    } catch {
      return this.empty();
    }
  }

  private write(state: DiscoveryState): void {
    try {
      localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(state));
    } catch {
      // Discovery remains functional when persistence is unavailable.
    }
  }

  private validSpec(value: any): boolean {
    return !!value &&
      typeof value.rootPath === 'string' &&
      typeof value.query === 'string' &&
      typeof value.recursive === 'boolean';
  }

  private specKey(spec: DiscoverySearchSpec): string {
    return [
      spec.rootPath.trim().replace(/\\/g, '/').toLocaleLowerCase(),
      spec.query.trim().toLocaleLowerCase(),
      spec.recursive ? 'r' : 'n',
      spec.type,
      spec.sort,
    ].join('|');
  }

  private id(prefix: string): string {
    return `${prefix}-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(16).slice(2)}`;
  }

  private empty(): DiscoveryState {
    return { version: 1, history: [], saved: [] };
  }
}
`````

`````typescript
import { Injectable } from '@angular/core';

import { ApiService } from './api.service';
import { PanelSourceRegistryService } from './panel-source-registry.service';
import { FileInfo, FileType } from '../shared/protocol';

export interface DiscoverySearchOptions {
  readonly recursive?: boolean;
  readonly showHidden?: boolean;
  readonly maxResults?: number;
  readonly maxVisitedDirectories?: number;
  readonly maxDepth?: number;
  readonly type?: 'all' | 'files' | 'folders' | 'archives';
  readonly signal?: AbortSignal;
  readonly onProgress?: (progress: DiscoverySearchProgress) => void;
  readonly onBatch?: (
    batch: readonly FileInfo[],
    progress: DiscoverySearchProgress,
  ) => void;
  readonly batchSize?: number;
}

export interface DiscoverySearchProgress {
  readonly sourceId: string;
  readonly visitedDirectories: number;
  readonly matchedEntries: number;
  readonly currentPath: string;
}

export interface DiscoverySearchResult {
  readonly rootPath: string;
  readonly sourceId: string;
  readonly sourceKind: string;
  readonly entries: readonly FileInfo[];
  readonly visitedDirectories: number;
  readonly truncated: boolean;
  readonly warnings: readonly string[];
}
import { WorkSchedulerService } from './work-scheduler.service';

@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })
export class DiscoverySearchService {
  constructor(
    private readonly api: ApiService,
    private readonly panelSources: PanelSourceRegistryService,
    private readonly work: WorkSchedulerService,
  ) {}

  async search(
    rootPath: string,
    query: string,
    options: DiscoverySearchOptions = {},
  ): Promise<DiscoverySearchResult> {
    const root = rootPath.trim();
    const needle = query.trim();

    if (!root || !needle) {
      return {
        rootPath: root,
        sourceId: '',
        sourceKind: '',
        entries: [],
        visitedDirectories: 0,
        truncated: false,
        warnings: [],
      };
    }

    const resolved = this.panelSources.resolve({
      path: root,
      entries: [],
      inArchive: false,
    });

    // Preserve the fast native backend search for ordinary local files.
    if (
      !options.onBatch &&
      resolved.source.kind === 'filesystem' &&
      /^([a-z]:[\\/]|\/|\\\\)/i.test(root)
    ) {
      try {
        const result = await this.api.search(
          root,
          needle,
          options.recursive !== false,
        );

        const matches = (result.matches ?? [])
          .filter(entry => this.typeAllowed(entry, options.type ?? 'all'))
          .slice(0, Math.max(1, options.maxResults ?? 500));

        return {
          rootPath: root,
          sourceId: resolved.location.sourceId,
          sourceKind: resolved.source.kind,
          entries: matches,
          visitedDirectories: 1,
          truncated: (result.matches?.length ?? 0) > matches.length,
          warnings: [],
        };
      } catch {
        // Fall through to PanelSource traversal. This is important for aliased
        // or plugin-backed paths that look filesystem-ish but aren't.
      }
    }

    return this.searchPanelSource(root, needle, resolved.location.sourceId, resolved.source.kind, options);
  }

  private async searchPanelSource(
    root: string,
    query: string,
    sourceId: string,
    sourceKind: string,
    options: DiscoverySearchOptions,
  ): Promise<DiscoverySearchResult> {
    const recursive = options.recursive !== false;
    const maxResults = Math.max(1, options.maxResults ?? 100_000);
    const maxVisited = Math.max(1, options.maxVisitedDirectories ?? 100_000);
    const maxDepth = Math.max(0, options.maxDepth ?? 64);
    const batchSize = Math.max(64, Math.min(2048, options.batchSize ?? 512));
    const matcher = this.matcher(query);

    // Streaming consumers own the result population. Do not also retain another
    // 100k-entry array in this service.
    const retainedMatches: FileInfo[] = [];
    const batch: FileInfo[] = [];
    const warnings: string[] = [];
    const visited = new Set<string>();
    const queue: Array<{ path: string; depth: number }> = [{ path: root, depth: 0 }];
    let matchedEntries = 0;
    let truncated = false;

    const progress = (currentPath: string): DiscoverySearchProgress => ({
      sourceId,
      visitedDirectories: visited.size,
      matchedEntries,
      currentPath,
    });

    const flush = (currentPath: string): void => {
      if (!batch.length) return;
      const out = batch.splice(0, batch.length);
      options.onBatch?.(out, progress(currentPath));
    };

    while (queue.length) {
      this.throwIfAborted(options.signal);

      if (visited.size >= maxVisited || matchedEntries >= maxResults) {
        truncated = true;
        break;
      }

      const current = queue.shift()!;
      const key = this.pathKey(current.path);
      if (visited.has(key)) continue;
      visited.add(key);

      let listing;
      try {
        listing = await this.work.schedule({
          key: `provider:list:${sourceId}:${current.path}:${options.showHidden ? 1 : 0}`,
          priority: 'interactive',
          kind: 'provider',
          run: async context => {
            this.throwIfAborted(options.signal);
            if (context.signal.aborted) {
              throw new DOMException('Provider listing cancelled.', 'AbortError');
            }
            return await this.panelSources.list(
              current.path,
              !!options.showHidden,
            );
          },
        }).promise;
      } catch (error) {
        warnings.push(`${current.path}: ${this.message(error)}`);
        continue;
      }

      for (const entry of listing.entries ?? []) {
        this.throwIfAborted(options.signal);
        if (!options.showHidden && entry.isHidden) continue;

        if (
          matcher(entry) &&
          this.typeAllowed(entry, options.type ?? 'all')
        ) {
          const copy = { ...entry };
          matchedEntries += 1;

          if (options.onBatch) {
            batch.push(copy);
            if (batch.length >= batchSize) flush(current.path);
          } else {
            retainedMatches.push(copy);
          }

          if (matchedEntries >= maxResults) {
            truncated = true;
            break;
          }
        }

        if (
          recursive &&
          current.depth < maxDepth &&
          entry.type === FileType.DIRECTORY &&
          !entry.isSymlink
        ) {
          queue.push({ path: entry.path, depth: current.depth + 1 });
        }
      }

      flush(current.path);
      options.onProgress?.(progress(current.path));

      if (!recursive) break;

      // Let Angular paint result windows and process cancellation between
      // directory batches rather than monopolising the renderer.
      if (options.onBatch && queue.length) {
        await this.work.yield('interactive', options.signal);
      }
    }

    flush(root);

    return {
      rootPath: root,
      sourceId,
      sourceKind,
      entries: retainedMatches,
      visitedDirectories: visited.size,
      truncated,
      warnings,
    };
  }

  private matcher(query: string): (entry: FileInfo) => boolean {
    const normalized = query.toLocaleLowerCase();

    if (query.includes('*') || query.includes('?')) {
      const escaped = query.replace(/[.+^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&');
      const regex = new RegExp(
        '^' + escaped.replace(/\*/g, '.*').replace(/\?/g, '.') + '$',
        'i',
      );
      return entry => regex.test(entry.name ?? '');
    }

    return entry =>
      (entry.name ?? '').toLocaleLowerCase().includes(normalized) ||
      (entry.path ?? '').toLocaleLowerCase().includes(normalized);
  }

  private typeAllowed(
    entry: FileInfo,
    type: NonNullable<DiscoverySearchOptions['type']>,
  ): boolean {
    if (type === 'all') return true;
    if (type === 'folders') return entry.type === FileType.DIRECTORY;
    if (type === 'archives') return entry.type === FileType.ARCHIVE;
    return entry.type === FileType.FILE;
  }

  private pathKey(path: string): string {
    return path.trim().replace(/\\/g, '/').replace(/\/+$/, '').toLocaleLowerCase();
  }

  private throwIfAborted(signal?: AbortSignal): void {
    if (signal?.aborted) {
      throw new DOMException('Search cancelled.', 'AbortError');
    }
  }

  private message(error: unknown): string {
    return error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error ?? 'Unknown error');
  }
}
`````

## File: manager/frontend/src/app/services/drive-lifecycle.service.ts
`````typescript
import { Injectable } from '@angular/core';
import { ApiService } from './api.service';

export interface DriveChange {
  readonly previous: readonly string[];
  readonly current: readonly string[];
}

@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })
export class DriveLifecycleService {
  private timer: ReturnType<typeof setInterval> | null = null;
  private lastSignature = '';
  private lastPaths: string[] = [];

  constructor(private readonly api: ApiService) {}

  start(
    onChange: (change: DriveChange) => void,
    intervalMs = 4000,
  ): () => void {
    this.stop();

    const poll = async () => {
      const response = await this.api.getDrives().catch(() => null);
      if (!response) return;

      const physical = (response.schemes ?? [])
        .filter(drive =>
          ['fixed', 'removable', 'network', 'cdrom', 'ramdisk']
            .includes(String(drive.schemeType).toLowerCase()),
        )
        .map(drive => drive.path)
        .filter(Boolean)
        .sort((a, b) => a.localeCompare(b));

      const signature = physical.join('\n');
      if (!this.lastSignature) {
        this.lastSignature = signature;
        this.lastPaths = physical;
        return;
      }

      if (signature !== this.lastSignature) {
        const previous = this.lastPaths;
        this.lastSignature = signature;
        this.lastPaths = physical;
        onChange({ previous, current: physical });
      }
    };

    void poll();
    this.timer = setInterval(() => void poll(), intervalMs);
    return () => this.stop();
  }

  stop(): void {
    if (this.timer !== null) {
      clearInterval(this.timer);
      this.timer = null;
    }
  }
}
`````

`````typescript
import { Injectable, OnDestroy } from '@angular/core';

/**
 * DropdownService — centralized manager for all dropdown open/close logic.
 *
 * ROOT CAUSE IT SOLVES:
 *   The classic race condition:
 *   1. User clicks a menu item
 *   2. `document:click` fires and closes the dropdown (isOpen = false)
 *   3. `*ngIf="isOpen"` destroys the DOM
 *   4. The item's `(click)` handler never fires — element is gone
 *
 * HOW IT WORKS:
 *   - Uses a `mousedown` listener on `document` (fires BEFORE click, blur, focus)
 *   - When mousedown fires, checks if the target is inside any registered dropdown
 *   - If inside → marks that dropdown as "interaction pending" (do NOT close)
 *   - The dropdown's own close logic checks this flag before closing
 *   - After the click fully resolves, the flag is cleared
 *
 * USAGE:
 *   1. Inject DropdownService into your component
 *   2. In your open logic: this.dropdownService.register(this.triggerEl, this.menuEl, () => this.close())
 *   3. In your close logic: if (this.dropdownService.isInteractionPending(id)) return;
 *   4. On destroy: this.dropdownService.unregister(id)
 *
 *   OR use the companion `appDropdown` directive for zero-boilerplate usage.
 */
@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })
export class DropdownService implements OnDestroy {
  private dropdowns = new Map<string, {
    trigger: Element;
    menu: Element;
    close: () => void;
  }>();

  private pendingId: string | null = null;
  private idCounter = 0;

  constructor() {
    // Use capture: true + mousedown so we run BEFORE any component sees the event
    document.addEventListener('mousedown', this.onGlobalMousedown, { capture: true });
    document.addEventListener('click', this.onGlobalClick, { capture: true });
  }

  ngOnDestroy(): void {
    document.removeEventListener('mousedown', this.onGlobalMousedown, { capture: true } as any);
    document.removeEventListener('click', this.onGlobalClick, { capture: true } as any);
  }

  /**
   * Register a dropdown. Returns a unique ID for this registration.
   *
   * @param trigger  The button/anchor that opens the dropdown
   * @param menu     The dropdown panel element
   * @param close    Callback to close this dropdown
   */
  register(trigger: Element, menu: Element, close: () => void): string {
    const id = `dd-${++this.idCounter}`;
    this.dropdowns.set(id, { trigger, menu, close });
    return id;
  }

  /** Update references after DOM changes (e.g. after *ngIf re-creates menu) */
  update(id: string, trigger: Element, menu: Element): void {
    const entry = this.dropdowns.get(id);
    if (entry) {
      entry.trigger = trigger;
      entry.menu = menu;
    }
  }

  unregister(id: string): void {
    this.dropdowns.delete(id);
    if (this.pendingId === id) this.pendingId = null;
  }

  /**
   * True if the user is currently clicking INSIDE this dropdown's menu.
   * Your close() logic should bail out if this returns true.
   */
  isInteractionPending(id: string): boolean {
    return this.pendingId === id;
  }

  /**
   * Close all other open dropdowns (pass the id of the one being opened).
   * Call this when opening a dropdown so others close.
   */
  closeOthers(exceptId: string): void {
    this.dropdowns.forEach((entry, id) => {
      if (id !== exceptId) entry.close();
    });
  }

  private onGlobalMousedown = (event: MouseEvent): void => {
    const target = event.target as Node;
    this.pendingId = null;

    for (const [id, { trigger, menu, close }] of this.dropdowns) {
      const inTrigger = trigger.contains(target);
      const inMenu = menu.contains(target);

      if (inMenu) {
        // User is clicking inside a menu — mark as pending so close() skips
        this.pendingId = id;
        return; // don't close anything
      }

      if (!inTrigger && !inMenu) {
        // Click is fully outside this dropdown — close it
        close();
      }
    }
  };

  private onGlobalClick = (_event: MouseEvent): void => {
    // Clear the pending flag after the full click cycle completes
    // Use a microtask so item (click) handlers still fire first
    Promise.resolve().then(() => { this.pendingId = null; });
  };
}
`````

`````typescript
import { fn, spyOnFn, stubGlobal, restoreGlobals } from '../testing/jasmine-test-helpers';
import { DuplicateFinderService } from './duplicate-finder.service';
import { FileType } from '../shared/protocol';

function f(path: string, size: number, modified = 1) {
  return { name: path.split('/').pop()!, path, type: FileType.FILE, size, modified, created: 0, accessed: 0, permissions: '', isHidden: false };
}
function d(path: string) {
  return { ...f(path, 0), type: FileType.DIRECTORY };
}

describe('DuplicateFinderService', () => {
  it('hashes only size-collision candidates and groups verified matches', async () => {
    const api = {
      listDirectory: fn(async (path: string) => path === '/root'
        ? { entries: [f('/root/a.txt', 10), f('/root/b.txt', 10), f('/root/c.txt', 20), d('/root/nested')] }
        : { entries: [f('/root/nested/d.txt', 10)] }),
      hashFile: fn(async (path: string) => path.endsWith('b.txt') ? 'other' : 'same'),
    };
    const result = await new DuplicateFinderService(api as any).scan('/root');
    expect(api.hashFile).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(3);
    expect((result.groups).length).toBe(1);
    expect(result.groups[0].files.map(x => x.path)).toEqual(['/root/a.txt', '/root/nested/d.txt']);
    expect(result.reclaimableBytes).toBe(10);
  });

  it('does not descend through directory symlinks', async () => {
    const linked = { ...d('/root/link'), isSymlink: true };
    const api = { listDirectory: fn(async () => ({ entries: [linked] })), hashFile: fn() };
    await new DuplicateFinderService(api as any).scan('/root');
    expect(api.listDirectory).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
  });

  it('returns suggested redundant paths while preserving one keeper', () => {
    const service = new DuplicateFinderService({} as any);
    const group = { hash: 'x', size: 3, files: [f('/a', 3), f('/b', 3), f('/c', 3)], reclaimableBytes: 6, suggestedKeeperPath: '/a' };
    expect(service.suggestedRedundantPaths([group])).toEqual(['/b', '/c']);
  });
});

describe('DuplicateFinderService keeper policies', () => {
  const service = new DuplicateFinderService({} as any);
  const group = {
    hash: 'same', size: 10, reclaimableBytes: 20,
    files: [f('/very/long/path/a.txt', 10, 2), f('/b.txt', 10, 3), f('/mid/c.txt', 10, 1)],
    suggestedKeeperPath: '/mid/c.txt',
  };

  it('supports oldest, newest and shortest-path keepers', () => {
    expect(service.keeperPath(group, 'oldest')).toBe('/mid/c.txt');
    expect(service.keeperPath(group, 'newest')).toBe('/b.txt');
    expect(service.keeperPath(group, 'shortest-path')).toBe('/b.txt');
  });

  it('builds redundant selections from the chosen policy', () => {
    expect(service.redundantPaths([group], 'newest')).toEqual(['/very/long/path/a.txt', '/mid/c.txt']);
  });
});
`````

`````typescript
import { Injectable } from '@angular/core';
import { ApiService } from './api.service';
import { FileInfo, FileType } from '../shared/protocol';

export interface DuplicateScanOptions {
  includeHidden?: boolean;
  minSize?: number;
  maxFiles?: number;
  maxDepth?: number;
}

export interface DuplicateScanProgress {
  phase: 'enumerating' | 'hashing';
  discoveredFiles: number;
  candidateFiles: number;
  hashedFiles: number;
}

export interface DuplicateGroup {
  hash: string;
  size: number;
  files: FileInfo[];
  reclaimableBytes: number;
  suggestedKeeperPath: string;
}

export type DuplicateKeeperPolicy = 'oldest' | 'newest' | 'shortest-path';

export interface DuplicateScanResult {
  root: string;
  groups: DuplicateGroup[];
  scannedFiles: number;
  hashedFiles: number;
  reclaimableBytes: number;
  truncated: boolean;
  warnings: string[];
}

@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })
export class DuplicateFinderService {
  constructor(private readonly api: ApiService) {}

  async scan(
    root: string,
    options: DuplicateScanOptions = {},
    onProgress?: (progress: DuplicateScanProgress) => void,
  ): Promise<DuplicateScanResult> {
    const includeHidden = !!options.includeHidden;
    const minSize = Math.max(0, options.minSize ?? 1);
    const maxFiles = Math.max(1, options.maxFiles ?? 20_000);
    const maxDepth = Math.max(0, options.maxDepth ?? 64);
    const files: FileInfo[] = [];
    const warnings: string[] = [];
    let truncated = false;

    const walk = async (path: string, depth: number): Promise<void> => {
      if (files.length >= maxFiles) { truncated = true; return; }
      if (depth > maxDepth) { truncated = true; return; }
      let listing;
      try {
        listing = await this.api.listDirectory(path, includeHidden);
      } catch (error) {
        warnings.push(`${path}: ${this.messageOf(error)}`);
        return;
      }
      for (const entry of listing.entries ?? []) {
        if (files.length >= maxFiles) { truncated = true; return; }
        if (!includeHidden && entry.isHidden) continue;
        if (entry.type === FileType.DIRECTORY && !entry.isSymlink) {
          await walk(entry.path, depth + 1);
          continue;
        }
        if (entry.type !== FileType.FILE || entry.isSymlink || entry.size < minSize) continue;
        files.push(entry);
        onProgress?.({ phase: 'enumerating', discoveredFiles: files.length, candidateFiles: 0, hashedFiles: 0 });
      }
    };

    await walk(root, 0);

    const bySize = new Map<number, FileInfo[]>();
    for (const file of files) {
      const bucket = bySize.get(file.size) ?? [];
      bucket.push(file);
      bySize.set(file.size, bucket);
    }
    const candidates = Array.from(bySize.values()).filter(group => group.length > 1).flat();
    const byHash = new Map<string, FileInfo[]>();
    let hashedFiles = 0;
    for (const file of candidates) {
      try {
        const hash = await this.api.hashFile(file.path);
        const key = `${file.size}:${hash}`;
        const bucket = byHash.get(key) ?? [];
        bucket.push(file);
        byHash.set(key, bucket);
      } catch (error) {
        warnings.push(`${file.path}: ${this.messageOf(error)}`);
      } finally {
        hashedFiles++;
        onProgress?.({ phase: 'hashing', discoveredFiles: files.length, candidateFiles: candidates.length, hashedFiles });
      }
    }

    const groups = Array.from(byHash.entries())
      .filter(([, group]) => group.length > 1)
      .map(([key, group]) => {
        const [sizeText, hash] = key.split(':', 2);
        const size = Number(sizeText) || group[0]?.size || 0;
        const sorted = [...group].sort((a, b) =>
          (a.modified - b.modified) || a.path.length - b.path.length || a.path.localeCompare(b.path));
        return {
          hash,
          size,
          files: sorted,
          reclaimableBytes: size * (sorted.length - 1),
          suggestedKeeperPath: sorted[0].path,
        } satisfies DuplicateGroup;
      })
      .sort((a, b) => b.reclaimableBytes - a.reclaimableBytes || a.files[0].path.localeCompare(b.files[0].path));

    return {
      root,
      groups,
      scannedFiles: files.length,
      hashedFiles,
      reclaimableBytes: groups.reduce((sum, group) => sum + group.reclaimableBytes, 0),
      truncated,
      warnings,
    };
  }

  keeperPath(group: DuplicateGroup, policy: DuplicateKeeperPolicy = 'oldest'): string {
    if (!group.files.length) return '';
    const files = [...group.files];
    if (policy === 'newest') {
      files.sort((a, b) => (b.modified - a.modified) || a.path.length - b.path.length || a.path.localeCompare(b.path));
      return files[0].path;
    }
    if (policy === 'shortest-path') {
      files.sort((a, b) => a.path.length - b.path.length || (a.modified - b.modified) || a.path.localeCompare(b.path));
      return files[0].path;
    }
    files.sort((a, b) => (a.modified - b.modified) || a.path.length - b.path.length || a.path.localeCompare(b.path));
    return files[0].path;
  }

  redundantPaths(groups: readonly DuplicateGroup[], policy: DuplicateKeeperPolicy = 'oldest'): string[] {
    return groups.flatMap(group => {
      const keeper = this.keeperPath(group, policy);
      return group.files.filter(file => file.path !== keeper).map(file => file.path);
    });
  }

  suggestedRedundantPaths(groups: readonly DuplicateGroup[]): string[] {
    return this.redundantPaths(groups, 'oldest');
  }

  private messageOf(error: unknown): string {
    return error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error ?? 'Unknown error');
  }
}
`````

`````typescript
import { Injectable } from '@angular/core';
import { FileInfo, FileProbe, FileType } from '../shared/protocol';
import { ApiService } from './api.service';

type ResolvedCategoryId = 'code' | 'video';
type CollisionExtension = 'ts' | 'mts';

interface CollisionResolutionContext {
  entry: FileInfo;
  probe(): Promise<FileProbe>;
}

interface CollisionSpec {
  fallback: ResolvedCategoryId;
  resolve: (ctx: CollisionResolutionContext) => Promise<ResolvedCategoryId>;
}

@Injectable({
  providedIn: 'root',
})
export class FileCategoryResolverService {
  private readonly resolvedByPath = new Map<string, ResolvedCategoryId>();
  private readonly pendingPaths = new Set<string>();
  private readonly listenersByPath = new Map<string, Set<() => void>>();
  private readonly collisionSpecs: Record<CollisionExtension, CollisionSpec> = {
    ts: {
      fallback: 'code',
      resolve: (ctx) => this.resolveTypeScriptOrTransportStream(ctx),
    },
    mts: {
      fallback: 'code',
      resolve: (ctx) => this.resolveTypeScriptOrTransportStream(ctx),
    },
  };

  constructor(private readonly api: ApiService) {}

  getResolvedCategory(path: string): ResolvedCategoryId | undefined {
    return this.resolvedByPath.get(path);
  }

  watch(path: string, listener: () => void): () => void {
    let listeners = this.listenersByPath.get(path);
    if (!listeners) {
      listeners = new Set();
      this.listenersByPath.set(path, listeners);
    }
    listeners.add(listener);

    return () => {
      const current = this.listenersByPath.get(path);
      if (!current) return;
      current.delete(listener);
      if (!current.size) {
        this.listenersByPath.delete(path);
      }
    };
  }

  ensureResolved(entry: FileInfo | null | undefined): void {
    const extension = this.getCollisionExtension(entry);
    if (!entry || !extension) return;
    if (this.resolvedByPath.has(entry.path)) return;

    const immediate = this.getImmediateResolution(entry, extension);
    if (immediate) {
      this.resolvedByPath.set(entry.path, immediate);
      this.notify(entry.path);
      return;
    }

    if (this.pendingPaths.has(entry.path)) return;

    this.pendingPaths.add(entry.path);
    void this.resolveAndCache(entry, extension);
  }

  private getCollisionExtension(entry: FileInfo | null | undefined): CollisionExtension | null {
    if (!entry || entry.type !== FileType.FILE || !entry.path) return null;
    const extension = this.getExtension(entry.name);
    return extension === 'ts' || extension === 'mts' ? extension : null;
  }

  private async resolveAndCache(entry: FileInfo, extension: CollisionExtension): Promise<void> {
    const spec = this.collisionSpecs[extension];
    let resolved = spec.fallback;

    try {
      const context = this.createResolutionContext(entry, extension);
      resolved = await spec.resolve(context);
    } catch {
      resolved = spec.fallback;
    } finally {
      this.pendingPaths.delete(entry.path);
      this.resolvedByPath.set(entry.path, resolved);
      this.notify(entry.path);
    }
  }

  private createResolutionContext(entry: FileInfo, extension: CollisionExtension): CollisionResolutionContext {
    let probePromise: Promise<FileProbe> | null = null;

    return {
      entry,
      probe: () => {
        probePromise ??= this.api.probeFile(entry.path);
        return probePromise;
      },
    };
  }

  private getImmediateResolution(entry: FileInfo, extension: CollisionExtension): ResolvedCategoryId | null {
    const fromMimeType = this.getResolutionFromMimeType(entry.mimeType);
    if (fromMimeType) {
      return fromMimeType;
    }

    if (this.isWebHttpPath(entry.path)) {
      return this.collisionSpecs[extension].fallback;
    }

    return null;
  }

  private getResolutionFromMimeType(mimeType: string | null | undefined): ResolvedCategoryId | null {
    const mime = (mimeType ?? '').split(';', 1)[0].trim().toLowerCase();
    if (!mime) {
      return null;
    }
    if (mime === 'video/mp2t' || mime === 'application/mp2t') {
      return 'video';
    }
    if (
      mime.startsWith('text/') ||
      mime.includes('typescript') ||
      mime.includes('javascript') ||
      mime === 'application/json' ||
      mime === 'application/xml'
    ) {
      return 'code';
    }
    return null;
  }

  private async resolveTypeScriptOrTransportStream(ctx: CollisionResolutionContext): Promise<ResolvedCategoryId> {
    const probe = await ctx.probe();
    return this.looksLikeTransportStream(probe) ? 'video' : 'code';
  }

  private looksLikeTransportStream(probe: FileProbe): boolean {
    const mime = (probe.mimeType ?? '').split(';', 1)[0].trim().toLowerCase();
    return mime === 'video/mp2t' || mime === 'application/mp2t' || !probe.isText;
  }

  private getExtension(name: string | null | undefined): string {
    const value = (name ?? '').trim().toLowerCase();
    const lastDot = value.lastIndexOf('.');
    return lastDot >= 0 ? value.slice(lastDot + 1) : '';
  }

  private isWebHttpPath(path: string | null | undefined): boolean {
    if (!path) {
      return false;
    }
    try {
      const parsed = new URL(path);
      return parsed.protocol === 'http:' || parsed.protocol === 'https:';
    } catch {
      return false;
    }
  }

  private notify(path: string): void {
    const listeners = this.listenersByPath.get(path);
    if (!listeners) return;
    for (const listener of listeners) {
      listener();
    }
  }
}
`````

`````typescript
import { Injectable } from '@angular/core';
import { createSubject } from '@epikodelabs/streamix';

import type { ArchiveFrame } from './archive.service';

export type FileClipboardOperation = 'copy' | 'cut';

export interface FileClipboardPayload {
  operation: FileClipboardOperation;
  paths: string[];
  sourcePaneId: 'left' | 'right';
  archiveFrame: ArchiveFrame | null;
  createdAt: number;
}

@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })
export class FileClipboardService {
  private readonly stateSubject = createSubject<FileClipboardPayload | null>();

  payload: FileClipboardPayload | null = null;
  readonly state$ = this.stateSubject;

  set(payload: Omit<FileClipboardPayload, 'createdAt'>): void {
    this.payload = {
      ...payload,
      paths: [...payload.paths],
      archiveFrame: payload.archiveFrame
        ? {
            ...payload.archiveFrame,
            nestedChain: [...(payload.archiveFrame.nestedChain ?? [])],
          }
        : null,
      createdAt: Date.now(),
    };
    this.stateSubject.next(this.payload);
  }

  clear(): void {
    this.payload = null;
    this.stateSubject.next(null);
  }
}
`````

`````typescript
import { Injectable } from '@angular/core';
import { FileInfo, FileType } from '../shared/protocol';
import { FilterQuery, FilterCriteria, FilterType } from '../shared/protocol-enhanced';

/**
 * A CriteriaGroup is one "segment" separated by OR in the filter string.
 * Within a group, same-type criteria (e.g. multiple EXTENSIONs) are OR-ed;
 * different types are AND-ed.
 * Between groups, the entry only needs to satisfy ONE group (OR semantics).
 */
export interface CriteriaGroup {
  criteria: FilterCriteria[];
  text?: string;
}

@Injectable({
  providedIn: 'root'
})
export class FilterService {

  /**
   * Filter file entries based on query.
   *
   * query.groups (new): OR-separated groups of criteria. Within each group,
   *   same-type criteria are OR-ed, different types are AND-ed.
   * query.criteria (legacy): flat list, all AND-ed (kept for back-compat).
   * query.text: plain text match, AND-ed on top of whichever group matched.
   */
  filterEntries(entries: FileInfo[], query: FilterQuery & { groups?: CriteriaGroup[] }): FileInfo[] {
    const groups: CriteriaGroup[] = query.groups ?? [];
    const hasGroups = groups.length > 0;
    const hasLegacyCriteria = !hasGroups && query.criteria && query.criteria.length > 0;

    if (!query.text && !hasGroups && !hasLegacyCriteria) {
      return entries;
    }

    return entries.filter(entry => {
      // ── Text filter (AND'd globally) ───────────────────────────────────
      if (query.text) {
        if (!this.matchesTextFilter(entry, query.text, query.caseSensitive)) {
          return false;
        }
      }

      // ── Group-based evaluation (new path) ─────────────────────────────
      if (hasGroups) {
        // Entry must satisfy AT LEAST ONE group (OR between groups)
        return groups.some(group => this.matchesGroup(entry, group, query.caseSensitive));
      }

      // ── Legacy flat criteria (all AND-ed, kept for back-compat) ───────
      if (hasLegacyCriteria) {
        for (const criterion of query.criteria!) {
          if (!this.matchesCriterion(entry, criterion, query.caseSensitive)) {
            return false;
          }
        }
      }

      return true;
    });
  }

  /**
   * Test whether an entry satisfies a single CriteriaGroup.
   *
   * Rules:
   *  - Same FilterType criteria → OR  (e.g. ext:jpg OR ext:png)
   *  - Different FilterType criteria → AND (e.g. ext:jpg AND size>1mb)
   *  - Group-level text → AND with the above
   */
  private matchesGroup(entry: FileInfo, group: CriteriaGroup, caseSensitive?: boolean): boolean {
    // Optional per-group text filter
    if (group.text) {
      if (!this.matchesTextFilter(entry, group.text, caseSensitive)) return false;
    }

    // Bucket criteria by type
    const buckets = new Map<FilterType, FilterCriteria[]>();
    for (const c of group.criteria) {
      if (!buckets.has(c.type)) buckets.set(c.type, []);
      buckets.get(c.type)!.push(c);
    }

    // Every bucket must be satisfied; within each bucket any one match suffices
    for (const [, bucket] of buckets) {
      const bucketMatch = bucket.some(c => this.matchesCriterion(entry, c, caseSensitive));
      if (!bucketMatch) return false;
    }

    return true;
  }

  /**
   * Parse filter text into a structured query with OR groups.
   *
   * Supports:
   * - OR separator:       "ext:pdf OR ext:png"     → two groups (any match)
   * - Plain text:         "document"
   * - Extension filter:   "ext:pdf"
   * - Type filter:        "type:file" or "type:dir"
   * - Size filter:        "size>1mb" or "size<100kb"
   * - Modified filter:    "modified:today" or "modified>2024-01-01"
   * - Glob pattern:       "*.pdf" or "doc*"
   *
   * Category presets emit e.g.:
   *   "ext:jpg ext:jpeg ext:png"          (single preset, OR within extensions)
   *   "ext:jpg ext:jpeg OR ext:js ext:ts" (two presets joined with OR)
   */
  parseFilterText(text: string): FilterQuery & { groups: CriteriaGroup[] } {
    const emptyQuery = (): FilterQuery & { groups: CriteriaGroup[] } => ({
      text: '',
      criteria: [],
      groups: [],
      caseSensitive: false,
    });

    if (!text || text.trim() === '') return emptyQuery();

    // Split on " OR " (case-insensitive, surrounded by whitespace)
    const segments = text.trim().split(/\s+OR\s+/i);

    if (segments.length === 1) {
      // No OR — parse as a single group, expose via both groups[] and legacy fields
      const group = this.parseSegment(segments[0]);
      return {
        text: group.text ?? '',
        criteria: group.criteria,   // legacy compat
        groups: [group],
        caseSensitive: false,
      };
    }

    // Multiple OR segments
    const groups = segments.map(seg => this.parseSegment(seg));
    return {
      text: '',       // per-group text lives inside each group
      criteria: [],   // legacy field unused when groups present
      groups,
      caseSensitive: false,
    };
  }

  /**
   * Parse one whitespace-separated segment into a CriteriaGroup.
   * Multiple ext: tokens within the segment become sibling EXTENSION criteria
   * that are OR-ed at evaluation time (same bucket logic in matchesGroup).
   */
  private parseSegment(segment: string): CriteriaGroup {
    const group: CriteriaGroup = { criteria: [] };
    const plainTextTokens: string[] = [];

    const tokens = segment.trim().split(/\s+/);

    for (const token of tokens) {
      if (!token) continue;

      if (token.includes(':')) {
        const colonIdx = token.indexOf(':');
        const prefix = token.slice(0, colonIdx);
        const value  = token.slice(colonIdx + 1);
        const criterion = this.parseFilterToken(prefix, value);
        if (criterion) {
          group.criteria.push(criterion);
          continue;
        }
      }

      // Size comparisons: size>1mb
      const sizeMatch = token.match(/^size([><=]+)(.+)$/i);
      if (sizeMatch) {
        const criterion = this.parseSizeFilter(sizeMatch[1], sizeMatch[2]);
        if (criterion) { group.criteria.push(criterion); continue; }
      }

      // Date comparisons: modified>2024-01-01
      const dateMatch = token.match(/^modified([><=]+)(.+)$/i);
      if (dateMatch) {
        const criterion = this.parseDateFilter(dateMatch[1], dateMatch[2]);
        if (criterion) { group.criteria.push(criterion); continue; }
      }

      // Glob pattern
      if (token.includes('*') || token.includes('?')) {
        group.criteria.push({ type: FilterType.GLOB, value: token, operator: 'contains' });
        continue;
      }

      plainTextTokens.push(token);
    }

    if (plainTextTokens.length > 0) {
      group.text = plainTextTokens.join(' ');
    }

    return group;
  }

  /**
   * Parse a filter token (prefix:value format)
   */
  private parseFilterToken(prefix: string, value: string): FilterCriteria | null {
    switch (prefix.toLowerCase()) {
      case 'ext':
      case 'extension':
        return {
          type: FilterType.EXTENSION,
          value: value.startsWith('.') ? value : `.${value}`,
          operator: 'equals',
        };

      case 'type': {
        const fileType = this.parseFileType(value);
        if (fileType) return { type: FilterType.TYPE, value: fileType, operator: 'equals' };
        break;
      }

      case 'name':
        return { type: FilterType.NAME, value, operator: 'contains' };

      case 'modified':
        return this.parseDateFilter('=', value);
    }

    return null;
  }

  private parseFileType(value: string): string | null {
    const lower = value.toLowerCase();
    if (lower === 'file' || lower === 'f') return FileType.FILE;
    if (lower === 'directory' || lower === 'dir' || lower === 'd' || lower === 'folder') return FileType.DIRECTORY;
    if (lower === 'symlink' || lower === 'link' || lower === 'l') return FileType.SYMLINK;
    return null;
  }

  private parseSizeFilter(operator: string, value: string): FilterCriteria | null {
    const sizeBytes = this.parseSizeValue(value);
    if (sizeBytes === null) return null;
    return { type: FilterType.SIZE, value: sizeBytes.toString(), operator: this.normalizeOperator(operator) };
  }

  private parseDateFilter(operator: string, value: string): FilterCriteria | null {
    const timestamp = this.parseDateValue(value);
    if (timestamp === null) return null;
    return { type: FilterType.MODIFIED, value: timestamp.toString(), operator: this.normalizeOperator(operator) };
  }

  private parseSizeValue(value: string): number | null {
    const match = value.match(/^(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)(b|kb|mb|gb)?$/i);
    if (!match) return null;
    const numValue = parseFloat(match[1]);
    switch ((match[2] || 'b').toLowerCase()) {
      case 'b':  return numValue;
      case 'kb': return numValue * 1024;
      case 'mb': return numValue * 1024 * 1024;
      case 'gb': return numValue * 1024 * 1024 * 1024;
      default:   return numValue;
    }
  }

  private parseDateValue(value: string): number | null {
    const lower = value.toLowerCase();
    const now = Date.now();
    const day = 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000;

    if (lower === 'today')     return now - day;
    if (lower === 'yesterday') return now - (2 * day);
    if (lower === 'week' || lower === 'thisweek') return now - (7 * day);
    if (lower === 'month' || lower === 'thismonth') return now - (30 * day);

    const date = new Date(value);
    return isNaN(date.getTime()) ? null : date.getTime();
  }

  private normalizeOperator(operator: string): FilterCriteria['operator'] {
    switch (operator) {
      case '>':  return 'gt';
      case '<':  return 'lt';
      case '>=': return 'gte';
      case '<=': return 'lte';
      case '=':
      case '==': return 'equals';
      default:   return 'equals';
    }
  }

  private matchesTextFilter(entry: FileInfo, text: string, caseSensitive?: boolean): boolean {
    const searchText = caseSensitive ? text : text.toLowerCase();
    const entryName  = caseSensitive ? entry.name : entry.name.toLowerCase();
    return entryName.includes(searchText);
  }

  private matchesCriterion(entry: FileInfo, criterion: FilterCriteria, caseSensitive?: boolean): boolean {
    switch (criterion.type) {
      case FilterType.NAME:      return this.matchesNameCriterion(entry, criterion, caseSensitive);
      case FilterType.EXTENSION: return this.matchesExtensionCriterion(entry, criterion);
      case FilterType.TYPE:
        // type:symlink matches both file-symlinks (SYMLINK) and
        // dir-symlinks (DIRECTORY + isSymlink).
        if (criterion.value === FileType.SYMLINK) {
          return entry.type === FileType.SYMLINK || !!(entry as any).isSymlink;
        }
        return entry.type === criterion.value;
      case FilterType.SIZE:      return this.matchesSizeCriterion(entry, criterion);
      case FilterType.MODIFIED:  return this.matchesModifiedCriterion(entry, criterion);
      case FilterType.GLOB:      return this.matchesGlobPattern(entry.name, criterion.value);
      default:                   return true;
    }
  }

  private matchesNameCriterion(entry: FileInfo, criterion: FilterCriteria, caseSensitive?: boolean): boolean {
    const name  = caseSensitive ? entry.name : entry.name.toLowerCase();
    const value = caseSensitive ? criterion.value : criterion.value.toLowerCase();
    switch (criterion.operator) {
      case 'equals':     return name === value;
      case 'contains':   return name.includes(value);
      case 'startsWith': return name.startsWith(value);
      case 'endsWith':   return name.endsWith(value);
      default:           return name.includes(value);
    }
  }

  private matchesExtensionCriterion(entry: FileInfo, criterion: FilterCriteria): boolean {
    if (entry.type !== FileType.FILE) return false;
    return this.getFileExtension(entry.name) === criterion.value;
  }

  private matchesSizeCriterion(entry: FileInfo, criterion: FilterCriteria): boolean {
    const targetSize = parseInt(criterion.value, 10);
    const entrySize  = entry.size;
    switch (criterion.operator) {
      case 'equals': return entrySize === targetSize;
      case 'gt':     return entrySize >  targetSize;
      case 'lt':     return entrySize <  targetSize;
      case 'gte':    return entrySize >= targetSize;
      case 'lte':    return entrySize <= targetSize;
      default:       return entrySize === targetSize;
    }
  }

  private matchesModifiedCriterion(entry: FileInfo, criterion: FilterCriteria): boolean {
    const targetTime = parseInt(criterion.value, 10);
    const entryTime  = entry.modified * 1000;
    switch (criterion.operator) {
      case 'equals': return this.isSameDay(entryTime, targetTime);
      case 'gt':     return entryTime >  targetTime;
      case 'lt':     return entryTime <  targetTime;
      case 'gte':    return entryTime >= targetTime;
      case 'lte':    return entryTime <= targetTime;
      default:       return this.isSameDay(entryTime, targetTime);
    }
  }

  private matchesGlobPattern(name: string, pattern: string): boolean {
    const regexPattern = pattern
      .replace(/\./g, '\\.')
      .replace(/\*/g, '.*')
      .replace(/\?/g, '.');
    return new RegExp(`^${regexPattern}$`, 'i').test(name);
  }

  private getFileExtension(filename: string): string {
    const lastDot = filename.lastIndexOf('.');
    if (lastDot === -1 || lastDot === 0) return '';
    return filename.substring(lastDot);
  }

  private isSameDay(time1: number, time2: number): boolean {
    const d1 = new Date(time1), d2 = new Date(time2);
    return d1.getFullYear() === d2.getFullYear() &&
           d1.getMonth()    === d2.getMonth()    &&
           d1.getDate()     === d2.getDate();
  }
}
`````

`````typescript
import { Injectable } from '@angular/core';
import { createBehaviorSubject, type Stream, createSubject } from '@epikodelabs/streamix';
import { debounce, distinctUntilChanged } from '@epikodelabs/streamix';
import { ApiService } from './api.service';
import { FileInfo, FileType } from '../shared/protocol';

/**
 * Search result with relevance scoring
 */
export interface SearchResultItem {
  file: FileInfo;
  score: number;
  matchType: 'exact' | 'prefix' | 'fuzzy' | 'content';
  highlightedName: string;
}

/**
 * Search index entry
 */
interface IndexEntry {
  path: string;
  name: string;
  normalizedName: string;
  type: FileType;
  size: number;
  modified: number;
  parentPath: string;
}

/**
 * Index statistics
 */
export interface IndexStats {
  totalFiles: number;
  totalDirectories: number;
  indexedPaths: string[];
  lastIndexTime: number;
  isIndexing: boolean;
}

/**
 * Search configuration
 */
export interface SearchConfig {
  maxResults: number;
  fuzzyThreshold: number;
  enableTypoTolerance: boolean;
  searchHidden: boolean;
  fileTypes: FileType[];
}

/**
 * Global search service with background indexing
 * Phase 2 Feature: Smart Global Search
 */
@Injectable({
  providedIn: 'root'
})
export class GlobalSearchService {
  // Search index (in-memory for MVP, could be moved to IndexedDB)
  private index: Map<string, IndexEntry> = new Map();
  private indexingInProgress$ = createBehaviorSubject<boolean>(false);
  private indexStats$ = createBehaviorSubject<IndexStats>({
    totalFiles: 0,
    totalDirectories: 0,
    indexedPaths: [],
    lastIndexTime: 0,
    isIndexing: false,
  });

  // Search configuration
  private config: SearchConfig = {
    maxResults: 50,
    fuzzyThreshold: 0.7,
    enableTypoTolerance: true,
    searchHidden: false,
    fileTypes: [FileType.FILE, FileType.DIRECTORY],
  };

  // Protected/System folders to skip (OS-specific)
  private protectedPaths: Set<string> = new Set([
    // Windows system folders
    '/PerfLogs',
    '/Recovery',
    '/System Volume Information',
    '/$Recycle.Bin',
    '/Windows/System32',
    '/Windows/WinSxS',
    '/Program Files/WindowsApps',
    // macOS system folders
    '/.Spotlight-V100',
    '/.Trashes',
    '/.fseventsd',
    '/System',
    '/private/var/db',
    // Linux system folders
    '/proc',
    '/sys',
    '/dev',
    '/run',
    '/tmp',
  ]);

  constructor(private apiService: ApiService) {
    // Start background indexing
    this.startBackgroundIndexing();
  }

  /**
   * Observable for indexing status
   */
  get isIndexing$(): Stream<boolean> {
    return this.indexingInProgress$;
  }

  /**
   * Observable for index statistics
   */
  get stats$(): Stream<IndexStats> {
    return this.indexStats$;
  }

  /**
   * Start background indexing of common paths
   */
  private async startBackgroundIndexing(): Promise<void> {
    // Index common root paths
    const rootPaths = ['/'];
    
    for (const path of rootPaths) {
      await this.indexPath(path, 2); // Depth of 2 for initial index
    }
  }

  /**
   * Index a path recursively
   */
  async indexPath(path: string, maxDepth: number = 3, currentDepth: number = 0): Promise<void> {
    if (currentDepth >= maxDepth) return;
    
    // Skip protected/system folders
    if (this.isProtectedPath(path)) {
      console.log(`Skipping protected path: ${path}`);
      return;
    }
    
    this.indexingInProgress$.next(true);
    const stats = this.indexStats$.value;
    stats.isIndexing = true;
    this.indexStats$.next(stats);

    try {
      const listing = await this.apiService.listDirectory(path, this.config.searchHidden);
      
      for (const entry of listing.entries) {
        // Skip protected folders
        if (this.isProtectedPath(entry.path)) {
          continue;
        }

        // Add to index
        const indexEntry: IndexEntry = {
          path: entry.path,
          name: entry.name,
          normalizedName: this.normalizeString(entry.name),
          type: entry.type,
          size: entry.size,
          modified: entry.modified,
          parentPath: path,
        };
        
        this.index.set(entry.path, indexEntry);
        
        // Update stats
        if (entry.type === FileType.FILE) {
          stats.totalFiles++;
        } else if (entry.type === FileType.DIRECTORY) {
          stats.totalDirectories++;
        }
        
        // Recursively index directories
        if (entry.type === FileType.DIRECTORY) {
          await this.indexPath(entry.path, maxDepth, currentDepth + 1);
        }
      }
      
      if (currentDepth === 0) {
        if (!stats.indexedPaths.includes(path)) {
          stats.indexedPaths.push(path);
        }
        stats.lastIndexTime = Date.now();
      }
      
      this.indexStats$.next(stats);
    } catch (error: any) {
      // Only log non-permission errors
      if (!error.message?.includes('Access is denied') && 
          !error.message?.includes('Permission denied') &&
          !error.message?.includes('EACCES')) {
        console.error('Failed to index path:', path, error);
      }
      // Silently skip permission errors
    } finally {
      if (currentDepth === 0) {
        this.indexingInProgress$.next(false);
        const updatedStats = this.indexStats$.value;
        updatedStats.isIndexing = false;
        this.indexStats$.next(updatedStats);
      }
    }
  }

  /**
   * Check if a path is protected/system folder
   */
  private isProtectedPath(path: string): boolean {
    // Check exact matches
    if (this.protectedPaths.has(path)) {
      return true;
    }

    // Check if path starts with any protected path
    for (const protectedPath of this.protectedPaths) {
      if (path.startsWith(protectedPath + '/') || path.startsWith(protectedPath + '\\')) {
        return true;
      }
    }

    // Check for common protected patterns
    const protectedPatterns = [
      /\/\$[A-Z]/,           // Windows special folders like $Recycle.Bin
      /\/\.[A-Z]/,           // Hidden system folders like .Spotlight-V100
      /System Volume/i,      // System Volume Information
      /WindowsApps/i,        // Windows Store apps
      /WinSxS/i,             // Windows side-by-side
    ];

    return protectedPatterns.some(pattern => pattern.test(path));
  }

  /**
   * Search the index
   */
  search(query: string, config?: Partial<SearchConfig>): SearchResultItem[] {
    if (!query || query.trim() === '') {
      return [];
    }

    const searchConfig = { ...this.config, ...config };
    const normalizedQuery = this.normalizeString(query);
    const results: SearchResultItem[] = [];

    for (const entry of this.index.values()) {
      // Filter by type
      if (!searchConfig.fileTypes.includes(entry.type)) {
        continue;
      }

      // Calculate relevance score
      const score = this.calculateRelevance(
        query,
        normalizedQuery,
        entry,
        searchConfig
      );

      if (score > 0) {
        results.push({
          file: this.indexEntryToFileInfo(entry),
          score,
          matchType: this.getMatchType(normalizedQuery, entry.normalizedName, score),
          highlightedName: this.highlightMatch(entry.name, query),
        });
      }
    }

    // Sort by score (descending)
    results.sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score);

    // Limit results
    return results.slice(0, searchConfig.maxResults);
  }

  /**
   * Calculate relevance score for a search result
   */
  private calculateRelevance(
    query: string,
    normalizedQuery: string,
    entry: IndexEntry,
    config: SearchConfig
  ): number {
    let score = 0;

    // Exact match
    if (entry.normalizedName === normalizedQuery) {
      score = 100;
    }
    // Exact case-sensitive match (bonus)
    else if (entry.name === query) {
      score = 95;
    }
    // Prefix match
    else if (entry.normalizedName.startsWith(normalizedQuery)) {
      score = 80;
    }
    // Contains match
    else if (entry.normalizedName.includes(normalizedQuery)) {
      score = 60;
    }
    // Fuzzy match
    else if (config.enableTypoTolerance) {
      const fuzzyScore = this.fuzzyMatch(normalizedQuery, entry.normalizedName);
      if (fuzzyScore >= config.fuzzyThreshold) {
        score = fuzzyScore * 50; // Scale to 0-50 range
      }
    }

    // Bonus for file name vs full path
    if (score > 0 && entry.name.toLowerCase().includes(query.toLowerCase())) {
      score += 10;
    }

    // Bonus for recent files
    const daysSinceModified = (Date.now() - entry.modified * 1000) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24);
    if (daysSinceModified < 7) {
      score += 5;
    }

    // Penalty for deep paths
    const pathDepth = entry.path.split('/').length;
    score -= Math.min(pathDepth * 0.5, 10);

    return Math.max(0, score);
  }

  /**
   * Fuzzy string matching (Levenshtein-based)
   */
  private fuzzyMatch(query: string, target: string): number {
    const distance = this.levenshteinDistance(query, target);
    const maxLength = Math.max(query.length, target.length);
    return 1 - (distance / maxLength);
  }

  /**
   * Calculate Levenshtein distance
   */
  private levenshteinDistance(a: string, b: string): number {
    const matrix: number[][] = [];

    for (let i = 0; i <= b.length; i++) {
      matrix[i] = [i];
    }

    for (let j = 0; j <= a.length; j++) {
      matrix[0][j] = j;
    }

    for (let i = 1; i <= b.length; i++) {
      for (let j = 1; j <= a.length; j++) {
        if (b.charAt(i - 1) === a.charAt(j - 1)) {
          matrix[i][j] = matrix[i - 1][j - 1];
        } else {
          matrix[i][j] = Math.min(
            matrix[i - 1][j - 1] + 1, // substitution
            matrix[i][j - 1] + 1,     // insertion
            matrix[i - 1][j] + 1      // deletion
          );
        }
      }
    }

    return matrix[b.length][a.length];
  }

  /**
   * Determine match type based on score and pattern
   */
  private getMatchType(
    normalizedQuery: string,
    normalizedName: string,
    score: number
  ): 'exact' | 'prefix' | 'fuzzy' | 'content' {
    if (score >= 95) return 'exact';
    if (normalizedName.startsWith(normalizedQuery)) return 'prefix';
    if (score < 60) return 'fuzzy';
    return 'content';
  }

  /**
   * Highlight matching parts of the name
   */
  private highlightMatch(name: string, query: string): string {
    const lowerName = name.toLowerCase();
    const lowerQuery = query.toLowerCase();
    const index = lowerName.indexOf(lowerQuery);

    if (index === -1) {
      return name;
    }

    return name.substring(0, index) +
           '<mark>' + name.substring(index, index + query.length) + '</mark>' +
           name.substring(index + query.length);
  }

  /**
   * Normalize string for comparison
   */
  private normalizeString(str: string): string {
    return str
      .toLowerCase()
      .trim()
      .replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, ''); // Remove special characters
  }

  /**
   * Convert index entry to FileInfo
   */
  private indexEntryToFileInfo(entry: IndexEntry): FileInfo {
    return {
      name: entry.name,
      path: entry.path,
      type: entry.type,
      size: entry.size,
      created: entry.modified, // We don't store created separately
      modified: entry.modified,
      accessed: entry.modified,
      permissions: '', // Not stored in index
      isHidden: entry.name.startsWith('.'),
    };
  }

  /**
   * Clear the index
   */
  clearIndex(): void {
    this.index.clear();
    const stats = this.indexStats$.value;
    stats.totalFiles = 0;
    stats.totalDirectories = 0;
    stats.indexedPaths = [];
    stats.lastIndexTime = 0;
    this.indexStats$.next(stats);
  }

  /**
   * Refresh the index
   */
  async refreshIndex(): Promise<void> {
    const stats = this.indexStats$.value;
    const paths = [...stats.indexedPaths];
    
    this.clearIndex();
    
    for (const path of paths) {
      await this.indexPath(path, 3);
    }
  }

  /**
   * Get current configuration
   */
  getConfig(): SearchConfig {
    return { ...this.config };
  }

  /**
   * Update configuration
   */
  updateConfig(updates: Partial<SearchConfig>): void {
    this.config = { ...this.config, ...updates };
  }

  /**
   * Add a path to the protected paths list
   */
  addProtectedPath(path: string): void {
    this.protectedPaths.add(path);
  }

  /**
   * Remove a path from the protected paths list
   */
  removeProtectedPath(path: string): void {
    this.protectedPaths.delete(path);
  }

  /**
   * Get all protected paths
   */
  getProtectedPaths(): string[] {
    return Array.from(this.protectedPaths);
  }

  /**
   * Clear all protected paths (use with caution)
   */
  clearProtectedPaths(): void {
    this.protectedPaths.clear();
  }
}
`````

`````typescript
import type {
  InputBindingDefinition,
  InputContextDefinition,
  KeyStroke,
} from './input-system.types';

export interface InputBindingAuditIssue {
  readonly kind:
    | 'same-context-collision'
    | 'text-key-without-typing-policy';
  readonly bindingIds: readonly string[];
  readonly contextId: string;
  readonly stroke: string;
}

export function auditInputBindings(
  bindings: readonly InputBindingDefinition[],
  contexts: readonly InputContextDefinition[],
): InputBindingAuditIssue[] {
  const issues: InputBindingAuditIssue[] = [];
  const byContextStroke = new Map<string, InputBindingDefinition[]>();

  for (const binding of bindings) {
    if (binding.trigger.device !== 'keyboard') continue;

    const stroke = binding.trigger.chord.steps[0];
    if (!stroke) continue;

    const key = `${binding.contextId}|${formatStroke(stroke)}`;
    const group = byContextStroke.get(key) ?? [];
    group.push(binding);
    byContextStroke.set(key, group);

    if (
      isTextKey(stroke) &&
      !binding.when?.includes('typing') &&
      contexts.some(context =>
        context.id === binding.contextId &&
        (context.kind === 'overlay' || context.kind === 'dialog'),
      )
    ) {
      issues.push({
        kind: 'text-key-without-typing-policy',
        bindingIds: [binding.id],
        contextId: binding.contextId,
        stroke: formatStroke(stroke),
      });
    }
  }

  for (const [key, group] of byContextStroke) {
    if (group.length < 2) continue;

    const [contextId, stroke] = key.split('|', 2);
    issues.push({
      kind: 'same-context-collision',
      bindingIds: group.map(binding => binding.id),
      contextId,
      stroke,
    });
  }

  return issues;
}

function isTextKey(stroke: KeyStroke): boolean {
  return (stroke.modifiers?.length ?? 0) === 0 &&
    /^[a-z0-9]$/i.test(stroke.key);
}

function formatStroke(stroke: KeyStroke): string {
  return [
    ...[...(stroke.modifiers ?? [])].sort(),
    stroke.key.toLocaleLowerCase(),
  ].join('+');
}
`````

`````typescript
import type { InputBindingDefinition } from './input-system.types';

/**
 * Returns true when two simple conjunctive `when` clauses may both evaluate to
 * true for the same input event. Unknown expressions are treated conservatively
 * as overlapping so the conflict inspector never hides a real collision.
 */
export function whenClausesCanOverlap(left?: string, right?: string): boolean {
  const leftTerms = parseConjunction(left);
  const rightTerms = parseConjunction(right);

  if (!leftTerms || !rightTerms) return true;

  if (leftTerms.has('__never__') || rightTerms.has('__never__')) return false;

  for (const [token, polarity] of leftTerms) {
    const peer = rightTerms.get(token);
    if (peer !== undefined && peer !== polarity) return false;
  }

  return true;
}

/**
 * Stable final tie-breaker for semantically equal bindings. Registration order
 * is intentionally excluded: plugin/component load timing must never change
 * which command owns a shortcut.
 */
export function compareStableBindingIdentity(
  left: Pick<InputBindingDefinition, 'id' | 'commandId'>,
  right: Pick<InputBindingDefinition, 'id' | 'commandId'>,
): number {
  if (left.id !== right.id) return left.id < right.id ? -1 : 1;
  if (left.commandId === right.commandId) return 0;
  return left.commandId < right.commandId ? -1 : 1;
}

function parseConjunction(expression?: string): Map<string, boolean> | null {
  const normalized = expression?.trim();
  if (!normalized || normalized === 'true') return new Map();

  const result = new Map<string, boolean>();
  const terms = normalized.split('&&').map(term => term.trim()).filter(Boolean);
  if (terms.length === 0) return new Map();

  for (const term of terms) {
    // The live input language is intentionally a conjunction of boolean tokens.
    // If richer syntax appears later, report overlap rather than guessing.
    if (term.includes('||') || term.includes('(') || term.includes(')')) return null;

    const negated = term.startsWith('!');
    const token = (negated ? term.slice(1) : term).trim();
    if (!/^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9]*$/.test(token)) return null;

    const polarity = !negated;
    const existing = result.get(token);
    if (existing !== undefined && existing !== polarity) {
      // An internally contradictory clause can never be active.
      return new Map([['__never__', true]]);
    }
    result.set(token, polarity);
  }

  return result;
}
`````

`````typescript
import { Injectable } from '@angular/core';
import { InputEngineService } from './input-engine.service';

@Injectable({
  providedIn: 'root'
})
export class InputContextService {
  private readonly leaseCounts = new Map<string, number>();

  constructor(private inputEngine: InputEngineService) {}

  acquire(contextId: string): () => void {
    const nextCount = (this.leaseCounts.get(contextId) ?? 0) + 1;
    this.leaseCounts.set(contextId, nextCount);
    if (nextCount === 1) {
      this.inputEngine.activateContext(contextId);
    }

    let released = false;
    return () => {
      if (released) return;
      released = true;
      this.release(contextId);
    };
  }

  private release(contextId: string): void {
    const currentCount = this.leaseCounts.get(contextId);
    if (!currentCount) return;

    if (currentCount <= 1) {
      this.leaseCounts.delete(contextId);
      this.inputEngine.deactivateContext(contextId);
      return;
    }

    this.leaseCounts.set(contextId, currentCount - 1);
  }
}
`````
