`````typescript
import { Injectable } from '@angular/core';
import { EventsOn } from 'wailsjs/runtime';

declare const window: any;

export interface NativeBrowserPaneSyncRequest {
  surfaceId: string;
  url: string;
  theme: 'dark' | 'light';
  backgroundColor: string;
  visible: boolean;
  x: number;
  y: number;
  width: number;
  height: number;
}

export interface NativeBrowserPaneIncomingMessage<T = unknown> {
  surfaceId: string;
  message: string;
  data: T;
}

export interface NativeBrowserPaneLifecycleEvent {
  surfaceId: string;
  state: 'started' | 'completed' | 'failed';
  url: string;
}

@Injectable({
  providedIn: 'root',
})
export class NativeBrowserPaneService {
  /** True once the Wails Go runtime has confirmed it's handling calls. */
  private _ready = false;
  private pendingRpcs = new Map<string, { resolve: (value: unknown) => void; reject: (reason: Error) => void; timer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> }>();

  get runtimeReady(): boolean {
    return this._ready;
  }

  constructor() {
    // Always listen for RPC responses so pending promises can resolve
    EventsOn('browser-pane:rpc', (event: { surfaceId?: string; message?: string } | null) => {
      const message = typeof event?.message === 'string' ? event.message : '';
      if (!message) return;
      try {
        const data = JSON.parse(message) as { id?: string; result?: unknown; error?: string } | null;
        if (!data?.id) return;
        this.handleRpcResponse(data.id, data.result, data.error);
      } catch {
        // ignore non-JSON
      }
    });
  }

  async sync(request: NativeBrowserPaneSyncRequest): Promise<boolean> {
    const api = window.go?.app?.App;
    if (!api?.BrowserPaneSync) {
      return false;
    }
    if (!this._ready) {
      // Probe readiness: call a binding that returns a value.
      // If Wails callbacks aren't registered yet, the call resolves undefined.
      if (!await this.probeReady()) {
        return false;
      }
    }
    try {
      await api.BrowserPaneSync(request);
      return true;
    } catch {
      return false;
    }
  }

  /** Check if Go bindings are responsive by calling a function that returns a known value. */
  private async probeReady(): Promise<boolean> {
    try {
      // BrowserPaneCaptureScreenshot with empty surfaceId should return '' from Go.
      // If Wails isn't ready, it resolves undefined.
      const api = window.go?.app?.App;
      if (!api?.BrowserPaneCaptureScreenshot) {
        return false;
      }
      const result = await api.BrowserPaneCaptureScreenshot('');
      // Go returns '' for empty surfaceId. If Wails isn't ready, result is undefined.
      if (result !== undefined) {
        this._ready = true;
        return true;
      }
      return false;
    } catch {
      // Go returns an error for empty surfaceId — but at least it responded!
      this._ready = true;
      return true;
    }
  }

  async dispose(surfaceId: string): Promise<void> {
    if (!surfaceId) {
      return;
    }
    const api = window.go?.app?.App;
    if (!api?.BrowserPaneDispose) {
      return;
    }
    await api.BrowserPaneDispose(surfaceId);
  }

  async captureScreenshot(surfaceId: string): Promise<string> {
    if (!surfaceId) {
      return '';
    }
    const api = window.go?.app?.App;
    if (!api?.BrowserPaneCaptureScreenshot) {
      return '';
    }
    return await api.BrowserPaneCaptureScreenshot(surfaceId);
  }

  async getDocumentBackground(surfaceId: string): Promise<string> {
    if (!surfaceId) {
      return '';
    }
    const api = window.go?.app?.App;
    if (!api?.BrowserPaneGetDocumentBackground) {
      return '';
    }
    try {
      return await api.BrowserPaneGetDocumentBackground(surfaceId);
    } catch {
      return '';
    }
  }

  async postMessage(surfaceId: string, message: unknown): Promise<boolean> {
    if (!surfaceId) {
      return false;
    }
    const api = window.go?.app?.App;
    if (!api?.BrowserPanePostMessage) {
      return false;
    }
    if (!this._ready && !await this.probeReady()) {
      return false;
    }
    try {
      await api.BrowserPanePostMessage(surfaceId, this.serializeMessage(message));
      return true;
    } catch {
      return false;
    }
  }

  onMessage(handler: (event: NativeBrowserPaneIncomingMessage) => void): (() => void) {
    return EventsOn('browser-pane:message', (event: { surfaceId?: string; message?: string } | null) => {
      const surfaceId = typeof event?.surfaceId === 'string' ? event.surfaceId : '';
      const message = typeof event?.message === 'string' ? event.message : '';
      if (!surfaceId) {
        return;
      }
      handler({
        surfaceId,
        message,
        data: this.parseMessage(message),
      });
    });
  }

  onSurfaceMessage(surfaceId: string, handler: (event: NativeBrowserPaneIncomingMessage) => void): (() => void) {
    return this.onMessage((event) => {
      if (event.surfaceId !== surfaceId) {
        return;
      }
      handler(event);
    });
  }

  onLifecycleEvent(handler: (event: NativeBrowserPaneLifecycleEvent) => void): (() => void) {
    return EventsOn('browser-pane:lifecycle', (event: { surfaceId?: string; state?: string; url?: string } | null) => {
      const surfaceId = typeof event?.surfaceId === 'string' ? event.surfaceId : '';
      const state = typeof event?.state === 'string' ? event.state : '';
      const url = typeof event?.url === 'string' ? event.url : '';
      if (!surfaceId || !state) {
        return;
      }
      handler({
        surfaceId,
        state: state as NativeBrowserPaneLifecycleEvent['state'],
        url,
      });
    });
  }

  onSurfaceLifecycleEvent(surfaceId: string, handler: (event: NativeBrowserPaneLifecycleEvent) => void): (() => void) {
    return this.onLifecycleEvent((event) => {
      if (event.surfaceId !== surfaceId) {
        return;
      }
      handler(event);
    });
  }

  async whenNavigationCompleted(surfaceId: string, timeoutMs = 30000): Promise<void> {
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      const unsubscribe = this.onSurfaceLifecycleEvent(surfaceId, (event) => {
        if (event.state === 'completed') {
          unsubscribe();
          resolve();
        }
      });
      setTimeout(() => {
        unsubscribe();
        reject(new Error(`Navigation completion timed out for ${surfaceId}`));
      }, timeoutMs);
    });
  }

  async rpcCall<T = unknown>(
    surfaceId: string,
    type: string,
    payload?: unknown,
    timeoutMs = 5000,
  ): Promise<T> {
    if (!surfaceId) {
      return Promise.reject(new Error('surfaceId is required'));
    }
    const id = this.generateRpcId();
    const request = { _rpc: true, id, v: 1, type, payload };

    const success = await this.postMessage(surfaceId, request);
    if (!success) {
      return Promise.reject(new Error(`Failed to send RPC request to ${surfaceId}`));
    }

    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      const timer = setTimeout(() => {
        this.pendingRpcs.delete(id);
        reject(new Error(`RPC '${type}' timed out after ${timeoutMs}ms`));
      }, timeoutMs);
      this.pendingRpcs.set(id, {
        resolve: resolve as (value: unknown) => void,
        reject,
        timer,
      });
    });
  }

  private generateRpcId(): string {
    return `rpc_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 9)}`;
  }

  private handleRpcResponse(id: string, result: unknown, error: string | undefined): void {
    const pending = this.pendingRpcs.get(id);
    if (!pending) return;
    clearTimeout(pending.timer);
    this.pendingRpcs.delete(id);
    if (error) {
      pending.reject(new Error(error));
    } else {
      pending.resolve(result);
    }
  }

  private serializeMessage(message: unknown): string {
    const serialized = JSON.stringify(message);
    return serialized === undefined ? 'null' : serialized;
  }

  private parseMessage(message: string): unknown {
    try {
      return JSON.parse(message);
    } catch {
      return message;
    }
  }
}
`````

## File: manager/frontend/src/app/services/navigation-intelligence.ts
`````typescript
export interface NavigationCandidate {
  readonly id: string;
  readonly label: string;
  readonly path: string;
  readonly kind: string;
  readonly accessCount?: number;
  readonly timestamp?: number;
  readonly pinned?: boolean;
  readonly current?: boolean;
}
export interface RankedNavigationCandidate<T extends NavigationCandidate> {
  readonly item: T; readonly score: number; readonly reasons: readonly string[];
}
const DAY = 86_400_000;
function segments(path: string): string[] {
  return (path ?? '').replace(/\\/g, '/').split('/').map(x => x.trim().toLowerCase()).filter(Boolean);
}
export function navigationAffinity(path: string, currentPath: string): number {
  const a=segments(path), b=segments(currentPath); let depth=0;
  while(depth<a.length && depth<b.length && a[depth]===b[depth]) depth++;
  return depth ? Math.min(18,(depth/Math.max(1,a.length))*18) : 0;
}
export function rankNavigationCandidates<T extends NavigationCandidate>(
  candidates: readonly T[], currentPath: string, now=Date.now(),
): RankedNavigationCandidate<T>[] {
  return candidates.map(item=>{
    let score=0; const reasons:string[]=[];
    if(item.pinned){score+=44;reasons.push('pinned')}
    const count=Math.max(0,item.accessCount??0);
    if(count){score+=Math.min(34,Math.log2(count+1)*8);reasons.push('frequent')}
    if(item.timestamp){
      const recency=Math.max(0,28-(Math.max(0,now-item.timestamp)/DAY)*4);
      score+=recency;if(recency>=8)reasons.push('recent');
    }
    const affinity=navigationAffinity(item.path,currentPath);
    if(affinity){score+=affinity;reasons.push('nearby')}
    if(item.current)score-=1000;
    return {item,score,reasons};
  }).filter(x=>x.score>-100).sort((a,b)=>b.score-a.score||a.item.label.localeCompare(b.item.label));
}
export function fuzzyPathScore(query:string,label:string,path:string):number{
  const needle=query.trim().toLowerCase(); if(!needle)return 0;
  const haystack=`${label} ${path}`.toLowerCase();
  if(haystack.startsWith(needle))return 120;if(haystack.includes(needle))return 90;
  let cursor=0,streak=0,score=0;
  for(const char of needle){const index=haystack.indexOf(char,cursor);if(index<0)return -1;streak=index===cursor?streak+1:0;score+=4+Math.min(10,streak*2);cursor=index+1}
  return score-Math.min(30,Math.floor(haystack.length/16));
}
`````

`````typescript
import {
  appendNestedArchiveEntry,
  normalizeNestedArchiveChain,
} from './archive.service';

export function auditNestedArchiveNavigation(
  containingChain: readonly string[],
  currentInnerPath: string,
  entryPath: string,
) {
  const normalized = normalizeNestedArchiveChain(containingChain);
  const result = appendNestedArchiveEntry(
    normalized,
    currentInnerPath,
    entryPath,
  );

  return {
    containingChain: normalized,
    resultChain: result,
    appendedExactlyOne: result.length === normalized.length + 1,
  };
}
`````

`````typescript
import { Injectable } from '@angular/core';

import { FileType, type FileInfo } from '../shared/protocol';
import { ConfirmDialogService, type ConfirmDialogDetailSection } from './confirm-dialog.service';
import { PluginManagerService } from './plugin-manager.service';

type AdapterFields = Readonly<Record<string, unknown>>;

interface SystemSurfaceRecord {
  readonly id: string;
  readonly name: string;
  readonly fields?: AdapterFields;
}

interface AdapterDiagnostic {
  readonly id?: string;
  readonly name?: string;
  readonly fields?: Readonly<{
    healthy?: boolean;
    summary?: string;
    checks?: readonly string[];
  }>;
}

@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })
export class NetworkAdapterService {
  private contextMenuRegistered = false;
  private readonly adapterContext = new Map<string, {
    name: string;
    fields: AdapterFields;
  }>();

  constructor(
    private readonly pluginManager: PluginManagerService,
    private readonly confirmDialog: ConfirmDialogService,
  ) {}

  ensureContextMenuRegistered(): void {
    if (this.contextMenuRegistered) return;
    this.contextMenuRegistered = true;

    const adapterFor = (currentDirectory: string, targetPath: string) => {
      if (currentDirectory.toLowerCase() !== 'network://adapters') return null;
      return this.adapterContext.get(targetPath) ?? null;
    };

    const score = (
      currentDirectory: string,
      targetPath: string,
      value: number,
      predicate: (fields: AdapterFields) => boolean = () => true,
    ): number => {
      const adapter = adapterFor(currentDirectory, targetPath);
      return adapter && predicate(adapter.fields) ? value : 0;
    };

    const has = (field: string) => (fields: AdapterFields) =>
      this.fieldValue(fields, field) !== '';
    const hasIndex = (fields: AdapterFields) => this.indexFromFields(fields) != null;
    const isEnabled = (fields: AdapterFields) => this.enabledFromFields(fields);
    const isDisabled = (fields: AdapterFields) => !this.enabledFromFields(fields);
    const isOperational = (fields: AdapterFields) =>
      this.text(fields, 'status').toLowerCase() === 'up';
    const canRenewDHCP = (fields: AdapterFields) =>
      hasIndex(fields) && isOperational(fields) && this.dhcpFromFields(fields);
    const canShowConnections = (fields: AdapterFields) =>
      isOperational(fields) && has('address')(fields);

    this.pluginManager.registerContextMenuItem({
      id: 'builtin.network.adapter.properties',
      label: 'Properties',
      score: context => score(context.currentDirectory, context.targetPath, 100),
      execute: context => this.showPropertiesByPath(context.targetPath),
    });

    this.pluginManager.registerContextMenuItem({
      id: 'builtin.network.adapter.enable',
      label: 'Enable adapter',
      score: context => score(
        context.currentDirectory,
        context.targetPath,
        96,
        fields => hasIndex(fields) && isDisabled(fields),
      ),
      execute: context => this.setEnabledByPath(context.targetPath, true),
    });

    this.pluginManager.registerContextMenuItem({
      id: 'builtin.network.adapter.disable',
      label: 'Disable adapter',
      score: context => score(
        context.currentDirectory,
        context.targetPath,
        96,
        fields => hasIndex(fields) && isEnabled(fields),
      ),
      execute: context => this.setEnabledByPath(context.targetPath, false),
    });

    this.pluginManager.registerContextMenuItem({
      id: 'builtin.network.adapter.renew',
      label: 'Renew DHCP',
      score: context => score(
        context.currentDirectory,
        context.targetPath,
        92,
        canRenewDHCP,
      ),
      execute: context => this.renewByPath(context.targetPath),
    });

    this.pluginManager.registerContextMenuItem({
      id: 'builtin.network.adapter.diagnose',
      label: 'Diagnose',
      score: context => score(
        context.currentDirectory,
        context.targetPath,
        88,
        hasIndex,
      ),
      execute: context => this.diagnoseByPath(context.targetPath),
    });

    this.pluginManager.registerContextMenuItem({
      id: 'builtin.network.adapter.connections',
      label: 'Show connections',
      score: context => score(
        context.currentDirectory,
        context.targetPath,
        84,
        canShowConnections,
      ),
      execute: context => {
        const adapter = this.adapterContext.get(context.targetPath);
        const address = adapter ? this.fieldValue(adapter.fields, 'address') : '';
        if (address) {
          window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('network-adapter-connections', {
            detail: { address },
          }));
        }
      },
    });

    this.pluginManager.registerContextMenuItem({
      id: 'builtin.network.adapter.copy-ip',
      label: 'Copy IP address',
      score: context => score(context.currentDirectory, context.targetPath, 80, has('address')),
      execute: context => this.copyFieldByPath(context.targetPath, 'address'),
    });

    this.pluginManager.registerContextMenuItem({
      id: 'builtin.network.adapter.copy-mac',
      label: 'Copy MAC address',
      score: context => score(context.currentDirectory, context.targetPath, 79, has('mac')),
      execute: context => this.copyFieldByPath(context.targetPath, 'mac'),
    });

    this.pluginManager.registerContextMenuItem({
      id: 'builtin.network.adapter.copy-gateway',
      label: 'Copy gateway',
      score: context => score(context.currentDirectory, context.targetPath, 78, has('gateway')),
      execute: context => this.copyFieldByPath(context.targetPath, 'gateway'),
    });

    this.pluginManager.registerContextMenuItem({
      id: 'builtin.network.adapter.copy-dns',
      label: 'Copy DNS servers',
      score: context => score(context.currentDirectory, context.targetPath, 77, fields =>
        has('dns')(fields) || has('dnsServers')(fields),
      ),
      execute: context => this.copyFieldByPath(context.targetPath, 'dnsServers', 'dns'),
    });

    this.pluginManager.registerContextMenuItem({
      id: 'builtin.network.adapter.settings',
      label: 'Open Network Settings',
      score: context => score(context.currentDirectory, context.targetPath, 70),
      execute: () => this.openSettings(),
    });
  }

  rememberAdapter(entry: FileInfo): void {
    if (!this.isAdapter(entry)) return;
    const fields = this.fields(entry) ?? {};
    this.adapterContext.set(entry.path, { name: entry.name, fields });
  }

  isAdapter(entry: FileInfo | null | undefined): boolean {
    return this.text(this.fields(entry), 'kind').toLowerCase() === 'adapter';
  }

  index(entry: FileInfo | null | undefined): number | null {
    return this.indexFromFields(this.fields(entry));
  }

  enabled(entry: FileInfo): boolean {
    return this.enabledFromFields(this.fields(entry) ?? {});
  }

  dhcpEnabled(entry: FileInfo): boolean {
    return this.dhcpFromFields(this.fields(entry) ?? {});
  }

  value(entry: FileInfo, field: string): string {
    const value = this.fields(entry)?.[field];
    if (Array.isArray(value)) return value.map(String).join(', ');
    return value == null ? '' : String(value);
  }

  primaryAddress(entry: FileInfo): string {
    return this.value(entry, 'address');
  }

  async showProperties(entry: FileInfo): Promise<void> {
    const fields = this.fields(entry) ?? {};
    await this.confirmDialog.alert({
      title: `${entry.name} — Network Adapter`,
      message: this.adapterSubtitle(fields),
      tone: 'info',
      footerHint: false,
      details: this.adapterPropertySections(entry.name, fields),
    });
  }

  async setEnabled(entry: FileInfo, enabled: boolean): Promise<void> {
    const index = this.requireIndex(entry);
    const verb = enabled ? 'enable' : 'disable';
    const confirmed = await this.confirmDialog.confirm({
      title: `${enabled ? 'Enable' : 'Disable'} Network Adapter`,
      message: `Are you sure you want to ${verb} ${entry.name}?${
        enabled ? '' : '\n\nExisting network connections through this adapter may be interrupted.'
      }`,
      confirmText: enabled ? 'Enable' : 'Disable',
      danger: !enabled,
    });
    if (!confirmed) return;

    const app = this.app();
    if (typeof app?.NetworkAdapterSetEnabled !== 'function') {
      throw new Error('NetworkAdapterSetEnabled binding is unavailable.');
    }
    await app.NetworkAdapterSetEnabled(index, enabled);
    this.changed();
  }

  async renewDHCP(entry: FileInfo): Promise<void> {
    if (!this.dhcpEnabled(entry)) {
      await this.confirmDialog.alert({
        title: 'Renew DHCP',
        message: `${entry.name} is not configured to use DHCP.`,
      });
      return;
    }

    const index = this.requireIndex(entry);
    const app = this.app();
    if (typeof app?.NetworkAdapterRenewDHCP !== 'function') {
      throw new Error('NetworkAdapterRenewDHCP binding is unavailable.');
    }
    await app.NetworkAdapterRenewDHCP(index);
    this.changed();
  }

  async diagnose(entry: FileInfo): Promise<void> {
    const index = this.requireIndex(entry);
    const app = this.app();
    if (typeof app?.NetworkAdapterDiagnose !== 'function') {
      throw new Error('NetworkAdapterDiagnose binding is unavailable.');
    }

    const result = await app.NetworkAdapterDiagnose(index) as AdapterDiagnostic;
    const healthy = result?.fields?.healthy === true;
    const summary = String(result?.fields?.summary ?? 'No diagnostic details were returned.');

    await this.confirmDialog.alert({
      title: `${entry.name} — ${healthy ? 'Connectivity OK' : 'Connectivity Issues'}`,
      message: '',
      tone: healthy ? 'success' : 'warning',
      footerHint: false,
      details: [{
        title: 'Diagnostics',
        rows: summary
          .split('\n')
          .map((line, index) => ({
            label: index === 0 ? 'Result' : '',
            value: line,
          })),
      }],
    });
  }

  async openSettings(): Promise<void> {
    const app = this.app();
    if (typeof app?.NetworkOpenSettings !== 'function') {
      throw new Error('NetworkOpenSettings binding is unavailable.');
    }
    await app.NetworkOpenSettings();
  }

  async copyValue(value: string): Promise<boolean> {
    const normalized = value.trim();
    if (!normalized) return false;

    try {
      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(normalized);
      return true;
    } catch {
      const runtime = (window as unknown as {
        runtime?: {
          ClipboardSetText?: (text: string) => Promise<boolean>;
        };
      }).runtime;
      return typeof runtime?.ClipboardSetText === 'function'
        ? await runtime.ClipboardSetText(normalized)
        : false;
    }
  }

  formatSpeed(bitsPerSecond: unknown): string {
    const value = Number(bitsPerSecond);
    if (!Number.isFinite(value) || value <= 0) return '';
    if (value >= 1_000_000_000) {
      return `${(value / 1_000_000_000).toFixed(value >= 10_000_000_000 ? 0 : 1)} Gbps`;
    }
    if (value >= 1_000_000) {
      return `${(value / 1_000_000).toFixed(value >= 100_000_000 ? 0 : 1)} Mbps`;
    }
    if (value >= 1_000) return `${(value / 1_000).toFixed(0)} Kbps`;
    return `${value.toFixed(0)} bps`;
  }

  private async showPropertiesByPath(path: string): Promise<void> {
    const record = await this.recordForPath(path);
    if (!record) return;
    const fields = record.fields ?? {};
    await this.confirmDialog.alert({
      title: `${record.name} — Network Adapter`,
      message: this.adapterSubtitle(fields),
      tone: 'info',
      footerHint: false,
      details: this.adapterPropertySections(record.name, fields),
    });
  }

  private async setEnabledByPath(path: string, enabled: boolean): Promise<void> {
    const record = await this.recordForPath(path);
    if (!record) return;
    await this.setEnabled(this.recordEntry(record), enabled);
  }

  private async renewByPath(path: string): Promise<void> {
    const record = await this.recordForPath(path);
    if (!record) return;
    await this.renewDHCP(this.recordEntry(record));
  }

  private async diagnoseByPath(path: string): Promise<void> {
    const record = await this.recordForPath(path);
    if (!record) return;
    await this.diagnose(this.recordEntry(record));
  }

  private async copyFieldByPath(
    path: string,
    field: string,
    fallbackField?: string,
  ): Promise<void> {
    const record = await this.recordForPath(path);
    if (!record) return;
    const fields = record.fields ?? {};
    let value = fields[field];
    if (this.fieldValue(fields, field) === '' && fallbackField) {
      value = fields[fallbackField];
    }
    const text = Array.isArray(value) ? value.map(String).join(', ') : String(value ?? '');
    await this.copyValue(text);
  }

  private async recordForPath(path: string): Promise<SystemSurfaceRecord | null> {
    const id = this.decodeRecordId(path);
    if (!id) return null;
    const app = this.app();
    if (typeof app?.SystemSurfaceList !== 'function') return null;

    const raw = await app.SystemSurfaceList('network');
    if (!Array.isArray(raw)) return null;

    for (const candidate of raw) {
      const record = candidate as any;
      const recordId = String(record?.id ?? record?.ID ?? '');
      if (recordId !== id) continue;
      const normalized = {
        id: recordId,
        name: String(record?.name ?? record?.Name ?? recordId),
        fields: (record?.fields ?? record?.Fields ?? {}) as AdapterFields,
      };
      this.adapterContext.set(path, {
        name: normalized.name,
        fields: normalized.fields ?? {},
      });
      return normalized;
    }
    return null;
  }

  private decodeRecordId(path: string): string {
    const match = /^network:\/\/entry\/(.+)$/i.exec(path.trim());
    if (!match) return '';
    try {
      return decodeURIComponent(match[1]);
    } catch {
      return match[1];
    }
  }

  private recordEntry(record: SystemSurfaceRecord): FileInfo {
    return {
      name: record.name,
      path: `network://entry/${encodeURIComponent(record.id)}`,
      type: FileType.FILE,
      size: 0,
      created: 0,
      modified: 0,
      accessed: 0,
      permissions: 'r--',
      isHidden: false,
      systemFields: record.fields ?? {},
    } as FileInfo;
  }

  private fields(entry: FileInfo | null | undefined): AdapterFields | undefined {
    return (entry as FileInfo & {
      systemFields?: AdapterFields;
    } | null | undefined)?.systemFields;
  }

  private requireIndex(entry: FileInfo): number {
    const index = this.index(entry);
    if (index == null) {
      throw new Error(`Network adapter index is unavailable for ${entry.name}.`);
    }
    return index;
  }

  private text(fields: AdapterFields | undefined, key: string): string {
    const value = fields?.[key];
    return value == null ? '' : String(value);
  }

  private adapterSubtitle(fields: AdapterFields): string {
    const description = this.text(fields, 'description');
    const status = this.text(fields, 'status');
    return [description, status].filter(Boolean).join(' · ');
  }

  private adapterPropertySections(
    name: string,
    fields: AdapterFields,
  ): readonly ConfirmDialogDetailSection[] {
    const sections: ConfirmDialogDetailSection[] = [];

    const identity = this.rows([
      ['Name', name],
      ['Description', this.text(fields, 'description')],
      ['Interface name', this.text(fields, 'interfaceName')],
      ['Status', this.text(fields, 'status')],
      ['Administrative state', this.text(fields, 'adminStatus')],
      ['Interface type', this.adapterType(fields)],
      ['Interface index', this.text(fields, 'index')],
    ]);
    if (identity.length) sections.push({ title: 'Adapter', rows: identity });

    const addressing = this.rows([
      ['IP addresses', this.stringList(fields['addresses']), true],
      ['Gateway', this.stringList(fields['gateways']) || this.text(fields, 'gateway'), true],
      ['DNS servers', this.stringList(fields['dnsServers']) || this.text(fields, 'dns'), true],
      ['DNS suffix', this.text(fields, 'dnsSuffix'), true],
      ['DHCP', this.booleanText(fields['dhcpEnabled'])],
    ]);
    if (addressing.length) sections.push({ title: 'Addressing', rows: addressing });

    const hardware = this.rows([
      ['MAC address', this.text(fields, 'mac'), true],
      ['Link speed', this.formatSpeed(fields['linkSpeed'])],
      ['Transmit speed', this.formatSpeed(fields['transmitSpeed'])],
      ['Receive speed', this.formatSpeed(fields['receiveSpeed'])],
      ['MTU', this.text(fields, 'mtu')],
      ['Flags', this.text(fields, 'flags')],
    ]);
    if (hardware.length) sections.push({ title: 'Hardware & link', rows: hardware });

    const traffic = this.rows([
      ['Received', this.formatBytes(fields['bytesReceived'])],
      ['Sent', this.formatBytes(fields['bytesSent'])],
      ['Receive errors', this.text(fields, 'receiveErrors')],
      ['Send errors', this.text(fields, 'sendErrors')],
      ['Receive discards', this.text(fields, 'receiveDiscards')],
      ['Send discards', this.text(fields, 'sendDiscards')],
    ]);
    if (traffic.length) sections.push({ title: 'Traffic', rows: traffic });

    return sections;
  }

  private rows(
    definitions: readonly (readonly [string, string | readonly string[], boolean?])[],
  ): ConfirmDialogDetailSection['rows'] {
    return definitions
      .filter(([, value]) => Array.isArray(value) ? value.length > 0 : String(value ?? '').trim() !== '')
      .map(([label, value, monospace]) => ({ label, value, monospace }));
  }

  private stringList(value: unknown): string | readonly string[] {
    if (Array.isArray(value)) {
      return value.map(String).map(item => item.trim()).filter(Boolean);
    }
    return String(value ?? '').trim();
  }

  private adapterType(fields: AdapterFields): string {
    const description = this.text(fields, 'description').toLowerCase();
    if (description.includes('bluetooth')) return 'Bluetooth PAN';
    if (description.includes('hyper-v')) return 'Hyper-V virtual adapter';
    if (description.includes('vmware')) return 'VMware virtual adapter';
    if (description.includes('virtualbox')) return 'VirtualBox virtual adapter';
    if (description.includes('wireguard')) return 'WireGuard adapter';
    if (description.includes('vpn') || description.includes('tap') || description.includes('tun')) {
      return 'VPN / virtual adapter';
    }

    const raw = Number(fields['ifType']);
    const friendly = new Map<number, string>([
      [6, 'Ethernet'],
      [24, 'Loopback'],
      [53, 'PPP / VPN'],
      [71, 'Wi-Fi'],
      [131, 'Tunnel'],
      [144, 'IEEE 1394'],
    ]).get(raw);
    if (friendly) return friendly;
    return Number.isFinite(raw) && raw > 0 ? `Type ${raw}` : '';
  }

  private fieldValue(fields: AdapterFields, field: string): string {
    const value = fields[field];
    if (Array.isArray(value)) return value.map(String).filter(Boolean).join(', ');
    return value == null ? '' : String(value).trim();
  }

  private indexFromFields(fields: AdapterFields | undefined): number | null {
    const value = Number(fields?.['index']);
    return Number.isFinite(value) && value > 0 ? Math.trunc(value) : null;
  }

  private enabledFromFields(fields: AdapterFields): boolean {
    const admin = this.text(fields, 'adminStatus').toLowerCase();
    if (admin) return admin === 'enabled';
    return this.text(fields, 'status').toLowerCase() === 'up';
  }

  private dhcpFromFields(fields: AdapterFields): boolean {
    const value = fields['dhcpEnabled'];
    return value === true || String(value).toLowerCase() === 'true';
  }

  private listText(value: unknown): string {
    return Array.isArray(value) ? value.map(String).join(', ') : String(value ?? '');
  }

  private booleanText(value: unknown): string {
    if (value === true || String(value).toLowerCase() === 'true') return 'Yes';
    if (value === false || String(value).toLowerCase() === 'false') return 'No';
    return '';
  }

  private formatBytes(value: unknown): string {
    const bytes = Number(value);
    if (!Number.isFinite(bytes) || bytes < 0) return '';
    if (bytes >= 1024 ** 3) return `${(bytes / 1024 ** 3).toFixed(2)} GB`;
    if (bytes >= 1024 ** 2) return `${(bytes / 1024 ** 2).toFixed(1)} MB`;
    if (bytes >= 1024) return `${(bytes / 1024).toFixed(1)} KB`;
    return `${bytes.toFixed(0)} B`;
  }

  private app(): any {
    return (window as any)?.go?.app?.App;
  }

  private changed(): void {
    window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('network-adapter-changed'));
  }
}
`````

`````typescript
import { OperationHistoryService } from './operation-history.service';

describe('OperationHistoryService synchronization journal', () => {
  beforeEach(() => localStorage.clear());

  it('records completed synchronization runs independently of undo history', () => {
    const service = new OperationHistoryService();
    service.recordSync({
      startedAt: 10, completedAt: 20, leftRoot: '/left', rightRoot: '/right',
      mode: 'bidirectional', recursive: true, planned: 4, succeeded: 3, skipped: 1, failed: 0, conflicts: 1,
    });

    expect(service.canUndo).toBe(false);
    expect(service.recentSyncs(1)[0]).toEqual(jasmine.objectContaining({
      leftRoot: '/left', rightRoot: '/right', mode: 'bidirectional', succeeded: 3, conflicts: 1,
    }));
  });

  it('persists synchronization history across service instances', () => {
    const first = new OperationHistoryService();
    first.recordSync({
      startedAt: 1, completedAt: 2, leftRoot: 'L', rightRoot: 'R',
      mode: 'left-to-right', recursive: false, planned: 1, succeeded: 1, skipped: 0, failed: 0, conflicts: 0,
    });

    const second = new OperationHistoryService();
    expect(second.recentSyncs()).toHaveSize(1);
    expect(second.recentSyncs()[0].mode).toBe('left-to-right');
  });
});
`````

`````typescript
import { Injectable } from '@angular/core';


export type SyncMode = 'left-to-right' | 'right-to-left' | 'bidirectional' | 'custom';

export interface SyncHistoryEntry {
  readonly id: string;
  readonly startedAt: number;
  readonly completedAt: number;
  readonly leftRoot: string;
  readonly rightRoot: string;
  readonly mode: SyncMode;
  readonly recursive: boolean;
  readonly planned: number;
  readonly succeeded: number;
  readonly skipped: number;
  readonly failed: number;
  readonly conflicts: number;
}

const SYNC_HISTORY_KEY = 'reassembly.syncHistory.v1';
const SYNC_HISTORY_LIMIT = 100;

export type OperationJournalState =
  | 'completed'
  | 'partial'
  | 'failed'
  | 'undone'
  | 'redone';

export interface OperationJournalEntry {
  readonly id: string;
  readonly label: string;
  readonly kind: string;
  readonly startedAt: number;
  readonly completedAt: number;
  readonly state: OperationJournalState;
  readonly reversible: boolean;
  readonly affectedPaths: readonly string[];
  readonly summary?: string;
  readonly error?: string;
}

export interface ReversibleAction {
  readonly label: string;
  readonly undo: () => Promise<void>;
  readonly redo: () => Promise<void>;
  readonly kind?: string;
  readonly affectedPaths?: readonly string[];
  readonly summary?: string;
}

@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })
export class OperationHistoryService {
  private readonly undoStack: ReversibleAction[] = [];
  private readonly redoStack: ReversibleAction[] = [];
  private running = false;
  private readonly limit = 100;
  private syncHistory: SyncHistoryEntry[] | null = null;
  private journal: OperationJournalEntry[] = [];

  get canUndo(): boolean {
    return !this.running && this.undoStack.length > 0;
  }

  get canRedo(): boolean {
    return !this.running && this.redoStack.length > 0;
  }

  record(action: ReversibleAction): void {
    if (this.running) return;
    this.undoStack.push(action);
    if (this.undoStack.length > this.limit) {
      this.undoStack.splice(0, this.undoStack.length - this.limit);
    }
    this.redoStack.length = 0;

    this.appendJournal({
      label: action.label,
      kind: action.kind ?? 'file-operation',
      reversible: true,
      affectedPaths: action.affectedPaths ?? [],
      summary: action.summary,
      state: 'completed',
    });
  }

  recordOutcome(entry: {
    label: string;
    kind?: string;
    reversible?: boolean;
    affectedPaths?: readonly string[];
    summary?: string;
    state?: OperationJournalState;
    error?: string;
    startedAt?: number;
  }): OperationJournalEntry {
    return this.appendJournal({
      label: entry.label,
      kind: entry.kind ?? 'file-operation',
      reversible: entry.reversible ?? false,
      affectedPaths: entry.affectedPaths ?? [],
      summary: entry.summary,
      state: entry.state ?? 'completed',
      error: entry.error,
      startedAt: entry.startedAt,
    });
  }

  recentOperations(limit = 100): readonly OperationJournalEntry[] {
    return this.journal.slice(0, Math.max(0, limit)).map(entry => ({
      ...entry,
      affectedPaths: [...entry.affectedPaths],
    }));
  }

  async undo(): Promise<string | null> {
    if (!this.canUndo) return null;
    const action = this.undoStack.pop();
    if (!action) return null;

    this.running = true;
    try {
      await action.undo();
      this.redoStack.push(action);
      this.markJournalState(action.label, 'undone');
      return action.label;
    } catch (error) {
      this.undoStack.push(action);
      throw error;
    } finally {
      this.running = false;
    }
  }

  async redo(): Promise<string | null> {
    if (!this.canRedo) return null;
    const action = this.redoStack.pop();
    if (!action) return null;

    this.running = true;
    try {
      await action.redo();
      this.undoStack.push(action);
      this.markJournalState(action.label, 'redone');
      return action.label;
    } catch (error) {
      this.redoStack.push(action);
      throw error;
    } finally {
      this.running = false;
    }
  }

  clear(): void {
    if (this.running) return;
    this.undoStack.length = 0;
    this.redoStack.length = 0;
  }

  clearJournal(): void {
    if (this.running) return;
    this.journal = [];
  }

  recordSync(entry: Omit<SyncHistoryEntry, 'id'> & { readonly id?: string }): SyncHistoryEntry {
    const recorded: SyncHistoryEntry = {
      ...entry,
      id: entry.id ?? globalThis.crypto?.randomUUID?.() ?? `${entry.completedAt}-${Math.random().toString(16).slice(2)}`,
    };
    const history = this.loadSyncHistory();
    history.unshift(recorded);
    if (history.length > SYNC_HISTORY_LIMIT) history.splice(SYNC_HISTORY_LIMIT);
    this.persistSyncHistory(history);
    return recorded;
  }

  recentSyncs(limit = 20): readonly SyncHistoryEntry[] {
    return this.loadSyncHistory().slice(0, Math.max(0, limit)).map(entry => ({ ...entry }));
  }

  clearSyncHistory(): void {
    this.syncHistory = [];
    try { localStorage.removeItem(SYNC_HISTORY_KEY); } catch { /* unavailable storage is non-fatal */ }
  }

  private appendJournal(entry: {
    label: string;
    kind: string;
    reversible: boolean;
    affectedPaths: readonly string[];
    summary?: string;
    state: OperationJournalState;
    error?: string;
    startedAt?: number;
  }): OperationJournalEntry {
    const completedAt = Date.now();
    const recorded: OperationJournalEntry = {
      id: globalThis.crypto?.randomUUID?.() ?? `${completedAt}-${Math.random().toString(16).slice(2)}`,
      label: entry.label,
      kind: entry.kind,
      startedAt: entry.startedAt ?? completedAt,
      completedAt,
      state: entry.state,
      reversible: entry.reversible,
      affectedPaths: [...entry.affectedPaths],
      summary: entry.summary,
      error: entry.error,
    };
    this.journal.unshift(recorded);
    if (this.journal.length > this.limit) this.journal.splice(this.limit);
    return recorded;
  }

  private markJournalState(label: string, state: 'undone' | 'redone'): void {
    const index = this.journal.findIndex(entry => entry.label === label && entry.reversible);
    if (index < 0) return;
    this.journal[index] = { ...this.journal[index], state, completedAt: Date.now() };
  }

  private loadSyncHistory(): SyncHistoryEntry[] {
    if (this.syncHistory) return this.syncHistory;
    try {
      const raw = localStorage.getItem(SYNC_HISTORY_KEY);
      const parsed = raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : [];
      this.syncHistory = Array.isArray(parsed) ? parsed.filter(this.isSyncHistoryEntry).slice(0, SYNC_HISTORY_LIMIT) : [];
    } catch {
      this.syncHistory = [];
    }
    return this.syncHistory;
  }

  private persistSyncHistory(history: readonly SyncHistoryEntry[]): void {
    this.syncHistory = [...history];
    try { localStorage.setItem(SYNC_HISTORY_KEY, JSON.stringify(this.syncHistory)); } catch { /* history is best-effort */ }
  }

  private readonly isSyncHistoryEntry = (value: unknown): value is SyncHistoryEntry => {
    if (!value || typeof value !== 'object') return false;
    const entry = value as Partial<SyncHistoryEntry>;
    return typeof entry.id === 'string' && typeof entry.startedAt === 'number' && typeof entry.completedAt === 'number' &&
      typeof entry.leftRoot === 'string' && typeof entry.rightRoot === 'string' && typeof entry.mode === 'string' &&
      typeof entry.planned === 'number' && typeof entry.succeeded === 'number' && typeof entry.skipped === 'number' &&
      typeof entry.failed === 'number' && typeof entry.conflicts === 'number';
  };

}
`````

`````typescript
import { Injectable } from '@angular/core';
import { OperationKind } from '../shared/protocol-enhanced';

export interface OperationConfig {
  kind: OperationKind;
  title: string;
  icon: string;
  themeColor: string;
  cancellable: boolean;
  pausable: boolean;
}

@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })
export class OperationRegistryService {
  private configs = new Map<OperationKind, OperationConfig>([
    ['copy', {
      kind: 'copy',
      title: 'Copying',
      icon: 'copy',
      themeColor: '--vsc-accent-blue',
      cancellable: true,
      pausable: false
    }],
    ['move', {
      kind: 'move',
      title: 'Moving',
      icon: 'move',
      themeColor: '--vsc-accent-purple',
      cancellable: true,
      pausable: false
    }],
    ['delete', {
      kind: 'delete',
      title: 'Deleting',
      icon: 'trash',
      themeColor: '--vsc-error',
      cancellable: true,
      pausable: false
    }],
    ['archive', {
      kind: 'archive',
      title: 'Archiving',
      icon: 'archive',
      themeColor: '--vsc-accent-orange',
      cancellable: true,
      pausable: false
    }],
    ['extract', {
      kind: 'extract',
      title: 'Extracting',
      icon: 'extract',
      themeColor: '--vsc-accent-green',
      cancellable: true,
      pausable: false
    }],
    ['search', {
      kind: 'search',
      title: 'Searching',
      icon: 'search',
      themeColor: '--vsc-info',
      cancellable: true,
      pausable: false
    }],
    ['calculate', {
      kind: 'calculate',
      title: 'Calculating',
      icon: 'calculator',
      themeColor: '--vsc-info',
      cancellable: true,
      pausable: false
    }]
  ]);

  /**
   * Register a new operation type configuration
   */
  register(config: OperationConfig): void {
    this.configs.set(config.kind, config);
  }

  /**
   * Get configuration for an operation kind
   */
  get(kind: OperationKind): OperationConfig {
    return this.configs.get(kind) ?? {
      kind,
      title: 'Processing',
      icon: 'gear',
      themeColor: '--vsc-foreground-dim',
      cancellable: false,
      pausable: false
    };
  }

  /**
   * Get all registered operation configurations
   */
  getAll(): OperationConfig[] {
    return Array.from(this.configs.values());
  }

  /**
   * Check if an operation kind exists
   */
  has(kind: OperationKind): boolean {
    return this.configs.has(kind);
  }

  /**
   * Remove an operation configuration
   */
  unregister(kind: OperationKind): boolean {
    return this.configs.delete(kind);
  }

  /**
   * Update an existing operation configuration
   */
  update(kind: OperationKind, partialConfig: Partial<OperationConfig>): boolean {
    const existing = this.configs.get(kind);
    if (!existing) return false;
    
    this.configs.set(kind, { ...existing, ...partialConfig });
    return true;
  }
}
`````

`````typescript
// operation.service.ts - Add resolveConflict method

import { Injectable, NgZone, OnDestroy } from '@angular/core';
import { 
  createSubject, 
  createBehaviorSubject,
  map,
  takeUntil,
  distinctUntilChanged,
  shareReplay
} from '@epikodelabs/streamix';
import { EventsOn, EventsOff } from 'wailsjs/runtime';
import { CancelOperation, DismissOperation, GetActiveOperations, ResolveConflict } from 'wailsjs/go/app/App';
import {
  OperationKind,
  OperationStatus,
  OpStartEvent,
  OpProgressEvent,
  OpCompleteEvent,
  ConflictEvent,
  ConflictResolution
} from '../shared/protocol-enhanced';
import { OperationRegistryService, OperationConfig } from './operation-registry.service';

export interface OperationState {
  id: string;
  config: OperationConfig;
  status: OperationStatus;
  error?: string;
  // Add conflict data
  conflictData?: {
    conflictId: string;
    sourcePath: string;
    destPath: string;
    sourceSize: number;
    destSize: number;
    isDirectory: boolean;
  };
  metrics: {
    totalBytes: number;
    processedBytes: number;
    totalItems: number;
    processedItems: number;
    currentFile?: string;
    currentFileSize?: number;
  };
  percentComplete: number;
  timing: {
    startedAt: number;
    elapsedMs: number;
    estimatedRemainingMs: number;
    speedBytesPerSecond: number;
  };
  isMinimized: boolean;
  isCollapsed: boolean;
  stackIndex: number;
  /** Public source locations captured when the operation starts. */
  sources: string[];
  /** Public destination location when the operation has one. */
  destination?: string;
}

export interface OperationHistoryEntry extends OperationState {
  completedAt: number;
}

export function normalizeOperationKind(value: unknown): OperationKind {
  const kind = String(value ?? '').trim().toLowerCase();
  switch (kind) {
    case 'copy': case 'move': case 'delete': case 'archive': case 'extract': case 'search': case 'calculate':
      return kind as OperationKind;
    default:
      return 'copy';
  }
}

export function normalizeOperationStatus(value: unknown): OperationStatus {
  const status = String(value ?? '').trim().toLowerCase();
  switch (status) {
    case 'pending': case 'running': case 'paused': case 'completed': case 'error': case 'cancelled':
      return status as OperationStatus;
    default:
      return 'running';
  }
}

@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })
export class OperationService implements OnDestroy {
  // Core state streams
  private operationsMap = new Map<string, OperationState>();
  readonly operations$ = createBehaviorSubject<Map<string, OperationState>>(new Map<string, OperationState>());
  readonly history$ = createBehaviorSubject<OperationHistoryEntry[]>([]);
  private readonly HISTORY_LIMIT = 100;
  
  // Add conflicts stream
  private conflictsSubject = createSubject<ConflictEvent[]>();
  public conflicts$ = this.conflictsSubject.pipe(shareReplay(1));
  
  private pendingConflicts = new Map<string, ConflictEvent>();
  private readonly collisionPolicyKey = 'reassembly.operations.collisionPolicy.v1';
  private collisionPolicy: ConflictResolution | 'ask' = this.loadCollisionPolicy();
  
  // Derived streams using Streamix
  public activeCount$ = this.operations$.pipe(
    map(ops => {
      let count = 0;
      ops.forEach(op => {
        if (op.status === 'running' || op.status === 'pending') count++;
      });
      return count;
    }),
    distinctUntilChanged(),
    shareReplay(1)
  );

  public visibleOperations$ = this.operations$.pipe(
    map(ops => {
      const visible: OperationState[] = [];
      ops.forEach(op => {
        if (!op.isCollapsed) visible.push(op);
      });
      return visible.sort((a, b) => a.stackIndex - b.stackIndex).slice(0, 3);
    }),
    shareReplay(1)
  );

  public collapsedOperations$ = this.operations$.pipe(
    map(ops => {
      const collapsed: OperationState[] = [];
      ops.forEach(op => {
        if (op.isCollapsed) collapsed.push(op);
      });
      return collapsed;
    }),
    shareReplay(1)
  );

  public hasActiveOperations$ = this.activeCount$.pipe(
    map(count => count > 0),
    distinctUntilChanged(),
    shareReplay(1)
  );

  // Cleanup
  private destroySubject = createSubject<void>();

  // Flag to track if events are set up
  private eventsSetup = false;

  constructor(
    private zone: NgZone,
    private registry: OperationRegistryService
  ) {
    this.setupWailsEvents();
    void this.hydrateActiveOperations();
  }

  private setupWailsEvents(): void {
    if (this.eventsSetup) return;
    
    const handleStart = (event: OpStartEvent) => {
      this.zone.run(() => this.handleStart(event));
    };

    const handleProgress = (event: OpProgressEvent) => {
      this.zone.run(() => this.handleProgress(event));
    };

    const handleComplete = (event: OpCompleteEvent) => {
      this.zone.run(() => this.handleComplete(event));
    };

    const handleConflict = (event: ConflictEvent) => {
      this.zone.run(() => this.handleConflict(event));
    };

    // Register event listeners
    EventsOn('operation:start', handleStart);
    EventsOn('operation:progress', handleProgress);
    EventsOn('operation:complete', handleComplete);
    EventsOn('operation:conflict', handleConflict);

    this.eventsSetup = true;

    // Store handlers for cleanup
    (this as any)._eventHandlers = { 
      handleStart, 
      handleProgress, 
      handleComplete,
      handleConflict 
    };
  }

  private handleStart(event: OpStartEvent): void {
    const config = this.registry.get(event.kind as OperationKind);
    const now = Date.now();
    
    const state: OperationState = {
      id: event.id,
      config,
      status: 'running',
      metrics: {
        totalBytes: event.totalBytes,
        processedBytes: 0,
        totalItems: event.totalItems,
        processedItems: 0,
        currentFile: event.sources[0]
      },
      percentComplete: 0,
      timing: {
        startedAt: now,
        elapsedMs: 0,
        estimatedRemainingMs: 0,
        speedBytesPerSecond: 0
      },
      isMinimized: false,
      isCollapsed: false,
      stackIndex: this.operationsMap.size,
      sources: [...(event.sources ?? [])],
      destination: event.destination || undefined
    };

    this.operationsMap.set(event.id, state);
    this.emitOperations();
  }

  private handleProgress(event: OpProgressEvent): void {
    const existing = this.operationsMap.get(event.id);
    if (!existing) return;

    const totalBytes = existing.metrics.totalBytes;
    const processedBytes = event.processedBytes;
    
    const percentComplete = totalBytes > 0 
      ? Math.min(100, (processedBytes / totalBytes) * 100)
      : 0;

    const updated: OperationState = {
      ...existing,
      metrics: {
        ...existing.metrics,
        processedBytes: event.processedBytes,
        processedItems: event.processedItems,
        currentFile: event.currentFile,
        currentFileSize: event.currentFileSize
      },
      percentComplete,
      timing: {
        startedAt: existing.timing.startedAt,
        elapsedMs: event.elapsedMs,
        estimatedRemainingMs: event.remainingMs,
        speedBytesPerSecond: event.speedBps
      }
    };

    this.operationsMap.set(event.id, updated);
    this.emitOperations();
  }

  private handleComplete(event: OpCompleteEvent): void {
    const existing = this.operationsMap.get(event.id);
    if (!existing) return;

    const updated: OperationState = {
      ...existing,
      status: event.status as OperationStatus,
      metrics: {
        ...existing.metrics,
        processedBytes: event.finalMetrics.processedBytes,
        processedItems: event.finalMetrics.processedItems
      },
      percentComplete: 100,
      timing: event.timing,
      error: event.error
    };

    this.operationsMap.set(event.id, updated);
    this.recordHistory(updated);

    // Successful/cancelled work belongs in history, not in the live operation stack.
    // Remove it synchronously so the UI never paints a stale "finished" operation.
    // Errors intentionally remain visible until the user dismisses them.
    if (event.status === 'completed' || event.status === 'cancelled') {
      this.dismiss(event.id);
      return;
    }

    this.emitOperations();
  }

  private handleConflict(event: ConflictEvent): void {
    // Store the conflict
    this.pendingConflicts.set(event.conflictId, event);
    this.conflictsSubject.next(Array.from(this.pendingConflicts.values()));

    if (this.collisionPolicy !== 'ask') {
      void this.resolveConflict(
        event.conflictId,
        this.collisionPolicy,
        true,
      );
      return;
    }

    // Update the operation state
    const existing = this.operationsMap.get(event.operationId);
    if (existing) {
      const updated: OperationState = {
        ...existing,
        status: 'paused',
        error: `Conflict: ${event.destPath} already exists`,
        conflictData: {
          conflictId: event.conflictId,
          sourcePath: event.sourcePath,
          destPath: event.destPath,
          sourceSize: event.sourceSize,
          destSize: event.destSize,
          isDirectory: event.isDirectory
        },
        metrics: {
          ...existing.metrics,
          currentFile: event.sourcePath
        }
      };
      this.operationsMap.set(event.operationId, updated);
      this.emitOperations();
    }
  }

  private emitOperations(): void {
    this.operations$.next(new Map(this.operationsMap));
  }

  // ============================================================================
  // Conflict Resolution
  // ============================================================================

  /**
   * Resolve a conflict by sending the user's decision to the backend
   */
  async resolveConflict(conflictId: string, resolution: ConflictResolution, applyToAll: boolean): Promise<boolean> {
    try {
      const result = await ResolveConflict(conflictId, resolution as any, applyToAll);
      
      if (result) {
        // Remove from pending conflicts
        const conflict = this.pendingConflicts.get(conflictId);
        this.pendingConflicts.delete(conflictId);
        this.conflictsSubject.next(Array.from(this.pendingConflicts.values()));

        // Resume or hide the operation depending on the user's choice
        if (conflict && !this.hasPendingConflictsForOperation(conflict.operationId)) {
          const op = this.operationsMap.get(conflict.operationId);
          if (op) {
            op.error = undefined;
            op.conflictData = undefined;

            // Skip/Cancel: immediately dismiss the toast so no moving dialog is shown again
            if (resolution === 'skip' || resolution === 'cancel') {
              this.dismiss(conflict.operationId);
            } else if (op.status === 'paused') {
              // For overwrite/rename, let it continue
              op.status = 'running';
              this.emitOperations();
            }
          }
        }
      }
      
      return result;
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Failed to resolve conflict:', error);
      return false;
    }
  }

  /**
   * Check if an operation has any pending conflicts
   */
  private hasPendingConflictsForOperation(operationId: string): boolean {
    for (const conflict of this.pendingConflicts.values()) {
      if (conflict.operationId === operationId) {
        return true;
      }
    }
    return false;
  }

  /**
   * Get all pending conflicts
   */
  getPendingConflicts(): ConflictEvent[] {
    return Array.from(this.pendingConflicts.values());
  }

  async waitForOperationSettlement(
    operationId: string,
    appearanceTimeoutMs: number = 2000,
    overallTimeoutMs: number = 300000,
  ): Promise<OperationStatus | 'dismissed' | 'missing'> {
    return await new Promise<OperationStatus | 'dismissed' | 'missing'>((resolve) => {
      let settled = false;
      let seenOperation = false;
      let appearanceTimer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null = null;
      let overallTimer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null = null;
      let subscription: { unsubscribe(): void } | null = null;

      const finish = (status: OperationStatus | 'dismissed' | 'missing') => {
        if (settled) return;
        settled = true;
        if (appearanceTimer) clearTimeout(appearanceTimer);
        if (overallTimer) clearTimeout(overallTimer);
        try { subscription?.unsubscribe(); } catch {}
        resolve(status);
      };

      appearanceTimer = setTimeout(() => {
        const op = this.operationsMap.get(operationId);
        if (!seenOperation && !op && !this.hasPendingConflictsForOperation(operationId)) {
          finish('missing');
        }
      }, appearanceTimeoutMs);

      overallTimer = setTimeout(() => {
        finish(seenOperation ? 'dismissed' : 'missing');
      }, overallTimeoutMs);

      subscription = this.operations$.subscribe((ops) => {
        const op = ops.get(operationId);
        if (op) {
          seenOperation = true;
          if (op.status === 'completed' || op.status === 'error' || op.status === 'cancelled') {
            finish(op.status);
          }
          return;
        }

        if (seenOperation && !this.hasPendingConflictsForOperation(operationId)) {
          finish('dismissed');
        }
      });
    });
  }

  /**
   * Get a specific pending conflict by ID
   */
  getConflict(conflictId: string): ConflictEvent | undefined {
    return this.pendingConflicts.get(conflictId);
  }

  // ============================================================================
  // Public API Methods
  // ============================================================================

  getCollisionPolicy(): ConflictResolution | 'ask' {
    return this.collisionPolicy;
  }

  setCollisionPolicy(policy: ConflictResolution | 'ask'): void {
    this.collisionPolicy = policy;
    try {
      localStorage.setItem(this.collisionPolicyKey, policy);
    } catch {
      // Preference remains valid for the current session.
    }
  }

  private loadCollisionPolicy(): ConflictResolution | 'ask' {
    try {
      const value = localStorage.getItem(this.collisionPolicyKey);
      if (
        value === 'overwrite' ||
        value === 'rename' ||
        value === 'skip' ||
        value === 'ask'
      ) {
        return value;
      }
    } catch {
      // Storage is optional.
    }
    return 'ask';
  }

  minimize(id: string): void {
    this.patchOperation(id, { isMinimized: true });
  }

  expand(id: string): void {
    this.patchOperation(id, { isMinimized: false });
  }

  collapse(id: string): void {
    this.patchOperation(id, { isCollapsed: true, isMinimized: false });
    this.reindexStack();
  }

  restore(id: string): void {
    this.patchOperation(id, { isCollapsed: false, isMinimized: false });
    this.reindexStack();
  }

  async cancel(id: string): Promise<void> {
    try {
      const result = await CancelOperation(id);
      if (!result) {
        console.warn('Cancel operation returned false');
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.error('Failed to cancel operation:', e);
    }
  }

  dismiss(id: string): void {
    this.operationsMap.delete(id);
    void DismissOperation(id).catch(error => console.warn('Failed to dismiss backend operation:', error));
    this.emitOperations();
    this.reindexStack();
  }

  collapseAll(): void {
    this.operationsMap.forEach(op => {
      op.isCollapsed = true;
      op.isMinimized = false;
    });
    this.emitOperations();
  }

  restoreAll(): void {
    this.operationsMap.forEach(op => {
      op.isCollapsed = false;
      op.isMinimized = false;
    });
    this.emitOperations();
    this.reindexStack();
  }


  clearHistory(): void {
    this.history$.next([]);
  }

  dismissFinished(): void {
    const finished = Array.from(this.operationsMap.values())
      .filter(operation =>
        operation.status === 'completed' ||
        operation.status === 'error' ||
        operation.status === 'cancelled',
      )
      .map(operation => operation.id);

    for (const id of finished) {
      this.dismiss(id);
    }
  }

  hasPendingConflict(operationId: string): boolean {
    return this.hasPendingConflictsForOperation(operationId);
  }


  private recordHistory(operation: OperationState): void {
    if (operation.status === 'running' || operation.status === 'pending' || operation.status === 'paused') return;
    const entry: OperationHistoryEntry = {
      ...operation,
      sources: [...operation.sources],
      metrics: { ...operation.metrics },
      timing: { ...operation.timing },
      completedAt: Date.now(),
    };
    const next = [entry, ...this.history$.value.filter((item: OperationHistoryEntry) => item.id !== entry.id)].slice(0, this.HISTORY_LIMIT);
    this.history$.next(next);
  }

  private async hydrateActiveOperations(): Promise<void> {
    try {
      const backend = await GetActiveOperations();
      for (const raw of backend ?? []) {
        if (this.operationsMap.has(raw.id)) continue;
        const kind = normalizeOperationKind(raw.type);
        const status = normalizeOperationStatus(raw.status);
        const state: OperationState = {
          id: raw.id,
          config: this.registry.get(kind),
          status,
          error: raw.error || undefined,
          sources: raw.sourcePath ? [raw.sourcePath] : [],
          destination: raw.destinationPath || undefined,
          metrics: {
            totalBytes: raw.totalBytes ?? 0,
            processedBytes: raw.processedBytes ?? 0,
            totalItems: raw.totalItems ?? 0,
            processedItems: raw.processedItems ?? 0,
            currentFile: raw.currentFile || undefined,
            currentFileSize: raw.currentFileSize || undefined,
          },
          percentComplete: raw.percentComplete ?? 0,
          timing: {
            startedAt: raw.startTime ?? Date.now(),
            elapsedMs: (raw.elapsedSeconds ?? 0) * 1000,
            estimatedRemainingMs: (raw.etaSeconds ?? 0) * 1000,
            speedBytesPerSecond: raw.speedBytesPerSec ?? 0,
          },
          isMinimized: false,
          isCollapsed: false,
          stackIndex: this.operationsMap.size,
        };
        this.operationsMap.set(state.id, state);
      }
      this.emitOperations();
    } catch (error) {
      // Startup hydration is best effort; live Wails events remain authoritative.
      console.warn('Failed to hydrate active operations:', error);
    }
  }

  private patchOperation(id: string, patch: Partial<OperationState>): void {
    const current = this.operationsMap.get(id);
    if (!current) return;

    this.operationsMap.set(id, { ...current, ...patch });
    this.emitOperations();
  }

  private reindexStack(): void {
    let index = 0;
    const sorted = Array.from(this.operationsMap.values())
      .filter(o => !o.isCollapsed)
      .sort((a, b) => a.stackIndex - b.stackIndex);

    sorted.forEach(op => {
      const updated = { ...op, stackIndex: index++ };
      this.operationsMap.set(op.id, updated);
    });

    this.emitOperations();
  }

  // ============================================================================
  // Formatters
  // ============================================================================

  formatBytes(bytes: number): string {
    if (bytes === 0) return '0 B';
    const k = 1024;
    const sizes = ['B', 'KB', 'MB', 'GB', 'TB'];
    const i = Math.floor(Math.log(bytes) / Math.log(k));
    return parseFloat((bytes / Math.pow(k, i)).toFixed(1)) + ' ' + sizes[i];
  }

  formatSpeed(bps: number): string {
    return this.formatBytes(bps) + '/s';
  }

  formatDuration(ms: number): string {
    if (ms < 0 || !isFinite(ms)) return '--:--';
    const seconds = Math.floor(ms / 1000);
    const minutes = Math.floor(seconds / 60);
    const hours = Math.floor(minutes / 60);
    
    if (hours > 0) {
      return `${hours}:${(minutes % 60).toString().padStart(2, '0')}:${(seconds % 60).toString().padStart(2, '0')}`;
    }
    return `${minutes}:${(seconds % 60).toString().padStart(2, '0')}`;
  }

  // ============================================================================
  // Cleanup
  // ============================================================================

  ngOnDestroy(): void {
    this.destroySubject.next();
    this.destroySubject.complete();
    
    // Clean up event listeners
    EventsOff('operation:start');
    EventsOff('operation:progress');
    EventsOff('operation:complete');
    EventsOff('operation:conflict');
  }
}
`````

`````typescript
import { FileInfo, FileType } from '../shared/protocol';
import { PaneComparisonService } from './pane-comparison.service';

function file(name: string, side: 'left' | 'right', overrides: Partial<FileInfo> = {}): FileInfo {
  return {
    name,
    path: `/${side}/${name}`,
    type: FileType.FILE,
    size: 10,
    created: 1,
    modified: 100,
    accessed: 1,
    permissions: '',
    isHidden: false,
    ...overrides,
  };
}

describe('PaneComparisonService', () => {
  const service = new PaneComparisonService();

  it('classifies missing, newer and size-different files by name', () => {
    const result = service.compare(
      [file('same.txt', 'left'), file('left.txt', 'left'), file('newer.txt', 'left', { modified: 200 }), file('size.txt', 'left', { size: 20 })],
      [file('same.txt', 'right'), file('right.txt', 'right'), file('newer.txt', 'right', { modified: 100 }), file('size.txt', 'right', { size: 10 })],
    );

    expect(result.summary).toEqual(jasmine.objectContaining({ same: 1, onlyLeft: 1, onlyRight: 1, leftNewer: 1, sizeDifferent: 1, different: 4 }));
  });

  it('treats timestamp differences within the tolerance as equal', () => {
    const result = service.compare([file('a.txt', 'left', { modified: 100 })], [file('a.txt', 'right', { modified: 101 })]);
    expect(result.items[0].status).toBe('same');
  });

  it('does not recursively compare directories', () => {
    const result = service.compare(
      [file('folder', 'left', { type: FileType.DIRECTORY, modified: 200 })],
      [file('folder', 'right', { type: FileType.DIRECTORY, modified: 100 })],
    );
    expect(result.items[0].status).toBe('same');
  });

  it('returns safe missing-only copy sets', () => {
    const result = service.compare([file('left.txt', 'left')], [file('right.txt', 'right')]);
    expect(service.missingOnRightPaths(result)).toEqual(['/left/left.txt']);
    expect(service.missingOnLeftPaths(result)).toEqual(['/right/right.txt']);
  });

  it('supports explicit size-only and date-only policies', () => {
    const sizeOnly = service.compare(
      [file('a.txt', 'left', { size: 10, modified: 200 })],
      [file('a.txt', 'right', { size: 10, modified: 100 })],
      { policy: 'size' },
    );
    expect(sizeOnly.items[0].status).toBe('same');

    const dateOnly = service.compare(
      [file('a.txt', 'left', { size: 20, modified: 100 })],
      [file('a.txt', 'right', { size: 10, modified: 100 })],
      { policy: 'date' },
    );
    expect(dateOnly.items[0].status).toBe('same');
  });

  it('verifies equal-size files by SHA-256 when hash policy is selected', async () => {
    const base = service.compare([file('a.txt', 'left')], [file('a.txt', 'right')], { policy: 'hash' });
    const api = {
      hashFile: async (path: string) => path.includes('/left/') ? 'aaa' : 'bbb',
      readFileRange: async () => ({ path: '', content: '', encoding: 'base64', size: 0 }),
    };
    const verified = await service.verify(api as any, base, 'hash');
    expect(verified.items[0].status).toBe('hash-different');
    expect(verified.summary.hashDifferent).toBe(1);
  });

  it('compares content in bounded ranges instead of loading complete files', async () => {
    const size = 300 * 1024;
    const base = service.compare(
      [file('a.bin', 'left', { size })],
      [file('a.bin', 'right', { size })],
      { policy: 'content' },
    );
    const calls: Array<[string, number, number]> = [];
    const api = {
      hashFile: async () => '',
      readFileRange: async (path: string, offset: number, length: number) => {
        calls.push([path, offset, length]);
        return { path, content: offset === 0 ? 'same' : (path.includes('/left/') ? 'left' : 'right'), encoding: 'base64', size };
      },
    };
    const verified = await service.verify(api as any, base, 'content');
    expect(verified.items[0].status).toBe('content-different');
    expect(calls.some(([, offset]) => offset > 0)).toBe(true);
  });

});
`````

`````typescript
import { Injectable } from '@angular/core';
import { FileInfo, FileType } from '../shared/protocol';
import type { ApiService } from './api.service';

export type PaneComparisonPolicy = 'size' | 'date' | 'size-date' | 'hash' | 'content';

export type PaneComparisonStatus =
  | 'only-left'
  | 'only-right'
  | 'left-newer'
  | 'right-newer'
  | 'size-different'
  | 'hash-different'
  | 'content-different'
  | 'type-different'
  | 'same';

export interface PaneComparisonItem {
  key: string;
  name: string;
  status: PaneComparisonStatus;
  left: FileInfo | null;
  right: FileInfo | null;
}

export interface PaneComparisonSummary {
  total: number;
  same: number;
  onlyLeft: number;
  onlyRight: number;
  leftNewer: number;
  rightNewer: number;
  sizeDifferent: number;
  hashDifferent: number;
  contentDifferent: number;
  typeDifferent: number;
  different: number;
}

export interface PaneComparisonResult {
  items: PaneComparisonItem[];
  summary: PaneComparisonSummary;
  policy: PaneComparisonPolicy;
}

export interface PaneComparisonOptions {
  caseSensitive?: boolean;
  modifiedToleranceSeconds?: number;
  policy?: PaneComparisonPolicy;
}

const DEFAULT_MODIFIED_TOLERANCE_SECONDS = 2;
const CONTENT_COMPARE_CHUNK_SIZE = 256 * 1024;

@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })
export class PaneComparisonService {
  compare(
    leftEntries: readonly FileInfo[],
    rightEntries: readonly FileInfo[],
    options: PaneComparisonOptions = {},
  ): PaneComparisonResult {
    const caseSensitive = options.caseSensitive ?? false;
    const tolerance = Math.max(0, options.modifiedToleranceSeconds ?? DEFAULT_MODIFIED_TOLERANCE_SECONDS);
    const policy = options.policy ?? 'size-date';
    const metadataPolicy = policy === 'hash' || policy === 'content' ? 'size' : policy;
    const left = this.index(leftEntries, caseSensitive);
    const right = this.index(rightEntries, caseSensitive);
    const keys = new Set([...left.keys(), ...right.keys()]);
    const items: PaneComparisonItem[] = [];

    for (const key of keys) {
      const leftEntry = left.get(key) ?? null;
      const rightEntry = right.get(key) ?? null;
      const entry = leftEntry ?? rightEntry;
      if (!entry) continue;

      items.push({
        key,
        name: entry.name,
        left: leftEntry,
        right: rightEntry,
        status: this.status(leftEntry, rightEntry, tolerance, metadataPolicy),
      });
    }

    items.sort((a, b) => a.name.localeCompare(b.name, undefined, { numeric: true, sensitivity: 'base' }));
    return this.fromItems(items, policy);
  }

  async verify(
    api: Pick<ApiService, 'hashFile' | 'readFileRange'>,
    result: PaneComparisonResult,
    policy: PaneComparisonPolicy = result.policy,
  ): Promise<PaneComparisonResult> {
    if (policy !== 'hash' && policy !== 'content') {
      return this.fromItems(result.items, policy);
    }

    const items = await Promise.all(result.items.map(async item => {
      if (!item.left || !item.right || item.left.type !== item.right.type) return { ...item };
      if (item.left.type === FileType.DIRECTORY) return { ...item, status: 'same' as PaneComparisonStatus };
      if (item.left.size !== item.right.size) return { ...item, status: 'size-different' as PaneComparisonStatus };

      if (policy === 'hash') {
        const [leftHash, rightHash] = await Promise.all([
          api.hashFile(item.left.path),
          api.hashFile(item.right.path),
        ]);
        return { ...item, status: leftHash === rightHash ? 'same' as const : 'hash-different' as const };
      }

      const same = await this.contentEqual(api, item.left.path, item.right.path, item.left.size);
      return { ...item, status: same ? 'same' as const : 'content-different' as const };
    }));

    return this.fromItems(items, policy);
  }

  fromItems(items: readonly PaneComparisonItem[], policy: PaneComparisonPolicy = 'size-date'): PaneComparisonResult {
    const normalized = [...items];
    const summary: PaneComparisonSummary = {
      total: normalized.length, same: 0, onlyLeft: 0, onlyRight: 0,
      leftNewer: 0, rightNewer: 0, sizeDifferent: 0, hashDifferent: 0,
      contentDifferent: 0, typeDifferent: 0, different: 0,
    };
    for (const item of normalized) {
      switch (item.status) {
        case 'same': summary.same++; break;
        case 'only-left': summary.onlyLeft++; break;
        case 'only-right': summary.onlyRight++; break;
        case 'left-newer': summary.leftNewer++; break;
        case 'right-newer': summary.rightNewer++; break;
        case 'size-different': summary.sizeDifferent++; break;
        case 'hash-different': summary.hashDifferent++; break;
        case 'content-different': summary.contentDifferent++; break;
        case 'type-different': summary.typeDifferent++; break;
      }
    }
    summary.different = summary.total - summary.same;
    return { items: normalized, summary, policy };
  }

  statusMaps(result: PaneComparisonResult): {
    readonly left: ReadonlyMap<string, PaneComparisonStatus>;
    readonly right: ReadonlyMap<string, PaneComparisonStatus>;
  } {
    const left = new Map<string, PaneComparisonStatus>();
    const right = new Map<string, PaneComparisonStatus>();

    for (const item of result.items) {
      if (item.left?.path) left.set(item.left.path, item.status);
      if (item.right?.path) right.set(item.right.path, item.status);
    }

    return { left, right };
  }

  leftDifferencePaths(result: PaneComparisonResult): string[] {
    return result.items.filter(item => item.left && item.status !== 'same' && item.status !== 'only-right').map(item => item.left!.path);
  }
  rightDifferencePaths(result: PaneComparisonResult): string[] {
    return result.items.filter(item => item.right && item.status !== 'same' && item.status !== 'only-left').map(item => item.right!.path);
  }
  missingOnRightPaths(result: PaneComparisonResult): string[] {
    return result.items.filter(item => item.status === 'only-left' && item.left).map(item => item.left!.path);
  }
  missingOnLeftPaths(result: PaneComparisonResult): string[] {
    return result.items.filter(item => item.status === 'only-right' && item.right).map(item => item.right!.path);
  }

  private index(entries: readonly FileInfo[], caseSensitive: boolean): Map<string, FileInfo> {
    const result = new Map<string, FileInfo>();
    for (const entry of entries ?? []) {
      if (!entry?.name || entry.path === '..') continue;
      const key = caseSensitive ? entry.name : entry.name.toLocaleLowerCase();
      if (!result.has(key)) result.set(key, entry);
    }
    return result;
  }

  private status(left: FileInfo | null, right: FileInfo | null, tolerance: number, policy: 'size' | 'date' | 'size-date'): PaneComparisonStatus {
    if (!left) return 'only-right';
    if (!right) return 'only-left';
    if (left.type !== right.type) return 'type-different';
    if (left.type === FileType.DIRECTORY && right.type === FileType.DIRECTORY) return 'same';

    if ((policy === 'size' || policy === 'size-date') && left.size !== right.size) return 'size-different';
    if (policy === 'size') return 'same';

    const delta = (left.modified || 0) - (right.modified || 0);
    if (Math.abs(delta) <= tolerance) return 'same';
    return delta > 0 ? 'left-newer' : 'right-newer';
  }

  private async contentEqual(
    api: Pick<ApiService, 'readFileRange'>,
    leftPath: string,
    rightPath: string,
    size: number,
  ): Promise<boolean> {
    for (let offset = 0; offset < size; offset += CONTENT_COMPARE_CHUNK_SIZE) {
      const length = Math.min(CONTENT_COMPARE_CHUNK_SIZE, size - offset);
      const [left, right] = await Promise.all([
        api.readFileRange(leftPath, offset, length),
        api.readFileRange(rightPath, offset, length),
      ]);
      if (left.content !== right.content) return false;
    }
    return true;
  }
}
`````

`````typescript
      id: first.id,
      name: 'Source ↔ Archive',
      roots: { left: 'C:/src', right: 'E:/archive' },
      modes: first.modes,
    });

    expect(updated.id).toBe(first.id);
    expect(service.listPresets().map(item => item.name))
      .toEqual(['Source ↔ Archive']);

    service.deletePreset(first.id);
    expect(service.listPresets()).toEqual([]);
  });
`````
