## File: manager/frontend/src/app/services/pane-intelligence.service.ts
`````typescript
import { Injectable } from '@angular/core';

export interface PaneIntelligenceModes {
  readonly linkedNavigation: boolean;
  readonly mirrorPresentation: boolean;
  readonly mirrorFilter: boolean;
  readonly syncScroll: boolean;
  readonly followSelection: boolean;
}

export interface PanePairRoots {
  readonly left: string;
  readonly right: string;
}

export interface WorkspacePaneIntelligence
  extends PaneIntelligenceModes {
  readonly roots: PanePairRoots | null;
  readonly updatedAt: number;
}

export interface PanePairPreset {
  readonly id: string;
  readonly name: string;
  readonly roots: PanePairRoots;
  readonly modes: PaneIntelligenceModes;
  readonly createdAt: number;
  readonly updatedAt: number;
}

interface PersistedPaneIntelligence {
  version: 1;
  workspaces: Record<string, WorkspacePaneIntelligence>;
  presets: PanePairPreset[];
}

const STORAGE_KEY = 'pane-intelligence-v1';

const DEFAULT_MODES: PaneIntelligenceModes = {
  linkedNavigation: false,
  mirrorPresentation: false,
  mirrorFilter: false,
  syncScroll: false,
  followSelection: false,
};

@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })
export class PaneIntelligenceService {
  loadWorkspace(workspaceId: string): WorkspacePaneIntelligence {
    const stored = this.read();
    const value = stored.workspaces[workspaceId];

    if (!value) {
      return {
        ...DEFAULT_MODES,
        roots: null,
        updatedAt: 0,
      };
    }

    return this.normalizeWorkspaceState(value);
  }

  saveWorkspace(
    workspaceId: string,
    state: Omit<WorkspacePaneIntelligence, 'updatedAt'>,
  ): void {
    if (!workspaceId) return;

    const stored = this.read();
    stored.workspaces[workspaceId] = {
      ...this.normalizeWorkspaceState(state),
      updatedAt: Date.now(),
    };
    this.write(stored);
  }

  removeWorkspace(workspaceId: string): void {
    const stored = this.read();
    if (!(workspaceId in stored.workspaces)) return;
    delete stored.workspaces[workspaceId];
    this.write(stored);
  }

  listPresets(): readonly PanePairPreset[] {
    return this.read().presets
      .slice()
      .sort((a, b) => a.name.localeCompare(b.name, undefined, {
        numeric: true,
        sensitivity: 'base',
      }));
  }

  savePreset(input: {
    id?: string;
    name: string;
    roots: PanePairRoots;
    modes: PaneIntelligenceModes;
  }): PanePairPreset {
    const name = input.name.trim();
    if (!name) throw new Error('Preset name is required.');
    if (!input.roots.left || !input.roots.right) {
      throw new Error('Both pane roots are required.');
    }

    const stored = this.read();
    const now = Date.now();
    const existing = input.id
      ? stored.presets.find(item => item.id === input.id)
      : stored.presets.find(item =>
          item.name.localeCompare(name, undefined, { sensitivity: 'base' }) === 0
        );

    const preset: PanePairPreset = {
      id: existing?.id ?? this.generateId(),
      name,
      roots: {
        left: input.roots.left,
        right: input.roots.right,
      },
      modes: this.normalizeModes(input.modes),
      createdAt: existing?.createdAt ?? now,
      updatedAt: now,
    };

    stored.presets = [
      ...stored.presets.filter(item => item.id !== preset.id),
      preset,
    ];
    this.write(stored);
    return preset;
  }

  deletePreset(id: string): void {
    const stored = this.read();
    const next = stored.presets.filter(item => item.id !== id);
    if (next.length === stored.presets.length) return;
    stored.presets = next;
    this.write(stored);
  }

  preset(id: string): PanePairPreset | null {
    return this.read().presets.find(item => item.id === id) ?? null;
  }

  private read(): PersistedPaneIntelligence {
    try {
      const raw = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
      if (!raw) return this.empty();

      const parsed = JSON.parse(raw) as Partial<PersistedPaneIntelligence>;
      const presets = Array.isArray(parsed.presets)
        ? parsed.presets
            .filter((item): item is PanePairPreset =>
              !!item &&
              typeof item === 'object' &&
              typeof (item as PanePairPreset).id === 'string' &&
              typeof (item as PanePairPreset).name === 'string'
            )
            .map(item => ({
              ...item,
              roots: {
                left: item.roots?.left ?? '',
                right: item.roots?.right ?? '',
              },
              modes: this.normalizeModes(item.modes),
            }))
        : [];

      return {
        version: 1,
        workspaces:
          parsed.workspaces && typeof parsed.workspaces === 'object'
            ? parsed.workspaces as Record<string, WorkspacePaneIntelligence>
            : {},
        presets,
      };
    } catch {
      return this.empty();
    }
  }

  private write(value: PersistedPaneIntelligence): void {
    try {
      localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(value));
    } catch {
      // Storage failure must never break file-manager interaction.
    }
  }

  private normalizeWorkspaceState(
    value: Partial<WorkspacePaneIntelligence>,
  ): WorkspacePaneIntelligence {
    const modes = this.normalizeModes(value);
    const roots =
      value.roots?.left && value.roots?.right
        ? { left: value.roots.left, right: value.roots.right }
        : null;

    return {
      ...modes,
      roots,
      updatedAt:
        typeof value.updatedAt === 'number' && Number.isFinite(value.updatedAt)
          ? value.updatedAt
          : 0,
    };
  }

  private normalizeModes(
    value: Partial<PaneIntelligenceModes> | null | undefined,
  ): PaneIntelligenceModes {
    return {
      linkedNavigation: !!value?.linkedNavigation,
      mirrorPresentation: !!value?.mirrorPresentation,
      mirrorFilter: !!value?.mirrorPresentation && !!value?.mirrorFilter,
      syncScroll: !!value?.syncScroll,
      followSelection: !!value?.followSelection,
    };
  }

  private empty(): PersistedPaneIntelligence {
    return {
      version: 1,
      workspaces: {},
      presets: [],
    };
  }

  private generateId(): string {
    return `pane-pair-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(16).slice(2)}`;
  }
}
`````

`````typescript
import { Injectable } from '@angular/core';
import type { ApiService } from './api.service';
import { FileType } from '../shared/protocol';
import type { FileInfo } from '../shared/protocol';
import { PaneComparisonService, type PaneComparisonItem, type PaneComparisonResult } from './pane-comparison.service';

export interface RecursivePaneComparisonOptions {
  showHidden?: boolean;
  maxDepth?: number;
  maxItems?: number;
}

export interface RecursivePaneComparisonResult {
  comparison: PaneComparisonResult;
  directoriesScanned: number;
  truncated: boolean;
  warnings: string[];
}

@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })
export class PaneRecursiveComparisonService {
  constructor(private readonly comparison: PaneComparisonService) {}

  async compare(
    api: ApiService,
    leftRoot: string,
    rightRoot: string,
    options: RecursivePaneComparisonOptions = {},
  ): Promise<RecursivePaneComparisonResult> {
    const maxDepth = Math.max(1, options.maxDepth ?? 64);
    const maxItems = Math.max(100, options.maxItems ?? 10000);
    const showHidden = options.showHidden ?? false;
    const items: PaneComparisonItem[] = [];
    const warnings: string[] = [];
    let directoriesScanned = 0;
    let truncated = false;

    const walk = async (leftDir: string, rightDir: string, relativeDir: string, depth: number): Promise<void> => {
      if (truncated || depth > maxDepth) {
        truncated = true;
        return;
      }

      let leftEntries: FileInfo[] = [];
      let rightEntries: FileInfo[] = [];
      try {
        [leftEntries, rightEntries] = await Promise.all([
          api.listDirectory(leftDir, showHidden).then(r => r.entries ?? []),
          api.listDirectory(rightDir, showHidden).then(r => r.entries ?? []),
        ]);
        directoriesScanned++;
      } catch (error) {
        warnings.push(`${relativeDir || '.'}: ${error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)}`);
        return;
      }

      const level = this.comparison.compare(leftEntries, rightEntries);
      for (const item of level.items) {
        if (item.name === '..' || item.left?.path === '..' || item.right?.path === '..') continue;
        const relativePath = relativeDir ? `${relativeDir}/${item.name}` : item.name;
        items.push({ ...item, key: relativePath.toLocaleLowerCase(), name: relativePath });
        if (items.length >= maxItems) {
          truncated = true;
          return;
        }

        const bothDirectories = item.left?.type === FileType.DIRECTORY && item.right?.type === FileType.DIRECTORY;
        const followsSymlink = !!item.left?.isSymlink || !!item.right?.isSymlink;
        if (bothDirectories && !followsSymlink) {
          await walk(item.left!.path, item.right!.path, relativePath, depth + 1);
          if (truncated) return;
        }
      }
    };

    await walk(leftRoot, rightRoot, '', 0);
    return {
      comparison: this.comparison.fromItems(items),
      directoriesScanned,
      truncated,
      warnings,
    };
  }
}
`````

`````typescript
import { Injectable } from '@angular/core';
import { createBehaviorSubject, type Stream } from '@epikodelabs/streamix';
import { ApiService } from './api.service';
import { FileType } from '../shared/protocol';
import {
  canonicalizeLocation,
  describeLocation,
  locationIdentity,
  locationLabel,
  type LocationKind,
} from './location-reference';

export interface LocationHistoryEntry {
  location: string;
  scheme: string;
  kind: LocationKind;
  timestamp: number;
  accessCount: number;
  paneId: string;
}

/** @deprecated Prefer LocationHistoryEntry. */
export type PathHistoryEntry = LocationHistoryEntry;

export interface PathSuggestion {
  path: string;
  displayName: string;
  matchType: 'history' | 'directory' | 'fuzzy';
  score: number;
  exists: boolean;
}

interface LegacyPathHistoryEntry {
  path?: string;
  location?: string;
  timestamp?: number;
  accessCount?: number;
  paneId?: string;
}

@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })
export class PathHistoryService {
  private readonly STORAGE_KEY = 'filemanager:path-history';
  private readonly MAX_HISTORY_ENTRIES = 100;

  private history = new Map<string, LocationHistoryEntry>();
  private historySubject = createBehaviorSubject<LocationHistoryEntry[]>([]);

  constructor(private apiService: ApiService) {
    this.loadHistory();
  }

  get history$(): Stream<LocationHistoryEntry[]> {
    return this.historySubject;
  }

  addLocation(location: string, paneId: string): void {
    const descriptor = describeLocation(location);
    if (!descriptor) return;

    const id = locationIdentity(descriptor.location);
    const existing = this.history.get(id);
    if (existing) {
      existing.timestamp = Date.now();
      existing.accessCount++;
      existing.paneId = paneId || existing.paneId;
    } else {
      this.history.set(id, {
        ...descriptor,
        timestamp: Date.now(),
        accessCount: 1,
        paneId,
      });
    }

    this.pruneHistory();
    this.saveHistory();
    this.emitHistory();
  }

  /** Compatibility alias while callers move from path to location terminology. */
  addPath(path: string, paneId: string): void {
    this.addLocation(path, paneId);
  }

  getRecentLocations(limit = 10): LocationHistoryEntry[] {
    return this.sortedHistory((a, b) => b.timestamp - a.timestamp).slice(0, limit);
  }

  getFrequentLocations(limit = 10, minimumAccessCount = 2): LocationHistoryEntry[] {
    return this.sortedHistory((a, b) =>
      b.accessCount - a.accessCount || b.timestamp - a.timestamp,
    ).filter(entry => entry.accessCount >= minimumAccessCount).slice(0, limit);
  }

  getRelatedLocations(location: string, limit = 10): LocationHistoryEntry[] {
    const descriptor = describeLocation(location);
    if (!descriptor || descriptor.scheme === 'filesystem') return [];
    const activeId = locationIdentity(descriptor.location);
    return this.getRecentLocations(this.MAX_HISTORY_ENTRIES)
      .filter(entry => entry.scheme === descriptor.scheme && locationIdentity(entry.location) !== activeId)
      .slice(0, limit);
  }

  async getSuggestions(query: string, currentPath: string): Promise<PathSuggestion[]> {
    if (!query || query.trim() === '') {
      return this.getRecentLocations(10).map(entry => this.toHistorySuggestion(entry));
    }

    const suggestions: PathSuggestion[] = [];
    suggestions.push(...this.getHistoryMatches(query));

    if (this.canUseDirectoryAutocomplete(query)) {
      suggestions.push(...await this.getDirectorySuggestions(query));
    }

    suggestions.push(...this.getFuzzyMatches(query));

    const uniqueLocations = new Set<string>();
    const uniqueSuggestions = suggestions.filter(suggestion => {
      const id = locationIdentity(suggestion.path);
      if (!id || uniqueLocations.has(id)) return false;
      uniqueLocations.add(id);
      return true;
    });

    uniqueSuggestions.sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score);
    return uniqueSuggestions.slice(0, 10);
  }

  private getHistoryMatches(query: string): PathSuggestion[] {
    const lowerQuery = query.toLowerCase();
    const matches: PathSuggestion[] = [];

    for (const entry of this.history.values()) {
      const lowerLocation = entry.location.toLowerCase();
      const lowerLabel = locationLabel(entry.location).toLowerCase();
      const prefix = lowerLocation.startsWith(lowerQuery) || lowerLabel.startsWith(lowerQuery);
      const contains = lowerLocation.includes(lowerQuery) || lowerLabel.includes(lowerQuery);
      if (!prefix && !contains) continue;

      matches.push({
        path: entry.location,
        displayName: locationLabel(entry.location),
        matchType: 'history',
        score: (prefix ? 100 : 80) + (entry.accessCount * (prefix ? 5 : 3)),
        exists: true,
      });
    }

    return matches;
  }

  private async getDirectorySuggestions(query: string): Promise<PathSuggestion[]> {
    try {
      const normalizedQuery = canonicalizeLocation(query);
      const lastSlash = normalizedQuery.lastIndexOf('/');
      if (lastSlash < 0) return [];

      const dirPath = normalizedQuery.substring(0, lastSlash + 1) || '/';
      const prefix = normalizedQuery.substring(lastSlash + 1);
      const listing = await this.apiService.listDirectory(dirPath, false);
      const suggestions: PathSuggestion[] = [];

      for (const entry of listing.entries) {
        if (entry.type !== FileType.DIRECTORY) continue;
        if (!entry.name.toLowerCase().startsWith(prefix.toLowerCase())) continue;
        const fullPath = canonicalizeLocation(`${dirPath}${entry.name}`);
        suggestions.push({
          path: fullPath,
          displayName: entry.name,
          matchType: 'directory',
          score: 90,
          exists: true,
        });
      }

      return suggestions;
    } catch {
      return [];
    }
  }

  private canUseDirectoryAutocomplete(query: string): boolean {
    const normalized = canonicalizeLocation(query);
    return (
      normalized.startsWith('/') ||
      normalized.startsWith('./') ||
      normalized.startsWith('../') ||
      /^filesystem:\/\/[a-z](?:\/.*)?$/i.test(normalized) ||
      normalized.startsWith('//')
    );
  }

  private getFuzzyMatches(query: string): PathSuggestion[] {
    const matches: PathSuggestion[] = [];
    const queryTokens = query.toLowerCase().split(/[\s\-_\/]/).filter(Boolean);
    if (queryTokens.length === 0) return matches;

    for (const entry of this.history.values()) {
      const searchable = `${locationLabel(entry.location)} ${entry.location}`.toLowerCase();
      const locationTokens = searchable.split(/[\s\-_\/]/).filter(Boolean);
      let matchCount = 0;

      for (const queryToken of queryTokens) {
        if (locationTokens.some(token => token.includes(queryToken))) matchCount++;
      }

      if (matchCount === 0) continue;
      const score = (matchCount / queryTokens.length) * 50 + (entry.accessCount * 2);
      if (score <= 20) continue;
      matches.push({
        path: entry.location,
        displayName: locationLabel(entry.location),
        matchType: 'fuzzy',
        score,
        exists: true,
      });
    }

    return matches;
  }

  private toHistorySuggestion(entry: LocationHistoryEntry): PathSuggestion {
    return {
      path: entry.location,
      displayName: locationLabel(entry.location),
      matchType: 'history',
      score: 50 + (entry.accessCount * 5),
      exists: true,
    };
  }

  private pruneHistory(): void {
    if (this.history.size <= this.MAX_HISTORY_ENTRIES) return;
    const entries = this.sortedHistory((a, b) => a.timestamp - b.timestamp);
    const toRemove = entries.slice(0, this.history.size - this.MAX_HISTORY_ENTRIES);
    for (const entry of toRemove) this.history.delete(locationIdentity(entry.location));
  }

  private loadHistory(): void {
    try {
      const stored = localStorage.getItem(this.STORAGE_KEY);
      if (!stored) return;
      const entries = JSON.parse(stored) as LegacyPathHistoryEntry[];
      for (const storedEntry of entries) {
        const rawLocation = storedEntry.location ?? storedEntry.path ?? '';
        const descriptor = describeLocation(rawLocation);
        if (!descriptor) continue;
        const id = locationIdentity(descriptor.location);
        const timestamp = Number(storedEntry.timestamp) || Date.now();
        const accessCount = Math.max(1, Number(storedEntry.accessCount) || 1);
        const paneId = storedEntry.paneId || 'left';
        const existing = this.history.get(id);

        if (existing) {
          if (timestamp >= existing.timestamp) {
            existing.timestamp = timestamp;
            existing.paneId = paneId;
          }
          existing.accessCount += accessCount;
        } else {
          this.history.set(id, { ...descriptor, timestamp, accessCount, paneId });
        }
      }
      this.pruneHistory();
      this.saveHistory(); // Persist the location-aware shape after legacy reads.
      this.emitHistory();
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Failed to load location history:', error);
    }
  }

  private saveHistory(): void {
    try {
      localStorage.setItem(this.STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(this.getRecentLocations(this.MAX_HISTORY_ENTRIES)));
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Failed to save location history:', error);
    }
  }

  private emitHistory(): void {
    this.historySubject.next(this.getRecentLocations(this.MAX_HISTORY_ENTRIES));
  }

  private sortedHistory(compare: (a: LocationHistoryEntry, b: LocationHistoryEntry) => number): LocationHistoryEntry[] {
    return Array.from(this.history.values()).sort(compare);
  }

  clearHistory(): void {
    this.history.clear();
    this.saveHistory();
    this.emitHistory();
  }

  getAllHistory(): LocationHistoryEntry[] {
    return this.getRecentLocations(this.MAX_HISTORY_ENTRIES);
  }

  removeLocation(location: string): void {
    const id = locationIdentity(location);
    if (!id) return;
    this.history.delete(id);
    this.saveHistory();
    this.emitHistory();
  }

  /** Compatibility alias while callers move from path to location terminology. */
  removePath(path: string): void {
    this.removeLocation(path);
  }
}
`````

`````typescript
import { LEGACY_PINNED_PATHS_KEY, PINNED_LOCATIONS_KEY } from '../components/address-bar.types';
import { PinnedLocationService } from './pinned-location.service';

describe('PinnedLocationService', () => {
  let service: PinnedLocationService;

  beforeEach(() => {
    localStorage.clear();
    service = new PinnedLocationService();
  });

  it('classifies searches as query locations', () => {
    const pin = service.create('search://?path=/src&pattern=TODO&contentSearch=true');
    expect(pin?.scheme).toBe('search');
    expect(pin?.kind).toBe('query');
    expect(pin?.location).toContain('pattern=TODO');
  });

  it('classifies ordinary paths as filesystem locations', () => {
    const pin = service.create('/home/user/projects');
    expect(pin?.scheme).toBe('filesystem');
    expect(pin?.kind).toBe('location');
  });

  it('migrates legacy pinned paths', () => {
    localStorage.setItem(LEGACY_PINNED_PATHS_KEY, JSON.stringify([{
      path: '/home/user/projects',
      label: 'Projects',
      icon: '📁',
      addedAt: 123,
    }]));

    const pins = service.load();
    expect((pins).length).toBe(1);
    expect(pins[0].label).toBe('Projects');
    expect(pins[0].location).toContain('/home/user/projects');
    expect(localStorage.getItem(PINNED_LOCATIONS_KEY)).toBeTruthy();
  });

  it('uses canonical identity for filesystem pins', () => {
    const pin = service.create('/home/user/projects');
    expect(pin).not.toBeNull();
    expect(service.isPinned([pin!], '/home/user/projects')).toBe(true);
  });

  it('persists semantic surface identity without storing runtime instances', () => {
    const pin = service.create('search://?path=/src&pattern=TODO', undefined, undefined, 123, 'search-results');
    expect(pin?.surfaceId).toBe('search-results');
    expect(pin?.id).toContain('|surface:search-results');

    service.save([pin!]);
    const [restored] = service.load();
    expect(restored.surfaceId).toBe('search-results');
    expect(restored.location).toBe(pin?.location);
  });

  it('allows the same durable location to be pinned for different surfaces', () => {
    const location = 'search://?path=/src&pattern=TODO';
    const dirPin = service.create(location, undefined, undefined, 1, 'dir')!;
    const resultsPin = service.create(location, undefined, undefined, 2, 'search-results')!;

    expect(dirPin.id).not.toBe(resultsPin.id);
    expect(service.isPinned([dirPin, resultsPin], location, 'dir')).toBe(true);
    expect(service.isPinned([dirPin, resultsPin], location, 'search-results')).toBe(true);
    expect(service.remove([dirPin, resultsPin], location, 'dir')).toEqual([resultsPin]);
  });

  it('infers surface identity from surface:// locations', () => {
    const pin = service.create('surface://console/session/main');
    expect(pin?.kind).toBe('surface');
    expect(pin?.surfaceId).toBe('console');
  });


  it('uses the dedicated search-results surface for search pins', () => {
    const pin = service.create('search://?path=/src&pattern=TODO');
    expect(pin?.surfaceId).toBe('search-results');
  });


  it('migrates search pins that were previously stored as dir surfaces', () => {
    localStorage.setItem(PINNED_LOCATIONS_KEY, JSON.stringify([{
      id: 'legacy-search', location: 'search://?path=/src&pattern=TODO', scheme: 'search', kind: 'query',
      surfaceId: 'dir', label: 'TODO', icon: '🔎', addedAt: 1,
    }]));

    expect(pin.surfaceId).toBe('search-results');

  });
`````

`````typescript
import { Injectable } from '@angular/core';
import {
  LEGACY_PINNED_PATHS_KEY,
  PINNED_LOCATIONS_KEY,
  PinnedLocation,
} from '../components/address-bar.types';
import {
  canonicalizeLocation,
  kindOfLocation,
  locationIcon,
  locationIdentity,
  locationLabel,
  schemeOfLocation,
} from './location-reference';

interface LegacyPinnedPath {
  path: string;
  label?: string;
  icon?: string;
  addedAt?: number;
}

@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })
export class PinnedLocationService {
  load(): PinnedLocation[] {
    const current = this.read<PinnedLocation[]>(PINNED_LOCATIONS_KEY);
    if (current) return current.map(pin => this.normalizeStoredPin(pin)).filter((pin): pin is PinnedLocation => !!pin);

    const legacy = this.read<LegacyPinnedPath[]>(LEGACY_PINNED_PATHS_KEY) ?? [];
    const migrated = legacy
      .map(pin => this.create(pin.path, pin.label, pin.icon, pin.addedAt))
      .filter((pin): pin is PinnedLocation => !!pin);

    if (migrated.length > 0) this.save(migrated);
    return migrated;
  }

  save(pins: readonly PinnedLocation[]): void {
    try {
      localStorage.setItem(PINNED_LOCATIONS_KEY, JSON.stringify(pins));
    } catch {
      // Pinning is a convenience feature; storage failures must not break navigation.
    }
  }

  create(
    location: string,
    label?: string,
    icon?: string,
    addedAt = Date.now(),
    surfaceId?: string,
  ): PinnedLocation | null {
    const canonical = this.canonicalize(location);
    if (!canonical) return null;
    const scheme = schemeOfLocation(canonical);
    const resolvedSurfaceId = this.resolveSurfaceId(canonical, surfaceId);
    return {
      id: this.identity(canonical, resolvedSurfaceId),
      location: canonical,
      scheme,
      kind: kindOfLocation(scheme),
      surfaceId: resolvedSurfaceId,
      label: label?.trim() || locationLabel(canonical),
      icon: icon?.trim() || locationIcon(scheme),
      addedAt,
    };
  }

  isPinned(pins: readonly PinnedLocation[], location: string, surfaceId?: string): boolean {
    const canonical = this.canonicalize(location);
    if (!canonical) return false;
    const id = this.identity(canonical, this.resolveSurfaceId(canonical, surfaceId));
    return pins.some(pin => pin.id === id);
  }

  remove(pins: readonly PinnedLocation[], location: string, surfaceId?: string): PinnedLocation[] {
    const canonical = this.canonicalize(location);
    if (!canonical) return [...pins];
    const id = this.identity(canonical, this.resolveSurfaceId(canonical, surfaceId));
    return pins.filter(pin => pin.id !== id);
  }

  schemeOf(location: string): string {
    return schemeOfLocation(location);
  }

  rename(pins: readonly PinnedLocation[], pinId: string, label: string): PinnedLocation[] {
    const nextLabel = label.trim();
    if (!nextLabel) return [...pins];
    return pins.map(pin => pin.id === pinId ? { ...pin, label: nextLabel } : pin);
  }

  contextLocation(location: string): string | null {
    const canonical = this.canonicalize(location);
    if (!canonical) return null;
    if (schemeOfLocation(canonical) !== 'search') return canonical;

    try {
      const query = canonical.slice('search://'.length);
      const params = new URLSearchParams(query.startsWith('?') ? query.slice(1) : query);
      const base = params.get('path')?.trim();
      return base ? this.canonicalize(base) : null;
    } catch {
      return null;
    }
  }

  private canonicalize(location: string): string {
    return canonicalizeLocation(location);
  }

  private normalizeStoredPin(pin: PinnedLocation): PinnedLocation | null {
    if (!pin || typeof pin.location !== 'string') return null;
    return this.create(
      pin.location,
      pin.label,
      pin.icon,
      Number(pin.addedAt) || Date.now(),
      typeof pin.surfaceId === 'string' && !(schemeOfLocation(pin.location) === 'search' && pin.surfaceId === 'dir')
        ? pin.surfaceId
        : undefined,
    );
  }


  private identity(location: string, surfaceId: string): string {
    return `${locationIdentity(location)}|surface:${surfaceId}`;
  }

  private resolveSurfaceId(location: string, surfaceId?: string): string {
    const explicit = surfaceId?.trim();
    if (explicit) return explicit;

    if (schemeOfLocation(location) === 'search') return 'search-results';
    if (kindOfLocation(location) !== 'surface') return 'dir';

    try {
      const parsed = new URL(location);
      const fromHost = parsed.hostname.trim();
      if (fromHost) return fromHost;
      const fromPath = parsed.pathname.split('/').filter(Boolean)[0]?.trim();
      if (fromPath) return fromPath;
    } catch {}

    return 'dir';
  }

  private read<T>(key: string): T | null {
    try {
      const raw = localStorage.getItem(key);
      return raw ? JSON.parse(raw) as T : null;
    } catch {
      return null;
    }
  }
}
`````

`````typescript
import type { PluginInstallationStateService } from './plugin-installation-state.service';

function coordinator(overrides: Partial<PluginLifecycleCoordinatorService> = {}): PluginLifecycleCoordinatorService {
  return {

    activateStartup: fn(async () => []),
    shutdown: fn(async () => []),

  } as unknown as PluginLifecycleCoordinatorService;

    } as unknown as PluginInstallationStateService;
  }

    const service = new PluginBootstrapService(lifecycle, installation());

    const [a, b] = await Promise.all([service.initialize(), service.initialize()]);

    expect(a.status).toBe('ready');
    expect(b.status).toBe('ready');
    expect(lifecycle.sync).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    expect(lifecycle.activateStartup).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
  });

        { pluginId: 'bad', activated: false, error: 'boom' },
      ]),

    expect(snapshot.status).toBe('degraded');
    expect(snapshot.errors).toEqual(['bad: boom']);
  });

    expect(result).toEqual(jasmine.objectContaining({ status: 'degraded' }));

  });

      shutdown: fn(async () => { order.push('shutdown'); return []; }),
    });
    const backend = {
      start: fn(async (selection: () => string[]) => { order.push(`backend:${selection().join(',')}`); }),
      stop: fn(() => { order.push('backend-stop'); }),
    };

    await service.shutdown();
`````

## File: manager/frontend/src/app/services/plugin-bootstrap.service.ts
`````typescript
import { Injectable, Optional } from '@angular/core';
import { createBehaviorSubject } from '@epikodelabs/streamix';
import {
  PluginLifecycleCoordinatorService,
  type ManagedPluginRuntimeSnapshot,
  type PluginActivationEventResult,
} from './plugin-lifecycle-coordinator.service';
import { BackendPluginCommandBridgeService } from './backend-plugin-command-bridge.service';
import { PluginInstallationStateService } from './plugin-installation-state.service';

export type PluginBootstrapStatus =
  | 'idle'
  | 'initializing'
  | 'ready'
  | 'degraded'
  | 'shutting-down'
  | 'stopped';

export interface PluginBootstrapSnapshot {
  status: PluginBootstrapStatus;
  runtimes: readonly ManagedPluginRuntimeSnapshot[];
  startupActivations: readonly PluginActivationEventResult[];
  errors: readonly string[];
}

const INITIAL_SNAPSHOT: PluginBootstrapSnapshot = {
  status: 'idle',
  runtimes: [],
  startupActivations: [],
  errors: [],
};

@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })
export class PluginBootstrapService {
  readonly state$ = createBehaviorSubject<PluginBootstrapSnapshot>(INITIAL_SNAPSHOT);

  private current: PluginBootstrapSnapshot = INITIAL_SNAPSHOT;
  private initializePromise: Promise<PluginBootstrapSnapshot> | null = null;
  private shutdownPromise: Promise<void> | null = null;

  constructor(
    private readonly lifecycle: PluginLifecycleCoordinatorService,
    private readonly installation: PluginInstallationStateService,
    @Optional() private readonly backendCommands?: BackendPluginCommandBridgeService,
  ) {}

  get snapshot(): PluginBootstrapSnapshot {
    return this.current;
  }

  /**
   * Discovers and reconciles plugins once, then activates packages that opted
   * into onStartup. Individual plugin activation failures degrade plugin
   * health but never prevent the file manager itself from starting.
   */
  initialize(selectionProvider: () => string[] = () => []): Promise<PluginBootstrapSnapshot> {
    if (this.current.status === 'ready' || this.current.status === 'degraded') {
      return Promise.resolve(this.current);
    }
    if (this.initializePromise) return this.initializePromise;

    this.publish({ ...INITIAL_SNAPSHOT, status: 'initializing' });
    this.initializePromise = this.runInitialize(selectionProvider).finally(() => {
      this.initializePromise = null;
    });
    return this.initializePromise;
  }

  /**
   * Application teardown is best-effort. We wait for an in-flight bootstrap
   * before deactivating so activation and cleanup cannot race each other.
   */
  shutdown(): Promise<void> {
    if (this.current.status === 'stopped') return Promise.resolve();
    if (this.shutdownPromise) return this.shutdownPromise;

    this.shutdownPromise = this.runShutdown().finally(() => {
      this.shutdownPromise = null;
    });
    return this.shutdownPromise;
  }

  bindSelectionProvider(selectionProvider: () => string[]): void {
    this.backendCommands?.setSelectionProvider(selectionProvider);
  }

  private async runInitialize(selectionProvider: () => string[]): Promise<PluginBootstrapSnapshot> {
    const bootstrapErrors: string[] = [];
    try {
      const relaunched = await this.installation.ensureStartupHostPrivilege();
      if (relaunched) {
        const snapshot: PluginBootstrapSnapshot = {
          status: 'initializing',
          runtimes: [],
          startupActivations: [],
          errors: [],
        };
        this.publish(snapshot);
        return snapshot;
      }
    } catch (error) {
      bootstrapErrors.push(`startup privilege: ${errorMessage(error)}`);
    }

    if (this.backendCommands) {
      try {
        await this.backendCommands.start(selectionProvider);
      } catch (error) {
        bootstrapErrors.push(`backend commands: ${errorMessage(error)}`);
      }
    }

    try {
      const runtimes = await this.lifecycle.sync();
      const startupActivations = await this.lifecycle.activateStartup();
      const errors = [
        ...bootstrapErrors,
        ...startupActivations
          .filter(result => !result.activated && result.error)
          .map(result => `${result.pluginId}: ${result.error}`),
      ];

      const status: PluginBootstrapStatus = errors.length ? 'degraded' : 'ready';
      const snapshot: PluginBootstrapSnapshot = {
        status,
        runtimes,
        startupActivations,
        errors,
      };
      this.publish(snapshot);
      return snapshot;
    } catch (error) {
      const message = errorMessage(error);
      const snapshot: PluginBootstrapSnapshot = {
        status: 'degraded',
        runtimes: [],
        startupActivations: [],
        errors: [...bootstrapErrors, message],
      };
      this.publish(snapshot);
      return snapshot;
    }
  }

  private async runShutdown(): Promise<void> {
    if (this.initializePromise) {
      await this.initializePromise.catch(() => undefined);
    }

    this.publish({ ...this.current, status: 'shutting-down' });
    let results: Awaited<ReturnType<PluginLifecycleCoordinatorService['shutdown']>> = [];
    try {
      results = await this.lifecycle.shutdown();
    } finally {
      this.backendCommands?.stop();
    }
    const shutdownErrors = results
      .filter(result => result.error)
      .map(result => `${result.pluginId}: ${result.error}`);

    this.publish({
      ...this.current,
      status: 'stopped',
      errors: [...this.current.errors, ...shutdownErrors],
    });
  }

  private publish(snapshot: PluginBootstrapSnapshot): void {
    this.current = snapshot;
    this.state$.next(snapshot);
  }
}

function errorMessage(error: unknown): string {
  return error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error);
}
`````

`````typescript
import { Injectable } from '@angular/core';
import type { PluginManifest } from '../plugin/plugin-manifest';

export type PluginPackageKind = 'directory' | 'archive';

export interface DiscoveredPluginPackage {
  manifest: PluginManifest;
  kind: PluginPackageKind;
  path: string;
  manifestPath: string;
  fingerprint: string;
  valid: boolean;
  errors: string[];
  warnings: string[];
}

interface PluginDiscoveryBindings {
  GetPluginDirectory(): Promise<string>;
  DiscoverPluginPackages(): Promise<unknown[]>;
}

function appBindings(): PluginDiscoveryBindings {
  const bindings = (window as any)?.go?.app?.App as PluginDiscoveryBindings | undefined;
  if (!bindings?.GetPluginDirectory || !bindings?.DiscoverPluginPackages) {
    throw new Error('Plugin discovery bindings are unavailable. Regenerate Wails bindings and restart the application.');
  }
  return bindings;
}

@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })
export class PluginDiscoveryService {
  getDirectory(): Promise<string> {
    return appBindings().GetPluginDirectory();
  }

  async discover(): Promise<DiscoveredPluginPackage[]> {
    const raw = await appBindings().DiscoverPluginPackages();
    return (raw ?? []).map(normalizeDiscoveredPluginPackage);
  }
}

export function normalizeDiscoveredPluginPackage(value: unknown): DiscoveredPluginPackage {
  const raw = (value ?? {}) as Record<string, unknown>;
  return {
    manifest: (raw['manifest'] ?? {}) as PluginManifest,
    kind: raw['kind'] === 'archive' ? 'archive' : 'directory',
    path: typeof raw['path'] === 'string' ? raw['path'] : '',
    manifestPath: typeof raw['manifestPath'] === 'string' ? raw['manifestPath'] : '',
    fingerprint: typeof raw['fingerprint'] === 'string' ? raw['fingerprint'] : '',
    valid: raw['valid'] === true,
    errors: stringArray(raw['errors']),
    warnings: stringArray(raw['warnings']),
  };
}

function stringArray(value: unknown): string[] {
  return Array.isArray(value) ? value.filter((item): item is string => typeof item === 'string') : [];
}
`````

`````typescript
import {

const discovered: DiscoveredPluginPackage = {
  manifest: {
    schemaVersion: 1,
    id: 'example',
    name: 'Example',
    version: '1.0.0',
    permissions: ['commands', 'network'],
  },
  path: '/plugins/example',
  manifestPath: '/plugins/example/plugin.json',
  valid: true,
  errors: [],
  warnings: [],
};

function state(overrides: Partial<PluginPackageState> = {}): PluginPackageState {
  return {
    pluginId: 'example', enabled: false, trusted: false, trustedVersion: undefined, grantedPermissions: [],
    quarantined: false, lastActivationStatus: 'never', updatedAt: 1, ...overrides,
  };
}

describe('plugin installation state', () => {
  it('keeps a newly discovered plugin disabled until explicitly enabled and permitted', () => {
    const managed = buildManagedPluginPackage(discovered, state());
    expect(managed.readyToActivate).toBe(false);
    expect(managed.missingPermissions).toEqual(['commands', 'network']);
  });

  it('allows explicitly granted permissions without global trust', () => {
    const managed = buildManagedPluginPackage(discovered, state({
      enabled: true,
      grantedPermissions: ['commands', 'network'],
    }));
    expect(managed.readyToActivate).toBe(true);
  });

  it('treats trusted packages as having their requested permissions', () => {
    const managed = buildManagedPluginPackage(discovered, state({ enabled: true, trusted: true, trustedVersion: '1.0.0' }));
    expect(managed.effectiveGrantedPermissions).toEqual(['commands', 'network']);
    expect(managed.readyToActivate).toBe(true);
  });

  it('keeps quarantined packages blocked even when trusted and enabled', () => {
    const managed = buildManagedPluginPackage(discovered, state({
      enabled: true, trusted: true, trustedVersion: '1.0.0', quarantined: true,
    }));
    expect(managed.readyToActivate).toBe(false);
  });

  it('requires trust review when the trusted version does not match the discovered package', () => {
    const managed = buildManagedPluginPackage(discovered, state({
      enabled: true, trusted: true, trustedVersion: '0.9.0',
    }));
    expect(managed.readyToActivate).toBe(false);
    expect(managed.missingPermissions).toEqual(['commands', 'network']);
  });

    expect(normalizePluginPackageState({ pluginId: 'x', enabled: true })).toEqual(jasmine.objectContaining({
      pluginId: 'x', enabled: true, trusted: false, trustedVersion: undefined, grantedPermissions: [],
      quarantined: false, lastActivationStatus: 'never',
    }));
  });
});
`````

## File: manager/frontend/src/app/services/plugin-installation-state.service.ts
`````typescript
import { Injectable } from '@angular/core';
import type { PluginManifest, PluginPermission } from '../plugin/plugin-manifest';
import {
  PluginDiscoveryService,
  type DiscoveredPluginPackage,
} from './plugin-discovery.service';

export type PluginActivationHealth = 'never' | 'success' | 'failed';

export interface PluginPackageState {
  pluginId: string;
  enabled: boolean;
  trusted: boolean;
  trustedVersion?: string;
  grantedPermissions: PluginPermission[];
  quarantined: boolean;
  quarantineReason?: string;
  lastActivationStatus: PluginActivationHealth;
  lastActivationError?: string;
  lastActivatedAt?: number;
  consecutiveActivationFailures: number;
  lastSeenVersion?: string;
  updatedAt: number;
}

export interface ManagedPluginPackage {
  discovered: DiscoveredPluginPackage;
  state: PluginPackageState;
  requestedPermissions: PluginPermission[];
  effectiveGrantedPermissions: PluginPermission[];
  missingPermissions: PluginPermission[];
  readyToActivate: boolean;
}

export interface PluginPackageStatePatch {
  enabled?: boolean;
  trusted?: boolean;
  grantedPermissions?: PluginPermission[];
  clearQuarantine?: boolean;
}

interface PluginStateBindings {
  GetPluginPackageStates(): Promise<unknown[]>;
  GetPluginPackageState(pluginId: string): Promise<unknown>;
  UpdatePluginPackageState(pluginId: string, patch: PluginPackageStatePatch): Promise<unknown>;
  EnsureUniversalPluginHostPrivilege(pluginId: string): Promise<boolean>;
  EnsureStartupPluginHostPrivilege?(): Promise<boolean>;
  QuarantinePluginPackage(pluginId: string, reason: string): Promise<unknown>;
  RecordPluginActivation(pluginId: string, success: boolean, activationError: string): Promise<unknown>;
}

function appBindings(): PluginStateBindings {
  const bindings = (window as any)?.go?.app?.App as PluginStateBindings | undefined;
  if (!bindings?.GetPluginPackageStates || !bindings?.UpdatePluginPackageState) {
    throw new Error('Plugin state bindings are unavailable. Regenerate Wails bindings and restart the application.');
  }
  return bindings;
}

@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })
export class PluginInstallationStateService {
  constructor(private readonly discovery: PluginDiscoveryService) {}

  async refresh(): Promise<ManagedPluginPackage[]> {
    const discovered = await this.discovery.discover();
    const states = (await appBindings().GetPluginPackageStates()).map(normalizePluginPackageState);
    const byId = new Map(states.map(state => [state.pluginId, state]));

    return discovered.map(pkg => {
      const state = byId.get(pkg.manifest.id) ?? defaultPluginPackageState(pkg.manifest.id, pkg.manifest.version);
      return buildManagedPluginPackage(pkg, state);
    });
  }

  async getState(pluginId: string): Promise<PluginPackageState> {
    return normalizePluginPackageState(await appBindings().GetPluginPackageState(pluginId));
  }

  async ensureStartupHostPrivilege(): Promise<boolean> {
    return !!(await appBindings().EnsureStartupPluginHostPrivilege?.());
  }

  async setEnabled(pluginId: string, enabled: boolean): Promise<PluginPackageState> {
    const state = await this.update(pluginId, { enabled });
    if (!enabled) return state;

    const bindings = appBindings();
    if (!bindings.EnsureUniversalPluginHostPrivilege) {
      await this.update(pluginId, { enabled: false });
      throw new Error(
        'Plugin privilege binding is unavailable. Regenerate Wails bindings and restart Manager.',
      );
    }

    try {
      await bindings.EnsureUniversalPluginHostPrivilege(pluginId);
      return state;
    } catch (error) {
      // Enabling is transactional with privilege acquisition. If UAC is
      // cancelled or relaunch fails, do not leave the plugin enabled.
      await this.update(pluginId, { enabled: false });
      throw error;
    }
  }

  async setTrusted(pluginId: string, trusted: boolean): Promise<PluginPackageState> {
    return this.update(pluginId, { trusted });
  }

  async setGrantedPermissions(pluginId: string, permissions: readonly PluginPermission[]): Promise<PluginPackageState> {
    return this.update(pluginId, { grantedPermissions: [...permissions] });
  }

  async clearQuarantine(pluginId: string): Promise<PluginPackageState> {
    return this.update(pluginId, { clearQuarantine: true });
  }

  async quarantine(pluginId: string, reason: string): Promise<PluginPackageState> {
    return normalizePluginPackageState(await appBindings().QuarantinePluginPackage(pluginId, reason));
  }

  async recordActivation(pluginId: string, success: boolean, error = ''): Promise<PluginPackageState> {
    return normalizePluginPackageState(await appBindings().RecordPluginActivation(pluginId, success, error));
  }

  private async update(pluginId: string, patch: PluginPackageStatePatch): Promise<PluginPackageState> {
    return normalizePluginPackageState(await appBindings().UpdatePluginPackageState(pluginId, patch));
  }
}

export function buildManagedPluginPackage(
  discovered: DiscoveredPluginPackage,
  state: PluginPackageState,
): ManagedPluginPackage {
  const requestedPermissions = [...(discovered.manifest.permissions ?? [])];
  const trustedForCurrentVersion = state.trusted && state.trustedVersion === discovered.manifest.version;
  const effectiveGrantedPermissions = trustedForCurrentVersion
    ? requestedPermissions
    : requestedPermissions.filter(permission => state.grantedPermissions.includes(permission));
  const granted = new Set(effectiveGrantedPermissions);
  const missingPermissions = requestedPermissions.filter(permission => !granted.has(permission));

  return {
    discovered,
    state,
    requestedPermissions,
    effectiveGrantedPermissions,
    missingPermissions,
    readyToActivate:
      discovered.valid &&
      state.enabled &&
      !state.quarantined &&
      missingPermissions.length === 0,
  };
}

export function normalizePluginPackageState(value: unknown): PluginPackageState {
  const raw = (value ?? {}) as Record<string, unknown>;
  return {
    pluginId: stringValue(raw['pluginId']),
    enabled: raw['enabled'] === true,
    trusted: raw['trusted'] === true,
    trustedVersion: optionalString(raw['trustedVersion']),
    grantedPermissions: stringArray(raw['grantedPermissions']) as PluginPermission[],
    quarantined: raw['quarantined'] === true,
    quarantineReason: optionalString(raw['quarantineReason']),
    lastActivationStatus: activationStatus(raw['lastActivationStatus']),
    lastActivationError: optionalString(raw['lastActivationError']),
    lastActivatedAt: optionalNumber(raw['lastActivatedAt']),
    consecutiveActivationFailures: numberValue(raw['consecutiveActivationFailures']),
    lastSeenVersion: optionalString(raw['lastSeenVersion']),
    updatedAt: numberValue(raw['updatedAt']),
  };
}

function defaultPluginPackageState(pluginId: string, version?: string): PluginPackageState {
  return {
    pluginId,
    enabled: false,
    trusted: false,
    trustedVersion: undefined,
    grantedPermissions: [],
    quarantined: false,
    lastActivationStatus: 'never',
    consecutiveActivationFailures: 0,
    lastSeenVersion: version,
    updatedAt: 0,
  };
}

function activationStatus(value: unknown): PluginActivationHealth {
  return value === 'success' || value === 'failed' ? value : 'never';
}
function stringValue(value: unknown): string { return typeof value === 'string' ? value : ''; }
function optionalString(value: unknown): string | undefined { return typeof value === 'string' && value ? value : undefined; }
function numberValue(value: unknown): number { return typeof value === 'number' && Number.isFinite(value) ? value : 0; }
function optionalNumber(value: unknown): number | undefined { return typeof value === 'number' && Number.isFinite(value) && value > 0 ? value : undefined; }
function stringArray(value: unknown): string[] { return Array.isArray(value) ? value.filter((item): item is string => typeof item === 'string') : []; }
`````

`````typescript
import { fn, spyOnFn, stubGlobal, restoreGlobals } from '../testing/jasmine-test-helpers';
import { PluginLifecycleCoordinatorService } from './plugin-lifecycle-coordinator.service';
import type { ManagedPluginPackage, PluginPackageState } from './plugin-installation-state.service';
import type { PluginRuntimeSnapshot } from './plugin-platform.service';

function state(overrides: Partial<PluginPackageState> = {}): PluginPackageState {
  return {
    pluginId: 'example',
    enabled: true,
    trusted: false,
    grantedPermissions: ['commands'],
    quarantined: false,
    lastActivationStatus: 'never',
    consecutiveActivationFailures: 0,
    updatedAt: 1,
    ...overrides,
  };
}

function managed(overrides: Partial<ManagedPluginPackage> = {}): ManagedPluginPackage {
  const base: ManagedPluginPackage = {
    discovered: {
      manifest: {
        schemaVersion: 1,
        id: 'example',
        name: 'Example',
        version: '1.0.0',
        permissions: ['commands'],
        activationEvents: ['onStartup'],
      },
      path: '/plugins/example',
      manifestPath: '/plugins/example/plugin.json',
      valid: true,
      errors: [],
      warnings: [],
    },
    state: state(),
    requestedPermissions: ['commands'],
    effectiveGrantedPermissions: ['commands'],
    missingPermissions: [],
    readyToActivate: true,
  };
  return { ...base, ...overrides };
}

function createPlatform(hasLoader = false) {
  const runtimes = new Map<string, PluginRuntimeSnapshot>();
  return {
    list: fn(() => Array.from(runtimes.values())),
    get: fn((id: string) => runtimes.get(id)),
    isInstalled: fn((id: string) => runtimes.has(id)),
    hasLoader: fn(() => hasLoader),
    installFromSource: fn(async (source: any, options: any) => {
      runtimes.set('example', {
        manifest: managed().discovered.manifest,
        state: 'installed',
        grantedPermissions: [...options.grantedPermissions],
        missingPermissions: [],
        source,
      });
    }),
    activate: fn(async (id: string) => {
      const runtime = runtimes.get(id);
      if (runtime) runtimes.set(id, { ...runtime, state: 'active' });
    }),
    deactivate: fn(async () => undefined),
    uninstall: fn(async (id: string) => { runtimes.delete(id); }),
  };
}

describe('PluginLifecycleCoordinatorService', () => {
  it('keeps policy-ready packages inert when no safe loader exists', async () => {
    const pkg = managed();
    const installation = { refresh: fn(async () => [pkg]) } as any;
    const platform = createPlatform(false);
    const coordinator = new PluginLifecycleCoordinatorService(installation, platform as any);

    const [snapshot] = await coordinator.sync();
    expect(snapshot.status).toBe('loader-unavailable');
    expect(platform.installFromSource).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('installs eligible packages without activating them during sync', async () => {
    const pkg = managed();
    const installation = { refresh: fn(async () => [pkg]) } as any;
    const platform = createPlatform(true);
    const coordinator = new PluginLifecycleCoordinatorService(installation, platform as any);

    const [snapshot] = await coordinator.sync();
    expect(snapshot.status).toBe('installed');
    expect(platform.installFromSource).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    expect(platform.activate).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('removes managed runtimes when persisted policy disables the plugin', async () => {
    const enabledPkg = managed();
    const disabledPkg = managed({
      state: state({ enabled: false }),
      readyToActivate: false,
    });
    let current = [enabledPkg];
    const installation = { refresh: fn(async () => current) } as any;
    const platform = createPlatform(true);
    const coordinator = new PluginLifecycleCoordinatorService(installation, platform as any);

    await coordinator.sync();
    current = [disabledPkg];

    expect(platform.uninstall).toHaveBeenCalledWith('example');

    await coordinator.activate('example');

    expect(installation.recordActivation).toHaveBeenCalledWith('example', true);
  });
});
`````

`````typescript
import { Injectable } from '@angular/core';
import type { PluginActivationEvent, PluginPermission } from '../plugin/plugin-manifest';
import type { PluginPackageSource } from '../plugin/plugin-package';
import {
  PluginInstallationStateService,
  type ManagedPluginPackage,
  type PluginPackageState,
} from './plugin-installation-state.service';
import { DirectoryPluginPackageLoaderService } from './directory-plugin-package-loader.service';
import { UniversalPluginPackageLoaderService } from './universal-plugin-package-loader.service';
import {
  PluginPlatformService,
  type PluginRuntimeSnapshot,
} from './plugin-platform.service';

const POLICY_SOURCE_OWNER = 'plugin-installation-state';

export type ManagedPluginRuntimeStatus =
  | 'invalid'
  | 'disabled'
  | 'quarantined'
  | 'permissions-required'
  | 'loader-unavailable'
  | 'installed'
  | 'active'
  | 'failed';

export interface ManagedPluginRuntimeSnapshot {
  plugin: ManagedPluginPackage;
  status: ManagedPluginRuntimeStatus;
  runtime?: PluginRuntimeSnapshot;
  reason?: string;
}

export interface PluginActivationEventResult {
  pluginId: string;
  activated: boolean;
  error?: string;
}

@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })
export class PluginLifecycleCoordinatorService {
  private managed = new Map<string, ManagedPluginPackage>();

  constructor(
    private readonly installation: PluginInstallationStateService,
    private readonly platform: PluginPlatformService,
    directoryLoader?: DirectoryPluginPackageLoaderService,
    archiveLoader?: UniversalPluginPackageLoaderService,
  ) {
    if (directoryLoader && !this.platform.hasLoader(directoryLoader.kind)) {
      this.platform.registerLoader(directoryLoader);
    }
    if (archiveLoader && !this.platform.hasLoader(archiveLoader.kind)) {
      this.platform.registerLoader(archiveLoader);
    }
  }

  /**
   * Reconciles disk discovery + persisted user policy with the executable
   * plugin platform. This method never broadens permissions and never activates
   * packages by itself.
   */
  async sync(): Promise<ManagedPluginRuntimeSnapshot[]> {
    const packages = await this.installation.refresh();
    this.managed = new Map(packages.map(pkg => [pkg.discovered.manifest.id, pkg]));

    await this.removeIneligibleManagedRuntimes();

    const snapshots: ManagedPluginRuntimeSnapshot[] = [];
    for (const pkg of packages) {
      snapshots.push(await this.reconcilePackage(pkg));
    }
    return snapshots;
  }

  async activate(pluginId: string): Promise<void> {
    const synced = await this.sync();
    const managed = this.mustGetManaged(pluginId);
    const status = synced.find(item => item.plugin.discovered.manifest.id === pluginId);
    if (!managed.readyToActivate) {
      throw new Error(status?.reason ?? `Plugin ${pluginId} is not eligible for activation.`);
    }
    if (!this.platform.isInstalled(pluginId)) {
      throw new Error(status?.reason ?? `Plugin ${pluginId} has no executable package loader.`);
    }

    try {
      await this.platform.activate(pluginId);
      await this.installation.recordActivation(pluginId, true);
    } catch (error) {
      const message = errorMessage(error);
      const state = await this.installation.recordActivation(pluginId, false, message);
      if (state.quarantined) {
        await this.removeRuntime(pluginId);
      }
      throw error;
    }
  }

  async deactivate(pluginId: string): Promise<void> {
    if (!this.platform.isInstalled(pluginId)) return;
    await this.platform.deactivate(pluginId);
  }

  async activateByEvent(event: PluginActivationEvent): Promise<PluginActivationEventResult[]> {
    await this.sync();
    const results: PluginActivationEventResult[] = [];

    for (const pkg of this.managed.values()) {
      if (!pkg.readyToActivate) continue;
      const events = pkg.discovered.manifest.activationEvents ?? ['onStartup'];
      if (!events.includes(event)) continue;
      if (!this.platform.isInstalled(pkg.discovered.manifest.id)) continue;

      try {
        await this.activate(pkg.discovered.manifest.id);
        results.push({ pluginId: pkg.discovered.manifest.id, activated: true });
      } catch (error) {
        results.push({
          pluginId: pkg.discovered.manifest.id,
          activated: false,
          error: errorMessage(error),
        });
      }
    }
    return results;
  }

  activateStartup(): Promise<PluginActivationEventResult[]> {
    return this.activateByEvent('onStartup');
  }

  /**
   * Best-effort lifecycle shutdown for application teardown. Every installed
   * plugin gets a chance to deactivate; one failing hook never blocks cleanup
   * of the remaining plugin scopes.
   */
  async shutdown(): Promise<readonly { pluginId: string; error?: string }[]> {
    const results: Array<{ pluginId: string; error?: string }> = [];
    const runtimes = [...this.platform.list()].reverse();

    for (const runtime of runtimes) {
      try {
        await this.platform.deactivate(runtime.manifest.id);
        results.push({ pluginId: runtime.manifest.id });
      } catch (error) {
        results.push({ pluginId: runtime.manifest.id, error: errorMessage(error) });
      }
    }

    return results;
  }

  async setEnabled(pluginId: string, enabled: boolean): Promise<PluginPackageState> {
    return this.installation.setEnabled(pluginId, enabled);
  }

  async setTrusted(pluginId: string, trusted: boolean): Promise<PluginPackageState> {
    const state = await this.installation.setTrusted(pluginId, trusted);
    await this.sync();
    return state;
  }

  async setGrantedPermissions(
    pluginId: string,
    permissions: readonly PluginPermission[],
  ): Promise<PluginPackageState> {
    return this.installation.setGrantedPermissions(pluginId, permissions);
  }

  async clearQuarantine(pluginId: string): Promise<PluginPackageState> {
    return this.installation.clearQuarantine(pluginId);
  }

  private async reconcilePackage(pkg: ManagedPluginPackage): Promise<ManagedPluginRuntimeSnapshot> {
    const id = pkg.discovered.manifest.id;

    if (!pkg.discovered.valid) {
      return { plugin: pkg, status: 'invalid', reason: pkg.discovered.errors.join(' ') || 'Invalid plugin package.' };
    }
    if (!pkg.state.enabled) {
      return { plugin: pkg, status: 'disabled', reason: 'Plugin is disabled.' };
    }
    if (pkg.state.quarantined) {
      return { plugin: pkg, status: 'quarantined', reason: pkg.state.quarantineReason || 'Plugin is quarantined.' };
    }
    if (pkg.missingPermissions.length) {
      return {
        plugin: pkg,
        status: 'permissions-required',
        reason: `Missing permissions: ${pkg.missingPermissions.join(', ')}.`,
      };
    }

    const source = this.sourceFor(pkg);
    let runtime = this.platform.get(id);
    const staleRuntime = runtime && (
      runtime.manifest.version !== pkg.discovered.manifest.version ||
      runtime.source?.uri !== source.uri ||
      runtime.source?.metadata?.['fingerprint'] !== source.metadata?.['fingerprint'] ||
      !samePermissions(runtime.grantedPermissions, pkg.effectiveGrantedPermissions)
    );

    if (staleRuntime) {
      await this.removeRuntime(id);
      runtime = undefined;
    }

    if (!runtime) {
      if (!this.platform.hasLoader(source.kind)) {
        return {
          plugin: pkg,
          status: 'loader-unavailable',
          reason: `No safe ${source.kind} plugin loader is registered.`,
        };
      }
      await this.platform.installFromSource(source, {
        trusted: false,
        grantedPermissions: pkg.effectiveGrantedPermissions,
        activate: false,
      });
      runtime = this.platform.get(id);
    }

    return {
      plugin: pkg,
      runtime,
      status: runtime?.state === 'active'
        ? 'active'
        : runtime?.state === 'failed'
          ? 'failed'
          : 'installed',
      reason: runtime?.error,
    };
  }

  private async removeIneligibleManagedRuntimes(): Promise<void> {
    for (const runtime of this.platform.list()) {
      if (runtime.source?.metadata?.['managedBy'] !== POLICY_SOURCE_OWNER) continue;
      const pkg = this.managed.get(runtime.manifest.id);
      if (!pkg || !pkg.readyToActivate) {
        await this.removeRuntime(runtime.manifest.id);
      }
    }
  }

  private async removeRuntime(pluginId: string): Promise<void> {
    if (!this.platform.isInstalled(pluginId)) return;
    await this.platform.uninstall(pluginId);
  }

  private sourceFor(pkg: ManagedPluginPackage): PluginPackageSource {
    return {
      kind: pkg.discovered.kind,
      uri: pkg.discovered.path,
      metadata: {
        managedBy: POLICY_SOURCE_OWNER,
        pluginId: pkg.discovered.manifest.id,
        manifestPath: pkg.discovered.manifestPath,
        version: pkg.discovered.manifest.version,
        fingerprint: pkg.discovered.fingerprint,
      },
    };
  }

  private mustGetManaged(pluginId: string): ManagedPluginPackage {
    const pkg = this.managed.get(pluginId);
    if (!pkg) throw new Error(`Plugin ${pluginId} is not a discovered package.`);
    return pkg;
  }
}

function samePermissions(a: readonly PluginPermission[], b: readonly PluginPermission[]): boolean {
  if (a.length !== b.length) return false;
  const left = new Set(a);
  return b.every(permission => left.has(permission));
}

function errorMessage(error: unknown): string {
  return error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error);
}
`````

`````typescript
import { fn, spyOnFn, stubGlobal, restoreGlobals } from '../testing/jasmine-test-helpers';
import { PluginPlatformService } from './plugin-platform.service';

  return {
    registerInput: fn(), unregisterInput: fn(),
    registerCommand: fn(), unregisterCommand: fn(),
    registerViewer: fn(), unregisterViewer: fn(),
    registerSurface: fn(), unregisterSurface: fn(),
    registerToolbarAction: fn(), unregisterToolbarAction: fn(),
    registerContextMenuItem: fn(), unregisterContextMenuItem: fn(),
    registerFileCategory: fn(), unregisterFileCategory: fn(),
  };
}

function pkg(activate = fn()): PluginPackage {
  return {
    manifest: {
      schemaVersion: 1,
      id: 'demo.tools',
      name: 'Demo Tools',
      version: '1.0.0',
      apiVersion: '^1.0.0',
      permissions: ['commands'],
    },
    activate,
  };
}

describe('PluginPlatformService', () => {
  it('installs and activates trusted packages', async () => {
    const activate = fn();
    const platform = new PluginPlatformService(registry() as any);
    await platform.install(pkg(activate), { trusted: true, activate: true });

    expect(activate).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    expect(platform.get('demo.tools')?.state).toBe('active');
  });

  it('refuses activation until requested permissions are granted', async () => {
    const platform = new PluginPlatformService(registry() as any);
    await platform.install(pkg());
    await expectAsync(platform.activate('demo.tools')).toBeRejectedWithError(/missing permissions/);
  });

  it('disposes all scoped contributions if activation fails', async () => {
    const target = registry();
    const platform = new PluginPlatformService(target as any);
    const broken = pkg(({ api }: any) => {
      api.registerCommand({ id: 'plugin.demo.run', title: 'Run', execute: () => undefined });
      throw new Error('boom');
    });
    await platform.install(broken, { trusted: true });

    await expectAsync(platform.activate('demo.tools')).toBeRejectedWithError(/boom/);
    expect(target.unregisterCommand).toHaveBeenCalledWith('plugin.demo.run');
    expect(platform.get('demo.tools')?.state).toBe('failed');
  });

  it('activates packages by declared activation event', async () => {
    const activate = fn();
    const p = pkg(activate);
    p.manifest = { ...p.manifest, activationEvents: ['onCommand:hash.sha256'] };
    const platform = new PluginPlatformService(registry() as any);
    await platform.install(p, { trusted: true });

    expect(await platform.activateByEvent('onStartup')).toEqual([]);
    expect(await platform.activateByEvent('onCommand:hash.sha256')).toEqual(['demo.tools']);
  });
});
`````

`````typescript
import { Injectable } from '@angular/core';
import { PluginManagerService } from './plugin-manager.service';
import {
  PLUGIN_API_VERSION,
  type PluginActivationEvent,
  type PluginManifest,
  type PluginPermission,
  validatePluginManifest,
} from '../plugin/plugin-manifest';
import type {
  PluginActivationContext,
  PluginPackage,
  PluginPackageLoader,
  PluginPackageSource,
} from '../plugin/plugin-package';
import { ScopedPluginRegistry } from '../plugin/scoped-plugin-registry';

export type PluginLifecycleState =
  | 'installed'
  | 'activating'
  | 'active'
  | 'deactivating'
  | 'inactive'
  | 'failed'
  | 'incompatible';

export interface PluginRuntimeSnapshot {
  manifest: PluginManifest;
  state: PluginLifecycleState;
  grantedPermissions: readonly PluginPermission[];
  missingPermissions: readonly PluginPermission[];
  error?: string;
  source?: PluginPackageSource;
}

export interface InstallPluginOptions {
  trusted?: boolean;
  grantedPermissions?: readonly PluginPermission[];
  source?: PluginPackageSource;
  activate?: boolean;
}

interface PluginRuntime {
  pkg: PluginPackage;
  state: PluginLifecycleState;
  granted: Set<PluginPermission>;
  scope?: ScopedPluginRegistry;
  context?: PluginActivationContext;
  error?: string;
  source?: PluginPackageSource;
}

@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })
export class PluginPlatformService {
  private readonly runtimes = new Map<string, PluginRuntime>();
  private readonly loaders = new Map<string, PluginPackageLoader>();

  constructor(private readonly contributions: PluginManagerService) {}

  async install(pkg: PluginPackage, options: InstallPluginOptions = {}): Promise<void> {
    const manifest = pkg.manifest;
    if (this.runtimes.has(manifest.id)) {
      throw new Error(`Plugin ${manifest.id} is already installed.`);
    }

    const validation = validatePluginManifest(manifest, PLUGIN_API_VERSION);
    const requested = new Set(manifest.permissions ?? []);
    const granted = options.trusted
      ? new Set(requested)
      : new Set(options.grantedPermissions ?? []);

    const runtime: PluginRuntime = {
      pkg,
      state: validation.valid ? 'installed' : 'incompatible',
      granted,
      source: options.source,
      error: validation.valid ? undefined : validation.errors.join(' '),
    };
    this.runtimes.set(manifest.id, runtime);

    if (!validation.valid) return;
    if (options.activate) await this.activate(manifest.id);
  }

  async uninstall(pluginId: string): Promise<void> {
    const runtime = this.mustGet(pluginId);
    if (runtime.state === 'active' || runtime.state === 'failed') {
      await this.deactivate(pluginId);
    }
    this.runtimes.delete(pluginId);
  }

  async activate(pluginId: string): Promise<void> {
    const runtime = this.mustGet(pluginId);
    if (runtime.state === 'active') return;
    if (runtime.state === 'incompatible') {
      throw new Error(runtime.error ?? `Plugin ${pluginId} is incompatible.`);
    }

    const missing = this.missingPermissions(runtime);
    if (missing.length) {
      throw new Error(`Plugin ${pluginId} is missing permissions: ${missing.join(', ')}.`);
    }

    runtime.state = 'activating';
    runtime.error = undefined;
    const scope = new ScopedPluginRegistry(pluginId, this.contributions, runtime.granted);
    const context: PluginActivationContext = {
      pluginId,
      manifest: runtime.pkg.manifest,
      api: scope,
      permissions: runtime.granted,
      host: { pluginApiVersion: PLUGIN_API_VERSION },
      hasPermission: permission => runtime.granted.has(permission),
    };
    runtime.scope = scope;
    runtime.context = context;

    try {
      await runtime.pkg.activate(context);
      runtime.state = 'active';
    } catch (error) {
      scope.dispose();
      runtime.scope = undefined;
      runtime.context = undefined;
      runtime.state = 'failed';
      runtime.error = error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error);
      throw error;
    }
  }

  async deactivate(pluginId: string): Promise<void> {
    const runtime = this.mustGet(pluginId);
    if (runtime.state !== 'active' && runtime.state !== 'failed') return;

    runtime.state = 'deactivating';
    let deactivateError: unknown;
    try {
      if (runtime.context) await runtime.pkg.deactivate?.(runtime.context);
    } catch (error) {
      deactivateError = error;
    } finally {
      runtime.scope?.dispose();
      runtime.scope = undefined;
      runtime.context = undefined;
      runtime.state = 'inactive';
    }

    if (deactivateError) throw deactivateError;
  }

  async activateByEvent(event: PluginActivationEvent): Promise<string[]> {
    const activated: string[] = [];
    for (const [id, runtime] of this.runtimes) {
      if (runtime.state !== 'installed' && runtime.state !== 'inactive') continue;
      const events = runtime.pkg.manifest.activationEvents ?? ['onStartup'];
      if (!events.includes(event)) continue;
      await this.activate(id);
      activated.push(id);
    }
    return activated;
  }

  setGrantedPermissions(pluginId: string, permissions: readonly PluginPermission[]): void {
    const runtime = this.mustGet(pluginId);
    if (runtime.state === 'active' || runtime.state === 'activating') {
      throw new Error(`Deactivate plugin ${pluginId} before changing permissions.`);
    }
    runtime.granted = new Set(permissions);
  }

  list(): PluginRuntimeSnapshot[] {
    return Array.from(this.runtimes.values()).map(runtime => this.snapshot(runtime));
  }

  get(pluginId: string): PluginRuntimeSnapshot | undefined {
    const runtime = this.runtimes.get(pluginId);
    return runtime ? this.snapshot(runtime) : undefined;
  }

  registerLoader(loader: PluginPackageLoader): void {
    if (this.loaders.has(loader.kind)) throw new Error(`Plugin loader ${loader.kind} is already registered.`);
    this.loaders.set(loader.kind, loader);
  }

  unregisterLoader(kind: string): void { this.loaders.delete(kind); }

  hasLoader(kind: string): boolean { return this.loaders.has(kind); }

  isInstalled(pluginId: string): boolean { return this.runtimes.has(pluginId); }

  async installFromSource(source: PluginPackageSource, options: Omit<InstallPluginOptions, 'source'> = {}): Promise<void> {
    const loader = this.loaders.get(source.kind);
    if (!loader) throw new Error(`No plugin package loader registered for ${source.kind}.`);
    const pkg = await loader.load(source);
    await this.install(pkg, { ...options, source });
  }

  private mustGet(pluginId: string): PluginRuntime {
    const runtime = this.runtimes.get(pluginId);
    if (!runtime) throw new Error(`Plugin ${pluginId} is not installed.`);
    return runtime;
  }

  private missingPermissions(runtime: PluginRuntime): PluginPermission[] {
    return (runtime.pkg.manifest.permissions ?? []).filter(permission => !runtime.granted.has(permission));
  }

  private snapshot(runtime: PluginRuntime): PluginRuntimeSnapshot {
    return {
      manifest: runtime.pkg.manifest,
      state: runtime.state,
      grantedPermissions: Array.from(runtime.granted),
      missingPermissions: this.missingPermissions(runtime),
      error: runtime.error,
      source: runtime.source,
    };
  }
}
`````

`````typescript
import { Injectable } from '@angular/core';
import { createBehaviorSubject } from '@epikodelabs/streamix';

import { ApiService } from './api.service';
import type { BatchItem, BatchResult } from '../shared/protocol-enhanced';

export type PowerTransferKind = 'copy' | 'move';
export type PowerTransferStatus =
  | 'queued'
  | 'running'
  | 'completed'
  | 'failed'
  | 'cancelled';

export interface PowerTransferJob {
  readonly id: string;
  readonly kind: PowerTransferKind;
  readonly items: readonly BatchItem[];
  readonly createdAt: number;
  readonly attempt: number;
  readonly status: PowerTransferStatus;
  readonly result?: BatchResult;
  readonly error?: string;
}

@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })
export class PowerFileOperationsService {
  private static readonly RECOVERY_KEY = 'file-manager.transfer-jobs.v1';

  private readonly jobs = new Map<string, PowerTransferJob>();
  private paused = false;
  private runningId: string | null = null;

  readonly jobs$ = createBehaviorSubject<readonly PowerTransferJob[]>([]);
  readonly paused$ = createBehaviorSubject<boolean>(false);
  private readonly waiters = new Map<
    string,
    Array<(job: PowerTransferJob) => void>
  >();

  constructor(private readonly api: ApiService) {
    this.restoreRecoverableJobs();
    void this.pump();
  }

  get isPaused(): boolean {
    return this.paused;
  }

  get pendingCount(): number {
    let count = 0;
    for (const job of this.jobs.values()) {
      if (job.status === 'queued') count += 1;
    }
    return count;
  }

  snapshot(): readonly PowerTransferJob[] {
    return [...this.jobs.values()]
      .sort((a, b) => a.createdAt - b.createdAt)
      .map(job => ({
        ...job,
        items: job.items.map(item => ({ ...item })),
      }));
  }

  enqueue(
    kind: PowerTransferKind,
    items: readonly BatchItem[],
  ): string {
    if (!items.length) throw new Error('Transfer queue requires at least one item.');

    const id =
      globalThis.crypto?.randomUUID?.() ??
      `transfer-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(16).slice(2)}`;

    this.jobs.set(id, {
      id,
      kind,
      items: items.map(item => ({ ...item })),
      createdAt: Date.now(),
      attempt: 1,
      status: 'queued',
    });

    this.emit();
    void this.pump();
    return id;
  }

  waitFor(id: string): Promise<PowerTransferJob> {
    const current = this.jobs.get(id);
    if (
      current &&
      (
        current.status === 'completed' ||
        current.status === 'failed' ||
        current.status === 'cancelled'
      )
    ) {
      return Promise.resolve({ ...current, items: current.items.map(item => ({ ...item })) });
    }

    return new Promise(resolve => {
      const waiters = this.waiters.get(id) ?? [];
      waiters.push(resolve);
      this.waiters.set(id, waiters);
    });
  }

  pauseQueue(): void {
    this.paused = true;
    this.paused$.next(true);
  }

  resumeQueue(): void {
    if (!this.paused) return;
    this.paused = false;
    this.paused$.next(false);
    void this.pump();
  }

  cancelQueued(id: string): boolean {
    const job = this.jobs.get(id);
    if (!job || job.status !== 'queued') return false;
    const cancelled = { ...job, status: 'cancelled' as const };
    this.jobs.set(id, cancelled);
    this.settle(cancelled);
    this.emit();
    return true;
  }

  retry(id: string): boolean {
    const job = this.jobs.get(id);
    if (!job || (job.status !== 'failed' && job.status !== 'cancelled')) {
      return false;
    }

    this.jobs.set(id, {
      ...job,
      status: 'queued',
      attempt: job.attempt + 1,
      result: undefined,
      error: undefined,
    });
    this.emit();
    void this.pump();
    return true;
  }

  dismiss(id: string): boolean {
    const job = this.jobs.get(id);
    if (!job || job.status === 'running' || job.status === 'queued') {
      return false;
    }
    this.jobs.delete(id);
    this.emit();
    return true;
  }

  private async pump(): Promise<void> {
    if (this.paused || this.runningId) return;

    const next = [...this.jobs.values()]
      .sort((a, b) => a.createdAt - b.createdAt)
      .find(job => job.status === 'queued');

    if (!next) return;

    this.runningId = next.id;
    this.jobs.set(next.id, { ...next, status: 'running' });
    this.emit();

    try {
      const result =
        next.kind === 'copy'
          ? await this.api.batchCopy([...next.items], true)
          : await this.api.batchMove([...next.items], true);

      const failed = result.failed > 0 || result.skipped > 0;
      const settled: PowerTransferJob = {
        ...next,
        status: failed ? 'failed' : 'completed',
        result,
        error: failed
          ? `${result.failed} failed · ${result.skipped} skipped`
          : undefined,
      };
      this.jobs.set(next.id, settled);
      this.settle(settled);
    } catch (error) {
      const settled: PowerTransferJob = {
        ...next,
        status: 'failed',
        error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error),
      };
      this.jobs.set(next.id, settled);
      this.settle(settled);
    } finally {
      this.runningId = null;
      this.emit();
      if (!this.paused) queueMicrotask(() => void this.pump());
    }
  }

  private settle(job: PowerTransferJob): void {
    const waiters = this.waiters.get(job.id);
    if (!waiters?.length) return;
    this.waiters.delete(job.id);
    const snapshot = {
      ...job,
      items: job.items.map(item => ({ ...item })),
    };
    for (const resolve of waiters) resolve(snapshot);
  }

  private emit(): void {
    this.persistRecoverableJobs();
    this.jobs$.next(this.snapshot());
  }

  private persistRecoverableJobs(): void {
    try {
      const recoverable = this.snapshot()
        .filter(job =>
          job.status === 'queued' ||
          job.status === 'running' ||
          job.status === 'failed'
        )
        .map(job => ({
          ...job,
          // A process crash cannot prove a running operation completed.
          // Recover it as failed so retry remains an explicit user action.
          status: job.status === 'running' ? 'failed' : job.status,
          error: job.status === 'running'
            ? 'Application restarted while this job was running.'
            : job.error,
        }));
      localStorage.setItem(
        PowerFileOperationsService.RECOVERY_KEY,
        JSON.stringify({ version: 1, jobs: recoverable }),
      );
    } catch {
      // Recovery persistence must never stall file operations.
    }
  }

  private restoreRecoverableJobs(): void {
    try {
      const raw = localStorage.getItem(PowerFileOperationsService.RECOVERY_KEY);
      if (!raw) return;
      const parsed = JSON.parse(raw) as {
        version?: number;
        jobs?: PowerTransferJob[];
      };
      if (parsed.version !== 1 || !Array.isArray(parsed.jobs)) return;

      for (const job of parsed.jobs) {
        if (!job?.id || !Array.isArray(job.items)) continue;
        this.jobs.set(job.id, {
          ...job,
          items: job.items.map(item => ({ ...item })),
          status: job.status === 'running' ? 'failed' : job.status,
          error: job.status === 'running'
            ? 'Application restarted while this job was running.'
            : job.error,
        });
      }
      this.jobs$.next(this.snapshot());
    } catch {
      // Ignore corrupt recovery data.
    }
  }
}
`````
