`````typescript
import { Injectable } from '@angular/core';

import type { FileInfo } from '../shared/protocol-enhanced';

export interface RecentFileRecord {
  readonly openedAt: number;
  readonly entry: FileInfo;
}

const STORAGE_KEY = 'reassembly.recentFiles.v1';
const MAX_RECENT_FILES = 100;

@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })
export class RecentFilesService {
  private records: RecentFileRecord[] | null = null;

  record(entry: FileInfo): void {
    if (!entry?.path || entry.path === '__parent__') return;
    const records = this.load();
    const key = this.key(entry.path);
    const next: RecentFileRecord[] = [
      { openedAt: Date.now(), entry: { ...entry } },
      ...records.filter(record => this.key(record.entry.path) !== key),
    ].slice(0, MAX_RECENT_FILES);

    this.records = next;
    this.persist();
  }

  recent(limit = 50): FileInfo[] {
    return this.recordsWithTimes(limit).map(record => ({ ...record.entry }));
  }

  recordsWithTimes(limit = 50): RecentFileRecord[] {
    return this.load()
      .slice(0, Math.max(0, limit))
      .map(record => ({
        openedAt: record.openedAt,
        entry: { ...record.entry },
      }));
  }

  search(query: string, limit = 50): FileInfo[] {
    const needle = query.trim().toLocaleLowerCase();
    return this.load()
      .filter(record =>
        !needle ||
        record.entry.name.toLocaleLowerCase().includes(needle) ||
        record.entry.path.toLocaleLowerCase().includes(needle)
      )
      .slice(0, Math.max(0, limit))
      .map(record => ({ ...record.entry }));
  }

  clear(): void {
    this.records = [];
    try { localStorage.removeItem(STORAGE_KEY); } catch { /* best effort */ }
  }

  private load(): RecentFileRecord[] {
    if (this.records) return this.records;
    try {
      const raw = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
      const parsed = raw ? JSON.parse(raw) as RecentFileRecord[] : [];
      this.records = (parsed ?? [])
        .filter(record => !!record?.entry?.path)
        .sort((a, b) => b.openedAt - a.openedAt)
        .slice(0, MAX_RECENT_FILES)
        .map(record => ({ openedAt: Number(record.openedAt) || 0, entry: { ...record.entry } }));
    } catch {
      this.records = [];
    }
    return this.records;
  }

  private persist(): void {
    try { localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(this.records ?? [])); } catch { /* best effort */ }
  }

  private key(path: string): string {
    return path.trim().replace(/\\/g, '/').toLocaleLowerCase();
  }
}
`````

`````typescript
import { Injectable } from '@angular/core';
import { FileInfo, FileType } from '../shared/protocol';
import { PARENT_ENTRY_PATH } from '../components/file-entry.component';

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   TYPES
───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

/** The VFS root the backend mounts the registry under. */
export const REGISTRY_ROOT = 'registry://';
export const REGISTRY_VFS_ROOT = '/registry';

/** Registry path separator (always forward slash in the VFS). */
const SEP = '/';

export interface RegistryFrame {
  /** Current public registry path, e.g. "registry://HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE/SOFTWARE/Microsoft" */
  path: string;
  entries: FileInfo[];
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   WAILS BRIDGE
───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

declare const window: any;

function app(): any {
  const a = window.go?.app?.App;
  if (!a) throw new Error('Wails bridge not available');
  return a;
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   PATH HELPERS
───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

function normalizeRegistryPath(path: string): string {
  const normalized = (path || '').trim().replace(/\\/g, '/');
  const match = /^registry:\/\/(.*)?$/i.exec(normalized);
  if (!match) return normalized;
  const rest = (match[1] || '').replace(/^\/+/, '').replace(/\/+/g, '/');
  return rest ? `${REGISTRY_ROOT}${rest}` : REGISTRY_ROOT;
}

export function registryToVfsPath(path: string): string {
  const normalized = normalizeRegistryPath(path);
  if (!isRegistryPath(normalized)) return normalized;
  const rest = normalized.slice(REGISTRY_ROOT.length).replace(/^\/+/, '');
  return rest ? `${REGISTRY_VFS_ROOT}/${rest}` : REGISTRY_VFS_ROOT;
}

export function registryFromVfsPath(path: string): string {
  const normalized = (path || '').trim().replace(/\\/g, '/');
  if (normalized === REGISTRY_VFS_ROOT) return REGISTRY_ROOT;
  if (normalized.startsWith(REGISTRY_VFS_ROOT + SEP)) {
    return `${REGISTRY_ROOT}${normalized.slice(REGISTRY_VFS_ROOT.length + 1)}`;
  }
  return normalizeRegistryPath(normalized);
}

/** True if the given public path is inside the registry root. */
export function isRegistryPath(path: string): boolean {
  const normalized = normalizeRegistryPath(path);
  return normalized === REGISTRY_ROOT || normalized.startsWith(REGISTRY_ROOT);
}

/**
 * Returns the display path shown in the pane breadcrumb.
 * Strips the "/registry" prefix so users see "HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE\…".
 */
export function registryDisplayPath(path: string): string {
  const normalized = normalizeRegistryPath(path);
  const rel = normalized.startsWith(REGISTRY_ROOT)
    ? normalized.slice(REGISTRY_ROOT.length)
    : normalized === REGISTRY_ROOT
    ? ''
    : normalized;
  return rel.replace(/\//g, '\\') || 'Registry';
}

/**
 * Builds a human-readable breadcrumb trail for a registry path.
 * e.g. ["Registry", "HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE", "SOFTWARE", "Microsoft"]
 */
export function registryBreadcrumbs(path: string): string[] {
  const normalized = normalizeRegistryPath(path);
  if (normalized === REGISTRY_ROOT) return ['Registry'];
  const rel = normalized.slice(REGISTRY_ROOT.length);
  return ['Registry', ...rel.split(SEP).filter(Boolean)];
}

/** Parent public path, or null if already at the registry root. */
export function registryParentPath(path: string): string | null {
  const normalized = normalizeRegistryPath(path);
  if (normalized === REGISTRY_ROOT) return null;
  const rel = normalized.slice(REGISTRY_ROOT.length);
  const idx = rel.lastIndexOf(SEP);
  if (idx < 0) return REGISTRY_ROOT;
  return `${REGISTRY_ROOT}${rel.slice(0, idx)}`;
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   ENTRY CONVERSION
───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

/**
 * Converts a raw VFSListDir entry for display in the file pane.
 * Keys appear as directories; values appear as files.
 */
function toFileInfo(raw: any): FileInfo {
  return {
    name:        raw.name,
    path:        registryFromVfsPath(raw.path),
    type:        raw.type as FileType,
    size:        raw.size ?? 0,
    modified:    raw.modified ?? 0,
    created:     raw.modified ?? 0,
    accessed:    raw.modified ?? 0,
    permissions: raw.type === FileType.DIRECTORY ? 'drwxr-xr-x' : '-r--r--r--',
    isHidden:    false,
    registryKind: raw.registryKind,
    registryValueType: raw.registryValueType,
    registryPreview: raw.registryPreview,
  };
}

/** Prepends the ".." parent row to a list of entries. */
function withParent(entries: FileInfo[], hasParent: boolean): FileInfo[] {
  if (!hasParent) return entries;
  const dotdot: FileInfo = {
    name:        '..',
    path:        PARENT_ENTRY_PATH,
    type:        FileType.DIRECTORY,
    size:        0,
    modified:    0,
    created:     0,
    accessed:    0,
    permissions: 'drwxr-xr-x',
    isHidden:    false,
  };
  return [dotdot, ...entries];
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   SERVICE
───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })
export class RegistryService {

  /* ─────────────── NAVIGATION ─────────────── */

  /** Load the registry root (list of hives). */
  async openRoot(): Promise<RegistryFrame> {
    return this.load(REGISTRY_ROOT);
  }

  /** Navigate into a subkey or stay at the frame root. */
  async navigateInto(path: string): Promise<RegistryFrame> {
    return this.load(path);
  }

  /** Navigate up one level; returns null if already at the registry root. */
  async navigateUp(current: RegistryFrame): Promise<RegistryFrame | null> {
    const parent = registryParentPath(current.path);
    if (!parent) return null;
    return this.load(parent);
  }

  /** Reload the current frame (after a write operation). */
  async refresh(frame: RegistryFrame): Promise<RegistryFrame> {
    return this.load(frame.path);
  }

  /* ─────────────── READ VALUE ─────────────── */

  /**
   * Reads the content of a registry value (a "file" in the VFS).
   * Returns the serialised string — the backend formats it based on value type:
   *   REG_SZ / REG_EXPAND_SZ  → the string
   *   REG_DWORD / REG_QWORD   → "4294967295 (0xFFFFFFFF)"
   *   REG_MULTI_SZ            → newline-separated strings
   *   REG_BINARY              → space-separated hex pairs
   */
  async readValue(path: string): Promise<string> {
    const result = await app().VFSReadFile(path, 'utf8');
    if (typeof result === 'string') return result;
    if (typeof result?.content === 'string') return result.content;
    return new TextDecoder().decode(result?.content ?? result ?? new Uint8Array());
  }

  /* ─────────────── WRITE OPERATIONS ─────────────── */

  /** Create a new subkey (like mkdir). */
  async createKey(parentPath: string, keyName: string): Promise<void> {
    const newPath = `${normalizeRegistryPath(parentPath)}${SEP}${keyName}`;
    await app().VFSMkdir(newPath);
  }

  /**
   * Set a REG_SZ value.  Creates or overwrites.
   * For other types, write the serialised form — the backend stores as REG_SZ.
   */
  async setValue(keyPath: string, valueName: string, data: string): Promise<void> {
    const valuePath = `${normalizeRegistryPath(keyPath)}${SEP}${valueName || '(default)'}`;
    await app().VFSWriteFile(valuePath, data);
  }

  /** Delete a key or value at the given VFS path. */
  async delete(path: string): Promise<void> {
    await app().VFSRemove(normalizeRegistryPath(path));
  }

  /** Rename is not supported by the registry; always rejects. */
  rename(_oldPath: string, _newName: string): Promise<void> {
    return Promise.reject(new Error('Registry keys and values cannot be renamed.'));
  }

  /* ─────────────── INTERNAL ─────────────── */

  private async load(path: string): Promise<RegistryFrame> {
    const currentPath = normalizeRegistryPath(path);
    const listing = await app().VFSListDir(currentPath);
    const hasParent = currentPath !== REGISTRY_ROOT;
    const entries = withParent(
      (listing?.entries ?? []).map(toFileInfo),
      hasParent,
    );
    return { path: currentPath, entries };
  }
}
`````

`````typescript
import { Injectable } from '@angular/core';
import type { PinnedLocation } from '../components/address-bar.types';
import { locationIdentity, schemeOfLocation } from './location-reference';
import { PinnedLocationService } from './pinned-location.service';
import type { RelatedLocationContext, RelatedLocationContribution } from './related-location.types';

@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })
export class RelatedLocationService {
  private readonly contributions = new Map<string, RelatedLocationContribution>();

  constructor(private readonly pins: PinnedLocationService) {
    this.register({
      id: 'builtin.saved-search-context',
      score: (candidate, context) => this.scoreSavedSearch(candidate, context),
    });
  }

  register(contribution: RelatedLocationContribution): void {
    this.contributions.set(contribution.id, contribution);
  }

  unregister(id: string): void {
    this.contributions.delete(id);
  }

  list(): readonly RelatedLocationContribution[] {
    return Array.from(this.contributions.values());
  }

  resolve(
    candidates: readonly PinnedLocation[],
    currentLocation: string,
    currentSurfaceId = 'dir',
  ): PinnedLocation[] {
    const context: RelatedLocationContext = {
      currentLocation,
      currentSurfaceId,
      contextLocation: this.pins.contextLocation(currentLocation),
    };
    if (!context.contextLocation) return [];

    return candidates
      .map((candidate, index) => ({
        candidate,
        index,
        score: this.scoreCandidate(candidate, context),
      }))
      .filter(entry => entry.score > 0)
      .sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score || b.candidate.addedAt - a.candidate.addedAt || a.index - b.index)
      .map(entry => entry.candidate);
  }

  private scoreCandidate(candidate: PinnedLocation, context: RelatedLocationContext): number {
    if (this.isCurrentPin(candidate, context)) return 0;

    let best = 0;
    for (const contribution of this.contributions.values()) {
      try {
        best = Math.max(best, Number(contribution.score(candidate, context)) || 0);
      } catch (error) {
        console.error(`Related-location contribution ${contribution.id} failed:`, error);
      }
    }
    return best;
  }

  private isCurrentPin(candidate: PinnedLocation, context: RelatedLocationContext): boolean {
    return candidate.surfaceId === context.currentSurfaceId
      && locationIdentity(candidate.location) === locationIdentity(context.currentLocation);
  }

  private scoreSavedSearch(candidate: PinnedLocation, context: RelatedLocationContext): number {
    if (candidate.scheme !== 'search' || !context.contextLocation) return 0;

    const candidateContext = this.pins.contextLocation(candidate.location);
    if (!candidateContext) return 0;

    const contextId = locationIdentity(context.contextLocation);
    const candidateId = locationIdentity(candidateContext);
    if (contextId && contextId === candidateId) return 1000;

    if (schemeOfLocation(context.contextLocation) !== 'filesystem' || schemeOfLocation(candidateContext) !== 'filesystem') {
      return 0;
    }

    const current = normalizeComparablePath(context.contextLocation);
    const saved = normalizeComparablePath(candidateContext);
    if (!current || !saved) return 0;

    if (saved.startsWith(`${current}/`)) return 760;
    if (current.startsWith(`${saved}/`)) return 700;
    return 0;
  }
}

function normalizeComparablePath(value: string): string {
  return value.replace(/\\/g, '/').replace(/\/+$/, '').toLowerCase();
}
`````

`````typescript
import { Injectable } from '@angular/core';
import { createBehaviorSubject } from '@epikodelabs/streamix';
import { contracts } from '../../../wailsjs/go/models';
import { ApiService } from './api.service';
import type { SourceCapabilities } from './source-capabilities';
import { ResilienceService, type SourceHealth } from './resilience.service';
import { normalizeProviderCapabilities, UNKNOWN_PROVIDER_CAPABILITIES, type ProviderCapabilities } from './provider-capabilities';

export type RemoteHierarchy = 'share-path' | 'path-backed';

export interface RemoteConnectionSnapshot {
  mounts: contracts.RemoteMount[];
  loading: boolean;
  error: string;
  refreshedAt: number;
}
const EMPTY: RemoteConnectionSnapshot = { mounts: [], loading: false, error: '', refreshedAt: 0 };

@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })
export class RemoteConnectionsService {
  readonly state$ = createBehaviorSubject<RemoteConnectionSnapshot>(EMPTY);
  private generation = 0;
  constructor(
    private readonly api: ApiService,
    private readonly resilience?: ResilienceService,
  ) {}

  get mounts(): contracts.RemoteMount[] { return this.state$.value.mounts; }

  async refresh(): Promise<contracts.RemoteMount[]> {
    const generation = ++this.generation;
    this.patch({ loading: true, error: '' });

    const load = async () => {
      if (this.resilience) {
        return this.resilience.execute(
          'remote:mount-list',
          () => this.api.remoteListConnections(),
          {
            policy: {
              maxAttempts: 3,
              initialDelayMs: 150,
              maxDelayMs: 1200,
              multiplier: 2,
              jitter: 0.15,
            },
          },
        );
      }
      return this.api.remoteListConnections();
    };

    try {
      const mounts = await load();
      if (generation !== this.generation) return this.mounts;
      const normalized = [...(mounts ?? [])].sort((a, b) =>
        this.label(a).localeCompare(this.label(b), undefined, {
          numeric: true,
          sensitivity: 'base',
        }),
      );
      this.state$.next({
        mounts: normalized,
        loading: false,
        error: '',
        refreshedAt: Date.now(),
      });
      return normalized;
    } catch (error) {
      if (generation !== this.generation) return this.mounts;

      // Do not erase a healthy pane merely because connection discovery failed.
      // Existing mounted roots remain visible and individually recoverable.
      this.patch({
        loading: false,
        error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error),
      });
      return this.mounts;
    }
  }

  async disconnect(mountOrPoint: contracts.RemoteMount|string): Promise<boolean> {
    const mountPoint=typeof mountOrPoint==='string'?mountOrPoint.trim():String(mountOrPoint.mountPoint??'').trim();
    if(!mountPoint)return false;
    try { await this.api.remoteDisconnect(mountPoint); await this.refresh(); return true; }
    catch(error){ this.patch({error:error instanceof Error?error.message:String(error)}); return false; }
  }

  findByUri(uri:string):contracts.RemoteMount|null{
    const needle=this.normalizeUri(uri); if(!needle)return null;
    return this.mounts.find(mount=>{
      const root=this.normalizeUri(mount.publicPath??'');
      return !!root&&(needle===root||needle.startsWith(root.endsWith('/')?root:root+'/'));
    })??null;
  }

  rootUri(mount:contracts.RemoteMount):string{return String(mount.publicPath??'').trim()}
  mountPoint(mount:contracts.RemoteMount):string{return String(mount.mountPoint??'').trim()}
  label(mount:contracts.RemoteMount):string{return String(mount.name||mount.publicPath||mount.host||'Remote')}
  protocol(mount:contracts.RemoteMount):string{return String(mount.protocol??'').trim().toLocaleLowerCase()}

  isRemoteUri(uri:string):boolean{
    const scheme=/^([a-z][a-z0-9+.-]*):\/\//i.exec((uri??'').trim())?.[1]?.toLowerCase();
    return scheme==='smb'||scheme==='s3'||scheme==='gdrive'||scheme==='dropbox'||scheme==='onedrive';
  }

  hierarchyFor(uri:string):RemoteHierarchy{
    const scheme=/^([a-z][a-z0-9+.-]*):\/\//i.exec((uri??'').trim())?.[1]?.toLowerCase();
    return scheme==='smb'?'share-path':'path-backed';
  }

  providerCapabilitiesFor(uri:string):ProviderCapabilities{const mount=this.findByUri(uri);if(!mount)return UNKNOWN_PROVIDER_CAPABILITIES;return normalizeProviderCapabilities((mount as contracts.RemoteMount&{capabilities?:Partial<ProviderCapabilities>}).capabilities)}

  capabilitiesFor(uri:string,base:SourceCapabilities):SourceCapabilities{const mount=this.findByUri(uri);if(!mount)return base;const provider=this.providerCapabilitiesFor(uri);if(mount.readOnly)return {read:base.read,create:false,delete:false,rename:false,trash:false};return {...base,rename:base.rename&&provider.rename,trash:base.trash&&provider.trash}}

  healthFor(uri: string): SourceHealth | null {
    const mount = this.findByUri(uri);
    if (!mount || !this.resilience) return null;
    return this.resilience.snapshot(this.healthKey(mount));
  }

  reportSuccess(uri: string): void {
    const mount = this.findByUri(uri);
    if (!mount || !this.resilience) return;
    this.resilience.markSuccess(this.healthKey(mount));
  }

  reportFailure(uri: string, error: unknown, terminal = false): void {
    const mount = this.findByUri(uri);
    if (!mount || !this.resilience) return;
    this.resilience.markFailure(this.healthKey(mount), error, terminal);
  }

  private healthKey(mount: contracts.RemoteMount): string {
    return `provider:${this.protocol(mount)}:${this.rootUri(mount).toLocaleLowerCase()}`;
  }

  private normalizeUri(value:string):string{return (value??'').trim().replace(/\/+$/,'').toLocaleLowerCase()}
  private patch(patch:Partial<RemoteConnectionSnapshot>):void{this.state$.next({...this.state$.value,...patch})}
}
`````

`````typescript
      'provider:s3:a',

      { policy: { maxAttempts: 1 } },
`````

`````typescript
import { Injectable } from '@angular/core';
import { createBehaviorSubject } from '@epikodelabs/streamix';

export type ResilienceState =
  | 'online'
  | 'degraded'
  | 'offline'
  | 'reconnecting';

export interface RetryPolicy {
  readonly maxAttempts: number;
  readonly initialDelayMs: number;
  readonly maxDelayMs: number;
  readonly multiplier: number;
  readonly jitter: number;
}

export interface SourceHealth {
  readonly key: string;
  readonly state: ResilienceState;
  readonly consecutiveFailures: number;
  readonly lastSuccessAt: number;
  readonly lastFailureAt: number;
  readonly lastError: string;
  readonly nextRetryAt: number;
}

const DEFAULT_RETRY: RetryPolicy = Object.freeze({
  maxAttempts: 3,
  initialDelayMs: 180,
  maxDelayMs: 2500,
  multiplier: 2,
  jitter: 0.2,
});

@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })
export class ResilienceService {
  private readonly health = new Map<string, SourceHealth>();

  readonly health$ = createBehaviorSubject<readonly SourceHealth[]>([]);

  snapshot(key: string): SourceHealth {
    return this.health.get(key) ?? {
      key,
      state: this.browserOffline() ? 'offline' : 'online',
      consecutiveFailures: 0,
      lastSuccessAt: 0,
      lastFailureAt: 0,
      lastError: '',
      nextRetryAt: 0,
    };
  }

  async execute<T>(
    key: string,
    operation: (signal: AbortSignal) => Promise<T>,
    options: {
      readonly signal?: AbortSignal;
      readonly policy?: Partial<RetryPolicy>;
      readonly retryable?: (error: unknown) => boolean;
    } = {},
  ): Promise<T> {
    const policy: RetryPolicy = {
      ...DEFAULT_RETRY,
      ...(options.policy ?? {}),
    };
    const retryable = options.retryable ?? (() => true);

    let lastError: unknown;
    for (let attempt = 1; attempt <= Math.max(1, policy.maxAttempts); attempt += 1) {
      this.throwIfAborted(options.signal);

      if (this.browserOffline()) {
        this.markFailure(key, new Error('Offline'), true);
        throw new Error('Offline');
      }

      if (attempt > 1) {
        this.patch(key, { state: 'reconnecting' });
      }

      const controller = new AbortController();
      const forwardAbort = () => controller.abort(options.signal?.reason);
      options.signal?.addEventListener('abort', forwardAbort, { once: true });

      try {
        const value = await operation(controller.signal);
        this.markSuccess(key);
        return value;
      } catch (error) {
        lastError = error;
        if (controller.signal.aborted || options.signal?.aborted) {
          throw error;
        }

        const shouldRetry = retryable(error) && attempt < policy.maxAttempts;
        this.markFailure(key, error, !shouldRetry);

        if (!shouldRetry) throw error;

        const delay = this.retryDelay(policy, attempt);
        this.patch(key, {
          state: 'degraded',
          nextRetryAt: Date.now() + delay,
        });
        await this.delay(delay, options.signal);
      } finally {
        options.signal?.removeEventListener('abort', forwardAbort);
      }
    }

    throw lastError;
  }

  markSuccess(key: string): void {
    this.health.set(key, {
      ...this.snapshot(key),
      state: 'online',
      consecutiveFailures: 0,
      lastSuccessAt: Date.now(),
      lastError: '',
      nextRetryAt: 0,
    });
    this.emit();
  }

  markFailure(key: string, error: unknown, terminal = false): void {
    const previous = this.snapshot(key);
    const failures = previous.consecutiveFailures + 1;
    this.health.set(key, {
      ...previous,
      state: terminal || this.browserOffline() ? 'offline' : 'degraded',
      consecutiveFailures: failures,
      lastFailureAt: Date.now(),
      lastError: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error),
    });
    this.emit();
  }

  clear(key: string): void {
    if (!this.health.delete(key)) return;
    this.emit();
  }

  private retryDelay(policy: RetryPolicy, attempt: number): number {
    const base = Math.min(
      policy.maxDelayMs,
      policy.initialDelayMs * Math.pow(policy.multiplier, Math.max(0, attempt - 1)),
    );
    const spread = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, policy.jitter));
    const jitter = 1 + (Math.random() * 2 - 1) * spread;
    return Math.max(0, Math.round(base * jitter));
  }

  private async delay(ms: number, signal?: AbortSignal): Promise<void> {
    if (ms <= 0) return;
    await new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => {
      const abort = () => {
        clearTimeout(handle);
        reject(new DOMException('Cancelled', 'AbortError'));
      };
      const handle = setTimeout(() => {
        signal?.removeEventListener('abort', abort);
        resolve();
      }, ms);
      signal?.addEventListener('abort', abort, { once: true });
    });
  }

  private throwIfAborted(signal?: AbortSignal): void {
    if (signal?.aborted) {
      throw new DOMException('Cancelled', 'AbortError');
    }
  }

  private browserOffline(): boolean {
    return typeof navigator !== 'undefined' && navigator.onLine === false;
  }

  private patch(key: string, patch: Partial<SourceHealth>): void {
    this.health.set(key, { ...this.snapshot(key), ...patch, key });
    this.emit();
  }

  private emit(): void {
    this.health$.next(
      [...this.health.values()].sort((a, b) => a.key.localeCompare(b.key)),
    );
  }
}
`````

`````typescript
import { ResultsPanelService } from './results-panel.service';
import { FileType } from '../shared/protocol';

function entry(path: string) {
  const name = path.split('/').pop() || path;
  return { name, path, type: FileType.FILE, size: 1, modified: 1, created: 1, accessed: 1, permissions: '', isHidden: false, isSymlink: false };
}

describe('ResultsPanelService producers', () => {
  beforeEach(() => sessionStorage.clear());

  it('creates search, recent, duplicate and plugin collections on one results scheme', () => {
    const service = new ResultsPanelService();
    const file = entry('/work/a.txt');

    const search = service.createSearch('Search: a', [file], '/work', 'a', true);
    const recent = service.createRecentFiles([file]);
    const duplicates = service.createDuplicateResults('/work', [file]);
    const plugin = service.createPluginCollection('demo', 'reports', 'Reports', [file]);

    expect([search.path, recent.path, duplicates.path, plugin.path].every(path => path.startsWith('results://'))).toBe(true);
    expect(search.metadata.kind).toBe('recursive-search');
    expect(recent.metadata.kind).toBe('recent-files');
    expect(duplicates.metadata.kind).toBe('duplicates');
    expect(plugin.metadata).toEqual(jasmine.objectContaining({ pluginId: 'demo', collectionId: 'reports', kind: 'plugin-collection' }));
  });

  it('removes all collections owned by one plugin only', () => {
    const service = new ResultsPanelService();
    const a = service.createPluginCollection('a', 'one', 'One', []);
    const b = service.createPluginCollection('b', 'two', 'Two', []);

    service.removePluginCollections('a');

    expect(service.get(a.path)).toBeNull();
    expect(service.get(b.path)).not.toBeNull();
  });
`````

`````typescript
import { Injectable } from '@angular/core';

import type { FileInfo } from '../shared/protocol-enhanced';
import {
  SearchResultIndex,
  type SearchResultSort,
  type SearchResultWindow,
} from './search-result-index';

export interface ResultsPanelMetadata {
  readonly resultCount?: number;
  readonly recoveredPartial?: boolean;
  readonly origin?: string;
  readonly rootPath?: string;
  readonly query?: string;
  readonly kind?: string;
  readonly pluginId?: string;
  readonly collectionId?: string;
  readonly refreshedAt?: string;
  readonly refreshWarnings?: string;
  readonly reclaimableBytes?: string;
  readonly duplicateGroups?: string;
  readonly searchStrategy?: 'auto' | 'live' | 'indexed';
  readonly minDuplicateSize?: string;
  readonly recursive?: boolean;
  readonly sort?: SearchResultSort;
  readonly estimatedResultCount?: number;
  readonly duplicateCandidateGroups?: number;
}

export interface ResultsPanelCreateOptions {
  readonly title: string;
  readonly entries: readonly FileInfo[];
  readonly metadata?: ResultsPanelMetadata;
}

export interface ResultsPanelDefinition {
  readonly id: string;
  readonly title: string;
  readonly path: string;
  readonly createdAt: number;
  readonly updatedAt?: number;
  readonly entries: readonly FileInfo[];
  readonly metadata: ResultsPanelMetadata;
  readonly pinned?: boolean;
}

export interface ResultsPanelRefreshResult {
  readonly entries: readonly FileInfo[];
  readonly metadata?: ResultsPanelMetadata;
  readonly title?: string;
}

export type ResultsPanelRefresher =
  () => Promise<ResultsPanelRefreshResult | readonly FileInfo[]>;

const STORAGE_KEY = 'reassembly.resultsPanels.v1';
const PINNED_STORAGE_KEY = 'reassembly.resultsPanels.pinned.v1';
const MAX_PANELS = 24;
const MAX_PERSISTED_ENTRIES_PER_PANEL = 2000;
const MAX_PERSISTED_TOTAL_ENTRIES = 8000;
const RECOVERY_KEY = 'reassembly.resultsPanels.recovery.v1';

function parseResultsId(path: string): string | null {
  const match = /^results:\/\/([^/?#]+)/i.exec((path ?? '').trim());
  return match?.[1] ? decodeURIComponent(match[1]) : null;
}

@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })
export class ResultsPanelService {
  private readonly panels = new Map<string, ResultsPanelDefinition>();
  private readonly refreshers = new Map<string, ResultsPanelRefresher>();
  private readonly indexes = new Map<string, SearchResultIndex>();
  private hydrated = false;

  create(
    title: string,
    entries: readonly FileInfo[],
    metadata: ResultsPanelMetadata = {},
  ): ResultsPanelDefinition {
    this.hydrate();

    const id =
      globalThis.crypto?.randomUUID?.() ??
      `${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(16).slice(2)}`;

    const path = `results://${encodeURIComponent(id)}`;
    const index = new SearchResultIndex();
    index.setSort(metadata.sort ?? 'relevance');
    index.append(entries, entries.length);

    const definition: ResultsPanelDefinition = {
      id,
      title: title.trim() || 'Results',
      path,
      createdAt: Date.now(),
      // Keep the public definition compatible. Runtime windowing uses the
      // chunked index below; persistence already truncates large collections.
      entries,
      metadata: {
        ...metadata,
        resultCount: metadata.resultCount ?? index.resultCount,
        duplicateCandidateGroups:
          metadata.duplicateCandidateGroups ??
          index.snapshot().duplicateCandidateGroups,
      },
    };

    this.panels.set(id, definition);
    this.indexes.set(id, index);
    this.trim();
    this.persist();
    return definition;
  }


  createSearch(
    title: string,
    entries: readonly FileInfo[],
    rootPath: string,
    query: string,
    recursive = false,
    strategy: 'auto' | 'live' | 'indexed' = 'auto',
  ): ResultsPanelDefinition {
    return this.create(title, entries, {
      origin: 'global-search',
      rootPath,
      query,
      kind: recursive ? 'recursive-search' : 'search',
      searchStrategy: strategy,
      recursive,
      resultCount: entries.length,
    });
  }

  createFromIndex(
    title: string,
    index: SearchResultIndex,
    metadata: ResultsPanelMetadata = {},
  ): ResultsPanelDefinition {
    const snapshot = index.snapshot();
    // Only a small preview is attached to the public/persisted definition.
    // The complete runtime population stays chunked in the index map.
    const preview = index.materialize(
      Math.min(MAX_PERSISTED_ENTRIES_PER_PANEL, snapshot.resultCount),
    );
    const definition = this.create(title, preview, {
      ...metadata,
      resultCount: snapshot.resultCount,
      estimatedResultCount: snapshot.resultCount,
      duplicateCandidateGroups: snapshot.duplicateCandidateGroups,
      sort: index.sort,
    });

    const id = parseResultsId(definition.path);
    if (id) this.indexes.set(id, index);
    return definition;
  }

  createRecentFiles(
    entries: readonly FileInfo[],
    title = 'Recent Files',
  ): ResultsPanelDefinition {
    return this.create(title, entries, {
      origin: 'recent-files',
      kind: 'recent-files',
    });
  }

  createDuplicateResults(
    rootPath: string,
    entries: readonly FileInfo[],
    title = 'Duplicate Results',
  ): ResultsPanelDefinition {
    return this.create(title, entries, {
      origin: 'duplicate-finder',
      rootPath,
      kind: 'duplicates',
    });
  }

  createPluginCollection(
    pluginId: string,
    collectionId: string,
    title: string,
    entries: readonly FileInfo[],
    metadata: ResultsPanelMetadata = {},
  ): ResultsPanelDefinition {
    const owner = pluginId.trim();
    const collection = collectionId.trim();
    if (!owner) throw new Error('Plugin collection requires a plugin id.');
    if (!collection) throw new Error('Plugin collection requires a collection id.');

    return this.create(title, entries, {
      ...metadata,
      origin: `plugin:${owner}`,
      kind: metadata.kind || 'plugin-collection',
      pluginId: owner,
      collectionId: collection,
    });
  }

  removePluginCollections(pluginId: string): void {
    this.hydrate();
    const owner = pluginId.trim();
    if (!owner) return;

    let changed = false;
    for (const [id, panel] of this.panels) {
      if (panel.metadata.pluginId !== owner) continue;
      this.panels.delete(id);
      this.refreshers.delete(id);
      this.indexes.delete(id);
      changed = true;
    }
    if (changed) this.persist();
  }

  get(path: string): ResultsPanelDefinition | null {
    this.hydrate();
    const id = parseResultsId(path);
    return id ? this.panels.get(id) ?? null : null;
  }

  async stream(
    path: string,
    options: {
      readonly batchSize?: number;
      readonly signal?: AbortSignal;
      readonly onBatch: (
        batch: readonly FileInfo[],
        loaded: number,
        total: number,
      ) => void;
    },
  ): Promise<number> {
    const panel = this.get(path);
    if (!panel) return 0;

    const index = this.ensureIndex(panel);
    const batchSize = Math.max(64, Math.min(2048, options.batchSize ?? 512));
    const total = index.resultCount;

    for (let start = 0; start < total; start += batchSize) {
      if (options.signal?.aborted) {
        throw new DOMException('Results stream cancelled.', 'AbortError');
      }

      const window = index.window(start, batchSize);
      options.onBatch(window.entries, start + window.entries.length, total);

      if (start + window.entries.length < total) {
        await this.nextFrame(options.signal);
      }
      if (!window.entries.length) break;
    }

    return total;
  }

  count(path: string): number {
    const panel = this.get(path);
    if (!panel) return 0;
    return Number(panel.metadata.resultCount ?? this.ensureIndex(panel).resultCount);
  }

  readWindow(
    path: string,
    offset: number,
    limit: number,
    options?: {
      readonly sort?: SearchResultSort;
      readonly filterText?: string;
    },
  ): SearchResultWindow {
    const panel = this.get(path);
    if (!panel) {
      return { offset: 0, limit: 0, totalCount: 0, sourceCount: 0, entries: [] };
    }

    const index = this.ensureIndex(panel);
    index.setSort(options?.sort ?? panel.metadata.sort ?? 'relevance');

    const filterText = options?.filterText?.trim().toLocaleLowerCase() ?? '';
    index.setFilter(filterText
      ? entry =>
          (entry.name ?? '').toLocaleLowerCase().includes(filterText) ||
          (entry.path ?? '').toLocaleLowerCase().includes(filterText)
      : null);

    return index.window(offset, limit);
  }

  backendSearchAlias(path: string): string | null {
    const panel = this.get(path);
    if (!panel) return null;

    const kind = panel.metadata.kind;
    if (kind !== 'search' && kind !== 'recursive-search') return null;

    const root = panel.metadata.rootPath?.trim() ?? '';
    const query = panel.metadata.query?.trim() ?? '';
    if (!root || !query) return null;

    const params = new URLSearchParams();
    params.set('path', root);
    params.set('pattern', query);
    params.set(
      'recursive',
      String(panel.metadata.recursive ?? kind === 'recursive-search'),
    );
    return `search://?${params.toString()}`;
  }

  private ensureIndex(panel: ResultsPanelDefinition): SearchResultIndex {
    let index = this.indexes.get(panel.id);
    if (index) return index;

    index = new SearchResultIndex();
    index.setSort(panel.metadata.sort ?? 'relevance');
    index.append(panel.entries, panel.entries.length);
    this.indexes.set(panel.id, index);
    return index;
  }

  private async nextFrame(signal?: AbortSignal): Promise<void> {
    if (signal?.aborted) {
      throw new DOMException('Results stream cancelled.', 'AbortError');
    }

    await new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => {
      let handle = 0;
      const abort = () => {
        if (handle && typeof cancelAnimationFrame === 'function') {
          cancelAnimationFrame(handle);
        }
        reject(new DOMException('Results stream cancelled.', 'AbortError'));
      };

      signal?.addEventListener('abort', abort, { once: true });

      if (typeof requestAnimationFrame === 'function') {
        handle = requestAnimationFrame(() => {
          signal?.removeEventListener('abort', abort);
          resolve();
        });
      } else {
        setTimeout(() => {
          signal?.removeEventListener('abort', abort);
          resolve();
        }, 0);
      }
    });

  has(path: string): boolean {
    return !!this.get(path);
  }

  title(path: string): string | null {
    return this.get(path)?.title ?? null;
  }

  remove(path: string): void {
    this.hydrate();
    const id = parseResultsId(path);
    if (!id) return;
    this.panels.delete(id);
    this.refreshers.delete(id);
    this.indexes.delete(id);
    this.persist();
  }

  update(
    path: string,
    update: {
      entries?: readonly FileInfo[];
      metadata?: ResultsPanelMetadata;
      title?: string;
    },
  ): ResultsPanelDefinition | null {
    this.hydrate();
    const id = parseResultsId(path);
    const current = id ? this.panels.get(id) : null;
    if (!id || !current) return null;

    const next: ResultsPanelDefinition = {
      ...current,
      title: update.title?.trim() || current.title,
      entries: update.entries
        ? update.entries.map(entry => ({ ...entry }))
        : current.entries,
      metadata: update.metadata
        ? { ...current.metadata, ...update.metadata }
        : current.metadata,
      updatedAt: Date.now(),
    };

    this.panels.set(id, next);
    if (update.entries) {
      const index = new SearchResultIndex();
      index.setSort(next.metadata.sort ?? 'relevance');
      index.append(next.entries, next.entries.length);
      this.indexes.set(id, index);
    }
    this.persist();
    return next;
  }

  registerRefresher(
    path: string,
    refresher: ResultsPanelRefresher,
  ): () => void {
    this.hydrate();
    const id = parseResultsId(path);
    if (!id || !this.panels.has(id)) {
      throw new Error(`Unknown results panel: ${path}`);
    }

    this.refreshers.set(id, refresher);
    return () => {
      if (this.refreshers.get(id) === refresher) {
        this.refreshers.delete(id);
      }
    };
  }

  canRefresh(path: string): boolean {
    this.hydrate();
    const id = parseResultsId(path);
    return !!id && this.refreshers.has(id);
  }

  async refresh(path: string): Promise<ResultsPanelDefinition | null> {
    this.hydrate();
    const id = parseResultsId(path);
    const current = id ? this.panels.get(id) : null;
    const refresher = id ? this.refreshers.get(id) : null;
    if (!id || !current || !refresher) return null;

    const value = await refresher();
    const result: ResultsPanelRefreshResult = Array.isArray(value)
      ? { entries: value }
      : value as ResultsPanelRefreshResult;

    return this.update(path, {
      entries: result.entries,
      metadata: result.metadata,
      title: result.title,
    });
  }

  rename(path: string, title: string): void {
    this.hydrate();
    const id = parseResultsId(path);
    const current = id ? this.panels.get(id) : null;
    const nextTitle = title.trim();
    if (!id || !current || !nextTitle) return;

    this.panels.set(id, { ...current, title: nextTitle });
    this.persist();
  }

  setPinned(path: string, pinned: boolean): void {
    this.hydrate();
    const id = parseResultsId(path);
    const current = id ? this.panels.get(id) : null;
    if (!id || !current) return;

    this.panels.set(id, { ...current, pinned });
    this.persist();
  }

  pinned(): readonly ResultsPanelDefinition[] {
    this.hydrate();
    return [...this.panels.values()]
      .filter(panel => !!panel.pinned)
      .sort((a,b) => b.createdAt - a.createdAt);
  }

  recent(): readonly ResultsPanelDefinition[] {
    this.hydrate();
    return [...this.panels.values()]
      .sort((left, right) => right.createdAt - left.createdAt);
  }

  private hydrate(): void {
    if (this.hydrated) return;
    this.hydrated = true;

    try {
      const raw = sessionStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
      const parsed = raw
        ? JSON.parse(raw) as ResultsPanelDefinition[]
        : [];

      for (const panel of parsed ?? []) {
        if (
          !panel?.id ||
          !panel?.path ||
          !Array.isArray(panel.entries)
        ) {
          continue;
        }

        this.panels.set(panel.id, {
          ...panel,
          entries: [...panel.entries],
          metadata: {
            ...(panel.metadata ?? {}),
            recoveredPartial:
              Number(panel.metadata?.resultCount ?? panel.entries.length) >
              panel.entries.length,
          },
        });
      }
    } catch {
      this.panels.clear();
    }

    try {
      const raw = localStorage.getItem(PINNED_STORAGE_KEY);
      const parsed = raw ? JSON.parse(raw) as ResultsPanelDefinition[] : [];

      for (const panel of parsed ?? []) {
        if (!panel?.id || !panel?.path || !Array.isArray(panel.entries)) continue;

        // Plugin-owned collections are lifecycle-owned and are intentionally
        // not resurrected from snapshots when their plugin is absent.
        if (panel.metadata?.pluginId) continue;

        this.panels.set(panel.id, {
          ...panel,
          pinned: true,
          entries: panel.entries.map(entry => ({ ...entry })),
          metadata: { ...(panel.metadata ?? {}) },
        });
      }
    } catch {
      // Session panels remain usable if persistent pinned hydration fails.
    }
  }

  private trim(): void {
    const orderedUnpinned = [...this.panels.values()]
      .filter(panel => !panel.pinned)
      .sort((left, right) => right.createdAt - left.createdAt);

    for (const panel of orderedUnpinned.slice(MAX_PANELS)) {
      this.panels.delete(panel.id);
    }
  }

  private persist(): void {
    try {
      let remaining = MAX_PERSISTED_TOTAL_ENTRIES;
      const payload = [...this.panels.values()]
        .sort((a,b)=>b.createdAt-a.createdAt)
        .map(panel => {
          const count = Math.min(
            panel.entries.length,
            MAX_PERSISTED_ENTRIES_PER_PANEL,
            remaining,
          );
          remaining -= count;

          return {
            ...panel,
            entries: panel.entries.slice(0,count),
            metadata: {
              ...panel.metadata,
              resultCount: panel.entries.length,
              recoveredPartial: false,
            },
          };
        });

      const encoded = JSON.stringify(payload);
      sessionStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, encoded);
      localStorage.setItem(RECOVERY_KEY, encoded);
    } catch {
      // The complete result model remains in memory. Persistence is bounded
      // recovery state, not the authoritative result store.
    }
  }
}
`````

`````typescript
import { Injectable } from '@angular/core';
import { DirectorySourceService } from './directory-source.service';
import { PathSuggestion } from './path-history.service';
import { normalizePath } from '../components/address-bar.utils';
import { FileType, FileInfo } from '../shared/protocol';

/**
 * Provider interface for scheme-specific autocompletion.
 * Each scheme (drive, smb, search, registry, etc.) can implement custom logic.
 */
export interface SchemeAutocompleteProvider {
  readonly scheme: string;

  /**
   * Determine if this provider should handle the given query.
   */
  canHandle(query: string): boolean;

  /**
   * Determine if the given path should fetch children for autocompletion.
   */
  shouldFetch(query: string): boolean;

  /**
   * Split a query into context (directory path) and prefix to match.
   */
  splitContext(query: string): { dirPath: string; prefix: string };

  /**
   * Fetch suggestions for the given directory and prefix.
   */
  fetchSuggestions(dirPath: string, prefix: string): Promise<PathSuggestion[]>;

  /**
   * Stream suggestions with batching support.
   */
  streamSuggestions(
    dirPath: string,
    prefix: string,
    onBatch: (suggestions: PathSuggestion[]) => void,
  ): Promise<PathSuggestion[]>;

  /**
   * Check if this provider supports streaming.
   */
  supportsStreaming(path: string): boolean;

  /**
   * Get the root path.
   */
  getRootPath(path: string): string | null;

  /**
   * Join a directory path and child name.
   */
  joinChildPath(basePath: string, childName: string): string;
}

/**
 * Default filesystem provider (covers filesystem://, local paths, Windows paths).
 */
class FilesystemAutocompleteProvider implements SchemeAutocompleteProvider {
  scheme = 'filesystem';

  constructor(private readonly directorySource: DirectorySourceService) {}

  canHandle(query: string): boolean {
    const scheme = this.extractScheme(query);
    // Handle only filesystem and local (no explicit scheme)
    return !scheme || scheme === 'filesystem';
  }

  shouldFetch(query: string): boolean {
    const q = (query || '').trim();
    if (!q) return false;

    const n = normalizePath(q);
    if (!n) return false;

    // Avoid listing the full filesystem root on short inputs.
    if (n === '/') return false;
    if (n.toLowerCase() === 'filesystem://') return false;

    // Any slash-based path, or Windows drive prefix
    if (n.includes('/')) return true;
    if (/^[A-Za-z]:/.test(n)) return true;

    return false;
  }

  splitContext(query: string): { dirPath: string; prefix: string } {
    const q = normalizePath((query || '').replace(/\\/g, '/'));
    if (!q) return { dirPath: '/', prefix: '' };

    // A Windows drive root is a directory context. Keep the trailing slash so
    // friendly `C:/` and canonical `filesystem://c/` have the same semantics.
    const driveRootMatch = /^filesystem:\/\/[a-z]$/i.exec(q);
    if (driveRootMatch) return { dirPath: `${q}/`, prefix: '' };

    // If path ends with slash, it's a directory
    if (q.endsWith('/')) return { dirPath: q, prefix: '' };

    // Find the last slash to split directory and prefix
    const lastSlash = q.lastIndexOf('/');
    if (lastSlash >= 0) {
      return { dirPath: q.slice(0, lastSlash + 1), prefix: q.slice(lastSlash + 1) };
    }

    // Handle bare Windows drive letter (e.g., "C:")
    if (/^[A-Za-z]:$/.test(q)) return { dirPath: `${q}/`, prefix: '' };

    // Single path component РІР‚вЂњ root context
    return { dirPath: '/', prefix: q };
  }

  async fetchSuggestions(dirPath: string, prefix: string): Promise<PathSuggestion[]> {
    try {
      const listing = await this.directorySource.listDirectory(dirPath, false);
      return this.filterAndFormatSuggestions(listing.entries, prefix);
    } catch {
      return [];
    }
  }

  async streamSuggestions(
    dirPath: string,
    prefix: string,
    onBatch: (suggestions: PathSuggestion[]) => void,
  ): Promise<PathSuggestion[]> {
    const suggestions = await this.fetchSuggestions(dirPath, prefix);
    onBatch(suggestions);
    return suggestions;
  }

  supportsStreaming(path: string): boolean {
    return this.directorySource.supportsStreaming(path);
  }

  getRootPath(path: string): string | null {
    return this.directorySource.getRootPath(path);
  }

  joinChildPath(basePath: string, childName: string): string {
    const trimmed = (basePath || '/').replace(/\/+$/, '');
    const joined = `${trimmed}/${childName}`.replace(/\\/g, '/');
    if (joined.startsWith('//')) {
      return `//${joined.slice(2).replace(/\/{2,}/g, '/')}`;
    }
    return joined.replace(/\/{2,}/g, '/');
  }

  private filterAndFormatSuggestions(entries: FileInfo[] = [], prefix: string): PathSuggestion[] {
    const prefixLower = prefix.toLowerCase();
    const accumulated: PathSuggestion[] = [];
    const seenNames = new Set<string>();

    for (const entry of entries) {
      if (entry.type !== FileType.DIRECTORY) continue;
      if (prefixLower && !entry.name.toLowerCase().startsWith(prefixLower)) continue;
      if (seenNames.has(entry.name)) continue;
      seenNames.add(entry.name);

      accumulated.push({
        path: normalizePath(entry.path),
        displayName: entry.name,
        matchType: 'directory',
        score: 100,
        exists: true,
      });
    }

    accumulated.sort((a, b) => a.path.localeCompare(b.path));
    return accumulated;
  }

  private extractScheme(query: string): string | null {
    const normalized = normalizePath((query || '').trim().replace(/\\/g, '/'));
    const schemeMatch = /^([a-z][a-z0-9+.-]*):\/\//i.exec(normalized);
    return schemeMatch ? schemeMatch[1].toLowerCase() : null;
  }
}

/**
 * Search scheme provider: supports comprehensive search queries via URL parameters.
 * Replaces need for custom search dialogs by encoding all filters in the URL.
 *
 * Supported parameters:
 * - path: Base directory to search from
 * - pattern: Search pattern (glob-style or regex)
 * - recursive: Whether to search recursively (default: true)
 * - regex: Use regex pattern matching (default: false)
 * - caseSensitive: Case-sensitive matching (default: false)
 * - fileTypes: Comma-separated file types to include (file,directory,symlink)
 * - minSize: Minimum file size in bytes
 * - maxSize: Maximum file size in bytes
 * - modifiedAfter: ISO 8601 date string (inclusive)
 * - modifiedBefore: ISO 8601 date string (inclusive)
 * - searchHidden: Include hidden files (default: false)
 * - contentSearch: Search inside file contents (default: false)
 * - extensions: Comma-separated file extensions to match (.txt,.md)
 *
 * Example: search://?path=filesystem://c&pattern=*.log&minSize=1000&modifiedAfter=2024-01-01
 */
class SearchAutocompleteProvider implements SchemeAutocompleteProvider {
  scheme = 'search';

  canHandle(query: string): boolean {
    const normalized = normalizePath((query || '').trim().replace(/\\/g, '/'));
    return /^search:\/\//i.test(normalized);
  }

  shouldFetch(query: string): boolean {
    const q = (query || '').trim();
    if (!q) return false;
    const n = normalizePath(q);
    // Don't fetch just for "search://" - need actual search params
    return /^search:\/\/\?/.test(n);
  }

  splitContext(query: string): { dirPath: string; prefix: string } {
    const q = normalizePath((query || '').replace(/\\/g, '/'));
    if (!q || q.toLowerCase() === 'search://') {
      return { dirPath: 'search://', prefix: '' };
    }

    // Validate search query parameters when present.
    try {
      const urlPart = q.slice('search://'.length);
      if (!urlPart.startsWith('?')) {
        return { dirPath: 'search://', prefix: '' };
      }

      void new URLSearchParams(urlPart.slice(1));
      
      // For search://?, we don't really have a "prefix" like filesystem
      // The entire query is the "context"
      return { dirPath: q, prefix: '' };
    } catch {
      return { dirPath: 'search://', prefix: '' };
    }
  }

  async fetchSuggestions(dirPath: string, _prefix: string): Promise<PathSuggestion[]> {
    // Search scheme doesn't provide directory listings in the traditional sense.
    // Suggestions could include:
    // 1. Common search filters (by extension, by size, etc.)
    // 2. Previously used search patterns
    // 3. Saved searches
    return this.getSearchFilterSuggestions(dirPath);
  }

  async streamSuggestions(
    dirPath: string,
    prefix: string,
    onBatch: (suggestions: PathSuggestion[]) => void,
  ): Promise<PathSuggestion[]> {
    const suggestions = await this.fetchSuggestions(dirPath, prefix);
    onBatch(suggestions);
    return suggestions;
  }

  supportsStreaming(_path: string): boolean {
    return true;
  }

  getRootPath(_path: string): string | null {
    return 'search://';
  }

  joinChildPath(basePath: string, childName: string): string {
    const value = (childName || '').trim();
    if (!value) return basePath || 'search://';

    const normalized = normalizePath((basePath || 'search://').replace(/\\/g, '/'));
    if (!normalized.toLowerCase().startsWith('search://')) {
      return normalized;
    }

    const urlPart = normalized.slice('search://'.length);
    const params = new URLSearchParams(urlPart.startsWith('?') ? urlPart.slice(1) : '');
    params.set('pattern', value);
    return `search://?${params.toString()}`;
  }

  /**
   * Parse search:// URL parameters into a structured object.
   */
  private parseSearchParams(urlPath: string): Record<string, string | null> {
    try {
      const urlPart = urlPath.slice('search://'.length);
      if (!urlPart.startsWith('?')) return {};
      const params = new URLSearchParams(urlPart.slice(1));
      const result: Record<string, string | null> = {};
      params.forEach((value, key) => {
        result[key] = value;
      });
      return result;
    } catch {
      return {};
    }
  }

  /**
   * Build search query with filters for suggestion purposes.
   * Could suggest common filter combinations or saved searches.
   */
  private getSearchFilterSuggestions(dirPath: string): PathSuggestion[] {
    const suggestions: PathSuggestion[] = [];

    // Parse current query if provided
    const params = this.parseSearchParams(dirPath);
    const hasPattern = !!params['pattern'];
    const currentUrl = dirPath;

    // 1. Suggest search parameters if user is typing them
    if (currentUrl.endsWith('&') || currentUrl.endsWith('?')) {
      const paramSuggestions = [
        { key: 'pattern=', label: 'pattern (glob/regex)', score: 95 },
        { key: 'path=', label: 'path (base directory)', score: 90 },
        { key: 'minSize=', label: 'minSize (bytes)', score: 85 },
        { key: 'maxSize=', label: 'maxSize (bytes)', score: 85 },
        { key: 'extensions=', label: 'extensions (.txt,.md)', score: 80 },
        { key: 'modifiedAfter=', label: 'modifiedAfter (YYYY-MM-DD)', score: 75 },
        { key: 'fileTypes=', label: 'fileTypes (file,directory)', score: 70 },
        { key: 'recursive=', label: 'recursive (true/false)', score: 65 },
        { key: 'regex=', label: 'regex (true/false)', score: 60 },
      ];

      for (const p of paramSuggestions) {
        suggestions.push({
          path: currentUrl + p.key,
          displayName: `Param: ${p.label}`,
          matchType: 'directory',
          score: p.score,
          exists: true,
        });
      }
    }

    // Suggest common values for specific parameters being typed
    if (currentUrl.endsWith('fileTypes=')) {
      const types = ['file', 'directory', 'file,directory', 'symlink'];
      types.forEach((t, i) => {
        suggestions.push({
          path: currentUrl + t,
          displayName: `Type: ${t}`,
          matchType: 'directory',
          score: 100 - i,
          exists: true,
        });
      });
    }

    if (currentUrl.endsWith('recursive=') || currentUrl.endsWith('regex=') || currentUrl.endsWith('caseSensitive=') || currentUrl.endsWith('searchHidden=') || currentUrl.endsWith('contentSearch=')) {
      ['true', 'false'].forEach((v, i) => {
        suggestions.push({
          path: currentUrl + v,
          displayName: v,
          matchType: 'directory',
          score: 100 - i,
          exists: true,
        });
      });
    }

    // 2. Original filter logic
    // Suggest common filter combinations if user hasn't added them yet
    if (hasPattern && !params['extensions']) {
      suggestions.push({
        path: this.buildSearchURL(params, { extensions: '.log,.txt,.md' }),
        displayName: 'Common docs (.log, .txt, .md)',
        matchType: 'directory',
        score: 80,
        exists: true,
      });

      suggestions.push({
        path: this.buildSearchURL(params, { extensions: '.exe,.dll,.sys' }),
        displayName: 'Binary files (.exe, .dll, .sys)',
        matchType: 'directory',
        score: 75,
        exists: true,
      });

      suggestions.push({
        path: this.buildSearchURL(params, { extensions: '.jpg,.png,.gif,.bmp' }),
        displayName: 'Images (.jpg, .png, .gif, .bmp)',
        matchType: 'directory',
        score: 75,
        exists: true,
      });
    }

    // Suggest size filters if not present
    if (hasPattern && !params['minSize'] && !params['maxSize']) {
      suggestions.push({
        path: this.buildSearchURL(params, { minSize: '1048576' }), // 1MB
        displayName: 'Larger than 1MB',
        matchType: 'directory',
        score: 70,
        exists: true,
      });

      suggestions.push({
        path: this.buildSearchURL(params, { maxSize: '1024' }), // 1KB
        displayName: 'Smaller than 1KB',
        matchType: 'directory',
        score: 70,
        exists: true,
      });
    }

    return suggestions;
  }

  /**
   * Build a search:// URL with merged parameters.
   */
  private buildSearchURL(
    currentParams: Record<string, any>,
    updates: Record<string, string | number | boolean | null>,
  ): string {
    const merged = { ...currentParams, ...updates };
    const params = new URLSearchParams();

    for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(merged)) {
      if (value !== null && value !== undefined) {
        params.append(key, String(value));
      }
    }

    return `search://?${params.toString()}`;
  }
}

/**
 * SMB scheme provider: Windows file sharing (SMB/CIFS).
 */
class SmbAutocompleteProvider implements SchemeAutocompleteProvider {
  scheme = 'smb';

  constructor(private readonly directorySource: DirectorySourceService) {}

  canHandle(query: string): boolean {
    const normalized = normalizePath((query || '').trim().replace(/\\/g, '/'));
    return /^smb:\/\//i.test(normalized);
  }

  shouldFetch(query: string): boolean {
    const q = (query || '').trim();
    if (!q) return false;
    const n = normalizePath(q);
    return /^smb:\/\/[^/]*(?:\/.*)?$/i.test(n) && n !== 'smb://';
  }

  splitContext(query: string): { dirPath: string; prefix: string } {
    const q = normalizePath((query || '').replace(/\\/g, '/'));
    if (!q) return { dirPath: 'smb://', prefix: '' };

    if (q.toLowerCase() === 'smb://') {
      return { dirPath: 'smb://', prefix: '' };
    }

    if (q.endsWith('/')) return { dirPath: q, prefix: '' };

    const lastSlash = q.lastIndexOf('/');
    if (lastSlash > 'smb://'.length - 1) {
      return { dirPath: q.slice(0, lastSlash + 1), prefix: q.slice(lastSlash + 1) };
    }

    return { dirPath: 'smb://', prefix: q.slice('smb://'.length) };
  }

  async fetchSuggestions(dirPath: string, prefix: string): Promise<PathSuggestion[]> {
    try {
      const listing = await this.directorySource.listDirectory(dirPath, false);
      return this.filterAndFormatSuggestions(listing.entries, prefix);
    } catch {
      return [];
    }
  }

  async streamSuggestions(
    dirPath: string,
    prefix: string,
    onBatch: (suggestions: PathSuggestion[]) => void,
  ): Promise<PathSuggestion[]> {
    const suggestions = await this.fetchSuggestions(dirPath, prefix);
    onBatch(suggestions);
    return suggestions;
  }

  supportsStreaming(path: string): boolean {
    return this.directorySource.supportsStreaming(path);
  }

  getRootPath(path: string): string | null {
    return this.directorySource.getRootPath(path);
  }

  joinChildPath(basePath: string, childName: string): string {
    const trimmed = (basePath || 'smb://').replace(/\/+$/, '');
    return `${trimmed}/${childName}`;
  }

  private filterAndFormatSuggestions(entries: FileInfo[] = [], prefix: string): PathSuggestion[] {
    const prefixLower = prefix.toLowerCase();
    const accumulated: PathSuggestion[] = [];
    const seenNames = new Set<string>();

    for (const entry of entries) {
      if (entry.type !== FileType.DIRECTORY) continue;
      if (prefixLower && !entry.name.toLowerCase().startsWith(prefixLower)) continue;
      if (seenNames.has(entry.name)) continue;
      seenNames.add(entry.name);

      accumulated.push({
        path: normalizePath(entry.path),
        displayName: entry.name,
        matchType: 'directory',
        score: 100,
        exists: true,
      });
    }

    accumulated.sort((a, b) => a.path.localeCompare(b.path));
    return accumulated;
  }
}

/**
 * Generic fallback provider for unknown schemes.
 */
class GenericSchemeAutocompleteProvider implements SchemeAutocompleteProvider {
  scheme: string;

  constructor(private readonly directorySource: DirectorySourceService, scheme: string) {
    this.scheme = scheme;
  }

  canHandle(query: string): boolean {
    const normalized = normalizePath((query || '').trim().replace(/\\/g, '/'));
    const schemeMatch = /^([a-z][a-z0-9+.-]*):\/\//i.exec(normalized);
    return schemeMatch ? schemeMatch[1].toLowerCase() === this.scheme : false;
  }

  shouldFetch(query: string): boolean {
    const q = (query || '').trim();
    if (!q) return false;
    const n = normalizePath(q);
    return n.includes('/') || n.endsWith('://');
  }

  splitContext(query: string): { dirPath: string; prefix: string } {
    const q = normalizePath((query || '').replace(/\\/g, '/'));
    if (!q) return { dirPath: `${this.scheme}://`, prefix: '' };

    // Scheme-only (e.g., "smb://")
    const schemeOnlyMatch = /^([a-z][a-z0-9+.-]*):\/\/$/.exec(q);
    if (schemeOnlyMatch) {
      return { dirPath: q, prefix: '' };
    }

    // Path ends with slash
    if (q.endsWith('/')) return { dirPath: q, prefix: '' };

    // Split on last slash
    const lastSlash = q.lastIndexOf('/');
    if (lastSlash >= 0) {
      return { dirPath: q.slice(0, lastSlash + 1), prefix: q.slice(lastSlash + 1) };
    }

    return { dirPath: `${this.scheme}://`, prefix: q.slice(`${this.scheme}://`.length) };
  }

  async fetchSuggestions(dirPath: string, prefix: string): Promise<PathSuggestion[]> {
    try {
      const listing = await this.directorySource.listDirectory(dirPath, false);
      return this.filterAndFormatSuggestions(listing.entries, prefix);
    } catch {
      return [];
    }
  }

  async streamSuggestions(
    dirPath: string,
    prefix: string,
    onBatch: (suggestions: PathSuggestion[]) => void,
  ): Promise<PathSuggestion[]> {
    const suggestions = await this.fetchSuggestions(dirPath, prefix);
    onBatch(suggestions);
    return suggestions;
  }

  supportsStreaming(path: string): boolean {
    return this.directorySource.supportsStreaming(path);
  }

  getRootPath(path: string): string | null {
    return this.directorySource.getRootPath(path);
  }

  joinChildPath(basePath: string, childName: string): string {
    const trimmed = (basePath || `${this.scheme}://`).replace(/\/+$/, '');
    return `${trimmed}/${childName}`;
  }

  private filterAndFormatSuggestions(entries: FileInfo[] = [], prefix: string): PathSuggestion[] {
    const prefixLower = prefix.toLowerCase();
    const accumulated: PathSuggestion[] = [];
    const seenNames = new Set<string>();

    for (const entry of entries) {
      if (entry.type !== FileType.DIRECTORY) continue;
      if (prefixLower && !entry.name.toLowerCase().startsWith(prefixLower)) continue;
      if (seenNames.has(entry.name)) continue;
      seenNames.add(entry.name);

      accumulated.push({
        path: normalizePath(entry.path),
        displayName: entry.name,
        matchType: 'directory',
        score: 100,
        exists: true,
      });
    }

    accumulated.sort((a, b) => a.path.localeCompare(b.path));
    return accumulated;
  }
}

/**
 * Scheme-oriented autocompletion service.
 * Routes autocompletion to scheme-specific providers.
 */
@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })
export class SchemeAutocompleteService {
  private readonly providers: SchemeAutocompleteProvider[];
  private readonly filesystemProvider: SchemeAutocompleteProvider;
  private readonly providerCache = new Map<string, SchemeAutocompleteProvider>();

  constructor(
    private readonly directorySource: DirectorySourceService,
  ) {
    this.filesystemProvider = new FilesystemAutocompleteProvider(directorySource);
    this.providers = [
      // Specialized providers for specific schemes (order matters for canHandle matching)
      new SearchAutocompleteProvider(),
      new SmbAutocompleteProvider(directorySource),
      new ArchiveAutocompleteProvider(directorySource),
      // Generic filesystem provider (catch-all for filesystem://, local paths, etc.)
      this.filesystemProvider,
    ];
  }

  /**
   * Extract the scheme from a path.
   * Returns the scheme portion (e.g., "drive", "smb", "search") or null.
   */
  getScheme(path: string): string | null {
    const normalized = normalizePath((path || '').trim().replace(/\\/g, '/'));
    const schemeMatch = /^([a-z][a-z0-9+.-]*):\/\//i.exec(normalized);
    return schemeMatch ? schemeMatch[1].toLowerCase() : null;
  }

  /**
   * Get or create the appropriate provider for a query.
   */
  private getProvider(query: string): SchemeAutocompleteProvider {
    // Try registered providers first
    for (const provider of this.providers) {
      if (provider.canHandle(query)) {
        return provider;
      }
    }

    // For unknown schemes, create or reuse a generic provider
    const scheme = this.getScheme(query);
    if (scheme) {
      if (!this.providerCache.has(scheme)) {
        this.providerCache.set(
          scheme,
          new GenericSchemeAutocompleteProvider(this.directorySource, scheme),
        );
      }
      return this.providerCache.get(scheme)!;
    }

    // Fallback to filesystem provider for no-scheme address bar values.
    return this.filesystemProvider;
  }

  /**
   * Determine if the given path should fetch children for autocompletion.
   */
  shouldFetchSuggestions(query: string): boolean {
    const provider = this.getProvider(query);
    return provider.shouldFetch(query);
  }

  /**
   * Split a query into the directory context and the prefix to match.
   */
  splitQueryContext(query: string): { dirPath: string; prefix: string } {
    const provider = this.getProvider(query);
    return provider.splitContext(query);
  }

  /**
   * Fetch suggestions for a directory and prefix.
   */
  async fetchSuggestions(dirPath: string, prefix: string): Promise<PathSuggestion[]> {
    const provider = this.getProvider(dirPath);
    return provider.fetchSuggestions(dirPath, prefix);
  }

  /**
   * Stream suggestions with batching support.
   */
  async streamSuggestions(
    dirPath: string,
    prefix: string,
    onBatch: (suggestions: PathSuggestion[]) => void,
  ): Promise<PathSuggestion[]> {
    const provider = this.getProvider(dirPath);
    return provider.streamSuggestions(dirPath, prefix, onBatch);
  }

  /**
   * Check if a given scheme supports streaming suggestions.
   */
  supportsStreaming(path: string): boolean {
    const provider = this.getProvider(path);
    return provider.supportsStreaming(path);
  }

  /**
   * Get the root path for a given path.
   */
  getRootPath(path: string): string | null {
    const provider = this.getProvider(path);
    return provider.getRootPath(path);
  }

  /**
   * Join a directory path and child name.
   */
  joinChildPath(basePath: string, childName: string): string {
    const provider = this.getProvider(basePath);
    return provider.joinChildPath(basePath, childName);
  }
}
`````

`````typescript
/**
 * Comprehensive search query parameters.
 * Replaces the need for custom search dialogs by encoding everything in the URL.
 */
export interface SearchQueryParams {
  /** Base directory to search from */
  path?: string;

  /** Search pattern (glob-style by default, regex if regex=true) */
  pattern?: string;

  /** Whether to search recursively (default: true) */
  recursive?: boolean;

  regex?: boolean;

  /** Case-sensitive pattern matching (default: false) */
  caseSensitive?: boolean;

  fileTypes?: string;

  minSize?: number;

  /** Maximum file size in bytes */
  maxSize?: number;

  /** Modified date (inclusive), ISO 8601 format: 2024-01-01 or 2024-01-01T12:00:00Z */
  modifiedAfter?: string;

  /** Modified date (inclusive), ISO 8601 format: 2024-12-31 or 2024-12-31T23:59:59Z */
  modifiedBefore?: string;

  /** Include hidden files (default: false) */
  searchHidden?: boolean;

  /** Search inside file contents (requires backend support) (default: false) */
  contentSearch?: boolean;

  /** Comma-separated file extensions to match: .txt,.md,.log */
  extensions?: string;

  /** Custom metadata filter (backend-specific) */
  metadata?: string;
}

  'recursive',
  'regex',
  'caseSensitive',
  'searchHidden',
  'contentSearch',
]);

const NUMBER_KEYS: ReadonlySet<keyof SearchQueryParams> = new Set([
  'minSize',
  'maxSize',
]);

      this.params.path = normalizePath(path);
    }
    return this;

  /** Set the search pattern (glob-style or regex). */
  setPattern(pattern: string): SearchQueryBuilder {
    if (pattern) {
      this.params.pattern = pattern;
    }
    return this;

  setRecursive(recursive: boolean): SearchQueryBuilder {

  static parseParams(url: string): Partial<SearchQueryParams> {

          return;
        }

        (params[typedKey] as string | undefined) = value;
      });

      return params;
    } catch {
      return {};
    }
  }

  static describeParams(params: Partial<SearchQueryParams>): string {
    const parts: string[] = [];

    if (params.pattern) parts.push(`Pattern: ${params.pattern}`);
    if (params.path) parts.push(`In: ${params.path}`);
    if (params.recursive === false) parts.push('Non-recursive');
    if (params.regex) parts.push('Regex mode');
    if (params.caseSensitive) parts.push('Case-sensitive');
    if (params.fileTypes) parts.push(`Types: ${params.fileTypes}`);
    if (params.extensions) parts.push(`Extensions: ${params.extensions}`);
    if (params.minSize) parts.push(`Min size: ${SearchQueryBuilder.formatBytes(params.minSize)}`);
    if (params.maxSize) parts.push(`Max size: ${SearchQueryBuilder.formatBytes(params.maxSize)}`);
    if (params.modifiedAfter) parts.push(`Modified after: ${params.modifiedAfter}`);
    if (params.modifiedBefore) parts.push(`Modified before: ${params.modifiedBefore}`);
    if (params.searchHidden) parts.push('Include hidden');
    if (params.contentSearch) parts.push('Search content');

    return parts.join(' | ');
  }

  private formatDate(date: string | Date): string {
    if (typeof date === 'string') {
      return date;
    }
    return date.toISOString().split('T')[0];
  }

  private static formatBytes(bytes: number): string {
    if (bytes < 1024) return `${bytes}B`;
    if (bytes < 1024 * 1024) return `${(bytes / 1024).toFixed(1)}KB`;
    if (bytes < 1024 * 1024 * 1024) return `${(bytes / (1024 * 1024)).toFixed(1)}MB`;
    return `${(bytes / (1024 * 1024 * 1024)).toFixed(1)}GB`;
  }
}

/**
 * Stateless service facade that creates isolated builder instances.
 */
@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })
export class SearchQueryBuilderService {
  create(initial: Partial<SearchQueryParams> = {}): SearchQueryBuilder {
    return new SearchQueryBuilder(initial);
  }

  fromUrl(url: string): SearchQueryBuilder {
    return new SearchQueryBuilder().fromUrl(url);
  }

  build(params: Partial<SearchQueryParams>): string {
    return new SearchQueryBuilder(params).build();
  }

  parse(url: string): Partial<SearchQueryParams> {
    return SearchQueryBuilder.parseParams(url);
  }

  toDescription(params: Partial<SearchQueryParams>): string {
    return SearchQueryBuilder.describeParams(params);
  }
}
`````

`````typescript
import { FileType, type FileInfo } from '../shared/protocol';
import { SearchResultIndex } from './search-result-index';

function entry(index: number, size = index + 1): FileInfo {
  return {
    name: `file-${String(index).padStart(6, '0')}.txt`,
    path: `/root/file-${String(index).padStart(6, '0')}.txt`,
    type: FileType.FILE,
    size,
    modified: index,
    created: index,
    accessed: index,
    permissions: '',
    isHidden: false,
    isSymlink: false,
  };
}

describe('SearchResultIndex', () => {
  it('keeps 100k results chunked and reads bounded windows', () => {
    const index = new SearchResultIndex();

    for (let start = 0; start < 100_000; start += 512) {
      index.append(
        Array.from(
          { length: Math.min(512, 100_000 - start) },
          (_, offset) => entry(start + offset),
        ),
      );
    }

    expect(index.resultCount).toBe(100_000);
    const window = index.window(50_000, 1_024);
    expect(window.entries.length).toBe(1_024);
    expect(window.totalCount).toBe(100_000);
  });

  it('progressively sorts independent runs without rebuilding one full array', () => {
    const index = new SearchResultIndex();
    index.setSort('name');
    index.append([entry(9), entry(7), entry(8)]);
    index.append([entry(2), entry(0), entry(1)]);

    const names = index.window(0, 6).entries.map(value => value.name);
    expect(names).toEqual([
      'file-000000.txt',
      'file-000001.txt',
      'file-000002.txt',
      'file-000007.txt',
      'file-000008.txt',
      'file-000009.txt',
    ]);
  });

  it('filters incrementally and indexes stable path identity', () => {
    const index = new SearchResultIndex();
    index.setFilter(value => value.name.endsWith('2.txt'));
    index.append([entry(0), entry(1), entry(2)]);
    index.append([entry(12), entry(13)]);

    expect(index.resultCount).toBe(2);
    expect(index.window(0, 10).entries.map(value => value.path)).toEqual([
      '/root/file-000002.txt',
      '/root/file-000012.txt',
    ]);
  });

  it('groups duplicate candidates without content hashing on the presentation path', () => {
    const index = new SearchResultIndex();
    index.append([
      entry(1, 4096),
      { ...entry(2, 4096), name: 'other.txt' },
      { ...entry(3, 4096), name: 'other.bin' },
    ]);

    const groups = index.duplicateCandidateGroups();
    expect(groups.some(group => group.size === 4096 && group.count === 2)).toBeTrue();
  });
});
`````
