`````typescript
import type { FileInfo } from '../shared/protocol';

export type SearchResultSort = 'relevance' | 'name' | 'path' | 'type';

export interface SearchResultWindow {
  readonly offset: number;
  readonly limit: number;
  readonly totalCount: number;
  readonly sourceCount: number;
  readonly entries: readonly FileInfo[];
}

export interface SearchDuplicateCandidateGroup {
  readonly key: string;
  readonly size: number;
  readonly count: number;
  readonly samplePaths: readonly string[];
}

export interface SearchResultIndexSnapshot {
  readonly sourceCount: number;
  readonly resultCount: number;
  readonly folderCount: number;
  readonly fileCount: number;
  readonly duplicateCandidateGroups: number;
}

type EntryFilter = (entry: FileInfo) => boolean;

interface IndexedEntry {
  readonly entry: FileInfo;
  readonly sequence: number;
}

interface HeapNode {
  readonly runIndex: number;
  readonly itemIndex: number;
  readonly value: IndexedEntry;
}

export class SearchResultIndex {
  private readonly chunks: IndexedEntry[][] = [];
  private runs: IndexedEntry[][] = [];
  private identity = new Map<string, IndexedEntry>();
  private duplicateCandidates = new Map<string, { size: number; paths: string[] }>();

  private sourceCountValue = 0;
  private resultCountValue = 0;
  private folderCountValue = 0;
  private nextSequence = 0;

  private sortValue: SearchResultSort = 'relevance';
  private filterValue: EntryFilter | null = null;

  get sourceCount(): number { return this.sourceCountValue; }
  get resultCount(): number { return this.resultCountValue; }
  get folderCount(): number { return this.folderCountValue; }
  get fileCount(): number { return this.resultCountValue - this.folderCountValue; }
  get sort(): SearchResultSort { return this.sortValue; }

  reset(sort: SearchResultSort = this.sortValue): void {
    this.chunks.length = 0;
    this.runs = [];
    this.identity.clear();
    this.duplicateCandidates.clear();
    this.sourceCountValue = 0;
    this.resultCountValue = 0;
    this.folderCountValue = 0;
    this.nextSequence = 0;
    this.sortValue = sort;
  }

  append(batch: readonly FileInfo[], sourceCount?: number): number {
    if (sourceCount !== undefined) {
      this.sourceCountValue = Math.max(this.sourceCountValue, Math.max(0, sourceCount));
    } else {
      this.sourceCountValue += batch.length;
    }

    const indexed: IndexedEntry[] = [];
    for (const candidate of batch) {
      const path = candidate.path ?? '';
      if (!path || this.identity.has(path)) continue;

      const value: IndexedEntry = {
        entry: candidate,
        sequence: this.nextSequence++,
      };
      this.identity.set(path, value);

      if (this.filterValue && !this.filterValue(candidate)) {
        continue;
      }

      indexed.push(value);
      this.resultCountValue += 1;
      if (candidate.type === 'DIRECTORY') this.folderCountValue += 1;
      this.indexDuplicateCandidate(candidate);
    }

    if (!indexed.length) return this.resultCountValue;

    this.chunks.push(indexed);
    this.runs.push(this.sortedRun(indexed));
    return this.resultCountValue;
  }

  setSort(sort: SearchResultSort): void {
    if (sort === this.sortValue) return;
    this.sortValue = sort;
    this.runs = this.chunks.map(chunk => this.sortedRun(chunk));
  }

  setFilter(filter: EntryFilter | null): void {
    if (filter === this.filterValue) return;
    this.filterValue = filter;
    this.rebuildProjection();
  }

  at(index: number): FileInfo | null {
    if (index < 0 || index >= this.resultCountValue) return null;
    return this.window(index, 1).entries[0] ?? null;
  }

  window(offset: number, limit: number): SearchResultWindow {
    const safeOffset = Math.max(0, Math.min(this.resultCountValue, Math.floor(offset)));
    const safeLimit = Math.max(0, Math.floor(limit));
    const entries = safeLimit > 0
      ? this.mergeWindow(safeOffset, safeLimit)
      : [];

    return {
      offset: safeOffset,
      limit: entries.length,
      totalCount: this.resultCountValue,
      sourceCount: Math.max(this.sourceCountValue, this.identity.size),
      entries,
    };
  }

  materialize(limit = Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER): FileInfo[] {
    return [...this.window(0, Math.min(this.resultCountValue, limit)).entries];
  }

  duplicateCandidateGroups(minCount = 2): readonly SearchDuplicateCandidateGroup[] {
    const groups: SearchDuplicateCandidateGroup[] = [];
    for (const [key, group] of this.duplicateCandidates) {
      if (group.paths.length < minCount) continue;
      groups.push({
        key,
        size: group.size,
        count: group.paths.length,
        samplePaths: group.paths.slice(0, 8),
      });
    }
    return groups.sort((a, b) => b.size - a.size || b.count - a.count);
  }

  snapshot(): SearchResultIndexSnapshot {
    return {
      sourceCount: Math.max(this.sourceCountValue, this.identity.size),
      resultCount: this.resultCountValue,
      folderCount: this.folderCountValue,
      fileCount: this.fileCount,
      duplicateCandidateGroups: this.duplicateCandidateGroups().length,
    };
  }

  private rebuildProjection(): void {
    this.runs = [];
    this.resultCountValue = 0;
    this.folderCountValue = 0;
    this.duplicateCandidates.clear();

    for (const chunk of this.chunks) {
      const filtered = this.filterValue
        ? chunk.filter(value => this.filterValue!(value.entry))
        : [...chunk];
      if (!filtered.length) continue;

      this.resultCountValue += filtered.length;
      for (const value of filtered) {
        if (value.entry.type === 'DIRECTORY') this.folderCountValue += 1;
        this.indexDuplicateCandidate(value.entry);
      }
      this.runs.push(this.sortedRun(filtered));
    }
  }

  private sortedRun(values: readonly IndexedEntry[]): IndexedEntry[] {
    if (this.sortValue === 'relevance') {
      return [...values];
    }
    return [...values].sort((a, b) => this.compare(a, b));
  }

  private compare(a: IndexedEntry, b: IndexedEntry): number {
    const left = a.entry;
    const right = b.entry;

    let result = 0;
    if (this.sortValue === 'name') {
      result = this.text(left.name).localeCompare(this.text(right.name), undefined, {
        numeric: true,
        sensitivity: 'base',
      });
    } else if (this.sortValue === 'path') {
      result = this.text(left.path).localeCompare(this.text(right.path), undefined, {
        numeric: true,
        sensitivity: 'base',
      });
    } else if (this.sortValue === 'type') {
      result = this.text(left.type).localeCompare(this.text(right.type)) ||
        this.text(left.name).localeCompare(this.text(right.name), undefined, {
          numeric: true,
          sensitivity: 'base',
        });
    }

    return result ||
      this.text(left.path).localeCompare(this.text(right.path), undefined, {
        numeric: true,
        sensitivity: 'base',
      }) ||
      a.sequence - b.sequence;
  }

  private mergeWindow(offset: number, limit: number): FileInfo[] {
    if (!this.runs.length || limit <= 0) return [];

    if (this.sortValue === 'relevance') {
      return this.insertionWindow(offset, limit);
    }

    const heap: HeapNode[] = [];
    for (let runIndex = 0; runIndex < this.runs.length; runIndex += 1) {
      const first = this.runs[runIndex][0];
      if (first) this.heapPush(heap, { runIndex, itemIndex: 0, value: first });
    }

    const output: FileInfo[] = [];
    let logicalIndex = 0;
    const end = offset + limit;

    while (heap.length && logicalIndex < end) {
      const node = this.heapPop(heap)!;
      if (logicalIndex >= offset) output.push(node.value.entry);
      logicalIndex += 1;

      const nextIndex = node.itemIndex + 1;
      const next = this.runs[node.runIndex][nextIndex];
      if (next) {
        this.heapPush(heap, {
          runIndex: node.runIndex,
          itemIndex: nextIndex,
          value: next,
        });
      }
    }
    return output;
  }

  private insertionWindow(offset: number, limit: number): FileInfo[] {
    const output: FileInfo[] = [];
    let skipped = 0;

    for (const run of this.runs) {
      if (skipped + run.length <= offset) {
        skipped += run.length;
        continue;
      }
      const start = Math.max(0, offset - skipped);
      for (let index = start; index < run.length && output.length < limit; index += 1) {
        output.push(run[index].entry);
      }
      skipped += run.length;
      if (output.length >= limit) break;
    }
    return output;
  }

  private heapPush(heap: HeapNode[], node: HeapNode): void {
    heap.push(node);
    let index = heap.length - 1;
    while (index > 0) {
      const parent = Math.floor((index - 1) / 2);
      if (this.compare(heap[parent].value, node.value) <= 0) break;
      heap[index] = heap[parent];
      index = parent;
    }
    heap[index] = node;
  }

  private heapPop(heap: HeapNode[]): HeapNode | undefined {
    if (!heap.length) return undefined;
    const root = heap[0];
    const last = heap.pop()!;
    if (!heap.length) return root;

    let index = 0;
    while (true) {
      const left = index * 2 + 1;
      const right = left + 1;
      if (left >= heap.length) break;

      let smallest = left;
      if (
        right < heap.length &&
        this.compare(heap[right].value, heap[left].value) < 0
      ) {
        smallest = right;
      }
      if (this.compare(last.value, heap[smallest].value) <= 0) break;

      heap[index] = heap[smallest];
      index = smallest;
    }
    heap[index] = last;
    return root;
  }

  private indexDuplicateCandidate(entry: FileInfo): void {
    if (entry.type === 'DIRECTORY' || !Number.isFinite(entry.size) || entry.size <= 0) return;

    // This is deliberately a cheap *candidate* grouping, not an exact-content
    // duplicate claim. Exact duplicate confirmation can hash only these groups.
    const extension = this.extension(entry.name ?? '');
    const key = `${entry.size}|${extension}`;
    let group = this.duplicateCandidates.get(key);
    if (!group) {
      group = { size: entry.size, paths: [] };
      this.duplicateCandidates.set(key, group);
    }
    group.paths.push(entry.path);
  }

  private extension(name: string): string {
    const index = name.lastIndexOf('.');
    return index > 0 ? name.slice(index + 1).toLocaleLowerCase() : '';
  }

  private text(value: unknown): string {
    return String(value ?? '');
  }
}
`````

`````typescript
import { FileType, type FileInfo } from '../shared/protocol';
import { ResultsPanelService } from './results-panel.service';
import { SearchResultIndex } from './search-result-index';

function entry(index: number): FileInfo {
  return {
    name: `item-${index}.txt`,
    path: `/items/item-${index}.txt`,
    type: FileType.FILE,
    size: index + 1,
    modified: index,
    created: index,
    accessed: index,
    permissions: '',
    isHidden: false,
    isSymlink: false,
  };
}

describe('100k search result panels', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    sessionStorage.clear();
    localStorage.clear();
  });

  it('opens a 100k runtime collection through bounded result windows', () => {
    const index = new SearchResultIndex();
    for (let start = 0; start < 100_000; start += 512) {
      index.append(
        Array.from(
          { length: Math.min(512, 100_000 - start) },
          (_, offset) => entry(start + offset),
        ),
      );
    }

    const service = new ResultsPanelService();
    const panel = service.createFromIndex('100k', index, {
      kind: 'search',
      rootPath: '/items',
      query: '*.txt',
      recursive: true,
    });

    expect(panel.entries.length).toBeLessThanOrEqual(2_000);
    expect(panel.metadata.resultCount).toBe(100_000);

    const window = service.readWindow(panel.path, 75_000, 1_024);
    expect(window.entries.length).toBe(1_024);
    expect(window.totalCount).toBe(100_000);
  });

  it('keeps saved query collections regenerable without persisting all results', () => {
    const service = new ResultsPanelService();
    const panel = service.createSearch(
      'Search',
      [entry(0)],
      'C:/Work',
      '*.txt',
      true,
    );

    expect(service.backendSearchAlias(panel.path)).toContain('search://?');
    expect(service.backendSearchAlias(panel.path)).toContain('pattern=');
    expect(service.backendSearchAlias(panel.path)).toContain('recursive=true');
  });
});
`````

`````typescript
import '@angular/compiler';
import { fn, spyOnFn, stubGlobal, restoreGlobals } from '../testing/jasmine-test-helpers';
import { FileType } from '../shared/protocol';
import { SelectionBasketService } from './selection-basket.service';

function makeStorage() {
  const data = new Map<string, string>();
  return {
    getItem: fn((key: string) => data.get(key) ?? null),
    setItem: fn((key: string, value: string) => data.set(key, value)),
    removeItem: fn((key: string) => data.delete(key)),
    clear: fn(() => data.clear()),
  };
}

function makeService() {
  const api = {
    getFileInfo: fn(async (path: string) => ({
      name: path.split('/').pop() || path,
      path,
      type: FileType.FILE,
      size: 12,
      modified: 10,
    })),
  };
  return { service: new SelectionBasketService(api as never), api };
}

describe('SelectionBasketService', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    stubGlobal('sessionStorage', makeStorage());
  });

  it('deduplicates canonical paths while preserving insertion order', () => {
    const { service } = makeService();
    expect(service.add(['filesystem://c/work/a.txt', 'filesystem://c/work/a.txt'], 'pane:left')).toBe(1);
    expect(service.add(['filesystem://c/work/b.txt'], 'search')).toBe(1);
    expect(service.paths).toEqual(['filesystem://c/work/a.txt', 'filesystem://c/work/b.txt']);
  });

  it('removes successful paths without clearing failed basket entries', () => {

    service.add(['filesystem://c/a.txt', 'filesystem://c/b.txt']);

});
`````

`````typescript
import { Injectable } from '@angular/core';
import { createBehaviorSubject, distinctUntilChanged, map, shareReplay } from '@epikodelabs/streamix';
import { FileType } from '../shared/protocol';
import { canonicalizeLocation, locationIdentity, locationLabel } from './location-reference';
import { ApiService } from './api.service';

export interface SelectionBasketEntry {
  id: string;
  path: string;
  label: string;
  addedAt: number;
  source?: string;
  type?: FileType;
  size?: number;
  modified?: number;
  metadataResolved: boolean;
}

interface StoredBasketEntry {
  path: string;
  addedAt: number;
  source?: string;
}

@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })
export class SelectionBasketService {
  private readonly storageKey = 'filemanager:selection-basket-v1';
  private readonly entriesSubject = createBehaviorSubject<SelectionBasketEntry[]>(this.load());

  readonly entries$ = this.entriesSubject;
  readonly count$ = this.entries$.pipe(
    map(entries => entries.length),
    distinctUntilChanged(),
    shareReplay(1),
  );

  constructor(private readonly api: ApiService) {
    for (const entry of this.entriesSubject.value) {
      void this.resolveMetadata(entry.id, entry.path);
    }
  }

  get snapshot(): readonly SelectionBasketEntry[] {
    return this.entriesSubject.value;
  }

  get paths(): string[] {
    return this.entriesSubject.value.map(entry => entry.path);
  }

  add(paths: readonly string[], source?: string): number {
    const current = [...this.entriesSubject.value];
    const ids = new Set(current.map(entry => entry.id));
    const added: SelectionBasketEntry[] = [];

    for (const raw of paths) {
      const path = canonicalizeLocation(raw);
      if (!path) continue;
      const id = locationIdentity(path);
      if (!id || ids.has(id)) continue;
      ids.add(id);
      added.push({
        id,
        path,
        label: locationLabel(path) || this.baseName(path),
        addedAt: Date.now(),
        source,
        metadataResolved: false,
      });
    }

    if (added.length === 0) return 0;
    this.publish([...current, ...added]);
    for (const entry of added) void this.resolveMetadata(entry.id, entry.path);
    return added.length;
  }

  remove(idOrPath: string): boolean {
    const identity = idOrPath.includes(':') && !idOrPath.includes('://')
      ? idOrPath
      : locationIdentity(canonicalizeLocation(idOrPath));
    const current = this.entriesSubject.value;
    const next = current.filter(entry => entry.id !== identity);
    if (next.length === current.length) return false;
    this.publish(next);
    return true;
  }

  removePaths(paths: readonly string[]): number {
    const identities = new Set(paths.map(path => locationIdentity(canonicalizeLocation(path))).filter(Boolean));
    if (identities.size === 0) return 0;
    const current = this.entriesSubject.value;
    const next = current.filter(entry => !identities.has(entry.id));
    const removed = current.length - next.length;
    if (removed > 0) this.publish(next);
    return removed;
  }

  clear(): void {
    if (this.entriesSubject.value.length === 0) return;
    this.publish([]);
  }

  contains(path: string): boolean {
    const id = locationIdentity(canonicalizeLocation(path));
    return !!id && this.entriesSubject.value.some(entry => entry.id === id);
  }

  private async resolveMetadata(id: string, path: string): Promise<void> {
    try {
      const info = await this.api.getFileInfo(path);
      this.update(id, {
        label: info.name || locationLabel(path) || this.baseName(path),
        type: info.type,
        size: info.size,
        modified: info.modified,
        metadataResolved: true,
      });
    } catch {
      this.update(id, { metadataResolved: true });
    }
  }

  private update(id: string, patch: Partial<SelectionBasketEntry>): void {
    const current = this.entriesSubject.value;
    const index = current.findIndex(entry => entry.id === id);
    if (index < 0) return;
    const next = [...current];
    next[index] = { ...next[index], ...patch };
    this.entriesSubject.next(next);
  }

  private publish(entries: SelectionBasketEntry[]): void {
    this.entriesSubject.next(entries);
    this.persist(entries);
  }

  private load(): SelectionBasketEntry[] {
    try {
      const raw = sessionStorage.getItem(this.storageKey);
      if (!raw) return [];
      const stored = JSON.parse(raw) as StoredBasketEntry[];
      if (!Array.isArray(stored)) return [];
      const result: SelectionBasketEntry[] = [];
      const seen = new Set<string>();
      for (const item of stored) {
        const path = canonicalizeLocation(item?.path ?? '');
        const id = locationIdentity(path);
        if (!path || !id || seen.has(id)) continue;
        seen.add(id);
        result.push({
          id,
          path,
          label: locationLabel(path) || this.baseName(path),
          addedAt: Number.isFinite(item.addedAt) ? item.addedAt : Date.now(),
          source: item.source,
          metadataResolved: false,
        });
      }
      return result;
    } catch {
      return [];
    }
  }

  private persist(entries: readonly SelectionBasketEntry[]): void {
    try {
      const stored: StoredBasketEntry[] = entries.map(({ path, addedAt, source }) => ({ path, addedAt, source }));
      sessionStorage.setItem(this.storageKey, JSON.stringify(stored));
    } catch {
      // Basket persistence is a convenience; the in-memory working set remains authoritative.
    }
  }

  private baseName(path: string): string {
    return path.replace(/[\\/]+$/, '').split(/[\\/]/).pop() || path;
  }
}
`````

`````typescript
import { Injectable } from '@angular/core';

import { DiscoverySearchService } from './discovery-search.service';
import { DuplicateFinderService } from './duplicate-finder.service';
import { RecentFilesService } from './recent-files.service';
import {
  ResultsPanelService,
  type ResultsPanelDefinition,
} from './results-panel.service';
import type { FileInfo } from '../shared/protocol-enhanced';

@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })
export class SmartResultsService {
  constructor(
    private readonly panels: ResultsPanelService,
    private readonly discovery: DiscoverySearchService,
    private readonly recentFiles: RecentFilesService,
    private readonly duplicates: DuplicateFinderService,
  ) {}

  attachBuiltInRefresh(path: string): boolean {
    const panel = this.panels.get(path);
    if (!panel || this.panels.canRefresh(path)) {
      return !!panel && this.panels.canRefresh(path);
    }

    const kind = panel.metadata.kind ?? '';
    const origin = panel.metadata.origin ?? '';

    if (origin === 'global-search' ||
        kind === 'search' ||
        kind === 'recursive-search') {
      const root = panel.metadata.rootPath?.trim() ?? '';
      const query = panel.metadata.query?.trim() ?? '';
      if (!root || !query) return false;

      this.panels.registerRefresher(path, async () => {
        const result = await this.discovery.search(root, query, {
          recursive: kind === 'recursive-search',
          maxResults: 500,
        });
        return {
          entries: result.entries,
          metadata: {
            ...panel.metadata,
            refreshedAt: String(Date.now()),
            refreshWarnings: result.warnings.join('\n'),
          },
        };
      });
      return true;
    }

    if (origin === 'recent-files' || kind === 'recent-files') {
      this.panels.registerRefresher(path, async () => ({
        entries: this.recentFiles.recent(100),
      }));
      return true;
    }

    if (origin === 'duplicate-finder' || kind === 'duplicates') {
      const root = panel.metadata.rootPath?.trim() ?? '';
      if (!root) return false;

      this.panels.registerRefresher(path, async () => {
        const result = await this.duplicates.scan(root, {
          includeHidden: false,
        });

        return {
          entries: this.flattenDuplicateGroups(result.groups),
          metadata: {
            ...panel.metadata,
            reclaimableBytes: String(result.reclaimableBytes),
            duplicateGroups: String(result.groups.length),
            refreshWarnings: result.warnings.join('\n'),
          },
        };
      });
      return true;
    }

    return false;
  }

  ensureRefreshability(path: string): boolean {
    return this.panels.canRefresh(path) || this.attachBuiltInRefresh(path);
  }

  async refresh(path: string): Promise<ResultsPanelDefinition | null> {
    if (!this.ensureRefreshability(path)) return null;
    return this.panels.refresh(path);
  }

  private flattenDuplicateGroups(
    groups: readonly { files: readonly FileInfo[] }[],
  ): FileInfo[] {
    const seen = new Set<string>();
    const entries: FileInfo[] = [];

    for (const group of groups) {
      for (const entry of group.files) {
        const key = entry.path.replace(/\\/g, '/').toLocaleLowerCase();
        if (seen.has(key)) continue;
        seen.add(key);
        entries.push({ ...entry });
      }
    }

    return entries;
  }
}
`````

`````typescript
    columns: [],

  afterEach(() => {
    delete (window as any).go;
  });

  it('exposes Process, User and System as file-like scope directories', async () => {
    const source = new SystemSurfacePanelSource(descriptor);
    const listing = await source.list({ path: 'environment://' }, false);

    expect(listing.entries.map(entry => entry.name)).toEqual([
      'Process variables',
      'User variables',
      'System variables',
    ]);
    expect(listing.entries.every(entry => entry.type === FileType.DIRECTORY)).toBe(true);

      SystemSurfaceList: jasmine.createSpy().and.resolveTo([
        { id: 'process:PATH', name: 'PATH', fields: { scope: 'Process', value: 'P' } },
        { id: 'user:PATH', name: 'PATH', fields: { scope: 'User', value: 'U' } },
        { id: 'system:PATH', name: 'PATH', fields: { scope: 'System', value: 'S' } },
      ]),
    } } };

    const source = new SystemSurfacePanelSource(descriptor);

    const process = await source.list({ path: 'environment://process' }, false);
    const user = await source.list({ path: 'environment://user' }, false);
    const system = await source.list({ path: 'environment://system' }, false);

    expect(process.entries.map(entry => entry.systemFields['value'])).toEqual(['P']);
    expect(user.entries.map(entry => entry.systemFields['value'])).toEqual(['U']);
    expect(system.entries.map(entry => entry.systemFields['value'])).toEqual(['S']);
  });

  it('returns the Environment root as parent for every scope', () => {
    const source = new SystemSurfacePanelSource(descriptor);
    expect(source.getParentPath({ path: 'environment://user' })).toBe('environment://');
    expect(source.getParentPath({ path: 'environment://system' })).toBe('environment://');
  });
});
`````

`````typescript
    expect(listing.entries[0].path).toBe('//NAS/Media');
`````

## File: manager/frontend/src/app/services/system-surface-panel-source.ts
`````typescript
import { FileType, type FileInfo } from '../shared/protocol';
import type { PanelSource, PanelSourceContext, PanelSourceListing } from './panel-source';
import type { SourceCapabilities } from './source-capabilities';

export type SystemSurfaceKind =
  | 'tasks'
  | 'services'
  | 'processes'
  | 'devices'
  | 'network'
  | 'environment'
  | 'shell-extensions';

export interface SystemSurfaceRecord {
  readonly id: string;
  readonly name: string;
  readonly fields?: Readonly<Record<string, unknown>>;
}

export interface SystemSurfaceColumn {
  readonly id: string;
  readonly label: string;
  readonly field: string;
  readonly width?: string;
}

export interface SystemSurfaceDescriptor {
  readonly kind: SystemSurfaceKind;
  readonly title: string;
  readonly columns: readonly SystemSurfaceColumn[];
}

export type SystemSurfaceFileInfo = FileInfo & {
  readonly systemSurfaceKind: SystemSurfaceKind;
  readonly systemRecordId: string;
  readonly systemFields: Readonly<Record<string, unknown>>;
};

const READ_ONLY: SourceCapabilities = Object.freeze({
  read: true,
  create: false,
  delete: false,
  rename: false,
  trash: false,
});

function rootFor(kind: SystemSurfaceKind): string {
  return `${kind}://`;
}

function stableLeafPath(kind: SystemSurfaceKind, id: string): string {
  return `${kind}://entry/${encodeURIComponent(id)}`;
}

const NETWORK_ROOT = 'network://';

function normalizeNetworkPath(path: string): string {
  const raw = String(path || NETWORK_ROOT).trim().replace(/\\/g, '/');
  if (!/^network:\/\//i.test(raw)) return NETWORK_ROOT;
  const body = raw.slice(raw.indexOf('://') + 3)
    .replace(/^\/+/, '')
    .replace(/\/+$/, '');
  return body ? `${NETWORK_ROOT}${body}` : NETWORK_ROOT;
}

const ENVIRONMENT_ROOT = 'environment://';

function normalizeEnvironmentPath(path: string): string {
  const raw = String(path || ENVIRONMENT_ROOT).trim().replace(/\\/g, '/');
  if (!/^environment:\/\//i.test(raw)) return ENVIRONMENT_ROOT;
  const body = raw.slice(raw.indexOf('://') + 3)
    .replace(/^\/+/, '')
    .replace(/\/+$/, '');
  return body ? `${ENVIRONMENT_ROOT}${body}` : ENVIRONMENT_ROOT;
}

function environmentRootEntries(): SystemSurfaceFileInfo[] {
  const scopes = [
    {
      id: 'process',
      name: 'Process variables',
      scope: 'Process',
      description: 'Environment inherited by this Manager process',
    },
    {
      id: 'user',
      name: 'User variables',
      scope: 'User',
      description: 'Variables persisted for the current Windows user',
    },
    {
      id: 'system',
      name: 'System variables',
      scope: 'System',
      description: 'Machine-wide Windows environment variables',
    },
  ] as const;

  return scopes.map(item => ({
    name: item.name,
    path: `${ENVIRONMENT_ROOT}${item.id}`,
    type: FileType.DIRECTORY,
    size: 0,
    created: 0,
    modified: 0,
    accessed: 0,
    permissions: 'r-x',
    isHidden: false,
    systemSurfaceKind: 'environment',
    systemRecordId: item.id,
    systemFields: {
      scope: item.scope,
      value: item.description,
      valueType: 'Scope',
      environmentNodeKind: 'scope',
    },
  }));
}

function fieldText(
  fields: Readonly<Record<string, unknown>> | undefined,
  field: string,
): string {
  const value = fields?.[field];
  return value == null ? '' : String(value);
}

function normalizeSystemRecords(raw: unknown): SystemSurfaceRecord[] {
  if (!Array.isArray(raw)) return [];
  return raw
    .filter(record => record && typeof record === 'object')
    .map((record: any, index: number) => ({
      id: String(record.id ?? record.ID ?? index),
      name: String(record.name ?? record.Name ?? record.id ?? record.ID ?? index),
      fields: (record.fields ?? record.Fields ?? {}) as Record<string, unknown>,
    }));
}

async function networkBackendRecords(
  method: 'NetworkListComputers' | 'NetworkListShares',
  argument?: string,
): Promise<SystemSurfaceRecord[]> {
  const app = (window as any)?.go?.app?.App;
  const fn = app?.[method];
  if (typeof fn !== 'function') return [];

  const raw = argument === undefined
    ? await fn.call(app)
    : await fn.call(app, argument);
  return normalizeSystemRecords(raw);
}

function networkRootEntries(): SystemSurfaceFileInfo[] {
  const categories = [
    {
      id: 'computers',
      name: 'Computers',
      kind: 'Computer group',
      status: 'Browse network computers',
    },
    {
      id: 'remote',
      name: 'Remote locations',
      kind: 'Location group',
      status: 'Connected remote filesystems',
    },
    {
      id: 'adapters',
      name: 'Network adapters',
      kind: 'Adapter group',
      status: 'Local interfaces',
    },
    {
      id: 'connections',
      name: 'Active connections',
      kind: 'Connection group',
      status: 'TCP and UDP endpoints',
    },
  ] as const;

  return categories.map(category => ({
    name: category.name,
    path: `${NETWORK_ROOT}${category.id}`,
    type: FileType.DIRECTORY,
    size: 0,
    created: 0,
    modified: 0,
    accessed: 0,
    permissions: 'r-x',
    isHidden: false,
    systemSurfaceKind: 'network',
    systemRecordId: category.id,
    systemFields: {
      kind: category.kind,
      status: category.status,
      local: '',
      remote: '',
      networkNodeKind: 'category',
    },
  }));
}

export class SystemSurfacePanelSource implements PanelSource {
  readonly id: string;
  readonly kind = 'virtual' as const;
  readonly title: string;

  constructor(readonly descriptor: SystemSurfaceDescriptor) {
    this.id = `builtin.system.${descriptor.kind}`;
    this.title = descriptor.title;
  }

  canHandle(context: PanelSourceContext): boolean {
    return context.path.toLowerCase().startsWith(rootFor(this.descriptor.kind));
  }

  capabilities(): SourceCapabilities { return READ_ONLY; }
  supportsStreaming(): boolean { return false; }
  getRootPath(): string { return rootFor(this.descriptor.kind); }

  getParentPath(context: PanelSourceContext): string {
    if (this.descriptor.kind === 'network') {
      const normalized = normalizeNetworkPath(context.path);
      if (normalized === NETWORK_ROOT) return NETWORK_ROOT;

      const body = normalized.slice(NETWORK_ROOT.length).replace(/\/+$/, '');
      const slash = body.lastIndexOf('/');
      return slash < 0 ? NETWORK_ROOT : `${NETWORK_ROOT}${body.slice(0, slash)}`;
    }

    if (this.descriptor.kind === 'environment') {
      const normalized = normalizeEnvironmentPath(context.path);
      return normalized === ENVIRONMENT_ROOT
        ? ENVIRONMENT_ROOT
        : ENVIRONMENT_ROOT;
    }

    return rootFor(this.descriptor.kind);
  }

  joinChildPath(context: PanelSourceContext, childName: string): string {
    if (this.descriptor.kind === 'network') {
      const base = normalizeNetworkPath(context.path).replace(/\/+$/, '');
      return `${base}/${encodeURIComponent(childName)}`;
    }

    if (this.descriptor.kind === 'environment') {
      const base = normalizeEnvironmentPath(context.path).replace(/\/+$/, '');
      return `${base}/${encodeURIComponent(childName)}`;
    }

    return stableLeafPath(this.descriptor.kind, childName);
  }

  canPreviewEntry(): boolean { return false; }

  activateEntry(_context: PanelSourceContext, entry: FileInfo): boolean {
    // Directories are navigated by DirectoryPaneComponent. Synthetic leaves
    // remain command/context-menu targets and must not enter the file viewer.
    return entry.type !== FileType.DIRECTORY;
  }

  async list(context: PanelSourceContext): Promise<PanelSourceListing> {
    if (this.descriptor.kind === 'network') {
      return this.listNetwork(context);
    }
    if (this.descriptor.kind === 'environment') {
      return this.listEnvironment(context);
    }

    const records = await this.records();
    return {
      location: {
        path: rootFor(this.descriptor.kind),
        sourceId: this.id,
        sourceKind: this.kind,
      },
      entries: records.map(record => this.toFileInfo(record)),
    };
  }

  async records(): Promise<SystemSurfaceRecord[]> {
    const app = (window as any)?.go?.app?.App;
    if (!app?.SystemSurfaceList) return [];
    const raw = await app.SystemSurfaceList(this.descriptor.kind);
    return normalizeSystemRecords(raw);
  }

  private async listEnvironment(
    context: PanelSourceContext,
  ): Promise<PanelSourceListing> {
    const path = normalizeEnvironmentPath(context.path);
    let entries: SystemSurfaceFileInfo[];

    if (path === ENVIRONMENT_ROOT) {
      entries = environmentRootEntries();
    } else {
      const scope = path.slice(ENVIRONMENT_ROOT.length).toLowerCase();
      const expectedScope =
        scope === 'process' ? 'process' :
        scope === 'user' ? 'user' :
        scope === 'system' ? 'system' :
        '';

      if (!expectedScope) {
        entries = [];
      } else {
        const records = (await this.records()).filter(record =>
          fieldText(record.fields, 'scope').toLowerCase() === expectedScope,
        );
        entries = records.map(record =>
          this.toFileInfo(
            record,
            `${ENVIRONMENT_ROOT}${scope}/entry/${encodeURIComponent(record.id)}`,
          ),
        );
      }
    }

    return {
      location: {
        path,
        sourceId: this.id,
        sourceKind: this.kind,
      },
      entries,
    };
  }

  private async listNetwork(
    context: PanelSourceContext,
  ): Promise<PanelSourceListing> {
    const path = normalizeNetworkPath(context.path);
    let entries: SystemSurfaceFileInfo[];

    if (path === NETWORK_ROOT) {
      entries = networkRootEntries();
    } else if (path === `${NETWORK_ROOT}adapters`) {
      const records = (await this.records()).filter(
        record => fieldText(record.fields, 'kind').toLowerCase() === 'adapter',
      );
      entries = records.map(record => this.toNetworkLeaf(record));
    } else if (path === `${NETWORK_ROOT}connections`) {
      const records = (await this.records()).filter(record => {
        const kind = fieldText(record.fields, 'kind').toLowerCase();
        return kind === 'tcp' || kind === 'udp';
      });
      entries = records.map(record => this.toNetworkLeaf(record));
    } else if (path === `${NETWORK_ROOT}computers`) {
      entries = (await networkBackendRecords('NetworkListComputers'))
        .map(record => this.toNetworkComputer(record));
    } else if (path.startsWith(`${NETWORK_ROOT}computers/`)) {
      const encoded = path.slice(`${NETWORK_ROOT}computers/`.length)
        .split('/')[0] ?? '';
      const computer = decodeURIComponent(encoded);
      entries = (await networkBackendRecords('NetworkListShares', computer))
        .map(record => this.toNetworkShare(record, computer));
    } else if (path === `${NETWORK_ROOT}remote`) {
      entries = await this.networkRemoteEntries();
    } else {
      entries = [];
    }

    return {
      location: {
        path,
        sourceId: this.id,
        sourceKind: this.kind,
      },
      entries,
    };
  }

  private toNetworkLeaf(record: SystemSurfaceRecord): SystemSurfaceFileInfo {
    return this.toFileInfo(record, stableLeafPath('network', record.id));
  }

  private toNetworkComputer(record: SystemSurfaceRecord): SystemSurfaceFileInfo {
    const fields = record.fields ?? {};
    return this.toFileInfo(
      {
        ...record,
        fields: {
          ...fields,
          kind: 'Computer',
          status: fieldText(fields, 'status') || 'Discovered',
        },
      },
      `${NETWORK_ROOT}computers/${encodeURIComponent(record.name)}`,
      FileType.DIRECTORY,
    );
  }

  private toNetworkShare(
    record: SystemSurfaceRecord,
    computer: string,
  ): SystemSurfaceFileInfo {
    const fields = record.fields ?? {};
    const unc = fieldText(fields, 'remote') ||
      `//${computer}/${record.name}`;
    return this.toFileInfo(
      {
        ...record,
        fields: {
          ...fields,
          kind: 'Share',
          status: fieldText(fields, 'status') || 'Available',
          remote: unc,
        },
      },
      unc.replace(/\\/g, '/'),
      FileType.DIRECTORY,
    );
  }

  private async networkRemoteEntries(): Promise<SystemSurfaceFileInfo[]> {
    const app = (window as any)?.go?.app?.App;
    if (!app?.RemoteListConnections) return [];

    const raw = await app.RemoteListConnections();
    if (!Array.isArray(raw)) return [];

    return raw.map((mount: any, index: number) => {
      const name = String(
        mount?.name ?? mount?.Name ??
        mount?.publicPath ?? mount?.PublicPath ??
        `Remote ${index + 1}`,
      );
      const publicPath = String(
        mount?.publicPath ?? mount?.PublicPath ?? '',
      ).trim();
      const host = String(mount?.host ?? mount?.Host ?? '').trim();
      const protocol = String(
        mount?.protocol ?? mount?.Protocol ?? '',
      ).trim().toUpperCase();

      return this.toFileInfo(
        {
          id: publicPath || name,
          name,
          fields: {
            kind: 'Remote',
            status: 'Connected',
            local: protocol,
            remote: publicPath || host,
          },
        },
        publicPath || `${NETWORK_ROOT}remote/${encodeURIComponent(name)}`,
        FileType.DIRECTORY,
      );
    });
  }

  private toFileInfo(
    record: SystemSurfaceRecord,
    path = stableLeafPath(this.descriptor.kind, record.id),
    type: FileType = FileType.FILE,
  ): SystemSurfaceFileInfo {
    const fields = record.fields ?? {};
    return {
      name: record.name,
      path,
      type,
      size: Number(fields['size'] ?? fields['workingSet'] ?? 0) || 0,
      created: 0,
      modified: 0,
      accessed: 0,
      permissions: type === FileType.DIRECTORY ? 'r-x' : 'r--',
      isHidden: false,
      systemSurfaceKind: this.descriptor.kind,
      systemRecordId: record.id,
      systemFields: fields,
    };
  }

}

export function systemField(entry: FileInfo, field: string): string {
  const value = (entry as Partial<SystemSurfaceFileInfo>).systemFields?.[field];
  if (value === null || value === undefined) return '';
  if (typeof value === 'boolean') return value ? 'Yes' : 'No';
  return String(value);
}
`````

`````typescript
import { Injectable } from '@angular/core';
import { createBehaviorSubject } from '@epikodelabs/streamix';

export type Theme = 'dark' | 'light';
export type ThemePreference = Theme | 'system';

@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })
export class ThemeService {
  private readonly themePreference$ = createBehaviorSubject<ThemePreference>(this.readInitialThemePreference());
  private theme$ = createBehaviorSubject<Theme>(this.resolveTheme(this.themePreference$.value));
  private compact$ = createBehaviorSubject<boolean>(this.readInitialCompact());
  private readonly systemThemeMedia = window.matchMedia ? window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: light)') : null;

  constructor() {
    this.systemThemeMedia?.addEventListener?.('change', () => {
      if (this.themePreference$.value === 'system') {
        const resolved = this.resolveTheme('system');
        this.theme$.next(resolved);
        this.applyTheme(resolved);
      }
    });
    this.applyTheme(this.theme$.value);
    this.applyCompact(this.compact$.value);
  }

  setTheme(theme: Theme) {
    this.setThemePreference(theme);
  }

  setThemePreference(theme: ThemePreference) {
    const resolved = this.resolveTheme(theme);
    this.themePreference$.next(theme);
    this.theme$.next(resolved);
    this.applyTheme(resolved);
    try { localStorage.setItem('app-theme', theme); } catch {}
  }

  toggleTheme() {
    this.setThemePreference(this.theme$.value === 'dark' ? 'light' : 'dark');
  }

  getTheme$() {
    return this.theme$;
  }

  getThemePreference$() {
    return this.themePreference$;
  }

  setCompact(compact: boolean) {
    this.compact$.next(compact);
    this.applyCompact(compact);
    try { localStorage.setItem('app-compact', compact ? '1' : '0'); } catch {}
  }

  toggleCompact() {
    this.setCompact(!this.compact$.value);
  }

  getCompact$() {
    return this.compact$;
  }

  private applyTheme(theme: Theme) {
    const root = document.documentElement;
    root.classList.toggle('vscode-light', theme === 'light');
    root.classList.toggle('vscode-dark', theme === 'dark');
  }

  private applyCompact(compact: boolean) {
    const root = document.documentElement;
    root.classList.toggle('compact-mode', compact);
  }

  private readInitialThemePreference(): ThemePreference {
    try {
      const stored = localStorage.getItem('app-theme');
      if (stored === 'light' || stored === 'dark' || stored === 'system') return stored;
    } catch {}
    return 'system';
  }

  private resolveTheme(theme: ThemePreference): Theme {
    if (theme === 'light' || theme === 'dark') return theme;
    if (window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: light)').matches) {
      return 'light';
    }
    return 'dark';
  }

  private readInitialCompact(): boolean {
    try {
      return localStorage.getItem('app-compact') === '1';
    } catch {}
    return false;
  }
}
`````

`````typescript
import { FileType, type FileInfo } from '../shared/protocol';
import { ThumbnailPipelineService } from './thumbnail-pipeline.service';
import { WorkSchedulerService } from './work-scheduler.service';

function image(path: string): FileInfo {
  return {
    name: path.split('/').pop() ?? path,
    path,
    type: FileType.FILE,
    size: 4096,
    modified: 1,
    created: 1,
    accessed: 1,
    permissions: '',
    isHidden: false,
    isSymlink: false,
  };
}

describe('ThumbnailPipelineService', () => {
  function service(): ThumbnailPipelineService {
    return new ThumbnailPipelineService(
      {} as any,
      new WorkSchedulerService(),
    );
  }

  it('uses central scheduler generations per grid scope', () => {
    const value = service();
    const first = value.beginGeneration('left-grid');
    expect(value.isCurrent('left-grid', first)).toBeTrue();

    const second = value.beginGeneration('left-grid');
    expect(second).toBe(first + 1);
    expect(value.isCurrent('left-grid', first)).toBeFalse();
    expect(value.isCurrent('left-grid', second)).toBeTrue();
  });

  it('only considers thumbnail-capable files', () => {
    const value = service();
    expect(value.canThumbnail(image('/photo.jpg'))).toBeTrue();
    expect(value.canThumbnail(image('/movie.mp4'))).toBeTrue();
    expect(value.canThumbnail(image('/notes.txt'))).toBeFalse();
  });

  it('keeps decoded-image cache bounded independently of work concurrency', () => {
    const value = service();
    expect((value as any).maxDecodedEntries).toBe(192);
    expect((value as any).maxDecodedBytes).toBe(96 * 1024 * 1024);
    expect((value as any).maxConcurrency).toBeUndefined();
  });
});
`````

`````typescript
import { Injectable } from '@angular/core';

import type { FileInfo } from '../shared/protocol';
import { FileType } from '../shared/protocol';
import { ApiService } from './api.service';
import {
  WorkSchedulerService,
  type WorkPriority,
} from './work-scheduler.service';

export type ThumbnailPriority = 'visible' | 'overscan' | 'idle';

export interface ThumbnailRequestOptions {
  readonly scope: string;
  readonly generation: number;
  readonly priority: ThumbnailPriority;
  readonly width?: number;
  readonly height?: number;
}

interface ThumbnailCacheEntry {
  readonly key: string;
  readonly objectUrl: string;
  readonly decodedImage: HTMLImageElement;
  readonly decodedBytes: number;
  lastUsed: number;
}

const IMAGE_EXTENSIONS = new Set([
  'avif', 'bmp', 'gif', 'heic', 'heif', 'hdr', 'jfif', 'jpe', 'jpeg', 'jpg',
  'jxl', 'jp2', 'png', 'pnm', 'ppm', 'psd', 'svg', 'tif', 'tiff', 'webp',
]);

const VIDEO_EXTENSIONS = new Set([
  'avi', 'm4v', 'mkv', 'mov', 'mp4', 'mpeg', 'mpg', 'webm', 'wmv',
]);

const THUMBNAIL_PRIORITY: Record<ThumbnailPriority, WorkPriority> = {
  visible: 'visible',
  overscan: 'prefetch',
  idle: 'idle',
};

@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })
export class ThumbnailPipelineService {
  private readonly cache = new Map<string, ThumbnailCacheEntry>();
  private decodedBytes = 0;

  private readonly maxDecodedEntries = 192;
  private readonly maxDecodedBytes = 96 * 1024 * 1024;

  constructor(
    private readonly api: ApiService,
    private readonly work: WorkSchedulerService,
  ) {}

  beginGeneration(scope: string): number {
    return this.work.beginGeneration(this.workScope(scope));
  }

  cancelScope(scope: string): void {
    this.work.cancelScope(this.workScope(scope));
  }

  isCurrent(scope: string, generation: number): boolean {
    return this.work.isCurrent(this.workScope(scope), generation);
  }

  canThumbnail(entry: FileInfo): boolean {
    if (!entry?.path || entry.type === FileType.DIRECTORY) return false;
    const ext = this.extension(entry.name || entry.path);
    return IMAGE_EXTENSIONS.has(ext) || VIDEO_EXTENSIONS.has(ext);
  }

  peek(entry: FileInfo, width = 160, height = 120): string | null {
    const key = this.cacheKey(entry, width, height);
    const cached = this.cache.get(key);
    if (!cached) return null;
    cached.lastUsed = performance.now();
    return cached.objectUrl;
  }

  request(
    entry: FileInfo,
    options: ThumbnailRequestOptions,
  ): Promise<string | null> {
    const width = Math.max(32, Math.min(512, Math.round(options.width ?? 160)));
    const height = Math.max(32, Math.min(512, Math.round(options.height ?? 120)));

    if (!this.canThumbnail(entry)) {
      return Promise.resolve(null);
    }

    const scope = this.workScope(options.scope);
    if (!this.work.isCurrent(scope, options.generation)) {
      return Promise.resolve(null);
    }

    const cacheKey = this.cacheKey(entry, width, height);
    const cached = this.cache.get(cacheKey);
    if (cached) {
      cached.lastUsed = performance.now();
      return Promise.resolve(cached.objectUrl);
    }

    const handle = this.work.schedule<string | null>({
      key: `thumbnail:${cacheKey}:${scope}:${options.generation}`,
      scope,
      generation: options.generation,
      priority: THUMBNAIL_PRIORITY[options.priority],
      kind: 'thumbnail',
      run: async context => {
        const alreadyCached = this.cache.get(cacheKey);
        if (alreadyCached) {
          alreadyCached.lastUsed = performance.now();
          return alreadyCached.objectUrl;
        }

        const sourceUrl = await this.buildSourceUrl(entry, width, height);
        if (!sourceUrl || context.signal.aborted) return null;

        const response = await fetch(sourceUrl, {
          signal: context.signal,
          cache: 'force-cache',
        });
        if (!response.ok || context.signal.aborted) return null;

        const blob = await response.blob();
        if (context.signal.aborted) return null;

        const objectUrl = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
        const decoded = new Image();
        decoded.decoding = 'async';
        decoded.src = objectUrl;

        try {
          await decoded.decode();
        } catch {
          URL.revokeObjectURL(objectUrl);
          return null;
        }

        if (context.signal.aborted) {
          decoded.src = '';
          URL.revokeObjectURL(objectUrl);
          return null;
        }

        const decodedBytes = Math.max(
          blob.size,
          decoded.naturalWidth * decoded.naturalHeight * 4,
        );

        const item: ThumbnailCacheEntry = {
          key: cacheKey,
          objectUrl,
          decodedImage: decoded,
          decodedBytes,
          lastUsed: performance.now(),
        };
        this.cache.set(cacheKey, item);
        this.decodedBytes += decodedBytes;
        this.evictIfNeeded();

        context.report({
          completed: 1,
          total: 1,
          message: entry.name,
          units: 'thumbnail',
        });
        return objectUrl;
      },
    });

    return handle.promise.catch(error => {
      if (error instanceof DOMException && error.name === 'AbortError') {
        return null;
      }
      throw error;
    });
  }

  stats(): {
    readonly decodedEntries: number;
    readonly decodedBytes: number;
    readonly pending: number;
    readonly active: number;
  } {
    const stats = this.work.stats('thumbnail');
    return {
      decodedEntries: this.cache.size,
      decodedBytes: this.decodedBytes,
      pending: stats.queued,
      active: stats.running,
    };
  }

  clear(): void {
    for (const cached of this.cache.values()) {
      this.disposeCached(cached);
    }
    this.cache.clear();
    this.decodedBytes = 0;
  }

  private async buildSourceUrl(
    entry: FileInfo,
    width: number,
    height: number,
  ): Promise<string | null> {
    const ext = this.extension(entry.name || entry.path);
    if (VIDEO_EXTENSIONS.has(ext)) {
      return await this.api.getVideoPreviewURL(entry.path);
    }
    if (ext === 'svg') {
      return await this.api.getStreamURL(entry.path);
    }
    return await this.api.getImageThumbnailURL(entry.path, width, height);
  }

  private evictIfNeeded(): void {
    if (
      this.cache.size <= this.maxDecodedEntries &&
      this.decodedBytes <= this.maxDecodedBytes
    ) {
      return;
    }

    const entries = [...this.cache.values()]
      .sort((left, right) => left.lastUsed - right.lastUsed);

    for (const cached of entries) {
      if (
        this.cache.size <= this.maxDecodedEntries &&
        this.decodedBytes <= this.maxDecodedBytes
      ) {
        break;
      }
      this.cache.delete(cached.key);
      this.decodedBytes = Math.max(0, this.decodedBytes - cached.decodedBytes);
      this.disposeCached(cached);
    }
  }

  private disposeCached(cached: ThumbnailCacheEntry): void {
    cached.decodedImage.src = '';
    URL.revokeObjectURL(cached.objectUrl);
  }

  private cacheKey(entry: FileInfo, width: number, height: number): string {
    return `${entry.path}|${entry.modified ?? 0}|${entry.size ?? 0}|${width}x${height}`;
  }

  private workScope(scope: string): string {
    return `thumbnail:${scope}`;
  }

  private extension(value: string): string {
    const leaf = value.split(/[\\/]/).pop() ?? value;
    const index = leaf.lastIndexOf('.');
    return index > 0 ? leaf.slice(index + 1).toLocaleLowerCase() : '';
  }
}
`````

`````typescript
import type { SourceCapabilities } from './source-capabilities';
import { canReceiveTransfer, canTransferBetween } from './transfer-capabilities';
const mutable: SourceCapabilities = { read: true, create: true, delete: true, rename: true, trash: false };
const readOnly: SourceCapabilities = { read: true, create: false, delete: false, rename: false, trash: false };
describe('transfer capabilities', () => {
  it('requires create capability on any transfer destination', () => {
    expect(canReceiveTransfer(mutable).allowed).toBe(true);
    expect(canReceiveTransfer(readOnly)).toEqual({ allowed: false, reason: 'destination-read-only' });
  });

  it('allows copying from a read-only source into a writable destination', () => expect(canTransferBetween('copy', readOnly, mutable)).toEqual({ allowed: true }));
  it('blocks copying into a read-only destination', () => expect(canTransferBetween('copy', mutable, readOnly)).toEqual({ allowed: false, reason: 'destination-read-only' }));
  it('blocks moving from a read-only source', () => expect(canTransferBetween('move', readOnly, mutable)).toEqual({ allowed: false, reason: 'source-not-removable' }));
  it('allows moving between mutable sources', () => expect(canTransferBetween('move', mutable, mutable)).toEqual({ allowed: true }));
});
`````

`````typescript
import type { SourceCapabilities } from './source-capabilities';

export type TransferOperation = 'copy' | 'move';

export interface TransferCapabilityDecision {
  readonly allowed: boolean;
  readonly reason?: 'source-unreadable' | 'source-not-removable' | 'destination-read-only';
}

export function canReceiveTransfer(destination: SourceCapabilities): TransferCapabilityDecision {
  return destination.create
    ? { allowed: true }
    : { allowed: false, reason: 'destination-read-only' };
}

export function canTransferBetween(operation: TransferOperation, source: SourceCapabilities, destination: SourceCapabilities): TransferCapabilityDecision {
  if (!source.read) return { allowed: false, reason: 'source-unreadable' };
  const receive = canReceiveTransfer(destination);
  if (!receive.allowed) return receive;
  if (operation === 'move' && !source.delete) return { allowed: false, reason: 'source-not-removable' };
  return { allowed: true };
}

export function transferBlockedMessage(operation: TransferOperation, decision: TransferCapabilityDecision): string {
  const action = operation === 'copy' ? 'Copy' : 'Move';
  switch (decision.reason) {
    case 'source-unreadable': return `${action} Not Available\nThe source cannot be read.`;
    case 'source-not-removable': return `${action} Not Available\nThe source is read-only and cannot be moved. You can copy it instead.`;
    case 'destination-read-only': return `${action} Not Available\nThe destination is read-only.`;
    default: return `${action} Not Available`;
  }
}
`````

`````typescript
import { Injectable } from '@angular/core';
import type {
  PluginPackage,
  PluginPackageLoader,
  PluginPackageSource,
} from '../plugin/plugin-package';
import type { PluginManifest } from '../plugin/plugin-manifest';

interface UniversalPluginBindings {
  PrepareUniversalPluginPackage(pluginId: string): Promise<{
    manifest: PluginManifest;
    kind: 'archive';
    archivePath: string;
    cachePath: string;
    valid: boolean;
    errors?: string[];
  }>;
  ReadUniversalPluginFrontendEntry(pluginId: string): Promise<string>;
  CallUniversalPluginBackend(pluginId: string, method: string, paramsJSON: string): Promise<unknown>;
  StopUniversalPluginBackend(pluginId: string): Promise<void>;
}

interface UniversalFrontendContext {
  readonly pluginId: string;
  readonly manifest: PluginManifest;
  readonly api: any;
  readonly backend: {
    call<T = unknown>(method: string, params?: unknown): Promise<T>;
  };
  hasPermission(permission: string): boolean;
}

interface UniversalFrontendModule {
  activate(
    context: UniversalFrontendContext,
  ): void | (() => void | Promise<void>) | Promise<void | (() => void | Promise<void>)>;
}

function appBindings(): UniversalPluginBindings {
  const bindings = (window as any)?.go?.app?.App as UniversalPluginBindings | undefined;
  if (
    !bindings?.PrepareUniversalPluginPackage ||
    !bindings?.ReadUniversalPluginFrontendEntry ||
    !bindings?.CallUniversalPluginBackend ||
    !bindings?.StopUniversalPluginBackend
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      'Universal plugin bindings are unavailable. Regenerate Wails bindings and restart the application.',
    );
  }
  return bindings;
}

async function importFrontend(source: string, pluginId: string): Promise<UniversalFrontendModule> {
  const blob = new Blob([source], { type: 'text/javascript' });
  const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  try {
    const module = await import(/* @vite-ignore */ url) as Partial<UniversalFrontendModule>;
    if (typeof module.activate !== 'function') {
      throw new Error(`Universal plugin ${pluginId} frontend does not export activate().`);
    }
    return module as UniversalFrontendModule;
  } finally {
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
  }
}

@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })
export class UniversalPluginPackageLoaderService implements PluginPackageLoader {
  readonly kind = 'archive';

  async load(source: PluginPackageSource): Promise<PluginPackage> {
    const pluginId = source.metadata?.['pluginId'];
    if (typeof pluginId !== 'string' || !pluginId) {
      throw new Error('Managed archive plugin source is missing pluginId metadata.');
    }

    const prepared = await appBindings().PrepareUniversalPluginPackage(pluginId);
    if (!prepared.valid) {
      throw new Error(
        `Universal plugin ${pluginId} is invalid: ${(prepared.errors ?? []).join(' ')}`,
      );
    }

    const sourceText = await appBindings().ReadUniversalPluginFrontendEntry(pluginId);
    const frontend = await importFrontend(sourceText, pluginId);
    let dispose: void | (() => void | Promise<void>);

    return {
      manifest: prepared.manifest,
      activate: async context => {
        const bindings = appBindings();
        dispose = await frontend.activate({
          pluginId,
          manifest: context.manifest,
          api: context.api,
          backend: {
            call: <T>(method: string, params?: unknown) =>
              bindings.CallUniversalPluginBackend(
                pluginId,
                method,
                JSON.stringify(params ?? {}),
              ) as Promise<T>,
          },
          hasPermission: permission =>
            context.permissions.has(permission as any),
        });
      },
      deactivate: async () => {
        try {
          await dispose?.();
        } finally {
          dispose = undefined;
          await appBindings().StopUniversalPluginBackend(pluginId);
        }
      },
    };
  }
}
`````

`````typescript
import { VirtualCollection } from './virtual-window';

interface Item {
  id: string;
}

function items(count: number, offset = 0): Item[] {
  return Array.from({ length: count }, (_, index) => ({
    id: `item-${offset + index}`,
  }));
}

describe('VirtualCollection', () => {
  it('keeps logical extent independent from loaded population', () => {
    const collection = new VirtualCollection<Item, string>({
      identity: item => item.id,
      itemExtent: 40,
      threshold: 100,
      overscanRows: 20,
      guardRows: 8,
    });

    collection.setLogicalCount(100_000);
    collection.populate(40_000, items(1_024, 40_000), 100_000);
    collection.updateViewport({
      scrollTop: 40_200 * 40,
      viewportHeight: 800,
    }, true);

    expect(collection.logicalCount).toBe(100_000);
    expect(collection.loadedItems.length).toBe(1_024);
    expect(collection.window.totalExtentPx).toBe(4_000_000);
  });

  it('retains the render window while visible rows remain inside the guard', () => {
    const collection = new VirtualCollection<Item, string>({
      identity: item => item.id,
      itemExtent: 40,
      threshold: 100,
      overscanRows: 64,
      guardRows: 24,
    });

    expect(prefetch.offset).toBeGreaterThan(0);
`````

`````typescript
export interface VirtualWindow {
  readonly enabled: boolean;
  readonly start: number;
  readonly end: number;
  readonly beforePx: number;
  readonly afterPx: number;
  readonly totalExtentPx: number;
  readonly columns: number;
}

export interface VirtualWindowInput {
  readonly itemCount: number;
  readonly scrollTop: number;
  readonly viewportHeight: number;
  readonly itemExtent: number;
  readonly columns?: number;
  readonly overscanRows?: number;
  readonly threshold?: number;
}

export interface VirtualCollectionOptions<T, K> {
  readonly identity: (item: T) => K;
  readonly itemExtent: number;
  readonly columns?: number;
  readonly threshold?: number;
  readonly overscanRows?: number;
  readonly guardRows?: number;
  readonly minimumPrefetchItems?: number;
  readonly prefetchMultiplier?: number;
  readonly prefetchGuardRatio?: number;
}

export interface VirtualViewport {
  readonly scrollTop: number;
  readonly viewportHeight: number;
  readonly columns?: number;
}

export interface VirtualPrefetchWindow {
  readonly offset: number;
  readonly limit: number;
  readonly end: number;
}

export interface VirtualCollectionSnapshot {
  readonly generation: number;
  readonly logicalCount: number;
  readonly loadedOffset: number;
  readonly loadedCount: number;
  readonly render: VirtualWindow;
  readonly prefetch: VirtualPrefetchWindow;
}

interface MutableVirtualCollectionOptions<T, K> {
  identity: (item: T) => K;
  itemExtent: number;
  columns: number;
  threshold: number;
  overscanRows: number;
  guardRows: number;
  minimumPrefetchItems: number;
  prefetchMultiplier: number;
  prefetchGuardRatio: number;
}

function clampInteger(value: number, minimum: number, maximum = Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER): number {
  if (!Number.isFinite(value)) return minimum;
  return Math.max(minimum, Math.min(maximum, Math.floor(value)));
}

function calculateRawWindow(input: VirtualWindowInput): VirtualWindow {
  const itemCount = clampInteger(input.itemCount, 0);
  const columns = clampInteger(input.columns ?? 1, 1);
  const itemExtent = Math.max(1, Number.isFinite(input.itemExtent) ? input.itemExtent : 1);
  const threshold = clampInteger(input.threshold ?? 300, 1);
  const overscanRows = clampInteger(input.overscanRows ?? 10, 0);
  const totalRows = Math.ceil(itemCount / columns);
  const totalExtentPx = totalRows * itemExtent;

  if (itemCount < threshold) {
    return {
      enabled: false,
      start: 0,
      end: itemCount,
      beforePx: 0,
      afterPx: 0,
      totalExtentPx,
      columns,
    };
  }

  const viewportHeight = Math.max(itemExtent, input.viewportHeight || 600);
  const maxScroll = Math.max(0, totalExtentPx - viewportHeight);
  const scrollTop = Math.max(0, Math.min(maxScroll, input.scrollTop || 0));

  const firstVisibleRow = Math.floor(scrollTop / itemExtent);
  const visibleRows = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(viewportHeight / itemExtent));
  const startRow = Math.max(0, firstVisibleRow - overscanRows);
  const endRow = Math.min(totalRows, firstVisibleRow + visibleRows + overscanRows);
  const start = Math.min(itemCount, startRow * columns);
  const end = Math.min(itemCount, endRow * columns);

  return {
    enabled: true,
    start,
    end,
    beforePx: startRow * itemExtent,
    afterPx: Math.max(0, (totalRows - endRow) * itemExtent),
    totalExtentPx,
    columns,
  };
}

/**
 * Generic virtualization/window engine shared by directory views and result sets.
 *
 * Logical collection size is deliberately independent from the currently loaded
 * item window. This is what allows a 100k-entry source to expose correct scroll
 * geometry while only ~1k entries are resident on the frontend.
 */
export class VirtualCollection<T, K = string> {
  private options: MutableVirtualCollectionOptions<T, K>;

  private generationValue = 0;
  private logicalCountValue = 0;

  private loadedOffsetValue = 0;
  private loadedItemsValue: readonly T[] = [];
  private loadedIdentityIndex = new Map<K, number>();

  private renderWindow: VirtualWindow;
  private prefetchWindow: VirtualPrefetchWindow = { offset: 0, limit: 0, end: 0 };

  constructor(options: VirtualCollectionOptions<T, K>) {
    this.options = {
      identity: options.identity,
      itemExtent: Math.max(1, options.itemExtent),
      columns: clampInteger(options.columns ?? 1, 1),
      threshold: clampInteger(options.threshold ?? 300, 1),
      overscanRows: clampInteger(options.overscanRows ?? 10, 0),
      guardRows: clampInteger(options.guardRows ?? 4, 0),
      minimumPrefetchItems: clampInteger(options.minimumPrefetchItems ?? 320, 1),
      prefetchMultiplier: Math.max(1, options.prefetchMultiplier ?? 2),
      prefetchGuardRatio: Math.max(0, Math.min(0.49, options.prefetchGuardRatio ?? 0.2)),
    };

    this.renderWindow = calculateRawWindow({
      itemCount: 0,
      scrollTop: 0,
      viewportHeight: this.options.itemExtent,
      itemExtent: this.options.itemExtent,
      columns: this.options.columns,
      overscanRows: this.options.overscanRows,
      threshold: this.options.threshold,
    });
  }

  get generation(): number {
    return this.generationValue;
  }

  get logicalCount(): number {
    return this.logicalCountValue;
  }

  get loadedOffset(): number {
    return this.loadedOffsetValue;
  }

  get loadedItems(): readonly T[] {
    return this.loadedItemsValue;
  }

  get window(): VirtualWindow {
    return this.renderWindow;
  }

  configure(options: Partial<Omit<VirtualCollectionOptions<T, K>, 'identity'>>): void {
    if (options.itemExtent !== undefined) {
      this.options.itemExtent = Math.max(1, options.itemExtent);
    }
    if (options.columns !== undefined) {
      this.options.columns = clampInteger(options.columns, 1);
    }
    if (options.threshold !== undefined) {
      this.options.threshold = clampInteger(options.threshold, 1);
    }
    if (options.overscanRows !== undefined) {
      this.options.overscanRows = clampInteger(options.overscanRows, 0);
    }
    if (options.guardRows !== undefined) {
      this.options.guardRows = clampInteger(options.guardRows, 0);
    }
    if (options.minimumPrefetchItems !== undefined) {
      this.options.minimumPrefetchItems = clampInteger(options.minimumPrefetchItems, 1);
    }
    if (options.prefetchMultiplier !== undefined) {
      this.options.prefetchMultiplier = Math.max(1, options.prefetchMultiplier);
    }
    if (options.prefetchGuardRatio !== undefined) {
      this.options.prefetchGuardRatio = Math.max(
        0,
        Math.min(0.49, options.prefetchGuardRatio),
      );
    }
  }

  /**
   * Begins a new source generation. Async callers should capture the returned
   * generation and verify isCurrent() before committing results.
   */
  begin(logicalCount = 0): number {
    this.generationValue += 1;
    this.logicalCountValue = clampInteger(logicalCount, 0);
    this.loadedOffsetValue = 0;
    this.loadedItemsValue = [];
    this.loadedIdentityIndex.clear();
    this.renderWindow = calculateRawWindow({
      itemCount: this.logicalCountValue,
      scrollTop: 0,
      viewportHeight: this.options.itemExtent,
      itemExtent: this.options.itemExtent,
      columns: this.options.columns,
      overscanRows: this.options.overscanRows,
      threshold: this.options.threshold,
    });
    this.prefetchWindow = this.calculatePrefetch(this.renderWindow);
    return this.generationValue;
  }

  cancel(): number {
    this.generationValue += 1;
    return this.generationValue;
  }

  isCurrent(generation: number): boolean {
    return generation === this.generationValue;
  }

  setLogicalCount(count: number): boolean {
    const next = clampInteger(count, 0);
    if (next === this.logicalCountValue) return false;
    this.logicalCountValue = next;
    return true;
  }

  /**
   * Replaces the currently resident population without affecting logical size.
   * Offset is the logical index represented by items[0].
   */
  populate(offset: number, items: readonly T[], logicalCount?: number): void {
    if (logicalCount !== undefined) {
      this.setLogicalCount(logicalCount);
    }
    this.loadedOffsetValue = clampInteger(offset, 0, this.logicalCountValue);
    this.loadedItemsValue = items;
    this.rebuildIdentityIndex();
  }

  /**
   * Efficient incremental population for local/result collections whose loaded
   * window starts at zero.
   */
  append(items: readonly T[], logicalCount?: number): void {
    if (!items.length) {
      if (logicalCount !== undefined) this.setLogicalCount(logicalCount);
      return;
    }
    if (logicalCount !== undefined) {
      this.setLogicalCount(logicalCount);
    } else if (this.loadedOffsetValue === 0) {
      this.logicalCountValue = Math.max(
        this.logicalCountValue,
        this.loadedItemsValue.length + items.length,
      );
    }
    this.loadedItemsValue = [...this.loadedItemsValue, ...items];
    this.rebuildIdentityIndex();
  }

  /**
   * Updates viewport geometry. The materialized render window is retained while
   * the visible range remains inside its guard band.
   */
  updateViewport(viewport: VirtualViewport, force = false): boolean {
    const columns = clampInteger(viewport.columns ?? this.options.columns, 1);
    this.options.columns = columns;

    const visible = calculateRawWindow({
      itemCount: this.logicalCountValue,
      scrollTop: viewport.scrollTop,
      viewportHeight: viewport.viewportHeight,
      itemExtent: this.options.itemExtent,
      columns,
      overscanRows: 0,
      threshold: this.options.threshold,
    });

    if (!visible.enabled) {
      const next = calculateRawWindow({
        itemCount: this.logicalCountValue,
        scrollTop: viewport.scrollTop,
        viewportHeight: viewport.viewportHeight,
        itemExtent: this.options.itemExtent,
        columns,
        overscanRows: this.options.overscanRows,
        threshold: this.options.threshold,
      });
      const changed = force || !sameWindow(this.renderWindow, next);
      if (changed) {
        this.renderWindow = next;
        this.prefetchWindow = this.calculatePrefetch(next);
      }
      return changed;
    }

    const guardItems = this.options.guardRows * columns;
    if (
      !force &&
      this.renderWindow.enabled &&
      this.renderWindow.columns === columns &&
      visible.start >= this.renderWindow.start + guardItems &&
      visible.end <= this.renderWindow.end - guardItems
    ) {
      return false;
    }

    const next = calculateRawWindow({
      itemCount: this.logicalCountValue,
      scrollTop: viewport.scrollTop,
      viewportHeight: viewport.viewportHeight,
      itemExtent: this.options.itemExtent,
      columns,
      overscanRows: this.options.overscanRows,
      threshold: this.options.threshold,
    });

    const changed = force || !sameWindow(this.renderWindow, next);
    if (changed) {
      this.renderWindow = next;
      this.prefetchWindow = this.calculatePrefetch(next);
    }
    return changed;
  }

  /**
   * Ensures a logical item index is represented by the render window. Useful
   * for keyboard-driven result lists that do not expose their own scroll host.
   */
  revealIndex(index: number, viewportItems = 160): boolean {
    if (this.logicalCountValue <= 0) return false;
    const safeIndex = clampInteger(index, 0, this.logicalCountValue - 1);
    const columns = this.options.columns;
    const rows = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(viewportItems / columns));
    const row = Math.floor(safeIndex / columns);
    const scrollTop = row * this.options.itemExtent;
    return this.updateViewport({
      scrollTop,
      viewportHeight: rows * this.options.itemExtent,
      columns,
    });
  }

  prefetch(): VirtualPrefetchWindow {
    return this.prefetchWindow;
  }

  /**
   * True when the requested render range is still comfortably inside the
   * currently resident backend window.
   */
  isRenderCoveredByLoadedGuard(window = this.renderWindow): boolean {
    if (!this.loadedItemsValue.length) return false;
    const loadedEnd = this.loadedOffsetValue + this.loadedItemsValue.length;
    const guard = Math.max(
      this.options.columns,
      Math.floor(this.loadedItemsValue.length * this.options.prefetchGuardRatio),
    );
    return (
      window.start >= this.loadedOffsetValue + guard &&
      window.end <= loadedEnd - guard
    );
  }

  renderedItems(window = this.renderWindow): readonly T[] {
    if (!this.loadedItemsValue.length) return [];
    const loadedEnd = this.loadedOffsetValue + this.loadedItemsValue.length;
    const start = Math.max(window.start, this.loadedOffsetValue);
    const end = Math.min(window.end, loadedEnd);
    if (end <= start) return [];
    return this.loadedItemsValue.slice(
      start - this.loadedOffsetValue,
      end - this.loadedOffsetValue,
    );
  }

  indexOfIdentity(identity: K): number {
    return this.loadedIdentityIndex.get(identity) ?? -1;
  }

  snapshot(): VirtualCollectionSnapshot {
    return {
      generation: this.generationValue,
      logicalCount: this.logicalCountValue,
      loadedOffset: this.loadedOffsetValue,
      loadedCount: this.loadedItemsValue.length,
      render: this.renderWindow,
      prefetch: this.prefetchWindow,
    };
  }

  private calculatePrefetch(window: VirtualWindow): VirtualPrefetchWindow {
    const visibleSpan = Math.max(
      this.options.columns,
      window.end - window.start,
    );
    const limit = Math.max(
      this.options.minimumPrefetchItems,
      Math.ceil(visibleSpan * this.options.prefetchMultiplier),
    );
    const offset = Math.max(
      0,
      Math.min(
        Math.max(0, this.logicalCountValue - limit),
        window.start - Math.floor((limit - visibleSpan) / 2),
      ),
    );
    const end = Math.min(this.logicalCountValue, offset + limit);
    return {
      offset,
      limit: Math.max(0, end - offset),
      end,
    };
  }

  private rebuildIdentityIndex(): void {
    this.loadedIdentityIndex.clear();
    for (let index = 0; index < this.loadedItemsValue.length; index += 1) {
      this.loadedIdentityIndex.set(
        this.options.identity(this.loadedItemsValue[index]),
        this.loadedOffsetValue + index,
      );
    }
  }
}

function sameWindow(a: VirtualWindow, b: VirtualWindow): boolean {
  return (
    a.enabled === b.enabled &&
    a.start === b.start &&
    a.end === b.end &&
    a.columns === b.columns &&
    a.totalExtentPx === b.totalExtentPx
  );
}

/**
 * Backwards-compatible pure facade for callers that only need one calculation.
 * New stateful collection surfaces should own a VirtualCollection instance.
 */
export function calculateVirtualWindow(input: VirtualWindowInput): VirtualWindow {
  return calculateRawWindow(input);
}
`````

`````typescript
import { WindowStateService } from './window-state.service';

describe('WindowStateService', () => {
  function createService(): WindowStateService {
    return new WindowStateService({ runOutsideAngular: (fn: () => void) => fn() } as any);
  }

  it('uses the backend work-area normalizer when available', async () => {
    const service = createService() as any;
    const originalGo = (window as any).go;
    (window as any).go = {
      app: {
        App: {
          NormalizeWindowStateForSave: jasmine.createSpy('NormalizeWindowStateForSave').and.resolveTo({
            width: 1600,
            height: 900,
            x: 0,
            y: 0,
            maximised: false,
            hasPosition: true,
          }),
        },
      },
    };

    try {
      const snapshot = await service.normalizeWindowStateForSave({
        width: 2200,
        height: 1400,
        x: 1800,
        y: 900,
        maximised: false,
        hasPosition: true,
      });

      expect(snapshot.width).toBe(1600);
      expect(snapshot.height).toBe(900);
      expect(snapshot.x).toBe(0);
      expect(snapshot.y).toBe(0);
      expect((window as any).go.app.App.NormalizeWindowStateForSave).toHaveBeenCalled();
    } finally {
      (window as any).go = originalGo;
    }
  });

  it('falls back to the original state when the backend helper is unavailable', async () => {
    const service = createService() as any;
    const originalGo = (window as any).go;
    (window as any).go = undefined;

    try {
      const original = {
        width: 1800,
        height: 1000,
        x: 400,
        y: 300,
        maximised: false,
        hasPosition: false,
      };
      const snapshot = await service.normalizeWindowStateForSave(original);

      expect(snapshot).toEqual(original);
    } finally {
      (window as any).go = originalGo;
    }
  });
});
`````
