## File: manager/frontend/src/app/services/window-state.service.ts
`````typescript
import { Injectable, NgZone, OnDestroy } from '@angular/core';
import { GetPreferences, SavePreferences } from 'wailsjs/go/app/App';
import {
  WindowGetSize,
  WindowGetPosition,
  WindowIsMaximised,
} from 'wailsjs/runtime';
import type { WindowState } from '../shared/protocol-enhanced';

interface BackendUserPreferences {
  windowState?: WindowState;
  [key: string]: unknown;
}

/**
 * Captures window geometry (size, position, maximised state) and persists it
 * via backend `UserPreferences`. Debounced so resize/move drags don't flood IPC.
 *
 * Restoration of size+maximised happens at backend bootstrap before wails.Run().
 * Restoration of position happens in the Wails OnStartup hook (also backend).
 * This service only handles the *capture* side from the frontend.
 */
@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })
export class WindowStateService implements OnDestroy {
  private debounceTimer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null = null;
  private cachedPreferences: BackendUserPreferences | null = null;
  private readonly captureHandler = () => this.scheduleCapture();
  private started = false;

  constructor(private readonly ngZone: NgZone) {}

  /** Start listening for resize / visibility changes. Idempotent. */
  start(): void {
    if (this.started) return;
    this.started = true;
    this.ngZone.runOutsideAngular(() => {
      window.addEventListener('resize', this.captureHandler, { passive: true });
      window.addEventListener('beforeunload', this.captureHandler);
    });
    // Seed normal-mode bounds before the user can maximise, so the first
    // maximise transition has a prior rect to preserve.
    this.scheduleCapture();
  }

  ngOnDestroy(): void {
    window.removeEventListener('resize', this.captureHandler);
    window.removeEventListener('beforeunload', this.captureHandler);
    if (this.debounceTimer) {
      clearTimeout(this.debounceTimer);
      this.debounceTimer = null;
    }
  }

  /** Force an immediate capture (e.g. before close). */
  async captureNow(): Promise<void> {
    if (this.debounceTimer) {
      clearTimeout(this.debounceTimer);
      this.debounceTimer = null;
    }
    await this.captureAndPersist();
  }

  private scheduleCapture(): void {
    if (this.debounceTimer) clearTimeout(this.debounceTimer);
    this.debounceTimer = setTimeout(() => {
      this.debounceTimer = null;
      void this.captureAndPersist();
    }, 400);
  }

  private async captureAndPersist(): Promise<void> {
    let observed: WindowState;
    try {
      const [size, position, maximised] = await Promise.all([
        WindowGetSize(),
        WindowGetPosition(),
        WindowIsMaximised(),
      ]);
      observed = {
        width: Math.round(size.w),
        height: Math.round(size.h),
        x: Math.round(position.x),
        y: Math.round(position.y),
        maximised: !!maximised,
        hasPosition: true,
      };
      observed = await this.normalizeWindowStateForSave(observed);
    } catch {
      return; // Wails runtime not yet attached.
    }

    if (observed.width <= 0 || observed.height <= 0) return;

    // Ignore minimised windows: Windows reports x/y = -32000 and a tiny size.
    // Keep the previously persisted normal bounds instead.
    if (this.isMinimised(observed)) {
      if (!observed.maximised) return;
      // If somehow maximised and minimised at the same time, drop the bogus bounds.
      observed = { ...observed, width: 0, height: 0, x: 0, y: 0, hasPosition: false };
    }

    try {
      const current = this.cachedPreferences ?? (await GetPreferences() as unknown as BackendUserPreferences);
      this.cachedPreferences = current;

      const snapshot = this.mergeNormalBounds(current.windowState, observed);

      if (this.isSameWindowState(current.windowState, snapshot)) return;

      await SavePreferences({
        ...current,
        windowState: snapshot,
      } as any);
      this.cachedPreferences = { ...current, windowState: snapshot };
    } catch {
      // Ignore backend errors during early startup or shutdown races.
    }
  }

  /**
   * Width/height/x/y always represent the last *normal* (non-maximised) bounds
   * so that un-maximising restores the user's prior geometry. When the observed
   * window is maximised, keep the previously persisted normal bounds and only
   * flip the maximised flag.
   */
  private mergeNormalBounds(prev: WindowState | undefined, observed: WindowState): WindowState {
    if (!observed.maximised) {
      return observed;
    }
    if (!prev || prev.width <= 0 || prev.height <= 0) {
      return observed;
    }
    return {
      width: prev.width,
      height: prev.height,
      x: prev.x,
      y: prev.y,
      maximised: true,
      hasPosition: prev.hasPosition ?? observed.hasPosition,
    };
  }

  private async normalizeWindowStateForSave(state: WindowState): Promise<WindowState> {
    const normalize = (window as any)?.go?.app?.App?.NormalizeWindowStateForSave;
    if (typeof normalize !== 'function') {
      return state;
    }
    try {
      return await normalize(state);
    } catch {
      return state;
    }
  }

  private isMinimised(state: WindowState): boolean {
    // Windows uses -32000 for minimised window coordinates.
    const minimisedCoord = -32000;
    const minVisibleSize = 50;
    return (
      state.x <= minimisedCoord ||
      state.y <= minimisedCoord ||
      state.width < minVisibleSize ||
      state.height < minVisibleSize
    );
  }

  private isSameWindowState(a: WindowState | undefined, b: WindowState): boolean {
    if (!a) return false;
    return (
      a.width === b.width &&
      a.height === b.height &&
      a.x === b.x &&
      a.y === b.y &&
      a.maximised === b.maximised &&
      !!a.hasPosition === !!b.hasPosition
    );
  }
}
`````

`````typescript
import { WorkSchedulerService } from './work-scheduler.service';

describe('WorkSchedulerService', () => {
  it('runs higher-priority queued work first', async () => {
    const scheduler = new WorkSchedulerService();
    const order: string[] = [];

    const blockers = Array.from({ length: 8 }, (_, index) =>
      scheduler.schedule({
        key: `block-${index}`,
        priority: 'interactive',
        kind: 'default',
        run: async context => {
          await context.yield('interactive');
          order.push(`block-${index}`);
        },
      }).promise,
    );

    const background = scheduler.schedule({
      key: 'background',
      priority: 'background',
      kind: 'default',
      run: () => { order.push('background'); },
    });

    const visible = scheduler.schedule({
      key: 'visible',
      priority: 'visible',
      kind: 'default',
      run: () => { order.push('visible'); },
    });

    await Promise.all([...blockers, visible.promise, background.promise]);
    expect(order.indexOf('visible')).toBeLessThan(order.indexOf('background'));
  });

  it('deduplicates equal work keys', async () => {
    const scheduler = new WorkSchedulerService();
    let calls = 0;

    const request = () => scheduler.schedule({
      key: 'metadata:/a',
      priority: 'interactive' as const,
      kind: 'metadata' as const,
      run: async context => {
        calls += 1;
        await context.yield();
        return 42;
      },
    });

    const first = request();
    const second = request();

    expect(first.id).toBe(second.id);
    expect(await first.promise).toBe(42);
    expect(await second.promise).toBe(42);
    expect(calls).toBe(1);
  });

  it('cancels an old scope generation', async () => {
    const scheduler = new WorkSchedulerService();
    const firstGeneration = scheduler.beginGeneration('pane:left');

    const first = scheduler.schedule({
      key: 'left:index:1',
      scope: 'pane:left',
      generation: firstGeneration,
      priority: 'background',
      kind: 'directory',
      run: async context => {
        await context.yield('background');
        return 'old';
      },
    });

    scheduler.beginGeneration('pane:left');

    await expectAsync(first.promise).toBeRejectedWith(
      jasmine.objectContaining({ name: 'AbortError' }),
    );
  });

  it('reports work progress centrally', async () => {
    const scheduler = new WorkSchedulerService();
    const progress: number[] = [];

    const handle = scheduler.schedule({
      priority: 'interactive',
      kind: 'search',
      run: context => {
        context.report({ completed: 1, total: 2 });
        context.report({ completed: 2, total: 2 });
        return 'done';
      },
    });

    handle.onProgress(value => progress.push(value.completed ?? 0));
    expect(await handle.promise).toBe('done');
    expect(progress).toContain(2);
  });
});
`````

`````typescript
import { Injectable } from '@angular/core';

export type WorkPriority =
  | 'visible'
  | 'interactive'
  | 'prefetch'
  | 'background'
  | 'idle';

export type WorkKind =
  | 'directory'
  | 'search'
  | 'thumbnail'
  | 'metadata'
  | 'hashing'
  | 'provider'
  | 'viewer'
  | 'default';

export interface WorkProgress {
  readonly completed?: number;
  readonly total?: number;
  readonly message?: string;
  readonly units?: string;
}

export interface WorkSnapshot {
  readonly id: number;
  readonly key: string | null;
  readonly scope: string | null;
  readonly generation: number | null;
  readonly priority: WorkPriority;
  readonly kind: WorkKind;
  readonly state: 'queued' | 'running' | 'completed' | 'cancelled' | 'failed';
  readonly createdAt: number;
  readonly startedAt?: number;
  readonly finishedAt?: number;
  readonly progress?: WorkProgress;
}

export interface WorkContext {
  readonly signal: AbortSignal;
  report(progress: WorkProgress): void;
  yield(priority?: WorkPriority): Promise<void>;
}

export interface WorkRequest<T> {
  readonly key?: string;
  readonly scope?: string;
  readonly generation?: number;
  readonly priority: WorkPriority;
  readonly kind?: WorkKind;
  readonly run: (context: WorkContext) => Promise<T> | T;
}

export interface WorkHandle<T> {
  readonly id: number;
  readonly promise: Promise<T>;
  cancel(): void;
  snapshot(): WorkSnapshot;
  onProgress(listener: (progress: WorkProgress) => void): () => void;
}

interface ScopeState {
  generation: number;
  controller: AbortController;
}

interface InternalWork<T = unknown> {
  id: number;
  key: string | null;
  scope: string | null;
  generation: number | null;
  priority: WorkPriority;
  kind: WorkKind;
  sequence: number;
  createdAt: number;
  startedAt?: number;
  finishedAt?: number;
  state: WorkSnapshot['state'];
  progress?: WorkProgress;
  controller: AbortController;
  inheritedAbortCleanup?: () => void;
  run: (context: WorkContext) => Promise<T> | T;
  resolve: (value: T) => void;
  reject: (error: unknown) => void;
  promise: Promise<T>;
  progressListeners: Set<(progress: WorkProgress) => void>;
}

const PRIORITY_ORDER: Record<WorkPriority, number> = {
  visible: 0,
  interactive: 1,
  prefetch: 2,
  background: 3,
  idle: 4,
};

const DEFAULT_KIND_LIMITS: Readonly<Record<WorkKind, number>> = {
  directory: 2,
  search: 2,
  thumbnail: 4,
  metadata: 4,
  hashing: 2,
  provider: 4,
  viewer: 3,
  default: 4,
};

@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })
export class WorkSchedulerService {
  private readonly queue: InternalWork<any>[] = [];
  private readonly activeByKind = new Map<WorkKind, number>();
  private readonly keyed = new Map<string, InternalWork<any>>();
  private readonly scopes = new Map<string, ScopeState>();
  private readonly snapshots = new Map<number, WorkSnapshot>();
  private readonly listeners = new Set<(snapshot: WorkSnapshot) => void>();

  private active = 0;
  private nextId = 1;
  private sequence = 0;

  private readonly maxConcurrency = 8;
  private readonly kindLimits = DEFAULT_KIND_LIMITS;

  beginGeneration(scope: string): number {
    const previous = this.scopes.get(scope);
    previous?.controller.abort();

    const generation = (previous?.generation ?? 0) + 1;
    const controller = new AbortController();
    this.scopes.set(scope, { generation, controller });

    this.cancelQueued(work =>
      work.scope === scope &&
      work.generation !== null &&
      work.generation !== generation
    );
    return generation;
  }

  cancelScope(scope: string): void {
    const state = this.scopes.get(scope);
    state?.controller.abort();
    this.scopes.delete(scope);

    this.cancelQueued(work => work.scope === scope);
  }

  isCurrent(scope: string, generation: number): boolean {
    return this.scopes.get(scope)?.generation === generation;
  }

  schedule<T>(request: WorkRequest<T>): WorkHandle<T> {
    const kind = request.kind ?? 'default';
    const scope = request.scope ?? null;
    const generation = request.generation ?? null;

    if (
      scope &&
      generation !== null &&
      !this.isCurrent(scope, generation)
    ) {
      return this.cancelledHandle<T>(
        request.key ?? null,
        scope,
        generation,
        request.priority,
        kind,
      );
    }

    const dedupKey = request.key?.trim() || null;
    if (dedupKey) {
      const existing = this.keyed.get(dedupKey);
      if (
        existing &&
        (existing.state === 'queued' || existing.state === 'running')
      ) {
        return this.handleFor(existing as InternalWork<T>);
      }
    }

    let resolve!: (value: T) => void;
    let reject!: (error: unknown) => void;
    const promise = new Promise<T>((res, rej) => {
      resolve = res;
      reject = rej;
    });

    const controller = new AbortController();
    let inheritedAbortCleanup: (() => void) | undefined;

    if (scope && generation !== null) {
      const scopeState = this.scopes.get(scope);
      if (scopeState) {
        const forwardAbort = () => controller.abort(scopeState.controller.signal.reason);
        if (scopeState.controller.signal.aborted) {
          controller.abort(scopeState.controller.signal.reason);
        } else {
          scopeState.controller.signal.addEventListener('abort', forwardAbort, { once: true });
          inheritedAbortCleanup = () =>
            scopeState.controller.signal.removeEventListener('abort', forwardAbort);
        }
      }
    }

    const work: InternalWork<T> = {
      id: this.nextId++,
      key: dedupKey,
      scope,
      generation,
      priority: request.priority,
      kind,
      sequence: this.sequence++,
      createdAt: performance.now(),
      state: 'queued',
      controller,
      inheritedAbortCleanup,
      run: request.run,
      resolve,
      reject,
      promise,
      progressListeners: new Set(),
    };

    if (dedupKey) this.keyed.set(dedupKey, work);
    this.queue.push(work as InternalWork<any>);
    this.sortQueue();
    this.publish(work);
    this.pump();

    return this.handleFor(work);
  }

  async yield(
    priority: WorkPriority = 'interactive',
    signal?: AbortSignal,
  ): Promise<void> {
    if (signal?.aborted) throw this.abortError();

    if (priority === 'idle' && typeof window !== 'undefined') {
      await new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => {
        let settled = false;
        const finish = () => {
          if (settled) return;
          settled = true;
          cleanup();
          resolve();
        };
        const abort = () => {
          if (settled) return;
          settled = true;
          cleanup();
          reject(this.abortError());
        };

        const ric = (window as Window & {
          requestIdleCallback?: (
            callback: IdleRequestCallback,
            options?: IdleRequestOptions,
          ) => number;
          cancelIdleCallback?: (handle: number) => void;
        }).requestIdleCallback;

        const cic = (window as Window & {
          cancelIdleCallback?: (handle: number) => void;
        }).cancelIdleCallback;

        const useIdleCallback = typeof ric === 'function';
        const handle = useIdleCallback
          ? ric!(() => finish(), { timeout: 250 })
          : window.setTimeout(finish, 32);

        const cleanup = () => {
          signal?.removeEventListener('abort', abort);
          if (useIdleCallback) {
            cic?.(handle);
          } else {
            clearTimeout(handle);
          }
        };

        signal?.addEventListener('abort', abort, { once: true });
      });
      return;
    }

    await new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => {
      const abort = () => {
        cleanup();
        reject(this.abortError());
      };
      const handle = setTimeout(() => {
        cleanup();
        resolve();
      }, priority === 'background' ? 8 : 0);
      const cleanup = () => {
        clearTimeout(handle);
        signal?.removeEventListener('abort', abort);
      };
      signal?.addEventListener('abort', abort, { once: true });
    });
  }

  subscribe(listener: (snapshot: WorkSnapshot) => void): () => void {
    this.listeners.add(listener);
    return () => this.listeners.delete(listener);
  }

  currentSnapshots(): readonly WorkSnapshot[] {
    return [...this.snapshots.values()]
      .sort((a, b) => a.id - b.id);
  }

  stats(kind?: WorkKind): {
    readonly queued: number;
    readonly running: number;
    readonly completed: number;
    readonly failed: number;
    readonly cancelled: number;
  } {
    const snapshots = [...this.snapshots.values()]
      .filter(snapshot => !kind || snapshot.kind === kind);

    const count = (state: WorkSnapshot['state']) =>
      snapshots.filter(snapshot => snapshot.state === state).length;

    return {
      queued: count('queued'),
      running: count('running'),
      completed: count('completed'),
      failed: count('failed'),
      cancelled: count('cancelled'),
    };
  }

  private pump(): void {
    while (this.active < this.maxConcurrency) {
      const index = this.nextRunnableIndex();
      if (index < 0) return;

      const work = this.queue.splice(index, 1)[0];
      if (work.controller.signal.aborted) {
        this.finishCancelled(work);
        continue;
      }

      this.active += 1;
      this.activeByKind.set(
        work.kind,
        (this.activeByKind.get(work.kind) ?? 0) + 1,
      );
      work.state = 'running';
      work.startedAt = performance.now();
      this.publish(work);

      void this.run(work);
    }
  }

  private async run(work: InternalWork<any>): Promise<void> {
    const context: WorkContext = {
      signal: work.controller.signal,
      report: progress => {
        if (work.controller.signal.aborted) return;
        work.progress = { ...progress };
        for (const listener of work.progressListeners) listener(work.progress);
        this.publish(work);
      },
      yield: priority => this.yield(priority ?? work.priority, work.controller.signal),
    };

    try {
      const result = await work.run(context);
      if (work.controller.signal.aborted) {
        this.finishCancelled(work);
      } else {
        work.state = 'completed';
        work.finishedAt = performance.now();
        work.resolve(result);
        this.finish(work);
      }
    } catch (error) {
      if (
        work.controller.signal.aborted ||
        (error instanceof DOMException && error.name === 'AbortError')
      ) {
        this.finishCancelled(work);
      } else {
        work.state = 'failed';
        work.finishedAt = performance.now();
        work.reject(error);
        this.finish(work);
      }
    }
  }

  private finishCancelled(work: InternalWork<any>): void {
    work.state = 'cancelled';
    work.finishedAt = performance.now();
    work.reject(this.abortError());
    this.finish(work);
  }

  private finish(work: InternalWork<any>): void {
    work.inheritedAbortCleanup?.();
    if (work.key && this.keyed.get(work.key) === work) {
      this.keyed.delete(work.key);
    }

    if (work.startedAt !== undefined) {
      this.active = Math.max(0, this.active - 1);
      this.activeByKind.set(
        work.kind,
        Math.max(0, (this.activeByKind.get(work.kind) ?? 1) - 1),
      );
    }

    this.publish(work);
    this.pruneSnapshots();
    this.pump();
  }

  private nextRunnableIndex(): number {
    for (let index = 0; index < this.queue.length; index += 1) {
      const work = this.queue[index];
      const limit = this.kindLimits[work.kind];
      if ((this.activeByKind.get(work.kind) ?? 0) < limit) {
        return index;
      }
    }
    return -1;
  }

  private sortQueue(): void {
    this.queue.sort(
      (left, right) =>
        PRIORITY_ORDER[left.priority] - PRIORITY_ORDER[right.priority] ||
        left.sequence - right.sequence,
    );
  }

  private cancelQueued(predicate: (work: InternalWork<any>) => boolean): void {
    for (let index = this.queue.length - 1; index >= 0; index -= 1) {
      const work = this.queue[index];
      if (!predicate(work)) continue;
      this.queue.splice(index, 1);
      work.controller.abort();
      this.finishCancelled(work);
    }
  }

  private handleFor<T>(work: InternalWork<T>): WorkHandle<T> {
    return {
      id: work.id,
      promise: work.promise,
      cancel: () => {
        work.controller.abort();
        if (work.state === 'queued') {
          const index = this.queue.indexOf(work as InternalWork<any>);
          if (index >= 0) this.queue.splice(index, 1);
          this.finishCancelled(work as InternalWork<any>);
        }
      },
      snapshot: () => this.snapshotOf(work),
      onProgress: listener => {
        work.progressListeners.add(listener);
        if (work.progress) listener(work.progress);
        return () => work.progressListeners.delete(listener);
      },
    };
  }

  private cancelledHandle<T>(
    key: string | null,
    scope: string,
    generation: number,
    priority: WorkPriority,
    kind: WorkKind,
  ): WorkHandle<T> {
    const id = this.nextId++;
    const snapshot: WorkSnapshot = {
      id,
      key,
      scope,
      generation,
      priority,
      kind,
      state: 'cancelled',
      createdAt: performance.now(),
      finishedAt: performance.now(),
    };
    this.snapshots.set(id, snapshot);
    const promise = Promise.reject<T>(this.abortError());
    // Avoid an unhandled rejection if the caller only examines the handle.
    void promise.catch(() => {});
    return {
      id,
      promise,
      cancel() {},
      snapshot: () => snapshot,
      onProgress: () => () => {},
    };
  }

  private snapshotOf(work: InternalWork<any>): WorkSnapshot {
    return {
      id: work.id,
      key: work.key,
      scope: work.scope,
      generation: work.generation,
      priority: work.priority,
      kind: work.kind,
      state: work.state,
      createdAt: work.createdAt,
      startedAt: work.startedAt,
      finishedAt: work.finishedAt,
      progress: work.progress,
    };
  }

  private publish(work: InternalWork<any>): void {
    const snapshot = this.snapshotOf(work);
    this.snapshots.set(work.id, snapshot);
    for (const listener of this.listeners) listener(snapshot);
  }

  private pruneSnapshots(): void {
    const terminal = [...this.snapshots.values()]
      .filter(snapshot =>
        snapshot.state === 'completed' ||
        snapshot.state === 'cancelled' ||
        snapshot.state === 'failed'
      )
      .sort((a, b) => (a.finishedAt ?? 0) - (b.finishedAt ?? 0));

    while (terminal.length > 256) {
      const oldest = terminal.shift();
      if (oldest) this.snapshots.delete(oldest.id);
    }
  }

  private abortError(): DOMException {
    return new DOMException('Work cancelled.', 'AbortError');
  }
}
`````

## File: manager/frontend/src/app/services/workspace-surface-action-registry.service.ts
`````typescript
import { Injectable } from '@angular/core';

import type {
  WorkspaceSurfaceActionContribution,
  WorkspaceSurfaceActionContext,
  WorkspaceSurfaceActionEvent,
  WorkspaceSurfaceActionHostServices,
} from './workspace-surface-action.types';

@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })
export class WorkspaceSurfaceActionRegistryService {
  private readonly contributions =
    new Map<string, WorkspaceSurfaceActionContribution>();

  register(
    contribution: WorkspaceSurfaceActionContribution,
  ): void {
    this.contributions.set(contribution.id, contribution);
  }

  unregister(id: string): void {
    this.contributions.delete(id);
  }

  list(): readonly WorkspaceSurfaceActionContribution[] {
    return [...this.contributions.values()];
  }

  resolve(
    event: WorkspaceSurfaceActionEvent,
  ): WorkspaceSurfaceActionContribution | null {
    let best: WorkspaceSurfaceActionContribution | null = null;
    let bestScore = 0;

    for (const contribution of this.contributions.values()) {
      if (
        contribution.action !== event.action ||
        (contribution.surfaceId &&
          contribution.surfaceId !== event.surface.surfaceId)
      ) {
        continue;
      }

      const score =
        contribution.score?.(event) ??
        (contribution.surfaceId === event.surface.surfaceId ? 100 : 10);

      if (score > bestScore) {
        best = contribution;
        bestScore = score;
      }
    }

    return best;
  }

  async dispatch(
    event: WorkspaceSurfaceActionEvent,
    services: WorkspaceSurfaceActionHostServices,
  ): Promise<boolean> {
    const contribution = this.resolve(event);
    if (!contribution) return false;

    const context: WorkspaceSurfaceActionContext = {
      event,
      services,
    };

    await contribution.execute(context);
    return true;
  }
}
`````

`````typescript
export interface WorkspacePresentation {
  readonly workspaceId: string;
  readonly title: string;
  readonly kind: WorkspaceKind;
  readonly lifetime: WorkspaceLifetime;
  readonly layout: WorkspaceLayout;
}

export function workspaceSurface(
  id: string,
  surfaceId: string,
  title: string,
  role: WorkspaceSurfaceRole = 'primary',
  state?: Readonly<Record<string, unknown>>,
  actions?: readonly WorkspaceSurfaceAction[],
): WorkspaceSurface {
  return {
    id,
    surfaceId,
    title,
    role,
    ...(state ? { state } : {}),
    ...(actions?.length ? { actions } : {}),
  };
}

export function surfaceLayout(
  surface: WorkspaceSurface,
): WorkspaceSurfaceLeaf {
  return { kind: 'surface', surface };
}

export function splitLayout(
  direction: 'horizontal' | 'vertical',
  first: WorkspaceLayout,
  second: WorkspaceLayout,
  ratio = 50,
): WorkspaceSplitLayout {
  return {
    kind: 'split',
    direction,
    ratio: Math.max(5, Math.min(95, ratio)),
    first,
    second,
  };
}

export function stackLayout(
  surfaces: readonly WorkspaceSurface[],
  activeSurfaceId = surfaces[0]?.id ?? '',
): WorkspaceStackLayout {
  return {
    kind: 'stack',
    activeSurfaceId,
    surfaces,
  };
}

export function fileWorkspacePresentation(
  workspaceId: string,
  splitRatio = 50,
): WorkspacePresentation {
  return {
    workspaceId,
    title: 'Files',
    kind: 'files',
    lifetime: 'persistent',
    layout: splitLayout(
      'horizontal',
      surfaceLayout(
        workspaceSurface(
          `${workspaceId}:left`,
          'directory-pane',
          'Left files',
          'primary',
          { paneId: 'left' },
        ),
      ),
      surfaceLayout(
        workspaceSurface(
          `${workspaceId}:right`,
          'directory-pane',
          'Right files',
          'secondary',
          { paneId: 'right' },
        ),
      ),
      splitRatio,
    ),
  };
}
`````

`````typescript
import { Injectable } from '@angular/core';
import { createBehaviorSubject } from '@epikodelabs/streamix';

import type { WorkspaceConfig } from '../shared/protocol-enhanced';
import {
  fileWorkspacePresentation,
  type WorkspaceLayout,
  type WorkspacePresentation,
  type WorkspaceSurface,
} from './workspace-surface.model';

interface PersistedToolWorkspaceEnvelope {
  readonly version: 1;
  readonly workspaces: readonly WorkspacePresentation[];
}

const PERSISTED_TOOL_WORKSPACES_KEY =
  'reassembly.toolWorkspaces.v1';
const MAX_PERSISTED_BYTES = 3_500_000;

@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })
export class WorkspaceSurfaceService {
  private readonly presentations = new Map<string, WorkspacePresentation>();
  private readonly activeSubject =
    createBehaviorSubject<WorkspacePresentation | null>(null);

  constructor() {
    this.hydratePersistentTools();
  }

  readonly active$ = this.activeSubject;

  get active(): WorkspacePresentation | null {
    return this.activeSubject.value;
  }

  ensureFilesWorkspace(workspace: WorkspaceConfig): WorkspacePresentation {
    const existing = this.presentations.get(workspace.id);
    if (existing?.kind === 'files') {
      const next = fileWorkspacePresentation(
        workspace.id,
        workspace.splitRatio ?? 50,
      );
      this.presentations.set(workspace.id, next);
      return next;
    }

    const presentation = fileWorkspacePresentation(
      workspace.id,
      workspace.splitRatio ?? 50,
    );
    this.presentations.set(workspace.id, presentation);
    return presentation;
  }

  activateFilesWorkspace(workspace: WorkspaceConfig): WorkspacePresentation {
    const presentation = this.ensureFilesWorkspace(workspace);
    this.activeSubject.next(presentation);
    return presentation;
  }

  listToolWorkspaces(): readonly WorkspacePresentation[] {
    return [...this.presentations.values()]
      .filter(presentation => presentation.kind === 'tool')
      .sort((left, right) =>
        left.title.localeCompare(right.title),
      );
  }

  listPersistentTools(): readonly WorkspacePresentation[] {
    return this.listToolWorkspaces()
      .filter(presentation => presentation.lifetime === 'persistent');
  }

  openToolWorkspace(
    title: string,
    layout: WorkspaceLayout,
    options: {
      id?: string;
      lifetime?: 'persistent' | 'transient';
    } = {},
  ): WorkspacePresentation {
    const id =
      options.id ??
      `tool:${globalThis.crypto?.randomUUID?.() ?? `${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(16).slice(2)}`}`;

    const presentation: WorkspacePresentation = {
      workspaceId: id,
      title: title.trim() || 'Tool',
      kind: 'tool',
      lifetime: options.lifetime ?? 'transient',
      layout,
    };

    this.presentations.set(id, presentation);
    this.activeSubject.next(presentation);
    return presentation;
  }

  promoteToWorkspace(
    surface: WorkspaceSurface,
    options: {
      title?: string;
      lifetime?: 'persistent' | 'transient';
    } = {},
  ): WorkspacePresentation {
    return this.openToolWorkspace(
      options.title ?? surface.title,
      { kind: 'surface', surface },
      { lifetime: options.lifetime },
    );
  }

  activate(workspaceId: string): boolean {
    const presentation = this.presentations.get(workspaceId);
    if (!presentation) return false;
    this.activeSubject.next(presentation);
    return true;
  }

  closeTransient(workspaceId: string): boolean {
    const presentation = this.presentations.get(workspaceId);
    if (!presentation || presentation.lifetime !== 'transient') return false;

    this.presentations.delete(workspaceId);
    if (this.activeSubject.value?.workspaceId === workspaceId) {
      this.activeSubject.next(null);
    }
    return true;
  }

  pin(workspaceId: string): WorkspacePresentation | null {
    const presentation = this.presentations.get(workspaceId);
    if (!presentation) return null;
    if (presentation.lifetime === 'persistent') return presentation;

    const pinned: WorkspacePresentation = {
      ...presentation,
      lifetime: 'persistent',
    };

    this.presentations.set(workspaceId, pinned);
    if (!this.persistPersistentTools()) {
      this.presentations.set(workspaceId, presentation);
      return null;
    }

    if (this.activeSubject.value?.workspaceId === workspaceId) {
      this.activeSubject.next(pinned);
    }
    return pinned;
  }

  rename(
    workspaceId: string,
    title: string,
  ): WorkspacePresentation | null {
    const presentation = this.presentations.get(workspaceId);
    const clean = title.trim();
    if (
      !presentation ||
      presentation.kind !== 'tool' ||
      presentation.lifetime !== 'persistent' ||
      !clean
    ) {
      return null;
    }

    const renamed: WorkspacePresentation = {
      ...presentation,
      title: clean,
    };

    this.presentations.set(workspaceId, renamed);
    if (!this.persistPersistentTools()) {
      this.presentations.set(workspaceId, presentation);
      return null;
    }

    if (this.activeSubject.value?.workspaceId === workspaceId) {
      this.activeSubject.next(renamed);
    }

    return renamed;
  }

  removePersistent(workspaceId: string): boolean {
    const presentation = this.presentations.get(workspaceId);
    if (
      !presentation ||
      presentation.kind !== 'tool' ||
      presentation.lifetime !== 'persistent'
    ) {
      return false;
    }

    this.presentations.delete(workspaceId);
    if (!this.persistPersistentTools()) {
      this.presentations.set(workspaceId, presentation);
      return false;
    }

    if (this.activeSubject.value?.workspaceId === workspaceId) {
      this.activeSubject.next(null);
    }
    return true;
  }

  updateSurfaceState(
    workspaceId: string,
    surfaceId: string,
    patch: Readonly<Record<string, unknown>>,
  ): WorkspacePresentation | null {
    const presentation = this.presentations.get(workspaceId);
    if (!presentation) return null;

    const layout = this.mapLayout(
      presentation.layout,
      surface =>
        surface.id === surfaceId
          ? {
              ...surface,
              state: {
                ...(surface.state ?? {}),
                ...patch,
              },
            }
          : surface,
    );

    const updated: WorkspacePresentation = {
      ...presentation,
      layout,
    };

    this.presentations.set(workspaceId, updated);

    if (
      updated.kind === 'tool' &&
      updated.lifetime === 'persistent' &&
      !this.persistPersistentTools()
    ) {
      this.presentations.set(workspaceId, presentation);
      return null;
    }

    if (this.activeSubject.value?.workspaceId === workspaceId) {
      this.activeSubject.next(updated);
    }

    return updated;
  }

  replaceSurfaceState(
    workspaceId: string,
    surfaceId: string,
    state: Readonly<Record<string, unknown>>,
  ): WorkspacePresentation | null {
    const presentation = this.presentations.get(workspaceId);
    if (!presentation) return null;

    const layout = this.mapLayout(
      presentation.layout,
      surface =>
        surface.id === surfaceId
          ? { ...surface, state: { ...state } }
          : surface,
    );

    const updated: WorkspacePresentation = {
      ...presentation,
      layout,
    };

    this.presentations.set(workspaceId, updated);

    if (
      updated.kind === 'tool' &&
      updated.lifetime === 'persistent' &&
      !this.persistPersistentTools()
    ) {
      this.presentations.set(workspaceId, presentation);
      return null;
    }

    if (this.activeSubject.value?.workspaceId === workspaceId) {
      this.activeSubject.next(updated);
    }

    return updated;
  }

  findSurface(
    workspaceId: string,
    surfaceId: string,
  ): WorkspaceSurface | null {
    const presentation = this.presentations.get(workspaceId);
    if (!presentation) return null;

    let found: WorkspaceSurface | null = null;
    this.mapLayout(presentation.layout, surface => {
      if (!found && surface.id === surfaceId) {
        found = surface;
      }
      return surface;
    });
    return found;
  }

  private mapLayout(
    layout: WorkspaceLayout,
    mapSurface: (surface: WorkspaceSurface) => WorkspaceSurface,
  ): WorkspaceLayout {
    switch (layout.kind) {
      case 'surface':
        return {
          ...layout,
          surface: mapSurface(layout.surface),
        };

      case 'split':
        return {
          ...layout,
          first: this.mapLayout(layout.first, mapSurface),
          second: this.mapLayout(layout.second, mapSurface),
        };

      case 'stack':
        return {
          ...layout,
          surfaces: layout.surfaces.map(mapSurface),
        };
    }
  }

  get(workspaceId: string): WorkspacePresentation | null {
    return this.presentations.get(workspaceId) ?? null;
  }

  private hydratePersistentTools(): void {
    try {
      const raw = localStorage.getItem(PERSISTED_TOOL_WORKSPACES_KEY);
      if (!raw) return;

      const envelope = JSON.parse(raw) as PersistedToolWorkspaceEnvelope;
      if (envelope?.version !== 1 || !Array.isArray(envelope.workspaces)) {
        return;
      }

      for (const presentation of envelope.workspaces) {
        if (
          !presentation?.workspaceId ||
          presentation.kind !== 'tool' ||
          presentation.lifetime !== 'persistent' ||
          !presentation.layout
        ) {
          continue;
        }

        this.presentations.set(
          presentation.workspaceId,
          presentation,
        );
      }
    } catch {
      // Corrupt sidecar persistence must never prevent the file manager opening.
    }
  }

  private persistPersistentTools(): boolean {
    try {
      const envelope: PersistedToolWorkspaceEnvelope = {
        version: 1,
        workspaces: this.listPersistentTools(),
      };
      const serialized = JSON.stringify(envelope);

      if (serialized.length > MAX_PERSISTED_BYTES) {
        return false;
      }

      localStorage.setItem(
        PERSISTED_TOOL_WORKSPACES_KEY,
        serialized,
      );
      return true;
    } catch {
      return false;
    }
  }
}
`````

`````typescript
];

function normalizeExtension(extension: string | null | undefined): string {
  return (extension ?? '').trim().toLowerCase().replace(/^\./, '');
}

export const FILE_CATEGORY_BY_ID = new Map<string, FileCategory>(
  DEFAULT_FILE_CATEGORIES.map((category) => [category.id, category] as const),
);

export const FILE_CATEGORIES_BY_EXTENSION = new Map<string, FileCategory[]>();
export const FILE_CATEGORY_EXTENSIONS = new Set<string>();

for (const category of DEFAULT_FILE_CATEGORIES) {
  for (const extension of category.extensions) {
    const normalized = normalizeExtension(extension);
    if (!normalized) continue;

    FILE_CATEGORY_EXTENSIONS.add(normalized);

    const matches = FILE_CATEGORIES_BY_EXTENSION.get(normalized);
    if (matches) {
      matches.push(category);
    } else {
      FILE_CATEGORIES_BY_EXTENSION.set(normalized, [category]);
    }
  }
}

export function getFileCategoriesForExtension(extension: string | null | undefined): FileCategory[] {
  return FILE_CATEGORIES_BY_EXTENSION.get(normalizeExtension(extension)) ?? [];
}

export function getPrimaryFileCategoryForExtension(extension: string | null | undefined): FileCategory | null {
  return getFileCategoriesForExtension(extension)[0] ?? null;
}

export function hasCollidingFileCategories(extension: string | null | undefined): boolean {
  return getFileCategoriesForExtension(extension).length > 1;
}
`````

`````typescript
/**
 * Enhanced protocol definitions with Phase 1 features:
 * - Tabs
 * - Workspaces
 * - Address Bar
 * - Item Filter
 * - Batch Operations
 * - Progress Tracking
 */

// Re-export everything from the base protocol so consumers only need one import.
export * from './protocol';

// ============================================================================
// Quick Access / Special Folders
// ============================================================================

// ============================================================================
// Tab Management
// ============================================================================

export type LocationKind = 'location' | 'query' | 'surface';

export interface LocationReference {
  location: string;
  scheme: string;
  kind: LocationKind;
}

export interface TabInfo {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  path: string;
  /** Canonical durable navigation target. Legacy workspaces may omit this and fall back to path. */
  location?: LocationReference;
  /** Stable rendered surface id. Legacy workspaces may omit this and fall back to kind. */
  surfaceId?: string;
  /** "dir" (default), "viewer", or "size-manager". Old persisted workspaces omit this field. */
  kind?: 'dir' | 'viewer' | 'size-manager';
  /** Viewer tab payload; only meaningful when kind === 'viewer'. */
  viewer?: {
    /** Absolute filesystem path to the viewed file (initially FS-only). */
    targetPath: string;
    /** Sibling filesystem files from the source pane, used for viewer next/previous navigation. */
    fileList?: ViewerFileListItem[];
    /** Optional explicit viewer selection override. */
    viewerId?: string;
    /** When true, this tab's target auto-follows selection in dir tabs. */
    autoFollow?: boolean;
    /** Origin of this preview (used to restore cursor when switching previews). */
    sourcePane?: 'left' | 'right';
    sourceTabId?: string;
    sourceDir?: string;
    /**
     * Present when the viewed file lives inside an archive.
      * The viewer uses this to call ArchiveRead through the shared VFS-backed
      * archive path instead of ReadFile. Cleared when autoFollow changes the
      * target to a regular filesystem file.
     */
    archiveContext?: {
      /** Outermost archive on disk, e.g. "filesystem://c/foo/archive.zip" */
      fsPath: string;
      /** Nested archive chain, e.g. ["inner.tar.gz"] — empty for flat archives */
      nestedChain: string[];
      /** Entry path inside the innermost archive, e.g. "src/main.go" */
      entryPath: string;
    };
  };
  /** If false, the UI hides the close button. Defaults to true when omitted. */
  isClosable?: boolean;
  isActive: boolean;
  isPinned: boolean;
  createdAt: number;
  /**
   * JSON-encoded per-tab view state (sort, view mode, filter, selection, cursor).
   * Opaque to the backend — produced and consumed by `DirTabStateController`.
   */
  viewStateJson?: string;
}

export interface ViewerFileListItem {
  path: string;
  name: string;
}

export interface PaneState {
  /** e.g. 'left' | 'right' */
  id: string;
  tabs: TabInfo[];
  activeTabId: string;
}

// ============================================================================
// Workspace Management
// ============================================================================

export interface WorkspaceConfig {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  icon?: string;
  color?: string;
  leftPane: PaneState;
  rightPane: PaneState;
  showHidden: boolean;
  /** Which pane held focus when the workspace was last saved. */
  activePaneId?: 'left' | 'right';
  /** Left-pane width as a percentage of the split container (0-100). */
  splitRatio?: number;
  createdAt: number;
  lastAccessedAt: number;
}

export interface WorkspaceList {
  workspaces: WorkspaceConfig[];
  activeWorkspaceId: string;
}

// ============================================================================
// Filter System
// ============================================================================

export enum FilterType {
  NAME = 'name',
  EXTENSION = 'ext',
  TYPE = 'type',
  SIZE = 'size',
  MODIFIED = 'modified',
  GLOB = 'glob',
}

export interface FilterCriteria {
  type: FilterType;
  value: string;
  operator?:
    | 'equals'
    | 'contains'
    | 'startsWith'
    | 'endsWith'
    | 'gt'
    | 'lt'
    | 'gte'
    | 'lte';
}

export interface FilterQuery {
  /** Simple text search across file names */
  text?: string;
  /** Advanced multi-criteria filters */
  criteria?: FilterCriteria[];
  caseSensitive?: boolean;
}

// ============================================================================
// Operation Types (from backend)
// ============================================================================

export type OperationKind = 'copy' | 'move' | 'delete' | 'archive' | 'extract' | 'search' | 'calculate';
export type OperationStatus = 'pending' | 'running' | 'paused' | 'completed' | 'error' | 'cancelled';

export type ConflictResolution = 'skip' | 'overwrite' | 'rename' | 'cancel';

export interface ConflictEvent {
  operationId: string;
  conflictId: string;
  sourcePath: string;
  destPath: string;
  sourceSize: number;
  destSize: number;
  sourceMtime: number;
  destMtime: number;
  isDirectory: boolean;
}

export interface ConflictResolutionRequest {
  resolution: ConflictResolution;
  applyToAll: boolean;
}

// ============================================================================
// Batch Operations
// ============================================================================

export interface BatchItem {
  source: string;
  destination: string;
  exactDestination?: boolean;
}

export interface BatchRequest {
  items: BatchItem[];
  recursive: boolean;
}

export interface BatchAffectedPath {
  source: string;
  destination: string;
}

export interface BatchResult {
  operationId: string;
  total: number;
  succeeded: number;
  skipped: number;
  failed: number;
  errors?: BatchItemError[];
  affectedPaths?: BatchAffectedPath[];
}

export type OperationErrorCode =
  | 'permission_denied'
  | 'not_found'
  | 'disk_full'
  | 'read_only'
  | 'already_exists'
  | 'invalid_path'
  | 'cancelled'
  | 'unknown';

const ERROR_CODE_MESSAGES: Record<OperationErrorCode, string> = {
  permission_denied: 'Permission denied',
  not_found:         'File not found',
  disk_full:         'Disk is full',
  read_only:         'Destination is read-only',
  already_exists:    'File already exists',
  invalid_path:      'Invalid path',
  cancelled:         'Cancelled',
  unknown:           'Unexpected error',
};

/** Returns a short, user-friendly label for the given error code. */
export function operationErrorMessage(code: OperationErrorCode): string {
  return ERROR_CODE_MESSAGES[code] ?? 'Unexpected error';
}

export interface BatchItemError {
  source: string;
  destination?: string;
`````

`````typescript
import { EventsOn } from 'wailsjs/runtime';
import type { FileInfo } from '../../shared/protocol';
import {
  ApiService,
  type DirectoryStreamOptions,
  type DirectoryStreamWindow,
} from '../../services/api.service';

export interface DirStreamMetaEvent {
  streamId: string;
  paneId: string;
  path: string;
  showHidden: boolean;
  sourceCount: number;
  totalCount: number;
  generation: number;
  enumerateMs: number;
}

export interface DirStreamBatchEvent {
  streamId: string;
  generation: number;
  paneId: string;
  path: string;
  entries: FileInfo[];
}

export interface DirStreamDoneEvent {
  streamId: string;
  paneId: string;
  path: string;
  entryCount: number;
  sourceCount: number;
  totalSize: number;
  durationMs: number;
  enumerateMs: number;
  indexMs: number;
  sortMs: number;
  generation: number;
}

export interface DirStreamErrorEvent {
  streamId: string;
  generation: number;
  paneId: string;
  path: string;
  error: string;
}

export interface DirectoryPipelineWindowTiming {
  bridgeMs: number;
  backendWindowMs: number;
}

export interface DirListStreamHandlers {
  onMeta: (event: DirStreamMetaEvent, isFirstMeta: boolean) => void;
  onBatch: (event: DirStreamBatchEvent, baseEntries: FileInfo[]) => void;
  onDone: (event: DirStreamDoneEvent) => void;
  onError: (event: DirStreamErrorEvent) => void;
}

/**
 * Pane-scoped controller that owns the Wails list-dir stream lifecycle:
 * start/cancel/wait + event filtering + base-entry accumulation.
 *
 * pane host stays responsible for converting base entries into
 * view-model entries (parent row, filtering, cursor restore, etc).
 */
export class DirListStreamController {
  private paneId: 'left' | 'right' = 'left';
  private handlers: DirListStreamHandlers | null = null;

  private activeStreamId: string | null = null;
  private metaSeen = false;
  private baseEntries: FileInfo[] = [];
  private pendingBatchEvent: DirStreamBatchEvent | null = null;
  private flushHandle: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null = null;

  private waiters = new Map<string, { resolve: () => void; reject: (err: Error) => void }>();
  private terminals = new Map<string, Error | null>();
  private eventDisposers: Array<() => void> = [];

  constructor(private api: ApiService) {}

  bind(paneId: 'left' | 'right', handlers: DirListStreamHandlers): void {
    this.paneId = paneId;
    this.handlers = handlers;

    this.eventDisposers.forEach(dispose => dispose());
    this.eventDisposers = [
      EventsOn('fs:listStream:meta', (event: DirStreamMetaEvent | null) => {
        this.handleMeta(event);
      }),
      EventsOn('fs:listStream:batch', (event: DirStreamBatchEvent | null) => {
        this.handleBatch(event);
      }),
      EventsOn('fs:listStream:done', (event: DirStreamDoneEvent | null) => {
        this.handleDone(event);
      }),
      EventsOn('fs:listStream:error', (event: DirStreamErrorEvent | null) => {
        this.handleError(event);
      }),
    ];
  }

  async unbind(): Promise<void> {
    await this.cancelActive();
    this.rejectAllWaiters(new Error('Pane disposed'));
    this.handlers = null;
    this.eventDisposers.forEach(dispose => dispose());
    this.eventDisposers = [];
  }

  getActiveStreamId(): string | null {
    return this.activeStreamId;
  }

  async readWindow(
    streamId: string,
    offset: number,
    limit: number,
  ): Promise<DirectoryStreamWindow & { pipelineTiming: DirectoryPipelineWindowTiming }> {
    const started = performance.now();
    const window = await this.api.readListDirectoryStreamWindow(streamId, offset, limit);
    return {
      ...window,
      pipelineTiming: {
        bridgeMs: performance.now() - started,
        backendWindowMs: Math.max(0, Number((window as DirectoryStreamWindow & { windowMs?: number }).windowMs ?? 0)),
      },
    };
  }

  async start(path: string, showHidden: boolean, options?: DirectoryStreamOptions): Promise<string> {
    await this.cancelActive();
    this.baseEntries = [];
    this.metaSeen = false;
    this.terminals.clear();

    const streamId = await this.api.startListDirectoryStream(this.paneId, path, showHidden, options);
    this.activeStreamId = streamId;
    return streamId;
  }

  waitFor(streamId: string): Promise<void> {
    if (this.terminals.has(streamId)) {
      const terminal = this.terminals.get(streamId) ?? null;
      this.terminals.delete(streamId);
      return terminal ? Promise.reject(terminal) : Promise.resolve();
    }

    return new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => {
      this.waiters.set(streamId, { resolve, reject });
    });
  }

  async cancelActive(): Promise<void> {
    const id = this.activeStreamId;
    if (!id) return;

    this.activeStreamId = null;
    this.metaSeen = false;
    this.baseEntries = [];
    this.pendingBatchEvent = null;
    this.cancelScheduledFlush();

    try {
      await this.api.cancelListDirectoryStream(id);
    } catch {
      // ignore
    }
    this.rejectWaiter(id, new Error('Directory stream cancelled'));
  }

  private resolveWaiter(streamId: string): void {
    const waiter = this.waiters.get(streamId);
    if (!waiter) {
      this.terminals.set(streamId, null);
      return;
    }
    this.waiters.delete(streamId);
    waiter.resolve();
  }

  private rejectWaiter(streamId: string, err: Error): void {
    const waiter = this.waiters.get(streamId);
    if (!waiter) {
      this.terminals.set(streamId, err);
      return;
    }
    this.waiters.delete(streamId);
    waiter.reject(err);
  }

  private rejectAllWaiters(err: Error): void {
    for (const [id, waiter] of this.waiters.entries()) {
      this.waiters.delete(id);
      waiter.reject(err);
    }
  }

  private handleMeta(event: DirStreamMetaEvent | null): void {
    if (!event || event.paneId !== this.paneId) return;
    if (!this.activeStreamId || event.streamId !== this.activeStreamId) return;
    if (!this.handlers) return;

    const isFirst = !this.metaSeen;
    this.metaSeen = true;
    this.handlers.onMeta(event, isFirst);
  }

  private handleBatch(event: DirStreamBatchEvent | null): void {
    if (!event || event.paneId !== this.paneId) return;
    if (!this.activeStreamId || event.streamId !== this.activeStreamId) return;
    if (!this.handlers) return;

    const incoming = event.entries || [];
    if (incoming.length > 0) {
      this.baseEntries.push(...incoming);
    }

    // Wails may deliver many 256-entry batches in one renderer turn. Collapse
    // them into at most one Angular-facing update per animation frame. The
    // accumulation array is intentionally stable; consumers must treat it as
    // read-only.
    this.pendingBatchEvent = event;
    this.scheduleFlush();
  }

  private scheduleFlush(): void {
    if (this.flushHandle !== null) return;

    this.flushHandle = setTimeout(() => {
      this.flushHandle = null;
      this.flushPendingBatch();
    }, 0);
  }

  private flushPendingBatch(): void {
    const event = this.pendingBatchEvent;
    const handlers = this.handlers;
    if (!event || !handlers) return;

    this.pendingBatchEvent = null;
    handlers.onBatch(event, this.baseEntries);
  }

  private cancelScheduledFlush(): void {
    if (this.flushHandle === null) return;
    clearTimeout(this.flushHandle);
    this.flushHandle = null;
  }

  private handleDone(event: DirStreamDoneEvent | null): void {
    if (!event || event.paneId !== this.paneId) return;
    if (!this.activeStreamId || event.streamId !== this.activeStreamId) return;
    if (!this.handlers) return;

    this.flushPendingBatch();
    this.handlers.onDone(event);
    this.resolveWaiter(event.streamId);

    // Reset internal state after completion so stale events don't apply.
    this.activeStreamId = null;
    this.metaSeen = false;
    this.pendingBatchEvent = null;
    this.cancelScheduledFlush();
    this.baseEntries = [];
  }

  private handleError(event: DirStreamErrorEvent | null): void {
    if (!event || event.paneId !== this.paneId) return;
    if (!this.activeStreamId || event.streamId !== this.activeStreamId) return;
    if (!this.handlers) return;

    this.handlers.onError(event);
    this.rejectWaiter(event.streamId, new Error(event.error || 'Failed to load directory'));

    this.activeStreamId = null;
    this.metaSeen = false;
    this.pendingBatchEvent = null;
    this.cancelScheduledFlush();
    this.baseEntries = [];
  }
}
`````

`````typescript
  constructor(public readonly tabId: string) {}

  currentPath = '';
  fsParentDir = '';
  showHiddenLoaded: boolean | null = null;

  entries: FileInfo[] = [];
  filteredEntries: FileInfo[] = [];

  selectedFiles: Set<string> = new Set<string>();
  selectionCursorPath: string | null = null;
  selectionAnchorPath: string | null = null;

  loading = false;
  error: string | null = null;

  filterQuery: FilterQuery = { text: '', criteria: [] };

  sortDirection: 'asc' | 'desc' = 'asc';
  directoriesFirst = true;
  colorizeByMime = false;

  lastPreviewTargetEmitted: string | null = null;

  /**
   * Holds restoration intent that hasn't fully landed yet — typically because
   * the directory stream is still running and the persisted selectedPaths /
   * cursor weren't all present in the entries available so far. Cleared once
   * either the user interacts or all paths resolve.
   */
  pendingRestore: {
    selectedPaths: string[];
    cursorPath: string | null;
    anchorPath: string | null;
    scrollTop: number | null;
    expandedPaths: string[];
  } | null = null;

  /** Set the first time the user manually changes selection / cursor / scroll. */
  userInteractedSinceLoad = false;

  getEntriesPaths(): string[] {

    return Array.from(this.optimisticHiddenPaths ?? []);
  }

  setOptimisticHiddenPaths(paths: string[]): void {
    this.optimisticHiddenPaths = new Set((paths ?? []).filter(Boolean));
  }
`````

`````typescript
import { DirTabState } from './dir-tab-state';
import { FilterQuery } from '../../shared/protocol-enhanced';
import { FileInfo } from '../../shared/protocol';

export interface PendingRestoreSlot {
  selectedPaths: string[];
  cursorPath: string | null;
  anchorPath: string | null;
  scrollTop: number | null;
  expandedPaths: string[];
}

export interface DirTabSessionState {
  getEntriesPaths(): string[];
  getOptimisticHiddenPaths(): string[];
  setOptimisticHiddenPaths(paths: string[]): void;

  currentPath: string;
  showHidden: boolean;
  entries: FileInfo[];
  currentView: DirTabState['currentView'];
  sortField: string;
  sortDirection: 'asc' | 'desc';
  directoriesFirst: boolean;
  colorizeByMime: boolean;
  filterQuery: FilterQuery;
  selectedFiles: Set<string>;
  selectionCursorPath: string | null;
  selectionAnchorPath: string | null;
  pendingRestore: PendingRestoreSlot | null;
  userInteractedSinceLoad: boolean;
}

export interface DirTabUiRuntime {
  isInArchive(): boolean;
  getSelectableEntriesPaths(): string[];
  applyFilter(): void;
  scrollToCursorPath(path: string): void;
  emitPreviewTargetFromState(): void;
  getExpandedPaths?(): string[];
  setExpandedPaths?(paths: string[]): void;
  /** Current scroll offset of the file list, or 0 if not measurable. */
  getScrollTop?(): number;
  /** Restore the file list scroll offset (best-effort). */
  setScrollTop?(top: number): void;
}

export interface DirTabRestoreTarget {
  session: DirTabSessionState;
  ui: DirTabUiRuntime;
}

/** Slice of DirTabState that is JSON-serialized for cross-restart persistence. */
export interface PersistedDirTabState {
  /**
   * Bumped whenever the persisted shape changes incompatibly. Older blobs run
   * through DIR_TAB_STATE_MIGRATIONS to upgrade to the current version on load.
   * Missing field is treated as version 0 (the original unversioned shape).
   */
  schemaVersion: number;
  path: string;
  showHidden: boolean;
  currentView: DirTabState['currentView'];
  sortField: string;
  sortDirection: 'asc' | 'desc';
  directoriesFirst: boolean;
  colorizeByMime: boolean;
  filterQuery: DirTabState['filterQuery'];
  selectedPaths: string[];
  cursorPath: string | null;
  anchorPath: string | null;
  scrollTop: number;
  expandedPaths?: string[];
  entries?: FileInfo[];
  optimisticHiddenPaths: string[];
}

export const CURRENT_DIR_TAB_STATE_VERSION = 1;

/**
 * Migrations from version N to N+1. Each entry takes the raw (parsed-JSON)
 * blob produced under version N and returns a blob shaped like version N+1.
 * Add a new entry here whenever the persisted shape changes incompatibly.
 */
export const DIR_TAB_STATE_MIGRATIONS: Record<number, (raw: any) => any> = {
  // 0 → 1: original shape — no field reshapes; just stamp the version.
  0: (raw) => ({ ...raw, schemaVersion: 1 }),
};

function migrateDirTabState(raw: any): Partial<PersistedDirTabState> | null {
  if (!raw || typeof raw !== 'object') return null;
  let working: any = raw;
  let version = typeof working.schemaVersion === 'number' ? working.schemaVersion : 0;
  while (version < CURRENT_DIR_TAB_STATE_VERSION) {
    const migrate = DIR_TAB_STATE_MIGRATIONS[version];
    if (!migrate) {
      // No migration registered — refuse rather than silently mis-interpret.
      return null;
    }
    working = migrate(working);
    version += 1;
  }
  return working as Partial<PersistedDirTabState>;
}

export type DirTabStatePersistCallback = (tabId: string, json: string) => void;

export class DirTabStateController {
  private readonly stateByTabId = new Map<string, DirTabState>();
  private persistCallback: DirTabStatePersistCallback | null = null;

  /** Register a callback invoked whenever a tab's persistable state changes. */
  setPersistCallback(callback: DirTabStatePersistCallback | null): void {
    this.persistCallback = callback;
  }

  save(tabId: string, target: DirTabRestoreTarget): void {
    if (!tabId) return;
    const state: DirTabState = {
      path: target.session.currentPath || '',
      showHidden: !!target.session.showHidden,
      currentView: target.session.currentView,
      sortField: target.session.sortField,
      sortDirection: target.session.sortDirection,
      directoriesFirst: target.session.directoriesFirst,
      colorizeByMime: target.session.colorizeByMime,
      filterQuery: target.session.filterQuery ?? { text: '', criteria: [] },
      selectedPaths: Array.from(target.session.selectedFiles ?? new Set<string>()),
      cursorPath: target.session.selectionCursorPath,
      anchorPath: target.session.selectionAnchorPath,
      scrollTop: Math.max(0, Math.round(target.ui.getScrollTop?.() ?? 0)),
      expandedPaths: Array.isArray(target.ui.getExpandedPaths?.()) ? target.ui.getExpandedPaths?.() ?? [] : [],
      entries: Array.isArray(target.session.entries) ? [...target.session.entries] : [],
      optimisticHiddenPaths: target.session.getOptimisticHiddenPaths(),
    };
    this.stateByTabId.set(tabId, state);

    if (this.persistCallback) {
      try {
        this.persistCallback(tabId, JSON.stringify(this.toPersisted(state)));
      } catch {
        // Persist callbacks must never throw out of save().
      }
    }
  }

  load(tabId: string): DirTabState | null {
    if (!tabId) return null;
    return this.stateByTabId.get(tabId) ?? null;
  }

  /** Seed the in-memory map from a persisted JSON blob (one-shot, on workspace load). */
  hydrateFromJson(tabId: string, json: string | null | undefined): void {
    if (!tabId || !json) return;
    if (this.stateByTabId.has(tabId)) return;
    let parsed: Partial<PersistedDirTabState> | null = null;
    try {
      const raw = JSON.parse(json) as Record<string, unknown>;
      const source = raw && typeof raw === 'object' && 'dir' in raw
        ? raw['dir']
        : raw;
      parsed = migrateDirTabState(source);
    } catch {
      return;
    }
    if (!parsed || typeof parsed !== 'object') return;

    this.stateByTabId.set(tabId, {
      path: parsed.path ?? '',
      showHidden: !!parsed.showHidden,
      currentView: parsed.currentView ?? 'list',
      sortField: parsed.sortField ?? 'name',
      sortDirection: parsed.sortDirection === 'desc' ? 'desc' : 'asc',
      directoriesFirst: !!parsed.directoriesFirst,
      colorizeByMime: !!parsed.colorizeByMime,
      filterQuery: parsed.filterQuery ?? { text: '', criteria: [] },
      selectedPaths: Array.isArray(parsed.selectedPaths) ? parsed.selectedPaths : [],
      cursorPath: parsed.cursorPath ?? null,
      anchorPath: parsed.anchorPath ?? null,
      scrollTop: typeof parsed.scrollTop === 'number' && parsed.scrollTop >= 0 ? parsed.scrollTop : 0,
      expandedPaths: Array.isArray(parsed.expandedPaths) ? parsed.expandedPaths.filter((path): path is string => typeof path === 'string') : [],
      entries: Array.isArray(parsed.entries) ? parsed.entries.map(entry => ({ ...entry })) : [],
      optimisticHiddenPaths: Array.isArray(parsed.optimisticHiddenPaths) ? parsed.optimisticHiddenPaths : [],
    });
  }

  delete(tabId: string): void {
    if (!tabId) return;
    this.stateByTabId.delete(tabId);
    this.persistCallback?.(tabId, '');
  }

  private toPersisted(state: DirTabState): PersistedDirTabState {
    return {
      schemaVersion: CURRENT_DIR_TAB_STATE_VERSION,
      path: state.path,
      showHidden: state.showHidden,
      currentView: state.currentView,
      sortField: state.sortField,
      sortDirection: state.sortDirection,
      directoriesFirst: state.directoriesFirst,
      colorizeByMime: state.colorizeByMime,
      filterQuery: state.filterQuery,
      selectedPaths: state.selectedPaths,
      cursorPath: state.cursorPath,
      anchorPath: state.anchorPath,
      scrollTop: state.scrollTop,
      expandedPaths: [...state.expandedPaths],
      entries: state.entries.map(entry => ({ ...entry })),
      optimisticHiddenPaths: state.optimisticHiddenPaths,
    };
  }

  applyBeforeLoad(state: DirTabState, session: DirTabSessionState): void {
    session.currentPath = state.path;
    session.currentView = state.currentView;
    session.sortField = state.sortField;
    session.sortDirection = state.sortDirection;
    session.directoriesFirst = state.directoriesFirst;
    session.colorizeByMime = state.colorizeByMime ?? false;
    session.filterQuery = state.filterQuery ?? { text: '', criteria: [] };
    session.entries = Array.isArray(state.entries) ? state.entries.map(entry => ({ ...entry })) : [];
  }

  finalizeAfterLoad(state: DirTabState, target: DirTabRestoreTarget): void {
    target.session.setOptimisticHiddenPaths(state.optimisticHiddenPaths ?? []);

    target.session.pendingRestore = {
      selectedPaths: [...(state.selectedPaths ?? [])],
      cursorPath: state.cursorPath ?? null,
      anchorPath: state.anchorPath ?? null,
      scrollTop: typeof state.scrollTop === 'number' ? state.scrollTop : null,
      expandedPaths: [...(state.expandedPaths ?? [])],
    };
    target.session.userInteractedSinceLoad = false;

    target.ui.applyFilter();
    this.applyPendingRestore(target);
  }

  /**
   * Re-attempt restoration of selection, cursor, anchor, scroll position, and
   * tree expansion against whatever entries are currently available. Safe to
   * call multiple times — each pass resolves whichever pending paths are now
   * present and leaves the rest pending for the next call. Bails out if the
   * user has touched the UI since the last load.
   */
  applyPendingRestore(target: DirTabRestoreTarget): void {
    const pending = target.session.pendingRestore;
    if (!pending || target.session.userInteractedSinceLoad) {
      return;
    }

    const present = new Set(target.session.getEntriesPaths());

    const resolvedSelected = pending.selectedPaths.filter(p => present.has(p));
    const stillPendingSelected = pending.selectedPaths.filter(p => !present.has(p));
    // Only seed selection while the user hasn't manually selected anything.
    // Once the user clicks a row, selectedFiles is non-empty and we leave it.
    if (target.session.selectedFiles.size === 0 && resolvedSelected.length > 0) {
      target.session.selectedFiles = new Set(resolvedSelected);
    }

    if (!target.session.selectionCursorPath) {
      if (pending.cursorPath && present.has(pending.cursorPath)) {
        target.session.selectionCursorPath = pending.cursorPath;
      } else if (resolvedSelected.length > 0) {
        target.session.selectionCursorPath = resolvedSelected[resolvedSelected.length - 1];
      } else {
        const selectable = target.ui.getSelectableEntriesPaths();
        if (selectable.length) target.session.selectionCursorPath = selectable[0];
      }
    }

    if (!target.session.selectionAnchorPath) {
      if (pending.anchorPath && present.has(pending.anchorPath)) {
        target.session.selectionAnchorPath = pending.anchorPath;
      } else {
        target.session.selectionAnchorPath = target.session.selectionCursorPath;
      }
    }

    target.ui.setExpandedPaths?.(pending.expandedPaths);

    if (pending.scrollTop !== null && target.ui.setScrollTop) {
      this.deferredApplyScrollTop(target.ui, pending.scrollTop);
    } else if (pending.scrollTop === null && target.session.selectionCursorPath) {
      target.ui.scrollToCursorPath(target.session.selectionCursorPath);
    }

    target.ui.emitPreviewTargetFromState();

    const cursorResolved = !pending.cursorPath || present.has(pending.cursorPath);
    const anchorResolved = !pending.anchorPath || present.has(pending.anchorPath);

    if (stillPendingSelected.length === 0 && cursorResolved && anchorResolved) {
      target.session.pendingRestore = null;
    } else {
      target.session.pendingRestore = {
        selectedPaths: stillPendingSelected,
        cursorPath: cursorResolved ? null : pending.cursorPath,
        anchorPath: anchorResolved ? null : pending.anchorPath,
        // Scroll only applies once; clear after first attempt so future entry
        // changes don't yank the user back to the persisted offset.
        scrollTop: null,
        // Same for expanded paths — set once.
        expandedPaths: [],
      };
    }
  }

  /**
   * setScrollTop runs before Angular has reconciled the new entries, so the
   * scrollable container's content height is often still stale. Try once
   * synchronously, then again on the next frame, then once more after layout
   * has likely settled — drop the attempt if the user has scrolled in between.
   */
  private deferredApplyScrollTop(ui: DirTabUiRuntime, target: number): void {
    if (!ui.setScrollTop) return;
    ui.setScrollTop(target);
    requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      if (!ui.setScrollTop) return;
      const current = ui.getScrollTop?.() ?? 0;
      if (Math.abs(current - target) > 4) {
        ui.setScrollTop(target);
      }
    });
  }
}
`````

`````typescript
import type { TabInfo, ViewerFileListItem } from '../shared/protocol-enhanced';
import type { ViewerArchiveContext } from '../viewers/viewer-archive-context';
import type { DirSurfaceVm } from './dir/dir-surface.vm';
import type { SizeManagerSurfaceVm } from './size-manager/size-manager-surface.vm';

/**
 * Common contract understood by the pane/tab infrastructure.
 *
 * Surface-specific data intentionally lives outside this base shape. A plugin
 * surface can therefore receive a useful context without extending a central
 * union every time a new surface is introduced.
 */
export interface SurfaceContext {
  paneId: 'left' | 'right';
  tab: TabInfo;
  /** Stable surface contribution id, e.g. "dir", "viewer", "console". */
  surfaceId: string;
  /** Built-ins may keep a legacy discriminator while callers migrate. */
  kind?: string;
  [key: string]: unknown;
}

/** Strongly typed extension helper for built-in and plugin-owned surfaces. */
export type SurfaceContextOf<
  TSurfaceId extends string,
  TData extends object = Record<never, never>,
> = SurfaceContext & { surfaceId: TSurfaceId } & TData;

export interface DirSurfaceContext extends SurfaceContext {
  surfaceId: 'dir';
  kind: 'dir';
  dirVm: DirSurfaceVm;
}


export interface SearchResultsSurfaceContext extends SurfaceContext {
  surfaceId: 'search-results';
  kind: 'search-results';
  dirVm: DirSurfaceVm;
}

export interface ViewerSurfaceContext extends SurfaceContext {
  surfaceId: 'viewer';
  kind: 'viewer';
  viewer: {
    targetPath: string;
    fileList: ViewerFileListItem[];
    archiveContext: ViewerArchiveContext | null;
    viewerId: string | null;
  };
}

export interface SizeManagerSurfaceContext extends SurfaceContext {
  surfaceId: 'size-manager';
  kind: 'size-manager';
  sizeVm: SizeManagerSurfaceVm;
}

export function isSurfaceContext<TSurfaceId extends string>(
  ctx: SurfaceContext | null | undefined,
  surfaceId: TSurfaceId,
): ctx is SurfaceContext & { surfaceId: TSurfaceId } {
  return ctx?.surfaceId === surfaceId;
}
`````

`````typescript
import { CommonModule, NgComponentOutlet } from '@angular/common';
import { ChangeDetectionStrategy, ChangeDetectorRef, Component, EventEmitter, Input, OnChanges, Output, Type, ViewChild } from '@angular/core';
import { SurfaceRegistryService } from './surface-registry.service';
import { SurfaceContext } from './surface-context';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-surface-outlet',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [CommonModule],
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
  template: `
    <ng-container *ngIf="component; else empty">
      <ng-container *ngComponentOutlet="component; inputs: outletInputs"></ng-container>
    </ng-container>

    <ng-template #empty>
      <div class="surface-empty"></div>
    </ng-template>
  `,
  styles: [`
    :host {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      flex: 1 1 0%;
      min-height: 0;
      min-width: 0;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .surface-empty {
      flex: 1 1 0%;
      min-height: 0;
    }
  `],
})
export class SurfaceOutletComponent implements OnChanges {
  @Input({ required: true }) ctx!: SurfaceContext;
  @Input() active = false;
  /** Re-emits `firstEntryArrived` from dynamic surfaces so parents may react. */
  @Output() firstEntryArrived = new EventEmitter<void>();
  @Output() viewportChange = new EventEmitter<void>();

  component: Type<unknown> | null = null;
  outletInputs: Record<string, unknown> = {};

  @ViewChild(NgComponentOutlet) private outlet?: NgComponentOutlet;

  private resolveSeq = 0;
  private resolvedSurfaceKey: string | null = null;
  private renderedInputSignature = '';
  private mountedSubscription: { unsubscribe: () => void } | null = null;

  constructor(
    private registry: SurfaceRegistryService,
    private cdr: ChangeDetectorRef,
  ) {}

  ngOnChanges(): void {
    const surfaceKey = this.ctx ? `${this.ctx.surfaceId}:${this.ctx.tab.id}` : 'dir';
    const inputSignature = JSON.stringify(this.ctx ?? null);

    // pane host rebuilds the surface context object on every change
    // detection pass. Reload the dynamic surface only when the surface identity
    // or active tab actually changes; otherwise just push fresh inputs into the
    // mounted one so long-running viewers keep their runtime state.
    if (this.component && this.resolvedSurfaceKey === surfaceKey) {
      if (this.renderedInputSignature !== inputSignature) {
        this.outletInputs = { ctx: this.ctx, active: this.active };
        this.renderedInputSignature = inputSignature;
        this.cdr.markForCheck();

        return;
      }

      this.outletInputs = { ctx: this.ctx, active: this.active };
      this.cdr.markForCheck();
      return;
    }

    const seq = ++this.resolveSeq;
    this.resolvedSurfaceKey = surfaceKey;
    const targetCtx = this.ctx;
    this.renderedInputSignature = inputSignature;
    this.cdr.markForCheck();

    void this.registry.resolve({ tab: targetCtx.tab, context: targetCtx }).then(({ component }) => {
      if (seq !== this.resolveSeq) return;
      this.outletInputs = { ctx: targetCtx, active: this.active };
      this.component = component;
      this.cdr.markForCheck();
      // Give Angular a tick to create the component instance, then wire outputs
      setTimeout(() => {
        const inst = this.mountedInstance;
        if (!inst) return;
        // Clean up previous subscription
        try { this.mountedSubscription?.unsubscribe(); } catch {}
        const subscriptions: Array<{ unsubscribe: () => void }> = [];
        if (inst.firstEntryArrived && typeof inst.firstEntryArrived.subscribe === 'function') {
          subscriptions.push(inst.firstEntryArrived.subscribe(() => this.firstEntryArrived.emit()));
        }
        if (inst.viewportChange && typeof inst.viewportChange.subscribe === 'function') {
          subscriptions.push(inst.viewportChange.subscribe(() => this.viewportChange.emit()));
        }
        this.mountedSubscription = subscriptions.length
          ? { unsubscribe: () => subscriptions.forEach(subscription => subscription.unsubscribe()) }
          : null;
      }, 0);
    }).catch(() => {
      if (seq !== this.resolveSeq) return;
      this.resolvedSurfaceKey = null;
      this.renderedInputSignature = '';
      this.component = null;
      this.cdr.markForCheck();
    });
  }

  // Proxy access used by pane host for keyboard commands.
  private get mountedInstance(): any {
    return (this.outlet as any)?.componentInstance ?? null;
  }
  get addressBar() { return this.mountedInstance?.addressBar; }
  get fileViewContainer() { return this.mountedInstance?.fileViewContainer; }
  get findWidget() { return this.mountedInstance?.findWidget; }
  get viewerHost() { return this.mountedInstance?.viewerHost; }
  get viewer() { return this.viewerHost?.mountedViewer; }

  supports(method: string): boolean {
    return typeof this.mountedInstance?.[method] === 'function';
  }

  invoke(method: string, ...args: unknown[]): unknown {
    const fn = this.mountedInstance?.[method];
    if (typeof fn !== 'function') return undefined;
    return fn.apply(this.mountedInstance, args);
  }

  focus(): void {
    const instance = this.mountedInstance as any;
    if (typeof instance?.focus === 'function') {
      instance.focus();
      return;
    }

    const element =
      instance?.elementRef?.nativeElement ??
      instance?.host?.nativeElement ??
      null;

    element?.focus?.({ preventScroll: true });
  }
}
`````

`````typescript
import { Injectable, Type } from '@angular/core';
import { ContributionRegistry } from '../plugin/contribution-registry';
import { SurfaceCapability, SurfaceContribution, SurfaceRequest } from './surface-contribution';
import { DirSurfaceTabComponent } from './builtins/dir-surface-tab.component';
import { SearchResultsSurfaceTabComponent } from './builtins/search-results-surface-tab.component';
import { ViewerSurfaceTabComponent } from './builtins/viewer-surface-tab.component';
import { SizeManagerSurfaceTabComponent } from './size-manager/size-manager-surface-tab.component';
import { DuplicateFinderSurfaceTabComponent } from './builtins/duplicate-finder-surface-tab.component';

function tabSurfaceId(req: SurfaceRequest): string {
  return req.tab.surfaceId ?? req.tab.kind ?? 'dir';
}

@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })
export class SurfaceRegistryService {
  readonly registry = new ContributionRegistry<SurfaceContribution, SurfaceRequest>();

  constructor() {
    this.register({
      id: 'dir',
      capabilities: ['navigate', 'selection', 'fileOperations', 'preview'],
      score: (req) => (tabSurfaceId(req) === 'dir' ? 100 : 0),
      load: () => DirSurfaceTabComponent,
    });

    this.register({
      id: 'search-results',
      capabilities: ['selection', 'fileOperations', 'preview'],
      score: (req) => (tabSurfaceId(req) === 'search-results' ? 100 : 0),
      load: () => SearchResultsSurfaceTabComponent,
    });

    this.register({
      id: 'viewer',
      capabilities: ['viewerControls'],
      score: (req) => (tabSurfaceId(req) === 'viewer' ? 100 : 0),
      load: () => ViewerSurfaceTabComponent,
    });

    this.register({
      id: 'size-manager',
      capabilities: ['navigate'],
      score: (req) => (tabSurfaceId(req) === 'size-manager' ? 100 : 0),
      load: () => SizeManagerSurfaceTabComponent,
    });

    this.register({
      id: 'duplicates',
      capabilities: [],
      score: (req) => (tabSurfaceId(req) === 'duplicates' ? 100 : 0),
      load: () => DuplicateFinderSurfaceTabComponent,
    });
  }

  register(c: SurfaceContribution): void {
    this.registry.register(c);
  }

  unregister(id: string): void {
    this.registry.unregister(id);
  }

  async resolve(req: SurfaceRequest): Promise<{ id: string; component: Type<unknown> }> {
    const id = tabSurfaceId(req);
    const exact = this.registry.list().find((candidate) => candidate.id === id);
    if (exact) {
      return { id: exact.id, component: await exact.load() };
    }
    return this.registry.resolve(req);
  }

  getCapabilities(req: SurfaceRequest): ReadonlySet<SurfaceCapability> {
    const id = tabSurfaceId(req);
    const exact = this.registry.list().find((candidate) => candidate.id === id);
    if (exact) {
      return new Set(exact.capabilities ?? []);
    }

    let best: SurfaceContribution | null = null;
    let bestScore = 0;
    for (const candidate of this.registry.list()) {
      const score = candidate.score(req);
      if (score > bestScore) {
        best = candidate;
        bestScore = score;
      }
    }
    return new Set(best?.capabilities ?? []);
  }

  list(): readonly SurfaceContribution[] {
    return this.registry.list();
  }
}
`````
