`````typescript
import type { TabInfo } from '../shared/protocol-enhanced';

export const BUILTIN_SURFACE_IDS = {
  dir: 'dir',
  viewer: 'viewer',
  sizeManager: 'size-manager',
  searchResults: 'search-results',
} as const;

export function legacyKindSurfaceId(kind: TabInfo['kind']): string {
  if (kind === 'viewer') return BUILTIN_SURFACE_IDS.viewer;
  if (kind === 'size-manager') return BUILTIN_SURFACE_IDS.sizeManager;
  return BUILTIN_SURFACE_IDS.dir;
}

export function tabSurfaceId(tab: Pick<TabInfo, 'surfaceId' | 'kind'>): string {
  return tab.surfaceId?.trim() || legacyKindSurfaceId(tab.kind);
}

export function tabLocation(tab: Pick<TabInfo, 'location' | 'path'>): string {
  return tab.location?.location?.trim() || tab.path?.trim() || '';
}
export function isDirectoryBackedSurfaceId(surfaceId: string): boolean {
  return surfaceId === BUILTIN_SURFACE_IDS.dir || surfaceId === BUILTIN_SURFACE_IDS.searchResults;
}
`````

`````typescript
type AnyFunction = (...args: any[]) => any;

export type MockSpy<T extends AnyFunction = AnyFunction> = jasmine.Spy & T & {
  mockImplementation(impl: T): MockSpy<T>;
  mockResolvedValue(value: Awaited<ReturnType<T>>): MockSpy<T>;
  mockRejectedValue(error: unknown): MockSpy<T>;
  mockRestore(): void;
};

const globalRestorers: Array<() => void> = [];

function enhanceSpy<T extends AnyFunction>(spy: jasmine.Spy): MockSpy<T> {
  const enhanced = spy as MockSpy<T>;

  enhanced.mockImplementation = (impl: T) => {
    spy.and.callFake(impl);
    return enhanced;
  };

  enhanced.mockResolvedValue = (value: Awaited<ReturnType<T>>) => {
    spy.and.returnValue(Promise.resolve(value));
    return enhanced;
  };

  enhanced.mockRejectedValue = (error: unknown) => {
    spy.and.returnValue(Promise.reject(error));
    return enhanced;
  };

  enhanced.mockRestore = () => {
    spy.and.callThrough();
  };

  return enhanced;
}

export function fn<T extends AnyFunction = AnyFunction>(impl?: T): MockSpy<T> {
  const spy = jasmine.createSpy('fn');
  const enhanced = enhanceSpy<T>(spy);
  if (impl) {
    enhanced.mockImplementation(impl);
  }
  return enhanced;
}

export function spyOnFn<T extends Record<string, any>, K extends keyof T & string>(
  target: T,
  method: K,
): MockSpy<Extract<T[K], AnyFunction>> {
  return enhanceSpy<Extract<T[K], AnyFunction>>(spyOn(target, method));
}

export function stubGlobal(name: string, value: unknown): void {
  const hadOwn = Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(globalThis, name);
  const descriptor = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(globalThis, name);
  const previousValue = (globalThis as Record<string, unknown>)[name];

  globalRestorers.push(() => {
    if (descriptor) {
      Object.defineProperty(globalThis, name, descriptor);
      return;
    }

    if (hadOwn) {
      Object.defineProperty(globalThis, name, {
        configurable: true,
        writable: true,
        value: previousValue,
      });
      return;
    }

    delete (globalThis as Record<string, unknown>)[name];
  });

  Object.defineProperty(globalThis, name, {
    configurable: true,
    writable: true,
    value,
  });
}

export function restoreGlobals(): void {
  while (globalRestorers.length > 0) {
    globalRestorers.pop()?.();
  }
}
`````

## File: manager/frontend/src/app/utils/attribute-flags.ts
`````typescript
/** Native attribute flag presentation, mirroring the Permissions column style.
 *
 * The filesystem provider reports Windows attribute flags as concatenated
 * characters in fixed order R, H, S, A (only set flags present — see
 * platform.FormatFileAttributes). This helper renders them positionally with
 * '-' placeholders so the column reads like a permission mask: 'RS' -> 'R-S-'.
 * Unix providers report no attribute characters; empty input stays empty.
 */
const ATTRIBUTE_FLAG_ORDER = ['R', 'H', 'S', 'A'] as const;

export function formatAttributeFlags(value: unknown): string {
  const raw = typeof value === 'string' ? value.trim().toUpperCase() : '';
  if (!raw) return '';
  const order: readonly string[] = ATTRIBUTE_FLAG_ORDER;
  const set = new Set(raw.split('').filter(ch => order.includes(ch)));
  if (set.size === 0) return '';
  return ATTRIBUTE_FLAG_ORDER.map(flag => (set.has(flag) ? flag : '-')).join('');
}
`````

## File: manager/frontend/src/app/utils/focus-navigation.utils.ts
`````typescript
const FOCUSABLE_SELECTOR = [
  'a[href]',
  'button:not([disabled])',
  'input:not([disabled]):not([type="hidden"])',
  'select:not([disabled])',
  'textarea:not([disabled])',
  '[contenteditable="true"]',
  '[tabindex]:not([tabindex="-1"])',
].join(', ');

function isFocusable(element: HTMLElement): boolean {
  if (!element.isConnected || element.tabIndex < 0) return false;
  if (element.hasAttribute('disabled') || element.getAttribute('aria-disabled') === 'true') return false;
  if (element.closest('[hidden], [inert], [aria-hidden="true"]')) return false;
  const style = getComputedStyle(element);
  return style.display !== 'none' &&
    style.visibility !== 'hidden' &&
    style.visibility !== 'collapse' &&
    element.getClientRects().length > 0;
}

export function moveFocusWithin(
  container: HTMLElement,
  delta: number,
  selector?: string,
): boolean {
  const candidates = Array.from(
    container.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>(selector || FOCUSABLE_SELECTOR),
  ).filter(isFocusable);

  if (!candidates.length) {
    container.focus();
    return false;
  }

  const active = document.activeElement instanceof HTMLElement
    ? document.activeElement
    : null;
  const current = active && container.contains(active)
    ? candidates.indexOf(active)
    : -1;
  const next = current >= 0
    ? (current + delta + candidates.length) % candidates.length
    : (delta >= 0 ? 0 : candidates.length - 1);

  candidates[next]?.focus();
  return true;
}
`````

`````typescript
import { SampleInfo } from '../../services/canvas-video-player.service';

/**
 * findPacketIndex tests — pure function for locating packets by timestamp
 */

// Export test utilities (these would be copy-pasted from segment-video-loader.ts for testing)
function findPacketIndex(packets: SampleInfo[], timeMs: number, requireKeyframe: boolean): number {
  let bestIndex = -1;
  
  if (requireKeyframe) {
    // Find the keyframe with timestamp <= timeMs (for backward seeks)
    for (let index = 0; index < packets.length; index += 1) {
      const packet = packets[index];
      if (packet.isRap && packet.timestampMs <= timeMs) {
        bestIndex = index;
      } else if (packet.timestampMs > timeMs && bestIndex >= 0) {
        break;
      }
    }
    
    if (bestIndex >= 0) {
      return bestIndex;
    }
    
    // If no keyframe before, find first keyframe
    return packets.findIndex(packet => packet.isRap);
  }
  
  // Regular forward seek - find first packet >= timeMs
  for (let index = 0; index < packets.length; index += 1) {
    if (packets[index].timestampMs >= timeMs) {
      return index;
    }
  }
  
  return packets.length > 0 ? packets.length - 1 : -1;
}

const mockPacket = (index: number, timestampMs: number, isRap: boolean): SampleInfo => ({
  index,
  timestampMs,
  durationMs: 33.33,
  isRap,
  data: new Uint8Array(0),
});

describe('findPacketIndex', () => {
  describe('forward seeks (requireKeyframe=false)', () => {
    it('should return -1 for empty packet list', () => {
      expect(findPacketIndex([], 500, false)).toBe(-1);
    });

    it('should return 0 for time before first packet', () => {
      const packets = [mockPacket(0, 100, true), mockPacket(1, 200, false)];
      expect(findPacketIndex(packets, 50, false)).toBe(0);
    });

    it('should find exact timestamp match', () => {
      const packets = [mockPacket(0, 100, true), mockPacket(1, 200, false), mockPacket(2, 300, true)];
      expect(findPacketIndex(packets, 200, false)).toBe(1);
    });

    it('should find first packet >= target time', () => {
      const packets = [mockPacket(0, 100, true), mockPacket(1, 200, false), mockPacket(2, 300, true)];
      // Target 150 should return packet at 200 (index 1)
      expect(findPacketIndex(packets, 150, false)).toBe(1);
    });

    it('should return last packet for time beyond all packets', () => {
      const packets = [mockPacket(0, 100, true), mockPacket(1, 200, false)];
      expect(findPacketIndex(packets, 500, false)).toBe(1);
    });

    it('should handle single packet', () => {
      const packets = [mockPacket(0, 100, true)];
      expect(findPacketIndex(packets, 150, false)).toBe(0);
    });
  });

  describe('backward seeks (requireKeyframe=true)', () => {
    it('should return -1 for empty packet list', () => {
      expect(findPacketIndex([], 500, true)).toBe(-1);
    });

    it('should find last keyframe <= target time', () => {
      const packets = [
        mockPacket(0, 100, true),
        mockPacket(1, 150, false),
        mockPacket(2, 200, true),

    });

    it('should handle all keyframes', () => {
      const packets = [
        mockPacket(0, 100, true),
        mockPacket(1, 200, true),
        mockPacket(2, 300, true),
      ];
      expect(findPacketIndex(packets, 250, true)).toBe(1);
    });

    it('should handle no keyframes', () => {
      const packets = [

        mockPacket(1, 200, false),
      ];
      // Should return first keyframe (-1) since none exist

    });

    it('should return exact keyframe match', () => {

        mockPacket(3, 170, false),

      expect(findPacketIndex(packets, 165, true)).toBe(0);
    });

  describe('edge cases', () => {

      const packets = [

        mockPacket(1, 2_000_000_000, false),

      ];
      // Note: the actual function doesn't clamp, so this tests current behavior

});

/**
 * collectPackets simulation tests
 */
describe('collectPackets pattern', () => {
  it('should preserve packet offsets when collecting', () => {
    const source: SampleInfo[] = [
      mockPacket(0, 0, true),
      mockPacket(1, 33, false),
      mockPacket(2, 66, true),
    ];

    const collected: SampleInfo[] = [];
    let cursor: SampleInfo | null = source[0];
    const timeOffsetMs = 1000;

    while (cursor) {
      collected.push({
        ...cursor,
        timestampMs: cursor.timestampMs + timeOffsetMs,
      });
      const nextIndex: number = source.indexOf(cursor) + 1;
      cursor = nextIndex < source.length ? source[nextIndex] : null;
    }

    // Verify offset was applied
    expect(collected[0].timestampMs).toBe(1000);
    expect(collected[1].timestampMs).toBe(1033);
    expect(collected[2].timestampMs).toBe(1066);
  });
});

/**
 * Segment index calculation tests
 */
describe('segment timing calculations', () => {
  const SEGMENT_DURATION = 2.0; // seconds

  function findSegmentIndex(timeMs: number, totalSegments: number, segmentDuration = SEGMENT_DURATION): number {
    for (let index = 0; index < totalSegments; index += 1) {
      const startMs = Math.round(index * segmentDuration * 1000);
      const endMs = startMs + Math.round(segmentDuration * 1000);
      if (timeMs < endMs) {
        return index;
      }
    }
    return Math.max(0, totalSegments - 1);
  }

  it('should find correct segment for times within range', () => {
    const totalSegments = 10;
    expect(findSegmentIndex(0, totalSegments)).toBe(0);
    expect(findSegmentIndex(1000, totalSegments)).toBe(0);
    expect(findSegmentIndex(2000, totalSegments)).toBe(1);
    expect(findSegmentIndex(4000, totalSegments)).toBe(2);
  });

  it('should return last segment for times beyond duration', () => {
    const totalSegments = 10;
    const duration = totalSegments * SEGMENT_DURATION * 1000; // 20 seconds in ms
    expect(findSegmentIndex(duration + 1000, totalSegments)).toBe(totalSegments - 1);
  });

  it('should handle boundary between segments', () => {
    const totalSegments = 5;
    // Boundary is at 2000ms
    expect(findSegmentIndex(1999, totalSegments)).toBe(0);
    expect(findSegmentIndex(2000, totalSegments)).toBe(1);
    expect(findSegmentIndex(2001, totalSegments)).toBe(1);
  });
});

/**
 * Backward vs forward seek parity tests
 */
describe('backward vs forward seek consistency', () => {
  it('seeking backward then forward to same time should find same packet', () => {
    const packets = [
      mockPacket(0, 0, true),
      mockPacket(1, 100, false),
      mockPacket(2, 200, true),
      mockPacket(3, 300, false),
      mockPacket(4, 400, true),
    ];

    // Forward seek to 250: should find packet at 300 (index 3)
    const forwardIndex = findPacketIndex(packets, 250, false);
    // Backward seek to 250: should find keyframe at 200 (index 2)
    const backwardIndex = findPacketIndex(packets, 250, true);

    // They're different (forward finds next, backward finds last keyframe)
    // but both should be valid
    expect(forwardIndex).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(0);
    expect(backwardIndex).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(0);
    expect(packets[forwardIndex].timestampMs).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(250);
    expect(packets[backwardIndex].timestampMs).toBeLessThanOrEqual(250);
  });

  it('backward seek should not skip to future keyframes', () => {
    const packets = [
      mockPacket(0, 0, true),
      mockPacket(1, 100, false),
      mockPacket(2, 200, false),
      mockPacket(3, 300, true),
      mockPacket(4, 400, false),
    ];

    // Seeking backward to 250 should find keyframe at 0, not 300
    const index = findPacketIndex(packets, 250, true);
    expect(packets[index].timestampMs).toBeLessThanOrEqual(250);
  });
});
`````

`````typescript
import {
  DemuxedAudioTrackSource,
  DemuxedPacketCursor,
  DemuxedVideoSource,
  ExtendedVideoDecoderConfig,
  SampleInfo,
  VideoMetadata,
  loadMp4DemuxedSourceFromBuffer,
} from '../../services/canvas-video-player.service';
import { createSubject, distinctUntilChanged } from '@epikodelabs/streamix';

interface SegmentedVideoManifestItem {
  index: number;
  startTime: number;
  durationSeconds: number;
  url: string;
}

interface SegmentedVideoManifest {
  mode: 'segmented';
  format: string;
  durationSeconds: number;
  segmentDuration: number;
  totalSegments: number;
  initSegmentUrl: string;
  segments: SegmentedVideoManifestItem[];
}

interface LoadedSegment {
  index: number;
  videoPackets: SampleInfo[];
  audioPackets: SampleInfo[];
}

interface PacketToken {
  segmentIndex: number;
  packetIndex: number;
}

const SEGMENT_PREFETCH_AHEAD = 3;
const SEGMENT_RETENTION_BEHIND = 6;
const SEGMENT_RETENTION_AHEAD = 6;

export class SegmentVideoLoader {
  private manifest: SegmentedVideoManifest | null = null;
  private initSegment: ArrayBuffer | null = null;
  private readonly loadedSegments = new Map<number, LoadedSegment>();
  private readonly pendingSegments = new Map<number, Promise<LoadedSegment>>();
  private readonly pendingSegmentControllers = new Map<number, AbortController>();
  private readonly anchorRequests$ = createSubject<number>();
  private readonly segmentFetches$ = createSubject<number>();
  private metadata: VideoMetadata | null = null;
  private decoderConfig: ExtendedVideoDecoderConfig | null = null;
  private audioMeta: Omit<DemuxedAudioTrackSource, 'getFirstPacket' | 'getPacketForTime' | 'getNextPacket'> | null = null;
  private activeWindowGeneration = 0;
  private currentAnchorIndex = 0;
  private disposed = false;
  private loadController: AbortController | null = null;
  // Segments that recently failed to load — keyed to the failure timestamp.
  // Prevents the render loop from hammering the server on permanent errors.
  private readonly failedSegments = new Map<number, number>();
  private static readonly SEGMENT_FAILURE_COOLDOWN_MS = 5000;

  constructor() {
    // Anchor changes cancel stale prefetch work and update window
    this.anchorRequests$
      .pipe(distinctUntilChanged())
      .subscribe((anchorIndex: number) => {
        this.currentAnchorIndex = anchorIndex;
        this.activeWindowGeneration += 1;
        this.abortPendingOutsideWindow(anchorIndex);
        this.pruneLoadedSegments(anchorIndex);
      });

    // Track segment fetch attempts for concurrency management
    // Deduplicate rapid successive requests for same segment
    this.segmentFetches$
      .pipe(distinctUntilChanged())
      .subscribe();
  }

  async load(manifestUrl: string): Promise<DemuxedVideoSource> {
    this.dispose();
    this.disposed = false;
    this.loadController = new AbortController();

    const manifestResponse = await fetch(manifestUrl, { signal: this.loadController.signal });
    if (!manifestResponse.ok) {
      throw new Error(`Failed to load segment manifest: ${manifestResponse.status}`);
    }

    this.manifest = await manifestResponse.json() as SegmentedVideoManifest;

    const initResponse = await fetch(this.manifest.initSegmentUrl, { signal: this.loadController.signal });
    if (!initResponse.ok) {
      throw new Error(`Failed to load init segment: ${initResponse.status}`);
    }
    this.initSegment = await initResponse.arrayBuffer();

    const initialWindowGeneration = this.activateWindow(0);
    const firstSegment = await this.ensureSegmentLoaded(0, initialWindowGeneration);
    this.prefetchAround(0, initialWindowGeneration);
    if (!this.metadata || !this.decoderConfig) {
      throw new Error('Segmented preview did not provide video metadata.');
    }

    return {
      metadata: this.metadata,
      decoderConfig: this.decoderConfig,
      audio: this.audioMeta ? {
        ...this.audioMeta,
        getFirstPacket: async () => this.getFirstAudioPacket(),
        getPacketForTime: async (timeMs: number) => this.getAudioPacketForTime(timeMs),
        getNextPacket: async (cursor: DemuxedPacketCursor) => this.getNextAudioPacket(cursor),
      } : undefined,
      supportsRandomAccess: true,
      getFirstPacket: async () => firstSegment.videoPackets.length > 0 ? this.makeCursor(0, 0, firstSegment.videoPackets) : null,
      getPacketForTime: async (timeMs: number, options?: { keyframe?: boolean }) => this.getPacketForTime(timeMs, options),
      getNextPacket: async (cursor: DemuxedPacketCursor) => this.getNextPacket(cursor),
      destroy: () => this.dispose(),
    };
  }

  private async ensureSegmentLoaded(index: number, windowGeneration = this.activeWindowGeneration): Promise<LoadedSegment> {
    const existing = this.loadedSegments.get(index);
    if (existing) {
      return existing;
    }

    // Refuse to retry a recently-failed segment so the render loop
    // cannot hammer the server at 60 fps on a permanent 500 error.
    const failedAt = this.failedSegments.get(index);
    if (failedAt !== undefined) {
      if (Date.now() - failedAt < SegmentVideoLoader.SEGMENT_FAILURE_COOLDOWN_MS) {
        throw new Error(`Segment ${index} failed to load recently`);
      }
      this.failedSegments.delete(index);
    }

    const pending = this.pendingSegments.get(index);
    if (pending) {
      return pending;
    }

    // Create and store promise synchronously to prevent duplicate fetches
    // Multiple concurrent requesters will share this same promise
    const loadPromise = this.loadSegment(index);
    this.pendingSegments.set(index, loadPromise);

    this.segmentFetches$.next(index);

    try {
      const segment = await loadPromise;
      this.loadedSegments.set(index, segment);
      return segment;
    } catch (err) {
      // Cache the failure unless it was an intentional abort (seek/dispose).
      if (!(err instanceof DOMException && err.name === 'AbortError')) {
        this.failedSegments.set(index, Date.now());
      }
      throw err;
    } finally {
      this.pendingSegments.delete(index);
    }
  }

  private async loadSegment(index: number): Promise<LoadedSegment> {
    if (!this.manifest || !this.initSegment) {
      throw new Error('Segment loader not initialized.');
    }
    if (this.disposed) {
      throw new DOMException('Segment loader disposed', 'AbortError');
    }

    const segment = this.manifest.segments[index];
    if (!segment) {
      throw new Error(`Segment ${index} is not available.`);
    }

    const controller = new AbortController();
    this.pendingSegmentControllers.set(index, controller);

    try {
      const segmentResponse = await fetch(segment.url, { signal: controller.signal });
      if (!segmentResponse.ok) {
        throw new Error(`Failed to load segment ${index}: ${segmentResponse.status}`);
      }

      const segmentBytes = await segmentResponse.arrayBuffer();
      const combined = concatenateBuffers(this.initSegment, segmentBytes);
      const source = await loadMp4DemuxedSourceFromBuffer(combined);

      if (!this.metadata) {
        const manifestDurationMs = this.manifest.durationSeconds > 0 ? this.manifest.durationSeconds * 1000 : 0;
        this.metadata = {
          ...source.metadata,
          duration: manifestDurationMs > 0 ? manifestDurationMs : source.metadata.duration,
          format: this.manifest.format || source.metadata.format,
        };
        this.decoderConfig = source.decoderConfig;
        if (source.audio) {
          this.audioMeta = {
            decoderConfig: source.audio.decoderConfig,
            codec: source.audio.codec,
            sampleRate: source.audio.sampleRate,
            numberOfChannels: source.audio.numberOfChannels,
          };
        }
      }

      const startOffsetMs = segment.startTime * 1000;
      const videoPackets = await collectPackets(
        () => source.getFirstPacket(),
        (cursor) => source.getNextPacket(cursor),
        startOffsetMs,
      );
      const audioPackets = source.audio
        ? await collectPackets(
            () => source.audio!.getFirstPacket(),
            (cursor) => source.audio!.getNextPacket(cursor),
            startOffsetMs,
          )
        : [];
      source.destroy?.();

      return { index, videoPackets, audioPackets };
    } finally {
      this.pendingSegmentControllers.delete(index);
    }
  }

  private async getPacketForTime(timeMs: number, options?: { keyframe?: boolean }): Promise<DemuxedPacketCursor | null> {
    if (!this.manifest) {
      return null;
    }

    let segmentIndex = this.findSegmentIndex(timeMs);
    const windowGeneration = this.activateWindow(segmentIndex);
    const maxBackwardSegments = options?.keyframe ? 5 : 1;
    let backwardAttempts = 0;

    while (segmentIndex >= 0 && backwardAttempts <= maxBackwardSegments) {
      let segment: LoadedSegment;
      try {
        segment = await this.ensureSegmentLoaded(segmentIndex, windowGeneration);
      } catch {
        // Segment failed to load — if we're searching for a keyframe walk
        // backward to the previous segment rather than propagating the error.
        if (!options?.keyframe) {
          break;
        }
        segmentIndex -= 1;
        backwardAttempts += 1;
        continue;
      }
      const packetIndex = findPacketIndex(segment.videoPackets, timeMs, options?.keyframe === true);
      if (packetIndex >= 0) {
        if (this.isActiveWindow(windowGeneration)) {
          this.prefetchAround(segmentIndex, windowGeneration);
        }
        return this.makeCursor(segmentIndex, packetIndex, segment.videoPackets);
      }

      if (!options?.keyframe) {
        break;
      }

      segmentIndex -= 1;
      backwardAttempts += 1;
    }
    return null;
  }

  private async getNextPacket(cursor: DemuxedPacketCursor): Promise<DemuxedPacketCursor | null> {
    const token = cursor.token as PacketToken;
    const windowGeneration = this.activeWindowGeneration;
    const segment = await this.ensureSegmentLoaded(token.segmentIndex, windowGeneration);
    const nextPacketIndex = token.packetIndex + 1;
    if (nextPacketIndex < segment.videoPackets.length) {
      return this.makeCursor(token.segmentIndex, nextPacketIndex, segment.videoPackets);
    }

    if (!this.manifest || token.segmentIndex + 1 >= this.manifest.totalSegments) {
      return null;
    }

    const nextSegmentIndex = token.segmentIndex + 1;
    const nextWindowGeneration = this.activateWindow(nextSegmentIndex);
    const nextSegment = await this.ensureSegmentLoaded(nextSegmentIndex, nextWindowGeneration);
    if (this.isActiveWindow(nextWindowGeneration)) {
      this.prefetchAround(nextSegmentIndex, nextWindowGeneration);
      }
    return nextSegment.videoPackets.length > 0
      ? this.makeCursor(nextSegmentIndex, 0, nextSegment.videoPackets)
      : null;
  }

  private async getFirstAudioPacket(): Promise<DemuxedPacketCursor | null> {
      const segment = await this.ensureSegmentLoaded(0, this.activeWindowGeneration);
    return segment.audioPackets.length > 0 ? this.makeCursor(0, 0, segment.audioPackets) : null;
  }

  private async getAudioPacketForTime(timeMs: number): Promise<DemuxedPacketCursor | null> {
    if (!this.manifest) {
      return null;
    }

    const segmentIndex = this.findSegmentIndex(timeMs);
      const windowGeneration = this.activeWindowGeneration;
      const segment = await this.ensureSegmentLoaded(segmentIndex, windowGeneration);
    const packetIndex = findPacketIndex(segment.audioPackets, timeMs, false);
      if (packetIndex >= 0 && this.isActiveWindow(windowGeneration)) {
        this.prefetchAround(segmentIndex, windowGeneration);
      }
    return packetIndex >= 0 ? this.makeCursor(segmentIndex, packetIndex, segment.audioPackets) : null;
  }

  private async getNextAudioPacket(cursor: DemuxedPacketCursor): Promise<DemuxedPacketCursor | null> {
    const token = cursor.token as PacketToken;
      const windowGeneration = this.activeWindowGeneration;
      const segment = await this.ensureSegmentLoaded(token.segmentIndex, windowGeneration);
    const nextPacketIndex = token.packetIndex + 1;
    if (nextPacketIndex < segment.audioPackets.length) {
      return this.makeCursor(token.segmentIndex, nextPacketIndex, segment.audioPackets);
    }

    if (!this.manifest || token.segmentIndex + 1 >= this.manifest.totalSegments) {
      return null;
    }

    const nextSegmentIndex = token.segmentIndex + 1;
    const nextWindowGeneration = this.activateWindow(nextSegmentIndex);
    const nextSegment = await this.ensureSegmentLoaded(nextSegmentIndex, nextWindowGeneration);
    if (this.isActiveWindow(nextWindowGeneration)) {
      this.prefetchAround(nextSegmentIndex, nextWindowGeneration);
      }
    return nextSegment.audioPackets.length > 0
      ? this.makeCursor(nextSegmentIndex, 0, nextSegment.audioPackets)
      : null;
  }

  private prefetchAround(anchorIndex: number, windowGeneration: number): void {
    if (!this.manifest) {
      return;
    }

    if (!this.isActiveWindow(windowGeneration)) {
      return;
    }

    // Prefetch forward
    for (let offset = 1; offset <= SEGMENT_PREFETCH_AHEAD; offset += 1) {
      const nextIndex = anchorIndex + offset;
      if (nextIndex >= this.manifest.totalSegments) {
        break;
      }
      if (this.loadedSegments.has(nextIndex) || this.pendingSegments.has(nextIndex)) {
        continue;
      }
      void this.ensureSegmentLoaded(nextIndex, windowGeneration).catch(() => {});
    }
    
    // Also prefetch backward when we're in the middle of the video
    if (anchorIndex > SEGMENT_PREFETCH_AHEAD) {
      for (let offset = 1; offset <= SEGMENT_PREFETCH_AHEAD; offset += 1) {
        const prevIndex = anchorIndex - offset;
        if (prevIndex < 0) {
          break;
        }
        if (this.loadedSegments.has(prevIndex) || this.pendingSegments.has(prevIndex)) {
          continue;
        }
        void this.ensureSegmentLoaded(prevIndex, windowGeneration).catch(() => {});
      }
    }
  }

  private pruneLoadedSegments(anchorIndex: number): void {
    const minIndex = Math.max(0, anchorIndex - SEGMENT_RETENTION_BEHIND);
    const maxIndex = anchorIndex + SEGMENT_RETENTION_AHEAD;
    for (const index of Array.from(this.loadedSegments.keys())) {
      if (index < minIndex || index > maxIndex) {
        this.loadedSegments.delete(index);
      }
    }
  }

  private findSegmentIndex(timeMs: number): number {
    if (!this.manifest) {
      return 0;
    }

    for (let index = 0; index < this.manifest.segments.length; index += 1) {
      const segment = this.manifest.segments[index];
      const startMs = segment.startTime * 1000;
      const endMs = startMs + (segment.durationSeconds * 1000);
      if (timeMs < endMs) {
        return index;
      }
    }

    return Math.max(0, this.manifest.segments.length - 1);
  }

  private makeCursor(segmentIndex: number, packetIndex: number, packets: SampleInfo[]): DemuxedPacketCursor | null {
    const packet = packets[packetIndex];
    if (!packet) {
      return null;
    }

    return {
      token: { segmentIndex, packetIndex },
      packet,
    };
  }

  private activateWindow(anchorIndex: number): number {
    if (this.activeWindowGeneration == 0 || this.currentAnchorIndex !== anchorIndex) {
      this.anchorRequests$.next(anchorIndex);
    }
    return this.activeWindowGeneration;
  }

  private isActiveWindow(windowGeneration: number): boolean {
    return windowGeneration === this.activeWindowGeneration;
  }

  private abortPendingOutsideWindow(anchorIndex: number): void {
    const minIndex = Math.max(0, anchorIndex - SEGMENT_RETENTION_BEHIND);
    const maxIndex = anchorIndex + SEGMENT_RETENTION_AHEAD + SEGMENT_PREFETCH_AHEAD;
    for (const [index, controller] of this.pendingSegmentControllers.entries()) {
      if (index < minIndex || index > maxIndex) {
        controller.abort();
      }
    }
  }

  private dispose(): void {
    if (this.loadController) {
      this.loadController.abort();
      this.loadController = null;
    }
    this.disposed = true;
    this.activeWindowGeneration += 1;
    for (const controller of this.pendingSegmentControllers.values()) {
      controller.abort();
    }
    this.pendingSegmentControllers.clear();
    this.pendingSegments.clear();
    this.loadedSegments.clear();
    this.failedSegments.clear();
    this.currentAnchorIndex = 0;
    this.manifest = null;
    this.initSegment = null;
    this.metadata = null;
    this.decoderConfig = null;
    this.audioMeta = null;
  }
}

async function collectPackets(
  getFirstPacket: () => Promise<DemuxedPacketCursor | null>,
  getNextPacket: (cursor: DemuxedPacketCursor) => Promise<DemuxedPacketCursor | null>,
  timeOffsetMs: number,
): Promise<SampleInfo[]> {
  const packets: SampleInfo[] = [];
  let cursor = await getFirstPacket();
  while (cursor) {
    packets.push({
      ...cursor.packet,
      timestampMs: cursor.packet.timestampMs + timeOffsetMs,
    });
    cursor = await getNextPacket(cursor);
  }
  return packets;
}

function findPacketIndex(packets: SampleInfo[], timeMs: number, requireKeyframe: boolean): number {
  let bestIndex = -1;
  
  if (requireKeyframe) {
    // Find the keyframe with timestamp <= timeMs (for backward seeks)
    for (let index = 0; index < packets.length; index += 1) {
      const packet = packets[index];
      if (packet.isRap && packet.timestampMs <= timeMs) {
        bestIndex = index;
      } else if (packet.timestampMs > timeMs && bestIndex >= 0) {
        break;
      }
    }
    
    if (bestIndex >= 0) {
      return bestIndex;
    }
    
    // If no keyframe before, find first keyframe
    return packets.findIndex(packet => packet.isRap);
  }
  
  // Regular forward seek - find first packet >= timeMs
  for (let index = 0; index < packets.length; index += 1) {
    if (packets[index].timestampMs >= timeMs) {
      return index;
    }
  }
  
  return packets.length > 0 ? packets.length - 1 : -1;
}

function concatenateBuffers(first: ArrayBuffer, second: ArrayBuffer): ArrayBuffer {
  const combined = new Uint8Array(first.byteLength + second.byteLength);
  combined.set(new Uint8Array(first), 0);
  combined.set(new Uint8Array(second), first.byteLength);
  return combined.buffer;
}
`````

`````typescript
import type { Type } from '@angular/core';
import type { FileProbe } from '../shared/protocol';
import type { ViewerArchiveContext } from './viewer-archive-context';

export interface ViewerRequest {
  targetPath: string;
  fileList?: { path: string; name: string }[];
  probe?: FileProbe | null;
  archiveContext?: ViewerArchiveContext | null;
  /** Optional explicit viewer id (from tab metadata). */
  viewerId?: string | null;
}

export interface ViewerContribution {
  /** Stable id, used in tab metadata and diagnostics. */
  id: string;
  /** Human label (optional). */
  title?: string;
  /**
   * Return a score: 0 = cannot handle; higher wins.
   * Keep it cheap; do not read file bytes here.
   */
  score(req: ViewerRequest): number;
  /** Lazy-load the viewer surface component (standalone Angular component). */
  load(): Promise<Type<unknown>> | Type<unknown>;
}
`````

`````typescript
  });
`````

`````typescript
    Object.defineProperty(value, 'mountedViewer', {
      get: () => ({ zoomIn() {} }),
`````

## File: manager/frontend/src/app/viewers/viewer-registry.service.ts
`````typescript
import { Injectable, Type } from '@angular/core';
import { ContributionRegistry } from '../plugin/contribution-registry';
import { ViewerSurfaceComponent } from '../surfaces/viewer/viewer-surface.component';
import { AudioViewerComponent } from './builtins/audio-viewer.component';
import { ViewerContribution, ViewerRequest } from './viewer-contribution';

function extLower(path: string): string {
  const p = (path ?? '').replace(/\\/g, '/');
  const i = p.lastIndexOf('.');
  if (i < 0) return '';
  return p.slice(i + 1).toLowerCase();
}

function previewPath(req: ViewerRequest): string {
  return req.archiveContext?.entryPath || req.targetPath;
}

function normalizeMime(mime: string | null | undefined): string {
  return (mime ?? '').split(';', 1)[0].trim().toLowerCase();
}

function probeLooksFont(req: ViewerRequest): boolean {
  const mime = normalizeMime(req.probe?.mimeType);
  return mime.startsWith('font/')
    || mime === 'application/font-woff'
    || mime === 'application/x-font-woff'
    || mime === 'application/vnd.ms-fontobject'
    || mime === 'application/x-font-ttf'
    || mime === 'application/x-font-otf'
    || mime === 'application/octet-stream' && ['ttf', 'ttc', 'otf', 'otc', 'woff', 'woff2', 'eot'].includes(extLower(previewPath(req)));
}

function probeLooksText(req: ViewerRequest): boolean {
  const mime = normalizeMime(req.probe?.mimeType);
  if (mime.startsWith('text/')) return true;
  if (mime.endsWith('+json') || mime.endsWith('+xml')) return true;
  return !!req.probe?.encoding;
}

function probeLooksTransportStream(req: ViewerRequest): boolean {
  const mime = normalizeMime(req.probe?.mimeType);
  return mime === 'video/mp2t' || mime === 'application/mp2t';
}

function probeLooksBinary(req: ViewerRequest): boolean {
  const probe = req.probe;
  if (!probe) return false;
  if (probe.isArchive) return false;
  return !probe.isText;
}

@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })
export class ViewerRegistryService {
  readonly registry = new ContributionRegistry<ViewerContribution, ViewerRequest>();

  constructor() {
    // Built-ins. This is the "spine" we can extend later with external bundles.
    this.register({
      id: 'legacy',
      title: 'Legacy Viewer',
      score: () => 1, // fallback for everything
      load: () => ViewerSurfaceComponent,
    });

    this.register({
      id: 'image',
      title: 'Image Viewer',
      score: (req) => {
        const ext = extLower(previewPath(req));
        if (ext === 'svg') return 50;
        if (['png', 'jpg', 'jpeg', 'gif', 'webp', 'bmp', 'ico', 'avif'].includes(ext)) return 50;
        if (['tiff', 'tif', 'exr', 'heif', 'heic', 'jp2', 'j2k', 'avif', 'jxl', 'fits', 'hdr', 'pfm'].includes(ext)) return 40;
        return 0;
      },
      load: async () => (await import('./builtins/image-viewer.component')).ImageViewerComponent,
    });

    this.register({
      id: 'video',
      title: 'Video Viewer',
      score: (req) => {
        const ext = extLower(previewPath(req));
        if (ext === 'ts') {
          if (probeLooksText(req)) return 0;
          if (probeLooksTransportStream(req)) return 70;
        }
        return ['mp4', 'm4v', 'webm', 'ogv', 'mov', 'qt', 'mkv', 'avi', 'divx', 'xvid', 'flv', 'ts', 'm2ts', 'mts', 'mpg', 'mpeg', 'vob', 'm2p', 'm2v', 'mjpeg', 'mjpg', 'm3u8', 'mxf', 'wmv'].includes(ext) ? 50 : 0;
      },
      load: async () => (await import('./builtins/video-viewer.component')).VideoViewerComponent,
    });

    this.register({
      id: 'audio',
      title: 'Audio Viewer',
      score: (req) => {
        const ext = extLower(previewPath(req));
        return ['mp3', 'wav', 'ogg', 'flac', 'aac', 'm4a'].includes(ext) ? 50 : 0;
      },
      load: () => AudioViewerComponent,
    });

    this.register({
      id: 'font',
      title: 'Font Viewer',
      score: (req) => {
        const ext = extLower(previewPath(req));
        if (['ttf', 'ttc', 'otf', 'otc', 'woff', 'woff2', 'eot'].includes(ext)) return 72;
        return probeLooksFont(req) ? 72 : 0;
      },
      load: async () => (await import('./builtins/font-viewer.component')).FontViewerComponent,
    });

    this.register({
      id: 'office',
      title: 'Document Viewer',
      score: (req) => {
        const ext = extLower(previewPath(req));
        return ['pdf', 'doc', 'docx', 'docm', 'xls', 'xlsx', 'xlsm', 'ppt', 'pptx', 'pptm', 'odt', 'ods', 'odp', 'rtf', 'epub', 'djvu', 'djv'].includes(ext) ? 45 : 0;
      },
      load: async () => (await import('./builtins/office-viewer.component')).OfficeViewerComponent,
    });

    this.register({
      id: 'markdown',
      title: 'Markup Viewer',
      score: (req) => ['md', 'markdown', 'mdx', 'html', 'htm'].includes(extLower(previewPath(req))) ? 60 : 0,
      load: async () => (await import('./builtins/markdown-viewer.component')).MarkdownViewerComponent,
    });

    this.register({
      id: 'binary',
      title: 'Binary Viewer',
      score: (req) => probeLooksBinary(req) ? 30 : 0,
      load: async () => (await import('./builtins/binary-viewer.component')).BinaryViewerComponent,
    });

    this.register({
      id: 'text',
      title: 'Code Viewer',
      score: (req) => {
        const ext = extLower(previewPath(req));
        if (ext === 'ts') {
          if (probeLooksTransportStream(req)) return 0;
          if (probeLooksText(req)) return 65;
        }
        if (['json', 'jsonc'].includes(ext)) return 60;
        return ['txt', 'log', 'csv', 'tsv', 'ini', 'cfg', 'conf', 'yaml', 'yml', 'toml', 'xml', 'html', 'htm', 'css', 'scss', 'sass', 'less', 'js', 'ts', 'jsx', 'tsx', 'vue', 'svelte', 'py', 'rb', 'go', 'rs', 'java', 'kt', 'swift', 'c', 'cpp', 'h', 'hpp', 'cs', 'php', 'sh', 'bash', 'zsh', 'fish', 'ps1', 'bat', 'cmd', 'sql', 'graphql', 'gql', 'proto', 'dockerfile', 'gitignore', 'env', 'lock', 'diff', 'patch', 'r', 'lua', 'm', 'pl', 'ex', 'exs'].includes(ext) ? 40 : 0;
      },
      load: async () => (await import('./builtins/text-viewer.component')).TextViewerComponent,
    });
  }

  register(c: ViewerContribution): void {
    this.registry.register(c);
  }

  unregister(id: string): void {
    this.registry.unregister(id);
  }

  async resolve(req: ViewerRequest): Promise<{ id: string; component: Type<unknown> }> {
    return this.registry.resolve(req, req.viewerId);
  }

  resolveId(req: ViewerRequest): string {
    return this.registry.pick(req, req.viewerId).id;
  }

  list(): readonly ViewerContribution[] {
    return this.registry.list();
  }
}
`````

`````html
<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8">
  <title>File Manager</title>
  <base href="/">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
  <link rel="icon" type="image/x-icon" href="favicon.ico">
  <!-- Prevent flash of wrong appearance by applying cached settings before first paint -->
  <script>
    (function () {
      var html = document.documentElement;
      var appearance = {};
      try {
        var raw = localStorage.getItem('app-appearance-v1');
        if (raw) appearance = JSON.parse(raw) || {};
      } catch (_) {}

      var theme = appearance.theme;
      var legacyTheme;
      try { legacyTheme = localStorage.getItem('app-theme'); } catch (_) {}
      if (theme !== 'dark' && theme !== 'light' && theme !== 'system') {
        theme = legacyTheme === 'dark' || legacyTheme === 'light' || legacyTheme === 'system' ? legacyTheme : 'system';
      }
      var prefersLight = window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: light)').matches;
      var dark = theme === 'dark' || (theme === 'system' && !prefersLight);
      html.classList.add(dark ? 'vscode-dark' : 'vscode-light');
      html.style.background = dark ? 'var(--vsc-editor-background)' : 'var(--vsc-on-accent)';

      var compact;
      try { compact = appearance.compactMode === true || localStorage.getItem('app-compact') === '1'; } catch (_) {}
      if (compact) html.classList.add('compact-mode');

      var accent = typeof appearance.accentColor === 'string' ? appearance.accentColor.trim() : '';
      if (/^#(?:[0-9a-fA-F]{3}|[0-9a-fA-F]{6})$/.test(accent)) {
        html.style.setProperty('--vsc-accent-blue', accent);
        html.style.setProperty('--vsc-accent', accent);

      }

      var zoom = typeof appearance.uiZoom === 'number' ? appearance.uiZoom : 100;
      if (zoom >= 75 && zoom <= 150 && zoom !== 100) {
        html.style.zoom = String(zoom / 100);
      }
    })();
`````

`````go
package app

import (
	"context"

	"wails-app/vfs/archive/cache"
)

// App is the Wails binding surface and thin wrapper around internal state.
type App struct {
	*State
	isProcessElevated func() bool
	hostResources     *hostResources
}

func NewApp(isProcessElevated func() bool) *App {
	return &App{
		isProcessElevated: isProcessElevated,
		hostResources:     newHostResources(),
	}
}

func (a *App) bindState(state *State) {
	a.State = state
}

func (a *App) Startup(ctx context.Context) {
	if a.State != nil {
		a.State.Startup(ctx)
	}
}

func (a *App) Shutdown() {
	a.hostResourcesOrCreate().shutdown()
	if a.State != nil {
		a.State.Shutdown()
	}
	if a.State != nil && a.State.PluginRegistry != nil {
		a.State.PluginRegistry.Shutdown()
	}
	cleanupSegmentedVideoPlaybackCache()
}

func (a *App) BeforeClose(ctx context.Context) bool {
	return false
}

func (a *App) EmitEvent(name string, data interface{}) {
	if a.State != nil {
		a.State.EmitEvent(name, data)
	}
}

func (a *App) InitVFS() {
	if a.State != nil {
		a.State.InitVFS()
	}
}

func (a *App) IsProcessElevated() bool {
	return a.isProcessElevated != nil && a.isProcessElevated()
}

// ArchCache returns the shared archive LRU cache so the stream middleware
// can open archive entries without buffering them in JS.
func (a *App) ArchCache() *cache.Cache {
	if a.State == nil {
		return nil
	}
	return a.State.archCache
}
`````

`````go
package app

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"

const astiavUnavailableMessage = "video transcoding and frame extraction are not available in this build"

type segmentedVideoRange struct {
	StartSeconds    float64
	DurationSeconds float64
}

func extractVideoFrame(ctx context.Context, inputPath string, targetFormat string, frameSeconds float64) ([]byte, error) {
	return nil, fmt.Errorf("%s", astiavUnavailableMessage)
}

func probeVideo(nativePath string) (*ffprobeOutput, error) {

}

func startAstiavTranscode(ctx context.Context, nativePath string, startSeconds float64, windowSeconds float64, playbackMode VideoPlaybackMode) (io.ReadCloser, error) {
	return nil, fmt.Errorf("%s", astiavUnavailableMessage)
}

func startAstiavTranscodeReader(ctx context.Context, r io.Reader, playbackMode VideoPlaybackMode) (io.ReadCloser, error) {
	return nil, fmt.Errorf("%s", astiavUnavailableMessage)
}

func buildFixedSegmentRanges(durationSeconds float64) []segmentedVideoRange {
	totalSegments := int(durationSeconds / segmentedPreviewSegmentSeconds)
	if durationSeconds > float64(totalSegments)*segmentedPreviewSegmentSeconds {
		totalSegments++
	}
	if totalSegments <= 0 {
		totalSegments = 1
	}

	ranges := make([]segmentedVideoRange, 0, totalSegments)
	for index := 0; index < totalSegments; index++ {
		startSeconds := float64(index) * segmentedPreviewSegmentSeconds
		segmentDuration := segmentedPreviewSegmentSeconds
		if remaining := durationSeconds - startSeconds; remaining > 0 && remaining < segmentDuration {
			segmentDuration = remaining
		}
		if segmentDuration <= 0 {
			segmentDuration = segmentedPreviewSegmentSeconds
		}

		ranges = append(ranges, segmentedVideoRange{
			StartSeconds:    startSeconds,
			DurationSeconds: segmentDuration,
		})
	}

	return ranges
}

func buildKeyframeAlignedSegmentRanges(ctx context.Context, nativePath string, durationSeconds float64) ([]segmentedVideoRange, error) {
	return nil, fmt.Errorf("%s", astiavUnavailableMessage)
}

func buildSegmentRangesFromKeyframes(keyframes []float64, durationSeconds float64) []segmentedVideoRange {
	if durationSeconds <= 0 {
		return buildFixedSegmentRanges(durationSeconds)
	}

	starts := make([]float64, 0, len(keyframes)+1)
	starts = append(starts, 0)
	for _, keyframeTime := range keyframes {
		if keyframeTime <= 0.001 || keyframeTime >= durationSeconds-0.001 {
			continue
		}
		if keyframeTime-starts[len(starts)-1] <= 0.001 {
			continue
		}
		starts = append(starts, keyframeTime)
	}

	ranges := make([]segmentedVideoRange, 0, len(starts))
	for index, startSeconds := range starts {
		endSeconds := durationSeconds
		if index+1 < len(starts) {
			endSeconds = starts[index+1]
		}
		segmentDuration := endSeconds - startSeconds
		if segmentDuration <= 0.001 {
			continue
		}

		ranges = append(ranges, segmentedVideoRange{
			StartSeconds:    startSeconds,
			DurationSeconds: segmentDuration,
		})
	}

	if len(ranges) == 0 {
		return buildFixedSegmentRanges(durationSeconds)
	}

	return ranges
}

func collectVideoKeyframeTimes(ctx context.Context, nativePath string) ([]float64, error) {
	return nil, fmt.Errorf("%s", astiavUnavailableMessage)
}

func estimateMediaDurationSeconds(ctx context.Context, nativePath string) (float64, error) {

}

func buildSegmentedVideoFragment(ctx context.Context, nativePath string, startSeconds float64, durationSeconds float64) ([]byte, []byte, error) {

}
`````

## File: manager/internal/app/batch_copy.go
`````go
package app

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"net/http"
	"os"
	pathpkg "path"
	"strings"

	contracts "wails-app/internal/contracts"
	"wails-app/internal/pathref"
	internalruntime "wails-app/internal/runtime"
)

func (s *State) handlesBatchVFSPath(path string) bool {
	if s.vfs == nil {
		return false
	}
	normalized := pathref.Normalize(path)
	if pathref.IsAlias(normalized) {
		return s.vfs.IsMounted(pathref.ToVFS(normalized))
	}
	return s.vfs.IsMounted(normalized)
}

func (s *State) copyBatchPath(
	source string,
	destination string,
	recursive bool,
	streamToFile func(io.Reader, string, int64, string) (int64, error),
) error {
	source = pathref.Normalize(source)
	destination = pathref.Normalize(destination)
	if pathref.IsWeb(source) {
		return s.copyBatchWebPath(source, destination, recursive, streamToFile)
	}

	if s.vfs == nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("virtual filesystem is not available")
	}

	if !s.handlesBatchVFSPath(source) {
		return fmt.Errorf("source is not a mounted virtual path")
	}

	info, err := internalruntime.VFSGetFileInfo(context.Background(), s.vfs, source)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}

	ctx := context.Background()
	if info.Type == contracts.FileTypeDirectory {
		if !recursive {
			return fmt.Errorf("source is a directory; use recursive=true")
		}
		return s.copyBatchVFSDirectory(ctx, source, destination, streamToFile)
	}

	return s.copyBatchVFSFile(ctx, source, destination, info, streamToFile)
}

func (s *State) copyBatchWebPath(
	source string,
	destination string,
	recursive bool,
	streamToFile func(io.Reader, string, int64, string) (int64, error),
) error {
	if s.Filesystem == nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("filesystem service is not available")
	}

	info, err := s.GetFileInfo(source)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}

	ctx := context.Background()
	if info.Type == contracts.FileTypeDirectory {
		if !recursive {
			return fmt.Errorf("source is a directory; use recursive=true")
		}
		return s.copyBatchWebDirectory(ctx, source, destination, streamToFile)
	}

	return s.copyBatchWebFile(ctx, source, destination, info, streamToFile)
}

func (s *State) copyBatchWebDirectory(
	ctx context.Context,
	source string,
	destination string,
	streamToFile func(io.Reader, string, int64, string) (int64, error),
) error {
	if err := s.ensureBatchDestinationDir(ctx, destination); err != nil {
		return err
	}

	listing, err := s.ListDirectory(source, false)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}

	for _, entry := range listing.Entries {
		childDestination := joinBatchPath(destination, entry.Name)
		if entry.Type == contracts.FileTypeDirectory {
			if err := s.copyBatchWebDirectory(ctx, entry.Path, childDestination, streamToFile); err != nil {
				return err
			}
			continue
		}

		entryCopy := entry
		if err := s.copyBatchWebFile(ctx, entry.Path, childDestination, &entryCopy, streamToFile); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}

	return nil
}

func (s *State) copyBatchWebFile(
	ctx context.Context,
	source string,
	destination string,
	info *contracts.FileInfo,
	streamToFile func(io.Reader, string, int64, string) (int64, error),
) error {
	reader, err := openBatchWebReader(ctx, source)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer reader.Close()

	if s.handlesBatchVFSPath(destination) {
		return s.writeBatchVFSFile(ctx, destination, reader)
	}

	if streamToFile == nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("stream copy callback is not available")
	}

	_, err = streamToFile(reader, pathref.ToNativePath(destination), info.Size, info.Name)
	return err
}

func openBatchWebReader(ctx context.Context, source string) (io.ReadCloser, error) {
	req, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, http.MethodGet, pathref.Normalize(source), nil)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	req.Header.Set("Accept", "*/*")
	req.Header.Set("User-Agent", "WailsFileManager/1.0")

	resp, err := http.DefaultClient.Do(req)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if resp.StatusCode < http.StatusOK || resp.StatusCode >= http.StatusBadRequest {
		defer resp.Body.Close()
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("request failed: HTTP %d", resp.StatusCode)
	}

	return resp.Body, nil
}

func (s *State) copyBatchVFSDirectory(
	ctx context.Context,
	source string,
	destination string,
	streamToFile func(io.Reader, string, int64, string) (int64, error),
) error {
	if err := s.ensureBatchDestinationDir(ctx, destination); err != nil {
		return err
	}

	listing, err := internalruntime.VFSListDir(context.Background(), s.vfs, source)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}

	for _, entry := range listing.Entries {
		childDestination := joinBatchPath(destination, entry.Name)
		if entry.Type == contracts.FileTypeDirectory {
			if err := s.copyBatchVFSDirectory(ctx, entry.Path, childDestination, streamToFile); err != nil {
				return err
			}
			continue
		}

		entryCopy := entry
		if err := s.copyBatchVFSFile(ctx, entry.Path, childDestination, &entryCopy, streamToFile); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}

	return nil
}

func (s *State) copyBatchVFSFile(
	ctx context.Context,
	source string,
	destination string,
	info *contracts.FileInfo,
	streamToFile func(io.Reader, string, int64, string) (int64, error),
) error {
	reader, err := s.vfs.Open(ctx, pathref.ToVFS(source))
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer reader.Close()

	if s.handlesBatchVFSPath(destination) {
		return s.writeBatchVFSFile(ctx, destination, reader)
	}

	if streamToFile == nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("stream copy callback is not available")
	}

	_, err = streamToFile(reader, pathref.ToNativePath(destination), info.Size, info.Name)
	return err
}

func (s *State) writeBatchVFSFile(ctx context.Context, destination string, reader io.Reader) error {
	internalPath := pathref.ToVFS(destination)
	if err := s.ensureVFSDir(ctx, pathpkg.Dir(internalPath)); err != nil {
		return err
	}

	file, err := s.vfs.Create(ctx, internalPath)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer file.Close()

	if _, err := io.Copy(file, reader); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return file.Sync()
}

func (s *State) ensureBatchDestinationDir(ctx context.Context, destination string) error {
	if s.handlesBatchVFSPath(destination) {
		return s.ensureVFSDir(ctx, pathref.ToVFS(destination))
	}
	return os.MkdirAll(pathref.ToNativePath(destination), 0o755)
}

func (s *State) ensureVFSDir(ctx context.Context, internalPath string) error {
	clean := cleanBatchVFSPath(internalPath)
	if clean == "/" || clean == "." {
		return nil
	}
	if s.vfs.Exists(ctx, clean) {
		return nil
	}

	parent := pathpkg.Dir(clean)
	if parent != clean {
		if err := s.ensureVFSDir(ctx, parent); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}

	if err := s.vfs.Mkdir(ctx, clean, 0o755); err != nil && !s.vfs.Exists(ctx, clean) {
		return err
	}
	return nil
}

func cleanBatchVFSPath(path string) string {
	normalized := strings.TrimSpace(strings.ReplaceAll(path, "\\", "/"))
	if normalized == "" {
		return "/"
	}
	return pathpkg.Clean("/" + strings.TrimPrefix(normalized, "/"))
}

func joinBatchPath(base string, child string) string {
	trimmedBase := strings.TrimRight(pathref.Normalize(base), "/")
	trimmedChild := strings.TrimLeft(strings.ReplaceAll(child, "\\", "/"), "/")
	if trimmedChild == "" {
		return trimmedBase
	}
	return pathref.Normalize(trimmedBase + "/" + trimmedChild)
}
`````

`````go
	{"user", "registry-run", `Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run`, registry.CURRENT_USER},
	{"user", "registry-run-once", `Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\RunOnce`, registry.CURRENT_USER},
	{"machine", "registry-run", `Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run`, registry.LOCAL_MACHINE},
	{"machine", "registry-run-once", `Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\RunOnce`, registry.LOCAL_MACHINE},
}

func (a *App) AutorunList() ([]contracts.AutorunEntry, error) {
	entries := make([]contracts.AutorunEntry, 0, 32)
	for _, loc := range autorunRegistryLocations {
		enabled, err := listAutorunRegistry(loc, loc.path, true)
		if err == nil {
			entries = append(entries, enabled...)
		}
		disabled, err := listAutorunRegistry(loc, loc.path+autorunDisabledSuffix, false)
		if err == nil {
			entries = append(entries, disabled...)
		}
	}
	entries = append(entries, listStartupFolder("user", userStartupFolder())...)
	entries = append(entries, listStartupFolder("machine", machineStartupFolder())...)
	return entries, nil
}

func (a *App) AutorunSetEnabled(id string, enabled bool) error {
	parts := strings.SplitN(id, "|", 4)
	if len(parts) != 4 {
		return fmt.Errorf("invalid autorun id")
	}
	kind, scope, origin, name := parts[0], parts[1], parts[2], parts[3]
	if kind == "registry" {
		return setRegistryAutorunEnabled(scope, origin, name, enabled)
	}
	if kind == "startup" {
		return setStartupAutorunEnabled(scope, name, enabled)
	}
	return fmt.Errorf("unsupported autorun kind %q", kind)
}

func (a *App) AutorunDelete(id string) error {
	parts := strings.SplitN(id, "|", 4)
	if len(parts) != 4 {
		return fmt.Errorf("invalid autorun id")
	}
	kind, scope, origin, name := parts[0], parts[1], parts[2], parts[3]
	if kind == "registry" {
		loc, ok := findAutorunRegistry(scope, origin)
		if !ok {
			return fmt.Errorf("unknown autorun registry location")
		}
		for _, path := range []string{loc.path, loc.path + autorunDisabledSuffix} {
			if key, err := registry.OpenKey(loc.root, path, registry.SET_VALUE); err == nil {
				_ = key.DeleteValue(name)
				key.Close()
			}
		}
		return nil
	}
	if kind == "startup" {
		folder := startupFolder(scope)
		if folder == "" {
			return fmt.Errorf("startup folder unavailable")
		}
		for _, candidate := range []string{name, name + autorunDisabledSuffix} {
			if err := os.Remove(filepath.Join(folder, candidate)); err == nil || os.IsNotExist(err) {
				continue
			} else {
				return err
			}
		}
		return nil
	}
	return fmt.Errorf("unsupported autorun kind %q", kind)
}

func listAutorunRegistry(loc autorunRegistryLocation, path string, enabled bool) ([]contracts.AutorunEntry, error) {
	key, err := registry.OpenKey(loc.root, path, registry.QUERY_VALUE)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer key.Close()
	names, err := key.ReadValueNames(-1)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	result := make([]contracts.AutorunEntry, 0, len(names))
	for _, name := range names {
		command, _, err := key.GetStringValue(name)
		if err != nil {
			continue
		}
		result = append(result, contracts.AutorunEntry{ID: "registry|" + loc.scope + "|" + loc.origin + "|" + name, Name: name, Command: command, Executable: commandExecutable(command), SourcePath: registryPublicPath(loc, path, name), Scope: loc.scope, Origin: loc.origin, Enabled: enabled})
	}
	return result, nil
}

func setRegistryAutorunEnabled(scope, origin, name string, enabled bool) error {
	loc, ok := findAutorunRegistry(scope, origin)
	if !ok {
		return fmt.Errorf("unknown autorun registry location")
	}
	srcPath, dstPath := loc.path, loc.path+autorunDisabledSuffix
	if enabled {
		srcPath, dstPath = dstPath, loc.path
	}
	src, err := registry.OpenKey(loc.root, srcPath, registry.QUERY_VALUE|registry.SET_VALUE)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer src.Close()
	value, valueType, err := src.GetStringValue(name)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	dst, _, err := registry.CreateKey(loc.root, dstPath, registry.SET_VALUE)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer dst.Close()
	if valueType == registry.EXPAND_SZ {
		err = dst.SetExpandStringValue(name, value)
	} else {
		err = dst.SetStringValue(name, value)
	}
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return src.DeleteValue(name)
}

func listStartupFolder(scope, folder string) []contracts.AutorunEntry {
	if folder == "" {
		return nil
	}
	items, err := os.ReadDir(folder)
	if err != nil {
		return nil
	}
	result := make([]contracts.AutorunEntry, 0, len(items))
	for _, item := range items {
		if item.IsDir() {
			continue
		}
		name := item.Name()
		enabled := true
		display := name
		if strings.HasSuffix(name, autorunDisabledSuffix) {
			enabled = false
			display = strings.TrimSuffix(name, autorunDisabledSuffix)
		}
		path := filepath.Join(folder, name)
		result = append(result, contracts.AutorunEntry{ID: "startup|" + scope + "|startup-folder|" + display, Name: display, Command: path, Executable: path, SourcePath: filepath.ToSlash(path), Scope: scope, Origin: "startup-folder", Enabled: enabled})
	}
	return result
}

func setStartupAutorunEnabled(scope, name string, enabled bool) error {
	folder := startupFolder(scope)
	if folder == "" {
		return fmt.Errorf("startup folder unavailable")
	}
	from, to := filepath.Join(folder, name), filepath.Join(folder, name+autorunDisabledSuffix)
	if enabled {
		from, to = to, filepath.Join(folder, name)
	}
	return os.Rename(from, to)
}
func startupFolder(scope string) string {
	if scope == "machine" {
		return machineStartupFolder()
	}
	return userStartupFolder()
}
func userStartupFolder() string {
	if p := os.Getenv("APPDATA"); p != "" {
		return filepath.Join(p, "Microsoft", "Windows", "Start Menu", "Programs", "Startup")
	}
	return ""
}
func machineStartupFolder() string {
	if p := os.Getenv("ProgramData"); p != "" {
		return filepath.Join(p, "Microsoft", "Windows", "Start Menu", "Programs", "StartUp")
	}
	return ""
}
func findAutorunRegistry(scope, origin string) (autorunRegistryLocation, bool) {
	for _, l := range autorunRegistryLocations {
		if l.scope == scope && l.origin == origin {
			return l, true
		}
	}
	return autorunRegistryLocation{}, false
}
func registryPublicPath(loc autorunRegistryLocation, path, name string) string {
	hive := "HKCU"
	if loc.root == registry.LOCAL_MACHINE {
		hive = "HKLM"
	}
	return "registry://" + hive + "/" + strings.ReplaceAll(path, "\\", "/") + "/" + name
}
func commandExecutable(command string) string {
	s := strings.TrimSpace(command)
	if s == "" {
		return ""
	}
	if strings.HasPrefix(s, "\"") {
		if i := strings.Index(s[1:], "\""); i >= 0 {
			return s[1 : i+1]
		}
	}
	if i := strings.IndexAny(s, " \t"); i >= 0 {
		return s[:i]
	}
	return s
}
`````

`````go
package app

import (
	"fmt"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"

	"wails-app/internal/contracts"
	"wails-app/internal/pathref"
)

// GetConvertedImageURL returns a stream URL that serves a converted preview image.
func (a *App) GetConvertedImageURL(path string, targetFormat string) (string, error) {
	if pathref.IsWeb(pathref.Normalize(path)) {
		return a.GetStreamURL(path), nil
	}
	info, err := a.State.GetFileInfo(path)
	if err != nil {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("cannot access file: %w", err)
	}

	if info.Type == contracts.FileTypeDirectory {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("cannot convert directory")
	}

	ext := strings.TrimPrefix(filepath.Ext(path), ".")
	ext = strings.ToLower(ext)
	if !a.State.Converter.IsSupportedSourceFormat(ext) {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("unsupported source format: .%s", ext)
	}

	targetFormat = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimPrefix(targetFormat, "."))
	return ConvertedStreamURLForFile(a.StreamBaseURL(), path, targetFormat), nil
}

// GetImageThumbnailURL returns a stream URL that serves a bounded thumbnail image.
func (a *App) GetImageThumbnailURL(path string, maxWidth int, maxHeight int) (string, error) {
	if pathref.IsWeb(pathref.Normalize(path)) {
		return a.GetStreamURL(path), nil
	}
	info, err := a.State.GetFileInfo(path)
	if err != nil {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("cannot access file: %w", err)
	}

	if info.Type == contracts.FileTypeDirectory {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("cannot thumbnail directory")
	}

	ext := strings.TrimPrefix(filepath.Ext(path), ".")
	ext = strings.ToLower(ext)
	if !a.State.Converter.IsSupportedSourceFormat(ext) {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("unsupported source format: .%s", ext)
	}

	return ThumbnailStreamURLForFile(a.StreamBaseURL(), path, "jpeg", maxWidth, maxHeight), nil
}

// GetArchiveImageThumbnailURL returns a thumbnail stream URL for an archive entry.
func (a *App) GetArchiveImageThumbnailURL(fsPath string, nestedChain []string, entryPath string, maxWidth int, maxHeight int) (string, error) {
	ext := strings.TrimPrefix(filepath.Ext(entryPath), ".")
	ext = strings.ToLower(ext)
	if !a.State.Converter.IsSupportedSourceFormat(ext) {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("unsupported source format: .%s", ext)
	}

	return ThumbnailStreamURLForEntry(a.StreamBaseURL(), fsPath, nestedChain, entryPath, "jpeg", maxWidth, maxHeight), nil
}

// GetConversionCapabilities returns what formats are supported for a given source format.
func (a *App) GetConversionCapabilities(sourceFileExt string) map[string]interface{} {
	ext := strings.ToLower(sourceFileExt)
	ext = strings.TrimPrefix(ext, ".")

	available := a.State.Converter.GetAvailableConversionFormats(ext)

	return map[string]interface{}{
		"sourceFormat":      ext,
		"supported":         a.State.Converter.IsSupportedSourceFormat(ext),
		"availableFormats":  available,
		"recommendedFormat": "webp", // WebP provides best compression/quality balance for previews
	}
}

// CanConvertImage checks if an image format can be converted for preview.
func (a *App) CanConvertImage(fileExt string) bool {
	ext := strings.ToLower(fileExt)
	ext = strings.TrimPrefix(ext, ".")
	return a.State.Converter.IsSupportedSourceFormat(ext)
}

// ConvertOfficeDocument converts an office document to PDF and returns the PDF file path.
// This is used by the office viewer component to convert documents before display.
func (a *App) ConvertOfficeDocument(path string) (map[string]interface{}, error) {
	if a.State.OfficeConverter == nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("office converter not available")
	}

	info, err := a.State.GetFileInfo(path)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("cannot access file: %w", err)
	}

	if info.Type == contracts.FileTypeDirectory {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("cannot convert directory")
	}

	ext := strings.TrimPrefix(filepath.Ext(path), ".")
	ext = strings.ToLower(ext)

	if !a.State.OfficeConverter.IsSupportedFormat(ext) {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("unsupported document format: .%s", ext)
	}

	if !a.State.OfficeConverter.IsAvailableForFormat(ext) {
		return map[string]interface{}{
			"success":      false,
			"error":        "Document converter not available",
			"availability": false,
			"instructions": a.State.OfficeConverter.AvailabilityInstructions(ext),
		}, nil
	}

	// Resolve VFS path to a real filesystem path for the selected converter.
	realPath, err := a.State.Filesystem.RealPath(path)
	if err != nil {
		return map[string]interface{}{
			"success": false,
			"error":   fmt.Sprintf("cannot resolve file path: %v", err),
		}, nil
	}

	pdfPath, err := a.State.OfficeConverter.ConvertToPDF(realPath)
	if err != nil {
		return map[string]interface{}{
			"success": false,
			"error":   err.Error(),
		}, nil
	}

	return map[string]interface{}{
		"success": true,
		"pdfPath": pdfPath,
	}, nil
}

// IsOfficeDocumentAvailable checks if any document conversion backend is available.
func (a *App) IsOfficeDocumentAvailable() bool {
	if a.State.OfficeConverter == nil {
		return false
	}
	return a.State.OfficeConverter.IsAvailable()
}
`````

`````go
package app

import (
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"

	"wails-app/internal/platform"
)

func (a *App) CreateSymbolicLink(target, linkPath string) error {
	resolvedTarget, err := a.State.Filesystem.RealPath(target)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("symlink: resolve target: %w", err)
	}
	resolvedLink, err := a.State.Filesystem.RealPath(linkPath)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("symlink: resolve link path: %w", err)
	}

	if _, err := os.Lstat(resolvedLink); err == nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("symlink: destination already exists: %s", linkPath)
	} else if !os.IsNotExist(err) {
		return err
	}

	if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(resolvedLink), 0755); err != nil {
		return err
	}

	if err := os.Symlink(resolvedTarget, resolvedLink); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("symlink: %w", err)
	}
	return nil
}

func (a *App) CreateHardLink(target, linkPath string) error {
	resolvedTarget, err := a.State.Filesystem.RealPath(target)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("hard link: resolve target: %w", err)
	}
	resolvedLink, err := a.State.Filesystem.RealPath(linkPath)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("hard link: resolve link path: %w", err)
	}

	info, err := os.Stat(resolvedTarget)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if info.IsDir() {
		return fmt.Errorf("hard link: directories are not supported")
	}

	if _, err := os.Lstat(resolvedLink); err == nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("hard link: destination already exists: %s", linkPath)
	} else if !os.IsNotExist(err) {
		return err
	}

	if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(resolvedLink), 0755); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := os.Link(resolvedTarget, resolvedLink); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("hard link: %w", err)
	}
	return nil
}

func (a *App) OpenTerminalAt(path string) error {
	resolved, err := a.State.Filesystem.RealPath(path)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("terminal: resolve path: %w", err)
	}

	info, err := os.Stat(resolved)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if !info.IsDir() {
		resolved = filepath.Dir(resolved)
	}

	return platform.OpenTerminalAt(resolved)
}
`````

## File: manager/internal/app/bindings_file_parts.go
`````go
package app

import (
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"

	"wails-app/internal/pathref"
)

// SplitFile splits a local file into sequential .partNNN files next to it.
// The operation writes each part through a temporary file before rename so a
// failed split never exposes a partially written part as complete.
func (a *App) SplitFile(path string, partSize int64) ([]string, error) {
	if partSize <= 0 {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("split file: part size must be positive")
	}

	source, err := a.State.Filesystem.RealPath(pathref.Normalize(path))
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("split file: resolve source: %w", err)
	}

	info, err := os.Stat(source)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("split file: stat source: %w", err)
	}
	if info.IsDir() {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("split file: source is a directory")
	}

	input, err := os.Open(source)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("split file: open source: %w", err)
	}
	defer input.Close()

	var created []string
	cleanup := func() {
		for _, public := range created {
			if native, resolveErr := a.State.Filesystem.RealPath(public); resolveErr == nil {
				_ = os.Remove(native)
			}
		}
	}

	for index := 1; ; index++ {
		partPath := fmt.Sprintf("%s.part%03d", source, index)
		temp, err := os.CreateTemp(filepath.Dir(source), ".part-*")
		if err != nil {
			cleanup()
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("split file: create part %d: %w", index, err)
		}
		tempPath := temp.Name()

		written, copyErr := io.CopyN(temp, input, partSize)
		closeErr := temp.Close()

		if copyErr != nil && copyErr != io.EOF {
			_ = os.Remove(tempPath)
			cleanup()
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("split file: write part %d: %w", index, copyErr)
		}
		if closeErr != nil {
			_ = os.Remove(tempPath)
			cleanup()
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("split file: close part %d: %w", index, closeErr)
		}
		if written == 0 {
			_ = os.Remove(tempPath)
			break
		}

		_ = os.Remove(partPath)
		if err := os.Rename(tempPath, partPath); err != nil {
			_ = os.Remove(tempPath)
			cleanup()
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("split file: commit part %d: %w", index, err)
		}

		created = append(created, pathref.FromNativePath(partPath))
		if copyErr == io.EOF {
			break
		}
	}

	return created, nil
}

// JoinFiles joins ordered local part files into destination. Destination is
// committed atomically from a temporary file in the same directory.
func (a *App) JoinFiles(parts []string, destination string) (string, error) {
	if len(parts) == 0 {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("join files: no parts")
	}

	dest, err := a.State.Filesystem.RealPath(pathref.Normalize(destination))
	if err != nil {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("join files: resolve destination: %w", err)
	}
	if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(dest), 0755); err != nil {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("join files: prepare destination: %w", err)
	}

	temp, err := os.CreateTemp(filepath.Dir(dest), ".join-*")
	if err != nil {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("join files: create temporary destination: %w", err)
	}
	tempPath := temp.Name()
	defer os.Remove(tempPath)

	for _, publicPart := range parts {
		part, err := a.State.Filesystem.RealPath(pathref.Normalize(publicPart))
		if err != nil {
			_ = temp.Close()
			return "", fmt.Errorf("join files: resolve part: %w", err)
		}

		input, err := os.Open(part)
		if err != nil {
			_ = temp.Close()
			return "", fmt.Errorf("join files: open %q: %w", publicPart, err)
		}

		_, copyErr := io.Copy(temp, input)
		closeErr := input.Close()
		if copyErr != nil {
			_ = temp.Close()
			return "", fmt.Errorf("join files: copy %q: %w", publicPart, copyErr)
		}
		if closeErr != nil {
			_ = temp.Close()
			return "", fmt.Errorf("join files: close %q: %w", publicPart, closeErr)
		}
	}

	if err := temp.Sync(); err != nil {
		_ = temp.Close()
		return "", fmt.Errorf("join files: sync destination: %w", err)
	}
	if err := temp.Close(); err != nil {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("join files: close destination: %w", err)
	}

	_ = os.Remove(dest)
	if err := os.Rename(tempPath, dest); err != nil {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("join files: commit destination: %w", err)
	}

	return pathref.FromNativePath(dest), nil
}
`````

`````go
// HashFile returns a SHA-256 digest for a file resolved through the normal public-path chain.
// Mounted VFS sources (cloud, SMB, memory and other providers) are streamed directly
// instead of being forced through a native-path conversion.
func (a *App) HashFile(path string) (string, error) {
	normalized := pathref.Normalize(path)
	var reader io.ReadCloser

	if a.State != nil && a.State.vfs != nil && a.State.vfs.IsMounted(pathref.ToVFS(normalized)) {
		f, err := a.State.vfs.Open(context.Background(), pathref.ToVFS(normalized))
		if err != nil {
			return "", err
		}
		reader = f
	} else {
		resolved, err := a.State.Filesystem.RealPath(normalized)
		if err != nil {
			return "", err
		}
		f, err := os.Open(resolved)
		if err != nil {
			return "", err
		}
		reader = f
	}
	defer reader.Close()

	h := sha256.New()
	if _, err := io.Copy(h, reader); err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	return hex.EncodeToString(h.Sum(nil)), nil
}
`````

`````go
package app

import (
	"strconv"

}

func (a *App) NetworkAdapterSetEnabled(index uint32, enabled bool) error {
	err := platform.SetNetworkAdapterEnabled(index, enabled)
	if err == nil {
		return nil
	}
	if !internalelevation.IsPermissionDenied(err) {
		return err
	}

	op := "network-adapter-disable"
	if enabled {
		op = "network-adapter-enable"
	}

	_, elevatedErr := runElevatedRequest(internalelevation.Request{
		Op:   op,
		Path: strconv.FormatUint(uint64(index), 10),
	})
	return elevatedErr
}

func (a *App) NetworkAdapterRenewDHCP(index uint32) error {
	err := platform.RenewNetworkAdapterDHCP(index)
	if err == nil {
		return nil
	}
	if !internalelevation.IsPermissionDenied(err) {
		return err
	}

	_, elevatedErr := runElevatedRequest(internalelevation.Request{
		Op:   "network-adapter-renew-dhcp",
		Path: strconv.FormatUint(uint64(index), 10),
	})
	return elevatedErr
}

func (a *App) NetworkAdapterDiagnose(index uint32) (contracts.SystemSurfaceRecord, error) {
	return platform.DiagnoseNetworkAdapter(index)
}

	return platform.OpenNetworkSettings()
`````

`````go
package app

import (
	"fmt"

	pluginpackage "wails-app/internal/pluginpackage"
)

// ReadPluginFrontendModule returns the constrained declarative frontend module
// for a discovered package. It never evaluates code and never accepts arbitrary paths.
func (a *App) ReadPluginFrontendModule(pluginID string) (pluginpackage.FrontendModule, error) {
	root, err := a.GetPluginDirectory()
	if err != nil {
		return pluginpackage.FrontendModule{}, err
	}
	packages, err := pluginpackage.Discover(root)
	if err != nil {
		return pluginpackage.FrontendModule{}, err
	}
	for _, pkg := range packages {
		if pkg.Manifest.ID == pluginID {
			return pluginpackage.ReadFrontendModule(root, pkg)
		}
	}
	return pluginpackage.FrontendModule{}, fmt.Errorf("plugin %s is not installed", pluginID)
}
`````

`````go
package app

import (
	"testing"

	pluginpackage "wails-app/internal/pluginpackage"
)

func TestRequiresStartupPluginHostPrivilege(t *testing.T) {
	t.Run("matches enabled elevated archive plugin", func(t *testing.T) {
		packages := []pluginpackage.DiscoveredPackage{
			{
				Kind:  "archive",
				Valid: true,
				Manifest: pluginpackage.Manifest{
					ID:      "elevated.plugin",
					Version: "1.0.0",
					Backend: &pluginpackage.BackendEntry{Privilege: "elevated"},
				},
			},
		}
		states := []pluginpackage.PackageState{
			{PluginID: "elevated.plugin", Enabled: true},
		}

		if !requiresStartupPluginHostPrivilege(packages, states) {
			t.Fatal("expected enabled elevated archive plugin to require startup elevation")
		}
	})

	t.Run("ignores disabled or non-elevated plugins", func(t *testing.T) {
		packages := []pluginpackage.DiscoveredPackage{
			{
				Kind:  "archive",
				Valid: true,
				Manifest: pluginpackage.Manifest{
					ID:      "normal.plugin",
					Version: "1.0.0",
					Backend: &pluginpackage.BackendEntry{Privilege: "normal"},
				},
			},
			{
				Kind:  "directory",
				Valid: true,
				Manifest: pluginpackage.Manifest{
					ID:      "elevated.directory",
					Version: "1.0.0",
					Backend: &pluginpackage.BackendEntry{Privilege: "elevated"},
				},
			},
			{
				Kind:  "archive",
				Valid: true,
				Manifest: pluginpackage.Manifest{
					ID:      "disabled.elevated",
					Version: "1.0.0",
					Backend: &pluginpackage.BackendEntry{Privilege: "elevated"},
				},
			},
		}
		states := []pluginpackage.PackageState{
			{PluginID: "normal.plugin", Enabled: true},
			{PluginID: "elevated.directory", Enabled: true},
			{PluginID: "disabled.elevated", Enabled: false},
		}

		if requiresStartupPluginHostPrivilege(packages, states) {
			t.Fatal("did not expect startup elevation without an enabled elevated archive plugin")
		}
	})
}
`````
