## File: manager/internal/app/bindings_plugin_packages.go
`````go
package app

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"time"

	wailsruntime "github.com/wailsapp/wails/v2/pkg/runtime"
	internalelevation "wails-app/internal/elevation"

	pluginpackage "wails-app/internal/pluginpackage"
)

const pluginPackageAppName = "wails-file-manager"

func pluginPackageStateStore() (*pluginpackage.StateStore, error) {
	return pluginpackage.NewStateStore(pluginPackageAppName)
}

// GetPluginDirectory returns the trusted per-user directory scanned for plugin packages.
// Discovery is metadata-only; no code is executed from this directory.
func (a *App) GetPluginDirectory() (string, error) {
	return pluginpackage.DefaultDirectory(pluginPackageAppName)
}

// DiscoverPluginPackages scans immediate child directories and .zip archives.
// ZIP discovery is metadata-only; archives are not extracted until policy allows installation.
func (a *App) DiscoverPluginPackages() ([]pluginpackage.DiscoveredPackage, error) {
	root, err := a.GetPluginDirectory()
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	packages, err := pluginpackage.Discover(root)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	store, err := pluginPackageStateStore()
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if err := store.Reconcile(packages); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return packages, nil
}

func (a *App) GetPluginPackageStates() ([]pluginpackage.PackageState, error) {
	store, err := pluginPackageStateStore()
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return store.List()
}

func (a *App) GetPluginPackageState(pluginID string) (pluginpackage.PackageState, error) {
	store, err := pluginPackageStateStore()
	if err != nil {
		return pluginpackage.PackageState{}, err
	}
	return store.Get(pluginID)
}

func (a *App) UpdatePluginPackageState(pluginID string, patch pluginpackage.PackageStatePatch) (pluginpackage.PackageState, error) {
	pkg, err := a.findDiscoveredPluginPackage(pluginID)
	if err != nil {
		return pluginpackage.PackageState{}, err
	}
	if patch.GrantedPermissions != nil {
		if err := pluginpackage.ValidateGrantedPermissions(pkg.Manifest, *patch.GrantedPermissions); err != nil {
			return pluginpackage.PackageState{}, err
		}
	}
	if patch.Trusted != nil && *patch.Trusted {
		version := pkg.Manifest.Version
		patch.TrustedVersion = &version
	}

	store, err := pluginPackageStateStore()
	if err != nil {
		return pluginpackage.PackageState{}, err
	}
	return store.Update(pluginID, patch)
}

func (a *App) findDiscoveredPluginPackage(pluginID string) (pluginpackage.DiscoveredPackage, error) {
	root, err := a.GetPluginDirectory()
	if err != nil {
		return pluginpackage.DiscoveredPackage{}, err
	}
	packages, err := pluginpackage.Discover(root)
	if err != nil {
		return pluginpackage.DiscoveredPackage{}, err
	}
	for _, pkg := range packages {
		if pkg.Manifest.ID != pluginID {
			continue
		}
		if !pkg.Valid {
			return pluginpackage.DiscoveredPackage{}, fmt.Errorf("plugin %s is not a valid discovered package", pluginID)
		}
		return pkg, nil
	}
	return pluginpackage.DiscoveredPackage{}, fmt.Errorf("plugin %s is not installed", pluginID)
}

func (a *App) QuarantinePluginPackage(pluginID, reason string) (pluginpackage.PackageState, error) {
	store, err := pluginPackageStateStore()
	if err != nil {
		return pluginpackage.PackageState{}, err
	}
	return store.Quarantine(pluginID, reason)
}

func (a *App) RecordPluginActivation(pluginID string, success bool, activationError string) (pluginpackage.PackageState, error) {
	store, err := pluginPackageStateStore()
	if err != nil {
		return pluginpackage.PackageState{}, err
	}
	return store.RecordActivation(pluginID, success, activationError)
}

// PrepareUniversalPluginPackage validates and extracts an archive into the per-user cache.
// Callers should only invoke this after the existing trust/permission policy admits the package.
func (a *App) PrepareUniversalPluginPackage(pluginID string) (pluginpackage.PreparedPackage, error) {
	pkg, err := a.findDiscoveredPluginPackage(pluginID)
	if err != nil {
		return pluginpackage.PreparedPackage{}, err
	}
	if pkg.Kind != "archive" {
		return pluginpackage.PreparedPackage{}, fmt.Errorf("plugin %s is not an archive package", pluginID)
	}
	return pluginpackage.PrepareUniversalArchive(pluginPackageAppName, pkg)
}

// ReadUniversalPluginFrontendEntry returns only the manifest-declared frontend entry.
func (a *App) ReadUniversalPluginFrontendEntry(pluginID string) (string, error) {
	pkg, err := a.PrepareUniversalPluginPackage(pluginID)
	if err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	if pkg.Manifest.Frontend == nil {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("plugin %s has no frontend entry", pluginID)
	}
	path := filepath.Join(pkg.CachePath, filepath.FromSlash(pkg.Manifest.Frontend.Entry))
	info, err := os.Stat(path)
	if err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	if !info.Mode().IsRegular() {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("frontend entry is not a regular file")
	}
	data, err := os.ReadFile(path)
	if err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	return string(data), nil
}

// EnsureUniversalPluginHostPrivilege is called when the user explicitly enables
// a universal plugin. The enabled state is persisted before this call.
func (a *App) EnsureUniversalPluginHostPrivilege(pluginID string) (bool, error) {
	pkg, err := a.PrepareUniversalPluginPackage(pluginID)
	if err != nil {
		return false, err
	}
	if pkg.Manifest.Backend == nil || pkg.Manifest.Backend.Privilege != "elevated" {
		return false, nil
	}
	return a.relaunchElevatedAndQuit()
}

// EnsureStartupPluginHostPrivilege checks persisted plugin policy at startup
// and relaunches Manager elevated when an enabled universal plugin requires it.
func (a *App) EnsureStartupPluginHostPrivilege() (bool, error) {
	root, err := a.GetPluginDirectory()
	if err != nil {
		return false, err
	}
	packages, err := pluginpackage.Discover(root)
	if err != nil {
		return false, err
	}
	store, err := pluginPackageStateStore()
	if err != nil {
		return false, err
	}
	if err := store.Reconcile(packages); err != nil {
		return false, err
	}
	states, err := store.List()
	if err != nil {
		return false, err
	}
	if !requiresStartupPluginHostPrivilege(packages, states) {
		return false, nil
	}
	return a.relaunchElevatedAndQuit()
}

func (a *App) CallUniversalPluginBackend(pluginID, method, paramsJSON string) (interface{}, error) {
	pkg, err := a.PrepareUniversalPluginPackage(pluginID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	raw := json.RawMessage(paramsJSON)
	if len(raw) == 0 {
		raw = json.RawMessage(`{}`)
	}
	if !json.Valid(raw) {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("backend params are not valid JSON")
	}

	result, err := pluginpackage.DefaultBackendManager.Call(pkg, method, raw)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if len(result) == 0 {
		return nil, nil
	}
	var value interface{}
	if err := json.Unmarshal(result, &value); err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("backend returned invalid JSON result: %w", err)
	}
	return value, nil
}

func (a *App) StopUniversalPluginBackend(pluginID string) error {
	return pluginpackage.DefaultBackendManager.Stop(pluginID)
}

func (a *App) relaunchElevatedAndQuit() (bool, error) {
	if internalelevation.IsProcessElevated() {
		return false, nil
	}
	if err := internalelevation.RelaunchCurrentProcessElevated(); err != nil {
		return false, err
	}

	if a.State != nil && a.State.Ctx != nil {
		ctx := a.State.Ctx
		go func() {
			time.Sleep(250 * time.Millisecond)
			wailsruntime.Quit(ctx)
		}()
	}
	return true, nil
}

func requiresStartupPluginHostPrivilege(
	packages []pluginpackage.DiscoveredPackage,
	states []pluginpackage.PackageState,
) bool {
	enabled := make(map[string]bool, len(states))
	for _, state := range states {
		enabled[state.PluginID] = state.Enabled
	}
	for _, pkg := range packages {
		if !pkg.Valid || pkg.Kind != "archive" {
			continue
		}
		if pkg.Manifest.Backend == nil || pkg.Manifest.Backend.Privilege != "elevated" {
			continue
		}
		if enabled[pkg.Manifest.ID] {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}
`````

`````go
package app

import (

)

// ListPlugins returns metadata for all registered plugins.
func (a *App) ListPlugins() []plugin.Info {
	if a.State == nil || a.State.PluginRegistry == nil {
		return nil
	}
	return a.State.PluginRegistry.List()
}

// GetPlugin returns metadata for a single plugin by ID.
func (a *App) GetPlugin(id string) *plugin.Info {
	if a.State == nil || a.State.PluginRegistry == nil {
		return nil
	}
	p := a.State.PluginRegistry.Get(id)
	if p == nil {
		return nil
	}
	info := p.Info()
	return &info
}

// InvokePluginCommand executes a command exposed by a plugin.
func (a *App) InvokePluginCommand(pluginID, commandID string, paths []string) error {
	if a.State == nil || a.State.PluginRegistry == nil {
		return nil
	}
	ctx := context.Background()
	return a.State.PluginRegistry.InvokeCommand(ctx, pluginID, commandID, paths)
}
`````

`````go
func TestEnvironmentSurfaceIsNative(t *testing.T) {
	source, err := os.ReadFile("bindings_system_surface_windows.go")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	text := string(source)

	if !strings.Contains(text, `normalizedKind == "environment"`) {
		t.Fatal("SystemSurfaceList must special-case environment")
	}
	if !strings.Contains(text, "platform.ListEnvironmentSurface()") {
		t.Fatal("Environment must use native platform.ListEnvironmentSurface")
	}

	scriptStart := strings.Index(text, "func systemSurfaceScript")
	if scriptStart < 0 {
		t.Fatal("systemSurfaceScript missing")
	}
	if strings.Contains(text[scriptStart:], `"environment":`) {
		t.Fatal("Environment must not have a PowerShell script entry")
	}
}
`````

## File: manager/internal/app/bindings_system_surface_windows.go
`````go
//go:build windows

package app

import (
	"bytes"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"os/exec"
	"strings"

	contracts "wails-app/internal/contracts"
	"wails-app/internal/platform"
)

func (a *App) SystemSurfaceList(kind string) ([]contracts.SystemSurfaceRecord, error) {
	normalizedKind := strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(kind))
	if normalizedKind == "network" {
		return platform.ListNetworkSurface()
	}
	if normalizedKind == "environment" {
		return platform.ListEnvironmentSurface()
	}

	script, ok := systemSurfaceScript(normalizedKind)
	if !ok {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("unsupported system surface %q", kind)
	}
	cmd := exec.Command("powershell.exe", "-NoProfile", "-NonInteractive", "-ExecutionPolicy", "Bypass", "-Command", script)
	var stderr bytes.Buffer
	cmd.Stderr = &stderr
	out, err := cmd.Output()
	if err != nil {
		message := strings.TrimSpace(stderr.String())
		if message == "" {
			message = err.Error()
		}
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("list %s: %s", kind, message)
	}
	trimmed := bytes.TrimSpace(out)
	if len(trimmed) == 0 || bytes.Equal(trimmed, []byte("null")) {
		return []contracts.SystemSurfaceRecord{}, nil
	}
	var raw any
	if err := json.Unmarshal(trimmed, &raw); err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("decode %s surface: %w", kind, err)
	}
	items, ok := raw.([]any)
	if !ok {
		items = []any{raw}
	}
	result := make([]contracts.SystemSurfaceRecord, 0, len(items))
	for index, item := range items {
		object, ok := item.(map[string]any)
		if !ok {
			continue
		}
		id := fmt.Sprint(object["id"])
		if id == "<nil>" || id == "" {
			id = fmt.Sprint(index)
		}
		name := fmt.Sprint(object["name"])
		if name == "<nil>" || name == "" {
			name = id
		}
		fields := map[string]any{}
		if value, ok := object["fields"].(map[string]any); ok {
			fields = value
		}
		result = append(result, contracts.SystemSurfaceRecord{ID: id, Name: name, Fields: fields})
	}
	return result, nil
}

func systemSurfaceScript(kind string) (string, bool) {
	const prefix = `$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; [Console]::OutputEncoding=[Text.UTF8Encoding]::new(); `
	scripts := map[string]string{
		"tasks":            `@(Get-ScheduledTask | ForEach-Object { $i=$_; $info=$null; try {$info=Get-ScheduledTaskInfo -TaskName $i.TaskName -TaskPath $i.TaskPath -ErrorAction Stop} catch {}; [pscustomobject]@{id=($i.TaskPath+$i.TaskName);name=$i.TaskName;fields=@{state=[string]$i.State;path=$i.TaskPath;nextRun=if($info){[string]$info.NextRunTime}else{''}}} }) | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5 -Compress`,
		"services":         `@(Get-CimInstance Win32_Service | ForEach-Object { [pscustomobject]@{id=$_.Name;name=$_.Name;fields=@{status=$_.State;startType=$_.StartMode;displayName=$_.DisplayName;path=$_.PathName}} }) | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5 -Compress`,
		"processes":        `@(Get-Process | ForEach-Object { $p=$_; $path=''; try {$path=$p.Path} catch {}; [pscustomobject]@{id=[string]$p.Id;name=$p.ProcessName;fields=@{pid=$p.Id;cpu=if($p.CPU){[math]::Round($p.CPU,2)}else{0};workingSet=$p.WorkingSet64;size=$p.WorkingSet64;path=$path}} }) | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5 -Compress`,
		"devices":          `@(Get-PnpDevice | ForEach-Object { [pscustomobject]@{id=$_.InstanceId;name=if($_.FriendlyName){$_.FriendlyName}else{$_.InstanceId};fields=@{status=[string]$_.Status;class=$_.Class;instanceId=$_.InstanceId}} }) | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5 -Compress`,
		"shell-extensions": `$roots=@(@{scope='Machine';root='HKLM:\Software\Classes'},@{scope='User';root='HKCU:\Software\Classes'}); $targets=@('*\shellex\ContextMenuHandlers','Directory\shellex\ContextMenuHandlers','Directory\Background\shellex\ContextMenuHandlers','AllFileSystemObjects\shellex\ContextMenuHandlers'); @($roots | ForEach-Object {$r=$_; $targets | ForEach-Object {$t=$_; Get-ChildItem ($r.root+'\'+$t) -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ForEach-Object {$v=(Get-Item $_.PSPath).GetValue(''); [pscustomobject]@{id=($r.scope+':'+$t+':'+$_.PSChildName);name=$_.PSChildName;fields=@{scope=$r.scope;target=$t;clsid=[string]$v}}}}}) | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5 -Compress`,
	}
	script, ok := scripts[kind]
	if !ok {
		return "", false
	}
	return prefix + script, true
}
`````

## File: manager/internal/app/bindings_utility.go
`````go
package app

import (
	"net/url"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"regexp"
	"strings"
	"time"

	contracts "wails-app/internal/contracts"
	"wails-app/internal/pathref"
	internalplatform "wails-app/internal/platform"
	internalutility "wails-app/internal/utility"
)

type ResolvedLink = internalutility.ResolvedLink

func (a *App) Ping() int64 {
	return time.Now().UnixMilli()
}

func (a *App) OpenFile(path string) error {
	return a.Utility.OpenFile(path)
}

func (a *App) ResolveLink(path string) (*ResolvedLink, error) {
	return a.Utility.ResolveLink(path)
}

func (a *App) IsAbsPath(path string) bool {
	if pathref.IsDrive(pathref.Normalize(path)) {
		return true
	}
	return filepath.IsAbs(path)
}

func (a *App) JoinPaths(parts []string) string {
	if joined, ok := joinAliasParts(parts); ok {
		return joined
	}
	return internalplatform.Join(parts...)
}

func joinAliasParts(parts []string) (string, bool) {
	if len(parts) == 0 {
		return "", false
	}

	first := pathref.Normalize(parts[0])
	if !pathref.IsAlias(first) && !pathref.IsDrive(first) {
		return "", false
	}

	joined := first
	for _, part := range parts[1:] {
		normalizedPart := strings.Trim(strings.ReplaceAll(part, "\\", "/"), "/")
		if normalizedPart == "" {
			continue
		}
		joined = trimAliasChildBase(joined) + "/" + normalizedPart
	}

	return pathref.Normalize(joined), true
}

var aliasRootPattern = regexp.MustCompile(`^[a-z][a-z0-9+.-]*://$`)

func trimAliasChildBase(path string) string {
	trimmed := strings.TrimSpace(strings.ReplaceAll(path, "\\", "/"))
	if aliasRootPattern.MatchString(strings.ToLower(trimmed)) {
		return trimmed
	}
	return strings.TrimRight(trimmed, "/")
}

func (a *App) SplitPath(path string) map[string]string {
	if dir, base, name, ext, ok := splitAliasPath(path); ok {
		return map[string]string{
			"dir":  dir,
			"base": base,
			"name": name,
			"ext":  ext,
		}
	}
	resolvedPath := pathref.ToNativePath(pathref.Normalize(path))
	dir, file, name, ext := internalplatform.SplitPath(resolvedPath)
	return map[string]string{
		"dir":  pathref.FromNativePath(dir),
		"base": file,
		"name": name,
		"ext":  ext,
	}
}

func (a *App) GetParentPath(path string) string {
	normalized := pathref.Normalize(path)
	if parent, ok := pathref.Parent(normalized); ok {
		return parent
	}
	return pathref.FromNativePath(internalplatform.ParentPath(pathref.ToNativePath(normalized)))
}

func (a *App) PathExists(path string) bool {
	normalized := pathref.Normalize(path)
	if pathref.IsWeb(normalized) {
		_, err := a.State.GetFileInfo(normalized)
		return err == nil
	}
	resolvedPath := pathref.ToNativePath(normalized)
	_, err := os.Lstat(resolvedPath)
	return err == nil
}

func (a *App) IsDirectory(path string) bool {
	normalized := pathref.Normalize(path)
	if pathref.IsWeb(normalized) {
		info, err := a.State.GetFileInfo(normalized)
		return err == nil && info != nil && info.Type == contracts.FileTypeDirectory
	}
	resolvedPath := pathref.ToNativePath(normalized)
	info, err := os.Lstat(resolvedPath)
	if err != nil {
		return false
	}
	return info.IsDir()
}

func (a *App) IsRoot(path string) bool {
	return filepath.Dir(path) == path
}

func (a *App) Breadcrumbs(path string) []map[string]string {
	return internalplatform.Breadcrumbs(path)
}

func (a *App) GetSpecialFolders() contracts.SpecialFoldersResponse {
	return internalplatform.GetSpecialFolders()
}

func splitAliasPath(path string) (dir string, base string, name string, ext string, ok bool) {
	normalized := pathref.Normalize(path)
	if !pathref.IsAlias(normalized) && !pathref.IsDrive(normalized) {
		return "", "", "", "", false
	}

	dir = normalized
	if parent, hasParent := pathref.Parent(normalized); hasParent {
		dir = parent
	}

	trimmed := strings.TrimRight(normalized, "/")
	if trimmed == strings.TrimRight(dir, "/") {
		return dir, "", "", "", true
	}

	slashIndex := strings.LastIndex(trimmed, "/")
	if slashIndex >= 0 {
		base = trimmed[slashIndex+1:]
	} else {
		base = trimmed
	}
	if pathref.IsWeb(normalized) {
		if decoded, err := url.PathUnescape(base); err == nil && decoded != "" {
			base = decoded
		}
	}
	ext = filepath.Ext(base)
	name = strings.TrimSuffix(base, ext)
	return dir, base, name, ext, true
}

func nativeResolvePath(path string) (string, error) {
	return pathref.ToNativePath(path), nil
}
`````

`````go
package app

import (
	"context"
	"io"
	"os"

	"github.com/mholt/archiver/v3"

	contracts "wails-app/internal/contracts"
	internalelevation "wails-app/internal/elevation"
)

type BuildConfig struct {
	SetContext func(context.Context)

	InitVFS        func()
	HandleFileDrop func(int, int, []string) error

	BuildFileInfo func(name, fullPath string, info os.FileInfo, hidden bool) contracts.FileInfo
	IsHidden      func(name, fullPath string) bool

	ClassifyError                  func(error) contracts.AppErrorCode
	IsPermissionDenied             func(error) bool
	ShouldRetryDeleteWithElevation func(error) bool
	CalculateSize                  func(path string) (items, bytes int64)
	Normalize                      func(string) string
	ArchiveEntryPath               func(archiver.File) string
	IsArchive                      func(string) bool
}

func BuildState(core *Core, filesystem Filesystem, elevation *internalelevation.Service, config BuildConfig) *State {
	state := NewState(core)
	state.Elevation = elevation
	state.Filesystem = filesystem
	state.Runtime = NewRuntimeService(RuntimeConfig{
		SetContext:           config.SetContext,
		SetOperationEmitter:  state.Operations.SetEmitter,
		CreatePaneWatch:      state.CreatePaneWatch,
		InitVFS:              config.InitVFS,
		HandleFileDrop:       config.HandleFileDrop,
		ClosePaneWatch:       state.ClosePaneWatch,
		CancelDirStreams:     state.CancelDirStreams,
		StopElevationSession: state.StopElevationSession,
		CloseArchiveCache:    state.CloseArchiveCache,
	})

	services := NewServices(ServiceConfig{
		Core:      core,
		Elevation: elevation,
		Events: ServiceEventsConfig{
			EmitEvent: func(name string, data interface{}) {
				state.Runtime.EmitEvent(state.Ctx, name, data)
			},
		},
		Directory: ServiceDirectoryConfig{
			ElevatedList:  filesystem.ElevatedList,
			BuildFileInfo: config.BuildFileInfo,
			IsHidden:      config.IsHidden,
			ListDirectory: state.ListDirectory,
		},
		Batch: ServiceBatchConfig{
			StartOperation:                 state.StartOperation,
			PromptConflict:                 state.PromptConflict,
			ClassifyError:                  config.ClassifyError,
			IsPermissionDenied:             config.IsPermissionDenied,
			ShouldRetryDeleteWithElevation: config.ShouldRetryDeleteWithElevation,
			RunElevatedCopy:                filesystem.RunElevatedCopy,
			RunElevatedMove:                filesystem.RunElevatedMove,
			RunElevatedDelete:              filesystem.RunElevatedDelete,
			CalculateSize:                  config.CalculateSize,
			GetFileInfo:                    filesystem.GetFileInfo,
			CopyBatchPath: func(source, destination string, recursive bool, streamToFile func(io.Reader, string, int64, string) (int64, error)) error {
				return state.copyBatchPath(source, destination, recursive, streamToFile)
			},
			ExtractNestedArchive: state.ExtractNestedArchive,
			Normalize:            config.Normalize,
			ArchiveEntryPath:     config.ArchiveEntryPath,
			IsArchive:            config.IsArchive,
		},
	})

	state.Archive = services.Archive
	state.Batch = services.Batch
	state.Converter = services.Converter
	state.OfficeConverter = core.OfficeConverter
	state.DirStream = services.DirStream
	state.Utility = services.Utility
	state.Navigation = services.Navigation
	state.Workspace = services.Workspace
	return state
}
`````

`````go
	OfficeConverter   *internalconverter.OfficeService

}

func NewCore() (*Core, error) {

	if err != nil {
		workspaceManager = internalworkspace.NewTransientManager()

	return &Core{

		NavigationManager: internalnav.NewManager(),

		OfficeConverter:   internalconverter.NewOfficeService(),

		PluginRegistry:    plugin.NewRegistry(),
	}, err
`````

`````go
package app

import (
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"

	contracts "wails-app/internal/contracts"
)

func filterEntries(entries []contracts.FileInfo, filter contracts.FilterQuery) []contracts.FileInfo {
	if filter.Text == "" && len(filter.Criteria) == 0 {
		return entries
	}

	result := make([]contracts.FileInfo, 0, len(entries))
	for _, entry := range entries {
		if matchesFilter(entry, filter) {
			result = append(result, entry)
		}
	}
	return result
}

func matchesFilter(entry contracts.FileInfo, filter contracts.FilterQuery) bool {
	if filter.Text != "" {
		name := entry.Name
		text := filter.Text
		if !filter.CaseSensitive {
			name = strings.ToLower(name)
			text = strings.ToLower(text)
		}
		if !strings.Contains(name, text) {
			return false
		}
	}

	for _, criteria := range filter.Criteria {
		if !matchesCriteria(entry, criteria, filter.CaseSensitive) {
			return false
		}
	}

	return true
}

func matchesCriteria(entry contracts.FileInfo, criteria contracts.FilterCriteria, caseSensitive bool) bool {
	switch criteria.Type {
	case contracts.FilterName:
		return compareStrings(entry.Name, criteria.Value, criteria.Operator, caseSensitive)
	case contracts.FilterExtension:
		ext := strings.TrimPrefix(filepath.Ext(entry.Name), ".")
		return compareStrings(ext, criteria.Value, criteria.Operator, caseSensitive)
	case contracts.FilterGlob:
		matched, _ := filepath.Match(criteria.Value, entry.Name)
		return matched
	case contracts.FilterType_:
		return strings.EqualFold(string(entry.Type), criteria.Value)
	}
	return true
}

func compareStrings(a, b, operator string, caseSensitive bool) bool {
	if !caseSensitive {
		a = strings.ToLower(a)
		b = strings.ToLower(b)
	}
	switch operator {
	case "equals":
		return a == b
	case "startsWith":
		return strings.HasPrefix(a, b)
	case "endsWith":
		return strings.HasSuffix(a, b)
	case "contains", "":
		return strings.Contains(a, b)
	}
	return strings.Contains(a, b)
}
`````

## File: manager/internal/app/host_resources.go
`````go
package app

import (
	"sync"

	internalbrowserpane "wails-app/internal/browserpane"
)

// hostResources owns Wails-host runtime resources that are not domain state.
// Keeping them separate prevents App from becoming the lifecycle owner for
// unrelated infrastructure as new bindings are added.
type hostResources struct {
	streamMu      sync.RWMutex
	streamBaseURL string

	browserPaneMu sync.Mutex
	browserPanes  *internalbrowserpane.Service
}

func newHostResources() *hostResources {
	return &hostResources{}
}

func (r *hostResources) setStreamBaseURL(baseURL string) {
	if r == nil {
		return
	}
	r.streamMu.Lock()
	r.streamBaseURL = baseURL
	r.streamMu.Unlock()
}

func (r *hostResources) streamURL() string {
	if r == nil {
		return ""
	}
	r.streamMu.RLock()
	defer r.streamMu.RUnlock()
	return r.streamBaseURL
}

func (r *hostResources) browserPaneService(emitEvent func(string, interface{})) *internalbrowserpane.Service {
	r.browserPaneMu.Lock()
	defer r.browserPaneMu.Unlock()
	if r.browserPanes == nil {
		r.browserPanes = internalbrowserpane.NewService(emitEvent)
	}
	return r.browserPanes
}

func (r *hostResources) shutdown() {
	if r == nil {
		return
	}

	// Detach before shutting down so a repeated shutdown is idempotent and the
	// resource is no longer retained by the composition root.
	r.browserPaneMu.Lock()
	service := r.browserPanes
	r.browserPanes = nil
	r.browserPaneMu.Unlock()

	if service != nil {
		_ = service.Shutdown()
	}
}

func (a *App) SetStreamBaseURL(baseURL string) {
	a.hostResourcesOrCreate().setStreamBaseURL(baseURL)
}

func (a *App) StreamBaseURL() string {
	return a.hostResourcesOrCreate().streamURL()
}

func (a *App) browserPaneService() *internalbrowserpane.Service {
	return a.hostResourcesOrCreate().browserPaneService(a.EmitEvent)
}

func (a *App) hostResourcesOrCreate() *hostResources {
	if a.hostResources == nil {
		a.hostResources = newHostResources()
	}
	return a.hostResources
}
`````

## File: manager/internal/app/proxy.go
`````go
package app

import (
	"fmt"
	"net"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httputil"
	"net/url"
	"time"

	"wails-app/vfs/archive/cache"
)

// StartDevProxy starts a reverse proxy on localhost for development.
// It routes /wails-stream/* to the stream server and everything else to Angular dev server.
func StartDevProxy(streamBaseURL, angularDevURL string, archCache *cache.Cache) (*http.Server, string, error) {
	listener, err := net.Listen("tcp", "127.0.0.1:0")
	if err != nil {
		return nil, "", fmt.Errorf("start dev proxy: %w", err)
	}

	proxyPort := listener.Addr().String()

	// Parse URLs for proxying
	streamURL, err := url.Parse(streamBaseURL)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, "", fmt.Errorf("invalid stream base URL: %w", err)
	}

	angularURL, err := url.Parse(angularDevURL)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, "", fmt.Errorf("invalid angular dev URL: %w", err)
	}

	// Create reverse proxies
	streamProxy := httputil.NewSingleHostReverseProxy(streamURL)
	angularProxy := httputil.NewSingleHostReverseProxy(angularURL)

	// Main proxy handler
	handler := http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		if r.URL.Path == "/wails-stream" || len(r.URL.Path) > len("/wails-stream") && r.URL.Path[:len("/wails-stream")] == "/wails-stream" {
			// Stream requests go to stream server
			streamProxy.ServeHTTP(w, r)
			return
		}
		// Everything else goes to Angular dev server
		angularProxy.ServeHTTP(w, r)
	})

	server := &http.Server{
		Handler:           handler,
		ReadHeaderTimeout: 30 * time.Second,
	}

	go func() {
		if err := server.Serve(listener); err != nil && err != http.ErrServerClosed {
			println("dev proxy error:", err.Error())
		}
	}()

	return server, "http://" + proxyPort, nil
}
`````

## File: manager/internal/app/remote_listing.go
`````go
package app

import (
	"fmt"
	"net/url"
	"sort"
	"strconv"
	"strings"

	contracts "wails-app/internal/contracts"
	"wails-app/internal/pathref"
)

// ListDirectory is the pane-facing directory entrypoint. It can expose remote
// scheme roots and auto-mount SMB locations on first navigation.
func (s *State) ListDirectory(path string, showHidden bool) (*contracts.DirectoryListing, error) {
	normalized := pathref.Normalize(path)
	if listing, ok := s.listRemoteRoot(normalized); ok {
		return listing, nil
	}
	if err := s.ensureRemoteMount(normalized); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return s.Filesystem.ListDirectory(normalized, showHidden)
}

func (s *State) GetFileInfo(path string) (*contracts.FileInfo, error) {
	normalized := pathref.Normalize(path)
	if protocol, ok := remoteProtocolRoot(normalized); ok {
		return &contracts.FileInfo{
			Name: pathref.FromVFS(remoteRootMountPoint(protocol)),
			Path: normalized,
			Type: contracts.FileTypeDirectory,
		}, nil
	}
	if err := s.ensureRemoteMount(normalized); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return s.Filesystem.GetFileInfo(normalized)
}

func (s *State) ProbeFile(path string) (*contracts.FileProbe, error) {
	normalized := pathref.Normalize(path)
	if _, ok := remoteProtocolRoot(normalized); ok {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("cannot probe remote root")
	}
	if err := s.ensureRemoteMount(normalized); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return s.Filesystem.ProbeFile(normalized)
}

func (s *State) ensureRemoteMount(path string) error {
	if s.vfs == nil {
		return nil
	}

	cfg, ok, err := remoteConfigFromPublicPath(path)
	if err != nil || !ok {
		return err
	}

	mountPath := remoteMountPath(cfg)
	if mountPath == "" || s.vfs.IsMounted(mountPath) {
		return nil
	}

	if cfg.Protocol != contracts.ProtocolSMB {
		return nil
	}

	_, err = s.RemoteConnect(cfg)
	return err
}

func (s *State) listRemoteRoot(path string) (*contracts.DirectoryListing, bool) {
	protocol, ok := remoteProtocolRoot(path)
	if !ok {
		return nil, false
	}

	s.remotesMu.Lock()
	defer s.remotesMu.Unlock()

	entries := make([]contracts.FileInfo, 0, len(s.remotes))
	for _, mount := range s.remotes {
		if mount.Protocol != protocol {
			continue
		}

		name := strings.TrimPrefix(mount.PublicPath, path)
		if name == "" || name == mount.PublicPath {
			name = mount.Host
		}

		entries = append(entries, contracts.FileInfo{
			Name: name,
			Path: mount.PublicPath,
			Type: contracts.FileTypeDirectory,
		})
	}

	sort.Slice(entries, func(i, j int) bool {
		return strings.ToLower(entries[i].Path) < strings.ToLower(entries[j].Path)
	})

	return &contracts.DirectoryListing{
		Path:      path,
		Entries:   entries,
		TotalSize: 0,
	}, true
}

func remoteProtocolRoot(path string) (contracts.RemoteProtocol, bool) {
	switch strings.ToLower(path) {
	case pathref.SMBScheme:
		return contracts.ProtocolSMB, true
	case pathref.S3Scheme:
		return contracts.ProtocolS3, true
	default:
		return "", false
	}
}

func remoteRootMountPoint(protocol contracts.RemoteProtocol) string {
	switch protocol {
	case contracts.ProtocolSMB:
		return "/remote/smb"
	case contracts.ProtocolS3:
		return "/remote/s3"
	default:
		return ""
	}
}

func remoteConfigFromPublicPath(path string) (contracts.RemoteConfig, bool, error) {
	normalized := pathref.Normalize(path)
	parsed, err := url.Parse(normalized)
	if err != nil {
		return contracts.RemoteConfig{}, false, fmt.Errorf("invalid remote path %q: %w", path, err)
	}

	if parsed.Host == "" {
		return contracts.RemoteConfig{}, false, nil
	}

	switch strings.ToLower(parsed.Scheme) {
	case string(contracts.ProtocolSMB):
		port := 445
		if rawPort := parsed.Port(); rawPort != "" {
			parsedPort, convErr := strconv.Atoi(rawPort)
			if convErr != nil {
				return contracts.RemoteConfig{}, false, fmt.Errorf("invalid SMB port %q", rawPort)
			}
			port = parsedPort
		}

		username := ""
		password := ""
		if parsed.User != nil {
			if user := parsed.User.Username(); user != "" {
				username = user
				if pass, ok := parsed.User.Password(); ok {
					password = pass
				} else {
					password = ""
				}
			}
		}

		share := ""
		if pathSegments := strings.Split(strings.Trim(parsed.Path, "/"), "/"); len(pathSegments) > 0 {
			share = strings.TrimSpace(pathSegments[0])
		}

		return contracts.RemoteConfig{
			Protocol: contracts.ProtocolSMB,
			Host:     parsed.Hostname(),
			Port:     port,
			Username: username,
			Password: password,
			Share:    share,
		}, true, nil
	case string(contracts.ProtocolS3):
		alias := strings.TrimSpace(parsed.Hostname())
		if alias == "" {
			return contracts.RemoteConfig{}, false, nil
		}

		return contracts.RemoteConfig{
			Protocol: contracts.ProtocolS3,
			Name:     alias,
		}, true, nil

	default:
		return contracts.RemoteConfig{}, false, nil
	}
}
`````

`````go
package app

func TestBuildRemoteOAuthAuthURLGoogle(t *testing.T) {
	session := &remoteOAuthSession{
		protocol:     contracts.ProtocolGDrive,
		clientID:     "google-client",
		redirectURI:  "http://127.0.0.1:32123/oauth/callback",
		state:        "state-123",
		codeVerifier: "verifier-123",
		scopes:       []string{"https://www.googleapis.com/auth/drive.readonly"},
	}

	rawURL, err := buildRemoteOAuthAuthURL(session)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("buildRemoteOAuthAuthURL() error = %v", err)
	}

	parsed, err := url.Parse(rawURL)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("url.Parse() error = %v", err)
	}

	if parsed.Host != "accounts.google.com" {
		t.Fatalf("host = %q, want accounts.google.com", parsed.Host)
	}

	query := parsed.Query()
	if got := query.Get("client_id"); got != "google-client" {
		t.Fatalf("client_id = %q, want google-client", got)
	}
	if got := query.Get("redirect_uri"); got != session.redirectURI {
		t.Fatalf("redirect_uri = %q, want %q", got, session.redirectURI)
	}
	if got := query.Get("code_challenge_method"); got != "S256" {
		t.Fatalf("code_challenge_method = %q, want S256", got)
	}
	if got := query.Get("access_type"); got != "offline" {
		t.Fatalf("access_type = %q, want offline", got)
	}
	if got := query.Get("prompt"); got != "consent" {
		t.Fatalf("prompt = %q, want consent", got)
	}
	if got := query.Get("scope"); !strings.Contains(got, "drive.readonly") {
		t.Fatalf("scope = %q, want drive.readonly", got)
	}
`````

## File: manager/internal/app/remote_oauth.go
`````go
package app

import (
	"context"
	"crypto/rand"
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/base64"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"net"
	"net/http"
	"net/url"
	"strings"
	"sync"
	"time"

	contracts "wails-app/internal/contracts"
)

const (
	remoteOAuthStatusPending   = "pending"
	remoteOAuthStatusComplete  = "complete"
	remoteOAuthStatusFailed    = "failed"
	remoteOAuthStatusCancelled = "cancelled"
)

type remoteOAuthSession struct {
	id           string
	protocol     contracts.RemoteProtocol
	clientID     string
	tenant       string
	redirectURI  string
	state        string
	codeVerifier string
	scopes       []string

	mu           sync.Mutex
	refreshMu    sync.Mutex
	status       string
	err          string
	accountName  string
	accountEmail string
	accessToken  string
	refreshToken string
	expiry       time.Time
	refCount     int

	server *http.Server
}

type remoteOAuthProviderConfig struct {
	authURL       string
	tokenURL      string
	defaultScopes []string
}

type remoteOAuthTokenResponse struct {
	AccessToken  string `json:"access_token"`
	RefreshToken string `json:"refresh_token"`
	ExpiresIn    int64  `json:"expires_in"`
	TokenType    string `json:"token_type"`
	Scope        string `json:"scope"`
	Error        string `json:"error"`
	Description  string `json:"error_description"`
}

func (s *State) RemoteOAuthBegin(req contracts.RemoteOAuthBeginRequest) (*contracts.RemoteOAuthBeginResponse, error) {
	protocol := req.Protocol
	if !isRemoteOAuthProtocol(protocol) {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("oauth is not supported for protocol: %s", protocol)
	}

	clientID := strings.TrimSpace(req.ClientID)
	if clientID == "" {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("client ID is required")
	}

	sessionID, err := randomToken(24)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("oauth: generate session id: %w", err)
	}
	stateToken, err := randomToken(24)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("oauth: generate state: %w", err)
	}
	codeVerifier, err := randomToken(48)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("oauth: generate verifier: %w", err)
	}

	listener, err := net.Listen("tcp", "127.0.0.1:0")
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("oauth: start callback listener: %w", err)
	}

	redirectURI := fmt.Sprintf("http://localhost:%d", listener.Addr().(*net.TCPAddr).Port)
	session := &remoteOAuthSession{
		id:           sessionID,
		protocol:     protocol,
		clientID:     clientID,
		tenant:       normalizeRemoteOAuthTenant(protocol, req.Tenant),
		redirectURI:  redirectURI,
		state:        stateToken,
		codeVerifier: codeVerifier,
		scopes:       normalizeRemoteOAuthScopes(protocol, req.Scopes),
		status:       remoteOAuthStatusPending,
	}

	mux := http.NewServeMux()
	callbackHandler := func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		s.handleRemoteOAuthCallback(session, w, r)
	}
	mux.HandleFunc("/", callbackHandler)
	mux.HandleFunc("/oauth/callback", callbackHandler)
	session.server = &http.Server{
		Handler:           mux,
		ReadHeaderTimeout: 15 * time.Second,
	}

	s.remoteOAuthMu.Lock()
	if existing := s.remoteOAuth[sessionID]; existing != nil {
		s.remoteOAuthMu.Unlock()
		listener.Close()
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("oauth: duplicate session id")
	}
	s.remoteOAuth[sessionID] = session
	s.remoteOAuthMu.Unlock()

	go func() {
		if err := session.server.Serve(listener); err != nil && err != http.ErrServerClosed {
			session.setFailure(fmt.Sprintf("callback listener failed: %v", err))
		}
	}()

	authURL, err := buildRemoteOAuthAuthURL(session)
	if err != nil {
		_ = session.shutdownCallbackServer(context.Background())
		s.remoteOAuthMu.Lock()
		delete(s.remoteOAuth, sessionID)
		s.remoteOAuthMu.Unlock()
		return nil, err
	}

	return &contracts.RemoteOAuthBeginResponse{
		SessionID:   session.id,
		Protocol:    session.protocol,
		AuthURL:     authURL,
		RedirectURI: session.redirectURI,
	}, nil
}

func (s *State) RemoteOAuthStatus(sessionID string) (*contracts.RemoteOAuthStatus, error) {
	session := s.getRemoteOAuthSession(sessionID)
	if session == nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("oauth session not found")
	}
	return session.snapshot(), nil
}

func (s *State) RemoteOAuthCancel(sessionID string) error {
	session := s.getRemoteOAuthSession(sessionID)
	if session == nil {
		return nil
	}

	session.mu.Lock()
	if session.status == remoteOAuthStatusPending {
		session.status = remoteOAuthStatusCancelled
	}
	session.mu.Unlock()

	if session.mountRefs() == 0 {
		s.remoteOAuthMu.Lock()
		delete(s.remoteOAuth, sessionID)
		s.remoteOAuthMu.Unlock()
	}
	return session.shutdownCallbackServer(context.Background())
}

func (s *State) RemoteConnectOAuth(req contracts.RemoteOAuthConnectRequest) (*contracts.RemoteMount, error) {
	session := s.getRemoteOAuthSession(req.SessionID)
	if session == nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("oauth session not found")
	}
	status := session.snapshot()
	if status.Status != remoteOAuthStatusComplete {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("oauth session is not ready")
	}

	mountName := strings.TrimSpace(req.Name)
	if mountName == "" {
		switch session.protocol {
		case contracts.ProtocolGDrive:
			mountName = "Google Drive"
		case contracts.ProtocolDropbox:
			mountName = "Dropbox"
		case contracts.ProtocolOneDrive:
			mountName = "OneDrive"
		}
	}

	mount, err := s.remoteConnect(contracts.RemoteConfig{
		Protocol: session.protocol,
		Name:     mountName,
	}, session)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	s.remoteOAuthMu.Lock()
	if current := s.remoteOAuth[session.id]; current != nil {
		current.mu.Lock()
		current.refCount++
		current.mu.Unlock()
		s.remoteOAuthRefs[mount.MountPoint] = session.id
	}
	s.remoteOAuthMu.Unlock()

	return mount, nil
}

func (s *State) handleRemoteOAuthCallback(session *remoteOAuthSession, w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	query := r.URL.Query()
	if !strings.EqualFold(query.Get("state"), session.state) {
		session.setFailure("state mismatch")
		writeRemoteOAuthHTML(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Authentication failed", "The OAuth state token did not match. Close this page and try again.")
		_ = session.shutdownCallbackServer(context.Background())
		return
	}

	if authErr := strings.TrimSpace(query.Get("error")); authErr != "" {
		description := strings.TrimSpace(query.Get("error_description"))
		if description != "" {
			session.setFailure(description)
		} else {
			session.setFailure(authErr)
		}
		writeRemoteOAuthHTML(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Authentication failed", session.errString())
		_ = session.shutdownCallbackServer(context.Background())
		return
	}

	code := strings.TrimSpace(query.Get("code"))
	if code == "" {
		session.setFailure("authorization code was not returned")
		writeRemoteOAuthHTML(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Authentication failed", "No authorization code was returned by the provider.")
		_ = session.shutdownCallbackServer(context.Background())
		return
	}

	if err := session.exchangeCode(r.Context(), code); err != nil {
		session.setFailure(err.Error())
		writeRemoteOAuthHTML(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Authentication failed", session.errString())
		_ = session.shutdownCallbackServer(context.Background())
		return
	}

	_ = session.loadAccountProfile(r.Context())
	writeRemoteOAuthHTML(w, http.StatusOK, "Authentication complete", "You can close this tab and return to the app.")
	_ = session.shutdownCallbackServer(context.Background())
}

func (s *State) getRemoteOAuthSession(sessionID string) *remoteOAuthSession {
	s.remoteOAuthMu.Lock()
	defer s.remoteOAuthMu.Unlock()
	return s.remoteOAuth[strings.TrimSpace(sessionID)]
}

func (s *State) releaseRemoteOAuthMount(mountPoint string) {
	s.remoteOAuthMu.Lock()
	sessionID := s.remoteOAuthRefs[mountPoint]
	if sessionID != "" {
		delete(s.remoteOAuthRefs, mountPoint)
	}
	session := s.remoteOAuth[sessionID]
	if session != nil {
		session.mu.Lock()
		if session.refCount > 0 {
			session.refCount--
		}
		refs := session.refCount
		status := session.status
		session.mu.Unlock()
		if refs == 0 && status != remoteOAuthStatusPending {
			delete(s.remoteOAuth, sessionID)
		}
	}
	s.remoteOAuthMu.Unlock()
}

func (s *State) shutdownRemoteOAuthSessions() {
	s.remoteOAuthMu.Lock()
	sessions := make([]*remoteOAuthSession, 0, len(s.remoteOAuth))
	for id, session := range s.remoteOAuth {
		delete(s.remoteOAuth, id)
		sessions = append(sessions, session)
	}
	clear(s.remoteOAuthRefs)
	s.remoteOAuthMu.Unlock()

	for _, session := range sessions {
		_ = session.shutdownCallbackServer(context.Background())
	}
}

func (s *remoteOAuthSession) snapshot() *contracts.RemoteOAuthStatus {
	s.mu.Lock()
	defer s.mu.Unlock()
	status := &contracts.RemoteOAuthStatus{
		SessionID:    s.id,
		Protocol:     s.protocol,
		Status:       s.status,
		Error:        s.err,
		AccountName:  s.accountName,
		AccountEmail: s.accountEmail,
	}
	if !s.expiry.IsZero() {
		status.ExpiresAt = s.expiry.Unix()
	}
	return status
}

func (s *remoteOAuthSession) setFailure(message string) {
	s.mu.Lock()
	defer s.mu.Unlock()
	if s.status == remoteOAuthStatusComplete {
		return
	}
	s.status = remoteOAuthStatusFailed
	s.err = strings.TrimSpace(message)
}

func (s *remoteOAuthSession) errString() string {
	s.mu.Lock()
	defer s.mu.Unlock()
	if strings.TrimSpace(s.err) == "" {
		return "Authentication failed."
	}
	return s.err
}

func (s *remoteOAuthSession) shutdownCallbackServer(ctx context.Context) error {
	if s.server == nil {
		return nil
	}
	shutdownCtx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, 3*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	return s.server.Shutdown(shutdownCtx)
}

func (s *remoteOAuthSession) mountRefs() int {
	s.mu.Lock()
	defer s.mu.Unlock()
	return s.refCount
}

func (s *remoteOAuthSession) AccessToken(ctx context.Context) (string, error) {
	s.mu.Lock()
	if strings.TrimSpace(s.accessToken) == "" {
		err := s.err
		s.mu.Unlock()
		if err == "" {
			err = "oauth access token is not available"
		}
		return "", fmt.Errorf("%s", err)
	}
	if s.refreshToken == "" || time.Until(s.expiry) > 90*time.Second {
		token := s.accessToken
		s.mu.Unlock()
		return token, nil
	}
	s.mu.Unlock()

	// Serialize refreshes so simultaneous VFS requests do not all exchange the
	// same refresh token. Re-check after acquiring the lock because another
	// caller may already have refreshed the session.
	s.refreshMu.Lock()
	defer s.refreshMu.Unlock()
	s.mu.Lock()
	if strings.TrimSpace(s.accessToken) != "" && (s.refreshToken == "" || time.Until(s.expiry) > 90*time.Second) {
		token := s.accessToken
		s.mu.Unlock()
		return token, nil
	}
	s.mu.Unlock()

	if err := s.refresh(ctx); err != nil {
		return "", err
	}

	s.mu.Lock()
	defer s.mu.Unlock()
	if strings.TrimSpace(s.accessToken) == "" {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("oauth access token is not available")
	}
	return s.accessToken, nil
}

func (s *remoteOAuthSession) exchangeCode(ctx context.Context, code string) error {
	token, err := s.exchange(ctx, url.Values{
		"grant_type":    {"authorization_code"},
		"code":          {code},
		"client_id":     {s.clientID},
		"redirect_uri":  {s.redirectURI},
		"code_verifier": {s.codeVerifier},
	})
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}

	s.mu.Lock()
	defer s.mu.Unlock()
	s.status = remoteOAuthStatusComplete
	s.err = ""
	s.accessToken = token.AccessToken
	if token.RefreshToken != "" {
		s.refreshToken = token.RefreshToken
	}
	s.expiry = time.Now().Add(time.Duration(token.ExpiresIn) * time.Second)
	return nil
}

func (s *remoteOAuthSession) refresh(ctx context.Context) error {
	s.mu.Lock()
	refreshToken := s.refreshToken
	s.mu.Unlock()
	if strings.TrimSpace(refreshToken) == "" {
		return nil
	}

	token, err := s.exchange(ctx, url.Values{
		"grant_type":    {"refresh_token"},
		"refresh_token": {refreshToken},
		"client_id":     {s.clientID},
		"scope":         {strings.Join(s.scopes, " ")},
	})
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}

	s.mu.Lock()
	defer s.mu.Unlock()
	s.accessToken = token.AccessToken
	if token.RefreshToken != "" {
		s.refreshToken = token.RefreshToken
	}
	if token.ExpiresIn > 0 {
		s.expiry = time.Now().Add(time.Duration(token.ExpiresIn) * time.Second)
	}
	return nil
}

func (s *remoteOAuthSession) exchange(ctx context.Context, values url.Values) (*remoteOAuthTokenResponse, error) {
	config := remoteOAuthProvider(s.protocol, s.tenant)
	request, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, http.MethodPost, config.tokenURL, strings.NewReader(values.Encode()))
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	request.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/x-www-form-urlencoded")

	response, err := http.DefaultClient.Do(request)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer response.Body.Close()

	var token remoteOAuthTokenResponse
	if err := json.NewDecoder(response.Body).Decode(&token); err != nil {
		body, _ := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(response.Body, 2048))
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("oauth token response decode failed: %v %s", err, strings.TrimSpace(string(body)))
	}

	if response.StatusCode < http.StatusOK || response.StatusCode >= http.StatusBadRequest {
		message := strings.TrimSpace(token.Description)
		if message == "" {
			message = strings.TrimSpace(token.Error)
		}
		if message == "" {
			message = fmt.Sprintf("token exchange failed with HTTP %d", response.StatusCode)
		}
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("%s", message)
	}
	if strings.TrimSpace(token.AccessToken) == "" {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("provider did not return an access token")
	}
	return &token, nil
}

func (s *remoteOAuthSession) loadAccountProfile(ctx context.Context) error {
	type profile struct {
		Name  string
		Email string
	}

	result := profile{}
	switch s.protocol {
	case contracts.ProtocolGDrive:
		var response struct {
			User struct {
				DisplayName  string `json:"displayName"`
				EmailAddress string `json:"emailAddress"`
			} `json:"user"`
		}
		if err := s.getJSON(ctx, "https://www.googleapis.com/drive/v3/about?fields=user(displayName,emailAddress)", &response); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		result.Name = response.User.DisplayName
		result.Email = response.User.EmailAddress
	case contracts.ProtocolDropbox:
		var response struct {
			Name struct {
				DisplayName string `json:"display_name"`
			} `json:"name"`
			Email string `json:"email"`
		}
		if err := s.postJSON(ctx, "https://api.dropboxapi.com/2/users/get_current_account", "null", &response); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		result.Name = response.Name.DisplayName
		result.Email = response.Email
	case contracts.ProtocolOneDrive:
		var response struct {
			DisplayName       string `json:"displayName"`
			UserPrincipalName string `json:"userPrincipalName"`
			Mail              string `json:"mail"`
		}
		if err := s.getJSON(ctx, "https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/me?$select=displayName,userPrincipalName,mail", &response); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		result.Name = response.DisplayName
		result.Email = strings.TrimSpace(response.Mail)
		if result.Email == "" {
			result.Email = response.UserPrincipalName
		}
	}

	s.mu.Lock()
	defer s.mu.Unlock()
	if strings.TrimSpace(result.Name) != "" {
		s.accountName = result.Name
	}
	if strings.TrimSpace(result.Email) != "" {
		s.accountEmail = result.Email
	}
	return nil
}

func (s *remoteOAuthSession) getJSON(ctx context.Context, endpoint string, target any) error {
	request, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, http.MethodGet, endpoint, nil)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	token, err := s.AccessToken(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	request.Header.Set("Authorization", "Bearer "+token)

	response, err := http.DefaultClient.Do(request)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer response.Body.Close()
	if response.StatusCode < http.StatusOK || response.StatusCode >= http.StatusBadRequest {
		body, _ := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(response.Body, 2048))
		return fmt.Errorf("profile request failed: HTTP %d: %s", response.StatusCode, strings.TrimSpace(string(body)))
	}
	return json.NewDecoder(response.Body).Decode(target)
}

func (s *remoteOAuthSession) postJSON(ctx context.Context, endpoint string, body string, target any) error {
	request, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, http.MethodPost, endpoint, strings.NewReader(body))
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	token, err := s.AccessToken(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	request.Header.Set("Authorization", "Bearer "+token)
	request.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")

	response, err := http.DefaultClient.Do(request)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer response.Body.Close()
	if response.StatusCode < http.StatusOK || response.StatusCode >= http.StatusBadRequest {
		body, _ := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(response.Body, 2048))
		return fmt.Errorf("profile request failed: HTTP %d: %s", response.StatusCode, strings.TrimSpace(string(body)))
	}
	return json.NewDecoder(response.Body).Decode(target)
}

func buildRemoteOAuthAuthURL(session *remoteOAuthSession) (string, error) {
	config := remoteOAuthProvider(session.protocol, session.tenant)
	values := url.Values{
		"client_id":             {session.clientID},
		"redirect_uri":          {session.redirectURI},
		"response_type":         {"code"},
		"state":                 {session.state},
		"code_challenge":        {pkceChallenge(session.codeVerifier)},
		"code_challenge_method": {"S256"},
	}

	scope := strings.Join(session.scopes, " ")
	if scope != "" {
		values.Set("scope", scope)
	}

	switch session.protocol {
	case contracts.ProtocolGDrive:
		values.Set("access_type", "offline")
		values.Set("include_granted_scopes", "true")
		values.Set("prompt", "consent")
	case contracts.ProtocolDropbox:
		values.Set("token_access_type", "offline")
	case contracts.ProtocolOneDrive:
		values.Set("response_mode", "query")
	}

	authURL, err := url.Parse(config.authURL)
	if err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	authURL.RawQuery = values.Encode()
	return authURL.String(), nil
}

func remoteOAuthProvider(protocol contracts.RemoteProtocol, tenant string) remoteOAuthProviderConfig {
	switch protocol {
	case contracts.ProtocolGDrive:
		return remoteOAuthProviderConfig{
			authURL:       "https://accounts.google.com/o/oauth2/v2/auth",
			tokenURL:      "https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token",
			defaultScopes: []string{"https://www.googleapis.com/auth/drive.readonly"},
		}
	case contracts.ProtocolDropbox:
		return remoteOAuthProviderConfig{
			authURL:       "https://www.dropbox.com/oauth2/authorize",
			tokenURL:      "https://api.dropboxapi.com/oauth2/token",
			defaultScopes: []string{"files.metadata.read", "files.content.read"},
		}
	case contracts.ProtocolOneDrive:
		base := "https://login.microsoftonline.com/" + normalizeRemoteOAuthTenant(protocol, tenant) + "/oauth2/v2.0"
		return remoteOAuthProviderConfig{
			authURL:       base + "/authorize",
			tokenURL:      base + "/token",
			defaultScopes: []string{"offline_access", "openid", "profile", "Files.Read"},
		}
	default:
		return remoteOAuthProviderConfig{}
	}
}

func normalizeRemoteOAuthScopes(protocol contracts.RemoteProtocol, scopes []string) []string {
	if len(scopes) == 0 {
		return append([]string(nil), remoteOAuthProvider(protocol, "").defaultScopes...)
	}
	result := make([]string, 0, len(scopes))
	for _, scope := range scopes {
		trimmed := strings.TrimSpace(scope)
		if trimmed != "" {
			result = append(result, trimmed)
		}
	}
	if len(result) == 0 {
		return append([]string(nil), remoteOAuthProvider(protocol, "").defaultScopes...)
	}
	return result
}

func normalizeRemoteOAuthTenant(protocol contracts.RemoteProtocol, tenant string) string {
	if protocol != contracts.ProtocolOneDrive {
		return ""
	}
	trimmed := strings.TrimSpace(tenant)
	if trimmed == "" {
		return "common"
	}
	return trimmed
}

func isRemoteOAuthProtocol(protocol contracts.RemoteProtocol) bool {
	return protocol == contracts.ProtocolGDrive ||
		protocol == contracts.ProtocolDropbox ||
		protocol == contracts.ProtocolOneDrive
}

func randomToken(length int) (string, error) {
	buf := make([]byte, length)
	if _, err := rand.Read(buf); err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	return base64.RawURLEncoding.EncodeToString(buf), nil
}

func pkceChallenge(verifier string) string {
	sum := sha256.Sum256([]byte(verifier))
	return base64.RawURLEncoding.EncodeToString(sum[:])
}

func writeRemoteOAuthHTML(w http.ResponseWriter, status int, title string, message string) {
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "text/html; charset=utf-8")
	w.WriteHeader(status)
	_, _ = io.WriteString(w, "<!doctype html><html><head><meta charset=\"utf-8\"><title>"+htmlEscape(title)+"</title><style>body{font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;background:#10161f;color:#f3f6fb;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;min-height:100vh;margin:0;padding:24px}main{max-width:560px;background:#182130;border:1px solid #2c394b;border-radius:14px;padding:24px;box-shadow:0 18px 50px rgba(0,0,0,.28)}h1{margin:0 0 10px;font-size:22px}p{margin:0;color:#d1d9e6;line-height:1.5}</style></head><body><main><h1>"+htmlEscape(title)+"</h1><p>"+htmlEscape(message)+"</p></main></body></html>")
}

func htmlEscape(value string) string {
	replacer := strings.NewReplacer(
		"&", "&amp;",
		"<", "&lt;",
		">", "&gt;",
		"\"", "&quot;",
		"'", "&#39;",
	)
	return replacer.Replace(value)
}
`````

`````go
package app

import (
	"testing"
	contracts "wails-app/internal/contracts"
)

func TestRemoteProviderCapabilities(t *testing.T) {
	for _, p := range []contracts.RemoteProtocol{contracts.ProtocolSMB, contracts.ProtocolS3, contracts.ProtocolGDrive, contracts.ProtocolOneDrive} {
		provider, err := remoteProviderFor(p)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		c := provider.Descriptor().Capabilities
		if p == contracts.ProtocolSMB && (!c.Rename || !c.AtomicMove || c.Pagination || c.Trash) {
			t.Fatalf("bad smb: %+v", c)
		}
		if p == contracts.ProtocolS3 && (!c.Pagination || !c.RandomAccess || !c.RangeRead || c.Rename) {
			t.Fatalf("bad s3: %+v", c)
		}
		if (p == contracts.ProtocolGDrive || p == contracts.ProtocolOneDrive) && (!c.Pagination || c.RandomAccess || c.RangeRead || c.Rename) {
			t.Fatalf("bad cloud: %+v", c)
		}
	}
}
`````

`````go
package app

import (
	"testing"

	contracts "wails-app/internal/contracts"
)

func TestRemoteProviderDescriptorsExposeConnectionSemantics(t *testing.T) {
	providers := remoteProviderDescriptors()
	if len(providers) < 5 {
		t.Fatalf("expected built-in providers, got %d", len(providers))
	}

	byProtocol := make(map[contracts.RemoteProtocol]contracts.RemoteProviderDescriptor, len(providers))
	for _, provider := range providers {
		byProtocol[provider.Protocol] = provider
	}

	for _, protocol := range []contracts.RemoteProtocol{
		contracts.ProtocolGDrive,
		contracts.ProtocolOneDrive,
		contracts.ProtocolS3,
	} {
		if _, ok := byProtocol[protocol]; !ok {
			t.Fatalf("missing provider descriptor for %s", protocol)
		}
	}

	if got := byProtocol[contracts.ProtocolGDrive]; got.Auth != "oauth-or-token" || !got.ReadOnly || got.Hierarchy != "id-backed" {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected Google Drive descriptor: %#v", got)
	}
	if got := byProtocol[contracts.ProtocolOneDrive]; got.Auth != "oauth-or-token" || !got.ReadOnly || got.Hierarchy != "id-backed" {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected OneDrive descriptor: %#v", got)
	}
	if got := byProtocol[contracts.ProtocolS3]; got.Auth != "access-key" || !got.ReadOnly || got.Hierarchy != "object-prefix" {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected S3 descriptor: %#v", got)
	}
}

func TestRemoteProviderUsesNonPOSIXS3MountIdentity(t *testing.T) {
	provider, err := remoteProviderFor(contracts.ProtocolS3)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	cfg := contracts.RemoteConfig{
		Protocol: contracts.ProtocolS3,
		Name:     "archive-store",
		Bucket:   "company-archive",
		Prefix:   "2026/reports",
	}
	if got, want := provider.MountPath(cfg), "/remote/s3/archive-store"; got != want {
		t.Fatalf("mount path mismatch: got %q want %q", got, want)
	}
	if got, want := provider.DisplayName(cfg), "archive-store (company-archive)"; got != want {
		t.Fatalf("display name mismatch: got %q want %q", got, want)
	}
	if provider.Descriptor().Hierarchy != "object-prefix" {
		t.Fatalf("S3 must advertise object-prefix hierarchy, got %q", provider.Descriptor().Hierarchy)
	}
}

func TestUnsupportedRemoteProviderFailsBeforeConnection(t *testing.T) {
	if _, err := remoteProviderFor(contracts.RemoteProtocol("unknown")); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("expected unsupported provider error")
	}
}
`````

`````go
package app

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"sort"
	"strings"

	contracts "wails-app/internal/contracts"
	vfslib "wails-app/vfs"
	"wails-app/vfs/cloudutil"
	vfsdropbox "wails-app/vfs/dropbox"
	vfsgdrive "wails-app/vfs/gdrive"
	vfsonedrive "wails-app/vfs/onedrive"
	vfss3 "wails-app/vfs/s3"
	vfssmb "wails-app/vfs/smb"
)

// remoteProvider is the backend provider contract used by RemoteConnect.
// It intentionally lives below the plugin layer: Phase 69 can adapt plugin
// contributions to this same contract without changing connection semantics.
type remoteProvider interface {
	Descriptor() contracts.RemoteProviderDescriptor
	Connect(context.Context, contracts.RemoteConfig, cloudutil.AccessTokenSource) (vfslib.FileSystem, error)
	MountPath(contracts.RemoteConfig) string
	DisplayName(contracts.RemoteConfig) string
	Host(contracts.RemoteConfig) string
}

type builtinRemoteProvider struct {
	descriptor contracts.RemoteProviderDescriptor
	connect    func(context.Context, contracts.RemoteConfig, cloudutil.AccessTokenSource) (vfslib.FileSystem, error)
}

func (p builtinRemoteProvider) Descriptor() contracts.RemoteProviderDescriptor { return p.descriptor }
func (p builtinRemoteProvider) MountPath(cfg contracts.RemoteConfig) string {
	return remoteMountPathFor(p.descriptor.Protocol, cfg)
}
func (p builtinRemoteProvider) DisplayName(cfg contracts.RemoteConfig) string {
	return remoteDisplayNameFor(p.descriptor.Protocol, cfg)
}
func (p builtinRemoteProvider) Host(cfg contracts.RemoteConfig) string {
	return remoteMountHostFor(p.descriptor.Protocol, cfg)
}
func (p builtinRemoteProvider) Connect(ctx context.Context, cfg contracts.RemoteConfig, token cloudutil.AccessTokenSource) (vfslib.FileSystem, error) {
	return p.connect(ctx, cfg, token)
}

var builtinRemoteProviders = map[contracts.RemoteProtocol]remoteProvider{
	contracts.ProtocolSMB: builtinRemoteProvider{
		descriptor: contracts.RemoteProviderDescriptor{Protocol: contracts.ProtocolSMB, Name: "SMB", Auth: "credentials", ReadOnly: false, Hierarchy: "posix-like", Capabilities: contracts.ProviderCapabilities{Pagination: false, RandomAccess: true, TotalCount: true, ServerSort: false, ServerFilter: false, RangeRead: true, Watch: false, Rename: true, AtomicMove: true, Trash: false}},
		connect: func(ctx context.Context, cfg contracts.RemoteConfig, _ cloudutil.AccessTokenSource) (vfslib.FileSystem, error) {
			return vfssmb.New(ctx, vfssmb.Config{Host: cfg.Host, Port: cfg.Port, Domain: cfg.Domain, Username: cfg.Username, Password: cfg.Password, Share: cfg.Share})
		},
	},
	contracts.ProtocolS3: builtinRemoteProvider{
		descriptor: contracts.RemoteProviderDescriptor{Protocol: contracts.ProtocolS3, Name: "S3", Auth: "access-key", ReadOnly: true, Hierarchy: "object-prefix", Capabilities: contracts.ProviderCapabilities{Pagination: true, RandomAccess: true, TotalCount: false, ServerSort: false, ServerFilter: false, RangeRead: true, Watch: false, Rename: false, AtomicMove: false, Trash: false}},
		connect: func(ctx context.Context, cfg contracts.RemoteConfig, _ cloudutil.AccessTokenSource) (vfslib.FileSystem, error) {
			return vfss3.New(ctx, vfss3.Config{Region: cfg.Region, Bucket: cfg.Bucket, Prefix: cfg.Prefix, Endpoint: cfg.Endpoint, AccessKeyID: cfg.AccessKeyID, SecretAccessKey: cfg.SecretAccessKey, SessionToken: cfg.SessionToken, Anonymous: cfg.Anonymous, UsePathStyle: cfg.UsePathStyle, Insecure: cfg.Insecure})
		},
	},
	contracts.ProtocolGDrive: builtinRemoteProvider{
		descriptor: contracts.RemoteProviderDescriptor{Protocol: contracts.ProtocolGDrive, Name: "Google Drive", Auth: "oauth-or-token", ReadOnly: true, Hierarchy: "id-backed", Capabilities: contracts.ProviderCapabilities{Pagination: true, RandomAccess: false, TotalCount: false, ServerSort: false, ServerFilter: false, RangeRead: false, Watch: false, Rename: false, AtomicMove: false, Trash: false}},
		connect: func(ctx context.Context, cfg contracts.RemoteConfig, token cloudutil.AccessTokenSource) (vfslib.FileSystem, error) {
			return vfsgdrive.New(ctx, vfsgdrive.Config{AccessToken: cfg.AccessToken, TokenSource: token})
		},
	},
	contracts.ProtocolDropbox: builtinRemoteProvider{
		descriptor: contracts.RemoteProviderDescriptor{Protocol: contracts.ProtocolDropbox, Name: "Dropbox", Auth: "oauth-or-token", ReadOnly: true, Hierarchy: "path-backed", Capabilities: contracts.ProviderCapabilities{Pagination: false, RandomAccess: false, TotalCount: false, ServerSort: false, ServerFilter: false, RangeRead: false, Watch: false, Rename: false, AtomicMove: false, Trash: false}},
		connect: func(ctx context.Context, cfg contracts.RemoteConfig, token cloudutil.AccessTokenSource) (vfslib.FileSystem, error) {
			return vfsdropbox.New(ctx, vfsdropbox.Config{AccessToken: cfg.AccessToken, TokenSource: token})
		},
	},
	contracts.ProtocolOneDrive: builtinRemoteProvider{
		descriptor: contracts.RemoteProviderDescriptor{Protocol: contracts.ProtocolOneDrive, Name: "OneDrive", Auth: "oauth-or-token", ReadOnly: true, Hierarchy: "id-backed", Capabilities: contracts.ProviderCapabilities{Pagination: true, RandomAccess: false, TotalCount: false, ServerSort: false, ServerFilter: false, RangeRead: false, Watch: false, Rename: false, AtomicMove: false, Trash: false}},
		connect: func(ctx context.Context, cfg contracts.RemoteConfig, token cloudutil.AccessTokenSource) (vfslib.FileSystem, error) {
			return vfsonedrive.New(ctx, vfsonedrive.Config{AccessToken: cfg.AccessToken, TokenSource: token})
		},
	},
}

func remoteProviderFor(protocol contracts.RemoteProtocol) (remoteProvider, error) {
	provider := builtinRemoteProviders[protocol]
	if provider == nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("unsupported protocol: %s", protocol)
	}
	return provider, nil
}

func remoteProviderDescriptors() []contracts.RemoteProviderDescriptor {
	result := make([]contracts.RemoteProviderDescriptor, 0, len(builtinRemoteProviders))
	for _, provider := range builtinRemoteProviders {
		result = append(result, provider.Descriptor())
	}
	sort.Slice(result, func(i, j int) bool { return result[i].Protocol < result[j].Protocol })
	return result
}

func remoteMountPathFor(protocol contracts.RemoteProtocol, cfg contracts.RemoteConfig) string {
	switch protocol {
	case contracts.ProtocolSMB:
		port := cfg.Port
		if port == 0 {
			port = 445
		}
		share := strings.Trim(cfg.Share, `/\\`)
		if share != "" {
			return fmt.Sprintf("/remote/smb/%s:%d/%s", cfg.Host, port, share)
		}
		return fmt.Sprintf("/remote/smb/%s:%d", cfg.Host, port)
	case contracts.ProtocolS3, contracts.ProtocolGDrive, contracts.ProtocolDropbox, contracts.ProtocolOneDrive:
		name := sanitizeRemoteMountSegment(cfg.Name)
		if name == "" {
			return ""
		}
		return fmt.Sprintf("/remote/%s/%s", protocol, name)
	default:
		return ""
	}
}

func remoteDisplayNameFor(protocol contracts.RemoteProtocol, cfg contracts.RemoteConfig) string {
	name := strings.TrimSpace(cfg.Name)
	if protocol == contracts.ProtocolS3 {
		bucket := strings.TrimSpace(cfg.Bucket)
		if name != "" && bucket != "" {
			return fmt.Sprintf("%s (%s)", name, bucket)
		}
		if name != "" {
			return name
		}
		if bucket != "" {
			return fmt.Sprintf("s3://%s", bucket)
		}
	}
	if name != "" {
		return name
	}
	if provider := builtinRemoteProviders[protocol]; provider != nil {
		return provider.Descriptor().Name
	}
	return fmt.Sprintf("%s://%s", protocol, remoteMountHostFor(protocol, cfg))
}

func remoteMountHostFor(protocol contracts.RemoteProtocol, cfg contracts.RemoteConfig) string {
	if protocol == contracts.ProtocolS3 {
		if endpoint := strings.TrimSpace(cfg.Endpoint); endpoint != "" {
			return endpoint
		}
		if name := strings.TrimSpace(cfg.Name); name != "" {
			return name
		}
	}
	switch protocol {
	case contracts.ProtocolGDrive:
		return "googleapis.com"
	case contracts.ProtocolDropbox:
		return "api.dropboxapi.com"
	case contracts.ProtocolOneDrive:
		return "graph.microsoft.com"
	default:
		return cfg.Host
	}
}
`````

## File: manager/internal/app/remote.go
`````go
package app

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"regexp"
	"strings"
	"time"

	contracts "wails-app/internal/contracts"
	"wails-app/internal/pathref"
	vfslib "wails-app/vfs"
	"wails-app/vfs/cloudutil"
)

var remoteMountSegmentPattern = regexp.MustCompile(`[^A-Za-z0-9._-]+`)

// RemoteConnect establishes a connection to a remote server, mounts the
// resulting filesystem in the VFS, and returns metadata about the mount.
// The public path (e.g. "smb://host/share") can be used for navigation immediately.
func (s *State) RemoteConnect(cfg contracts.RemoteConfig) (*contracts.RemoteMount, error) {
	return s.remoteConnect(cfg, nil)
}

func contractProviderCapabilities(value vfslib.ProviderCapabilities) contracts.ProviderCapabilities {
	return contracts.ProviderCapabilities{Pagination: value.Pagination, RandomAccess: value.RandomAccess, TotalCount: value.TotalCount, ServerSort: value.ServerSort, ServerFilter: value.ServerFilter, RangeRead: value.RangeRead, Watch: value.Watch, Rename: value.Rename, AtomicMove: value.AtomicMove, Trash: value.Trash}
}

func (s *State) remoteConnect(cfg contracts.RemoteConfig, tokenSource cloudutil.AccessTokenSource) (*contracts.RemoteMount, error) {
	if s.vfs == nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("vfs not initialized")
	}

	provider, err := remoteProviderFor(cfg.Protocol)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	mountPath := provider.MountPath(cfg)
	if mountPath == "" {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("invalid %s mount configuration", cfg.Protocol)
	}

	// Check for a pre-existing mount at the same path.
	s.remotesMu.Lock()
	if existing, ok := s.remotes[mountPath]; ok {
		s.remotesMu.Unlock()
		return &existing, nil
	}
	s.remotesMu.Unlock()

	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 30*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	remoteFS, err := provider.Connect(ctx, cfg, tokenSource)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	displayName := provider.DisplayName(cfg)
	if _, err := s.vfs.Mount(mountPath, remoteFS, false, displayName, vfslib.VolumeRemote); err != nil {
		if c, ok := remoteFS.(interface{ Close() error }); ok {
			_ = c.Close()
		}
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("vfs: mount %s: %w", mountPath, err)
	}

	descriptor := provider.Descriptor()
	capabilities := descriptor.Capabilities
	if capable, ok := remoteFS.(vfslib.CapabilityFileSystem); ok {
		capabilities = contractProviderCapabilities(capable.ProviderCapabilities())
	}
	mount := contracts.RemoteMount{Protocol: cfg.Protocol, Host: provider.Host(cfg), Name: displayName, PublicPath: pathref.FromVFS(mountPath), MountPoint: mountPath, ReadOnly: descriptor.ReadOnly, Capabilities: capabilities}

	s.remotesMu.Lock()
	s.remotes[mountPath] = mount
	s.remotesMu.Unlock()

	return &mount, nil
}

// RemoteDisconnect unmounts the remote filesystem at mountPoint and closes
// the underlying connection.
func (s *State) RemoteDisconnect(mountPoint string) error {
	if err := s.vfs.Unmount(mountPoint); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	s.remotesMu.Lock()
	delete(s.remotes, mountPoint)
	s.remotesMu.Unlock()
	s.releaseRemoteOAuthMount(mountPoint)
	return nil
}

// RemoteListConnections returns all currently active remote mounts.
func (s *State) RemoteListConnections() []contracts.RemoteMount {
	s.remotesMu.Lock()
	defer s.remotesMu.Unlock()
	result := make([]contracts.RemoteMount, 0, len(s.remotes))
	for _, m := range s.remotes {
		result = append(result, m)
	}
	return result
}

// RemoteListProviders returns the provider contract visible to the frontend.
func (s *State) RemoteListProviders() []contracts.RemoteProviderDescriptor {
	return remoteProviderDescriptors()
}

// remoteMountPath computes the internal VFS mount point for a remote config.
// The scheme-to-vfsRoot mapping mirrors the aliasSpecs in pathref/registry.go:
//
//	smb://host:445/shr  → /remote/smb/host:445/shr
func remoteMountPath(cfg contracts.RemoteConfig) string {
	return remoteMountPathFor(cfg.Protocol, cfg)
}

func remoteDisplayName(cfg contracts.RemoteConfig) string {
	return remoteDisplayNameFor(cfg.Protocol, cfg)
}

func remoteMountHost(cfg contracts.RemoteConfig) string {
	return remoteMountHostFor(cfg.Protocol, cfg)
}

func sanitizeRemoteMountSegment(value string) string {
	trimmed := strings.TrimSpace(value)
	trimmed = strings.ReplaceAll(trimmed, "\\", "-")
	trimmed = strings.ReplaceAll(trimmed, "/", "-")
	trimmed = remoteMountSegmentPattern.ReplaceAllString(trimmed, "-")
	trimmed = strings.Trim(trimmed, "-.")
	if trimmed == "." || trimmed == ".." {
		return ""
	}
	return trimmed
}
`````

## File: manager/internal/app/runner.go
`````go
package app

import (
	"context"
	"embed"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"net"
	"net/http"
	"os"
	"time"

	"wails-app/internal/workspace"
	"wails-app/vfs/archive/cache"

	"github.com/wailsapp/wails/v2"
	"github.com/wailsapp/wails/v2/pkg/options"
	"github.com/wailsapp/wails/v2/pkg/options/assetserver"
	wailsruntime "github.com/wailsapp/wails/v2/pkg/runtime"
)

func Run(assets embed.FS, binding interface{}, archCache *cache.Cache, onStartup func(context.Context), onBeforeClose func(context.Context) bool, onShutdown func(context.Context)) error {
	appBinding, _ := binding.(*App)
	if appBinding == nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("app binding is required")
	}

	// Detect if we're in dev mode (Angular dev server is expected to be running on :4200)
	isDev := os.Getenv("WAILS_DEV") == "true"

	if isDev {
		// Development: Use reverse proxy combining stream server + Angular dev server
		streamServer, streamBaseURL, err := startUnifiedServer(appBinding, archCache)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}

		angularDevURL := "http://127.0.0.1:4200"
		proxyServer, proxyURL, err := StartDevProxy(streamBaseURL, angularDevURL, archCache)
		if err != nil {
			streamServer.Shutdown(context.Background())
			return err
		}

		appBinding.SetStreamBaseURL(proxyURL)

		defer func() {
			shutdownCtx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 5*time.Second)
			defer cancel()

			if err := proxyServer.Shutdown(shutdownCtx); err != nil && !errors.Is(err, http.ErrServerClosed) {
				println("dev proxy shutdown error:", err.Error())
			}

			if err := streamServer.Shutdown(shutdownCtx); err != nil && !errors.Is(err, http.ErrServerClosed) {
				println("stream server shutdown error:", err.Error())
			}
		}()
	} else {
		// Production: Use unified stream server + embedded Wails assets
		streamServer, streamBaseURL, err := startUnifiedServer(appBinding, archCache)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}

		appBinding.SetStreamBaseURL(streamBaseURL)

		defer func() {
			shutdownCtx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 5*time.Second)
			defer cancel()
			if err := streamServer.Shutdown(shutdownCtx); err != nil && !errors.Is(err, http.ErrServerClosed) {
				println("stream server shutdown error:", err.Error())
			}
		}()
	}

	width, height := 1280, 800
	x, y := 0, 0
	hasPosition := false
	startState := options.Normal

	if saved := workspace.LoadStoredWindowState("wails-file-manager"); saved != nil {
		// Detect a minimised/restored window that Windows reported as off-screen
		// (x/y == -32000) with a tiny size. Ignore such state and use defaults.
		const minVisibleSize = 50
		const minimisedCoord = -32000
		minimised := saved.X <= minimisedCoord || saved.Y <= minimisedCoord ||
			saved.Width < minVisibleSize || saved.Height < minVisibleSize

		if !minimised && saved.Width >= 480 && saved.Height >= 320 {
			width = saved.Width
			height = saved.Height
		}
		// Legacy records (pre-HasPosition) had no flag; infer one from non-zero
		// coords. New records always carry HasPosition explicitly so legitimate
		// (0,0) restores correctly.
		if !minimised && (saved.HasPosition || saved.X != 0 || saved.Y != 0) {
			x = saved.X
			y = saved.Y
			hasPosition = true
		}
		if saved.Maximised && !minimised {
			startState = options.Maximised
		}
	}

	if startState != options.Maximised {
		x, y, width, height = fitStartupWindowBounds(x, y, width, height, hasPosition)
	}

	wrappedStartup := onStartup
	if hasPosition && startState != options.Maximised {
		savedX, savedY, savedW, savedH := x, y, width, height
		wrappedStartup = func(ctx context.Context) {
			if onStartup != nil {
				onStartup(ctx)
			}
			wailsruntime.WindowSetPosition(ctx, savedX, savedY)
			if !rectIntersectsAnyScreen(ctx, savedX, savedY, savedW, savedH) {
				wailsruntime.WindowCenter(ctx)
			}
		}
	}

	return wails.Run(&options.App{
		Title:            "File Manager",
		Width:            width,
		Height:           height,
		Frameless:        true,
		AssetServer:      &assetserver.Options{Assets: assets},
		BackgroundColour: &options.RGBA{R: 27, G: 38, B: 54, A: 255},
		WindowStartState: startState,
		OnStartup:        wrappedStartup,
		OnBeforeClose:    onBeforeClose,
		OnShutdown:       onShutdown,
		DragAndDrop: &options.DragAndDrop{
			EnableFileDrop:     true,
			DisableWebViewDrop: false,
		},
		Bind: []interface{}{binding},
	})
}

// rectIntersectsAnyScreen reports whether the window rect is likely visible
// on a connected display. Wails v2 Screen does not expose origin coordinates,
// so we treat the primary display as starting at (0,0) and allow a reasonable
// margin for multi-monitor negative coordinates.
func rectIntersectsAnyScreen(ctx context.Context, x, y, w, h int) bool {
	screens, err := wailsruntime.ScreenGetAll(ctx)
	if err != nil || len(screens) == 0 {
		// Fail open: assume the position is fine if we cannot enumerate.
		return true
	}
	primary := screens[0]
	const margin = 200 // allow some negative coordinates for multi-monitor
	// If the window is completely outside the primary screen (with margin),
	// assume it is off-screen.
	if x+w < -margin || y+h < -margin {
		return false
	}
	if x > primary.Width+margin || y > primary.Height+margin {
		return false
	}
	return true
}

// startUnifiedServer starts a single server that handles both:
// - Video stream requests (/wails-stream)
// - Archive entry streaming
func startUnifiedServer(appBinding *App, archCache *cache.Cache) (*http.Server, string, error) {
	listener, err := net.Listen("tcp", "127.0.0.1:0")
	if err != nil {
		return nil, "", fmt.Errorf("start unified server: %w", err)
	}

	baseURL := "http://" + listener.Addr().String()

	server := &http.Server{
		Handler:           NewUnifiedHandler(appBinding, archCache),
		ReadHeaderTimeout: 30 * time.Second,
	}

	go func() {
		if err := server.Serve(listener); err != nil && !errors.Is(err, http.ErrServerClosed) {
			println("unified server error:", err.Error())
		}
	}()

	return server, baseURL, nil
}
`````

`````go
package app

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"

	"github.com/wailsapp/wails/v2/pkg/runtime"

	internalruntime "wails-app/internal/runtime"
)

type RuntimeConfig struct {
	SetContext            func(context.Context)
	SetOperationEmitter   func(func(string, interface{}))
	CreatePaneWatch       func()
	InitVFS               func()
	HandleFileDrop        func(int, int, []string) error
	ClosePaneWatch        func()
	CancelDirStreams      func()
	StopElevationSession  func()
	CloseArchiveCache     func()
}

type RuntimeService struct {
	config RuntimeConfig
}

func NewRuntimeService(config RuntimeConfig) *RuntimeService {
	return &RuntimeService{config: config}
}

func (s *RuntimeService) Startup(ctx context.Context) {
	if s.config.SetContext != nil {
		s.config.SetContext(ctx)
	}
	if s.config.SetOperationEmitter != nil {
		s.config.SetOperationEmitter(func(name string, data interface{}) {
			s.EmitEvent(ctx, name, data)
		})
	}
	if s.config.CreatePaneWatch != nil {
		s.config.CreatePaneWatch()
	}
	if s.config.InitVFS != nil {
		s.config.InitVFS()
	}
	internalruntime.BindNativeFileDrop(ctx, func(x, y int, paths []string) {
		if s.config.HandleFileDrop == nil {
			return
		}
		if err := s.config.HandleFileDrop(x, y, paths); err != nil {
			fmt.Printf("[wails:file-drop] HandleFileDrop error: %v\n", err)
		}
	})
}

func (s *RuntimeService) Shutdown() {
	if s.config.ClosePaneWatch != nil {
		s.config.ClosePaneWatch()
	}
	if s.config.CancelDirStreams != nil {
		s.config.CancelDirStreams()
	}
	if s.config.StopElevationSession != nil {
		s.config.StopElevationSession()
	}
	if s.config.CloseArchiveCache != nil {
		s.config.CloseArchiveCache()
	}
}

func (s *RuntimeService) EmitEvent(ctx context.Context, name string, data interface{}) {
	if ctx != nil {
		runtime.EventsEmit(ctx, name, data)
	}
}
`````

`````go
package app

import "testing"

func TestBuildSegmentRangesFromKeyframes(t *testing.T) {
	ranges := buildSegmentRangesFromKeyframes([]float64{0, 5.873, 11.745, 18.952}, 21.955)
	if len(ranges) != 4 {
		t.Fatalf("expected 4 ranges, got %d", len(ranges))
	}

	assertRange := func(index int, wantStart float64, wantDuration float64) {
		t.Helper()
		got := ranges[index]
		if diff := absFloat(got.StartSeconds - wantStart); diff > 0.001 {
			t.Fatalf("range %d start mismatch: got %.3f want %.3f", index, got.StartSeconds, wantStart)
		}
		if diff := absFloat(got.DurationSeconds - wantDuration); diff > 0.001 {
			t.Fatalf("range %d duration mismatch: got %.3f want %.3f", index, got.DurationSeconds, wantDuration)
		}
	}

	assertRange(0, 0, 5.873)
	assertRange(1, 5.873, 5.872)
	assertRange(2, 11.745, 7.207)
	assertRange(3, 18.952, 3.003)
}

func TestBuildSegmentRangesFromKeyframesPrependsZeroStart(t *testing.T) {
	ranges := buildSegmentRangesFromKeyframes([]float64{5.873, 11.745}, 12)
	if len(ranges) != 3 {
		t.Fatalf("expected 3 ranges, got %d", len(ranges))
	}
	if ranges[0].StartSeconds != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("expected first range to start at zero, got %.3f", ranges[0].StartSeconds)
	}
}

func TestShouldUseKeyframeAlignedSegments(t *testing.T) {
	cases := map[string]bool{
		"sample.mp4":  false,
		"sample.m4v":  false,
		"sample.webm": false,
		"sample.mkv":  true,
		"sample.flv":  true,
		"sample.avi":  true,
		"sample.divx": true,
		"sample.xvid": true,
		"sample.mov":  true,
		"sample.ts":   true,
		"sample.mpg":  true,
		"sample.wmv":  true,
		"sample.asf":  true,
		"sample.ogv":  true,
		"sample.mxf":  true,
	}

	for path, want := range cases {
		if got := shouldUseKeyframeAlignedSegments(path); got != want {
			t.Fatalf("shouldUseKeyframeAlignedSegments(%q) = %v, want %v", path, got, want)
		}
	}
}

func absFloat(value float64) float64 {
	if value < 0 {
		return -value
	}
	return value
`````
