`````go
type archiveOperationAdapter struct {

func (a *archiveOperationAdapter) ID() string {

func (a *archiveOperationAdapter) Complete() {

func (a *archiveOperationAdapter) SetError(err error) {

}

func (a *archiveOperationAdapter) SetTotal(totalItems, totalBytes int64) {
	a.op.SetTotal(totalItems, totalBytes)
}

func (a *archiveOperationAdapter) UpdateProgress(processedItems, processedBytes int64, currentFile string, currentFileSize int64) {
	a.op.UpdateProgress(processedItems, processedBytes, currentFile, currentFileSize)
}

func (a *archiveOperationAdapter) IsCancelled() bool {
	return a.op.IsCancelled()
}

type Services struct {
	Elevation  *internalelevation.Service
	Archive    *internalarchive.Service
	Batch      *internalbatch.Service
	Converter  *internalconverter.Service
	DirStream  *internalruntime.DirStreamService
	Utility    *internalutility.Service
	Navigation *internalnav.Service
	Workspace  *internalworkspace.Service
}

type ServiceEventsConfig struct {
	EmitEvent func(string, interface{})
}

type ServiceDirectoryConfig struct {
	ElevatedList  func(path string, showHidden bool) ([]contracts.FileInfo, error)
	BuildFileInfo func(name, fullPath string, info os.FileInfo, hidden bool) contracts.FileInfo
	IsHidden      func(name, fullPath string) bool
	ListDirectory func(path string, showHidden bool) (*contracts.DirectoryListing, error)
}

type ServiceBatchConfig struct {
	StartOperation                 func(kind contracts.OperationType, title, source, dest string) *internalops.ActiveOperation
	PromptConflict                 func(event contracts.ConflictEvent)
	ClassifyError                  func(error) contracts.AppErrorCode
	IsPermissionDenied             func(error) bool
	ShouldRetryDeleteWithElevation func(error) bool
	RunElevatedCopy                func(src, dst string, recursive bool) (bool, error)
	RunElevatedMove                func(src, dst string) (bool, error)
	RunElevatedDelete              func(path string, recursive bool, useTrash *bool) (bool, error)
	CalculateSize                  func(path string) (items, bytes int64)
	GetFileInfo                    func(path string) (*contracts.FileInfo, error)
	CopyBatchPath                  func(source, destination string, recursive bool, streamToFile func(io.Reader, string, int64, string) (int64, error)) error
	ExtractNestedArchive           func(archivePath string, nestedChain []string) ([]byte, error)
	Normalize                      func(string) string
	ArchiveEntryPath               func(archiver.File) string
	IsArchive                      func(string) bool
}

type ServiceConfig struct {
	Core      *Core
	Elevation *internalelevation.Service
	Events    ServiceEventsConfig
	Directory ServiceDirectoryConfig
	Batch     ServiceBatchConfig
}

func NewServices(config ServiceConfig) *Services {
	batch := config.Batch
	directory := config.Directory

	return &Services{
		Elevation: config.Elevation,
		Archive: internalarchive.NewService(
			config.Core.ArchiveCache,
			func(opType contracts.OperationType, title, source, dest string) internalarchive.Operation {
				return &archiveOperationAdapter{op: batch.StartOperation(opType, title, source, dest)}
			},
		),
		Batch: internalbatch.NewService(internalbatch.ServiceConfig{
			StartOperation:   batch.StartOperation,
			ConflictPrompter: internalbatch.ConflictPrompterFunc(batch.PromptConflict),
			BatchErr: func(source, destination string, err error) contracts.BatchItemError {
				return contracts.BatchItemError{
					Source:      source,
					Destination: destination,
					Error:       err.Error(),
					Code:        batch.ClassifyError(err),
				}
			},
			IsPermissionDenied:             batch.IsPermissionDenied,
			ShouldRetryDeleteWithElevation: batch.ShouldRetryDeleteWithElevation,
			RunElevatedCopy:                batch.RunElevatedCopy,
			RunElevatedMove:                batch.RunElevatedMove,
			RunElevatedDelete:              batch.RunElevatedDelete,
			MoveToTrash:                    internalplatform.MoveToTrash,
			CalculateSize:                  batch.CalculateSize,
			ResolvePath:                    nativeResolvePath,
			ToPublicPath:                   pathref.FromNativePath,
			GetFileInfo:                    batch.GetFileInfo,
			CopyPath:                       batch.CopyBatchPath,
			ExtractNestedArchive:           batch.ExtractNestedArchive,
			Normalize:                      batch.Normalize,
			ArchiveEntryPath:               batch.ArchiveEntryPath,
			IsArchive:                      batch.IsArchive,
		}),
		Converter: config.Core.Converter,
		DirStream: internalruntime.NewDirStreamService(
			config.Events.EmitEvent,
			directory.ElevatedList,
			directory.BuildFileInfo,
			directory.IsHidden,
			nativeResolvePath,
		),
		Utility: config.newUtility(),
		Navigation: internalnav.NewService(
			config.Core.NavigationManager,
			directory.ListDirectory,
		),
		Workspace: internalworkspace.NewService(config.Core.WorkspaceManager),
	}
}

func (c ServiceConfig) newUtility() *internalutility.Service {
	return internalutility.NewService(internalutility.ServiceConfig{
		EmitEvent: c.Events.EmitEvent,
	})
}
`````

## File: manager/internal/app/startup_privilege.go
`````go
package app

import (
	internalelevation "wails-app/internal/elevation"
	pluginpackage "wails-app/internal/pluginpackage"
	internalworkspace "wails-app/internal/workspace"
)

func MaybeRelaunchElevatedForStartup() (bool, error) {
	if internalelevation.IsProcessElevated() {
		return false, nil
	}
	if !startupRequiresElevation() {
		return false, nil
	}
	if err := internalelevation.RelaunchCurrentProcessElevated(); err != nil {
		return false, err
	}
	return true, nil
}

func startupRequiresElevation() bool {
	return startupPluginsRequireElevation() || internalworkspace.StoredStateRequiresElevation(pluginPackageAppName)
}

func startupPluginsRequireElevation() bool {
	root, err := pluginpackage.DefaultDirectory(pluginPackageAppName)
	if err != nil {
		return false
	}
	packages, err := pluginpackage.Discover(root)
	if err != nil {
		return false
	}
	store, err := pluginPackageStateStore()
	if err != nil {
		return false
	}
	if err := store.Reconcile(packages); err != nil {
		return false
	}
	states, err := store.List()
	if err != nil {
		return false
	}
	return requiresStartupPluginHostPrivilege(packages, states)
}
`````

`````go
package app

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	htmlpkg "html"
	"io"
	"mime"
	"net/http"
	"net/url"
	"os"

	"strconv"
	"strings"
	"time"

	"wails-app/internal/pathref"
	vfslib "wails-app/vfs"
	"wails-app/vfs/archive/cache"
)

const streamPath = "/wails-stream"

const defaultPreviewWindowSeconds = 90.0

const defaultThumbnailSize = 256

const defaultVideoFramePreviewSeconds = 1.0

const remoteHTMLRewriteLimit = 8 * 1024 * 1024

var remoteStreamClient = &http.Client{}

// NewUnifiedHandler creates a server that handles:
// - Video streaming via /wails-stream (legacy)
// - Archive entry streaming (legacy)
// - Range requests for seeking
func NewUnifiedHandler(app *App, archCache *cache.Cache) http.Handler {
	return http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		// Handle OPTIONS requests for CORS
		if r.Method == http.MethodOptions {
			setCORSHeaders(w)
			w.WriteHeader(http.StatusNoContent)
			return
		}

		// Route to legacy streaming
		if r.URL.Path == streamPath {
			serveStreamRequest(w, r, app, archCache)
			return
		}

		// Other paths return 404
		http.NotFound(w, r)
	})
}

func serveStreamRequest(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, app *App, archCache *cache.Cache) {
	q := r.URL.Query()
	transcodeFormat := strings.ToLower(q.Get("transcode"))
	playbackMode := strings.ToLower(q.Get("mode"))
	startSeconds := parseStartSeconds(q.Get("start"))
	windowSeconds := parseWindowSeconds(q.Get("window"))

	// ── Converted disk image ───────────────────────────────────────────────
	path := q.Get("path")
	if path != "" && q.Get("segmentManifest") == "1" {
		serveSegmentManifest(w, r, path)
		return
	}
	if segmentKey := q.Get("segmentKey"); segmentKey != "" {
		if q.Get("segmentManifest") == "1" {
			serveSegmentManifestByKey(w, r, segmentKey)
			return
		}
		if q.Get("segmentInit") == "1" {
			serveSegmentFile(w, r, segmentKey, "init.mp4")
			return
		}
		if rawIndex := q.Get("segmentIndex"); rawIndex != "" {
			segmentIndex, err := strconv.Atoi(rawIndex)
			if err != nil || segmentIndex < 0 {
				http.Error(w, "invalid segment index", http.StatusBadRequest)
				return
			}
			serveSegmentFile(w, r, segmentKey, segmentedVideoFileName(segmentIndex))
			return
		}
	}
	convertFormat := q.Get("convert")
	thumbnailFormat := q.Get("thumb")
	thumbnailWidth := parseThumbnailDimension(q.Get("thumbWidth"))
	thumbnailHeight := parseThumbnailDimension(q.Get("thumbHeight"))
	frameFormat := strings.ToLower(q.Get("frame"))
	frameSeconds := parseStartSeconds(q.Get("frameTime"))
	if path != "" && thumbnailFormat != "" {
		serveThumbnailPath(w, r, app, path, thumbnailFormat, thumbnailWidth, thumbnailHeight)
		return
	}
	if path != "" && frameFormat != "" {
		serveVideoFramePath(w, r, path, frameFormat, frameSeconds)
		return
	}
	if path != "" && convertFormat != "" {
		serveConvertedPath(w, r, app, path, convertFormat)
		return
	}
	if path != "" && transcodeFormat != "" {
		serveTranscodedPath(w, r, path, transcodeFormat, playbackMode, startSeconds, windowSeconds)
		return
	}

	// ── Archive entry ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
	fsPath := q.Get("fsPath")
	entry := q.Get("entry")
	if fsPath != "" && entry != "" && transcodeFormat != "" {
		serveTranscodedArchiveEntry(w, r, archCache, fsPath, entry, q.Get("nested"), transcodeFormat, playbackMode, startSeconds)
		return
	}
	if fsPath != "" && entry != "" && thumbnailFormat != "" {
		serveThumbnailArchiveEntry(w, r, app, archCache, fsPath, entry, q.Get("nested"), thumbnailFormat, thumbnailWidth, thumbnailHeight)
		return
	}
	if fsPath != "" && entry != "" && frameFormat != "" {
		serveVideoFrameArchiveEntry(w, r, archCache, fsPath, entry, q.Get("nested"), frameFormat, frameSeconds)
		return
	}
	if fsPath != "" && entry != "" {
		serveArchiveEntry(w, r, archCache, fsPath, entry, q.Get("nested"))
		return
	}

	// ── Disk / VFS path ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
	path = q.Get("path")
	if path == "" {
		http.Error(w, "missing path parameter", http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}
	servePath(w, r, app, path)
}

func serveConvertedPath(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, app *App, publicPath string, targetFormat string) {
	if app == nil || app.State == nil || app.State.Converter == nil {
		http.Error(w, "converter unavailable", http.StatusServiceUnavailable)
		return
	}

	publicPath = pathref.Normalize(publicPath)
	nativePath := pathref.ToNativePath(publicPath)
	if strings.Contains(nativePath, "..") {
		http.Error(w, "invalid path", http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}

	converted, err := app.State.Converter.ConvertFormat(nativePath, targetFormat)
	if err != nil {
		http.Error(w, "conversion failed: "+err.Error(), http.StatusUnsupportedMediaType)
		return
	}

	setCORSHeaders(w)
	setContentType(w, "preview."+targetFormat)
	w.Header().Set("Cache-Control", "no-store")
	http.ServeContent(w, r, "preview."+targetFormat, time.Time{}, bytes.NewReader(converted))
}

func serveThumbnailPath(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, app *App, publicPath string, targetFormat string, maxWidth int, maxHeight int) {
	if app == nil || app.State == nil || app.State.Converter == nil {
		http.Error(w, "converter unavailable", http.StatusServiceUnavailable)
		return
	}

	publicPath = pathref.Normalize(publicPath)
	nativePath := pathref.ToNativePath(publicPath)
	if strings.Contains(nativePath, "..") {
		http.Error(w, "invalid path", http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}

	thumbnail, err := app.State.Converter.CreateThumbnail(nativePath, targetFormat, maxWidth, maxHeight)
	if err != nil {
		http.Error(w, "thumbnail failed: "+err.Error(), http.StatusUnsupportedMediaType)
		return
	}

	setCORSHeaders(w)
	setContentType(w, "thumbnail."+targetFormat)
	w.Header().Set("Cache-Control", "no-store")
	http.ServeContent(w, r, "thumbnail."+targetFormat, time.Time{}, bytes.NewReader(thumbnail))
}

func serveThumbnailArchiveEntry(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, app *App, archCache *cache.Cache, fsPath string, entryPath string, nestedRaw string, targetFormat string, maxWidth int, maxHeight int) {
	if app == nil || app.State == nil || app.State.Converter == nil {
		http.Error(w, "converter unavailable", http.StatusServiceUnavailable)
		return
	}

	nativeFsPath := pathref.ToNativePath(fsPath)
	if strings.Contains(nativeFsPath, "..") || strings.Contains(entryPath, "..") {
		http.Error(w, "invalid path", http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}

	var nestedChain []string
	if nestedRaw != "" {
		nestedChain = strings.Split(nestedRaw, ",")
	}

	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(r.Context(), 5*time.Minute)
	defer cancel()

	arch, err := archCache.Get(ctx, nativeFsPath, nestedChain, "")
	if err != nil {
		http.Error(w, "cannot open archive: "+err.Error(), http.StatusInternalServerError)
		return
	}

	entryFile, err := arch.Open(ctx, entryPath)
	if err != nil {
		http.Error(w, "cannot open entry: "+err.Error(), http.StatusNotFound)
		return
	}
	defer entryFile.Close()

	tempPattern := "wails-thumb-*" + filepath.Ext(entryPath)
	tempFile, err := os.CreateTemp("", tempPattern)
	if err != nil {
		http.Error(w, "failed to prepare thumbnail input", http.StatusInternalServerError)
		return
	}
	tempPath := tempFile.Name()
	defer func() {
		tempFile.Close()
		_ = os.Remove(tempPath)
	}()

	if _, err := io.Copy(tempFile, entryFile); err != nil {
		http.Error(w, "failed to read archive entry", http.StatusInternalServerError)
		return
	}
	if err := tempFile.Close(); err != nil {
		http.Error(w, "failed to finalize thumbnail input", http.StatusInternalServerError)
		return
	}

	thumbnail, err := app.State.Converter.CreateThumbnail(tempPath, targetFormat, maxWidth, maxHeight)
	if err != nil {
		http.Error(w, "thumbnail failed: "+err.Error(), http.StatusUnsupportedMediaType)
		return
	}

	setCORSHeaders(w)
	setContentType(w, "thumbnail."+targetFormat)
	w.Header().Set("Cache-Control", "no-store")
	http.ServeContent(w, r, "thumbnail."+targetFormat, time.Time{}, bytes.NewReader(thumbnail))
}

	publicPath = pathref.Normalize(publicPath)

func serveTranscodedPath(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, publicPath string, targetFormat string, playbackMode string, startSeconds float64, windowSeconds float64) {
	if strings.ToLower(targetFormat) != "mp4" {
		http.Error(w, "unsupported transcode target", http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}

	nativePath := pathref.ToNativePath(pathref.Normalize(publicPath))
	if strings.Contains(nativePath, "..") {
		http.Error(w, "invalid path", http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}

	if _, err := os.Stat(nativePath); err != nil {
		if os.IsNotExist(err) {
			http.Error(w, "not found", http.StatusNotFound)
			return
		}
		http.Error(w, "cannot open file", http.StatusInternalServerError)
		return
	}

	stdout, err := startAstiavTranscode(r.Context(), nativePath, startSeconds, windowSeconds, normalizePlaybackMode(playbackMode))
	if err != nil {
		http.Error(w, "failed to start transcoder: "+err.Error(), http.StatusInternalServerError)
		return
	}
	defer stdout.Close()

	if durationSeconds := probeFileDurationSeconds(nativePath); durationSeconds > 0 {
		w.Header().Set("X-Video-Duration-Seconds", strconv.FormatFloat(durationSeconds, 'f', 3, 64))
	}

	streamTranscodedOutput(w, r, stdout)
}

func serveTranscodedArchiveEntry(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, archCache *cache.Cache, fsPath, entryPath, nestedRaw string, targetFormat string, playbackMode string, startSeconds float64) {
	if strings.ToLower(targetFormat) != "mp4" {
		http.Error(w, "unsupported transcode target", http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}
	if startSeconds > 0 {
		http.Error(w, "seeking is not available for archive video previews", http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}

	nativeFsPath := pathref.ToNativePath(fsPath)
	if strings.Contains(nativeFsPath, "..") || strings.Contains(entryPath, "..") {
		http.Error(w, "invalid path", http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}

	var nestedChain []string
	if nestedRaw != "" {
		nestedChain = strings.Split(nestedRaw, ",")
	}

	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(r.Context(), 5*time.Minute)
	defer cancel()

	arch, err := archCache.Get(ctx, nativeFsPath, nestedChain, "")
	if err != nil {
		http.Error(w, "cannot open archive: "+err.Error(), http.StatusInternalServerError)
		return
	}

	entryFile, err := arch.Open(ctx, entryPath)
	if err != nil {
		http.Error(w, "cannot open entry: "+err.Error(), http.StatusNotFound)
		return
	}
	defer entryFile.Close()

	stdout, err := startAstiavTranscodeReader(r.Context(), entryFile, normalizePlaybackMode(playbackMode))
	if err != nil {
		http.Error(w, "failed to start reader transcoder: "+err.Error(), http.StatusInternalServerError)
		return
	}
	defer stdout.Close()

	streamTranscodedOutput(w, r, stdout)
}

func servePath(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, app *App, publicPath string) {
	publicPath = pathref.Normalize(publicPath)
	if pathref.IsWeb(publicPath) {
		serveRemotePath(w, r, publicPath)
		return
	}
	if shouldServeViaVFS(app, publicPath) {
		serveVFSFile(w, r, app.State.vfs, publicPath)
		return
	}
	serveDiskFile(w, r, publicPath)
}

func shouldServeViaVFS(app *App, publicPath string) bool {
	if app == nil || app.State == nil || app.State.vfs == nil {
		return false
	}
	if pathref.IsAlias(publicPath) {
		return app.State.vfs.IsMounted(pathref.ToVFS(publicPath))
	}
	return app.State.vfs.IsMounted(publicPath)
}

func serveVFSFile(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, vfs *vfslib.Unified, publicPath string) {
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(r.Context(), 5*time.Minute)
	defer cancel()

	internalPath := publicPath
	if pathref.IsAlias(publicPath) {
		internalPath = pathref.ToVFS(publicPath)
	}

	fi, err := vfs.Stat(ctx, internalPath)
	if err != nil || fi.IsDir() {
		http.Error(w, "not a file", http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}

	f, err := vfs.Open(ctx, internalPath)
	if err != nil {
		http.Error(w, "cannot open file", http.StatusNotFound)
		return
	}
	defer f.Close()

	setCORSHeaders(w)
	setContentType(w, fi.Name())
	w.Header().Set("Cache-Control", "no-store")
	w.Header().Set("Accept-Ranges", "bytes")
	if _, err := f.Seek(0, io.SeekStart); err == nil {
		http.ServeContent(w, r, fi.Name(), fi.ModTime(), f)
		return
	}
	serveNonSeekableVFSFile(w, r, f, fi)
}

func serveNonSeekableVFSFile(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, f io.Reader, fi vfslib.FileInfo) {
	size := fi.Size()
	if size < 0 {
		size = 0
	}

	rangeHeader := strings.TrimSpace(r.Header.Get("Range"))
	if rangeHeader != "" && size > 0 {
		start, end, ok := parseSingleByteRange(rangeHeader, size)
		if !ok {
			w.Header().Set("Content-Range", fmt.Sprintf("bytes */%d", size))
			http.Error(w, "invalid range", http.StatusRequestedRangeNotSatisfiable)
			return
		}

		if start > 0 {
			if _, err := io.CopyN(io.Discard, f, start); err != nil {
				http.Error(w, "cannot read file", http.StatusInternalServerError)
				return
			}
		}

		length := end - start + 1
		w.Header().Set("Content-Range", fmt.Sprintf("bytes %d-%d/%d", start, end, size))
		w.Header().Set("Content-Length", strconv.FormatInt(length, 10))
		w.WriteHeader(http.StatusPartialContent)
		if r.Method == http.MethodHead {
			return
		}
		if _, err := io.CopyN(w, f, length); err != nil && !errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {
			return
		}
		return
	}

	if size > 0 {
		w.Header().Set("Content-Length", strconv.FormatInt(size, 10))
	}
	if r.Method == http.MethodHead {
		w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
		return
	}
	if _, err := io.Copy(w, f); err != nil {
		return
	}
}

func parseSingleByteRange(header string, size int64) (int64, int64, bool) {
	if size <= 0 {
		return 0, 0, false
	}
	if !strings.HasPrefix(strings.ToLower(header), "bytes=") {
		return 0, 0, false
	}

	spec := strings.TrimSpace(header[len("bytes="):])
	if spec == "" || strings.Contains(spec, ",") {
		return 0, 0, false
	}

	dash := strings.IndexByte(spec, '-')
	if dash < 0 {
		return 0, 0, false
	}

	startRaw := strings.TrimSpace(spec[:dash])
	endRaw := strings.TrimSpace(spec[dash+1:])

	switch {
	case startRaw == "" && endRaw == "":
		return 0, 0, false
	case startRaw == "":
		suffix, err := strconv.ParseInt(endRaw, 10, 64)
		if err != nil || suffix <= 0 {
			return 0, 0, false
		}
		if suffix > size {
			suffix = size
		}
		return size - suffix, size - 1, true
	default:
		start, err := strconv.ParseInt(startRaw, 10, 64)
		if err != nil || start < 0 || start >= size {
			return 0, 0, false
		}
		if endRaw == "" {
			return start, size - 1, true
		}
		end, err := strconv.ParseInt(endRaw, 10, 64)
		if err != nil || end < start {
			return 0, 0, false
		}
		if end >= size {
			end = size - 1
		}
		return start, end, true
	}
}

// serveDiskFile resolves the public path (filesystem:// scheme) to a native OS path
// and lets http.ServeContent handle range requests.
func serveDiskFile(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, publicPath string) {
	nativePath := pathref.ToNativePath(publicPath)
	// Reject any path traversal attempts
	if strings.Contains(nativePath, "..") {
		http.Error(w, "invalid path", http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}

	f, err := os.Open(nativePath)
	if err != nil {
		if os.IsNotExist(err) {
			http.Error(w, "not found", http.StatusNotFound)
		} else {
			http.Error(w, "cannot open file", http.StatusInternalServerError)
		}
		return
	}
	defer f.Close()

	fi, err := f.Stat()
	if err != nil || fi.IsDir() {
		http.Error(w, "not a file", http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}

	setCORSHeaders(w)
	setContentType(w, nativePath)
	http.ServeContent(w, r, fi.Name(), fi.ModTime(), f)
}

func serveRemotePath(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, publicPath string) {
	targetURL, err := normalizeRemoteStreamURL(publicPath)
	if err != nil {
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}

	req, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(r.Context(), r.Method, targetURL, nil)
	if err != nil {
		http.Error(w, "invalid remote request", http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}
	req.Header.Set("Accept", firstNonEmpty(r.Header.Get("Accept"), "*/*"))
	req.Header.Set("Accept-Language", firstNonEmpty(r.Header.Get("Accept-Language"), "en"))
	req.Header.Set("User-Agent", firstNonEmpty(r.Header.Get("User-Agent"), "WailsFileManager/1.0"))
	for _, name := range []string{"Range", "If-None-Match", "If-Modified-Since"} {
		if value := strings.TrimSpace(r.Header.Get(name)); value != "" {
			req.Header.Set(name, value)
		}
	}

	resp, err := remoteStreamClient.Do(req)
	if err != nil {
		http.Error(w, "cannot open remote resource", http.StatusBadGateway)
		return
	}
	defer resp.Body.Close()

	if shouldRewriteRemoteHTML(resp, r.Method) {
		serveRewrittenRemoteHTML(w, r, resp)
		return
	}

	writeRemoteResponse(w, r, resp, false, nil)
}

// serveArchiveEntry opens the archive (or uses the LRU cache), then pipes the
// requested entry. Because archive entries are not seekable, range requests are
// not supported — but the full content is piped without buffering in JS.
func serveArchiveEntry(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, archCache *cache.Cache, fsPath, entryPath, nestedRaw string) {
	nativeFsPath := pathref.ToNativePath(fsPath)
	if strings.Contains(nativeFsPath, "..") || strings.Contains(entryPath, "..") {
		http.Error(w, "invalid path", http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}

	var nestedChain []string
	if nestedRaw != "" {
		nestedChain = strings.Split(nestedRaw, ",")
	}

	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(r.Context(), 5*time.Minute)
	defer cancel()

	arch, err := archCache.Get(ctx, nativeFsPath, nestedChain, "")
	if err != nil {
		http.Error(w, "cannot open archive: "+err.Error(), http.StatusInternalServerError)
		return
	}

	f, err := arch.Open(ctx, entryPath)
	if err != nil {
		http.Error(w, "cannot open entry: "+err.Error(), http.StatusNotFound)
		return
	}
	defer f.Close()

	setCORSHeaders(w)
	setContentType(w, entryPath)
	w.Header().Set("Cache-Control", "no-store")
	w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
	io.Copy(w, f) //nolint:errcheck — client disconnect is not an error
}

func shouldRewriteRemoteHTML(resp *http.Response, method string) bool {
	if resp == nil || strings.EqualFold(method, http.MethodHead) {
		return false
	}
	if resp.StatusCode < http.StatusOK || resp.StatusCode >= http.StatusMultipleChoices {
		return false
	}
	if resp.ContentLength > remoteHTMLRewriteLimit {
		return false
	}
	mediaType, _, err := mime.ParseMediaType(resp.Header.Get("Content-Type"))
	if err != nil {
		mediaType = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(strings.Split(resp.Header.Get("Content-Type"), ";")[0]))
	}
	switch strings.ToLower(mediaType) {
	case "text/html", "application/xhtml+xml":
		return true
	default:
		return false
	}
}

func serveRewrittenRemoteHTML(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, resp *http.Response) {
	body, err := io.ReadAll(resp.Body)
	if err != nil {
		http.Error(w, "cannot read remote document", http.StatusBadGateway)
		return
	}

	baseHref := ""
	if resp.Request != nil && resp.Request.URL != nil {
		baseHref = resp.Request.URL.String()
		if resp.Request.URL.Path == "" {
			baseHref += "/"
		}
	}
	rewritten := injectHTMLBaseTag(body, baseHref)
	writeRemoteResponse(w, r, resp, true, rewritten)
}

func writeRemoteResponse(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, resp *http.Response, rewritten bool, body []byte) {
	setCORSHeaders(w)
	copyRemoteHeaders(w.Header(), resp.Header, rewritten)
	w.Header().Set("Cache-Control", "no-store")
	w.WriteHeader(resp.StatusCode)
	if strings.EqualFold(r.Method, http.MethodHead) {
		return
	}
	if rewritten {
		_, _ = w.Write(body)
		return
	}
	_, _ = io.Copy(w, resp.Body)
}

func copyRemoteHeaders(dst http.Header, src http.Header, rewritten bool) {
	skip := map[string]struct{}{
		"connection":                          {},
		"keep-alive":                          {},
		"proxy-authenticate":                  {},
		"proxy-authorization":                 {},
		"te":                                  {},
		"trailer":                             {},
		"transfer-encoding":                   {},
		"upgrade":                             {},
		"x-frame-options":                     {},
		"content-security-policy":             {},
		"content-security-policy-report-only": {},
		"cross-origin-embedder-policy":        {},
		"cross-origin-opener-policy":          {},
		"cross-origin-resource-policy":        {},
		"alt-svc":                             {},
	}
	if rewritten {
		skip["content-length"] = struct{}{}
		skip["content-encoding"] = struct{}{}
		skip["etag"] = struct{}{}
	}

	for key, values := range src {
		if _, blocked := skip[strings.ToLower(key)]; blocked {
			continue
		}
		dst.Del(key)
		for _, value := range values {
			dst.Add(key, value)
		}
	}
}

func normalizeRemoteStreamURL(publicPath string) (string, error) {
	normalized := pathref.Normalize(publicPath)
	if !pathref.IsWeb(normalized) {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("unsupported remote scheme")
	}

	parsed, err := url.Parse(normalized)
	if err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	if parsed.Host == "" {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("invalid remote URL")
	}

	parsed.Scheme = strings.ToLower(parsed.Scheme)
	parsed.Host = strings.ToLower(parsed.Host)
	parsed.Fragment = ""
	parsed.Path = strings.ReplaceAll(parsed.Path, "\\", "/")
	return parsed.String(), nil
}

func injectHTMLBaseTag(document []byte, baseHref string) []byte {
	if len(document) == 0 || strings.TrimSpace(baseHref) == "" {
		return document
	}

	lowerDocument := strings.ToLower(string(document))
	if strings.Contains(lowerDocument, "<base ") {
		return document
	}

	baseTag := `<base href="` + htmlpkg.EscapeString(baseHref) + `">`
	if headStart := strings.Index(lowerDocument, "<head"); headStart >= 0 {
		if headEnd := strings.Index(lowerDocument[headStart:], ">"); headEnd >= 0 {
			insertAt := headStart + headEnd + 1
			return append(document[:insertAt], append([]byte(baseTag), document[insertAt:]...)...)
		}
	}
	if htmlStart := strings.Index(lowerDocument, "<html"); htmlStart >= 0 {
		if htmlEnd := strings.Index(lowerDocument[htmlStart:], ">"); htmlEnd >= 0 {
			insertAt := htmlStart + htmlEnd + 1
			headBlock := []byte("<head>" + baseTag + "</head>")
			return append(document[:insertAt], append(headBlock, document[insertAt:]...)...)
		}
	}
	return append([]byte("<head>"+baseTag+"</head>"), document...)
}

func streamTranscodedOutput(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, stdout io.ReadCloser) {
	firstChunk := make([]byte, 32*1024)
	n, readErr := stdout.Read(firstChunk)
	if n == 0 {
		if r.Context().Err() != nil {
			return
		}

		if readErr != nil && readErr != io.EOF {
			message := readErr.Error()
			http.Error(w, message, http.StatusInternalServerError)
			return
		}

		http.Error(w, "media transcode produced no output", http.StatusInternalServerError)
		return
	}

	setCORSHeaders(w)
	w.Header().Set("Cache-Control", "no-store")
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "video/mp4")
	w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)

	if _, err := w.Write(firstChunk[:n]); err != nil {
		return
	}

	_, _ = io.Copy(w, stdout)
}
`````

`````go
package app

import (
	"context"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"

	"wails-app/internal/pathref"
	"wails-app/vfs/archive/cache"
)

type VideoPlaybackMode string

const (
	VideoPlaybackModeDirect    VideoPlaybackMode = "direct"
	VideoPlaybackModeSegmented VideoPlaybackMode = "segmented"
	VideoPlaybackModeRemux     VideoPlaybackMode = "remux"
	VideoPlaybackModeTranscode VideoPlaybackMode = "transcode"
)

type VideoPlaybackPlan struct {
	Mode            VideoPlaybackMode `json:"mode"`
	Format          string            `json:"format"`
	VideoCodec      string            `json:"videoCodec,omitempty"`
	AudioCodec      string            `json:"audioCodec,omitempty"`
	DurationSeconds float64           `json:"durationSeconds"`
	ZeroDelay       bool              `json:"zeroDelay"`
	Seekable        bool              `json:"seekable"`
	UseNativePlayer bool              `json:"useNativePlayer"`
	URL             string            `json:"url"`
}

var directPreviewExtensions = map[string]bool{
	".mp4":  true,
	".m4v":  true,
	".mkv":  true,
	".webm": true,
	".ogv":  true,
	".mxf":  true,
}

var remuxableVideoCodecs = map[string]bool{
	"h264": true,
	"hevc": true,
	"h265": true,
	"av1":  true,
}

var remuxableAudioCodecs = map[string]bool{
	"":    true,
	"aac": true,
}

var transcodePreferredVideoCodecs = map[string]bool{
	"mpeg2video": true,
	"vc1":        true,
	"mjpeg":      true,
	"mpeg4":      true,
	"msmpeg4v3":  true,
	"wmv3":       true,
	"vp6":        true,
	"vp6f":       true,
}

func (a *App) GetVideoPlaybackPlan(publicPath string) VideoPlaybackPlan {
	return buildDiskVideoPlaybackPlan(a.StreamBaseURL(), publicPath)
}

func (a *App) GetArchiveVideoPlaybackPlan(fsPath string, nestedChain []string, entryPath string) VideoPlaybackPlan {
	return buildArchiveVideoPlaybackPlan(a.StreamBaseURL(), a.ArchCache(), fsPath, nestedChain, entryPath)
}

func buildDiskVideoPlaybackPlan(baseURL, publicPath string) VideoPlaybackPlan {
	if pathref.IsWeb(pathref.Normalize(publicPath)) {
		return VideoPlaybackPlan{
			Mode:            VideoPlaybackModeDirect,
			Format:          strings.TrimPrefix(strings.ToLower(filepath.Ext(publicPath)), "."),
			Seekable:        true,
			UseNativePlayer: false,
			URL:             StreamURLForFile(baseURL, publicPath),
		}
	}

	probe, _ := probeVideo(pathref.ToNativePath(pathref.Normalize(publicPath)))
	format := strings.TrimPrefix(strings.ToLower(filepath.Ext(publicPath)), ".")
	var videoCodec, audioCodec string
	var durationSeconds float64
	if probe != nil {
		format = firstNonEmpty(format, primaryFormatName(probe.Format.FormatName))
		videoCodec, audioCodec = extractProbeCodecs(probe)
		durationSeconds = resolveVideoDurationSeconds(context.Background(), pathref.ToNativePath(pathref.Normalize(publicPath)), probe)
	}

	return VideoPlaybackPlan{
		Mode:            VideoPlaybackModeDirect,
		Format:          format,
		VideoCodec:      videoCodec,
		AudioCodec:      audioCodec,
		DurationSeconds: durationSeconds,
		Seekable:        true,
		UseNativePlayer: false,
		URL:             StreamURLForFile(baseURL, publicPath),
	}
}

func buildArchiveVideoPlaybackPlan(baseURL string, archCache *cache.Cache, fsPath string, nestedChain []string, entryPath string) VideoPlaybackPlan {
	_ = archCache

	return VideoPlaybackPlan{
		Mode:            VideoPlaybackModeDirect,
		Format:          strings.TrimPrefix(strings.ToLower(filepath.Ext(entryPath)), "."),
		Seekable:        false,
		UseNativePlayer: false,
		URL:             StreamURLForEntry(baseURL, fsPath, nestedChain, entryPath),
	}
}

func decidePlaybackMode(name, videoCodec, audioCodec string) VideoPlaybackMode {
	ext := strings.ToLower(filepath.Ext(name))
	if directPreviewExtensions[ext] && supportsDirectVideoCodec(videoCodec) {
		return VideoPlaybackModeDirect
	}
	if remuxableVideoCodecs[strings.ToLower(videoCodec)] && remuxableAudioCodecs[strings.ToLower(audioCodec)] {
		switch ext {
		case ".mov", ".qt", ".flv", ".ts", ".mts", ".m2ts":
			return VideoPlaybackModeRemux
		}
	}
	if transcodePreferredVideoCodecs[strings.ToLower(videoCodec)] {
		return VideoPlaybackModeTranscode
	}
	if shouldTranscodeVideoPreview(name) {
		return VideoPlaybackModeTranscode
	}
	return VideoPlaybackModeDirect
}

func decideDiskPlaybackMode(name, videoCodec, audioCodec string) VideoPlaybackMode {
	vc := strings.ToLower(videoCodec)
	ac := strings.ToLower(audioCodec)
	if remuxableVideoCodecs[vc] && remuxableAudioCodecs[ac] {
		return VideoPlaybackModeRemux
	}
	if transcodePreferredVideoCodecs[vc] || shouldTranscodeVideoPreview(name) {
		return VideoPlaybackModeTranscode
	}
	return VideoPlaybackModeRemux
}

func shouldAttemptSegmentedDiskPlayback(name, videoCodec, audioCodec string) bool {
	switch strings.ToLower(filepath.Ext(name)) {
	case ".mp4", ".m4v", ".mkv", ".webm", ".mov", ".qt",
		".avi", ".divx", ".xvid",
		".flv", ".ts", ".mts", ".m2ts",
		".mpg", ".mpeg", ".vob", ".m2v", ".m2p",
		".wmv", ".asf", ".ogv", ".mxf",
		".mjpeg", ".mjpg":
		return true
	}
	return false
}

func supportsDirectVideoCodec(videoCodec string) bool {
	return !transcodePreferredVideoCodecs[strings.ToLower(videoCodec)]
}

func supportsSegmentedVideoCodec(videoCodec string) bool {
	return supportsDirectVideoCodec(videoCodec)
}

func shouldPreferDirectDiskPlayback(name, videoCodec string) bool {
	if !supportsDirectVideoCodec(videoCodec) {
		return false
	}

	switch strings.ToLower(filepath.Ext(name)) {
	case ".mp4", ".m4v":
		return true
	default:
		return false
	}
}

func shouldTranscodeVideoPreview(name string) bool {
	switch strings.ToLower(filepath.Ext(name)) {
	case ".avi", ".divx", ".xvid", ".flv", ".mov", ".qt", ".mpg", ".mpeg", ".vob", ".m2v", ".m2p", ".ts", ".mts", ".m2ts", ".mjpeg", ".mjpg":
		return true
	default:
		return false
	}
}
`````

`````go
package app

import (
	"context"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
)

type ffprobeOutput struct {
	Format struct {
		FormatName string `json:"format_name"`
		Duration   string `json:"duration"`
	} `json:"format"`
	Streams []struct {
		CodecType string `json:"codec_type"`
		CodecName string `json:"codec_name"`
	} `json:"streams"`
}

func extractProbeCodecs(probe *ffprobeOutput) (string, string) {
	if probe == nil {
		return "", ""
	}
	var videoCodec string
	var audioCodec string
	for _, stream := range probe.Streams {
		switch stream.CodecType {
		case "video":
			if videoCodec == "" {
				videoCodec = strings.ToLower(stream.CodecName)
			}
		case "audio":
			if audioCodec == "" {
				audioCodec = strings.ToLower(stream.CodecName)
			}
		}
	}
	return videoCodec, audioCodec
}

func parseProbeDuration(raw string) float64 {
	if raw == "" {
		return 0
	}
	seconds, err := strconv.ParseFloat(raw, 64)
	if err != nil || seconds < 0 {
		return 0
	}
	return seconds
}

func resolveVideoDurationSeconds(ctx context.Context, nativePath string, probe *ffprobeOutput) float64 {
	if probe != nil {
		if durationSeconds := parseProbeDuration(probe.Format.Duration); durationSeconds > 0 {
			return durationSeconds
		}
	}

	durationSeconds, err := estimateMediaDurationSeconds(ctx, nativePath)
	if err != nil || durationSeconds <= 0 {
		return 0
	}
	return durationSeconds
}

func probeFileDurationSeconds(nativePath string) float64 {
	probe, err := probeVideo(nativePath)
	if err != nil {
		return 0
	}
	return resolveVideoDurationSeconds(context.Background(), nativePath, probe)
}
`````

`````go
	return joinStreamBaseURL(baseURL) + streamPath + "?segmentKey=" + urlEncode(cacheKey) + "&segmentInit=1"
}

func segmentFileURL(baseURL, cacheKey string, index int) string {
	return joinStreamBaseURL(baseURL) + streamPath + "?segmentKey=" + urlEncode(cacheKey) + "&segmentIndex=" + urlEncode(strconv.Itoa(index))
}

func buildSegmentedVideoManifest(baseURL string, entry segmentedVideoCacheEntry) segmentedVideoManifest {
	if len(entry.SegmentRanges) > 0 {
		segments := make([]segmentedVideoManifestItem, 0, len(entry.SegmentRanges))
		for index, segmentRange := range entry.SegmentRanges {
			segments = append(segments, segmentedVideoManifestItem{
				Index:           index,
				StartTime:       segmentRange.StartSeconds,
				DurationSeconds: segmentRange.DurationSeconds,
				URL:             segmentFileURL(baseURL, entry.CacheKey, index),
			})
		}

		return segmentedVideoManifest{
			Mode:            string(VideoPlaybackModeSegmented),
			Format:          entry.Format,
			DurationSeconds: entry.DurationSeconds,
			SegmentDuration: entry.SegmentDuration,
			TotalSegments:   len(entry.SegmentRanges),
			InitSegmentURL:  segmentInitURL(baseURL, entry.CacheKey),
			Segments:        segments,
		}
	}

	segments := make([]segmentedVideoManifestItem, 0, entry.TotalSegments)
	for index := 0; index < entry.TotalSegments; index++ {
		startTime := float64(index) * entry.SegmentDuration
		segmentDuration := entry.SegmentDuration
		if remaining := entry.DurationSeconds - startTime; remaining < segmentDuration {
			segmentDuration = remaining
		}
		if segmentDuration < 0 {
			segmentDuration = 0
		}
		segments = append(segments, segmentedVideoManifestItem{
			Index:           index,
			StartTime:       startTime,
			DurationSeconds: segmentDuration,
			URL:             segmentFileURL(baseURL, entry.CacheKey, index),
		})
	}

	return segmentedVideoManifest{
		Mode:            string(VideoPlaybackModeSegmented),
		Format:          entry.Format,
		DurationSeconds: entry.DurationSeconds,
		SegmentDuration: entry.SegmentDuration,
		TotalSegments:   entry.TotalSegments,
		InitSegmentURL:  segmentInitURL(baseURL, entry.CacheKey),
		Segments:        segments,
	}
}

func ensureSegmentedVideoCacheEntry(ctx context.Context, publicPath string) (segmentedVideoCacheEntry, error) {
	publicPath = pathref.Normalize(publicPath)
	nativePath := pathref.ToNativePath(publicPath)
	if strings.Contains(nativePath, "..") {
		return segmentedVideoCacheEntry{}, fmt.Errorf("invalid path")
	}

	fi, err := os.Stat(nativePath)
	if err != nil {
		return segmentedVideoCacheEntry{}, err
	}

	cacheKey := segmentedVideoCacheKey(nativePath, fi)
	entry, err := segmentedPlaybackCache.Ensure(ctx, cacheKey, func(buildCtx context.Context) (*segmentedVideoPlaybackCacheEntry, error) {
		return buildSegmentedVideoCache(buildCtx, nativePath, cacheKey)
	})
	if err != nil {
		return segmentedVideoCacheEntry{}, err
	}
	return entry.manifest, nil
}

func archiveSegmentedVideoCacheKey(fsPath string, nestedChain []string, entryPath string) string {
	parts := make([]string, 0, 2+len(nestedChain))
	parts = append(parts, fsPath)
	parts = append(parts, nestedChain...)
	parts = append(parts, entryPath)
	hash := sha1.Sum([]byte(strings.Join(parts, "|")))
	return "arch-" + fmt.Sprintf("%x", hash)
}

func ensureArchiveSegmentedVideoCacheEntry(ctx context.Context, archCache *cache.Cache, fsPath string, nestedChain []string, entryPath string) (segmentedVideoCacheEntry, error) {
	if archCache == nil {
		return segmentedVideoCacheEntry{}, fmt.Errorf("archive cache unavailable")
	}
	cacheKey := archiveSegmentedVideoCacheKey(fsPath, nestedChain, entryPath)
	entry, err := segmentedPlaybackCache.Ensure(ctx, cacheKey, func(buildCtx context.Context) (*segmentedVideoPlaybackCacheEntry, error) {
		return buildArchiveSegmentedVideoCache(buildCtx, archCache, fsPath, nestedChain, entryPath, cacheKey)
	})
	if err != nil {
		return segmentedVideoCacheEntry{}, err
	}
	return entry.manifest, nil
}

func buildArchiveSegmentedVideoCache(ctx context.Context, archCache *cache.Cache, fsPath string, nestedChain []string, entryPath string, cacheKey string) (*segmentedVideoPlaybackCacheEntry, error) {
	nativeFsPath := pathref.ToNativePath(fsPath)
	if strings.Contains(nativeFsPath, "..") || strings.Contains(entryPath, "..") {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("invalid path")
	}

	extractCtx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, 5*time.Minute)
	defer cancel()

	arch, err := archCache.Get(extractCtx, nativeFsPath, nestedChain, "")
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("cannot open archive: %w", err)
	}

	entryFile, err := arch.Open(extractCtx, entryPath)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("cannot open entry: %w", err)
	}
	defer entryFile.Close()

	ext := filepath.Ext(entryPath)
	tmp, err := os.CreateTemp("", "wails-seg-*"+ext)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("cannot create temp file: %w", err)
	}
	tmpPath := tmp.Name()

	if _, err := io.Copy(tmp, entryFile); err != nil {
		tmp.Close()
		os.Remove(tmpPath)
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("cannot extract entry: %w", err)
	}
	if err := tmp.Close(); err != nil {
		os.Remove(tmpPath)
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("cannot finalize temp file: %w", err)
	}

	result, err := buildSegmentedVideoCache(ctx, tmpPath, cacheKey)
	if err != nil {
		os.Remove(tmpPath)
		return nil, err
	}
	result.cleanup = func() { os.Remove(tmpPath) } //nolint:errcheck
	return result, nil
}

func buildSegmentedVideoCache(ctx context.Context, nativePath string, cacheKey string) (*segmentedVideoPlaybackCacheEntry, error) {

	probe, err := probeVideo(nativePath)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	videoCodec, _ := extractProbeCodecs(probe)
	if !supportsSegmentedVideoCodec(videoCodec) {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("segmented playback requires transcoding for video codec %q", videoCodec)
	}
	durationSeconds := resolveVideoDurationSeconds(ctx, nativePath, probe)
	segmentRanges := buildFixedSegmentRanges(durationSeconds)
	if shouldUseKeyframeAlignedSegments(nativePath) {
		if keyframeRanges, err := buildKeyframeAlignedSegmentRanges(ctx, nativePath, durationSeconds); err == nil && len(keyframeRanges) > 0 {
			segmentRanges = keyframeRanges
		}
	}

	manifest := segmentedVideoCacheEntry{
		CacheKey:        cacheKey,
		Format:          "mp4",
		DurationSeconds: durationSeconds,
		SegmentDuration: segmentedPreviewSegmentSeconds,
		TotalSegments:   len(segmentRanges),
		SegmentRanges:   segmentRanges,
	}

	firstSegmentStart := 0.0
	firstSegmentDuration := segmentedPreviewSegmentSeconds
	if len(segmentRanges) > 0 {
		firstSegmentStart = segmentRanges[0].StartSeconds
		firstSegmentDuration = segmentRanges[0].DurationSeconds
	}
	if firstSegmentDuration <= 0 {
		firstSegmentDuration = segmentedPreviewSegmentSeconds
	}

	initSegment, firstSegment, err := buildSegmentedVideoFragment(ctx, nativePath, firstSegmentStart, firstSegmentDuration)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	now := time.Now()
	return &segmentedVideoPlaybackCacheEntry{
		manifest:    manifest,
		nativePath:  nativePath,
		initSegment: initSegment,
		segments: map[int][]byte{
			0: firstSegment,
		},
		segmentSeen: map[int]time.Time{
			0: now,
		},
		inflight:   make(map[int]*segmentedVideoSegmentBuild),
		createdAt:  now,
		lastAccess: now,
	}, nil
}

func shouldUseKeyframeAlignedSegments(nativePath string) bool {
	switch strings.ToLower(filepath.Ext(nativePath)) {
	case ".mp4", ".m4v", ".webm":
		return false
	default:
		return shouldAttemptSegmentedDiskPlayback(nativePath, "", "")
	}
}

func requiresAccurateSegmentSeek(nativePath string) bool {
	switch strings.ToLower(filepath.Ext(nativePath)) {
	case ".avi", ".divx", ".xvid":
		return true
	default:
		return false
	}
}

func splitFragmentedMP4(data []byte) ([]byte, []byte, error) {
	if len(data) < 8 {
		return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to build segmented preview: fragmented mp4 output too small")
	}

	splitOffset := -1
	for offset := 0; offset+8 <= len(data); {
		boxSize := int(uint32(data[offset])<<24 | uint32(data[offset+1])<<16 | uint32(data[offset+2])<<8 | uint32(data[offset+3]))
		headerSize := 8
		if boxSize == 1 {
			if offset+16 > len(data) {
				return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to build segmented preview: invalid extended mp4 box")
			}
			largeSize := uint64(data[offset+8])<<56 | uint64(data[offset+9])<<48 | uint64(data[offset+10])<<40 | uint64(data[offset+11])<<32 |
				uint64(data[offset+12])<<24 | uint64(data[offset+13])<<16 | uint64(data[offset+14])<<8 | uint64(data[offset+15])
			if largeSize > uint64(len(data)-offset) || largeSize < 16 {
				return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to build segmented preview: invalid extended mp4 size")
			}
			boxSize = int(largeSize)
			headerSize = 16
		} else if boxSize == 0 {
			boxSize = len(data) - offset
		}
		if boxSize < headerSize || offset+boxSize > len(data) {
			return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to build segmented preview: invalid mp4 box size")
		}

		boxType := string(data[offset+4 : offset+8])
		if boxType == "sidx" || boxType == "styp" || boxType == "moof" || boxType == "mdat" {
			splitOffset = offset
			break
		}
		offset += boxSize
	}

	if splitOffset <= 0 || splitOffset >= len(data) {
		return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to build segmented preview: could not split initialization segment")
	}

	initSegment := append([]byte(nil), data[:splitOffset]...)
	mediaSegment := append([]byte(nil), data[splitOffset:]...)
	if len(mediaSegment) == 0 {
		return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to build segmented preview: empty media segment")
	}
	return initSegment, mediaSegment, nil
}

func segmentedVideoCacheKey(nativePath string, fi os.FileInfo) string {
	hash := sha1.Sum([]byte(strings.Join([]string{nativePath, strconv.FormatInt(fi.Size(), 10), strconv.FormatInt(fi.ModTime().UnixNano(), 10)}, "|")))
	return fmt.Sprintf("%x", hash)
}

func newSegmentedVideoPlaybackCache() *segmentedVideoPlaybackCache {
	return &segmentedVideoPlaybackCache{
		entries:  make(map[string]*segmentedVideoPlaybackCacheEntry),
		inflight: make(map[string]*segmentedVideoPlaybackBuild),
	}
}

func (c *segmentedVideoPlaybackCache) Ensure(ctx context.Context, cacheKey string, build func(context.Context) (*segmentedVideoPlaybackCacheEntry, error)) (*segmentedVideoPlaybackCacheEntry, error) {
	for {
		c.mu.Lock()
		c.evictExpiredLocked(time.Now())
		if entry, ok := c.entries[cacheKey]; ok {
			entry.lastAccess = time.Now()
			c.mu.Unlock()
			return entry, nil
		}
		pending, ok := c.inflight[cacheKey]
		if !ok {
			buildCtx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
			pending = &segmentedVideoPlaybackBuild{done: make(chan struct{}), cancel: cancel}
			c.inflight[cacheKey] = pending
			go c.runPlaybackBuild(cacheKey, pending, buildCtx, build)
		}
		pending.waiters++
		c.mu.Unlock()

		select {
		case <-pending.done:
			if pending.err != nil {
				return nil, pending.err
			}
			if pending.entry != nil {
				return pending.entry, nil
			}
		case <-ctx.Done():
			c.releasePlaybackBuildWaiter(cacheKey, pending)
			return nil, ctx.Err()
		}
	}
}

func (c *segmentedVideoPlaybackCache) runPlaybackBuild(cacheKey string, pending *segmentedVideoPlaybackBuild, buildCtx context.Context, build func(context.Context) (*segmentedVideoPlaybackCacheEntry, error)) {
	entry, err := build(buildCtx)

	c.mu.Lock()
	defer c.mu.Unlock()
	if err == nil && entry != nil {
		entry.lastAccess = time.Now()
		c.entries[cacheKey] = entry
	}
	pending.entry = entry
	pending.err = err
	if current, ok := c.inflight[cacheKey]; ok && current == pending {
		delete(c.inflight, cacheKey)
	}
	close(pending.done)
}

func (c *segmentedVideoPlaybackCache) releasePlaybackBuildWaiter(cacheKey string, pending *segmentedVideoPlaybackBuild) {
	c.mu.Lock()
	defer c.mu.Unlock()
	current, ok := c.inflight[cacheKey]
	if !ok || current != pending {
		return
	}
	if pending.waiters > 0 {
		pending.waiters--
	}
	if pending.waiters == 0 && pending.cancel != nil {
		pending.cancel()
	}
}

func (c *segmentedVideoPlaybackCache) File(ctx context.Context, cacheKey string, fileName string) ([]byte, time.Time, bool, error) {
	now := time.Now()
	c.mu.Lock()
	c.evictExpiredLocked(now)
	entry, ok := c.entries[cacheKey]
	if ok {
		entry.lastAccess = now
	}
	c.mu.Unlock()
	if !ok {
		return nil, time.Time{}, false, nil
	}

	content, err := entry.file(ctx, fileName)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, time.Time{}, false, err
	}
	if len(content) == 0 {
		return nil, time.Time{}, false, nil
	}

	c.mu.Lock()
	entry.lastAccess = time.Now()
	c.mu.Unlock()
	return content, entry.createdAt, true, nil
}

func (c *segmentedVideoPlaybackCache) Clear() {
	c.mu.Lock()
	for _, entry := range c.entries {
		if entry.cleanup != nil {
			go entry.cleanup()
		}
	}
	clear(c.entries)
	clear(c.inflight)
	c.mu.Unlock()
}

func (c *segmentedVideoPlaybackCache) Get(cacheKey string) (*segmentedVideoPlaybackCacheEntry, bool) {
	c.mu.Lock()
	defer c.mu.Unlock()
	entry, ok := c.entries[cacheKey]
	if ok {
		entry.lastAccess = time.Now()
	}
	return entry, ok
}

func (c *segmentedVideoPlaybackCache) evictExpiredLocked(now time.Time) {
	for cacheKey, entry := range c.entries {
		if now.Sub(entry.lastAccess) > segmentedVideoCacheTTL {
			delete(c.entries, cacheKey)
			if entry.cleanup != nil {
				go entry.cleanup()
			}
		}
	}
}

func cleanupSegmentedVideoPlaybackCache() {
	segmentedPlaybackCache.Clear()
}

func (e *segmentedVideoPlaybackCacheEntry) file(ctx context.Context, fileName string) ([]byte, error) {
	if fileName == "init.mp4" {
		initSegment, _, err := e.ensureSegment(ctx, 0)
		return initSegment, err
	}

	segmentIndex, ok := parseSegmentedVideoFileName(fileName)
	if !ok {
		return nil, nil
	}
	_, segment, err := e.ensureSegment(ctx, segmentIndex)
	return segment, err
}

func (e *segmentedVideoPlaybackCacheEntry) ensureSegment(ctx context.Context, segmentIndex int) ([]byte, []byte, error) {
	if segmentIndex < 0 || segmentIndex >= e.manifest.TotalSegments {
		return nil, nil, nil
	}

	for {
		now := time.Now()
		e.mu.Lock()
		if len(e.initSegment) > 0 {
			if segment, ok := e.segments[segmentIndex]; ok {
				e.segmentSeen[segmentIndex] = now
				e.lastAccess = now
				initSegment := append([]byte(nil), e.initSegment...)
				mediaSegment := append([]byte(nil), segment...)
				e.mu.Unlock()
				return initSegment, mediaSegment, nil
			}
		}
		pending, ok := e.inflight[segmentIndex]
		if !ok {
			buildCtx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
			pending = &segmentedVideoSegmentBuild{done: make(chan struct{}), cancel: cancel}
			e.inflight[segmentIndex] = pending

			startSeconds, durationSeconds := e.segmentRange(segmentIndex)

			go e.runSegmentBuild(segmentIndex, pending, buildCtx, startSeconds, durationSeconds)
		}
		pending.waiters++
		e.mu.Unlock()

		select {
		case <-pending.done:
			if pending.err != nil {
				return nil, nil, pending.err
			}
			return pending.init, pending.segment, nil
		case <-ctx.Done():
			e.releaseSegmentBuildWaiter(segmentIndex, pending)
			return nil, nil, ctx.Err()
		}
	}
}

func (e *segmentedVideoPlaybackCacheEntry) segmentRange(segmentIndex int) (float64, float64) {
	if segmentIndex >= 0 && segmentIndex < len(e.manifest.SegmentRanges) {
		segmentRange := e.manifest.SegmentRanges[segmentIndex]
		durationSeconds := segmentRange.DurationSeconds
		if durationSeconds <= 0 {
			durationSeconds = e.manifest.SegmentDuration
		}
		return segmentRange.StartSeconds, durationSeconds
	}

	startSeconds := float64(segmentIndex) * e.manifest.SegmentDuration
	durationSeconds := e.manifest.SegmentDuration
	if remaining := e.manifest.DurationSeconds - startSeconds; remaining > 0 && remaining < durationSeconds {
		durationSeconds = remaining
	}
	if durationSeconds <= 0 {
		durationSeconds = e.manifest.SegmentDuration
	}
	return startSeconds, durationSeconds
}

func (e *segmentedVideoPlaybackCacheEntry) runSegmentBuild(segmentIndex int, pending *segmentedVideoSegmentBuild, buildCtx context.Context, startSeconds float64, durationSeconds float64) {
	initSegment, mediaSegment, err := buildSegmentedVideoFragment(buildCtx, e.nativePath, startSeconds, durationSeconds)

	e.mu.Lock()
	defer e.mu.Unlock()
	if err == nil {
		now := time.Now()
		if len(e.initSegment) == 0 {
			e.initSegment = initSegment
		}
		e.segments[segmentIndex] = mediaSegment
		e.segmentSeen[segmentIndex] = now
		e.lastAccess = now
		e.pruneSegmentsLocked()
	}
	pending.init = initSegment
	pending.segment = mediaSegment
	pending.err = err
	if current, ok := e.inflight[segmentIndex]; ok && current == pending {
		delete(e.inflight, segmentIndex)
	}
	close(pending.done)
}

func (e *segmentedVideoPlaybackCacheEntry) releaseSegmentBuildWaiter(segmentIndex int, pending *segmentedVideoSegmentBuild) {
	e.mu.Lock()
	defer e.mu.Unlock()
	current, ok := e.inflight[segmentIndex]
	if !ok || current != pending {
		return
	}
	if pending.waiters > 0 {
		pending.waiters--
	}
	if pending.waiters == 0 && pending.cancel != nil {
		pending.cancel()
	}
}

func (e *segmentedVideoPlaybackCacheEntry) pruneSegmentsLocked() {
	if len(e.segments) <= segmentedVideoMaxResidentSegments {
		return
	}

	type residentSegment struct {
		index int
		seen  time.Time
	}
	resident := make([]residentSegment, 0, len(e.segments))
	for index, seenAt := range e.segmentSeen {
		resident = append(resident, residentSegment{index: index, seen: seenAt})
	}
	sort.Slice(resident, func(left int, right int) bool {
		return resident[left].seen.Before(resident[right].seen)
	})
	for len(resident) > segmentedVideoMaxResidentSegments {
		oldest := resident[0]
		delete(e.segments, oldest.index)
		delete(e.segmentSeen, oldest.index)
		resident = resident[1:]
	}
}

func parseSegmentedVideoFileName(fileName string) (int, bool) {
	if !strings.HasPrefix(fileName, "segment_") || !strings.HasSuffix(fileName, ".m4s") {
		return 0, false
	}
	rawIndex := strings.TrimSuffix(strings.TrimPrefix(fileName, "segment_"), ".m4s")
	segmentNumber, err := strconv.Atoi(rawIndex)
	if err != nil || segmentNumber <= 0 {
		return 0, false
	}
	return segmentNumber - 1, true
}
`````

`````go
package app

import (

// StreamURLForFile builds the /wails-stream URL for a disk path.
// Called from the frontend via Wails binding.
func StreamURLForFile(baseURL, publicPath string) string {
	return joinStreamBaseURL(baseURL) + streamPath + "?path=" + urlEncode(publicPath)
}

// StreamURLForEntry builds the /wails-stream URL for an archive entry.
func StreamURLForEntry(baseURL, fsPath string, nestedChain []string, entryPath string) string {
	u := joinStreamBaseURL(baseURL) + streamPath + "?fsPath=" + urlEncode(fsPath) + "&entry=" + urlEncode(entryPath)
	if len(nestedChain) > 0 {
		u += "&nested=" + urlEncode(strings.Join(nestedChain, ","))
	}
	return u
}

// ConvertedStreamURLForFile builds the /wails-stream URL for a disk path that should be converted on demand.
func ConvertedStreamURLForFile(baseURL, publicPath, targetFormat string) string {
	return joinStreamBaseURL(baseURL) + streamPath + "?path=" + urlEncode(publicPath) + "&convert=" + urlEncode(targetFormat)
}

func ThumbnailStreamURLForFile(baseURL, publicPath, targetFormat string, maxWidth int, maxHeight int) string {
	return joinStreamBaseURL(baseURL) + streamPath + "?path=" + urlEncode(publicPath) + "&thumb=" + urlEncode(targetFormat) + "&thumbWidth=" + strconv.Itoa(maxWidth) + "&thumbHeight=" + strconv.Itoa(maxHeight)
}

func ThumbnailStreamURLForEntry(baseURL, fsPath string, nestedChain []string, entryPath string, targetFormat string, maxWidth int, maxHeight int) string {
	u := joinStreamBaseURL(baseURL) + streamPath + "?fsPath=" + urlEncode(fsPath) + "&entry=" + urlEncode(entryPath) + "&thumb=" + urlEncode(targetFormat) + "&thumbWidth=" + strconv.Itoa(maxWidth) + "&thumbHeight=" + strconv.Itoa(maxHeight)
	if len(nestedChain) > 0 {
		u += "&nested=" + urlEncode(strings.Join(nestedChain, ","))
	}
	return u
}

func VideoFramePreviewURLForFile(baseURL, publicPath, targetFormat string, frameSeconds float64) string {

	if frameSeconds > 0 {
		u += "&frameTime=" + strconv.FormatFloat(frameSeconds, 'f', 3, 64)
	}

}

func VideoFramePreviewURLForEntry(baseURL, fsPath string, nestedChain []string, entryPath string, targetFormat string, frameSeconds float64) string {
	u := joinStreamBaseURL(baseURL) + streamPath + "?fsPath=" + urlEncode(fsPath) + "&entry=" + urlEncode(entryPath) + "&frame=" + urlEncode(targetFormat)
	if frameSeconds > 0 {
		u += "&frameTime=" + strconv.FormatFloat(frameSeconds, 'f', 3, 64)
	}
	if len(nestedChain) > 0 {
		u += "&nested=" + urlEncode(strings.Join(nestedChain, ","))
	}
	return u
}

func joinStreamBaseURL(baseURL string) string {
	return strings.TrimRight(baseURL, "/")
}

func urlEncode(s string) string {
	// Manual percent-encoding for path characters. We only need to encode the
	// characters that would break query-string parsing.
	var b strings.Builder
	for _, c := range []byte(s) {
		switch {
		case c >= 'A' && c <= 'Z', c >= 'a' && c <= 'z', c >= '0' && c <= '9':
			b.WriteByte(c)
		case c == '-', c == '_', c == '.', c == '~',
			c == '/', c == ':', c == '@':
			b.WriteByte(c)
		default:
			b.WriteString("%" + hexByte(c))
		}
	}
	return b.String()
}

func hexByte(b byte) string {
	const hex = "0123456789ABCDEF"
	return string([]byte{hex[b>>4], hex[b&0xf]})
}

// GetStreamURL is a Wails-bound method that returns the stream URL for any path.
// Exposed so the frontend can call App.GetStreamURL(path) to get a ready-to-use src.
func (a *App) GetStreamURL(publicPath string) string {
	return StreamURLForFile(a.StreamBaseURL(), publicPath)
}

// GetArchiveStreamURL is a Wails-bound method for archive entries.
func (a *App) GetArchiveStreamURL(fsPath string, nestedChain []string, entryPath string) string {
	return StreamURLForEntry(a.StreamBaseURL(), fsPath, nestedChain, entryPath)
}

func (a *App) GetVideoPreviewURL(publicPath string) string {
	return VideoFramePreviewURLForFile(a.StreamBaseURL(), publicPath, "png", defaultVideoFramePreviewSeconds)
}

func (a *App) GetArchiveVideoPreviewURL(fsPath string, nestedChain []string, entryPath string) string {
	return VideoFramePreviewURLForEntry(a.StreamBaseURL(), fsPath, nestedChain, entryPath, "png", defaultVideoFramePreviewSeconds)
}

func FFmpegPreviewURLForFile(baseURL, publicPath, targetFormat, playbackMode string, startSeconds float64, windowSeconds float64, durationSeconds float64) string {
	u := joinStreamBaseURL(baseURL) + streamPath + "?path=" + urlEncode(publicPath) + "&transcode=" + urlEncode(targetFormat)
	if playbackMode != "" {
		u += "&mode=" + urlEncode(playbackMode)
	}
	if startSeconds > 0 {
		u += "&start=" + urlEncode(strconv.FormatFloat(startSeconds, 'f', 3, 64))
	}
	if windowSeconds > 0 {
		u += "&window=" + urlEncode(strconv.FormatFloat(windowSeconds, 'f', 3, 64))
	}
	if durationSeconds > 0 {
		u += "&duration=" + urlEncode(strconv.FormatFloat(durationSeconds, 'f', 3, 64))
	}
	return u
}

func FFmpegPreviewURLForEntry(baseURL, fsPath string, nestedChain []string, entryPath string, targetFormat, playbackMode string, startSeconds float64, windowSeconds float64, durationSeconds float64) string {
	u := joinStreamBaseURL(baseURL) + streamPath + "?fsPath=" + urlEncode(fsPath) + "&entry=" + urlEncode(entryPath) + "&transcode=" + urlEncode(targetFormat)
	if playbackMode != "" {
		u += "&mode=" + urlEncode(playbackMode)
	}
	if startSeconds > 0 {
		u += "&start=" + urlEncode(strconv.FormatFloat(startSeconds, 'f', 3, 64))
	}
	if windowSeconds > 0 {
		u += "&window=" + urlEncode(strconv.FormatFloat(windowSeconds, 'f', 3, 64))
	}
	if durationSeconds > 0 {
		u += "&duration=" + urlEncode(strconv.FormatFloat(durationSeconds, 'f', 3, 64))
	}
	if len(nestedChain) > 0 {
		u += "&nested=" + urlEncode(strings.Join(nestedChain, ","))
	}
	return u
}
`````

`````go
package app

import (
	"mime"
	"net/http"
	"path/filepath"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
)

func parseStartSeconds(raw string) float64 {
	if raw == "" {
		return 0
	}
	seconds, err := strconv.ParseFloat(raw, 64)
	if err != nil || seconds < 0 {
		return 0
	}
	return seconds
}

func parseWindowSeconds(raw string) float64 {
	if raw == "" {
		return 0
	}
	seconds, err := strconv.ParseFloat(raw, 64)
	if err != nil || seconds <= 0 {
		return 0
	}
	return seconds
}

func parseThumbnailDimension(raw string) int {
	if raw == "" {
		return defaultThumbnailSize
	}
	value, err := strconv.Atoi(raw)
	if err != nil || value <= 0 {
		return defaultThumbnailSize
	}
	if value > 2048 {
		return 2048
	}
	return value
}

func normalizePlaybackMode(raw string) VideoPlaybackMode {
	if strings.EqualFold(raw, string(VideoPlaybackModeSegmented)) {
		return VideoPlaybackModeSegmented
	}
	if strings.EqualFold(raw, string(VideoPlaybackModeRemux)) {
		return VideoPlaybackModeRemux
	}
	return VideoPlaybackModeTranscode
}

func requestBaseURL(r *http.Request) string {
	if r == nil {
		return ""
	}
	scheme := "http"
	if r.TLS != nil {
		scheme = "https"
	}
	return scheme + "://" + r.Host
}

func setCORSHeaders(w http.ResponseWriter) {
	w.Header().Set("Access-Control-Allow-Origin", "*")
	w.Header().Set("Access-Control-Allow-Methods", "GET, HEAD, OPTIONS")
	w.Header().Set("Access-Control-Allow-Headers", "Content-Type, Range, Accept-Ranges")
	w.Header().Set("Access-Control-Expose-Headers", "Content-Length, Content-Range, Content-Type")
}

func setContentType(w http.ResponseWriter, name string) {
	ext := strings.ToLower(filepath.Ext(name))
	ct := mime.TypeByExtension(ext)
	if ct == "" {
		ct = extMIME(ext)
	}
	if ct != "" {
		w.Header().Set("Content-Type", ct)
	}
}

// extMIME covers formats not in the stdlib mime database.
func extMIME(ext string) string {
	m := map[string]string{
		".mkv":   "video/x-matroska",
		".avi":   "video/x-msvideo",
		".divx":  "video/x-msvideo",
		".xvid":  "video/x-msvideo",
		".flv":   "video/x-flv",
		".wmv":   "video/x-ms-wmv",
		".mpg":   "video/mpeg",
		".mpeg":  "video/mpeg",
		".vob":   "video/mpeg",
		".m2v":   "video/mpeg",
		".m2p":   "video/mpeg",
		".ts":    "video/mp2t",
		".mts":   "video/mp2t",
		".m2ts":  "video/mp2t",
		".mjpeg": "video/x-motion-jpeg",
		".mjpg":  "video/x-motion-jpeg",
		".qt":    "video/quicktime",
		".m3u8":  "application/x-mpegURL",
		".mxf":   "application/mxf",
		".webp":  "image/webp",
		".avif":  "image/avif",
		".heic":  "image/heic",
		".heif":  "image/heif",
	}
	return m[ext]
}

func primaryFormatName(raw string) string {
	if raw == "" {
		return ""
	}
	parts := strings.Split(raw, ",")
	return strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(parts[0]))
}

func firstNonEmpty(values ...string) string {
	for _, value := range values {
		if strings.TrimSpace(value) != "" {
			return value
		}
	}
	return ""
}
`````

`````go
package app

import (
	"context"

	contracts "wails-app/internal/contracts"
	"wails-app/internal/pathref"
	internalruntime "wails-app/internal/runtime"
)

func (s *State) InitVFS() {
	vfs, err := internalruntime.InitVFS()
	if err != nil {
		return
	}
	s.vfs = vfs
	if s.Filesystem != nil {
		s.Filesystem.SetVFS(s.vfs)
	}
	if s.Utility != nil {
		s.Utility.SetVFS(s.vfs)
	}
	if s.DirStream != nil {
		s.DirStream.SetVFS(
			func(path string) (*contracts.DirectoryListing, error) {
				return internalruntime.VFSListDir(context.Background(), s.vfs, path)
			},
			func(path string) bool {
				normalized := pathref.Normalize(path)
				if pathref.IsAlias(normalized) {
					return s.vfs.IsMounted(pathref.ToVFS(normalized))
				}
				return s.vfs.IsMounted(normalized)
			},
		)
		s.DirStream.SetVFSPaged(func(ctx context.Context, path, token string, limit int) (*contracts.DirectoryPage, error) {
			return internalruntime.VFSListDirPage(ctx, s.vfs, path, token, limit)
		})
	}
}

func (s *State) VFSListDir(path string) (*contracts.DirectoryListing, error) {
	if s.Filesystem != nil && pathref.IsRegistry(path) {
		return s.Filesystem.ListDirectory(path, false)
	}
	return internalruntime.VFSListDir(context.Background(), s.vfs, path)
}

func (s *State) VFSReadFile(path string, encoding string) (*contracts.FileContent, error) {
	if s.Filesystem != nil && pathref.IsRegistry(path) {
		return s.Filesystem.ReadFile(path, encoding)
	}
	return internalruntime.VFSReadFile(context.Background(), s.vfs, path, encoding)
}

func (s *State) VFSWriteFile(path string, content string, encoding string) (*contracts.OperationResult, error) {
	if s.Filesystem != nil && pathref.IsRegistry(path) {
		return s.Filesystem.WriteFile(path, content, encoding)
	}
	return internalruntime.VFSWriteFile(context.Background(), s.vfs, path, content, encoding)
}

func (s *State) VFSMkdir(path string) (*contracts.OperationResult, error) {
	if s.Filesystem != nil && pathref.IsRegistry(path) {
		return s.Filesystem.CreateDirectory(path, false)
	}
	return internalruntime.VFSMkdir(context.Background(), s.vfs, path)
}

func (s *State) VFSRemove(path string) (*contracts.OperationResult, error) {
`````

`````go
	x, y, width, height := fitBoundsToDisplay(
		displayRect{left: 0, top: 0, right: 1200, bottom: 700},
`````

`````go
//go:build windows

package app

import (
	"unsafe"

	"golang.org/x/sys/windows"
)

const (
	spiGetWorkArea          = 0x0030
	monitorDefaultToPrimary = 0x00000001
	monitorDefaultToNearest = 0x00000002
)

var (
	user32DLL                = windows.NewLazySystemDLL("user32.dll")
	shcoreDLL                = windows.NewLazySystemDLL("shcore.dll")
	procGetMonitorInfoW      = user32DLL.NewProc("GetMonitorInfoW")
	procMonitorFromRect      = user32DLL.NewProc("MonitorFromRect")
	procSystemParametersInfo = user32DLL.NewProc("SystemParametersInfoW")
	procGetDpiForMonitor     = shcoreDLL.NewProc("GetDpiForMonitor")
)

const mdtEffectiveDPI = 0

type winRect struct {
	Left   int32
	Top    int32
	Right  int32
	Bottom int32
}

type monitorInfo struct {
	CbSize    uint32
	RcMonitor winRect
	RcWork    winRect
	DwFlags   uint32
}

func fitStartupWindowBounds(x, y, width, height int, hasPosition bool) (int, int, int, int) {
	metrics, ok := startupWorkMetrics(x, y, width, height, hasPosition)
	if !ok {
		return x, y, width, height
	}

	maxWidth := scaleToDefaultDPI(metrics.right-metrics.left, metrics.dpiX)
	maxHeight := scaleToDefaultDPI(metrics.bottom-metrics.top, metrics.dpiY)
	width = clampWindowDimension(width, maxWidth)
	height = clampWindowDimension(height, maxHeight)

	if !hasPosition {
		return x, y, width, height
	}

	windowWidthPx := scaleWithDPI(width, metrics.dpiX)
	windowHeightPx := scaleWithDPI(height, metrics.dpiY)
	if x < metrics.left {
		x = metrics.left
	}
	if y < metrics.top {
		y = metrics.top
	}
	if x+windowWidthPx > metrics.right {
		x = metrics.right - windowWidthPx
	}
	if y+windowHeightPx > metrics.bottom {
		y = metrics.bottom - windowHeightPx
	}
	if x < metrics.left {
		x = metrics.left
	}
	if y < metrics.top {
		y = metrics.top
	}

	return x, y, width, height
}

func startupWorkArea(x, y, width, height int, hasPosition bool) (displayRect, bool) {
	metrics, ok := startupWorkMetrics(x, y, width, height, hasPosition)
	if !ok {
		return displayRect{}, false
	}
	return displayRect{
		left:   metrics.left,
		top:    metrics.top,
		right:  metrics.left + scaleToDefaultDPI(metrics.right-metrics.left, metrics.dpiX),
		bottom: metrics.top + scaleToDefaultDPI(metrics.bottom-metrics.top, metrics.dpiY),
	}, true
}

type workAreaMetrics struct {
	left   int
	top    int
	right  int
	bottom int
	dpiX   uint
	dpiY   uint
}

func startupWorkMetrics(x, y, width, height int, hasPosition bool) (workAreaMetrics, bool) {
	if hasPosition {
		if metrics, ok := monitorWorkMetricsForRect(winRect{
			Left:   int32(x),
			Top:    int32(y),
			Right:  int32(x + width),
			Bottom: int32(y + height),
		}); ok {
			return metrics, true
		}
	}
	return primaryWorkMetrics()
}

func primaryWorkMetrics() (workAreaMetrics, bool) {
	var rect winRect
	ret, _, _ := procSystemParametersInfo.Call(
		uintptr(spiGetWorkArea),
		0,
		uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(&rect)),
		0,
	)
	if ret == 0 {
		return workAreaMetrics{}, false
	}
	// SPI_GETWORKAREA returns physical-pixel bounds. Resolve the owning monitor
	// so we can convert the work area into Wails' default 96-DPI space using
	// the monitor's effective DPI instead of assuming 96.
	if metrics, ok := monitorWorkMetricsForRect(rect); ok {
		return metrics, true
	}
	return workAreaMetrics{
		left:   int(rect.Left),
		top:    int(rect.Top),
		right:  int(rect.Right),
		bottom: int(rect.Bottom),
		dpiX:   96,
		dpiY:   96,
	}, true
}

func monitorWorkMetricsForRect(rect winRect) (workAreaMetrics, bool) {
	monitor, _, _ := procMonitorFromRect.Call(
		uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(&rect)),
		uintptr(monitorDefaultToNearest),
	)
	if monitor == 0 {
		monitor, _, _ = procMonitorFromRect.Call(
			uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(&rect)),
			uintptr(monitorDefaultToPrimary),
		)
		if monitor == 0 {
			return workAreaMetrics{}, false
		}
	}

	info := monitorInfo{CbSize: uint32(unsafe.Sizeof(monitorInfo{}))}
	ret, _, _ := procGetMonitorInfoW.Call(
		monitor,
		uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(&info)),
	)
	if ret == 0 {
		return workAreaMetrics{}, false
	}

	dpiX, dpiY := monitorDPI(monitor)
	return workAreaMetrics{
		left:   int(info.RcWork.Left),
		top:    int(info.RcWork.Top),
		right:  int(info.RcWork.Right),
		bottom: int(info.RcWork.Bottom),
		dpiX:   dpiX,
		dpiY:   dpiY,
	}, true
}

func monitorDPI(monitor uintptr) (uint, uint) {
	var dpiX uint32 = 96
	var dpiY uint32 = 96
	if procGetDpiForMonitor.Find() == nil {
		ret, _, _ := procGetDpiForMonitor.Call(
			monitor,
			uintptr(mdtEffectiveDPI),
			uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(&dpiX)),
			uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(&dpiY)),
		)
		if ret == 0 && dpiX > 0 && dpiY > 0 {
			return uint(dpiX), uint(dpiY)
		}
	}
	return 96, 96
}

func scaleWithDPI(value int, dpi uint) int {
	if dpi == 0 {
		return value
	}
	return (value * int(dpi)) / 96
}

func scaleToDefaultDPI(value int, dpi uint) int {
	if dpi == 0 {
		return value
	}
	return (value * 96) / int(dpi)
}
`````

`````go
package app

import contracts "wails-app/internal/contracts"

type displayRect struct {
	left   int
	top    int
	right  int
	bottom int
}

func (r displayRect) width() int {
	return maxInt(0, r.right-r.left)
}

func (r displayRect) height() int {
	return maxInt(0, r.bottom-r.top)
}

func fitBoundsToDisplay(area displayRect, x, y, width, height int, hasPosition bool) (int, int, int, int) {
	if area.width() <= 0 || area.height() <= 0 {
		return x, y, width, height
	}

	width = clampWindowDimension(width, area.width())
	height = clampWindowDimension(height, area.height())

	if !hasPosition {
		return x, y, width, height
	}

	if x < area.left {
		x = area.left
	}
	if y < area.top {
		y = area.top
	}
	if x+width > area.right {
		x = area.right - width
	}
	if y+height > area.bottom {
		y = area.bottom - height
	}
	if x < area.left {
		x = area.left
	}
	if y < area.top {
		y = area.top
	}

	return x, y, width, height
}

func clampWindowDimension(value, limit int) int {
	if limit <= 0 {
		return value
	}
	if value > limit {
		return limit
	}
	return value
}

func maxInt(a, b int) int {
	if a > b {
		return a
	}
	return b
}

func normalizeWindowStateForSave(state contracts.WindowState) contracts.WindowState {
	if state.Width <= 0 || state.Height <= 0 {
		return state
	}
	x, y, width, height := fitStartupWindowBounds(state.X, state.Y, state.Width, state.Height, state.HasPosition)
	state.X = x
	state.Y = y
	state.Width = width
	state.Height = height
	return state
}

func maxWindowViewport(state contracts.WindowState) contracts.WindowViewport {
	area, ok := startupWorkArea(state.X, state.Y, state.Width, state.Height, state.HasPosition)
	if !ok {
		return contracts.WindowViewport{}
	}
	return contracts.WindowViewport{
		X:      area.left,
		Y:      area.top,
		Width:  area.width(),
		Height: area.height(),
	}
}

func GetMaxWindowViewport(state contracts.WindowState) contracts.WindowViewport {
	return maxWindowViewport(state)
}
`````

## File: manager/internal/archive/extract_helpers.go
`````go
package archive

import (
	"archive/tar"
	"compress/bzip2"
	"compress/gzip"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"
)

func wrapTarReader(src *os.File, fsPath string) (*tar.Reader, func(), error) {
	lower := strings.ToLower(fsPath)
	switch {
	case strings.HasSuffix(lower, ".tar.gz"), strings.HasSuffix(lower, ".tgz"):
		gr, err := gzip.NewReader(src)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, nil, err
		}
		return tar.NewReader(gr), func() { gr.Close() }, nil
	case strings.HasSuffix(lower, ".tar.bz2"):
		return tar.NewReader(bzip2.NewReader(src)), nil, nil
	case strings.HasSuffix(lower, ".tar.xz"):
		return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("tar.xz extraction is handled via archiver.Walk, not wrapTarReader")
	default:
		return tar.NewReader(src), nil, nil
	}
}

func extractWriteFile(destPath string, reader io.Reader) (int64, error) {
	f, err := os.OpenFile(destPath, os.O_CREATE|os.O_WRONLY|os.O_TRUNC, 0644)
	if err != nil {
		return 0, err
	}
	n, copyErr := io.Copy(f, reader)
	closeErr := f.Close()
	if copyErr != nil {
		return n, copyErr
	}
	return n, closeErr
}

func extractDestPath(entryName, destDir string, flatten bool) string {
	entryName = normalizeArchiveEntryPath(entryName)
	if flatten {
		return filepath.Join(destDir, filepath.Base(entryName))
	}
	return filepath.Join(destDir, filepath.FromSlash(entryName))
}

func matchesEntriesForExtract(innerPath string, entries []string) bool {
	cleanInner := normalizePath(innerPath)
	isDirHeader := strings.HasSuffix(strings.ReplaceAll(innerPath, "\\", "/"), "/")
	for _, entry := range entries {
		entry = normalizePath(entry)
		if entry == "" {
			return true
		}
		if cleanInner == entry {
			if isDirHeader {
				return false
			}
			return true
		}
		if entry == "" || cleanInner == entry || strings.HasPrefix(cleanInner, entry+"/") {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}

func rebaseExtractPath(entryName, stripPrefix string) (string, bool) {
	entry := normalizePath(entryName)
	if entry == "" {
		return "", false
	}
	prefix := normalizePath(stripPrefix)
	if prefix == "" {
		return entry, true
	}
	if entry == prefix {
		return "", false
	}
	prefixWithSep := prefix + "/"
	if strings.HasPrefix(entry, prefixWithSep) {
		rel := strings.TrimPrefix(entry, prefixWithSep)
		if rel == "" {
			return "", false
		}
		return rel, true
	}
	return entry, true
}
`````

`````go
package archive

import (
	"archive/zip"
	"context"
`````
