`````go
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"testing"

	contracts "wails-app/internal/contracts"
	"wails-app/internal/pathref"
	vfsarchive "wails-app/vfs/archive"
	"wails-app/vfs/archive/cache"
)

// makeTestZip creates a zip file with a single entry returning the native path.
func makeTestZip(t *testing.T, dir string, name string, entryName string, content string) string {
	t.Helper()
	zipPath := filepath.Join(dir, name)
	f, err := os.Create(zipPath)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("create zip: %v", err)
	}
	w := zip.NewWriter(f)
	fw, err := w.Create(entryName)
	if err != nil {
		f.Close()
		t.Fatalf("zip.Create entry: %v", err)
	}
	if _, err := fw.Write([]byte(content)); err != nil {
		f.Close()
		t.Fatalf("zip.Write: %v", err)
	}
	if err := w.Close(); err != nil {
		f.Close()
		t.Fatalf("zip.Close: %v", err)
	}
	f.Close()
	return zipPath
}

func newNoopOperation() Operation {
	return &noopOp{}
}

type noopOp struct{}

func (n *noopOp) ID() string                                 { return "test-op" }
func (n *noopOp) Complete()                                  {}
func (n *noopOp) SetError(error)                             {}
func (n *noopOp) SetTotal(int64, int64)                      {}
func (n *noopOp) UpdateProgress(int64, int64, string, int64) {}
func (n *noopOp) IsCancelled() bool                          { return false }

func newTestService() *Service {
	// ExtractEntries/ExtractNestedArchive don't use the cache; provide a no-op opener.
	c := cache.New(func(_ context.Context, fsPath string, nestedChain []string, password string) (vfsarchive.Archive, error) {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("cache not used in these tests")
	})
	return NewService(c, func(_ contracts.OperationType, _, _, _ string) Operation {
		return newNoopOperation()
	})
}

// TestExtractEntriesAcceptsPublicFsPath verifies that CopyEntries correctly
// converts a filesystem:// scheme path to a native OS path before accessing
// the archive on disk.
func TestExtractEntriesAcceptsPublicFsPath(t *testing.T) {
	tmp := t.TempDir()
	const entryName = "hello.txt"
	const content = "hello from archive"
	nativeZip := makeTestZip(t, tmp, "test.zip", entryName, content)

	// Build a public filesystem:// path as the frontend would send
	publicZipPath := pathref.FromNativePath(nativeZip)

	destDir := filepath.Join(tmp, "output")
	publicDestDir := pathref.FromNativePath(destDir)

	svc := newTestService()
	req := contracts.ArchiveEntriesRequest{
		FsPath:         publicZipPath,
		NestedChain:    nil,
		Entries:        []string{entryName},
		StripPrefix:    "",
		DestinationDir: publicDestDir,
	}

	succeeded, failed, errs, fatalErr := svc.ExtractEntries(req, newNoopOperation())
	if fatalErr != nil {
		t.Fatalf("ExtractEntries fatal error: %v", fatalErr)
	}
	if len(errs) > 0 {
		t.Fatalf("ExtractEntries errors: %v", errs)
	}
	if failed != 0 || succeeded != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected result: succeeded=%d failed=%d", succeeded, failed)
	}

	extractedPath := filepath.Join(destDir, entryName)
	data, err := os.ReadFile(extractedPath)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("read extracted file: %v", err)
	}
	if string(data) != content {
		t.Fatalf("content mismatch: want %q got %q", content, string(data))
	}
}

// TestCopyEntriesAcceptsPublicFsPath verifies the full CopyEntries path with
// public filesystem:// paths, matching what the frontend sends to ArchiveCopyEntries.
func TestCopyEntriesAcceptsPublicFsPath(t *testing.T) {
	tmp := t.TempDir()
	const entryName = "doc/readme.txt"
	const content = "copy entries test"
	nativeZip := makeTestZip(t, tmp, "archive.zip", entryName, content)

	publicZipPath := pathref.FromNativePath(nativeZip)
	destDir := filepath.Join(tmp, "dest")
	publicDestDir := pathref.FromNativePath(destDir)

	svc := newTestService()
	req := contracts.ArchiveEntriesRequest{
		FsPath:         publicZipPath,
		Entries:        []string{entryName},
		DestinationDir: publicDestDir,
	}

	result, err := svc.CopyEntries(req)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("CopyEntries error: %v", err)
	}
	if result.Failed != 0 || result.Succeeded != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected result: %+v", result)
	}

	data, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(destDir, filepath.FromSlash(entryName)))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("read extracted file: %v", err)
	}
	if string(data) != content {
		t.Fatalf("content mismatch: want %q got %q", content, string(data))
	}
}

// TestExtractNestedArchiveAcceptsPublicFsPath verifies that ExtractNestedArchive
// converts the filesystem:// path before opening the outer archive.
func TestExtractNestedArchiveAcceptsPublicFsPath(t *testing.T) {
	tmp := t.TempDir()
	const innerEntry = "inner.txt"
	const content = "nested content"

	// Create inner zip (bytes)
	innerZipPath := makeTestZip(t, tmp, "inner.zip", innerEntry, content)
	innerZipBytes, err := os.ReadFile(innerZipPath)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("read inner zip: %v", err)
	}

	// Create outer zip containing inner.zip
	outerZipPath := filepath.Join(tmp, "outer.zip")
	f, err := os.Create(outerZipPath)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("create outer zip: %v", err)
	}
	w := zip.NewWriter(f)
	fw, err := w.Create("inner.zip")
	if err != nil {
		f.Close()
		t.Fatalf("create inner.zip in outer: %v", err)
	}
	if _, err := fw.Write(innerZipBytes); err != nil {
		f.Close()
		t.Fatalf("write inner.zip data: %v", err)
	}
	w.Close()
	f.Close()

	publicOuterPath := pathref.FromNativePath(outerZipPath)

	svc := newTestService()
	data, err := svc.ExtractNestedArchive(publicOuterPath, []string{"inner.zip"})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("ExtractNestedArchive error: %v", err)
	}
	if len(data) == 0 {
		t.Fatalf("ExtractNestedArchive returned empty data")
	}
	// Verify the returned bytes are a valid zip containing innerEntry
	r, err := zip.NewReader(readerAt(data), int64(len(data)))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("parse returned data as zip: %v", err)
	}
	if len(r.File) == 0 || r.File[0].Name != innerEntry {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected inner zip contents: %v", r.File)
	}
}

// readerAt wraps a byte slice to implement io.ReaderAt.
type byteReaderAt []byte

func readerAt(b []byte) byteReaderAt { return byteReaderAt(b) }

func (b byteReaderAt) ReadAt(p []byte, off int64) (int, error) {
	if off >= int64(len(b)) {
		return 0, nil
	}
	n := copy(p, b[off:])
	return n, nil
}
`````

`````go
package archive

import (
	"archive/tar"
	"archive/zip"
	"bytes"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"

	contracts "wails-app/internal/contracts"

	"github.com/mholt/archiver/v3"
)

var errCancelled = errors.New("cancelled")

func (s *Service) extractZipSync(fsPath string, entries []string, stripPrefix string, destDir string, flatten bool, op Operation) (succeeded, failed int, errs []contracts.BatchItemError, fatalErr error) {
	r, err := zip.OpenReader(fsPath)
	if err != nil {
		return 0, 0, nil, err
	}
	defer r.Close()
	var matches []*zip.File
	for _, f := range r.File {
		if matchesEntriesForExtract(normalizeArchiveEntryPath(f.Name), entries) {
			matches = append(matches, f)
		}
	}
	op.SetTotal(int64(len(matches)), 0)
	var processed int64
	for _, f := range matches {
		if op.IsCancelled() {
			errs = append(errs, contracts.BatchItemError{Source: f.Name, Error: errCancelled.Error()})
			failed++
			continue
		}
		if f.FileInfo().IsDir() {
			continue
		}
		relPath, ok := rebaseExtractPath(f.Name, stripPrefix)
		if !ok {
			continue
		}
		destPath := extractDestPath(relPath, destDir, flatten)
		if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(destPath), 0755); err != nil {
			errs = append(errs, contracts.BatchItemError{Source: f.Name, Error: err.Error()})
			failed++
			continue
		}
		rc, err := f.Open()
		if err != nil {
			errs = append(errs, contracts.BatchItemError{Source: f.Name, Error: err.Error()})
			failed++
			continue
		}
		n, writeErr := extractWriteFile(destPath, rc)
		rc.Close()
		if writeErr != nil {
			errs = append(errs, contracts.BatchItemError{Source: f.Name, Error: writeErr.Error()})
			failed++
			continue
		}
		succeeded++
		processed++
		op.UpdateProgress(processed, n, f.Name, n)
	}
	return
}

func (s *Service) extractTarSync(fsPath string, entries []string, stripPrefix string, destDir string, flatten bool, op Operation) (succeeded, failed int, errs []contracts.BatchItemError, fatalErr error) {
	lower := strings.ToLower(fsPath)
	if strings.HasSuffix(lower, ".tar.xz") {
		return s.extractTarXzViaArchiver(fsPath, entries, stripPrefix, destDir, flatten, op)
	}
	src, err := os.Open(fsPath)
	if err != nil {
		return 0, 0, nil, err
	}
	defer src.Close()
	tr, closeExtra, err := wrapTarReader(src, fsPath)
	if err != nil {
		return 0, 0, nil, err
	}
	if closeExtra != nil {
		defer closeExtra()
	}
	op.SetTotal(0, 0)
	var processed int64
	for {
		if op.IsCancelled() {
			break
		}
		hdr, err := tr.Next()
		if err == io.EOF {
			break
		}
		if err != nil {
			return succeeded, failed, errs, err
		}
		if hdr.FileInfo().IsDir() || !matchesEntriesForExtract(normalizeArchiveEntryPath(hdr.Name), entries) {
			continue
		}
		relPath, ok := rebaseExtractPath(hdr.Name, stripPrefix)
		if !ok {
			continue
		}
		destPath := extractDestPath(relPath, destDir, flatten)
		if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(destPath), 0755); err != nil {
			errs = append(errs, contracts.BatchItemError{Source: hdr.Name, Error: err.Error()})
			failed++
			continue
		}
		n, writeErr := extractWriteFile(destPath, tr)
		if writeErr != nil {
			errs = append(errs, contracts.BatchItemError{Source: hdr.Name, Error: writeErr.Error()})
			failed++
			continue
		}
		succeeded++
		processed++
		op.UpdateProgress(processed, n, hdr.Name, n)
	}
	return
}

func (s *Service) extractTarXzViaArchiver(fsPath string, entries []string, stripPrefix, destDir string, flatten bool, op Operation) (succeeded, failed int, errs []contracts.BatchItemError, fatalErr error) {
	op.SetTotal(0, 0)
	var processed int64
	walkErr := archiver.Walk(fsPath, func(f archiver.File) error {
		if op.IsCancelled() {
			return errCancelled
		}
		hdr, ok := f.Header.(*tar.Header)
		if !ok || f.IsDir() {
			return nil
		}
		if !matchesEntriesForExtract(normalizeArchiveEntryPath(hdr.Name), entries) {
			return nil
		}
		relPath, ok := rebaseExtractPath(hdr.Name, stripPrefix)
		if !ok {
			return nil
		}
		destPath := extractDestPath(relPath, destDir, flatten)
		if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(destPath), 0755); err != nil {
			errs = append(errs, contracts.BatchItemError{Source: hdr.Name, Error: err.Error()})
			failed++
			return nil
		}
		n, writeErr := extractWriteFile(destPath, f)
		if writeErr != nil {
			errs = append(errs, contracts.BatchItemError{Source: hdr.Name, Error: writeErr.Error()})
			failed++
			return nil
		}
		succeeded++
		processed++
		op.UpdateProgress(processed, n, hdr.Name, n)
		return nil
	})
	if walkErr != nil && !errors.Is(walkErr, errCancelled) {
		fatalErr = walkErr
	}
	return
}

func (s *Service) extractArchiveReaderSync(fsPath string, entries []string, stripPrefix, destDir string, flatten bool, op Operation) (succeeded, failed int, errs []contracts.BatchItemError, fatalErr error) {
	f, err := os.Open(fsPath)
	if err != nil {
		return 0, 0, nil, err
	}
	defer f.Close()
	fi, err := f.Stat()
	if err != nil {
		return 0, 0, nil, err
	}
	aIface, err := archiver.ByExtension(fsPath)
	if err != nil {
		return 0, 0, nil, fmt.Errorf("extractArchiveReaderSync: %w", err)
	}
	reader, ok := aIface.(archiver.Reader)
	if !ok {
		return 0, 0, nil, fmt.Errorf("extractArchiveReaderSync: format %q is not readable", fsPath)
	}
	if err := reader.Open(f, fi.Size()); err != nil {
		return 0, 0, nil, err
	}
	defer reader.Close()
	op.SetTotal(0, 0)
	var processed int64
	for {
		if op.IsCancelled() {
			break
		}
		entry, err := reader.Read()
		if err == io.EOF {
			break
		}
		if err != nil {
			return succeeded, failed, errs, err
		}
		entryName := archiveEntryPath(entry)
		if entry.IsDir() || !matchesEntriesForExtract(normalizeArchiveEntryPath(entryName), entries) {
			entry.Close()
			continue
		}
		relPath, ok := rebaseExtractPath(entryName, stripPrefix)
		if !ok {
			entry.Close()
			continue
		}
		destPath := extractDestPath(relPath, destDir, flatten)
		if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(destPath), 0755); err != nil {
			errs = append(errs, contracts.BatchItemError{Source: entryName, Error: err.Error()})
			failed++
			entry.Close()
			continue
		}
		n, writeErr := extractWriteFile(destPath, entry)
		entry.Close()
		if writeErr != nil {
			errs = append(errs, contracts.BatchItemError{Source: entryName, Error: writeErr.Error()})
			failed++
			continue
		}
		succeeded++
		processed++
		op.UpdateProgress(processed, n, entryName, n)
	}
	return
}

func (s *Service) extractEntriesFromBytes(data []byte, archiveName string, entries []string, stripPrefix string, destDir string, flatten bool, op Operation) (succeeded, failed int, errs []contracts.BatchItemError, fatalErr error) {
	if !isZipMagic(data) && needsArchiveReader(archiveName) {
		reader, err := openArchiveReader(archiveName, data)
		if err != nil {
			return 0, 0, nil, err
		}
		defer reader.Close()
		op.SetTotal(0, 0)
		var processed int64
		for {
			if op.IsCancelled() {
				break
			}
			f, err := reader.Read()
			if err == io.EOF {
				break
			}
			if err != nil {
				return succeeded, failed, errs, err
			}
			entryName := archiveEntryPath(f)
			if f.IsDir() || !matchesEntriesForExtract(normalizeArchiveEntryPath(entryName), entries) {
				f.Close()
				continue
			}
			relPath, ok := rebaseExtractPath(entryName, stripPrefix)
			if !ok {
				f.Close()
				continue
			}
			destPath := extractDestPath(relPath, destDir, flatten)
			if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(destPath), 0755); err != nil {
				errs = append(errs, contracts.BatchItemError{Source: entryName, Error: err.Error()})
				failed++
				f.Close()
				continue
			}
			n, writeErr := extractWriteFile(destPath, f)
			f.Close()
			if writeErr != nil {
				errs = append(errs, contracts.BatchItemError{Source: entryName, Error: writeErr.Error()})
				failed++
				continue
			}
			succeeded++
			processed++
			op.UpdateProgress(processed, n, entryName, n)
		}
		return
	}
	if isZipMagic(data) {
		r, err := zip.NewReader(bytes.NewReader(data), int64(len(data)))
		if err != nil {
			return 0, 0, nil, err
		}
		var matches []*zip.File
		for _, f := range r.File {
			if matchesEntriesForExtract(normalizeArchiveEntryPath(f.Name), entries) {
				matches = append(matches, f)
			}
		}
		op.SetTotal(int64(len(matches)), 0)
		var processed int64
		for _, f := range matches {
			if op.IsCancelled() {
				errs = append(errs, contracts.BatchItemError{Source: f.Name, Error: errCancelled.Error()})
				failed++
				continue
			}
			if f.FileInfo().IsDir() {
				continue
			}
			relPath, ok := rebaseExtractPath(f.Name, stripPrefix)
			if !ok {
				continue
			}
			destPath := extractDestPath(relPath, destDir, flatten)
			if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(destPath), 0755); err != nil {
				errs = append(errs, contracts.BatchItemError{Source: f.Name, Error: err.Error()})
				failed++
				continue
			}
			rc, err := f.Open()
			if err != nil {
				errs = append(errs, contracts.BatchItemError{Source: f.Name, Error: err.Error()})
				failed++
				continue
			}
			n, writeErr := extractWriteFile(destPath, rc)
			rc.Close()
			if writeErr != nil {
				errs = append(errs, contracts.BatchItemError{Source: f.Name, Error: writeErr.Error()})
				failed++
				continue
			}
			succeeded++
			processed++
			op.UpdateProgress(processed, n, f.Name, n)
		}
		return
	}
	tr := tar.NewReader(bytes.NewReader(data))
	op.SetTotal(0, 0)
	var processed int64
	for {
		if op.IsCancelled() {
			break
		}
		hdr, err := tr.Next()
		if err == io.EOF {
			break
		}
		if err != nil {
			return succeeded, failed, errs, err
		}
		if hdr.FileInfo().IsDir() || !matchesEntriesForExtract(normalizeArchiveEntryPath(hdr.Name), entries) {
			continue

		relPath, ok := rebaseExtractPath(hdr.Name, stripPrefix)

		}

		if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(destPath), 0755); err != nil {
			errs = append(errs, contracts.BatchItemError{Source: hdr.Name, Error: err.Error()})
			failed++

		n, writeErr := extractWriteFile(destPath, tr)

			failed++
`````

`````go
package archive

import (
	"testing"
)

func TestIsZipMagic(t *testing.T) {
	if IsZipMagic(nil) {
		t.Fatal("expected false for nil")
	}
	if IsZipMagic([]byte{0x50, 0x4b}) {
		t.Fatal("expected false for too-short data")
	}
	// Valid ZIP local file header signature
	if !IsZipMagic([]byte{0x50, 0x4b, 0x03, 0x04}) {
		t.Fatal("expected true for valid ZIP magic")
	}
	// Empty archive signature
	if !IsZipMagic([]byte{0x50, 0x4b, 0x05, 0x06}) {
		t.Fatal("expected true for empty ZIP magic")
	}
	if IsZipMagic([]byte{0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00}) {
		t.Fatal("expected false for non-ZIP data")
	}
}

func TestIsRarArchiveName(t *testing.T) {
	if IsRarArchiveName("") {
		t.Fatal("expected false for empty")
	}
	if !IsRarArchiveName("file.rar") {
		t.Fatal("expected true for .rar")
	}
	if !IsRarArchiveName("FILE.RAR") {
		t.Fatal("expected true for .RAR")
	}
	if IsRarArchiveName("file.zip") {
		t.Fatal("expected false for .zip")
	}
}

func TestIsZipArchiveName(t *testing.T) {
	if isZipArchiveName("") {
		t.Fatal("expected false for empty")
	}
	if !isZipArchiveName("archive.zip") {
		t.Fatal("expected true for .zip")
	}
	if isZipArchiveName("archive.rar") {
		t.Fatal("expected false for .rar")
	}
}

func TestUsesStdlibArchiveHandling(t *testing.T) {
	tests := []struct {
		name string
		want bool
	}{
		{"archive.tar", true},
		{"archive.tar.gz", true},
		{"archive.tgz", true},
		{"archive.tar.bz2", true},
		{"archive.tar.xz", true},
		{"file.gz", true},
		{"file.bz2", true},
		{"file.xz", true},
		{"archive.zip", true},
		{"archive.rar", false},
		{"archive.7z", false},
	}
	for _, tc := range tests {
		got := usesStdlibArchiveHandling(tc.name)
		if got != tc.want {
			t.Fatalf("usesStdlibArchiveHandling(%q) = %v, want %v", tc.name, got, tc.want)
		}
	}
}

func TestNeedsArchiveReader(t *testing.T) {
	if needsArchiveReader("") {
		t.Fatal("expected false for empty")
	}
	if !needsArchiveReader("file.rar") {
		t.Fatal("expected true for .rar (needs external reader)")
	}
	if needsArchiveReader("file.tar") {
		t.Fatal("expected false for .tar (uses stdlib)")
	}
}

func TestNormalizeArchiveEntryPath(t *testing.T) {
	tests := []struct {
		input string
		want  string
	}{
		{"folder/file.txt", "folder/file.txt"},
		{"\\folder\\file.txt", "folder/file.txt"},
		{"/folder/file.txt", "folder/file.txt"},
		{"/", ""},
	}
	for _, tc := range tests {
		got := normalizeArchiveEntryPath(tc.input)
		if got != tc.want {
			t.Fatalf("normalizeArchiveEntryPath(%q) = %q, want %q", tc.input, got, tc.want)
		}
	}
}

func TestMatchesEntries(t *testing.T) {
	entries := []string{"docs", "src/main.go"}
	if !matchesEntries("docs/readme.md", entries) {
		t.Fatal("expected match for child of docs")
	}
	if !matchesEntries("docs", entries) {
		t.Fatal("expected exact match")
	}
	if matchesEntries("other/file.txt", entries) {
		t.Fatal("expected no match")
	}
	if !matchesEntries("src/main.go", entries) {
		t.Fatal("expected exact match for nested path")
	}
	if matchesEntries("src", entries) {
		t.Fatal("expected no match for parent prefix")
	}
}

	tests := []struct {

		want string
	}{
		{"archive.tar.gz", ".tar.gz"},
		{"archive.tar.bz2", ".tar.bz2"},
		{"archive.tar.xz", ".tar.xz"},
		{"archive.tgz", ".tgz"},
		{"archive.tbz2", ".tbz2"},
		{"archive.zip", ".zip"},
		{"archive.rar", ".rar"},
		{"archive.7z", ".7z"},
		{"noext", ""},

		if got != tc.want {
			t.Fatalf("detectArchiveExt(%q) = %q, want %q", tc.name, got, tc.want)
`````

## File: manager/internal/archive/helpers.go
`````go
package archive

import (
	"archive/tar"
	"archive/zip"
	"bytes"
	"fmt"
	"strings"

	"github.com/mholt/archiver/v3"
)

var archiveStdlibSuffixes = []string{".tar", ".tar.gz", ".tgz", ".tar.bz2", ".tar.xz", ".gz", ".bz2", ".xz", ".zip"}

func isZipMagic(data []byte) bool {
	return len(data) >= 4 &&
		data[0] == 'P' && data[1] == 'K' &&
		((data[2] == 0x03 && data[3] == 0x04) ||
			(data[2] == 0x05 && data[3] == 0x06))
}

func IsZipMagic(data []byte) bool {
	return isZipMagic(data)
}

func needsArchiveReader(name string) bool {
	if name == "" {
		return false
	}
	return !usesStdlibArchiveHandling(name)
}

func NeedsArchiveReader(name string) bool {
	return needsArchiveReader(name)
}

func isRarArchiveName(name string) bool {
	if name == "" {
		return false
	}
	return strings.HasSuffix(strings.ToLower(name), ".rar")
}

func IsRarArchiveName(name string) bool {
	return isRarArchiveName(name)
}

func isZipArchiveName(name string) bool {
	if name == "" {
		return false
	}
	return strings.HasSuffix(strings.ToLower(name), ".zip")
}

func usesStdlibArchiveHandling(name string) bool {
	lower := strings.ToLower(name)
	for _, sfx := range archiveStdlibSuffixes {
		if strings.HasSuffix(lower, sfx) {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}

func openArchiveReader(archiveName string, data []byte) (archiver.Reader, error) {
	if archiveName == "" {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("archive name required to read from bytes")
	}
	aIface, err := archiver.ByExtension(archiveName)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	reader, ok := aIface.(archiver.Reader)
	if !ok {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("archive format %q cannot be read from bytes", archiveName)
	}
	if err := reader.Open(bytes.NewReader(data), int64(len(data))); err != nil {
		reader.Close()
		return nil, err
	}
	return reader, nil
}

func OpenArchiveReader(archiveName string, data []byte) (archiver.Reader, error) {
	return openArchiveReader(archiveName, data)
}

func ArchiveEntryPath(f archiver.File) string {
	return archiveEntryPath(f)
}

func archiveEntryPath(f archiver.File) string {
	switch hdr := f.Header.(type) {
	case *zip.FileHeader:
		return strings.TrimSuffix(hdr.Name, "/")
	case *tar.Header:
		return strings.TrimSuffix(hdr.Name, "/")
	}
	return f.Name()
}

func normalizeArchiveEntryPath(path string) string {
	path = strings.ReplaceAll(path, "\\", "/")
	return strings.TrimPrefix(path, "/")
}

func matchesEntries(innerPath string, entries []string) bool {
	cleanInner := normalizePath(innerPath)
	for _, entry := range entries {
		entry = normalizePath(entry)
		if entry == "" || cleanInner == entry || strings.HasPrefix(cleanInner, entry+"/") {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}
`````

`````go
package archive

import (
	"archive/tar"
	"archive/zip"
	"bytes"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"os"

	"github.com/mholt/archiver/v3"

	"wails-app/internal/pathref"
)

func (s *Service) ExtractNestedArchive(fsPath string, nestedChain []string) ([]byte, error) {
	fsPath = pathref.ToNativePath(fsPath)
	if len(nestedChain) == 0 {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("empty nested chain")
	}

	current, err := s.extractFromFile(fsPath, nestedChain[0])
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("extracting %q from %q: %w", nestedChain[0], fsPath, err)
	}

	for index := 1; index < len(nestedChain); index++ {
		next, err := s.extractFromBytes(current, nestedChain[index], nestedChain[index])
		if err != nil {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("extracting %q (chain depth %d): %w", nestedChain[index], index, err)
		}
		current = next
	}
	return current, nil
}

func (s *Service) extractFromFile(fsPath, entryPath string) ([]byte, error) {
	want := normalizePath(entryPath)

	if isZipArchiveName(fsPath) {
		return s.extractFromFileZip(fsPath, want)
	}
	if needsArchiveReader(fsPath) {
		return s.extractFromFileArchiveReader(fsPath, want)
	}
	return s.extractFromFileViaArchiver(fsPath, want)
}

func (s *Service) extractFromFileZip(fsPath, want string) ([]byte, error) {
	r, err := zip.OpenReader(fsPath)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer r.Close()

	for _, f := range r.File {
		if normalizePath(f.Name) == want {
			rc, err := f.Open()
			if err != nil {
				return nil, err
			}
			defer rc.Close()
			return io.ReadAll(rc)
		}
	}
	return nil, fmt.Errorf("entry %q not found in %q", want, fsPath)
}

func (s *Service) extractFromFileViaArchiver(fsPath, want string) ([]byte, error) {
	var buf []byte
	err := archiver.Walk(fsPath, func(f archiver.File) error {
		if normalizePath(archiveEntryPath(f)) == want {
			var readErr error
			buf, readErr = io.ReadAll(f)
			if readErr != nil {
				return readErr
			}
			return archiver.ErrStopWalk
		}
		return nil
	})
	if err != nil && err != archiver.ErrStopWalk {
		return nil, err
	}
	if buf == nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("entry %q not found in %q", want, fsPath)
	}
	return buf, nil
}

func (s *Service) extractFromFileArchiveReader(fsPath, want string) ([]byte, error) {
	f, err := os.Open(fsPath)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer f.Close()

	fi, err := f.Stat()
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	aIface, err := archiver.ByExtension(fsPath)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("extractFromFileArchiveReader: %w", err)
	}
	reader, ok := aIface.(archiver.Reader)
	if !ok {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("extractFromFileArchiveReader: format %q is not readable", fsPath)
	}
	if err := reader.Open(f, fi.Size()); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer reader.Close()

	for {
		entry, err := reader.Read()
		if err == io.EOF {
			break
		}
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		if normalizePath(archiveEntryPath(entry)) == want {
			buf, readErr := io.ReadAll(entry)
			entry.Close()
			if readErr != nil {
				return nil, readErr
			}
			return buf, nil
		}
		entry.Close()
	}
	return nil, fmt.Errorf("entry %q not found in %q", want, fsPath)
}

func (s *Service) extractFromBytes(data []byte, entryPath string, archiveName string) ([]byte, error) {
	want := normalizePath(entryPath)

	if isZipMagic(data) {
		return s.extractFromZipBytes(data, want)
	}
	if archiveName != "" && needsArchiveReader(archiveName) {
		return s.extractFromArchiveReader(data, archiveName, want)
	}
	return s.extractFromTarBytes(data, want)
}

func (s *Service) extractFromZipBytes(data []byte, want string) ([]byte, error) {
	r, err := zip.NewReader(bytes.NewReader(data), int64(len(data)))
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	for _, f := range r.File {
		if normalizePath(f.Name) == want {
			rc, err := f.Open()
			if err != nil {
				return nil, err
			}
			defer rc.Close()
			return io.ReadAll(rc)
		}
	}
	return nil, fmt.Errorf("entry %q not found in ZIP", want)
}

func (s *Service) extractFromTarBytes(data []byte, want string) ([]byte, error) {
	tr := tar.NewReader(bytes.NewReader(data))
	for {
		h, err := tr.Next()
		if err == io.EOF {
			break
		}
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		if normalizePath(h.Name) == want {
			return io.ReadAll(tr)
		}
	}
	return nil, fmt.Errorf("entry %q not found in archive", want)
}

func (s *Service) extractFromArchiveReader(data []byte, archiveName, want string) ([]byte, error) {
	reader, err := openArchiveReader(archiveName, data)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer reader.Close()

	for {
		f, err := reader.Read()
		if err == io.EOF {
			break
		}
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		if normalizePath(archiveEntryPath(f)) == want {
			buf, readErr := io.ReadAll(f)
			f.Close()
			if readErr != nil {
				return nil, readErr
			}
			return buf, nil
		}
		if err := f.Close(); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
	}

	return nil, fmt.Errorf("entry %q not found in %s", want, archiveName)
}
`````

## File: manager/internal/archive/resolve.go
`````go
package archive

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"

	vfsarchive "wails-app/vfs/archive"
)

// ResolveChain opens a possibly nested archive chain and returns the innermost
// archive ready for browsing.
func ResolveChain(ctx context.Context, fsPath string, nestedChain []string, password string) (vfsarchive.Archive, error) {
	handler, ok := vfsarchive.ForPath(fsPath)
	if !ok {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("no archive handler for %q", fsPath)
	}

	if len(nestedChain) == 0 {
		return handler.Open(ctx, fsPath, vfsarchive.OpenOptions{ReadOnly: true, Password: password})
	}

	outer, err := handler.Open(ctx, fsPath, vfsarchive.OpenOptions{ReadOnly: true, Password: password})
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("open %q: %w", fsPath, err)
	}

	data, err := readArchiveEntryBytes(ctx, outer, nestedChain[0])
	outer.Close()
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("extract %q from %q: %w", nestedChain[0], fsPath, err)
	}

	for index := 1; index < len(nestedChain); index++ {
		currentName := nestedChain[index-1]
		mid, err := openArchiveFromMemory(ctx, currentName, data, password)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("open level %d %q from bytes: %w", index, currentName, err)
		}
		next, err := readArchiveEntryBytes(ctx, mid, nestedChain[index])
		mid.Close()
		if err != nil {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("extract %q from level %d (%q): %w", nestedChain[index], index, currentName, err)
		}
		data = next
	}

	return openArchiveFromMemory(ctx, nestedChain[len(nestedChain)-1], data, password)
}

func openArchiveFromMemory(ctx context.Context, name string, data []byte, password string) (vfsarchive.Archive, error) {
	handler, ok := vfsarchive.ForPath(name)
	if !ok {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("no archive handler for %q", name)
	}

	ext := detectArchiveExt(name)
	if ext == "" {
		ext = ".tmp"
	}
	tempFile, err := os.CreateTemp("", "vfs-nested-*"+ext)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("temp file for %q: %w", name, err)
	}
	tempPath := tempFile.Name()

	if _, err := tempFile.Write(data); err != nil {
		tempFile.Close()
		os.Remove(tempPath)
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("write temp %q: %w", name, err)
	}
	if err := tempFile.Close(); err != nil {
		os.Remove(tempPath)
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("close temp %q: %w", name, err)
	}

	arch, err := handler.Open(ctx, tempPath, vfsarchive.OpenOptions{ReadOnly: true, Password: password})
	if err != nil {
		os.Remove(tempPath)
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("open %q from temp: %w", name, err)
	}
	return &tempArchive{Archive: arch, tmp: tempPath}, nil
}

func readArchiveEntryBytes(ctx context.Context, arch vfsarchive.Archive, entryPath string) ([]byte, error) {
	file, err := arch.Open(ctx, normalizePath(entryPath))
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("open entry %q: %w", entryPath, err)
	}
	defer file.Close()
	return io.ReadAll(file)
}

type tempArchive struct {
	vfsarchive.Archive
	tmp string
}

func (t *tempArchive) Close() error {
	err := t.Archive.Close()
	os.Remove(t.tmp)
	return err
}

func detectArchiveExt(name string) string {
	lower := strings.ToLower(name)
	switch {
	case strings.HasSuffix(lower, ".tar.gz"):
		return ".tar.gz"
	case strings.HasSuffix(lower, ".tar.bz2"):
		return ".tar.bz2"
	case strings.HasSuffix(lower, ".tar.xz"):
		return ".tar.xz"
	case strings.HasSuffix(lower, ".tgz"):
		return ".tgz"
	case strings.HasSuffix(lower, ".tbz2"):
		return ".tbz2"
	default:
		return filepath.Ext(name)
	}
}
`````

## File: manager/internal/archive/rewrite.go
`````go
package archive

import (
	"archive/tar"
	"archive/zip"
	"bytes"
	"compress/bzip2"
	"compress/gzip"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"

	"github.com/mholt/archiver/v3"
)

func rewriteZip(fsPath string, entries []string, op Operation) (removed, kept int, err error) {
	r, err := zip.OpenReader(fsPath)
	if err != nil {
		return 0, 0, err
	}
	defer r.Close()

	op.SetTotal(int64(len(r.File)), 0)

	tmp, err := os.CreateTemp(filepath.Dir(fsPath), ".archive-rewrite-*.zip")
	if err != nil {
		return 0, 0, err
	}
	tmpPath := tmp.Name()
	defer func() {
		tmp.Close()
		if err != nil {
			os.Remove(tmpPath)
		}
	}()

	w := zip.NewWriter(tmp)
	defer w.Close()

	var processed int64
	for _, f := range r.File {
		if op.IsCancelled() {
			return removed, kept, fmt.Errorf("cancelled")
		}

		innerPath := normalizeArchiveEntryPath(f.Name)
		if matchesEntries(innerPath, entries) {
			removed++
			processed++
			op.UpdateProgress(processed, 0, f.Name, 0)
			continue
		}

		rc, openErr := f.Open()
		if openErr != nil {
			return removed, kept, fmt.Errorf("open %q: %w", f.Name, openErr)
		}

		hdr, _ := zip.FileInfoHeader(f.FileInfo())
		hdr.Name = f.Name
		hdr.Method = f.Method
		fw, writeErr := w.CreateHeader(hdr)
		if writeErr != nil {
			rc.Close()
			return removed, kept, writeErr
		}

		n, copyErr := io.Copy(fw, rc)
		rc.Close()
		if copyErr != nil {
			return removed, kept, fmt.Errorf("copy %q: %w", f.Name, copyErr)
		}

		kept++
		processed++
		op.UpdateProgress(processed, n, f.Name, n)
	}

	if err = w.Close(); err != nil {
		return removed, kept, err
	}
	tmp.Close()
	return removed, kept, os.Rename(tmpPath, fsPath)
}

func rewriteTar(fsPath string, entries []string, compression string, op Operation) (removed, kept int, err error) {
	srcFile, err := os.Open(fsPath)
	if err != nil {
		return 0, 0, err
	}
	defer srcFile.Close()

	var tarReader *tar.Reader
	switch compression {
	case "gz":
		gr, gzErr := gzip.NewReader(srcFile)
		if gzErr != nil {
			return 0, 0, gzErr
		}
		defer gr.Close()
		tarReader = tar.NewReader(gr)
	case "bz2":
		tarReader = tar.NewReader(bzip2.NewReader(srcFile))
	default:
		tarReader = tar.NewReader(srcFile)
	}

	if compression == "xz" {
		return rewriteTarXzViaArchiver(fsPath, entries, op)
	}

	tmp, err := os.CreateTemp(filepath.Dir(fsPath), ".archive-rewrite-*")
	if err != nil {
		return 0, 0, err
	}
	tmpPath := tmp.Name()
	defer func() {
		tmp.Close()
		if err != nil {
			os.Remove(tmpPath)
		}
	}()

	var tarWriter *tar.Writer
	var gzWriter *gzip.Writer
	if compression == "gz" || compression == "bz2" {
		gzWriter = gzip.NewWriter(tmp)
		tarWriter = tar.NewWriter(gzWriter)
	} else {
		tarWriter = tar.NewWriter(tmp)
	}

	var processed int64
	for {
		if op.IsCancelled() {
			if gzWriter != nil {
				tarWriter.Close()
				gzWriter.Close()
			} else {
				tarWriter.Close()
			}
			return removed, kept, fmt.Errorf("cancelled")
		}

		hdr, tarErr := tarReader.Next()
		if tarErr == io.EOF {
			break
		}
		if tarErr != nil {
			return removed, kept, tarErr
		}

		innerPath := normalizeArchiveEntryPath(hdr.Name)
		if matchesEntries(innerPath, entries) {
			removed++
			processed++
			op.UpdateProgress(processed, 0, hdr.Name, 0)
			continue
		}

		if writeErr := tarWriter.WriteHeader(hdr); writeErr != nil {
			return removed, kept, writeErr
		}
		n, copyErr := io.Copy(tarWriter, tarReader)
		if copyErr != nil {
			return removed, kept, copyErr
		}
		kept++
		processed++
		op.UpdateProgress(processed, n, hdr.Name, n)
	}

	if gzWriter != nil {
		if e := tarWriter.Close(); e != nil {
			return removed, kept, e
		}
		if e := gzWriter.Close(); e != nil {
			return removed, kept, e
		}
	} else {
		if e := tarWriter.Close(); e != nil {
			return removed, kept, e
		}
	}
	tmp.Close()
	return removed, kept, os.Rename(tmpPath, fsPath)
}

func rewriteTarXzViaArchiver(fsPath string, entries []string, op Operation) (removed, kept int, err error) {
	type keptEntry struct {
		hdr  *tar.Header
		data []byte
	}
	var keptEntries []keptEntry

	walkErr := archiver.Walk(fsPath, func(f archiver.File) error {
		if op.IsCancelled() {
			return fmt.Errorf("cancelled")
		}
		hdr, ok := f.Header.(*tar.Header)
		if !ok {
			return nil
		}
		innerPath := normalizeArchiveEntryPath(hdr.Name)
		if matchesEntries(innerPath, entries) {
			removed++
			return nil
		}
		data, rerr := io.ReadAll(f)
		if rerr != nil {
			return rerr
		}
		keptEntries = append(keptEntries, keptEntry{hdr: hdr, data: data})
		kept++
		return nil
	})
	if walkErr != nil {
		return removed, kept, walkErr
	}

	tmp, err := os.CreateTemp(filepath.Dir(fsPath), ".archive-rewrite-*.tar.xz")
	if err != nil {
		return removed, kept, err
	}
	tmpPath := tmp.Name()
	defer func() {
		tmp.Close()
		if err != nil {
			os.Remove(tmpPath)
		}
	}()

	txz := archiver.NewTarXz()
	if e := txz.Create(tmp); e != nil {
		return removed, kept, fmt.Errorf("create tar.xz: %w", e)
	}

	var processed int64
	for _, ke := range keptEntries {
		if err = txz.Write(archiver.File{
			FileInfo: archiver.FileInfo{
				FileInfo:   ke.hdr.FileInfo(),
				CustomName: ke.hdr.Name,
			},
			ReadCloser: io.NopCloser(bytes.NewReader(ke.data)),
		}); err != nil {
			txz.Close()
			return removed, kept, fmt.Errorf("write %q: %w", ke.hdr.Name, err)
		}
		processed++
		op.UpdateProgress(processed, int64(len(ke.data)), ke.hdr.Name, int64(len(ke.data)))
	}

	if err = txz.Close(); err != nil {
		return removed, kept, err
	}
	tmp.Close()
	return removed, kept, os.Rename(tmpPath, fsPath)
}
`````

## File: manager/internal/archive/service.go
`````go
package archive

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"mime"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"
	"sync"
	"time"

	"wails-app/internal/contentprobe"
	contracts "wails-app/internal/contracts"
	"wails-app/internal/pathref"
	"wails-app/internal/work"
	vfslib "wails-app/vfs"
	vfsarchive "wails-app/vfs/archive"
	"wails-app/vfs/archive/cache"
)

// Service owns the archive-facing orchestration boundary while delegating
// concrete archive work to injected application closures.
type Service struct {
	archCache      *cache.Cache
	startOperation func(opType contracts.OperationType, title, source, dest string) Operation
	streamsMu      sync.RWMutex
	streamsCancel  map[string]context.CancelFunc
}

type Operation interface {
	ID() string
	Complete()
	SetError(error)
	SetTotal(totalItems, totalBytes int64)
	UpdateProgress(processedItems, processedBytes int64, currentFile string, currentFileSize int64)
	IsCancelled() bool
}

func NewService(
	archCache *cache.Cache,
	startOperation func(opType contracts.OperationType, title, source, dest string) Operation,
) *Service {
	return &Service{
		archCache:      archCache,
		startOperation: startOperation,
		streamsCancel:  make(map[string]context.CancelFunc),
	}
}

func (s *Service) Browse(fsPath string, nestedChain []string, innerPath string) (contracts.ArchiveListing, error) {
	ctx := context.Background()

	// Convert filesystem:// scheme paths to native OS paths
	nativePath := pathref.ToNativePath(fsPath)

	arch, err := s.archCache.Get(ctx, nativePath, nestedChain, "")
	if err != nil {
		return contracts.ArchiveListing{}, fmt.Errorf("vfs: open %q: %w", nativePath, err)
	}

	vfsEntries, err := arch.ReadDir(ctx, normalizePath(innerPath))
	if err != nil {
		return contracts.ArchiveListing{}, fmt.Errorf("vfs: readdir %q in %q: %w", innerPath, fsPath, err)
	}

	entries := make([]contracts.FileInfo, 0, len(vfsEntries))
	for _, entry := range vfsEntries {
		entries = append(entries, vfsEntryToFileInfo(entry, nestedChain))
	}

	return contracts.ArchiveListing{
		ArchivePath: fsPath,
		InnerPath:   innerPath,
		NestedChain: nestedChain,
		Entries:     entries,
	}, nil
}

func (s *Service) ReadFile(fsPath string, nestedChain []string, entryPath string, encoding string) (*contracts.FileContent, error) {
	entryPath = normalizePath(entryPath)

	ctx := context.Background()
	// Convert filesystem:// scheme paths to native OS paths
	nativePath := pathref.ToNativePath(fsPath)

	arch, err := s.archCache.Get(ctx, nativePath, nestedChain, "")
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("archive read: open %q: %w", nativePath, err)
	}

	f, err := arch.Open(ctx, entryPath)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("archive read: open entry %q: %w", entryPath, err)
	}
	defer f.Close()

	data, err := io.ReadAll(f)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	probe := contentprobe.ProbeBytes(data)
	if encoding == "" {
		encoding = "utf8"
		if probe.IsText && probe.Encoding != "" {
			encoding = probe.Encoding
		}
	}

	content, err := contentprobe.Decode(data, encoding)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	return &contracts.FileContent{
		Path:     entryPath,
		Content:  content,
		Encoding: encoding,
		Size:     int64(len(data)),
	}, nil
}

func (s *Service) ProbeFile(fsPath string, nestedChain []string, entryPath string) (*contracts.FileProbe, error) {
	entryPath = normalizePath(entryPath)

	ctx := context.Background()
	nativePath := pathref.ToNativePath(fsPath)

	arch, err := s.archCache.Get(ctx, nativePath, nestedChain, "")
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("archive probe: open %q: %w", nativePath, err)
	}

	f, err := arch.Open(ctx, entryPath)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("archive probe: open entry %q: %w", entryPath, err)
	}
	defer f.Close()

	_, probe, err := contentprobe.ProbeReader(f)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	return &contracts.FileProbe{
		MimeType:  probe.MimeType,
		Encoding:  probe.Encoding,
		IsText:    probe.IsText,
		IsArchive: probe.IsArchive,
	}, nil
}

func (s *Service) ReadFileStream(fsPath string, nestedChain []string, entryPath string, chunkSize int, emitEvent func(string, interface{})) (string, error) {
	entryPath = normalizePath(entryPath)

	if chunkSize <= 0 {
		chunkSize = 64 * 1024 // 64KB default chunk size
	}

	// Generate streamID
	streamID := fmt.Sprintf("archive-read-%d", time.Now().UnixNano())

	// Create cancellation context
	ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
	s.streamsMu.Lock()
	s.streamsCancel[streamID] = cancel
	s.streamsMu.Unlock()

	// Archive streaming uses the same central bounded worker scheduler.
	work.Default.Submit(ctx, work.Task{
		Key:      "archive-stream:" + streamID,
		Priority: work.PriorityInteractive,
		Kind:     "viewer",
		Run: func(ctx context.Context, reporter work.Reporter) error {
			defer func() {
				s.streamsMu.Lock()
				delete(s.streamsCancel, streamID)
				s.streamsMu.Unlock()
			}()

			// Convert filesystem:// scheme paths to native OS paths
			nativePath := pathref.ToNativePath(fsPath)

			arch, err := s.archCache.Get(ctx, nativePath, nestedChain, "")
			if err != nil {
				emitEvent("archive:read:error", map[string]interface{}{
					"streamID": streamID,
					"error":    fmt.Sprintf("archive read: open %q: %v", nativePath, err),
				})
				return err
			}

			f, err := arch.Open(ctx, entryPath)
			if err != nil {
				emitEvent("archive:read:error", map[string]interface{}{
					"streamID": streamID,
					"error":    fmt.Sprintf("archive read: open entry %q: %v", entryPath, err),
				})
				return err
			}
			defer f.Close()

			// Stream file in chunks
			bytesRead := int64(0)
			for {
				select {
				case <-ctx.Done():
					emitEvent("archive:read:cancelled", map[string]interface{}{
						"streamID": streamID,
					})
					return ctx.Err()
				default:
				}

				chunk := make([]byte, chunkSize)
				n, err := f.Read(chunk)
				if err != nil && err != io.EOF {
					emitEvent("archive:read:error", map[string]interface{}{
						"streamID": streamID,
						"error":    fmt.Sprintf("archive read: failed to read chunk: %v", err),
					})
					return err
				}

				if n > 0 {
					bytesRead += int64(n)
					emitEvent("archive:read:chunk", map[string]interface{}{
						"streamID":  streamID,
						"data":      chunk[:n],
						"bytesRead": bytesRead,
					})
				}

				if err == io.EOF {
					emitEvent("archive:read:done", map[string]interface{}{
						"streamID":   streamID,
						"totalBytes": bytesRead,
					})
					return nil
				}
			}
		},
	})

	return streamID, nil
}

func (s *Service) CancelReadStream(streamID string) {
	s.streamsMu.Lock()
	defer s.streamsMu.Unlock()

	if cancel, exists := s.streamsCancel[streamID]; exists {
		cancel()
		delete(s.streamsCancel, streamID)
	}
}

func (s *Service) CopyEntries(req contracts.ArchiveEntriesRequest) (*contracts.ArchiveEntriesResult, error) {
	req.FsPath = pathref.ToNativePath(req.FsPath)
	req.DestinationDir = pathref.ToNativePath(req.DestinationDir)
	if req.DestinationDir == "" {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("destinationDir is required")
	}

	op := s.startOperation(contracts.OpCopy, "Copy from archive", req.FsPath, req.DestinationDir)
	succeeded, failed, errs, err := s.ExtractEntries(req, op)
	if err != nil {
		op.SetError(err)
		return nil, err
	}

	op.Complete()
	return &contracts.ArchiveEntriesResult{
		OperationID: op.ID(),
		Total:       succeeded + failed,
		Succeeded:   succeeded,
		Failed:      failed,
		Errors:      errs,
	}, nil
}

func (s *Service) MoveEntries(req contracts.ArchiveEntriesRequest) (*contracts.ArchiveEntriesResult, error) {
	req.FsPath = pathref.ToNativePath(req.FsPath)
	req.DestinationDir = pathref.ToNativePath(req.DestinationDir)
	if req.DestinationDir == "" {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("destinationDir is required")
	}
	if len(req.Entries) == 0 {
		return &contracts.ArchiveEntriesResult{}, nil
	}

	op := s.startOperation(contracts.OpMove, "Move from archive", req.FsPath, req.DestinationDir)
	succeeded, failed, errs, err := s.ExtractEntries(req, op)
	if err != nil {
		op.SetError(err)
		return nil, err
	}

	result := &contracts.ArchiveEntriesResult{
		OperationID: op.ID(),
		Total:       succeeded + failed,
		Succeeded:   succeeded,
		Failed:      failed,
		Errors:      errs,
	}

	if failed > 0 {
		op.SetError(fmt.Errorf("%d file(s) failed to extract; archive not modified", failed))
		return result, nil
	}

	if len(req.NestedChain) > 0 {
		result.SourceRemoved = false
		result.Errors = append(result.Errors, contracts.BatchItemError{
			Source: req.FsPath,
			Error:  "entries copied but NOT removed: deleting from nested archives is not supported",
		})
		op.Complete()
		return result, nil
	}

	deleteReq := contracts.ArchiveEntriesRequest{FsPath: req.FsPath, Entries: req.Entries}
	delResult, delErr := s.DeleteEntries(deleteReq)
	if delErr != nil {
		result.SourceRemoved = false
		result.Errors = append(result.Errors, contracts.BatchItemError{
			Source: req.FsPath,
			Error:  "entries extracted but NOT removed from archive: " + delErr.Error(),
		})
		op.Complete()
		return result, nil
	}

	result.SourceRemoved = true
	if delResult.Failed > 0 {
		result.Errors = append(result.Errors, delResult.Errors...)
	}
	op.Complete()
	return result, nil
}

func (s *Service) ExtractEntries(req contracts.ArchiveEntriesRequest, op Operation) (succeeded, failed int, errs []contracts.BatchItemError, fatalErr error) {
	req.FsPath = pathref.ToNativePath(req.FsPath)
	req.DestinationDir = pathref.ToNativePath(req.DestinationDir)

	if err := os.MkdirAll(req.DestinationDir, 0755); err != nil {
		return 0, 0, nil, fmt.Errorf("create destination: %w", err)
	}

	if len(req.NestedChain) > 0 {
		data, err := s.ExtractNestedArchive(req.FsPath, req.NestedChain)
		if err != nil {
			return 0, 0, nil, err
		}
		return s.extractEntriesFromBytes(data, req.NestedChain[len(req.NestedChain)-1], req.Entries, req.StripPrefix, req.DestinationDir, req.FlattenPaths, op)
	}

	handler, ok := vfsarchive.ForPath(req.FsPath)
	if !ok {
		return s.extractArchiveReaderSync(req.FsPath, req.Entries, req.StripPrefix, req.DestinationDir, req.FlattenPaths, op)
	}
	switch handler.Name() {
	case "zip":
		return s.extractZipSync(req.FsPath, req.Entries, req.StripPrefix, req.DestinationDir, req.FlattenPaths, op)
	case "tar":
		return s.extractTarSync(req.FsPath, req.Entries, req.StripPrefix, req.DestinationDir, req.FlattenPaths, op)
	default:
		return s.extractArchiveReaderSync(req.FsPath, req.Entries, req.StripPrefix, req.DestinationDir, req.FlattenPaths, op)
	}
}

func (s *Service) DeleteEntries(req contracts.ArchiveEntriesRequest) (*contracts.ArchiveEntriesResult, error) {
	req.FsPath = pathref.ToNativePath(req.FsPath)
	if len(req.NestedChain) > 0 {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("deleting entries from nested archives is not supported")
	}
	if len(req.Entries) == 0 {
		return &contracts.ArchiveEntriesResult{}, nil
	}

	op := s.startOperation(contracts.OpDelete, "Delete from archive", req.FsPath, "")
	op.SetTotal(0, 0)

	removed, kept, rewriteErr := s.rewriteEntries(req.FsPath, req.Entries, op)
	if rewriteErr != nil {
		op.SetError(rewriteErr)
	}

	result := &contracts.ArchiveEntriesResult{
		OperationID:   op.ID(),
		Total:         removed + kept,
		Succeeded:     removed,
		SourceRemoved: rewriteErr == nil,
	}

	if rewriteErr != nil {
		result.Failed = 1
		result.Errors = []contracts.BatchItemError{{Source: req.FsPath, Error: rewriteErr.Error()}}
		return result, rewriteErr
	}

	op.Complete()
	return result, nil
}

func (s *Service) rewriteEntries(fsPath string, entries []string, op Operation) (removed, kept int, err error) {
	handler, ok := vfsarchive.ForPath(fsPath)
	if !ok {
		return 0, 0, fmt.Errorf("unsupported archive format: %q", fsPath)
	}
	switch handler.Name() {
	case "zip":
		return rewriteZip(fsPath, entries, op)
	case "tar":
		lower := strings.ToLower(fsPath)
		switch {
		case strings.HasSuffix(lower, ".tar.gz"), strings.HasSuffix(lower, ".tgz"):
			return rewriteTar(fsPath, entries, "gz", op)
		case strings.HasSuffix(lower, ".tar.bz2"):
			return rewriteTar(fsPath, entries, "bz2", op)
		case strings.HasSuffix(lower, ".tar.xz"):
			return rewriteTar(fsPath, entries, "xz", op)
		default:
			return rewriteTar(fsPath, entries, "", op)
		}
	default:
		return 0, 0, unsupportedRewriteFormatError(fsPath)
	}
}

func unsupportedRewriteFormatError(fsPath string) error {
	ext := strings.ToUpper(strings.TrimPrefix(filepath.Ext(strings.ToLower(fsPath)), "."))
	if ext == "" {
		ext = "UNKNOWN"
	}
	return fmt.Errorf("deleting entries from %s archives is not supported (format is read-only)", ext)
}

func normalizePath(path string) string {
	return strings.Trim(strings.ReplaceAll(path, "\\", "/"), "/")
}

func vfsEntryToFileInfo(entry vfslib.FileInfo, parentChain []string) contracts.FileInfo {
	entryType := contracts.FileTypeFile
	switch {
	case entry.IsDir():
		entryType = contracts.FileTypeDirectory
	case entry.IsArchive():
		entryType = contracts.FileTypeArchive
	case entry.IsSymlink():
		entryType = contracts.FileTypeSymlink
	}

	var nestedChain []string
	if entryType == contracts.FileTypeArchive {
		nestedChain = append(append([]string{}, parentChain...), entry.Path())
	}

	return contracts.FileInfo{
		Name:        entry.Name(),
		Path:        entry.Path(),
		Type:        entryType,
		MimeType:    mime.TypeByExtension(filepath.Ext(entry.Name())),
		Size:        entry.Size(),
		Modified:    entry.ModTime().Unix(),
		IsHidden:    entry.IsHidden(),
		IsSymlink:   entry.IsSymlink(),
		IsNested:    entryType == contracts.FileTypeArchive,
		NestedChain: nestedChain,
	}
}
`````

`````go
package batch

import (
	"fmt"
	"sync"
	"sync/atomic"

	contracts "wails-app/internal/contracts"
)

// ConflictManager coordinates paused batch operations waiting on a user
// conflict resolution from the frontend.
type ConflictManager struct {
	mu      sync.Mutex
	pending map[string]chan contracts.ConflictResolutionRequest
	counter int64
}

func NewConflictManager() *ConflictManager {
	return &ConflictManager{pending: make(map[string]chan contracts.ConflictResolutionRequest)}
}

func (m *ConflictManager) NextID(opID string) string {
	return fmt.Sprintf("%s-conflict-%d", opID, atomic.AddInt64(&m.counter, 1))
}

func (m *ConflictManager) Register(id string) <-chan contracts.ConflictResolutionRequest {
	response := make(chan contracts.ConflictResolutionRequest, 1)
	m.mu.Lock()
	m.pending[id] = response
	m.mu.Unlock()
	return response
}

func (m *ConflictManager) Resolve(id string, req contracts.ConflictResolutionRequest) bool {
	m.mu.Lock()
	response, ok := m.pending[id]
	if ok {
		delete(m.pending, id)
	}
	m.mu.Unlock()
	if !ok {
		return false
	}
	response <- req
	return true
}

func (m *ConflictManager) CancelAll() {
	m.mu.Lock()
	defer m.mu.Unlock()
	for id, response := range m.pending {
		response <- contracts.ConflictResolutionRequest{Resolution: contracts.ConflictCancel}
		delete(m.pending, id)
	}
}
`````

## File: manager/internal/batch/extract.go
`````go
package batch

import (
	"archive/tar"
	"archive/zip"
	"bytes"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"

	"github.com/mholt/archiver/v3"

	internalarchive "wails-app/internal/archive"
	contracts "wails-app/internal/contracts"
)

type ExtractCallbacks struct {
	IsCancelled      func() bool
	CheckConflict    func(srcLabel, dst string, blanket **contracts.ConflictResolution) (string, bool, error)
	StreamToFile     func(r io.Reader, dst string, size int64, label string) (int64, error)
	ArchiveEntryPath func(archiver.File) string
	Normalize        func(string) string
	IsArchive        func(string) bool
}

type ArchiveExtractor struct {
	callbacks ExtractCallbacks
}

func NewArchiveExtractor(callbacks ExtractCallbacks) *ArchiveExtractor {
	return &ArchiveExtractor{callbacks: callbacks}
}

func (e *ArchiveExtractor) ExtractOnDisk(archivePath string, req *contracts.BatchExtractRequest, destRoot string, blanket *contracts.ConflictResolution) (int64, int64, *contracts.ConflictResolution, error) {
	ctx := extractCtx{callbacks: e.callbacks, req: req, blanket: blanket, destRoot: destRoot, depth: 0}
	files, bytes, err := ctx.extractOnDisk(archivePath)
	return files, bytes, ctx.blanket, err
}

type extractCtx struct {
	callbacks ExtractCallbacks
	req       *contracts.BatchExtractRequest
	blanket   *contracts.ConflictResolution
	destRoot  string
	depth     int
}

func (ec *extractCtx) cancelled() bool {
	return ec.callbacks.IsCancelled != nil && ec.callbacks.IsCancelled()
}

func (ec *extractCtx) tooDeep() bool {
	if !ec.req.ExpandNestedArchives {
		return true
	}
	if ec.req.MaxNestDepth < 0 {
		return false
	}
	return ec.depth >= ec.req.MaxNestDepth
}

func (ec *extractCtx) extractOnDisk(archivePath string) (int64, int64, error) {
	if strings.HasSuffix(strings.ToLower(archivePath), ".zip") {
		return ec.extractZipOnDisk(archivePath)
	}
	return ec.extractTarOnDisk(archivePath)
}

func (ec *extractCtx) extractZipOnDisk(archivePath string) (int64, int64, error) {
	r, err := zip.OpenReader(archivePath)
	if err != nil {
		return 0, 0, err
	}
	defer r.Close()

	rootStrip := zipRootPrefix(r.File, ec.req.FlattenSingleRoot, ec.callbacks.Normalize)
	var totalFiles, totalBytes int64

	for _, f := range r.File {
		if ec.cancelled() {
			return totalFiles, totalBytes, fmt.Errorf("operation cancelled")
		}

		ep := ec.callbacks.Normalize(f.Name)
		if rootStrip != "" {
			if ep = strings.TrimPrefix(ep, rootStrip); ep == "" {
				continue
			}
		}
		destPath := filepath.Join(ec.destRoot, filepath.FromSlash(ep))

		if f.FileInfo().IsDir() {
			os.MkdirAll(destPath, 0755)
			continue
		}

		if ec.callbacks.IsArchive(f.Name) && !ec.tooDeep() {
			rc, err := f.Open()
			if err != nil {
				return totalFiles, totalBytes, err
			}
			data, err := io.ReadAll(rc)
			rc.Close()
			if err != nil {
				return totalFiles, totalBytes, err
			}
			child := ec.child(filepath.Join(ec.destRoot, ArchiveBaseName(f.Name)))
			nf, nb, nerr := child.extractNestedFromBytes(data, f.Name)
			ec.blanket = child.blanket
			totalFiles += nf
			totalBytes += nb
			if nerr != nil {
				return totalFiles, totalBytes, nerr
			}
			continue
		}

		rc, err := f.Open()
		if err != nil {
			return totalFiles, totalBytes, err
		}
		finalDst, skip, cerr := ec.callbacks.CheckConflict(f.Name, destPath, &ec.blanket)
		if cerr != nil {
			rc.Close()
			return totalFiles, totalBytes, cerr
		}
		if skip {
			rc.Close()
			continue
		}
		written, werr := ec.callbacks.StreamToFile(rc, finalDst, int64(f.UncompressedSize64), f.Name)
		rc.Close()
		if werr != nil {
			return totalFiles, totalBytes, werr
		}
		totalFiles++
		totalBytes += written
	}
	return totalFiles, totalBytes, nil
}

func (ec *extractCtx) extractTarOnDisk(archivePath string) (int64, int64, error) {
	var rootStrip string
	if ec.req.FlattenSingleRoot {
		var tops []string
		_ = archiver.Walk(archivePath, func(f archiver.File) error {
			parts := strings.SplitN(ec.callbacks.Normalize(ec.callbacks.ArchiveEntryPath(f)), "/", 2)
			tops = appendUnique(tops, parts[0])
			return nil
		})
		if len(tops) == 1 {
			rootStrip = tops[0] + "/"
		}
	}

	var totalFiles, totalBytes int64
	err := archiver.Walk(archivePath, func(f archiver.File) error {
		if ec.cancelled() {
			return fmt.Errorf("operation cancelled")
		}
		ep := ec.callbacks.Normalize(ec.callbacks.ArchiveEntryPath(f))
		if rootStrip != "" {
			if ep = strings.TrimPrefix(ep, rootStrip); ep == "" {
				return nil
			}
		}
		destPath := filepath.Join(ec.destRoot, filepath.FromSlash(ep))

		if f.IsDir() {
			return os.MkdirAll(destPath, 0755)
		}
		if ec.callbacks.IsArchive(f.Name()) && !ec.tooDeep() {
			data, err := io.ReadAll(f)
			if err != nil {
				return err
			}
			child := ec.child(filepath.Join(ec.destRoot, ArchiveBaseName(f.Name())))
			nf, nb, nerr := child.extractNestedFromBytes(data, f.Name())
			ec.blanket = child.blanket
			totalFiles += nf
			totalBytes += nb
			return nerr
		}

		finalDst, skip, err := ec.callbacks.CheckConflict(f.Name(), destPath, &ec.blanket)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if skip {
			return nil
		}
		written, err := ec.callbacks.StreamToFile(f, finalDst, f.Size(), f.Name())
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		totalFiles++
		totalBytes += written
		return nil
	})
	return totalFiles, totalBytes, err
}

func (ec *extractCtx) extractNestedFromBytes(data []byte, archiveName string) (int64, int64, error) {
	if internalarchive.IsZipMagic(data) {
		return ec.extractZipBytes(data)
	}
	if internalarchive.IsRarArchiveName(archiveName) {
		return ec.extractRarBytes(data, archiveName)
	}
	return ec.extractTarBytes(data)
}

func (ec *extractCtx) extractZipBytes(data []byte) (int64, int64, error) {
	r, err := zip.NewReader(bytes.NewReader(data), int64(len(data)))
	if err != nil {
		return 0, 0, err
	}
	var totalFiles, totalBytes int64
	for _, f := range r.File {
		if ec.cancelled() {
			return totalFiles, totalBytes, fmt.Errorf("operation cancelled")
		}
		ep := ec.callbacks.Normalize(f.Name)
		destPath := filepath.Join(ec.destRoot, filepath.FromSlash(ep))
		if f.FileInfo().IsDir() {
			os.MkdirAll(destPath, 0755)
			continue
		}
		if ec.callbacks.IsArchive(f.Name) && !ec.tooDeep() {
			rc, err := f.Open()
			if err != nil {
				return totalFiles, totalBytes, err
			}
			nested, err := io.ReadAll(rc)
			rc.Close()
			if err != nil {
				return totalFiles, totalBytes, err
			}
			child := ec.child(filepath.Join(ec.destRoot, ArchiveBaseName(f.Name)))
			nf, nb, nerr := child.extractNestedFromBytes(nested, f.Name)
			ec.blanket = child.blanket
			totalFiles += nf
			totalBytes += nb
			if nerr != nil {
				return totalFiles, totalBytes, nerr
			}
			continue
		}
		rc, err := f.Open()
		if err != nil {
			return totalFiles, totalBytes, err
		}
		finalDst, skip, cerr := ec.callbacks.CheckConflict(f.Name, destPath, &ec.blanket)
		if cerr != nil {
			rc.Close()
			return totalFiles, totalBytes, cerr
		}
		if skip {
			rc.Close()
			continue
		}
		written, werr := ec.callbacks.StreamToFile(rc, finalDst, int64(f.UncompressedSize64), f.Name)
		rc.Close()
		if werr != nil {
			return totalFiles, totalBytes, werr
		}
		totalFiles++
		totalBytes += written
	}
	return totalFiles, totalBytes, nil
}

func (ec *extractCtx) extractTarBytes(data []byte) (int64, int64, error) {
	tr := tar.NewReader(bytes.NewReader(data))
	var totalFiles, totalBytes int64
	for {
		h, err := tr.Next()
		if err == io.EOF {
			break
		}
		if err != nil {
			return totalFiles, totalBytes, err
		}
		if ec.cancelled() {
			return totalFiles, totalBytes, fmt.Errorf("operation cancelled")
		}
		ep := ec.callbacks.Normalize(h.Name)
		destPath := filepath.Join(ec.destRoot, filepath.FromSlash(ep))
		if h.FileInfo().IsDir() {
			os.MkdirAll(destPath, 0755)
			continue
		}
		if ec.callbacks.IsArchive(h.Name) && !ec.tooDeep() {
			nested, err := io.ReadAll(tr)
			if err != nil {
				return totalFiles, totalBytes, err
			}
			child := ec.child(filepath.Join(ec.destRoot, ArchiveBaseName(h.Name)))
			nf, nb, nerr := child.extractNestedFromBytes(nested, h.Name)
			ec.blanket = child.blanket
			totalFiles += nf
			totalBytes += nb
			if nerr != nil {
				return totalFiles, totalBytes, nerr
			}
			continue
		}
		finalDst, skip, cerr := ec.callbacks.CheckConflict(h.Name, destPath, &ec.blanket)
		if cerr != nil {
			return totalFiles, totalBytes, cerr
		}
		if skip {
			continue
		}
		written, werr := ec.callbacks.StreamToFile(tr, finalDst, h.Size, h.Name)
		if werr != nil {
			return totalFiles, totalBytes, werr
		}
		totalFiles++
		totalBytes += written
	}
	return totalFiles, totalBytes, nil
}

func (ec *extractCtx) extractRarBytes(data []byte, archiveName string) (int64, int64, error) {
	reader, err := internalarchive.OpenArchiveReader(archiveName, data)
	if err != nil {
		return 0, 0, err
	}
	defer reader.Close()

	var totalFiles, totalBytes int64
	for {
		f, err := reader.Read()
		if err == io.EOF {
			break
		}
		if err != nil {
			return totalFiles, totalBytes, err
		}
		if ec.cancelled() {
			f.Close()
			return totalFiles, totalBytes, fmt.Errorf("operation cancelled")
		}
		ep := ec.callbacks.Normalize(ec.callbacks.ArchiveEntryPath(f))
		destPath := filepath.Join(ec.destRoot, filepath.FromSlash(ep))
		if f.IsDir() {
			f.Close()
			os.MkdirAll(destPath, 0755)
			continue
		}
		if ec.callbacks.IsArchive(f.Name()) && !ec.tooDeep() {
			nested, err := io.ReadAll(f)
			f.Close()
			if err != nil {
				return totalFiles, totalBytes, err
			}
			child := ec.child(filepath.Join(ec.destRoot, ArchiveBaseName(f.Name())))
			nf, nb, nerr := child.extractNestedFromBytes(nested, f.Name())
			ec.blanket = child.blanket
			totalFiles += nf
			totalBytes += nb
			if nerr != nil {
				return totalFiles, totalBytes, nerr
			}
			continue
		}
		finalDst, skip, cerr := ec.callbacks.CheckConflict(f.Name(), destPath, &ec.blanket)
		if cerr != nil {
			f.Close()
			return totalFiles, totalBytes, cerr
		}
		if skip {
			f.Close()
			continue
		}
		written, werr := ec.callbacks.StreamToFile(f, finalDst, f.Size(), f.Name())
		f.Close()
		if werr != nil {
			return totalFiles, totalBytes, werr
		}
		totalFiles++
		totalBytes += written
	}
	return totalFiles, totalBytes, nil
}

func (ec *extractCtx) child(destRoot string) *extractCtx {
	return &extractCtx{
		callbacks: ec.callbacks,
		req:       ec.req,
		blanket:   ec.blanket,
		destRoot:  destRoot,
		depth:     ec.depth + 1,
	}
}

func ArchiveBaseName(name string) string {
	base := filepath.Base(name)
	for _, suffix := range []string{".tar.gz", ".tar.bz2", ".tar.xz"} {
		if strings.HasSuffix(strings.ToLower(base), suffix) {
			return base[:len(base)-len(suffix)]
		}
	}
	if ext := filepath.Ext(base); ext != "" {
		return base[:len(base)-len(ext)]
	}
	return base
}

func zipRootPrefix(files []*zip.File, flatten bool, normalize func(string) string) string {
	if !flatten {
		return ""
	}
	var tops []string
	for _, f := range files {
		parts := strings.SplitN(normalize(f.Name), "/", 2)
		tops = appendUnique(tops, parts[0])
	}
	if len(tops) == 1 {
		return tops[0] + "/"
	}
	return ""
}

func appendUnique(slice []string, s string) []string {
	for _, v := range slice {
		if v == s {
			return slice
		}
	}
	return append(slice, s)
}
`````

`````go
package batch

import (
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"runtime"
	"strings"

	contracts "wails-app/internal/contracts"
)

type FileOperator struct {
	isCancelled func() bool
	progress    *ProgressTracker
}

func NewFileOperator(isCancelled func() bool, progress *ProgressTracker) *FileOperator {
	return &FileOperator{isCancelled: isCancelled, progress: progress}
}

func SameDir(a, b string) bool {
	cleanA := filepath.Clean(a)
	cleanB := filepath.Clean(b)
	if runtime.GOOS == "windows" {
		return strings.EqualFold(cleanA, cleanB)
	}
	return cleanA == cleanB
}

func SamePath(a, b string) bool {
	cleanA := filepath.Clean(a)
	cleanB := filepath.Clean(b)
	if runtime.GOOS == "windows" {
		return strings.EqualFold(cleanA, cleanB)
	}
	return cleanA == cleanB
}

func ApplyResolution(res contracts.ConflictResolution, dst string) (string, bool, error) {
	switch res {
	case contracts.ConflictSkip:
		return dst, true, nil
	case contracts.ConflictOverwrite:
		return dst, false, nil
	case contracts.ConflictRename:
		renamed, err := uniqueDestination(dst)
		return renamed, false, err
	case contracts.ConflictCancel:
		return "", true, fmt.Errorf("operation cancelled by user")
	default:
		return dst, true, nil
	}
}

func (f *FileOperator) StreamToFile(r io.Reader, dst string, size int64, label string) (int64, error) {
	if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(dst), 0755); err != nil {
		return 0, err
	}
	out, err := os.Create(dst)
	if err != nil {
		return 0, err
	}
	defer out.Close()

	baseItems, baseBytes := f.progress.Snapshot()
	f.progress.Set(baseItems, baseBytes, label, size, false)

	buf := make([]byte, 32*1024)
	var written int64
	for {
		if f.isCancelled != nil && f.isCancelled() {
			out.Close()
			os.Remove(dst)
			return 0, fmt.Errorf("operation cancelled")
		}
		nr, readErr := r.Read(buf)
		if nr > 0 {
			nw, writeErr := out.Write(buf[:nr])
			if writeErr != nil {
				return written, writeErr
			}
			written += int64(nw)
			f.progress.Set(baseItems, baseBytes+written, label, size, false)
		}
		if readErr == io.EOF {
			break
		}
		if readErr != nil {
			return written, readErr
		}
	}

	f.progress.Set(baseItems+1, baseBytes+written, "", 0, false)
	return written, nil
}

func (f *FileOperator) CopyPath(src, dst string, recursive bool) error {
	info, err := os.Stat(src)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if info.IsDir() {
		if !recursive {
			return fmt.Errorf("source is a directory; use recursive=true")
		}
		return walkDirOrdered(src, func(path string, isDir bool, size int64) error {
			if f.isCancelled != nil && f.isCancelled() {
				return fmt.Errorf("operation cancelled")
			}
			rel, _ := filepath.Rel(src, path)
			target := filepath.Join(dst, rel)
			if isDir {
				return os.MkdirAll(target, 0755)
			}
			file, err := os.Open(path)
			if err != nil {
				return err
			}
			defer file.Close()
			_, err = f.StreamToFile(file, target, size, filepath.Base(path))
			return err
		})
	}
	file, err := os.Open(src)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer file.Close()
	_, err = f.StreamToFile(file, dst, info.Size(), filepath.Base(src))
	return err
}

func (f *FileOperator) DeleteDir(path string) error {
	var files, dirs []string
	walkDirOrdered(path, func(current string, isDir bool, _ int64) error {
		if current == path {
			return nil
		}
		if isDir {
			dirs = append(dirs, current)
		} else {
			files = append(files, current)
		}
		return nil
	})

	for _, file := range files {
		if f.isCancelled != nil && f.isCancelled() {
			return fmt.Errorf("operation cancelled")
		}
		var size int64
		if info, err := os.Stat(file); err == nil {
			size = info.Size()
		}
		os.Remove(file)
		f.progress.Advance(1, size, filepath.Base(file), size, false)
	}
	for index := len(dirs) - 1; index >= 0; index-- {
		os.Remove(dirs[index])
	}
	return os.Remove(path)
}

func uniqueDestination(dst string) (string, error) {
	ext := filepath.Ext(dst)
	base := dst[:len(dst)-len(ext)]
	if candidate := fmt.Sprintf("%s_copy%s", base, ext); pathAvailable(candidate) {
		return candidate, nil
	}
	for index := 2; index <= 999; index++ {
		candidate := fmt.Sprintf("%s_copy%d%s", base, index, ext)
		if pathAvailable(candidate) {
			return candidate, nil
		}
	}
	return "", fmt.Errorf("could not find a free name for %q", dst)
}

func pathAvailable(path string) bool {
	_, err := os.Lstat(path)
	return os.IsNotExist(err)
}

func walkDirOrdered(root string, visit func(path string, isDir bool, size int64) error) error {
	return filepath.Walk(root, func(path string, info os.FileInfo, err error) error {
		if err != nil {
			return nil
		}
		return visit(path, info.IsDir(), info.Size())
	})
}
`````

## File: manager/internal/batch/progress.go
`````go
package batch

import (
	"sync"
	"time"

	internalops "wails-app/internal/ops"
)

// ProgressTracker batches frequent progress updates before forwarding them to
// the shared operations runtime.
type ProgressTracker struct {
	op       *internalops.ActiveOperation
	throttle time.Duration
	lastEmit time.Time

	mu             sync.Mutex
	processedItems int64
	processedBytes int64
	currentFile    string
	currentSize    int64
}

func NewProgressTracker(op *internalops.ActiveOperation) *ProgressTracker {
	return &ProgressTracker{
		op:       op,
		throttle: 100 * time.Millisecond,
		lastEmit: time.Now(),
	}
}

func (p *ProgressTracker) Set(items, bytes int64, file string, fileSize int64, force bool) {
	p.mu.Lock()
	p.processedItems = items
	p.processedBytes = bytes
	p.currentFile = file
	p.currentSize = fileSize
	now := time.Now()
	emit := force || now.Sub(p.lastEmit) >= p.throttle
	if emit {
		p.lastEmit = now
	}
	i, b, f, s := p.processedItems, p.processedBytes, p.currentFile, p.currentSize
	p.mu.Unlock()
	if emit {
		p.op.UpdateProgress(i, b, f, s)
	}
}

func (p *ProgressTracker) Flush() {
	p.mu.Lock()
	i, b, f, s := p.processedItems, p.processedBytes, p.currentFile, p.currentSize
	p.mu.Unlock()
	p.op.UpdateProgress(i, b, f, s)
}

func (p *ProgressTracker) Snapshot() (int64, int64) {
	p.mu.Lock()
	defer p.mu.Unlock()
	return p.processedItems, p.processedBytes
}

func (p *ProgressTracker) Advance(itemDelta, byteDelta int64, file string, fileSize int64, force bool) (int64, int64) {
	p.mu.Lock()
	p.processedItems += itemDelta
	p.processedBytes += byteDelta
	i, b := p.processedItems, p.processedBytes
	p.mu.Unlock()
	p.Set(i, b, file, fileSize, force)
	return i, b
}
`````

## File: manager/internal/batch/selective_extract.go

`````go
package batch

import (
	"archive/tar"
	"archive/zip"
	"bytes"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"

	"github.com/mholt/archiver/v3"

	internalarchive "wails-app/internal/archive"
	contracts "wails-app/internal/contracts"
)

type SelectiveExtractCallbacks struct {
	IsCancelled          func() bool
	CheckConflict        func(srcLabel, dst string, blanket **contracts.ConflictResolution) (string, bool, error)
	ExtractNestedArchive func(archivePath string, nestedChain []string) ([]byte, error)
	Normalize            func(string) string
	ArchiveEntryPath     func(archiver.File) string
}

type SelectiveExtractor struct {
	callbacks     SelectiveExtractCallbacks
	progress      *ProgressTracker
	addTotalBytes func(int64)
}

type archiveEntry struct {
	innerPath string
	data      []byte
	size      int64
	mtime     int64
}

func NewSelectiveExtractor(callbacks SelectiveExtractCallbacks, progress *ProgressTracker, addTotalBytes func(int64)) *SelectiveExtractor {
	return &SelectiveExtractor{callbacks: callbacks, progress: progress, addTotalBytes: addTotalBytes}
}

func (e *SelectiveExtractor) ExtractItem(item contracts.SelectiveExtractItem, defaultDest string, blanket *contracts.ConflictResolution) (int64, int64, *contracts.ConflictResolution, error) {
	if e.callbacks.IsCancelled != nil && e.callbacks.IsCancelled() {
		return 0, 0, blanket, fmt.Errorf("operation cancelled")
	}

	destRoot := item.DestinationDir
	if destRoot == "" {
		destRoot = defaultDest
	}

	var collected []archiveEntry
	var err error
	if len(item.NestedChain) == 0 {
		collected, err = e.collectFromDisk(item.ArchivePath, item.Entries)
	} else {
		collected, err = e.collectFromNested(item.ArchivePath, item.NestedChain, item.Entries)
	}
	if err != nil {
		return 0, 0, blanket, err
	}
	if len(collected) == 0 {
		return 0, 0, blanket, nil
	}

	var totalSize int64
	for _, entry := range collected {
		totalSize += entry.size
	}
	if e.addTotalBytes != nil {
		e.addTotalBytes(totalSize)
	}

	files, bytes, err := e.writeEntries(collected, destRoot, item.StripPrefix, item.FlattenPaths, &blanket)
	return files, bytes, blanket, err
}

func (e *SelectiveExtractor) collectFromDisk(archivePath string, entries []string) ([]archiveEntry, error) {
	if strings.HasSuffix(strings.ToLower(archivePath), ".zip") {
		return e.collectZipFile(archivePath, entries)
	}
	return e.collectTarFile(archivePath, entries)
}

func (e *SelectiveExtractor) collectZipFile(archivePath string, entries []string) ([]archiveEntry, error) {
	r, err := zip.OpenReader(archivePath)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer r.Close()

	var out []archiveEntry
	for _, f := range r.File {
		if f.FileInfo().IsDir() {
			continue
		}
		ep := e.callbacks.Normalize(f.Name)
		if !wantEntry(ep, entries, e.callbacks.Normalize) {
			continue
		}
		rc, err := f.Open()
		if err != nil {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("open %q: %w", f.Name, err)
		}
		data, err := io.ReadAll(rc)
		rc.Close()
		if err != nil {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("read %q: %w", f.Name, err)
		}
		out = append(out, archiveEntry{ep, data, int64(f.UncompressedSize64), f.Modified.Unix()})
	}
	return out, nil
}

func (e *SelectiveExtractor) collectTarFile(archivePath string, entries []string) ([]archiveEntry, error) {
	var out []archiveEntry
	err := archiver.Walk(archivePath, func(f archiver.File) error {
		if f.IsDir() {
			return nil
		}
		ep := e.callbacks.Normalize(e.callbacks.ArchiveEntryPath(f))
		if !wantEntry(ep, entries, e.callbacks.Normalize) {
			return nil
		}
		data, err := io.ReadAll(f)
		if err != nil {
			return fmt.Errorf("read %q: %w", ep, err)
		}
		var mtime int64
		if hdr, ok := f.Header.(*tar.Header); ok {
			mtime = hdr.ModTime.Unix()
		}
		out = append(out, archiveEntry{ep, data, f.Size(), mtime})
		return nil
	})
	return out, err
}

func (e *SelectiveExtractor) collectFromNested(archivePath string, nestedChain []string, entries []string) ([]archiveEntry, error) {
	data, err := e.callbacks.ExtractNestedArchive(archivePath, nestedChain)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("resolve nested chain: %w", err)
	}
	return e.collectFromBytes(data, nestedChain[len(nestedChain)-1], entries)
}

func (e *SelectiveExtractor) collectFromBytes(data []byte, archiveName string, entries []string) ([]archiveEntry, error) {
	if internalarchive.IsZipMagic(data) {
		return e.collectZipBytes(data, entries)
	}
	if internalarchive.IsRarArchiveName(archiveName) {
		return e.collectRarBytes(data, archiveName, entries)
	}
	return e.collectTarBytes(data, entries)
}

func (e *SelectiveExtractor) collectZipBytes(data []byte, entries []string) ([]archiveEntry, error) {
	r, err := zip.NewReader(bytes.NewReader(data), int64(len(data)))
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	var out []archiveEntry
	for _, f := range r.File {
		if f.FileInfo().IsDir() {
			continue
		}
		ep := e.callbacks.Normalize(f.Name)
		if !wantEntry(ep, entries, e.callbacks.Normalize) {
			continue
		}
		rc, err := f.Open()
		if err != nil {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("open %q: %w", f.Name, err)
		}
		buf, err := io.ReadAll(rc)
		rc.Close()
		if err != nil {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("read %q: %w", f.Name, err)
		}
		out = append(out, archiveEntry{ep, buf, int64(f.UncompressedSize64), f.Modified.Unix()})
	}
	return out, nil
}

func (e *SelectiveExtractor) collectTarBytes(data []byte, entries []string) ([]archiveEntry, error) {
	tr := tar.NewReader(bytes.NewReader(data))
	var out []archiveEntry
	for {
		h, err := tr.Next()
		if err == io.EOF {
			break
		}
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		if h.FileInfo().IsDir() {
			io.Copy(io.Discard, tr)
			continue
		}
		ep := e.callbacks.Normalize(h.Name)
		if !wantEntry(ep, entries, e.callbacks.Normalize) {
			io.Copy(io.Discard, tr)
			continue
		}
		buf, err := io.ReadAll(tr)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("read %q: %w", h.Name, err)
		}
		out = append(out, archiveEntry{ep, buf, h.Size, h.ModTime.Unix()})
	}
	return out, nil
}

func (e *SelectiveExtractor) collectRarBytes(data []byte, archiveName string, entries []string) ([]archiveEntry, error) {
	reader, err := internalarchive.OpenArchiveReader(archiveName, data)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer reader.Close()

	var out []archiveEntry
	for {
		f, err := reader.Read()
		if err == io.EOF {
			break
		}
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		ep := e.callbacks.Normalize(e.callbacks.ArchiveEntryPath(f))
		if f.IsDir() || !wantEntry(ep, entries, e.callbacks.Normalize) {
			f.Close()
			continue
		}
		buf, err := io.ReadAll(f)
		f.Close()
		if err != nil {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("read %q: %w", ep, err)
		}
		out = append(out, archiveEntry{ep, buf, f.Size(), f.ModTime().Unix()})
	}
	return out, nil
}

func (e *SelectiveExtractor) writeEntries(collected []archiveEntry, destRoot string, stripPrefix string, flatten bool, blanket **contracts.ConflictResolution) (int64, int64, error) {
	var totalFiles, totalBytes int64
	rebasePrefix := e.callbacks.Normalize(stripPrefix)

	for _, entry := range collected {
		if e.callbacks.IsCancelled != nil && e.callbacks.IsCancelled() {
			return totalFiles, totalBytes, fmt.Errorf("operation cancelled")
		}

		relPath := e.callbacks.Normalize(entry.innerPath)
		if rebasePrefix != "" {
			if relPath == rebasePrefix {
				continue
			}
			prefixWithSep := rebasePrefix + "/"
			relPath = strings.TrimPrefix(relPath, prefixWithSep)
		}
		if relPath == "" {
			continue
		}

		var destPath string
		if flatten {
			destPath = filepath.Join(destRoot, filepath.Base(filepath.FromSlash(relPath)))
		} else {
			destPath = filepath.Join(destRoot, filepath.FromSlash(relPath))
		}

		finalDst, skip, err := e.callbacks.CheckConflict(entry.innerPath, destPath, blanket)
		if err != nil {
			return totalFiles, totalBytes, err
		}
		if skip {
			continue
		}

		if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(finalDst), 0755); err != nil {
			return totalFiles, totalBytes, err
		}

		baseItems, baseBytes := e.progress.Snapshot()
		e.progress.Set(baseItems, baseBytes, filepath.Base(entry.innerPath), entry.size, false)

		if err := os.WriteFile(finalDst, entry.data, 0644); err != nil {
			return totalFiles, totalBytes, fmt.Errorf("write %q: %w", finalDst, err)
		}

		written := int64(len(entry.data))
		e.progress.Set(baseItems+1, baseBytes+written, "", 0, false)

		totalFiles++
		totalBytes += written
	}
	return totalFiles, totalBytes, nil
}

func wantEntry(innerPath string, entries []string, normalize func(string) string) bool {
	if len(entries) == 0 {
		return true
	}
	for _, entry := range entries {
		entry = normalize(entry)
		if entry == "" || entry == "." {
			return true
		}
		if innerPath == entry || strings.HasPrefix(innerPath, entry+"/") {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}
`````

`````go
func TestNormalizeItemDestinationKeepsExactDestination(t *testing.T) {
	tempDir := t.TempDir()
	sourcePath := filepath.Join(tempDir, "New Folder")
	destPath := filepath.Join(tempDir, "Existing")

	if err := os.Mkdir(sourcePath, 0o755); err != nil {

		ToPublicPath: func(path string) string { return path },

	normalized, err := runner.normalizeItemDestination(contracts.BatchItem{
		Source:           sourcePath,
		Destination:      destPath,
		ExactDestination: true,
	}, sourcePath)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("normalizeItemDestination returned error: %v", err)
	}

		t.Fatalf("exact destination mismatch\nwant: %q\n got: %q", destPath, normalized)

	}

	})
`````

`````go
		]
	}`, func(path string) {

	}, nil)

	if emitted != pageURL {
		t.Fatalf("expected emitted path %q, got %q", pageURL, emitted)
	}

	resources := webresourcecache.Load(pageURL)
	if len(resources) != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("expected 1 cached resource, got %d", len(resources))
	}
	if resources[0].URL != "https://example.com/app.js" {
		t.Fatalf("expected cached resource url %q, got %q", "https://example.com/app.js", resources[0].URL)

	if resources[0].Size != 42 {

	}
}
`````
