`````go
package filesystem

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"io/fs"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"sync"
	"time"

	contracts "wails-app/internal/contracts"
	elevation "wails-app/internal/elevation"
	"wails-app/internal/pathref"
	internalruntime "wails-app/internal/runtime"
	"wails-app/internal/work"
	vfslib "wails-app/vfs"
)

type elevationClientProvider interface {
	Client() elevation.Client
}

type ServiceConfig struct {
	Elevation            elevationClientProvider
	EmitEvent            func(string, interface{})
	StartElevatedSession func() (*elevation.SessionStatus, error)

	Raw      *RawService
	Metadata MetadataCallbacks

	IsProcessElevated              func() bool
	ExecuteElevatedRequest         func(elevation.Request) elevation.Response
	RunElevatedRequest             func(elevation.Request) (elevation.Response, error)
	IsPermissionDenied             func(error) bool
	ShouldRetryDeleteWithElevation func(error) bool
}

type Service struct {
	elevation            elevationClientProvider
	emitEvent            func(string, interface{})
	startElevatedSession func() (*elevation.SessionStatus, error)
	raw                  *RawService
	metadata             MetadataCallbacks
	web                  *webAliasService
	vfs                  *vfslib.Unified
	duStreams            *duStreamRegistry
	duCache              *DiskUsageCache
	streamsMu            sync.RWMutex
	streamsCancel        map[string]context.CancelFunc

	isProcessElevated              func() bool
	executeElevatedRequest         func(elevation.Request) elevation.Response
	runElevatedRequest             func(elevation.Request) (elevation.Response, error)
	isPermissionDenied             func(error) bool
	shouldRetryDeleteWithElevation func(error) bool
}

func NewService(config ServiceConfig) *Service {
	return &Service{
		elevation:                      config.Elevation,
		emitEvent:                      config.EmitEvent,
		startElevatedSession:           config.StartElevatedSession,
		raw:                            config.Raw,
		metadata:                       config.Metadata,
		web:                            newWebAliasService(),
		duStreams:                      newDuStreamRegistry(),
		duCache:                        NewDiskUsageCache(DefaultDiskUsageCacheCapacity),
		streamsCancel:                  make(map[string]context.CancelFunc),
		isProcessElevated:              config.IsProcessElevated,
		executeElevatedRequest:         config.ExecuteElevatedRequest,
		runElevatedRequest:             config.RunElevatedRequest,
		isPermissionDenied:             config.IsPermissionDenied,
		shouldRetryDeleteWithElevation: config.ShouldRetryDeleteWithElevation,
	}
}

func (s *Service) resolvePublicPath(path string) (string, error) {
	normalized := pathref.Normalize(path)
	if s.handlesWebAliasPath(normalized) {
		return normalized, nil
	}
	if resolved, ok := pathref.ResolveLocalCloudPath(normalized); ok {
		return resolved, nil
	}
	return pathref.ToNativePath(normalized), nil
}

func (s *Service) handlesWebAliasPath(path string) bool {
	return s.web != nil && s.web.handles(pathref.Normalize(path))
}

func (s *Service) webAliasUnsupported(operation string) error {
	return fmt.Errorf("%s not supported for web aliases", operation)
}

func (s *Service) toPublicPath(path string) string {
	return pathref.FromNativePath(filepath.ToSlash(path))
}

func (s *Service) toRequestedPublicPath(path string, requestedPath string) string {
	if pathref.IsLocalCloud(requestedPath) {
		if mapped, ok := pathref.LocalCloudAliasFromNativePath(path); ok {
			return mapped
		}
	}
	return s.toPublicPath(path)
}

func (s *Service) mapFileInfo(info contracts.FileInfo) contracts.FileInfo {
	info.Path = s.toPublicPath(info.Path)
	if info.SearchBasePath != "" {
		info.SearchBasePath = s.toPublicPath(info.SearchBasePath)
	}
	if info.SearchParentPath != "" {
		info.SearchParentPath = s.toPublicPath(info.SearchParentPath)
	}
	return info
}

func (s *Service) mapListing(listing *contracts.DirectoryListing, requestedPath string) *contracts.DirectoryListing {
	if listing == nil {
		return nil
	}
	if requestedPath != "" {
		listing.Path = pathref.Normalize(requestedPath)
	} else {
		listing.Path = s.toPublicPath(listing.Path)
	}
	for index := range listing.Entries {
		info := listing.Entries[index]
		info.Path = s.toRequestedPublicPath(info.Path, requestedPath)
		if info.SearchBasePath != "" {
			if pathref.IsLocalCloud(requestedPath) {
				info.SearchBasePath = pathref.Normalize(requestedPath)
			} else {
				info.SearchBasePath = s.toPublicPath(info.SearchBasePath)
			}
		}
		if info.SearchParentPath != "" {
			info.SearchParentPath = s.toRequestedPublicPath(info.SearchParentPath, requestedPath)
		}
		listing.Entries[index] = info
	}
	return listing
}

func (s *Service) mapFileContent(file *contracts.FileContent, requestedPath string) *contracts.FileContent {
	if file == nil {
		return nil
	}
	if requestedPath != "" {
		file.Path = pathref.Normalize(requestedPath)
	} else {
		file.Path = s.toPublicPath(file.Path)
	}
	return file
}

func (s *Service) mapOperation(op *contracts.OperationResult) *contracts.OperationResult {
	if op == nil {
		return nil
	}
	for index := range op.AffectedPaths {
		op.AffectedPaths[index] = s.toPublicPath(op.AffectedPaths[index])
	}
	return op
}

func (s *Service) SetVFS(v *vfslib.Unified) {
	s.vfs = v
}

// RealPath resolves a public path to the underlying real filesystem path.

// Uses the same resolution chain as resolvePublicPath for consistency.
func (s *Service) RealPath(path string) (string, error) {
	if path == "" {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("empty path")
	}
	return s.resolvePublicPath(path)
}

func (s *Service) handlesVFSPath(path string) bool {
	if s.vfs == nil {
		return false
	}
	normalized := pathref.Normalize(path)
	if pathref.IsAlias(normalized) {
		return s.vfs.IsMounted(pathref.ToVFS(normalized))
	}
	return s.vfs.IsMounted(normalized)
}

func (s *Service) emit(name string, data interface{}) {
	if s.emitEvent != nil {
		s.emitEvent(name, data)
	}
}

func (s *Service) elevationTargetSingle(path string) string {
	return path
}

func (s *Service) elevationTargetPair(source, destination string) string {
	return fmt.Sprintf("%s -> %s", source, destination)
}

func (s *Service) ListDirectory(path string, showHidden bool) (*contracts.DirectoryListing, error) {
	path = pathref.Normalize(path)
	if pathref.IsSearch(path) {
		return s.listSearchAlias(path)
	}
	if s.handlesWebAliasPath(path) {
		return s.web.listDirectory(path)
	}
	if s.handlesVFSPath(path) {
		listing, err := internalruntime.VFSListDir(context.Background(), s.vfs, path)
		if err == nil {
			return listing, nil
		}
		if !pathref.IsRegistry(path) || !s.isPermissionDenied(err) {
			return nil, err
		}

		resp, elevErr := s.runElevatedWithEvents("list", s.elevationTargetSingle(path), elevation.Request{
			Op:         "list",
			Path:       path,
			ShowHidden: showHidden,
		})
		if elevErr != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		return resp.DirListing, nil
	}
	resolvedPath, err := s.resolvePublicPath(path)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	listing, err := s.raw.ListDirectory(resolvedPath, showHidden)
	if err == nil {
		return s.mapListing(listing, path), nil
	}
	if !s.isPermissionDenied(err) {
		return nil, err
	}

	resp, elevErr := s.runElevatedWithEvents("list", s.elevationTargetSingle(path), elevation.Request{
		Op:         "list",
		Path:       resolvedPath,
		ShowHidden: showHidden,
	})
	if elevErr != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return s.mapListing(resp.DirListing, path), nil
}

func (s *Service) listSearchAlias(path string) (*contracts.DirectoryListing, error) {
	if path == pathref.SearchScheme {
		return &contracts.DirectoryListing{
			Path:      pathref.SearchScheme,
			Entries:   []contracts.FileInfo{},
			TotalSize: 0,
		}, nil
	}

	query, ok := pathref.ParseSearch(path)
	if !ok {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("invalid search alias path")
	}

	result, err := s.SearchFiles(query.BasePath, query.Pattern, query.Recursive)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	entries := append([]contracts.FileInfo{}, result.Matches...)
	var total int64
	for _, entry := range entries {
		total += entry.Size
	}

	return &contracts.DirectoryListing{
		Path:      path,
		Entries:   entries,
		TotalSize: total,
	}, nil
}

func (s *Service) ElevatedList(path string, showHidden bool) ([]contracts.FileInfo, error) {
	resp, err := s.runElevatedWithEvents("list", path, elevation.Request{
		Op:         "list",
		Path:       path,
		ShowHidden: showHidden,
	})
	if err != nil || resp.DirListing == nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return resp.DirListing.Entries, nil
}

func (s *Service) DirSizeRecursive(path string) (int64, error) {
	path = pathref.Normalize(path)
	if s.handlesWebAliasPath(path) {
		return 0, s.webAliasUnsupported("directory size")
	}
	if s.handlesVFSPath(path) {
		return 0, fmt.Errorf("directory size not supported for remote paths")
	}
	resolvedPath, err := s.resolvePublicPath(path)
	if err != nil {
		return 0, err
	}
	var total int64
	queue := []string{resolvedPath}
	for len(queue) > 0 {
		current := queue[0]
		queue = queue[1:]
		entries, err := os.ReadDir(current)
		if err != nil {
			continue
		}
		for _, entry := range entries {
			full := filepath.Join(current, entry.Name())
			if entry.IsDir() {
				queue = append(queue, full)
			} else {
				info, err := entry.Info()
				if err == nil {
					total += info.Size()
				}
			}
		}
	}
	return total, nil
}

func (s *Service) GetFileInfo(path string) (*contracts.FileInfo, error) {
	path = pathref.Normalize(path)
	if s.handlesWebAliasPath(path) {
		return s.web.getFileInfo(path)
	}
	if s.handlesVFSPath(path) {
		return internalruntime.VFSGetFileInfo(context.Background(), s.vfs, path)
	}
	resolvedPath, err := s.resolvePublicPath(path)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	info, err := os.Lstat(resolvedPath)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	name := filepath.Base(resolvedPath)
	fi := BuildFileInfo(s.metadata, name, filepath.ToSlash(resolvedPath), info)
	fi.Path = path
	return &fi, nil
}

func (s *Service) ReadFile(path string, encoding string) (*contracts.FileContent, error) {
	path = pathref.Normalize(path)
	if s.handlesWebAliasPath(path) {
		return s.web.readFile(path, encoding)
	}
	if s.handlesVFSPath(path) {
		file, err := internalruntime.VFSReadFile(context.Background(), s.vfs, path, encoding)
		if err == nil {
			return file, nil
		}
		if !pathref.IsRegistry(path) || !s.isPermissionDenied(err) {
			return nil, err
		}

		resp, elevErr := s.runElevatedWithEvents("read", s.elevationTargetSingle(path), elevation.Request{
			Op:       "read",
			Path:     path,
			Encoding: encoding,
		})
		if elevErr != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		return resp.File, nil
	}

	resolvedPath, err := s.resolvePublicPath(path)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	file, err := s.raw.ReadFile(resolvedPath, encoding)
	if err == nil {
		return s.mapFileContent(file, path), nil
	}
	if !s.isPermissionDenied(err) {
		return nil, err
	}

	resp, elevErr := s.runElevatedWithEvents("read", s.elevationTargetSingle(path), elevation.Request{
		Op:       "read",
		Path:     resolvedPath,
		Encoding: encoding,
	})
	if elevErr != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return s.mapFileContent(resp.File, path), nil
}

func (s *Service) ReadFileRange(path string, offset int64, length int) (*contracts.FileContent, error) {
	path = pathref.Normalize(path)
	if s.handlesWebAliasPath(path) {
		return s.web.readFileRange(path, offset, length)
	}
	if s.handlesVFSPath(path) {
		return internalruntime.VFSReadFileRange(context.Background(), s.vfs, path, offset, length)
	}

	resolvedPath, err := s.resolvePublicPath(path)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	file, err := s.raw.ReadFileRange(resolvedPath, offset, length)
	if err != nil {

	}
	return s.mapFileContent(file, path), nil
}

func (s *Service) ProbeFile(path string) (*contracts.FileProbe, error) {
	path = pathref.Normalize(path)
	if s.handlesWebAliasPath(path) {
		return s.web.probeFile(path)
	}
	if s.handlesVFSPath(path) {
		probe, err := internalruntime.VFSProbeFile(context.Background(), s.vfs, path)
		if err == nil {
			return probe, nil
		}
		if !pathref.IsRegistry(path) || !s.isPermissionDenied(err) {
			return nil, err
		}
		return nil, err
	}

	resolvedPath, err := s.resolvePublicPath(path)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return s.raw.ProbeFile(resolvedPath)
}

func (s *Service) ReadFileStream(path string, chunkSize int, emitEvent func(string, interface{})) (string, error) {
	path = pathref.Normalize(path)
	if s.handlesWebAliasPath(path) {
		return "", s.webAliasUnsupported("file stream")
	}

	if chunkSize <= 0 {
		chunkSize = 64 * 1024 // 64KB default chunk size
	}

	// Generate streamID
	streamID := fmt.Sprintf("file-read-%d", time.Now().UnixNano())

	// Create cancellation context
	ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
	s.streamsMu.Lock()
	s.streamsCancel[streamID] = cancel
	s.streamsMu.Unlock()

	// File streaming uses the central bounded worker scheduler.
	work.Default.Submit(ctx, work.Task{
		Key:      "file-stream:" + streamID,
		Priority: work.PriorityInteractive,
		Kind:     "viewer",
		Run: func(ctx context.Context, reporter work.Reporter) error {
			defer func() {
				s.streamsMu.Lock()
				delete(s.streamsCancel, streamID)
				s.streamsMu.Unlock()
			}()

			var reader io.ReadCloser

			if s.handlesVFSPath(path) {
				internalPath := pathref.ToVFS(path)
				vfsFile, vfsErr := s.vfs.Open(ctx, internalPath)
				if vfsErr != nil {
					emitEvent("file:read:error", map[string]interface{}{
						"streamID": streamID,
						"error":    fmt.Sprintf("open vfs file: %v", vfsErr),
					})
					return vfsErr
				}
				reader = vfsFile
			} else {
				// Resolve path
				resolvedPath, resolveErr := s.resolvePublicPath(path)
				if resolveErr != nil {
					emitEvent("file:read:error", map[string]interface{}{
						"streamID": streamID,
						"error":    fmt.Sprintf("resolve path: %v", resolveErr),
					})
					return resolveErr
				}

				// Open file
				file, err := os.Open(resolvedPath)
				if err != nil {
					emitEvent("file:read:error", map[string]interface{}{
						"streamID": streamID,
						"error":    fmt.Sprintf("open file: %v", err),
					})
					return err
				}
				reader = file
			}
			defer reader.Close()

			// Stream file in chunks
			bytesRead := int64(0)
			for {
				select {
				case <-ctx.Done():
					emitEvent("file:read:cancelled", map[string]interface{}{
						"streamID": streamID,
					})
					return ctx.Err()
				default:
				}

				chunk := make([]byte, chunkSize)
				n, err := reader.Read(chunk)
				if err != nil && err != io.EOF {
					emitEvent("file:read:error", map[string]interface{}{
						"streamID": streamID,
						"error":    fmt.Sprintf("read chunk: %v", err),
					})
					return err
				}

				if n > 0 {
					bytesRead += int64(n)
					emitEvent("file:read:chunk", map[string]interface{}{
						"streamID":  streamID,
						"data":      chunk[:n],
						"bytesRead": bytesRead,
					})
				}

				if err == io.EOF {
					emitEvent("file:read:done", map[string]interface{}{
						"streamID":   streamID,
						"totalBytes": bytesRead,
					})
					return nil
				}
			}
		},
	})

	return streamID, nil
}

func (s *Service) CancelReadStream(streamID string) {
	s.streamsMu.Lock()
	defer s.streamsMu.Unlock()

	if cancel, exists := s.streamsCancel[streamID]; exists {
		cancel()
		delete(s.streamsCancel, streamID)
	}
}

func (s *Service) WriteFile(path string, content string, encoding string) (*contracts.OperationResult, error) {
	path = pathref.Normalize(path)
	if s.handlesWebAliasPath(path) {
		return nil, s.webAliasUnsupported("write")
	}
	if s.handlesVFSPath(path) {
		op, err := internalruntime.VFSWriteFile(context.Background(), s.vfs, path, content, encoding)
		if err == nil {
			return op, nil
		}
		if !pathref.IsRegistry(path) || !s.isPermissionDenied(err) {
			return nil, err
		}

		resp, elevErr := s.runElevatedWithEvents("write", s.elevationTargetSingle(path), elevation.Request{
			Op:       "write",
			Path:     path,
			Content:  content,
			Encoding: encoding,
		})
		if elevErr != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		return resp.Operation, nil
	}

	resolvedPath, err := s.resolvePublicPath(path)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	op, err := s.raw.WriteFile(resolvedPath, content, encoding)
	if err == nil {
		return s.mapOperation(op), nil
	}
	if !s.isPermissionDenied(err) {
		return nil, err
	}

	resp, elevErr := s.runElevatedWithEvents("write", s.elevationTargetSingle(path), elevation.Request{
		Op:       "write",
		Path:     resolvedPath,
		Content:  content,
		Encoding: encoding,
	})
	if elevErr != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return s.mapOperation(resp.Operation), nil
}

func (s *Service) WriteRegistryValue(
	path string,
	valueType string,
	data string,
) (*contracts.OperationResult, error) {
	path = pathref.Normalize(path)
	if !pathref.IsRegistry(path) || !s.handlesVFSPath(path) {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("registry value write requires a mounted registry:// path")
	}

	op, err := internalruntime.VFSWriteRegistryValue(
		context.Background(),
		s.vfs,
		path,
		valueType,
		data,
	)
	if err == nil {
		return op, nil
	}
	if !s.isPermissionDenied(err) {
		return nil, err
	}

	resp, elevErr := s.runElevatedWithEvents(
		"registry-write",
		s.elevationTargetSingle(path),
		elevation.Request{
			Op:        "registry-write",
			Path:      path,
			Content:   data,
			ValueType: valueType,
		},
	)
	if elevErr != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return resp.Operation, nil
}

func (s *Service) SearchFiles(path, pattern string, recursive bool) (*contracts.SearchResult, error) {
	path = pathref.Normalize(path)
	if s.handlesWebAliasPath(path) {
		return nil, s.webAliasUnsupported("search")
	}
	if s.handlesVFSPath(path) {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("search not supported for remote paths")
	}
	var matches []contracts.FileInfo
	basePath := pathref.Normalize(path)
	resolvedPath, err := s.resolvePublicPath(path)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	walkFn := func(p string, d fs.DirEntry, err error) error {
		if err != nil {
			return nil
		}
		if p == resolvedPath {
			return nil
		}
		if !recursive && d.IsDir() && p != resolvedPath {
			return filepath.SkipDir
		}

		name := d.Name()
		matched, err := pathref.MatchSearchPattern(pattern, name)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if !matched {
			return nil
		}

		info, err := d.Info()
		if err != nil {
			return nil
		}
		entry := BuildFileInfo(s.metadata, name, filepath.ToSlash(p), info)
		entry.Path = s.toRequestedPublicPath(entry.Path, path)
		entry.SearchBasePath = basePath
		entry.SearchPattern = pattern
		entry.SearchParentPath = s.toRequestedPublicPath(filepath.ToSlash(filepath.Dir(p)), path)
		matches = append(matches, entry)
		return nil
	}

	if err := filepath.WalkDir(resolvedPath, walkFn); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	if matches == nil {
		matches = []contracts.FileInfo{}
	}

	return &contracts.SearchResult{
		Path:         basePath,
		Matches:      matches,
		TotalMatches: len(matches),
	}, nil
}

type elevationEvent struct {
	RequestID string `json:"requestId,omitempty"`
	Phase     string `json:"phase"`
	Operation string `json:"operation"`
	Target    string `json:"target"`
	Message   string `json:"message,omitempty"`
	Success   bool   `json:"success,omitempty"`
	Error     string `json:"error,omitempty"`
}

func (s *Service) emitElevationRequested(requestID, op, target string) {
	s.emit("elevation:requested", elevationEvent{
		RequestID: requestID,
		Phase:     "requested",
		Operation: op,
		Target:    target,
		Message:   "Administrative privileges required. Confirm to show OS elevation prompt.",
	})
}

func (s *Service) emitElevationResult(requestID, op, target string, success bool, err error) {
	evt := elevationEvent{
		RequestID: requestID,
		Phase:     "result",
		Operation: op,
		Target:    target,
		Success:   success,
	}
	if err != nil {
		evt.Error = err.Error()
		evt.Message = "Elevation failed or was cancelled."
	} else {
		evt.Message = "Elevated operation completed."
	}
	s.emit("elevation:result", evt)
}

func (s *Service) runElevatedWithEvents(op, target string, req elevation.Request) (elevation.Response, error) {
	if s.isProcessElevated != nil && s.isProcessElevated() {
		return s.executeElevatedRequest(req), nil
	}

	var svc elevation.Client
	if s.elevation != nil {
		svc = s.elevation.Client()
	}

	if (svc == nil || !svc.Alive()) && s.startElevatedSession != nil {
		s.emit("elevation:session-starting", map[string]string{"op": op, "target": target})
		if status, startErr := s.startElevatedSession(); startErr == nil {
			s.emit("elevation:session-started", status)
			if s.elevation != nil {
				svc = s.elevation.Client()
			}
		}
	}

	if svc != nil && svc.Alive() {
		resp, err := svc.Dispatch(req)
		if err != nil {
			s.emit("elevation:auto-failed", map[string]interface{}{"op": op, "target": target, "error": err.Error()})
			return elevation.Response{}, err
		}
		s.emit("elevation:auto-started", map[string]string{"op": op, "target": target})
		return resp, nil
	}

	s.emit("elevation:uac-requested", map[string]string{
		"phase":     "requested",
		"operation": op,
		"target":    target,
	})
	resp, err := s.runElevatedRequest(req)
	if err != nil {
		s.emit("elevation:auto-failed", map[string]interface{}{"op": op, "target": target, "error": err.Error()})
		return elevation.Response{}, err
	}
	s.emit("elevation:auto-started", map[string]string{"op": op, "target": target})
	return resp, nil
}
`````

`````go
func TestWebAliasListDirectoryDiscoversLinkedEntries(t *testing.T) {
	server := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		switch r.URL.Path {
		case "/index.html":
			w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "text/html; charset=utf-8")
			_, _ = w.Write([]byte(`<!doctype html><html><head><title>Index of /</title></head><body><h1>Index of /</h1><a href="/docs/page.html">Docs</a><a href="/assets/app.js">App</a><a href="/home?hl=en-US">Home</a><script src="/assets/app.js"></script></body></html>`))
		default:
			http.NotFound(w, r)
		}
	}))
	defer server.Close()

	service := newWebAliasService()
	listing, err := service.listDirectory(server.URL + "/index.html")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("listDirectory returned error: %v", err)
	}

	if listing.Path != server.URL+"/index.html" {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected listing path: %q", listing.Path)
	}
	if len(listing.Entries) != 2 {
		t.Fatalf("expected 2 entries, got %d", len(listing.Entries))
	}

	expected := map[string]contracts.FileType{
		server.URL + "/assets/app.js":  contracts.FileTypeFile,
		server.URL + "/docs/page.html": contracts.FileTypeDirectory,
	}
	for _, entry := range listing.Entries {

	if err != nil {

	if len(listing.Entries) != 0 {
`````

`````go
package filesystem

import (
	"bytes"
	"encoding/base64"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"mime"
	"net/http"
	"net/url"
	vpath "path"
	"sort"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
	"sync"
	"time"

	"golang.org/x/net/html"

	"wails-app/internal/contentprobe"
	contracts "wails-app/internal/contracts"
	"wails-app/internal/pathref"
	"wails-app/internal/webresourcecache"
)

const (
	webAliasTimeout   = 30 * time.Second
	webAliasReadLimit = 4 * 1024 * 1024
)

type webAliasService struct {
	client   *http.Client
	metaMu   sync.RWMutex
	metadata map[string]webAliasMetadata
}

type webAliasMetadata struct {
	size       int64
	mimeType   string
	modifiedAt int64
	fileType   contracts.FileType
}

func newWebAliasService() *webAliasService {
	return &webAliasService{
		client:   &http.Client{Timeout: webAliasTimeout},
		metadata: make(map[string]webAliasMetadata),
	}
}

func (s *webAliasService) lookupMetadata(path string) (webAliasMetadata, bool) {
	s.metaMu.RLock()
	defer s.metaMu.RUnlock()
	meta, ok := s.metadata[path]
	return meta, ok
}

func (s *webAliasService) rememberMetadata(path string, meta webAliasMetadata) {
	if path == "" {
		return
	}

	s.metaMu.Lock()
	defer s.metaMu.Unlock()

	current := s.metadata[path]
	if meta.size > 0 {
		current.size = meta.size
	}
	if meta.mimeType != "" {
		current.mimeType = meta.mimeType
	}
	if meta.modifiedAt > 0 {
		current.modifiedAt = meta.modifiedAt
	}
	if meta.fileType != "" {
		current.fileType = meta.fileType
	}
	s.metadata[path] = current
}

func (s *webAliasService) applyCachedMetadata(entries []contracts.FileInfo) []contracts.FileInfo {
	result := make([]contracts.FileInfo, len(entries))
	copy(result, entries)

	for i, entry := range result {
		meta, ok := s.lookupMetadata(entry.Path)
		if !ok {
			continue
		}
		if meta.size > 0 {
			result[i].Size = meta.size
		}
		if meta.mimeType != "" {
			result[i].MimeType = meta.mimeType
		}
		if meta.modifiedAt > 0 {
			result[i].Created = meta.modifiedAt
			result[i].Modified = meta.modifiedAt
			result[i].Accessed = meta.modifiedAt
		}
		if meta.fileType != "" {
			result[i].Type = meta.fileType
		}
	}

	return result
}

func (s *webAliasService) handles(path string) bool {
	return pathref.IsWeb(path)
}

func (s *webAliasService) listDirectory(path string) (*contracts.DirectoryListing, error) {
	requestedPath := pathref.Normalize(path)
	targetURL, rootOnly, err := normalizeWebAliasPath(requestedPath)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	if rootOnly {
		return &contracts.DirectoryListing{
			Path:      requestedPath,
			Entries:   []contracts.FileInfo{},
			TotalSize: 0,
		}, nil
	}

	if cached, ok := s.lookupMetadata(requestedPath); ok && cached.fileType == contracts.FileTypeFile {
		entries := s.applyCachedMetadata(cachedWebResources(targetURL))
		return &contracts.DirectoryListing{
			Path:      requestedPath,
			Entries:   entries,
			TotalSize: sumFileSizes(entries),
		}, nil
	}

	sample, headers, sampleSize, err := s.fetchSample(targetURL)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	contentType := normalizedMediaType(headers.Get("Content-Type"))
	if contentType == "" {
		contentType = contentprobe.ProbeBytes(sample).MimeType
	}
	modifiedAt := parseHTTPModified(headers.Get("Last-Modified"))

	if fileType := inferWebAliasFileTypeFromSample(targetURL, contentType, sample); fileType == contracts.FileTypeFile {
		s.rememberMetadata(requestedPath, webAliasMetadata{
			size:       sampleSize,
			mimeType:   contentType,
			modifiedAt: modifiedAt,
			fileType:   contracts.FileTypeFile,
		})
		entries := s.applyCachedMetadata(cachedWebResources(targetURL))
		return &contracts.DirectoryListing{
			Path:      requestedPath,
			Entries:   entries,
			TotalSize: sumFileSizes(entries),
		}, nil
	}

	resp, err := s.request(http.MethodGet, targetURL, nil)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer resp.Body.Close()

	if resp.StatusCode < http.StatusOK || resp.StatusCode >= http.StatusBadRequest {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("request failed: HTTP %d", resp.StatusCode)
	}

	body, err := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(resp.Body, webAliasReadLimit))
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	entries := []contracts.FileInfo{}
	if isHTMLResponse(resp.Header.Get("Content-Type"), body) {
		entries = discoverWebEntries(targetURL, body)
		if len(entries) == 0 {
			entries = cachedWebResources(targetURL)
		}
		entries = s.applyCachedMetadata(entries)
	}

	resolvedType := contracts.FileTypeFile
	if len(entries) > 0 {
		resolvedType = contracts.FileTypeDirectory
	}
	s.rememberMetadata(requestedPath, webAliasMetadata{
		size:       responseSize(resp, int64(len(body))),
		mimeType:   normalizedMediaType(resp.Header.Get("Content-Type")),
		modifiedAt: parseHTTPModified(resp.Header.Get("Last-Modified")),
		fileType:   resolvedType,
	})

	return &contracts.DirectoryListing{
		Path:      requestedPath,
		Entries:   entries,
		TotalSize: sumFileSizes(entries),
	}, nil
}

func (s *webAliasService) getFileInfo(path string) (*contracts.FileInfo, error) {
	requestedPath := pathref.Normalize(path)
	targetURL, rootOnly, err := normalizeWebAliasPath(requestedPath)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	if rootOnly {
		return &contracts.FileInfo{
			Name:        strings.TrimSuffix(requestedPath, "://"),
			Path:        requestedPath,
			Type:        contracts.FileTypeDirectory,
			Permissions: "r--",
			IsHidden:    false,
		}, nil
	}

	parsed, err := url.Parse(targetURL)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	var (
		contentType string
		size        int64
		modifiedAt  int64
		sample      []byte
	)

	if cached, ok := s.lookupMetadata(requestedPath); ok {
		contentType = cached.mimeType
		size = cached.size
		modifiedAt = cached.modifiedAt
	}

	if contentType == "" || size == 0 {
		var headers http.Header
		var sampleSize int64
		var sampleErr error
		sample, headers, sampleSize, sampleErr = s.fetchSample(targetURL)
		if sampleErr == nil {
			if contentType == "" {
				contentType = normalizedMediaType(headers.Get("Content-Type"))
				if contentType == "" {
					contentType = contentprobe.ProbeBytes(sample).MimeType
				}
			}
			if size == 0 {
				size = sampleSize
			}
			if modifiedAt == 0 {
				modifiedAt = parseHTTPModified(headers.Get("Last-Modified"))
			}
		}
	}

	fileType := contracts.FileTypeFile
	if contentType != "" && isHTMLMediaType(contentType) {
		fileType = inferWebAliasFileTypeFromSample(targetURL, contentType, sample)
	} else if parsed.RawQuery == "" && isLikelyWebPage(parsed) {
		fileType = contracts.FileTypeDirectory
	}

	s.rememberMetadata(requestedPath, webAliasMetadata{
		size:       size,
		mimeType:   contentType,
		modifiedAt: modifiedAt,
		fileType:   fileType,
	})

	return &contracts.FileInfo{
		Name:        webEntryDisplayName(parsed),
		Path:        requestedPath,
		Type:        fileType,
		MimeType:    contentType,
		Size:        size,
		Created:     modifiedAt,
		Modified:    modifiedAt,
		Accessed:    modifiedAt,
		Permissions: "r--",
		IsHidden:    false,
	}, nil
}

func (s *webAliasService) probeFile(path string) (*contracts.FileProbe, error) {
	targetURL, rootOnly, err := normalizeWebAliasPath(path)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if rootOnly {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("cannot probe scheme root")
	}

	sample, headers, _, err := s.fetchSample(targetURL)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	probe := contentprobe.ProbeBytes(sample)
	if headerType := normalizedMediaType(headers.Get("Content-Type")); headerType != "" {
		probe.MimeType = headerType
		probe.IsText = probe.IsText || isTextMediaType(headerType)
	}

	fileType := contracts.FileTypeFile
	if probe.MimeType != "" && isHTMLMediaType(probe.MimeType) {
		fileType = inferWebAliasFileTypeFromSample(targetURL, probe.MimeType, sample)
	}
	s.rememberMetadata(pathref.Normalize(path), webAliasMetadata{
		size:       responseSize(&http.Response{Header: headers}, 0),
		mimeType:   probe.MimeType,
		modifiedAt: parseHTTPModified(headers.Get("Last-Modified")),
		fileType:   fileType,
	})

	return &contracts.FileProbe{
		MimeType:  probe.MimeType,
		Encoding:  probe.Encoding,
		IsText:    probe.IsText,
		IsArchive: probe.IsArchive,
	}, nil
}

func (s *webAliasService) readFile(path string, encoding string) (*contracts.FileContent, error) {
	requestedPath := pathref.Normalize(path)
	targetURL, rootOnly, err := normalizeWebAliasPath(requestedPath)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if rootOnly {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("cannot read scheme root")
	}

	resp, err := s.request(http.MethodGet, targetURL, nil)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer resp.Body.Close()

	if resp.StatusCode < http.StatusOK || resp.StatusCode >= http.StatusBadRequest {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("request failed: HTTP %d", resp.StatusCode)
	}

	data, err := io.ReadAll(resp.Body)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	probe := contentprobe.ProbeBytes(data)
	if encoding == "" {
		encoding = "utf8"
		if probe.IsText && probe.Encoding != "" {
			encoding = probe.Encoding
		}
	}

	content, err := contentprobe.Decode(data, encoding)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	totalSize := responseSize(resp, int64(len(data)))
	fileType := contracts.FileTypeFile
	if probe.MimeType != "" && isHTMLMediaType(probe.MimeType) {
		fileType = contracts.FileTypeDirectory
	}
	s.rememberMetadata(requestedPath, webAliasMetadata{
		size:       totalSize,
		mimeType:   probe.MimeType,
		modifiedAt: parseHTTPModified(resp.Header.Get("Last-Modified")),
		fileType:   fileType,
	})

	return &contracts.FileContent{
		Path:     requestedPath,
		Content:  content,
		Encoding: encoding,
		Size:     totalSize,
	}, nil
}

func (s *webAliasService) readFileRange(path string, offset int64, length int) (*contracts.FileContent, error) {
	requestedPath := pathref.Normalize(path)
	targetURL, rootOnly, err := normalizeWebAliasPath(requestedPath)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if rootOnly {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("cannot read scheme root")
	}
	if length <= 0 {
		return &contracts.FileContent{
			Path:     requestedPath,
			Content:  "",
			Encoding: "base64",
			Size:     0,
		}, nil
	}

	headers := map[string]string{
		"Range": fmt.Sprintf("bytes=%d-%d", offset, offset+int64(length)-1),
	}
	resp, err := s.request(http.MethodGet, targetURL, headers)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer resp.Body.Close()

	if resp.StatusCode == http.StatusRequestedRangeNotSatisfiable {
		return &contracts.FileContent{
			Path:     requestedPath,
			Content:  "",
			Encoding: "base64",
			Size:     0,
		}, nil
	}
	if resp.StatusCode < http.StatusOK || resp.StatusCode >= http.StatusBadRequest {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("request failed: HTTP %d", resp.StatusCode)
	}

	if resp.StatusCode == http.StatusOK && offset > 0 {
		if _, err := io.CopyN(io.Discard, resp.Body, offset); err != nil && err != io.EOF {
			return nil, err
		}
	}

	data, err := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(resp.Body, int64(length)))
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	totalSize := responseSize(resp, offset+int64(len(data)))
	s.rememberMetadata(requestedPath, webAliasMetadata{
		size:       totalSize,
		mimeType:   normalizedMediaType(resp.Header.Get("Content-Type")),
		modifiedAt: parseHTTPModified(resp.Header.Get("Last-Modified")),
		fileType:   contracts.FileTypeFile,
	})

	return &contracts.FileContent{
		Path:     requestedPath,
		Content:  base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString(data),
		Encoding: "base64",
		Size:     totalSize,
	}, nil
}

func (s *webAliasService) fetchSample(targetURL string) ([]byte, http.Header, int64, error) {
	resp, err := s.request(http.MethodGet, targetURL, map[string]string{
		"Range":           fmt.Sprintf("bytes=0-%d", contentprobe.SampleLimit-1),
		"Accept-Encoding": "identity",
	})
	if err != nil {
		return nil, nil, 0, err
	}
	defer resp.Body.Close()

	if resp.StatusCode < http.StatusOK || resp.StatusCode >= http.StatusBadRequest {
		return nil, nil, 0, fmt.Errorf("request failed: HTTP %d", resp.StatusCode)
	}

	sample, err := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(resp.Body, contentprobe.SampleLimit))
	if err != nil {
		return nil, nil, 0, err
	}

	return sample, resp.Header.Clone(), responseSize(resp, int64(len(sample))), nil
}

func (s *webAliasService) request(method string, targetURL string, extraHeaders map[string]string) (*http.Response, error) {
	req, err := http.NewRequest(method, targetURL, nil)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	req.Header.Set("Accept", "*/*")
	req.Header.Set("User-Agent", "WailsFileManager/1.0")
	for key, value := range extraHeaders {
		if strings.TrimSpace(value) == "" {
			continue
		}
		req.Header.Set(key, value)
	}
	return s.client.Do(req)
}

func normalizeWebAliasPath(path string) (string, bool, error) {
	normalized := pathref.Normalize(path)
	switch normalized {
	case pathref.HTTPAliasScheme, pathref.HTTPSAliasScheme:
		return normalized, true, nil
	}

	parsed, err := url.Parse(normalized)
	if err != nil {
		return "", false, err
	}
	if parsed.Host == "" {
		return "", false, fmt.Errorf("invalid web alias path %q", path)
	}

	switch strings.ToLower(parsed.Scheme) {
	case "http", "https":
	default:
		return "", false, fmt.Errorf("unsupported web alias scheme %q", parsed.Scheme)
	}

	parsed.Scheme = strings.ToLower(parsed.Scheme)
	parsed.Host = strings.ToLower(parsed.Host)
	parsed.Fragment = ""
	parsed.Path = strings.ReplaceAll(parsed.Path, "\\", "/")
	if parsed.Path == "/" {
		parsed.Path = ""
	} else {
		parsed.Path = strings.TrimRight(parsed.Path, "/")
	}
	parsed.RawPath = ""

	return parsed.String(), false, nil
}

func inferWebAliasFileTypeFromSample(targetURL string, contentType string, sample []byte) contracts.FileType {
	if !isHTMLMediaType(contentType) {
		return contracts.FileTypeFile
	}

	parsed, err := url.Parse(targetURL)
	if err != nil {
		return contracts.FileTypeFile
	}

	switch probeWebDirectoryListingSample(sample) {
	case webDirectoryListingYes:
		return contracts.FileTypeDirectory
	case webDirectoryListingNo:
		return contracts.FileTypeFile
	default:
		if parsed.RawQuery == "" && isLikelyWebPage(parsed) {
			return contracts.FileTypeDirectory
		}
		return contracts.FileTypeFile
	}
}

type webDirectoryListingProbe int

const (
	webDirectoryListingUnknown webDirectoryListingProbe = iota
	webDirectoryListingYes
	webDirectoryListingNo
)

func probeWebDirectoryListingSample(sample []byte) webDirectoryListingProbe {
	if len(sample) == 0 {
		return webDirectoryListingUnknown
	}

	doc, err := html.Parse(bytes.NewReader(sample))
	if err != nil {
		return webDirectoryListingUnknown
	}

	sawLabel := false
	for _, tag := range []string{"title", "h1"} {
		label := strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(firstElementText(doc, tag)))
		if label == "" {
			continue
		}
		sawLabel = true
		if isDirectoryListingLabel(label) {
			return webDirectoryListingYes
		}
	}

	if sawLabel {
		return webDirectoryListingNo
	}

	return webDirectoryListingUnknown
}

func discoverWebEntries(pageURL string, body []byte) []contracts.FileInfo {
	baseURL, err := url.Parse(pageURL)
	if err != nil {
		return []contracts.FileInfo{}
	}

	doc, err := html.Parse(bytes.NewReader(body))
	if err != nil {
		return []contracts.FileInfo{}
	}
	if !looksLikeDirectoryListing(doc) {
		return []contracts.FileInfo{}
	}

	resolvedBase := findHTMLBaseURL(doc, directoryListingBaseURL(baseURL))
	currentURL := canonicalWebURL(directoryListingCurrentURL(baseURL))
	entries := make(map[string]contracts.FileInfo)

	var walk func(*html.Node)
	walk = func(node *html.Node) {
		if node == nil {
			return
		}

		if node.Type == html.ElementNode {
			switch strings.ToLower(node.Data) {
			case "a":
				addWebEntry(entries, resolvedBase, currentURL, attrValue(node, "href"), true)
			}
		}

		for child := node.FirstChild; child != nil; child = child.NextSibling {
			walk(child)
		}
	}

	walk(doc)

	if len(entries) == 0 {
		return []contracts.FileInfo{}
	}

	keys := make([]string, 0, len(entries))
	for key := range entries {
		keys = append(keys, key)
	}
	sort.Strings(keys)

	files := make([]contracts.FileInfo, 0, len(keys))
	for _, key := range keys {
		files = append(files, entries[key])
	}
	return files
}

func directoryListingBaseURL(baseURL *url.URL) *url.URL {
	if baseURL == nil {
		return nil
	}

	resolved := *baseURL
	resolved.Path = strings.ReplaceAll(resolved.Path, "\\", "/")
	name := strings.ToLower(vpath.Base(resolved.Path))
	if name == "index.html" || name == "index.htm" {
		resolved.Path = vpath.Dir(resolved.Path)
	}
	if resolved.Path == "." || resolved.Path == "/" || resolved.Path == "" {
		resolved.Path = "/"
	} else if !strings.HasSuffix(resolved.Path, "/") {
		resolved.Path += "/"
	}
	return &resolved
}

func directoryListingCurrentURL(baseURL *url.URL) *url.URL {
	if baseURL == nil {
		return nil
	}

	resolved := *baseURL
	resolved.Path = strings.ReplaceAll(resolved.Path, "\\", "/")
	name := strings.ToLower(vpath.Base(resolved.Path))
	if name == "index.html" || name == "index.htm" {
		resolved.Path = vpath.Dir(resolved.Path)
	}
	if resolved.Path == "." || resolved.Path == "/" {
		resolved.Path = ""
	} else {
		resolved.Path = strings.TrimRight(resolved.Path, "/")
	}
	resolved.RawPath = ""
	return &resolved
}

func addWebEntry(entries map[string]contracts.FileInfo, baseURL *url.URL, currentURL string, rawRef string, navigable bool) {
	resolved, ok := resolveWebReference(baseURL, rawRef)
	if !ok {
		return
	}
	if strings.TrimSpace(resolved.RawQuery) != "" {
		return
	}

	target := canonicalWebURL(resolved)
	if target == "" || target == currentURL {
		return
	}
	if !strings.HasPrefix(target, currentURL+"/") {
		return
	}
	if _, exists := entries[target]; exists {
		return
	}

	fileType := contracts.FileTypeFile
	if navigable && isLikelyWebPage(resolved) {
		fileType = contracts.FileTypeDirectory
	}

	entries[target] = contracts.FileInfo{
		Name:        webEntryDisplayName(resolved),
		Path:        target,
		Type:        fileType,
		MimeType:    mime.TypeByExtension(strings.ToLower(vpath.Ext(resolved.Path))),
		Permissions: "r--",
		IsHidden:    false,
	}
}

func cachedWebResources(pageURL string) []contracts.FileInfo {
	resources := webresourcecache.Load(pageURL)
	if len(resources) == 0 {
		return []contracts.FileInfo{}
	}

	entries := make([]contracts.FileInfo, 0, len(resources))
	for _, resource := range resources {
		parsed, err := url.Parse(resource.URL)
		if err != nil {
			continue
		}
		if !shouldIncludeCachedWebResource(parsed, resource.InitiatorType, resource.MimeType, resource.Size) {
			continue
		}
		entries = append(entries, contracts.FileInfo{
			Name:        webEntryDisplayName(parsed),
			Path:        canonicalWebURL(parsed),
			Type:        contracts.FileTypeFile,
			MimeType:    chooseCachedResourceMimeType(parsed, resource.MimeType),
			Size:        resource.Size,
			Permissions: "r--",
			IsHidden:    false,
		})
	}
	if len(entries) == 0 {
		return []contracts.FileInfo{}
	}
	sort.Slice(entries, func(i, j int) bool {
		return entries[i].Path < entries[j].Path
	})
	return entries
}

func shouldIncludeCachedWebResource(parsed *url.URL, initiatorType string, mimeType string, size int64) bool {
	if parsed == nil || size <= 0 {
		return false
	}
	mimeType = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(mimeType))
	ext := strings.ToLower(vpath.Ext(parsed.Path))
	if ext != "" {
		if isLikelyWebPage(parsed) {
			return false
		}
		return true
	}
	if strings.HasPrefix(mimeType, "application/javascript") ||
		strings.HasPrefix(mimeType, "text/javascript") ||
		strings.HasPrefix(mimeType, "text/css") ||
		strings.HasPrefix(mimeType, "image/") ||
		strings.HasPrefix(mimeType, "audio/") ||
		strings.HasPrefix(mimeType, "video/") ||
		strings.HasPrefix(mimeType, "font/") ||
		strings.Contains(mimeType, "font") {
		return true
	}
	switch strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(initiatorType)) {
	case "script", "css", "img", "image", "audio", "video", "track", "font", "link", "beacon":
		return true
	default:
		return false
	}
}

func chooseCachedResourceMimeType(parsed *url.URL, cached string) string {
	if trimmed := strings.TrimSpace(cached); trimmed != "" {
		return trimmed
	}
	return mime.TypeByExtension(strings.ToLower(vpath.Ext(parsed.Path)))
}

func resolveWebReference(baseURL *url.URL, rawRef string) (*url.URL, bool) {
	ref := strings.TrimSpace(rawRef)
	if ref == "" {
		return nil, false
	}

	lower := strings.ToLower(ref)
	if strings.HasPrefix(lower, "#") ||
		strings.HasPrefix(lower, "javascript:") ||
		strings.HasPrefix(lower, "mailto:") ||
		strings.HasPrefix(lower, "tel:") ||
		strings.HasPrefix(lower, "data:") {
		return nil, false
	}

	parsed, err := url.Parse(ref)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, false
	}
	resolved := baseURL.ResolveReference(parsed)
	switch strings.ToLower(resolved.Scheme) {
	case "http", "https":
		resolved.Fragment = ""
		return resolved, true
	default:
		return nil, false
	}
}

func findHTMLBaseURL(doc *html.Node, fallback *url.URL) *url.URL {
	var walk func(*html.Node) *url.URL
	walk = func(node *html.Node) *url.URL {
		if node == nil {
			return nil
		}

		if node.Type == html.ElementNode && strings.EqualFold(node.Data, "base") {
			href := strings.TrimSpace(attrValue(node, "href"))
			if href != "" {
				if parsed, ok := resolveWebReference(fallback, href); ok {
					return parsed
				}
			}
		}

		for child := node.FirstChild; child != nil; child = child.NextSibling {
			if resolved := walk(child); resolved != nil {
				return resolved
			}
		}
		return nil
	}

	if resolved := walk(doc); resolved != nil {
		return resolved
	}
	return fallback
}

func looksLikeDirectoryListing(doc *html.Node) bool {
	for _, tag := range []string{"title", "h1"} {
		if label := strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(firstElementText(doc, tag))); isDirectoryListingLabel(label) {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}

func isDirectoryListingLabel(label string) bool {
	return strings.HasPrefix(label, "index of") || strings.HasPrefix(label, "directory listing for")
}

func firstElementText(root *html.Node, tag string) string {
	var walk func(*html.Node) string
	walk = func(node *html.Node) string {
		if node == nil {
			return ""
		}
		if node.Type == html.ElementNode && strings.EqualFold(node.Data, tag) {
			return nodeText(node)
		}
		for child := node.FirstChild; child != nil; child = child.NextSibling {
			if text := walk(child); text != "" {
				return text
			}
		}
		return ""
	}
	return walk(root)
}

func nodeText(node *html.Node) string {
	var parts []string
	var walk func(*html.Node)
	walk = func(current *html.Node) {
		if current == nil {
			return
		}
		if current.Type == html.TextNode {
			if text := strings.TrimSpace(current.Data); text != "" {
				parts = append(parts, text)
			}
		}
		for child := current.FirstChild; child != nil; child = child.NextSibling {
			walk(child)
		}
	}
	walk(node)
	return strings.Join(parts, " ")
}

func attrValue(node *html.Node, name string) string {
	for _, attr := range node.Attr {
		if strings.EqualFold(attr.Key, name) {
			return attr.Val
		}
	}
	return ""
}

func parseSrcset(raw string) []string {
	if strings.TrimSpace(raw) == "" {
		return nil
	}

	parts := strings.Split(raw, ",")
	values := make([]string, 0, len(parts))
	for _, part := range parts {
		fields := strings.Fields(strings.TrimSpace(part))
		if len(fields) == 0 {
			continue
		}
		values = append(values, fields[0])
	}
	return values
}

func webEntryDisplayName(parsed *url.URL) string {
	trimmedPath := strings.Trim(strings.TrimRight(parsed.Path, "/"), "/")
	if trimmedPath == "" {
		if parsed.RawQuery != "" {
			return parsed.Host + "?" + parsed.RawQuery
		}
		return parsed.Host
	}

	name := vpath.Base(trimmedPath)
	if name == "." || name == "/" || name == "" {
		name = parsed.Host
	}
	if parsed.RawQuery != "" {
		return name + "?" + parsed.RawQuery
	}
	return name
}

func canonicalWebURL(parsed *url.URL) string {
	if parsed == nil {
		return ""
	}

	clone := *parsed
	clone.Scheme = strings.ToLower(clone.Scheme)
	clone.Host = strings.ToLower(clone.Host)
	clone.Fragment = ""
	clone.Path = strings.ReplaceAll(clone.Path, "\\", "/")
	if clone.Path == "/" {
		clone.Path = ""
	} else {
		clone.Path = strings.TrimRight(clone.Path, "/")
	}
	clone.RawPath = ""
	return clone.String()
}

func isLikelyWebPage(parsed *url.URL) bool {
	if parsed == nil {
		return false
	}

	if strings.HasSuffix(parsed.Path, "/") {
		return true
	}

	switch strings.ToLower(vpath.Ext(parsed.Path)) {
	case ".html", ".htm", ".xhtml", ".shtml", ".php", ".asp", ".aspx", ".jsp", ".jspx", ".cfm":
		return true
	default:
		return false
	}
}

func isHTMLResponse(contentType string, body []byte) bool {
	if isHTMLMediaType(normalizedMediaType(contentType)) {
		return true
	}
	return isHTMLMediaType(contentprobe.ProbeBytes(body).MimeType)
}

func isHTMLMediaType(contentType string) bool {
	switch normalizedMediaType(contentType) {
	case "text/html", "application/xhtml+xml":
		return true
	default:
		return false
	}
}

func isTextMediaType(contentType string) bool {
	contentType = normalizedMediaType(contentType)
	if contentType == "" {
		return false
	}
	if strings.HasPrefix(contentType, "text/") {
		return true
	}
	return strings.HasSuffix(contentType, "+json") || strings.HasSuffix(contentType, "+xml") ||
		contentType == "application/json" || contentType == "application/xml" ||
		contentType == "application/javascript" || contentType == "application/ecmascript"
}

func normalizedMediaType(contentType string) string {
	if contentType == "" {
		return ""
	}
	mediaType, _, err := mime.ParseMediaType(contentType)
	if err != nil {
		return strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(strings.Split(contentType, ";")[0]))
	}
	return strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(mediaType))
}

func parseHTTPModified(raw string) int64 {
	if strings.TrimSpace(raw) == "" {
		return 0
	}
	timestamp, err := time.Parse(http.TimeFormat, raw)
	if err != nil {
		return 0
	}
	return timestamp.Unix()
}

func responseSize(resp *http.Response, fallback int64) int64 {
	if resp == nil {
		return fallback
	}

	if contentRange := strings.TrimSpace(resp.Header.Get("Content-Range")); contentRange != "" {
		if slash := strings.LastIndex(contentRange, "/"); slash >= 0 && slash < len(contentRange)-1 {
			if size, err := strconv.ParseInt(contentRange[slash+1:], 10, 64); err == nil {
				return size
			}
		}
	}

	if resp.ContentLength > 0 {
		return resp.ContentLength
	}
	if headerLength := strings.TrimSpace(resp.Header.Get("Content-Length")); headerLength != "" {
		if size, err := strconv.ParseInt(headerLength, 10, 64); err == nil {
			return size
		}
	}
	return fallback
}

func sumFileSizes(entries []contracts.FileInfo) int64 {
	var total int64
	for _, entry := range entries {
		total += entry.Size
	}
	return total
}
`````

`````go
package navigation

import "sync"

const defaultMaxHistory = 200

type paneHistory struct {
	back    []string
	forward []string
}

// Manager stores per-pane navigation history independently of the Wails binding layer.
type Manager struct {
	mu      sync.Mutex
	panes   map[string]*paneHistory
	maxSize int
}

func NewManager() *Manager {
	return &Manager{
		panes:   make(map[string]*paneHistory),
		maxSize: defaultMaxHistory,
	}
}

func (m *Manager) pane(id string) *paneHistory {
	if _, ok := m.panes[id]; !ok {
		m.panes[id] = &paneHistory{}
	}
	return m.panes[id]
}

// Navigate pushes a new path and clears the forward stack.
func (m *Manager) Navigate(paneID, path string) {
	m.mu.Lock()
	defer m.mu.Unlock()

	pane := m.pane(paneID)
	if len(pane.back) > 0 && pane.back[len(pane.back)-1] == path {
		return
	}

	pane.back = append(pane.back, path)
	if len(pane.back) > m.maxSize {
		pane.back = pane.back[len(pane.back)-m.maxSize:]
	}
	pane.forward = nil
}

// GoBack moves back one step and returns the new current path.
func (m *Manager) GoBack(paneID string) string {
	m.mu.Lock()
	defer m.mu.Unlock()

	pane := m.pane(paneID)
	if len(pane.back) < 2 {
		return ""
	}

	current := pane.back[len(pane.back)-1]
	pane.back = pane.back[:len(pane.back)-1]
	pane.forward = append(pane.forward, current)

	return pane.back[len(pane.back)-1]
}

// GoForward moves forward one step and returns the new current path.
func (m *Manager) GoForward(paneID string) string {
	m.mu.Lock()
	defer m.mu.Unlock()

	pane := m.pane(paneID)
	if len(pane.forward) == 0 {
		return ""
	}

	next := pane.forward[len(pane.forward)-1]
	pane.forward = pane.forward[:len(pane.forward)-1]
	pane.back = append(pane.back, next)

	return next
}

func (m *Manager) CanGoBack(paneID string) bool {
	m.mu.Lock()
	defer m.mu.Unlock()
	return len(m.pane(paneID).back) >= 2
}

func (m *Manager) CanGoForward(paneID string) bool {
	m.mu.Lock()
	defer m.mu.Unlock()
	return len(m.pane(paneID).forward) > 0
}

func (m *Manager) CurrentPath(paneID string) string {
	m.mu.Lock()
	defer m.mu.Unlock()
	pane := m.pane(paneID)
	if len(pane.back) == 0 {
		return ""
	}
	return pane.back[len(pane.back)-1]
}

func (m *Manager) ClearHistory(paneID string) {
	m.mu.Lock()
	defer m.mu.Unlock()
	m.panes[paneID] = &paneHistory{}
}
`````

`````go
package navigation

import (
	"testing"

	contracts "wails-app/internal/contracts"
)

func TestSyncPathKeepsGoUpAlignedWithPanePath(t *testing.T) {
	manager := NewManager()
	service := NewService(manager, func(path string, showHidden bool) (*contracts.DirectoryListing, error) {
		return &contracts.DirectoryListing{Path: path}, nil
	})

	service.SyncPath("left", "smb://fileserver/share/docs")

	listing, err := service.GoUp("left")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("GoUp returned error: %v", err)
	}
	if listing.Path != "smb://fileserver/share" {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected parent path\nwant: %q\n got: %q", "smb://fileserver/share", listing.Path)
	}
}
`````

## File: manager/internal/navigation/service.go
`````go
package navigation

import (
	"fmt"
	"path/filepath"

	contracts "wails-app/internal/contracts"
	"wails-app/internal/pathref"
)

// Service owns pane navigation orchestration while delegating history storage
// to Manager and directory listing to the filesystem layer.
type Service struct {
	manager       *Manager
	listDirectory func(path string, showHidden bool) (*contracts.DirectoryListing, error)
}

func NewService(manager *Manager, listDirectory func(path string, showHidden bool) (*contracts.DirectoryListing, error)) *Service {
	return &Service{
		manager:       manager,
		listDirectory: listDirectory,
	}
}

func (s *Service) Navigate(paneID, path string) (*contracts.DirectoryListing, error) {
	s.manager.Navigate(paneID, path)
	return s.listDirectory(path, false)
}

func (s *Service) NavigateShowHidden(paneID, path string, showHidden bool) (*contracts.DirectoryListing, error) {
	s.manager.Navigate(paneID, path)
	return s.listDirectory(path, showHidden)
}

func (s *Service) Back(paneID string) (*contracts.DirectoryListing, error) {
	path := s.manager.GoBack(paneID)
	if path == "" {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("no previous location for pane %q", paneID)
	}
	return s.listDirectory(path, false)
}

func (s *Service) Forward(paneID string) (*contracts.DirectoryListing, error) {
	path := s.manager.GoForward(paneID)
	if path == "" {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("no forward location for pane %q", paneID)
	}
	return s.listDirectory(path, false)
}

func (s *Service) GoUp(paneID string) (*contracts.DirectoryListing, error) {
	current := s.manager.CurrentPath(paneID)
	if current == "" {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("no current path for pane %q", paneID)
	}
	if parent, ok := pathref.Parent(current); ok {
		return s.Navigate(paneID, parent)
	}
	parent := filepath.ToSlash(filepath.Dir(current))
	if parent == filepath.ToSlash(current) {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("already at root")
	}
	return s.Navigate(paneID, parent)
}

// SyncPath updates the backend navigation manager to match a pane's current
// path without triggering another directory read.
func (s *Service) SyncPath(paneID, path string) {
	if path == "" {
		return
	}
	s.manager.Navigate(paneID, path)
}
`````

`````go
	op.UpdateProgress(1, 100, "file1.txt", 50)
	if op.Progress.PercentComplete != 10 {
		t.Fatalf("expected 10%%, got %f", op.Progress.PercentComplete)
	}

	// Sleep so duration > 0.1s for speed calculation
	time.Sleep(150 * time.Millisecond)
	op.UpdateProgress(2, 300, "file2.txt", 60)

	if op.Progress.ProcessedItems != 2 || op.Progress.ProcessedBytes != 300 {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected progress values")
	}
	if op.Progress.CurrentFile != "file2.txt" {
		t.Fatalf("expected current file 'file2.txt', got %s", op.Progress.CurrentFile)
	}
	if op.Progress.SpeedBytesPerSec == 0 {
		t.Fatal("expected non-zero instant speed after 0.1s+ gap")
	}
	if op.Progress.AvgSpeedBytesPerSec == 0 {
		t.Fatal("expected non-zero avg speed")
	}

	// Events: start + start (SetTotal) + progress + progress
	if len(*events) < 4 {
		t.Fatalf("expected at least 4 events, got %d", len(*events))
	}
}

	op.Complete()

	if op.Progress.Status != contracts.StatusCompleted {

	}
	if op.Progress.PercentComplete != 100 {
		t.Fatalf("expected 100%%, got %f", op.Progress.PercentComplete)
	}
	if op.Progress.EndTime == nil {
		t.Fatal("expected EndTime to be set")
	}

func TestSetErrorSetsFinalState(t *testing.T) {
	m, events := newTestManager()
	op := m.StartOperation(contracts.OpCopy, "", "", "")
	op.SetError(os.ErrPermission)

	if op.Progress.Status != contracts.StatusError {
		t.Fatalf("expected status ERROR, got %s", op.Progress.Status)
	}
	if op.Progress.Error == nil || *op.Progress.Error != os.ErrPermission.Error() {
		t.Fatalf("expected error string to be set")
	}
	if op.Progress.EndTime == nil {
		t.Fatal("expected EndTime to be set")
	}
	ce := (*events)[1].data.(completeEvent)
	if ce.Status != "error" {
		t.Fatalf("expected complete status 'error', got %s", ce.Status)
	}
	if ce.Error != os.ErrPermission.Error() {
		t.Fatalf("expected error message in complete event")
	}
}

func TestCancelSignal(t *testing.T) {
	m, _ := newTestManager()

func TestCalculateSize(t *testing.T) {
	tmp := t.TempDir()
	// Create nested structure
	if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(tmp, "a.txt"), []byte("hello"), 0644); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	sub := filepath.Join(tmp, "sub")
	if err := os.Mkdir(sub, 0755); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(sub, "b.txt"), []byte("world!!"), 0644); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}

	items, bytes := CalculateSize(tmp)
	if items != 4 { // a.txt, sub, sub/b.txt, tmp root counted by walk
		t.Fatalf("expected 4 items, got %d", items)
	}
	if bytes != 12 { // "hello" (5) + "world!!" (7)
		t.Fatalf("expected 12 bytes, got %d", bytes)
	}
}

func TestCalculateSizeMissingPath(t *testing.T) {
	items, bytes := CalculateSize("/nonexistent/path/12345")
	if items != 0 || bytes != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("expected 0 items and 0 bytes for missing path, got %d / %d", items, bytes)
	}
}
`````

`````go
package ops

import (
	"fmt"
	"io/fs"
	"math"
	"path/filepath"
	"sync"
	"time"

	contracts "wails-app/internal/contracts"
)

type startEvent struct {
	ID          string   `json:"id"`
	Kind        string   `json:"kind"`
	Title       string   `json:"title"`
	Sources     []string `json:"sources"`
	Destination string   `json:"destination,omitempty"`
	TotalBytes  int64    `json:"totalBytes"`
	TotalItems  int64    `json:"totalItems"`
}

type progressEvent struct {
	ID              string  `json:"id"`
	ProcessedBytes  int64   `json:"processedBytes"`
	ProcessedItems  int64   `json:"processedItems"`
	CurrentFile     string  `json:"currentFile,omitempty"`
	CurrentFileSize int64   `json:"currentFileSize,omitempty"`
	SpeedBps        float64 `json:"speedBps"`
	ElapsedMs       int64   `json:"elapsedMs"`
	RemainingMs     int64   `json:"remainingMs"`
}

type completeEvent struct {
	ID           string       `json:"id"`
	Status       string       `json:"status"`
	Error        string       `json:"error,omitempty"`
	FinalMetrics finalMetrics `json:"finalMetrics"`
	Timing       finalTiming  `json:"timing"`
}

type finalMetrics struct {
	TotalBytes     int64 `json:"totalBytes"`
	ProcessedBytes int64 `json:"processedBytes"`
	TotalItems     int64 `json:"totalItems"`
	ProcessedItems int64 `json:"processedItems"`
}

type finalTiming struct {
	StartedAt            int64   `json:"startedAt"`
	ElapsedMs            int64   `json:"elapsedMs"`
	EstimatedRemainingMs int64   `json:"estimatedRemainingMs"`
	SpeedBytesPerSecond  float64 `json:"speedBytesPerSecond"`
}

const maxSpeedSamples = 10

type speedRingBuffer struct {
	buf  [maxSpeedSamples]float64
	head int
	len  int
}

func (r *speedRingBuffer) push(v float64) {
	r.buf[r.head] = v
	r.head = (r.head + 1) % maxSpeedSamples
	if r.len < maxSpeedSamples {
		r.len++
	}
}

func (r *speedRingBuffer) avg() float64 {
	if r.len == 0 {
		return 0
	}
	var sum float64
	for i := 0; i < r.len; i++ {
		idx := (r.head - r.len + i) % maxSpeedSamples
		if idx < 0 {
			idx += maxSpeedSamples
		}
		sum += r.buf[idx]
	}
	return sum / float64(r.len)
}

type progressSnapshot struct {
	timeAtStart     time.Time
	lastUpdateTime  time.Time
	lastUpdateBytes int64
	speedSamples    speedRingBuffer
}

type ActiveOperation struct {
	ID        string
	Type      contracts.OperationType
	Progress  contracts.OperationProgress
	snapshot  progressSnapshot
	cancel    chan struct{}
	mu        sync.RWMutex
	emitEvent func(string, interface{})
}

type Manager struct {
	operations map[string]*ActiveOperation
	mu         sync.RWMutex
	nextID     int
	emitEvent  func(string, interface{})
}

func NewManager() *Manager {
	return &Manager{operations: make(map[string]*ActiveOperation), nextID: 1}
}

func (om *Manager) SetEmitter(emitEvent func(string, interface{})) {
	om.mu.Lock()
	defer om.mu.Unlock()
	om.emitEvent = emitEvent
	for _, op := range om.operations {
		op.emitEvent = emitEvent
	}
}

func (om *Manager) StartOperation(opType contracts.OperationType, title, source, dest string) *ActiveOperation {
	om.mu.Lock()
	defer om.mu.Unlock()

	id := fmt.Sprintf("op-%d-%d", time.Now().Unix(), om.nextID)
	om.nextID++
	now := time.Now()
	op := &ActiveOperation{
		ID:        id,
		Type:      opType,
		emitEvent: om.emitEvent,
		Progress: contracts.OperationProgress{
			ID:              id,
			Type:            opType,
			Status:          contracts.StatusRunning,
			Title:           title,
			SourcePath:      source,
			DestinationPath: dest,
			StartTime:       now.UnixMilli(),
		},
		snapshot: progressSnapshot{timeAtStart: now, lastUpdateTime: now},
		cancel:   make(chan struct{}),
	}
	om.operations[id] = op
	op.emitStart(source, dest)
	return op
}

func (om *Manager) GetOperation(id string) *ActiveOperation {
	om.mu.RLock()
	defer om.mu.RUnlock()
	return om.operations[id]
}

func (om *Manager) ListActiveOperations() []contracts.OperationProgress {
	om.mu.RLock()
	defer om.mu.RUnlock()
	result := make([]contracts.OperationProgress, 0)
	for _, op := range om.operations {
		op.mu.RLock()
		prog := op.Progress
		op.mu.RUnlock()
		if prog.Status == contracts.StatusRunning || prog.Status == contracts.StatusPaused {
			result = append(result, prog)
		}
	}
	return result
}

func (om *Manager) CancelOperation(id string) bool {
	om.mu.Lock()
	op, exists := om.operations[id]
	if !exists {
		om.mu.Unlock()
		return false
	}
	op.mu.Lock()
	om.mu.Unlock()
	defer op.mu.Unlock()
	if op.Progress.Status == contracts.StatusRunning {
		close(op.cancel)
		op.Progress.Status = contracts.StatusCancelled
		op.emitComplete("cancelled", "")
		return true
	}
	return false
}

func (om *Manager) RemoveOperation(id string) {
	om.mu.Lock()
	delete(om.operations, id)
	om.mu.Unlock()
}

func (op *ActiveOperation) SetTotal(totalItems, totalBytes int64) {
	op.mu.Lock()
	defer op.mu.Unlock()
	op.Progress.TotalItems = totalItems
	op.Progress.TotalBytes = totalBytes
	op.emitStart(op.Progress.SourcePath, op.Progress.DestinationPath)
}

func (op *ActiveOperation) UpdateProgress(processedItems, processedBytes int64, currentFile string, currentFileSize int64) {
	op.mu.Lock()
	defer op.mu.Unlock()
	now := time.Now()
	op.Progress.ProcessedItems = processedItems
	op.Progress.ProcessedBytes = processedBytes
	op.Progress.CurrentFile = currentFile
	op.Progress.CurrentFileSize = currentFileSize
	if op.Progress.TotalBytes > 0 {
		op.Progress.PercentComplete = math.Min(100, float64(processedBytes)/float64(op.Progress.TotalBytes)*100)
	} else if op.Progress.TotalItems > 0 {
		op.Progress.PercentComplete = math.Min(100, float64(processedItems)/float64(op.Progress.TotalItems)*100)
	}
	duration := now.Sub(op.snapshot.lastUpdateTime).Seconds()
	if duration > 0.1 {
		bytesDelta := processedBytes - op.snapshot.lastUpdateBytes
		instantSpeed := float64(bytesDelta) / duration
		op.snapshot.speedSamples.push(instantSpeed)
		op.Progress.AvgSpeedBytesPerSec = op.snapshot.speedSamples.avg()
		op.Progress.SpeedBytesPerSec = instantSpeed
		op.snapshot.lastUpdateTime = now
		op.snapshot.lastUpdateBytes = processedBytes
	}
	elapsed := now.Sub(op.snapshot.timeAtStart)
	op.Progress.ElapsedSeconds = int64(elapsed.Seconds())
	var etaMs int64
	if op.Progress.AvgSpeedBytesPerSec > 0 && op.Progress.TotalBytes > 0 {
		remainingBytes := op.Progress.TotalBytes - processedBytes
		etaMs = int64(float64(remainingBytes) / op.Progress.AvgSpeedBytesPerSec * 1000)
		op.Progress.ETASeconds = etaMs / 1000
	}
	op.emitProgress(elapsed.Milliseconds(), etaMs)
}

func (op *ActiveOperation) Complete() {
	op.mu.Lock()
	defer op.mu.Unlock()
	now := time.Now().UnixMilli()
	op.Progress.Status = contracts.StatusCompleted
	op.Progress.EndTime = &now
	op.Progress.PercentComplete = 100
	op.Progress.ETASeconds = 0
	op.emitComplete("completed", "")
}

func (op *ActiveOperation) SetError(err error) {
	op.mu.Lock()
	defer op.mu.Unlock()
	now := time.Now().UnixMilli()
	msg := err.Error()
	op.Progress.Status = contracts.StatusError
	op.Progress.EndTime = &now
	op.Progress.Error = &msg
	op.emitComplete("error", msg)
}

func (op *ActiveOperation) IsCancelled() bool {
	select {
	case <-op.cancel:
		return true
	default:
		return false
	}
}

func (op *ActiveOperation) CancelSignal() <-chan struct{} {
	return op.cancel
}

func (op *ActiveOperation) AddTotalBytes(delta int64) {
	op.mu.Lock()
	defer op.mu.Unlock()
	op.Progress.TotalBytes += delta
}

func (op *ActiveOperation) emitStart(source, dest string) {
	if op.emitEvent == nil {
		return
	}
	op.emitEvent("operation:start", startEvent{ID: op.ID, Kind: operationKind(op.Type), Title: op.Progress.Title, Sources: []string{source}, Destination: dest, TotalBytes: op.Progress.TotalBytes, TotalItems: op.Progress.TotalItems})
}

func (op *ActiveOperation) emitProgress(elapsedMs, remainingMs int64) {
	if op.emitEvent == nil {
		return
	}
	op.emitEvent("operation:progress", progressEvent{ID: op.ID, ProcessedBytes: op.Progress.ProcessedBytes, ProcessedItems: op.Progress.ProcessedItems, CurrentFile: op.Progress.CurrentFile, CurrentFileSize: op.Progress.CurrentFileSize, SpeedBps: op.Progress.AvgSpeedBytesPerSec, ElapsedMs: elapsedMs, RemainingMs: remainingMs})
}

func (op *ActiveOperation) emitComplete(status, errMsg string) {
	if op.emitEvent == nil {
		return
	}
	elapsed := time.Since(op.snapshot.timeAtStart)
	op.emitEvent("operation:complete", completeEvent{ID: op.ID, Status: status, Error: errMsg, FinalMetrics: finalMetrics{TotalBytes: op.Progress.TotalBytes, ProcessedBytes: op.Progress.ProcessedBytes, TotalItems: op.Progress.TotalItems, ProcessedItems: op.Progress.ProcessedItems}, Timing: finalTiming{StartedAt: op.Progress.StartTime, ElapsedMs: elapsed.Milliseconds(), EstimatedRemainingMs: 0, SpeedBytesPerSecond: op.Progress.AvgSpeedBytesPerSec}})
}

func CalculateSize(path string) (items, bytes int64) {
	filepath.WalkDir(path, func(_ string, d fs.DirEntry, err error) error {
		if err != nil {
			return nil
		}
		items++
		if !d.IsDir() {
			if info, infoErr := d.Info(); infoErr == nil {
				bytes += info.Size()
			}
		}
		return nil
	})
	return
}

func operationKind(t contracts.OperationType) string {
	switch t {
	case contracts.OpCopy:
		return "copy"
	case contracts.OpMove:
		return "move"
	case contracts.OpDelete:
		return "delete"
	case contracts.OpArchive:
		return "archive"
	case contracts.OpExtract:
		return "extract"
	case contracts.OpSearch:
		return "search"
	case contracts.OpCalculate:
		return "calculate"
	default:
		return "copy"
	}
}
`````

## File: manager/internal/pathref/cloud.go
`````go
package pathref

import (
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"
	"sync"
	"time"
)

type LocalCloudProvider struct {
	Name     string
	Scheme   string
	RootPath string
}

type localCloudSpec struct {
	name       string
	scheme     string
	candidates func(home string) []string
}

var (
	userHomeDirFn = os.UserHomeDir
	pathExistsFn  = func(path string) bool {
		info, err := os.Stat(path)
		return err == nil && info.IsDir()
	}
)

var (
	cloudCacheMu     sync.RWMutex
	cloudCache       []LocalCloudProvider
	cloudCacheHome   string
	cloudCacheTime   time.Time
	cloudCacheTTL    = 60 * time.Second
)

var localCloudSpecs = []localCloudSpec{
	{
		name:   "OneDrive",
		scheme: OneDriveScheme,
		candidates: func(home string) []string {
			return []string{
				filepath.Join(home, "OneDrive"),
				filepath.Join(home, "OneDrive - Personal"),
				filepath.Join(home, "Library", "CloudStorage", "OneDrive*"),
			}
		},
	},
	{
		name:   "Google Drive",
		scheme: GDriveScheme,
		candidates: func(home string) []string {
			return []string{
				filepath.Join(home, "Google Drive", "My Drive"),
				filepath.Join(home, "Google Drive"),
				filepath.Join(home, "My Drive"),
				filepath.Join(home, "Library", "CloudStorage", "GoogleDrive*"),
			}
		},
	},
	{
		name:   "Dropbox",
		scheme: DropboxScheme,
		candidates: func(home string) []string {
			return []string{
				filepath.Join(home, "Dropbox"),
				filepath.Join(home, "Library", "CloudStorage", "Dropbox*"),
			}
		},
	},
}

func AvailableLocalCloudProviders() []LocalCloudProvider {
	home, err := userHomeDirFn()
	if err != nil || strings.TrimSpace(home) == "" {
		cloudCacheMu.Lock()
		cloudCache = nil
		cloudCacheHome = ""
		cloudCacheTime = time.Now()
		cloudCacheMu.Unlock()
		return nil
	}

	cloudCacheMu.RLock()
	if time.Since(cloudCacheTime) < cloudCacheTTL && cloudCache != nil && filepath.Clean(home) == cloudCacheHome {
		result := make([]LocalCloudProvider, len(cloudCache))
		copy(result, cloudCache)
		cloudCacheMu.RUnlock()
		return result
	}
	cloudCacheMu.RUnlock()

	cloudCacheMu.Lock()
	defer cloudCacheMu.Unlock()
	// Double-check after acquiring write lock.
	if time.Since(cloudCacheTime) < cloudCacheTTL && cloudCache != nil && filepath.Clean(home) == cloudCacheHome {
		result := make([]LocalCloudProvider, len(cloudCache))
		copy(result, cloudCache)
		return result
	}

	providers := make([]LocalCloudProvider, 0, len(localCloudSpecs))
	for _, spec := range localCloudSpecs {
		root := resolveExistingCloudRoot(home, spec.candidates(home))
		if root == "" {
			continue
		}
		providers = append(providers, LocalCloudProvider{
			Name:     spec.name,
			Scheme:   spec.scheme,
			RootPath: root,
		})
	}

	cloudCache = providers
	cloudCacheHome = filepath.Clean(home)
	cloudCacheTime = time.Now()
	result := make([]LocalCloudProvider, len(providers))
	copy(result, providers)
	return result
}

func ResolveLocalCloudPath(path string) (string, bool) {
	normalized := Normalize(path)
	for _, provider := range AvailableLocalCloudProviders() {
		if !strings.HasPrefix(strings.ToLower(normalized), provider.Scheme) {
			continue
		}

		suffix := strings.TrimPrefix(normalized, provider.Scheme)
		if suffix == "" {
			return filepath.Clean(provider.RootPath), true
		}
		return filepath.Join(provider.RootPath, filepath.FromSlash(suffix)), true
	}
	return "", false
}

func LocalCloudAliasFromNativePath(path string) (string, bool) {
	native := filepath.ToSlash(filepath.Clean(path))
	for _, provider := range AvailableLocalCloudProviders() {
		root := filepath.ToSlash(filepath.Clean(provider.RootPath))
		if !pathHasPrefix(native, root) {
			continue
		}

		suffix := strings.TrimPrefix(native, root)
		suffix = strings.TrimPrefix(suffix, "/")
		if suffix == "" {
			return provider.Scheme, true
		}
		return provider.Scheme + suffix, true
	}
	return "", false
}

func IsLocalCloud(path string) bool {
	normalized := strings.ToLower(Normalize(path))
	return strings.HasPrefix(normalized, OneDriveScheme) ||
		strings.HasPrefix(normalized, GDriveScheme) ||
		strings.HasPrefix(normalized, DropboxScheme)
}

func resolveExistingCloudRoot(home string, candidates []string) string {
	for _, candidate := range candidates {
		for _, expanded := range expandCloudCandidate(candidate) {
			if !pathExistsFn(expanded) {
				continue
			}
			return filepath.Clean(expanded)
		}
	}
	return ""
}

func expandCloudCandidate(pattern string) []string {
	if strings.ContainsAny(pattern, "*?[") {
		matches, err := filepath.Glob(pattern)
		if err != nil {
			return nil
		}
		return matches
	}
	return []string{pattern}
}

func pathHasPrefix(path string, prefix string) bool {
	if filepath.Separator == '\\' {
		path = strings.ToLower(path)
		prefix = strings.ToLower(prefix)
	}

	if path == prefix {
		return true
	}

	return strings.HasPrefix(path, prefix+"/")
}
`````
