`````go
package pathref

import (
	"net/url"
	"path/filepath"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
)

const (
	DriveScheme      = "filesystem://"
	RegistryScheme   = "registry://"
	SearchScheme     = "search://"
	HTTPAliasScheme  = "http://"
	HTTPSAliasScheme = "https://"
	SMBScheme        = "smb://"
	S3Scheme         = "s3://"
	OneDriveScheme   = "onedrive://"
	GDriveScheme     = "gdrive://"
	DropboxScheme    = "dropbox://"
	registryVFSRoot  = "/registry"
	smbVFSRoot       = "/remote/smb"
	s3VFSRoot        = "/remote/s3"
	oneDriveVFSRoot  = "/remote/onedrive"
	gDriveVFSRoot    = "/remote/gdrive"
	dropboxVFSRoot   = "/remote/dropbox"
)

type aliasSpec struct {
	scheme  string
	vfsRoot string
}

type SearchQuery struct {
	BasePath  string `json:"basePath"`
	Pattern   string `json:"pattern"`
	Recursive bool   `json:"recursive"`
}

var aliasSpecs = []aliasSpec{
	{scheme: RegistryScheme, vfsRoot: registryVFSRoot},
	{scheme: SearchScheme},
	{scheme: HTTPSAliasScheme},
	{scheme: HTTPAliasScheme},
	{scheme: SMBScheme, vfsRoot: smbVFSRoot},
	{scheme: S3Scheme, vfsRoot: s3VFSRoot},
	{scheme: OneDriveScheme, vfsRoot: oneDriveVFSRoot},
	{scheme: GDriveScheme, vfsRoot: gDriveVFSRoot},
	{scheme: DropboxScheme, vfsRoot: dropboxVFSRoot},
}

var registryHivePrefixes = []string{
	"HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE",
	"HKEY_CURRENT_USER",
	"HKEY_CLASSES_ROOT",
	"HKEY_USERS",
	"HKEY_CURRENT_CONFIG",
	"HKLM",
	"HKCU",
	"HKCR",
	"HKU",
	"HKCC",
}

func aliasSpecFor(path string) (aliasSpec, bool) {
	normalized := strings.TrimSpace(strings.ReplaceAll(path, "\\", "/"))
	for _, spec := range aliasSpecs {
		if len(normalized) >= len(spec.scheme) && strings.EqualFold(normalized[:len(spec.scheme)], spec.scheme) {
			return spec, true
		}
	}
	return aliasSpec{}, false
}

func normalizeAliasPath(path string, spec aliasSpec) string {
	trimmed := strings.TrimSpace(strings.ReplaceAll(path, "\\", "/"))
	rest := trimmed[len(spec.scheme):]
	rest = strings.Trim(rest, "/")
	if rest == "" {
		return spec.scheme
	}
	return spec.scheme + rest
}

func aliasRoot(path string) (string, bool) {
	if spec, ok := aliasSpecFor(path); ok {
		return spec.scheme, true
	}
	return "", false
}

func Normalize(path string) string {
	trimmed := strings.TrimSpace(strings.ReplaceAll(path, "\\", "/"))
	if trimmed == "" {
		return ""
	}
	// Convert UNC paths (//host/share/...) to smb:// scheme
	if len(trimmed) > 2 && trimmed[:2] == "//" && trimmed[2] != '/' {
		trimmed = SMBScheme + trimmed[2:]
	}
	if drivePath, ok := normalizeDrivePath(trimmed); ok {
		return drivePath
	}
	if spec, ok := aliasSpecFor(trimmed); ok {
		return normalizeAliasPath(trimmed, spec)
	}
	if !IsRegistry(trimmed) {
		return trimmed
	}
	return normalizeAliasPath(trimmed, aliasSpec{scheme: RegistryScheme, vfsRoot: registryVFSRoot})
}

func normalizeDrivePath(path string) (string, bool) {
	trimmed := strings.TrimSpace(strings.ReplaceAll(path, "\\", "/"))
	if len(trimmed) >= len(DriveScheme) && strings.EqualFold(trimmed[:len(DriveScheme)], DriveScheme) {
		// If the character immediately following the scheme is a slash,
		// treat this as a unix-style absolute path (filesystem:///...) and
		// do not normalize as a Windows drive reference.
		if len(trimmed) > len(DriveScheme) && trimmed[len(DriveScheme)] == '/' {
			return "", false
		}
		// drive form: filesystem://c or filesystem://c/...
		if len(trimmed) >= len(DriveScheme)+1 {
			rest := trimmed[len(DriveScheme):]
			if len(rest) == 0 || !isAlpha(rest[0]) {
				return "", false
			}
			drive := strings.ToLower(rest[:1])
			remainder := strings.Trim(rest[1:], "/")
			if remainder == "" {
				return DriveScheme + drive, true
			}
			return DriveScheme + drive + "/" + strings.ReplaceAll(remainder, "//", "/"), true
		}
	}
	if len(trimmed) >= 2 && isAlpha(trimmed[0]) && trimmed[1] == ':' {
		drive := strings.ToLower(trimmed[:1])
		remainder := strings.Trim(trimmed[2:], "/")
		if remainder == "" {
			return DriveScheme + drive, true
		}
		remainder = strings.Join(strings.FieldsFunc(remainder, func(r rune) bool { return r == '/' }), "/")
		if remainder == "" {
			return DriveScheme + drive, true
		}
		return DriveScheme + drive + "/" + remainder, true
	}
	return "", false
}

func isAlpha(b byte) bool {
	return (b >= 'a' && b <= 'z') || (b >= 'A' && b <= 'Z')
}

func IsDrive(path string) bool {
	_, ok := normalizeDrivePath(path)
	return ok
}

func ToNativePath(path string) string {
	normalized := Normalize(path)
	if !strings.HasPrefix(strings.ToLower(normalized), DriveScheme) {
		if resolved, ok := ResolveLocalCloudPath(normalized); ok {
			return resolved
		}
		return normalized
	}
	rest := normalized[len(DriveScheme):]
	if len(rest) == 0 {
		return normalized
	}
	drive := strings.ToUpper(rest[:1])
	remainder := strings.TrimPrefix(rest[1:], "/")
	if remainder == "" {
		return filepath.FromSlash(drive + ":/")
	}
	return filepath.FromSlash(drive + ":/" + remainder)
}

func FromNativePath(path string) string {
	if drivePath, ok := normalizeDrivePath(path); ok {
		return drivePath
	}
	return strings.TrimSpace(strings.ReplaceAll(path, "\\", "/"))
}

func IsRegistry(path string) bool {
	spec, ok := aliasSpecFor(path)
	return ok && spec.scheme == RegistryScheme
}

func IsAlias(path string) bool {
	_, ok := aliasSpecFor(path)
	return ok
}

func IsSearch(path string) bool {
	spec, ok := aliasSpecFor(path)
	return ok && spec.scheme == SearchScheme
}

func IsWeb(path string) bool {
	spec, ok := aliasSpecFor(path)
	return ok && (spec.scheme == HTTPAliasScheme || spec.scheme == HTTPSAliasScheme)
}

func BuildSearch(basePath, pattern string, recursive bool) (string, error) {
	basePath = Normalize(basePath)
	if basePath == "" || pattern == "" {
		return "", nil
	}
	parts := []string{
		"path=" + readableSearchValue(basePath),
		"pattern=" + readableSearchValue(pattern),
		"recursive=" + strconv.FormatBool(recursive),
	}
	return SearchScheme + "?" + strings.Join(parts, "&"), nil
}

func readableSearchValue(value string) string {
	escaped := url.QueryEscape(value)
	replacer := strings.NewReplacer(
		"%2F", "/",
		"%3A", ":",
		"%2A", "*",
	)
	return replacer.Replace(escaped)
}

func ParseSearch(path string) (SearchQuery, bool) {
	normalized := Normalize(path)
	if !IsSearch(normalized) || normalized == SearchScheme {
		return SearchQuery{}, false
	}
	raw := strings.TrimPrefix(normalized, SearchScheme)
	if !strings.HasPrefix(raw, "?") {
		return SearchQuery{}, false
	}
	values, err := url.ParseQuery(strings.TrimPrefix(raw, "?"))
	if err != nil {
		return SearchQuery{}, false
	}
	query := SearchQuery{
		BasePath:  Normalize(values.Get("path")),
		Pattern:   values.Get("pattern"),
		Recursive: strings.EqualFold(values.Get("recursive"), "true") || values.Get("recursive") == "1",
	}
	query.BasePath = Normalize(query.BasePath)
	if query.BasePath == "" || query.Pattern == "" {
		return SearchQuery{}, false
	}
	return query, true
}

func NormalizeSearchPattern(pattern string) string {
	trimmed := strings.TrimSpace(pattern)
	if trimmed == "" {
		return ""
	}
	if strings.ContainsAny(trimmed, "*?[") {
		return trimmed
	}
	return "*" + trimmed + "*"
}

func MatchSearchPattern(pattern, name string) (bool, error) {
	normalizedPattern := NormalizeSearchPattern(pattern)
	if normalizedPattern == "" {
		return false, nil
	}
	return filepath.Match(strings.ToLower(normalizedPattern), strings.ToLower(name))
}

func ToVFS(path string) string {
	normalized := Normalize(path)
	spec, ok := aliasSpecFor(normalized)
	if !ok || spec.vfsRoot == "" {
		return normalized
	}
	if converted, ok := remoteAliasToVFS(normalized, spec); ok {
		return converted
	}
	rest := strings.TrimPrefix(normalized, spec.scheme)
	if rest == "" {
		return spec.vfsRoot
	}
	return spec.vfsRoot + "/" + rest
}

func remoteAliasToVFS(path string, spec aliasSpec) (string, bool) {
	return RemoteURLToVFS(path, spec.scheme, spec.vfsRoot)
}

// RemoteURLToVFS converts a public remote URL (e.g. smb://host/share) into a
// VFS path (e.g. /remote/smb/host:445/share).  It handles default ports for
// known schemes and returns (_, false) for unsupported schemes or malformed
// URLs.  This is the canonical implementation shared by pathref and the VFS
// layer.
func RemoteURLToVFS(path, scheme, vfsRoot string) (string, bool) {
	defaultPort := ""
	switch scheme {
	case SMBScheme:
		defaultPort = "445"
	default:
		return "", false
	}

	parsed, err := url.Parse(path)
	if err != nil || parsed.Host == "" {
		return "", false
	}

	host := parsed.Hostname()
	if host == "" {
		return "", false
	}

	port := parsed.Port()
	if port == "" {
		port = defaultPort
	}

	base := vfsRoot + "/" + host + ":" + port
	rest := strings.Trim(parsed.Path, "/")
	if rest == "" {
		return base, true
	}

	return base + "/" + rest, true
}

func FromVFS(path string) string {
	normalized := strings.TrimSpace(strings.ReplaceAll(path, "\\", "/"))
	for _, spec := range aliasSpecs {
		if spec.vfsRoot == "" {
			continue
		}
		if normalized == spec.vfsRoot {
			return spec.scheme
		}
		if strings.HasPrefix(normalized, spec.vfsRoot+"/") {
			return spec.scheme + strings.TrimPrefix(normalized, spec.vfsRoot+"/")
		}
	}
	return normalized
}

func FromVFSEntry(basePublicPath, entryPath string) string {
	basePublicPath = Normalize(basePublicPath)
	entryPath = strings.TrimSpace(strings.ReplaceAll(entryPath, "\\", "/"))
	if !IsAlias(basePublicPath) {
		return FromVFS(entryPath)
	}
	if IsAlias(entryPath) || strings.HasPrefix(entryPath, registryVFSRoot) {
		return FromVFS(entryPath)
	}
	if !IsRegistry(basePublicPath) {
		if root, ok := aliasRoot(basePublicPath); ok {
			if basePublicPath == root {
				return Normalize(root + strings.TrimPrefix(entryPath, "/"))
			}
			trimmedBase := strings.TrimSuffix(basePublicPath, "/")
			return Normalize(trimmedBase + "/" + strings.TrimPrefix(entryPath, "/"))
		}
		return FromVFS(entryPath)
	}
	for _, prefix := range registryHivePrefixes {
		if strings.EqualFold(entryPath, prefix) || strings.HasPrefix(strings.ToUpper(entryPath), prefix+"/") {
			return Normalize(RegistryScheme + entryPath)
		}
	}
	if basePublicPath == RegistryScheme {
		return Normalize(RegistryScheme + entryPath)
	}
	trimmedBase := strings.TrimSuffix(basePublicPath, "/")
	return Normalize(trimmedBase + "/" + strings.TrimPrefix(entryPath, "/"))
}

func Parent(path string) (string, bool) {
	normalized := Normalize(path)
	root, ok := aliasRoot(normalized)
	if !ok {
		return "", false
	}
	rest := strings.TrimPrefix(normalized, root)
	if rest == "" {
		return "", false
	}
	idx := strings.LastIndex(rest, "/")
	if idx < 0 {
		return root, true
	}
	return root + rest[:idx], true
}
`````

`````go
//go:build !windows

package platform

import (
	"fmt"
	"os"

	contracts "wails-app/internal/contracts"
)

func GetPathAttributes(path string) (contracts.PathAttributes, error) {
	info, err := os.Lstat(path)
	if err != nil {
		return contracts.PathAttributes{}, err
	}
	mode := uint32(info.Mode().Perm())
	return contracts.PathAttributes{
		Permissions: info.Mode().Perm().String(),
		UnixMode:    mode,
		ReadOnly:    mode&0222 == 0,
		Hidden:      len(info.Name()) > 0 && info.Name()[0] == '.',
	}, nil
}

func SetPathAttributes(path string, update contracts.PathAttributesUpdate) error {
	if update.UnixMode == nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("attributes: unix mode is required")
	}
	return os.Chmod(path, os.FileMode(*update.UnixMode&07777))
}
`````

`````go
//go:build windows

package platform

import (
	"fmt"
	"syscall"

	contracts "wails-app/internal/contracts"
)

func GetPathAttributes(path string) (contracts.PathAttributes, error) {
	ptr, err := syscall.UTF16PtrFromString(path)
	if err != nil {
		return contracts.PathAttributes{}, err
	}
	attrs, err := syscall.GetFileAttributes(ptr)
	if err != nil {
		return contracts.PathAttributes{}, err
	}
	return contracts.PathAttributes{
		ReadOnly: attrs&syscall.FILE_ATTRIBUTE_READONLY != 0,
		Hidden:   attrs&syscall.FILE_ATTRIBUTE_HIDDEN != 0,
		System:   attrs&syscall.FILE_ATTRIBUTE_SYSTEM != 0,
		Archive:  attrs&syscall.FILE_ATTRIBUTE_ARCHIVE != 0,
	}, nil
}

func SetPathAttributes(path string, update contracts.PathAttributesUpdate) error {
	ptr, err := syscall.UTF16PtrFromString(path)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	attrs, err := syscall.GetFileAttributes(ptr)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	apply := func(value *bool, flag uint32) {
		if value == nil {
			return
		}
		if *value {
			attrs |= flag
		} else {
			attrs &^= flag
		}
	}
	apply(update.ReadOnly, syscall.FILE_ATTRIBUTE_READONLY)
	apply(update.Hidden, syscall.FILE_ATTRIBUTE_HIDDEN)
	apply(update.System, syscall.FILE_ATTRIBUTE_SYSTEM)
	apply(update.Archive, syscall.FILE_ATTRIBUTE_ARCHIVE)
	if attrs == 0 {
		attrs = syscall.FILE_ATTRIBUTE_NORMAL
	}
	if err := syscall.SetFileAttributes(ptr, attrs); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("attributes: %w", err)
	}
	return nil
}
`````

`````go
//go:build !windows

package platform

import (
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"syscall"

	contracts "wails-app/internal/contracts"
)

func GetPathCapacity(path string) (contracts.PathCapacity, error) {
	target := filepath.Clean(path)

	// Statfs needs an existing filesystem location. If the caller passed a file,
	// querying the containing directory is equivalent for capacity purposes.
	if info, err := os.Stat(target); err == nil && !info.IsDir() {
		target = filepath.Dir(target)
	}

	var stat syscall.Statfs_t
	if err := syscall.Statfs(target, &stat); err != nil {
		return contracts.PathCapacity{}, err
	}

	blockSize := int64(stat.Bsize)
	return contracts.PathCapacity{
		TotalSpace: int64(stat.Blocks) * blockSize,
		FreeSpace:  int64(stat.Bavail) * blockSize,
	}, nil
}
`````

`````go
//go:build windows

package platform

import (
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"syscall"

	"golang.org/x/sys/windows"

	contracts "wails-app/internal/contracts"
)

func GetPathCapacity(path string) (contracts.PathCapacity, error) {
	target := filepath.Clean(path)
	if info, err := os.Stat(target); err == nil && !info.IsDir() {
		target = filepath.Dir(target)
	}

	volume := filepath.VolumeName(target)
	root := volume + `\`
	if volume == "" {
		root = target
	}

	rootPtr, err := windows.UTF16PtrFromString(root)
	if err != nil {
		return contracts.PathCapacity{}, err
	}

	var freeAvailable uint64
	var total uint64
	var totalFree uint64
	if err := windows.GetDiskFreeSpaceEx(
		rootPtr,
		(*uint64)(&freeAvailable),
		(*uint64)(&total),
		(*uint64)(&totalFree),
	); err != nil {
		return contracts.PathCapacity{}, err
	}

	var fsNameBuf [256]uint16
	var fsName *string
	if err := windows.GetVolumeInformation(
		rootPtr,
		nil,
		0,
		nil,
		nil,
		nil,
		&fsNameBuf[0],
		uint32(len(fsNameBuf)),
	); err == nil {
		fs := syscall.UTF16ToString(fsNameBuf[:])
		if fs != "" {
			fsName = &fs
		}
	}

	return contracts.PathCapacity{
		TotalSpace: int64(total),
		FreeSpace:  int64(freeAvailable),
		FileSystem: fsName,
	}, nil
}
`````

## File: manager/internal/platform/environment_surface_windows.go
`````go
//go:build windows

package platform

import (
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"sort"
	"strings"

	"golang.org/x/sys/windows/registry"

	contracts "wails-app/internal/contracts"
)

const (
	userEnvironmentRegistryPath   = `Environment`
	systemEnvironmentRegistryPath = `SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Session Manager\Environment`
)

// ListEnvironmentSurface returns process, user and system environment variables
// without starting PowerShell or any other child process.
func ListEnvironmentSurface() ([]contracts.SystemSurfaceRecord, error) {
	records := make([]contracts.SystemSurfaceRecord, 0, len(os.Environ())+64)

	for _, pair := range os.Environ() {
		name, value, ok := strings.Cut(pair, "=")
		if !ok || strings.TrimSpace(name) == "" {
			continue
		}
		records = append(records, contracts.SystemSurfaceRecord{
			ID:   "process:" + name,
			Name: name,
			Fields: map[string]any{
				"scope":     "Process",
				"value":     value,
				"valueType": "Process",
				"readOnly":  true,
			},
		})
	}

	user, userErr := environmentRegistryRecords(
		registry.CURRENT_USER,
		userEnvironmentRegistryPath,
		"User",
		"user:",
	)
	records = append(records, user...)

	system, systemErr := environmentRegistryRecords(
		registry.LOCAL_MACHINE,
		systemEnvironmentRegistryPath,
		"System",
		"system:",
	)
	records = append(records, system...)

	// Registry access to one scope should not hide process variables or the
	// other scope. Return an error only when no data at all can be produced.
	if len(records) == 0 {
		if userErr != nil {
			return nil, userErr
		}
		if systemErr != nil {
			return nil, systemErr
		}
	}

	sort.SliceStable(records, func(i, j int) bool {
		leftScope := environmentScopeOrder(fieldString(records[i].Fields, "scope"))
		rightScope := environmentScopeOrder(fieldString(records[j].Fields, "scope"))
		if leftScope != rightScope {
			return leftScope < rightScope
		}
		return strings.ToLower(records[i].Name) < strings.ToLower(records[j].Name)
	})

	return records, nil
}

func environmentRegistryRecords(
	root registry.Key,
	path string,
	scope string,
	idPrefix string,
) ([]contracts.SystemSurfaceRecord, error) {
	key, err := registry.OpenKey(root, path, registry.QUERY_VALUE)
	if err != nil {
		return []contracts.SystemSurfaceRecord{}, err
	}
	defer key.Close()

	names, err := key.ReadValueNames(-1)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	records := make([]contracts.SystemSurfaceRecord, 0, len(names))
	for _, name := range names {
		value, valueType, err := key.GetStringValue(name)
		if err != nil {
			// Environment values are expected to be REG_SZ or REG_EXPAND_SZ.
			// Ignore unrelated value kinds rather than failing the whole scope.
			continue
		}

		records = append(records, contracts.SystemSurfaceRecord{
			ID:   idPrefix + name,
			Name: name,
			Fields: map[string]any{
				"scope":        scope,
				"value":        value,
				"valueType":    environmentRegistryValueType(valueType),
				"expandable":   valueType == registry.EXPAND_SZ,
				"registryType": valueType,
				"readOnly":     false,
			},
		})
	}
	return records, nil
}

func environmentRegistryValueType(valueType uint32) string {
	switch valueType {
	case registry.EXPAND_SZ:
		return "Expandable"
	case registry.SZ:
		return "String"
	default:
		return "String"
	}
}

func environmentScopeOrder(scope string) int {
	switch strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(scope)) {
	case "process":
		return 0
	case "user":
		return 1
	case "system":
		return 2
	default:
		return 3
	}
}

func fieldString(fields map[string]any, key string) string {
	if fields == nil {
		return ""
	}
	value, ok := fields[key]
	if !ok || value == nil {
		return ""
	}
	return strings.TrimSpace(fmt.Sprint(value))
}
`````

`````go
package platform

import "syscall"

func EnsureHiddenPath(path string) error {
	ptr, err := syscall.UTF16PtrFromString(path)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	attrs, err := syscall.GetFileAttributes(ptr)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if attrs&syscall.FILE_ATTRIBUTE_HIDDEN != 0 {
		return nil
	}
	return syscall.SetFileAttributes(ptr, attrs|syscall.FILE_ATTRIBUTE_HIDDEN)
`````

`````go
//go:build !windows

package platform

import (
	"io"
	"os"
	"os/exec"
	"path/filepath"
	"runtime"
	"syscall"
)

func OpenFileWithDefaultApp(path string) error {
	var cmd *exec.Cmd
	switch runtime.GOOS {
	case "darwin":
		cmd = exec.Command("open", path)
	default:
		cmd = exec.Command("xdg-open", path)
	}
	return startDetached(cmd)
}

func SymlinkPointsToDir(path string) bool {
	info, err := os.Stat(path)
	if err != nil {
		return false
	}
	return info.IsDir()
}

func IsUntrackedDirectoryJunction(_ string) bool {
	return false
}

func ResolveLinkPath(symlinkPath string) (target string, isDir bool, err error) {
	resolved, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(symlinkPath)
	if err != nil {
		return "", false, err
	}
	info, err := os.Stat(resolved)
	if err != nil {
		return "", false, err
	}
	return resolved, info.IsDir(), nil
}

func startDetached(cmd *exec.Cmd) error {
	cmd.Stdin = nil
	cmd.Stdout = io.Discard
	cmd.Stderr = io.Discard
	cmd.SysProcAttr = &syscall.SysProcAttr{Setsid: true}
	if err := cmd.Start(); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	go func() { _ = cmd.Wait() }()
	return nil
}
`````

## File: manager/internal/platform/links_windows.go
`````go
//go:build windows

package platform

import (
	"encoding/binary"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"
	"syscall"
	"unsafe"

	"golang.org/x/sys/windows"

	"wails-app/internal/pathref"
)

const (
	swShownormal = 1
	seErrNoAssoc = 31
)

func OpenFileWithDefaultApp(path string) error {
	ret, callErr, err := shellExecute("open", path)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if ret > 32 {
		return nil
	}
	if ret == seErrNoAssoc {
		fallbackRet, fallbackCallErr, fallbackErr := shellExecute("openas", path)
		if fallbackErr != nil {
			return fallbackErr
		}
		if fallbackRet > 32 {
			return nil
		}
		if fallbackCallErr != nil && fallbackCallErr != syscall.Errno(0) {
			return fmt.Errorf("ShellExecuteW failed: %w", fallbackCallErr)
		}
		return fmt.Errorf("ShellExecuteW failed with code %d", fallbackRet)
	}
	if callErr != nil && callErr != syscall.Errno(0) {
		return fmt.Errorf("ShellExecuteW failed: %w", callErr)
	}
	return fmt.Errorf("ShellExecuteW failed with code %d", ret)
}

func shellExecute(verbValue string, path string) (uintptr, error, error) {
	verb, err := syscall.UTF16PtrFromString(verbValue)
	if err != nil {
		return 0, nil, err
	}
	target, err := syscall.UTF16PtrFromString(path)
	if err != nil {
		return 0, nil, err
	}

	shell32 := windows.NewLazySystemDLL("shell32.dll")
	shellExecute := shell32.NewProc("ShellExecuteW")
	ret, _, callErr := shellExecute.Call(
		0,
		uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(verb)),
		uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(target)),
		0,
		0,
		swShownormal,
	)
	if callErr != nil && callErr != syscall.Errno(0) {
		return ret, callErr, nil
	}
	return ret, nil, nil
}

func SymlinkPointsToDir(path string) bool {
	if !isNativeLinkPath(path) {
		return false
	}
	ptr, err := syscall.UTF16PtrFromString(path)
	if err != nil {
		return false
	}
	attrs, err := syscall.GetFileAttributes(ptr)
	if err != nil {
		return false
	}
	return attrs&syscall.FILE_ATTRIBUTE_DIRECTORY != 0
}

func IsUntrackedDirectoryJunction(path string) bool {
	if !isNativeLinkPath(path) {
		return false
	}
	ptr, err := syscall.UTF16PtrFromString(path)
	if err != nil {
		return false
	}
	attrs, err := syscall.GetFileAttributes(ptr)
	if err != nil {
		return false
	}
	const reparsePoint = uint32(0x400)
	return attrs&syscall.FILE_ATTRIBUTE_DIRECTORY != 0 && attrs&reparsePoint != 0
}

func ResolveLinkPath(lnkPath string) (target string, isDir bool, err error) {
	data, err := os.ReadFile(lnkPath)
	if err != nil {
		return "", false, err
	}
	if len(data) < 76 {
		return "", false, fmt.Errorf(".lnk file too small")
	}
	if data[0] != 0x4C || data[1] != 0 || data[2] != 0 || data[3] != 0 {
		return "", false, fmt.Errorf("not a valid .lnk file")
	}

	linkFlags := binary.LittleEndian.Uint32(data[20:24])
	fileAttrs := binary.LittleEndian.Uint32(data[24:28])
	isDir = (fileAttrs & 0x10) != 0

	hasIDList := (linkFlags & 0x01) != 0
	hasLinkInfo := (linkFlags & 0x02) != 0
	isUnicode := (linkFlags & 0x80) != 0

	offset := 76
	if hasIDList {
		if offset+2 > len(data) {
			return "", isDir, fmt.Errorf("unexpected EOF in IDList")
		}
		idListSize := int(binary.LittleEndian.Uint16(data[offset : offset+2]))
		offset += 2 + idListSize
	}

	if !hasLinkInfo {
		return "", isDir, fmt.Errorf("no LinkInfo section")
	}
	if offset+32 > len(data) {
		return "", isDir, fmt.Errorf("unexpected EOF in LinkInfo")
	}

	liStart := offset
	liHeaderSize := int(binary.LittleEndian.Uint32(data[liStart+4 : liStart+8]))
	liFlags := binary.LittleEndian.Uint32(data[liStart+8 : liStart+12])
	if liFlags&0x01 == 0 {
		return "", isDir, fmt.Errorf("no local volume path in .lnk")
	}

	var path string
	if isUnicode && liHeaderSize >= 0x24 && liStart+32 <= len(data) {
		unicodeOffset := int(binary.LittleEndian.Uint32(data[liStart+28 : liStart+32]))
		pathStart := liStart + unicodeOffset
		if pathStart < len(data) {
			path = readUTF16LEString(data[pathStart:])
		}
	}
	if path == "" {
		ansiOffset := int(binary.LittleEndian.Uint32(data[liStart+16 : liStart+20]))
		pathStart := liStart + ansiOffset
		if pathStart < len(data) {
			end := pathStart
			for end < len(data) && data[end] != 0 {
				end++
			}
			path = string(data[pathStart:end])
		}
	}

	if path == "" {
		return "", isDir, fmt.Errorf("could not extract target path from .lnk")
	}
	return filepath.ToSlash(path), isDir, nil
}

func readUTF16LEString(data []byte) string {
	var chars []uint16
	for i := 0; i+1 < len(data); i += 2 {
		ch := binary.LittleEndian.Uint16(data[i : i+2])
		if ch == 0 {
			break
		}
		chars = append(chars, ch)
	}
	return syscall.UTF16ToString(chars)
}

func isNativeLinkPath(path string) bool {
	trimmed := ToSlash(path)
	if trimmed == "" {
		return false
	}
	if pathref.IsRegistry(trimmed) {
		return false
	}
	if pathref.IsAlias(trimmed) {
		return false
	}
	return pathref.IsDrive(trimmed) || strings.HasPrefix(trimmed, "//")
}
`````

`````go
package platform

import (
	"os"
`````

`````go
func CheckHidden(_ string, path string) bool {
	if !isNativeMetadataPath(path) {
		return false
	}
	ptr, err := syscall.UTF16PtrFromString(path)
	if err != nil {
		return false
	}
	attrs, err := syscall.GetFileAttributes(ptr)
	if err != nil {
		return false
	}
	return attrs&syscall.FILE_ATTRIBUTE_HIDDEN != 0
}

func GetCreatedTime(info os.FileInfo) int64 {
	if stat, ok := info.Sys().(*syscall.Win32FileAttributeData); ok {
		return stat.CreationTime.Nanoseconds() / int64(time.Second)
	}
	return info.ModTime().Unix()
}

func GetAccessedTime(info os.FileInfo) int64 {
	if stat, ok := info.Sys().(*syscall.Win32FileAttributeData); ok {
		return stat.LastAccessTime.Nanoseconds() / int64(time.Second)
	}
	return info.ModTime().Unix()
}

func isNativeMetadataPath(path string) bool {
	trimmed := ToSlash(path)
	if trimmed == "" {
		return false
	}
	if pathref.IsRegistry(trimmed) {
		return false
	}
	if pathref.IsAlias(trimmed) {
		return false
	}
	return pathref.IsDrive(trimmed) || strings.HasPrefix(trimmed, "//")
}
`````

`````go
//go:build linux

package platform

import (
	"os"

	"golang.org/x/sys/unix"
)

// JoinMountNamespace makes the calling process join the specified mount namespace.
// The nsPath should be a path like "/proc/<pid>/ns/mnt".
func JoinMountNamespace(nsPath string) error {
	f, err := os.Open(nsPath)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer f.Close()

	if err := unix.Setns(int(f.Fd()), unix.CLONE_NEWNS); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return nil
}
`````

`````go
	ifAdminStatusDown = 2

// NetworkAdapterMetadata returns rich native adapter metadata keyed by interface
// index. It is used to enrich the ordinary network:// adapter rows.
func NetworkAdapterMetadata() (map[uint32]map[string]any, error) {
	var size uint32 = 16 * 1024
	flags := uintptr(gaaFlagIncludePrefix | gaaFlagIncludeGateways)

	for attempts := 0; attempts < 3; attempts++ {
		buffer := make([]byte, size)
		result, _, callErr := procGetAdaptersAddresses.Call(
			0, // AF_UNSPEC
			flags,
			0,
			uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(&buffer[0])),
			uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(&size)),
		)

		if result == errorBufferOverflow {
			continue
		}
		if result != 0 {
			return nil, windowsError(result, callErr)
		}

		resultMap := make(map[uint32]map[string]any)
		current := (*ipAdapterAddresses)(unsafe.Pointer(&buffer[0]))
		for current != nil {
			index := current.IfIndex
			if index == 0 {
				index = current.Ipv6IfIndex
			}
			if index != 0 {
				fields := map[string]any{
					"index":         index,
					"friendlyName":  windows.UTF16PtrToString(current.FriendlyName),
					"description":   windows.UTF16PtrToString(current.Description),
					"dnsSuffix":     windows.UTF16PtrToString(current.DnsSuffix),
					"mtu":           current.Mtu,
					"ifType":        current.IfType,
					"status":        adapterOperStatus(current.OperStatus),
					"dhcpEnabled":   current.Flags&ipAdapterDhcpEnabled != 0,
					"linkSpeed":     maxU64(current.TransmitLinkSpeed, current.ReceiveLinkSpeed),
					"transmitSpeed": current.TransmitLinkSpeed,
					"receiveSpeed":  current.ReceiveLinkSpeed,
				}

				macLength := int(current.PhysicalAddressLength)
				if macLength > len(current.PhysicalAddress) {
					macLength = len(current.PhysicalAddress)
				}
				if macLength > 0 {
					fields["mac"] = formatMAC(current.PhysicalAddress[:macLength])
				}

				addresses := collectAdapterAddresses(current.FirstUnicastAddress)
				gateways := collectGatewayAddresses(current.FirstGatewayAddress)
				dnsServers := collectDNSServerAddresses(current.FirstDnsServerAddress)
				fields["addresses"] = addresses
				fields["address"] = firstString(addresses)
				fields["gateways"] = gateways
				fields["gateway"] = firstString(gateways)
				fields["dnsServers"] = dnsServers
				fields["dns"] = strings.Join(dnsServers, ", ")

				if row, err := readIfRow(index); err == nil {
					fields["adminStatus"] = adapterAdminStatus(row.AdminStatus)
					fields["bytesReceived"] = uint64(row.InOctets)
					fields["bytesSent"] = uint64(row.OutOctets)
					fields["receiveErrors"] = uint64(row.InErrors)
					fields["sendErrors"] = uint64(row.OutErrors)
					fields["receiveDiscards"] = uint64(row.InDiscards)
					fields["sendDiscards"] = uint64(row.OutDiscards)
				}

				resultMap[index] = fields
			}
			current = current.Next
		}
		return resultMap, nil
	}

	return nil, fmt.Errorf("GetAdaptersAddresses: buffer size kept changing")
}

func SetNetworkAdapterEnabled(index uint32, enabled bool) error {
	row, err := readIfRow(index)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}

	if enabled {
		row.AdminStatus = ifAdminStatusUp
	} else {
		row.AdminStatus = ifAdminStatusDown
	}

	result, _, callErr := procSetIfEntry.Call(uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(row)))
	if result != 0 {
		return windowsError(result, callErr)
	}
	return nil
}

func RenewNetworkAdapterDHCP(index uint32) error {
	mapping := ipAdapterIndexMap{Index: index}
	result, _, callErr := procIpRenewAddress.Call(uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(&mapping)))
	if result != 0 {
		return windowsError(result, callErr)
	}
	return nil
}

func DiagnoseNetworkAdapter(index uint32) (contracts.SystemSurfaceRecord, error) {
	metadata, err := NetworkAdapterMetadata()
	if err != nil {
		return contracts.SystemSurfaceRecord{}, err
	}
	fields, ok := metadata[index]
	if !ok {
		return contracts.SystemSurfaceRecord{}, fmt.Errorf("network adapter %d not found", index)
	}

	checks := make([]string, 0, 6)
	healthy := true

	status := strings.ToLower(fmt.Sprint(fields["status"]))
	if status == "up" {
		checks = append(checks, "Interface is up")
	} else {
		healthy = false
		checks = append(checks, "Interface is not operational")
	}

	if strings.TrimSpace(fmt.Sprint(fields["address"])) != "" {
		checks = append(checks, "IP address is configured")
	} else {
		healthy = false
		checks = append(checks, "No IP address is configured")
	}

	if strings.TrimSpace(fmt.Sprint(fields["gateway"])) != "" {
		checks = append(checks, "Default gateway is configured")
	} else {
		checks = append(checks, "No default gateway is configured")
	}

	if strings.TrimSpace(fmt.Sprint(fields["dns"])) != "" {
		checks = append(checks, "DNS servers are configured")
	} else {
		checks = append(checks, "No DNS servers are configured")
	}

	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 2500*time.Millisecond)
	defer cancel()
	if _, lookupErr := net.DefaultResolver.LookupHost(ctx, "www.microsoft.com"); lookupErr == nil {
		checks = append(checks, "DNS resolution succeeds")
	} else {
		healthy = false
		checks = append(checks, "DNS resolution failed: "+lookupErr.Error())
	}

	conn, dialErr := net.DialTimeout("tcp", "1.1.1.1:443", 2500*time.Millisecond)
	if dialErr == nil {
		_ = conn.Close()
		checks = append(checks, "Outbound TCP connectivity succeeds")
	} else {
		healthy = false
		checks = append(checks, "Outbound TCP connectivity failed: "+dialErr.Error())
	}

	return contracts.SystemSurfaceRecord{
		ID:   fmt.Sprintf("adapter-diagnostic:%d", index),
		Name: fmt.Sprint(fields["friendlyName"]),
		Fields: map[string]any{
			"healthy": healthy,
			"summary": strings.Join(checks, "\n"),
			"checks":  checks,
		},
	}, nil
}

func OpenNetworkSettings() error {
	target, err := windows.UTF16PtrFromString("ms-settings:network-status")
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	result, _, callErr := procShellExecute.Call(
		0,
		0,
		uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(target)),
		0,
		0,
		shellShowNormal,
	)
	if result <= 32 {
		if callErr != nil && callErr != windows.ERROR_SUCCESS {
			return callErr
		}
		return fmt.Errorf("ShellExecuteW(ms-settings:network-status) failed: %d", result)
	}
	return nil
}

func readIfRow(index uint32) (*mibIfRow, error) {
	row := &mibIfRow{Index: index}
	result, _, callErr := procGetIfEntry.Call(uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(row)))
	if result != 0 {
		return nil, windowsError(result, callErr)
	}
	return row, nil
}

func collectAdapterAddresses(head *adapterUnicastAddress) []string {
	result := make([]string, 0, 4)
	for current := head; current != nil; current = current.Next {
		if value := socketAddressIP(current.Address); value != "" {
			result = appendUnique(result, value)
		}
	}
	sort.Strings(result)
	return result
}

func collectDNSServerAddresses(head *adapterDnsServerAddress) []string {
	result := make([]string, 0, 4)
	for current := head; current != nil; current = current.Next {
		if value := socketAddressIP(current.Address); value != "" {
			result = appendUnique(result, value)
		}
	}
	return result
}

func collectGatewayAddresses(head *adapterGatewayAddress) []string {
	result := make([]string, 0, 2)
	for current := head; current != nil; current = current.Next {
		if value := socketAddressIP(current.Address); value != "" {
			result = appendUnique(result, value)
		}
	}
	return result
}

func socketAddressIP(address socketAddress) string {
	if address.Sockaddr == nil || address.SockaddrLength <= 0 {
		return ""
	}

	family := *(*uint16)(unsafe.Pointer(address.Sockaddr))
	switch family {
	case addressFamilyIPv4:
		raw := (*syscall.RawSockaddrInet4)(unsafe.Pointer(address.Sockaddr))
		return net.IP(raw.Addr[:]).String()
	case addressFamilyIPv6:
		raw := (*syscall.RawSockaddrInet6)(unsafe.Pointer(address.Sockaddr))
		ip := net.IP(raw.Addr[:]).String()
		if raw.Scope_id != 0 {
			return fmt.Sprintf("%s%%%d", ip, raw.Scope_id)
		}
		return ip
	default:
		return ""
	}
}

func adapterOperStatus(status uint32) string {
	switch status {
	case 1:
		return "Up"
	case 2:
		return "Down"
	case 3:
		return "Testing"
	case 4:
		return "Unknown"
	case 5:
		return "Dormant"
	case 6:
		return "Not present"
	case 7:
		return "Lower layer down"
	default:
		return fmt.Sprintf("Status %d", status)
	}
}

func adapterAdminStatus(status uint32) string {
	switch status {
	case ifAdminStatusUp:
		return "Enabled"
	case ifAdminStatusDown:
		return "Disabled"
	default:
		return fmt.Sprintf("Admin %d", status)
	}
}

func formatMAC(address []byte) string {
	parts := make([]string, len(address))
	for i, value := range address {
		parts[i] = fmt.Sprintf("%02X", value)
	}
	return strings.Join(parts, ":")
}

func appendUnique(values []string, value string) []string {
	for _, existing := range values {
		if existing == value {
			return values
		}
	}
	return append(values, value)
}

func firstString(values []string) string {
	if len(values) == 0 {
		return ""
	}
	return values[0]
}

func maxU64(a, b uint64) uint64 {
	if a > b {
		return a
	}
	return b
}
`````

`````go
//go:build windows

package platform

import (
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

func TestPortFromDWORDPreservesNetworkByteOrder(t *testing.T) {
	// MIB_* tables expose ports in network byte order in the low WORD.
	if got := portFromDWORD(0x5000); got != 80 {
		t.Fatalf("portFromDWORD(0x5000) = %d, want 80", got)
	}
	if got := portFromDWORD(0xbb01); got != 443 {
		t.Fatalf("portFromDWORD(0xbb01) = %d, want 443", got)
	}
}

func TestTCPStateNames(t *testing.T) {
	if got := tcpState(2); got != "Listen" {
		t.Fatalf("tcpState(2) = %q, want Listen", got)
	}
	if got := tcpState(5); got != "Established" {
		t.Fatalf("tcpState(5) = %q, want Established", got)
	}
}

func TestNetworkSurfaceUsesNativeTables(t *testing.T) {
	records, err := ListNetworkSurface()
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("ListNetworkSurface: %v", err)
	}
	for _, record := range records {
		kind := strings.TrimSpace(record.Fields["kind"].(string))
		if kind != "Adapter" && kind != "TCP" && kind != "UDP" {
			t.Fatalf("unexpected network kind %q", kind)
		}
	}
}
`````

`````go
//go:build windows

package platform

import (
	"encoding/binary"
	"fmt"
	"net"
	"sort"
	"strings"
	"syscall"
	"unsafe"

	"golang.org/x/sys/windows"

	contracts "wails-app/internal/contracts"
)

const (
	addressFamilyIPv4 = 2
	addressFamilyIPv6 = 23

	tcpTableOwnerPIDAll = 5
	udpTableOwnerPID    = 1

	errorInsufficientBuffer = syscall.Errno(122)

	maxPreferredLength = 0xffffffff
	nerrSuccess        = 0
	errorMoreData      = 234
	svTypeAll          = 0xffffffff
)

var (
	iphlpapiDLL             = windows.NewLazySystemDLL("iphlpapi.dll")
	procGetExtendedTcpTable = iphlpapiDLL.NewProc("GetExtendedTcpTable")
	procGetExtendedUdpTable = iphlpapiDLL.NewProc("GetExtendedUdpTable")

	netapi32DLL          = windows.NewLazySystemDLL("netapi32.dll")
	procNetServerEnum    = netapi32DLL.NewProc("NetServerEnum")
	procNetShareEnum     = netapi32DLL.NewProc("NetShareEnum")
	procNetApiBufferFree = netapi32DLL.NewProc("NetApiBufferFree")
)

type mibTCPRowOwnerPID struct {
	State      uint32
	LocalAddr  uint32
	LocalPort  uint32
	RemoteAddr uint32
	RemotePort uint32
	OwningPID  uint32
}

type mibTCP6RowOwnerPID struct {
	LocalAddr     [16]byte
	LocalScopeID  uint32
	LocalPort     uint32
	RemoteAddr    [16]byte
	RemoteScopeID uint32
	RemotePort    uint32
	State         uint32
	OwningPID     uint32
}

type mibUDPRowOwnerPID struct {
	LocalAddr uint32
	LocalPort uint32
	OwningPID uint32
}

type mibUDP6RowOwnerPID struct {
	LocalAddr    [16]byte
	LocalScopeID uint32
	LocalPort    uint32
	OwningPID    uint32
}

type serverInfo100 struct {
	PlatformID uint32
	Name       *uint16
}

type shareInfo1 struct {
	NetName *uint16
	Type    uint32
	Remark  *uint16
}

// ListNetworkComputers discovers visible Windows network servers/workstations
// through NetServerEnum. It does not spawn a shell or PowerShell.
func ListNetworkComputers() ([]contracts.SystemSurfaceRecord, error) {
	var buffer *byte
	var entriesRead uint32
	var totalEntries uint32
	var resumeHandle uint32
	records := make([]contracts.SystemSurfaceRecord, 0, 32)

	for {
		result, _, callErr := procNetServerEnum.Call(
			0,
			100,
			uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(&buffer)),
			maxPreferredLength,
			uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(&entriesRead)),
			uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(&totalEntries)),
			svTypeAll,
			0,
			uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(&resumeHandle)),
		)

		if buffer != nil {
			base := uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(buffer))
			rowSize := unsafe.Sizeof(serverInfo100{})
			for i := uint32(0); i < entriesRead; i++ {
				row := (*serverInfo100)(unsafe.Pointer(base + uintptr(i)*rowSize))
				name := strings.TrimSpace(windows.UTF16PtrToString(row.Name))
				if name == "" {
					continue
				}
				records = append(records, contracts.SystemSurfaceRecord{
					ID:   strings.ToLower(name),
					Name: name,
					Fields: map[string]any{
						"kind":   "Computer",
						"status": "Discovered",
						"remote": `\\` + name,
					},
				})
			}
			procNetApiBufferFree.Call(uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(buffer)))
			buffer = nil
		}

		if result == nerrSuccess {
			break
		}
		if result != errorMoreData {
			return records, windowsError(result, callErr)
		}
	}

	sort.SliceStable(records, func(i, j int) bool {
		return strings.ToLower(records[i].Name) < strings.ToLower(records[j].Name)
	})
	return records, nil
}

// ListNetworkShares lists non-administrative shares exposed by one computer.
// Returned remote paths are ordinary UNC paths, allowing DirectoryPane to hand
// browsing back to the filesystem source when the user opens a share.
func ListNetworkShares(computer string) ([]contracts.SystemSurfaceRecord, error) {
	computer = strings.TrimSpace(strings.TrimPrefix(computer, `\\`))
	if computer == "" {
		return []contracts.SystemSurfaceRecord{}, nil
	}

	serverName, err := windows.UTF16PtrFromString(`\\` + computer)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	var buffer *byte
	var entriesRead uint32
	var totalEntries uint32
	var resumeHandle uint32
	records := make([]contracts.SystemSurfaceRecord, 0, 16)

	for {
		result, _, callErr := procNetShareEnum.Call(
			uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(serverName)),
			1,
			uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(&buffer)),
			maxPreferredLength,
			uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(&entriesRead)),
			uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(&totalEntries)),
			uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(&resumeHandle)),
		)

		if buffer != nil {
			base := uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(buffer))
			rowSize := unsafe.Sizeof(shareInfo1{})
			for i := uint32(0); i < entriesRead; i++ {
				row := (*shareInfo1)(unsafe.Pointer(base + uintptr(i)*rowSize))
				name := strings.TrimSpace(windows.UTF16PtrToString(row.NetName))
				if name == "" || strings.HasSuffix(name, "$") {
					continue
				}
				remark := strings.TrimSpace(windows.UTF16PtrToString(row.Remark))
				unc := `\\` + computer + `\` + name
				records = append(records, contracts.SystemSurfaceRecord{
					ID:   strings.ToLower(computer + "/" + name),
					Name: name,
					Fields: map[string]any{
						"kind":      "Share",
						"status":    shareTypeName(row.Type),
						"remote":    unc,
						"remark":    remark,
						"shareType": row.Type,
					},
				})
			}
			procNetApiBufferFree.Call(uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(buffer)))
			buffer = nil
		}

		if result == nerrSuccess {
			break
		}
		if result != errorMoreData {
			return records, windowsError(result, callErr)
		}
	}

	sort.SliceStable(records, func(i, j int) bool {
		return strings.ToLower(records[i].Name) < strings.ToLower(records[j].Name)
	})
	return records, nil
}

func shareTypeName(value uint32) string {
	switch value & 0xff {
	case 0:
		return "Disk"
	case 1:
		return "Printer"
	case 2:
		return "Device"
	case 3:
		return "IPC"
	default:
		return "Share"
	}
}

// ListNetworkSurface returns the Manager-owned network:// rows without launching
// PowerShell, cmd.exe, netstat, or any other child process.
func ListNetworkSurface() ([]contracts.SystemSurfaceRecord, error) {
	records := make([]contracts.SystemSurfaceRecord, 0, 128)

	adapters, adapterErr := networkAdapterRecords()
	records = append(records, adapters...)

	tcp4, tcp4Err := tcpRecords(addressFamilyIPv4)
	records = append(records, tcp4...)

	tcp6, tcp6Err := tcpRecords(addressFamilyIPv6)
	records = append(records, tcp6...)

	udp4, udp4Err := udpRecords(addressFamilyIPv4)
	records = append(records, udp4...)

	udp6, udp6Err := udpRecords(addressFamilyIPv6)
	records = append(records, udp6...)

	// A partially available Network pane is more useful than failing the whole
	// surface because one Windows table is unavailable. Return an error only if
	// every native source failed.
	errors := compactErrors(adapterErr, tcp4Err, tcp6Err, udp4Err, udp6Err)
	if len(records) == 0 && len(errors) > 0 {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("list network: %s", strings.Join(errors, "; "))
	}

	sort.SliceStable(records, func(i, j int) bool {
		ki := fmt.Sprint(records[i].Fields["kind"])
		kj := fmt.Sprint(records[j].Fields["kind"])
		if ki != kj {
			return networkKindOrder(ki) < networkKindOrder(kj)
		}
		return strings.ToLower(records[i].Name) < strings.ToLower(records[j].Name)
	})

	return records, nil
}

func networkAdapterRecords() ([]contracts.SystemSurfaceRecord, error) {
	interfaces, err := net.Interfaces()
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("interfaces: %w", err)
	}

	metadata, metadataErr := NetworkAdapterMetadata()
	records := make([]contracts.SystemSurfaceRecord, 0, len(interfaces))
	for _, iface := range interfaces {
		addresses, _ := iface.Addrs()
		ipAddresses := make([]string, 0, len(addresses))
		for _, address := range addresses {
			if value := strings.TrimSpace(address.String()); value != "" {
				ipAddresses = append(ipAddresses, value)
			}
		}

		status := "Down"
		if iface.Flags&net.FlagUp != 0 {
			status = "Up"
		}

		fields := map[string]any{
			"kind":      "Adapter",
			"status":    status,
			"local":     strings.Join(ipAddresses, " · "),
			"remote":    "",
			"index":     iface.Index,
			"mtu":       iface.MTU,
			"flags":     iface.Flags.String(),
			"addresses": ipAddresses,
			"address":   firstString(ipAddresses),
			"mac":       iface.HardwareAddr.String(),
		}

		if rich, ok := metadata[uint32(iface.Index)]; ok {
			for key, value := range rich {
				fields[key] = value
			}
			if value := strings.TrimSpace(fmt.Sprint(rich["friendlyName"])); value != "" {
				// Preserve the Go interface name as interfaceName while showing
				// the friendly Windows adapter name in the row.
				fields["interfaceName"] = iface.Name
			}
			if richAddresses, ok := rich["addresses"].([]string); ok && len(richAddresses) > 0 {
				fields["local"] = strings.Join(richAddresses, " · ")
			}
		}

		name := iface.Name
		if rich, ok := metadata[uint32(iface.Index)]; ok {
			if friendly := strings.TrimSpace(fmt.Sprint(rich["friendlyName"])); friendly != "" {
				name = friendly
			}
		}

		records = append(records, contracts.SystemSurfaceRecord{
			ID:     fmt.Sprintf("adapter:%d", iface.Index),
			Name:   name,
			Fields: fields,
		})
	}

	if len(records) == 0 && metadataErr != nil {
		return nil, metadataErr
	}
	return records, nil
}

func tcpRecords(family uint32) ([]contracts.SystemSurfaceRecord, error) {
	buffer, err := extendedTableBuffer(procGetExtendedTcpTable, family, tcpTableOwnerPIDAll)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("tcp table af=%d: %w", family, err)
	}
	if len(buffer) < 4 {
		return []contracts.SystemSurfaceRecord{}, nil
	}

	count := binary.LittleEndian.Uint32(buffer[:4])
	offset := uintptr(4)

	switch family {
	case addressFamilyIPv4:
		rowSize := unsafe.Sizeof(mibTCPRowOwnerPID{})
		records := make([]contracts.SystemSurfaceRecord, 0, count)
		for i := uint32(0); i < count; i++ {
			if offset+rowSize > uintptr(len(buffer)) {
				break
			}
			row := *(*mibTCPRowOwnerPID)(unsafe.Pointer(&buffer[offset]))
			offset += rowSize

			local := endpoint(ipv4FromDWORD(row.LocalAddr), portFromDWORD(row.LocalPort))
			remote := endpoint(ipv4FromDWORD(row.RemoteAddr), portFromDWORD(row.RemotePort))
			records = append(records, networkSocketRecord(
				"TCP",
				tcpState(row.State),
				local,
				remote,
				row.OwningPID,
				"4",
			))
		}
		return records, nil

	case addressFamilyIPv6:
		rowSize := unsafe.Sizeof(mibTCP6RowOwnerPID{})
		records := make([]contracts.SystemSurfaceRecord, 0, count)
		for i := uint32(0); i < count; i++ {
			if offset+rowSize > uintptr(len(buffer)) {
				break
			}
			row := *(*mibTCP6RowOwnerPID)(unsafe.Pointer(&buffer[offset]))
			offset += rowSize

			local := endpoint(ipv6WithScope(row.LocalAddr, row.LocalScopeID), portFromDWORD(row.LocalPort))
			remote := endpoint(ipv6WithScope(row.RemoteAddr, row.RemoteScopeID), portFromDWORD(row.RemotePort))
			records = append(records, networkSocketRecord(
				"TCP",
				tcpState(row.State),
				local,
				remote,
				row.OwningPID,
				"6",
			))
		}
		return records, nil
	default:
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("unsupported address family %d", family)
	}
}

func udpRecords(family uint32) ([]contracts.SystemSurfaceRecord, error) {
	buffer, err := extendedTableBuffer(procGetExtendedUdpTable, family, udpTableOwnerPID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("udp table af=%d: %w", family, err)
	}
	if len(buffer) < 4 {
		return []contracts.SystemSurfaceRecord{}, nil
	}

	count := binary.LittleEndian.Uint32(buffer[:4])
	offset := uintptr(4)

	switch family {
	case addressFamilyIPv4:
		rowSize := unsafe.Sizeof(mibUDPRowOwnerPID{})
		records := make([]contracts.SystemSurfaceRecord, 0, count)
		for i := uint32(0); i < count; i++ {
			if offset+rowSize > uintptr(len(buffer)) {
				break
			}
			row := *(*mibUDPRowOwnerPID)(unsafe.Pointer(&buffer[offset]))
			offset += rowSize

			local := endpoint(ipv4FromDWORD(row.LocalAddr), portFromDWORD(row.LocalPort))
			records = append(records, networkSocketRecord("UDP", "Listening", local, "", row.OwningPID, "4"))
		}
		return records, nil

	case addressFamilyIPv6:
		rowSize := unsafe.Sizeof(mibUDP6RowOwnerPID{})
		records := make([]contracts.SystemSurfaceRecord, 0, count)
		for i := uint32(0); i < count; i++ {
			if offset+rowSize > uintptr(len(buffer)) {
				break
			}
			row := *(*mibUDP6RowOwnerPID)(unsafe.Pointer(&buffer[offset]))
			offset += rowSize

			local := endpoint(ipv6WithScope(row.LocalAddr, row.LocalScopeID), portFromDWORD(row.LocalPort))
			records = append(records, networkSocketRecord("UDP", "Listening", local, "", row.OwningPID, "6"))
		}
		return records, nil
	default:
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("unsupported address family %d", family)
	}
}

func extendedTableBuffer(proc *windows.LazyProc, family, tableClass uint32) ([]byte, error) {
	var size uint32

	result, _, callErr := proc.Call(
		0,
		uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(&size)),
		0,
		uintptr(family),
		uintptr(tableClass),
		0,
	)
	if result != 0 && syscall.Errno(result) != errorInsufficientBuffer {
		return nil, windowsError(result, callErr)
	}
	if size == 0 {
		return []byte{}, nil
	}

	buffer := make([]byte, size)
	result, _, callErr = proc.Call(
		uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(&buffer[0])),
		uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(&size)),
		0,
		uintptr(family),
		uintptr(tableClass),
		0,
	)
	if result != 0 {
		return nil, windowsError(result, callErr)
	}
	return buffer[:size], nil
}

func windowsError(result uintptr, callErr error) error {
	if result != 0 {
		return syscall.Errno(result)
	}
	if callErr != nil && callErr != windows.ERROR_SUCCESS {
		return callErr
	}
	return syscall.EINVAL
}

func networkSocketRecord(
	kind, status, local, remote string,
	pid uint32,
	ipVersion string,
) contracts.SystemSurfaceRecord {
	name := kind + " " + local
	id := fmt.Sprintf(
		"%s%s:%d:%s:%s",
		strings.ToLower(kind),
		ipVersion,
		pid,
		local,
		remote,
	)
	return contracts.SystemSurfaceRecord{
		ID:   id,
		Name: name,
		Fields: map[string]any{
			"kind":      kind,
			"status":    status,
			"local":     local,
			"remote":    remote,
			"pid":       pid,
			"ipVersion": ipVersion,
		},
	}
}

func ipv4FromDWORD(value uint32) string {
	ip := net.IPv4(
		byte(value),
		byte(value>>8),
		byte(value>>16),
		byte(value>>24),
	)
	return ip.String()
}

func ipv6WithScope(address [16]byte, scopeID uint32) string {
	ip := net.IP(address[:]).String()
	if scopeID == 0 {
		return ip
	}
	return fmt.Sprintf("%s%%%d", ip, scopeID)
}

func portFromDWORD(value uint32) uint16 {
	raw := uint16(value)
	return raw<<8 | raw>>8
}

func endpoint(address string, port uint16) string {
	if strings.Contains(address, ":") {
		return fmt.Sprintf("[%s]:%d", address, port)
	}
	return fmt.Sprintf("%s:%d", address, port)
}

func tcpState(state uint32) string {
	switch state {
	case 1:
		return "Closed"
	case 2:
		return "Listen"
	case 3:
		return "SynSent"
	case 4:
		return "SynReceived"
	case 5:
		return "Established"
	case 6:
		return "FinWait1"
	case 7:
		return "FinWait2"
	case 8:
		return "CloseWait"
	case 9:
		return "Closing"
	case 10:
		return "LastAck"
	case 11:
		return "TimeWait"
	case 12:
		return "DeleteTCB"
	default:
		return fmt.Sprintf("State %d", state)
	}
}

func compactErrors(errors ...error) []string {
	result := make([]string, 0, len(errors))
	for _, err := range errors {
		if err != nil {
			result = append(result, err.Error())
		}
	}
	return result
}

func networkKindOrder(kind string) int {
	switch kind {
	case "Adapter":
		return 0
	case "TCP":
		return 1
	case "UDP":
		return 2
	default:
		return 3
	}
}
`````

`````go
func OpenFileWithChooser(path string) error {
	return fmt.Errorf("open with chooser is not provided by this desktop; select an application explicitly")

func OpenFileWithApplication(path, application string) error {
	application = strings.TrimSpace(application)
	if application == "" {
		return fmt.Errorf("open with: application is required")
	}

	if runtime.GOOS == "darwin" {
		return startDetached(exec.Command("open", "-a", application, path))
	}

	// On Linux this intentionally accepts an executable name or absolute path.
	// We do not route through a shell, so user input cannot inject shell syntax.
	return startDetached(exec.Command(application, path))
}
`````

`````go
//go:build windows

package platform

import (
	"fmt"
	"os/exec"
	"strings"
)

func OpenFileWithChooser(path string) error {
	ret, callErr, err := shellExecute("openas", path)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if ret > 32 {
		return nil
	}
	if callErr != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("Open With failed: %w", callErr)
	}
	return fmt.Errorf("Open With failed with code %d", ret)
}

func OpenFileWithApplication(path, application string) error {
	application = strings.TrimSpace(application)
	if application == "" {
		return fmt.Errorf("open with: application is required")
	}

	cmd := exec.Command(application, path)
	return cmd.Start()
}
`````

`````go
package platform

import (

func TestToSlash(t *testing.T) {
	if got := ToSlash(`C:\Users\name`); got != "C:/Users/name" {
		t.Fatalf("ToSlash failed: %q", got)
	}

	}

	tests := []struct {
		input string
		want  string
	}{
		{`C:\Users\name`, "C:/Users/name"},
		{"/home/user/", "home/user"},
		{"///a///b///", "a///b"},
		{"", ""},
		{"no-separators", "no-separators"},
	}
	for _, tc := range tests {
		got := Normalize(tc.input)
		if got != tc.want {
			t.Fatalf("Normalize(%q) = %q, want %q", tc.input, got, tc.want)
		}
	}
}

	tests := []struct {
		base  string
		child string
		want  string
	}{

		{"", "docs", "docs"},
		{"/home/", "/docs/", "home/docs"},
	}
	for _, tc := range tests {
		got := JoinNormalized(tc.base, tc.child)
		if got != tc.want {
			t.Fatalf("JoinNormalized(%q, %q) = %q, want %q", tc.base, tc.child, got, tc.want)
		}
	}
}

func TestJoin(t *testing.T) {
	if got := Join("a", "b", "c"); got != "a/b/c" {
		t.Fatalf("Join failed: %q", got)
	}
	if got := Join(); got != "" {
		t.Fatalf("Join() with no args failed: %q", got)
	}
}

func TestParentPath(t *testing.T) {
	tests := []struct {
		input string
		want  string
	}{
		{"/home/user/docs", "/home/user"},
		{"/home/user", "/home"},
		{"/home", "/"},
		{"/", "/"},
		{"C:/Users", "C:/"},

	if dir != "/home/user" || base != "file.txt" || name != "file" || ext != ".txt" {
		t.Fatalf("SplitPath failed: dir=%q base=%q name=%q ext=%q", dir, base, name, ext)

	dir, base, name, ext = SplitPath("/home/user/.gitignore")
	// filepath.Ext(".gitignore") returns ".gitignore"; name becomes ""
	if name != "" || ext != ".gitignore" {
		t.Fatalf("SplitPath dotfile failed: name=%q ext=%q", name, ext)
	}

	if len(crumbs) != 4 {

	if crumbs[1]["label"] != "home" || crumbs[2]["label"] != "user" || crumbs[3]["label"] != "docs" {
`````

## File: manager/internal/platform/paths.go
`````go
package platform

import (
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"
)

func ToSlash(path string) string {
	return filepath.ToSlash(path)
}

func CleanPath(path string) string {
	return ToSlash(filepath.Clean(path))
}

func Normalize(path string) string {
	return strings.Trim(strings.ReplaceAll(path, "\\", "/"), "/")
}

func JoinNormalized(base, child string) string {
	base = Normalize(base)
	child = Normalize(child)
	if base == "" {
		return child
	}
	return base + "/" + child
}

func Join(parts ...string) string {
	if len(parts) == 0 {
		return ""
	}
	return ToSlash(filepath.Join(parts...))
}

func ParentPath(path string) string {
	parent := filepath.Dir(path)
	if parent == path {
		return ToSlash(path)
	}
	return ToSlash(parent)
}

func SplitPath(path string) (dir, base, name, ext string) {
	dir, base = filepath.Split(path)
	ext = filepath.Ext(base)
	name = strings.TrimSuffix(base, ext)
	return CleanPath(dir), base, name, ext
}

func Breadcrumbs(path string) []map[string]string {
	path = filepath.Clean(path)

	type segment struct {
		label string
		path  string
	}
	segments := make([]segment, 0)
	current := path
	for {
		parent := filepath.Dir(current)
		isRoot := parent == current

		label := filepath.Base(current)
		if isRoot {
			label = current
		}

		segments = append(segments, segment{label: label, path: current})
		if isRoot {
			break
		}
		current = parent
	}

	for left, right := 0, len(segments)-1; left < right; left, right = left+1, right-1 {
		segments[left], segments[right] = segments[right], segments[left]
	}

	crumbs := make([]map[string]string, len(segments))
	for index, seg := range segments {
		crumbs[index] = map[string]string{
			"label": seg.label,
			"path":  ToSlash(seg.path),
		}
	}
	return crumbs
}
`````

`````go
//go:build !windows

package platform

import (
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"os/exec"
	"path/filepath"
	"runtime"
)

func RevealInFileManager(path string) error {
	if runtime.GOOS == "darwin" {
		return startDetached(exec.Command("open", "-R", path))
	}

	info, err := os.Stat(path)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}

	target := path
	if !info.IsDir() {
		target = filepath.Dir(path)
	}

	if _, err := exec.LookPath("xdg-open"); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("reveal: xdg-open is unavailable: %w", err)
	}
	return startDetached(exec.Command("xdg-open", target))
}
`````

`````go
//go:build windows

package platform

import (
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"os/exec"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"
)

func RevealInFileManager(path string) error {
	path = strings.TrimSpace(path)
	if path == "" {
		return fmt.Errorf("reveal: empty path")
	}

	info, err := os.Stat(path)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}

	if info.IsDir() {
		return exec.Command("explorer.exe", path).Start()
	}

	// Explorer's /select syntax requires the comma as part of the same argument.
	return exec.Command(
		"explorer.exe",
		"/select,"+filepath.Clean(path),
	).Start()
}
`````

`````go
//go:build !windows

package platform

import (
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"
)

func CreateShortcut(target, shortcutPath string) error {
	target = strings.TrimSpace(target)
	shortcutPath = strings.TrimSpace(shortcutPath)
	if target == "" || shortcutPath == "" {
		return fmt.Errorf("shortcut: target and destination are required")
	}
	if _, err := os.Lstat(shortcutPath); err == nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("shortcut: destination already exists: %s", shortcutPath)
	} else if !os.IsNotExist(err) {
		return err
	}
	if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(shortcutPath), 0755); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return os.Symlink(target, shortcutPath)
}
`````

## File: manager/internal/platform/shortcut_windows.go
`````go
//go:build windows

package platform

import (
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"os/exec"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"
)

func CreateShortcut(target, shortcutPath string) error {
	target = strings.TrimSpace(target)
	shortcutPath = strings.TrimSpace(shortcutPath)
	if target == "" || shortcutPath == "" {
		return fmt.Errorf("shortcut: target and destination are required")
	}
	if !strings.EqualFold(filepath.Ext(shortcutPath), ".lnk") {
		shortcutPath += ".lnk"
	}
	if _, err := os.Lstat(shortcutPath); err == nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("shortcut: destination already exists: %s", shortcutPath)
	} else if !os.IsNotExist(err) {
		return err
	}
	if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(shortcutPath), 0755); err != nil {
		return err
	}

	const script = `
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$target = $env:FM_SHORTCUT_TARGET
$path = $env:FM_SHORTCUT_PATH
$shell = New-Object -ComObject WScript.Shell
$link = $shell.CreateShortcut($path)
$link.TargetPath = $target
if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $target -PathType Leaf) {
  $link.WorkingDirectory = Split-Path -Parent $target
} else {
  $link.WorkingDirectory = $target
}
$link.Save()
`
	cmd := exec.Command(
		"powershell",
		"-NoProfile",
		"-NonInteractive",
		"-ExecutionPolicy",
		"Bypass",
		"-Command",
		script,
	)
	cmd.Env = append(
		os.Environ(),
		"FM_SHORTCUT_TARGET="+target,
		"FM_SHORTCUT_PATH="+shortcutPath,
	)
	output, err := cmd.CombinedOutput()
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf(
			"shortcut: powershell: %w: %s",
			err,
			strings.TrimSpace(string(output)),
		)
	}
	return nil
}
`````

`````go
//go:build !windows

package platform

import (
	"os"
	"path/filepath"

	contracts "wails-app/internal/contracts"
)

func getSpecialFoldersPlatform() []contracts.SpecialFolder {
	home := getHomeDir()
	if home == "" {
		return nil
	}

	folders := []contracts.SpecialFolder{
		{Name: "Home", Path: home, Icon: "home"},
	}

	xdgDirs := []struct {
		name string
		icon string
		env  string
		def  string
	}{
		{name: "Desktop", icon: "desktop", env: "XDG_DESKTOP_DIR", def: "Desktop"},
		{name: "Documents", icon: "documents", env: "XDG_DOCUMENTS_DIR", def: "Documents"},
		{name: "Downloads", icon: "downloads", env: "XDG_DOWNLOAD_DIR", def: "Downloads"},
		{name: "Music", icon: "music", env: "XDG_MUSIC_DIR", def: "Music"},
		{name: "Pictures", icon: "pictures", env: "XDG_PICTURES_DIR", def: "Pictures"},
		{name: "Videos", icon: "videos", env: "XDG_VIDEOS_DIR", def: "Videos"},
	}

	for _, dir := range xdgDirs {
		path := os.Getenv(dir.env)
		if path == "" {
			path = filepath.Join(home, dir.def)
		}
		if stat, err := os.Stat(path); err == nil && stat.IsDir() {
			folders = append(folders, contracts.SpecialFolder{
				Name: dir.name,
				Path: filepath.ToSlash(path),
				Icon: dir.icon,
			})
		}
	}

	return folders
}
`````

`````go
package platform

import (
	"path/filepath"
	"syscall"
	"unsafe"

	"golang.org/x/sys/windows"

	contracts "wails-app/internal/contracts"
)

var (
	folderDesktop         = windows.GUID{Data1: 0xB4BFCC3A, Data2: 0xDB2C, Data3: 0x424C, Data4: [8]byte{0xB0, 0x29, 0x7F, 0xE9, 0x9A, 0x87, 0xC6, 0x41}}
	folderDocuments       = windows.GUID{Data1: 0xFDD39AD0, Data2: 0x238F, Data3: 0x46AF, Data4: [8]byte{0xAD, 0xB4, 0x6C, 0x85, 0x48, 0x03, 0x69, 0xC7}}
	folderDownloads       = windows.GUID{Data1: 0x374DE290, Data2: 0x123F, Data3: 0x4565, Data4: [8]byte{0x91, 0x64, 0x39, 0xC4, 0x92, 0x5E, 0x46, 0x7B}}
	folderMusic           = windows.GUID{Data1: 0x4BD8D571, Data2: 0x6D19, Data3: 0x48D3, Data4: [8]byte{0xBE, 0x97, 0x42, 0x22, 0x20, 0x08, 0x0E, 0x43}}
	folderPictures        = windows.GUID{Data1: 0x33E28130, Data2: 0x4E1E, Data3: 0x4676, Data4: [8]byte{0x83, 0x5A, 0x98, 0x39, 0x5C, 0x3B, 0xC3, 0xBB}}
	folderVideos          = windows.GUID{Data1: 0x18989B1D, Data2: 0x99B5, Data3: 0x455B, Data4: [8]byte{0x84, 0x1C, 0xAB, 0x7C, 0x74, 0xE4, 0xDD, 0xFC}}
	specialFoldersShell32 = syscall.NewLazyDLL("shell32.dll")
)

var procSHGetKnownFolderPath = specialFoldersShell32.NewProc("SHGetKnownFolderPath")

func getSpecialFoldersPlatform() []contracts.SpecialFolder {
	folders := make([]contracts.SpecialFolder, 0, 7)

	appendIfPresent := func(name, path, icon string) {
		if path != "" {
			folders = append(folders, contracts.SpecialFolder{Name: name, Path: path, Icon: icon})
		}
	}

	appendIfPresent("Home", getHomeDir(), "home")
	appendIfPresent("Desktop", getKnownFolderPath(&folderDesktop), "desktop")
	appendIfPresent("Documents", getKnownFolderPath(&folderDocuments), "documents")
	appendIfPresent("Downloads", getKnownFolderPath(&folderDownloads), "downloads")
	appendIfPresent("Music", getKnownFolderPath(&folderMusic), "music")
	appendIfPresent("Pictures", getKnownFolderPath(&folderPictures), "pictures")
	appendIfPresent("Videos", getKnownFolderPath(&folderVideos), "videos")

	return folders
}

func getKnownFolderPath(folderID *windows.GUID) string {
	var path *uint16
	ret, _, _ := procSHGetKnownFolderPath.Call(
		uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(folderID)),
		0,
		0,
		uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(&path)),
	)
	if ret != 0 {
		return ""
	}
	defer windows.CoTaskMemFree(unsafe.Pointer(path))

	result := syscall.UTF16ToString((*[1 << 16]uint16)(unsafe.Pointer(path))[:])
	return filepath.ToSlash(result)
}
`````

## File: manager/internal/platform/system_unix.go
`````go
//go:build !windows

package platform

import (
	"bufio"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"os/exec"
	"path/filepath"
	"runtime"
	"strings"
	"syscall"

	contracts "wails-app/internal/contracts"
)

func getOSTypeAndVersion() (contracts.OSType, string) {
	switch runtime.GOOS {
	case "linux":
		return contracts.OSLinux, readLinuxVersion()
	case "darwin":
		return contracts.OSDarwin, readDarwinVersion()
	default:
		return contracts.OSUnknown, "unknown"
	}
}

func readLinuxVersion() string {
	file, err := os.Open("/etc/os-release")
	if err == nil {
		defer file.Close()
		scanner := bufio.NewScanner(file)
		for scanner.Scan() {
			line := scanner.Text()
			if strings.HasPrefix(line, "VERSION_ID=") {
				return strings.Trim(strings.TrimPrefix(line, "VERSION_ID="), `"`)
			}
		}
	}

	out, err := exec.Command("uname", "-r").Output()
	if err == nil {
		return strings.TrimSpace(string(out))
	}
	return "unknown"
}

func readDarwinVersion() string {
	out, err := exec.Command("sw_vers", "-productVersion").Output()
	if err == nil {
		return strings.TrimSpace(string(out))
	}
	return "unknown"
}

func getSystemDrive() string {
	return "/"
}

func listDrivesPlatform() []contracts.DriveInfo {
	if runtime.GOOS == "darwin" {
		return listDrivesDarwin()
	}
	return listDrivesLinux()
}

func listDrivesLinux() []contracts.DriveInfo {
	var drives []contracts.DriveInfo

	file, err := os.Open("/proc/mounts")
	if err != nil {
		return drives
	}
	defer file.Close()

	realFS := map[string]bool{
		"ext2": true, "ext3": true, "ext4": true,
		"xfs": true, "btrfs": true, "zfs": true,
		"vfat": true, "ntfs": true, "exfat": true,
		"fuseblk": true, "fuse": true,
	}

	seen := map[string]bool{}
	scanner := bufio.NewScanner(file)
	for scanner.Scan() {
		fields := strings.Fields(scanner.Text())
		if len(fields) < 3 {
			continue
		}
		device, mount, fsType := fields[0], fields[1], fields[2]
		if !realFS[strings.ToLower(fsType)] || seen[mount] {
			continue
		}
		seen[mount] = true

		var stat syscall.Statfs_t
		if err := syscall.Statfs(mount, &stat); err != nil {
			continue
		}

		total := int64(stat.Blocks) * int64(stat.Bsize)
		free := int64(stat.Bfree) * int64(stat.Bsize)
		name := filepath.Base(device)
		if name == "." || name == string(filepath.Separator) {
			name = device
		}
		fs := fsType

		drives = append(drives, contracts.DriveInfo{
			Name:       name,
			Path:       mount,
			SchemeType: guessSchemeTypeLinux(device),
			TotalSpace: total,
			FreeSpace:  free,
			FileSystem: &fs,
		})
	}

	return drives
}

func guessSchemeTypeLinux(device string) contracts.SchemeType {
	if strings.Contains(device, ":") || strings.HasPrefix(device, "//") {
		return contracts.SchemeNetwork
	}
	if strings.Contains(device, "sr") || strings.Contains(device, "cdrom") {
		return contracts.SchemeCDROM
	}
	if strings.HasPrefix(device, "tmpfs") || strings.HasPrefix(device, "ramfs") {
		return contracts.SchemeRAMDisk
	}

	name := filepath.Base(device)
	for _, candidate := range linuxBlockDeviceCandidates(name) {
		removablePath := fmt.Sprintf("/sys/block/%s/removable", candidate)
		data, err := os.ReadFile(removablePath)
		if err == nil && strings.TrimSpace(string(data)) == "1" {
			return contracts.SchemeRemovable
		}
	}
	return contracts.SchemeFixed
}

func linuxBlockDeviceCandidates(name string) []string {
	trimmed := strings.TrimSpace(name)
	if trimmed == "" {
		return nil
	}

	candidates := []string{trimmed}
	if prefix, ok := trimLinuxPSuffix(trimmed); ok {
		candidates = append(candidates, prefix)
	}
	if prefix := strings.TrimRight(trimmed, "0123456789"); prefix != "" && prefix != trimmed {
		candidates = append(candidates, prefix)
	}

	unique := make([]string, 0, len(candidates))
	seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(candidates))
	for _, candidate := range candidates {
		if candidate == "" {
			continue
		}
		if _, ok := seen[candidate]; ok {
			continue
		}
		seen[candidate] = struct{}{}
		unique = append(unique, candidate)
	}
	return unique
}

func trimLinuxPSuffix(name string) (string, bool) {
	idx := strings.LastIndex(name, "p")
	if idx <= 0 || idx >= len(name)-1 {
		return "", false
	}
	suffix := name[idx+1:]
	if strings.Trim(suffix, "0123456789") != "" {
		return "", false
	}
	prefix := name[:idx]
	if !strings.ContainsAny(prefix, "0123456789") {
		return "", false
	}
	return prefix, true
}

func listDrivesDarwin() []contracts.DriveInfo {
	var drives []contracts.DriveInfo

	out, err := exec.Command("df", "-k").Output()
	if err != nil {
		return drives
	}

	lines := strings.Split(string(out), "\n")
	for i, line := range lines {
		if i == 0 || strings.TrimSpace(line) == "" {
			continue
		}
		fields := strings.Fields(line)
		if len(fields) < 9 {
			continue
		}
		device := fields[0]
		mount := strings.Join(fields[8:], " ")
		if !strings.HasPrefix(device, "/dev/") && !strings.HasPrefix(device, "//") {
			continue
		}

		var stat syscall.Statfs_t
		if err := syscall.Statfs(mount, &stat); err != nil {
			continue
		}

		total := int64(stat.Blocks) * int64(stat.Bsize)
		free := int64(stat.Bfree) * int64(stat.Bsize)
		name := filepath.Base(device)
		fsType := getFSTypeDarwin(mount)

		drives = append(drives, contracts.DriveInfo{
			Name:       name,
			Path:       mount,
			SchemeType: guessSchemeTypeDarwin(device),
			TotalSpace: total,
			FreeSpace:  free,
			FileSystem: &fsType,
		})
	}

	return drives
}

func getFSTypeDarwin(mount string) string {
	out, err := exec.Command("stat", "-f", "%T", mount).Output()
	if err != nil {
		return "unknown"
	}
	return strings.TrimSpace(string(out))
}

func guessSchemeTypeDarwin(device string) contracts.SchemeType {
	if strings.Contains(device, ":") || strings.HasPrefix(device, "//") {
		return contracts.SchemeNetwork
	}
	if strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(device), "disk") {
		return contracts.SchemeFixed
	}
	return contracts.SchemeUnknown
}
`````

## File: manager/internal/platform/system_windows.go
`````go
//go:build windows

package platform

import (
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"
	"syscall"
	"unsafe"

	"golang.org/x/sys/windows"
	"golang.org/x/sys/windows/registry"

	contracts "wails-app/internal/contracts"
)

func getOSTypeAndVersion() (contracts.OSType, string) {
	key, err := registry.OpenKey(registry.LOCAL_MACHINE,
		`SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion`, registry.QUERY_VALUE)
	if err != nil {
		return contracts.OSWindows, "unknown"
	}
	defer key.Close()

	major, _, _ := key.GetIntegerValue("CurrentMajorVersionNumber")
	minor, _, _ := key.GetIntegerValue("CurrentMinorVersionNumber")
	build, _, _ := key.GetStringValue("CurrentBuildNumber")
	ubr, _, _ := key.GetIntegerValue("UBR")

	version := ""
	if ubr > 0 {
		version = strings.Join([]string{
			intToStr(int(major)), intToStr(int(minor)), build, intToStr(int(ubr)),
		}, ".")
	} else {
		version = strings.Join([]string{intToStr(int(major)), intToStr(int(minor)), build}, ".")
	}

	return contracts.OSWindows, version
}

func getSystemDrive() string {
	if drive := os.Getenv("SystemDrive"); drive != "" {
		return driveRootReference(drive)
	}
	return "filesystem://c"
}

func listDrivesPlatform() []contracts.DriveInfo {
	var drives []contracts.DriveInfo

	buf := make([]uint16, 256)
	n, err := windows.GetLogicalDriveStrings(uint32(len(buf)), &buf[0])
	if err == nil && n > 0 {
		roots := strings.Split(syscall.UTF16ToString(buf[:n]), "\x00")
		for _, root := range roots {
			root = strings.TrimSpace(root)
			if root == "" {
				continue
			}
			// Build drive info and skip virtual/WinFsp mounts so they are hidden from the UI.
			// Some WinFSP-backed filesystems expose a filesystem name or volume name
			// containing "winfsp"; detect and skip those drives here.
			info := buildDriveInfo(root)
			fsName := ""
			if info.FileSystem != nil {
				fsName = strings.ToLower(*info.FileSystem)
			}
			if strings.Contains(fsName, "winfsp") || strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(info.Name), "winfsp") {
				// skip this drive
				continue
			}
			drives = append(drives, info)
		}
	}

	return drives
}

func buildDriveInfo(root string) contracts.DriveInfo {
	rootPtr, _ := syscall.UTF16PtrFromString(root)
	schemeType := toSchemeType(windows.GetDriveType(rootPtr))
	name := strings.TrimSuffix(root, `\`)

	var freeBytesAvailable, totalBytes, totalFreeBytes uint64
	_ = windows.GetDiskFreeSpaceEx(rootPtr,
		(*uint64)(unsafe.Pointer(&freeBytesAvailable)),
		(*uint64)(unsafe.Pointer(&totalBytes)),
		(*uint64)(unsafe.Pointer(&totalFreeBytes)))

	var fsNameBuf [256]uint16
	var volNameBuf [256]uint16
	err := windows.GetVolumeInformation(rootPtr,
		&volNameBuf[0], uint32(len(volNameBuf)),
		nil, nil, nil,
		&fsNameBuf[0], uint32(len(fsNameBuf)))

	var fsName *string
	if err == nil {
		fs := syscall.UTF16ToString(fsNameBuf[:])
		if fs != "" {
			fsName = &fs
		}
		vol := syscall.UTF16ToString(volNameBuf[:])
		if vol != "" {
			name = vol + " (" + name + ")"
		}
	}

	return contracts.DriveInfo{
		Name:       name,
		Path:       driveRootReference(root),
		SchemeType: schemeType,
		TotalSpace: int64(totalBytes),
		FreeSpace:  int64(totalFreeBytes),
		FileSystem: fsName,
	}
}

func driveRootReference(root string) string {
	normalized := strings.TrimSpace(filepath.ToSlash(root))
	if len(normalized) >= 2 && normalized[1] == ':' {
		return "filesystem://" + strings.ToLower(normalized[:1])
	}
	return normalized
}

func toSchemeType(kind uint32) contracts.SchemeType {
	const (
		driveRemovable = 2
		driveFixed     = 3
		driveRemote    = 4
		driveCDROM     = 5
		driveRAMDisk   = 6
	)
	switch kind {
	case driveRemovable:
		return contracts.SchemeRemovable
	case driveFixed:
		return contracts.SchemeFixed
	case driveRemote:
		return contracts.SchemeNetwork
	case driveCDROM:
		return contracts.SchemeCDROM
	case driveRAMDisk:
		return contracts.SchemeRAMDisk
	default:
		return contracts.SchemeUnknown
	}
}

func intToStr(n int) string {
	if n == 0 {
		return "0"
	}
	neg := n < 0
	if neg {
		n = -n
	}
	buf := make([]byte, 0, 20)
	for n > 0 {
		buf = append([]byte{byte('0' + n%10)}, buf...)
		n /= 10
	}
	if neg {
		buf = append([]byte{'-'}, buf...)
	}
	return string(buf)
}

// JoinMountNamespace is not supported on Windows. Return an informative error.
func JoinMountNamespace(nsPath string) error {
	return fmt.Errorf("join mount namespace not supported on Windows: %s", nsPath)
}
`````

`````go
package platform

import (
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"runtime"

	contracts "wails-app/internal/contracts"
	"wails-app/internal/pathref"
)

func GetOSInfo() contracts.OSInfoResponse {
	hostname, _ := os.Hostname()
	arch := runtime.GOARCH

	switch arch {
	case "amd64":
		arch = "x86_64"
	case "arm64":
		arch = "aarch64"
	}

	osType, version := getOSTypeAndVersion()
	var systemDrive *string
	if osType == contracts.OSWindows {
		drive := getSystemDrive()
		systemDrive = &drive
	}

	return contracts.OSInfoResponse{
		OS:          osType,
		Version:     version,
		Arch:        arch,
		Hostname:    hostname,
		SystemDrive: systemDrive,
	}
}

func ListDrives() contracts.DrivesList {
	return contracts.DrivesList{Schemes: append(listDrivesPlatform(), syntheticDrives()...)}
}

func GetSpecialFolders() contracts.SpecialFoldersResponse {
	return contracts.SpecialFoldersResponse{Folders: getSpecialFoldersPlatform()}
}

func getHomeDir() string {
	home, err := os.UserHomeDir()
	if err != nil {
		return ""
	}
	return filepath.ToSlash(home)
}

func syntheticDrives() []contracts.DriveInfo {
	drives := []contracts.DriveInfo{
		{
			Name:       "Registry",
			Path:       pathref.RegistryScheme,
			SchemeType: contracts.SchemeRegistry,
		},
		{
			Name:       "Search",
			Path:       pathref.SearchScheme,
			SchemeType: contracts.SchemeSearch,
		},
		{
			Name:       "HTTP",
			Path:       pathref.HTTPAliasScheme,
			SchemeType: contracts.SchemeHTTP,
		},
		{
			Name:       "HTTPS",
			Path:       pathref.HTTPSAliasScheme,
			SchemeType: contracts.SchemeHTTPS,
		},
		{
			Name:       "SMB",
			Path:       pathref.SMBScheme,
			SchemeType: contracts.SchemeSMB,
		},
		{
			Name:       "S3",
			Path:       pathref.S3Scheme,
			SchemeType: contracts.SchemeS3,
		},
	}

	for _, provider := range pathref.AvailableLocalCloudProviders() {
		drives = append(drives, contracts.DriveInfo{
			Name:       provider.Name,
			Path:       provider.Scheme,
			SchemeType: cloudSchemeType(provider.Scheme),
		})
	}

	return drives
}

func cloudSchemeType(scheme string) contracts.SchemeType {
	switch scheme {
	case pathref.OneDriveScheme:
		return contracts.SchemeCloudOneDrive
	case pathref.GDriveScheme:
		return contracts.SchemeCloudGoogle
	case pathref.DropboxScheme:
		return contracts.SchemeCloudDropbox
	default:
		return contracts.SchemeUnknown
	}
}
`````

`````go
//go:build !windows

package platform

import (
	"fmt"
	"os/exec"
	"runtime"
)

func OpenTerminalAt(path string) error {
	if runtime.GOOS == "darwin" {
		return startDetached(exec.Command("open", "-a", "Terminal", path))
	}

	candidates := []*exec.Cmd{
		exec.Command("x-terminal-emulator", "--working-directory="+path),
		exec.Command("gnome-terminal", "--working-directory="+path),
		exec.Command("konsole", "--workdir", path),
		exec.Command("xfce4-terminal", "--working-directory="+path),
		exec.Command("kitty", "--directory", path),
		exec.Command("alacritty", "--working-directory", path),
	}

	var lastErr error
	for _, cmd := range candidates {
		if _, err := exec.LookPath(cmd.Path); err != nil {
			lastErr = err
			continue
		}
		if err := startDetached(cmd); err == nil {
			return nil
		} else {
			lastErr = err
		}
	}

	if lastErr != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("terminal: no supported terminal emulator could be started: %w", lastErr)
	}
	return fmt.Errorf("terminal: no supported terminal emulator found")
}
`````

`````go
//go:build windows

package platform

import (
	"fmt"
	"os/exec"
	"strings"
)

func OpenTerminalAt(path string) error {
	path = strings.TrimSpace(path)
	if path == "" {
		return fmt.Errorf("terminal: empty path")
	}

	// Prefer Windows Terminal when installed. It understands -d as the startup directory.
	if wt, err := exec.LookPath("wt.exe"); err == nil {
		return exec.Command(wt, "-d", path).Start()
	}

	// cmd.exe opens its own console window from a Wails GUI process.
	return exec.Command("cmd.exe", "/K", "cd", "/d", path).Start()
}
`````

`````go
package plugin

import (
	"context"

	contracts "wails-app/internal/contracts"

// CommandPlugin allows plugins to register custom commands that appear in the
// toolbar and context menu.
type CommandPlugin interface {
	Plugin
	// Commands returns the list of commands this plugin provides.
	Commands() []CommandInfo
	// IsApplicable returns true if the command can act on the given paths.
	IsApplicable(commandID string, paths []string) bool
	// Execute runs the command.
	Execute(ctx context.Context, commandID string, paths []string) error
}

// CommandResult is the standard result shape for command execution.
type CommandResult struct {
	Success bool   `json:"success"`
	Message string `json:"message,omitempty"`
}

// ToOperationResult converts a CommandResult to the standard operation result.
func (r CommandResult) ToOperationResult(paths ...string) contracts.OperationResult {
	return contracts.OperationResult{
		Success:       r.Success,
		Message:       r.Message,
		AffectedPaths: paths,
	}
}
`````
