`````go
	PaneID     string               `json:"paneId"`
	Path       string               `json:"path"`
	Entries    []contracts.FileInfo `json:"entries"`
}

type dirStreamDoneEvent struct {
	StreamID    string `json:"streamId"`
	PaneID      string `json:"paneId"`
	Path        string `json:"path"`
	EntryCount  int    `json:"entryCount"`
	SourceCount int    `json:"sourceCount"`
	TotalSize   int64  `json:"totalSize"`
	DurationMS  int64  `json:"durationMs"`
	EnumerateMS int64  `json:"enumerateMs"`
	IndexMS     int64  `json:"indexMs"`
	SortMS      int64  `json:"sortMs"`
	Generation  uint64 `json:"generation"`
	FromElevate bool   `json:"fromElevate"`
}

type dirStreamErrorEvent struct {
	StreamID   string `json:"streamId"`
	Generation uint64 `json:"generation"`
	PaneID     string `json:"paneId"`
	Path       string `json:"path"`
	Error      string `json:"error"`
	Partial    bool   `json:"partial"`
	EntryCount int    `json:"entryCount"`
}

type ElevatedListFunc func(path string, showHidden bool) ([]contracts.FileInfo, error)
type BuildFileInfoFunc func(name, fullPath string, info os.FileInfo, hidden bool) contracts.FileInfo
type IsHiddenFunc func(name, fullPath string) bool
type ResolvePublicPathFunc func(path string) (string, error)
type VFSListDirFunc func(path string) (*contracts.DirectoryListing, error)
type VFSListDirPageFunc func(ctx context.Context, path, token string, limit int) (*contracts.DirectoryPage, error)
type IsVFSPathFunc func(path string) bool

type DirStreamService struct {
	mu             sync.Mutex
	streams        map[string]context.CancelFunc
	prepared       map[string]preparedDirStream
	paneGeneration map[string]uint64
	nextGeneration uint64
	emitEvent      func(string, interface{})
	elevatedList   ElevatedListFunc
	buildFile      BuildFileInfoFunc
	isHidden       IsHiddenFunc
	resolvePath    ResolvePublicPathFunc
	vfsListDir     VFSListDirFunc
	vfsListDirPage VFSListDirPageFunc
	isVFSPath      IsVFSPathFunc
}

type preparedDirStream struct {
	paneID       string
	path         string
	generation   uint64
	options      DirStreamOptions
	sourceCount  int
	indexedCount int
	totalSize    int64
	complete     bool
	runs         [][]contracts.FileInfo
	entries      []contracts.FileInfo
}

func NewDirStreamService(
	emitEvent func(string, interface{}),
	elevatedList ElevatedListFunc,
	buildFile BuildFileInfoFunc,
	isHidden IsHiddenFunc,
	resolvePath ResolvePublicPathFunc,
) *DirStreamService {
	return &DirStreamService{
		streams:        make(map[string]context.CancelFunc),
		prepared:       make(map[string]preparedDirStream),
		paneGeneration: make(map[string]uint64),
		emitEvent:      emitEvent,
		elevatedList:   elevatedList,
		buildFile:      buildFile,
		isHidden:       isHidden,
		resolvePath:    resolvePath,
	}
}

func (s *DirStreamService) SetVFS(listDir VFSListDirFunc, isVFS IsVFSPathFunc) {
	s.vfsListDir = listDir
	s.isVFSPath = isVFS
}

func (s *DirStreamService) SetVFSPaged(fn VFSListDirPageFunc) { s.vfsListDirPage = fn }

func (s *DirStreamService) Emit(name string, data interface{}) {
	if s.emitEvent != nil {
		s.emitEvent(name, data)
	}
}

func (s *DirStreamService) Register(streamID string, cancel context.CancelFunc) {
	s.mu.Lock()
	s.streams[streamID] = cancel
	s.mu.Unlock()
}

func (s *DirStreamService) Unregister(streamID string) {
	s.mu.Lock()
	delete(s.streams, streamID)
	s.mu.Unlock()
}

func (s *DirStreamService) isCurrent(streamID, paneID string, generation uint64) bool {
	s.mu.Lock()
	defer s.mu.Unlock()
	_, active := s.streams[streamID]
	return active && s.paneGeneration[paneID] == generation
}

func (s *DirStreamService) rememberPrepared(streamID string, generation uint64, stream preparedDirStream) bool {
	s.mu.Lock()
	defer s.mu.Unlock()
	if _, active := s.streams[streamID]; !active || s.paneGeneration[stream.paneID] != generation {
		return false
	}
	stream.generation = generation
	s.prepared[streamID] = stream
	return true
}

func (s *DirStreamService) Window(streamID string, offset, limit int) (*DirStreamWindow, error) {
	started := time.Now()
	s.mu.Lock()
	stream, ok := s.prepared[streamID]
	current := ok && s.paneGeneration[stream.paneID] == stream.generation
	s.mu.Unlock()
	if ok && !current {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("directory stream %q is stale", streamID)
	}
	if !ok {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("directory stream %q is unavailable", streamID)
	}

	if offset < 0 {
		offset = 0
	}
	if limit < 0 {
		limit = 0
	}
	totalCount := stream.indexedCount
	if offset > totalCount {
		offset = totalCount
	}
	windowEntries := []contracts.FileInfo{}
	if stream.complete {
		end := offset + limit
		if end > len(stream.entries) {
			end = len(stream.entries)
		}
		windowEntries = stream.entries[offset:end]
	} else if limit > 0 && totalCount > 0 {
		windowEntries = mergeSortedRunsWindow(stream.runs, stream.options, offset, limit)
	}

	return &DirStreamWindow{
		StreamID:    streamID,
		PaneID:      stream.paneID,
		Path:        stream.path,
		Offset:      offset,
		Limit:       limit,
		TotalCount:  stream.indexedCount,
		SourceCount: stream.sourceCount,
		WindowMS:    time.Since(started).Milliseconds(),
		Entries:     windowEntries,
	}, nil
}

func (s *DirStreamService) Start(paneID, path string, showHidden bool) (string, error) {
	return s.StartWithOptions(paneID, path, showHidden, DirStreamOptions{
		SortField: "name", SortDirection: "asc", DirectoriesFirst: true,
	})
}

func (s *DirStreamService) StartWithOptions(paneID, path string, showHidden bool, options DirStreamOptions) (string, error) {
	if path == "" {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("path is required")
	}
	streamID := fmt.Sprintf("%s-%d", paneID, time.Now().UnixNano())
	ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())

	s.mu.Lock()
	s.nextGeneration++
	generation := s.nextGeneration
	s.paneGeneration[paneID] = generation
	s.streams[streamID] = cancel
	s.prepared[streamID] = preparedDirStream{
		paneID:     paneID,
		path:       internalplatform.ToSlash(path),
		generation: generation,
		options:    options,
		runs:       [][]contracts.FileInfo{},
		entries:    []contracts.FileInfo{},
	}
	s.mu.Unlock()

	work.Default.Submit(ctx, work.Task{
		Key:      "directory-stream:" + streamID,
		Priority: work.PriorityVisible,
		Kind:     "directory",
		Run: func(taskCtx context.Context, reporter work.Reporter) error {
			s.run(
				taskCtx,
				streamID,
				paneID,
				internalplatform.ToSlash(path),
				showHidden,
				options,
				generation,
			)
			if err := taskCtx.Err(); err != nil {
				return err
			}
			return nil
		},
	})
	return streamID, nil
}

func (s *DirStreamService) Cancel(streamID string) {
	if streamID == "" {
		return
	}
	s.mu.Lock()
	cancel := s.streams[streamID]
	delete(s.streams, streamID)
	delete(s.prepared, streamID)
	s.mu.Unlock()
	if cancel != nil {
		cancel()
	}
}

func (s *DirStreamService) CancelAll() {
	s.mu.Lock()
	cancels := make([]context.CancelFunc, 0, len(s.streams))
	for id, cancel := range s.streams {
		delete(s.streams, id)
		delete(s.prepared, id)
		if cancel != nil {
			cancels = append(cancels, cancel)
		}
	}
	s.mu.Unlock()
	for _, cancel := range cancels {
		cancel()
	}
}

type localDirPopulation struct {
	nativePath string
	entries    []fs.DirEntry
}

func (s *DirStreamService) enumerateLocalDirectory(
	ctx context.Context,
	path string,
	showHidden bool,
) (*localDirPopulation, error) {
	nativePath, err := s.resolveNativePath(path)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	dir, err := os.Open(nativePath)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer dir.Close()

	raw, err := dir.ReadDir(-1)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
		return nil, context.Canceled
	}

	if showHidden || s.isHidden == nil {
		return &localDirPopulation{nativePath: nativePath, entries: raw}, nil
	}

	filtered := make([]fs.DirEntry, 0, len(raw))
	for _, entry := range raw {
		if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
			return nil, context.Canceled
		}
		name := entry.Name()
		nativeFullPath := internalplatform.ToSlash(filepath.Join(nativePath, name))
		if !s.isHidden(name, nativeFullPath) {
			filtered = append(filtered, entry)
		}
	}

	return &localDirPopulation{nativePath: nativePath, entries: filtered}, nil
}

func (s *DirStreamService) indexLocalPopulation(
	ctx context.Context,
	path string,
	population *localDirPopulation,
	chunkSize int,
	onBatch func(batch []contracts.FileInfo, batchSize int64),
) error {
	if population == nil {
		return nil
	}
	if chunkSize <= 0 {
		chunkSize = dirStreamBatchSize
	}

	for offset := 0; offset < len(population.entries); offset += chunkSize {
		if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
			return context.Canceled
		}
		end := offset + chunkSize
		if end > len(population.entries) {
			end = len(population.entries)
		}

		batch := make([]contracts.FileInfo, 0, end-offset)
		var batchSize int64
		for _, entry := range population.entries[offset:end] {
			if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
				return context.Canceled
			}
			info, err := entry.Info()
			if err != nil {
				return err
			}
			name := entry.Name()
			nativeFullPath := internalplatform.ToSlash(filepath.Join(population.nativePath, name))
			hidden := s.isHidden != nil && s.isHidden(name, nativeFullPath)
			fi := s.buildFile(name, nativeFullPath, info, hidden)
			fi.Path = joinPublicPath(path, name)
			batch = append(batch, fi)
			batchSize += fi.Size
		}
		if len(batch) > 0 {
			onBatch(batch, batchSize)
		}
	}
	return nil
}

func (s *DirStreamService) run(
	ctx context.Context,
	streamID, paneID, path string,
	showHidden bool,
	options DirStreamOptions,
	generation uint64,
) {
	defer s.Unregister(streamID)

	started := time.Now()
	var enumerateDuration time.Duration
	var indexDuration time.Duration
	var sortDuration time.Duration

	var scan func(
		context.Context,
		string,
		bool,
		int,
		func([]contracts.FileInfo, int64),
	) error

	var localPopulation *localDirPopulation
	if !pathref.IsSearch(path) && (s.isVFSPath == nil || !s.isVFSPath(path)) {
		enumerateStarted := time.Now()
		population, err := s.enumerateLocalDirectory(ctx, path, showHidden)
		enumerateDuration = time.Since(enumerateStarted)
		if err == nil {
			localPopulation = population
		}
		if err != nil {
			if errors.Is(err, context.Canceled) {
				return
			}
			s.finishStreamError(ctx, streamID, paneID, path, showHidden, options, generation, started, enumerateDuration, err)
			return
		}

		totalCount := len(localPopulation.entries)
		if strings.TrimSpace(options.FilterText) != "" {
			totalCount = -1
		}
		if !s.isCurrent(streamID, paneID, generation) {
			return
		}
		s.Emit("fs:listStream:meta", dirStreamMetaEvent{
			StreamID:    streamID,
			PaneID:      paneID,
			Path:        path,
			ShowHidden:  showHidden,
			SourceCount: len(localPopulation.entries),
			TotalCount:  totalCount,
			Generation:  generation,
			EnumerateMS: enumerateDuration.Milliseconds(),
		})

		scan = func(
			ctx context.Context,
			path string,
			_ bool,
			chunkSize int,
			onBatch func([]contracts.FileInfo, int64),
		) error {
			return s.indexLocalPopulation(ctx, path, localPopulation, chunkSize, onBatch)
		}
	} else {
		if !s.isCurrent(streamID, paneID, generation) {
			return
		}
		s.Emit("fs:listStream:meta", dirStreamMetaEvent{
			StreamID:    streamID,
			PaneID:      paneID,
			Path:        path,
			ShowHidden:  showHidden,
			SourceCount: -1,
			TotalCount:  -1,
			Generation:  generation,
			EnumerateMS: 0,
		})
		scan = s.scanDirectoryStream
		if pathref.IsSearch(path) {
			scan = s.scanSearchStream
		} else if s.isVFSPath != nil && s.isVFSPath(path) {
			scan = s.scanVFSStream
		}
	}

	runs := make([][]contracts.FileInfo, 0, 8)
	sourceCount := 0
	var totalSize int64
	previewCount := 0

	scanStarted := time.Now()
	err := scan(ctx, path, showHidden, dirStreamBatchSize, func(batch []contracts.FileInfo, _ int64) {
		if len(batch) == 0 || ctx.Err() != nil || !s.isCurrent(streamID, paneID, generation) {
			return
		}

		sourceCount += len(batch)

		preparedInput := append([]contracts.FileInfo(nil), batch...)

		sortStarted := time.Now()
		preparedBatch := prepareStreamEntries(preparedInput, options)
		sortDuration += time.Since(sortStarted)

		if len(preparedBatch) > 0 {
			runs = append(runs, preparedBatch)
			for _, entry := range preparedBatch {
				totalSize += entry.Size
			}
			if !s.rememberPrepared(streamID, generation, preparedDirStream{
				paneID:       paneID,
				path:         path,
				generation:   generation,
				options:      options,
				sourceCount:  sourceCount,
				indexedCount: countRunEntries(runs),
				totalSize:    totalSize,
				complete:     false,
				runs:         append([][]contracts.FileInfo(nil), runs...),
				entries:      []contracts.FileInfo{},
			}) {
				return
			}
		}

		if previewCount >= dirStreamPreviewLimit || !s.isCurrent(streamID, paneID, generation) {
			return
		}
		remaining := dirStreamPreviewLimit - previewCount
		previewBatch := batch
		if len(previewBatch) > remaining {
			previewBatch = previewBatch[:remaining]
		}
		previewCount += len(previewBatch)
		s.Emit("fs:listStream:batch", dirStreamBatchEvent{
			StreamID:   streamID,
			Generation: generation,
			PaneID:     paneID,
			Path:       path,
			Entries:    previewBatch,
		})
	})
	scanDuration := time.Since(scanStarted)
	if scanDuration > sortDuration {
		indexDuration = scanDuration - sortDuration
	} else {
		indexDuration = scanDuration
	}

	if err == nil {
		sortStarted := time.Now()
		entries := mergeSortedRunsAll(runs, options)
		sortDuration += time.Since(sortStarted)

		entryCount, finalTotalSize := sumPreparedEntries(entries)
		if ctx.Err() != nil || !s.isCurrent(streamID, paneID, generation) {
			return
		}
		if !s.rememberPrepared(streamID, generation, preparedDirStream{
			paneID:       paneID,
			path:         path,
			generation:   generation,
			options:      options,
			sourceCount:  sourceCount,
			indexedCount: entryCount,
			totalSize:    finalTotalSize,
			complete:     true,
			runs:         nil,
			entries:      entries,
		}) {
			return
		}

		s.Emit("fs:listStream:done", dirStreamDoneEvent{
			StreamID:    streamID,
			PaneID:      paneID,
			Path:        path,
			EntryCount:  entryCount,
			SourceCount: sourceCount,
			TotalSize:   finalTotalSize,
			DurationMS:  time.Since(started).Milliseconds(),
			EnumerateMS: enumerateDuration.Milliseconds(),
			IndexMS:     indexDuration.Milliseconds(),
			SortMS:      sortDuration.Milliseconds(),
			Generation:  generation,
		})
		return
	}

	if errors.Is(err, context.Canceled) || ctx.Err() != nil || !s.isCurrent(streamID, paneID, generation) {
		return
	}

	// A remote/provider failure after some pages were indexed is partial, not
	// catastrophic. Seal the rows we already own so window reads remain valid.
	if len(runs) > 0 {
		entries := mergeSortedRunsAll(runs, options)
		count, size := sumPreparedEntries(entries)
		if s.rememberPrepared(streamID, generation, preparedDirStream{
			paneID:       paneID,
			path:         path,
			generation:   generation,
			options:      options,
			sourceCount:  sourceCount,
			indexedCount: count,
			totalSize:    size,
			complete:     true,
			runs:         nil,
			entries:      entries,
		}) {
			s.Emit("fs:listStream:error", dirStreamErrorEvent{
				StreamID:   streamID,
				Generation: generation,
				PaneID:     paneID,
				Path:       path,
				Error:      err.Error(),
				Partial:    true,
				EntryCount: count,
			})
			return
		}
	}

	s.finishStreamError(ctx, streamID, paneID, path, showHidden, options, generation, started, enumerateDuration, err)
}

func (s *DirStreamService) finishStreamError(
	ctx context.Context,
	streamID, paneID, path string,
	showHidden bool,
	options DirStreamOptions,
	generation uint64,
	started time.Time,
	enumerateDuration time.Duration,
	err error,
) {
	if ctx.Err() != nil || !s.isCurrent(streamID, paneID, generation) {
		return
	}
	if s.elevatedList != nil {
		entries, elevErr := s.elevatedList(path, showHidden)
		if elevErr == nil {
			if entries == nil {
				entries = []contracts.FileInfo{}
			}
			sourceCount := len(entries)
			sortStarted := time.Now()
			entries = prepareStreamEntries(entries, options)
			sortDuration := time.Since(sortStarted)
			count, size := sumPreparedEntries(entries)
			if ctx.Err() != nil || !s.isCurrent(streamID, paneID, generation) {
				return
			}
			if !s.rememberPrepared(streamID, generation, preparedDirStream{
				paneID:       paneID,
				path:         path,
				generation:   generation,
				options:      options,
				sourceCount:  sourceCount,
				indexedCount: count,
				totalSize:    size,
				complete:     true,
				runs:         nil,
				entries:      entries,
			}) {
				return
			}
			s.Emit("fs:listStream:done", dirStreamDoneEvent{
				StreamID:    streamID,
				PaneID:      paneID,
				Path:        path,
				EntryCount:  count,
				SourceCount: sourceCount,
				TotalSize:   size,
				DurationMS:  time.Since(started).Milliseconds(),
				EnumerateMS: enumerateDuration.Milliseconds(),
				SortMS:      sortDuration.Milliseconds(),
				Generation:  generation,
				FromElevate: true,
			})
			return
		}
	}

	if !s.isCurrent(streamID, paneID, generation) {
		return
	}
	s.Emit("fs:listStream:error", dirStreamErrorEvent{
		StreamID:   streamID,
		Generation: generation,
		PaneID:     paneID,
		Path:       path,
		Error:      err.Error(),
		Partial:    false,
		EntryCount: 0,
	})
}

func sumPreparedEntries(entries []contracts.FileInfo) (int, int64) {
	var totalSize int64
	for _, entry := range entries {
		totalSize += entry.Size
	}
	return len(entries), totalSize
}

func countRunEntries(runs [][]contracts.FileInfo) int {
	total := 0
	for _, run := range runs {
		total += len(run)
	}
	return total
}

func prepareStreamEntries(entries []contracts.FileInfo, options DirStreamOptions) []contracts.FileInfo {
	needle := strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(options.FilterText))
	if needle != "" {
		filtered := make([]contracts.FileInfo, 0, len(entries))
		for _, entry := range entries {
			if strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(entry.Name), needle) || strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(entry.Path), needle) {
				filtered = append(filtered, entry)
			}
		}
		entries = filtered
	}
	descending := strings.EqualFold(options.SortDirection, "desc")
	sort.SliceStable(entries, func(i, j int) bool {
		comparison := comparePreparedEntries(entries[i], entries[j], options)
		if descending {
			return comparison > 0
		}
		return comparison < 0
	})
	return entries
}

func comparePreparedEntries(left, right contracts.FileInfo, options DirStreamOptions) int {
	if left.Path == "__parent__" || right.Path == "__parent__" {
		if left.Path == right.Path {
			return 0
		}
		if left.Path == "__parent__" {
			return -1
		}
		return 1
	}
	if options.DirectoriesFirst && (left.Type == contracts.FileTypeDirectory) != (right.Type == contracts.FileTypeDirectory) {
		if left.Type == contracts.FileTypeDirectory {
			return -1
		}
		return 1
	}
	switch options.SortField {
	case "size":
		if comparison := compareInt64(left.Size, right.Size); comparison != 0 {
			return comparison
		}
	case "modified":
		if comparison := compareInt64(left.Modified, right.Modified); comparison != 0 {
			return comparison
		}
	case "type":
		if comparison := strings.Compare(string(left.Type), string(right.Type)); comparison != 0 {
			return comparison
		}
	default:
		if comparison := strings.Compare(strings.ToLower(left.Name), strings.ToLower(right.Name)); comparison != 0 {
			return comparison
		}
	}
	return strings.Compare(strings.ToLower(left.Name), strings.ToLower(right.Name))
}

func compareInt64(left, right int64) int {
	if left < right {
		return -1
	}
	if left > right {
		return 1
	}
	return 0
}

type sortedRunCursor struct {
	runIndex   int
	entryIndex int
	entry      contracts.FileInfo
}

type sortedRunHeap struct {
	items   []sortedRunCursor
	options DirStreamOptions
}

func (h sortedRunHeap) Len() int { return len(h.items) }

func (h sortedRunHeap) Less(i, j int) bool {
	comparison := comparePreparedEntries(h.items[i].entry, h.items[j].entry, h.options)
	if strings.EqualFold(h.options.SortDirection, "desc") {
		comparison = -comparison
	}
	if comparison == 0 {
		if h.items[i].runIndex != h.items[j].runIndex {
			return h.items[i].runIndex < h.items[j].runIndex
		}
		return h.items[i].entryIndex < h.items[j].entryIndex
	}
	return comparison < 0
}

func (h sortedRunHeap) Swap(i, j int) { h.items[i], h.items[j] = h.items[j], h.items[i] }

func (h *sortedRunHeap) Push(x interface{}) {
	h.items = append(h.items, x.(sortedRunCursor))
}

func (h *sortedRunHeap) Pop() interface{} {
	last := len(h.items) - 1
	item := h.items[last]
	h.items = h.items[:last]
	return item
}

func mergeSortedRunsWindow(runs [][]contracts.FileInfo, options DirStreamOptions, offset, limit int) []contracts.FileInfo {
	if limit <= 0 || len(runs) == 0 {
		return []contracts.FileInfo{}
	}
	queue := &sortedRunHeap{options: options}
	for runIndex, run := range runs {
		if len(run) == 0 {
			continue
		}
		heap.Push(queue, sortedRunCursor{
			runIndex:   runIndex,
			entryIndex: 0,
			entry:      run[0],
		})
	}
	if queue.Len() == 0 {
		return []contracts.FileInfo{}
	}
	window := make([]contracts.FileInfo, 0, limit)
	needed := offset + limit
	position := 0
	for queue.Len() > 0 && position < needed {
		cursor := heap.Pop(queue).(sortedRunCursor)
		if position >= offset {
			window = append(window, cursor.entry)
		}
		position++
		nextIndex := cursor.entryIndex + 1
		if nextIndex < len(runs[cursor.runIndex]) {
			heap.Push(queue, sortedRunCursor{
				runIndex:   cursor.runIndex,
				entryIndex: nextIndex,
				entry:      runs[cursor.runIndex][nextIndex],
			})
		}
	}
	return window
}

func mergeSortedRunsAll(runs [][]contracts.FileInfo, options DirStreamOptions) []contracts.FileInfo {
	total := countRunEntries(runs)
	if total == 0 {
		return []contracts.FileInfo{}
	}
	return mergeSortedRunsWindow(runs, options, 0, total)
}

func (s *DirStreamService) scanVFSStream(ctx context.Context, path string, showHidden bool, chunkSize int, onBatch func([]contracts.FileInfo, int64)) error {
	if s.vfsListDirPage != nil {
		token := ""
		for {
			if ctx.Err() != nil {
				return context.Canceled
			}
			page, err := s.vfsListDirPage(ctx, path, token, chunkSize)
			if err != nil {
				return err
			}
			batch := make([]contracts.FileInfo, 0, len(page.Entries))
			var size int64
			for _, fi := range page.Entries {
				if ctx.Err() != nil {
					return context.Canceled
				}
				if !showHidden && fi.IsHidden {
					continue
				}
				batch = append(batch, fi)
				size += fi.Size
			}
			if len(batch) > 0 {
				onBatch(batch, size)
			}
			if page.NextToken == "" {
				return nil
			}
			token = page.NextToken
		}
	}
	if s.vfsListDir == nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("vfs listing not available")
	}
	listing, err := s.vfsListDir(path)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	batch := make([]contracts.FileInfo, 0, chunkSize)
	var size int64
	for _, fi := range listing.Entries {
		if ctx.Err() != nil {
			return context.Canceled
		}
		if !showHidden && fi.IsHidden {
			continue
		}
		batch = append(batch, fi)
		size += fi.Size
		if len(batch) >= chunkSize {
			onBatch(batch, size)
			batch = make([]contracts.FileInfo, 0, chunkSize)
			size = 0
		}
	}
	if len(batch) > 0 {
		onBatch(batch, size)
	}
	return nil
}

func (s *DirStreamService) scanDirectoryStream(
	ctx context.Context,
	path string,
	showHidden bool,
	chunkSize int,
	onBatch func(batch []contracts.FileInfo, batchSize int64),
) error {
	nativePath, err := s.resolveNativePath(path)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}

	dir, err := os.Open(nativePath)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer dir.Close()

	for {
		select {
		case <-ctx.Done():
			return context.Canceled
		default:
		}

		infos, readErr := dir.Readdir(chunkSize)
		if len(infos) > 0 {
			batch := make([]contracts.FileInfo, 0, len(infos))
			batchSize := int64(0)
			for _, info := range infos {
				name := info.Name()
				nativeFullPath := internalplatform.ToSlash(filepath.Join(nativePath, name))
				publicFullPath := joinPublicPath(path, name)
				hidden := s.isHidden != nil && s.isHidden(name, nativeFullPath)
				if !showHidden && hidden {
					continue
				}
				fi := s.buildFile(name, nativeFullPath, info, hidden)
				fi.Path = publicFullPath
				batch = append(batch, fi)
				batchSize += fi.Size
			}
			if len(batch) > 0 {
				onBatch(batch, batchSize)
			}
		}
		if readErr != nil {
			if errors.Is(readErr, io.EOF) {
				return nil
			}
			return readErr
		}
	}
}

func (s *DirStreamService) scanSearchStream(
	ctx context.Context,
	path string,
	showHidden bool,
	chunkSize int,
	onBatch func(batch []contracts.FileInfo, batchSize int64),
) error {
	if path == pathref.SearchScheme {
		return nil
	}

	query, ok := pathref.ParseSearch(path)
	if !ok {
		return fmt.Errorf("invalid search alias path")
	}

	basePath := internalplatform.ToSlash(query.BasePath)
	nativeBasePath, err := s.resolveNativePath(query.BasePath)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	batch := make([]contracts.FileInfo, 0, chunkSize)
	batchSize := int64(0)
	flush := func() {
		if len(batch) == 0 {
			return
		}
		out := append([]contracts.FileInfo(nil), batch...)
		onBatch(out, batchSize)
		batch = batch[:0]
		batchSize = 0
	}

	err = filepath.WalkDir(nativeBasePath, func(currentPath string, entry fs.DirEntry, walkErr error) error {
		select {
		case <-ctx.Done():
			return context.Canceled
		default:
		}

		if walkErr != nil {
			if errors.Is(walkErr, fs.ErrPermission) || errors.Is(walkErr, os.ErrPermission) {
				if entry != nil && entry.IsDir() {
					return filepath.SkipDir
				}
				return nil
			}
			return nil
		}

		if currentPath == nativeBasePath {
			return nil
		}

		name := entry.Name()
		fullPath := internalplatform.ToSlash(currentPath)
		publicFullPath := pathref.FromNativePath(fullPath)
		hidden := s.isHidden != nil && s.isHidden(name, fullPath)
		if !showHidden && hidden {
			if entry.IsDir() {
				return filepath.SkipDir
			}
			return nil
		}

		matched, matchErr := pathref.MatchSearchPattern(query.Pattern, name)
		if matchErr != nil {
			return matchErr
		}
		if matched {
			info, infoErr := entry.Info()
			if infoErr == nil {
				fi := s.buildFile(name, fullPath, info, hidden)
				fi.Path = publicFullPath
				fi.SearchBasePath = basePath
				fi.SearchPattern = query.Pattern
				fi.SearchParentPath = pathref.FromNativePath(internalplatform.ToSlash(filepath.Dir(fullPath)))
				batch = append(batch, fi)
				batchSize += fi.Size
				if len(batch) >= chunkSize {
					flush()
				}
			}
		}

		if !query.Recursive && entry.IsDir() {
			return filepath.SkipDir
		}

		return nil
	})
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}

	flush()
	return nil
}

func (s *DirStreamService) resolveNativePath(path string) (string, error) {
	if s.resolvePath != nil {
		return s.resolvePath(path)
	}
	return pathref.ToNativePath(path), nil
}

func joinPublicPath(basePath string, name string) string {
	trimmedBase := strings.TrimRight(internalplatform.ToSlash(basePath), "/")
	if trimmedBase == "" || trimmedBase == "/" {
		return "/" + name
	}
	return trimmedBase + "/" + name
}
`````

`````go
package runtime

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"

	wailsruntime "github.com/wailsapp/wails/v2/pkg/runtime"
)

func BindNativeFileDrop(ctx context.Context, onDrop func(x, y int, paths []string)) {
	wailsruntime.EventsOn(ctx, "wails:file-drop", func(optionalData ...interface{}) {
		fmt.Println("[wails:file-drop] Backend listener fired!")
		x, y, paths, ok := parseNativeFileDrop(optionalData)
		if !ok {
			return
		}

		fmt.Printf("[wails:file-drop] x=%d, y=%d, paths=%v\n", x, y, paths)
		onDrop(x, y, paths)
	})
}

func parseNativeFileDrop(optionalData []interface{}) (int, int, []string, bool) {
	if len(optionalData) == 0 {
		return 0, 0, nil, false
	}

	data, ok := optionalData[0].(map[string]interface{})
	if !ok {
		return 0, 0, nil, false
	}

	fmt.Printf("[wails:file-drop] Native event received: %+v\n", data)

	x := 0
	y := 0
	if xVal, ok := data["x"].(float64); ok {
		x = int(xVal)
	}
	if yVal, ok := data["y"].(float64); ok {
		y = int(yVal)
	}

	paths := make([]string, 0)
	if pathsVal, ok := data["paths"].([]interface{}); ok {
		for _, pathValue := range pathsVal {
			if path, ok := pathValue.(string); ok {
				paths = append(paths, path)
			}
		}
	}

	return x, y, paths, true
}
`````

`````go
package runtime

import (
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"
	"sync"
	"time"

	"github.com/fsnotify/fsnotify"

	"wails-app/internal/pathref"
	internalplatform "wails-app/internal/platform"
)

type paneDirectoryChangedEvent struct {
	PaneID string `json:"paneId"`
	Path   string `json:"path"`
}

type PaneWatchManager struct {
	emitEvent    func(string, interface{})
	resolvePath  func(string) (string, error)
	toPublicPath func(string) string
	mu           sync.Mutex
	watcher      *fsnotify.Watcher
	panePaths    map[string]string
	panePublic   map[string]string
	pathRef      map[string]int
	paneDebounce map[string]*time.Timer
	closed       bool
}

func NewPaneWatchManager(emitEvent func(string, interface{}), resolvePath func(string) (string, error), toPublicPath func(string) string) *PaneWatchManager {
	w, err := fsnotify.NewWatcher()
	if err != nil {
		return &PaneWatchManager{
			emitEvent:    emitEvent,
			resolvePath:  resolvePath,
			toPublicPath: toPublicPath,
			panePaths:    make(map[string]string),
			panePublic:   make(map[string]string),
			pathRef:      make(map[string]int),
			paneDebounce: make(map[string]*time.Timer),
		}
	}

	manager := &PaneWatchManager{
		emitEvent:    emitEvent,
		resolvePath:  resolvePath,
		toPublicPath: toPublicPath,
		watcher:      w,
		panePaths:    make(map[string]string),
		panePublic:   make(map[string]string),
		pathRef:      make(map[string]int),
		paneDebounce: make(map[string]*time.Timer),
	}
	go manager.loop()
	return manager
}

func (m *PaneWatchManager) Close() {
	m.mu.Lock()
	if m.closed {
		m.mu.Unlock()
		return
	}
	m.closed = true
	for paneID, timer := range m.paneDebounce {
		timer.Stop()
		delete(m.paneDebounce, paneID)
	}
	w := m.watcher
	m.watcher = nil
	m.mu.Unlock()

	if w != nil {
		_ = w.Close()
	}
}

func (m *PaneWatchManager) SetPaneDirectory(paneID, path string) error {
	watchPath, err := m.normalizeWatchPath(path)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	publicPath := m.toEventPath(watchPath)

	m.mu.Lock()
	defer m.mu.Unlock()

	if m.closed {
		return nil
	}

	prev := m.panePaths[paneID]
	if prev == watchPath && m.panePublic[paneID] == publicPath {
		return nil
	}
	if prev != "" {
		m.removeWatchLocked(prev)
	}
	if watchPath == "" {
		delete(m.panePaths, paneID)
		delete(m.panePublic, paneID)
		return nil
	}

	m.panePaths[paneID] = watchPath
	m.panePublic[paneID] = publicPath
	return m.addWatchLocked(watchPath)
}

func (m *PaneWatchManager) loop() {
	for {
		m.mu.Lock()
		w := m.watcher
		closed := m.closed || w == nil
		m.mu.Unlock()
		if closed {
			return
		}

		select {
		case evt, ok := <-w.Events:
			if !ok {
				return
			}
			if evt.Op&(fsnotify.Create|fsnotify.Write|fsnotify.Remove|fsnotify.Rename|fsnotify.Chmod) == 0 {
				continue
			}
			affectedDir := normalizeNativeWatchPath(filepath.Dir(evt.Name))
			if affectedDir == "" {
				continue
			}
			m.scheduleForAffectedDir(affectedDir)
		case _, ok := <-w.Errors:
			if !ok {
				return
			}
		}
	}
}

func (m *PaneWatchManager) scheduleForAffectedDir(dir string) {
	m.mu.Lock()
	defer m.mu.Unlock()

	if m.closed {
		return
	}

	for paneID, panePath := range m.panePaths {
		if panePath != dir {
			continue
		}
		if existing := m.paneDebounce[paneID]; existing != nil {
			existing.Stop()
		}
		id := paneID
		path := m.panePublic[paneID]
		m.paneDebounce[paneID] = time.AfterFunc(200*time.Millisecond, func() {
			if m.emitEvent != nil {
				m.emitEvent("fs:directoryChanged", paneDirectoryChangedEvent{
					PaneID: id,
					Path:   path,
				})
			}
		})
	}
}

func (m *PaneWatchManager) addWatchLocked(path string) error {
	if m.pathRef[path] > 0 {
		m.pathRef[path]++
		return nil
	}
	if m.watcher != nil {
		if err := m.watcher.Add(path); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}
	m.pathRef[path] = 1
	return nil
}

func (m *PaneWatchManager) removeWatchLocked(path string) {
	count := m.pathRef[path]
	if count <= 1 {
		delete(m.pathRef, path)
		if m.watcher != nil {
			_ = m.watcher.Remove(path)
		}
		return
	}
	m.pathRef[path] = count - 1
}

func (m *PaneWatchManager) normalizeWatchPath(path string) (string, error) {
	trimmed := strings.TrimSpace(path)
	if trimmed == "" {
		return "", nil
	}
	if pathref.IsRegistry(trimmed) || pathref.IsAlias(trimmed) {
		return "", nil
	}
	if m.resolvePath != nil {
		resolved, err := m.resolvePath(trimmed)
		if err != nil {
			return "", err
		}
		trimmed = resolved
	}
	return normalizeNativeWatchPath(trimmed), nil
}

func (m *PaneWatchManager) toEventPath(path string) string {
	trimmed := strings.TrimSpace(path)
	if trimmed == "" {
		return ""
	}
	if m.toPublicPath != nil {
		if publicPath := strings.TrimSpace(m.toPublicPath(trimmed)); publicPath != "" {
			return pathref.Normalize(publicPath)
		}
	}
	return normalizeNativeWatchPath(trimmed)
}

func normalizeNativeWatchPath(path string) string {
	trimmed := strings.TrimSpace(path)
	if trimmed == "" {
		return ""
	}
	if pathref.IsRegistry(trimmed) || pathref.IsAlias(trimmed) {
		return ""
	}
	return internalplatform.ToSlash(filepath.Clean(trimmed))
}
`````

`````go
package runtime

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/base64"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"mime"
	"path/filepath"

	internalarchive "wails-app/internal/archive"
	"wails-app/internal/contentprobe"
	contracts "wails-app/internal/contracts"
	"wails-app/internal/pathref"
	vfslib "wails-app/vfs"
	"wails-app/vfs/mount"
	"wails-app/vfs/osfs"
	vfsregistry "wails-app/vfs/registry"

	_ "wails-app/vfs/archive/7z"
	_ "wails-app/vfs/archive/rar"
	_ "wails-app/vfs/archive/tar"
	_ "wails-app/vfs/archive/zip"
)

func InitVFS() (*vfslib.Unified, error) {
	manager := mount.NewManager(osfs.New("/"))
	vfs := vfslib.NewUnified(manager)
	if err := mountBuiltInFilesystems(vfs); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return vfs, nil
}

func VFSListDir(ctx context.Context, vfs *vfslib.Unified, path string) (*contracts.DirectoryListing, error) {
	publicPath := pathref.Normalize(path)
	internalPath := pathref.ToVFS(path)
	entries, err := vfs.ReadDir(ctx, internalPath)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	files := make([]contracts.FileInfo, 0, len(entries))
	var total int64
	for _, entry := range entries {
		file := convertVFSInfo(entry)
		file.Path = pathref.FromVFSEntry(publicPath, file.Path)
		if len(file.NestedChain) > 0 {
			for index, nested := range file.NestedChain {
				file.NestedChain[index] = pathref.FromVFSEntry(publicPath, nested)
			}
		}
		files = append(files, file)
		total += file.Size
	}

	return &contracts.DirectoryListing{
		Path:      publicPath,
		Entries:   files,
		TotalSize: total,
	}, nil
}

func VFSListDirPage(ctx context.Context, vfs *vfslib.Unified, path, token string, limit int) (*contracts.DirectoryPage, error) {
	publicPath := pathref.Normalize(path)
	page, err := vfs.ReadDirPage(ctx, pathref.ToVFS(path), token, limit)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	out := make([]contracts.FileInfo, 0, len(page.Entries))
	for _, entry := range page.Entries {
		file := convertVFSInfo(entry)
		file.Path = pathref.FromVFSEntry(publicPath, file.Path)
		out = append(out, file)
	}
	return &contracts.DirectoryPage{Path: publicPath, Entries: out, NextToken: page.NextToken, TotalCount: page.TotalCount, HasTotal: page.HasTotal}, nil
}

func VFSOpenArchive(ctx context.Context, vfs *vfslib.Unified, path string, nested []string) (contracts.ArchiveListing, error) {
	mountPoint, err := mountArchive(ctx, vfs, path, nested)
	if err != nil {
		return contracts.ArchiveListing{}, err
	}

	entries, err := vfs.ReadDir(ctx, mountPoint)
	if err != nil {
		return contracts.ArchiveListing{}, err
	}

	files := make([]contracts.FileInfo, 0, len(entries))
	for _, entry := range entries {
		files = append(files, convertVFSInfoWithChain(entry, nested))
	}

	return contracts.ArchiveListing{
		ArchivePath: path,
		InnerPath:   mountPoint,
		NestedChain: nested,
		Entries:     files,
	}, nil
}

func VFSReadFileRange(ctx context.Context, vfs *vfslib.Unified, path string, offset int64, length int) (*contracts.FileContent, error) {
	publicPath := pathref.Normalize(path)
	internalPath := pathref.ToVFS(path)
	file, err := vfs.Open(ctx, internalPath)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer file.Close()

	info, err := file.Stat()
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	fileSize := info.Size()

	if offset < 0 {
		offset = 0
	}
	if offset > fileSize {
		offset = fileSize
	}
	available := fileSize - offset
	if int64(length) > available {
		length = int(available)
	}
	if length <= 0 {
		return &contracts.FileContent{
			Path:     publicPath,
			Content:  "",
			Encoding: "base64",
			Size:     fileSize,
		}, nil
	}

	if _, seekErr := file.Seek(offset, io.SeekStart); seekErr != nil {
		return nil, seekErr
	}

	buf := make([]byte, length)
	n, err := io.ReadFull(file, buf)
	if err != nil && err != io.ErrUnexpectedEOF {
		return nil, err
	}

	return &contracts.FileContent{
		Path:     publicPath,
		Content:  base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString(buf[:n]),
		Encoding: "base64",
		Size:     fileSize,
	}, nil
}

func VFSReadFile(ctx context.Context, vfs *vfslib.Unified, path string, encoding string) (*contracts.FileContent, error) {
	publicPath := pathref.Normalize(path)
	internalPath := pathref.ToVFS(path)
	file, err := vfs.Open(ctx, internalPath)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer file.Close()

	data, err := io.ReadAll(file)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	probe := contentprobe.ProbeBytes(data)
	if encoding == "" {
		encoding = "utf8"
		if probe.IsText && probe.Encoding != "" {
			encoding = probe.Encoding
		}
	}

	content, err := contentprobe.Decode(data, encoding)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	return &contracts.FileContent{
		Path:     publicPath,
		Content:  content,
		Encoding: encoding,
		Size:     int64(len(data)),
	}, nil
}

func VFSGetFileInfo(ctx context.Context, vfs *vfslib.Unified, path string) (*contracts.FileInfo, error) {
	publicPath := pathref.Normalize(path)
	internalPath := pathref.ToVFS(path)
	info, err := vfs.Stat(ctx, internalPath)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	fi := convertVFSInfo(info)
	fi.Path = publicPath
	return &fi, nil
}

func VFSProbeFile(ctx context.Context, vfs *vfslib.Unified, path string) (*contracts.FileProbe, error) {
	internalPath := pathref.ToVFS(path)
	file, err := vfs.Open(ctx, internalPath)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer file.Close()

	_, probe, err := contentprobe.ProbeReader(file)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return &contracts.FileProbe{
		MimeType:  probe.MimeType,
		Encoding:  probe.Encoding,
		IsText:    probe.IsText,
		IsArchive: probe.IsArchive,
	}, nil
}

func VFSWriteFile(ctx context.Context, vfs *vfslib.Unified, path string, content string, encoding string) (*contracts.OperationResult, error) {
	publicPath := pathref.Normalize(path)
	internalPath := pathref.ToVFS(path)

	var data []byte
	var err error
	if encoding == "base64" {
		data, err = base64.StdEncoding.DecodeString(content)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
	} else {
		data = []byte(content)
	}

	file, err := vfs.Create(ctx, internalPath)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer file.Close()

	if _, err := file.Write(data); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if err := file.Sync(); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	return &contracts.OperationResult{
		Success:       true,
		Message:       "File written successfully",
		AffectedPaths: []string{publicPath},
	}, nil
}

func VFSWriteRegistryValue(
	ctx context.Context,
	vfs *vfslib.Unified,
	path string,
	valueType string,
	data string,
) (*contracts.OperationResult, error) {
	publicPath := pathref.Normalize(path)
	internalPath := pathref.ToVFS(path)
	if err := vfs.WriteRegistryValue(ctx, internalPath, valueType, data); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return &contracts.OperationResult{
		Success:       true,
		Message:       "Registry value written successfully",
		AffectedPaths: []string{publicPath},
	}, nil
}

func VFSMkdir(ctx context.Context, vfs *vfslib.Unified, path string) (*contracts.OperationResult, error) {
	publicPath := pathref.Normalize(path)
	internalPath := pathref.ToVFS(path)
	if err := vfs.Mkdir(ctx, internalPath, 0755); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	return &contracts.OperationResult{
		Success:       true,
		Message:       "Directory created successfully",
		AffectedPaths: []string{publicPath},
	}, nil
}

func VFSRemove(ctx context.Context, vfs *vfslib.Unified, path string) (*contracts.OperationResult, error) {
	publicPath := pathref.Normalize(path)
	internalPath := pathref.ToVFS(path)
	if err := vfs.Remove(ctx, internalPath); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	return &contracts.OperationResult{
		Success:       true,
		Message:       "Deleted successfully",
		AffectedPaths: []string{publicPath},
	}, nil
}

func VFSMountArchive(ctx context.Context, vfs *vfslib.Unified, path string) (string, error) {
	return mountArchive(ctx, vfs, path, nil)
}

func VFSUnmount(ctx context.Context, vfs *vfslib.Unified, mountPoint string) error {
	return vfs.Unmount(mountPoint)
}

func mountArchive(ctx context.Context, vfs *vfslib.Unified, osPath string, nested []string) (string, error) {
	osPath = pathref.ToNativePath(osPath)
	arch, err := internalarchive.ResolveChain(ctx, osPath, nested, "")
	if err != nil {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("vfs: open archive %q (chain %v): %w", osPath, nested, err)
	}

	mountPoint := archiveMountPoint(osPath, nested)
	if _, err := vfs.Mount(mountPoint, arch, true, filepath.Base(osPath), vfslib.VolumeArchive); err != nil {
		_ = arch.Close()
		return "", fmt.Errorf("vfs: mount %q -> %q: %w", osPath, mountPoint, err)
	}
	return mountPoint, nil
}

func archiveMountPoint(osPath string, nested []string) string {
	base := filepath.ToSlash(filepath.Clean("/archives/" + osPath))
	for _, nestedPath := range nested {
		base += "/" + filepath.ToSlash(nestedPath)
	}
	return base
}

func convertVFSInfo(entry vfslib.FileInfo) contracts.FileInfo {
	return convertVFSInfoWithChain(entry, nil)
}

func convertVFSInfoWithChain(entry vfslib.FileInfo, parentChain []string) contracts.FileInfo {
	fileType := contracts.FileTypeFile
	switch {
	case entry.IsDir():
		fileType = contracts.FileTypeDirectory
	case entry.IsArchive():
		fileType = contracts.FileTypeArchive
	case entry.IsSymlink():
		fileType = contracts.FileTypeSymlink
	}

	var nestedChain []string
	if fileType == contracts.FileTypeArchive {
		nestedChain = append(append([]string{}, parentChain...), entry.Path())
	}

	file := contracts.FileInfo{
		Name:        entry.Name(),
		Path:        entry.Path(),
		Type:        fileType,
		MimeType:    mime.TypeByExtension(filepath.Ext(entry.Name())),
		Size:        entry.Size(),
		Modified:    entry.ModTime().Unix(),
		IsHidden:    entry.IsHidden(),
		IsSymlink:   entry.IsSymlink(),
		IsNested:    fileType == contracts.FileTypeArchive,
		NestedChain: nestedChain,
	}

	vfsregistry.ApplyFileInfoMetadata(&file, entry)

	return file
}
`````

## File: manager/internal/utility/clipboard_windows.go
`````go
//go:build windows

package utility

import (
	"fmt"
	"syscall"
	"unsafe"
)

var (
	user32           = syscall.NewLazyDLL("user32.dll")
	shell32          = syscall.NewLazyDLL("shell32.dll")
	openClipboard    = user32.NewProc("OpenClipboard")
	closeClipboard   = user32.NewProc("CloseClipboard")
	getClipboardData = user32.NewProc("GetClipboardData")
	dragQueryFile    = shell32.NewProc("DragQueryFileW")
)

func GetFilePaths() ([]string, error) {
	ret, _, err := openClipboard.Call()
	if ret == 0 {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to open clipboard: %w", err)
	}
	defer closeClipboard.Call()

	const cfHdrop = 15
	ret, _, err = getClipboardData.Call(cfHdrop)
	hDrop := uintptr(ret)
	if hDrop == 0 {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("no clipboard data in CF_HDROP format")
	}

	ret, _, _ = dragQueryFile.Call(hDrop, ^uintptr(0), 0, 0)
	fileCount := ret
	if fileCount == 0 {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("no files in clipboard drag data")
	}

	paths := make([]string, 0, fileCount)
	for index := uintptr(0); index < fileCount; index++ {
		ret, _, _ = dragQueryFile.Call(hDrop, index, 0, 0)
		bufferSize := ret
		if bufferSize == 0 {
			continue
		}

		pathBuf := make([]uint16, bufferSize+1)
		dragQueryFile.Call(hDrop, index, uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(&pathBuf[0])), bufferSize+1)

		path := syscall.UTF16ToString(pathBuf)
		if path != "" {
			paths = append(paths, path)
		}
	}

	if len(paths) == 0 {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("could not extract file paths from clipboard")
	}
	return paths, nil
}

func ReadText() (string, error) {
	ret, _, err := openClipboard.Call()
	if ret == 0 {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("failed to open clipboard: %w", err)
	}
	defer closeClipboard.Call()

	const cfUnicodeText = 13
	ret, _, err = getClipboardData.Call(cfUnicodeText)
	if ret == 0 {
		ret, _, _ = getClipboardData.Call(1)
		if ret == 0 {
			return "", fmt.Errorf("no text in clipboard")
		}
	}
	return "[clipboard text data available]", nil
}
`````

## File: manager/internal/utility/executables.go
`````go
package utility

import (
	"os"
	"os/exec"
	"path/filepath"
	"runtime"
	"strings"
	"sync"
)

var (
	bundledToolsDirsOnce sync.Once
	bundledToolsDirs     []string
)

// ResolveExecutable returns an executable from the bundled tools directory if
// present, then falls back to PATH or absolute candidates.
func ResolveExecutable(candidates ...string) (string, bool) {
	for _, candidate := range candidates {
		if resolved, ok := resolveBundledCandidate(candidate); ok {
			return resolved, true
		}
	}

	for _, candidate := range candidates {
		if candidate == "" {
			continue
		}
		if resolved, err := exec.LookPath(candidate); err == nil {
			return resolved, true
		}
		if filepath.IsAbs(candidate) {
			if info, err := os.Stat(candidate); err == nil && !info.IsDir() {
				return candidate, true
			}
		}
	}

	return "", false
}

func resolveBundledCandidate(candidate string) (string, bool) {
	trimmed := strings.TrimSpace(candidate)
	if trimmed == "" {
		return "", false
	}

	base := filepath.Base(trimmed)
	names := uniqueExecutableNames(base)
	for _, root := range bundledToolsRoots() {
		for _, name := range names {
			if resolved, ok := findExecutableUnderRoot(root, name); ok {
				return resolved, true
			}
		}
	}

	return "", false
}

func uniqueExecutableNames(name string) []string {
	if name == "" {
		return nil
	}

	seen := map[string]struct{}{}
	result := []string{}
	appendName := func(value string) {
		value = strings.TrimSpace(value)
		if value == "" {
			return
		}
		key := strings.ToLower(value)
		if _, ok := seen[key]; ok {
			return
		}
		seen[key] = struct{}{}
		result = append(result, value)
	}

	appendName(name)
	if runtime.GOOS == "windows" && filepath.Ext(name) == "" {
		appendName(name + ".exe")
	}
	return result
}

func bundledToolsRoots() []string {
	bundledToolsDirsOnce.Do(func() {
		seen := map[string]struct{}{}
		appendRoot := func(root string) {
			root = strings.TrimSpace(root)
			if root == "" {
				return
			}
			abs, err := filepath.Abs(root)
			if err != nil {
				return
			}
			info, err := os.Stat(abs)
			if err != nil || !info.IsDir() {
				return
			}
			key := strings.ToLower(abs)
			if _, ok := seen[key]; ok {
				return
			}
			seen[key] = struct{}{}
			bundledToolsDirs = append(bundledToolsDirs, abs)
		}

		for _, envName := range []string{"WAILS_TOOLS_DIR", "WAILS_EXTERNAL_TOOLS_DIR"} {
			appendRoot(os.Getenv(envName))
		}

		if exePath, err := os.Executable(); err == nil {
			exeDir := filepath.Dir(exePath)
			appendRoot(filepath.Join(exeDir, "tools"))
			appendRoot(filepath.Join(exeDir, "portable-tools"))
			appendRoot(filepath.Join(exeDir, "..", "tools"))
		}

		if cwd, err := os.Getwd(); err == nil {
			appendRoot(filepath.Join(cwd, "tools"))
			appendRoot(filepath.Join(cwd, "portable-tools"))
		}
	})

	return bundledToolsDirs
}

func findExecutableUnderRoot(root string, fileName string) (string, bool) {
	direct := filepath.Join(root, fileName)
	if info, err := os.Stat(direct); err == nil && !info.IsDir() {
		return direct, true
	}

	entries, err := os.ReadDir(root)
	if err != nil {
		return "", false
	}
	for _, entry := range entries {
		if !entry.IsDir() {
			continue
		}
		candidate := filepath.Join(root, entry.Name(), fileName)
		if info, err := os.Stat(candidate); err == nil && !info.IsDir() {
			return candidate, true
		}
	}

	return "", false
}
`````

`````go
package utility

import (
	"fmt"
	"os"

	"wails-app/internal/pathref"
	internalplatform "wails-app/internal/platform"
	vfslib "wails-app/vfs"
)

type memoryPathResolver interface {
	ResolvePublicPath(path string) (string, bool, error)
	ToPublicPath(path string) string
}

type ServiceConfig struct {
	EmitEvent func(string, interface{})
}

type Service struct {
	emitEvent func(string, interface{})
	vfs       *vfslib.Unified
}

type ResolvedLink struct {
	Target string `json:"target"`
	IsDir  bool   `json:"isDir"`
}

func NewService(config ServiceConfig) *Service {
	return &Service{
		emitEvent: config.EmitEvent,
	}
}

func (s *Service) SetVFS(v *vfslib.Unified) {
	s.vfs = v
}

func (s *Service) resolvePublicPath(path string) (string, error) {
	normalized := pathref.Normalize(path)
	if pathref.IsWeb(normalized) {
		return normalized, nil
	}
	if resolved, ok := pathref.ResolveLocalCloudPath(normalized); ok {
		return resolved, nil
	}
	if s.vfs != nil {
		resolvedPath, err := s.vfs.ResolvePublicPath(normalized)
		if err != nil {
			return "", err
		}
		if resolvedPath == "" {
			return "", fmt.Errorf("path %q is virtual-only and not available to the OS", normalized)
		}
		return resolvedPath, nil
	}
	nativePath := pathref.ToNativePath(normalized)
	return nativePath, nil
}

func (s *Service) toPublicPath(path string) string {
	return pathref.FromNativePath(path)
}

func (s *Service) OpenFile(path string) error {
	normalized := pathref.Normalize(path)
	if pathref.IsWeb(normalized) {
		return internalplatform.OpenFileWithDefaultApp(normalized)
	}
	resolvedPath, err := s.resolvePublicPath(path)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return internalplatform.OpenFileWithDefaultApp(resolvedPath)
}

func (s *Service) ResolveLink(path string) (*ResolvedLink, error) {
	normalized := pathref.Normalize(path)
	resolvedPath, err := s.resolvePublicPath(path)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	target, isDir, err := internalplatform.ResolveLinkPath(resolvedPath)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	publicTarget := s.toPublicPath(target)
	if pathref.IsLocalCloud(normalized) {
		if mapped, ok := pathref.LocalCloudAliasFromNativePath(target); ok {
			publicTarget = mapped
		}
	}
	return &ResolvedLink{Target: publicTarget, IsDir: isDir}, nil
}

func (s *Service) HandleFileDrop(x int, y int, paths []string) error {
	fmt.Printf("[HandleFileDrop] Called with x=%d, y=%d, %d paths: %v\n", x, y, len(paths), paths)

	if len(paths) == 0 {
		return fmt.Errorf("no paths provided")
	}

	providedPaths := paths
	isRelativeOnly := false
	for _, path := range paths {
		if !isAbsolutePath(path) {
			isRelativeOnly = true
			fmt.Printf("[HandleFileDrop] Path is relative: %s\n", path)
			break
		}
	}

	if isRelativeOnly {
		fmt.Println("[HandleFileDrop] Detected filename-only paths, attempting clipboard fallback...")
		clipboardPaths, err := GetFilePaths()
		if err == nil && len(clipboardPaths) > 0 {
			fmt.Printf("[HandleFileDrop] Got %d paths from clipboard: %v\n", len(clipboardPaths), clipboardPaths)
			providedPaths = clipboardPaths
		} else {
			fmt.Println("[HandleFileDrop] Clipboard fallback failed:", err)
			fmt.Printf("[HandleFileDrop] Continuing with provided %d paths\n", len(paths))
		}
	}

	validPaths := make([]string, 0, len(providedPaths))
	for _, path := range providedPaths {
		if path == "" {
			continue
		}
		fmt.Printf("[HandleFileDrop] Checking path: %s\n", path)
		if stat, err := os.Stat(path); err == nil {
			validPaths = append(validPaths, path)
			fmt.Printf("[HandleFileDrop] Path exists: %s (isDir=%v)\n", path, stat.IsDir())
		} else {
			fmt.Printf("[HandleFileDrop] Path does not exist: %s (%v)\n", path, err)
		}
	}

	if len(validPaths) == 0 {
		fmt.Println("[HandleFileDrop] No valid file paths after validation")
		return fmt.Errorf("no valid file paths after validation")
	}

	fmt.Printf("[HandleFileDrop] Emitting file:drop event with %d valid files\n", len(validPaths))
	if s.emitEvent != nil {
		s.emitEvent("file:drop", map[string]interface{}{
			"x":     x,
			"y":     y,
			"paths": validPaths,
		})
	}
	return nil
}

func isAbsolutePath(path string) bool {
	if len(path) == 0 {
		return false
	}
	if len(path) > 1 && path[1] == ':' {
		return true
	}
	if len(path) > 1 && path[0] == '\\' && path[1] == '\\' {
		return true
	}
	return path[0] == '/'
}
`````

`````go
package webresourcecache

import (
	"net/url"
	"sort"
	"strings"
	"sync"
)

type Resource struct {
	URL           string
	Size          int64
	InitiatorType string
	MimeType      string
}

var (
	mu            sync.RWMutex
	pageResources = make(map[string]map[string]Resource)
)

func Store(pageURL string, resources []Resource) bool {
	normalizedPage := normalizeURL(pageURL)
	if normalizedPage == "" {
		return false
	}

	mu.RLock()
	existing := cloneResources(pageResources[normalizedPage])
	mu.RUnlock()

	next := make(map[string]Resource)
	for _, resource := range resources {
		normalizedResource := normalizeURL(resource.URL)
		if normalizedResource == "" || normalizedResource == normalizedPage {
			continue
		}
		current := existing[normalizedResource]
		size := resource.Size
		if size <= 0 {
			size = current.Size
		}
		mimeType := strings.TrimSpace(resource.MimeType)
		if mimeType == "" {
			mimeType = current.MimeType
		}
		next[normalizedResource] = Resource{
			URL:           normalizedResource,
			Size:          size,
			InitiatorType: strings.TrimSpace(resource.InitiatorType),
			MimeType:      mimeType,
		}
	}

	mu.Lock()
	defer mu.Unlock()
	if resourcesEqual(pageResources[normalizedPage], next) {
		return false
	}
	pageResources[normalizedPage] = next
	return true
}

func Merge(pageURL string, resource Resource) bool {
	normalizedPage := normalizeURL(pageURL)
	normalizedResource := normalizeURL(resource.URL)
	if normalizedPage == "" || normalizedResource == "" || normalizedPage == normalizedResource {
		return false
	}

	mu.Lock()
	defer mu.Unlock()
	if pageResources[normalizedPage] == nil {
		pageResources[normalizedPage] = make(map[string]Resource)
	}
	current := pageResources[normalizedPage][normalizedResource]
	next := current
	next.URL = normalizedResource
	if resource.Size > 0 {
		next.Size = resource.Size
	}
	if strings.TrimSpace(resource.InitiatorType) != "" {
		next.InitiatorType = strings.TrimSpace(resource.InitiatorType)
	}
	if strings.TrimSpace(resource.MimeType) != "" {
		next.MimeType = strings.TrimSpace(resource.MimeType)
	}
	if current == next {
		return false
	}
	pageResources[normalizedPage][normalizedResource] = next
	return true
}

func Clear(pageURL string) {
	normalizedPage := normalizeURL(pageURL)
	if normalizedPage == "" {
		return
	}
	mu.Lock()
	delete(pageResources, normalizedPage)
	mu.Unlock()
}

func Load(pageURL string) []Resource {
	normalizedPage := normalizeURL(pageURL)
	if normalizedPage == "" {
		return nil
	}

	mu.RLock()
	stored := pageResources[normalizedPage]
	mu.RUnlock()
	if len(stored) == 0 {
		return nil
	}

	keys := make([]string, 0, len(stored))
	for key := range stored {
		keys = append(keys, key)
	}
	sort.Strings(keys)

	result := make([]Resource, 0, len(keys))
	for _, key := range keys {
		result = append(result, stored[key])
	}
	return result
}

func cloneResources(input map[string]Resource) map[string]Resource {
	if len(input) == 0 {
		return map[string]Resource{}
	}
	result := make(map[string]Resource, len(input))
	for key, value := range input {
		result[key] = value
	}
	return result
}

func normalizeURL(raw string) string {
	trimmed := strings.TrimSpace(raw)
	if trimmed == "" {
		return ""
	}
	parsed, err := url.Parse(trimmed)
	if err != nil {
		return ""
	}
	scheme := strings.ToLower(parsed.Scheme)
	if scheme != "http" && scheme != "https" {
		return ""
	}
	parsed.Scheme = scheme
	parsed.Host = strings.ToLower(parsed.Host)
	parsed.Fragment = ""
	parsed.Path = strings.ReplaceAll(parsed.Path, "\\", "/")
	if parsed.Path == "/" {
		parsed.Path = ""
	} else {
		parsed.Path = strings.TrimRight(parsed.Path, "/")
	}
	parsed.RawPath = ""
	return parsed.String()
}

func resourcesEqual(left, right map[string]Resource) bool {
	if len(left) != len(right) {
		return false
	}
	for key, leftValue := range left {
		rightValue, ok := right[key]
		if !ok {
			return false
		}
		if leftValue.Size != rightValue.Size || leftValue.InitiatorType != rightValue.InitiatorType || leftValue.MimeType != rightValue.MimeType {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}
`````

`````go
package work

import (
	"context"
	"sync"
	"testing"
	"time"
)

func TestSchedulerDeduplicatesActiveKeys(t *testing.T) {
	scheduler := NewScheduler(1)
	defer scheduler.Close()

	var mu sync.Mutex
	calls := 0

	task := Task{
		Key:      "hash:/a",
		Priority: PriorityBackground,
		Kind:     "hashing",
		Run: func(ctx context.Context, reporter Reporter) error {
			mu.Lock()
			calls++
			mu.Unlock()
			time.Sleep(5 * time.Millisecond)
			return nil
		},
	}

	first := scheduler.Submit(context.Background(), task)
	second := scheduler.Submit(context.Background(), task)

	if first.task != second.task {
		t.Fatal("expected active task deduplication")
	}
	if err := first.Err(); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}

	mu.Lock()
	defer mu.Unlock()
	if calls != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("calls = %d, want 1", calls)
	}
}

func TestSchedulerReportsProgress(t *testing.T) {
	scheduler := NewScheduler(1)
	defer scheduler.Close()

	handle := scheduler.Submit(context.Background(), Task{
		Priority: PriorityInteractive,
		Kind:     "search",
		Run: func(ctx context.Context, reporter Reporter) error {
			reporter.Report(Progress{Completed: 2, Total: 10, Units: "files"})
			return nil
		},
	})
	if err := handle.Err(); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	snapshot := handle.Snapshot()
	if snapshot.Progress.Completed != 2 || snapshot.Progress.Total != 10 {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected progress: %+v", snapshot.Progress)
	}
}

func TestSchedulerCancellationUsesContext(t *testing.T) {
	scheduler := NewScheduler(1)
	defer scheduler.Close()

	ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
	handle := scheduler.Submit(ctx, Task{
		Priority: PriorityBackground,
		Kind:     "directory",
		Run: func(ctx context.Context, reporter Reporter) error {
			<-ctx.Done()
			return ctx.Err()
		},
	})

	cancel()
	if err := handle.Err(); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("expected cancellation error")
	}
	if handle.Snapshot().State != "cancelled" {
		t.Fatalf("state = %q, want cancelled", handle.Snapshot().State)
	}
}
`````

## File: manager/internal/work/scheduler.go
`````go
package work

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"sort"
	"sync"
	"sync/atomic"
	"time"
)

type Priority int

const (
	PriorityVisible Priority = iota
	PriorityInteractive
	PriorityPrefetch
	PriorityBackground
	PriorityIdle
)

type Progress struct {
	Completed int64
	Total     int64
	Message   string
	Units     string
}

type Reporter interface {
	Report(Progress)
}

type reporterFunc func(Progress)

func (f reporterFunc) Report(progress Progress) { f(progress) }

type Task struct {
	Key      string
	Priority Priority
	Kind     string
	Run      func(context.Context, Reporter) error
}

type Snapshot struct {
	ID         uint64
	Key        string
	Priority   Priority
	Kind       string
	State      string
	CreatedAt  time.Time
	StartedAt  time.Time
	FinishedAt time.Time
	Progress   Progress
}

type Handle struct {
	task *scheduledTask
}

func (h *Handle) Done() <-chan struct{} { return h.task.done }

func (h *Handle) Err() error {
	<-h.task.done
	h.task.mu.RLock()
	defer h.task.mu.RUnlock()
	return h.task.err
}

func (h *Handle) Cancel() {
	h.task.cancel()
}

func (h *Handle) Snapshot() Snapshot {
	return h.task.snapshot()
}

type scheduledTask struct {
	mu       sync.RWMutex
	id       uint64
	task     Task
	sequence uint64
	ctx      context.Context
	cancel   context.CancelFunc
	done     chan struct{}

	state      string
	createdAt  time.Time
	startedAt  time.Time
	finishedAt time.Time
	progress   Progress
	err        error
	finished   bool
}

func (t *scheduledTask) snapshot() Snapshot {
	t.mu.RLock()
	defer t.mu.RUnlock()
	return Snapshot{
		ID:         t.id,
		Key:        t.task.Key,
		Priority:   t.task.Priority,
		Kind:       t.task.Kind,
		State:      t.state,
		CreatedAt:  t.createdAt,
		StartedAt:  t.startedAt,
		FinishedAt: t.finishedAt,
		Progress:   t.progress,
	}
}

type Scheduler struct {
	mu       sync.Mutex
	cond     *sync.Cond
	queue    []*scheduledTask
	keyed    map[string]*scheduledTask
	closed   bool
	nextID   atomic.Uint64
	sequence atomic.Uint64

	listenersMu sync.RWMutex
	listeners   map[uint64]func(Snapshot)
	nextSubID   atomic.Uint64
}

func NewScheduler(concurrency int) *Scheduler {
	if concurrency <= 0 {
		concurrency = 1
	}

	s := &Scheduler{
		keyed:     make(map[string]*scheduledTask),
		listeners: make(map[uint64]func(Snapshot)),
	}
	s.cond = sync.NewCond(&s.mu)

	for index := 0; index < concurrency; index++ {
		go s.worker()
	}
	return s
}

var Default = NewScheduler(8)

func (s *Scheduler) Submit(parent context.Context, task Task) *Handle {
	if parent == nil {
		parent = context.Background()
	}
	if task.Run == nil {
		panic("work: nil task Run")
	}
	if task.Kind == "" {
		task.Kind = "default"
	}

	s.mu.Lock()
	if task.Key != "" {
		if existing := s.keyed[task.Key]; existing != nil {
			existing.mu.RLock()
			active := !existing.finished
			existing.mu.RUnlock()
			if active {
				s.mu.Unlock()
				return &Handle{task: existing}
			}
		}
	}

	ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(parent)
	item := &scheduledTask{
		id:        s.nextID.Add(1),
		task:      task,
		sequence:  s.sequence.Add(1),
		ctx:       ctx,
		cancel:    cancel,
		done:      make(chan struct{}),
		state:     "queued",
		createdAt: time.Now(),
	}
	s.queue = append(s.queue, item)
	if task.Key != "" {
		s.keyed[task.Key] = item
	}
	s.sortQueueLocked()
	s.mu.Unlock()

	s.publish(item.snapshot())
	s.cond.Signal()
	return &Handle{task: item}
}

func (s *Scheduler) Subscribe(listener func(Snapshot)) func() {
	if listener == nil {
		return func() {}
	}
	id := s.nextSubID.Add(1)
	s.listenersMu.Lock()
	s.listeners[id] = listener
	s.listenersMu.Unlock()

	return func() {
		s.listenersMu.Lock()
		delete(s.listeners, id)
		s.listenersMu.Unlock()
	}
}

func (s *Scheduler) Close() {
	s.mu.Lock()
	if s.closed {
		s.mu.Unlock()
		return
	}
	s.closed = true
	queued := append([]*scheduledTask(nil), s.queue...)
	s.queue = nil
	s.mu.Unlock()

	for _, task := range queued {
		task.cancel()
		s.finish(task, context.Canceled, "cancelled")
	}
	s.cond.Broadcast()
}

func (s *Scheduler) worker() {
	for {
		s.mu.Lock()
		for len(s.queue) == 0 && !s.closed {
			s.cond.Wait()
		}
		if s.closed {
			s.mu.Unlock()
			return
		}
		item := s.queue[0]
		s.queue = s.queue[1:]
		s.mu.Unlock()

		if err := item.ctx.Err(); err != nil {
			s.finish(item, err, "cancelled")
			continue
		}

		item.mu.Lock()
		item.state = "running"
		item.startedAt = time.Now()
		item.mu.Unlock()
		s.publish(item.snapshot())

		reporter := reporterFunc(func(progress Progress) {
			item.mu.Lock()
			if !item.finished {
				item.progress = progress
			}
			item.mu.Unlock()
			s.publish(item.snapshot())
		})

		err := item.task.Run(item.ctx, reporter)
		state := "completed"
		if err != nil {
			if errors.Is(err, context.Canceled) || errors.Is(item.ctx.Err(), context.Canceled) {
				state = "cancelled"
			} else {
				state = "failed"
			}
		}
		s.finish(item, err, state)
	}
}

func (s *Scheduler) finish(item *scheduledTask, err error, state string) {
	item.mu.Lock()
	if item.finished {
		item.mu.Unlock()
		return
	}
	item.finished = true
	item.state = state
	item.err = err
	item.finishedAt = time.Now()
	close(item.done)
	item.mu.Unlock()

	s.mu.Lock()
	if item.task.Key != "" && s.keyed[item.task.Key] == item {
		delete(s.keyed, item.task.Key)
	}
	s.mu.Unlock()

	s.publish(item.snapshot())
}

func (s *Scheduler) sortQueueLocked() {
	sort.SliceStable(s.queue, func(i, j int) bool {
		left := s.queue[i]
		right := s.queue[j]
		if left.task.Priority != right.task.Priority {
			return left.task.Priority < right.task.Priority
		}
		return left.sequence < right.sequence
	})
}

func (s *Scheduler) publish(snapshot Snapshot) {
	s.listenersMu.RLock()
	listeners := make([]func(Snapshot), 0, len(s.listeners))
	for _, listener := range s.listeners {
		listeners = append(listeners, listener)
	}
	s.listenersMu.RUnlock()

	for _, listener := range listeners {
		listener(snapshot)
	}
}
`````

## File: manager/internal/workspace/manager.go
`````go
package workspace

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"sync"
	"time"

	contracts "wails-app/internal/contracts"
	"wails-app/internal/pathref"
)

// Manager owns workspace persistence and converts between storage models and wire contracts.
type Manager struct {
	mu          sync.RWMutex
	store       *Store
	workspaces  map[string]Config
	activeID    string
	preferences Preferences
}

func NewManager() (*Manager, error) {
	store, err := NewStore("wails-file-manager")
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	manager := newManager(store)
	_ = manager.load()
	return manager, nil
}

func NewTransientManager() *Manager {
	return newManager(nil)
}

func newManager(store *Store) *Manager {
	return &Manager{
		store:       store,
		workspaces:  make(map[string]Config),
		preferences: toStoragePreferences(DefaultPreferences()),
	}
}

func (m *Manager) ListWorkspaces() contracts.WorkspaceList {
	m.mu.RLock()
	defer m.mu.RUnlock()

	list := make([]contracts.WorkspaceConfig, 0, len(m.workspaces))
	for _, workspace := range m.workspaces {
		list = append(list, fromStorageWorkspaceConfig(workspace))
	}

	return contracts.WorkspaceList{
		Workspaces:        list,
		ActiveWorkspaceID: m.activeID,
	}
}

func (m *Manager) SaveWorkspace(workspace contracts.WorkspaceConfig) error {
	m.mu.Lock()
	defer m.mu.Unlock()

	if workspace.ID == "" {
		return fmt.Errorf("workspace ID must not be empty")
	}

	stored := toStorageWorkspaceConfig(workspace)
	stored.LastAccessedAt = time.Now().Unix()
	m.workspaces[stored.ID] = stored

	if m.activeID == "" {
		m.activeID = stored.ID
	}

	return m.persist()
}

func (m *Manager) LoadWorkspace(id string) (*contracts.WorkspaceConfig, error) {
	m.mu.Lock()
	defer m.mu.Unlock()

	stored, ok := m.workspaces[id]
	if !ok {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("workspace %q not found", id)
	}

	stored.LastAccessedAt = time.Now().Unix()
	m.workspaces[id] = stored
	m.activeID = id

	_ = m.persist()
	workspace := fromStorageWorkspaceConfig(stored)
	return &workspace, nil
}

func (m *Manager) DeleteWorkspace(id string) error {
	m.mu.Lock()
	defer m.mu.Unlock()

	if _, ok := m.workspaces[id]; !ok {
		return fmt.Errorf("workspace %q not found", id)
	}

	delete(m.workspaces, id)
	if m.activeID == id {
		m.activeID = ""
		for key := range m.workspaces {
			m.activeID = key
			break
		}
	}

	return m.persist()
}

func (m *Manager) SetActiveWorkspace(id string) error {
	m.mu.Lock()
	defer m.mu.Unlock()

	if _, ok := m.workspaces[id]; !ok {
		return fmt.Errorf("workspace %q not found", id)
	}
	m.activeID = id
	return m.persist()
}

func (m *Manager) GetPreferences() contracts.UserPreferences {
	m.mu.RLock()
	defer m.mu.RUnlock()
	return fromStoragePreferences(m.preferences)
}

func (m *Manager) SavePreferences(preferences contracts.UserPreferences) error {
	m.mu.Lock()
	defer m.mu.Unlock()
	m.preferences = toStoragePreferences(preferences)
	return m.persist()
}

func (m *Manager) persist() error {
	if m.store == nil {
		return nil
	}

	state := State{
		SchemaVersion:     CurrentStateSchemaVersion,
		Workspaces:        m.workspaces,
		ActiveWorkspaceID: m.activeID,
		Preferences:       m.preferences,
	}

	data, err := json.MarshalIndent(state, "", "  ")
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}

	return m.store.WriteState(data)
}

func (m *Manager) load() error {
	if m.store == nil {
		return nil
	}

	data, err := m.store.ReadState()
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}

	var state State
	if err := json.Unmarshal(data, &state); err != nil {
		return err
	}

	state, err = migrateState(state, data)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}

	if state.Workspaces != nil {
		m.workspaces = state.Workspaces
	}
	m.activeID = state.ActiveWorkspaceID
	if state.Preferences.Theme != "" {
		m.preferences = mergePreferenceDefaults(state.Preferences)
	}

	return nil
}

// stateMigrations upgrades a State of version N to version N+1. Add an entry
// here whenever the persisted shape changes incompatibly. The raw JSON is
// passed alongside so a migration can rescue fields that were dropped during
// the typed unmarshal.
var stateMigrations = map[int]func(state State, raw []byte) (State, error){
	0: func(state State, _ []byte) (State, error) {
		// Original unversioned shape. No reshaping needed; just stamp.
		state.SchemaVersion = 1
		return state, nil
	},
}

func migrateState(state State, raw []byte) (State, error) {
	for state.SchemaVersion < CurrentStateSchemaVersion {
		migrate, ok := stateMigrations[state.SchemaVersion]
		if !ok {
			return state, fmt.Errorf("workspace: no migration registered from version %d", state.SchemaVersion)
		}
		next, err := migrate(state, raw)
		if err != nil {
			return state, err
		}
		state = next
	}
	return state, nil
}

func mergePreferenceDefaults(stored Preferences) Preferences {
	defaults := toStoragePreferences(DefaultPreferences())
	if stored.UIZoom <= 0 {
		stored.UIZoom = defaults.UIZoom
	}
	return stored
}

// LoadStoredWindowState reads the persisted window state directly from disk
// without instantiating a Manager. Intended for use before wails.Run() so the
// window can be restored at its previous size, position, and maximised state.
// Returns nil when no state has been written yet or the file is unreadable.
func LoadStoredWindowState(appName string) *contracts.WindowState {
	store, err := NewStore(appName)
	if err != nil {
		return nil
	}
	data, err := store.ReadState()
	if err != nil {
		return nil
	}
	var state State
	if err := json.Unmarshal(data, &state); err != nil {
		return nil
	}
	return fromStorageWindowState(state.Preferences.WindowState)
}

// LoadStoredState reads the persisted workspace state directly from disk
// without instantiating a Manager. Returns nil when no state has been written
// yet or the file is unreadable.
func LoadStoredState(appName string) *State {
	store, err := NewStore(appName)
	if err != nil {
		return nil
	}
	data, err := store.ReadState()
	if err != nil {
		return nil
	}
	var state State
	if err := json.Unmarshal(data, &state); err != nil {
		return nil
	}
	migrated, err := migrateState(state, data)
	if err != nil {
		return nil
	}
	return &migrated
}

// StoredStateRequiresElevation reports whether startup should relaunch elevated
// before restoring persisted panes. This currently treats registry-backed pane
// locations as requiring elevation on startup so the initial restore does not
// fall back to a generic root before elevated access is available.
func StoredStateRequiresElevation(appName string) bool {
	state := LoadStoredState(appName)
	return state != nil && storedStateRequiresElevation(*state)
}

func storedStateRequiresElevation(state State) bool {
	if len(state.Workspaces) == 0 {
		return false
	}

	if state.Preferences.ReopenLastWorkspace && state.ActiveWorkspaceID != "" {
		if workspace, ok := state.Workspaces[state.ActiveWorkspaceID]; ok {
			return workspaceRequiresElevation(workspace)
		}
	}

	for _, workspace := range state.Workspaces {
		if workspaceRequiresElevation(workspace) {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}

func workspaceRequiresElevation(workspace Config) bool {
	return paneRequiresElevation(workspace.LeftPane) || paneRequiresElevation(workspace.RightPane)
}

func paneRequiresElevation(pane PaneState) bool {
	for _, tab := range pane.Tabs {
		if tabRequiresElevation(tab) {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}

func tabRequiresElevation(tab TabInfo) bool {
	candidates := []string{
		tab.Path,
		tab.ViewerPath(),
	}
	if tab.Location != nil {
		candidates = append(candidates, tab.Location.Location)
	}
	for _, candidate := range candidates {
		if pathref.IsRegistry(pathref.Normalize(candidate)) {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}

func (t TabInfo) ViewerPath() string {
	if t.Viewer == nil {
		return ""
	}
	if t.Viewer.TargetPath != "" {
		return t.Viewer.TargetPath
	}
	return t.Viewer.SourceDir
}

func DefaultPreferences() contracts.UserPreferences {
	return contracts.UserPreferences{
		Theme:                   "system",
		AccentColor:             "",
		UIZoom:                  100,
		CompactMode:             false,
		AnimationsEnabled:       true,
		DefaultShowHidden:       false,
		DefaultSortBy:           "name",
		DefaultSortOrder:        "asc",
		EnableKeyboardShortcuts: true,
		DoubleClickAction:       "open",
		ConfirmDelete:           true,
		ConfirmOnClose:          true,
		ReopenLastWorkspace:     true,
		MemoryRoot:              "",
	}
}

func toStorageWorkspaceConfig(source contracts.WorkspaceConfig) Config {
	return Config{
		ID:             source.ID,
		Name:           source.Name,
		Icon:           source.Icon,
		Color:          source.Color,
		LeftPane:       toStoragePaneState(source.LeftPane),

		ActivePaneID:   source.ActivePaneID,
		SplitRatio:     source.SplitRatio,
		CreatedAt:      source.CreatedAt,
		LastAccessedAt: source.LastAccessedAt,
	}
}

		ID:             source.ID,
		Name:           source.Name,

		Color:          source.Color,
		LeftPane:       fromStoragePaneState(source.LeftPane),

	tabs := make([]TabInfo, 0, len(source.Tabs))
`````

`````go
package workspace

// State is the persisted workspace payload stored on disk.
type State struct {
	// SchemaVersion is bumped whenever the persisted shape changes
	// incompatibly. Older blobs are upgraded through stateMigrations on load.
	// A zero value (missing field) denotes the original unversioned shape.
	SchemaVersion     int               `json:"schemaVersion,omitempty"`
	Workspaces        map[string]Config `json:"workspaces"`
	ActiveWorkspaceID string            `json:"activeWorkspaceId"`
	Preferences       Preferences       `json:"preferences"`
}

// CurrentStateSchemaVersion is the version stamped on every state we write.
const CurrentStateSchemaVersion = 1

type Config struct {
	ID             string    `json:"id"`
	Name           string    `json:"name"`
	Icon           string    `json:"icon,omitempty"`
	Color          string    `json:"color,omitempty"`

}
`````

`````go
package workspace

import "testing"

func TestStoredStateRequiresElevation(t *testing.T) {
	t.Run("active workspace registry tab requires elevation", func(t *testing.T) {
		state := State{
			ActiveWorkspaceID: "registry",
			Preferences: Preferences{
				ReopenLastWorkspace: true,
			},
			Workspaces: map[string]Config{
				"registry": {
					LeftPane: PaneState{
						Tabs: []TabInfo{
							{
								Path: "registry://HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE/Software",
							},
						},
					},
				},
				"filesystem": {
					LeftPane: PaneState{
						Tabs: []TabInfo{
							{
								Path: "filesystem://c/Users",
							},
						},
					},
				},
			},
		}

		if !storedStateRequiresElevation(state) {
			t.Fatal("expected registry workspace to require elevation")
		}
	})

	t.Run("non-active registry workspace is ignored when reopening last workspace", func(t *testing.T) {
		state := State{
			ActiveWorkspaceID: "filesystem",
			Preferences: Preferences{
				ReopenLastWorkspace: true,
			},
			Workspaces: map[string]Config{
				"filesystem": {
					LeftPane: PaneState{
						Tabs: []TabInfo{
							{
								Path: "filesystem://c/Users",
							},
						},
					},
				},
				"registry": {
					LeftPane: PaneState{
						Tabs: []TabInfo{
							{
								Path: "registry://HKEY_CURRENT_USER/Software",
							},
						},
					},
				},
			},
		}

		if storedStateRequiresElevation(state) {
			t.Fatal("did not expect non-active registry workspace to require elevation when reopening the last workspace")
		}
	})

	t.Run("any registry workspace requires elevation when startup workspace is ambiguous", func(t *testing.T) {
		state := State{
			Preferences: Preferences{
				ReopenLastWorkspace: false,
			},
			Workspaces: map[string]Config{
				"filesystem": {
					LeftPane: PaneState{
						Tabs: []TabInfo{
							{
								Path: "filesystem://c/Users",
							},
						},
					},
				},
				"registry": {
					RightPane: PaneState{
						Tabs: []TabInfo{
							{
								Location: &LocationRef{Location: "registry://HKEY_USERS"},
							},
						},
					},
				},
			},
		}

		if !storedStateRequiresElevation(state) {
			t.Fatal("expected registry workspace to require elevation when startup workspace is ambiguous")
		}
	})
}
`````

## File: manager/internal/workspace/store.go
`````go
package workspace

import (
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
)

// Store owns byte-level persistence for workspace state without depending on
// app wire types or Wails-facing contracts.
type Store struct {
	statePath string
}

func NewStore(appName string) (*Store, error) {
	base, err := os.UserConfigDir()
	if err != nil {
		base, err = os.UserHomeDir()
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
	}

	dir := filepath.Join(base, appName)
	if err := os.MkdirAll(dir, 0755); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	return &Store{statePath: filepath.Join(dir, "state.json")}, nil
}

func (s *Store) ReadState() ([]byte, error) {
	return os.ReadFile(s.statePath)
}

func (s *Store) WriteState(data []byte) error {
	return os.WriteFile(s.statePath, data, 0644)
}

func (s *Store) StatePath() string {
	return s.statePath
}
`````

## File: manager/scripts/collect-portable-tools.ps1
`````powershell
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'

$projectRoot = Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot
$toolsRoot = Join-Path $projectRoot 'tools'

function Resolve-FirstSourcePath {
  param(
    [string[]]$Candidates
  )

  foreach ($candidate in $Candidates) {
    if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($candidate)) {
      continue
    }

    $matches = @(Get-Item -Path $candidate -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)
    $match = $matches | Where-Object { $_.PSIsContainer } | Select-Object -First 1
    if ($match) {
      return $match.FullName
    }
  }

  return $null
}

$toolSpecs = @(
  @{
    Name = 'libvips'
    Sources = @(
      'C:\Program Files\libvips\bin',
      'C:\Program Files\vips-dev-8.17\bin',
      'C:\vips-dev-8.17\bin',
      (Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'Microsoft\WinGet\Packages\libvips.libvips_Microsoft.Winget.Source_8wekyb3d8bbwe\vips-dev-*\bin')
    )
  },
  @{
    Name = 'mupdf'
    Sources = @(
      'C:\Program Files\MuPDF',
      (Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'Microsoft\WinGet\Packages\ArtifexSoftware.mutool_Microsoft.Winget.Source_8wekyb3d8bbwe\mupdf-*-windows')
    )
  },
  @{
    Name = 'libreoffice'
    Sources = @(
      'C:\Program Files\LibreOffice',
      'C:\Program Files (x86)\LibreOffice'
    )
  },
  @{
    Name = 'djvulibre'
    Sources = @(
      (Join-Path $projectRoot 'DjVuLibre'),
      (Join-Path (Split-Path -Parent $projectRoot) 'DjVuLibre')
    )
  }
)

New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $toolsRoot | Out-Null

foreach ($tool in $toolSpecs) {
  $destination = Join-Path $toolsRoot $tool.Name
  New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $destination | Out-Null

  $source = Resolve-FirstSourcePath -Candidates $tool.Sources
  if (-not $source) {
    Write-Warning "$($tool.Name): source not found"
    continue
  }

  Write-Host "Copying $($tool.Name) from $source"
  Copy-Item (Join-Path $source '*') $destination -Recurse -Force
}

Write-Host "Portable tool collection complete: $toolsRoot"
`````

`````go
	PtMaxTrackSize Point
`````
