`````go
package archive

import (
	"context"

	"wails-app/vfs"
)

// Handler is the interface every archive format plugin must implement.
// Register implementations with Register() from an init() function.
type Handler interface {
	// Identity & capability
	Name() string         // Short name: "zip", "tar.gz", "7z"
	Extensions() []string // Dot-prefixed: [".zip"], [".tar.gz", ".tgz"]
	Magic() []byte        // Header bytes for content-based detection (nil = extension only)
	CanRead() bool
	CanWrite() bool  // Supports in-place modification (rewrite)
	CanCreate() bool // Supports creating new archives from scratch
	CanStream() bool // Can read entries without seeking (good for tarballs)

	// Detect reports whether the first bytes of a file match this format.
	Detect(data []byte) bool

	// Open returns an Archive ready to use. The caller must call Archive.Close().
	Open(ctx context.Context, path string, opts OpenOptions) (Archive, error)
}

// OpenOptions controls how an archive is opened.
type OpenOptions struct {
	ReadOnly    bool
	Password    string   // For encrypted formats (zip AES, 7z, rar)
	NestedChain []string // Ordered list of entry paths to resolve before opening.
	// Example: outer.zip contains inner.tar.gz; NestedChain = ["inner.tar.gz"]
}

// Archive represents an opened archive and exposes it as a vfs.FileSystem.
// The caller is responsible for calling Close().
type Archive interface {
	vfs.FileSystem // Archives are navigable as read (and sometimes write) filesystems.

	// Archive-specific
	Comment() string // Global archive comment (zip supports this; others return "")
	IsSolid() bool   // True for solid-compression formats (7z, some rar)
	EntryCount() int // Total number of entries

	// Targeted extraction — more efficient than Open+Read for large archives.
	Extract(ctx context.Context, srcEntryPath, dstOSPath string) error
	ExtractSelected(ctx context.Context, entries []string, dstOSPath string, opts ExtractOptions) (*ExtractResult, error)

	Close() error
}

// ExtractOptions controls how entries are extracted to disk.
type ExtractOptions struct {
	// StripPrefix removes a leading path component from every entry before writing.
	// Example: StripPrefix="a/b" turns "a/b/c.txt" into "c.txt" at the destination.
	StripPrefix  string
	FlattenPaths bool // Drop all directory structure; write everything flat.
	PreserveTime bool // Restore mtime/atime from archive metadata.
	Progress     ProgressFunc
	// OnConflict is called when dstPath already exists.
	// Return the final path to write to, or ("", true, nil) to skip.
	OnConflict ConflictFunc
}

type ProgressFunc func(current, total int64, currentFile string)

// ExtractResult summarises the outcome of an ExtractSelected call.
type ExtractResult struct {
	Extracted int          // number of entries successfully written
	Bytes     int64        // total uncompressed bytes written
	Failed    int          // number of entries that could not be extracted
	Errors    []EntryError // per-entry errors (len == Failed)
}

// EntryError pairs an archive entry path with the error that occurred.
type EntryError struct {
	Entry string
	Err   error
}

// ConflictFunc is called when an extraction target already exists on disk.
// Returning ("", true, nil) skips the entry.
// Returning (path, false, nil) writes to path (which may differ from dst for renames).
type ConflictFunc func(src, dst string) (resolvedDst string, skip bool, err error)
`````

## File: manager/vfs/archive/registry.go
`````go
package archive

import (
	"fmt"
	"strings"
	"sync"
)

// Registry maps file extensions and magic bytes to Handler implementations.
type Registry struct {
	mu      sync.RWMutex
	byName  map[string]Handler // keyed by Handler.Name()
	byExt   map[string]Handler // keyed by lowercase dot-prefixed extension
	byMagic []Handler          // handlers that expose Magic() bytes, checked in registration order
}

// NewRegistry creates an empty Registry.
func NewRegistry() *Registry {
	return &Registry{
		byName: make(map[string]Handler),
		byExt:  make(map[string]Handler),
	}
}

// Register adds h to the registry. Returns an error if the name is already taken.
// Intended to be called from package init() functions.
func (r *Registry) Register(h Handler) error {
	r.mu.Lock()
	defer r.mu.Unlock()

	name := h.Name()
	if _, exists := r.byName[name]; exists {
		return fmt.Errorf("archive: handler %q already registered", name)
	}
	r.byName[name] = h

	for _, ext := range h.Extensions() {
		// Lowercase, ensure leading dot.
		ext = strings.ToLower(ext)
		if !strings.HasPrefix(ext, ".") {
			ext = "." + ext
		}
		r.byExt[ext] = h
	}

	if len(h.Magic()) > 0 {
		r.byMagic = append(r.byMagic, h)
	}

	return nil
}

// ForName returns the handler registered under the given name.
func (r *Registry) ForName(name string) (Handler, bool) {
	r.mu.RLock()
	defer r.mu.RUnlock()
	h, ok := r.byName[name]
	return h, ok
}

// ForPath selects a handler by matching the longest known extension suffix of
// path. For example "archive.tar.gz" matches ".tar.gz" before ".gz".
// path may be just a filename or a full OS path.
func (r *Registry) ForPath(path string) (Handler, bool) {
	r.mu.RLock()
	defer r.mu.RUnlock()

	lower := strings.ToLower(path)

	// Try compound extensions first (longest match wins).
	// We iterate all registered extensions sorted by length descending.
	// Since the map is small, a linear scan is fine.
	best := ""
	var bestHandler Handler
	for ext, h := range r.byExt {
		if strings.HasSuffix(lower, ext) && len(ext) > len(best) {
			best = ext
			bestHandler = h
		}
	}
	if bestHandler != nil {
		return bestHandler, true
	}
	return nil, false
}

// Detect tries to identify the format by inspecting the first bytes of a file.
// Returns the matching handler or (nil, false) if none matched.
func (r *Registry) Detect(data []byte) (Handler, bool) {
	r.mu.RLock()
	defer r.mu.RUnlock()

	for _, h := range r.byMagic {
		if h.Detect(data) {
			return h, true
		}
	}
	return nil, false
}

// List returns the names of all registered handlers.
func (r *Registry) List() []string {
	r.mu.RLock()
	defer r.mu.RUnlock()

	names := make([]string, 0, len(r.byName))
	for name := range r.byName {
		names = append(names, name)
	}
	return names
}

// DefaultRegistry is the package-level registry used by Register and helper
// functions. Format packages call archive.Register(h) from their init().
var DefaultRegistry = NewRegistry()

// Register adds h to DefaultRegistry. Logs and returns if the handler name
// conflicts — this is a programming error caught at startup, not a runtime
// condition. Prefer DefaultRegistry.Register for explicit error handling.
func Register(h Handler) {
	_ = DefaultRegistry.Register(h)
}

// ForPath is a convenience wrapper around DefaultRegistry.ForPath.
func ForPath(path string) (Handler, bool) {
	return DefaultRegistry.ForPath(path)
}

// ForName is a convenience wrapper around DefaultRegistry.ForName.
func ForName(name string) (Handler, bool) {
	return DefaultRegistry.ForName(name)
}

// Detect is a convenience wrapper around DefaultRegistry.Detect.
func Detect(data []byte) (Handler, bool) {
	return DefaultRegistry.Detect(data)
}

// IsArchiveExt reports whether name has a file extension that matches a
// registered archive handler.  It uses the same longest-suffix matching as
// ForPath, so it stays automatically in sync with whatever handlers have been
// registered via init() — no separate extension list to maintain.
func IsArchiveExt(name string) bool {
	_, ok := DefaultRegistry.ForPath(name)
	return ok
}
`````

`````go
package cloudutil

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"io/fs"
	"path"
	"strings"
	"sync"
	"time"

	"wails-app/vfs"
	vfsarchive "wails-app/vfs/archive"
)

// CleanPath normalizes a VFS-relative remote path into slash-separated form.
func CleanPath(p string) string {
	trimmed := strings.TrimLeft(strings.ReplaceAll(p, `\`, `/`), "/")
	if trimmed == "" || trimmed == "." {
		return ""
	}
	cleaned := path.Clean(trimmed)
	if cleaned == "." {
		return ""
	}
	return cleaned
}

// Info is a small read-only VFS file info implementation for cloud adapters.
type Info struct {
	NameValue    string
	SizeValue    int64
	ModifiedTime time.Time
	Dir          bool
}

func (fi *Info) Name() string { return fi.NameValue }
func (fi *Info) Size() int64  { return fi.SizeValue }
func (fi *Info) Mode() fs.FileMode {
	if fi.Dir {
		return fs.ModeDir | 0o555
	}
	return 0o444
}
func (fi *Info) ModTime() time.Time   { return fi.ModifiedTime }
func (fi *Info) IsDir() bool          { return fi.Dir }
func (fi *Info) Sys() any             { return nil }
func (fi *Info) Path() string         { return fi.NameValue }
func (fi *Info) RealPath() string     { return "" }
func (fi *Info) Volume() vfs.Volume   { return nil }
func (fi *Info) IsArchive() bool      { return !fi.Dir && isArchiveExt(fi.NameValue) }
func (fi *Info) IsHidden() bool       { return strings.HasPrefix(fi.NameValue, ".") }
func (fi *Info) IsSymlink() bool      { return false }
func (fi *Info) IsNested() bool       { return false }
func (fi *Info) MountChain() []string { return nil }

var _ vfs.FileInfo = (*Info)(nil)

// Loader downloads file content on first access.
type Loader func(context.Context) ([]byte, error)

// ReadOnlyFile is a small in-memory, read-only file handle for cloud adapters.
type ReadOnlyFile struct {
	ctx      context.Context
	info     vfs.FileInfo
	loader   Loader
	loadOnce sync.Once
	loadErr  error
	data     []byte
	pos      int64
}

// NewReadOnlyFile returns a lazily-loaded in-memory file handle.
func NewReadOnlyFile(ctx context.Context, info vfs.FileInfo, loader Loader) *ReadOnlyFile {
	return &ReadOnlyFile{
		ctx:    ctx,
		info:   info,
		loader: loader,
	}
}

func (f *ReadOnlyFile) ensureLoaded() error {
	f.loadOnce.Do(func() {
		f.data, f.loadErr = f.loader(f.ctx)
	})
	return f.loadErr
}

func (f *ReadOnlyFile) Read(p []byte) (int, error) {
	if len(p) == 0 {
		return 0, nil
	}
	if err := f.ensureLoaded(); err != nil {
		return 0, err
	}
	if f.pos >= int64(len(f.data)) {
		return 0, io.EOF
	}
	n := copy(p, f.data[f.pos:])
	f.pos += int64(n)
	return n, nil
}

func (f *ReadOnlyFile) Write(_ []byte) (int, error) {
	return 0, vfs.ErrReadOnly
}

func (f *ReadOnlyFile) Seek(offset int64, whence int) (int64, error) {
	if err := f.ensureLoaded(); err != nil {
		return 0, err
	}

	next := offset
	switch whence {
	case io.SeekStart:
	case io.SeekCurrent:
		next = f.pos + offset
	case io.SeekEnd:
		next = int64(len(f.data)) + offset
	default:
		return 0, fmt.Errorf("cloudutil: invalid seek whence %d", whence)
	}
	if next < 0 {
		return 0, fmt.Errorf("cloudutil: negative seek position")
	}
	f.pos = next
	return f.pos, nil
}

func (f *ReadOnlyFile) Close() error {
	return nil
}

func (f *ReadOnlyFile) Stat() (vfs.FileInfo, error) {
	return f.info, nil
}

func (f *ReadOnlyFile) Sync() error {
	return vfs.ErrReadOnly
}

var _ vfs.File = (*ReadOnlyFile)(nil)

func isArchiveExt(name string) bool {
	return vfsarchive.IsArchiveExt(name)
}
`````

`````go
package cloudutil

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"strings"
)

// AccessTokenSource returns a valid bearer token for cloud-backed VFS adapters.
type AccessTokenSource interface {
	AccessToken(context.Context) (string, error)
}

// StaticAccessTokenSource always returns the same access token.
type StaticAccessTokenSource struct {
	token string
}

// NewStaticAccessTokenSource validates and wraps a fixed bearer token.
func NewStaticAccessTokenSource(token string) (*StaticAccessTokenSource, error) {
	trimmed := strings.TrimSpace(token)
	if trimmed == "" {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("cloudutil: access token is required")
	}
	return &StaticAccessTokenSource{token: trimmed}, nil
}

// AccessToken implements AccessTokenSource.
func (s *StaticAccessTokenSource) AccessToken(context.Context) (string, error) {
	if s == nil || strings.TrimSpace(s.token) == "" {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("cloudutil: access token is required")
	}
	return s.token, nil
}
`````

`````go
// Package dropbox provides a read-only vfs.FileSystem backed by the Dropbox API.
package dropbox

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"io/fs"
	"net/http"
	"path"
	"strings"
	"time"

	"wails-app/vfs"
	"wails-app/vfs/cloudutil"
)

const (
	apiBaseURL     = "https://api.dropboxapi.com/2"
	contentBaseURL = "https://content.dropboxapi.com/2"
)

// Config holds Dropbox connection parameters.
type Config struct {
	AccessToken string
	TokenSource cloudutil.AccessTokenSource
}

// FS implements vfs.FileSystem over the Dropbox file API.
type FS struct {
	client      *http.Client
	tokenSource cloudutil.AccessTokenSource
}

var _ vfs.FileSystem = (*FS)(nil)

type metadata struct {
	Tag            string `json:".tag"`
	Name           string `json:"name"`
	Size           int64  `json:"size,omitempty"`
	ClientModified string `json:"client_modified,omitempty"`
	ServerModified string `json:"server_modified,omitempty"`
}

type listFolderResponse struct {
	Entries []metadata `json:"entries"`
	Cursor  string     `json:"cursor"`
	HasMore bool       `json:"has_more"`
}

func New(ctx context.Context, cfg Config) (*FS, error) {
	source := cfg.TokenSource
	if source == nil {
		var err error
		source, err = cloudutil.NewStaticAccessTokenSource(cfg.AccessToken)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("dropbox: %w", err)
		}
	}

	fs := &FS{
		client:      &http.Client{Timeout: 60 * time.Second},
		tokenSource: source,
	}
	if _, err := fs.listFolder(ctx, ""); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return fs, nil
}

func (f *FS) Open(ctx context.Context, p string) (vfs.File, error) {
	cleaned := cloudutil.CleanPath(p)
	if cleaned == "" {
		return nil, vfs.ErrNotFile
	}

	info, err := f.statMetadata(ctx, cleaned)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if info.IsDir() {
		return nil, vfs.ErrNotFile
	}

	return cloudutil.NewReadOnlyFile(ctx, info, func(ctx context.Context) ([]byte, error) {
		return f.download(ctx, cleaned)
	}), nil
}

func (f *FS) Stat(ctx context.Context, p string) (vfs.FileInfo, error) {
	cleaned := cloudutil.CleanPath(p)
	if cleaned == "" {
		return &cloudutil.Info{NameValue: "Dropbox", Dir: true}, nil
	}
	return f.statMetadata(ctx, cleaned)
}

func (f *FS) ReadDir(ctx context.Context, p string) ([]vfs.FileInfo, error) {
	cleaned := cloudutil.CleanPath(p)
	if cleaned != "" {
		info, err := f.statMetadata(ctx, cleaned)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		if !info.IsDir() {
			return nil, vfs.ErrNotDir
		}
	}

	entries, err := f.listFolder(ctx, cleaned)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	result := make([]vfs.FileInfo, 0, len(entries))
	for _, entry := range entries {
		result = append(result, toInfo(entry))
	}
	return result, nil
}

func (f *FS) Exists(ctx context.Context, p string) bool {
	_, err := f.Stat(ctx, p)
	return err == nil
}

func (f *FS) Create(_ context.Context, _ string) (vfs.File, error) { return nil, vfs.ErrReadOnly }
func (f *FS) Mkdir(_ context.Context, _ string, _ fs.FileMode) error {
	return vfs.ErrReadOnly
}
func (f *FS) Remove(_ context.Context, _ string) error { return vfs.ErrReadOnly }
func (f *FS) Rename(_ context.Context, _, _ string) error {
	return vfs.ErrReadOnly
}
func (f *FS) Join(elem ...string) string        { return path.Join(elem...) }
func (f *FS) Split(p string) (string, string)   { return path.Split(p) }
func (f *FS) IsAbs(p string) bool               { return strings.HasPrefix(p, "/") }
func (f *FS) RealPath(_ string) (string, error) { return "", nil }

func (f *FS) statMetadata(ctx context.Context, cleaned string) (vfs.FileInfo, error) {
	var meta metadata
	if err := f.postJSON(ctx, apiBaseURL+"/files/get_metadata", map[string]string{
		"path": dropboxPath(cleaned),
	}, &meta, nil); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return toInfo(meta), nil
}

func (f *FS) listFolder(ctx context.Context, cleaned string) ([]metadata, error) {
	var response listFolderResponse
	if err := f.postJSON(ctx, apiBaseURL+"/files/list_folder", map[string]any{
		"path": dropboxPath(cleaned),
	}, &response, nil); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	entries := append([]metadata{}, response.Entries...)
	cursor := response.Cursor
	for response.HasMore {
		response = listFolderResponse{}
		if err := f.postJSON(ctx, apiBaseURL+"/files/list_folder/continue", map[string]string{
			"cursor": cursor,
		}, &response, nil); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		entries = append(entries, response.Entries...)
		cursor = response.Cursor
	}

	return entries, nil
}

func (f *FS) download(ctx context.Context, cleaned string) ([]byte, error) {
	headers := map[string]string{
		"Dropbox-API-Arg": mustJSON(map[string]string{"path": dropboxPath(cleaned)}),
	}
	request, err := f.newRequest(ctx, http.MethodPost, contentBaseURL+"/files/download", nil, headers)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	response, err := f.client.Do(request)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer response.Body.Close()

	if response.StatusCode == http.StatusNotFound {
		return nil, vfs.ErrNotFound
	}
	if response.StatusCode < http.StatusOK || response.StatusCode >= http.StatusBadRequest {
		body, _ := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(response.Body, 4*1024))
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("dropbox: download failed: HTTP %d: %s", response.StatusCode, strings.TrimSpace(string(body)))
	}
	return io.ReadAll(response.Body)
}

func (f *FS) postJSON(ctx context.Context, endpoint string, body any, target any, headers map[string]string) error {
	payload, err := json.Marshal(body)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	request, err := f.newRequest(ctx, http.MethodPost, endpoint, bytes.NewReader(payload), headers)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	request.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")

	response, err := f.client.Do(request)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer response.Body.Close()

	switch response.StatusCode {
	case http.StatusOK:
	case http.StatusNotFound:
		return vfs.ErrNotFound
	default:
		body, _ := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(response.Body, 4*1024))
		return fmt.Errorf("dropbox: request failed: HTTP %d: %s", response.StatusCode, strings.TrimSpace(string(body)))
	}

	return json.NewDecoder(response.Body).Decode(target)
}

func (f *FS) newRequest(ctx context.Context, method string, endpoint string, body io.Reader, headers map[string]string) (*http.Request, error) {
	request, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, method, endpoint, body)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	token, err := f.tokenSource.AccessToken(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	request.Header.Set("Authorization", "Bearer "+token)
	for key, value := range headers {
		request.Header.Set(key, value)
	}
	return request, nil
}

func dropboxPath(cleaned string) string {
	if cleaned == "" {
		return ""
	}
	return "/" + cleaned
}

func toInfo(meta metadata) *cloudutil.Info {
	modified := parseTime(meta.ServerModified)
	if modified.IsZero() {
		modified = parseTime(meta.ClientModified)
	}
	return &cloudutil.Info{
		NameValue:    meta.Name,
		SizeValue:    meta.Size,
		ModifiedTime: modified,
		Dir:          meta.Tag == "folder",
	}
}

func parseTime(value string) time.Time {
	if strings.TrimSpace(value) == "" {
		return time.Time{}
	}
	parsed, _ := time.Parse(time.RFC3339, value)
	return parsed
}

func mustJSON(value any) string {
	data, _ := json.Marshal(value)
	return string(data)
}
`````

`````go
// Package gdrive provides a read-only vfs.FileSystem backed by the Google Drive API.
package gdrive

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"io/fs"
	"net/http"
	"net/url"
	"path"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
	"sync"
	"time"

	"wails-app/vfs"
	"wails-app/vfs/cloudutil"
)

const apiBaseURL = "https://www.googleapis.com/drive/v3"

// Config holds Google Drive connection parameters.
type Config struct {
	AccessToken string
	TokenSource cloudutil.AccessTokenSource
}

// FS implements vfs.FileSystem over the Google Drive API.
type FS struct {
	client        *http.Client
	tokenSource   cloudutil.AccessTokenSource
	rootName      string
	childrenMu    sync.RWMutex
	childrenCache map[string][]fileMetadata
}

var _ vfs.FileSystem = (*FS)(nil)
var _ vfs.CapabilityFileSystem = (*FS)(nil)
var _ vfs.PagedFileSystem = (*FS)(nil)

func (f *FS) ProviderCapabilities() vfs.ProviderCapabilities {
	return vfs.ProviderCapabilities{Pagination: true, RandomAccess: false, TotalCount: false, ServerSort: false, ServerFilter: false, RangeRead: false, Watch: false, Rename: false, AtomicMove: false, Trash: false}
}

type fileMetadata struct {
	ID              string          `json:"id"`
	Name            string          `json:"name"`
	MimeType        string          `json:"mimeType"`
	Size            string          `json:"size,omitempty"`
	ModifiedTime    string          `json:"modifiedTime,omitempty"`
	ShortcutDetails shortcutDetails `json:"shortcutDetails,omitempty"`
}

type shortcutDetails struct {
	TargetID       string `json:"targetId,omitempty"`
	TargetMimeType string `json:"targetMimeType,omitempty"`
}

type listResponse struct {
	Files         []fileMetadata `json:"files"`
	NextPageToken string         `json:"nextPageToken"`
}

func New(ctx context.Context, cfg Config) (*FS, error) {
	source := cfg.TokenSource
	if source == nil {
		var err error
		source, err = cloudutil.NewStaticAccessTokenSource(cfg.AccessToken)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("gdrive: %w", err)
		}
	}

	fs := &FS{
		client:        &http.Client{Timeout: 60 * time.Second},
		tokenSource:   source,
		childrenCache: make(map[string][]fileMetadata),
	}

	root, err := fs.fetchMetadataByID(ctx, "root")
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	fs.rootName = root.Name
	return fs, nil
}

func (f *FS) Open(ctx context.Context, p string) (vfs.File, error) {
	cleaned := cloudutil.CleanPath(p)
	if cleaned == "" {
		return nil, vfs.ErrNotFile
	}

	meta, err := f.resolvePath(ctx, cleaned)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	info := toInfo(meta)
	if info.IsDir() {
		return nil, vfs.ErrNotFile
	}
	if isGoogleWorkspaceFile(meta) {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("gdrive: native Google Workspace files are not downloadable yet")
	}

	id := resolvedID(meta)
	return cloudutil.NewReadOnlyFile(ctx, info, func(ctx context.Context) ([]byte, error) {
		return f.download(ctx, id)
	}), nil
}

func (f *FS) Stat(ctx context.Context, p string) (vfs.FileInfo, error) {
	cleaned := cloudutil.CleanPath(p)
	if cleaned == "" {
		name := f.rootName
		if name == "" {
			name = "Google Drive"
		}
		return &cloudutil.Info{NameValue: name, Dir: true}, nil
	}

	meta, err := f.resolvePath(ctx, cleaned)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return toInfo(meta), nil
}

func (f *FS) ReadDir(ctx context.Context, p string) ([]vfs.FileInfo, error) {
	cleaned := cloudutil.CleanPath(p)
	parentID := "root"
	if cleaned != "" {
		meta, err := f.resolvePath(ctx, cleaned)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		if resolvedMimeType(meta) != folderMimeType {
			return nil, vfs.ErrNotDir
		}
		parentID = resolvedID(meta)
	}

	children, err := f.listChildren(ctx, parentID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	result := make([]vfs.FileInfo, 0, len(children))
	for _, child := range children {
		result = append(result, toInfo(child))
	}
	return result, nil
}

func (f *FS) ReadDirPage(ctx context.Context, p, token string, limit int) (vfs.DirectoryPage, error) {
	cleaned := cloudutil.CleanPath(p)
	parentID := "root"
	if cleaned != "" {
		meta, err := f.resolvePath(ctx, cleaned)
		if err != nil {
			return vfs.DirectoryPage{}, err
		}
		if resolvedMimeType(meta) != folderMimeType {
			return vfs.DirectoryPage{}, vfs.ErrNotDir
		}
		parentID = resolvedID(meta)
	}
	if limit <= 0 || limit > 1000 {
		limit = 1000
	}
	query := url.Values{}
	query.Set("q", fmt.Sprintf("'%s' in parents and trashed = false", strings.ReplaceAll(parentID, "'", "\\'")))
	query.Set("fields", "nextPageToken,files(id,name,mimeType,size,modifiedTime,shortcutDetails(targetId,targetMimeType))")
	query.Set("pageSize", strconv.Itoa(limit))
	query.Set("supportsAllDrives", "true")
	query.Set("includeItemsFromAllDrives", "true")
	if token != "" {
		query.Set("pageToken", token)
	}
	var response listResponse
	if err := f.getJSON(ctx, apiBaseURL+"/files?"+query.Encode(), &response); err != nil {
		return vfs.DirectoryPage{}, err
	}
	entries := make([]vfs.FileInfo, 0, len(response.Files))
	for _, child := range response.Files {
		entries = append(entries, toInfo(child))
	}
	return vfs.DirectoryPage{Entries: entries, NextToken: response.NextPageToken}, nil
}

func (f *FS) Exists(ctx context.Context, p string) bool {
	_, err := f.Stat(ctx, p)
	return err == nil
}

func (f *FS) Create(_ context.Context, _ string) (vfs.File, error) { return nil, vfs.ErrReadOnly }
func (f *FS) Mkdir(_ context.Context, _ string, _ fs.FileMode) error {
	return vfs.ErrReadOnly
}
func (f *FS) Remove(_ context.Context, _ string) error { return vfs.ErrReadOnly }
func (f *FS) Rename(_ context.Context, _, _ string) error {
	return vfs.ErrReadOnly
}
func (f *FS) Join(elem ...string) string        { return path.Join(elem...) }
func (f *FS) Split(p string) (string, string)   { return path.Split(p) }
func (f *FS) IsAbs(p string) bool               { return strings.HasPrefix(p, "/") }
func (f *FS) RealPath(_ string) (string, error) { return "", nil }

func (f *FS) resolvePath(ctx context.Context, cleaned string) (fileMetadata, error) {
	currentID := "root"
	segments := strings.Split(cleaned, "/")
	for index, segment := range segments {
		children, err := f.listChildren(ctx, currentID)
		if err != nil {
			return fileMetadata{}, err
		}

		candidate, ok := chooseByName(children, segment, index < len(segments)-1)
		if !ok {
			return fileMetadata{}, vfs.ErrNotFound
		}

		if index < len(segments)-1 && resolvedMimeType(candidate) != folderMimeType {
			return fileMetadata{}, vfs.ErrNotFound
		}

		currentID = resolvedID(candidate)
		if index == len(segments)-1 {
			return candidate, nil
		}
	}
	return fileMetadata{}, vfs.ErrNotFound
}

func (f *FS) listChildren(ctx context.Context, parentID string) ([]fileMetadata, error) {
	f.childrenMu.RLock()
	if cached, ok := f.childrenCache[parentID]; ok {
		f.childrenMu.RUnlock()
		return append([]fileMetadata(nil), cached...), nil
	}
	f.childrenMu.RUnlock()

	query := url.Values{}
	query.Set("q", fmt.Sprintf("'%s' in parents and trashed = false", strings.ReplaceAll(parentID, "'", "\\'")))
	query.Set("fields", "nextPageToken,files(id,name,mimeType,size,modifiedTime,shortcutDetails(targetId,targetMimeType))")
	query.Set("pageSize", "1000")
	query.Set("supportsAllDrives", "true")
	query.Set("includeItemsFromAllDrives", "true")

	nextToken := ""
	files := make([]fileMetadata, 0)
	for {
		pageQuery := cloneValues(query)
		if nextToken != "" {
			pageQuery.Set("pageToken", nextToken)
		}
		var response listResponse
		if err := f.getJSON(ctx, apiBaseURL+"/files?"+pageQuery.Encode(), &response); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		files = append(files, response.Files...)
		if response.NextPageToken == "" {
			break
		}
		nextToken = response.NextPageToken
	}

	f.childrenMu.Lock()
	f.childrenCache[parentID] = append([]fileMetadata(nil), files...)
	f.childrenMu.Unlock()
	return files, nil
}

func (f *FS) fetchMetadataByID(ctx context.Context, id string) (fileMetadata, error) {
	query := url.Values{}
	query.Set("fields", "id,name,mimeType,size,modifiedTime,shortcutDetails(targetId,targetMimeType)")
	query.Set("supportsAllDrives", "true")

	var meta fileMetadata
	if err := f.getJSON(ctx, apiBaseURL+"/files/"+url.PathEscape(id)+"?"+query.Encode(), &meta); err != nil {
		return fileMetadata{}, err
	}
	return meta, nil
}

func (f *FS) download(ctx context.Context, id string) ([]byte, error) {
	query := url.Values{}
	query.Set("alt", "media")
	query.Set("supportsAllDrives", "true")

	request, err := f.newRequest(ctx, http.MethodGet, apiBaseURL+"/files/"+url.PathEscape(id)+"?"+query.Encode())
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	response, err := f.client.Do(request)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer response.Body.Close()

	if response.StatusCode == http.StatusNotFound {
		return nil, vfs.ErrNotFound
	}
	if response.StatusCode < http.StatusOK || response.StatusCode >= http.StatusBadRequest {
		body, _ := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(response.Body, 4*1024))
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("gdrive: download failed: HTTP %d: %s", response.StatusCode, strings.TrimSpace(string(body)))
	}
	return io.ReadAll(response.Body)
}

func (f *FS) getJSON(ctx context.Context, endpoint string, target any) error {
	request, err := f.newRequest(ctx, http.MethodGet, endpoint)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	response, err := f.client.Do(request)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer response.Body.Close()

	switch response.StatusCode {
	case http.StatusOK:
	case http.StatusNotFound:
		return vfs.ErrNotFound
	default:
		body, _ := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(response.Body, 4*1024))
		return fmt.Errorf("gdrive: request failed: HTTP %d: %s", response.StatusCode, strings.TrimSpace(string(body)))
	}
	return json.NewDecoder(response.Body).Decode(target)
}

func (f *FS) newRequest(ctx context.Context, method string, endpoint string) (*http.Request, error) {
	request, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, method, endpoint, nil)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	token, err := f.tokenSource.AccessToken(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	request.Header.Set("Authorization", "Bearer "+token)
	return request, nil
}

func chooseByName(children []fileMetadata, name string, wantDir bool) (fileMetadata, bool) {
	for _, child := range children {
		if child.Name == name && resolvedMimeType(child) == folderMimeType && wantDir {
			return child, true
		}
	}
	for _, child := range children {
		if child.Name == name {
			return child, true
		}
	}
	return fileMetadata{}, false
}

func toInfo(meta fileMetadata) *cloudutil.Info {
	return &cloudutil.Info{
		NameValue:    meta.Name,
		SizeValue:    parseSize(meta.Size),
		ModifiedTime: parseTime(meta.ModifiedTime),
		Dir:          resolvedMimeType(meta) == folderMimeType,
	}
}

func resolvedID(meta fileMetadata) string {
	if meta.ShortcutDetails.TargetID != "" {
		return meta.ShortcutDetails.TargetID
	}
	return meta.ID
}

func resolvedMimeType(meta fileMetadata) string {
	if meta.ShortcutDetails.TargetMimeType != "" {
		return meta.ShortcutDetails.TargetMimeType
	}
	return meta.MimeType
}

func parseSize(value string) int64 {
	if strings.TrimSpace(value) == "" {
		return 0
	}
	parsed, _ := strconv.ParseInt(value, 10, 64)
	return parsed
}

func parseTime(value string) time.Time {
	if strings.TrimSpace(value) == "" {
		return time.Time{}
	}
	parsed, _ := time.Parse(time.RFC3339, value)
	return parsed
}

func cloneValues(source url.Values) url.Values {
	target := make(url.Values, len(source))
	for key, values := range source {
		target[key] = append([]string(nil), values...)
	}
	return target
}

const folderMimeType = "application/vnd.google-apps.folder"

func isGoogleWorkspaceFile(meta fileMetadata) bool {
	mimeType := resolvedMimeType(meta)
	return strings.HasPrefix(mimeType, "application/vnd.google-apps.") && mimeType != folderMimeType
}
`````

`````go
// Package mount manages virtual filesystem mount points.
// It routes VFS operations to the correct underlying FileSystem based on path prefix.
package mount

import (
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"path"
	"strings"
	"sync"

	"wails-app/vfs"
)

// Manager routes VFS operations to the correct FileSystem based on mount point.
// Mounts are resolved deepest-first so that /a/b/c takes priority over /a/b.
//
// Manager satisfies the vfs.Mounter interface.
type Manager struct {
	mu     sync.RWMutex
	mounts []entry // ordered deepest-first
	root   vfs.FileSystem
	nextID int
}

type entry struct {
	mountPoint string
	fs         vfs.FileSystem
	volume     vfs.Volume
	readOnly   bool
}

// NewManager creates a Manager with root as the "/" filesystem.
func NewManager(root vfs.FileSystem) *Manager {
	return &Manager{
		root:   root,
		mounts: make([]entry, 0),
	}
}

// Mount registers fs at mountPoint.
// Implements vfs.Mounter.
func (m *Manager) Mount(mountPoint string, fs vfs.FileSystem, readOnly bool, name string, vtype vfs.VolumeType) (vfs.Volume, error) {
	m.mu.Lock()
	defer m.mu.Unlock()

	mountPoint = clean(mountPoint)

	for _, e := range m.mounts {
		if e.mountPoint == mountPoint {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("mount: %q is already mounted", mountPoint)
		}
	}

	vol := &volume{
		id:       fmt.Sprintf("vol-%d", m.nextID),
		name:     name,
		vtype:    vtype,
		root:     mountPoint,
		fs:       fs,
		mgr:      m,
		readOnly: readOnly,
	}
	m.nextID++

	e := entry{
		mountPoint: mountPoint,
		fs:         fs,
		volume:     vol,
		readOnly:   readOnly,
	}

	// Keep sorted by descending length (deepest first).
	inserted := false
	for i, existing := range m.mounts {
		if len(mountPoint) > len(existing.mountPoint) {
			m.mounts = append(m.mounts[:i], append([]entry{e}, m.mounts[i:]...)...)
			inserted = true
			break
		}
	}
	if !inserted {
		m.mounts = append(m.mounts, e)
	}

	return vol, nil
}

// Unmount removes the mount at mountPoint and closes the FS if it is an io.Closer.
// Implements vfs.Mounter.
func (m *Manager) Unmount(mountPoint string) error {
	m.mu.Lock()
	defer m.mu.Unlock()

	mountPoint = clean(mountPoint)

	for i, e := range m.mounts {
		if e.mountPoint == mountPoint {
			if closer, ok := e.fs.(io.Closer); ok {
				_ = closer.Close()
			}
			m.mounts = append(m.mounts[:i], m.mounts[i+1:]...)
			return nil
		}
	}
	return fmt.Errorf("mount: %q not found", mountPoint)
}

// Resolve finds the deepest mount covering path and returns its FileSystem,
// the path translated into that FS's namespace, and the Volume (nil = root FS).
// Implements vfs.Mounter.
func (m *Manager) Resolve(path string) (vfs.FileSystem, string, vfs.Volume, error) {
	m.mu.RLock()
	defer m.mu.RUnlock()

	path = clean(path)

	for _, e := range m.mounts {
		mp := e.mountPoint
		if path == mp || strings.HasPrefix(path, mp+"/") {
			rel := strings.TrimPrefix(path, mp)
			if rel == "" {
				rel = "/"
			}
			return e.fs, rel, e.volume, nil
		}
	}

	return m.root, path, nil, nil
}

// ListMounts returns a snapshot of all current mounts.
// Implements vfs.Mounter.
func (m *Manager) ListMounts() []vfs.MountedEntry {
	m.mu.RLock()
	defer m.mu.RUnlock()

	result := make([]vfs.MountedEntry, len(m.mounts))
	for i, e := range m.mounts {
		result[i] = vfs.MountedEntry{
			MountPoint: e.mountPoint,
			FS:         e.fs,
			Volume:     e.volume,
			ReadOnly:   e.readOnly,
		}
	}
	return result
}

// clean normalises a mount point to an absolute clean slash-separated path.
func clean(p string) string {
	if p == "" {
		return "/"
	}
	return path.Clean("/" + strings.TrimPrefix(p, "/"))
}

// volume implements vfs.Volume.
type volume struct {
	id       string
	name     string
	vtype    vfs.VolumeType
	root     string
	fs       vfs.FileSystem
	mgr      *Manager
	readOnly bool
}

func (v *volume) ID() string           { return v.id }
func (v *volume) Name() string         { return v.name }
func (v *volume) Type() vfs.VolumeType { return v.vtype }
func (v *volume) Root() string         { return v.root }
func (v *volume) IsReadOnly() bool     { return v.readOnly }
func (v *volume) Unmount() error       { return v.mgr.Unmount(v.root) }

var _ vfs.Volume = (*volume)(nil)
var _ vfs.Mounter = (*Manager)(nil)
`````

`````go
// Package onedrive provides a read-only vfs.FileSystem backed by the Microsoft Graph OneDrive API.
package onedrive

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"io/fs"
	"net/http"
	"net/url"
	"path"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
	"time"

	"wails-app/vfs"
	"wails-app/vfs/cloudutil"
)

const graphBaseURL = "https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0"

// Config holds OneDrive connection parameters.
type Config struct {
	AccessToken string
	TokenSource cloudutil.AccessTokenSource
}

// FS implements vfs.FileSystem over the OneDrive API.
type FS struct {
	client      *http.Client
	tokenSource cloudutil.AccessTokenSource
}

var _ vfs.FileSystem = (*FS)(nil)
var _ vfs.CapabilityFileSystem = (*FS)(nil)
var _ vfs.PagedFileSystem = (*FS)(nil)

func (f *FS) ProviderCapabilities() vfs.ProviderCapabilities {
	return vfs.ProviderCapabilities{Pagination: true, RandomAccess: false, TotalCount: false, ServerSort: false, ServerFilter: false, RangeRead: false, Watch: false, Rename: false, AtomicMove: false, Trash: false}
}

type item struct {
	Name                 string          `json:"name"`
	Size                 int64           `json:"size"`
	LastModifiedDateTime string          `json:"lastModifiedDateTime"`
	File                 json.RawMessage `json:"file"`
	Folder               json.RawMessage `json:"folder"`
}

type childrenResponse struct {
	Value    []item `json:"value"`
	NextLink string `json:"@odata.nextLink"`
}

func New(ctx context.Context, cfg Config) (*FS, error) {
	source := cfg.TokenSource
	if source == nil {
		var err error
		source, err = cloudutil.NewStaticAccessTokenSource(cfg.AccessToken)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("onedrive: %w", err)
		}
	}

	fs := &FS{
		client:      &http.Client{Timeout: 60 * time.Second},
		tokenSource: source,
	}
	if _, err := fs.fetchItem(ctx, ""); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return fs, nil
}

func (f *FS) Open(ctx context.Context, p string) (vfs.File, error) {
	cleaned := cloudutil.CleanPath(p)
	if cleaned == "" {
		return nil, vfs.ErrNotFile
	}

	meta, err := f.fetchItem(ctx, cleaned)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	info := toInfo(meta)
	if info.IsDir() {
		return nil, vfs.ErrNotFile
	}

	return cloudutil.NewReadOnlyFile(ctx, info, func(ctx context.Context) ([]byte, error) {
		return f.download(ctx, cleaned)
	}), nil
}

func (f *FS) Stat(ctx context.Context, p string) (vfs.FileInfo, error) {
	cleaned := cloudutil.CleanPath(p)
	meta, err := f.fetchItem(ctx, cleaned)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	info := toInfo(meta)
	if cleaned == "" && info.Name() == "" {
		info.NameValue = "OneDrive"
	}
	return info, nil
}

func (f *FS) ReadDir(ctx context.Context, p string) ([]vfs.FileInfo, error) {
	cleaned := cloudutil.CleanPath(p)
	if cleaned != "" {
		meta, err := f.fetchItem(ctx, cleaned)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		if len(meta.Folder) == 0 {
			return nil, vfs.ErrNotDir
		}
	}

	nextURL := graphBaseURL + childrenEndpoint(cleaned) + "?$select=name,size,lastModifiedDateTime,file,folder"
	result := make([]vfs.FileInfo, 0)
	for nextURL != "" {
		var response childrenResponse
		if err := f.getJSON(ctx, nextURL, &response); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		for _, entry := range response.Value {
			result = append(result, toInfo(entry))
		}
		nextURL = response.NextLink
	}
	return result, nil
}

func (f *FS) ReadDirPage(ctx context.Context, p, token string, limit int) (vfs.DirectoryPage, error) {
	cleaned := cloudutil.CleanPath(p)
	if cleaned != "" {
		meta, err := f.fetchItem(ctx, cleaned)
		if err != nil {
			return vfs.DirectoryPage{}, err
		}
		if len(meta.Folder) == 0 {
			return vfs.DirectoryPage{}, vfs.ErrNotDir
		}
	}
	if limit <= 0 || limit > 999 {
		limit = 999
	}
	nextURL := token
	if nextURL == "" {
		nextURL = graphBaseURL + childrenEndpoint(cleaned) + "?$select=name,size,lastModifiedDateTime,file,folder&$top=" + strconv.Itoa(limit)
	}
	var response childrenResponse
	if err := f.getJSON(ctx, nextURL, &response); err != nil {
		return vfs.DirectoryPage{}, err
	}
	entries := make([]vfs.FileInfo, 0, len(response.Value))
	for _, entry := range response.Value {
		entries = append(entries, toInfo(entry))
	}
	return vfs.DirectoryPage{Entries: entries, NextToken: response.NextLink}, nil
}

func (f *FS) Exists(ctx context.Context, p string) bool {
	_, err := f.Stat(ctx, p)
	return err == nil
}

func (f *FS) Create(_ context.Context, _ string) (vfs.File, error) { return nil, vfs.ErrReadOnly }
func (f *FS) Mkdir(_ context.Context, _ string, _ fs.FileMode) error {
	return vfs.ErrReadOnly
}
func (f *FS) Remove(_ context.Context, _ string) error { return vfs.ErrReadOnly }
func (f *FS) Rename(_ context.Context, _, _ string) error {
	return vfs.ErrReadOnly
}
func (f *FS) Join(elem ...string) string        { return path.Join(elem...) }
func (f *FS) Split(p string) (string, string)   { return path.Split(p) }
func (f *FS) IsAbs(p string) bool               { return strings.HasPrefix(p, "/") }
func (f *FS) RealPath(_ string) (string, error) { return "", nil }

func (f *FS) fetchItem(ctx context.Context, cleaned string) (item, error) {
	endpoint := graphBaseURL + itemEndpoint(cleaned)
	query := "?$select=name,size,lastModifiedDateTime,file,folder"
	var response item
	if err := f.getJSON(ctx, endpoint+query, &response); err != nil {
		return item{}, err
	}
	return response, nil
}

func (f *FS) download(ctx context.Context, cleaned string) ([]byte, error) {
	request, err := f.newRequest(ctx, http.MethodGet, graphBaseURL+contentEndpoint(cleaned), nil)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	response, err := f.client.Do(request)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer response.Body.Close()

	if response.StatusCode == http.StatusNotFound {
		return nil, vfs.ErrNotFound
	}
	if response.StatusCode < http.StatusOK || response.StatusCode >= http.StatusBadRequest {
		body, _ := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(response.Body, 4*1024))
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("onedrive: download failed: HTTP %d: %s", response.StatusCode, strings.TrimSpace(string(body)))
	}
	return io.ReadAll(response.Body)
}

func (f *FS) getJSON(ctx context.Context, endpoint string, target any) error {
	request, err := f.newRequest(ctx, http.MethodGet, endpoint, nil)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	response, err := f.client.Do(request)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer response.Body.Close()

	switch response.StatusCode {
	case http.StatusOK:
	case http.StatusNotFound:
		return vfs.ErrNotFound
	default:
		body, _ := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(response.Body, 4*1024))
		return fmt.Errorf("onedrive: request failed: HTTP %d: %s", response.StatusCode, strings.TrimSpace(string(body)))
	}
	return json.NewDecoder(response.Body).Decode(target)
}

func (f *FS) newRequest(ctx context.Context, method string, endpoint string, body io.Reader) (*http.Request, error) {
	request, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, method, endpoint, body)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	token, err := f.tokenSource.AccessToken(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	request.Header.Set("Authorization", "Bearer "+token)
	return request, nil
}

func itemEndpoint(cleaned string) string {
	if cleaned == "" {
		return "/me/drive/root"
	}
	return "/me/drive/root:/" + escapePath(cleaned) + ":"
}

func childrenEndpoint(cleaned string) string {
	if cleaned == "" {
		return "/me/drive/root/children"
	}
	return itemEndpoint(cleaned) + "/children"
}

func contentEndpoint(cleaned string) string {
	return itemEndpoint(cleaned) + "/content"
}

func escapePath(cleaned string) string {
	parts := strings.Split(cleaned, "/")
	for index, part := range parts {
		parts[index] = url.PathEscape(part)
	}
	return strings.Join(parts, "/")
}

func toInfo(meta item) *cloudutil.Info {
	return &cloudutil.Info{
		NameValue:    meta.Name,
		SizeValue:    meta.Size,
		ModifiedTime: parseTime(meta.LastModifiedDateTime),
		Dir:          len(meta.Folder) > 0,
	}
}

func parseTime(value string) time.Time {
	if strings.TrimSpace(value) == "" {
		return time.Time{}
	}
	parsed, _ := time.Parse(time.RFC3339, value)
	return parsed
}
`````

## File: manager/vfs/osfs/hidden_windows.go
`````go
//go:build windows

package osfs

import (
	"strings"
	"syscall"
)

func isHiddenName(name string) bool {
	if strings.HasPrefix(name, ".") {
		return true
	}
	// Check Windows FILE_ATTRIBUTE_HIDDEN. This is a best-effort check
	// for the filename alone; the full attribute check happens in
	// internal/platform when browsing through RawService.
	ptr, err := syscall.UTF16PtrFromString(name)
	if err != nil {
		return false
	}
	attrs, err := syscall.GetFileAttributes(ptr)
	if err != nil {
		return false
	}
	return attrs&syscall.FILE_ATTRIBUTE_HIDDEN != 0
}
`````

`````go
// Package osfs adapts the real OS filesystem to the vfs.FileSystem interface.
package osfs

import (
	"context"
	"io/fs"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"runtime"
	"strings"

	"wails-app/vfs"
	vfsarchive "wails-app/vfs/archive"
)

// FS is a vfs.FileSystem backed by the real OS filesystem.
type FS struct{ root string }

// New creates an FS rooted at osRoot. Pass "/" to expose the whole machine.
func New(osRoot string) *FS {
	return &FS{root: filepath.Clean(osRoot)}
}

// abs translates a VFS path to an absolute OS path, preventing path traversal.
func (f *FS) abs(p string) string {
	clean := filepath.FromSlash(filepath.Clean("/" + p))
	if runtime.GOOS == "windows" && (f.root == filepath.Clean("/") || f.root == `\`) {
		trimmed := strings.TrimPrefix(filepath.ToSlash(clean), "/")
		if len(trimmed) >= 2 && isWindowsDriveSegment(trimmed) {
			drivePath := strings.ToUpper(trimmed[:1]) + ":"
			remainder := strings.TrimPrefix(trimmed[1:], "/")
			if remainder == "" {
				return filepath.Clean(drivePath + `/`)
			}
			return filepath.FromSlash(drivePath + `/` + remainder)
		}
	}
	return filepath.Join(f.root, clean)
}

func (f *FS) Open(_ context.Context, path string) (vfs.File, error) {
	fh, err := os.Open(f.abs(path))
	if err != nil {
		return nil, mapErr(err)
	}
	return &file{fh}, nil
}

func (f *FS) Stat(_ context.Context, path string) (vfs.FileInfo, error) {
	info, err := os.Lstat(f.abs(path))
	if err != nil {
		return nil, mapErr(err)
	}
	return &fileInfo{FileInfo: info, vfsPath: filepath.ToSlash(path), osPath: f.abs(path)}, nil
}

func (f *FS) ReadDir(_ context.Context, path string) ([]vfs.FileInfo, error) {
	entries, err := os.ReadDir(f.abs(path))
	if err != nil {
		return nil, mapErr(err)
	}
	result := make([]vfs.FileInfo, 0, len(entries))
	for _, e := range entries {
		info, err := e.Info()
		if err != nil {
			continue
		}
		childVFS := filepath.ToSlash(filepath.Join(path, e.Name()))
		result = append(result, &fileInfo{
			FileInfo: info,
			vfsPath:  childVFS,
			osPath:   filepath.Join(f.abs(path), e.Name()),
		})
	}
	return result, nil
}

func (f *FS) Exists(_ context.Context, path string) bool {
	_, err := os.Lstat(f.abs(path))
	return err == nil
}

func (f *FS) Create(_ context.Context, path string) (vfs.File, error) {
	osPath := f.abs(path)
	if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(osPath), 0755); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	fh, err := os.Create(osPath)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return &file{fh}, nil
}

func (f *FS) Mkdir(_ context.Context, path string, perm fs.FileMode) error {
	return os.MkdirAll(f.abs(path), perm)
}

func (f *FS) Remove(_ context.Context, path string) error {
	return os.RemoveAll(f.abs(path))
}

func (f *FS) Rename(_ context.Context, old, new string) error {
	return os.Rename(f.abs(old), f.abs(new))
}

func (f *FS) Join(elem ...string) string { return filepath.ToSlash(filepath.Join(elem...)) }
func (f *FS) Split(p string) (string, string) {
	d, n := filepath.Split(p)
	return filepath.ToSlash(d), n
}
func (f *FS) IsAbs(p string) bool               { return filepath.IsAbs(p) }
func (f *FS) RealPath(p string) (string, error) { return f.abs(p), nil }

var _ vfs.FileSystem = (*FS)(nil)

// ── fileInfo ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

type fileInfo struct {
	os.FileInfo
	vfsPath string
	osPath  string
}

func (fi *fileInfo) Path() string         { return fi.vfsPath }
func (fi *fileInfo) RealPath() string     { return fi.osPath }
func (fi *fileInfo) Volume() vfs.Volume   { return nil }
func (fi *fileInfo) IsArchive() bool      { return !fi.IsDir() && isArchiveExt(fi.Name()) }
func (fi *fileInfo) IsHidden() bool       { return isHiddenName(fi.Name()) }
func (fi *fileInfo) IsSymlink() bool      { return fi.FileInfo.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 }
func (fi *fileInfo) IsNested() bool       { return false }
func (fi *fileInfo) MountChain() []string { return nil }

var _ vfs.FileInfo = (*fileInfo)(nil)

// ── file ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

type file struct{ *os.File }

func (f *file) Stat() (vfs.FileInfo, error) {
	info, err := f.File.Stat()
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return &fileInfo{FileInfo: info, osPath: f.File.Name(), vfsPath: filepath.ToSlash(f.File.Name())}, nil
}
func (f *file) Sync() error { return f.File.Sync() }

var _ vfs.File = (*file)(nil)

// ── helpers ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

func isArchiveExt(name string) bool {
	return vfsarchive.IsArchiveExt(name)
}

func mapErr(err error) error {
	if os.IsNotExist(err) {
		return vfs.ErrNotFound
	}
	if os.IsPermission(err) {
		return vfs.ErrReadOnly
	}
	return err
}

func isWindowsDriveSegment(path string) bool {
	if len(path) < 1 {
		return false
	}
	drive := path[0]
	return ((drive >= 'a' && drive <= 'z') || (drive >= 'A' && drive <= 'Z')) &&
		(len(path) == 1 || path[1] == '/')
}
`````

`````go
package registry

import (

type Metadata interface {
	RegistryKind() string
	RegistryValueType() string
	RegistryPreview() string
}

func ApplyFileInfoMetadata(file *contracts.FileInfo, entry vfs.FileInfo) {
	if file == nil {
		return
	}
	metadata, ok := entry.(Metadata)
	if !ok {
		return
	}
	file.RegistryKind = metadata.RegistryKind()
`````

`````go
//go:build windows

package registry

import (
	"context"
	"testing"

	"golang.org/x/sys/windows/registry"
)

func TestWriteRegistryValueReplacesType(t *testing.T) {
	const keyPath = `Software\ReassemblyTypedValueTest`
	const valueName = "Value"

	key, _, err := registry.CreateKey(
		registry.CURRENT_USER,
		keyPath,
		registry.ALL_ACCESS,
	)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	defer func() {
		key.Close()
		_ = registry.DeleteKey(registry.CURRENT_USER, keyPath)
	}()

	if err := key.SetStringValue(valueName, "42"); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}

	fs := &FS{}
	path := "HKEY_CURRENT_USER/Software/ReassemblyTypedValueTest/Value"
	if err := fs.WriteRegistryValue(
		context.Background(),
		path,
		"REG_DWORD",
		"42",
	); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}

	got, valueType, err := key.GetIntegerValue(valueName)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if valueType != registry.DWORD {
		t.Fatalf("type = %d, want REG_DWORD", valueType)
	}
	if got != 42 {
		t.Fatalf("value = %d, want 42", got)
	}
}

func TestWriteRegistryValueRollsBackOnFailedTypeReplacement(t *testing.T) {
	const keyPath = `Software\ReassemblyTypedValueRollbackTest`
	const valueName = "Value"

	key, _, err := registry.CreateKey(
		registry.CURRENT_USER,
		keyPath,
		registry.ALL_ACCESS,
	)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	defer func() {
		key.Close()
		_ = registry.DeleteKey(registry.CURRENT_USER, keyPath)
	}()

	if err := key.SetStringValue(valueName, "original"); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}

	fs := &FS{}
	path := "HKEY_CURRENT_USER/Software/ReassemblyTypedValueRollbackTest/Value"
	err = fs.WriteRegistryValue(
		context.Background(),
		path,
		"REG_DWORD",
		"not-a-number",
	)
	if err == nil {
		t.Fatal("expected type replacement to fail")
	}

	got, valueType, readErr := key.GetStringValue(valueName)
	if readErr != nil {
		t.Fatal(readErr)
	}
	if valueType != registry.SZ {
		t.Fatalf("type = %d, want REG_SZ after rollback", valueType)
	}
	if got != "original" {
		t.Fatalf("value = %q, want original after rollback", got)
	}
}
`````
