## File: manager/vfs/registry/registry.go
`````go
//go:build windows

// Package registry exposes the Windows Registry as a vfs.FileSystem.
//
// # Mapping
//
// The registry tree maps naturally onto the VFS directory model:
//
//	Registry concept          VFS concept
//	────────────────────────  ─────────────────────────────────────
//	Hive (HKLM, HKCU, …)     top-level directory
//	Key                       directory
//	Named value               file
//	Default value ("")        file named "(default)"
//
// ReadDir on a key returns both its subkeys (as dirs) and its values (as files)
// in a single listing, matching how a real file manager would show a key.
//
// # Value serialisation
//
// Values are serialised to UTF-8 text so they can be read through the File
// interface.  The format mirrors .reg file conventions:
//
//	REG_SZ / REG_EXPAND_SZ   the string, no decoration
//	REG_MULTI_SZ              one string per line
//	REG_DWORD / REG_QWORD     decimal (hex in parentheses): 4294967295 (0xFFFFFFFF)
//	REG_BINARY                upper-case hex pairs: DE AD BE EF …
//	REG_NONE / unknown        "(empty)" or hex dump
//
// # Write support
//
// Create/Mkdir/Remove/Rename delegate to the appropriate registry API calls.
// Most write operations require elevation; the OS returns access-denied
// naturally and the error is propagated as-is — no special handling needed.
//
// Rename supports sibling key and value renames while preserving value types.
//
// # Build constraints
//
// This file only compiles on Windows.  A companion registry_stub.go provides
// a no-op New() for other platforms so the rest of the codebase compiles
// everywhere without build tags at the call site.
package registry

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"encoding/binary"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"io/fs"
	"os"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
	"syscall"
	"time"
	"unsafe"

	"golang.org/x/sys/windows"
	"golang.org/x/sys/windows/registry"

	"wails-app/vfs"
)

// ── Hive table ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

type hiveEntry struct {
	name string
	key  registry.Key
}

var hives = []hiveEntry{
	{"HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE", registry.LOCAL_MACHINE},
	{"HKEY_CURRENT_USER", registry.CURRENT_USER},
	{"HKEY_CLASSES_ROOT", registry.CLASSES_ROOT},
	{"HKEY_USERS", registry.USERS},
	{"HKEY_CURRENT_CONFIG", registry.CURRENT_CONFIG},
	// Short aliases — resolved in openKey.
	{"HKLM", registry.LOCAL_MACHINE},
	{"HKCU", registry.CURRENT_USER},
	{"HKCR", registry.CLASSES_ROOT},
	{"HKU", registry.USERS},
	{"HKCC", registry.CURRENT_CONFIG},
}

var (
	advapi32          = windows.NewLazySystemDLL("advapi32.dll")
	regRenameKeyProc  = advapi32.NewProc("RegRenameKey")
	regSetValueExProc = advapi32.NewProc("RegSetValueExW")
)

// canonical returns the canonical long name for a hive abbreviation.
var canonical = map[string]string{
	"HKLM": "HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE",
	"HKCU": "HKEY_CURRENT_USER",
	"HKCR": "HKEY_CLASSES_ROOT",
	"HKU":  "HKEY_USERS",
	"HKCC": "HKEY_CURRENT_CONFIG",
}

// ── FS ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

// FS implements vfs.FileSystem over the Windows Registry.
type FS struct{}

// New returns an FS that exposes the Windows Registry.
// The returned error is always nil on Windows; the companion stub returns
// ErrNotSupported on other platforms.
func New() (*FS, error) {
	return &FS{}, nil
}

// ── path helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

// splitPath breaks a VFS path into (hiveName, subkeyPath, valueName).
//
// Rules:
//   - path ""  or "/"        → root listing (no hive)
//   - path "HKLM"            → hive root, no subkey, no value
//   - path "HKLM/SOFTWARE"   → hive=HKLM, subkey="SOFTWARE", no value
//
// Whether the last component is a subkey or a value name is determined by
// actually opening it at call time (Stat/Open), not here.
func splitPath(path string) (hive, subkey string) {
	path = strings.Trim(strings.ReplaceAll(path, "\\", "/"), "/")
	if path == "" {
		return "", ""
	}
	parts := strings.SplitN(path, "/", 2)
	hive = strings.ToUpper(parts[0])
	if c, ok := canonical[hive]; ok {
		hive = c
	}
	if len(parts) == 2 {
		subkey = parts[1]
	}
	return hive, subkey
}

// rootKey returns the registry.Key constant for the named hive.
func rootKey(hiveName string) (registry.Key, bool) {
	upper := strings.ToUpper(hiveName)
	if c, ok := canonical[upper]; ok {
		upper = c
	}
	for _, h := range hives {
		if h.name == upper {
			return h.key, true
		}
	}
	return 0, false
}

func isPermissionError(err error) bool {
	if err == nil {
		return false
	}
	if os.IsPermission(err) {
		return true
	}
	msg := strings.ToLower(err.Error())
	return strings.Contains(msg, "permission denied") ||
		strings.Contains(msg, "access is denied") ||
		strings.Contains(msg, "operation not permitted") ||
		strings.Contains(msg, "eacces") ||
		strings.Contains(msg, "eperm")
}

func mapLookupError(err error) error {
	if err == nil {
		return nil
	}
	if isPermissionError(err) {
		return fs.ErrPermission
	}
	return vfs.ErrNotFound
}

func mapAccessError(err error) error {
	if err == nil {
		return nil
	}
	if isPermissionError(err) {
		return fs.ErrPermission
	}
	return err
}

// openKey opens the registry key for path with the requested access mask.
// It returns the open key and the value name component (empty if path is a key).
// Caller must close the returned key when done (unless it is a hive root).
func openKey(path string, access uint32) (key registry.Key, valueName string, isHiveRoot bool, err error) {
	hiveName, subkey := splitPath(path)
	if hiveName == "" {
		return 0, "", false, vfs.ErrNotFound
	}

	root, ok := rootKey(hiveName)
	if !ok {
		return 0, "", false, vfs.ErrNotFound
	}

	if subkey == "" {
		// Path is the hive root itself — not a real openable key, but valid.
		return root, "", true, nil
	}

	// Try opening subkey directly first.
	k, err := registry.OpenKey(root, strings.ReplaceAll(subkey, "/", "\\"), access)
	if err == nil {
		return k, "", false, nil
	}
	if isPermissionError(err) {
		return 0, "", false, fs.ErrPermission
	}

	// If that failed, maybe the last component is a value name.
	idx := strings.LastIndex(subkey, "/")
	if idx < 0 {
		// e.g. "HKLM/SomeName" where SomeName is a value of the hive root.
		// Try treating the whole subkey as a value of the hive root.
		return root, subkey, true, nil
	}

	parentSubkey := subkey[:idx]
	valName := subkey[idx+1:]
	pk, err2 := registry.OpenKey(root, strings.ReplaceAll(parentSubkey, "/", "\\"), access)
	if err2 != nil {
		return 0, "", false, mapLookupError(err2)
	}
	return pk, valName, false, nil
}

func apiValueName(name string) string {
	if strings.EqualFold(strings.TrimSpace(name), "(default)") {
		return ""
	}
	return name
}

// ── FileSystem interface ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────

func (f *FS) Open(_ context.Context, path string) (vfs.File, error) {
	k, valName, isHiveRoot, err := openKey(path, registry.QUERY_VALUE)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if !isHiveRoot {
		defer k.Close()
	}

	if valName == "" {
		// Path points to a key, not a value — not a readable file.
		return nil, vfs.ErrNotFile
	}

	value, err := readRegistryValue(k, valName)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	info := &valueInfo{
		path:      path,
		name:      valName,
		size:      int64(len(value.data)),
		modTime:   time.Time{},
		valueType: value.valueType,
		preview:   value.preview,
	}
	return &regFile{reader: bytes.NewReader(value.data), info: info}, nil
}

func (f *FS) Stat(_ context.Context, path string) (vfs.FileInfo, error) {
	path = strings.Trim(strings.ReplaceAll(path, "\\", "/"), "/")

	// Root.
	if path == "" {
		return &keyInfo{path: "", name: "registry", isRoot: true}, nil
	}

	hiveName, subkey := splitPath(path)
	if hiveName == "" {
		return nil, vfs.ErrNotFound
	}

	// Hive root.
	if subkey == "" {
		root, ok := rootKey(hiveName)
		if !ok {
			return nil, vfs.ErrNotFound
		}
		_ = root
		return &keyInfo{path: path, name: hiveName}, nil
	}

	root, ok := rootKey(hiveName)
	if !ok {
		return nil, vfs.ErrNotFound
	}

	// Try as a key.
	k, err := registry.OpenKey(root, strings.ReplaceAll(subkey, "/", "\\"), registry.QUERY_VALUE)
	if err == nil {
		defer k.Close()
		return &keyInfo{path: path, name: lastName(path)}, nil
	}
	if isPermissionError(err) {
		return nil, fs.ErrPermission
	}

	// Try as a value.
	idx := strings.LastIndex(subkey, "/")
	var parentKey registry.Key
	var valName string
	if idx < 0 {
		parentKey = root
		valName = subkey
	} else {
		pk, err2 := registry.OpenKey(root, strings.ReplaceAll(subkey[:idx], "/", "\\"), registry.QUERY_VALUE)
		if err2 != nil {
			return nil, mapLookupError(err2)
		}
		defer pk.Close()
		parentKey = pk
		valName = subkey[idx+1:]
	}

	value, err := readRegistryValue(parentKey, valName)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, mapLookupError(err)
	}
	return &valueInfo{
		path:      path,
		name:      valName,
		size:      int64(len(value.data)),
		valueType: value.valueType,
		preview:   value.preview,
	}, nil
}

func (f *FS) ReadDir(_ context.Context, path string) ([]vfs.FileInfo, error) {
	path = strings.Trim(strings.ReplaceAll(path, "\\", "/"), "/")

	// Root — list hives.
	if path == "" {
		result := make([]vfs.FileInfo, 0, 5)
		seen := map[string]bool{}
		for _, h := range hives {
			if seen[h.name] || len(h.name) <= 4 { // skip short aliases
				continue
			}
			seen[h.name] = true
			result = append(result, &keyInfo{path: h.name, name: h.name})
		}
		return result, nil
	}

	hiveName, subkey := splitPath(path)
	root, ok := rootKey(hiveName)
	if !ok {
		return nil, vfs.ErrNotFound
	}

	var k registry.Key
	if subkey == "" {
		k = root
	} else {
		var err error
		k, err = registry.OpenKey(root, strings.ReplaceAll(subkey, "/", "\\"),
			registry.ENUMERATE_SUB_KEYS|registry.QUERY_VALUE)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, mapLookupError(err)
		}
		defer k.Close()
	}

	var result []vfs.FileInfo

	// Subkeys → directories.
	subkeyNames, err := k.ReadSubKeyNames(-1)
	if err == nil {
		for _, name := range subkeyNames {
			childPath := path + "/" + name
			result = append(result, &keyInfo{path: childPath, name: name})
		}
	} else if isPermissionError(err) {
		return nil, fs.ErrPermission
	}

	// Values → files.
	valueNames, err := k.ReadValueNames(-1)
	if err == nil {
		for _, name := range valueNames {
			displayName := name
			if name == "" {
				displayName = "(default)"
			}
			value, _ := readRegistryValue(k, name)
			childPath := path + "/" + displayName
			result = append(result, &valueInfo{
				path:      childPath,
				name:      displayName,
				size:      int64(len(value.data)),
				valueType: value.valueType,
				preview:   value.preview,
			})
		}
	} else if isPermissionError(err) {
		return nil, fs.ErrPermission
	}

	return result, nil
}

func (f *FS) Exists(ctx context.Context, path string) bool {
	info, err := f.Stat(ctx, path)
	return err == nil && info != nil
}

// ── Write operations ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

// Create creates a new REG_SZ value at path.  The caller writes the string
// value through the returned File; on Close the value is written.
func (f *FS) Create(_ context.Context, path string) (vfs.File, error) {
	k, valName, _, err := openKey(path, registry.SET_VALUE)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if valName == "" {
		k.Close()
		return nil, vfs.ErrNotFile
	}
	return &writeFile{key: k, valName: valName}, nil
}

// Mkdir creates a new registry key at path.
func (f *FS) Mkdir(_ context.Context, path string, _ fs.FileMode) error {
	hiveName, subkey := splitPath(path)
	root, ok := rootKey(hiveName)
	if !ok {
		return vfs.ErrNotFound
	}
	if subkey == "" {
		return vfs.ErrExists
	}
	k, _, err := registry.CreateKey(root, strings.ReplaceAll(subkey, "/", "\\"), registry.SET_VALUE)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("registry mkdir %q: %w", path, mapAccessError(err))
	}
	k.Close()
	return nil
}

// Remove deletes a registry key or value at path.
func (f *FS) Remove(_ context.Context, path string) error {
	hiveName, subkey := splitPath(path)
	root, ok := rootKey(hiveName)
	if !ok {
		return vfs.ErrNotFound
	}
	if subkey == "" {
		return fmt.Errorf("registry remove: cannot delete hive root")
	}

	registryPath := strings.ReplaceAll(subkey, "/", "\\")

	// Detect keys explicitly. DeleteKey only succeeds for empty keys, so a
	// Registry group with children must be removed recursively.
	if key, err := registry.OpenKey(root, registryPath, registry.READ); err == nil {
		key.Close()
		if err := deleteRegistryKeyTree(root, registryPath); err != nil {
			return fmt.Errorf("registry remove key %q: %w", path, err)
		}
		return nil
	} else if isPermissionError(err) {
		return fs.ErrPermission
	}

	// Otherwise treat the leaf as a Registry value.
	idx := strings.LastIndex(subkey, "/")
	var parentKey registry.Key
	var valName string
	if idx < 0 {
		parentKey = root
		valName = subkey
	} else {
		pk, err := registry.OpenKey(
			root,
			strings.ReplaceAll(subkey[:idx], "/", "\\"),
			registry.SET_VALUE,
		)
		if err != nil {
			return mapLookupError(err)
		}
		defer pk.Close()
		parentKey = pk
		valName = subkey[idx+1:]
	}

	if err := parentKey.DeleteValue(apiValueName(valName)); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf(
			"registry remove value %q: %w",
			valName,
			mapAccessError(err),
		)
	}
	return nil
}

func deleteRegistryKeyTree(root registry.Key, path string) error {
	key, err := registry.OpenKey(root, path, registry.READ)
	if err != nil {
		return mapLookupError(err)
	}

	children, err := key.ReadSubKeyNames(-1)
	key.Close()
	if err != nil {
		return mapAccessError(err)
	}

	for _, child := range children {
		childPath := path + "\\" + child
		if err := deleteRegistryKeyTree(root, childPath); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}

	if err := registry.DeleteKey(root, path); err != nil {
		return mapAccessError(err)
	}
	return nil
}

// Rename renames a registry key or value within its current parent.
func (f *FS) Rename(_ context.Context, oldPath, newPath string) error {
	oldHive, oldSubkey := splitPath(oldPath)
	newHive, newSubkey := splitPath(newPath)
	if oldHive == "" || newHive == "" {
		return vfs.ErrNotFound
	}
	if !strings.EqualFold(oldHive, newHive) {
		return fmt.Errorf("registry rename: source and destination hives differ")
	}
	if oldSubkey == "" || newSubkey == "" {
		return fmt.Errorf("registry rename: hive roots cannot be renamed")
	}

	oldParent, oldName := splitParentPath(oldSubkey)
	newParent, newName := splitParentPath(newSubkey)
	if !strings.EqualFold(oldParent, newParent) {
		return fmt.Errorf("registry rename: moving between parent keys is not supported")
	}
	if strings.TrimSpace(newName) == "" {
		return fmt.Errorf("registry rename: destination name is empty")
	}

	root, ok := rootKey(oldHive)
	if !ok {
		return vfs.ErrNotFound
	}

	if key, err := registry.OpenKey(root, strings.ReplaceAll(oldSubkey, "/", "\\"), registry.READ); err == nil {
		key.Close()
		return renameRegistryKey(root, oldParent, oldName, newName)
	} else if isPermissionError(err) {
		return fs.ErrPermission
	}

	return renameRegistryValue(root, oldParent, oldName, newName)
}

func splitParentPath(path string) (parent, name string) {
	path = strings.Trim(strings.ReplaceAll(path, "\\", "/"), "/")
	i := strings.LastIndex(path, "/")
	if i < 0 {
		return "", path
	}
	return path[:i], path[i+1:]
}

func renameRegistryKey(root registry.Key, parentPath, oldName, newName string) error {
	parent := root
	if parentPath != "" {
		k, err := registry.OpenKey(root, strings.ReplaceAll(parentPath, "/", "\\"), registry.ALL_ACCESS)
		if err != nil {
			return mapAccessError(err)
		}
		defer k.Close()
		parent = k
	}

	oldPtr, err := windows.UTF16PtrFromString(oldName)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	newPtr, err := windows.UTF16PtrFromString(newName)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	result, _, _ := regRenameKeyProc.Call(
		uintptr(parent),
		uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(oldPtr)),
		uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(newPtr)),
	)
	if result != 0 {
		return mapAccessError(syscall.Errno(result))
	}
	return nil
}

func renameRegistryValue(root registry.Key, parentPath, oldName, newName string) error {
	parent := root
	if parentPath != "" {
		k, err := registry.OpenKey(
			root,
			strings.ReplaceAll(parentPath, "/", "\\"),
			registry.QUERY_VALUE|registry.SET_VALUE,
		)
		if err != nil {
			return mapAccessError(err)
		}
		defer k.Close()
		parent = k
	}

	oldAPIName := apiValueName(oldName)
	newAPIName := apiValueName(newName)
	if _, _, err := parent.GetValue(newAPIName, nil); err == nil {
		return fs.ErrExist
	} else if !errors.Is(err, registry.ErrNotExist) && !errors.Is(err, registry.ErrShortBuffer) {
		return mapAccessError(err)
	}

	data, valueType, err := rawRegistryValue(parent, oldAPIName)
	if err != nil {
		return mapLookupError(err)
	}
	if err := setRawRegistryValue(parent, newAPIName, valueType, data); err != nil {
		return mapAccessError(err)
	}
	if err := parent.DeleteValue(oldAPIName); err != nil {
		_ = parent.DeleteValue(newAPIName)
		return mapAccessError(err)
	}
	return nil
}

func rawRegistryValue(k registry.Key, name string) ([]byte, uint32, error) {
	size, valueType, err := k.GetValue(name, nil)
	if err != nil && !errors.Is(err, registry.ErrShortBuffer) {
		return nil, valueType, err
	}
	if size == 0 {
		return nil, valueType, nil
	}
	buf := make([]byte, size)
	n, valueType, err := k.GetValue(name, buf)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, valueType, err
	}
	return buf[:n], valueType, nil
}

func setRawRegistryValue(k registry.Key, name string, valueType uint32, data []byte) error {
	namePtr, err := windows.UTF16PtrFromString(name)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	var dataPtr uintptr
	if len(data) > 0 {
		dataPtr = uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(&data[0]))
	}
	result, _, _ := regSetValueExProc.Call(
		uintptr(k),
		uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(namePtr)),
		0,
		uintptr(valueType),
		dataPtr,
		uintptr(len(data)),
	)
	if result != 0 {
		return syscall.Errno(result)
	}
	return nil
}

// ── Path helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

func (f *FS) Join(elem ...string) string        { return strings.Join(elem, "/") }
func (f *FS) IsAbs(path string) bool            { return false } // registry paths are always relative to root
func (f *FS) RealPath(_ string) (string, error) { return "", nil }

func (f *FS) Split(path string) (string, string) {
	i := strings.LastIndex(path, "/")
	if i < 0 {
		return "", path
	}
	return path[:i], path[i+1:]
}

// ── Value serialisation ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────

type registryValueData struct {
	data      []byte
	valueType string
	preview   string
}

// readRegistryValue reads a registry value and serialises it to UTF-8 bytes.
func readRegistryValue(k registry.Key, name string) (registryValueData, error) {
	name = apiValueName(name)
	// Try as string (REG_SZ, REG_EXPAND_SZ).
	if s, valueType, err := k.GetStringValue(name); err == nil {
		return registryValueData{
			data:      []byte(s),
			valueType: registryTypeName(valueType),
			preview:   previewRegistryValue(s),
		}, nil
	}

	// Try as integer (REG_DWORD, REG_QWORD). Preserve the Registry value's
	// declared capacity in the hexadecimal representation: DWORD is 32-bit and
	// QWORD is 64-bit, even when the numeric value itself has leading zeroes.
	if n, valueType, err := k.GetIntegerValue(name); err == nil {
		var serialized string
		switch valueType {
		case registry.DWORD, registry.DWORD_BIG_ENDIAN:
			serialized = fmt.Sprintf("%d (0x%08X)", uint32(n), uint32(n))
		case registry.QWORD:
			serialized = fmt.Sprintf("%d (0x%016X)", n, n)
		default:
			serialized = fmt.Sprintf("%d (0x%X)", n, n)
		}
		return registryValueData{
			data:      []byte(serialized),
			valueType: registryTypeName(valueType),
			preview:   serialized,
		}, nil
	}

	// Try as multi-string (REG_MULTI_SZ).
	if ss, valueType, err := k.GetStringsValue(name); err == nil {
		serialized := strings.Join(ss, "\n")
		return registryValueData{
			data:      []byte(serialized),
			valueType: registryTypeName(valueType),
			preview:   previewRegistryValue(serialized),
		}, nil
	}

	// Fall back to the raw Registry representation. This preserves REG_BINARY,
	// REG_NONE and less common value types instead of coercing them.
	b, valueType, err := rawRegistryValue(k, name)
	if err != nil {
		return registryValueData{}, fmt.Errorf("registry: read value %q: %w", name, err)
	}
	serialized := formatRegistryBytes(b)
	return registryValueData{
		data:      []byte(serialized),
		valueType: registryTypeName(valueType),
		preview:   previewRegistryValue(serialized),
	}, nil
}

func registryTypeName(valueType uint32) string {
	switch valueType {
	case registry.NONE:
		return "REG_NONE"
	case registry.SZ:
		return "REG_SZ"
	case registry.EXPAND_SZ:
		return "REG_EXPAND_SZ"
	case registry.BINARY:
		return "REG_BINARY"
	case registry.DWORD:
		return "REG_DWORD"
	case registry.DWORD_BIG_ENDIAN:
		return "REG_DWORD_BIG_ENDIAN"
	case registry.LINK:
		return "REG_LINK"
	case registry.MULTI_SZ:
		return "REG_MULTI_SZ"
	case registry.RESOURCE_LIST:
		return "REG_RESOURCE_LIST"
	case registry.FULL_RESOURCE_DESCRIPTOR:
		return "REG_FULL_RESOURCE_DESCRIPTOR"
	case registry.RESOURCE_REQUIREMENTS_LIST:
		return "REG_RESOURCE_REQUIREMENTS_LIST"
	case registry.QWORD:
		return "REG_QWORD"
	default:
		return fmt.Sprintf("REG_0x%X", valueType)
	}
}

func previewRegistryValue(value string) string {
	preview := strings.ReplaceAll(value, "\r\n", " | ")
	preview = strings.ReplaceAll(preview, "\n", " | ")
	preview = strings.ReplaceAll(preview, "\t", " ")
	preview = strings.TrimSpace(preview)
	if preview == "" {
		return "(empty)"
	}
	const limit = 120
	if len(preview) > limit {
		return preview[:limit-1] + "..."
	}
	return preview
}

func lastName(path string) string {
	i := strings.LastIndex(path, "/")
	if i < 0 {
		return path
	}
	return path[i+1:]
}

// ── keyInfo ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

type keyInfo struct {
	path   string
	name   string
	isRoot bool
}

func (k *keyInfo) Name() string       { return k.name }
func (k *keyInfo) Size() int64        { return 0 }
func (k *keyInfo) Mode() fs.FileMode  { return fs.ModeDir | 0555 }
func (k *keyInfo) ModTime() time.Time { return time.Time{} }
func (k *keyInfo) IsDir() bool        { return true }
func (k *keyInfo) Sys() any           { return nil }

func (k *keyInfo) Path() string         { return k.path }
func (k *keyInfo) RealPath() string     { return "" }
func (k *keyInfo) Volume() vfs.Volume   { return nil }
func (k *keyInfo) IsArchive() bool      { return false }
func (k *keyInfo) IsHidden() bool       { return false }
func (k *keyInfo) IsSymlink() bool      { return false }
func (k *keyInfo) IsNested() bool       { return false }
func (k *keyInfo) MountChain() []string { return nil }
func (k *keyInfo) RegistryKind() string { return "Key" }
func (k *keyInfo) RegistryValueType() string {
	return ""
}
func (k *keyInfo) RegistryPreview() string { return "" }

// ── valueInfo ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

type valueInfo struct {
	path      string
	name      string
	size      int64
	modTime   time.Time
	valueType string
	preview   string
}

func (v *valueInfo) Name() string       { return v.name }
func (v *valueInfo) Size() int64        { return v.size }
func (v *valueInfo) Mode() fs.FileMode  { return 0444 }
func (v *valueInfo) ModTime() time.Time { return v.modTime }
func (v *valueInfo) IsDir() bool        { return false }
func (v *valueInfo) Sys() any           { return nil }

func (v *valueInfo) Path() string         { return v.path }
func (v *valueInfo) RealPath() string     { return "" }
func (v *valueInfo) Volume() vfs.Volume   { return nil }
func (v *valueInfo) IsArchive() bool      { return false }
func (v *valueInfo) IsHidden() bool       { return false }
func (v *valueInfo) IsSymlink() bool      { return false }
func (v *valueInfo) IsNested() bool       { return false }
func (v *valueInfo) MountChain() []string { return nil }
func (v *valueInfo) RegistryKind() string { return "Value" }
func (v *valueInfo) RegistryValueType() string {
	return v.valueType
}
func (v *valueInfo) RegistryPreview() string { return v.preview }

// ── regFile (read) ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

type regFile struct {
	reader *bytes.Reader
	info   *valueInfo
}

func (f *regFile) Read(p []byte) (int, error)  { return f.reader.Read(p) }
func (f *regFile) Write(_ []byte) (int, error) { return 0, vfs.ErrReadOnly }
func (f *regFile) Seek(offset int64, whence int) (int64, error) {
	return f.reader.Seek(offset, whence)
}
func (f *regFile) Close() error                { return nil }
func (f *regFile) Stat() (vfs.FileInfo, error) { return f.info, nil }
func (f *regFile) Sync() error                 { return nil }

// ── writeFile (write) ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

// writeFile buffers a textual Registry representation. Existing values keep
// their Registry type; newly created values default to REG_SZ.
type writeFile struct {
	key     registry.Key
	valName string
	buf     bytes.Buffer
}

func (w *writeFile) Read(_ []byte) (int, error) { return 0, io.EOF }
func (w *writeFile) Seek(_ int64, _ int) (int64, error) {
	return 0, fmt.Errorf("registry write file: seek not supported")
}
func (w *writeFile) Write(p []byte) (int, error) { return w.buf.Write(p) }
func (w *writeFile) Sync() error                 { return nil }
func (w *writeFile) Stat() (vfs.FileInfo, error) {
	return &valueInfo{name: w.valName, size: int64(w.buf.Len())}, nil
}
func (w *writeFile) Close() error {
	defer w.key.Close()
	return writeRegistryTextValue(w.key, apiValueName(w.valName), w.buf.String())
}

func (f *FS) WriteRegistryValue(
	_ context.Context,
	path string,
	valueTypeName string,
	text string,
) error {
	k, valName, _, err := openKey(path, registry.QUERY_VALUE|registry.SET_VALUE)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer k.Close()
	if valName == "" {
		return vfs.ErrNotFile
	}

	name := apiValueName(valName)
	targetType, err := parseRegistryTypeName(valueTypeName)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}

	_, currentType, readErr := k.GetValue(name, nil)
	exists := readErr == nil || errors.Is(readErr, registry.ErrShortBuffer)
	if readErr != nil && !errors.Is(readErr, registry.ErrNotExist) && !errors.Is(readErr, registry.ErrShortBuffer) {
		return mapAccessError(readErr)
	}

	if exists && currentType == targetType {
		return writeRegistryValueAsType(k, name, targetType, text)
	}

	var originalData []byte
	var originalType uint32
	if exists {
		originalData, originalType, err = rawRegistryValue(k, name)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if err := k.DeleteValue(name); err != nil {
			return mapAccessError(err)
		}
	}

	if err := writeRegistryValueAsType(k, name, targetType, text); err != nil {
		if exists {
			if restoreErr := setRawRegistryValue(k, name, originalType, originalData); restoreErr != nil {
				return fmt.Errorf(
					"registry value replacement failed: %v; rollback failed: %w",
					err,
					restoreErr,
				)
			}
		}
		return err
	}
	return nil
}

func parseRegistryTypeName(name string) (uint32, error) {
	switch strings.ToUpper(strings.TrimSpace(name)) {
	case "REG_NONE":
		return registry.NONE, nil
	case "REG_SZ":
		return registry.SZ, nil
	case "REG_EXPAND_SZ":
		return registry.EXPAND_SZ, nil
	case "REG_BINARY":
		return registry.BINARY, nil
	case "REG_DWORD":
		return registry.DWORD, nil
	case "REG_DWORD_BIG_ENDIAN":
		return registry.DWORD_BIG_ENDIAN, nil
	case "REG_MULTI_SZ":
		return registry.MULTI_SZ, nil
	case "REG_QWORD":
		return registry.QWORD, nil
	default:
		return 0, fmt.Errorf("unsupported Registry value type %q", name)
	}
}

func writeRegistryValueAsType(
	k registry.Key,
	name string,
	valueType uint32,
	text string,
) error {
	switch valueType {
	case registry.SZ:
		return k.SetStringValue(name, text)
	case registry.EXPAND_SZ:
		return k.SetExpandStringValue(name, text)
	case registry.MULTI_SZ:
		normalized := strings.ReplaceAll(text, "\r\n", "\n")
		if normalized == "" {
			return k.SetStringsValue(name, []string{})
		}
		return k.SetStringsValue(name, strings.Split(normalized, "\n"))
	case registry.DWORD:
		value, err := parseRegistryInteger(text, 32)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		return k.SetDWordValue(name, uint32(value))
	case registry.DWORD_BIG_ENDIAN:
		value, err := parseRegistryInteger(text, 32)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		data := make([]byte, 4)
		binary.BigEndian.PutUint32(data, uint32(value))
		return setRawRegistryValue(k, name, valueType, data)
	case registry.QWORD:
		value, err := parseRegistryInteger(text, 64)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		return k.SetQWordValue(name, value)
	case registry.BINARY, registry.NONE:
		data, err := parseRegistryBytes(text)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		return setRawRegistryValue(k, name, valueType, data)
	default:
		return fmt.Errorf("unsupported Registry value type 0x%X", valueType)
	}
}

func writeRegistryTextValue(k registry.Key, name, text string) error {
	_, valueType, err := k.GetValue(name, nil)
	if errors.Is(err, registry.ErrNotExist) {
		return writeRegistryValueAsType(k, name, registry.SZ, text)
	}
	if err != nil && !errors.Is(err, registry.ErrShortBuffer) {
		return mapAccessError(err)
	}
	return writeRegistryValueAsType(k, name, valueType, text)
}

func parseRegistryInteger(text string, bits int) (uint64, error) {
	value := strings.TrimSpace(text)
	if i := strings.Index(value, "("); i >= 0 {
		value = strings.TrimSpace(value[:i])
	}
	if value == "" {
		return 0, fmt.Errorf("registry integer value is empty")
	}
	n, err := strconv.ParseUint(value, 0, bits)
	if err != nil {
		return 0, fmt.Errorf("invalid REG_DWORD/REG_QWORD value %q: %w", text, err)
	}
	return n, nil
}

func parseRegistryBytes(text string) ([]byte, error) {
	value := strings.TrimSpace(text)
	if value == "" || strings.EqualFold(value, "(empty)") {
		return nil, nil
	}
	fields := strings.Fields(strings.NewReplacer(",", " ", ";", " ").Replace(value))
	out := make([]byte, 0, len(fields))
	for _, field := range fields {
		field = strings.TrimPrefix(strings.TrimPrefix(field, "0x"), "0X")
		if len(field) == 0 || len(field) > 2 {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("invalid registry byte %q", field)
		}
		n, err := strconv.ParseUint(field, 16, 8)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("invalid registry byte %q: %w", field, err)
		}
		out = append(out, byte(n))
	}
	return out, nil
}

func formatRegistryBytes(data []byte) string {
	if len(data) == 0 {
		return "(empty)"
	}
	var sb strings.Builder
	for i, byt := range data {
		if i > 0 {
			sb.WriteByte(' ')
		}
		fmt.Fprintf(&sb, "%02X", byt)
	}
	return sb.String()
}

var _ vfs.FileSystem = (*FS)(nil)
`````

`````go
// Package s3 provides a read-only vfs.FileSystem backed by an S3-compatible
// object store such as AWS S3 or MinIO.
package s3

import (
	"context"
	"crypto/tls"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"io/fs"
	"net/http"
	"path"
	"strings"
	"time"

	"github.com/aws/aws-sdk-go-v2/aws"
	awsconfig "github.com/aws/aws-sdk-go-v2/config"
	"github.com/aws/aws-sdk-go-v2/credentials"
	s3sdk "github.com/aws/aws-sdk-go-v2/service/s3"
	"github.com/aws/smithy-go"

	"wails-app/vfs"
	vfsarchive "wails-app/vfs/archive"
)

const readChunkSize = 8 * 1024 * 1024

// Config holds S3-compatible connection parameters.
type Config struct {
	Region          string
	Bucket          string
	Prefix          string
	Endpoint        string
	AccessKeyID     string
	SecretAccessKey string
	SessionToken    string
	Anonymous       bool
	UsePathStyle    bool
	Insecure        bool
}

// FS implements vfs.FileSystem over one bucket and optional prefix.
type FS struct {
	client *s3sdk.Client
	bucket string
	prefix string
}

var _ vfs.FileSystem = (*FS)(nil)
var _ vfs.CapabilityFileSystem = (*FS)(nil)
var _ vfs.PagedFileSystem = (*FS)(nil)

func (f *FS) ProviderCapabilities() vfs.ProviderCapabilities {
	return vfs.ProviderCapabilities{Pagination: true, RandomAccess: true, TotalCount: false, ServerSort: false, ServerFilter: false, RangeRead: true, Watch: false, Rename: false, AtomicMove: false, Trash: false}
}

// New creates an S3-backed filesystem rooted at cfg.Bucket/cfg.Prefix.
func New(ctx context.Context, cfg Config) (*FS, error) {
	bucket := strings.TrimSpace(cfg.Bucket)
	if bucket == "" {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("s3: bucket is required")
	}

	region := strings.TrimSpace(cfg.Region)
	if region == "" {
		region = "us-east-1"
	}

	loadOptions := []func(*awsconfig.LoadOptions) error{
		awsconfig.WithRegion(region),
	}

	if cfg.Anonymous {
		loadOptions = append(loadOptions, awsconfig.WithCredentialsProvider(aws.AnonymousCredentials{}))
	} else if cfg.AccessKeyID != "" || cfg.SecretAccessKey != "" || cfg.SessionToken != "" {
		loadOptions = append(loadOptions,
			awsconfig.WithCredentialsProvider(credentials.NewStaticCredentialsProvider(
				cfg.AccessKeyID,
				cfg.SecretAccessKey,
				cfg.SessionToken,
			)),
		)
	}

	if endpoint := normalizeEndpoint(cfg.Endpoint, cfg.Insecure); endpoint != "" {
		loadOptions = append(loadOptions, awsconfig.WithBaseEndpoint(endpoint))
	}

	if cfg.Insecure {
		transport := http.DefaultTransport.(*http.Transport).Clone()
		transport.TLSClientConfig = &tls.Config{InsecureSkipVerify: true} //nolint:gosec
		loadOptions = append(loadOptions, awsconfig.WithHTTPClient(&http.Client{Transport: transport}))
	}

	awsCfg, err := awsconfig.LoadDefaultConfig(ctx, loadOptions...)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("s3: load config: %w", err)
	}
	if cfg.Anonymous {
		awsCfg.Credentials = aws.AnonymousCredentials{}
	}

	client := s3sdk.NewFromConfig(awsCfg, func(o *s3sdk.Options) {
		if cfg.Anonymous {
			o.Credentials = aws.AnonymousCredentials{}
		}
		o.UsePathStyle = cfg.UsePathStyle
	})

	if _, err := client.ListObjectsV2(ctx, &s3sdk.ListObjectsV2Input{
		Bucket:  aws.String(bucket),
		Prefix:  listProbePrefix(cleanPrefix(cfg.Prefix)),
		MaxKeys: aws.Int32(1),
	}); err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("s3: head bucket %s: %w", bucket, mapErr(err))
	}

	return &FS{
		client: client,
		bucket: bucket,
		prefix: cleanPrefix(cfg.Prefix),
	}, nil
}

func listProbePrefix(prefix string) *string {
	if prefix == "" {
		return nil
	}
	return aws.String(prefix)
}

// Close releases idle HTTP connections held by the AWS client.
func (f *FS) Close() error {
	if transport, ok := f.client.Options().HTTPClient.(*http.Client); ok {
		if httpTransport, ok := transport.Transport.(*http.Transport); ok {
			httpTransport.CloseIdleConnections()
		}
	}
	return nil
}

func (f *FS) Open(ctx context.Context, p string) (vfs.File, error) {
	cleaned := cleanPath(p)
	if cleaned == "" {
		return nil, vfs.ErrNotFile
	}

	info, err := f.statObject(ctx, cleaned)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	return &readFile{
		ctx:    ctx,
		client: f.client,
		bucket: f.bucket,
		key:    f.objectKey(cleaned),
		size:   info.size,
		info:   info,
	}, nil
}

func (f *FS) Stat(ctx context.Context, p string) (vfs.FileInfo, error) {
	cleaned := cleanPath(p)
	if cleaned == "" {
		return &fileInfo{name: f.rootName(), isDir: true}, nil
	}

	if info, err := f.statObject(ctx, cleaned); err == nil {
		return info, nil
	} else if !errors.Is(err, vfs.ErrNotFound) {
		return nil, err
	}

	exists, err := f.directoryExists(ctx, cleaned)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if !exists {
		return nil, vfs.ErrNotFound
	}

	return &fileInfo{name: path.Base(cleaned), isDir: true}, nil
}

// ReadDir lists one pseudo-directory level using common prefixes and direct objects.
func (f *FS) ReadDir(ctx context.Context, p string) ([]vfs.FileInfo, error) {
	entries := make([]vfs.FileInfo, 0)
	token := ""
	for {
		page, err := f.ReadDirPage(ctx, p, token, 1000)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		entries = append(entries, page.Entries...)
		if page.NextToken == "" {
			return entries, nil
		}
		token = page.NextToken
	}
}

func (f *FS) ReadDirPage(ctx context.Context, p, token string, limit int) (vfs.DirectoryPage, error) {
	cleaned := cleanPath(p)
	if cleaned != "" {
		info, err := f.Stat(ctx, cleaned)
		if err != nil {
			return vfs.DirectoryPage{}, err
		}
		if !info.IsDir() {
			return vfs.DirectoryPage{}, vfs.ErrNotDir
		}
	}
	if limit <= 0 || limit > 1000 {
		limit = 1000
	}
	prefix := f.directoryKey(cleaned)
	input := &s3sdk.ListObjectsV2Input{Bucket: aws.String(f.bucket), Delimiter: aws.String("/"), MaxKeys: aws.Int32(int32(limit))}
	if prefix != "" {
		input.Prefix = aws.String(prefix)
	}
	if token != "" {
		input.ContinuationToken = aws.String(token)
	}
	out, err := f.client.ListObjectsV2(ctx, input)
	if err != nil {
		return vfs.DirectoryPage{}, mapErr(err)
	}
	entries := make([]vfs.FileInfo, 0, len(out.CommonPrefixes)+len(out.Contents))
	seen := map[string]struct{}{}
	for _, cp := range out.CommonPrefixes {
		name := childName(prefix, aws.ToString(cp.Prefix))
		if name == "" {
			continue
		}
		if _, ok := seen[name]; ok {
			continue
		}
		seen[name] = struct{}{}
		entries = append(entries, &fileInfo{name: name, isDir: true})
	}
	for _, obj := range out.Contents {
		key := aws.ToString(obj.Key)
		name := childName(prefix, key)
		if name == "" || strings.Contains(name, "/") {
			continue
		}
		if _, ok := seen[name]; ok {
			continue
		}
		seen[name] = struct{}{}
		entries = append(entries, &fileInfo{name: name, size: aws.ToInt64(obj.Size), modTime: timeValue(obj.LastModified), isDir: false})
	}
	return vfs.DirectoryPage{Entries: entries, NextToken: aws.ToString(out.NextContinuationToken)}, nil
}

func (f *FS) Exists(ctx context.Context, p string) bool {
	_, err := f.Stat(ctx, p)
	return err == nil
}

func (f *FS) Create(_ context.Context, _ string) (vfs.File, error) {
	return nil, vfs.ErrReadOnly
}

func (f *FS) Mkdir(_ context.Context, _ string, _ fs.FileMode) error {
	return vfs.ErrReadOnly
}

func (f *FS) Remove(_ context.Context, _ string) error {
	return vfs.ErrReadOnly
}

func (f *FS) Rename(_ context.Context, _, _ string) error {
	return vfs.ErrReadOnly
}

func (f *FS) Join(elem ...string) string      { return path.Join(elem...) }
func (f *FS) Split(p string) (string, string) { return path.Split(p) }
func (f *FS) IsAbs(p string) bool             { return strings.HasPrefix(p, "/") }
func (f *FS) RealPath(_ string) (string, error) {
	return "", nil
}

func (f *FS) statObject(ctx context.Context, p string) (*fileInfo, error) {
	output, err := f.client.HeadObject(ctx, &s3sdk.HeadObjectInput{
		Bucket: aws.String(f.bucket),
		Key:    aws.String(f.objectKey(p)),
	})
	if err != nil {
		return nil, mapErr(err)
	}

	return &fileInfo{
		name:    path.Base(p),
		size:    aws.ToInt64(output.ContentLength),
		modTime: timeValue(output.LastModified),
		isDir:   false,
	}, nil
}

func (f *FS) directoryExists(ctx context.Context, p string) (bool, error) {
	prefix := f.directoryKey(p)
	if prefix == "" {
		return true, nil
	}

	page, err := f.client.ListObjectsV2(ctx, &s3sdk.ListObjectsV2Input{
		Bucket:    aws.String(f.bucket),
		Prefix:    aws.String(prefix),
		Delimiter: aws.String("/"),
		MaxKeys:   aws.Int32(1),
	})
	if err != nil {
		return false, mapErr(err)
	}

	return len(page.CommonPrefixes) > 0 || len(page.Contents) > 0, nil
}

func (f *FS) rootName() string {
	if f.prefix != "" {
		return path.Base(f.prefix)
	}
	return f.bucket
}

func (f *FS) objectKey(p string) string {
	cleaned := cleanPath(p)
	if f.prefix == "" {
		return cleaned
	}
	if cleaned == "" {
		return f.prefix
	}
	return f.prefix + "/" + cleaned
}

func (f *FS) directoryKey(p string) string {
	combined := f.objectKey(p)
	if combined == "" {
		return ""
	}
	return strings.TrimSuffix(combined, "/") + "/"
}

type fileInfo struct {
	name    string
	size    int64
	modTime time.Time
	isDir   bool
}

func (fi *fileInfo) Name() string { return fi.name }
func (fi *fileInfo) Size() int64  { return fi.size }
func (fi *fileInfo) Mode() fs.FileMode {
	if fi.isDir {
		return fs.ModeDir | 0555
	}
	return 0444
}
func (fi *fileInfo) ModTime() time.Time   { return fi.modTime }
func (fi *fileInfo) IsDir() bool          { return fi.isDir }
func (fi *fileInfo) Sys() any             { return nil }
func (fi *fileInfo) Path() string         { return fi.name }
func (fi *fileInfo) RealPath() string     { return "" }
func (fi *fileInfo) Volume() vfs.Volume   { return nil }
func (fi *fileInfo) IsArchive() bool      { return !fi.isDir && isArchiveExt(fi.name) }
func (fi *fileInfo) IsHidden() bool       { return strings.HasPrefix(fi.name, ".") }
func (fi *fileInfo) IsSymlink() bool      { return false }
func (fi *fileInfo) IsNested() bool       { return false }
func (fi *fileInfo) MountChain() []string { return nil }

var _ vfs.FileInfo = (*fileInfo)(nil)

type readFile struct {
	ctx       context.Context
	client    *s3sdk.Client
	bucket    string
	key       string
	size      int64
	position  int64
	body      io.ReadCloser
	bodyStart int64
	bodyEnd   int64
	info      *fileInfo
}

func (f *readFile) Read(p []byte) (int, error) {
	if len(p) == 0 {
		return 0, nil
	}
	if f.position >= f.size {
		return 0, io.EOF
	}
	if err := f.ensureBody(); err != nil {
		return 0, err
	}

	n, err := f.body.Read(p)
	f.position += int64(n)
	if err == io.EOF {
		_ = f.closeBody()
		if f.position < f.size && n > 0 {
			return n, nil
		}
	}
	return n, err
}

func (f *readFile) Write(_ []byte) (int, error) {
	return 0, vfs.ErrReadOnly
}

func (f *readFile) Seek(offset int64, whence int) (int64, error) {
	var base int64
	switch whence {
	case io.SeekStart:
		base = 0
	case io.SeekCurrent:
		base = f.position
	case io.SeekEnd:
		base = f.size
	default:
		return 0, fmt.Errorf("s3: invalid seek whence %d", whence)
	}

	next := base + offset
	if next < 0 {
		return 0, fmt.Errorf("s3: negative seek position")
	}
	f.position = next
	_ = f.closeBody()
	return next, nil
}

func (f *readFile) Close() error {
	return f.closeBody()
}

func (f *readFile) Stat() (vfs.FileInfo, error) {
	return f.info, nil
}

func (f *readFile) Sync() error { return nil }

var _ vfs.File = (*readFile)(nil)

func (f *readFile) ensureBody() error {
	if f.body != nil && f.position >= f.bodyStart && f.position <= f.bodyEnd {
		return nil
	}
	_ = f.closeBody()

	end := minInt64(f.size-1, f.position+readChunkSize-1)
	output, err := f.client.GetObject(f.ctx, &s3sdk.GetObjectInput{
		Bucket: aws.String(f.bucket),
		Key:    aws.String(f.key),
		Range:  aws.String(fmt.Sprintf("bytes=%d-%d", f.position, end)),
	})
	if err != nil {
		return mapErr(err)
	}

	f.body = output.Body
	f.bodyStart = f.position
	f.bodyEnd = end
	return nil
}

func (f *readFile) closeBody() error {
	if f.body == nil {
		return nil
	}
	err := f.body.Close()
	f.body = nil
	return err
}

func cleanPrefix(prefix string) string {
	cleaned := cleanPath(prefix)
	if cleaned == "." {
		return ""
	}
	return cleaned
}

func cleanPath(p string) string {
	trimmed := strings.TrimSpace(strings.ReplaceAll(p, "\\", "/"))
	trimmed = strings.Trim(trimmed, "/")
	if trimmed == "" || trimmed == "." {
		return ""
	}
	cleaned := path.Clean(trimmed)
	if cleaned == "." {
		return ""
	}
	return strings.TrimPrefix(cleaned, "/")
}

func childName(basePrefix, key string) string {
	if key == "" {
		return ""
	}
	relative := strings.TrimPrefix(key, basePrefix)
	relative = strings.Trim(relative, "/")
	if relative == "" {
		return ""
	}
	parts := strings.Split(relative, "/")
	if len(parts) == 0 {
		return ""
	}
	return parts[0]
}

func normalizeEndpoint(endpoint string, insecure bool) string {
	trimmed := strings.TrimSpace(endpoint)
	if trimmed == "" {
		return ""
	}
	if strings.HasPrefix(trimmed, "http://") || strings.HasPrefix(trimmed, "https://") {
		return trimmed
	}
	if insecure {
		return "http://" + trimmed
	}
	return "https://" + trimmed
}

func timeValue(value *time.Time) time.Time {
	if value == nil {
		return time.Time{}
	}
	return *value
}

func minInt64(a, b int64) int64 {
	if a < b {
		return a
	}
	return b
}

func isArchiveExt(name string) bool {
	return vfsarchive.IsArchiveExt(name)
}

func mapErr(err error) error {
	if err == nil {
		return nil
	}

	var apiErr smithy.APIError
	if errors.As(err, &apiErr) {
		switch apiErr.ErrorCode() {
		case "NotFound", "NoSuchBucket", "NoSuchKey", "NoSuchUpload":
			return vfs.ErrNotFound
		}
	}

	lower := strings.ToLower(err.Error())
	if strings.Contains(lower, "not found") || strings.Contains(lower, "no such key") || strings.Contains(lower, "status code: 404") {
		return vfs.ErrNotFound
	}
	if strings.Contains(lower, "forbidden") || strings.Contains(lower, "access denied") {
		return vfs.ErrReadOnly
	}
	return err
}
`````

`````go
package smb

import "testing"

func TestCleanUsesShareRelativePaths(t *testing.T) {
	fs := &FS{}

	tests := []struct {
		name string
		in   string
		want string
	}{
		{name: "empty root", in: "", want: "."},
		{name: "dot root", in: ".", want: "."},
		{name: "slash root", in: "/", want: "."},
		{name: "nested path", in: "/oleks/Downloads/unlocker", want: "oleks/Downloads/unlocker"},
		{name: "backslashes", in: `\oleks\Downloads\unlocker`, want: "oleks/Downloads/unlocker"},
	}

	for _, tc := range tests {
		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			if got := fs.clean(tc.in); got != tc.want {
				t.Fatalf("clean(%q) = %q, want %q", tc.in, got, tc.want)
			}
		})
	}
}
`````

`````go
// Package smb provides a vfs.FileSystem backed by an SMB2/3 share connection.
package smb

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"io/fs"
	"net"
	"path"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
	"time"

	smb2 "github.com/hirochachacha/go-smb2"

	"wails-app/vfs"
	vfsarchive "wails-app/vfs/archive"
)

// Config holds SMB connection parameters.
type Config struct {
	Host     string
	Port     int    // default 445
	Domain   string // NTLM domain; may be empty
	Username string
	Password string
	Share    string // share name, e.g. "Documents"
}

// FS implements vfs.FileSystem backed by one SMB share.
type FS struct {
	conn  net.Conn
	sess  *smb2.Session
	share *smb2.Share
}

var _ vfs.FileSystem = (*FS)(nil)
var _ vfs.CapabilityFileSystem = (*FS)(nil)

func (f *FS) ProviderCapabilities() vfs.ProviderCapabilities {
	return vfs.ProviderCapabilities{Pagination: false, RandomAccess: true, TotalCount: true, ServerSort: false, ServerFilter: false, RangeRead: true, Watch: false, Rename: true, AtomicMove: true, Trash: false}
}

// New connects to the SMB server and mounts the named share.
func New(ctx context.Context, cfg Config) (*FS, error) {
	if cfg.Port == 0 {
		cfg.Port = 445
	}
	addr := net.JoinHostPort(cfg.Host, strconv.Itoa(cfg.Port))
	conn, err := net.DialTimeout("tcp", addr, 30*time.Second)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("smb: dial %s: %w", addr, err)
	}

	d := &smb2.Dialer{
		Initiator: &smb2.NTLMInitiator{
			User:     cfg.Username,
			Password: cfg.Password,
			Domain:   cfg.Domain,
		},
	}
	sess, err := d.DialContext(ctx, conn)
	if err != nil {
		_ = conn.Close()
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("smb: authenticate: %w", err)
	}

	shareName := `\\` + cfg.Host + `\` + strings.TrimLeft(cfg.Share, `\/`)
	share, err := sess.Mount(shareName)
	if err != nil {
		_ = sess.Logoff()
		_ = conn.Close()
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("smb: mount %s: %w", shareName, err)
	}
	return &FS{conn: conn, sess: sess, share: share}, nil
}

// Close unmounts the share, ends the session, and closes the TCP connection.
func (f *FS) Close() error {
	_ = f.share.Umount()
	_ = f.sess.Logoff()
	return f.conn.Close()
}

// clean converts a VFS-relative path to the share-relative format expected by
// go-smb2. Mounted SMB shares should see "." for the share root and must not
// receive a leading slash for nested paths.
func (f *FS) clean(p string) string {
	trimmed := strings.TrimLeft(strings.ReplaceAll(p, `\`, `/`), "/")
	if trimmed == "" || trimmed == "." {
		return "."
	}
	return path.Clean(trimmed)
}

// ── FileSystem implementation ────────────────────────────────────────────────

func (f *FS) Open(_ context.Context, p string) (vfs.File, error) {
	fh, err := f.share.Open(f.clean(p))
	if err != nil {
		return nil, mapErr(err)
	}
	return &file{File: fh}, nil
}

func (f *FS) Stat(_ context.Context, p string) (vfs.FileInfo, error) {
	si, err := f.share.Lstat(f.clean(p))
	if err != nil {
		return nil, mapErr(err)
	}
	return &fileInfo{FileInfo: si}, nil
}

// ReadDir lists a share directory. Each FileInfo.Path() is the entry name only.
func (f *FS) ReadDir(_ context.Context, p string) ([]vfs.FileInfo, error) {
	entries, err := f.share.ReadDir(f.clean(p))
	if err != nil {
		return nil, mapErr(err)
	}
	result := make([]vfs.FileInfo, 0, len(entries))
	for _, e := range entries {
		result = append(result, &fileInfo{FileInfo: e})
	}
	return result, nil
}

func (f *FS) Exists(ctx context.Context, p string) bool {
	_, err := f.Stat(ctx, p)
	return err == nil
}

func (f *FS) Create(_ context.Context, p string) (vfs.File, error) {
	fh, err := f.share.Create(f.clean(p))
	if err != nil {
		return nil, mapErr(err)
	}
	return &file{File: fh}, nil
}

func (f *FS) Mkdir(_ context.Context, p string, perm fs.FileMode) error {
	return mapErr(f.share.MkdirAll(f.clean(p), perm))
}

func (f *FS) Remove(_ context.Context, p string) error {
	return mapErr(f.share.RemoveAll(f.clean(p)))
}

func (f *FS) Rename(_ context.Context, old, nw string) error {
	return mapErr(f.share.Rename(f.clean(old), f.clean(nw)))
}

func (f *FS) Join(elem ...string) string        { return path.Join(elem...) }
func (f *FS) Split(p string) (string, string)   { return path.Split(p) }
func (f *FS) IsAbs(p string) bool               { return strings.HasPrefix(p, "/") }
func (f *FS) RealPath(_ string) (string, error) { return "", nil }

// ── fileInfo ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

type fileInfo struct {
	fs.FileInfo
}

func (fi *fileInfo) Path() string         { return fi.FileInfo.Name() }
func (fi *fileInfo) RealPath() string     { return "" }
func (fi *fileInfo) Volume() vfs.Volume   { return nil }
func (fi *fileInfo) IsArchive() bool      { return !fi.IsDir() && isArchiveExt(fi.Name()) }
func (fi *fileInfo) IsHidden() bool       { return strings.HasPrefix(fi.Name(), ".") }
func (fi *fileInfo) IsSymlink() bool      { return fi.Mode()&fs.ModeSymlink != 0 }
func (fi *fileInfo) IsNested() bool       { return false }
func (fi *fileInfo) MountChain() []string { return nil }

var _ vfs.FileInfo = (*fileInfo)(nil)

// ── file ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

type file struct {
	*smb2.File
}

func (f *file) Stat() (vfs.FileInfo, error) {
	si, err := f.File.Stat()
	if err != nil {
		return nil, mapErr(err)
	}
	return &fileInfo{FileInfo: si}, nil
}

func (f *file) Sync() error { return f.File.Sync() }

var _ vfs.File = (*file)(nil)

// ── helpers ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

func isArchiveExt(name string) bool {
	return vfsarchive.IsArchiveExt(name)
}

func mapErr(err error) error {
	if err == nil {
		return nil
	}
	s := strings.ToLower(err.Error())
	if strings.Contains(s, "object name not found") ||
		strings.Contains(s, "no such file") ||
		strings.Contains(s, "not found") {
		return vfs.ErrNotFound
	}
	if strings.Contains(s, "access is denied") || strings.Contains(s, "permission denied") {
		return vfs.ErrReadOnly
	}
	return err
}
`````

`````go
package vfs

import "testing"

func TestPublicAliasToVFSPreservesS3AliasPath(t *testing.T) {
	got, ok := publicAliasToVFS("s3://minio-dev/backups/2026", s3Scheme, s3VFSRoot)
	if !ok {
		t.Fatalf("publicAliasToVFS(s3) did not match")
	}

	want := "/remote/s3/minio-dev/backups/2026"
	if got != want {
		t.Fatalf("publicAliasToVFS(s3) mismatch\nwant: %q\n got: %q", want, got)
	}
}

func TestPublicAliasToVFSPreservesCloudProviderAliasPath(t *testing.T) {
	tests := []struct {
		name   string
		path   string
		scheme string
		root   string
		want   string
	}{
		{name: "onedrive", path: "onedrive://personal/docs", scheme: oneDriveScheme, root: oneDriveVFSRoot, want: "/remote/onedrive/personal/docs"},
		{name: "gdrive", path: "gdrive://team/designs", scheme: gDriveScheme, root: gDriveVFSRoot, want: "/remote/gdrive/team/designs"},
		{name: "dropbox", path: "dropbox://workspace/contracts", scheme: dropboxScheme, root: dropboxVFSRoot, want: "/remote/dropbox/workspace/contracts"},
	}

	for _, tt := range tests {
		t.Run(tt.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			got, ok := publicAliasToVFS(tt.path, tt.scheme, tt.root)
			if !ok {
				t.Fatalf("publicAliasToVFS(%s) did not match", tt.name)
			}
			if got != tt.want {
				t.Fatalf("publicAliasToVFS(%s) mismatch\nwant: %q\n got: %q", tt.name, tt.want, got)
			}
		})
	}
}
`````

`````go
package vfs

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"io/fs"
	vpath "path"
	"path/filepath"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
	"time"

	"wails-app/internal/pathref"
)

// Mounter is the interface Unified requires from a mount manager.
// mount.Manager satisfies this via the adapter in vfs/mount.
type Mounter interface {
	Mount(mountPoint string, fs FileSystem, readOnly bool, name string, vtype VolumeType) (Volume, error)
	Unmount(mountPoint string) error
	Resolve(path string) (FileSystem, string, Volume, error)
	ListMounts() []MountedEntry
}

// MountedEntry describes one active mount point.
type MountedEntry struct {
	MountPoint string
	FS         FileSystem
	Volume     Volume
	ReadOnly   bool
}

// Unified is the top-level VFS the application uses.
// Construct it with NewUnified, then call Open/Stat/ReadDir/etc. on it.
//
// To support archive formats, blank-import their packages in main.go:
//
//	import _ "wails-app/vfs/archive/zip"
//	import _ "wails-app/vfs/archive/tar"
type Unified struct {
	mounts Mounter
}

type RegistryValueWriter interface {
	WriteRegistryValue(ctx context.Context, path, valueType, data string) error
}

const (
	registryScheme = "registry://"
	httpScheme     = "http://"
	httpsScheme    = "https://"
	smbScheme      = "smb://"
	s3Scheme       = "s3://"
	oneDriveScheme = "onedrive://"
	gDriveScheme   = "gdrive://"
	dropboxScheme  = "dropbox://"

	registryVFSRoot = "/registry"
	smbVFSRoot      = "/remote/smb"
	s3VFSRoot       = "/remote/s3"
	oneDriveVFSRoot = "/remote/onedrive"
	gDriveVFSRoot   = "/remote/gdrive"
	dropboxVFSRoot  = "/remote/dropbox"
)

// NewUnified creates a Unified VFS backed by the given Mounter.
func NewUnified(mounts Mounter) *Unified {
	return &Unified{mounts: mounts}
}

func (u *Unified) Mount(mountPoint string, fs FileSystem, readOnly bool, name string, vtype VolumeType) (Volume, error) {
	return u.mounts.Mount(mountPoint, fs, readOnly, name, vtype)
}

func (u *Unified) Unmount(mountPoint string) error {
	return u.mounts.Unmount(mountPoint)
}

func (u *Unified) Open(ctx context.Context, path string) (File, error) {
	fsys, rel, _, err := u.mounts.Resolve(path)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return fsys.Open(ctx, rel)
}

func (u *Unified) Stat(ctx context.Context, path string) (FileInfo, error) {
	fsys, rel, _, err := u.mounts.Resolve(path)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return fsys.Stat(ctx, rel)
}

func (u *Unified) ProviderCapabilities(path string) (ProviderCapabilities, error) {
	fsys, _, _, err := u.mounts.Resolve(path)
	if err != nil {
		return ProviderCapabilities{}, err
	}
	if capable, ok := fsys.(CapabilityFileSystem); ok {
		return capable.ProviderCapabilities(), nil
	}
	return ProviderCapabilities{}, nil
}

func (u *Unified) ReadDirPage(ctx context.Context, path, token string, limit int) (DirectoryPage, error) {
	fsys, rel, _, err := u.mounts.Resolve(path)
	if err != nil {
		return DirectoryPage{}, err
	}
	if limit <= 0 {
		limit = 512
	}
	if paged, ok := fsys.(PagedFileSystem); ok {
		page, err := paged.ReadDirPage(ctx, rel, token, limit)
		if err != nil {
			return DirectoryPage{}, err
		}
		page.Entries = sanitizeDirectoryEntries(page.Entries)
		return page, nil
	}
	entries, err := u.ReadDir(ctx, path)
	if err != nil {
		return DirectoryPage{}, err
	}
	offset := 0
	if token != "" {
		offset, err = strconv.Atoi(token)
		if err != nil || offset < 0 {
			return DirectoryPage{}, fmt.Errorf("vfs: invalid directory page token")
		}
	}
	if offset > len(entries) {
		offset = len(entries)
	}
	end := offset + limit
	if end > len(entries) {
		end = len(entries)
	}
	next := ""
	if end < len(entries) {
		next = strconv.Itoa(end)
	}
	return DirectoryPage{Entries: entries[offset:end], NextToken: next, TotalCount: len(entries), HasTotal: true}, nil
}

func sanitizeDirectoryEntries(entries []FileInfo) []FileInfo {
	writeIdx := 0
	for _, entry := range entries {
		if entry == nil || entry.Name() == "." || entry.Name() == ".." {
			continue
		}
		entries[writeIdx] = entry
		writeIdx++
	}
	return entries[:writeIdx]
}

func (u *Unified) ReadDir(ctx context.Context, path string) ([]FileInfo, error) {
	fsys, rel, _, err := u.mounts.Resolve(path)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	entries, err := fsys.ReadDir(ctx, rel)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	entries = sanitizeDirectoryEntries(entries)

	// Inject synthetic directory entries for sub-mounts under path.
	cleanPath := cleanVFSPath(path)
	for _, m := range u.mounts.ListMounts() {
		if cleanVFSPath(vpath.Dir(m.MountPoint)) == cleanPath {
			name := vpath.Base(m.MountPoint)
			if name == "." || name == ".." {
				continue
			}
			entries = append(entries, &mountPointInfo{
				name: name,
				path: m.MountPoint,
				vol:  m.Volume,
			})
		}
	}
	return entries, nil
}

func (u *Unified) Exists(ctx context.Context, path string) bool {
	_, err := u.Stat(ctx, path)
	return err == nil
}

func (u *Unified) Create(ctx context.Context, path string) (File, error) {
	fsys, rel, _, err := u.mounts.Resolve(path)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return fsys.Create(ctx, rel)
}

func (u *Unified) Mkdir(ctx context.Context, path string, perm fs.FileMode) error {
	fsys, rel, _, err := u.mounts.Resolve(path)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return fsys.Mkdir(ctx, rel, perm)
}

func (u *Unified) Remove(ctx context.Context, path string) error {
	fsys, rel, _, err := u.mounts.Resolve(path)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return fsys.Remove(ctx, rel)
}

func (u *Unified) WriteRegistryValue(
	ctx context.Context,
	path string,
	valueType string,
	data string,
) error {
	fsys, rel, _, err := u.mounts.Resolve(path)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	writer, ok := fsys.(RegistryValueWriter)
	if !ok {
		return fmt.Errorf("vfs: registry value writes are not supported by this filesystem")
	}
	return writer.WriteRegistryValue(ctx, rel, valueType, data)
}

func (u *Unified) Rename(ctx context.Context, oldPath, newPath string) error {
	fsOld, relOld, volOld, err := u.mounts.Resolve(oldPath)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	_, relNew, volNew, err := u.mounts.Resolve(newPath)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if volOld != volNew {
		return fmt.Errorf("vfs: cannot rename across filesystems")
	}
	return fsOld.Rename(ctx, relOld, relNew)
}

// IsMounted reports whether path is currently served by a non-root (non-osfs)
// mount — i.e. the path resolves inside an archive or other special FS.
// Returns false for plain OS paths that resolve through the root osfs.
func (u *Unified) IsMounted(path string) bool {
	_, _, vol, err := u.mounts.Resolve(path)
	return err == nil && vol != nil
}

func (u *Unified) Join(elem ...string) string { return strings.Join(elem, "/") }
func (u *Unified) Split(path string) (string, string) {
	i := strings.LastIndex(path, "/")
	if i < 0 {
		return "", path
	}
	return path[:i], path[i+1:]
}
func (u *Unified) IsAbs(path string) bool { return strings.HasPrefix(path, "/") }

// ResolvePublicPath converts a public/scheme path (e.g., "filesystem://c/Users/...") to a real filesystem path.
// This handles the conversion from user-facing paths to actual filesystem paths.
func (u *Unified) ResolvePublicPath(path string) (string, error) {
	if path == "" {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("empty path")
	}

	trimmed := strings.TrimSpace(strings.ReplaceAll(path, "\\", "/"))

	if strings.HasPrefix(strings.ToLower(trimmed), httpScheme) || strings.HasPrefix(strings.ToLower(trimmed), httpsScheme) {
		return trimmed, nil
	}

	// Special handling for filesystem:// scheme paths
	if strings.HasPrefix(strings.ToLower(trimmed), "filesystem://") {
		rest := strings.TrimLeft(trimmed[len("filesystem://"):], "/")
		if len(rest) > 0 && isWindowsDriveLetter(rune(rest[0])) {
			// Convert filesystem://c/Users/... to C:\Users\...
			drive := strings.ToUpper(rest[:1])
			remainder := strings.TrimPrefix(rest[1:], "/")
			if remainder == "" {
				return drive + ":/", nil
			}
			return filepath.FromSlash(drive + ":/" + remainder), nil
		}
	}

	// For other paths, use normal VFS mount resolution
	vfsPath := u.pathrefToVFS(trimmed)
	if isVirtualAliasPath(trimmed) {
		_, _, vol, err := u.mounts.Resolve(vfsPath)
		if err != nil {
			return "", err
		}
		if vol == nil {
			return "", nil
		}
	}
	return u.RealPath(vfsPath)
}

func isVirtualAliasPath(path string) bool {
	trimmed := strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(strings.ReplaceAll(path, "\\", "/")))
	return strings.HasPrefix(trimmed, registryScheme) ||
		strings.HasPrefix(trimmed, httpScheme) ||
		strings.HasPrefix(trimmed, httpsScheme) ||
		strings.HasPrefix(trimmed, smbScheme) ||
		strings.HasPrefix(trimmed, s3Scheme) ||
		strings.HasPrefix(trimmed, oneDriveScheme) ||
		strings.HasPrefix(trimmed, gDriveScheme) ||
		strings.HasPrefix(trimmed, dropboxScheme)
}

// isWindowsDriveLetter checks if a rune is a valid Windows drive letter.
func isWindowsDriveLetter(r rune) bool {
	return (r >= 'a' && r <= 'z') || (r >= 'A' && r <= 'Z')
}

// pathrefToVFS converts a path using pathref semantics.
// We can't import pathref here due to circular deps, so we handle filesystem:// locally.
func (u *Unified) pathrefToVFS(path string) string {
	trimmed := strings.TrimSpace(strings.ReplaceAll(path, "\\", "/"))

	// Handle filesystem://c/ scheme paths
	if strings.HasPrefix(strings.ToLower(trimmed), "filesystem://") {
		rest := strings.TrimLeft(trimmed[len("filesystem://"):], "/")
		if len(rest) > 0 {
			// filesystem://c/Users/... -> /c/Users/...
			return "/" + rest
		}
	}

	if converted, ok := publicAliasToVFS(trimmed, registryScheme, registryVFSRoot); ok {
		return converted
	}
	if converted, ok := publicAliasToVFS(trimmed, smbScheme, smbVFSRoot); ok {
		return converted
	}
	if converted, ok := publicAliasToVFS(trimmed, s3Scheme, s3VFSRoot); ok {
		return converted
	}
	if converted, ok := publicAliasToVFS(trimmed, oneDriveScheme, oneDriveVFSRoot); ok {
		return converted
	}
	if converted, ok := publicAliasToVFS(trimmed, gDriveScheme, gDriveVFSRoot); ok {
		return converted
	}
	if converted, ok := publicAliasToVFS(trimmed, dropboxScheme, dropboxVFSRoot); ok {
		return converted
	}

	return trimmed
}

func publicAliasToVFS(path string, scheme string, vfsRoot string) (string, bool) {
	if !strings.HasPrefix(strings.ToLower(path), scheme) {
		return "", false
	}

	switch scheme {
	case smbScheme:
		if converted, ok := pathref.RemoteURLToVFS(path, scheme, vfsRoot); ok {
			return converted, true
		}
	}

	rest := strings.Trim(strings.TrimPrefix(path, scheme), "/")
	if rest == "" {
		return vfsRoot, true
	}
	return vfsRoot + "/" + rest, true
}

func (u *Unified) RealPath(path string) (string, error) {
	fsys, rel, _, err := u.mounts.Resolve(path)
	if err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	return fsys.RealPath(rel)
}

func cleanVFSPath(p string) string {
	if p == "" {
		return "/"
	}
	return vpath.Clean("/" + strings.TrimPrefix(p, "/"))
}

// mountPointInfo is a synthetic FileInfo injected for each active sub-mount.
type mountPointInfo struct {
	name string
	path string
	vol  Volume
}

func (m *mountPointInfo) Name() string         { return m.name }
func (m *mountPointInfo) Size() int64          { return 0 }
func (m *mountPointInfo) Mode() fs.FileMode    { return fs.ModeDir | 0555 }
func (m *mountPointInfo) ModTime() time.Time   { return time.Time{} }
func (m *mountPointInfo) IsDir() bool          { return true }
func (m *mountPointInfo) Sys() any             { return nil }
func (m *mountPointInfo) Path() string         { return m.path }
func (m *mountPointInfo) RealPath() string     { return "" }
func (m *mountPointInfo) Volume() Volume       { return m.vol }
func (m *mountPointInfo) IsArchive() bool      { return false }
func (m *mountPointInfo) IsHidden() bool       { return false }
func (m *mountPointInfo) IsSymlink() bool      { return false }
func (m *mountPointInfo) IsNested() bool       { return false }
func (m *mountPointInfo) MountChain() []string { return nil }

var _ FileInfo = (*mountPointInfo)(nil)
`````

`````go
package vfs

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"io"
	"io/fs"
)

// Sentinel errors
var (
	ErrReadOnly = errors.New("filesystem is read-only")
	ErrNotFound = errors.New("path not found")
	ErrNotDir   = errors.New("path is not a directory")
	ErrNotFile  = errors.New("path is not a file")
	ErrExists   = errors.New("path already exists")
)

// FileInfo extends fs.FileInfo with VFS-specific metadata.
type FileInfo interface {
	fs.FileInfo
	Path() string     // Full VFS path
	RealPath() string // Underlying real path (if applicable)
	Volume() Volume   // Source volume (nil for nested archive entries)
	IsArchive() bool  // True if the entry can be mounted as a sub-filesystem
	IsHidden() bool
	IsSymlink() bool
	IsNested() bool       // Lives inside an archive chain
	MountChain() []string // Archive chain leading here
}

// Volume represents a mounted filesystem.
type Volume interface {
	ID() string
	Name() string
	Type() VolumeType
	Root() string
	IsReadOnly() bool
	Unmount() error
}

type VolumeType string

const (
	VolumeLocal    VolumeType = "local"
	VolumeArchive  VolumeType = "archive"
	VolumeRemote   VolumeType = "remote"
	VolumeRegistry VolumeType = "registry"
)

// FileSystem is the core VFS interface every adapter must implement.
// Write operations return ErrReadOnly on read-only filesystems rather than panicking.
type FileSystem interface {
	// Read operations
	Open(ctx context.Context, path string) (File, error)
	Stat(ctx context.Context, path string) (FileInfo, error)
	ReadDir(ctx context.Context, path string) ([]FileInfo, error)
	Exists(ctx context.Context, path string) bool

	// Write operations — may return ErrReadOnly
	Create(ctx context.Context, path string) (File, error)
	Mkdir(ctx context.Context, path string, perm fs.FileMode) error
	Remove(ctx context.Context, path string) error
	Rename(ctx context.Context, oldPath, newPath string) error

	// Path helpers
	Join(elem ...string) string
	Split(path string) (dir, file string)
	IsAbs(path string) bool

	// RealPath translates a VFS path to the underlying OS path, if applicable.
	// Returns ("", nil) for purely virtual filesystems (in-memory archives, etc.).
	RealPath(vfsPath string) (string, error)
}

// ProviderCapabilities describes what a mounted adapter actually implements.
type ProviderCapabilities struct {
	Pagination   bool
	RandomAccess bool
	TotalCount   bool
	ServerSort   bool
	ServerFilter bool
	RangeRead    bool
	Watch        bool
	Rename       bool
	AtomicMove   bool
	Trash        bool
}

type CapabilityFileSystem interface {
	FileSystem
	ProviderCapabilities() ProviderCapabilities
}

type DirectoryPage struct {
	Entries    []FileInfo
	NextToken  string
	TotalCount int
	HasTotal   bool
}

type PagedFileSystem interface {
	FileSystem
	ReadDirPage(ctx context.Context, path, token string, limit int) (DirectoryPage, error)
}

// File represents an open file handle inside the VFS.
type File interface {
	io.Reader
	io.Writer
	io.Seeker
	io.Closer
	Stat() (FileInfo, error)
	Sync() error
}
`````

`````yaml
  timeout: 5m
  go: "1.24"
  build-tags:
    - windows
  skip-dirs:
    - third_party
    - tools

linters:
  enable:
    - errcheck
    - gosimple
    - govet
    - ineffassign
    - staticcheck
    - typecheck
    - unused
    - gofmt
    - misspell
    - gosec
    - bodyclose
    - noctx
    - prealloc
  disable:
    # Disabled because CGO/COM interop legitimately requires unsafe.Pointer patterns
    - gocritic

linters-settings:
  errcheck:
    check-type-assertions: true
    check-blank: true
  govet:
    enable-all: true
    disable:
      - shadow
  gosec:
    severity: medium
    confidence: medium
    excludes:
      # G103: Use of unsafe.Pointer — allowed for COM interop
      - G103
      # G107: Url provided to HTTP request as taint input — we control URLs
      - G107
      # G204: Subprocess launched with variable — we control command args
      - G204
      # G304: File path provided as taint input — file manager needs this
      - G304
      # G306: Poor file permissions used when writing to a new file
      - G306
  misspell:
    locale: US

issues:
  exclude-use-default: false
  max-issues-per-linter: 0
  max-same-issues: 0
  exclude-rules:
    # COM callback functions legitimately convert uintptr back to unsafe.Pointer
    - path: internal/browserpane/pane_windows.go
      linters:
        - govet
      text: "possible misuse of unsafe.Pointer"
    # Test files may have relaxed standards
    - path: _test\.go
      linters:
        - gosec
        - errcheck
`````

## File: manager/main.go
`````go
package main

import (
	"context"
	"embed"
	"os"

	internalapp "wails-app/internal/app"
)

//go:embed all:frontend/dist
var assets embed.FS

func main() {
	// Elevated service mode: helper process binds TCP, serves JWT-auth'd requests.
	if handled, err := internalapp.MaybeRunElevatedService(os.Args); handled {
		if err != nil {
			println("Elevated service error:", err.Error())
			os.Exit(1)
		}
		os.Exit(0)
	}

	// Legacy single-shot elevated helper (per-op UAC spawn).
	if handled, err := internalapp.MaybeRunElevatedHelper(os.Args); handled {
		if err != nil {
			println("Elevated helper error:", err.Error())
			os.Exit(1)
		}
		os.Exit(0)
	}

	// When the last restored workspace requires elevated access (for example a
	// registry:// pane on Windows), relaunch before opening the main window so
	// the first visible restore uses the correct address.
	if handled, err := internalapp.MaybeRelaunchElevatedForStartup(); handled {
		if err != nil {
			println("Startup elevation error:", err.Error())
			os.Exit(1)
		}
		os.Exit(0)
	}

	app := internalapp.BuildApp()

	err := internalapp.Run(
		assets,
		app,
		app.ArchCache(),
		app.Startup,
		app.BeforeClose,
		func(context.Context) { app.Shutdown() },
	)

	if err != nil {
		println("Error:", err.Error())
	}
}
`````

`````typescript
/**
 * Canonical file entry contract shared by Manager, plugins, pane contracts,
 * and panel sources.
 *
 * Keep this structurally aligned with the Wails FileInfo wire model. Provider-
 * specific metadata belongs in explicit optional fields or derived interfaces;
 * do not add a catch-all index signature because it makes the contract stricter
 * for ordinary FileInfo values.
 */
export declare enum FileType {
    FILE = "FILE",
    DIRECTORY = "DIRECTORY",
    ARCHIVE = "ARCHIVE",
    SYMLINK = "SYMLINK"
}
/** Backward-compatible name used by early core consumers. */
export type FileEntryType = FileType;
export interface FileInfo {
    name: string;
    path: string;
    type: FileType;
    mimeType?: string;
    size: number;
    created: number;
    modified: number;
    accessed: number;
    permissions: string;
    isHidden: boolean;
    isSymlink?: boolean;
    registryKind?: string;
    registryValueType?: string;
    registryPreview?: string;
    searchBasePath?: string;
    searchPattern?: string;
    searchParentPath?: string;
    isNested?: boolean;
    nestedChain?: string[];
}
export interface FileProbe {
    mimeType: string;
    encoding?: string;
    isText: boolean;
    isArchive: boolean;
}
`````

## File: packages/core/frontend/src/contracts/input/input-system.ts
`````typescript
export type InputContextKind = 'global' | 'pane' | 'dialog' | 'overlay' | 'widget';

export type InputSourceKind = 'default' | 'workspace' | 'user' | 'plugin';

export type InputDeviceKind = 'keyboard' | 'mouse';

export interface KeyStroke {
  key: string;
  modifiers?: Array<'ctrl' | 'shift' | 'alt' | 'meta'>;
}

export interface KeyChord {
  steps: KeyStroke[];
}

export interface MouseGesture {
  type:
    | 'click'
    | 'doubleClick'
    | 'mousedown'
    | 'mouseup'
    | 'drag'
    | 'wheel';
  button?: 'left' | 'middle' | 'right';
  modifiers?: Array<'ctrl' | 'shift' | 'alt' | 'meta'>;
  direction?: 'up' | 'down' | 'left' | 'right';
}

export type InputTrigger =
  | { device: 'keyboard'; chord: KeyChord }
  | { device: 'mouse'; gesture: MouseGesture };

export interface InputContextDefinition {
  id: string;
  kind: InputContextKind;
  priority: number;
  parentId?: string;
  description: string;

  /**
   * When active, bindings from lower non-global contexts are hidden.
   * Global bindings remain available for application-wide commands such as F1.
   */
  exclusive?: boolean;
}

export interface InputBindingDefinition {
  id: string;
  commandId: string;
  trigger: InputTrigger;
  contextId: string;
  source: InputSourceKind;
  priority?: number;
  when?: string;
  description: string;
  /** Display category used by the keybinding editor (e.g. 'Navigation', 'File Operations'). */
  category?: string;
  /** Runtime enable/disable state reflected in snapshots. */
  enabled?: boolean;
  preventDefault?: boolean;
  stopPropagation?: boolean;
}

export interface CommandDefinition {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  description?: string;
  category?: string;
  icon?: string;
  /** Canonical human-facing name used by interactive invocation surfaces. */
  name?: string;
  /** Additional human-facing names. Keep aliases globally unambiguous. */
  aliases?: string[];
  /** Only show in command palette when these contexts are active. Empty = always show. */
  contextIds?: string[];
}

export type CommandInvocationSource =
  | 'keyboard'
  | 'mouse'
  | 'palette'
  | 'toolbar'
  | 'context-menu'
  | 'console'
  | 'api'
  | 'programmatic';

export type CommandArguments = Readonly<Record<string, unknown>>;

/** Structured command invocation shared by every execution surface. */
export interface CommandInvocation {
  source: CommandInvocationSource;
  args?: CommandArguments;
  context?: Readonly<Record<string, unknown>>;
}

export type InputCommandHandler = (invocation?: CommandInvocation) => void | Promise<void>;

/**
 * Runtime command descriptor. Keeps discoverable command metadata and execution
 * together while allowing availability to stay context-driven.
 */
export interface CommandDescriptor extends CommandDefinition {
  execute: InputCommandHandler;
  isEnabled?: (invocation?: CommandInvocation) => boolean;
}

export interface CommandState extends CommandDefinition {
  enabled: boolean;
  registered: boolean;
}

/** Normalized command metadata for discovery UIs such as the palette or console. */
export interface CommandCatalogEntry extends CommandState {
  preferredBinding?: InputBindingDefinition;
}

/**
 * An owned plugin input bundle. Commands, contexts, and default bindings are
 * registered and removed together under pluginId.
 */
export interface PluginInputContribution {
  pluginId: string;
  commands: CommandDescriptor[];
  contexts?: InputContextDefinition[];
  bindings?: InputBindingDefinition[];
}


export interface DialogBindingCatalogEntry {
  context: InputContextDefinition;
  bindings: InputBindingDefinition[];
}

export interface BindingResolution {
  binding: InputBindingDefinition;
  score: {
    contextPriority: number;
    sourcePriority: number;
    bindingPriority: number;
  };
}

export interface InputBindingConflict {
  readonly bindingId: string;
  readonly conflictingBindingId: string;
  readonly contextId: string;
  readonly triggerLabel: string;
  readonly winnerBindingId: string;
  readonly loserBindingId: string;
  readonly reason:
    | 'same-context'
    | 'overlapping-context'
    | 'shadowed-by-source'
    | 'shadowed-by-priority';
}

export interface InputBindingCustomization {
  readonly id: string;
  readonly trigger?: InputTrigger;
  readonly enabled?: boolean;
}
`````

`````typescript
import type { FileInfo } from '../files/index.js';
import type { ProviderCapabilities } from './provider-capabilities.js';
import type { SourceCapabilities } from './source-capabilities.js';

export type BuiltinPanelSourceKind =
  | 'filesystem'
  | 'archive'
  | 'remote'
  | 'results'
  | 'virtual';

export type PanelSourceKind = BuiltinPanelSourceKind | (string & {});

export interface PanelSourceContext<TEntry extends FileInfo = FileInfo> {
  readonly path: string;
  readonly entries?: readonly TEntry[];
  readonly inArchive?: boolean;
  readonly archiveTopLevel?: boolean;
}

export interface PanelSourceLocation<TKind extends PanelSourceKind = PanelSourceKind> {
  readonly path: string;
  readonly sourceId: string;
  readonly sourceKind: TKind;
}

export interface PanelSourceListing<
  TEntry extends FileInfo = FileInfo,
  TKind extends PanelSourceKind = PanelSourceKind,
> {
  readonly location: PanelSourceLocation<TKind>;
  readonly entries: readonly TEntry[];
}

export interface PanelSource<
  TEntry extends FileInfo = FileInfo,
  TKind extends PanelSourceKind = PanelSourceKind,
> {
  readonly id: string;
  readonly kind: TKind;
  readonly title: string;

  canHandle(context: PanelSourceContext<TEntry>): boolean;
  capabilities(context: PanelSourceContext<TEntry>): SourceCapabilities;
  providerCapabilities?(context: PanelSourceContext<TEntry>): ProviderCapabilities | null;

  list(
    context: PanelSourceContext<TEntry>,
    showHidden: boolean,
  ): Promise<PanelSourceListing<TEntry, TKind>>;

  getRootPath(context: PanelSourceContext<TEntry>): string | null;
  getParentPath(context: PanelSourceContext<TEntry>): string;
  joinChildPath(context: PanelSourceContext<TEntry>, childName: string): string;
  supportsStreaming(context: PanelSourceContext<TEntry>): boolean;

  activateEntry?(
    context: PanelSourceContext<TEntry>,
    entry: TEntry,
  ): boolean | Promise<boolean>;

  canPreviewEntry?(context: PanelSourceContext<TEntry>, entry: TEntry): boolean;
}

export interface ResolvedPanelSource<
  TEntry extends FileInfo = FileInfo,
  TKind extends PanelSourceKind = PanelSourceKind,
> {
  readonly source: PanelSource<TEntry, TKind>;
  readonly location: PanelSourceLocation<TKind>;
  readonly capabilities: SourceCapabilities;
  readonly providerCapabilities: ProviderCapabilities | null;
}
`````

`````typescript
export interface ProviderCapabilities {
  readonly pagination: boolean;
  readonly randomAccess: boolean;
  readonly totalCount: boolean;
  readonly serverSort: boolean;
  readonly serverFilter: boolean;
  readonly rangeRead: boolean;
  readonly watch: boolean;
  readonly rename: boolean;
  readonly atomicMove: boolean;
  readonly trash: boolean;
}

export const UNKNOWN_PROVIDER_CAPABILITIES: ProviderCapabilities = Object.freeze({
  pagination: false,
  randomAccess: false,
  totalCount: false,
  serverSort: false,
  serverFilter: false,
  rangeRead: false,
  watch: false,
  rename: false,
  atomicMove: false,
  trash: false,
});

export function normalizeProviderCapabilities(
  value: Partial<ProviderCapabilities> | null | undefined,
): ProviderCapabilities {
  return {
    pagination: !!value?.pagination,
    randomAccess: !!value?.randomAccess,
    totalCount: !!value?.totalCount,
    serverSort: !!value?.serverSort,
    serverFilter: !!value?.serverFilter,
    rangeRead: !!value?.rangeRead,
    watch: !!value?.watch,
    rename: !!value?.rename,
    atomicMove: !!value?.atomicMove,
    trash: !!value?.trash,
  };
}
`````
