`````javascript
const READ_ONLY = Object.freeze({
    read: true, create: false, delete: false, rename: false, trash: false,
});
const MUTABLE = Object.freeze({
    read: true, create: true, delete: true, rename: true, trash: false,
});
const LOCAL = Object.freeze({ ...MUTABLE, trash: true });
export function getSourceCapabilities(location, options) {
    if (options?.inArchive)
        return MUTABLE;
    const value = (location ?? '').trim();
    const match = /^([a-z][a-z0-9+.-]*):\/\//i.exec(value);
    if (!match)
        return LOCAL;
    switch (match[1].toLowerCase()) {
        case 'filesystem':
            return LOCAL;
        case 'memory':
        case 'smb':
        case 'registry':
            return MUTABLE;
        case 'gdrive':
        case 'dropbox':
        case 'onedrive':
        case 's3':
        case 'search':
        case 'http':
        case 'https':
            return READ_ONLY;
        default:
            return READ_ONLY;
    }
}
`````

`````typescript
export interface SourceCapabilities {
  readonly read: boolean;
  readonly create: boolean;
  readonly delete: boolean;
  readonly rename: boolean;
  readonly trash: boolean;
}

const READ_ONLY: SourceCapabilities = Object.freeze({
  read: true, create: false, delete: false, rename: false, trash: false,
});

const MUTABLE: SourceCapabilities = Object.freeze({
  read: true, create: true, delete: true, rename: true, trash: false,
});

const LOCAL: SourceCapabilities = Object.freeze({ ...MUTABLE, trash: true });

export function getSourceCapabilities(
  location: string,
  options?: { inArchive?: boolean },
): SourceCapabilities {
  if (options?.inArchive) return MUTABLE;

  const value = (location ?? '').trim();
  const match = /^([a-z][a-z0-9+.-]*):\/\//i.exec(value);
  if (!match) return LOCAL;

  switch (match[1].toLowerCase()) {
    case 'filesystem':
      return LOCAL;
    case 'memory':
    case 'smb':
    case 'registry':
      return MUTABLE;
    case 'gdrive':
    case 'dropbox':
    case 'onedrive':
    case 's3':
    case 'search':
    case 'http':
    case 'https':
      return READ_ONLY;
    default:
      return READ_ONLY;
  }
}
`````

## File: packages/core/frontend/src/runtime/panes/pane-renderer-registry.ts
`````typescript
export interface PaneRendererMatch<TKind extends string = string> {
  readonly kind: TKind;
  readonly scheme: string;
}

export interface PaneRendererContribution<TKind extends string = string> {
  readonly id: string;
  readonly kind: TKind;
  score(scheme: string, path: string): number;
}

/** Framework-neutral renderer resolver. Angular/React/etc. adapters live outside core. */
export class PaneRendererRegistry<TKind extends string = string> {
  private readonly contributions = new Map<string, PaneRendererContribution<TKind>>();

  constructor(private readonly fallbackKind: TKind) {}

  register(contribution: PaneRendererContribution<TKind>): () => void {
    this.contributions.set(contribution.id, contribution);
    return () => this.contributions.delete(contribution.id);
  }

  resolve(path: string): PaneRendererMatch<TKind> {
    const scheme = schemeOf(path);
    let winner: PaneRendererContribution<TKind> | null = null;
    let score = 0;

    for (const candidate of this.contributions.values()) {
      const next = candidate.score(scheme, path);
      if (next > score) {
        score = next;
        winner = candidate;
      }
    }

    return { kind: winner?.kind ?? this.fallbackKind, scheme };
  }
}

export function schemeOf(path: string): string {
  return /^([a-z][a-z0-9+.-]*):/i
    .exec(String(path ?? '').trim())?.[1]?.toLowerCase() ?? '';
}
`````

`````typescript
import {
  Component,
  Directive,
  ViewEncapsulation,
} from '@angular/core';

/**
 * Shared pane collection chrome used by Directory, Registry and future
 * specialized sibling panes.
 *
 * These primitives intentionally own only visual/layout behavior. Selection,
 * navigation, virtualization and domain semantics remain in the consuming pane.
 */
@Component({
  selector: 'reassembly-pane-table',
  standalone: true,
  template: '<ng-content></ng-content>',
  encapsulation: ViewEncapsulation.None,
  styles: [`
    reassembly-pane-table {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      flex: 1 1 0%;
      min-width: 0;
      min-height: 0;
      overflow: hidden;
      background: var(--vsc-editor-background);
      color: var(--vsc-foreground);
    }

    .reassembly-pane-table-header {
      flex: 0 0 auto;
      background: var(--vsc-tabbar-background);
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--vsc-border);
      color: var(--vsc-foreground-dim);
      user-select: none;
    }

    .reassembly-pane-table-header-row {
      min-height: 28px;
      height: 28px;
      font-weight: 600;
    }

    .reassembly-pane-table-body {
      flex: 1 1 0%;
      min-width: 0;
      min-height: 0;
      overflow: auto;
      outline: none;
    }

    .reassembly-pane-table-row {
      box-sizing: border-box;
      position: relative;
      min-height: 24px;
      height: 24px;
      padding: 0 var(--vsc-padding-md);
      border-bottom: 1px solid transparent;
      cursor: default;
      user-select: none;
      color: var(--vsc-foreground);
    }

    .reassembly-pane-table-row:not(.reassembly-pane-table-header-row):hover {
      background: var(--vsc-list-hover-background);
    }

    .reassembly-pane-table-row.selected {
      background: var(--vsc-list-active-background);
      color: var(--vsc-foreground-bright, var(--vsc-list-active-foreground, var(--vsc-foreground)));
    }

    .reassembly-pane-table-row.cursor:not(.selected) {
      background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--vsc-list-active-background) 35%, transparent);
      box-shadow: inset 2px 0 0 0 var(--vsc-accent-blue);
    }

    .reassembly-pane-table-row.cursor.selected {
      outline: none;
    }

    /*
     * Pane ownership must be visible on the row itself, not only on the outer
     * pane border. The active pane is the transfer source; the inactive pane is
     * the destination. Keep inactive selections legible but deliberately quiet.
     */
    .pane:not(.active-pane) .reassembly-pane-table-row.selected {
      background: var(
        --vsc-list-inactive-selection,
        color-mix(in srgb, var(--vsc-list-active-background) 48%, transparent)
      );
      color: var(--vsc-foreground);
    }

    .pane:not(.active-pane) .reassembly-pane-table-row.cursor {
      box-shadow: inset 2px 0 0 color-mix(
        in srgb,
        var(--vsc-foreground-dim, var(--vsc-border-bright)) 58%,
        transparent
      );
    }

    .pane:not(.active-pane) .reassembly-pane-table-row.cursor:not(.selected) {
      background: color-mix(
        in srgb,
        var(--vsc-list-inactive-selection, var(--vsc-list-active-background)) 38%,
        transparent
      );
    }

    .pane.active-pane .reassembly-pane-table-row.cursor {
      box-shadow:
        inset 3px 0 0 var(--vsc-accent-blue, var(--vsc-focus-border)),
        inset 0 0 0 1px color-mix(
          in srgb,
          var(--vsc-accent-blue, var(--vsc-focus-border)) 42%,
          transparent
        );
    }

    .pane.active-pane .reassembly-pane-table-row.cursor.selected {
      background: color-mix(
        in srgb,
        var(--vsc-list-active-background) 82%,
        var(--vsc-accent-blue, var(--vsc-focus-border)) 18%
      );
    }

    .reassembly-pane-table-row.drop-target,
    .reassembly-pane-table-row.drag-over {
      outline: 1px dashed var(--vsc-focus-border);
      outline-offset: -1px;
      background: var(--vsc-list-hover-background);
    }

    .reassembly-pane-table-cell {
      max-width: 100%;
      box-sizing: border-box;
      position: relative;
      min-width: 0;
      padding: 0 var(--vsc-padding-sm);
      overflow: hidden;
      white-space: nowrap;
      text-overflow: ellipsis;
      font-size: var(--vsc-font-size);
    }

    .reassembly-pane-table-divider {
      position: absolute;
      top: 0;
      bottom: 0;
      right: -3px;
      width: 6px;
      cursor: col-resize;
      background: transparent;
      z-index: 3;
    }

    .reassembly-pane-table-divider::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      top: 2px;
      bottom: 2px;
      left: 50%;
      width: 1px;
      transform: translateX(-50%);
      background: var(--vsc-border);
    }

    .reassembly-pane-table-divider:hover::before {
      background: var(--vsc-focus-border);
    }

    .reassembly-pane-table-empty {
      min-height: 120px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 4px;
      color: var(--vsc-description-foreground, var(--vsc-foreground-dim));
      font-size: var(--vsc-font-size);
    }
  `],
})
`````

`````go
package contracts

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"testing"
)

func TestFileInfoWireShape(t *testing.T) {
	raw, err := json.Marshal(FileInfo{Name: "example.txt", Path: "C:/example.txt", Type: FileTypeFile, Size: 42})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	var got map[string]any
	if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &got); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if got["name"] != "example.txt" || got["type"] != string(FileTypeFile) {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected wire shape: %s", raw)
	}
}

func TestSystemSurfaceRecordKeepsOpenFields(t *testing.T) {
	record := SystemSurfaceRecord{ID: "process:42", Name: "demo", Fields: map[string]any{"pid": 42}}
	raw, err := json.Marshal(record)
	if err != nil || len(raw) == 0 {
		t.Fatalf("encode failed: %v", err)
	}
}
`````

`````go
package contracts

// OperationType categorizes long-running operations.
type OperationType string

const (
	OpCopy      OperationType = "COPY"
	OpMove      OperationType = "MOVE"
	OpDelete    OperationType = "DELETE"
	OpArchive   OperationType = "ARCHIVE"
	OpExtract   OperationType = "EXTRACT"
	OpSearch    OperationType = "SEARCH"
	OpCalculate OperationType = "CALCULATE"
)

// OperationStatus represents the current state.
type OperationStatus string

const (
	StatusPending   OperationStatus = "PENDING"
	StatusRunning   OperationStatus = "RUNNING"
	StatusPaused    OperationStatus = "PAUSED"
	StatusCompleted OperationStatus = "COMPLETED"
	StatusCancelled OperationStatus = "CANCELLED"
	StatusError     OperationStatus = "ERROR"
)

// OperationProgress holds all progress state for an operation.
type OperationProgress struct {
	ID              string          `json:"id"`
	Type            OperationType   `json:"type"`
	Status          OperationStatus `json:"status"`
	Title           string          `json:"title"`
	SourcePath      string          `json:"sourcePath"`
	DestinationPath string          `json:"destinationPath,omitempty"`

	TotalItems      int64  `json:"totalItems"`
	ProcessedItems  int64  `json:"processedItems"`
	TotalBytes      int64  `json:"totalBytes"`
	ProcessedBytes  int64  `json:"processedBytes"`
	CurrentFile     string `json:"currentFile"`
	CurrentFileSize int64  `json:"currentFileSize"`

	PercentComplete     float64 `json:"percentComplete"`
	SpeedBytesPerSec    float64 `json:"speedBytesPerSec"`
	AvgSpeedBytesPerSec float64 `json:"avgSpeedBytesPerSec"`
	ETASeconds          int64   `json:"etaSeconds"`

	StartTime      int64  `json:"startTime"`
	ElapsedSeconds int64  `json:"elapsedSeconds"`
	EndTime        *int64 `json:"endTime,omitempty"`

	Error *string `json:"error,omitempty"`
}
`````

## File: packages/core/README.md
`````markdown
# @reassembly/core

Cross-language contracts and framework-neutral runtime shared by Manager and plugins.

```text
packages/core/
  frontend/
    src/
      contracts/
        files/
        input/
        panes/
        sources/
      runtime/
        panes/
  go/
    contracts/
```

Frontend code is deliberately domain-oriented rather than a flat list.
The Go module owns stable wire contracts shared by Manager and future backend plugins.

Angular components, Wails bindings, workspace persistence, and concrete provider
implementations stay outside core.
`````

## File: plugins/registry/backend/inline_preview_test.go
`````go
package main

import "testing"

func TestInlinePreviewAlwaysShowsDataAndBoundsLargeValues(t *testing.T) {
	got := inlinePreview(regDWORD, []byte{1, 0, 0, 0})
	if got != "1" {
		t.Fatalf("DWORD preview = %q, want 1", got)
	}

	long := make([]byte, 600)
	for i := range long {
		long[i] = 'A'
	}
	got = inlinePreview(regBinary, long)
	if got == "" {
		t.Fatal("large Registry value preview must not be empty")
	}
	if len([]rune(got)) > 241 {
		t.Fatalf("preview too long: %d runes", len([]rune(got)))
	}
}
`````

`````go
	errorNoMoreItems = 259
	errorMoreData    = 234

	keyRead      = 0x20019
	keyWrite     = 0x20006
	keyAllAccess = 0xF003F

	regNone     = 0
	regSZ       = 1
	regExpandSZ = 2
	regBinary   = 3

var (
	advapi32         = syscall.NewLazyDLL("advapi32.dll")
	regOpenKeyExW    = advapi32.NewProc("RegOpenKeyExW")
	regCloseKey      = advapi32.NewProc("RegCloseKey")
	regEnumKeyExW    = advapi32.NewProc("RegEnumKeyExW")
	regEnumValueW    = advapi32.NewProc("RegEnumValueW")
	regQueryValueExW = advapi32.NewProc("RegQueryValueExW")
	regSetValueExW   = advapi32.NewProc("RegSetValueExW")
	regCreateKeyExW  = advapi32.NewProc("RegCreateKeyExW")
	regDeleteValueW  = advapi32.NewProc("RegDeleteValueW")
	regDeleteTreeW   = advapi32.NewProc("RegDeleteTreeW")
	regRenameKey     = advapi32.NewProc("RegRenameKey")
)

type request struct {
	ID     any             `json:"id,omitempty"`
	Method string          `json:"method"`
	Params json.RawMessage `json:"params,omitempty"`
}

type response struct {
	ID     any       `json:"id,omitempty"`
	Result any       `json:"result,omitempty"`
	Error  *rpcError `json:"error,omitempty"`
}

type rpcError struct {
	Code    string `json:"code"`
	Message string `json:"message"`
}

type entry struct {
	Name      string `json:"name"`
	Path      string `json:"path"`
	Kind      string `json:"kind"`
	ValueType string `json:"valueType,omitempty"`
	Preview   string `json:"preview,omitempty"`
}

type listing struct {
	Path    string  `json:"path"`
	Entries []entry `json:"entries"`
}

type hive struct {
	name   string
	handle syscall.Handle
}

var hives = []hive{
	{"HKEY_CLASSES_ROOT", syscall.Handle(0x80000000)},
	{"HKEY_CURRENT_USER", syscall.Handle(0x80000001)},
	{"HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE", syscall.Handle(0x80000002)},
	{"HKEY_USERS", syscall.Handle(0x80000003)},
	{"HKEY_CURRENT_CONFIG", syscall.Handle(0x80000005)},
}

var aliases = map[string]string{
	"HKCR": "HKEY_CLASSES_ROOT", "HKCU": "HKEY_CURRENT_USER", "HKLM": "HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE",
	"HKU": "HKEY_USERS", "HKCC": "HKEY_CURRENT_CONFIG",
}

func main() {
	scanner := bufio.NewScanner(os.Stdin)
	scanner.Buffer(make([]byte, 64*1024), 4*1024*1024)
	enc := json.NewEncoder(os.Stdout)
	for scanner.Scan() {
		var req request
		if err := json.Unmarshal(scanner.Bytes(), &req); err != nil {
			_ = enc.Encode(response{Error: &rpcError{Code: "invalid_request", Message: err.Error()}})
			continue
		}
		result, err := dispatch(req.Method, req.Params)
		if err != nil {
			_ = enc.Encode(response{ID: req.ID, Error: &rpcError{Code: "registry_error", Message: err.Error()}})
			continue
		}
		_ = enc.Encode(response{ID: req.ID, Result: result})
	}
}

func dispatch(method string, raw json.RawMessage) (any, error) {
	switch method {
	case "hello":
		return map[string]any{"protocol": 1, "plugin": "reassembly.registry", "target": "windows-x64"}, nil
	case "registry.list":
		var p struct {
			Path string `json:"path"`
		}
		if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &p); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		return list(p.Path)
	case "registry.read":
		var p struct {
			Path string `json:"path"`
		}
		if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &p); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		return readValue(p.Path)
	case "registry.write":
		var p struct{ Path, Type, Data string }
		if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &p); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		return okResult(writeValue(p.Path, p.Type, p.Data))
	case "registry.createKey":
		var p struct {
			Path string `json:"path"`
		}
		if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &p); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		return okResult(createKey(p.Path))
	case "registry.delete":
		var p struct {
			Path string `json:"path"`
		}
		if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &p); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		return okResult(deletePath(p.Path))
	case "registry.rename":
		var p struct{ Path, NewName string }
		if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &p); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		return okResult(renamePath(p.Path, p.NewName))
	default:
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("unknown method %q", method)
	}
}

func okResult(err error) (any, error) {
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return map[string]any{"ok": true}, nil
}

func normalize(path string) string {
	p := strings.TrimSpace(strings.ReplaceAll(path, "\\", "/"))
	if len(p) >= len("registry://") && strings.EqualFold(p[:len("registry://")], "registry://") {
		p = p[len("registry://"):]
	}
	p = strings.Trim(p, "/")
	return p
}

func split(path string) (syscall.Handle, string, error) {
	p := normalize(path)
	if p == "" {
		return 0, "", nil
	}
	parts := strings.SplitN(p, "/", 2)
	name := strings.ToUpper(parts[0])
	if c, ok := aliases[name]; ok {
		name = c
	}
	var root syscall.Handle
	found := false
	for _, h := range hives {
		if h.name == name {
			root = h.handle
			found = true
			break
		}
	}
	if !found {
		return 0, "", fmt.Errorf("unknown registry hive %q", parts[0])
	}
	sub := ""
	if len(parts) == 2 {
		sub = strings.ReplaceAll(parts[1], "/", "\\")
	}
	return root, sub, nil
}

func public(path string) string {
	p := normalize(path)
	if p == "" {
		return "registry://"
	}
	return "registry://" + strings.ReplaceAll(p, "\\", "/")
}
func join(base, name string) string {
	b := strings.TrimSuffix(public(base), "/")
	if b == "registry:" {
		b = "registry://"
	}
	if b == "registry://" {
		return b + name
	}
	return b + "/" + name
}

func utf16Ptr(s string) (*uint16, error) { return syscall.UTF16PtrFromString(s) }
func closeKey(h syscall.Handle) {
	if h != 0 {
		regCloseKey.Call(uintptr(h))
	}
}
func winerr(r uintptr) error {
	if r == errorSuccess {
		return nil
	}
	return syscall.Errno(r)
}

func open(root syscall.Handle, sub string, access uint32) (syscall.Handle, error) {
	if sub == "" {
		return root, nil
	}
	p, err := utf16Ptr(sub)
	if err != nil {
		return 0, err
	}
	var out syscall.Handle
	r, _, _ := regOpenKeyExW.Call(uintptr(root), uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(p)), 0, uintptr(access), uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(&out)))
	if r != 0 {
		return 0, winerr(r)
	}
	return out, nil
}

func list(path string) (listing, error) {
	root, sub, err := split(path)
	if err != nil {
		return listing{}, err
	}
	if root == 0 {
		out := listing{Path: "registry://", Entries: make([]entry, 0, len(hives))}
		for _, h := range hives {
			out.Entries = append(out.Entries, entry{Name: h.name, Path: "registry://" + h.name, Kind: "key"})
		}
		return out, nil
	}
	k, err := open(root, sub, keyRead)
	if err != nil {
		return listing{}, err
	}
	if sub != "" {
		defer closeKey(k)
	}
	out := listing{Path: public(path), Entries: []entry{}}
	for i := uint32(0); ; i++ {
		buf := make([]uint16, 16384)
		n := uint32(len(buf))
		r, _, _ := regEnumKeyExW.Call(uintptr(k), uintptr(i), uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(&buf[0])), uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(&n)), 0, 0, 0, 0)
		if r == errorNoMoreItems {
			break
		}
		if r != 0 {
			return listing{}, winerr(r)
		}
		name := syscall.UTF16ToString(buf[:n])
		out.Entries = append(out.Entries, entry{Name: name, Path: join(path, name), Kind: "key"})
	}
	for i := uint32(0); ; i++ {
		nameBuf := make([]uint16, 16384)
		nameLen := uint32(len(nameBuf))
		typ := uint32(0)
		dataLen := uint32(0)
		r, _, _ := regEnumValueW.Call(uintptr(k), uintptr(i), uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(&nameBuf[0])), uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(&nameLen)), 0, uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(&typ)), 0, uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(&dataLen)))
		if r == errorNoMoreItems {
			break
		}
		if r != 0 && r != errorMoreData {
			return listing{}, winerr(r)
		}
		name := syscall.UTF16ToString(nameBuf[:nameLen])
		display := name
		if display == "" {
			display = "(default)"
		}
		preview := ""
		if v, e := queryRaw(k, name); e == nil {
			preview = inlinePreview(v.typ, v.data)
		}
		out.Entries = append(out.Entries, entry{Name: display, Path: join(path, display), Kind: "value", ValueType: typeName(typ), Preview: preview})
	}
	return out, nil
}

type rawValue struct {
	typ  uint32
	data []byte
}

func queryRaw(k syscall.Handle, name string) (rawValue, error) {
	actual := name
	if strings.EqualFold(name, "(default)") {
		actual = ""
	}
	p, err := utf16Ptr(actual)
	if err != nil {
		return rawValue{}, err
	}
	typ := uint32(0)
	n := uint32(0)
	r, _, _ := regQueryValueExW.Call(uintptr(k), uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(p)), 0, uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(&typ)), 0, uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(&n)))
	if r != 0 && r != errorMoreData {
		return rawValue{}, winerr(r)
	}
	data := make([]byte, n)
	var ptr uintptr
	if n > 0 {
		ptr = uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(&data[0]))
	}
	r, _, _ = regQueryValueExW.Call(uintptr(k), uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(p)), 0, uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(&typ)), ptr, uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(&n)))
	if r != 0 {
		return rawValue{}, winerr(r)
	}
	return rawValue{typ: typ, data: data[:n]}, nil
}

func parentValue(path string) (syscall.Handle, string, string, error) {
	root, sub, err := split(path)
	if err != nil {
		return 0, "", "", err
	}
	if root == 0 || sub == "" {
		return 0, "", "", errors.New("path is not a registry value")
	}
	i := strings.LastIndex(sub, "\\")
	parent := ""
	name := sub
	if i >= 0 {
		parent = sub[:i]
		name = sub[i+1:]
	}
	if strings.EqualFold(name, "(default)") {
		name = ""
	}
	return root, parent, name, nil
}

func readValue(path string) (any, error) {
	root, parent, name, err := parentValue(path)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	k, err := open(root, parent, keyRead)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if parent != "" {
		defer closeKey(k)
	}
	v, err := queryRaw(k, name)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return map[string]any{"path": public(path), "type": typeName(v.typ), "data": formatValue(v.typ, v.data)}, nil
}

func typeName(t uint32) string {
	switch t {
	case regSZ:
		return "REG_SZ"
	case regExpandSZ:
		return "REG_EXPAND_SZ"
	case regBinary:
		return "REG_BINARY"
	case regDWORD:
		return "REG_DWORD"
	case regMultiSZ:
		return "REG_MULTI_SZ"
	case regQWORD:
		return "REG_QWORD"
	case regNone:
		return "REG_NONE"
	default:
		return fmt.Sprintf("REG_%d", t)
	}
}

func formatValue(t uint32, b []byte) string {
	switch t {
	case regSZ, regExpandSZ, regMultiSZ:
		if len(b)%2 != 0 {
			return string(b)
		}
		u := make([]uint16, len(b)/2)
		for i := range u {
			u[i] = binary.LittleEndian.Uint16(b[i*2:])
		}
		s := string(utf16.Decode(u))
		s = strings.TrimRight(s, "\x00")
		if t == regMultiSZ {
			return strings.ReplaceAll(s, "\x00", "\n")
		}
		return s
	case regDWORD:
		if len(b) >= 4 {
			return strconv.FormatUint(uint64(binary.LittleEndian.Uint32(b)), 10)
		}
	case regQWORD:
		if len(b) >= 8 {
			return strconv.FormatUint(binary.LittleEndian.Uint64(b), 10)
		}
	case regBinary, regNone:
		return strings.ToUpper(hex.EncodeToString(b))
	}
	return strings.ToUpper(hex.EncodeToString(b))
}

func inlinePreview(t uint32, b []byte) string {
	// List rows should always contain useful data, but a single Registry value
	// must not make the directory listing enormous. The editor reads the full
	// value through registry.read when the leaf is activated.
	s := formatValue(t, b)
	s = strings.ReplaceAll(s, "\r\n", " | ")
	s = strings.ReplaceAll(s, "\n", " | ")
	s = strings.ReplaceAll(s, "\t", " ")
	s = strings.TrimSpace(s)
	if s == "" {
		return "(empty)"
	}
	const maxRunes = 240
	r := []rune(s)
	if len(r) > maxRunes {
		return string(r[:maxRunes]) + "…"
	}
	return s
}

func parseData(t string, s string) (uint32, []byte, error) {
	typ := strings.ToUpper(strings.TrimSpace(t))
	switch typ {
	case "REG_SZ", "REG_EXPAND_SZ", "REG_MULTI_SZ":
		rt := uint32(regSZ)
		if typ == "REG_EXPAND_SZ" {
			rt = regExpandSZ
		}
		if typ == "REG_MULTI_SZ" {
			rt = regMultiSZ
			s = strings.ReplaceAll(s, "\r\n", "\n")
			s = strings.ReplaceAll(s, "\n", "\x00")
		}
		u := utf16.Encode([]rune(s + "\x00"))
		if rt == regMultiSZ {
			u = append(u, 0)
		}
		b := make([]byte, len(u)*2)
		for i, v := range u {
			binary.LittleEndian.PutUint16(b[i*2:], v)
		}
		return rt, b, nil
	case "REG_DWORD":
		n, err := strconv.ParseUint(strings.TrimSpace(s), 0, 32)
		if err != nil {
			return 0, nil, err
		}
		b := make([]byte, 4)
		binary.LittleEndian.PutUint32(b, uint32(n))
		return regDWORD, b, nil
	case "REG_QWORD":
		n, err := strconv.ParseUint(strings.TrimSpace(s), 0, 64)
		if err != nil {
			return 0, nil, err
		}
		b := make([]byte, 8)
		binary.LittleEndian.PutUint64(b, n)
		return regQWORD, b, nil
	case "REG_BINARY", "REG_NONE":
		clean := strings.NewReplacer(" ", "", ":", "", "-", "").Replace(s)
		b, err := hex.DecodeString(clean)
		if err != nil {
			return 0, nil, err
		}
		if typ == "REG_NONE" {
			return regNone, b, nil
		}
		return regBinary, b, nil
	default:
		return 0, nil, fmt.Errorf("unsupported registry type %q", t)
	}
}

func writeValue(path, t, data string) error {
	root, parent, name, err := parentValue(path)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	k, err := open(root, parent, keyWrite)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if parent != "" {
		defer closeKey(k)
	}
	typ, b, err := parseData(t, data)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	p, _ := utf16Ptr(name)
	var ptr uintptr
	if len(b) > 0 {
		ptr = uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(&b[0]))
	}
	r, _, _ := regSetValueExW.Call(uintptr(k), uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(p)), 0, uintptr(typ), ptr, uintptr(len(b)))
	return winerr(r)
}

func createKey(path string) error {
	root, sub, err := split(path)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if root == 0 || sub == "" {
		return errors.New("cannot create registry root/hive")
	}
	p, _ := utf16Ptr(sub)
	var out syscall.Handle
	var disp uint32
	r, _, _ := regCreateKeyExW.Call(uintptr(root), uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(p)), 0, 0, 0, uintptr(keyAllAccess), 0, uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(&out)), uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(&disp)))
	if r == 0 {
		closeKey(out)
	}
	return winerr(r)
}

func deletePath(path string) error {
	root, sub, err := split(path)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if root == 0 || sub == "" {
		return errors.New("cannot delete registry root/hive")
	}
	if k, e := open(root, sub, keyRead); e == nil {
		closeKey(k)
		p, _ := utf16Ptr(sub)
		r, _, _ := regDeleteTreeW.Call(uintptr(root), uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(p)))
		return winerr(r)
	}
	root, parent, name, err := parentValue(path)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	k, err := open(root, parent, keyWrite)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if parent != "" {
		defer closeKey(k)
	}
	p, _ := utf16Ptr(name)
	r, _, _ := regDeleteValueW.Call(uintptr(k), uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(p)))
	return winerr(r)
}

func renamePath(path, newName string) error {
	newName = strings.TrimSpace(newName)
	if newName == "" || strings.ContainsAny(newName, "/\\") {
		return errors.New("newName must be one registry name")
	}
	root, sub, err := split(path)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if root == 0 || sub == "" {
		return errors.New("cannot rename registry root/hive")
	}
	if k, e := open(root, sub, keyRead); e == nil {
		closeKey(k)
		i := strings.LastIndex(sub, "\\")
		parent := ""
		old := sub
		if i >= 0 {
			parent = sub[:i]
			old = sub[i+1:]
		}
		pk, e := open(root, parent, keyAllAccess)
		if e != nil {
			return e
		}
		if parent != "" {
			defer closeKey(pk)
		}
		op, _ := utf16Ptr(old)
		np, _ := utf16Ptr(newName)
		r, _, _ := regRenameKey.Call(uintptr(pk), uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(op)), uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(np)))
		return winerr(r)
	}
	root, parent, name, err := parentValue(path)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	k, err := open(root, parent, keyAllAccess)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if parent != "" {
		defer closeKey(k)
	}
	v, err := queryRaw(k, name)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	np, _ := utf16Ptr(newName)
	var ptr uintptr
	if len(v.data) > 0 {
		ptr = uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(&v.data[0]))
	}
	r, _, _ := regSetValueExW.Call(uintptr(k), uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(np)), 0, uintptr(v.typ), ptr, uintptr(len(v.data)))
	if r != 0 {
		return winerr(r)
	}
	op, _ := utf16Ptr(name)
	r, _, _ = regDeleteValueW.Call(uintptr(k), uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(op)))
	return winerr(r)
}
`````

`````javascript
/**
 * Reassembly universal Registry frontend.
 *
 * Keep this entry intentionally simple while we rework pane architecture:
 * the plugin owns the `registry://` source and backend bridge, while Manager
 * continues to render the collection with its stable host-side pane pipeline.
 */

const ROOT = 'registry://';
const ROOT_HIVES = Object.freeze([
  'HKEY_CLASSES_ROOT',
  'HKEY_CURRENT_USER',
  'HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE',
  'HKEY_USERS',
  'HKEY_CURRENT_CONFIG',
]);

function normalizePath(path) {
  const raw = String(path || ROOT).trim().replace(/\\/g, '/');
  if (!/^registry:\/\//i.test(raw)) return raw;
  const body = raw.slice(raw.indexOf('://') + 3).replace(/^\/+/, '');
  return body ? `${ROOT}${body}` : ROOT;
}

function joinPath(base, child) {
  const b = normalizePath(base).replace(/\/+$/, '');
  const c = String(child ?? '').replace(/^\/+|\/+$/g, '');
  if (!c) return normalizePath(base);
  if (b === 'registry:' || b === 'registry://') return `${ROOT}${c}`;
  return `${b}/${c}`;
}

function parentPath(path) {
  const normalized = normalizePath(path).replace(/\/+$/, '');
  if (normalized === 'registry:' || normalized === 'registry://') return ROOT;
  const body = normalized.slice(ROOT.length);
  const slash = body.lastIndexOf('/');
  return slash < 0 ? ROOT : `${ROOT}${body.slice(0, slash)}`;
}

function toFileInfo(entry, basePath) {
  const kind = String(entry?.kind ?? '').toLowerCase();
  const preview = String(entry?.preview ?? '');
  const name = String(entry?.name ?? '');
  const path = name
    ? joinPath(basePath, name)
    : normalizePath(entry?.path ?? basePath ?? ROOT);

  return {
    name,
    path,
    type: kind === 'key' ? 'DIRECTORY' : 'FILE',
    size: kind === 'value' ? new TextEncoder().encode(preview).byteLength : 0,
    created: 0,
    modified: 0,
    accessed: 0,
    permissions: '',
    isHidden: false,
    registryKind: kind === 'key' ? 'Key' : 'Value',
    registryValueType: entry?.valueType,
    registryPreview: preview,
  };
}

function rootListing() {
  return {
    path: ROOT,
    entries: ROOT_HIVES.map(name => toFileInfo({
      name,
      path: `${ROOT}${name}`,
      kind: 'key',
    }, ROOT)),
  };
}

async function backendCall(ctx, method, params, timeoutMs = 4000) {
  return await Promise.race([
    ctx.backend.call(method, params),
    new Promise((_, reject) => {
      const timeout = setTimeout(() => {
        clearTimeout(timeout);
        reject(new Error(`Registry backend ${method} timed out after ${timeoutMs} ms.`));
      }, timeoutMs);
    }),
  ]);
}

export async function activate(ctx) {
  if (!ctx?.api?.registerPanelSource) {
    throw new Error('Universal host does not expose the scoped plugin registry API.');
  }
  if (!ctx?.backend?.call) {
    throw new Error('Universal host does not expose backend.call().');
  }

  const source = {
    id: 'registry',
    kind: 'registry',
    title: 'Registry',

    canHandle(context) {
      return /^registry:\/\//i.test(String(context?.path ?? ''));
    },

    capabilities() {
      return {
        read: true,
        create: true,
        delete: true,
        rename: true,
        trash: false,
      };
    },

    async list(context) {
      const path = normalizePath(context?.path ?? ROOT);
      const result = path === ROOT
        ? rootListing()
        : await backendCall(ctx, 'registry.list', { path });
      const locationPath = normalizePath(result?.path ?? path);
      return {
        location: {
          path: locationPath,
          sourceId: 'registry',
          sourceKind: 'registry',
        },
        entries: Array.isArray(result?.entries)
          ? result.entries.map(entry => toFileInfo(entry, locationPath))
          : [],
      };
    },

    getRootPath() {
      return ROOT;
    },

    getParentPath(context) {
      return parentPath(context?.path ?? ROOT);
    },

    joinChildPath(context, childName) {
      return joinPath(context?.path ?? ROOT, childName);
    },

    supportsStreaming() {
      return false;
    },
  };

  ctx.api.registerPanelSource(source);

  return () => {
    // ScopedPluginRegistry owns cleanup and unregisters contributions.
  };
}
`````

`````javascript
import { spawnSync } from 'node:child_process';
import { resolve } from 'node:path';

const backend = resolve(import.meta.dirname, '..', 'backend');

const args = [
  'build',
  '-trimpath',
  '-ldflags=-s -w -H=windowsgui',
  '-o',
  'plugin.exe',
  '.',
];

const result = spawnSync('go', args, {
  cwd: backend,
  env: {
    ...process.env,
    GOOS: 'windows',
    GOARCH: 'amd64',
    CGO_ENABLED: '0',

    // Important: plugin backend is its own Go module.
    // Do not inherit the manager repository's go.work.
    GOWORK: 'off',
  },
  stdio: 'inherit',
  shell: false,
});

if (result.error) {
  if (result.error.code === 'ENOENT') {
    throw new Error(
      'Go was not found on PATH. Install Go or add go.exe to PATH before running npm run build:backend.',
    );
  }

  throw result.error;
}

if (result.status !== 0) {
  process.exit(result.status ?? 1);
}

console.log('Built backend/plugin.exe for windows-x64');
`````

`````typescript
import {
  RegistryFileType as FileType,
  type RegistryFileInfo,
  type RegistrySourceCapabilities,
} from '../registry-model';
import type { RegistryPanelSourceHost } from '../registry-panel-source';
import type { RegistryPluginOperations } from '../registry.plugin';

export interface RegistryBackendTransport {
  call<T = unknown>(method: string, params?: Readonly<Record<string, unknown>>): Promise<T>;
}

export interface RegistryDialogHost {
  prompt(request: {
    title: string;
    message: string;
    confirmText: string;
    defaultValue?: string;
    historyKey?: string;
  }): Promise<string | null>;
  confirm(request: {
    title: string;
    message: string;
    confirmText: string;
    danger?: boolean;
  }): Promise<boolean>;
}

interface RegistryWireEntry {
  name: string;
  path: string;
  kind: string;
  valueType?: string;
  preview?: string;
}

interface RegistryWireListing {
  path: string;
  entries: RegistryWireEntry[];
}

interface RegistryListingResult {
  path: string;
  entries: RegistryFileInfo[];
}

export interface RegistryBackendHello {
  protocol: number;
  plugin: string;
  target: string;
}

interface RegistryReadResult {
  content?: string;
  data?: string;
}

export class RegistryBackendError extends Error {
  constructor(message: string, readonly method?: string, readonly causeValue?: unknown) {
    super(message);
    this.name = 'RegistryBackendError';
  }
}

const ROOT = 'registry://';

export function normalizeRegistryPath(path: string): string {
  const raw = (path || ROOT).trim().replace(/\\/g, '/');
  if (!/^registry:\/\//i.test(raw)) return raw;
  return `registry://${raw.slice(raw.indexOf('://') + 3).replace(/^\/+/, '')}`;
}

export function joinRegistryPath(parts: readonly string[]): string {
  if (!parts.length) return ROOT;
  const [head, ...tail] = parts;
  let result = normalizeRegistryPath(head || ROOT);
  for (const part of tail) {
    const segment = String(part ?? '').replace(/^\/+|\/+$/g, '');
    if (!segment) continue;
    result = result === ROOT ? `${ROOT}${segment}` : `${result.replace(/\/+$/, '')}/${segment}`;
  }
  return normalizeRegistryPath(result);
}


function toRegistryFileInfo(entry: RegistryWireEntry): RegistryFileInfo {
  const kind = String(entry.kind ?? '').toLowerCase();
  return {
    name: entry.name,
    path: normalizeRegistryPath(entry.path),
    type: kind === 'key' ? FileType.DIRECTORY : FileType.FILE,
    size: kind === 'value' ? new TextEncoder().encode(entry.preview ?? '').byteLength : 0,
    created: 0,
    modified: 0,
    accessed: 0,
    permissions: '',
    isHidden: false,
    registryKind: kind === 'key' ? 'Key' : 'Value',
    registryValueType: entry.valueType,
    registryPreview: entry.preview,
  };
}

export class RegistryBackendClient {
  private helloResult?: RegistryBackendHello;

  constructor(private readonly transport: RegistryBackendTransport) {}

  async initialize(): Promise<RegistryBackendHello> {
    if (this.helloResult) return this.helloResult;
    const hello = await this.call<RegistryBackendHello>('hello');
    if (hello.protocol !== 1) {
      throw new RegistryBackendError(`Unsupported Registry backend protocol ${hello.protocol}.`, 'hello');
    }
    if (hello.plugin !== 'reassembly.registry') {
      throw new RegistryBackendError(`Unexpected Registry backend identity: ${hello.plugin}.`, 'hello');
    }
    this.helloResult = hello;
    return hello;
  }

  private async call<T>(method: string, params?: Readonly<Record<string, unknown>>): Promise<T> {
    try {
      return await this.transport.call<T>(method, params);
    } catch (error) {
      const message = error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error);
      throw new RegistryBackendError(`Registry backend ${method} failed: ${message}`, method, error);
    }
  }

  async list(path: string): Promise<RegistryListingResult> {
    const result = await this.call<RegistryWireListing>('registry.list', {
      path: normalizeRegistryPath(path),
    });
    return {
      path: normalizeRegistryPath(result.path),
      entries: (result.entries ?? []).map(toRegistryFileInfo),
    };
  }

  async read(path: string): Promise<RegistryReadResult> {
    const result = await this.call<RegistryReadResult>('registry.read', {
      path: normalizeRegistryPath(path),
    });
    return {
      ...result,
      content: result.content ?? result.data ?? '',
    };
  }

  async stat(path: string): Promise<RegistryFileInfo> {
    const normalized = normalizeRegistryPath(path).replace(/\/+$/, '');
    const body = normalized.slice(ROOT.length);
    const slash = body.lastIndexOf('/');
    const parent = slash < 0 ? ROOT : `${ROOT}${body.slice(0, slash)}`;
    const listing = await this.list(parent);
    const match = listing.entries.find(entry =>
      normalizeRegistryPath(entry.path).replace(/\/+$/, '').toLowerCase() === normalized.toLowerCase()
    );
    if (!match) throw new Error(`Registry entry not found: ${path}`);
    return match;
  }

  createKey(path: string): Promise<unknown> {
    return this.call('registry.createKey', { path: normalizeRegistryPath(path) });
  }

  write(path: string, type: string, data: string): Promise<unknown> {
    return this.call('registry.write', {
      path: normalizeRegistryPath(path),
      type,
      data,
    });
  }

  delete(path: string): Promise<unknown> {
    return this.call('registry.delete', { path: normalizeRegistryPath(path) });
  }

  rename(path: string, newName: string): Promise<unknown> {
    return this.call('registry.rename', {
      path: normalizeRegistryPath(path),
      newName,
    });
  }
}

export function createRegistryPanelSourceHost(
  backend: RegistryBackendClient,
): RegistryPanelSourceHost {
  return {
    getPathKind: path => /^registry:\/\//i.test(path) ? 'registry' : 'unknown',
    listDirectory: (path) => backend.list(path),
    getRootPath: path => /^registry:\/\//i.test(path) ? ROOT : null,
    getParentPath: path => {
      const normalized = normalizeRegistryPath(path).replace(/\/+$/, '');
      if (normalized === 'registry:' || normalized === ROOT.replace(/\/$/, '')) return ROOT;
      const body = normalized.slice(ROOT.length);
      const slash = body.lastIndexOf('/');
      return slash < 0 ? ROOT : `${ROOT}${body.slice(0, slash)}`;
    },
    joinChildPath: (path, childName) => joinRegistryPath([path, childName]),
    supportsStreaming: () => false,
    capabilities: (): RegistrySourceCapabilities => ({
      read: true,
      create: true,
      delete: true,
      rename: true,
      trash: false,
    }),
  };
}

export function createRegistryOperations(
  backend: RegistryBackendClient,
  dialogs: RegistryDialogHost,
): RegistryPluginOperations {
  return {
    joinPaths: async parts => joinRegistryPath(parts),
    createDirectory: path => backend.createKey(path),
    writeFile: (path, content) => backend.write(path, 'REG_SZ', content),
    getFileInfo: path => backend.stat(path),
    moveFile: (source, destination) => {
      const name = destination.replace(/\/+$/, '').split('/').pop() ?? '';
      return backend.rename(source, name);
    },
    readFile: path => backend.read(path),
    writeRegistryValue: (path, type, data) => backend.write(path, type, data),
    deletePath: path => backend.delete(path),
    prompt: request => dialogs.prompt(request),
    confirm: request => dialogs.confirm(request),
  };
}

export const REGISTRY_HIVES = Object.freeze([
  'HKEY_CURRENT_USER',
  'HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE',
  'HKEY_CLASSES_ROOT',
  'HKEY_USERS',
  'HKEY_CURRENT_CONFIG',
] as const);

export type RegistryHive = typeof REGISTRY_HIVES[number];

export function registryHivePath(hive: RegistryHive): string {
  return `${ROOT}${hive}`;
}

export async function suggestRegistryChildren(
  backend: RegistryBackendClient,
  path: string,
  prefix = '',
): Promise<RegistryFileInfo[]> {
  const listing = await backend.list(path);
  const needle = prefix.trim().toLocaleLowerCase();
  return listing.entries
    .filter(entry => String(entry.registryKind ?? '').toLowerCase() === 'key')
    .filter(entry => !needle || entry.name.toLocaleLowerCase().startsWith(needle))
    .sort((a, b) => a.name.localeCompare(b.name));
}
`````

`````typescript
import { RegistryKeyEditorService } from '../registry-key-editor.service';
import { RegistryValueEditorService } from '../registry-value-editor.service';
import {
  createRegistryPlugin,
  type RegistryPluginApi,
  type RegistryPluginDefinition,
} from '../registry.plugin';
import {
  RegistryBackendClient,
  createRegistryOperations,
  createRegistryPanelSourceHost,
  type RegistryBackendTransport,
  type RegistryDialogHost,
} from './registry-backend';

/** Generic host contract. No Registry-specific filesystem service is exposed. */
export interface UniversalRegistryHost {
  readonly backend: RegistryBackendTransport;
  readonly dialogs: RegistryDialogHost;
  readonly api: RegistryPluginApi;
  readonly keyEditor: RegistryKeyEditorService;
  readonly valueEditor: RegistryValueEditorService;
}

export interface ActiveUniversalRegistryPlugin {
  readonly definition: RegistryPluginDefinition;
  dispose(): void;
}

export async function activateUniversalRegistryPlugin(
  host: UniversalRegistryHost,
): Promise<ActiveUniversalRegistryPlugin> {
  const backend = new RegistryBackendClient(host.backend);
  await backend.initialize();
  const definition = createRegistryPlugin({
    panelSource: createRegistryPanelSourceHost(backend),
    operations: createRegistryOperations(backend, host.dialogs),
    keyEditor: host.keyEditor,
    valueEditor: host.valueEditor,
  });

  definition.backend.onRegister(host.api);
  return {
    definition,
    dispose: () => definition.backend.onUnregister(host.api),
  };
}
`````

`````typescript
export class RegistryKeyEditorComponent implements OnInit, OnDestroy {
  @ViewChild('nameInput')
  private nameInput?: ElementRef<HTMLInputElement>;

  request: RegistryKeyEditRequest | null = null;
  name = '';

  private readonly destroy$ = createSubject<void>();

  constructor(
    private readonly editor: RegistryKeyEditorService,
    private readonly cdr: ChangeDetectorRef,
  ) {}

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.editor.active$
      .pipe(takeUntil(this.destroy$))
      .subscribe(active => {
        this.request = active?.request ?? null;
        this.name = active?.request.name ?? '';
        this.cdr.markForCheck();

        if (active) {
          requestAnimationFrame(() => {
            const input = this.nameInput?.nativeElement;
            if (!input) return;
            input.focus({ preventScroll: true });
            const end = input.value.length;
            input.setSelectionRange(end, end);
          });
        }
      });
  }

  ngOnDestroy(): void {
    this.destroy$.next();
    this.destroy$.complete();
  }

  save(): void {
    const name = this.name.trim();
    if (!name) return;
    this.editor.resolve(name);
  }

  cancel(): void {
    this.editor.resolve(null);
  }

  onDialogKeyDown(event: KeyboardEvent): void {
    event.stopPropagation();

    if (event.key === 'Escape') {
      event.preventDefault();
      this.cancel();
    }
  }
}
`````

`````typescript
import { Injectable } from '@angular/core';
import { createBehaviorSubject } from '@epikodelabs/streamix';

export interface RegistryKeyEditRequest {
  title: string;
  name: string;
  confirmText: string;
}

interface ActiveRegistryKeyEdit {
  request: RegistryKeyEditRequest;
  resolve: (result: string | null) => void;
}

@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })
export class RegistryKeyEditorService {
  readonly active$ = createBehaviorSubject<ActiveRegistryKeyEdit | null>(null);

  open(request: RegistryKeyEditRequest): Promise<string | null> {
    const active = this.active$.value;
    if (active) {
      active.resolve(null);
    }

    return new Promise(resolve => {
      this.active$.next({ request, resolve });
    });
  }

  resolve(result: string | null): void {
    const active = this.active$.value;
    if (!active) return;
    this.active$.next(null);
    active.resolve(result);
  }
}
`````

`````typescript
import type { PanelSource, PanelSourceContext, PanelSourceListing } from '@reassembly/core/contracts/sources';
import type {
  RegistryFileInfo,
  RegistrySourceCapabilities,
} from './registry-model';

export type RegistryPanelSourceContext = PanelSourceContext<RegistryFileInfo>;
export type RegistryPanelSourceListing = PanelSourceListing<RegistryFileInfo, 'registry'>;

export interface RegistryPanelSourceHost {
  getPathKind(path: string, entries: readonly RegistryFileInfo[]): string;
  listDirectory(path: string, showHidden: boolean): Promise<{
    path: string;
    entries: readonly RegistryFileInfo[];
  }>;
  getRootPath(path: string, entries: readonly RegistryFileInfo[]): string | null;
  getParentPath(path: string): string;
  joinChildPath(path: string, childName: string): string;
  supportsStreaming(path: string): boolean;
  capabilities(path: string): RegistrySourceCapabilities;
}

/**
 * Registry-owned PanelSource. Manager supplies only generic directory/VFS
 * capabilities through RegistryPanelSourceHost.
 */
export class RegistryPanelSource implements PanelSource<RegistryFileInfo, 'registry'> {
  readonly id = 'registry';
  readonly kind = 'registry' as const;
  readonly title = 'Registry';

  constructor(
    private readonly host: RegistryPanelSourceHost,
    private readonly activateValue?: (
      context: RegistryPanelSourceContext,
      entry: RegistryFileInfo,
    ) => boolean | Promise<boolean>,
  ) {}

  canHandle(context: RegistryPanelSourceContext): boolean {
    return this.host.getPathKind(
      context.path,
      context.entries ?? [],
    ) === 'registry';
  }

  capabilities(context: RegistryPanelSourceContext): RegistrySourceCapabilities {
    return this.host.capabilities(context.path);
  }

  async list(
    context: RegistryPanelSourceContext,
    showHidden: boolean,
  ): Promise<RegistryPanelSourceListing> {
    const listing = await this.host.listDirectory(context.path, showHidden);
    return {
      location: {
        path: listing.path || context.path,
        sourceId: this.id,
        sourceKind: this.kind,
      },
      entries: listing.entries,
    };
  }

  getRootPath(context: RegistryPanelSourceContext): string | null {
    return this.host.getRootPath(context.path, context.entries ?? []);
  }

  getParentPath(context: RegistryPanelSourceContext): string {
    return this.host.getParentPath(context.path);
  }

  joinChildPath(
    context: RegistryPanelSourceContext,
    childName: string,
  ): string {
    return this.host.joinChildPath(context.path, childName);
  }

  supportsStreaming(context: RegistryPanelSourceContext): boolean {
    return this.host.supportsStreaming(context.path);
  }

  activateEntry(
    context: RegistryPanelSourceContext,
    entry: RegistryFileInfo,
  ): boolean | Promise<boolean> {
    if (entry.path === '__parent__') return false;
    const kind = String(entry.registryKind ?? '').toLowerCase();
    if (kind !== 'value') return false;
    return this.activateValue?.(context, entry) ?? false;
  }

  canPreviewEntry(
    _context: RegistryPanelSourceContext,
    entry: RegistryFileInfo,
  ): boolean {
    const kind = String(entry.registryKind ?? '').toLowerCase();
    return kind !== 'key' && entry.path !== '__parent__';
  }
}
`````

`````typescript
import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';

const frontend = readFileSync(
  new URL('../frontend/index.js', import.meta.url),
  'utf8',
);

describe('Registry universal root fallback', () => {
  it('keeps the five Windows root hives in the source adapter', () => {
    for (const hive of [
      'HKEY_CLASSES_ROOT',
      'HKEY_CURRENT_USER',
      'HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE',
      'HKEY_USERS',
      'HKEY_CURRENT_CONFIG',
    ]) {
      expect(frontend).toContain(`'${hive}'`);
    }
  });

  it('keeps presentation out of the universal archive entry', () => {
    expect(frontend).toContain("id: 'registry'");
    expect(frontend).not.toContain('RegistryPaneComponent');
    expect(frontend).not.toContain('@angular/core');
  });
});
`````

`````typescript
export class RegistryValueEditorComponent implements OnInit, OnDestroy {
  @ViewChild('dataInput')
  private dataInput?: ElementRef<HTMLTextAreaElement>;

  readonly registryTypes = [
    'REG_SZ',
    'REG_EXPAND_SZ',
    'REG_BINARY',
    'REG_DWORD',
    'REG_DWORD_BIG_ENDIAN',
    'REG_MULTI_SZ',
    'REG_QWORD',
    'REG_NONE',
  ] as const;

  request: RegistryValueEditRequest | null = null;
  type = 'REG_SZ';
  data = '';

  private readonly destroy$ = createSubject<void>();

  constructor(
    private readonly editor: RegistryValueEditorService,
    private readonly cdr: ChangeDetectorRef,
  ) {}

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.editor.active$
      .pipe(takeUntil(this.destroy$))
      .subscribe(active => {
        this.request = active?.request ?? null;
        this.type = active?.request.type ?? 'REG_SZ';
        this.data = active?.request.data ?? '';
        this.cdr.markForCheck();

        if (active) {
          requestAnimationFrame(() => {
            const input = this.dataInput?.nativeElement;
            if (!input) return;
            input.focus({ preventScroll: true });
            const end = input.value.length;
            input.setSelectionRange(end, end);
          });
        }
      });
  }

  ngOnDestroy(): void {
    this.destroy$.next();
    this.destroy$.complete();
  }

  save(): void {
    if (!this.request) return;
    this.editor.resolve({
      type: this.type,
      data: this.data,
    });
  }

  cancel(): void {
    this.editor.resolve(null);
  }

  onKeyDown(event: KeyboardEvent): void {
    if (event.key !== 'Escape') return;
    event.preventDefault();
    event.stopPropagation();
    this.cancel();
  }
}
`````

## File: plugins/registry/src/registry-value-editor.service.ts
`````typescript
import { Injectable } from '@angular/core';
import { createBehaviorSubject } from '@epikodelabs/streamix';

export interface RegistryValueEditRequest {
  path: string;
  name: string;
  type: string;
  data: string;
}

export interface RegistryValueEditResult {
  type: string;
  data: string;
}

interface ActiveRegistryValueEdit {
  request: RegistryValueEditRequest;
  resolve: (result: RegistryValueEditResult | null) => void;
}

@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })
export class RegistryValueEditorService {
  readonly active$ = createBehaviorSubject<ActiveRegistryValueEdit | null>(null);

  edit(request: RegistryValueEditRequest): Promise<RegistryValueEditResult | null> {
    // Registry edit is intentionally single-instance. Resolve any stale request
    // as cancelled instead of stacking invisible prompt surfaces.
    const active = this.active$.value;
    if (active) {
      active.resolve(null);
    }

    return new Promise(resolve => {
      this.active$.next({ request, resolve });
    });
  }

  resolve(result: RegistryValueEditResult | null): void {
    const active = this.active$.value;
    if (!active) return;
    this.active$.next(null);
    active.resolve(result);
  }
}
`````

`````typescript
import {
  RegistryKeyEditorService,
} from './registry-key-editor.service';
import {
  RegistryValueEditorService,
} from './registry-value-editor.service';
import {
  RegistryPanelSource,
  type RegistryPanelSourceHost,
} from './registry-panel-source';
import type { RegistryFileInfo } from './registry-model';

export interface RegistryCommandInvocation {
  source?: string;
  context?: Readonly<Record<string, unknown>>;
}

export interface RegistryCommandDescriptor {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  description?: string;
  category?: string;
  execute(invocation?: RegistryCommandInvocation): void | Promise<void>;
  isEnabled?(invocation?: RegistryCommandInvocation): boolean;
}

export interface RegistryMenuContext {
  currentDirectory: string;
  targetPath: string;
  selectedPaths: string[];
}

export interface RegistryToolbarContext {
  selectedPaths: string[];
  currentDirectory: string;
}

export interface RegistryToolbarContribution {
  id: string;
  commandId?: string;
  label?: string;
  score(context: RegistryToolbarContext): number;
}

export interface RegistryContextMenuContribution {
  id: string;
  commandId?: string;
  label?: string;
  score(context: RegistryMenuContext): number;
}


export interface RegistryPluginApi {
  registerPanelSource(source: RegistryPanelSource): void;
  unregisterPanelSource(id: string): void;
  registerCommand(command: RegistryCommandDescriptor): void;
  unregisterCommand(id: string): void;
  registerToolbarAction(action: RegistryToolbarContribution): void;
  unregisterToolbarAction(id: string): void;
  registerContextMenuItem(item: RegistryContextMenuContribution): void;
  unregisterContextMenuItem(id: string): void;
}

export interface RegistryPluginOperations {
  joinPaths(parts: string[]): Promise<string>;
  createDirectory(path: string, recursive: boolean): Promise<unknown>;
  writeFile(path: string, content: string, encoding: string): Promise<unknown>;
  getFileInfo(path: string): Promise<RegistryFileInfo>;
  moveFile(source: string, destination: string): Promise<unknown>;
  readFile(path: string, encoding: string): Promise<{ content?: string }>;
  writeRegistryValue(path: string, type: string, data: string): Promise<unknown>;
  deletePath(path: string, recursive: boolean, useTrash: boolean): Promise<unknown>;
  prompt(request: {
    title: string;
    message: string;
    confirmText: string;
    defaultValue?: string;
    historyKey?: string;
  }): Promise<string | null>;
  confirm(request: {
    title: string;
    message: string;
    confirmText: string;
    danger?: boolean;
  }): Promise<boolean>;
}

export interface RegistryPluginOptions {
  panelSource: RegistryPanelSourceHost;
  operations: RegistryPluginOperations;
  keyEditor: RegistryKeyEditorService;
  valueEditor: RegistryValueEditorService;
}

export interface RegistryPluginBackend {
  id: string;
  onRegister(api: RegistryPluginApi): void;
  onUnregister(api: RegistryPluginApi): void;
}

export interface RegistryPluginDescriptor {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  version: string;
  description: string;
  schemes: string[];
}

export interface RegistryPluginDefinition {
  backend: RegistryPluginBackend;
  descriptor: RegistryPluginDescriptor;
}

const COMMAND = {
  newKey: 'reassembly.registry.newKey',
  newValue: 'reassembly.registry.newValue',
  edit: 'reassembly.registry.edit',
  delete: 'reassembly.registry.delete',
} as const;

const TOOLBAR = {
  newKey: 'reassembly.registry.newKey.toolbar',
  newValue: 'reassembly.registry.newValue.toolbar',
  edit: 'reassembly.registry.edit.toolbar',
  delete: 'reassembly.registry.delete.toolbar',
  refresh: 'reassembly.registry.refresh.toolbar',
} as const;

const MENU = {
  newKey: 'reassembly.registry.newKey.menu',
  newValue: 'reassembly.registry.newValue.menu',
  edit: 'reassembly.registry.edit.menu',
  delete: 'reassembly.registry.delete.menu',
  refresh: 'reassembly.registry.refresh.menu',
} as const;

function isRegistry(path: string): boolean {
  return /^registry:\/\//i.test((path ?? '').trim());
}

function commandContext(invocation?: RegistryCommandInvocation): RegistryMenuContext {
  const raw = invocation?.context ?? {};
  const selectedPaths = Array.isArray(raw['selectedPaths'])
    ? raw['selectedPaths'].filter((value): value is string => typeof value === 'string')
    : [];

  const currentDirectory =
    typeof raw['currentDirectory'] === 'string'
      ? raw['currentDirectory']
      : typeof raw['path'] === 'string'
        ? raw['path']
        : '';

  const targetPath =
    typeof raw['targetPath'] === 'string'
      ? raw['targetPath']
      : selectedPaths[0] ?? currentDirectory;

  return { currentDirectory, targetPath, selectedPaths };
}

async function refreshAfter(
  invocation: RegistryCommandInvocation | undefined,
  action: () => Promise<void>,
): Promise<void> {
  await action();
  const refresh = invocation?.context?.['refresh'];
  if (typeof refresh === 'function') {
    await Promise.resolve(refresh());
  }
}

export function createRegistryPlugin(
  options: RegistryPluginOptions,
): RegistryPluginDefinition {
  const ops = options.operations;

  const createKey = async (context: RegistryMenuContext): Promise<void> => {
    if (!isRegistry(context.currentDirectory)) return;

    const name = await options.keyEditor.open({
      title: 'New Registry Key',
      name: '',
      confirmText: 'Create',
    });
    if (!name) return;

    const path = await ops.joinPaths([context.currentDirectory, name]);
    await ops.createDirectory(path, false);
  };

  const createValue = async (context: RegistryMenuContext): Promise<void> => {
    if (!isRegistry(context.currentDirectory)) return;

    const name = (await ops.prompt({
      title: 'New Registry Value',
      message: 'Enter the value name.',
      confirmText: 'Next',
      historyKey: 'reassembly.registry.newValue.name',
    }))?.trim();
    if (!name) return;

    const path = await ops.joinPaths([context.currentDirectory, name]);
    const value = await options.valueEditor.edit({
      path,
      name,
      type: 'REG_SZ',
      data: '',
    });
    if (!value) return;

    await ops.writeRegistryValue(path, value.type, value.data);
  };

  const editEntry = async (context: RegistryMenuContext): Promise<void> => {
    if (
      !isRegistry(context.targetPath) ||
      context.targetPath === context.currentDirectory
    ) {
      return;
    }

    const info = await ops.getFileInfo(context.targetPath);
    const kind = String(info.registryKind ?? '').toLowerCase();

    if (kind === 'key') {
      const name = await options.keyEditor.open({
        title: `Edit Registry Key — ${info.name}`,
        name: info.name,
        confirmText: 'Rename',
      });
      if (!name || name === info.name) return;

      const separator = context.targetPath.lastIndexOf('/');
      if (separator < 0) return;
      const parent = context.targetPath.slice(0, separator);
      const destination = await ops.joinPaths([parent, name]);
      await ops.moveFile(context.targetPath, destination);
      return;
    }

    if (kind !== 'value') return;

    const current = await ops.readFile(context.targetPath, 'utf8');
    const edit = await options.valueEditor.edit({
      path: context.targetPath,
      name: info.name,
      type: info.registryValueType || 'REG_SZ',
      data: current.content ?? '',
    });
    if (!edit) return;

    await ops.writeRegistryValue(
      context.targetPath,
      edit.type,
      edit.data,
    );
  };

  const deleteEntry = async (context: RegistryMenuContext): Promise<void> => {
    if (
      !isRegistry(context.targetPath) ||
      context.targetPath === context.currentDirectory
    ) {
      return;
    }

    const confirmed = await ops.confirm({
      title: 'Delete Registry Entry',
      message: `Delete ${context.targetPath}?`,
      confirmText: 'Delete',
      danger: true,
    });
    if (!confirmed) return;

    await ops.deletePath(context.targetPath, true, false);
  };

  const source = new RegistryPanelSource(
    options.panelSource,
    async (context, entry) => {
      await editEntry({
        currentDirectory: context.path,
        targetPath: entry.path,
        selectedPaths: [entry.path],
      });
      return true;
    },
  );


  const backend: RegistryPluginBackend = {
    id: 'reassembly.registry',
    onRegister: api => {
      api.registerPanelSource(source);

      api.registerCommand({
        id: COMMAND.newKey,
        title: 'Registry: New Key',
        category: 'Registry',
        execute: invocation => refreshAfter(
          invocation,
          () => createKey(commandContext(invocation)),
        ),
        isEnabled: invocation =>
          isRegistry(commandContext(invocation).currentDirectory),
      });

      api.registerCommand({
        id: COMMAND.newValue,
        title: 'Registry: New Value',
        category: 'Registry',
        execute: invocation => refreshAfter(
          invocation,
          () => createValue(commandContext(invocation)),
        ),
        isEnabled: invocation =>
          isRegistry(commandContext(invocation).currentDirectory),
      });

      api.registerCommand({
        id: COMMAND.edit,
        title: 'Registry: Edit',
        category: 'Registry',
        execute: invocation => refreshAfter(
          invocation,
          () => editEntry(commandContext(invocation)),
        ),
        isEnabled: invocation => {
          const context = commandContext(invocation);
          return isRegistry(context.targetPath) &&
            context.targetPath !== context.currentDirectory;
        },
      });

      api.registerCommand({
        id: COMMAND.delete,
        title: 'Registry: Delete Entry',
        category: 'Registry',
        execute: invocation => refreshAfter(
          invocation,
          () => deleteEntry(commandContext(invocation)),
        ),
        isEnabled: invocation => {
          const context = commandContext(invocation);
          return isRegistry(context.targetPath) &&
            context.targetPath !== context.currentDirectory;
        },
      });

      api.registerToolbarAction({
        id: TOOLBAR.newKey,
        commandId: COMMAND.newKey,
        label: 'New key',
        score: context => isRegistry(context.currentDirectory) ? 100 : 0,
      });

      api.registerToolbarAction({
        id: TOOLBAR.newValue,
        commandId: COMMAND.newValue,
        label: 'New value',
        score: context => isRegistry(context.currentDirectory) ? 99 : 0,
      });

      api.registerToolbarAction({
        id: TOOLBAR.edit,
        commandId: COMMAND.edit,
        label: 'Edit',
        score: context =>
          isRegistry(context.currentDirectory) && context.selectedPaths.length
            ? 98
            : 0,
      });

      api.registerToolbarAction({
        id: TOOLBAR.delete,
        commandId: COMMAND.delete,
        label: 'Delete',
        score: context =>
          isRegistry(context.currentDirectory) && context.selectedPaths.length
            ? 97
            : 0,
      });

      api.registerToolbarAction({
        id: TOOLBAR.refresh,
        commandId: 'pane.nav.refresh',
        label: 'Refresh',
        score: context => isRegistry(context.currentDirectory) ? 96 : 0,
      });

      api.registerContextMenuItem({
        id: MENU.newKey,
        commandId: COMMAND.newKey,
        label: 'New Key',
        score: context =>
          isRegistry(context.currentDirectory) &&
          context.targetPath === context.currentDirectory
            ? 95
            : 0,
      });

      api.registerContextMenuItem({
        id: MENU.newValue,
        commandId: COMMAND.newValue,
        label: 'New Value',
        score: context =>
          isRegistry(context.currentDirectory) &&
          context.targetPath === context.currentDirectory
            ? 94
            : 0,
      });

      api.registerContextMenuItem({
        id: MENU.refresh,
        commandId: 'pane.nav.refresh',
        label: 'Refresh',
        score: context =>
          isRegistry(context.currentDirectory) &&
          context.targetPath === context.currentDirectory
            ? 80
            : 0,
      });

      api.registerContextMenuItem({
        id: MENU.edit,
        commandId: COMMAND.edit,
        label: 'Edit',
        score: context =>
          isRegistry(context.targetPath) &&
          context.targetPath !== context.currentDirectory
            ? 90
            : 0,
      });

      api.registerContextMenuItem({
        id: MENU.delete,
        commandId: COMMAND.delete,
        label: 'Delete',
        score: context =>
          isRegistry(context.targetPath) &&
          context.targetPath !== context.currentDirectory
            ? 85
            : 0,
      });
    },
    onUnregister: api => {
      api.unregisterContextMenuItem(MENU.refresh);
      api.unregisterContextMenuItem(MENU.delete);
      api.unregisterContextMenuItem(MENU.edit);
      api.unregisterContextMenuItem(MENU.newValue);
      api.unregisterContextMenuItem(MENU.newKey);

      api.unregisterToolbarAction(TOOLBAR.refresh);
      api.unregisterToolbarAction(TOOLBAR.delete);
      api.unregisterToolbarAction(TOOLBAR.edit);
      api.unregisterToolbarAction(TOOLBAR.newValue);
      api.unregisterToolbarAction(TOOLBAR.newKey);

      api.unregisterCommand(COMMAND.delete);
      api.unregisterCommand(COMMAND.edit);
      api.unregisterCommand(COMMAND.newValue);
      api.unregisterCommand(COMMAND.newKey);

      api.unregisterPanelSource(source.id);
    },
  };

  return {
    backend,
    descriptor: {
      id: 'reassembly.registry',
      name: 'Windows Registry',
      version: '1.3.2',
      description: 'Registry panel source, editors, commands, toolbar and context-menu actions.',
      schemes: ['registry'],
    },
  };
}
`````

## File: plugins/registry/README.md
`````markdown
# Reassembly Registry Plugin

Windows Registry domain package for Reassembly.

## Ownership

The package owns Registry semantics, not the pane chrome:

- `RegistryPanelSource` and Registry entry contracts
- Registry create/edit/delete command behavior
- Registry toolbar contributions
- Registry entry/background context-menu contributions
- key and value editor services/components
- the universal Registry backend adapter

The Manager owns the visual pane shell. `manager/frontend/src/app/components/registry-pane.component.ts`
is intentionally a Directory-pane sibling so Directory and Registry keep the same visual and interaction language.
The shared Manager context-menu and toolbar renderers display plugin contributions; the plugin does not ship a second pane UI.

## Context menu contract

Registry uses the common Manager context-menu renderer with Registry-owned actions:

- background: **New Key**, **New Value**, **Refresh**
- entry: **Edit**, **Delete**

The host must execute the `PresentedCommand` created for the right-click context so `targetPath`,
`currentDirectory`, and `selectedPaths` are preserved exactly.

## Backend protocol

The backend understands:

- `hello`
- `registry.list`
- `registry.read`
- `registry.write`
- `registry.createKey`
- `registry.delete`
- `registry.rename`

## Build

```bash
npm run build:frontend
npm run test
npm run build:backend
```

`registry-pane.component.ts` is intentionally **not** part of this package's public API.
`````

## File: plugins/README.md
`````markdown
# Plugins

Plugins are sibling projects of `manager`. Each plugin owns its source-specific presentation and contributions while consuming only the public plugin SDK/contracts.

A plugin should not import from `manager/frontend/src/app/components`, private services, or backend implementation packages. Host operations are accessed through published plugin capabilities.

## Built-in workspace plugins

`plugins/registry` is a compile-time built-in plugin package. It is source-linked
into Manager through the npm workspace while still using the same
`PluginManagerService.registerBackend()` contribution lifecycle at runtime.

This is intentionally distinct from user-installed directory plugins under the
application configuration directory, whose current frontend modules are
declarative/data-only.
`````

## File: scripts/registry-boundary.mjs
`````javascript
#!/usr/bin/env node

import { existsSync, readFileSync, rmSync } from 'node:fs';
import { resolve } from 'node:path';

const root = resolve(import.meta.dirname, '..');
const fix = process.argv.includes('--fix');

const required = [
  'manager/frontend/src/app/components/registry-pane.component.ts',
  'plugins/registry/src/registry.plugin.ts',
  'plugins/registry/src/registry-panel-source.ts',
  'plugins/registry/src/registry-key-editor.component.ts',
  'plugins/registry/src/registry-value-editor.component.ts',
  'plugins/registry/src/registry-key-editor.service.ts',
  'plugins/registry/src/registry-value-editor.service.ts',
  'plugins/registry/src/registry-plugin-host.component.ts',
];

const obsoletePluginPresentation = [
  'plugins/registry/src/registry-pane.component.ts',
  'plugins/registry/src/registry-pane.component.d.ts',
  'plugins/registry/src/registry-pane.component.js',
  'plugins/registry/src/registry-pane.component.js.map',
  'plugins/registry/src/registry-pane.component.spec.ts',
  'plugins/registry/src/registry-pane-core-presentation.spec.ts',
  'plugins/registry/src/registry-pane-storage.spec.ts',
];

if (fix) {
  for (const rel of obsoletePluginPresentation) {
    const path = resolve(root, rel);
    if (!existsSync(path)) continue;
    rmSync(path);
    console.log(`removed  ${rel}`);
  }
}

const errors = [];
for (const rel of required) {
  if (!existsSync(resolve(root, rel))) errors.push(`missing required ownership file: ${rel}`);
}
for (const rel of obsoletePluginPresentation) {
  if (existsSync(resolve(root, rel))) errors.push(`obsolete plugin presentation remains: ${rel}`);
}

const publicApiPath = resolve(root, 'plugins/registry/src/public-api.ts');
if (existsSync(publicApiPath)) {
  const text = readFileSync(publicApiPath, 'utf8');
  if (text.includes("./registry-pane.component")) {
    errors.push('Registry plugin public API still exports registry-pane.component.');
  }
}

const pluginPath = resolve(root, 'plugins/registry/src/registry.plugin.ts');
if (existsSync(pluginPath)) {
  const text = readFileSync(pluginPath, 'utf8');
  if (/RegistryPanelPresentationContribution|registerPanelPresentation|unregisterPanelPresentation/.test(text)) {
    errors.push('Registry plugin still claims pane-presentation ownership.');
  }
  for (const label of ['New key', 'New value', 'Edit', 'Delete', 'Refresh']) {
    if (!text.includes(`label: '${label}'`)) errors.push(`missing Registry toolbar action: ${label}`);
  }
  for (const label of ['New Key', 'New Value', 'Edit', 'Delete', 'Refresh']) {
    if (!text.includes(`label: '${label}'`)) errors.push(`missing Registry context-menu action: ${label}`);
  }
}

const hostPath = resolve(root, 'manager/frontend/src/app/components/pane-host.component.ts');
if (existsSync(hostPath)) {
  const text = readFileSync(hostPath, 'utf8');
  if (!text.includes("from './registry-pane.component'")) {
    errors.push('PaneHost must render the Manager-owned Registry Directory clone.');
  }
  if (/RegistryPaneComponent[^\r\n]*@reassembly\/registry-plugin|@reassembly\/registry-plugin[^\r\n]*RegistryPaneComponent/.test(text)) {
    errors.push('PaneHost imports the obsolete plugin-owned Registry pane.');
  }
}

if (errors.length) {
  console.error(`Registry ownership audit failed with ${errors.length} issue(s):`);
  for (const error of errors) console.error(`  - ${error}`);
  process.exit(1);
}

console.log('OK: Registry ownership is split consistently.');
console.log('  Manager: Directory-clone pane presentation + generic menu/toolbar renderer.');
console.log('  Plugin: panel source, Registry commands, toolbar/context contributions, editors.');
`````

## File: scripts/run-wails-dev.mjs
`````javascript
import { spawn } from 'node:child_process';
import path from 'node:path';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';

const __dirname = path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url));
const managerDir = path.join(__dirname, '..', 'manager');
const userArgs = process.argv.slice(2);

const args = ['dev', ...userArgs];
if (process.platform === 'win32' && !includesFlag(args, '-ldflags')) {
  args.push('-ldflags=-H=windowsgui');
}

const child = spawn('wails', args, {
  cwd: managerDir,
  stdio: 'inherit',
  shell: false,
});

child.on('exit', code => {
  process.exit(code ?? 0);
});

child.on('error', error => {
  console.error(`Failed to start Wails dev: ${error.message}`);
  process.exit(1);
});

function includesFlag(args, flag) {
  return args.some(arg => arg === flag || arg.startsWith(`${flag}=`));
}
`````

## File: scripts/verify-core-package.mjs
`````javascript
#!/usr/bin/env node

import { existsSync, readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { resolve } from 'node:path';

const root = resolve(import.meta.dirname, '..');
const corePackagePath = resolve(root, 'packages/core/package.json');
const managerTsconfigPath = resolve(root, 'manager/frontend/tsconfig.json');
const registryTsconfigPath = resolve(root, 'plugins/registry/tsconfig.json');
const registryLibTsconfigPath = resolve(root, 'plugins/registry/tsconfig.lib.json');

const corePackage = readJson(corePackagePath);
const managerTsconfig = readJson(managerTsconfigPath);
const registryTsconfig = readJson(registryTsconfigPath);
const registryLibTsconfig = readJson(registryLibTsconfigPath);

const sourceTargets = new Map([
  ['@reassembly/core', 'packages/core/frontend/src/index.ts'],
  ['@reassembly/core/contracts/files', 'packages/core/frontend/src/contracts/files/index.ts'],
  ['@reassembly/core/contracts/input', 'packages/core/frontend/src/contracts/input/index.ts'],
  ['@reassembly/core/contracts/sources', 'packages/core/frontend/src/contracts/sources/index.ts'],
  ['@reassembly/core/contracts/panes', 'packages/core/frontend/src/contracts/panes/index.ts'],
  ['@reassembly/core/runtime/panes', 'packages/core/frontend/src/runtime/panes/index.ts'],
  ['@reassembly/core/files', 'packages/core/frontend/src/contracts/files/index.ts'],
  ['@reassembly/core/input', 'packages/core/frontend/src/contracts/input/index.ts'],
  ['@reassembly/core/sources', 'packages/core/frontend/src/contracts/sources/index.ts'],
  ['@reassembly/core/panes', 'packages/core/frontend/src/contracts/panes/index.ts'],
  ['@reassembly/core/renderer', 'packages/core/frontend/src/runtime/panes/index.ts'],
  ['@reassembly/core/ui/panes', 'packages/core/frontend/src/ui/panes/index.ts'],
]);

const expectedExports = new Set(
  [...sourceTargets.keys()].map(specifier =>
    specifier === '@reassembly/core'
      ? '.'
      : `./${specifier.slice('@reassembly/core/'.length)}`,
  ),
);

let failed = false;

for (const exportName of expectedExports) {
  if (!corePackage.exports?.[exportName]) {
    fail(`core package is missing export ${exportName}`);
  }
}

for (const [specifier, sourceRelativePath] of sourceTargets) {
  const sourcePath = resolve(root, sourceRelativePath);
  if (!existsSync(sourcePath)) {
    fail(`core source entry point does not exist: ${sourceRelativePath}`);
  }

  verifyPathAlias('manager/frontend/tsconfig.json', managerTsconfig, specifier, sourcePath);
  verifyPathAlias('plugins/registry/tsconfig.json', registryTsconfig, specifier, sourcePath);
  verifyPathAlias('plugins/registry/tsconfig.lib.json', registryLibTsconfig, specifier, sourcePath);
}

for (const config of [
  ['manager/frontend/tsconfig.json', managerTsconfig],
  ['plugins/registry/tsconfig.json', registryTsconfig],
  ['plugins/registry/tsconfig.lib.json', registryLibTsconfig],
]) {
  const [label, json] = config;
  if (json.compilerOptions?.paths?.['@reassembly/core/*']) {
    fail(`${label} still contains the broad @reassembly/core/* escape hatch`);
  }
}

const paneExport = corePackage.exports?.['./ui/panes'];
if (paneExport) {
  assertFileTarget('types', paneExport.types);
  assertFileTarget('default', paneExport.default);
}

if (!failed) {
  console.log('ok: @reassembly/core package exports and workspace source aliases are aligned');
}

process.exit(failed ? 1 : 0);

function verifyPathAlias(label, config, specifier, expectedAbsolutePath) {
  const values = config.compilerOptions?.paths?.[specifier];
  if (!Array.isArray(values) || values.length !== 1) {
    fail(`${label} must map ${specifier} to exactly one public source entry point`);
    return;
  }

  const configDir = resolve(root, label, '..');
  const actualAbsolutePath = resolve(configDir, values[0]);
  if (actualAbsolutePath !== expectedAbsolutePath) {
    fail(
      `${label} maps ${specifier} to ${values[0]}, expected ${expectedAbsolutePath}`,
    );
  }
}

function assertFileTarget(kind, packageRelativePath) {
  if (typeof packageRelativePath !== 'string') {
    fail(`./ui/panes is missing its ${kind} target`);
    return;
  }

  const absolute = resolve(root, 'packages/core', packageRelativePath);
  if (!existsSync(absolute)) {
    // Dist is allowed to be absent before the Core build. Source alignment is the
    // editor contract; this diagnostic simply makes the build prerequisite clear.
    console.warn(`pending build: ${packageRelativePath}`);
  }
}

function readJson(path) {
  return JSON.parse(readFileSync(path, 'utf8'));
}

function fail(message) {
  console.error(`core-package: ${message}`);
  failed = true;
}
`````

`````javascript
import { existsSync, readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { resolve } from 'node:path';

const root = resolve(import.meta.dirname, '..');

const required = [
  'node_modules/@angular/animations/package.json',
  'node_modules/@angular/animations/fesm2022/animations.mjs',
  'plugins/registry/dist/package.json',
];

let failed = false;
for (const rel of required) {
  const path = resolve(root, rel);
  if (!existsSync(path)) {
    console.error(`missing: ${rel}`);
    failed = true;
  } else {
    console.log(`ok: ${rel}`);
  }
}

const animationsPackage = resolve(root, 'node_modules/@angular/animations/package.json');
if (existsSync(animationsPackage)) {
  const pkg = JSON.parse(readFileSync(animationsPackage, 'utf8'));
  const browser = pkg.exports?.['./browser'];
  if (!browser) {
    console.error('missing export: @angular/animations/browser');
    failed = true;
  } else {
    console.log('ok: @angular/animations/browser export');
  }
}

process.exit(failed ? 1 : 0);
`````
