## File: package.json
`````json
{
  "name": "reassembly-workspace",
  "private": true,
  "scripts": {
    "dev:app": "npm run build:core:frontend && node scripts/run-wails-dev.mjs",
    "build:core": "npm run build:core:frontend && npm run build:core:go",
    "build:plugins": "npm run build:core && npm run verify:core-package && npm run build --workspace @reassembly/registry-plugin",
    "build:frontend": "npm run build:plugins && npm --prefix manager/frontend run build",
    "build:go": "npm run build:core:go && go build ./manager/...",
    "build:app": "npm run build:plugins && cd manager && wails build",
    "build": "npm run build:app",
    "check": "npm run build:plugins && npm --prefix manager/frontend run build && npm run build:go",
    "test:core": "npm run test:core:frontend && npm run test:core:go",
    "test:plugins": "npm run test:core && npm run verify:core-package && npm run test --workspace @reassembly/registry-plugin",
    "test:frontend": "npm --prefix manager/frontend test",
    "test:go": "npm run test:core:go && go test ./manager/...",
    "test": "npm run test:plugins && npm run test:frontend && npm run test:go",
    "verify:core-package": "node scripts/verify-core-package.mjs",
    "verify:workspace": "npm run verify:core-package && node scripts/verify-workspace.mjs",
    "build:core:frontend": "npm run build --workspace @reassembly/core",
    "build:core:go": "go build ./packages/core/go/...",
    "test:core:frontend": "npm run test --workspace @reassembly/core",
    "test:core:go": "go test ./packages/core/go/..."
  },
  "workspaces": [
    "manager/frontend",
    "packages/*",
    "plugins/*"
  ]
}
`````

## File: README.md
`````markdown
# Reassembly Workspace

This repository is organized as a workspace with the host application and plugins as sibling projects.

```text
.
├── manager/
│   ├── frontend/
│   ├── internal/
│   ├── vfs/
│   ├── go.mod
│   └── wails.json
├── plugins/
│   └── registry/
├── docs/
├── .github/
└── go.work
```

`manager` is the Wails host application. Plugins must depend only on public plugin contracts/capabilities exposed by the host; they must not import Manager component or service internals.

The Registry frontend plugin now lives in `plugins/registry`. Registry presentation, editors, panel-source behavior, commands, and context-menu contributions are owned there. The Registry backend remains in `manager/vfs/registry` until a backend plugin ABI exists.

For Windows live development, use `npm run dev:app`. That wrapper runs `wails dev` from `manager/` and adds `-ldflags "-H windowsgui"` so `wails-app` stays a GUI binary during elevated restarts.
`````

## File: docs/INPUT_SYSTEM_ARCHITECTURE.md
`````markdown
# Input System Architecture

## Objective

Replace the current mix of global shortcuts and component-local key handlers with a unified input system that supports:

- VS Code-style keybinding resolution
- Chord shortcuts such as `Ctrl+K Ctrl+C`
- Mouse gestures
- Plugin-provided bindings
- Dynamic rebinding at runtime
- Context priority resolution

The immediate goal of this document is to define the dialog and overlay binding surface so the refactor starts from a complete inventory instead of ad hoc handlers.

## Current State

The frontend input model has completed its core migration. The architecture now consists of:

- `frontend/src/app/services/input-engine.service.ts` — the primary engine with context-aware resolution, command registration, source-priority binding resolution, plugin binding registration, and pending chord state.
- `frontend/src/app/services/dialog-input-catalog.ts` — canonical binding catalog for all dialogs and overlays.
- Component-level command registration via `InputEngineService` for dialogs, overlays, and widgets.
- `frontend/src/app/services/keyboard.service.ts` — now acts as a compatibility adapter that registers legacy global shortcuts into the shared engine instead of dispatching through a separate listener.
- `frontend/src/app/services/shortcut-registry.service.ts` — still defines the default global shortcut set, but those bindings now resolve through the shared engine with DOM-aware `when` guards and per-binding propagation control.

A small number of local `HostListener` or template `keydown` handlers remain as fallback behavior in a few surfaces, but the canonical path for all new bindings is command-first.

## Dialog And Overlay Inventory

### Dialogs / Modals

All dialogs below now register commands via `InputEngineService` and acquire their input context via `InputContextService`. Bindings are defined in `frontend/src/app/services/dialog-input-catalog.ts`.

| Surface | Context ID | Bindings |
|---|---|---|
| Confirm dialog | `dialog.confirm` | `Enter` (accept), `Escape` (cancel), `Tab` / `Shift+Tab` (focus), `ArrowLeft` / `ArrowRight` (focus) |
| Global search | `dialog.globalSearch` | `Escape` (close), `ArrowUp` / `ArrowDown` (navigate), `Enter` (open), `Ctrl+Enter` (open folder), `Ctrl+,` (settings) |
| Global search settings | `dialog.globalSearch.settings` | `Escape` (close), `Enter` (apply), `ArrowLeft` / `ArrowRight` (focus) |
| Keyboard help | `dialog.keyboardHelp` | `Escape` (close), `Ctrl+F` (focus search), `Ctrl+S` (export), `ArrowUp` / `ArrowDown` (navigate), `Space` (toggle) |
| Path history viewer | `dialog.pathHistory` | `Escape` (close), `Ctrl+F` (focus filter), `ArrowUp` / `ArrowDown` (navigate), `Enter` (open), `Delete` (remove), `Ctrl+Delete` (clear all) |
| Filter custom dialog | `filter-bar.component.ts` | `Escape` closes via parent listener; inline filter widget handles its own keys |

### Overlays

All overlays below now have dedicated input contexts and command bindings.

| Surface | Context ID | Bindings |
|---|---|---|
| Address bar quick access | `overlay.quickAccess` | `Escape` (close), `Tab` / `Shift+Tab` (section), `ArrowUp` / `ArrowDown` (item), `Enter` (open), `Delete` (remove pin) |
| Address bar edit | `overlay.addressBar.edit` | `Enter`, `Escape`, `Tab`, `Shift+Tab`, arrows |
| Drive dropdown | `overlay.addressBar.schemes` | `Escape` (close), `ArrowUp` / `ArrowDown` (item), `ArrowLeft` / `ArrowRight` (column), `Enter` (open) |
| Sibling dropdown | `overlay.addressBar.siblings` | `Escape` (close), `ArrowUp` / `ArrowDown` (item), `Enter` (open) |
| Workspace selector menu | `overlay.workspaceSelector` | `Escape` (close), `ArrowUp` / `ArrowDown` (item), `Enter` (activate), `Delete` (delete) |
| Filter preset/category dropdowns | `overlay.filter.presets` | `Escape` (close), `ArrowUp` / `ArrowDown` (item), `Enter` (select) |
| Filter widget | `widget.filterInline` | `Escape` (close), `Enter` / `F3` (next match), `Shift+Enter` / `Shift+F3` (prev match) |

## Target Architecture

### 1. Commands, Not Inline Closures

Bindings should target command IDs rather than component closures.

Examples:

- `dialog.confirm.accept`
- `dialog.confirm.cancel`
- `dialog.globalSearch.nextResult`
- `dialog.globalSearch.openSelected`
- `overlay.quickAccess.nextItem`
- `overlay.workspaceSelector.close`

Components can still implement the behavior, but command registration and binding registration must be separate concerns.

### 2. Resolver Model

The input engine should resolve events using this order:

1. Active modal/dialog context
2. Active overlay context
3. Focused widget context
4. Active pane context
5. Global context

Within the same context level, choose the highest priority binding by:

1. Context specificity
2. Source priority: user > workspace > plugin > default
3. Explicit numeric priority
4. Most recent registration as a final deterministic tie-breaker

### 3. Context Stack

The engine should maintain a stack of input contexts rather than infer everything from DOM traversal.

Each context should define:

- `id`
- `kind`: `global`, `pane`, `dialog`, `overlay`, `widget`
- `priority`
- optional parent context
- activation predicate or lifecycle hook

This is required for nested surfaces such as:

- Global search -> settings dialog
- Keyboard help -> import file flow -> confirm alert
- Pane -> address bar -> quick access overlay

### 4. Multi-Step Sequences

The engine must support keybinding sequences, not only single combinations.

Examples:

- `Ctrl+K Ctrl+C`
- `Ctrl+K Ctrl+S`
- `G G`

Sequence handling requirements:

- timeout window per chord sequence
- prefix matching
- cancellation on unmatched continuation
- visible pending-chord state so the UI can hint when the engine is waiting for the second step

### 5. Mouse Gestures

Mouse bindings should be first-class entries, not ad hoc pointer handlers.

Initial gesture families:

- click variants: left, middle, right, double-click
- wheel with modifiers
- drag gestures with button and modifier state
- path gestures such as right-drag menu triggers

Examples:

- `mouse.doubleClick.left` -> `pane.openSelection`
- `mouse.drag.right` -> `pane.showDragOperationMenu`
- `mouse.wheel.ctrl` -> `viewer.zoom`

### 6. Dynamic Rebinding

Bindings must be editable at runtime and reloaded without restarting the app.

Required layers:

- built-in defaults
- plugin defaults
- workspace overrides
- user overrides

The current import/export behavior in `keyboard.service.ts` can become one persistence layer, but the runtime engine should treat it as data rather than direct mutable state on shortcut objects.

### 7. Plugin Bindings

Plugins should be able to contribute:

- commands
- contexts
- keybindings
- mouse gestures

Plugin bindings must declare:

- stable source ID
- binding source type `plugin`
- optional when/context expression
- optional weight/priority

## Migration Plan

### Phase A ✅ Complete

- Introduced typed input-system model and dialog binding catalog.
- Bridged existing keyboard shortcut registrations through the new engine.
- Catalog is the read-only source of truth for design and audit.

### Phase B ✅ Complete

- `keyboard.service.ts` now acts as a compatibility adapter registering into the shared engine.
- Dialog key handlers moved from local `HostListener` logic into command bindings.
- Resolver supports contexts, source priority, and chords.

### Phase C 🔄 In Progress

- Mouse gesture dispatch exists in the input engine for click, double-click, button, and wheel gestures.
- Browser-shell mouse bindings cover file-entry double-click open and viewer `Ctrl+Wheel` zoom.
- Plugin contribution API surface is designed but not yet wired end-to-end.
- UI for live rebinding and conflict inspection is not yet implemented.

## Start Point For This Refactor

All dialog and overlay contexts listed above are live. Further work should focus on:

1. Expanding mouse gesture coverage as more commands are migrated.
2. Implementing the live-rebinding UI.
3. Completing the plugin binding contribution API.

## Implementation Status

All core input system features are implemented:

- `frontend/src/app/services/input-engine.service.ts` — context registration, command registration, source-priority binding resolution, plugin binding registration, pending chord state, and mouse gesture dispatch.
- `frontend/src/app/services/dialog-input-catalog.ts` — canonical binding catalog for all dialogs and overlays.
- `frontend/src/app/services/input-context.service.ts` — lease-counted context activation.

Dialog contexts:
- `dialog.confirm`
- `dialog.globalSearch`
- `dialog.globalSearch.settings`
- `dialog.keyboardHelp`
- `dialog.pathHistory`

Overlay contexts:
- `overlay.quickAccess`
- `overlay.addressBar.schemes`
- `overlay.addressBar.siblings`
- `overlay.workspaceSelector`
- `overlay.filter.presets`

Widget contexts:
- `widget.filterInline`
- `overlay.addressBar.edit`

Legacy adapter:
- `keyboard.service.ts` registers legacy shortcuts into the shared engine.
- `shortcut-registry.service.ts` bindings resolve through the shared engine with DOM-aware `when` guards.

Remaining work (Phase C):
- Plugin binding contribution API end-to-end wiring.
- Live-rebinding UI.
- Expanded mouse gesture coverage as more commands migrate.
`````

`````typescript
    return `reassembly.address.${this.paneId}`;
  }

  private get ownerId(): string {
    return `reassembly.address.${this.paneId}`;
  }

  private commandId(name: string): string {
    return `${this.ownerId}.${name}`;
  }

  constructor(
    private readonly input: InputEngineService,
    private readonly history: PathHistoryService,
    private readonly panelSources: PanelSourceRegistryService,
    private readonly cdr: ChangeDetectorRef,
  ) {}

  get displayPath(): string {
    return formatPathForDisplay(this.path || '/');
  }

  get breadcrumbSegments(): BreadcrumbSegment[] {
    const raw = this.displayPath || '/';
    const normalized = raw.replace(/\\/g, '/');

    const scheme = /^([a-z][a-z0-9+.-]*):\/\/(.*)$/i.exec(normalized);
    if (scheme) {
      const schemeName = scheme[1];
      const prefix = `${schemeName}://`;
      const parts = scheme[2].split('/').filter(Boolean);
      const segments: BreadcrumbSegment[] = [{
        // Show the semantic scheme root, not a folder-looking name.
        // Preserve the scheme spelling supplied by the location.
        label: `${schemeName}:`,
        path: prefix,
        root: true,
        archiveBoundary: false,
      }];

      let current = prefix;
      for (const part of parts) {
        current = `${current}${current.endsWith('/') ? '' : '/'}${part}`;
        segments.push({
          // Presentation is case-preserving. Never case-fold breadcrumb labels.
          label: part,
          path: current,
          root: false,
          archiveBoundary: this.isArchiveBreadcrumb(part),
        });
      }
      return segments;
    }

    const drive = /^([a-z]:)(?:\/(.*))?$/i.exec(normalized);
    if (drive) {
      const segments: BreadcrumbSegment[] = [{
        label: drive[1],
        path: `${drive[1]}/`,
        root: true,
        archiveBoundary: false,
      }];
      let current = `${drive[1]}/`;
      for (const part of (drive[2] ?? '').split('/').filter(Boolean)) {
        current = `${current.replace(/\/$/, '')}/${part}`;
        segments.push({
          label: part,
          path: current,
          root: false,
          archiveBoundary: this.isArchiveBreadcrumb(part),
        });
      }
      return segments;
    }

    const parts = normalized.split('/').filter(Boolean);
    const segments: BreadcrumbSegment[] = [{
      label: '/',
      path: '/',
      root: true,
      archiveBoundary: false,
    }];
    let current = '';
    for (const part of parts) {
      current += `/${part}`;
      segments.push({
          label: part,
          path: current,
          root: false,
          archiveBoundary: this.isArchiveBreadcrumb(part),
        });
    }
    return segments;
  }

  private isArchiveBreadcrumb(label: string): boolean {
    return /\.(?:zip|7z|rar|tar|tgz|gz|bz2|xz|jar|war|ear|apk|cbz|cbr)$/i.test(
      label,
    );
  }

  onDisplayPathClick(event: MouseEvent): void {
    if (this.editing) return;

    const target = event.target as HTMLElement | null;
    if (target?.closest('button, input, a, [role="button"]')) return;

    this.beginEdit();
  }

  navigateToSegment(segment: BreadcrumbSegment): void {
    if (!segment.path || segment.path === this.path) return;
    this.navigate.emit(segment.path);
  }

  ngOnChanges(changes: SimpleChanges): void {
    if (changes['path'] && !this.editing) {
      this.scheduleBreadcrumbScrollToEnd();
    }
  }

  ngAfterViewInit(): void {
    this.scheduleBreadcrumbScrollToEnd();
  }

  onBreadcrumbWheel(event: WheelEvent): void {
    const el = this.breadcrumbs?.nativeElement;
    if (!el || el.scrollWidth <= el.clientWidth) return;

    const delta =
      Math.abs(event.deltaX) > Math.abs(event.deltaY)
        ? event.deltaX
        : event.deltaY;

    if (!delta) return;
    el.scrollLeft += delta;
    event.preventDefault();
  }

  private scheduleBreadcrumbScrollToEnd(): void {
    queueMicrotask(() => {
      const el = this.breadcrumbs?.nativeElement;
      if (!el || this.editing) return;
      el.scrollLeft = el.scrollWidth;
    });
  }

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.input.registerContext({
      id: this.contextId,
      kind: 'overlay',
      priority: 250,
      parentId: 'reassembly.manager',
      description: `Reassembly location editor (${this.paneId})`,
    });

    this.input.registerCommandDescriptor({
      id: this.commandId(COMMAND.accept),
      title: 'Open Location',
      category: 'Navigation',
      execute: () => this.acceptEdit(),
    }, this.ownerId);

    this.input.registerCommandDescriptor({
      id: this.commandId(COMMAND.cancel),
      title: 'Cancel Location Edit',
      category: 'Navigation',
      execute: () => this.cancelEdit(),
    }, this.ownerId);

    this.input.registerCommandDescriptor({
      id: this.commandId(COMMAND.next),
      title: 'Next Location Suggestion',
      category: 'Navigation',
      execute: () => this.moveSuggestion(1),
    }, this.ownerId);

    this.input.registerCommandDescriptor({
      id: this.commandId(COMMAND.previous),
      title: 'Previous Location Suggestion',
      category: 'Navigation',
      execute: () => this.moveSuggestion(-1),
    }, this.ownerId);

    this.input.registerCommandDescriptor({
      id: this.commandId(COMMAND.complete),
      title: 'Show Location Suggestions',
      category: 'Navigation',
      execute: () => this.forceSourceSuggestions(),
    }, this.ownerId);

    this.bindings = editorBindings(this.paneId, this.contextId);
    for (const binding of this.bindings) {
      this.input.registerBinding(binding);
    }
  }

  ngOnDestroy(): void {
    if (this.blurTimer) {
      clearTimeout(this.blurTimer);
      this.blurTimer = null;
    }

    this.input.deactivateContext(this.contextId);

    for (const binding of this.bindings) {
      this.input.unregisterBinding(binding.id);
    }

    for (const commandName of Object.values(COMMAND)) {
      this.input.unregisterCommandDescriptor(this.commandId(commandName), this.ownerId);
    }
  }

  beginEdit(): void {
    if (this.editing) {
      this.focusAndSelect();
      return;
    }

    this.editing = true;
    this.value = formatSearchAliasForEdit(this.path) ?? formatPathForDisplay(this.path || '/');
    this.suggestions = [];
    this.suggestionIndex = -1;
    this.activateEditorContext();
    this.cdr.detectChanges();
    this.focusAndSelect();

    queueMicrotask(() => this.focusAndSelect());
    void this.refreshSuggestions();
  }

  activateEditorContext(): void {
    if (!this.editing) return;
    this.input.activateContext(this.contextId);
  }

  onBlur(): void {
    if (this.blurTimer) clearTimeout(this.blurTimer);
    this.blurTimer = setTimeout(() => {
      this.blurTimer = null;
      if (this.editing) {
        this.cancelEdit();
      }
    }, 0);
  }

  onValueChange(value: string): void {
    this.value = value;
    this.suggestionIndex = -1;
    void this.refreshSuggestions();
  }

  chooseSuggestion(index: number): void {
    const suggestion = this.suggestions[index];
    if (!suggestion) return;
    this.value = formatPathForDisplay(suggestion.path);
    this.acceptEdit(suggestion.path);
  }

  cancelEdit(): void {
    if (!this.editing) return;

    if (this.blurTimer) {
      clearTimeout(this.blurTimer);
      this.blurTimer = null;
    }

    this.editing = false;
    this.value = '';
    this.suggestions = [];
    this.suggestionIndex = -1;
    this.input.deactivateContext(this.contextId);
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
  }

  private acceptEdit(explicitPath?: string): void {
    const candidate = explicitPath ?? (
      this.suggestionIndex >= 0
        ? this.suggestions[this.suggestionIndex]?.path
        : undefined
    ) ?? this.value;

    const resolvedCandidate = this.resolveImplicitAddressRoot(candidate) ?? candidate;
    const normalized = normalizeAddressBarPathInput(resolvedCandidate, this.path);
    if (!normalized) return;

    this.cancelEdit();
    this.navigate.emit(normalized);
  }

  private async moveSuggestion(delta: -1 | 1): Promise<void> {
    if (this.suggestions.length === 0) {
      await this.forceSourceSuggestions();
    }
    if (this.suggestions.length === 0) return;

    if (this.suggestionIndex < 0) {
      this.suggestionIndex = delta > 0 ? 0 : this.suggestions.length - 1;
    } else {
      this.suggestionIndex = (
        this.suggestionIndex + delta + this.suggestions.length
      ) % this.suggestions.length;
    }

    const suggestion = this.suggestions[this.suggestionIndex];
    if (suggestion) {
      this.value = formatPathForDisplay(suggestion.path);
    }

    this.cdr.markForCheck();
  }

  private splitSourceAutocompleteContext(value: string): { dirPath: string; prefix: string } | null {
    const raw = (value || '').trim().replace(/\\/g, '/');
    if (!raw) return null;

    const resolvedRaw = this.resolveImplicitAddressRoot(raw) ?? raw;
    const normalized = normalizeAddressBarPathInput(resolvedRaw, this.path);
    if (!normalized) return null;

    // The editor displays Windows roots as C:/ while the source boundary uses
    // filesystem://c/. Treat the root itself as the directory context.
    if (/^[a-z]:\/$/i.test(raw)) {
      const root = normalizePath(normalized);
      return {
        dirPath: root.endsWith('/') ? root : `${root}/`,
        prefix: '',
      };
    }

    // Scheme roots are complete directory contexts too.
    if (/^[a-z][a-z0-9+.-]*:\/\/$/i.test(raw)) {
      return { dirPath: raw, prefix: '' };
    }

    // A trailing slash means "list this directory".
    if (raw.endsWith('/')) {
      return { dirPath: normalized, prefix: '' };
    }

    const normalizedSlashes = normalized.replace(/\\/g, '/');
    const slash = normalizedSlashes.lastIndexOf('/');
    if (slash < 0) {
      return { dirPath: this.path || '/', prefix: raw };
    }

    return {
      dirPath: normalizedSlashes.slice(0, slash + 1),
      prefix: normalizedSlashes.slice(slash + 1),
    };
  }

  private resolveImplicitAddressRoot(value: string): string | null {
    const raw = (value || '').trim();
    if (!raw) return null;

    const normalized = raw
      .replace(/\\/g, '/')
      .replace(/:(?:\/\/?)?$/, '')
      .trim()
      .toLowerCase();

    if (!normalized || normalized.includes('/')) {
      return null;
    }

    if (/^[a-z]$/i.test(normalized)) {
      return `${normalized.toUpperCase()}:`;
    }

    for (const root of SOURCE_ROOT_SUGGESTIONS) {
      const resolved = this.panelSources.resolve({
        path: root.path,
        entries: [],
        inArchive: false,
      });
      if (resolved.source.kind === 'filesystem') continue;

      const schemeName = root.path.slice(0, root.path.indexOf(':')).toLowerCase();
      const displayName = root.displayName.toLowerCase();
      if (normalized === schemeName || normalized === displayName) {
        return root.path;
      }
    }

    return null;
  }

  private async forceSourceSuggestions(): Promise<void> {
    if (!this.editing) return;

    const generation = ++this.suggestionGeneration;
    const split = this.splitSourceAutocompleteContext(this.value);
    if (!split) {
      await this.refreshSuggestions();
      return;
    }

    try {
      const context = {
        path: split.dirPath,
        entries: [] as FileInfo[],
        inArchive: false,
      };
      const resolved = this.panelSources.resolve(context);
      const listing = await resolved.source.list(context, false);

      if (generation !== this.suggestionGeneration || !this.editing) return;

      const prefix = split.prefix.toLowerCase();
      const seen = new Set<string>();
      const suggestions: PathSuggestion[] = [];

      for (const entry of listing.entries) {
        if (entry.type !== FileType.DIRECTORY) continue;
        if (prefix && !entry.name.toLowerCase().startsWith(prefix)) continue;
        if (seen.has(entry.path)) continue;
        seen.add(entry.path);

        suggestions.push({
          path: entry.path,
          displayName: entry.name,
          matchType: 'directory',
          score: 100,
          exists: true,
        });

        // Keep the live dropdown bounded even when a source contains thousands
        // of records. Source-specific optimized completion can replace list()
        // later without changing the address-bar command contract.
        if (suggestions.length >= 100) break;
      }

      suggestions.sort((left, right) =>
        left.displayName.localeCompare(right.displayName),
      );

      this.suggestions = suggestions;
      this.suggestionIndex = suggestions.length > 0 ? 0 : -1;
      this.cdr.markForCheck();
    } catch {
      if (generation !== this.suggestionGeneration || !this.editing) return;
      this.suggestions = [];
      this.suggestionIndex = -1;
      this.cdr.markForCheck();
    }
  }

  private async refreshSuggestions(): Promise<void> {
    const generation = ++this.suggestionGeneration;

    try {
      const historySuggestions = await this.history.getSuggestions(this.value, this.path);
      if (generation !== this.suggestionGeneration || !this.editing) return;

      const query = this.value.trim();
      const sourceSuggestions = this.buildSourceRootSuggestions(query);
      const seen = new Set<string>();
      const suggestions = [...sourceSuggestions, ...historySuggestions].filter(suggestion => {
        const key = suggestion.path.toLowerCase();
        if (seen.has(key)) return false;
        seen.add(key);
        return true;
      });

      this.suggestions = suggestions.sort((left, right) => {
        const leftScore = fuzzyPathScore(query, left.displayName, left.path);
        const rightScore = fuzzyPathScore(query, right.displayName, right.path);
        return rightScore - leftScore || right.score - left.score;
      });
      this.suggestionIndex = -1;
      this.cdr.markForCheck();
    } catch {
      if (generation !== this.suggestionGeneration || !this.editing) return;

      this.suggestions = [];
      this.suggestionIndex = -1;
      this.cdr.markForCheck();
    }
  }

  private buildSourceRootSuggestions(query: string): PathSuggestion[] {
    const normalizedQuery = query.trim().toLowerCase();
    const results: PathSuggestion[] = [];

    for (const root of SOURCE_ROOT_SUGGESTIONS) {
      const resolved = this.panelSources.resolve({
        path: root.path,
        entries: [],
        inArchive: false,
      });

      // Optional/plugin roots (for example Registry) only appear when a real
      // PanelSource owns them. bin:// is built in and therefore always resolves
      // to the dedicated BinPanelSource rather than the filesystem fallback.
      if (resolved.source.kind === 'filesystem') continue;

      const schemeName = root.path.slice(0, root.path.indexOf(':'));
      const matches = !normalizedQuery ||
        root.path.toLowerCase().startsWith(normalizedQuery) ||
        schemeName.startsWith(normalizedQuery) ||
        root.displayName.toLowerCase().includes(normalizedQuery);
      if (!matches) continue;

      results.push({
        path: root.path,
        displayName: root.displayName,
        matchType: 'directory',
        score: 140,
        exists: true,
      });
    }

    return results;
  }

  private focusAndSelect(): void {
    const input = this.editor?.nativeElement;
    if (!input) return;

    input.focus();
    input.select();
    this.scrollEditorToEnd(input);

    // Angular/ngModel and browser selection painting may update the input's
    // horizontal viewport after select(). Re-apply the tail position once the
    // DOM has settled so long paths always open showing their rightmost part.
    requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      if (this.editor?.nativeElement === input && this.editing) {
        this.scrollEditorToEnd(input);
      }
    });
  }

  private scrollEditorToEnd(input: HTMLInputElement): void {
    input.scrollLeft = input.scrollWidth;
  }
}
`````

`````typescript
import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';

const app = readFileSync(new URL('../app.component.ts', import.meta.url), 'utf8');
const dual = readFileSync(new URL('./dual-pane.component.ts', import.meta.url), 'utf8');

const globalOverlays = [
  'app-command-palette',
  'app-global-search',
  'app-tools-center',
  'app-disk-usage-dialog',
  'app-selection-basket',
  'app-workspace-switcher',
  'app-path-history',
  'app-quick-access',
  'app-remote-connections',
  'app-closed-tabs',
  'app-operation-journal',
  'app-keyboard-help',
  'app-input-center',
];

describe('application overlay ownership', () => {
  it('mounts user-openable overlays at the application shell', () => {
    for (const selector of globalOverlays) {
      expect(app).withContext(selector).toContain(`<${selector}`);
    }
  });

  it('keeps the pane manager free of global dialog ownership', () => {
    for (const selector of globalOverlays) {
      expect(dual).withContext(selector).not.toContain(`<${selector}`);
    }
  });

  it('keeps pane-local context menus inside DualPane', () => {
    expect(dual).toContain('<app-context-menu');
  });
});
`````

`````typescript
const binding = readFileSync(new URL('../../../../internal/app/bindings_archive_create.go', import.meta.url), 'utf8');

describe('two-way archive pane transfer', () => {
  it('makes top-level ZIP panes writable but keeps nested/non-ZIP archives read-only', () => {
    expect(sources).toContain('create: writableZip');
    expect(sources).toContain('/\\.zip(?:\\/|$)/i.test(context.path)');
  });

  it('routes filesystem-to-archive F5/F6 through archive import', () => {
    expect(dual).toContain('this.archiveService.importPaths(frame, selected)');
    expect(dual).toContain("if (operation === 'move')");
    expect(archive).toContain('ArchiveImportEntries');
  });

  it('keeps archive-to-archive disabled until a direct streaming bridge exists', () => {
    expect(dual).toContain('if (destination.contextState.isInArchive) return false;');
  });

  it('rewrites ZIPs transactionally instead of modifying them in place', () => {
    expect(binding).toContain('os.CreateTemp(filepath.Dir(resolvedArchive), ".archive-import-*.zip")');
    expect(binding).toContain('os.Rename(resolvedArchive, backup)');
    expect(binding).toContain('os.Rename(tmpPath, resolvedArchive)');
  });
});
`````

`````scss
  border-radius: 3px;
  font-size: 13px;
  font-family: inherit;
  cursor: pointer;
  border: 1px solid transparent;
  transition: background 0.15s;

  &--secondary {
    background: var(--vsc-button-secondary-background, var(--vsc-control-background));
    color: var(--vsc-button-secondary-foreground, var(--vsc-foreground));
    border-color: var(--vsc-button-secondary-border, var(--vsc-border-bright));

    &:hover {
      background: var(--vsc-button-secondary-hover-background, var(--vsc-border));
    }
  }

  &--primary {
    background: var(--vsc-button-primary-background, var(--vsc-button-background));
    color: var(--vsc-button-primary-foreground, var(--vsc-on-accent));

    &:hover:not(:disabled) {
      background: var(--vsc-button-primary-hover-background, var(--vsc-button-hover));
    }

    &:disabled {
      opacity: 0.5;
      cursor: not-allowed;
    }
  }
}
`````

`````typescript
import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';

const source = readFileSync(new URL('./bin-pane.component.ts', import.meta.url), 'utf8');

describe('Bin grouped cursor overflow geometry', () => {
  it('preserves the standard parent row inset after expand/collapse', () => {
    const selector = '.list.view-details.bin-grouped .list-content-track > .entry.bin-group-header,';
    const start = source.indexOf(selector);
    const end = source.indexOf('}', start);
    const block = source.slice(start, end + 1);

    expect(start).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(0);

    expect(block).toContain('margin-right: 4px;');
    expect(block).toContain('border-radius: 3px;');
  });

  it('adds hierarchy indentation without dropping the right inset or radius', () => {
    const selector = '.list.view-details.bin-grouped .list-content-track > .entry.bin-revision-row {';
    const start = source.indexOf(selector);
    const end = source.indexOf('}', start);
    const block = source.slice(start, end + 1);

    expect(start).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(0);
    expect(block).toContain('margin-left: 26px;');
    expect(block).toContain('margin-right: 4px;');
    expect(block).toContain('border-radius: 3px;');
  });

  it('keeps cursor and selection radius unchanged', () => {
    expect(source).toContain('.entry.bin-group-header.cursor,');
    expect(source).toContain('.entry.bin-revision-row.cursor,');
    expect(source).toContain('border-radius: 3px;');
  });
});
`````

`````typescript
import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';

const source = readFileSync(new URL('./bin-pane.component.ts', import.meta.url), 'utf8');

describe('Bin horizontal overflow cursor surface', () => {
  it('uses one intrinsic-width content track for header and every row', () => {
    expect(source).toContain('class="list-content-track"');
    expect(source).toContain('.list.view-details .list-content-track {');
    expect(source).toContain('grid-template-columns: minmax(100%, max-content);');
    expect(source).toContain('width: max-content;');
    expect(source).toContain('min-width: 100%;');
  });

  it('stretches cursor rows to the shared track instead of sizing each row independently', () => {
    const start = source.indexOf('.list.view-list .entry,\n    .list.view-details .entry,');
    const end = source.indexOf('}', start);
    const block = source.slice(start, end + 1);

    expect(start).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(0);
    expect(block).toContain('width: auto;');
    expect(block).toContain('min-width: 0;');
    expect(block).toContain('justify-self: stretch;');
    expect(block).not.toContain('width: 100%;');
  });

  it('keeps the Details header on the same track as rows', () => {
    const listOpen = source.indexOf('class="list"');
    const track = source.indexOf('class="list-content-track"', listOpen);
    const header = source.indexOf('class="details-header-viewport"', track);
    const entry = source.indexOf('class="entry"', header);
    const trackClose = source.indexOf('<div class="empty"', entry);

    expect(track).toBeGreaterThan(listOpen);
    expect(header).toBeGreaterThan(track);
    expect(entry).toBeGreaterThan(header);
    expect(trackClose).toBeGreaterThan(entry);
  });
});
`````

`````typescript
import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';

const dual = readFileSync(new URL('./dual-pane.component.ts', import.meta.url), 'utf8');
const api = readFileSync(new URL('../services/api.service.ts', import.meta.url), 'utf8');

const bindingsPath = new URL('../../../../internal/app/bindings_file_basics.go', import.meta.url);
const contractsPath = new URL('../../../../internal/contracts/trash_transfer.go', import.meta.url);
const bindings = readFileSync(bindingsPath, 'utf8');
const contracts = readFileSync(contractsPath, 'utf8');

describe('Recycle Bin operations integration', () => {
  it('uses one tracked backend operation for copy/restore transfers out of bin', () => {
    expect(dual).toContain('this.api.batchTransferTrash(');
    expect(api).toContain('BatchTransferTrash(request:');
    expect(bindings).toContain('func (a *App) BatchTransferTrash(');
    expect(bindings).toContain('a.StartOperation(opType, title, "bin://", req.DestinationDir)');
    expect(bindings).toContain('op.SetTotal(int64(len(req.IDs)), 0)');
    expect(bindings).toContain('op.UpdateProgress(');
    expect(bindings).toContain('op.IsCancelled()');
    expect(bindings).toContain('op.Complete()');
  });

  it('maps copy to COPY and restore-to-pane to MOVE operation kinds', () => {
    expect(bindings).toContain('opType = contracts.OpCopy');
    expect(bindings).toContain('title = "Copy from Recycle Bin"');
    expect(bindings).toContain('opType = contracts.OpMove');
    expect(bindings).toContain('title = "Restore from Recycle Bin"');
    expect(contracts).toContain('TrashTransferCopy');
    expect(contracts).toContain('TrashTransferRestore');
  });
  it('models filesystem to Recycle Bin as MOVE progress', () => {
    const batchService = readFileSync(
      new URL('../../../../internal/batch/service.go', import.meta.url),
      'utf8',
    );
    const transfers = readFileSync(
      new URL('../../../../internal/batch/transfers.go', import.meta.url),
      'utf8',
    );

    expect(batchService).toContain('opType = contracts.OpMove');
    expect(batchService).toContain('title = "Move to Recycle Bin"');
    expect(batchService).toContain('destination = "bin://"');
    expect(transfers).toContain('itemWork := work[path]');
    expect(transfers).toContain('itemWork.bytes');
  });

});
`````

`````typescript
import {
  FILE_MANAGER_BINDINGS,
  FILE_MANAGER_COMMANDS,
} from './command-registry';

describe('file manager command registry', () => {
  it('keeps command IDs stable and pane-scoped', () => {
    expect(FILE_MANAGER_COMMANDS.navigateUp).toBe('pane.nav.navigateUp');
    expect(FILE_MANAGER_COMMANDS.copyToOtherPane).toBe('pane.ctrl.copyToOther');
    expect(FILE_MANAGER_COMMANDS.openOperations).toBe('app.operations.open');
  });

  it('keeps binding ids unique', () => {
    const ids = FILE_MANAGER_BINDINGS.map(binding => binding.id);
    expect(new Set(ids).size).toBe(ids.length);
  });

  it('keeps every default binding attached to a known command id', () => {
    const commandIds = new Set<string>();
    for (const value of Object.values(FILE_MANAGER_COMMANDS)) {
      if (typeof value === 'string') commandIds.add(value);
    }
    for (let index = 1; index <= 9; index += 1) {
      commandIds.add(FILE_MANAGER_COMMANDS.jumpToTab(index));
    }

    for (const binding of FILE_MANAGER_BINDINGS) {
      expect(commandIds.has(binding.commandId))
        .withContext(binding.id)
        .toBe(true);
    }
  });
});
`````

`````typescript
/**

 */

  cursorRight:          'pane.cursor.right',

  createArchive:        'pane.files.createArchive',
} as const;

const NAV  = 'Navigation';
const TABS = 'Tab Management';
const FILES = 'File Operations';
const SRCH = 'Search & Filter';
const WS   = 'Workspaces';
const PANE = 'Pane Control';
const TOOLS = 'Tools';

type Mod = 'ctrl' | 'shift' | 'alt' | 'meta';

function kb(
  id: string,
  commandId: string,
  key: string,
  description: string,
  opts?: {
    modifiers?: Mod[];
    when?: string;
    stopPropagation?: boolean;
    category?: string;
  },
): InputBindingDefinition {
  return {
    id,
    commandId,
    contextId: 'global',
    source: 'default',
    description,
    category: opts?.category,
    when: opts?.when ?? '!typing && !quickAccess',
    preventDefault: true,
    stopPropagation: opts?.stopPropagation !== false,
    trigger: {
      device: 'keyboard',
      chord: {
        steps: [{ key, modifiers: opts?.modifiers?.length ? opts.modifiers : undefined }],
      },
    },
  };
}

function chord(
  id: string,
  commandId: string,
  s1: { key: string; modifiers?: Mod[] },
  s2: { key: string; modifiers?: Mod[] },
  description: string,
  category: string,
): InputBindingDefinition {
  return {
    id,
    commandId,
    contextId: 'global',
    source: 'default',
    description,
    category,
    when: '!typing && !quickAccess',
    preventDefault: true,
    stopPropagation: true,
    trigger: {
      device: 'keyboard',
      chord: {
        steps: [
          { key: s1.key, modifiers: s1.modifiers?.length ? s1.modifiers : undefined },
          { key: s2.key, modifiers: s2.modifiers?.length ? s2.modifiers : undefined },
        ],
      },
    },
  };
}

// ─── Binding catalog ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export const FILE_MANAGER_BINDINGS: InputBindingDefinition[] = [

  // ── Navigation ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  kb('pane.nav.openCommandPalette.ctrlShiftP', FILE_MANAGER_COMMANDS.openCommandPalette, 'p', 'Open command palette', { modifiers: ['ctrl', 'shift'], category: NAV }),
  kb('pane.nav.openGlobalSearch.ctrlK', FILE_MANAGER_COMMANDS.openGlobalSearch, 'k', 'Open global search', { modifiers: ['ctrl'], category: NAV }),
  chord('pane.nav.openGlobalSearch.gs', FILE_MANAGER_COMMANDS.openGlobalSearch, { key: 'g' }, { key: 's' }, 'Open global search (G then S)', NAV),
  kb('pane.nav.showPathHistory.ctrlH', FILE_MANAGER_COMMANDS.showPathHistory, 'h', 'Show path history', { modifiers: ['ctrl'], category: NAV }),
  chord('pane.nav.showPathHistory.gh', FILE_MANAGER_COMMANDS.showPathHistory, { key: 'g' }, { key: 'h' }, 'Show path history (G then H)', NAV),
  kb('pane.nav.quickPathJump.ctrlP', FILE_MANAGER_COMMANDS.quickPathJump, 'p', 'Quick path jump', { modifiers: ['ctrl'], category: NAV }),
  kb('pane.nav.navigateUp.backspace', FILE_MANAGER_COMMANDS.navigateUp, 'backspace', 'Go to parent directory', { category: NAV }),
  kb('pane.nav.refresh.ctrlR', FILE_MANAGER_COMMANDS.refresh, 'r', 'Refresh current pane', { modifiers: ['ctrl'], category: NAV }),
  kb('pane.nav.showKeyboardHelp.ctrlSlash', FILE_MANAGER_COMMANDS.showKeyboardHelp, '/', 'Show keyboard shortcuts', { modifiers: ['ctrl'], category: NAV }),
  kb('pane.nav.openSettings.ctrlShiftS', FILE_MANAGER_COMMANDS.openSettings, 's', 'Open settings', { modifiers: ['ctrl', 'shift'], category: NAV }),

  // ── Cursor movement ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  kb('pane.cursor.up',       FILE_MANAGER_COMMANDS.cursorUp,        'arrowup',    'Move cursor up',              { category: NAV }),
  kb('pane.cursor.down',     FILE_MANAGER_COMMANDS.cursorDown,      'arrowdown',  'Move cursor down',            { category: NAV }),
  kb('pane.cursor.left',     FILE_MANAGER_COMMANDS.cursorLeft,      'arrowleft',  'Move cursor left',            { category: NAV }),
  kb('pane.cursor.right',    FILE_MANAGER_COMMANDS.cursorRight,     'arrowright', 'Move cursor right',           { category: NAV }),
  kb('pane.cursor.home',     FILE_MANAGER_COMMANDS.cursorHome,      'home',       'Move cursor to first item',   { category: NAV }),
  kb('pane.cursor.end',      FILE_MANAGER_COMMANDS.cursorEnd,       'end',        'Move cursor to last item',    { category: NAV }),
  kb('pane.cursor.pageUp',   FILE_MANAGER_COMMANDS.cursorPageUp,    'pageup',     'Move cursor up by page',      { category: NAV }),
  kb('pane.cursor.pageDown', FILE_MANAGER_COMMANDS.cursorPageDown,  'pagedown',   'Move cursor down by page',    { category: NAV }),

  // ── Tabs ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  kb('pane.tabs.new.ctrlT',          FILE_MANAGER_COMMANDS.newTab,       't',   'Open new tab',              { modifiers: ['ctrl'],          category: TABS }),
  kb('pane.tabs.close.ctrlW',        FILE_MANAGER_COMMANDS.closeTab,     'w',   'Close current tab',         { modifiers: ['ctrl'],          category: TABS }),
  kb('pane.tabs.next.ctrlTab',       FILE_MANAGER_COMMANDS.nextTab,      'tab', 'Switch to next tab',         { modifiers: ['ctrl'],          category: TABS }),
  kb('pane.tabs.prev.ctrlShiftTab',  FILE_MANAGER_COMMANDS.prevTab,      'tab', 'Switch to previous tab',    { modifiers: ['ctrl', 'shift'], category: TABS }),

  ...[1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9].map(i =>
`````

`````typescript
import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { resolve } from 'node:path';

describe('Testify @reassembly/core path alias ordering', () => {
  const root = resolve(import.meta.dirname, '../../../../..');

  for (const rel of [
    'manager/frontend/tsconfig.json',
    'plugins/registry/tsconfig.json',
    'plugins/registry/tsconfig.lib.json',
  ]) {
    it(`keeps the bare core alias after every public subpath in ${rel}`, () => {
      const config = JSON.parse(readFileSync(resolve(root, rel), 'utf8'));
      const keys = Object.keys(config.compilerOptions?.paths ?? {});
      const rootIndex = keys.indexOf('@reassembly/core');

      expect(rootIndex).toBeGreaterThan(-1);
      for (const key of keys) {
        if (!key.startsWith('@reassembly/core/')) continue;
        expect(keys.indexOf(key)).toBeLessThan(rootIndex);
      }
    });
  }
});
`````

## File: manager/frontend/src/app/components/file-view-events.controller.ts
`````typescript
import type { EventEmitter } from '@angular/core';
import type { FileInfo } from '../shared/protocol';
import { FileType } from '../shared/protocol';
import type { TreeNode } from './pane-tree.component';
import { PARENT_ENTRY_PATH } from './file-entry.component';

export interface FileViewEventsHost {
  selectionChange: EventEmitter<FileInfo[]>;
  navigate: EventEmitter<FileInfo>;
  openInNewTab: EventEmitter<FileInfo>;
  contextMenu: EventEmitter<{ event: MouseEvent; entry: FileInfo }>;
  nodeDoubleClick: EventEmitter<FileInfo>;
  rename: EventEmitter<{ entry: FileInfo; newName: string }>;
  setSelectedPaths(paths: string[]): void;
  setCursorPath(path: string | null): void;
}

export class FileViewEventsController {
  onSelectionChange(host: FileViewEventsHost, entries: FileInfo[]): void {
    host.setSelectedPaths(
      entries
        .map((entry) => entry.path)
        .filter((path) => path !== PARENT_ENTRY_PATH),
    );
    host.setCursorPath(entries.length > 0 ? entries[entries.length - 1].path : null);
    host.selectionChange.emit(entries);
  }

  onNavigate(host: FileViewEventsHost, entry: FileInfo | TreeNode | Event): void {
    const payload = this.toFileInfo(entry);
    if (!payload) return;
    host.navigate.emit(payload);
  }

  onContextMenu(host: FileViewEventsHost, event: { event: MouseEvent; entry: FileInfo }): void {
    host.contextMenu.emit(event);
  }

  onOpenInNewTab(host: FileViewEventsHost, entry: FileInfo): void {
    host.openInNewTab.emit(entry);
  }

  onTreeSelectionChange(host: FileViewEventsHost, nodes: TreeNode[]): void {
    const files = nodes.map((node) => this.treeNodeToFileInfo(node));
    host.setSelectedPaths(nodes.map((node) => node.path));
    host.setCursorPath(nodes.length > 0 ? nodes[nodes.length - 1].path : null);
    host.selectionChange.emit(files);
  }

  onTreeContextMenu(host: FileViewEventsHost, event: { event: MouseEvent; node: TreeNode }): void {
    host.contextMenu.emit({ event: event.event, entry: this.treeNodeToFileInfo(event.node) });
  }

  onTreeRename(host: FileViewEventsHost, event: { node: TreeNode; newName: string }): void {
    host.rename.emit({
      entry: this.treeNodeToFileInfo(event.node),
      newName: event.newName,
    });
  }

  onTreeOpenInNewTab(host: FileViewEventsHost, node: TreeNode): void {
    host.openInNewTab.emit(this.treeNodeToFileInfo(node));
  }

  onTreeNodeDoubleClick(host: FileViewEventsHost, node: TreeNode): void {
    const file = this.treeNodeToFileInfo(node);
    if (!file) return;

    if (node.type === FileType.DIRECTORY) {
      host.navigate.emit(file);
      return;
    }

    host.nodeDoubleClick.emit(file);
  }

  treeNodeToFileInfo(node: TreeNode): FileInfo {
    return {
      name: node.name,
      path: node.path,
      type: node.type,
      size: node.size,
      modified: node.modified,
      created: node.created,
    } as FileInfo;
  }

  private toFileInfo(entry: FileInfo | TreeNode | Event): FileInfo | null {
    if (!entry || entry instanceof Event) return null;
    const candidate = entry as any;
    if (!candidate.path) return null;

    const payload: any = {
      name: candidate.name,
      path: candidate.path,
      type: candidate.type,
      size: candidate.size,
      modified: candidate.modified,
      created: candidate.created,
    };
    if (Array.isArray(candidate.nestedChain)) {
      payload.nestedChain = [...candidate.nestedChain];
    }
    return payload as FileInfo;
  }
}
`````

## File: manager/frontend/src/app/components/file-view-lifecycle.controller.ts
`````typescript
import type { ChangeDetectorRef, SimpleChanges } from '@angular/core';
import type { ViewLayout } from './pane-view-host.component';

export interface FileViewLifecycleHost {
  get currentView(): ViewLayout;
  sortEntries(): void;
  syncTreeToCurrentPath(): void;
  refreshCurrentTreePath(): void;
  resortTreeNodes(): void;
  markTreeNodesChanged(): void;
  markForCheck(): void;
}

export class FileViewLifecycleController {
  onChanges(host: FileViewLifecycleHost, changes: SimpleChanges): void {
    host.sortEntries();

    const switchedToTree = !!changes['currentView'] && host.currentView === 'tree';
    const treeRelevantChange = switchedToTree || !!changes['currentPath'] || !!changes['showHidden'];
    const treeEntriesChanged = host.currentView === 'tree' && !!changes['entries'];
    const treeSortChanged = host.currentView === 'tree' &&
      (!!changes['sortField'] || !!changes['sortDirection'] || !!changes['directoriesFirst']);

    if (host.currentView === 'tree' && treeRelevantChange) {
      host.syncTreeToCurrentPath();
      return;
    }

    if (treeEntriesChanged) {
      host.refreshCurrentTreePath();
      return;
    }

    if (treeSortChanged) {
      host.resortTreeNodes();
      host.markTreeNodesChanged();
      host.markForCheck();
    }
  }
}
`````

## File: manager/frontend/src/app/components/file-view-sort.controller.ts
`````typescript
import { FileType, type FileInfo } from '../shared/protocol';
import type { TreeNode } from './pane-tree.component';

export interface FileViewSortHost {
  get entries(): FileInfo[];
  get sortField(): string;
  get sortDirection(): 'asc' | 'desc';
  get directoriesFirst(): boolean;
  setSortedEntries(entries: FileInfo[]): void;
}

export class FileViewSortController {
  sortEntries(host: FileViewSortHost, parentEntryPath: string): void {
    const sorted = [...host.entries];
    const multiplier = host.sortDirection === 'asc' ? 1 : -1;

    sorted.sort((left, right) => {
      if (left.path === parentEntryPath) return -1;
      if (right.path === parentEntryPath) return 1;

      if (host.directoriesFirst) {
        if (left.type === FileType.DIRECTORY && right.type !== FileType.DIRECTORY) return -1;
        if (right.type === FileType.DIRECTORY && left.type !== FileType.DIRECTORY) return 1;
      }

      return this.compareEntries(host.sortField, multiplier, left, right);
    });

    host.setSortedEntries(sorted);
  }

  sortTreeNodes(host: FileViewSortHost, nodes: TreeNode[]): TreeNode[] {
    const multiplier = host.sortDirection === 'asc' ? 1 : -1;
    return [...nodes].sort((left, right) => {
      if (host.directoriesFirst) {
        const leftIsDir = left.type === FileType.DIRECTORY || left.type === FileType.ARCHIVE;
        const rightIsDir = right.type === FileType.DIRECTORY || right.type === FileType.ARCHIVE;
        if (leftIsDir && !rightIsDir) return -1;
        if (!leftIsDir && rightIsDir) return 1;
      }

      return this.compareByField(host.sortField, multiplier, left, right);
    });
  }

  resortAllLoadedTreeNodes(host: FileViewSortHost, nodes: TreeNode[]): void {
    for (const node of nodes) {
      if (!node.children?.length) continue;
      node.children = this.sortTreeNodes(host, node.children);
      this.resortAllLoadedTreeNodes(host, node.children);
    }
  }

  private compareEntries(
    sortField: string,
    multiplier: number,
    left: FileInfo,
    right: FileInfo,
  ): number {
    return this.compareByField(sortField, multiplier, left, right);
  }

  private compareByField(
    sortField: string,
    multiplier: number,
    left: Pick<FileInfo, 'name' | 'type' | 'size' | 'modified' | 'registryKind' | 'registryValueType' | 'registryPreview' | 'searchParentPath'>,
    right: Pick<FileInfo, 'name' | 'type' | 'size' | 'modified' | 'registryKind' | 'registryValueType' | 'registryPreview' | 'searchParentPath'>,
  ): number {
    let comparison = 0;
    switch (sortField) {
      case 'name':
        comparison = left.name.localeCompare(right.name);
        break;
      case 'size':
        comparison = (left.size || 0) - (right.size || 0);
        break;
      case 'modified':
        comparison = (left.modified || 0) - (right.modified || 0);
        break;
      case 'type': {
        const leftType = this.sortTypeLabel(left);
        const rightType = this.sortTypeLabel(right);
        comparison = leftType.localeCompare(rightType);
        break;
      }
      case 'registryKind':
        comparison = (left.registryKind || '').localeCompare(right.registryKind || '');
        break;
      case 'registryValueType':
        comparison = (left.registryValueType || '').localeCompare(right.registryValueType || '');
        break;
      case 'registryPreview':
        comparison = (left.registryPreview || '').localeCompare(right.registryPreview || '');
        break;
      case 'searchParentPath':
        comparison = (left.searchParentPath || '').localeCompare(right.searchParentPath || '');
        break;
      default:
        comparison = left.name.localeCompare(right.name);
    }
    return comparison * multiplier;
  }

  private sortTypeLabel(entry: Pick<FileInfo, 'name' | 'type'>): string {
    return entry.type === FileType.DIRECTORY || entry.type === FileType.ARCHIVE
      ? 'folder'
      : (entry.name.split('.').pop() || '');
  }
}
`````

`````typescript
export class FilterDropdownComponent implements OnChanges, OnDestroy, OnInit {

  @Input() presets:    FilterPreset[] = [];
  @Input() selected:   FilterPreset[] = [];
  @Input() hasDynamic = false;
  @Input() contextId = 'overlay.filter.category';

  @Output() itemToggle      = new EventEmitter<FilterPreset>();
  @Output() clearAll        = new EventEmitter<void>();
  @Output() refresh         = new EventEmitter<void>();
  @Output() groupModeChange = new EventEmitter<{ group: string; mode: 'AND' | 'OR' }>();
  @Output() closeRequested  = new EventEmitter<void>();

  groups: FilterGroup[] = [];
  private groupModes = new Map<string, 'AND' | 'OR'>();
  private focusedGroupName: string | null = null;
  private focusedPresetId: string | null = null;
  private readonly commandOwner = `filterDropdown:${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8)}`;
  private releaseOverlayContext: (() => void) | null = null;

  // Define which groups are OR vs AND
  private readonly orGroups = new Set(['Basic', 'Extensions', 'Other']);
  private readonly andGroups = new Set(['Date', 'Size', 'Special']);

  constructor(
    private cdr: ChangeDetectorRef,
    private inputContexts: InputContextService,
    private inputEngine: InputEngineService,
  ) {}

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.initializeGroupModes();
    this.registerInputCommands();
    this.releaseOverlayContext ??= this.inputContexts.acquire(this.contextId);
  }

  ngOnChanges(changes: SimpleChanges): void {
    if (changes['presets']) {
      this.buildGroups();
    }
  }

  ngOnDestroy(): void {
    this.releaseOverlayContext?.();
    this.releaseOverlayContext = null;
    this.unregisterInputCommands();
  }

  private initializeGroupModes(): void {
    // OR groups
    this.orGroups.forEach(group => this.groupModes.set(group, 'OR'));
    // AND groups
    this.andGroups.forEach(group => this.groupModes.set(group, 'AND'));
  }

  isSelected(preset: FilterPreset): boolean {
    return this.selected.some(p => p.id === preset.id);
  }

  getGroupMode(group: string): 'AND' | 'OR' {
    return this.groupModes.get(group) ?? 'OR';
  }

  onItemClick(preset: FilterPreset, event: MouseEvent): void {
    event.preventDefault();
    event.stopPropagation();
    this.itemToggle.emit(preset);
  }

  onClearAllClick(event: MouseEvent): void {
    event.preventDefault();
    event.stopPropagation();
    this.clearAll.emit();
  }

  onRefreshClick(event: MouseEvent): void {
    event.preventDefault();
    event.stopPropagation();
    this.refresh.emit();
  }

  isFocused(groupName: string, presetId: string): boolean {
    return this.focusedGroupName === groupName && this.focusedPresetId === presetId;
  }

  setFocusedItem(groupName: string, presetId: string): void {
    this.focusedGroupName = groupName;
    this.focusedPresetId = presetId;
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
    this.focusFocusedItem();
  }

  private buildGroups(): void {
    const map = new Map<string, FilterPreset[]>();
    
    for (const p of this.presets) {
      const g = p.group || 'Other';
      if (!map.has(g)) map.set(g, []);
      map.get(g)!.push(p);
    }

    this.groups = Array.from(map.entries())
      .sort((a, b) => {
        const groupA = a[0];
        const groupB = b[0];
        
        const aIsOr = this.orGroups.has(groupA);
        const bIsOr = this.orGroups.has(groupB);
        
        if (aIsOr && !bIsOr) return -1;
        if (!aIsOr && bIsOr) return 1;
        
        const ia = GROUP_ORDER.indexOf(groupA);
        const ib = GROUP_ORDER.indexOf(groupB);
        return (ia === -1 ? 999 : ia) - (ib === -1 ? 999 : ib);
      })
      .map(([name, presets]) => ({ 
        name, 
        presets: this.sortPresetsByCount(presets)
      }));

    const firstPreset = this.groups[0]?.presets[0] ?? null;
    if (firstPreset) {
      this.focusedGroupName ??= this.groups[0].name;
      this.focusedPresetId ??= firstPreset.id;
    } else {
      this.focusedGroupName = null;
      this.focusedPresetId = null;
    }
    
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
    this.focusFocusedItem();
  }

  private sortPresetsByCount(presets: FilterPreset[]): FilterPreset[] {
    return [...presets].sort((a, b) => {
      const countA = a.count ?? 0;
      const countB = b.count ?? 0;
      if (countA !== countB) return countB - countA;
      return a.name.localeCompare(b.name);
    });
  }

  private moveFocus(delta: number): void {
    const items = this.groups.flatMap(group => group.presets.map(preset => ({ groupName: group.name, preset })));
    if (items.length === 0) return;

    const currentIndex = items.findIndex(item => this.isFocused(item.groupName, item.preset.id));
    const baseIndex = currentIndex >= 0 ? currentIndex : 0;
    const nextIndex = Math.max(0, Math.min(items.length - 1, baseIndex + delta));
    this.focusedGroupName = items[nextIndex].groupName;
    this.focusedPresetId = items[nextIndex].preset.id;
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
    this.focusFocusedItem();
  }

  private toggleFocused(): void {
    const preset = this.groups
      .flatMap(group => group.presets)
      .find(item => item.id === this.focusedPresetId);
    if (!preset) return;
    this.itemToggle.emit(preset);
  }

  private registerInputCommands(): void {
    const prefix = this.contextId === 'overlay.filter.presets' ? 'overlay.filter.presets' : 'overlay.filter.category';

    this.inputEngine.registerCommand(`${prefix}.close`, () => {
      this.closeRequested.emit();
    }, this.commandOwner);

    this.inputEngine.registerCommand(`${prefix}.prevItem`, () => {
      this.moveFocus(-1);
    }, this.commandOwner);

    this.inputEngine.registerCommand(`${prefix}.nextItem`, () => {
      this.moveFocus(1);
    }, this.commandOwner);

    this.inputEngine.registerCommand(`${prefix}.select`, () => {
      this.toggleFocused();
    }, this.commandOwner);
  }

  private unregisterInputCommands(): void {
    const prefix = this.contextId === 'overlay.filter.presets' ? 'overlay.filter.presets' : 'overlay.filter.category';
    this.inputEngine.unregisterCommand(`${prefix}.close`, this.commandOwner);
    this.inputEngine.unregisterCommand(`${prefix}.prevItem`, this.commandOwner);
    this.inputEngine.unregisterCommand(`${prefix}.nextItem`, this.commandOwner);
    this.inputEngine.unregisterCommand(`${prefix}.select`, this.commandOwner);
  }

  private focusFocusedItem(): void {
    requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      const item = document.querySelector<HTMLElement>('.fd-item.fd-item--focused');
      item?.focus({ preventScroll: true });
    });
  }
}
`````

`````typescript
import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';

const read = (name: string) =>
  readFileSync(new URL(`./${name}`, import.meta.url), 'utf8');

describe('details-row cursor width', () => {
  it('uses viewport-width Details rows in all Directory-family panes', () => {
    for (const name of [
      'directory-pane.component.ts',
      'registry-pane.component.ts',
      'autorun-pane.component.ts',
      'network-pane.component.ts',
      'environment-pane.component.ts',

      const source = read(name);
      const start = source.indexOf('.list.view-details .entry {');
      const block = source.slice(start, source.indexOf('}', start) + 1);
      expect(block).toContain('width: 100%');
      expect(block).toContain('min-width: 100%');
    }
  });

  it('does not require intrinsic-width FileDetails rows', () => {
    const source = read('pane-details.component.ts');
    expect(source).not.toContain('width: max-content;');
    expect(source).toContain('.details-window.virtual-window');

  it('keeps SystemTable row-width behavior scoped to SystemTable', () => {
    const source = read('system-table-pane.component.ts');
    expect(source).toContain('.row {display:grid; width:max-content;min-width:100%;');
`````

`````typescript
import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';

describe('inactive pane entry activation ordering', () => {
  const paneFiles = [
    'directory-pane.component.ts',
    'bin-pane.component.ts',
    'registry-pane.component.ts',
    'autorun-pane.component.ts',
  ];

  it('does not activate DirectoryPane-derived surfaces on mousedown', () => {
    for (const name of paneFiles) {
      const source = readFileSync(new URL(`./${name}`, import.meta.url), 'utf8');
      expect(source).withContext(name)
        .not.toContain('(mousedown)="activateRequested.emit()"');
      expect(source).withContext(name)
        .toContain('(focusin)="activateRequested.emit()"');
    }
  });

  it('activates dual-pane slots after child click handlers, not on pointerdown', () => {
    const source = readFileSync(new URL('./dual-pane.component.ts', import.meta.url), 'utf8');
    expect(source).toContain(`(click)="activate('left')"`);
    expect(source).toContain(`(click)="activate('right')"`);
    expect(source).not.toContain(`(pointerdown)="activate('left')"`);
    expect(source).not.toContain(`(pointerdown)="activate('right')"`);
  });
});
`````

## File: manager/frontend/src/app/components/pane-clipboard.controller.ts
`````typescript
import type { FileInfo } from '../shared/protocol';
import type { ArchiveFrame } from '../services/archive.service';
import { ArchiveService } from '../services/archive.service';
import { ApiService } from '../services/api.service';
import { FileClipboardService } from '../services/file-clipboard.service';
import { OperationHistoryService } from '../services/operation-history.service';
import { ActionFeedbackService } from '../services/action-feedback.service';
import { ConfirmDialogService } from '../services/confirm-dialog.service';

export interface PaneClipboardHost {
  readonly paneId: 'left' | 'right';
  readonly path: string;
  readonly selectedEntries: readonly FileInfo[];
  readonly canCut: boolean;
  readonly canPaste: boolean;
  readonly currentArchiveFrame: ArchiveFrame | null;
  refresh(): Promise<void>;
  focusContent?(): void;
}

/** Shared pane-local clipboard behavior for directory-capable pane implementations. */
export class PaneClipboardController {
  constructor(
    private readonly clipboard: FileClipboardService,
    private readonly api: ApiService,
    private readonly archive: ArchiveService,
    private readonly history: OperationHistoryService,
    private readonly feedback: ActionFeedbackService,
    private readonly confirm: ConfirmDialogService,
  ) {}

  copy(host: PaneClipboardHost): void {
    const entries = host.selectedEntries;
    if (!entries.length) return;

    this.clipboard.set({
      operation: 'copy',
      paths: entries.map(entry => entry.path),
      sourcePaneId: host.paneId,
      archiveFrame: this.cloneArchiveFrame(host.currentArchiveFrame),
    });
  }

  cut(host: PaneClipboardHost): void {
    if (!host.canCut) return;
    const entries = host.selectedEntries;
    if (!entries.length) return;

    this.clipboard.set({
      operation: 'cut',
      paths: entries.map(entry => entry.path),
      sourcePaneId: host.paneId,
      archiveFrame: this.cloneArchiveFrame(host.currentArchiveFrame),
    });
  }

  async paste(host: PaneClipboardHost): Promise<void> {
    const payload = this.clipboard.payload;
    if (!payload || !host.canPaste) return;

    try {
      if (payload.archiveFrame) {
        const result = payload.operation === 'copy'
          ? await this.archive.copy(payload.archiveFrame, payload.paths, host.path)
          : await this.archive.move(payload.archiveFrame, payload.paths, host.path);

        if (payload.operation === 'cut' && result.failed === 0 && result.sourceRemoved) {
          this.clipboard.clear();
        }

        await host.refresh();

        if (result.failed > 0) {
          await this.confirm.alert({
            title: 'Paste Completed with Errors',
            message: `${result.failed} archive entr${result.failed === 1 ? 'y' : 'ies'} could not be ${payload.operation === 'copy' ? 'extracted' : 'moved'}.`,
          });
        }
        return;
      }

      const items = await Promise.all(payload.paths.map(async source => ({
        source,
        destination: await this.api.joinPaths([host.path, this.leafName(source)]),
      })));

      const result = payload.operation === 'copy'
        ? await this.api.batchCopy(items, true)
        : await this.api.batchMove(items, true);

      const affected = result.affectedPaths ?? [];
      if (
        result.failed === 0 &&
        result.skipped === 0 &&
        affected.length === result.succeeded &&
        affected.length > 0
      ) {
        this.history.record({
          label: `${payload.operation === 'copy' ? 'Paste copy' : 'Paste move'} ${affected.length} item${affected.length === 1 ? '' : 's'}`,
          kind: payload.operation === 'copy' ? 'paste-copy' : 'paste-move',
          affectedPaths: affected.map(item => item.destination),
          summary: `${affected.length} item${affected.length === 1 ? '' : 's'}`,
          undo: async () => {
            if (payload.operation === 'copy') {
              const deletion = await this.api.batchDelete(
                affected.map(item => item.destination),
                true,
                false,
              );
              if (deletion.failed > 0 || deletion.skipped > 0) {
                throw new Error('Undo paste copy failed.');
              }
              return;
            }

            const back = await this.api.batchMove(
              affected.map(item => ({
                source: item.destination,
                destination: item.source,
                exactDestination: true,
              })),
              true,
            );
            if (back.failed > 0 || back.skipped > 0) {
              throw new Error('Undo paste move failed.');
            }
          },
          redo: async () => {
            const forward = affected.map(item => ({
              source: item.source,
              destination: item.destination,
              exactDestination: true,
            }));
            const redone = payload.operation === 'copy'
              ? await this.api.batchCopy(forward, true)
              : await this.api.batchMove(forward, true);
            if (redone.failed > 0 || redone.skipped > 0) {
              throw new Error('Redo paste operation failed.');
            }
          },
        });
      } else if (result.succeeded > 0 || result.failed > 0 || result.skipped > 0) {
        this.history.recordOutcome({
          label: `${payload.operation === 'copy' ? 'Paste copy' : 'Paste move'} ${result.total} item${result.total === 1 ? '' : 's'}`,
          kind: payload.operation === 'copy' ? 'paste-copy' : 'paste-move',
          reversible: false,
          affectedPaths: affected.map(item => item.destination),
          state: result.failed > 0 || result.skipped > 0 ? 'partial' : 'completed',
          summary: `${result.succeeded} succeeded · ${result.skipped} skipped · ${result.failed} failed`,
        });
      }

      if (payload.operation === 'cut' && result.failed === 0) {
        this.clipboard.clear();
      }

      if (result.failed === 0 && result.skipped === 0) {
        this.feedback.success(
          payload.operation === 'copy' ? 'Paste completed' : 'Move completed',
          `${result.succeeded} item${result.succeeded === 1 ? '' : 's'}`,
        );
      } else {
        this.feedback.warning(
          'Paste completed with issues',
          `${result.succeeded} succeeded · ${result.skipped} skipped · ${result.failed} failed`,
        );
      }

      // ApiService publishes filesystem copy/move mutations. The pane observer
      // reconciles the destination without a second eager directory reload.
      host.focusContent?.();

      if (result.failed > 0 || result.skipped > 0) {
        await this.confirm.alert({
          title: 'Paste Completed with Issues',
          message: [
            result.failed > 0
              ? `${result.failed} item${result.failed === 1 ? '' : 's'} failed.`
              : '',
            result.skipped > 0
              ? `${result.skipped} item${result.skipped === 1 ? '' : 's'} were skipped.`
              : '',
          ].filter(Boolean).join('\n'),
        });
      }
    } catch (error) {
      await this.confirm.alert({
        title: 'Paste Failed',
        message: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error),
      });
    }
  }

  private cloneArchiveFrame(frame: ArchiveFrame | null): ArchiveFrame | null {
    if (!frame) return null;
    return {
      ...frame,
      nestedChain: [...(frame.nestedChain ?? [])],
      listing: {
        ...frame.listing,
        entries: (frame.listing.entries ?? []).map(entry => ({ ...entry })),
      },
    };
  }

  private leafName(path: string): string {
    const normalized = (path ?? '').replace(/\\/g, '/').replace(/\/+$/, '');
    const index = normalized.lastIndexOf('/');
    return index >= 0 ? normalized.slice(index + 1) : normalized;
  }
}
`````

`````typescript
const read = (name: string) =>
  readFileSync(new URL(`./${name}`, import.meta.url), 'utf8');

describe('pane Details column resize architecture', () => {
  const resize = read('pane-details-resize-handle.directive.ts');
  const details = read('pane-details.component.ts');
  const directory = read('directory-pane.component.ts');
  const registry = read('registry-pane.component.ts');

  it('has exactly one mouse drag implementation for Details column resizing', () => {
    expect(resize).toContain("window.addEventListener('mousemove'");
    expect(resize).toContain("window.addEventListener('mouseup'");

      expect(consumer).not.toContain('onColumnResizeStart');

      expect(consumer).not.toContain('cleanupColumnResizeListeners');

    expect(directory).toContain("[paneDetailsResizeHandle]=\"'name'\"");
    expect(directory).toContain("[paneDetailsResizeHandle]=\"'bin-name'\"");

    expect(registry).toContain("[paneDetailsResizeHandle]=\"'value'\"");

  it('uses the same inherited width variables for header and rows', () => {
    expect(details).toContain('--details-column-');
    expect(directory).toContain('var(--details-column-name-width');
    expect(registry).toContain('var(--details-column-name-width');
`````
