## File: manager/frontend/src/app/components/pane-file-commands.controller.ts
`````typescript
import { FileInfo, FileType } from '../shared/protocol';
import { ApiService } from '../services/api.service';
import { ConfirmDialogService } from '../services/confirm-dialog.service';
import { OperationHistoryService } from '../services/operation-history.service';

export interface PaneFileCommandsHost {
  readonly path: string;
  readonly selectedEntries: readonly FileInfo[];
  readonly cursorEntry: FileInfo | null;
  readonly canCreate: boolean;
  readonly isDirectoryTab: boolean;
  readonly isInArchive: boolean;
  refresh(): Promise<void>;
  selectPath(path: string): void;
}

/** Shared creation/manipulation commands for directory-capable panes. */
export class PaneFileCommandsController {
  constructor(
    private readonly api: ApiService,
    private readonly confirm: ConfirmDialogService,
    private readonly history: OperationHistoryService,
  ) {}

  async newFile(host: PaneFileCommandsHost): Promise<void> {
    await this.createDocument(host, {
      title: 'New File',
      defaultName: 'New File.txt',
      content: '',
      historyKey: 'reassembly.newFile',
      historyLabel: 'Create file',
    });
  }

  async newDocumentTemplate(
    host: PaneFileCommandsHost,
    kind: 'text' | 'markdown' | 'json',
  ): Promise<void> {
    const templates = {
      text: { title: 'New Text Document', defaultName: 'New Text Document.txt', content: '' },
      markdown: { title: 'New Markdown Document', defaultName: 'README.md', content: '# Title\n\n' },
      json: { title: 'New JSON Document', defaultName: 'data.json', content: '{\n  \n}\n' },
    } as const;
    const template = templates[kind];
    await this.createDocument(host, {
      ...template,
      historyKey: `reassembly.newTemplate.${kind}`,
      historyLabel: `Create ${template.title.toLowerCase()}`,
    });
  }

  async duplicateSelected(host: PaneFileCommandsHost): Promise<void> {
    if (!this.canMutate(host) || !host.selectedEntries.length) return;
    try {
      const result = await this.api.batchCopy(
        host.selectedEntries.map(entry => ({ source: entry.path, destination: host.path, exactDestination: false })),
        true,
      );
      const affected = result.affectedPaths ?? [];
      if (result.failed === 0 && result.skipped === 0 && affected.length === result.succeeded && affected.length > 0) {
        this.history.record({
          label: `Duplicate ${affected.length} item${affected.length === 1 ? '' : 's'}`,
          undo: async () => {
            const deletion = await this.api.batchDelete(affected.map(item => item.destination), true, false);
            if (deletion.failed > 0) throw new Error('Undo duplicate failed.');
          },
          redo: async () => {
            const redone = await this.api.batchCopy(affected.map(item => ({
              source: item.source,
              destination: item.destination,
              exactDestination: true,
            })), true);
            if (redone.failed > 0 || redone.skipped > 0) throw new Error('Redo duplicate failed.');
          },
        });
      }
      await host.refresh();
      if (affected.length === 1) host.selectPath(affected[0].destination);
    } catch (error) {
      await this.showError('Duplicate', error);
    }
  }

  async moveSelectionToNewFolder(host: PaneFileCommandsHost): Promise<void> {
    if (!this.canMutate(host) || !host.selectedEntries.length) return;
    const entries = [...host.selectedEntries];
    const requested = await this.confirm.prompt({
      title: 'Move to New Folder',
      message: `Create a folder and move ${entries.length} selected item${entries.length === 1 ? '' : 's'} into it:`,
      confirmText: 'Create & Move',
      defaultValue: 'New Folder',
      historyKey: 'reassembly.moveSelectionToNewFolder',
    });
    const folderName = await this.validateRequestedLeaf(requested, host.path);
    if (!folderName) return;

    const sourcePaths = entries.map(entry => entry.path);
    try {
      const folderPath = await this.api.joinPaths([host.path, folderName]);
      await this.api.createDirectory(folderPath, false);
      const result = await this.api.batchMove(sourcePaths.map(source => ({
        source,
        destination: folderPath,
        exactDestination: false,
      })), true);
      const affected = result.affectedPaths ?? [];
      if (result.failed > 0 || result.skipped > 0 || affected.length !== sourcePaths.length) {
        throw new Error(`Move completed only partially (${result.succeeded}/${result.total}).`);
      }
      this.history.record({
        label: `Move ${affected.length} item${affected.length === 1 ? '' : 's'} to ${folderName}`,
        undo: async () => {
          const back = await this.api.batchMove(affected.map(item => ({
            source: item.destination,
            destination: item.source,
            exactDestination: true,
          })), true);
          if (back.failed > 0 || back.skipped > 0) throw new Error('Undo move-to-folder failed.');
          await this.api.deleteFile(folderPath, true, false);
        },
        redo: async () => {
          await this.api.createDirectory(folderPath, false);
          const forward = await this.api.batchMove(affected.map(item => ({
            source: item.source,
            destination: folderPath,
            exactDestination: false,
          })), true);
          if (forward.failed > 0 || forward.skipped > 0) throw new Error('Redo move-to-folder failed.');
        },
      });
      await host.refresh();
      host.selectPath(folderPath);
    } catch (error) {
      await this.showError('Move Selection to New Folder', error);
    }
  }

  async createLinkForSelected(host: PaneFileCommandsHost, kind: 'symbolic' | 'hard'): Promise<void> {
    if (!this.canMutate(host)) return;
    const entry = host.cursorEntry ?? host.selectedEntries[0];
    if (!entry || entry.path === '__parent__') return;
    if (kind === 'hard' && entry.type === FileType.DIRECTORY) {
      await this.confirm.alert({ title: 'Hard Link', message: 'Hard links to directories are not supported.' });
      return;
    }
    const requested = await this.confirm.prompt({
      title: kind === 'symbolic' ? 'Create Symbolic Link' : 'Create Hard Link',
      message: `Link to "${entry.name}" as:`,
      confirmText: 'Create',
      defaultValue: `${entry.name}${kind === 'symbolic' ? ' link' : ' hardlink'}`,
      historyKey: `reassembly.${kind}Link.name`,
    });
    const cleanName = await this.validateRequestedLeaf(requested, host.path);
    if (!cleanName) return;
    try {
      const destination = await this.api.joinPaths([host.path, cleanName]);
      const create = () => kind === 'symbolic'
        ? this.api.createSymbolicLink(entry.path, destination)
        : this.api.createHardLink(entry.path, destination);
      await create();
      this.history.record({
        label: `${kind === 'symbolic' ? 'Create symbolic link' : 'Create hard link'} ${cleanName}`,
        undo: () => this.api.deleteFile(destination, true, false),
        redo: async () => { await create(); },
      });
      await host.refresh();
      host.selectPath(destination);
    } catch (error) {
      await this.showError(kind === 'symbolic' ? 'Create Symbolic Link' : 'Create Hard Link', error);
    }
  }

  async createShortcutForSelected(host: PaneFileCommandsHost): Promise<void> {
    if (!this.canMutate(host)) return;
    const entry = host.cursorEntry ?? host.selectedEntries[0];
    if (!entry || entry.path === '__parent__') return;
    try {
      const osInfo = await this.api.getOSInfo();
      const windows = String(osInfo?.os).toLowerCase() === 'windows';
      let name = await this.confirm.prompt({
        title: 'Create Shortcut',
        message: `Create a shortcut to "${entry.name}" as:`,
        confirmText: 'Create',
        defaultValue: windows ? `${entry.name} - Shortcut.lnk` : `${entry.name} shortcut`,
        historyKey: 'reassembly.shortcut.name',
      });
      name = this.cleanLeafName(name);
      if (!name) {
        await this.confirm.alert({ title: 'Invalid Name', message: 'Choose a valid shortcut filename.' });
        return;
      }
      if (windows && !/\.lnk$/i.test(name)) name += '.lnk';
      if (!(await this.ensureLeafAvailable(host.path, name))) return;
      const destination = await this.api.joinPaths([host.path, name]);
      const create = () => this.api.createShortcut(entry.path, destination);
      await create();
      this.history.record({
        label: `Create shortcut ${name}`,
        undo: () => this.api.deleteFile(destination, true, false),
        redo: async () => { await create(); },
      });
      await host.refresh();
      host.selectPath(destination);
    } catch (error) {
      await this.showError('Create Shortcut', error);
    }
  }

  private async createDocument(
    host: PaneFileCommandsHost,
    spec: { title: string; defaultName: string; content: string; historyKey: string; historyLabel: string },
  ): Promise<void> {
    if (!host.canCreate || host.isInArchive) return;
    const requested = await this.confirm.prompt({
      title: spec.title,
      message: 'Enter a name for the new document.',
      confirmText: 'Create',
      defaultValue: spec.defaultName,
      historyKey: spec.historyKey,
    });
    const cleanName = await this.validateRequestedLeaf(requested, host.path);
    if (!cleanName) return;
    try {
      const destination = await this.api.joinPaths([host.path, cleanName]);
      const create = () => this.api.writeFile(destination, spec.content, 'utf8');
      await create();
      this.history.record({
        label: `${spec.historyLabel} ${cleanName}`,
        undo: () => this.api.deleteFile(destination, true, false),
        redo: async () => { await create(); },
      });
      await host.refresh();
      host.selectPath(destination);
    } catch (error) {
      await this.showError(spec.title, error);
    }
  }

  private canMutate(host: PaneFileCommandsHost): boolean {
    return host.isDirectoryTab && !host.isInArchive && host.canCreate;
  }

  private cleanLeafName(value: string | null): string {
    const clean = (value ?? '').trim();
    if (!clean || clean === '.' || clean === '..' || /[\/\\]/.test(clean) || /[<>:"|?*\u0000-\u001f]/.test(clean) || /[ .]$/.test(clean)) return '';
    const base = clean.split('.')[0].toUpperCase();
    const reserved = new Set(['CON','PRN','AUX','NUL','COM1','COM2','COM3','COM4','COM5','COM6','COM7','COM8','COM9','LPT1','LPT2','LPT3','LPT4','LPT5','LPT6','LPT7','LPT8','LPT9']);
    return reserved.has(base) ? '' : clean;
  }

  private async ensureLeafAvailable(directory: string, leafName: string): Promise<boolean> {
    const destination = await this.api.joinPaths([directory, leafName]);
    try {
      await this.api.getFileInfo(destination);
      await this.confirm.alert({ title: 'Name Already Exists', message: `An item named "${leafName}" already exists in this folder.` });
      return false;
    } catch {
      return true;
    }
  }

  private async validateRequestedLeaf(value: string | null, directory: string): Promise<string> {
    if (value === null) {
      return '';
    }
    const clean = this.cleanLeafName(value);
    if (!clean) {
      await this.confirm.alert({
        title: 'Invalid Name',
        message: ['Choose a normal file or folder name.', 'Path separators, control characters, < > : " | ? *, trailing spaces/dots,', 'and Windows reserved device names such as CON, PRN, AUX, COM1 and LPT1 are not allowed.'].join('\n'),
      });
      return '';
    }
    return await this.ensureLeafAvailable(directory, clean) ? clean : '';
  }

  private async showError(title: string, error: unknown): Promise<void> {
    await this.confirm.alert({ title: `${title} Error`, message: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error) });
  }
}
`````

`````typescript
import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';

describe('Grid thumbnail pipeline integration', () => {
  const grid = readFileSync(
    new URL('./pane-grid.component.ts', import.meta.url),
    'utf8',
  );
  const entry = readFileSync(
    new URL('./file-entry.component.ts', import.meta.url),
    'utf8',
  );
  const thumbnails = readFileSync(
    new URL('../services/thumbnail-pipeline.service.ts', import.meta.url),
    'utf8',
  );

  it('keeps grid virtualization row-aligned through VirtualCollection', () => {
    expect(grid).toContain('const firstVisibleRow');
    expect(grid).toContain('visibleStart = firstVisibleRow * columns');
    expect(grid).toContain('const renderWindow = this.virtualCollection.window');
  });

  it('prioritizes visible then overscan then idle thumbnails', () => {
    const visible = grid.indexOf("'visible'");
    const overscan = grid.indexOf("'overscan'");
    const idle = grid.indexOf("'idle'");
    expect(visible).toBeGreaterThan(-1);
    expect(overscan).toBeGreaterThan(visible);
    expect(idle).toBeGreaterThan(overscan);
  });

  it('updates thumbnail priority on scroll even when the retained DOM window stays fixed', () => {
    const scrollStart = grid.indexOf('private onScroll');
    const scrollEnd = grid.indexOf('private resetScroll', scrollStart);
    const body = grid.slice(scrollStart, scrollEnd);
    expect(body).toContain('this.refreshThumbnailPriorities()');
  });

  it('does not fetch thumbnails inside FileEntryComponent', () => {
    expect(entry).toContain('@Input() thumbnailSrc');
    expect(entry).not.toContain('getImageThumbnailURL');
    expect(entry).not.toContain('fetch(');
  });

  it('cancels stale thumbnail work and bounds decoded images', () => {
    expect(thumbnails).toContain('beginGeneration(scope: string)');
    expect(thumbnails).toContain('controller.abort()');
    expect(thumbnails).toContain('maxDecodedEntries = 192');
    expect(thumbnails).toContain('maxDecodedBytes = 96 * 1024 * 1024');
    expect(thumbnails).toContain('URL.revokeObjectURL');
  });
});
`````

## File: manager/frontend/src/app/components/pane-horizontal-overflow-inset-cursor.spec.ts
`````typescript
import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';

function read(name: string): string {
  return readFileSync(new URL(`./${name}`, import.meta.url), 'utf8');
}

describe('pane horizontal overflow cursor geometry', () => {
  const directoryFamily = [
    'directory-pane.component.ts',
    'registry-pane.component.ts',
    'autorun-pane.component.ts',
    'network-pane.component.ts',
    'environment-pane.component.ts',
  ];

  it('uses one max-content track and preserves the standard 4px row inset', () => {
    for (const name of directoryFamily) {
      const source = read(name);
      expect(source).toContain('grid-template-columns: minmax(100%, max-content);');
      expect(source).toContain('margin-left: 4px;');
      expect(source).toContain('margin-right: 4px;');
      expect(source).toContain('justify-self: stretch;');
    }
  });

  it('keeps Details headers flush while rows retain their cursor inset', () => {
    for (const name of directoryFamily) {
      const source = read(name);
      expect(source).toContain('.list.view-details > .details-header-viewport > .details-header {');
      expect(source).toContain('margin: 0;');
      expect(source).toContain('padding: 0;');
    }
  });

  it('keeps Bin parent cursors inset and adds hierarchy indentation only to revision rows', () => {
    const source = read('bin-pane.component.ts');
    expect(source).toContain('.list.view-details .list-content-track {');
    expect(source).toContain('grid-template-columns: minmax(100%, max-content);');
    expect(source).toContain('.list.view-details .list-content-track > .entry {');
    expect(source).toContain('margin-left: 4px;');
    expect(source).toContain('margin-right: 4px;');
    expect(source).toContain('.list.view-details.bin-grouped .list-content-track > .entry.bin-revision-row {');
    expect(source).toContain('margin-left: 26px;');
  });

  it('uses the same overflow track/inset contract in System Table', () => {
    const source = read('system-table-pane.component.ts');
    expect(source).toContain('grid-template-columns: minmax(100%, max-content);');
    expect(source).toContain('margin-left: 4px;');
    expect(source).toContain('margin-right: 4px;');
  });
});
`````

`````typescript
    app-bin-pane,app-registry-pane,app-autorun-pane,app-network-pane,app-environment-pane,app-system-table-pane{display:flex;flex:1 1 0%;min-width:0;min-height:0;overflow:hidden;background:var(--vsc-editor-background,#fff)}

})
export class PaneHostComponent implements DoCheck, PanePeerPort, PaneStatePort {
  @ViewChild('component') private inner?: DirectoryPaneComponent | RegistryPaneComponent | AutorunPaneComponent | NetworkPaneComponent | EnvironmentPaneComponent;
  @ViewChild('locationEditor') private locationEditor?: ElementRef<HTMLInputElement>;

  @Input() paneId: 'left' | 'right' = 'left';
  @Input() active = false;
  @Input() showHidden = false;
  @Input() currentPathPinned = false;
  @Input() pluginToolbarActions: readonly PresentedCommand[] = [];
  @Input() comparisonStatuses: ReadonlyMap<string, PaneComparisonStatus> = new Map<string, PaneComparisonStatus>();

  specializedLocationEditing = false;
  specializedLocationDraft = '';

  @Output() readonly activateRequested = new EventEmitter<void>();
  @Output() readonly navigationTrailRequested = new EventEmitter<{ direction: 'back' | 'forward'; event: MouseEvent; entries: readonly string[] }>();
  @Output() readonly remoteRecoveryRequested = new EventEmitter<void>();
  @Output() readonly togglePinRequested = new EventEmitter<void>();
  @Output() readonly locationChange = new EventEmitter<string>();
  @Output() readonly cursorChange = new EventEmitter<FileInfo | null>();
  @Output() readonly presentationChange = new EventEmitter<PanePresentation>();
  @Output() readonly viewportChange = new EventEmitter<{ topName: string | null; ratio: number }>();
  @Output() readonly entryContextMenu = new EventEmitter<{ event: MouseEvent; entry: FileInfo }>();
  @Output() readonly backgroundContextMenu = new EventEmitter<MouseEvent>();
  @Output() readonly internalDrop = new EventEmitter<{ event: DragEvent; targetPath: string; targetEntry: FileInfo | null }>();

  readonly provider: PanelSourcePaneSession;

  constructor(
    private readonly workspaceService: WorkspaceService,
    panelSources: PanelSourceRegistryService,
    pluginLifecycle: PluginLifecycleCoordinatorService,
    private readonly renderers: PaneRendererRegistryService,
    private readonly pluginManager: PluginManagerService,
    private readonly inputEngine: InputEngineService,
    private readonly element: ElementRef<HTMLElement>,
    changeDetector: ChangeDetectorRef,
  ) {
    this.provider = new PanelSourcePaneSession(
      workspaceService,
      panelSources,
      pluginLifecycle,
      {
        changed: () => changeDetector.markForCheck(),
        locationChanged: path => this.locationChange.emit(path),
        cursorChanged: entry => this.cursorChange.emit(entry),
        presentationChanged: presentation => this.presentationChange.emit(presentation),
        viewportChanged: viewport => this.viewportChange.emit(viewport),
      },
    );
  }

  get effectivePluginToolbarActions(): readonly PresentedCommand[] {
    if (this.pluginToolbarActions.length) {
      return this.pluginToolbarActions;
    }

    const component = this.activeComponent;
    const currentDirectory =
      component?.path ??
      this.workspaceService.getActiveTab(this.paneId)?.path ??
      '';

    if (!currentDirectory) return [];

    const selectedPaths = Array.from(component?.selectedPaths ?? [])
      .filter(path => !!path && path !== '__parent__');

    const context: ToolbarContext = {
      selectedPaths,
      currentDirectory,
    };

    return adaptPluginToolbarActions(
      this.pluginManager.resolveToolbarActions(context),
      context,
      this.inputEngine,
    );
  }

  ngDoCheck(): void {
    if (this.rendererKind === 'directory' || this.rendererKind === 'bin' || this.rendererKind === 'registry' || this.rendererKind === 'autorun' || this.rendererKind === 'network' || this.rendererKind === 'environment') return;
    const path = this.workspaceService.getActiveTab(this.paneId)?.path ?? '';
    void this.provider.sync(this.paneId, path, this.showHidden);
    if (!this.specializedLocationEditing) this.specializedLocationDraft = this.provider.path;
  }

  get rendererKind(): PaneRendererKind {
    const path = this.workspaceService.getActiveTab(this.paneId)?.path ?? '';
    return this.renderers.resolve(path).kind;
  }

  private get activeComponent(): PaneComponent | undefined {
    return this.rendererKind === 'directory' || this.rendererKind === 'bin' || this.rendererKind === 'registry' || this.rendererKind === 'autorun' || this.rendererKind === 'network' || this.rendererKind === 'environment'
      ? (this.inner as unknown as PaneComponent | undefined)
      : this.provider;
  }

  get contextState(): PaneContextState {
    const component = this.activeComponent;
    return {
      get path() { return component?.path ?? ''; },
      get entries() { return component?.entries ?? []; },
      get visibleEntries() { return component?.visibleEntries ?? []; },
      get activeSurfaceId() { return component?.activeSurfaceId ?? ''; },
      get viewMode() { return component?.viewMode ?? 'list'; },
      get sourceCapabilities() { return component?.sourceCapabilities ?? getSourceCapabilities(component?.path ?? ''); },
      get activePanelSource() { return component?.activePanelSource; },
      get currentArchiveFrame() { return component?.currentArchiveFrame ?? null; },
      get isDirectoryTab() { return !!component?.isDirectoryTab; },
      get isInArchive() { return !!component?.isInArchive; },
    };
  }

  get tabState(): PaneTabState {
    const component = this.activeComponent;
    return {
      get tabs() { return component?.tabs ?? []; },
      get activeTab() { return component?.activeTab; },
      get activeViewerTab() { return component?.activeViewerTab; },
    };
  }

  get viewerState(): PaneViewerState {
    const component = this.activeComponent;
    return {
      get mountedViewer() { return component?.mountedViewer; },
      get viewerArchiveContext() { return component?.viewerArchiveContext ?? null; },
    };
  }

  get pinState(): PanePinState {
    const component = this.activeComponent;
    return {
      get location() { return component?.pinnableLocation ?? ''; },
      get surfaceId() { return component?.pinnableSurfaceId ?? 'dir'; },
      get title() { return component?.pinnableTitle ?? ''; },
    };
  }

  get mutationState(): PaneMutationState {
    const component = this.activeComponent;
    return {
      get hasSelection() { return !!component?.hasSelection; },
      get canCreate() { return !!component?.canCreate; },
      get canRename() { return !!component?.canRename; },
      get canDelete() { return !!component?.canDelete; },
      get canCut() { return !!component?.canCut; },
      get canPaste() { return !!component?.canPaste; },
    };
  }

  get peerState(): PanePeerState {
    const component = this.activeComponent;
    return {
      get path() { return component?.path ?? ''; },
      get entries() { return component?.entries ?? []; },
      get cursorEntry() { return component?.cursorEntry ?? null; },
      get selectedPaths() { return component?.selectedPaths ?? new Set<string>(); },
      get sourceCapabilities() { return component?.sourceCapabilities ?? getSourceCapabilities(component?.path ?? ''); },
      get isDirectoryTab() { return !!component?.isDirectoryTab; },
      get isInArchive() { return !!component?.isInArchive; },
    };
  }

  get peerNavigation(): PanePeerNavigation {
    const component = this.activeComponent;
    return {
      refresh: () => component?.refresh() ?? Promise.resolve(),
      canNavigateToLocation: path => component?.canNavigateToLocation(path) ?? false,
      navigateLinkedLocation: (path, options) =>
        component?.navigateLinkedLocation(path, options).then(Boolean) ?? Promise.resolve(false),
    };
  }

  get peerSelection(): PanePeerSelection {
    const component = this.activeComponent;
    return {
      selectPeerByName: name => component?.selectPeerByName(name) ?? false,
      selectPaths: paths => component?.selectPaths(paths),
    };
  }

  get navigation(): PaneNavigation | undefined { return this.activeComponent; }
  get selection(): PaneSelection { return this.activeComponent!; }
  get commands(): PaneCommands | undefined { return this.activeComponent; }
  get presentation(): PanePresentationPort | undefined { return this.activeComponent; }
  get viewport(): PaneViewportPort | undefined { return this.activeComponent; }
  get tabCommands(): PaneTabs | undefined { return this.activeComponent; }
  get viewerCommands(): PaneViewerCommands | undefined { return this.activeComponent; }

  onProviderBackgroundClick(event: MouseEvent): void {
    if (event.target === event.currentTarget) this.provider.clearSelection();
  }

  onProviderSelect(event: any): void {
    this.provider.selectFromPointer(event.entry as FileInfo, event.event as MouseEvent);
  }

  onProviderOpen(entry: any): void { void this.provider.openEntry(entry as FileInfo); }

  onProviderContextMenu(event: any): void {
    this.entryContextMenu.emit({ entry: event.entry as FileInfo, event: event.event as MouseEvent });
  }

  beginSpecializedLocationEdit(): void {
    this.specializedLocationDraft = this.provider.path;
    this.specializedLocationEditing = true;
    queueMicrotask(() => this.locationEditor?.nativeElement.focus());
  }

  cancelSpecializedLocationEdit(): void {
    this.specializedLocationDraft = this.provider.path;
    this.specializedLocationEditing = false;
  }

  commitSpecializedLocationEdit(): void {
    const next = this.specializedLocationDraft.trim();
    this.specializedLocationEditing = false;
    if (!next || next === this.provider.path) return;
    void this.provider.navigateTo(next);
  }

  onProviderTabChange(tab: any): void { this.workspaceService.switchTab(this.paneId, tab.id); }
  onProviderTabClose(tab: any): void { this.workspaceService.closeTab(this.paneId, tab.id); }
  onProviderTabPin(tab: any): void { this.workspaceService.toggleTabPin(this.paneId, tab.id); }

  getKeyboardContextMenuAnchor(): { x: number; y: number } | null {
    const root = this.element.nativeElement;
    const active = document.activeElement instanceof HTMLElement
      ? document.activeElement
      : null;

    const anchor = active && root.contains(active)
      ? active
      : root.querySelector<HTMLElement>(
          '.details-row.cursor, .grid-item.cursor, .tree-row.cursor, .file-entry.cursor, [aria-selected="true"]',
        ) ?? root;

    const rect = anchor.getBoundingClientRect();
    return {
      x: rect.left + Math.min(120, Math.max(24, rect.width / 2)),
      y: rect.top + Math.min(18, Math.max(12, rect.height / 2)),
    };
  }
}
`````

`````typescript
const component = (name: string) =>

const service = (name: string) =>
  readFileSync(new URL(`../services/${name}`, import.meta.url), 'utf8');

describe('natural pane move reconciliation', () => {
  it('publishes batch move/copy mutations instead of relying on command refreshes', () => {
    const api = service('api.service.ts');
    expect(api).toContain("kind: 'move'");
    expect(api).toContain("origin: 'batch-move'");
    expect(api).toContain("kind: 'copy'");
    expect(api).toContain("origin: 'batch-copy'");
  });

  it('does not eagerly reload both panes after ordinary F5/F6 transfer', () => {
    const dual = component('dual-pane.component.ts');
    const start = dual.indexOf("private async transferToOther(operation: 'copy' | 'move')");
    const end = dual.indexOf('private isRecycleBinPath', start);
    const method = dual.slice(start, end);
    expect(method).not.toContain('await destination.navigation?.refresh();');
    expect(method).not.toContain('await source.navigation?.refresh();');
  });

  it('does not eagerly reload a filesystem paste destination', () => {
    const clipboard = component('pane-clipboard.controller.ts');
    const start = clipboard.indexOf('async paste(host: PaneClipboardHost)');
    const end = clipboard.indexOf('private cloneArchiveFrame', start);
    const method = clipboard.slice(start, end);
    expect(method).toContain('host.focusContent?.();');
    expect(method).not.toContain('await host.refresh();\n      host.focusContent?.();');
  });

  it('recovers a moved-away cursor at the same row index', () => {
    const pane = component('directory-pane.component.ts');
    expect(pane).toContain('cursorIndexBeforeRefresh');
    expect(pane).toContain('reconcileSelectionAfterRefresh(');
    expect(pane).toContain('Math.min(previousCursorIndex, selectable.length - 1)');
  });

  it('preserves surviving multi-selection across watcher reconciliation', () => {
    const pane = component('directory-pane.component.ts');
    expect(pane).toContain('selectionBeforeRefresh');
    expect(pane).toContain('survivingSelection');
  });
});
`````

`````typescript
describe('natural move selection timing', () => {
  const directory = read('directory-pane.component.ts');
  const dual = read('dual-pane.component.ts');

  it('reconciles moved source rows before the watcher refresh', () => {
`````

`````typescript
import { readdirSync, readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { basename, dirname, join } from 'node:path';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';

const here = dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url));
const rendererFiles = [
  'pane-list.component.ts',
  'pane-grid.component.ts',
  'pane-tree.component.ts',
  'pane-details.component.ts',
] as const;

describe('pane renderer architecture', () => {
  it('has exactly one shared renderer for each collection presentation', () => {
    const files = readdirSync(here);
    for (const name of rendererFiles) expect(files).toContain(name);

    expect(files).not.toContain('file-list.component.ts');
    expect(files).not.toContain('file-grid.component.ts');
    expect(files).not.toContain('file-tree.component.ts');
    expect(files).not.toContain('file-details.component.ts');
  });

  it('uses only pane-* selectors and class names for shared renderers', () => {
    const expected = [
      ['pane-list.component.ts', 'PaneListComponent', "selector: 'app-pane-list'"],
      ['pane-grid.component.ts', 'PaneGridComponent', "selector: 'app-pane-grid'"],
      ['pane-tree.component.ts', 'PaneTreeComponent', "selector: 'app-pane-tree'"],
      ['pane-details.component.ts', 'PaneDetailsComponent', "selector: 'app-pane-details'"],
    ] as const;

    for (const [file, className, selector] of expected) {
      const source = readFileSync(join(here, file), 'utf8');
      expect(source).toContain(`export class ${className}`);
      expect(source).toContain(selector);
    }
  });

  it('contains no references to the retired File renderer classes/selectors', () => {
    const forbidden = [
      'FileListComponent', 'FileGridComponent', 'FileTreeComponent', 'FileDetailsComponent',
      'app-file-list', 'app-file-grid', 'app-file-tree', 'app-file-details',
      'file-list.component', 'file-grid.component', 'file-tree.component', 'file-details.component',
    ];

    for (const name of readdirSync(here).filter(name => /\.(?:ts|html|scss)$/.test(name))) {
      if (basename(name) === 'pane-renderer-architecture.spec.ts') continue;
      const source = readFileSync(join(here, name), 'utf8');
      for (const token of forbidden) expect(source).not.toContain(token);
    }
  });
});
`````

`````typescript
import '@angular/compiler';
import { SimpleChange } from '@angular/core';
import { fn, stubGlobal, restoreGlobals } from '../testing/jasmine-test-helpers';

import { PaneViewHostComponent } from './pane-view-host.component';

function createComponent(): PaneViewHostComponent {
  return new PaneViewHostComponent(
    {} as any,
    {} as any,
    { markForCheck: fn() } as any,
  );
}

function applyPathChanges(component: PaneViewHostComponent): void {
  component.ngOnChanges({
    browserPath: new SimpleChange('', component.browserPath, true),
    currentPath: new SimpleChange('', component.currentPath, true),
  });
}

function createLocalStorageMock(initial: Record<string, string> = {}) {
  const store = new Map(Object.entries(initial));

  return {
    getItem: fn((key: string) => store.get(key) ?? null),
    setItem: fn((key: string, value: string) => {
      store.set(key, value);
    }),
    removeItem: fn((key: string) => {
      store.delete(key);
    }),
    clear: fn(() => {
      store.clear();
    }),
  };
}

describe('PaneViewHostComponent', () => {
  afterEach(() => {
    restoreGlobals();
  });

  it('prefers the live current path over a stale browser path', () => {
    const component = createComponent();

    component.browserPath = 'https://old.example.com';
    component.currentPath = 'filesystem://c';
    applyPathChanges(component);

    expect(component.getBrowserPath()).toBe('filesystem://c');
    expect(component.showBrowserPane()).toBe(false);
  });

  it('updates the browser pane when a new web address is entered', () => {
    const component = createComponent();

    component.browserPath = 'https://old.example.com';
    component.currentPath = 'https://new.example.com/docs';
    applyPathChanges(component);

    expect(component.getBrowserPath()).toBe('https://new.example.com/docs');
    expect(component.showBrowserPane()).toBe(true);
  });

  it('loads and clamps the persisted browser pane split for the current pane', () => {
    stubGlobal('localStorage', createLocalStorageMock({
      'fileManager_browserPaneSplit:right': '90',
    }));

    const component = createComponent();
    component.paneId = 'right';
    component.ngOnChanges({
      paneId: new SimpleChange('left', 'right', true),
    });

    expect(component.browserPaneSplit).toBe(72);
  });
});
`````

## File: manager/frontend/src/app/components/panel-source-pane-session.ts
`````typescript
import type { FileInfo } from '../shared/protocol';
import { FileType } from '../shared/protocol';
import type { SourceCapabilities } from '../services/source-capabilities';
import type { PanelSourceRegistryService } from '../services/panel-source-registry.service';
import type { PluginLifecycleCoordinatorService } from '../services/plugin-lifecycle-coordinator.service';
import type { WorkspaceService } from '../services/workspace.service';
import type {
  PaneComponent,
  PanePresentation,
  PaneViewportSnapshot,
} from './pane-component.contract';
import { schemeOf } from './pane-renderer-registry.service';

const PARENT_ENTRY_PATH = '__parent__';

export interface PanelSourcePaneSessionEvents {
  readonly changed?: () => void;
  readonly locationChanged?: (path: string) => void;
  readonly cursorChanged?: (entry: FileInfo | null) => void;
  readonly presentationChanged?: (presentation: PanePresentation) => void;
  readonly viewportChanged?: (snapshot: PaneViewportSnapshot) => void;
}

/**
 * Shared shell state for non-directory sibling panes.
 *
 * PanelSource owns data/navigation semantics.
 * A sibling component owns domain presentation.
 * This session owns the narrow pane contracts consumed by DualPane.
 */
export class PanelSourcePaneSession implements PaneComponent {
  paneId: 'left' | 'right' = 'left';
  showHidden = false;

  path = '';
  entries: FileInfo[] = [];
  selectedPaths: ReadonlySet<string> = new Set<string>();
  cursorPath: string | null = null;
  loading = false;
  error = '';
  viewMode: 'list' | 'details' = 'details';
  lastAction = '';

  readonly activeViewerTab = null;
  readonly mountedViewer = null;
  readonly viewerArchiveContext = null;
  readonly currentArchiveFrame = null;

  private backTrail: string[] = [];
  private forwardTrail: string[] = [];
  private loadToken = 0;
  private syncedTabId = '';
  private syncedPath = '';
  private viewport: PaneViewportSnapshot = { topName: null, ratio: 0 };

  constructor(
    private readonly workspace: WorkspaceService,
    private readonly panelSources: PanelSourceRegistryService,
    private readonly pluginLifecycle: PluginLifecycleCoordinatorService,
    private readonly events: PanelSourcePaneSessionEvents = {},
  ) {}

  get activeSurfaceId(): string { return schemeOf(this.path) || 'panel-source'; }
  get pinnableSurfaceId(): string { return this.activeSurfaceId; }

  get tabs(): readonly any[] { return this.workspace.getTabs(this.paneId); }
  get activeTab(): any { return this.workspace.getActiveTab(this.paneId); }

  get visibleEntries(): readonly FileInfo[] { return this.entries; }

  get cursorEntry(): FileInfo | null {
    return this.cursorPath
      ? this.entries.find(entry => entry.path === this.cursorPath) ?? null
      : null;
  }

  get selectedEntries(): FileInfo[] {
    return this.entries.filter(entry => this.selectedPaths.has(entry.path));
  }

  get activePanelSource(): any {
    return this.panelSources.resolve({
      path: this.path,
      entries: this.entries,
      inArchive: false,
    });
  }

  get sourceCapabilities(): SourceCapabilities {
    return this.activePanelSource.capabilities;
  }

  get pinnableLocation(): string { return this.path; }
  get pinnableTitle(): string {
    return this.activePanelSource?.source?.title || this.path;
  }

  get hasSelection(): boolean { return this.selectedPaths.size > 0; }

  // Mutations on specialized panes are domain commands, not generic file
  // mutations. This prevents F7/Delete/etc. from taking the filesystem path.
  get canCreate(): boolean { return false; }
  get canRename(): boolean { return false; }
  get canDelete(): boolean { return false; }
  get canCut(): boolean { return false; }
  get canPaste(): boolean { return false; }

  get isInArchive(): boolean { return false; }
  get isDirectoryTab(): boolean { return true; }

  async sync(
    paneId: 'left' | 'right',
    path: string,
    showHidden: boolean,
  ): Promise<void> {
    this.paneId = paneId;
    this.showHidden = showHidden;
    const tab = this.workspace.getActiveTab(paneId);
    const tabId = tab?.id ?? '';

    if (!path) return;

    const canonicalPath = this.canonicalize(path);
    if (!canonicalPath) return;

    if (
      tabId === this.syncedTabId &&
      canonicalPath === this.syncedPath &&
      canonicalPath === this.path &&
      !this.error
    ) {
      return;
    }

    // Publish the location before asynchronous plugin activation/listing.
    // Dedicated sibling panes must never render with path="" while their
    // provider is being activated.
    if (this.path !== canonicalPath) {
      this.path = canonicalPath;
      this.events.locationChanged?.(canonicalPath);
      this.events.changed?.();
    }

    const loaded = await this.load(
      canonicalPath,
      { history: 'none', preserveSelection: true },
    );

    // Only mark a tab/path pair synchronized after a successful load.
    // A startup activation race must be retryable on the next check.
    if (loaded) {
      this.syncedTabId = tabId;
      this.syncedPath = this.path;
    }
  }

  async refresh(): Promise<void> {
    if (this.path) await this.load(this.path, { history: 'none', preserveSelection: true });
  }

  focusContent(): void {}
  focusLocation(): void {}
  focusFilter(): void {}

  canGoBack(): boolean { return this.backTrail.length > 0; }
  canGoForward(): boolean { return this.forwardTrail.length > 0; }

  goBack(): void {
    const target = this.backTrail.pop();
    if (!target) return;
    if (this.path) this.forwardTrail.push(this.path);
    void this.load(target, { history: 'none', preserveSelection: false });
  }

  goForward(): void {
    const target = this.forwardTrail.pop();
    if (!target) return;
    if (this.path) this.backTrail.push(this.path);
    void this.load(target, { history: 'none', preserveSelection: false });
  }

  navigateUp(): void {
    if (!this.path) return;
    const resolved = this.activePanelSource;
    const parent = resolved.source.getParentPath({
      path: this.path,
      entries: this.entries,
      inArchive: false,
    });
    if (parent && parent !== this.path) {
      void this.load(parent, { history: 'record', preserveSelection: false });
    }
  }

  async navigateTo(path: string): Promise<void> {
    const canonicalPath = this.canonicalize(path);
    if (!canonicalPath) return;

    if (this.path !== canonicalPath) {
      this.path = canonicalPath;
      this.error = '';
      this.events.locationChanged?.(canonicalPath);
      this.events.changed?.();
    }

    await this.load(canonicalPath, { history: 'record', preserveSelection: false });
  }

  navigateLinkedLocation(path: string): Promise<boolean> {
    return this.navigateTo(path).then(() => true);
  }

  canNavigateToLocation(path: string): boolean {
    return !!schemeOf(path) && schemeOf(path) === schemeOf(this.path || path);
  }

  currentLocationAvailable(): Promise<boolean> { return Promise.resolve(!!this.path); }

  jumpNavigationHistory(path: string): Promise<boolean> {
    return this.navigateTo(path).then(() => true);
  }

  panePresentation(): PanePresentation {
    return {
      viewMode: this.viewMode,
      sortField: 'name',
      sortDirection: 'asc',
      directoriesFirst: true,
      filterText: '',
      filterVisible: false,
    };
  }

  applyMirroredPresentation(presentation: PanePresentation): void {
    if (presentation.viewMode === 'list' || presentation.viewMode === 'details') {
      this.setViewMode(presentation.viewMode);
    }
  }

  setViewMode(viewMode: 'list' | 'details'): void {
    if (this.viewMode === viewMode) return;
    this.viewMode = viewMode;
    this.events.presentationChanged?.(this.panePresentation());
    this.events.changed?.();
  }

  viewportSnapshot(): PaneViewportSnapshot { return this.viewport; }

  syncViewportToPeer(snapshot: PaneViewportSnapshot): void {
    this.viewport = snapshot;
    this.events.changed?.();
  }

  onScroll(event: Event): void {
    const element = event.target as HTMLElement | null;
    if (!element) return;
    const max = Math.max(0, element.scrollHeight - element.clientHeight);
    this.viewport = {
      topName: this.entries[0]?.name ?? null,
      ratio: max > 0 ? element.scrollTop / max : 0,
    };
    this.events.viewportChanged?.(this.viewport);
  }

  openEntry(entry: FileInfo): Promise<void> {
    if (entry.path === PARENT_ENTRY_PATH) {
      this.navigateUp();
      return Promise.resolve();
    }

    const resolved = this.activePanelSource;
    const activation = resolved.source.activateEntry?.(
      { path: this.path, entries: this.entries, inArchive: false },
      entry,
    );

    if (activation !== undefined) {
      if (typeof activation === 'boolean') {
        if (activation) {
          this.selectPaths([entry.path]);
          return Promise.resolve();
        }
        // false means "not handled"; continue to normal navigation below.
      } else {
        return activation.then(async (handled: boolean) => {
          if (handled) {
            this.selectPaths([entry.path]);
            return;
          }
          if (entry.type === FileType.DIRECTORY) {
            await this.navigateTo(entry.path);
          } else {
            this.selectPaths([entry.path]);
          }
        });
      }
    }

    if (entry.type === FileType.DIRECTORY) {
      return this.navigateTo(entry.path);
    }

    this.selectPaths([entry.path]);
    return Promise.resolve();
  }

  openViewer(_entry: FileInfo, _viewerId?: string | null, _autoFollow?: boolean): any { return null; }
  openSelectedWithViewer(_viewerId: string): Promise<void> { return Promise.resolve(); }
  openQuickView(_entry: FileInfo): void {}
  openActiveViewerExternally(): Promise<void> { return Promise.resolve(); }
  returnToViewerSource(): Promise<void> { return Promise.resolve(); }
  openResultsPanel(_title: string, _entries: readonly FileInfo[], _metadata?: unknown): Promise<void> { return Promise.resolve(); }
  openRecentFilesPanel(): Promise<void> { return Promise.resolve(); }
  openSurfaceTab(_surfaceId: string, _title?: string, _location?: string): Promise<void> { return Promise.resolve(); }

  closeActiveTab(): void {
    const tab = this.activeTab;
    if (tab) this.workspace.closeTab(this.paneId, tab.id);
  }

  newTab(): void { this.workspace.addTab(this.paneId, this.path || '', true); }
  nextTab(): void { this.switchRelativeTab(1); }
  previousTab(): void { this.switchRelativeTab(-1); }

  jumpToTab(index: number): void {
    const tab = this.tabs[index];
    if (tab) this.workspace.switchTab(this.paneId, tab.id);
  }

  closeOtherTabs(): void {
    const active = this.activeTab;
    if (!active) return;
    for (const tab of [...this.tabs]) {
      if (tab.id !== active.id && tab.isClosable && !tab.isPinned) {
        this.workspace.closeTab(this.paneId, tab.id);
      }
    }
  }

  closeTabsToRight(): void {
    const active = this.activeTab;
    if (!active) return;
    const index = this.tabs.findIndex(tab => tab.id === active.id);
    for (const tab of this.tabs.slice(index + 1)) {
      if (tab.isClosable && !tab.isPinned) this.workspace.closeTab(this.paneId, tab.id);
    }
  }

  toggleActiveTabPin(): void {
    const active = this.activeTab;
    if (active) this.workspace.toggleTabPin(this.paneId, active.id);
  }

  exportActiveTabId(): string | null { return this.activeTab?.id ?? null; }
  exportTabCount(): number { return this.tabs.length; }

  async restoreWorkspaceState(): Promise<void> {
    const active = this.activeTab;
    if (active?.path) await this.sync(this.paneId, active.path, this.showHidden);
  }

  reloadWorkspaceTabs(_preferredTabId?: string): Promise<void> { return Promise.resolve(); }

  moveCursor(delta: number, extend = false): void {
    const entries = this.selectableEntries();
    if (!entries.length) return;

    const current = entries.findIndex(entry => entry.path === this.cursorPath);
    const index = current < 0
      ? (delta < 0 ? entries.length - 1 : 0)
      : Math.max(0, Math.min(entries.length - 1, current + delta));
    const path = entries[index]?.path;
    if (!path) return;
    this.cursorPath = path;
    if (!extend) this.selectedPaths = new Set([path]);
    this.emitCursor();
  }

  moveCursorHome(extend = false): void { this.moveCursor(-Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER, extend); }
  moveCursorEnd(extend = false): void { this.moveCursor(Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER, extend); }
  moveCursorPage(direction: -1 | 1, extend = false): void { this.moveCursor(direction * 10, extend); }

  selectAll(): void {
    this.selectedPaths = new Set(this.selectableEntries().map(entry => entry.path));
    this.cursorPath ??= this.selectableEntries()[0]?.path ?? null;
    this.emitCursor();
  }

  clearSelection(): void {
    this.selectedPaths = new Set<string>();
    this.events.changed?.();
  }

  toggleCurrentSelection(): void {
    if (!this.cursorPath) return;
    const next = new Set(this.selectedPaths);
    if (next.has(this.cursorPath)) next.delete(this.cursorPath);
    else next.add(this.cursorPath);
    this.selectedPaths = next;
    this.emitCursor();
  }

  extendSelection(delta: number): void { this.moveCursor(delta, true); }

  invertSelection(): void {
    const old = this.selectedPaths;
    this.selectedPaths = new Set(
      this.selectableEntries().filter(entry => !old.has(entry.path)).map(entry => entry.path),
    );
    this.emitCursor();
  }

  selectSameExtension(): void {}
  selectSameType(): void {}

  selectFiles(): void {
    this.selectedPaths = new Set(
      this.selectableEntries().filter(entry => entry.type !== FileType.DIRECTORY).map(entry => entry.path),
    );
    this.emitCursor();
  }

  selectFolders(): void {
    this.selectedPaths = new Set(
      this.selectableEntries().filter(entry => entry.type === FileType.DIRECTORY).map(entry => entry.path),
    );
    this.emitCursor();
  }

  unselectFiles(): void {
    this.selectedPaths = new Set(
      [...this.selectedPaths].filter(path =>
        this.entries.find(entry => entry.path === path)?.type === FileType.DIRECTORY,
      ),
    );
    this.emitCursor();
  }

  unselectFolders(): void {
    this.selectedPaths = new Set(
      [...this.selectedPaths].filter(path =>
        this.entries.find(entry => entry.path === path)?.type !== FileType.DIRECTORY,
      ),
    );
    this.emitCursor();
  }

  selectByMaskPrompt(): Promise<void> { return Promise.resolve(); }
  unselectByMaskPrompt(): Promise<void> { return Promise.resolve(); }

  selectPaths(paths: readonly string[]): void {
    const available = new Set(this.entries.map(entry => entry.path));
    this.selectedPaths = new Set(paths.filter(path => available.has(path)));
    this.cursorPath = [...this.selectedPaths][0] ?? this.cursorPath;
    this.emitCursor();
  }

  selectComparisonItem(path: string): void { this.selectPaths([path]); }

  recoverVisibleCursor(): void {
    if (!this.entries.length) {
      this.cursorPath = null;
      this.selectedPaths = new Set<string>();
    } else if (!this.cursorPath || !this.entries.some(entry => entry.path === this.cursorPath)) {
      this.cursorPath = this.selectableEntries()[0]?.path ?? this.entries[0]?.path ?? null;
    }
    this.emitCursor();
  }

  calculateSelectedSize(): Promise<void> { return Promise.resolve(); }

  selectPeerByName(name: string): boolean {
    const entry = this.entries.find(candidate => candidate.name === name);
    if (!entry) return false;
    this.selectPaths([entry.path]);
    return true;
  }

  selectFromPointer(entry: FileInfo, event: MouseEvent): void {
    const next = new Set(this.selectedPaths);
    if (event.ctrlKey || event.metaKey) {
      if (next.has(entry.path)) next.delete(entry.path);
      else next.add(entry.path);
    } else {
      next.clear();
      next.add(entry.path);
    }
    this.selectedPaths = next;
    this.cursorPath = entry.path;
    this.emitCursor();
  }

  copySelected(): void {}
  cutSelected(): void {}
  paste(): Promise<void> { return Promise.resolve(); }
  deleteSelected(_permanent?: boolean): Promise<void> { return Promise.resolve(); }
  renameSelected(): Promise<void> { return Promise.resolve(); }
  newFolder(): Promise<void> { return Promise.resolve(); }
  newFile(): Promise<void> { return Promise.resolve(); }
  newDocumentTemplate(_kind: string): Promise<void> { return Promise.resolve(); }
  moveSelectionToNewFolder(): Promise<void> { return Promise.resolve(); }
  duplicateSelected(): Promise<void> { return Promise.resolve(); }
  revealSelectedInFileManager(): Promise<void> { return Promise.resolve(); }
  touchSelectedModifiedTime(): Promise<void> { return Promise.resolve(); }
  editSelectedAttributes(): Promise<void> { return Promise.resolve(); }
  showSelectedProperties(): Promise<void> { return Promise.resolve(); }
  showSelectedChecksum(): Promise<void> { return Promise.resolve(); }

  createZipFromSelection(): Promise<void> { return Promise.resolve(); }
  extractSelectedTo(_destinationDir: string, _flattenPaths = false): Promise<boolean> { return Promise.resolve(false); }
  transferArchiveSelectionTo(_destinationDir: string, _operation: 'copy' | 'move'): Promise<null> { return Promise.resolve(null); }
  treeLeft(): void {}
  treeRight(): void {}

  private async load(
    requestedPath: string,
    options: { history: 'record' | 'none'; preserveSelection: boolean },
  ): Promise<boolean> {
    const path = this.canonicalize(requestedPath);
    if (!path) return false;

    const token = ++this.loadToken;
    const previousPath = this.path;
    const previousSelection = new Set(this.selectedPaths);

    this.loading = true;
    this.error = '';
    this.lastAction = `load: ${path}`;
    this.events.changed?.();

    try {
      await this.activatePluginsForLocation(path);

      const context = { path, entries: this.entries, inArchive: false };
      const resolved = this.panelSources.resolve(context);
      if (resolved.source.kind === 'filesystem') {
        throw new Error(`No panel source is registered for ${schemeOf(path)}://.`);
      }

      const listing = await resolved.source.list(context, this.showHidden);
      if (token !== this.loadToken) return false;

      const nextPath = listing.location.path || path;
      this.path = nextPath;
      this.entries = this.withParent(nextPath, [...listing.entries] as FileInfo[], resolved.source);
      this.selectedPaths = options.preserveSelection
        ? new Set([...previousSelection].filter(candidate => this.entries.some(entry => entry.path === candidate)))
        : new Set<string>();

      if (!this.cursorPath || !this.entries.some(entry => entry.path === this.cursorPath)) {
        this.cursorPath = this.selectableEntries()[0]?.path ?? this.entries[0]?.path ?? null;
      }

      if (options.history === 'record' && previousPath && previousPath !== nextPath) {
        this.backTrail.push(previousPath);
        this.forwardTrail = [];
      }

      this.syncWorkspacePath(nextPath);
      this.events.locationChanged?.(nextPath);
      this.emitCursor();
      this.events.presentationChanged?.(this.panePresentation());
      return true;
    } catch (error) {
      if (token !== this.loadToken) return false;
      this.error = error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error);
      this.entries = [];
      this.selectedPaths = new Set<string>();
      this.cursorPath = null;
      this.events.cursorChanged?.(null);
      return false;
    } finally {
      if (token === this.loadToken) {
        this.loading = false;
        this.events.changed?.();
      }
    }
  }

  private withParent(path: string, entries: FileInfo[], source: any): FileInfo[] {
    const context = { path, entries, inArchive: false };
    const root = source.getRootPath(context);
    if (!path || !root || path === root || entries.some(entry => entry.path === PARENT_ENTRY_PATH)) {
      return entries;
    }

    return [{
      name: '..',
      path: PARENT_ENTRY_PATH,
      type: FileType.DIRECTORY,
      size: 0,
      created: 0,
      modified: 0,
      accessed: 0,
      permissions: '',
      isHidden: false,
    }, ...entries];
  }

  private selectableEntries(): FileInfo[] {
    return this.entries.filter(entry => entry.path !== PARENT_ENTRY_PATH);
  }

  private emitCursor(): void {
    this.events.cursorChanged?.(this.cursorEntry);
    this.events.changed?.();
  }

  private switchRelativeTab(delta: -1 | 1): void {
    const tabs = this.tabs;
    if (tabs.length < 2) return;
    const current = tabs.findIndex(tab => tab.id === this.activeTab?.id);
    const next = ((current < 0 ? 0 : current) + delta + tabs.length) % tabs.length;
    this.workspace.switchTab(this.paneId, tabs[next].id);
  }

  private syncWorkspacePath(path: string): void {
    const active = this.workspace.getActiveTab(this.paneId);
    if (!active || active.path === path) return;
    this.workspace.updateTabPath(this.paneId, active.id, path);
    this.syncedPath = path;
  }

  private async activatePluginsForLocation(path: string): Promise<void> {
    const scheme = schemeOf(path);
    if (!scheme || scheme === 'filesystem') return;

    const results = await this.pluginLifecycle.activateByEvent(`onScheme:${scheme}`);
    const failed = results.find(result => !result.activated);
    if (failed) {
      throw new Error(failed.error || `Plugin ${failed.pluginId} failed to activate for ${scheme}://.`);
    }
  }

  private canonicalize(path: string): string {
    let value = String(path ?? '').trim();
    if (/^\/[a-z][a-z0-9+.-]*:/i.test(value)) value = value.slice(1);
    const scheme = schemeOf(value);
    if (scheme && value.toLowerCase() === `${scheme}:`) return `${scheme}://`;
    return value;
  }
}
`````

`````typescript
import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';

const component = readFileSync(
  new URL('./perf-overlay.component.ts', import.meta.url),
  'utf8',
);

describe('Performance overlay draggable contract', () => {
  it('allows pointer interaction and starts dragging from the overlay', () => {
    expect(component).toContain('pointer-events: auto;');
    expect(component).toContain('(pointerdown)="startDrag($event)"');
    expect(component).toContain('element.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);');
    expect(component).toContain('event.stopPropagation();');
  });

  it('tracks document pointer events while keeping the overlay in the viewport', () => {
    expect(component).toContain("@HostListener('document:pointermove', ['$event'])");
    expect(component).toContain("@HostListener('document:pointerup', ['$event'])");
    expect(component).toContain("@HostListener('document:pointercancel', ['$event'])");
    expect(component).toContain('window.innerWidth - this.dragWidth - this.viewportMarginPx');
    expect(component).toContain('window.innerHeight - this.dragHeight - this.viewportMarginPx');
  });

  it('lets component state own top and bottom positioning so drag does not stretch the panel', () => {
    expect(component).toContain('[style.top.px]="positionTop"');
    expect(component).toContain('[style.bottom.px]="positionTop === null ? 8 : null"');
    expect(component).not.toContain('bottom: 8px;');
  });

  it('can reset to the default bottom-left position', () => {
    expect(component).toContain('(dblclick)="resetPosition($event)"');
    expect(component).toContain('this.positionLeft = 8;');
    expect(component).toContain('this.positionTop = null;');
  });
});
`````

`````typescript
      box-shadow: var(--vsc-shadow-medium);

export class ResponsiveToolbarComponent
  implements AfterViewInit, OnChanges, OnDestroy {
  @Input() actions: readonly ResponsiveToolbarCommand[] = [];
  @Input() ariaLabel = 'Toolbar actions';
  @Input() overflowLabel = 'More actions';
  @Input() showIcons = true;
  @Input() align: 'left' | 'right' = 'right';
  @Input() minVisible = 0;

  @ViewChild('toolbar', { static: true })
  private toolbarRef!: ElementRef<HTMLElement>;

  @ViewChildren('measureAction', { read: ElementRef })
  private measureActionRefs!: QueryList<ElementRef<HTMLElement>>;

  @ViewChild('measureOverflow', { read: ElementRef })
  private measureOverflowRef!: ElementRef<HTMLElement>;

  visibleActions: readonly ResponsiveToolbarCommand[] = [];
  overflowActions: readonly ResponsiveToolbarCommand[] = [];
  overflowOpen = false;

  private resizeObserver: ResizeObserver | null = null;
  private measurementFrame = 0;
  private lastSignature = '';

  constructor(private readonly cdr: ChangeDetectorRef) {}

  ngAfterViewInit(): void {
    this.resizeObserver = new ResizeObserver(() => this.scheduleMeasurement());
    this.resizeObserver.observe(this.toolbarRef.nativeElement);
    this.measureActionRefs.changes.subscribe(() => this.scheduleMeasurement());
    this.scheduleMeasurement();
  }

  ngOnChanges(_changes: SimpleChanges): void {
    const signature = this.actions
      .map(action => [
        action.id,
        action.label,
        action.shortcut ?? '',
        action.enabled ? '1' : '0',
        action.separatorBefore ? '1' : '0',
      ].join(':'))
      .join('|');

    if (signature === this.lastSignature) return;
    this.lastSignature = signature;
    this.visibleActions = this.actions;
    this.overflowActions = [];
    this.overflowOpen = false;
    this.scheduleMeasurement();
  }

  ngOnDestroy(): void {
    this.resizeObserver?.disconnect();
    this.resizeObserver = null;
    if (this.measurementFrame) {
      cancelAnimationFrame(this.measurementFrame);
    }
  }

  toggleOverflow(event: MouseEvent): void {
    event.preventDefault();
    event.stopPropagation();
    this.overflowOpen = !this.overflowOpen;
  }

  invoke(action: ResponsiveToolbarCommand): void {
    if (!action.enabled) return;
    this.overflowOpen = false;
    void Promise.resolve(action.execute());
  }

  trackAction(_index: number, action: ResponsiveToolbarCommand): string {
    return action.id;
  }

  actionTitle(action: ResponsiveToolbarCommand): string {
    return action.shortcut
      ? `${action.label} (${action.shortcut})`
      : action.label;
  }

  isDanger(action: ResponsiveToolbarCommand): boolean {
    return action.icon === 'delete' || /\b(delete|remove)\b/i.test(action.label);
  }

  actionIcon(action: ResponsiveToolbarCommand): string {
    return action.iconText || this.iconGlyph(action.icon);
  }

  iconGlyph(icon?: string): string {
    switch (icon) {
      case 'new-folder': return '+';
      case 'delete': return '';
      case 'copy': return '\u2398';
      case 'move': return '\u2192';
      case 'refresh': return '\u21BB';
      case 'plugin': return '\u25C6';
      default: return '';
    }
  }

  private scheduleMeasurement(): void {
    if (!this.toolbarRef || typeof requestAnimationFrame !== 'function') return;
    if (this.measurementFrame) cancelAnimationFrame(this.measurementFrame);
    this.measurementFrame = requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      this.measurementFrame = 0;
      this.measure();
    });
  }

  private measure(): void {
    const available = this.toolbarRef.nativeElement.clientWidth;
    const refs = this.measureActionRefs?.toArray() ?? [];
    if (!available || refs.length !== this.actions.length) {
      this.visibleActions = this.actions;
      this.overflowActions = [];
      this.cdr.markForCheck();
      return;
    }

    const widths = refs.map(ref =>
      Math.ceil(ref.nativeElement.getBoundingClientRect().width),
    );
    const overflowWidth = Math.ceil(
      this.measureOverflowRef?.nativeElement.getBoundingClientRect().width || 30,
    );
    const gap = 4;

    const fullWidth = widths.reduce(
      (sum, width, index) => sum + width + (index > 0 ? gap : 0),
      0,
    );

    if (fullWidth <= available) {
      this.visibleActions = this.actions;
      this.overflowActions = [];
      this.overflowOpen = false;
      this.cdr.markForCheck();
      return;
    }

    const usable = Math.max(0, available - overflowWidth - gap);
    let used = 0;
    let visibleCount = 0;

    for (const width of widths) {
      const next = used + (visibleCount > 0 ? gap : 0) + width;
      if (next > usable) break;
      used = next;
      visibleCount++;
    }

    visibleCount = Math.min(
      this.actions.length,
      Math.max(Math.min(this.minVisible, this.actions.length), visibleCount),
    );

    this.visibleActions = this.actions.slice(0, visibleCount);
    this.overflowActions = this.actions.slice(visibleCount);
    if (!this.overflowActions.length) this.overflowOpen = false;
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
  }
}
`````

`````typescript
import { Component, Input, Output, EventEmitter, ElementRef, ViewChild } from '@angular/core';
import { CommonModule } from '@angular/common';
import { TabComponent } from './tab.component';
import { TabInfo } from '../shared/protocol-enhanced';

export type PaneId = 'left' | 'right';

export interface TabDropEvent {
  tabId: string;
  fromPaneId: PaneId;
  toPaneId: PaneId;
  toIndex: number;
}

interface TabDragPayload {

@Component({

export class TabBarComponent {
  @ViewChild('scrollViewport', { static: true }) scrollViewport?: ElementRef<HTMLElement>;
  @ViewChild('tabsList', { static: true }) tabsList?: ElementRef<HTMLElement>;

  /** The pane that owns this tab bar. Required for cross-pane drag/drop. */
  @Input() paneId: PaneId = 'left';
  @Input() tabs: TabInfo[] = [];
  @Input() activeTabId = '';
  @Input() isCompact = false;
  /** Forwarded from pane host — true when browsing inside an archive. */
  @Input() inArchive = false;

  @Output() tabChange = new EventEmitter<TabInfo>();
  @Output() tabClose = new EventEmitter<TabInfo>();
  @Output() tabPin = new EventEmitter<TabInfo>();
  @Output() newTab = new EventEmitter<void>();
  @Output() tabDragStart = new EventEmitter<TabInfo>();

  /** Fired when a tab is dropped into this tab bar (reorder or cross-pane move). */
  @Output() tabDrop = new EventEmitter<TabDropEvent>();

  dropIndicatorX: number | null = null;
  private dropIndex: number | null = null;

  trackByTabId(index: number, tab: TabInfo): string {
    return tab.id;
  }

  onTabClick(tab: TabInfo) { this.tabChange.emit(tab); }
  onTabClose(tab: TabInfo) { this.tabClose.emit(tab); }
  onTabPin(tab: TabInfo) { this.tabPin.emit(tab); }
  onNewTab() { this.newTab.emit(); }

  onDragStart(event: DragEvent, tab: TabInfo): void {
    // Avoid starting a drag when interacting with tab action buttons.
    const target = event.target as HTMLElement | null;
    if (target?.closest('.tab-actions')) {
      event.preventDefault();
      return;
    }

    if (!event.dataTransfer) return;

    this.tabDragStart.emit(tab);
    event.dataTransfer.effectAllowed = 'move';

    const payload: TabDragPayload = { source: 'tab', tabId: tab.id, fromPaneId: this.paneId };
    // IMPORTANT: Some embedded engines (notably WebView2) can be quirky with
    // custom MIME types and/or hiding getData() during dragover.
    // Mirror the internal app DnD convention used by PaneListComponent.
    const payloadStr = JSON.stringify(payload);
    try { event.dataTransfer.setData('application/json', payloadStr); } catch {}
    try { event.dataTransfer.setData('application/x-wails-tab', payloadStr); } catch {}
    try { event.dataTransfer.setData('text/plain', payloadStr); } catch {}

    this.dropIndicatorX = null;
    this.dropIndex = null;
  }

  onDragEnd(_event: DragEvent): void {
    this.dropIndicatorX = null;
    this.dropIndex = null;
  }

  onDragOver(event: DragEvent): void {
    if (!this.isSupportedTabDrag(event)) return;

    // Prevent default to allow drop; otherwise cursor shows "not allowed".
    event.preventDefault();
    if (event.dataTransfer) event.dataTransfer.dropEffect = 'move';

    const computed = this.computeDropPosition(event.clientX);
    if (!computed) {
      this.dropIndicatorX = null;
      this.dropIndex = null;
      return;
    }
    this.dropIndicatorX = computed.indicatorX;
    this.dropIndex = computed.index;
  }

  onDragLeave(event: DragEvent): void {
    const related = (event.relatedTarget as HTMLElement | null);
    const viewport = this.scrollViewport?.nativeElement;
    if (!viewport) return;
    if (related && viewport.contains(related)) return;
    this.dropIndicatorX = null;
    this.dropIndex = null;
  }

  onDrop(event: DragEvent): void {
    if (this.isSupportedTabDrag(event)) {
      event.preventDefault();
    }

    const payload = this.readPayload(event);
    if (!payload) {
      this.dropIndicatorX = null;
      this.dropIndex = null;
      return;
    }

    const toIndex = this.dropIndex ?? this.tabs.length;
    this.tabDrop.emit({
      tabId: payload.tabId,
      fromPaneId: payload.fromPaneId,
      toPaneId: this.paneId,
      toIndex,
    });

    this.dropIndicatorX = null;
    this.dropIndex = null;
  }

  private readPayload(event: DragEvent): TabDragPayload | null {
    const dt = event.dataTransfer;
    if (!dt) return null;
    const raw = dt.getData('application/json') || dt.getData('application/x-wails-tab') || dt.getData('text/plain');
    if (!raw) return null;
    try {
      const parsed = JSON.parse(raw) as TabDragPayload;
      if (parsed?.source && parsed.source !== 'tab') return null;
      if (!parsed?.tabId) return null;
      if (parsed.fromPaneId !== 'left' && parsed.fromPaneId !== 'right') return null;
      return parsed;
    } catch {
      return null;
    }
  }

  private isSupportedTabDrag(event: DragEvent): boolean {
    const dt = event.dataTransfer;
    if (!dt) return false;
    const types = Array.from(dt.types ?? []);
    // Only accept our internal drags; avoid interfering with external OS drags.
    if (types.length === 0) {
      return dt.effectAllowed === 'move' || dt.effectAllowed === 'copyMove';
    }
    return types.includes('application/json') || types.includes('application/x-wails-tab');
  }

  private computeDropPosition(clientX: number): { index: number; indicatorX: number } | null {
    const viewport = this.scrollViewport?.nativeElement;
    const listEl = this.tabsList?.nativeElement;
    if (!viewport || !listEl) return null;

    const tabEls = Array.from(listEl.querySelectorAll('app-tab')) as HTMLElement[];
    const listRect = listEl.getBoundingClientRect();

    if (tabEls.length === 0) {
      const indicatorX = (clientX - listRect.left) + viewport.scrollLeft;
      return { index: 0, indicatorX: Math.max(0, indicatorX) };
    }

    let index = tabEls.length;
    let indicatorClientX = tabEls[tabEls.length - 1].getBoundingClientRect().right;

    for (let i = 0; i < tabEls.length; i++) {
      const r = tabEls[i].getBoundingClientRect();
      const mid = r.left + r.width / 2;
      if (clientX < mid) {
        index = i;
        indicatorClientX = r.left;
        break;
      }
    }

    const indicatorX = (indicatorClientX - listRect.left) + viewport.scrollLeft;
    return { index, indicatorX: Math.max(0, indicatorX) };
  }
}
`````

`````typescript
  });
`````

`````typescript
    expect(paneTree).toContain("export type TreeContentMode = 'all' | 'folders';");
    expect(paneTree).toContain("@Input() contentMode: TreeContentMode = 'all';");
    expect(container).toContain('[contentMode]="treeContentMode"');
    expect(controller).toContain("host.treeContentMode === 'all' || entry.type === FileType.DIRECTORY");
  });
`````

`````typescript
export class WorkspaceSelectorComponent implements AfterViewInit, OnChanges, OnDestroy, OnInit {
  @Input() workspaces: WorkspaceConfig[] = [];
  @Input() activeWorkspace: WorkspaceConfig | null = null;
  @Input() showMenu = false;

  @ViewChild('wsSelector') wsSelectorRef?: ElementRef<HTMLElement>;

  @Output() workspaceChange = new EventEmitter<WorkspaceConfig>();
  @Output() createNew = new EventEmitter<void>();
  @Output() rename = new EventEmitter<void>();
  @Output() deleteWorkspace = new EventEmitter<void>();
  @Output() menuToggle = new EventEmitter<boolean>();

  anchorElement: HTMLElement | null = null;
  selectedIndex = -1;

  private readonly commandOwner = `overlay.workspaceSelector:${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8)}`;
  private releaseOverlayContext: (() => void) | null = null;

  constructor(
    private cdr: ChangeDetectorRef,
    private inputContexts: InputContextService,
    private inputEngine: InputEngineService,
  ) {}

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.registerInputCommands();
    this.syncSelection();
    this.syncContextLease();
  }

  ngAfterViewInit(): void {
    this.anchorElement = this.wsSelectorRef?.nativeElement ?? null;
    this.cdr.detectChanges();
  }

  ngOnChanges(_changes: SimpleChanges): void {
    this.syncSelection();
    this.syncContextLease();
  }

  ngOnDestroy(): void {
    this.releaseOverlayContext?.();
    this.releaseOverlayContext = null;
    this.unregisterInputCommands();
  }

  // isOpen is two-way bound to appDropdown — directive handles all close/outside-click logic
  toggleMenu(): void {
    this.showMenu = !this.showMenu;
    this.syncSelection();
    this.syncContextLease();
    this.menuToggle.emit(this.showMenu);
    if (this.showMenu) {
      this.focusSelectedItem();
    }
  }

  onSelect(workspace: WorkspaceConfig): void {
    this.workspaceChange.emit(workspace);
    this.showMenu = false;
    this.syncContextLease();
    this.menuToggle.emit(false);
  }

  onMenuStateChange(show: boolean): void {
    this.showMenu = show;
    this.syncSelection();
    this.syncContextLease();
    this.menuToggle.emit(show);
    if (show) {
      this.focusSelectedItem();
    }
  }

  setSelectedIndex(index: number): void {
    if (index < 0 || index >= this.workspaces.length) return;
    this.selectedIndex = index;
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
    this.focusSelectedItem();
  }

  private moveSelection(delta: number): void {
    if (this.workspaces.length === 0) return;
    const baseIndex = this.selectedIndex >= 0 ? this.selectedIndex : 0;
    this.selectedIndex = Math.max(0, Math.min(this.workspaces.length - 1, baseIndex + delta));
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
    this.focusSelectedItem();
  }

  private activateSelected(): void {
    const workspace = this.workspaces[this.selectedIndex];
    if (!workspace) return;
    this.onSelect(workspace);
  }

  private syncSelection(): void {
    if (this.workspaces.length === 0) {
      this.selectedIndex = -1;
      return;
    }

    const activeIndex = this.workspaces.findIndex(workspace => workspace.id === this.activeWorkspace?.id);
    this.selectedIndex = activeIndex >= 0 ? activeIndex : 0;
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
  }

  private syncContextLease(): void {
    if (this.showMenu) {
      this.releaseOverlayContext ??= this.inputContexts.acquire('overlay.workspaceSelector');
      return;
    }

    this.releaseOverlayContext?.();
    this.releaseOverlayContext = null;
  }

  private registerInputCommands(): void {
    this.inputEngine.registerCommand('overlay.workspaceSelector.close', () => {
      if (!this.showMenu) return;
      this.onMenuStateChange(false);
    }, this.commandOwner);

    this.inputEngine.registerCommand('overlay.workspaceSelector.prevItem', () => {
      if (!this.showMenu) return;
      this.moveSelection(-1);
    }, this.commandOwner);

    this.inputEngine.registerCommand('overlay.workspaceSelector.nextItem', () => {
      if (!this.showMenu) return;
      this.moveSelection(1);
    }, this.commandOwner);

    this.inputEngine.registerCommand('overlay.workspaceSelector.activateSelected', () => {
      if (!this.showMenu) return;
      this.activateSelected();
    }, this.commandOwner);
  }

  private unregisterInputCommands(): void {
    this.inputEngine.unregisterCommand('overlay.workspaceSelector.close', this.commandOwner);
    this.inputEngine.unregisterCommand('overlay.workspaceSelector.prevItem', this.commandOwner);
    this.inputEngine.unregisterCommand('overlay.workspaceSelector.nextItem', this.commandOwner);
    this.inputEngine.unregisterCommand('overlay.workspaceSelector.activateSelected', this.commandOwner);
  }

  onCreateNew(): void { this.createNew.emit(); }
  onRename(): void { this.rename.emit(); }
  onDelete(): void { this.deleteWorkspace.emit(); }

  private focusSelectedItem(): void {
    requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      const item = document.querySelector<HTMLElement>('.ws-item.ws-item--selected');
      item?.focus({ preventScroll: true });
    });
  }
}
`````

`````typescript
import { Injectable } from '@angular/core';
import { QueuedDialogGate } from './dialog-gate';

export interface ArchiveFilesDialogRequest {
  title: string;
  message: string;
  confirmText: string;
  defaultValue: string;
  resolve(value: string | null): void;
}

@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })
export class ArchiveFilesDialogService {
  private readonly gate = new QueuedDialogGate<ArchiveFilesDialogRequest, string | null>();
  readonly activeRequest$ = this.gate.activeRequest$;
  readonly mountedRequest$ = this.gate.mountedRequest$;
  readonly closingRequest$ = this.gate.closingRequest$;

  open(request: Omit<ArchiveFilesDialogRequest, 'resolve'>): Promise<string | null> {
    return new Promise<string | null>((resolve) => {
      this.gate.enqueue({
        ...request,
        resolve,
      });
    });
  }

  submit(value: string): void {
    this.gate.beginClose(value);
  }

  close(): void {
    this.gate.beginClose(null);
  }

  finishClose(): void {
    this.gate.finishClose();
  }
}
`````
