`````typescript
import { Injectable, inject } from '@angular/core';
import { ArchiveListing } from '../shared/protocol-enhanced';
import { FileInfo, FileType } from '../shared/protocol';
import { PARENT_ENTRY_PATH } from '../components/file-entry.component';
import { ResourceMutationService } from './resource-mutation.service';

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   TYPES
───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

export interface ArchiveFrame {
  fsPath: string;
  nestedChain: string[];
  innerPath: string;
  listing: ArchiveListing;
}

export interface ArchiveBrowseTarget {
  frame: ArchiveFrame;
  browseChain: string[];
  browseInnerPath: string;
}

export interface ArchiveEntriesRequest {
  fsPath: string;
  nestedChain: string[];
  entries: string[];
  stripPrefix?: string;
  destinationDir: string;
  flattenPaths: boolean;
}


export interface ArchiveImportRequest {
  fsPath: string;
  nestedChain: string[];
  destinationPath: string;
  sources: string[];
}

export interface ArchiveEntriesResult {
  operationId: string;
  total: number;
  succeeded: number;
  failed: number;
  sourceRemoved: boolean;
  errors?: Array<{ source: string; error: string }>;
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   HELPERS
───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

// FIX: added .tbz2 and .txz which the tar handler registers but were missing,
// causing those files to be treated as plain files and nested-chain parsing to
// break for paths containing them.
export function isArchive(name: string): boolean {
  const l = name.toLowerCase();
  return (
    l.endsWith('.zip') ||
    l.endsWith('.tar') ||
    l.endsWith('.tgz') ||
    l.endsWith('.tar.gz') ||
    l.endsWith('.tar.bz2') ||
    l.endsWith('.tbz2') ||    // added
    l.endsWith('.tar.xz') ||
    l.endsWith('.txz') ||     // added
    l.endsWith('.gz') ||
    l.endsWith('.bz2') ||
    l.endsWith('.xz') ||
    l.endsWith('.rar') ||
    l.endsWith('.7z')
  );
}

export function normalizeArchiveInnerPath(path: string): string {
  const parts: string[] = [];

  for (const part of (path ?? '').replace(/\\/g, '/').split('/')) {
    if (!part || part === '.') continue;
    if (part === '..') {
      parts.pop();
      continue;
    }
    parts.push(part);
  }

  return parts.join('/');
}

export function resolveArchiveChildInnerPath(
  currentInnerPath: string,
  entryPath: string,
): string {
  const current = normalizeArchiveInnerPath(currentInnerPath);
  const entry = normalizeArchiveInnerPath(entryPath);

  if (!current) return entry;
  if (!entry) return current;
  if (entry === current || entry.startsWith(`${current}/`)) return entry;

  return normalizeArchiveInnerPath(`${current}/${entry}`);
}

export function normalizeNestedArchiveChain(
  chain: readonly string[],
): string[] {
  return chain
    .map(segment => normalizeArchiveInnerPath(segment))
    .filter(Boolean);
}

export function appendNestedArchiveEntry(
  containingChain: readonly string[],
  currentInnerPath: string,
  entryPath: string,
): string[] {
  const chain = normalizeNestedArchiveChain(containingChain);
  const nestedArchivePath = resolveArchiveChildInnerPath(
    currentInnerPath,
    entryPath,
  );

  if (!nestedArchivePath) return chain;
  if (chain[chain.length - 1] === nestedArchivePath) return chain;

  return [...chain, nestedArchivePath];
}

export function normalizeArchiveLocation(path: string): string {
  const raw = (path ?? '').trim().replace(/\\/g, '/');
  if (!raw) return '';

  // Collapse duplicate slashes only in the path body, never in `scheme://`.
  const scheme = /^([a-z][a-z0-9+.-]*:\/\/)(.*)$/i.exec(raw);
  if (scheme) {
    const prefix = scheme[1];
    const body = scheme[2].replace(/\/{2,}/g, '/').replace(/\/$/, '');
    return `${prefix}${body}`;
  }

  // Preserve an absolute POSIX root while normalizing duplicate separators.
  const absolute = raw.startsWith('/');
  const body = raw.replace(/\/{2,}/g, '/').replace(/\/$/, '');
  return absolute && !body.startsWith('/') ? `/${body}` : body;
}

export function joinArchiveLocation(
  base: string,
  ...parts: readonly string[]
): string {
  const cleanBase = normalizeArchiveLocation(base);
  const cleanParts = parts
    .map(part => (part ?? '').replace(/\\/g, '/').replace(/^\/+|\/+$/g, ''))
    .filter(Boolean);

  if (cleanParts.length === 0) return cleanBase;
  return normalizeArchiveLocation(`${cleanBase}/${cleanParts.join('/')}`);
}

export function sameArchiveLocation(left: string, right: string): boolean {
  return normalizeArchiveLocation(left).toLocaleLowerCase() ===
    normalizeArchiveLocation(right).toLocaleLowerCase();
}

export function buildArchiveDisplayPath(
  rootFsPath: string,
  stack: ArchiveFrame[]
): string {
  if (stack.length === 0) return normalizeArchiveLocation(rootFsPath);

  const frame = stack[stack.length - 1];
  const archiveFsPath = normalizeArchiveLocation(stack[0].fsPath || rootFsPath);

  return joinArchiveLocation(
    archiveFsPath,
    ...frame.nestedChain,
    frame.innerPath,
  );
}

export function buildArchiveTabTitle(
  rootFsPath: string,
  stack: ArchiveFrame[]
): string {

  if (stack.length === 0)
    return rootFsPath.split('/').filter(Boolean).pop() ?? rootFsPath;

  const frame = stack[stack.length - 1];

  if (frame.innerPath)
    return frame.innerPath.split('/').filter(Boolean).pop() ?? frame.innerPath;

  if (frame.nestedChain.length > 0)
    return frame.nestedChain[frame.nestedChain.length - 1];

  return rootFsPath.split('/').filter(Boolean).pop() ?? rootFsPath;
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   WAILS BRIDGE
───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

declare const window: any;

async function goBrowse(
  fsPath: string,
  nestedChain: string[],
  innerPath: string
): Promise<ArchiveListing> {

  const app = window.go?.app?.App;
  if (!app) throw new Error('Wails bridge not available');

  return app.ArchiveBrowse(fsPath, nestedChain, innerPath);
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   PATH UTILITIES
───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

/**
 * Decomposes a global archive path like
 *   "filesystem://c/foo/bar.zip/nested.zip/dir/file.txt"
 * into the three components expected by the backend:
 *   fsPath      = "filesystem://c/foo/bar.zip"
 *   nestedChain = ["nested.zip"]
 *   innerPath   = "dir/file.txt"
 */
export function parseArchivePath(globalPath: string): { fsPath: string; nestedChain: string[]; innerPath: string } {
  const norm = normalizeArchiveLocation(globalPath);
  const parts = norm.split('/');

  const firstIdx = parts.findIndex(p => isArchive(p));
  if (firstIdx === -1) return { fsPath: globalPath, nestedChain: [], innerPath: '' };

  const fsPath = normalizeArchiveLocation(
    parts.slice(0, firstIdx + 1).join('/'),
  );
  const rest = parts.slice(firstIdx + 1);

  // Accumulate segments; each time we hit an archive name it closes a nestedChain entry.
  const nestedChain: string[] = [];
  const accum: string[] = [];
  for (const seg of rest) {
    accum.push(seg);
    if (isArchive(seg)) {
      nestedChain.push(accum.join('/'));
      accum.length = 0;
    }
  }
  return { fsPath, nestedChain, innerPath: accum.join('/') };
}

/**
 * Builds a global archive path from its three components.
 * Empty parts are omitted so trailing slashes are avoided.
 */
export function buildArchivePath(
  fsPath: string,
  nestedChain: string[],
  innerPath: string,
): string {
  return joinArchiveLocation(fsPath, ...nestedChain, innerPath);
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   SERVICE
───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })
export class ArchiveService {
  private readonly resourceMutations = inject(ResourceMutationService);
  /**
   * Extracts entries from an archive. If the user selects all top-level entries (the root),
   * it uses BatchExtract for efficiency. Otherwise, it uses BatchSelectiveExtract for a subset.
   * @param frame The current archive frame
   * @param entries The selected entry paths (relative to the archive root)
   * @param destDir The destination directory for extraction
   * @param flattenPaths Whether to flatten extracted paths
   */
  async extractEntries(
    frame: ArchiveFrame,
    entries: string[],
    destDir: string,
    flattenPaths = false
  ): Promise<any> {
    // 1. Filter out the ".." parent entry
    const filteredEntries = entries.filter(e => e !== PARENT_ENTRY_PATH);
    
    // 2. Get all entries currently visible in this frame
    const allInView = frame.listing.entries
      .map(e => e.path)
      .filter(e => e !== PARENT_ENTRY_PATH);

    // 3. Check if we are at the true root of the physical archive
    const isAtArchiveRoot = frame.nestedChain.length === 0 && !frame.innerPath;

    // 4. Check if everything in the current view is selected
    const isAllSelected = 
      filteredEntries.length > 0 &&
      filteredEntries.length === allInView.length &&
      filteredEntries.every(e => allInView.includes(e));

    // Fallback to BatchExtract ONLY if at the root and everything is selected
    if (isAtArchiveRoot && isAllSelected) {
      const result = await window.go.app.App.BatchExtract({
        archives: [frame.fsPath],
        destinationDir: destDir,
        createSubdirectory: false,
        expandNestedArchives: false,
        flattenSingleRoot: flattenPaths,
      });
      this.resourceMutations.publish({ kind: 'modify', items: [{ source: destDir }], origin: 'archive-extract' });
      return result;
    } 
    
    // Otherwise, use Selective Extraction to ensure only the 
    // contents of the current folder/selection are processed
    const result = await window.go.app.App.BatchSelectiveExtract({
      items: [
        {
          archivePath: frame.fsPath,
          nestedChain: frame.nestedChain,
          entries: filteredEntries,
          stripPrefix: frame.innerPath || '',
          destinationDir: destDir,
          flattenPaths,
        },
      ],
      destinationDir: destDir,
    });
    this.resourceMutations.publish({ kind: 'modify', items: [{ source: destDir }], origin: 'archive-extract' });
    return result;
  }

  /* ─────────────── OPEN ─────────────── */

  async openRootArchive(fsPath: string): Promise<ArchiveFrame> {
    const canonicalFsPath = normalizeArchiveLocation(fsPath);
    const listing = await goBrowse(canonicalFsPath, [], '');
    return {
      fsPath: canonicalFsPath,
      nestedChain: [],
      innerPath: '',
      listing,
    };
  }

  async openNestedArchive(
    frame: ArchiveFrame,
    entryNestedChain: string[]
  ): Promise<ArchiveFrame> {

    const listing = await goBrowse(
      frame.fsPath,
      entryNestedChain,
      ''
    );

    return {
      fsPath: frame.fsPath,
      nestedChain: entryNestedChain,
      innerPath: '',
      listing
    };
  }

  /* ─────────────── NAVIGATION ─────────────── */

  async navigateInto(
    frame: ArchiveFrame,
    folderInnerPath: string
  ): Promise<ArchiveFrame> {
    const innerPath = normalizeArchiveInnerPath(folderInnerPath);

    const listing = await goBrowse(
      frame.fsPath,
      frame.nestedChain,
      innerPath,
    );

    return { ...frame, innerPath, listing };
  }

  async navigateUp(frame: ArchiveFrame): Promise<ArchiveFrame | null> {

    if (!frame.innerPath)
      return null;

    const parentInnerPath = frame.innerPath.includes('/')
      ? frame.innerPath.replace(/\/[^/]+$/, '')
      : '';

    const listing = await goBrowse(
      frame.fsPath,
      frame.nestedChain,
      parentInnerPath
    );

    return { ...frame, innerPath: parentInnerPath, listing };
  }

  /* ─────────────── UNIVERSAL RESOLVER ─────────────── */

  resolveBrowseTarget(
    seg: { name: string; fullPath: string },
    stack: ArchiveFrame[]
  ): ArchiveBrowseTarget | null {

    if (!stack?.length)
      return null;

    const archiveBase = stack[0].fsPath.replace(/\\/g, '/');
    const vNorm = seg.fullPath.replace(/\\/g, '/');

    const afterArchive = vNorm.startsWith(archiveBase)
      ? vNorm.slice(archiveBase.length).replace(/^\/+/, '')
      : '';

    const parts = afterArchive.split('/').filter(Boolean);

    let owningFrame = stack[0];

    for (const frame of stack) {

      const chain = frame.nestedChain;

      const matches =
        chain.length <= parts.length &&
        chain.every((c, i) => c === parts[i]);

      if (matches && chain.length >= owningFrame.nestedChain.length)
        owningFrame = frame;
    }

    const chain = owningFrame.nestedChain;
    let innerParts = parts.slice(chain.length);

    if (isArchive(seg.name))
      innerParts = innerParts.slice(1);

    return {
      frame: owningFrame,
      browseChain: chain,
      browseInnerPath: innerParts.join('/')
    };
  }

  /* ─────────────── OPERATIONS ─────────────── */

  async importPaths(
    frame: ArchiveFrame,
    sources: string[],
  ): Promise<ArchiveEntriesResult> {
    if (frame.nestedChain.length > 0) {
      throw new Error('Nested archives are read-only.');
    }
    if (!/\.zip$/i.test(frame.fsPath)) {
      throw new Error('Only ZIP archives currently support adding files.');
    }
    const request: ArchiveImportRequest = {
      fsPath: frame.fsPath,
      nestedChain: [],
      destinationPath: frame.innerPath || '',
      sources: [...sources],
    };
    const app = window.go?.app?.App;
    if (typeof app?.ArchiveImportEntries !== 'function') {
      throw new Error('ArchiveImportEntries binding is unavailable. Run Wails binding generation.');
    }
    const result = await app.ArchiveImportEntries(request);
    this.resourceMutations.publish({
      kind: 'modify',
      items: [{ source: frame.fsPath }],
      origin: 'archive-import',
    });
    return result;
  }

  async copy(
    frame: ArchiveFrame,
    entries: string[],
    destDir: string,
    flattenPaths = false,
  ): Promise<ArchiveEntriesResult> {

    const req: ArchiveEntriesRequest = {
      fsPath: frame.fsPath,
      nestedChain: frame.nestedChain,
      entries,
      stripPrefix: frame.innerPath || '',
      destinationDir: destDir,
      flattenPaths,
    };

    const result = await window.go.app.App.ArchiveCopyEntries(req);
    this.resourceMutations.publish({ kind: 'modify', items: [{ source: destDir }], origin: 'archive-copy' });
    return result;
  }

  async move(
    frame: ArchiveFrame,
    entries: string[],
    destDir: string,
    flattenPaths = false,
  ): Promise<ArchiveEntriesResult> {

    const req: ArchiveEntriesRequest = {
      fsPath: frame.fsPath,
      nestedChain: frame.nestedChain,
      entries,
      stripPrefix: frame.innerPath || '',
      destinationDir: destDir,
      flattenPaths,
    };

    const result = await window.go.app.App.ArchiveMoveEntries(req);
    this.resourceMutations.publish({ kind: 'modify', items: [{ source: frame.fsPath }], origin: 'archive-move' });
    this.resourceMutations.publish({ kind: 'modify', items: [{ source: destDir }], origin: 'archive-move' });
    return result;
  }

  async delete(
    frame: ArchiveFrame,
    entries: string[],
  ): Promise<ArchiveEntriesResult> {

    if (frame.nestedChain.length > 0) {
      return Promise.reject(new Error(
        'Deleting entries from nested archives is not supported. ' +
        'Navigate to the top-level archive first.'
      ));
    }

    const req: ArchiveEntriesRequest = {
      fsPath: frame.fsPath,
      nestedChain: [],
      entries,
      destinationDir: '',
      flattenPaths: false,
    };

    const result = await window.go.app.App.ArchiveDeleteEntries(req);
    this.resourceMutations.publish({ kind: 'modify', items: [{ source: frame.fsPath }], origin: 'archive-delete' });
    return result;
  }

  async copyByContext(
    archivePath: string,
    innerPaths: string[],
    destDir: string,
  ): Promise<ArchiveEntriesResult> {
    const { fsPath, nestedChain } = parseArchivePath(archivePath);
    const req: ArchiveEntriesRequest = {
      fsPath,
      nestedChain,
      entries: innerPaths,
      stripPrefix: '',
      destinationDir: destDir,
      flattenPaths: false,
    };
    const result = await window.go.app.App.ArchiveCopyEntries(req);
    this.resourceMutations.publish({ kind: 'modify', items: [{ source: destDir }], origin: 'archive-copy' });
    return result;
  }

  async moveByContext(
    archivePath: string,
    innerPaths: string[],
    destDir: string,
  ): Promise<ArchiveEntriesResult> {
    const { fsPath, nestedChain } = parseArchivePath(archivePath);
    const req: ArchiveEntriesRequest = {
      fsPath,
      nestedChain,
      entries: innerPaths,
      stripPrefix: '',
      destinationDir: destDir,
      flattenPaths: false,
    };
    const result = await window.go.app.App.ArchiveMoveEntries(req);
    this.resourceMutations.publish({ kind: 'modify', items: [{ source: fsPath }], origin: 'archive-move' });
    this.resourceMutations.publish({ kind: 'modify', items: [{ source: destDir }], origin: 'archive-move' });
    return result;
  }

  /* ─────────────── UTILITIES ─────────────── */

  async refreshFrame(frame: ArchiveFrame): Promise<ArchiveFrame> {

    const listing = await goBrowse(
      frame.fsPath,
      frame.nestedChain,
      frame.innerPath
    );

    return { ...frame, listing };
  }

  listingToFileInfos(listing: ArchiveListing): FileInfo[] {

    const dotdot: FileInfo = {
      name: '..',
      path: PARENT_ENTRY_PATH,
      type: FileType.DIRECTORY,
      size: 0,
      modified: 0,
      created: 0,
      accessed: 0,
      permissions: 'drwxr-xr-x',
      isHidden: false,
    };

    const entries: FileInfo[] =
      listing.entries.map(e => ({
        name: e.name,
        path: e.path,
        type: e.type as FileType,
        size: e.size,
        modified: e.modified, // already UnixMilli from backend
        created: e.modified,
        accessed: e.modified,
        permissions:
          e.type === FileType.DIRECTORY
            ? 'drwxr-xr-x'
            : '-rw-r--r--',
        isHidden: e.name.startsWith('.'),
        // FIX: nestedChain is now populated for archive entries by the backend
        // (convertVFSInfoWithChain / vfsEntryToFileInfo) for all formats.
        nestedChain: (e as any).nestedChain ?? undefined,
      }));

    return [dotdot, ...entries];
  }
}
`````

`````typescript
import { Injectable } from '@angular/core';
import type { FileInfo } from '../shared/protocol';
import { QueuedDialogGate } from './dialog-gate';

export interface BatchRenameItem {
  entry: FileInfo;
  newName: string;
}

export interface BatchRenameOptions {
  pattern: string;
  startAt: number;
  increment: number;
}

export interface BatchRenameRequest {
  items: BatchRenameItem[];
  currentPath: string;
  resolve(value: BatchRenameItem[] | null): void;
}

@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })
export class BatchRenameDialogService {
  private readonly gate = new QueuedDialogGate<BatchRenameRequest, BatchRenameItem[] | null>();
  public readonly activeRequest$ = this.gate.activeRequest$;
  public readonly mountedRequest$ = this.gate.mountedRequest$;
  public readonly closingRequest$ = this.gate.closingRequest$;

  openDialog(items: BatchRenameItem[], currentPath: string): Promise<BatchRenameItem[] | null> {
    return new Promise<BatchRenameItem[] | null>((resolve) => {
      this.gate.enqueue({
        items,
        currentPath,
        resolve,
      });
    });
  }

  resolveActive(result: BatchRenameItem[] | null): void {
    this.gate.beginClose(result);
  }

  finishClose(): void {
    this.gate.finishClose();
  }
}
`````

`````typescript
describe('BinPanelSource', () => {

    const api = {
      listTrashEntries: async () => [{ id: 'native-id', name: 'report.txt', originalPath: 'C:/Work/report.txt', trashedPath: 'native', deletedAt: '2026-08-22T10:00:00Z', size: 42, isDir: false, canRestore: true }],

    expect(listing.entries[0].type).toBe(FileType.FILE);
    expect(listing.entries[0].path.startsWith('bin://entry/')).toBeTrue();
    expect((listing.entries[0] as any).binOriginalPath).toBe('C:/Work/report.txt');
  });

  it('preserves the real filename extension from the original path', async () => {
    const api = {
      // Windows ShellItem.Name may be the extension-hidden display name.
      listTrashEntries: async () => [{ id: 'zip-id', name: 'backup', originalPath: 'C:/Work/backup.zip', trashedPath: 'native', deletedAt: '2026-08-22T10:00:00Z', size: 42, isDir: true, canRestore: true }],
    } as any;
    const source = new BinPanelSource(api);

    const listing = await source.list({ path: 'bin://' });

    expect(listing.entries[0].name).toBe('backup.zip');
    expect(listing.entries[0].type).toBe(FileType.ARCHIVE);
  });

  it('round-trips native trash identities through synthetic paths', () => {
    const source = new BinPanelSource({} as any);
    const id = 'C:/\u0024Recycle.Bin/item with spaces';
    const path = `bin://entry/${encodeURIComponent(id)}`;
    expect(source.decodeEntryPath(path)).toBe(id);
  });
});
`````

`````typescript
import { Injectable } from '@angular/core';

import { FileType, type FileInfo } from '../shared/protocol';
import type { TrashEntry } from './api.service';
import { ApiService } from './api.service';
import { isArchive } from './archive.service';
import type { PanelSource, PanelSourceContext, PanelSourceListing } from './panel-source';
import type { SourceCapabilities } from './source-capabilities';

export type BinFileInfo = FileInfo & {
  binId: string;
  binOriginalPath: string;
  binDeletedAt: string;
  binCanRestore: boolean;
};

const ROOT = 'bin://';
const READ_ONLY: SourceCapabilities = Object.freeze({
  read: true,
  create: false,
  delete: false,
  rename: false,
  trash: false,
});

@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })
export class BinPanelSource implements PanelSource {
  readonly id = 'builtin.bin';
  readonly kind = 'virtual' as const;
  readonly title = 'Bin';

  constructor(private readonly api: ApiService) {}

  canHandle(context: PanelSourceContext): boolean {
    return /^bin:\/\//i.test(context.path);
  }

  capabilities(): SourceCapabilities { return READ_ONLY; }
  supportsStreaming(): boolean { return false; }
  getRootPath(): string { return ROOT; }
  getParentPath(): string { return ROOT; }
  joinChildPath(): string { return ROOT; }

  async list(_context: PanelSourceContext): Promise<PanelSourceListing> {
    const entries = (await this.api.listTrashEntries()).map(entry => this.toFileInfo(entry));
    return {
      location: { path: ROOT, sourceId: this.id, sourceKind: this.kind },
      entries,
    };
  }

  canPreviewEntry(): boolean { return false; }

  // Recycle-bin entries are synthetic shell items. They must never be sent to
  // the ordinary file viewer using their bin:// identity.
  activateEntry(): boolean { return true; }

  decodeEntryPath(path: string): string | null {
    const match = /^bin:\/\/entry\/(.+)$/i.exec(path ?? '');
    if (!match?.[1]) return null;
    try { return decodeURIComponent(match[1]); } catch { return null; }
  }

  async restore(id: string): Promise<string> {
    return await this.api.restoreTrashEntry(id);
  }

  async deletePermanently(id: string): Promise<void> {
    await this.api.deleteTrashEntry(id);
  }

  async empty(): Promise<void> {
    await this.api.emptyTrash();
  }

  private basename(path: string): string {
    const normalized = (path || '').trim().replace(/\\/g, '/').replace(/\/+$/, '');
    if (!normalized) return '';
    const index = normalized.lastIndexOf('/');
    return index >= 0 ? normalized.slice(index + 1) : normalized;
  }

  private toFileInfo(entry: TrashEntry): BinFileInfo {
    const deleted = Date.parse(entry.deletedAt || '');
    // Prefer the basename from the original path. On Windows the Recycle Bin
    // shell's display Name can omit extensions when Explorer hides them.
    const originalName = this.basename(entry.originalPath);
    const name = originalName || entry.name;
    const type = isArchive(name)
      ? FileType.ARCHIVE
      : entry.isDir
        ? FileType.DIRECTORY
        : FileType.FILE;
    return {
      name,
      path: `bin://entry/${encodeURIComponent(entry.id)}`,
      type,
      size: entry.size,
      created: 0,
      modified: Number.isFinite(deleted) ? Math.floor(deleted / 1000) : 0,
      accessed: 0,
      permissions: entry.canRestore ? 'r--' : '---',
      isHidden: false,
      binId: entry.id,
      binOriginalPath: entry.originalPath,
      binDeletedAt: entry.deletedAt,
      binCanRestore: entry.canRestore,
    };
  }
}
`````

`````typescript
import { Injectable } from '@angular/core';

import { ApiService } from './api.service';
import { ConfirmDialogService } from './confirm-dialog.service';
import { WorkspaceSurfaceActionRegistryService } from './workspace-surface-action-registry.service';
import type {
  WorkspaceSurfaceActionContext,
  WorkspaceSurfaceActionContribution,
} from './workspace-surface-action.types';
import { FileType } from '../shared/protocol';
import { formatLocalDateTimeInput } from '../utils/local-date-time';

@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })
export class BuiltinWorkspaceSurfaceActionsService {
  private registered = false;

  constructor(
    private readonly registry: WorkspaceSurfaceActionRegistryService,
    private readonly api: ApiService,
    private readonly confirmDialog: ConfirmDialogService,
  ) {}

  register(): void {
    if (this.registered) return;
    this.registered = true;

    for (const contribution of this.contributions()) {
      this.registry.register(contribution);
    }
  }

  private contributions(): readonly WorkspaceSurfaceActionContribution[] {
    return [
      {
        id: 'builtin.workspace.search.open',
        surfaceId: 'search-workspace',
        action: 'open',
        execute: context => this.openSearchResult(context),
      },
      {
        id: 'builtin.workspace.search.reveal',
        surfaceId: 'search-workspace',
        action: 'reveal',
        execute: context => this.revealSearchResult(context),
      },
      {
        id: 'builtin.workspace.search.copyPath',
        surfaceId: 'search-workspace',
        action: 'copy-path',
        execute: context => this.copySearchPath(context),
      },
      {
        id: 'builtin.workspace.compare.copyLeftRight',
        surfaceId: 'compare-workspace',
        action: 'copy-left-right',
        execute: context => this.copyMissing(context, true),
      },
      {
        id: 'builtin.workspace.compare.copyRightLeft',
        surfaceId: 'compare-workspace',
        action: 'copy-right-left',
        execute: context => this.copyMissing(context, false),
      },
      {
        id: 'builtin.workspace.details.reveal',
        surfaceId: 'details-workspace',
        action: 'reveal',
        execute: context => this.revealDetails(context),
      },
      {
        id: 'builtin.workspace.details.rename',
        surfaceId: 'details-workspace',
        action: 'rename',
        execute: context => this.renameDetails(context),
      },
      {
        id: 'builtin.workspace.details.modified',
        surfaceId: 'details-workspace',
        action: 'modified-time',
        execute: context => this.modifiedTime(context),
      },
      {
        id: 'builtin.workspace.details.attributes',
        surfaceId: 'details-workspace',
        action: 'attributes',
        execute: context => this.attributes(context),
      },
      {
        id: 'builtin.workspace.details.copyPath',
        surfaceId: 'details-workspace',
        action: 'copy-path',
        execute: context => this.copyDetailsPath(context),
      },
    ];
  }

  /** Row-targeted actions pass { path } in the payload; toolbar actions pass
    nothing and fall back to the inspected folder (surface.state.path). */
  private targetPath(context: WorkspaceSurfaceActionContext): string {
    const payloadPath = String((context.event.payload as { path?: string } | undefined)?.path ?? '');
    return payloadPath || String(context.event.surface.state?.['path'] ?? '');
  }

  private async copyDetailsPath(
    context: WorkspaceSurfaceActionContext,
  ): Promise<void> {
    const path = this.targetPath(context);
    if (!path) return;

    try {
      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(path);
    } catch (error) {
      await this.showError(error);
    }
  }

  private async openSearchResult(
    context: WorkspaceSurfaceActionContext,
  ): Promise<void> {
    const entry = context.event.payload as any;
    if (!entry?.path) return;

    try {
      if (entry.type === FileType.DIRECTORY) {
        context.services.closeToolWorkspace();
        const pane = context.services.getActivePane() as {
          navigateTo?(path: string): void | Promise<void>;
        } | null;

        await pane?.navigateTo?.(entry.path);
      } else {
        await this.api.openFile(entry.path);
      }
    } catch (error) {
      await this.showError(error);
    }
  }

  private async revealSearchResult(
    context: WorkspaceSurfaceActionContext,
  ): Promise<void> {
    const entry = context.event.payload as any;
    if (!entry?.path) return;

    try {
      await this.api.revealInFileManager(entry.path);
    } catch (error) {
      await this.showError(error);
    }
  }

  private async copySearchPath(
    context: WorkspaceSurfaceActionContext,
  ): Promise<void> {
    const entry = context.event.payload as any;
    if (!entry?.path) return;

    try {
      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(entry.path);
    } catch (error) {
      await this.showError(error);
    }
  }

  private async copyMissing(
    context: WorkspaceSurfaceActionContext,
    leftToRight: boolean,
  ): Promise<void> {
    const surface = context.event.surface;
    const leftPath = String(surface.state?.['leftPath'] ?? '');
    const rightPath = String(surface.state?.['rightPath'] ?? '');
    const rows = Array.isArray(surface.state?.['rows'])
      ? (surface.state?.['rows'] as any[])
      : [];

    if (!leftPath || !rightPath) return;

    const candidates = rows.filter(row =>
      leftToRight
        ? row.status === 'only-left' || row.status === 'onlyLeft'
        : row.status === 'only-right' || row.status === 'onlyRight',
    );

    if (candidates.length === 0) {
      await this.confirmDialog.alert({
        title: 'Compare Workspace',
        message: leftToRight
          ? 'There are no items that exist only on the left.'
          : 'There are no items that exist only on the right.',
      });
      return;
    }

    const confirmed = await this.confirmDialog.confirm({
      title: leftToRight ? 'Copy Missing →' : '← Copy Missing',
      message: `Copy ${candidates.length} missing item${
        candidates.length === 1 ? '' : 's'
      }?`,
      confirmText: 'Copy',
    });
    if (!confirmed) return;

    context.services.patchSurface(surface.id, {
      busy: true,
      error: '',
    });

    try {
      const destinationRoot = leftToRight ? rightPath : leftPath;
      const items = candidates.map(row => ({
        source: leftToRight ? row.leftPath : row.rightPath,
        destination: destinationRoot,
        exactDestination: false,
      }));

      const result = await this.api.batchCopy(items, true);
      if (result.failed > 0) {
        throw new Error(
          `Copy completed with ${result.failed} failure${
            result.failed === 1 ? '' : 's'
          }.`,
        );
      }

      await context.services.refreshSurface(surface);
    } catch (error) {
      context.services.patchSurface(surface.id, {
        busy: false,
        error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error),
      });
    }
  }

  private async revealDetails(
    context: WorkspaceSurfaceActionContext,
  ): Promise<void> {
    const path = this.targetPath(context);
    if (!path) return;

    try {
      await this.api.revealInFileManager(path);
    } catch (error) {
      await this.showError(error);
    }
  }

  private async renameDetails(
    context: WorkspaceSurfaceActionContext,
  ): Promise<void> {
    const surface = context.event.surface;
    const path = this.targetPath(context);
    if (!path) return;

    try {
      const info = await this.api.getFileInfo(path);
      const name = await this.confirmDialog.prompt({
        title: `Rename — ${info.name}`,
        message: 'New name:',
        confirmText: 'Rename',
        defaultValue: info.name,
        historyKey: 'reassembly.workspace.details.rename',
      });

      if (!name || name === info.name) return;

      const parent = path.replace(/[\\/][^\\/]+$/, '');
      const destination = await this.api.joinPaths([
        parent,
        String(name).trim(),
      ]);

      const result = await this.api.batchMove(
        [{
          source: path,
          destination,
          exactDestination: true,
        }],
        true,
      );

      if (result.failed > 0 || result.skipped > 0) {
        throw new Error('Rename failed.');
      }

      // Only the toolbar renames the inspected folder itself; row-targeted
      // renames leave the inspector's path untouched.
      const renamedInspectedFolder = path === String(surface.state?.['path'] ?? '');
      let toRefresh = surface;
      if (renamedInspectedFolder) {
        context.services.patchSurface(surface.id, {
          path: destination,
        });

        toRefresh = {
          ...surface,
          state: {
            ...(surface.state ?? {}),
            path: destination,
          },
        };
      }

      await context.services.refreshSurface(toRefresh);
    } catch (error) {
      context.services.patchSurface(surface.id, {
        busy: false,
        error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error),
      });
    }
  }

  private async modifiedTime(
    context: WorkspaceSurfaceActionContext,
  ): Promise<void> {
    const surface = context.event.surface;
    const path = this.targetPath(context);
    if (!path) return;

    try {
      const value = await this.confirmDialog.prompt({
        title: 'Modified Time',
        message: 'Enter YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss or "now".',
        confirmText: 'Apply',
        defaultValue: formatLocalDateTimeInput(),
        historyKey: 'reassembly.workspace.details.modified',
      });

      if (!value) return;

      const raw = String(value).trim();
      const timestamp =
        raw.toLowerCase() === 'now'
          ? Date.now()
          : new Date(raw).getTime();

      if (!Number.isFinite(timestamp)) {
        throw new Error('Invalid date/time.');
      }

      await this.api.setModifiedTime(path, timestamp);
      await context.services.refreshSurface(surface);
    } catch (error) {
      context.services.patchSurface(surface.id, {
        busy: false,
        error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error),
      });
    }
  }

  private async attributes(
    context: WorkspaceSurfaceActionContext,
  ): Promise<void> {
    const surface = context.event.surface;
    const path = this.targetPath(context);
    if (!path) return;

    try {
      const [osInfo, attributes] = await Promise.all([
        this.api.getOSInfo(),
        this.api.getPathAttributes(path),
      ]);

      if (String(osInfo?.os).toLowerCase() === 'windows') {
        const current = [
          attributes.readOnly ? 'readonly' : '',
          attributes.hidden ? 'hidden' : '',
          attributes.system ? 'system' : '',
          attributes.archive ? 'archive' : '',
        ].filter(Boolean).join(',');

        const value = await this.confirmDialog.prompt({
          title: 'Attributes',
          message: 'Comma-separated: readonly, hidden, system, archive',
          confirmText: 'Apply',
          defaultValue: current,
          historyKey: 'reassembly.workspace.details.attributes',
        });

        if (value === null || value === undefined) return;

        const tokens = new Set(
          String(value)
            .split(',')
            .map(token => token.trim().toLowerCase())
            .filter(Boolean),
        );

        await this.api.setPathAttributes(path, {
          readOnly: tokens.has('readonly'),
          hidden: tokens.has('hidden'),
          system: tokens.has('system'),
          archive: tokens.has('archive'),
        });
      } else {
        const currentMode = (attributes.unixMode || 0)
          .toString(8)
          .padStart(4, '0');

        const value = await this.confirmDialog.prompt({
          title: 'Permissions',
          message: 'Unix permission mode, e.g. 0644 or 0755:',
          confirmText: 'Apply',
          defaultValue: currentMode,
          historyKey: 'reassembly.workspace.details.permissions',
        });

        if (!value) return;

        const normalized = String(value).trim();
        if (!/^[0-7]{3,4}$/.test(normalized)) {
          throw new Error('Invalid Unix permission mode.');
        }

        await this.api.setPathAttributes(path, {
          unixMode: Number.parseInt(normalized, 8),
        });
      }

      await context.services.refreshSurface(surface);
    } catch (error) {
      context.services.patchSurface(surface.id, {
        busy: false,
        error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error),
      });
    }
  }

  private async showError(error: unknown): Promise<void> {
    await this.confirmDialog.alert({
      title: 'Workspace Action Failed',
      message: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error),
    });
  }
}
`````

`````typescript
import { createBehaviorSubject } from '@epikodelabs/streamix';

export interface QueuedDialogRequest<TResult> {
  resolve(result: TResult): void;
}

export class QueuedDialogGate<TRequest extends QueuedDialogRequest<TResult>, TResult> {
  readonly activeRequest$ = createBehaviorSubject<TRequest | null>(null);
  readonly mountedRequest$ = createBehaviorSubject<TRequest | null>(null);
  readonly closingRequest$ = createBehaviorSubject<TRequest | null>(null);

  private readonly queue: TRequest[] = [];
  private pendingClose: { request: TRequest; result: TResult } | null = null;

  get activeRequest(): TRequest | null {
    return this.activeRequest$.value;
  }

  get queuedRequests(): readonly TRequest[] {
    return this.queue;
  }

  enqueue(request: TRequest): void {
    this.queue.push(request);
    this.tryOpenNext();
  }

  beginClose(result: TResult): void {
    const active = this.activeRequest$.value;
    if (!active || this.pendingClose) {
      return;
    }

    this.pendingClose = { request: active, result };
    this.closingRequest$.next(active);
    this.activeRequest$.next(null);
  }

  finishClose(): void {
    if (!this.pendingClose) {
      return;
    }

    const { request, result } = this.pendingClose;
    this.pendingClose = null;
    request.resolve(result);
    this.closingRequest$.next(null);
    this.mountedRequest$.next(null);
    this.tryOpenNext();
  }

  resolveActive(result: TResult): void {
    this.beginClose(result);
    this.finishClose();
  }

  protected tryOpenNext(): void {
    if (this.activeRequest$.value || this.pendingClose) {
      return;
    }

    const next = this.queue.shift() ?? null;
    this.activeRequest$.next(next);
    this.mountedRequest$.next(next);
  }
}
`````

`````typescript
import { Injectable } from '@angular/core';

interface DirectoryListingProvider {

  buildPathSegments(path: string): PathSegment[];

function isWebHttpPath(path: string): boolean {
  const normalized = normalizePath(path);
  try {
    const parsed = new URL(normalized);
    return (parsed.protocol === 'http:' || parsed.protocol === 'https:') && parsed.host.length > 0;
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

function looksLikeHtmlDocument(content: string): boolean {
  const sample = (content || '').trimStart().slice(0, 512).toLowerCase();
  return sample.startsWith('<!doctype html') ||
    sample.startsWith('<html') ||
    sample.includes('<head') ||
    sample.includes('<body');
}

function canonicalizeWebUrl(raw: string): string {
  const parsed = new URL(raw);
  parsed.protocol = parsed.protocol.toLowerCase();
  parsed.host = parsed.host.toLowerCase();
  parsed.hash = '';
  parsed.pathname = parsed.pathname.replace(/\\/g, '/');
  if (parsed.pathname === '/') {
    parsed.pathname = '';
  } else {
    parsed.pathname = parsed.pathname.replace(/\/+$/, '');
  }
  return parsed.toString();
}

function isLikelyWebPage(pathname: string): boolean {
  if (!pathname || pathname.endsWith('/')) {
    return true;
  }

  const match = /\.([^.\/]+)$/.exec(pathname);
  const ext = match?.[1]?.toLowerCase() || '';
  return ext === '' || [
    'html', 'htm', 'xhtml', 'shtml', 'php', 'asp', 'aspx', 'jsp', 'jspx', 'cfm',
  ].includes(ext);
}

function webEntryDisplayName(target: URL): string {
  const trimmedPath = target.pathname.replace(/\/+$/, '').replace(/^\/+/, '');
  if (!trimmedPath) {
    return target.search ? `${target.host}${target.search}` : target.host;
  }

  const segments = trimmedPath.split('/');
  const base = segments[segments.length - 1] || target.host;
  return target.search ? `${base}${target.search}` : base;
}

function parseSrcset(value: string | null): string[] {
  if (!value) return [];
  return value
    .split(',')
    .map((part) => part.trim().split(/\s+/)[0] || '')
    .filter(Boolean);
}

function resolveWebReference(baseUrl: URL, rawRef: string | null): URL | null {
  const ref = (rawRef || '').trim();
  if (!ref) return null;

  const lower = ref.toLowerCase();
  if (
    lower.startsWith('#') ||
    lower.startsWith('javascript:') ||
    lower.startsWith('mailto:') ||
    lower.startsWith('tel:') ||
    lower.startsWith('data:')
  ) {
    return null;
  }

  try {
    const resolved = new URL(ref, baseUrl);
    if (resolved.protocol !== 'http:' && resolved.protocol !== 'https:') {
      return null;
    }
    resolved.hash = '';
    return resolved;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

function makeWebEntry(path: string, type: FileType): FileInfo {
  const target = new URL(path);
  return {
    name: webEntryDisplayName(target),
    path,
    type,
    size: 0,
    modified: 0,
    mimeType: '',
    isHidden: false,
  } as FileInfo;
}

function discoverWebEntriesFromHtml(content: string, pageUrl: string): FileInfo[] {
  let currentUrl: URL;
  try {
    currentUrl = new URL(canonicalizeWebUrl(pageUrl));
  } catch {
    return [];
  }

  const parser = new DOMParser();
  const document = parser.parseFromString(content, 'text/html');

  const baseHref = document.querySelector('base[href]')?.getAttribute('href') || null;
  const baseUrl = resolveWebReference(currentUrl, baseHref) || currentUrl;

  const entries = new Map<string, FileInfo>();
  const addEntry = (rawRef: string | null, navigable: boolean): void => {
    const resolved = resolveWebReference(baseUrl, rawRef);
    if (!resolved) return;

    if (resolved.search) {
      return;
    }

    const normalized = canonicalizeWebUrl(resolved.toString());
    if (normalized === currentUrl.toString() || entries.has(normalized)) {
      return;
    }

    const type = navigable && isLikelyWebPage(resolved.pathname)
      ? FileType.DIRECTORY
      : FileType.FILE;
    entries.set(normalized, makeWebEntry(normalized, type));
  };

  document.querySelectorAll('a[href]').forEach((node) => addEntry(node.getAttribute('href'), true));

  return Array.from(entries.values()).sort((left, right) => left.path.localeCompare(right.path));
}

function trimPathForChild(basePath: string): string {
  const normalized = normalizePath(basePath || '/');
  return /^[a-z][a-z0-9+.-]*:\/\/$/i.test(normalized)
    ? normalized
    : normalized.replace(/\/+$/, '');
}

class FilesystemDirectoryProvider implements DirectoryListingProvider {
  readonly kind: DirectorySourceKind = 'filesystem';

  constructor(private readonly apiService: ApiService) {}

  canHandlePath(_path: string): boolean {
    return true;
  }

  canHandleEntries(_entries: FileInfo[]): boolean {
    return false;
  }

  listDirectory(path: string, showHidden: boolean): Promise<DirectorySourceListing> {
    return this.apiService.listDirectory(path, showHidden);
  }

  getRootPath(path: string): string | null {
    const normalized = normalizePath(path || '/');

    const driveMatch = /^(?:filesystem|drive):\/\/([a-z])(?:\/.*)?$/i.exec(normalized);
    if (driveMatch) return `filesystem://${driveMatch[1].toLowerCase()}`;

    // Native Windows paths are valid filesystem locations too. Preserve their
    // drive-root representation instead of falling through to the POSIX root.
    // C:/Users/name -> C:/ (never a synthetic / or \ node).
    const nativeDriveMatch = /^([a-z]):(?:\/.*)?$/i.exec(normalized);
    if (nativeDriveMatch) return `${nativeDriveMatch[1].toUpperCase()}:/`;

    const aliasMatch = /^([a-z][a-z0-9+.-]*):\/\//i.exec(normalized);
    if (aliasMatch) return `${aliasMatch[1].toLowerCase()}://`;
    return '/';
  }

  joinChildPath(basePath: string, childName: string): string {
    const trimmedBase = trimPathForChild(basePath);
    return `${trimmedBase}/${childName}`;
  }

  supportsStreaming(_path: string): boolean {
    return true;
  }
}


class BinDirectoryProvider implements DirectoryListingProvider {
  readonly kind: DirectorySourceKind = 'filesystem';

  constructor(private readonly apiService: ApiService) {}

  canHandlePath(path: string): boolean {
    return /^bin:\/\//i.test(normalizePath(path));
  }

  canHandleEntries(_entries: FileInfo[]): boolean {
    return false;
  }

  async listDirectory(_path: string, _showHidden: boolean): Promise<DirectorySourceListing> {
    const entries = await this.apiService.listTrashEntries();
    return {
      path: 'bin://',
      entries: entries.map(entry => {
        const deleted = Date.parse(entry.deletedAt || '');
        return {
          name: entry.name,
          path: `bin://entry/${encodeURIComponent(entry.id)}`,
          type: entry.isDir ? FileType.DIRECTORY : FileType.FILE,
          size: Number(entry.size) || 0,
          created: 0,
          modified: Number.isFinite(deleted) ? deleted : 0,
          accessed: 0,
          permissions: 'r--',
          isHidden: false,
          // Explicit provider metadata is part of the canonical FileInfo contract.
          // Keeping trash identity separate from display grouping means Latest/vN
          // rows remain independently actionable.
          binTrashId: entry.id,
          binOriginalPath: entry.originalPath || '',
          binDeletedAt: entry.deletedAt || '',
          binCanRestore: entry.canRestore,
        } as FileInfo;
      }),
    };
  }

  getRootPath(_path: string): string | null { return 'bin://'; }
  joinChildPath(_basePath: string, _childName: string): string { return 'bin://'; }
  supportsStreaming(_path: string): boolean { return false; }
}

class AliasDirectoryProvider implements DirectoryListingProvider {
  readonly kind: DirectorySourceKind = 'filesystem';

  constructor(private readonly apiService: ApiService) {}

  canHandlePath(path: string): boolean {
    return isAliasPath(path) && !isRegistryPath(path);
  }

  canHandleEntries(_entries: FileInfo[]): boolean {
    return false;
  }

  listDirectory(path: string, showHidden: boolean): Promise<DirectorySourceListing> {
    return this.apiService.listDirectory(path, showHidden);
  }

  getRootPath(path: string): string | null {
    const normalized = normalizePath(path);
    if (/^search:\/\//i.test(normalized) && normalized.toLowerCase() !== 'search://') {
      return normalized;
    }
    if (isWebHttpPath(normalized)) {
      try {
        const parsed = new URL(normalized);
        return `${parsed.protocol.toLowerCase()}//${parsed.host.toLowerCase()}`;
      } catch {
        return null;
      }
    }
    const aliasMatch = /^([a-z][a-z0-9+.-]*):\/\//i.exec(normalized);
    return aliasMatch ? `${aliasMatch[1].toLowerCase()}://` : null;
  }

  joinChildPath(basePath: string, childName: string): string {
    const normalizedBase = trimPathForChild(basePath);
    return `${normalizedBase}/${childName}`;
  }

  supportsStreaming(_path: string): boolean {
    return /^search:\/\//i.test(_path);
  }
}

class RegistryDirectoryProvider implements DirectoryListingProvider {
  readonly kind: DirectorySourceKind = 'registry';

  constructor(private readonly registryService: RegistryService) {}

  canHandlePath(path: string): boolean {
    return isRegistryPath(path);
  }

  canHandleEntries(entries: FileInfo[]): boolean {
    return entries.some((entry) =>
      entry.path !== '__parent__' &&
      (isRegistryPath(entry.path) || !!entry.registryKind || !!entry.registryValueType || !!entry.registryPreview),
    );
  }

  async listDirectory(path: string, _showHidden: boolean): Promise<DirectorySourceListing> {
    const frame: RegistryFrame = path === REGISTRY_ROOT
      ? await this.registryService.openRoot()
      : await this.registryService.navigateInto(path);

    return {
      path: frame.path,
      entries: frame.entries,
    };
  }

  getRootPath(_path: string): string | null {
    return REGISTRY_ROOT;
  }

  joinChildPath(basePath: string, childName: string): string {
    if (basePath === REGISTRY_ROOT) {
      return `${REGISTRY_ROOT}${childName}`;
    }
    return `${trimPathForChild(basePath)}/${childName}`;
  }

  supportsStreaming(_path: string): boolean {
    return false;
  }
}

@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })
export class DirectorySourceService implements FileViewDirectorySource {
  private readonly providers: DirectoryListingProvider[];

  constructor(
    private readonly apiService: ApiService,
    private readonly archiveService: ArchiveService,
    private readonly registryService: RegistryService,
  ) {
    this.providers = [
      new RegistryDirectoryProvider(this.registryService),
      new BinDirectoryProvider(this.apiService),
      new AliasDirectoryProvider(this.apiService),
      new FilesystemDirectoryProvider(this.apiService),
    ];
  }

  async listDirectory(path: string, showHidden: boolean = false): Promise<DirectorySourceListing> {
    return this.providerForPath(path).listDirectory(path, showHidden);
  }

  async browseArchive(fsPath: string, nestedChain: string[] = [], innerPath: string = ''): Promise<ArchiveListing> {
    return this.apiService.archiveBrowse(fsPath, nestedChain, innerPath);
  }

  async getArchiveFrame(fsPath: string, nestedChain: string[] = [], innerPath: string = ''): Promise<ArchiveFrame> {
    let frame = await this.archiveService.openRootArchive(fsPath);

    for (let index = 0; index < nestedChain.length; index += 1) {
      frame = await this.archiveService.openNestedArchive(frame, nestedChain.slice(0, index + 1));
    }

    if (innerPath) {
      frame = await this.archiveService.navigateInto(frame, innerPath);
    }

    return frame;
  }

  openNestedArchive(frame: ArchiveFrame, nestedChain: string[]): Promise<ArchiveFrame> {
    return this.archiveService.openNestedArchive(frame, nestedChain);
  }

  navigateArchive(frame: ArchiveFrame, folderInnerPath: string): Promise<ArchiveFrame> {
    return this.archiveService.navigateInto(frame, folderInnerPath);
  }

  navigateArchiveUp(frame: ArchiveFrame): Promise<ArchiveFrame | null> {
    return this.archiveService.navigateUp(frame);
  }

  refreshArchive(frame: ArchiveFrame): Promise<ArchiveFrame> {
    return this.archiveService.refreshFrame(frame);
  }

  resolveArchiveBrowseTarget(seg: { name: string; fullPath: string }, stack: ArchiveFrame[]): ArchiveBrowseTarget | null {
    return this.archiveService.resolveBrowseTarget(seg, stack);
  }

  archiveListingToFileInfos(listing: ArchiveListing): FileInfo[] {
    return this.archiveService.listingToFileInfos(listing);
  }

  getPathKind(path: string, entries: FileInfo[] = []): DirectorySourceKind {
    return this.providerFor(path, entries).kind;
  }

  getRootPath(path: string, entries: FileInfo[] = []): string | null {
    return this.providerFor(path, entries).getRootPath(path);
  }

  getParentPath(path: string): string {
    const normalized = normalizePath(path);
    const { fsDirPath, archiveInnerParts } = parsePathWithArchives(normalized);

    if (archiveInnerParts.length > 0) {
      const parentInnerParts = archiveInnerParts.slice(0, -1);
      return parentInnerParts.length > 0
        ? normalizePath(`${fsDirPath}/${parentInnerParts.join('/')}`)
        : fsDirPath;
    }

    return parentPath(normalized);
  }

  isRootPath(path: string): boolean {
    const normalized = normalizePath(path);
    if (this.isPathInsideArchive(normalized)) {
      return false;
    }

    const rootPath = this.getRootPath(normalized);
    return !!rootPath && normalized === normalizePath(rootPath);
  }

  isPathInsideArchive(path: string): boolean {
    const normalized = normalizeArchiveLocation(path);
    if (!normalized || isRegistryPath(normalized)) {
      return false;
    }

    const { fsPath } = parseArchivePath(normalized);
    const leafName =
      fsPath.replace(/\\/g, '/').split('/').filter(Boolean).pop() ?? '';

    return isArchive(leafName);
  }

  buildPathSegments(path: string): PathSegment[] {
    const normalized = normalizePath(path);
    const { fsDirPath, archiveInnerParts } = parsePathWithArchives(normalized);
    const baseSegments = archiveInnerParts.length > 0
      ? buildSegmentsFromParsedPath(fsDirPath, archiveInnerParts)
      : buildBasicSegments(normalized);

    let insideArchive = false;
    return baseSegments.map((segment) => {
      const isArchiveRoot = isArchive(segment.label);
      const nextSegment: PathSegment = {
        ...segment,
        isArchiveRoot,
        isArchiveInner: insideArchive,
      };
      if (isArchiveRoot) {
        insideArchive = true;
      }
      return nextSegment;
    });
  }

  joinChildPath(basePath: string, childName: string): string {
    return this.providerForPath(basePath).joinChildPath(basePath, childName);
  }

  supportsStreaming(path: string): boolean {
    return this.providerForPath(path).supportsStreaming(path);
  }

  private providerFor(path: string, entries: FileInfo[] = []): DirectoryListingProvider {
    const entryMatch = this.providers.find((provider) => provider.canHandleEntries(entries));
    if (entryMatch) return entryMatch;
    return this.providerForPath(path);
  }

  private providerForPath(path: string): DirectoryListingProvider {
    return this.providers.find((provider) => provider.canHandlePath(path)) ?? this.providers[this.providers.length - 1];
  }
`````

`````typescript
import { Injectable } from '@angular/core';
import { InputTrigger, InputBindingDefinition } from './input-system.types';
import { FILE_MANAGER_BINDINGS } from '../components/command-registry';
import { BUILTIN_INPUT_CATALOG } from './dialog-input-catalog';

export interface KeybindingOverride {
  id: string;
  trigger?: InputTrigger;
  enabled?: boolean;
}

const STORAGE_KEY = 'keybinding-overrides-v1';

function buildDefaultCatalog(): Map<string, InputBindingDefinition> {
  const map = new Map<string, InputBindingDefinition>();
  for (const binding of FILE_MANAGER_BINDINGS) {
    map.set(binding.id, binding);
  }
  for (const entry of BUILTIN_INPUT_CATALOG) {
    for (const binding of entry.bindings) {
      map.set(binding.id, binding);
    }
  }
  return map;
}

@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })
export class KeybindingStorageService {
  private readonly defaults = buildDefaultCatalog();
  private overrides: KeybindingOverride[] = [];

  constructor() {
    this.load();
  }

  getOverrides(): KeybindingOverride[] {
    return this.overrides.map(override => ({ ...override }));
  }

  getOverride(bindingId: string): KeybindingOverride | undefined {
    const override = this.overrides.find(item => item.id === bindingId);
    return override ? { ...override } : undefined;
  }

  hasOverride(bindingId: string): boolean {
    return this.overrides.some(item => item.id === bindingId);
  }

  getDefaultBinding(bindingId: string): InputBindingDefinition | undefined {
    return this.defaults.get(bindingId);
  }

  getDefaultBindings(): InputBindingDefinition[] {
    return Array.from(this.defaults.values()).map(binding => ({ ...binding }));
  }

  mergeWithDefaults(snapshot: InputBindingDefinition[]): InputBindingDefinition[] {
    const merged = new Map<string, InputBindingDefinition>();

    for (const binding of this.defaults.values()) {
      merged.set(binding.id, { ...binding, enabled: true });
    }

    for (const binding of snapshot) {
      merged.set(binding.id, binding);
    }

    return Array.from(merged.values());
  }

  setOverride(override: KeybindingOverride): void {
    const idx = this.overrides.findIndex(o => o.id === override.id);
    if (idx >= 0) {
      this.overrides[idx] = { ...this.overrides[idx], ...override };
    } else {
      this.overrides.push(override);
    }
    this.save();
  }

  removeOverride(bindingId: string): void {
    this.overrides = this.overrides.filter(o => o.id !== bindingId);
    this.save();
  }

  resetAll(): void {
    this.overrides = [];
    this.save();
  }

  applyOverrides(engine: {
    registerBinding(binding: InputBindingDefinition): void;
    updateBindingTrigger(bindingId: string, trigger: InputTrigger): boolean;
    setBindingEnabled(bindingId: string, enabled: boolean): void;
  }): void {
    for (const override of this.overrides) {
      if (override.trigger) {
        engine.updateBindingTrigger(override.id, override.trigger);
      }
      if (typeof override.enabled === 'boolean') {
        engine.setBindingEnabled(override.id, override.enabled);
      }
    }
  }

  private load(): void {
    try {
      const raw = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
      if (raw) {
        const parsed = JSON.parse(raw) as KeybindingOverride[];
        if (Array.isArray(parsed)) {
          this.overrides = parsed;
        }
      }
    } catch {
      // ignore parse errors
    }
  }

  private save(): void {
    try {
      localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(this.overrides));
    } catch {
      // ignore storage errors
    }
  }
}
`````

## File: manager/frontend/src/app/services/native-overlay-freeze.service.ts
`````typescript
import { Injectable } from '@angular/core';

/**
 * Ref-counted freeze for native browser overlays.
 *
 * Any component that needs to draw HTML on top of the native Win32 browser
 * pane (dialogs, dropdowns, filter widgets, etc.) should acquire a freeze
 * before showing and release it on close.  While at least one freeze is
 * held the body gets a `native-overlay-frozen` class which tells
 * `PaneViewHostComponent` to replace the live overlay with a canvas
 * screenshot.
 */
@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })
export class NativeOverlayFreezeService {
  private holders = new Set<string>();

  get frozen(): boolean {
    return this.holders.size > 0;
  }

  acquire(key: string): void {
    if (this.holders.has(key)) {
      return;
    }
    this.holders.add(key);
    this.sync();
  }

  release(key: string): void {
    if (!this.holders.delete(key)) {
      return;
    }
    this.sync();
  }

  private sync(): void {
    if (typeof document === 'undefined' || typeof window === 'undefined') {
      return;
    }
    if (this.holders.size > 0) {
      document.body.classList.add('native-overlay-frozen');
    } else {
      document.body.classList.remove('native-overlay-frozen');
    }
    window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('native-overlay-freeze-change'));
  }
}
`````

`````typescript
import { Injectable } from '@angular/core';
import { QueuedDialogGate } from './dialog-gate';
import type {
  PaneComparisonPolicy,
  PaneComparisonResult,
} from './pane-comparison.service';

export interface PaneCompareDialogViewModel {
  getLeftPath(): string;
  getRightPath(): string;
  getResult(): PaneComparisonResult;
  getPolicy(): PaneComparisonPolicy;
  onPolicyChange(policy: PaneComparisonPolicy): void | Promise<void>;
  onSelectLeft(): void;
  onSelectRight(): void;
  onCopyMissingLeftToRight(): void | Promise<void>;
  onCopyMissingRightToLeft(): void | Promise<void>;
  onOpenRecursiveCompare(): void | Promise<void>;
  onOpenSyncReview(): void | Promise<void>;
}

export interface PaneCompareDialogRequest {
  viewModel: PaneCompareDialogViewModel;
  resolve(): void;
}

@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })
export class PaneCompareDialogService {
  private readonly gate = new QueuedDialogGate<PaneCompareDialogRequest, void>();
  readonly activeRequest$ = this.gate.activeRequest$;
  readonly mountedRequest$ = this.gate.mountedRequest$;
  readonly closingRequest$ = this.gate.closingRequest$;

  openDialog(viewModel: PaneCompareDialogViewModel): Promise<void> {
    return new Promise<void>((resolve) => {
      this.gate.enqueue({ viewModel, resolve });
    });
  }

  close(): void {
    this.gate.beginClose(undefined);
  }

  finishClose(): void {
    this.gate.finishClose();
  }

  notifyActiveChanged(): void {
    const active = this.gate.activeRequest;
    if (!active) {
      return;
    }
    this.activeRequest$.next({ ...active });
  }
}
`````

`````typescript
import { FileType } from '../shared/protocol';
import type { FileInfo } from '../shared/protocol-enhanced';
import { PanelSourceRegistryService } from './panel-source-registry.service';

function entry(path: string): FileInfo {
  const name = path.split('/').pop() || path;
  return {
    name,
    path,
    type: FileType.FILE,
    size: 1,
    modified: 1,
    created: 1,
    accessed: 1,
    permissions: '',
    isHidden: false,
    isSymlink: false,
  };
}

describe('PanelSourceRegistryService', () => {
  function createService() {
    const directories = {
      listDirectory: jasmine.createSpy('listDirectory').and.callFake(async (path: string) => ({
        path,
        entries: [entry(`${path}/local.txt`)],
      })),
      getRootPath: jasmine.createSpy('getRootPath').and.returnValue('filesystem://c'),
      getParentPath: jasmine.createSpy('getParentPath').and.returnValue('filesystem://c'),
      joinChildPath: jasmine.createSpy('joinChildPath').and.callFake((path: string, name: string) => `${path}/${name}`),
      supportsStreaming: jasmine.createSpy('supportsStreaming').and.returnValue(true),
      getPathKind: jasmine.createSpy('getPathKind').and.returnValue('filesystem'),
    };
    const remoteConnections = {
      isRemoteUri: jasmine.createSpy('isRemoteUri').and.returnValue(false),
      capabilitiesFor: jasmine.createSpy('capabilitiesFor'),
    };
    const resultsPanels = {
      get: jasmine.createSpy('get').and.returnValue(null),
      create: jasmine.createSpy('create'),
      title: jasmine.createSpy('title'),
    };

    return {
      service: new PanelSourceRegistryService(
        directories as any,
        remoteConnections as any,
        resultsPanels as any,
      ),
      directories,
    };
  }

  it('treats the local filesystem as a normal panel source', async () => {
    const { service, directories } = createService();
    const context = {
      path: 'filesystem://c/work',
      entries: [] as FileInfo[],
      inArchive: false,
    };

    const resolved = service.resolve(context);
    const listing = await service.listContext(context, false);

    expect(resolved.source.id).toBe('filesystem');
    expect(resolved.source.kind).toBe('filesystem');
    expect(resolved.location.sourceId).toBe('filesystem.local');
    expect(directories.listDirectory).toHaveBeenCalledWith('filesystem://c/work', false);
    expect(listing.entries.map(item => item.name)).toEqual(['local.txt']);
  });

  it('treats an open archive as its own panel source without falling through to filesystem listing', async () => {
    const { service, directories } = createService();
    const entries = [entry('docs/readme.txt')];
    const context = {
      path: 'filesystem://c/work/package.zip/docs',
      entries,
      inArchive: true,
      archiveTopLevel: true,
    };

    const resolved = service.resolve(context);
    const listing = await service.listContext(context, false);

    expect(resolved.source.id).toBe('archive');
    expect(resolved.source.kind).toBe('archive');
    expect(resolved.capabilities.create).toBe(true);
    expect(resolved.capabilities.rename).toBe(false);
    expect(listing.location.sourceId).toBe('archive');
    expect(listing.entries).toEqual(entries);
    expect(listing.entries).not.toBe(entries);
    expect(directories.listDirectory).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('keeps archive mutation policy compatible with top-level versus nested archives', () => {
    const { service } = createService();

    const topLevel = service.resolve({
      path: 'filesystem://c/work/package.zip',
      inArchive: true,
      archiveTopLevel: true,
    });
    const nested = service.resolve({
      path: 'filesystem://c/work/package.zip/nested.zip',
      inArchive: true,
      archiveTopLevel: false,
    });

    const tar = service.resolve({
      path: 'filesystem://c/work/package.tar/docs',
      inArchive: true,
      archiveTopLevel: true,
    });

    expect(topLevel.capabilities.create).toBe(true);
    expect(topLevel.capabilities.delete).toBe(true);
    expect(nested.capabilities.create).toBe(false);
    expect(nested.capabilities.delete).toBe(false);
    expect(tar.capabilities.create).toBe(false);
  });
  it('resolves contributed panel sources before ordinary built-ins and removes them cleanly', () => {
    const { service } = createService();
    const source = {
      id: 'plugin.demo',
      kind: 'virtual' as const,
      title: 'Demo',
      canHandle: (context: any) => context.path.startsWith('demo://'),
      capabilities: () => ({ read: true, create: false, delete: false, rename: false, trash: false }),
      list: async (context: any) => ({ location: { path: context.path, sourceId: 'plugin.demo', sourceKind: 'virtual' as const }, entries: [] }),
      getRootPath: () => 'demo://',
      getParentPath: () => 'demo://',
      joinChildPath: (_context: any, name: string) => `demo://${name}`,
      supportsStreaming: () => false,
    };

    service.register(source);
    const resolved = service.resolve({ path: 'demo://collection' });
    expect(resolved.source.id).toBe('plugin.demo');
    expect(resolved.location.sourceId).toBe('plugin.demo');
    expect(service.listSources().some(candidate => candidate.id === 'plugin.demo')).toBe(true);

    service.unregister('plugin.demo');
    expect(service.listSources().some(candidate => candidate.id === 'plugin.demo')).toBe(false);
  });

  it('keeps Registry out of core resolution until the Registry plugin contributes it', () => {
    const { service, directories } = createService();
    (directories.getPathKind as jasmine.Spy).and.returnValue('registry');

    expect(service.resolve({ path: 'registry://HKEY_CURRENT_USER/Software' }).source.id).toBe('filesystem');

    service.register({
      id: 'registry',
      kind: 'registry' as const,
      title: 'Registry',
      canHandle: (context: any) => directories.getPathKind(context.path, context.entries ?? []) === 'registry',
      capabilities: () => ({
        read: true,
        create: true,
        delete: true,
        rename: true,
        trash: false,
      }),
      list: async (context: any, showHidden: boolean) => {
        const listing = await directories.listDirectory(context.path, showHidden);
        return {
          location: {
            path: listing.path || context.path,
            sourceId: 'registry',
            sourceKind: 'registry' as const,
          },
          entries: listing.entries,
        };
      },
      getRootPath: (context: any) => directories.getRootPath(context.path, context.entries ?? []),
      getParentPath: (context: any) => directories.getParentPath(context.path),
      joinChildPath: (context: any, name: string) => directories.joinChildPath(context.path, name),
      supportsStreaming: (context: any) => directories.supportsStreaming(context.path),
    });
    const resolved = service.resolve({ path: 'registry://HKEY_CURRENT_USER/Software' });
    expect(resolved.source.id).toBe('registry');
    expect(resolved.source.kind).toBe('registry');
  });

});
`````
