import { Injectable } from '@angular/core';

import type { FileInfo } from '../shared/protocol-enhanced';
import { DirectorySourceService } from './directory-source.service';
import {
  type PanelSource,
  type PanelSourceContext,
  type PanelSourceKind,
  type PanelSourceListing,
  type ResolvedPanelSource,
} from './panel-source';
import { RemoteConnectionsService } from './remote-connections.service';
import { ResilienceService } from './resilience.service';

import {
  ResultsPanelService,
  type ResultsPanelMetadata,
} from './results-panel.service';
import {
  getSourceCapabilities,
  type SourceCapabilities,
} from './source-capabilities';

const ARCHIVE_READ_ONLY: SourceCapabilities = Object.freeze({
  read: true,
  create: false,
  delete: false,
  rename: false,
  trash: false,
});

function schemeOf(path: string): string | null {
  const match = /^([a-z][a-z0-9+.-]*):\/\//i.exec((path ?? '').trim());
  return match?.[1]?.toLowerCase() ?? null;
}

abstract class BasePanelSource implements PanelSource {
  abstract readonly id: string;
  abstract readonly kind: PanelSourceKind;
  abstract readonly title: string;

  constructor(
    protected readonly directories: DirectorySourceService,
  ) {}

  abstract canHandle(context: PanelSourceContext): boolean;
  abstract capabilities(context: PanelSourceContext): SourceCapabilities;

  async list(
    context: PanelSourceContext,
    showHidden: boolean,
  ): Promise<PanelSourceListing> {
    const listing = await this.directories.listDirectory(
      context.path,
      showHidden,
    );

    return {
      location: {
        path: listing.path || context.path,
        sourceId: this.id,
        sourceKind: this.kind,
      },
      entries: listing.entries,
    };
  }

  getRootPath(context: PanelSourceContext): string | null {
    return this.directories.getRootPath(
      context.path,
      [...(context.entries ?? [])],
    );
  }

  getParentPath(context: PanelSourceContext): string {
    return this.directories.getParentPath(context.path);
  }

  joinChildPath(
    context: PanelSourceContext,
    childName: string,
  ): string {
    return this.directories.joinChildPath(context.path, childName);
  }

  supportsStreaming(context: PanelSourceContext): boolean {
    return this.directories.supportsStreaming(context.path);
  }

  activateEntry(
    _context: PanelSourceContext,
    _entry: FileInfo,
  ): boolean | Promise<boolean> {
    return false;
  }

  canPreviewEntry(
    _context: PanelSourceContext,
    _entry: FileInfo,
  ): boolean {
    return true;
  }
}

class ArchivePanelSource extends BasePanelSource {
  readonly id = 'archive';
  readonly kind = 'archive' as const;
  readonly title = 'Archive';

  canHandle(context: PanelSourceContext): boolean {
    return !!context.inArchive;
  }

  capabilities(context: PanelSourceContext): SourceCapabilities {
    const writableZip =
      !!context.archiveTopLevel &&
      /\.zip(?:\/|$)/i.test(context.path);
    return {
      ...ARCHIVE_READ_ONLY,
      create: writableZip,
      delete: !!context.archiveTopLevel,
    };
  }

  override async list(
    context: PanelSourceContext,
    _showHidden: boolean,
  ): Promise<PanelSourceListing> {
    return {
      location: {
        path: context.path,
        sourceId: this.id,
        sourceKind: this.kind,
      },
      entries: [...(context.entries ?? [])],
    };
  }

  override supportsStreaming(): boolean {
    return false;
  }
}

export class RemotePanelSource extends BasePanelSource {
  readonly kind = 'remote' as const;

  constructor(
    directories: DirectorySourceService,
    private readonly remote: RemoteConnectionsService,
    private readonly resilience?: ResilienceService,
    readonly id = 'remote',
    readonly title = 'Remote',
    private readonly schemes: readonly string[] | null = null,
  ) {
    super(directories);
  }

  canHandle(context: PanelSourceContext): boolean {
    if (!this.remote.isRemoteUri(context.path)) return false;
    if (!this.schemes?.length) return true;
    const scheme = schemeOf(context.path);
    return !!scheme && this.schemes.includes(scheme);
  }

  override async list(
    context: PanelSourceContext,
    showHidden: boolean,
  ): Promise<PanelSourceListing> {
    const mount = this.remote.findByUri(context.path);
    const key = mount
      ? `provider:${this.remote.protocol(mount)}:${this.remote.rootUri(mount).toLocaleLowerCase()}`
      : `provider:${schemeOf(context.path) ?? 'remote'}:${context.path}`;

    try {
      const listing = this.resilience
        ? await this.resilience.execute(
            key,
            () => super.list(context, showHidden),
            {
              policy: {
                maxAttempts: 3,
                initialDelayMs: 180,
                maxDelayMs: 1800,
                multiplier: 2,
                jitter: 0.2,
              },
            },
          )
        : await super.list(context, showHidden);

      this.remote.reportSuccess(context.path);
      return listing;
    } catch (error) {
      this.remote.reportFailure(context.path, error);
      // The caller fails this pane load only. No shared lock/global promise is
      // held, so another pane/provider continues independently.
      throw error;
    }
  }

  capabilities(context: PanelSourceContext): SourceCapabilities {
    return this.remote.capabilitiesFor(
      context.path,
      getSourceCapabilities(context.path),
    );
  }

  providerCapabilities(context: PanelSourceContext) { return this.remote.providerCapabilitiesFor(context.path); }

  override getRootPath(context: PanelSourceContext): string | null {
    const scheme = schemeOf(context.path);
    if (!scheme) return null;
    const mount = this.remote.findByUri(context.path);
    if (mount?.publicPath) return String(mount.publicPath);
    return `${scheme}://`;
  }

  override getParentPath(context: PanelSourceContext): string {
    const root = this.getRootPath(context);
    if (!root || context.path === root) return root ?? context.path;

    const mount = this.remote.findByUri(context.path);
    const mountRoot = String(mount?.publicPath ?? '').replace(/\/+$/, '');
    const current = context.path.replace(/\/+$/, '');

    if (mountRoot && current === mountRoot) {
      return `${schemeOf(context.path)}://`;
    }
    if (mountRoot && current.startsWith(`${mountRoot}/`)) {
      const slash = current.lastIndexOf('/');
      return slash > mountRoot.length ? current.slice(0, slash) : mountRoot;
    }
    return super.getParentPath(context);
  }

  override joinChildPath(
    context: PanelSourceContext,
    childName: string,
  ): string {
    const hierarchy = this.remote.hierarchyFor(context.path);
    if (hierarchy === 'share-path' || hierarchy === 'path-backed') {
      return `${context.path.replace(/\/+$/, '')}/${childName}`;
    }
    return super.joinChildPath(context, childName);
  }
}


class BinPanelSource extends BasePanelSource {
  readonly id = 'bin';
  readonly kind = 'bin' as const;
  readonly title = 'Recycle Bin';

  canHandle(context: PanelSourceContext): boolean {
    return schemeOf(context.path) === 'bin';
  }

  capabilities(_context: PanelSourceContext): SourceCapabilities {
    return { read: true, create: false, delete: false, rename: false, trash: false };
  }

  override getRootPath(): string { return 'bin://'; }
  override getParentPath(): string { return 'bin://'; }
  override joinChildPath(): string { return 'bin://'; }
  override supportsStreaming(): boolean { return false; }

  override activateEntry(): boolean {
    // Recycle-bin entries are shell objects, not navigable filesystem paths.
    // Consume activation so the pane never falls back to native-path handling.
    return true;
  }

  override canPreviewEntry(): boolean { return false; }
}

class ResultsPanelSource extends BasePanelSource {
  readonly id = 'results';
  readonly kind = 'results' as const;
  readonly title = 'Results';

  constructor(
    directories: DirectorySourceService,
    private readonly results: ResultsPanelService,
  ) {
    super(directories);
  }

  canHandle(context: PanelSourceContext): boolean {
    return /^results:\/\//i.test(context.path);
  }

  capabilities(_context: PanelSourceContext): SourceCapabilities {
    return {
      read: true,
      create: false,
      delete: false,
      rename: false,
      trash: false,
    };
  }

  override async list(
    context: PanelSourceContext,
    _showHidden: boolean,
  ): Promise<PanelSourceListing> {
    const panel = this.results.get(context.path);

    return {
      location: {
        path: context.path,
        sourceId: panel ? `results.${panel.id}` : 'results.expired',
        sourceKind: this.kind,
      },
      entries: panel ? panel.entries : [],
    };
  }

  override getRootPath(context: PanelSourceContext): string | null {
    return context.path;
  }

  override getParentPath(context: PanelSourceContext): string {
    return context.path;
  }

  override joinChildPath(
    context: PanelSourceContext,
    _childName: string,
  ): string {
    return context.path;
  }

  override supportsStreaming(_context: PanelSourceContext): boolean {
    return false;
  }
}

class VirtualPanelSource extends BasePanelSource {
  readonly id = 'virtual';
  readonly kind = 'virtual' as const;
  readonly title = 'Virtual';

  canHandle(context: PanelSourceContext): boolean {
    const scheme = schemeOf(context.path);
    return scheme === 'search' || scheme === 'http' || scheme === 'https';
  }

  capabilities(context: PanelSourceContext): SourceCapabilities {
    return getSourceCapabilities(context.path);
  }
}

class FilesystemPanelSource extends BasePanelSource {
  readonly id = 'filesystem';
  readonly kind = 'filesystem' as const;
  readonly title = 'Files';

  canHandle(): boolean {
    return true;
  }

  capabilities(context: PanelSourceContext): SourceCapabilities {
    return getSourceCapabilities(context.path);
  }
}

@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })
export class PanelSourceRegistryService {
  private readonly sources: PanelSource[];

  constructor(
    private readonly directories: DirectorySourceService,
    remoteConnections: RemoteConnectionsService,
    private readonly resultsPanels: ResultsPanelService,
    resilience?: ResilienceService,
  ) {
    this.sources = [
      new ArchivePanelSource(this.directories),
      new BinPanelSource(this.directories),
      new RemotePanelSource(this.directories, remoteConnections, resilience),
      new ResultsPanelSource(this.directories, this.resultsPanels),
      new VirtualPanelSource(this.directories),
      new FilesystemPanelSource(this.directories),
    ];
  }

  register(source: PanelSource): void {
    if (!source?.id?.trim()) throw new Error('PanelSource id is required.');
    if (source.id === 'filesystem') {
      throw new Error('The filesystem fallback PanelSource cannot be replaced.');
    }
    this.unregister(source.id);
    // Contributions resolve before ordinary built-ins, while an active archive frame
    // remains the strongest source identity and filesystem remains the fallback.
    const archiveIndex = this.sources.findIndex(candidate => candidate.id === 'archive');
    this.sources.splice(archiveIndex >= 0 ? archiveIndex + 1 : 0, 0, source);
  }

  unregister(id: string): void {
    const index = this.sources.findIndex(source => source.id === id && source.id !== 'filesystem');
    if (index >= 0) this.sources.splice(index, 1);
  }

  listSources(): readonly PanelSource[] {
    return [...this.sources];
  }

  resolve(context: PanelSourceContext): ResolvedPanelSource {
    const source =
      this.sources.find(candidate => candidate.canHandle(context)) ??
      this.sources[this.sources.length - 1];

    return {
      source,
      location: {
        path: context.path,
        sourceId: this.sourceId(source, context.path),
        sourceKind: source.kind,
      },
      capabilities: source.capabilities(context),
      providerCapabilities: source.providerCapabilities?.(context) ?? null,
    };
  }

  createResultsPanel(
    title: string,
    entries: readonly FileInfo[],
    metadata: ResultsPanelMetadata = {},
  ): string {
    return this.resultsPanels.create(
      title,
      entries,
      metadata,
    ).path;
  }

  createSearchResultsPanel(
    title: string,
    entries: readonly FileInfo[],
    rootPath: string,
    query: string,
    recursive = false,
  ): string {
    return this.resultsPanels.createSearch(
      title, entries, rootPath, query, recursive,
    ).path;
  }

  titleFor(path: string): string | null {
    if (/^results:\/\//i.test(path)) {
      return this.resultsPanels.title(path);
    }
    return null;
  }

  isRootPath(
    path: string,
    entries: readonly FileInfo[] = [],
  ): boolean {
    const resolved = this.resolve({
      path,
      entries,
      inArchive: false,
    });

    const root = resolved.source.getRootPath({
      path,
      entries,
      inArchive: false,
    });

    return !!root && root === path;
  }

  getParentPath(
    path: string,
    entries: readonly FileInfo[] = [],
  ): string {
    const context: PanelSourceContext = {
      path,
      entries,
      inArchive: false,
    };
    return this.resolve(context).source.getParentPath(context);
  }

  streamMode(
    path: string,
    entries: readonly FileInfo[] = [],
  ): 'backend' | 'results' | null {
    if (/^results:\/\//i.test(path)) {
      return this.resultsPanels.has(path) ? 'results' : null;
    }

    const context: PanelSourceContext = {
      path,
      entries,
      inArchive: false,
    };
    const resolved = this.resolve(context);

    return resolved.source.supportsStreaming(context)
      ? 'backend'
      : null;
  }

  resultsPanelCount(path: string): number {
    return this.resultsPanels.count(path);
  }

  resultsPanelSearchAlias(path: string): string | null {
    return this.resultsPanels.backendSearchAlias(path);
  }

  readResultsPanelWindow(
    path: string,
    offset: number,
    limit: number,
    options?: {
      readonly sort?: 'relevance' | 'name' | 'path' | 'type';
      readonly filterText?: string;
    },
  ) {
    return this.resultsPanels.readWindow(path, offset, limit, options);
  }

  async streamResultsPanel(
    path: string,
    options: {
      readonly batchSize?: number;
      readonly signal?: AbortSignal;
      readonly onBatch: (
        batch: readonly FileInfo[],
        loaded: number,
        total: number,
      ) => void;
    },
  ): Promise<number> {
    return this.resultsPanels.stream(path, options);
  }

  async listContext(
    context: PanelSourceContext,
    showHidden: boolean,
  ): Promise<PanelSourceListing> {
    const resolved = this.resolve(context);
    const listing = await resolved.source.list(context, showHidden);

    return {
      ...listing,
      location: {
        ...listing.location,
        sourceId: this.sourceId(resolved.source, listing.location.path),
      },
    };
  }

  async list(
    path: string,
    showHidden: boolean,
    entries: readonly FileInfo[] = [],
  ): Promise<PanelSourceListing> {
    return this.listContext({
      path,
      entries,
      inArchive: false,
    }, showHidden);
  }

  async listDirectory(
    path: string,
    showHidden: boolean,
    entries: readonly FileInfo[] = [],
  ): Promise<{ path: string; entries: FileInfo[] }> {
    const listing = await this.list(path, showHidden, entries);
    return {
      path: listing.location.path,
      entries: [...listing.entries],
    };
  }

  private sourceId(source: PanelSource, path: string): string {
    const scheme = schemeOf(path);

    switch (source.kind) {
      case 'filesystem':
        return !scheme || scheme === 'filesystem'
          ? 'filesystem.local'
          : `filesystem.${scheme}`;
      case 'remote':
        return source.id !== 'remote'
          ? source.id
          : (scheme ? `remote.${scheme}` : source.id);
      case 'results': {
        const panel = this.resultsPanels.get(path);
        return panel ? `results.${panel.id}` : 'results.expired';
      }
      case 'virtual':
        return source.id === 'virtual'
          ? (scheme ? `virtual.${scheme}` : source.id)
          : source.id;
      default:
        return source.id;
    }
  }
}

import { ApplicationRef, Injectable, NgZone } from '@angular/core';
import { BehaviorSubject } from 'rxjs';

export interface PerfProbeSnapshot {
  readonly fps: number;
  readonly avgFrameMs: number;
  readonly worstFrameMs: number;
  readonly longFramesPerSecond: number;
  readonly ticksPerSecond: number;
  readonly avgTickMs: number;
  readonly pointerMovesPerSecond: number;
  readonly benchmark: PerfBenchmarkResult | null;
}

export interface PerfBenchmarkResult {
  readonly durationMs: number;
  readonly fps: number;
  readonly avgFrameMs: number;
  readonly worstFrameMs: number;
  readonly longFrameCount: number;
  readonly longFramesPerSecond: number;
  readonly ticksPerSecond: number;
  readonly avgTickMs: number;
  readonly pointerMovesPerSecond: number;
}

declare global {
  interface Window {
    __afmPerf?: {
      runBenchmark: (durationMs?: number) => Promise<PerfBenchmarkResult>;
      clearBenchmark: () => void;
      getSnapshot: () => PerfProbeSnapshot;
    };
  }
}

@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })
export class PerfProbeService {
  private readonly snapshotSubject = new BehaviorSubject<PerfProbeSnapshot>({
    fps: 0,
    avgFrameMs: 0,
    worstFrameMs: 0,
    longFramesPerSecond: 0,
    ticksPerSecond: 0,
    avgTickMs: 0,
    pointerMovesPerSecond: 0,
    benchmark: null,
  });

  readonly snapshot$ = this.snapshotSubject.asObservable();

  private started = false;
  private reportTimer = 0;
  private tickCount = 0;
  private tickTotalMs = 0;
  private pointerMoveCount = 0;
  private sampledFps = 0;
  private sampledWorstFrameMs = 0;
  private sampleActive = false;
  private sampleHandle = 0;
  private sampleStartedAt = 0;
  private sampleLastFrameAt = 0;
  private sampleFrameCount = 0;
  private sampleFrameTotalMs = 0;
  private sampleWorstFrameMs = 0;
  private sampleLongFrameCount = 0;
  private sampledAvgFrameMs = 0;
  private latestBenchmark: PerfBenchmarkResult | null = null;

  constructor(
    private readonly appRef: ApplicationRef,
    private readonly ngZone: NgZone,
  ) {
    if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
      this.installWindowApi();
    }
  }

  start(): void {
    if (this.started || typeof window === 'undefined') {
      return;
    }

    this.started = true;
    this.instrumentTicks();
    this.ngZone.runOutsideAngular(() => {
      this.installWindowApi();
      window.addEventListener('pointermove', this.onPointerMove, { passive: true });
      this.beginFrameSample();
      this.reportTimer = window.setInterval(() => {
        this.publishSnapshot();
        this.beginFrameSample();
      }, 1000);
    });
  }

  private instrumentTicks(): void {
    const appRef = this.appRef as ApplicationRef & { tick: () => void };
    const originalTick = appRef.tick.bind(this.appRef);
    appRef.tick = () => {
      const startedAt = performance.now();
      try {
        originalTick();
      } finally {
        this.tickCount += 1;
        this.tickTotalMs += performance.now() - startedAt;
      }
    };
  }

  private readonly onPointerMove = (): void => {
    this.pointerMoveCount += 1;
  };

  private installWindowApi(): void {
    window.__afmPerf = {
      runBenchmark: (durationMs?: number) => {
        this.start();
        return this.runBenchmark(durationMs);
      },
      clearBenchmark: () => {
        this.latestBenchmark = null;
        this.publishSnapshot();
      },
      getSnapshot: () => this.snapshotSubject.getValue(),
    };
  }

  private beginFrameSample(): void {
    if (this.sampleActive) {
      return;
    }

    this.sampleActive = true;
    this.sampleStartedAt = performance.now();
    this.sampleLastFrameAt = 0;
    this.sampleFrameCount = 0;
    this.sampleFrameTotalMs = 0;
    this.sampleWorstFrameMs = 0;
    this.sampleLongFrameCount = 0;
    this.sampleHandle = requestAnimationFrame(this.onSampleFrame);
  }

  private readonly onSampleFrame = (timestamp: number): void => {
    if (!this.sampleActive) {
      return;
    }

    if (this.sampleLastFrameAt > 0) {
      const delta = timestamp - this.sampleLastFrameAt;
      this.sampleFrameTotalMs += delta;
      this.sampleWorstFrameMs = Math.max(this.sampleWorstFrameMs, delta);
      if (delta >= 20) {
        this.sampleLongFrameCount += 1;
      }
    }
    this.sampleLastFrameAt = timestamp;
    this.sampleFrameCount += 1;

    const elapsed = timestamp - this.sampleStartedAt;
    if (elapsed >= 250) {
      const seconds = elapsed > 0 ? elapsed / 1000 : 0.25;
      this.sampledFps = seconds > 0 ? Math.round(this.sampleFrameCount / seconds) : 0;
      this.sampledAvgFrameMs = this.sampleFrameCount > 1 ? this.sampleFrameTotalMs / (this.sampleFrameCount - 1) : 0;
      this.sampledWorstFrameMs = this.sampleWorstFrameMs;
      this.sampleActive = false;
      this.sampleHandle = 0;
      return;
    }

    this.sampleHandle = requestAnimationFrame(this.onSampleFrame);
  };

  private publishSnapshot(): void {
    const ticksPerSecond = this.tickCount;
    const avgTickMs = ticksPerSecond > 0 ? this.tickTotalMs / ticksPerSecond : 0;
    this.snapshotSubject.next({
      fps: this.sampledFps,
      avgFrameMs: this.sampledAvgFrameMs,
      worstFrameMs: this.sampledWorstFrameMs,
      longFramesPerSecond: this.sampleLongFrameCount,
      ticksPerSecond,
      avgTickMs,
      pointerMovesPerSecond: this.pointerMoveCount,
      benchmark: this.latestBenchmark,
    });
    this.tickCount = 0;
    this.tickTotalMs = 0;
    this.pointerMoveCount = 0;
  }

  async runBenchmark(durationMs = 5000): Promise<PerfBenchmarkResult> {
    const clampedDurationMs = Math.max(250, Math.round(durationMs));
    return await new Promise<PerfBenchmarkResult>((resolve) => {
      let startedAt = 0;
      let lastFrameAt = 0;
      let frameCount = 0;
      let frameTotalMs = 0;
      let worstFrameMs = 0;
      let longFrameCount = 0;
      const tickCountStart = this.tickCount;
      const tickTotalMsStart = this.tickTotalMs;
      const pointerMoveCountStart = this.pointerMoveCount;

      const onFrame = (timestamp: number): void => {
        if (startedAt === 0) {
          startedAt = timestamp;
          lastFrameAt = timestamp;
          frameCount = 1;
          requestAnimationFrame(onFrame);
          return;
        }

        const frameDelta = timestamp - lastFrameAt;
        lastFrameAt = timestamp;
        frameCount += 1;
        frameTotalMs += frameDelta;
        worstFrameMs = Math.max(worstFrameMs, frameDelta);
        if (frameDelta >= 20) {
          longFrameCount += 1;
        }

        const elapsed = timestamp - startedAt;
        if (elapsed < clampedDurationMs) {
          requestAnimationFrame(onFrame);
          return;
        }

        const durationSeconds = elapsed > 0 ? elapsed / 1000 : clampedDurationMs / 1000;
        const benchTickCount = this.tickCount - tickCountStart;
        const benchTickTotalMs = this.tickTotalMs - tickTotalMsStart;
        const avgTickMs = benchTickCount > 0 ? benchTickTotalMs / benchTickCount : 0;
        const result: PerfBenchmarkResult = {
          durationMs: elapsed,
          fps: durationSeconds > 0 ? Math.round(frameCount / durationSeconds) : 0,
          avgFrameMs: frameCount > 1 ? frameTotalMs / (frameCount - 1) : 0,
          worstFrameMs,
          longFrameCount,
          longFramesPerSecond: durationSeconds > 0 ? longFrameCount / durationSeconds : 0,
          ticksPerSecond: durationSeconds > 0 ? benchTickCount / durationSeconds : 0,
          avgTickMs,
          pointerMovesPerSecond: durationSeconds > 0 ? (this.pointerMoveCount - pointerMoveCountStart) / durationSeconds : 0,
        };
        this.latestBenchmark = result;
        this.publishSnapshot();
        resolve(result);
      };

      requestAnimationFrame(onFrame);
    });
  }
}

  it('coalesces a burst of identical bin invalidations into one listener delivery', async () => {
    const service = new ResourceMutationService();
    const received: any[] = [];
    const release = service.subscribe(mutation => received.push(mutation));

    for (let index = 0; index < 25; index += 1) {
      service.publish({
        kind: 'modify',
        items: [{ source: 'bin://' }],
        origin: 'recycle-bin',
      });
    }

    expect(received.length).toBe(1);

import { Injectable } from '@angular/core';
import { normalizePath, parentPath, samePath } from '../components/address-bar.utils';

export type ResourceMutationKind = 'create' | 'delete' | 'move' | 'copy' | 'modify' | 'restore';

export interface ResourceMutationItem {
  source?: string;
  destination?: string;
}

export interface ResourceMutation {
  readonly kind: ResourceMutationKind;
  readonly items: readonly ResourceMutationItem[];
  readonly origin?: string;
  readonly timestamp: number;
}

export type ResourceMutationListener = (mutation: ResourceMutation) => void | Promise<void>;

function canonical(path: string): string {
  return normalizePath(path || '');
}

export function isSameOrDescendantPath(path: string, ancestor: string): boolean {
  if (!path || !ancestor) return false;
  if (samePath(path, ancestor)) return true;
  const target = canonical(path);
  const base = canonical(ancestor);
  if (!target || !base) return false;
  const prefix = base.endsWith('/') ? base : `${base}/`;
  return target.toLocaleLowerCase().startsWith(prefix.toLocaleLowerCase());
}

export function remapDescendantPath(path: string, source: string, destination: string): string | null {
  if (!isSameOrDescendantPath(path, source)) return null;
  const target = canonical(path);
  const from = canonical(source);
  const to = canonical(destination);
  if (samePath(target, from)) return to;
  const suffix = target.slice(from.length).replace(/^\/+/, '');
  return suffix ? `${to.replace(/\/+$/, '')}/${suffix}` : to;
}

export function deletionRecoveryPath(path: string, deletedPaths: readonly string[]): string | null {
  const covering = deletedPaths
    .filter(candidate => isSameOrDescendantPath(path, candidate))
    .sort((left, right) => canonical(right).length - canonical(left).length)[0];
  return covering ? parentPath(covering) : null;
}

export function mutationTouchesDirectory(mutation: ResourceMutation, directory: string): boolean {
  const dir = canonical(directory);
  if (!dir) return false;
  return mutation.items.some(item => {
    const sourceParent = item.source ? parentPath(item.source) : '';
    const destinationParent = item.destination ? parentPath(item.destination) : '';
    if (sourceParent && samePath(sourceParent, dir)) return true;
    if (destinationParent && samePath(destinationParent, dir)) return true;
    if (mutation.kind === 'modify' && item.source && samePath(item.source, dir)) return true;
    return false;
  });
}

const MUTATION_COALESCE_MS = 80;

interface PendingMutation {
  kind: ResourceMutationKind;
  origin?: string;
  timestamp: number;
  items: Map<string, ResourceMutationItem>;
}

@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })
export class ResourceMutationService {
  private readonly listeners = new Set<ResourceMutationListener>();
  private readonly pending = new Map<ResourceMutationKind, PendingMutation>();
  private flushTimer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null = null;

  subscribe(listener: ResourceMutationListener): () => void {
    this.listeners.add(listener);
    return () => this.listeners.delete(listener);
  }

  publish(input: Omit<ResourceMutation, 'timestamp'> & { timestamp?: number }): void {
    const items = input.items
      .map(item => ({
        source: item.source ? canonical(item.source) : undefined,
        destination: item.destination ? canonical(item.destination) : undefined,
      }))
      .filter(item => !!item.source || !!item.destination);
    if (!items.length) return;

    const timestamp = input.timestamp ?? Date.now();
    let pending = this.pending.get(input.kind);
    if (!pending) {
      pending = {
        kind: input.kind,
        origin: input.origin,
        timestamp,
        items: new Map<string, ResourceMutationItem>(),
      };
      this.pending.set(input.kind, pending);
    } else {
      pending.timestamp = Math.max(pending.timestamp, timestamp);
      if (pending.origin !== input.origin) pending.origin = undefined;
    }

    for (const item of items) {
      const key = `${item.source ?? ''}\u0000${item.destination ?? ''}`;
      pending.items.set(key, item);
    }

    if (this.flushTimer === null) {
      this.flushTimer = setTimeout(() => this.flush(), MUTATION_COALESCE_MS);
    }
  }

  private flush(): void {
    this.flushTimer = null;
    const batch = [...this.pending.values()];
    this.pending.clear();

    for (const pending of batch) {
      const mutation: ResourceMutation = {
        kind: pending.kind,
        items: [...pending.items.values()],
        origin: pending.origin,
        timestamp: pending.timestamp,
      };
      for (const listener of [...this.listeners]) {
        void Promise.resolve(listener(mutation)).catch(error => {
          console.warn('Resource mutation listener failed', error);
        });
      }
    }
  }
}

@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })
export class SettingsService {
  private settings$ = createBehaviorSubject<ProjectSettings>(this.loadSettings());
  private readonly dialogGate = new QueuedDialogGate<SettingsDialogRequest, boolean>();
  private backendPreferences: BackendUserPreferences | null = null;

  constructor() {
    void this.loadBackendPreferences();
  }

  readonly settings: Stream<ProjectSettings> = this.settings$;
  readonly currentSettings = this.settings$.value;

  getSettings$(): Stream<ProjectSettings> {
    return this.settings$;
  }

  getSettings(): ProjectSettings {
    return this.settings$.value;
  }

  updateSettings(settings: Partial<ProjectSettings>): void {
    const current = this.settings$.value;
    const merged: ProjectSettings = {
      general: { ...current.general, ...settings.general },
      files: { ...current.files, ...settings.files },
      editor: { ...current.editor, ...settings.editor },
      view: { ...current.view, ...settings.view },
      advanced: { ...current.advanced, ...settings.advanced },
    };
    this.settings$.next(merged);
    this.saveSettings(merged);
  }

  updateGeneralSettings(settings: Partial<GeneralSettings>): void {
    this.updateSettings({ general: { ...this.settings$.value.general, ...settings } });
  }

  updateFileSettings(settings: Partial<FileSettings>): void {
    this.updateSettings({ files: { ...this.settings$.value.files, ...settings } });
  }

  updateEditorSettings(settings: Partial<EditorSettings>): void {
    this.updateSettings({ editor: { ...this.settings$.value.editor, ...settings } });
  }

  updateViewSettings(settings: Partial<ViewSettings>): void {
    this.updateSettings({ view: { ...this.settings$.value.view, ...settings } });
  }

  updateAdvancedSettings(settings: Partial<AdvancedSettings>): void {
    this.updateSettings({ advanced: { ...this.settings$.value.advanced, ...settings } });
  }

  resetToDefaults(): void {
    this.settings$.next(DEFAULT_SETTINGS);
    this.saveSettings(DEFAULT_SETTINGS);
  }

  resetSection(section: keyof ProjectSettings): void {
    const current = this.settings$.value;
    const updated = { ...current, [section]: DEFAULT_SETTINGS[section] };
    this.settings$.next(updated);
    this.saveSettings(updated);
  }

  openSettings(initialTab?: SettingsTab): Promise<boolean> {
    return new Promise<boolean>((resolve) => {
      this.dialogGate.enqueue({
        resolve,
        initialTab,
      });
    });
  }

  closeSettings(confirmed: boolean): void {
    this.dialogGate.beginClose(confirmed);
  }

  getActiveRequest$(): Stream<SettingsDialogRequest | null> {
    return this.dialogGate.activeRequest$;
  }

  getMountedRequest$(): Stream<SettingsDialogRequest | null> {
    return this.dialogGate.mountedRequest$;
  }

  getClosingRequest$(): Stream<SettingsDialogRequest | null> {
    return this.dialogGate.closingRequest$;
  }

  getClosingRequest(): SettingsDialogRequest | null {
    return this.dialogGate.closingRequest$.value;
  }

  finishCloseSettings(): void {
    this.dialogGate.finishClose();
  }

  private loadSettings(): ProjectSettings {
    let result = DEFAULT_SETTINGS;
    try {
      const stored = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
      if (stored) {
        const parsed = JSON.parse(stored) as Partial<ProjectSettings>;
        result = this.mergeWithDefaults(parsed);
      }
    } catch {
      // Ignore parse errors
    }

    writeAppearanceCache({
      theme: result.general.theme,
      accentColor: result.general.accentColor,
      uiZoom: result.general.uiZoom,
      compactMode: result.view.compactMode,
      animationsEnabled: result.view.animationsEnabled,
    });
    return result;
  }

  private saveSettings(settings: ProjectSettings): void {
    try {
      localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(settings));
    } catch {
      // Ignore storage errors
    }

    void this.syncBackendPreferences(settings);
  }

  private async loadBackendPreferences(): Promise<void> {
    try {
      const preferences = await GetPreferences() as unknown as BackendUserPreferences;
      this.backendPreferences = preferences;

      const current = this.settings$.value;
      const themeValue = this.coerceTheme(preferences.theme, current.general.theme);
      const accentColor = typeof preferences.accentColor === 'string'
        ? preferences.accentColor
        : current.general.accentColor;
      const uiZoom = typeof preferences.uiZoom === 'number' && preferences.uiZoom > 0
        ? preferences.uiZoom
        : current.general.uiZoom;
      const compactMode = typeof preferences.compactMode === 'boolean'
        ? preferences.compactMode
        : current.view.compactMode;
      const animationsEnabled = typeof preferences.animationsEnabled === 'boolean'
        ? preferences.animationsEnabled
        : current.view.animationsEnabled;

      const merged: ProjectSettings = {
        ...current,
        general: {
          ...current.general,
          theme: themeValue,
          accentColor,
          uiZoom,
          confirmOnClose: typeof preferences.confirmOnClose === 'boolean'
            ? preferences.confirmOnClose
            : current.general.confirmOnClose,
          reopenLastWorkspace: typeof preferences.reopenLastWorkspace === 'boolean'
            ? preferences.reopenLastWorkspace
            : current.general.reopenLastWorkspace,
        },
        view: {
          ...current.view,
          compactMode,
          animationsEnabled,
        },
      };

      this.settings$.next(merged);
      writeAppearanceCache({
        theme: merged.general.theme,
        accentColor: merged.general.accentColor,
        uiZoom: merged.general.uiZoom,
        compactMode: merged.view.compactMode,
        animationsEnabled: merged.view.animationsEnabled,
      });
      try {
        localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(merged));
      } catch {
        // Ignore storage errors
      }
    } catch {
      // Ignore backend availability errors during bootstrap.
    }
  }

  private async syncBackendPreferences(settings: ProjectSettings): Promise<void> {
    writeAppearanceCache({
      theme: settings.general.theme,
      accentColor: settings.general.accentColor,
      uiZoom: settings.general.uiZoom,
      compactMode: settings.view.compactMode,
      animationsEnabled: settings.view.animationsEnabled,
    });

    try {
      const current = this.backendPreferences ?? await GetPreferences() as unknown as BackendUserPreferences;
      this.backendPreferences = current;

      await SavePreferences({
        ...current,
        theme: settings.general.theme,
        accentColor: settings.general.accentColor,
        uiZoom: settings.general.uiZoom,
        compactMode: settings.view.compactMode,
        animationsEnabled: settings.view.animationsEnabled,
        confirmOnClose: settings.general.confirmOnClose,
        reopenLastWorkspace: settings.general.reopenLastWorkspace,
      } as any);
    } catch {
      // Ignore backend sync errors during early startup or tests.
    }
  }

  private coerceTheme(value: unknown, fallback: GeneralSettings['theme']): GeneralSettings['theme'] {
    return value === 'dark' || value === 'light' || value === 'system' ? value : fallback;
  }

  private mergeWithDefaults(stored: Partial<ProjectSettings>): ProjectSettings {
    const files = { ...DEFAULT_SETTINGS.files, ...stored.files };
    if (files.defaultOpenAction !== 'edit' && files.defaultOpenAction !== 'external') {
      files.defaultOpenAction = 'external';
    }

    return {
      general: { ...DEFAULT_SETTINGS.general, ...stored.general },
      files,
      editor: { ...DEFAULT_SETTINGS.editor, ...stored.editor },
      view: { ...DEFAULT_SETTINGS.view, ...stored.view },
      advanced: { ...DEFAULT_SETTINGS.advanced, ...stored.advanced },
    };
  }
}

import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';

describe('SourceChangeObserverService architecture', () => {
  const observer = readFileSync(
    new URL('./source-change-observer.service.ts', import.meta.url),
    'utf8',
  );
  const directory = readFileSync(
    new URL('../components/directory-pane.component.ts', import.meta.url),
    'utf8',
  );
  const bin = readFileSync(
    new URL('../components/bin-pane.component.ts', import.meta.url),
    'utf8',
  );

  it('feeds both filesystem and Bin producers into ResourceMutationService', () => {
    expect(observer).toContain("'fs:directoryChanged'");
    expect(observer).toContain("origin: 'filesystem-watch'");
    expect(observer).toContain("origin: 'bin-os-observer'");
    expect(observer).toContain('this.mutations.publish({');
  });

  it('keeps Bin polling shared, adaptive, and inactive without consumers', () => {
    expect(observer).toContain('binObserverCount');
    expect(observer).toContain('BIN_VISIBLE_POLL_MS');
    expect(observer).toContain('BIN_HIDDEN_POLL_MS');
    expect(observer).toContain("document.visibilityState === 'hidden'");
    expect(observer).toContain('if (this.binObserverCount !== 0) return;');
  });

  it('owns the refresh in-flight gate instead of duplicating it in panes', () => {
    expect(observer).toContain('record.refreshing');
    expect(observer).toContain('record.pending');
    expect(directory).not.toContain('mutationRefreshRunning');
    expect(bin).not.toContain('binMutationRefreshRunning');
  });

  it('makes panes register locations without listening to producer events directly', () => {
    expect(directory).toContain('this.sourceChanges.observe(');
    expect(directory).toContain('this.sourceObservation?.setLocation(nextPath);');
    expect(bin).toContain('this.sourceChanges.observe(');
    expect(bin).toContain('this.sourceObservation.setLocation(BIN_ROOT_PATH);');
    expect(directory).not.toContain("EventsOn('fs:directoryChanged'");
    expect(bin).not.toContain("EventsOn('fs:directoryChanged'");
  });
});

`````typescript
import { Injectable, OnDestroy } from '@angular/core';
import { EventsOn } from 'wailsjs/runtime';

import {
  ResourceMutationService,
  mutationTouchesDirectory,
} from './resource-mutation.service';
import { normalizePath } from '../components/address-bar.utils';

const BIN_ROOT = 'bin://';
const BIN_VISIBLE_POLL_MS = 3_000;
const BIN_HIDDEN_POLL_MS = 12_000;

interface DirectoryChangedEvent {
  path?: string;
}

interface TrashFingerprintEntry {
  id?: string;
  deletedAt?: string;
  size?: number;
  originalPath?: string;
}

interface ObservationRecord {
  readonly paneId: string;
  location: string;
  readonly refresh: () => void | Promise<void>;
  refreshing: boolean;
  pending: boolean;
}

export interface SourceObservation {
  setLocation(location: string): void;
  close(): void;
}

/**
 * One change-observation coordinator for pane sources.
 *
 * Producers are source-specific:
 * - native/filesystem:// locations use the backend fsnotify watcher;
 * - bin:// uses one shared, adaptive Recycle Bin fingerprint poll while observed.
 *
 * Every producer publishes into ResourceMutationService. Consumers are dispatched
 * from that single coalesced mutation stream and never listen to producer events
 * directly.
 */
@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })
export class SourceChangeObserverService implements OnDestroy {
  private readonly observations = new Map<symbol, ObservationRecord>();
  private readonly releaseFilesystemEvents: () => void;
  private readonly releaseMutations: () => void;

  private binObserverCount = 0;
  private binPollTimer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null = null;
  private binPollRunning = false;
  private binFingerprint: string | null = null;
  private destroyed = false;

  constructor(private readonly mutations: ResourceMutationService) {
    this.releaseFilesystemEvents = EventsOn(
      'fs:directoryChanged',
      (event: DirectoryChangedEvent | null) => {
        const path = normalizePath(String(event?.path ?? '').trim());
        if (!path) return;
        this.mutations.publish({
          kind: 'modify',
          items: [{ source: path }],
          origin: 'filesystem-watch',
        });
      },
    );

    this.releaseMutations = this.mutations.subscribe(mutation => {
      // A mutation performed by this application already tells us Bin changed.
      // Reset the polling baseline so the next OS poll does not echo the same
      // logical change back into the bus a second time.
      if (
        mutation.origin === 'recycle-bin' &&
        mutationTouchesDirectory(mutation, BIN_ROOT)
      ) {
        this.binFingerprint = null;
      }

      for (const [token, record] of this.observations) {
        if (!record.location) continue;
        if (!mutationTouchesDirectory(mutation, record.location)) continue;
        void this.refreshObservation(token, record);
      }
    });
  }

  observe(
    paneId: string,
    refresh: () => void | Promise<void>,
  ): SourceObservation {
    const token = Symbol(paneId);
    const record: ObservationRecord = {
      paneId,
      location: '',
      refresh,
      refreshing: false,
      pending: false,
    };
    this.observations.set(token, record);

    let closed = false;
    return {
      setLocation: location => {
        if (closed) return;
        this.setObservationLocation(record, location);
      },
      close: () => {
        if (closed) return;
        closed = true;
        this.removeObservation(token, record);
      },
    };
  }

  ngOnDestroy(): void {
    this.destroyed = true;
    this.releaseFilesystemEvents();
    this.releaseMutations();
    for (const [token, record] of [...this.observations]) {
      this.removeObservation(token, record);
    }
    this.stopBinPolling();
  }

  private setObservationLocation(
    record: ObservationRecord,
    location: string,
  ): void {
    const next = normalizePath(String(location ?? '').trim());
    if (record.location === next) return;

    const wasBin = this.isBin(record.location);
    const isBin = this.isBin(next);
    record.location = next;

    if (wasBin !== isBin) {
      if (isBin) this.acquireBinObservation();
      else this.releaseBinObservation();
    }

    // The backend watcher is pane-scoped but internally ref-counts identical
    // native directories. Clearing it for logical sources prevents fsnotify
    // from being asked to watch bin://, registry://, archives, etc.
    const watchLocation = this.isFilesystem(next) ? next : '';
    void this.setBackendPaneDirectory(record.paneId, watchLocation);
  }

  private removeObservation(
    token: symbol,
    record: ObservationRecord,
  ): void {
    this.observations.delete(token);
    if (this.isBin(record.location)) this.releaseBinObservation();
    void this.setBackendPaneDirectory(record.paneId, '');
  }

  private async refreshObservation(
    token: symbol,
    record: ObservationRecord,
  ): Promise<void> {
    if (!this.observations.has(token)) return;

    if (record.refreshing) {
      record.pending = true;
      return;
    }

    record.refreshing = true;
    try {
      do {
        record.pending = false;
        if (!this.observations.has(token)) return;
        await record.refresh();
      } while (record.pending && this.observations.has(token));
    } catch (error) {
      console.warn('Source change refresh failed', error);
    } finally {
      record.refreshing = false;
    }
  }

  private async setBackendPaneDirectory(
    paneId: string,
    location: string,
  ): Promise<void> {
    try {
      const app = window.go?.app?.App as unknown as {
        SetPaneDirectory?: (paneId: string, path: string) => Promise<void>;
      };
      if (typeof app?.SetPaneDirectory !== 'function') return;
      await app.SetPaneDirectory(paneId, location);
    } catch (error) {
      console.warn('Unable to update directory watcher', error);
    }
  }

  private acquireBinObservation(): void {
    this.binObserverCount += 1;
    if (this.binObserverCount !== 1) return;
    this.binFingerprint = null;
    this.scheduleBinPoll(0);
  }

  private releaseBinObservation(): void {
    this.binObserverCount = Math.max(0, this.binObserverCount - 1);
    if (this.binObserverCount !== 0) return;
    this.stopBinPolling();
    this.binFingerprint = null;
  }

  private scheduleBinPoll(delay: number): void {
    if (this.destroyed || this.binObserverCount === 0) return;
    if (this.binPollTimer !== null) clearTimeout(this.binPollTimer);
    this.binPollTimer = setTimeout(() => {
      this.binPollTimer = null;
      void this.pollBin();
    }, delay);
  }

  private async pollBin(): Promise<void> {
    if (
      this.destroyed ||
      this.binObserverCount === 0 ||
      this.binPollRunning
    ) {
      return;
    }

    this.binPollRunning = true;
    try {
      const app = window.go?.app?.App as unknown as {
        ListTrashEntries?: () => Promise<TrashFingerprintEntry[]>;
      };
      if (typeof app?.ListTrashEntries !== 'function') return;

      const entries = await app.ListTrashEntries();
      const next = this.trashFingerprint(entries ?? []);

      if (this.binFingerprint !== null && this.binFingerprint !== next) {
        this.mutations.publish({
          kind: 'modify',
          items: [{ source: BIN_ROOT }],
          origin: 'bin-os-observer',
        });
      }
      this.binFingerprint = next;
    } catch (error) {
      // Polling is a fallback observer. A transient Shell/OS failure must not
      // affect the pane or start a retry storm.
      console.warn('Recycle Bin observation failed', error);
    } finally {
      this.binPollRunning = false;
      if (this.binObserverCount > 0 && !this.destroyed) {
        const delay =
          typeof document !== 'undefined' &&
          document.visibilityState === 'hidden'
            ? BIN_HIDDEN_POLL_MS
            : BIN_VISIBLE_POLL_MS;
        this.scheduleBinPoll(delay);
      }
    }
  }

  private stopBinPolling(): void {
    if (this.binPollTimer !== null) {
      clearTimeout(this.binPollTimer);
      this.binPollTimer = null;
    }
  }

  private trashFingerprint(
    entries: readonly TrashFingerprintEntry[],
  ): string {
    return entries
      .map(entry => [
        String(entry.id ?? ''),
        String(entry.deletedAt ?? ''),
        String(entry.size ?? ''),
        normalizePath(String(entry.originalPath ?? '')),
      ].join('\u0001'))
      .sort()
      .join('\u0002');
  }

  private isBin(location: string): boolean {
    return /^bin:\/\/(?:|.*)$/i.test(location);
  }

  private isFilesystem(location: string): boolean {
    if (!location) return false;
    if (/^filesystem:\/\//i.test(location)) return true;
    return !/^[a-z][a-z0-9+.-]*:\/\//i.test(location);
  }
}

import { Injectable } from '@angular/core';
import { Subject } from 'rxjs';
import { QueuedDialogGate } from './dialog-gate';

export interface TrashDialogRequest {
  resolve(value: void): void;
}

@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })
export class TrashDialogService {
  private readonly gate = new QueuedDialogGate<TrashDialogRequest, void>();
  readonly activeRequest$ = this.gate.activeRequest$;
  readonly mountedRequest$ = this.gate.mountedRequest$;
  readonly closingRequest$ = this.gate.closingRequest$;
  readonly mutated$ = new Subject<void>();

  open(): Promise<void> {
    return new Promise<void>((resolve) => {
      this.gate.enqueue({ resolve });
    });
  }

  close(): void {
    this.gate.beginClose(undefined);
  }

  finishClose(): void {
    this.gate.finishClose();
  }

  notifyMutated(): void {
    this.mutated$.next();
  }
}

/**
 * Shared protocol definitions between client and server.
 * These types define the command structure and responses.
 */

// ============================================================================
// OS Info
// ============================================================================

export enum OSType {
  WINDOWS = 'windows',
  LINUX = 'linux',
  MACOS = 'macos',
  UNKNOWN = 'unknown',
}

export interface OSInfoResponse {
  /** e.g. "windows", "linux", "macos" */
  os: OSType;
  /** e.g. "10.0.22621", "22.04 LTS", "14.3" */
  version: string;
  /** e.g. "x86_64", "aarch64" */
  arch: string;
  /** Machine hostname */
  hostname: string;
  /**
   * On Windows: the system drive root reference, exposed as a public path
  * token such as "filesystem://c". null on non-Windows platforms.
   */
  systemDrive: string | null;
}

// ============================================================================
// Schemes
// ============================================================================

export type SchemeType =
  | 'fixed'
  | 'removable'
  | 'network'
  | 'cdrom'
  | 'ramdisk'
  | 'memory'
  | 'registry'
  | 'bin'
  | 'search'
  | 'http'
  | 'https'
  | 'smb'
  | 's3'
  | 'unknown'
  | 'cloud-onedrive'
  | 'cloud-google'
  | 'cloud-dropbox';

export interface DriveInfo {
  /** Short label, e.g. "C:" on Windows or "sda1" on Linux */
  name: string;
  /** Canonical mount/root path, e.g. "filesystem://c" on Windows */
  path: string;
  /** Physical drive kind or a synthetic cloud mount used by the frontend address bar. */
  schemeType: SchemeType;
  /** Total capacity in bytes */
  totalSpace: number;
  /** Free space in bytes */
  freeSpace: number;
  /** e.g. "NTFS", "ext4" */
  fileSystem: string | null;
}

export interface DrivesList {
  schemes: DriveInfo[];
}

export interface SpecialFolder {
  name: string;
  path: string;
  icon: string;
}

// ============================================================================
// Commands (Client -> Server)
// ============================================================================

export enum CommandType {
  LIST_DRIVES = 'LIST_DRIVES',
  LIST_DIRECTORY = 'LIST_DIRECTORY',
  READ_FILE = 'READ_FILE',
  WRITE_FILE = 'WRITE_FILE',
  DELETE_FILE = 'DELETE_FILE',
  CREATE_DIRECTORY = 'CREATE_DIRECTORY',
  MOVE_FILE = 'MOVE_FILE',
  COPY_FILE = 'COPY_FILE',
  GET_FILE_INFO = 'GET_FILE_INFO',
  SEARCH_FILES = 'SEARCH_FILES',
  GET_OS_INFO = 'GET_OS_INFO',
}

export interface BaseCommand {
  /** Unique command ID for tracking */
  id: string;
  type: CommandType;
  timestamp: number;
}

export interface GetOSInfoCommand extends BaseCommand {
  type: CommandType.GET_OS_INFO;
}

export interface ListDrivesCommand extends BaseCommand {
  type: CommandType.LIST_DRIVES;
}

export interface ListDirectoryCommand extends BaseCommand {
  type: CommandType.LIST_DIRECTORY;
  path: string;
  showHidden?: boolean;
}

export interface ReadFileCommand extends BaseCommand {
  type: CommandType.READ_FILE;
  path: string;
  encoding?: 'utf8' | 'base64';
}

export interface WriteFileCommand extends BaseCommand {
  type: CommandType.WRITE_FILE;
  path: string;
  content: string;
  encoding?: 'utf8' | 'base64';
}

export interface DeleteFileCommand extends BaseCommand {
  type: CommandType.DELETE_FILE;
  path: string;
  /** Required when deleting a directory */
  recursive?: boolean;
}

export interface CreateDirectoryCommand extends BaseCommand {
  type: CommandType.CREATE_DIRECTORY;
  path: string;
  /** Create parent directories as needed */
  recursive?: boolean;
}

export interface MoveFileCommand extends BaseCommand {
  type: CommandType.MOVE_FILE;
  source: string;
  destination: string;
}

export interface CopyFileCommand extends BaseCommand {
  type: CommandType.COPY_FILE;
  source: string;
  destination: string;
  /** Required when copying a directory */
  recursive?: boolean;
}

export interface GetFileInfoCommand extends BaseCommand {
  type: CommandType.GET_FILE_INFO;
  path: string;
}

export interface SearchFilesCommand extends BaseCommand {
  type: CommandType.SEARCH_FILES;
  path: string;
  pattern: string;
  recursive?: boolean;
}

export type Command =
  | GetOSInfoCommand
  | ListDrivesCommand
  | ListDirectoryCommand
  | ReadFileCommand
  | WriteFileCommand
  | DeleteFileCommand
  | CreateDirectoryCommand
  | MoveFileCommand
  | CopyFileCommand
  | GetFileInfoCommand
  | SearchFilesCommand;

// ============================================================================
// Responses (Server -> Client)
// ============================================================================

export enum ResponseStatus {
  SUCCESS = 'SUCCESS',
  ERROR = 'ERROR',
}

export interface BaseResponse {
  /** References the originating command ID */
  commandId: string;
  status: ResponseStatus;
  timestamp: number;
}

export interface SuccessResponse<T = unknown> extends BaseResponse {
  status: ResponseStatus.SUCCESS;
  data: T;
}

export interface ErrorResponse extends BaseResponse {
  status: ResponseStatus.ERROR;
  error: {
    code: string;
    message: string;
    details?: unknown;
  };
}

export type Response<T = unknown> = SuccessResponse<T> | ErrorResponse;

// ============================================================================
// File-system Data Types
// ============================================================================

export enum FileType {
  FILE = 'FILE',
  DIRECTORY = 'DIRECTORY',
  ARCHIVE = 'ARCHIVE',
  SYMLINK = 'SYMLINK',
}

export interface FileInfo {
  name: string;
  /** Absolute path РІР‚вЂќ always includes drive letter on Windows */
  path: string;
  type: FileType;
  mimeType?: string;
  /** Size in bytes */
  size: number;
  /** Unix timestamp */
  created: number;
  /** Unix timestamp */
  modified: number;
  /** Unix timestamp */
  accessed: number;
  /** Full native permission summary exposed by the filesystem provider. */
  permissions: string;
  /** Native file owner when the provider can resolve one (for example DOMAIN\\user on Windows). */
  owner?: string;
  /** Native filesystem attribute flags (for example R, H, S, A on Windows). */
  attributes?: string;
  isHidden: boolean;
  /** True for both dir-symlinks (type=DIRECTORY) and file-symlinks (type=SYMLINK). */
  isSymlink?: boolean;
  registryKind?: string;
  registryValueType?: string;
  registryPreview?: string;
  searchBasePath?: string;
  searchPattern?: string;
  searchParentPath?: string;
}

export interface FileProbe {
  mimeType: string;
  encoding?: string;
  isText: boolean;
  isArchive: boolean;
}

export interface DirectoryListing {
  path: string;
  entries: FileInfo[];
  totalSize: number;
}

export interface FileContent {
  path: string;
  content: string;
  encoding: 'utf8' | 'base64';
  size: number;
}

export interface OperationResult {
  success: boolean;
  message?: string;
  affectedPaths?: string[];
}

export interface SearchResult {
  path: string;
  matches: FileInfo[];
  totalMatches: number;
}

// ============================================================================
// Archive Types
// ============================================================================

/** Represents a single file/folder inside an archive */
export interface ArchiveEntry {
  name: string;
  path: string;
  type: 'FILE' | 'DIRECTORY' | 'ARCHIVE';
  size: number;
  modified: number;
  isNested: boolean;
  nestedChain?: string[];
}

/** Represents the contents of an archive or a folder inside an archive */
export interface ArchiveListing {
  archivePath: string;
  innerPath: string;
  nestedChain?: string[];
  entries: ArchiveEntry[];
}

// ============================================================================
// WebSocket Message Types
// ============================================================================

export enum MessageType {
  COMMAND = 'COMMAND',
  RESPONSE = 'RESPONSE',
  PING = 'PING',
  PONG = 'PONG',
  AUTH = 'AUTH',
}

export interface WebSocketMessage {
  type: MessageType;
  payload: unknown;
}

export interface AuthPayload {
  token: string;
}

          <input class="filter" type="search" placeholder="Filter groups…" [(ngModel)]="filterText" [disabled]="scanning">

export class DuplicateFinderSurfaceTabComponent implements OnChanges {
  @Input({ required: true }) ctx!: SurfaceContext;
  @Input() active = false;
  rootPath = '';
  minSize = 1;
  includeHidden = false;
  scanning = false;
  progress: DuplicateScanProgress | null = null;
  result: DuplicateScanResult | null = null;
  selected = new Set<string>();
  keeperPolicy: DuplicateKeeperPolicy = 'oldest';
  sortMode: 'wasted' | 'copies' | 'size' | 'path' = 'wasted';
  filterText = '';
  private loadKey = '';

  constructor(
    private readonly finder: DuplicateFinderService,
    private readonly api: ApiService,
    private readonly confirm: ConfirmDialogService,
    private readonly workspace: WorkspaceService,
    private readonly basket: SelectionBasketService,
    private readonly resultsPanels: ResultsPanelService,
    private readonly cdr: ChangeDetectorRef,
  ) {}

  ngOnChanges(): void {
    const key = this.ctx?.tab?.path ?? '';
    if (key === this.loadKey) return;
    this.loadKey = key;
    this.rootPath = this.parseRoot(key);
    this.result = null;
    this.selected.clear();
    if (this.rootPath) void this.scan();
  }

  async scan(): Promise<void> {
    if (!this.rootPath || this.scanning) return;
    this.scanning = true; this.progress = null; this.selected.clear(); this.cdr.markForCheck();
    try {
      this.result = await this.finder.scan(this.rootPath, { includeHidden: this.includeHidden, minSize: this.minSize }, p => {
        this.progress = p; this.cdr.markForCheck();
      });
    } catch (error) {
      await this.confirm.alert(`Duplicate Scan Failed\n${error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)}`);
    } finally {
      this.scanning = false; this.progress = null; this.cdr.markForCheck();
    }
  }

  selectSuggested(): void {
    this.selected = new Set(this.finder.redundantPaths(this.result?.groups ?? [], this.keeperPolicy));
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
  }

  onKeeperPolicyChange(): void {
    if (this.selected.size > 0) this.selectSuggested();
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
  }

  get visibleGroups(): DuplicateGroup[] {
    const needle = this.filterText.trim().toLowerCase();
    const groups = [...(this.result?.groups ?? [])].filter(group => !needle || group.files.some(file => file.path.toLowerCase().includes(needle)));
    groups.sort((a, b) => {
      switch (this.sortMode) {
        case 'copies': return b.files.length - a.files.length || b.reclaimableBytes - a.reclaimableBytes;
        case 'size': return b.size - a.size || b.reclaimableBytes - a.reclaimableBytes;
        case 'path': return (a.files[0]?.path ?? '').localeCompare(b.files[0]?.path ?? '');
        default: return b.reclaimableBytes - a.reclaimableBytes || (a.files[0]?.path ?? '').localeCompare(b.files[0]?.path ?? '');
      }
    });
    return groups;
  }

  keeperPath(group: DuplicateGroup): string { return this.finder.keeperPath(group, this.keeperPolicy); }

  groupIcon(group: DuplicateGroup): string {
    const ext = (group.files[0]?.name.split('.').pop() ?? '').toLowerCase();
    if (['jpg','jpeg','png','gif','webp','bmp','tif','tiff','heic','heif','avif'].includes(ext)) return '🖼️';
    if (['mp4','mkv','mov','avi','webm','m4v'].includes(ext)) return '🎬';
    if (['mp3','flac','wav','m4a','aac','ogg'].includes(ext)) return '🎵';
    if (['zip','7z','rar','tar','gz','bz2','xz'].includes(ext)) return '📦';
    if (['pdf','doc','docx','txt','md','rtf'].includes(ext)) return '📄';
    return '📎';
  }

  toggle(path: string): void {
    const next = new Set(this.selected); next.has(path) ? next.delete(path) : next.add(path); this.selected = next;
  }

  openResultsPanel(): void {
    const entries = this.uniqueResultFiles();
    if (entries.length === 0) return;

    const panel = this.resultsPanels.createDuplicateResults(
      this.rootPath,
      entries,
      `Duplicates: ${this.rootPath}`,
    );
    const tab = this.workspace.addTab(this.ctx.paneId, panel.path, true);
    if (tab) {
      this.workspace.updateTabPathAndTitle(this.ctx.paneId, tab.id, panel.path, panel.title);
    }
  }

  private uniqueResultFiles(): import('../../shared/protocol').FileInfo[] {
    const files = new Map<string, import('../../shared/protocol').FileInfo>();
    for (const group of this.visibleGroups) {
      for (const file of group.files) files.set(file.path, { ...file });
    }
    return [...files.values()];
  }

  collectSelected(): void {
    this.basket.add(Array.from(this.selected), 'duplicates');
  }

  async deleteSelected(): Promise<void> {
    const paths = Array.from(this.selected);
    if (!paths.length) return;
    const bytes = this.selectedBytes();
    const ok = await this.confirm.confirm({ title: 'Remove Duplicate Files', message: `Move ${paths.length} selected duplicate file(s) to Trash?\nPotentially reclaim ${this.formatSize(bytes)}.`, confirmText: 'Move to Trash', danger: true });
    if (!ok) return;
    const result = await this.api.batchDelete(paths, false, true);
    if (result.failed > 0) await this.confirm.alert(`Duplicate Cleanup Completed With Errors\n${result.failed} item(s) could not be removed.`);
    await this.scan();
  }

  preview(path: string, name: string): void {
    this.workspace.addViewerTab(this.ctx.paneId, path, { activate: true, title: name, autoFollow: false });
  }

  trackGroup(_index: number, group: DuplicateGroup): string { return `${group.size}:${group.hash}`; }
  formatSize(bytes: number): string {
    if (!bytes) return '0 B'; const units = ['B','KB','MB','GB','TB']; const i = Math.min(Math.floor(Math.log(bytes)/Math.log(1024)), units.length-1); const value = bytes/Math.pow(1024,i); return `${i === 0 ? value : value.toFixed(1)} ${units[i]}`;
  }

  private selectedBytes(): number {
    let total = 0; for (const group of this.result?.groups ?? []) for (const file of group.files) if (this.selected.has(file.path)) total += file.size; return total;
  }
  private parseRoot(location: string): string {
    try { const url = new URL(location); return url.searchParams.get('path') ?? ''; } catch { return ''; }
  }
}

      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      flex: 1 1 0%;
      min-height: 0;
      min-width: 0;
      overflow: hidden;
    }
  `],
})
export class SearchResultsSurfaceTabComponent {
  @Input({ required: true }) ctx!: SearchResultsSurfaceContext;
  @Input() active = false;
  @ViewChild('dir') private dir?: DirSurfaceTabComponent;

  get currentSurfacePath(): string {
    if (this.active) return this.ctx?.dirVm?.currentPath || this.ctx?.tab?.path || '';
    return this.ctx?.tab?.path || this.ctx?.dirVm?.currentPath || '';
  }

  get querySummary(): string {
    const location = this.ctx?.tab?.location?.location || this.ctx?.tab?.path || '';
    try {
      const raw = location.slice('search://'.length);
      const params = new URLSearchParams(raw.startsWith('?') ? raw.slice(1) : raw);
      const pattern = params.get('pattern') || params.get('q') || 'Search';
      const base = params.get('path');
      return base ? `${pattern} in ${base}` : pattern;
    } catch {
      return location || 'Search';
    }
  }

  get addressBar() { return this.dir?.addressBar; }
  get fileViewContainer() { return this.dir?.fileViewContainer; }
  get findWidget() { return this.dir?.findWidget; }
}

import { Pipe, PipeTransform } from '@angular/core';
import { formatLocalDate, formatLocalDateTime, formatLocalTime } from './local-date-time';

export type LocalDateTimeDisplay = 'dateTime' | 'date' | 'time';

@Pipe({
  name: 'localDateTime',
  standalone: true,
  pure: true,
})
export class LocalDateTimePipe implements PipeTransform {
  transform(value: unknown, display: LocalDateTimeDisplay = 'dateTime', fallback = ''): string {
    if (display === 'date') return formatLocalDate(value, fallback);
    if (display === 'time') return formatLocalTime(value, fallback);
    return formatLocalDateTime(value, fallback);
  }
}

import {
  formatLocalDate,
  formatLocalDateTime,
  formatLocalDateTimeInput,
  formatLocalTime,
} from './local-date-time';

describe('local date/time presentation', () => {
  it('formats timestamps using the machine local timezone', () => {
    const date = new Date(2026, 7, 24, 6, 7, 8);
    expect(formatLocalDateTime(date)).toBe(date.toLocaleString([], {
      year: 'numeric',
      month: '2-digit',
      day: '2-digit',
      hour: '2-digit',
      minute: '2-digit',
    }));
    expect(formatLocalDate(date)).toBe(date.toLocaleDateString());
    expect(formatLocalTime(date)).toBe(date.toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' }));
  });

  it('accepts both Unix seconds and JavaScript milliseconds', () => {
    const millis = new Date(2026, 7, 24, 6, 7, 8).getTime();
    expect(formatLocalDateTime(Math.floor(millis / 1000))).toBe(formatLocalDateTime(Math.floor(millis / 1000) * 1000));
  });

  it('creates local editable timestamps without converting through UTC', () => {
    const date = new Date(2026, 7, 24, 6, 7, 8);
    expect(formatLocalDateTimeInput(date)).toBe('2026-08-24T06:07:08');
  });
});

/** GUI-only local date/time presentation helpers.
 *
 * Internal timestamps stay canonical. These helpers are the single boundary
 * where timestamps become user-visible local date/time strings.
 */
export function localDate(value: unknown): Date | null {
  if (value instanceof Date) {
    return Number.isNaN(value.getTime()) ? null : value;
  }

  if (typeof value === 'number') {
    if (!Number.isFinite(value) || value <= 0) return null;
    const millis = Math.abs(value) < 10_000_000_000 ? value * 1000 : value;
    const date = new Date(millis);
    return Number.isNaN(date.getTime()) ? null : date;
  }

  if (typeof value === 'string') {
    const trimmed = value.trim();
    if (!trimmed) return null;
    const numeric = Number(trimmed);
    if (Number.isFinite(numeric) && /^[-+]?\d+(?:\.\d+)?$/.test(trimmed)) {
      return localDate(numeric);
    }
    const date = new Date(trimmed);
    return Number.isNaN(date.getTime()) ? null : date;
  }

  return null;
}

export function formatLocalDateTime(value: unknown, fallback = ''): string {
  const date = localDate(value);
  if (!date) return fallback;
  return date.toLocaleString([], {
    year: 'numeric',
    month: '2-digit',
    day: '2-digit',
    hour: '2-digit',
    minute: '2-digit',
  });
}

export function formatLocalDate(value: unknown, fallback = ''): string {
  const date = localDate(value);
  return date ? date.toLocaleDateString() : fallback;
}

export function formatLocalTime(value: unknown, fallback = ''): string {
  const date = localDate(value);
  return date
    ? date.toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' })
    : fallback;
}

/** YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss in the machine's local timezone, for native/local inputs. */
export function formatLocalDateTimeInput(value: unknown = Date.now()): string {
  const date = localDate(value) ?? new Date();
  const pad = (part: number) => String(part).padStart(2, '0');
  return [
    date.getFullYear(),
    '-', pad(date.getMonth() + 1),
    '-', pad(date.getDate()),
    'T', pad(date.getHours()),
    ':', pad(date.getMinutes()),
    ':', pad(date.getSeconds()),
  ].join('');
}

    flex: 0 0 auto;
    overflow-x: auto;
    overflow-y: hidden;
    scrollbar-width: none;
    white-space: nowrap;
  }

  .viewer-toolbar::-webkit-scrollbar {
    display: none;
  }

  .viewer-toolbar > * {
    flex: 0 0 auto;
  }

  .tool-btn {
    box-sizing: border-box;
    flex: 0 0 auto;
    min-width: 24px;
    height: 23px;
    padding: 0 6px;
    border: 1px solid transparent;
    border-radius: 3px;
    background: transparent;
    color: var(--vsc-foreground);
    font: inherit;
    font-size: 11px;
    line-height: 21px;
    cursor: pointer;
  }

  .tool-btn:hover:not(:disabled) {
    border-color: transparent;
    background: var(--vsc-list-hover-background);
  }

  .tool-btn:focus-visible {
    outline: 1px solid var(--vsc-focus-ring, var(--vsc-focus-border));
    outline-offset: -1px;
  }

  .tool-btn.active {
    border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--vsc-accent-blue, var(--vsc-focus-ring)) 34%, transparent);
    background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--vsc-accent-blue, var(--vsc-focus-ring)) 12%, transparent);
    color: var(--vsc-foreground);
  }

  .tool-btn:disabled {
    opacity: .35;
    cursor: default;
  }

  .zoom-label {
    flex: 0 0 auto;
    min-width: 40px;
    font-size: 10px;
    color: var(--vsc-description-foreground, var(--vsc-foreground-dim));
  }

  .toolbar-divider {
    flex: 0 0 1px;
    width: 1px;
    height: 16px;
    margin: 0 4px;
    background: var(--vsc-border-subtle, var(--vsc-border));
  }

  /* ViewerHost owns identity; nested viewers expose only contextual tools. */
  :host-context(app-viewer-host-surface) .viewer-header {
    display: none !important;
  }

  @media (max-width: 720px) {
    .viewer-header {
      padding-inline: 6px;
    }

    .header-meta .size-badge,
    .header-meta .dim-badge,
    .header-meta .line-badge {
      display: none;
    }

    .path { display: none; }
  }
`;

export function buildDisplayName(info: FileInfo | null, targetPath: string, archiveContext: ViewerArchiveContext | null): string {
  if (info?.name) {
    return info.name;
  }
  if (archiveContext?.entryPath) {
    return baseName(archiveContext.entryPath);
  }
  return targetPath ? baseName(targetPath) : '';
}

export function baseName(path: string): string {
  return (path ?? '').replace(/\\/g, '/').split('/').pop() || path;
}

export function extractExt(path: string): string {
  const normalized = (path ?? '').replace(/\\/g, '/');
  const last = normalized.split('/').pop() ?? normalized;
  const index = last.lastIndexOf('.');
  return index >= 0 ? last.slice(index + 1).toLowerCase() : '';
}

export function formatSize(bytes: number): string {
  if (!bytes || bytes <= 0) {
    return '';
  }
  const units = ['B', 'KB', 'MB', 'GB'];
  const unitIndex = Math.min(Math.floor(Math.log(bytes) / Math.log(1024)), units.length - 1);
  const value = bytes / Math.pow(1024, unitIndex);
  return `${unitIndex === 0 ? value : value.toFixed(1)} ${units[unitIndex]}`;
}

export function makeSyntheticInfo(name: string, path: string, size: number): FileInfo {
  return {
    name,
    path,
    size,
    type: FileType.FILE,
    modified: 0,
    created: 0,
    accessed: 0,
    permissions: '',
    isHidden: false,
  } as FileInfo;
}

export function sanitizeSvg(text: string): string {
  return (text ?? '')
    .replace(/<\?xml[^>]*\?>/gi, '')
    .replace(/<!DOCTYPE[^>]*>/gi, '')
    .trim();
}

export function inferImageMime(ext: string): string | null {
  return ({
    png: 'image/png',
    jpg: 'image/jpeg',
    jpeg: 'image/jpeg',
    gif: 'image/gif',
    webp: 'image/webp',
    bmp: 'image/bmp',
    ico: 'image/x-icon',
    tif: 'image/tiff',
    tiff: 'image/tiff',
    avif: 'image/avif',
    psd: 'image/vnd.adobe.photoshop',
    ai: 'image/application/postscript',
    heic: 'image/heic',
    heif: 'image/heif',
  } as Record<string, string>)[ext] ?? null;
}

export function inferVideoMime(ext: string): string | null {
  return ({
    mp4: 'video/mp4',
    m4v: 'video/mp4',
    webm: 'video/webm',
    ogv: 'video/ogg',
    mov: 'video/quicktime',
    qt: 'video/quicktime',
    mkv: 'video/x-matroska',
    avi: 'video/x-msvideo',
    divx: 'video/x-msvideo',
    xvid: 'video/x-msvideo',
    flv: 'video/x-flv',
    ts: 'video/mp2t',
    m2ts: 'video/mp2t',
    mts: 'video/mp2t',
    mpg: 'video/mpeg',
    mpeg: 'video/mpeg',
    vob: 'video/mpeg',
    m2p: 'video/mpeg',
    m2v: 'video/mpeg',
    mjpeg: 'video/x-motion-jpeg',
    mjpg: 'video/x-motion-jpeg',
    m3u8: 'application/x-mpegURL',
    mxf: 'application/mxf',
    wmv: 'video/x-ms-wmv',
  } as Record<string, string>)[ext] ?? null;
}

export function inferAudioMime(ext: string): string | null {
  return ({
    mp3: 'audio/mpeg',
    wav: 'audio/wav',
    ogg: 'audio/ogg',
    flac: 'audio/flac',
    aac: 'audio/aac',
    m4a: 'audio/mp4',
  } as Record<string, string>)[ext] ?? null;
}

export function isTextExtension(ext: string): boolean {
  return new Set([
    'txt', 'log', 'csv', 'tsv', 'ini', 'cfg', 'conf', 'yaml', 'yml', 'toml',
    'xml', 'html', 'htm', 'css', 'scss', 'sass', 'less',
    'js', 'ts', 'jsx', 'tsx', 'vue', 'svelte',
    'py', 'rb', 'go', 'rs', 'java', 'kt', 'swift', 'c', 'cpp', 'h', 'hpp',
    'cs', 'php', 'sh', 'bash', 'zsh', 'fish', 'ps1', 'bat', 'cmd',
    'sql', 'graphql', 'gql', 'proto', 'dockerfile', 'gitignore', 'env',
    'lock', 'diff', 'patch', 'r', 'lua', 'm', 'pl', 'ex', 'exs',
  ]).has(ext);
}

export function looksLikeText(content: string): boolean {
  const sample = content.slice(0, 1024);
  let controlCount = 0;
  for (let index = 0; index < sample.length; index++) {
    const code = sample.charCodeAt(index);
    if (code < 9 || (code > 13 && code < 32)) {
      controlCount++;
    }
  }
  return sample.length === 0 || controlCount / sample.length < 0.05;
}

export function syntaxHighlightJson(json: string): string {
  return json
    .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
    .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
    .replace(/>/g, '&gt;')
    .replace(
      /("(\\u[a-zA-Z0-9]{4}|\\[^u]|[^\\"])*"(\s*:)?|\b(true|false|null)\b|-?\d+(?:\.\d*)?(?:[eE][+\-]?\d+)?)/g,
      (match) => {
        if (/^"/.test(match)) {
          return match.endsWith(':')
            ? `<span class="json-key">${match}</span>`
            : `<span class="json-str">${match}</span>`;
        }
        if (/true|false/.test(match)) {
          return `<span class="json-bool">${match}</span>`;
        }
        if (/null/.test(match)) {
          return `<span class="json-null">${match}</span>`;
        }
        return `<span class="json-num">${match}</span>`;
      },
    );
}

export function renderMarkdown(markdown: string): string {
  let html = markdown
    .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
    .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
    .replace(/>/g, '&gt;')
    .replace(/```[\w]*\n([\s\S]*?)```/g, (_match, code) => `<pre><code>${code}</code></pre>`)
    .replace(/^###### (.+)$/gm, '<h6>$1</h6>')
    .replace(/^##### (.+)$/gm, '<h5>$1</h5>')
    .replace(/^#### (.+)$/gm, '<h4>$1</h4>')
    .replace(/^### (.+)$/gm, '<h3>$1</h3>')
    .replace(/^## (.+)$/gm, '<h2>$1</h2>')
    .replace(/^# (.+)$/gm, '<h1>$1</h1>')
    .replace(/^---+$/gm, '<hr>')
    .replace(/^&gt; (.+)$/gm, '<blockquote>$1</blockquote>')
    .replace(/\*\*\*(.+?)\*\*\*/g, '<strong><em>$1</em></strong>')
    .replace(/\*\*(.+?)\*\*/g, '<strong>$1</strong>')
    .replace(/\*(.+?)\*/g, '<em>$1</em>')
    .replace(/__(.+?)__/g, '<strong>$1</strong>')
    .replace(/_(.+?)_/g, '<em>$1</em>')
    .replace(/`([^`]+)`/g, '<code>$1</code>')
    .replace(/~~(.+?)~~/g, '<del>$1</del>')
    .replace(/!\[([^\]]*)\]\(([^)]+)\)/g, '<img src="$2" alt="$1">')
    .replace(/\[([^\]]+)\]\(([^)]+)\)/g, '<a href="$2" target="_blank" rel="noopener">$1</a>')
    .replace(/^\s*[-*+] (.+)$/gm, '<li>$1</li>')
    .replace(/^\s*\d+\. (.+)$/gm, '<li>$1</li>')
    .replace(/(<li>.*<\/li>\n?)+/gs, (match) => `<ul>${match}</ul>`)
    .replace(/\n{2,}/g, '</p><p>');

  if (!/^<(h[1-6]|ul|ol|pre|blockquote|hr)/.test(html.trim())) {
    html = `<p>${html}</p>`;
  }
  return html;
}
`````
