`````typescript
export class ImageViewerComponent implements OnChanges, OnDestroy {
  private carouselListElement: HTMLDivElement | null = null;
  private viewerSurfaceElement: HTMLDivElement | null = null;
  private scrollListenerCleanup: (() => void) | null = null;
  private pendingInitialCenterFrame: number | null = null;
  previewCenterIndex = 0;
  private previewCommitTimer: number | null = null;
  private readonly previewCommitDelay = 150;
  private suppressPreviewCommit = false;
  private suppressPreviewCommitTimer: number | null = null;
  private explicitSelectionLockIndex: number | null = null;
  private explicitSelectionLockTimer: number | null = null;
  
  // Pointer gesture properties for natural scrolling
  private pointerDragActive = false;
  private pointerLastY: number | null = null;
  private pointerScrollAccumulator = 0;
  private readonly previewStep = 800; // Reduced from 1000 for slightly more responsive feel
  private pendingPreviewIndex: number | null = null;
  private readonly pointerMaxGestureSteps = 3; // Max 3 items per gesture
  private readonly pointerScrollSensitivity = 0.008; // Increased slightly for better responsiveness
  private pointerGestureCompletedSteps = 0; // Track completed steps in current gesture

  // Wheel-based scrolling properties
  private wheelScrollAccumulator = 0;
  private readonly wheelStepThreshold = 150; // Lower threshold for wheel vs touch
  private wheelDebounceTimer: number | null = null;
  private lastWheelTimestamp = 0;
  private readonly wheelCooldownMs = 100;

  visibleCarouselItems: CarouselVirtualFrame[] = [];
  private virtualStartIndex = 0;
  private virtualEndIndex = 0;
  virtualLeadingWidth = 0;
  virtualTrailingWidth = 0;
  private readonly virtualBuffer = 6;

  @ViewChild('viewerSurface', { static: true })
  set viewerSurfaceRef(value: ElementRef<HTMLDivElement> | undefined) {
    this.viewerSurfaceElement = value?.nativeElement ?? null;
  }

  @ViewChild('carouselList', { static: false })
  set carouselListRef(value: ElementRef<HTMLDivElement> | undefined) {
    const element = value?.nativeElement ?? null;
    if (element === this.carouselListElement) {
      return;
    }
    this.detachCarouselScrollListener();
    this.carouselListElement = element;
    if (element) {
      this.scheduleCenterOnCurrentItem();
      this.attachCarouselScrollListener(element);
    }
  }

  @Input() targetPath = '';
  @Input() fileList: ViewerFileListItem[] = [];
  @Input() archiveContext: ViewerArchiveContext | null = null;
  @Input() viewerId: string | null = null;
  @Input() probe: FileProbe | null = null;

  kind: ImageViewerKind = 'empty';
  error: string | null = null;
  info: FileInfo | null = null;
  imageSrc: string | null = null;
  imageMeta: ImageMeta | null = null;
  imageLoaded = false;
  imageSwitchPending = false;
  zoomLevel = 0;
  showCheckerboard = false;
  carouselItems: CarouselImageItem[] = [];
  currentCarouselIndex = 0;

  private activeTargetPath = '';
  private activeArchiveContext: ViewerArchiveContext | null = null;
  private destroyed = false;
  private contextToken = 0;
  private displayToken = 0;

  private readonly nativeImageExts = new Set(['svg', 'png', 'jpg', 'jpeg', 'gif', 'webp', 'bmp', 'ico', 'avif']);
  private readonly convertibleImageExts = new Set(['tiff', 'tif', 'exr', 'heif', 'heic', 'jp2', 'j2k', 'jxl', 'fits', 'hdr', 'pfm']);
  private readonly thumbnailWidth = 160;
  private readonly thumbnailHeight = 120;
  private readonly thumbnailHydrationRadius = 4;
  private readonly carouselItemDefaultWidth = 112;
  private readonly carouselItemGap = 12;
  private deletionInProgress = false;

  constructor(
    private api: ApiService,
    private cdr: ChangeDetectorRef,
  ) {}

  get activeContext(): ViewerArchiveContext | null {
    return this.activeArchiveContext;
  }

  get displayName(): string {
    if (this.info?.name) return this.info.name;
    if (this.activeArchiveContext?.entryPath) return this.baseName(this.activeArchiveContext.entryPath);
    return this.activeTargetPath ? this.baseName(this.activeTargetPath) : '';
  }

  get displayPath(): string {
    if (this.activeArchiveContext) {
      return `${this.activeArchiveContext.fsPath} :: ${this.activeArchiveContext.entryPath}`;
    }
    return this.activeTargetPath;
  }

  get fileExt(): string {
    return this.extractExt(this.activeArchiveContext?.entryPath ?? this.activeTargetPath);
  }

  get typeBadge(): string {
    const ext = this.fileExt;
    return ext ? ext.toUpperCase() : 'FILE';
  }

  get imageTransform(): string {
    return this.zoomLevel === 0 ? 'none' : `scale(${this.zoomLevel})`;
  }

  get zoomLabel(): string {
    return this.zoomLevel === 0 ? 'Fit' : `${Math.round(this.zoomLevel * 100)}%`;
  }

  get hasCarousel(): boolean {
    return this.carouselItems.length > 1;
  }

  get hasPrevious(): boolean {
    return this.currentCarouselIndex > 0;
  }

  get hasNext(): boolean {
    return this.currentCarouselIndex >= 0 && this.currentCarouselIndex < this.carouselItems.length - 1;
  }

  async ngOnChanges(): Promise<void> {
    const token = ++this.contextToken;
    this.resetState();

    const path = (this.targetPath ?? '').trim();
    if (!path) {
      this.kind = 'empty';
      this.cdr.markForCheck();
      return;
    }

    if (this.archiveContext) {
      this.kind = 'unsupported';
      this.error = 'Preview inside archives is disabled.';
      this.cdr.markForCheck();
      return;
    }

    this.kind = 'loading';
    this.cdr.markForCheck();

    try {
      const prepared = await this.prepareDiskCarousel(path);

      if (token !== this.contextToken || this.destroyed) {
        return;
      }

      this.carouselItems = prepared.items;
      this.currentCarouselIndex = prepared.index;
      this.previewCenterIndex = prepared.index;
      this.lockExplicitSelection(prepared.index, 400);
      this.seedVirtualWindowAround(prepared.index);
      this.cdr.markForCheck();
      this.scheduleCenterOnCurrentItem();

      await this.displayCarouselIndex(prepared.index, token);
      this.onCarouselScroll();
    } catch (err: any) {
      if (token !== this.contextToken || this.destroyed) {
        return;
      }
      this.error = err?.message || String(err);
      this.kind = 'error';
      this.cdr.markForCheck();
    }
  }

  ngOnDestroy(): void {
    this.destroyed = true;
    this.detachCarouselScrollListener();
    if (this.pendingInitialCenterFrame !== null) {
      cancelAnimationFrame(this.pendingInitialCenterFrame);
      this.pendingInitialCenterFrame = null;
    }
    this.clearPreviewCommitTimer();
    this.clearSuppressPreviewCommitTimer();
    this.clearExplicitSelectionLockTimer();
    if (this.wheelDebounceTimer) {
      window.clearTimeout(this.wheelDebounceTimer);
      this.wheelDebounceTimer = null;
    }
  }

  private attachCarouselScrollListener(el: HTMLDivElement): void {
    const handler = () => this.onCarouselScroll();
    el.addEventListener('scroll', handler, { passive: true });
    this.scrollListenerCleanup = () => el.removeEventListener('scroll', handler);
    this.onCarouselScroll();
  }

  private detachCarouselScrollListener(): void {
    if (this.scrollListenerCleanup) {
      this.scrollListenerCleanup();
      this.scrollListenerCleanup = null;
    }
  }

  private onCarouselScroll(): void {
    const el = this.carouselListElement;
    if (!el) return;
    this.updateVirtualWindow();
    if (!this.carouselItems.length) {
      return;
    }
    const rangeStart = Math.max(0, this.virtualStartIndex - this.thumbnailHydrationRadius);
    const endCandidate = this.virtualEndIndex - 1 + this.thumbnailHydrationRadius;
    const rangeEnd = Math.min(this.carouselItems.length - 1, endCandidate);
    const visible: number[] = [];
    for (let idx = rangeStart; idx <= rangeEnd; idx++) {
      visible.push(idx);
    }
    this.hydrateThumbnailsForIndices(visible);
    if (this.explicitSelectionLockIndex !== null) {
      return;
    }
    if (this.suppressPreviewCommit) {
      return;
    }
    const centerIndex = this.computeCenterIndex(el);
    this.updatePreviewCenterIndex(centerIndex);
    this.schedulePreviewCommit();
  }

  private schedulePreviewCommit(): void {
    if (this.pointerDragActive) {
      return;
    }
    this.clearPreviewCommitTimer();
    this.previewCommitTimer = window.setTimeout(() => {
      this.previewCommitTimer = null;
      this.commitPreviewSelection();
    }, this.previewCommitDelay);
  }

  private clearPreviewCommitTimer(): void {
    if (this.previewCommitTimer !== null) {
      window.clearTimeout(this.previewCommitTimer);
      this.previewCommitTimer = null;
    }
  }

  private armSuppressPreviewCommit(durationMs: number): void {
    this.suppressPreviewCommit = true;
    this.clearSuppressPreviewCommitTimer();
    this.suppressPreviewCommitTimer = window.setTimeout(() => {
      this.suppressPreviewCommit = false;
      this.suppressPreviewCommitTimer = null;
    }, durationMs);
  }

  private clearSuppressPreviewCommitTimer(): void {
    if (this.suppressPreviewCommitTimer !== null) {
      window.clearTimeout(this.suppressPreviewCommitTimer);
      this.suppressPreviewCommitTimer = null;
    }
  }

  private lockExplicitSelection(index: number, durationMs = 320): void {
    this.explicitSelectionLockIndex = index;
    this.clearExplicitSelectionLockTimer();
    this.explicitSelectionLockTimer = window.setTimeout(() => {
      this.explicitSelectionLockIndex = null;
      this.explicitSelectionLockTimer = null;
    }, durationMs);
  }

  private clearExplicitSelectionLockTimer(): void {
    if (this.explicitSelectionLockTimer !== null) {
      window.clearTimeout(this.explicitSelectionLockTimer);
      this.explicitSelectionLockTimer = null;
    }
  }

  private commitPreviewSelection(): void {
    if (!this.hasCarousel) {
      return;
    }
    const candidate = this.previewCenterIndex;
    if (candidate < 0) {
      return;
    }
    this.centerCarouselItem(candidate, 'smooth');
    if (candidate === this.currentCarouselIndex) {
      return;
    }
    void this.displayCarouselIndex(candidate, this.contextToken);
  }

  private updatePreviewCenterIndex(centerIndex: number): void {
    if (centerIndex < 0 || centerIndex >= this.carouselItems.length) {
      return;
    }
    if (centerIndex === this.previewCenterIndex) {
      return;
    }
    this.previewCenterIndex = centerIndex;
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
  }


  onImageHostWheel(event: WheelEvent): void {
    if (!this.hasCarousel) {
      return;
    }
    event.preventDefault();

    // Use vertical wheel movement to switch the active image.
    let delta = event.deltaY;
    if (delta === 0 || Math.abs(delta) < Math.abs(event.deltaX)) {
      return;
    }

    if (event.deltaMode === 1) {
      delta = delta * 40;
    } else if (event.deltaMode === 2) {
      delta = delta * 200;
    }

    const scaledDelta = delta * 0.5;
    this.wheelScrollAccumulator += scaledDelta;

    const now = Date.now();
    if (now - this.lastWheelTimestamp < this.wheelCooldownMs) {
      return;
    }
    this.lastWheelTimestamp = now;
    
    // Clear previous debounce timer
    if (this.wheelDebounceTimer) {
      window.clearTimeout(this.wheelDebounceTimer);
    }
    
    // Process the accumulated scroll
    this.processWheelScroll();
    
    // Set debounce to process any remaining accumulation after wheel stops
    this.wheelDebounceTimer = window.setTimeout(() => {
      this.processWheelScroll(true); // Force final processing
      this.wheelDebounceTimer = null;
    }, this.wheelCooldownMs);
  }

  private processWheelScroll(isFinal: boolean = false): void {
    if (!this.hasCarousel) return;

    const threshold = isFinal ? this.wheelStepThreshold / 2 : this.wheelStepThreshold;
    const steps = Math.floor(Math.abs(this.wheelScrollAccumulator) / threshold);
    let shouldCommit = false;

    if (steps > 0) {
      const direction = Math.sign(this.wheelScrollAccumulator);
      const maxSteps = Math.min(steps, this.pointerMaxGestureSteps);
      let movedSteps = 0;
      for (let i = 0; i < maxSteps; i++) {
        const moved = this.tryAdvancePreview(direction);
        if (moved) {
          movedSteps++;
        } else {
          break; // Can't move further (at edge)
        }
      }

      this.wheelScrollAccumulator -= direction * movedSteps * threshold;
      shouldCommit = movedSteps > 0;
    }

    if (isFinal && Math.abs(this.wheelScrollAccumulator) > threshold * 0.3) {
      const direction = Math.sign(this.wheelScrollAccumulator);
      shouldCommit = this.tryAdvancePreview(direction) || shouldCommit;
      this.wheelScrollAccumulator = 0;
    }

    if (shouldCommit && this.pendingPreviewIndex !== null && this.pendingPreviewIndex !== this.currentCarouselIndex) {
      this.commitPreviewSelection();
      this.pendingPreviewIndex = null;
    }

    if (Math.abs(this.wheelScrollAccumulator) < threshold * 0.1) {
      this.wheelScrollAccumulator = 0;
    }
  }

  private centerCarouselItem(index: number, behavior: ScrollBehavior = 'auto'): void {
    const el = this.carouselListElement;
    if (!el) {
      return;
    }
    this.armSuppressPreviewCommit(behavior === 'smooth' ? 280 : 80);
    const itemEl = el.querySelector<HTMLElement>(`.carousel-item[data-index="${index}"]`);
    if (itemEl) {
      const itemCenter = itemEl.offsetLeft + itemEl.offsetWidth / 2;
      const targetLeft = itemCenter - el.clientWidth / 2;
      const nativeMaxScroll = Math.max(0, el.scrollWidth - el.clientWidth);
      const clampedLeft = Math.max(0, Math.min(targetLeft, nativeMaxScroll));
      el.scrollTo({ left: clampedLeft, behavior });
      return;
    }

    el.scrollTo({ left: this.getAlignedScrollLeftForIndex(el, index), behavior });
  }

  private getCarouselItemStride(): number {
    return this.carouselItemDefaultWidth + this.carouselItemGap;
  }

  private getCarouselPaddingLeft(el: HTMLDivElement): number {
    const style = getComputedStyle(el);
    return parseFloat(style.paddingInlineStart) || parseFloat(style.paddingLeft) || 0;
  }

  private getAlignedScrollLeftForIndex(el: HTMLDivElement, index: number): number {
    const stride = this.getCarouselItemStride();
    const paddingLeft = this.getCarouselPaddingLeft(el);
    const viewportWidth = el.clientWidth;
    const lead = Math.max(0, (viewportWidth - this.carouselItemDefaultWidth) / 2);
    const target = paddingLeft + index * stride - lead;
    const nativeMaxScroll = Math.max(0, el.scrollWidth - viewportWidth);
    return Math.max(0, Math.min(target, nativeMaxScroll));
  }

  private updateVirtualWindow(): void {
    const el = this.carouselListElement;
    const totalItems = this.carouselItems.length;
    if (!el || totalItems === 0) {
      this.visibleCarouselItems = [];
      this.virtualStartIndex = 0;
      this.virtualEndIndex = 0;
      this.virtualLeadingWidth = 0;
      this.virtualTrailingWidth = 0;
      return;
    }
    const stride = this.getCarouselItemStride();
    const paddingLeft = this.getCarouselPaddingLeft(el);
    const effectiveScroll = Math.max(0, el.scrollLeft - paddingLeft);
    const approxIndex = Math.floor(effectiveScroll / stride);
    const start = Math.max(0, approxIndex - this.virtualBuffer);
    const viewportItems = Math.ceil(el.clientWidth / stride) + this.virtualBuffer * 2;
    const end = Math.min(totalItems, start + viewportItems);
    this.virtualStartIndex = start;
    this.virtualEndIndex = end;
    const frames: CarouselVirtualFrame[] = [];
    for (let idx = start; idx < end; idx++) {
      const item = this.carouselItems[idx];
      if (item) {
        frames.push({ item, index: idx });
      }
    }
    this.visibleCarouselItems = frames;
    this.virtualLeadingWidth = start * stride;
    this.virtualTrailingWidth = Math.max(0, (totalItems - end) * stride);
  }

  private computeCenterIndex(el: HTMLDivElement): number {
    if (!this.carouselItems.length) {
      return -1;
    }
    const wrapper = el.parentElement;
    const itemElements = Array.from(el.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>('.carousel-item[data-index]'));
    if (wrapper && itemElements.length > 0) {
      const wrapperRect = wrapper.getBoundingClientRect();
      const indicatorCenterX = wrapperRect.left + wrapperRect.width / 2;
      let bestIndex = -1;
      let bestDistance = Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY;

      for (const itemEl of itemElements) {
        const rawIndex = Number(itemEl.dataset['index']);
        if (!Number.isFinite(rawIndex)) {
          continue;
        }
        const rect = itemEl.getBoundingClientRect();
        const itemCenterX = rect.left + rect.width / 2;
        const distance = Math.abs(itemCenterX - indicatorCenterX);
        if (distance < bestDistance) {
          bestDistance = distance;
          bestIndex = rawIndex;
        }
      }

      if (bestIndex >= 0) {
        return Math.max(0, Math.min(this.carouselItems.length - 1, bestIndex));
      }
    }

    const stride = this.getCarouselItemStride();
    const paddingLeft = this.getCarouselPaddingLeft(el);
    const effectiveScroll = Math.max(0, el.scrollLeft - paddingLeft);
    const centeredItemOrigin = effectiveScroll + Math.max(0, (el.clientWidth - this.carouselItemDefaultWidth) / 2);
    return Math.max(0, Math.min(this.carouselItems.length - 1, Math.round(centeredItemOrigin / stride)));
  }

  onImageHostPointerDown(event: PointerEvent): void {
    if (event.pointerType === 'mouse') {
      return;
    }
    const host = event.currentTarget as HTMLElement | null;
    if (!host) {
      return;
    }
    this.pointerDragActive = true;
    this.pointerLastY = event.clientY;
    this.pointerScrollAccumulator = 0;
    this.pendingPreviewIndex = this.previewCenterIndex;
    this.pointerGestureCompletedSteps = 0;
    this.focusViewerSurface();
    host.setPointerCapture?.(event.pointerId);
    this.clearPreviewCommitTimer();
    event.preventDefault();
  }

  onImageHostPointerMove(event: PointerEvent): void {
    if (!this.pointerDragActive || this.pointerLastY === null) {
      return;
    }
    const deltaY = this.pointerLastY - event.clientY;
    this.pointerLastY = event.clientY;
    
    // Only accumulate if we haven't reached max steps for this gesture
    if (this.pointerGestureCompletedSteps < this.pointerMaxGestureSteps && Math.abs(deltaY) > 0.2) {
      const scaled = deltaY * this.pointerScrollSensitivity;
      this.pointerScrollAccumulator += scaled;
      this.consumePointerScroll();
    }
    event.preventDefault();
  }

  onImageHostPointerUp(event: PointerEvent): void {
    if (!this.pointerDragActive) {
      return;
    }
    const host = event.currentTarget as HTMLElement | null;
    host?.releasePointerCapture?.(event.pointerId);
    this.pointerDragActive = false;
    this.pointerLastY = null;
    
    // Only commit if we actually changed the preview index
    if (this.pendingPreviewIndex !== null && this.pendingPreviewIndex !== this.currentCarouselIndex) {
      this.commitPreviewSelection();
    }
    
    this.pointerScrollAccumulator = 0;
    this.pendingPreviewIndex = null;
    this.pointerGestureCompletedSteps = 0;
    event.preventDefault();
  }

  private consumePointerScroll(): void {
    const stepThreshold = this.previewStep;
    // Only consume if we haven't reached max steps for this gesture
    while (Math.abs(this.pointerScrollAccumulator) >= stepThreshold && 
           this.pointerGestureCompletedSteps < this.pointerMaxGestureSteps) {
      const direction = Math.sign(this.pointerScrollAccumulator);
      const moved = this.tryAdvancePreview(direction);
      if (moved) {
        this.pointerScrollAccumulator -= direction * stepThreshold;
        this.pointerGestureCompletedSteps++;
      } else {
        // Can't move further (at edge of carousel), break out
        break;
      }
    }
    
    // Reset accumulator if we've reached max steps to prevent further movement
    if (this.pointerGestureCompletedSteps >= this.pointerMaxGestureSteps) {
      this.pointerScrollAccumulator = 0;
    }
  }

  private tryAdvancePreview(direction: number): boolean {
    if (!this.hasCarousel || direction === 0) {
      return false;
    }
    const length = this.carouselItems.length;
    const current = this.pendingPreviewIndex ?? this.previewCenterIndex;
    const nextIndex = Math.max(0, Math.min(length - 1, current + direction));
    if (nextIndex === current) {
      return false; // At edge, couldn't move
    }
    this.pendingPreviewIndex = nextIndex;
    this.previewCenterIndex = nextIndex;
    this.centerCarouselItem(nextIndex);
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
    return true; // Successfully moved
  }


  private canDeleteCurrentTarget(): boolean {
    const selectedItem = this.carouselItems[this.previewCenterIndex] ?? null;
    return !!selectedItem?.diskPath && !selectedItem.archiveContext && !this.deletionInProgress;
  }

  private async deleteCurrentTarget(): Promise<void> {
    if (!this.canDeleteCurrentTarget()) {
      return;
    }
    const selectedItem = this.carouselItems[this.previewCenterIndex] ?? null;
    const targetPath = selectedItem?.diskPath ?? '';
    if (!targetPath) {
      return;
    }
    const currentIndex = this.carouselItems.findIndex(item => item.diskPath === targetPath);
    if (currentIndex < 0) {
      return;
    }
    this.deletionInProgress = true;
    try {
      const result = await this.api.batchDelete([targetPath], true, true);
      if (result.failed > 0) {
        const message = result.errors?.[0]?.error ?? 'Delete failed';
        console.error('Image viewer delete failed', message);
        this.error = message;
        this.cdr.markForCheck();
        return;
      }

      this.fileList = this.fileList.filter(item => item.path !== targetPath);
      this.carouselItems.splice(currentIndex, 1);
      if (!this.carouselItems.length) {
        this.resetState();
        this.kind = 'empty';
        this.cdr.markForCheck();
        return;
      }

      const nextIndex = currentIndex < this.carouselItems.length
        ? currentIndex
        : this.carouselItems.length - 1;
      this.currentCarouselIndex = nextIndex;
      this.previewCenterIndex = nextIndex;
      this.seedVirtualWindowAround(nextIndex);
      this.scheduleCenterOnCurrentItem();
      await this.displayCarouselIndex(nextIndex, this.contextToken, { preserveCurrentImage: true });
      this.onCarouselScroll();
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.error('Image viewer delete failed', err);
      this.error = err?.message ?? String(err);
      this.cdr.markForCheck();
    } finally {
      this.deletionInProgress = false;
    }
  }

  private async hydrateThumbnailsForIndices(indices: number[]): Promise<void> {
    const token = this.contextToken;
    const tasks: Array<Promise<void>> = [];
    for (const idx of indices) {
      const item = this.carouselItems[idx];
      if (item) {
        tasks.push(this.hydrateThumbnailUrl(item, token));
      }
    }
    await Promise.all(tasks);
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
  }

  zoomIn(): void {
    this.zoomLevel = this.zoomLevel === 0 ? 1.25 : Math.min(this.zoomLevel * 1.25, 8);
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
  }

  zoomOut(): void {
    this.zoomLevel = this.zoomLevel === 0 ? 0.8 : Math.max(this.zoomLevel * 0.8, 0.1);
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
  }

  resetZoom(): void {
    this.zoomLevel = 0;
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
  }

  zoom100(): void {
    this.zoomLevel = 1;
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
  }

  toggleCheckerboard(): void {
    this.showCheckerboard = !this.showCheckerboard;
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
  }

  onImageLoad(event: Event): void {
    const img = event.target as HTMLImageElement;
    this.imageMeta = { width: img.naturalWidth, height: img.naturalHeight };
    this.imageLoaded = true;
    this.imageSwitchPending = false;
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
  }

  onImageError(): void {
    this.error = 'Image failed to render.';
    this.kind = 'error';
    this.imageLoaded = false;
    this.imageSwitchPending = false;
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
  }

  onThumbnailError(item: CarouselImageItem): void {
    item.thumbnailFailed = true;
    item.thumbnailSrc = null;
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
  }

  thumbnailFallback(item: CarouselImageItem): string {
    const base = item.name.trim();
    return (base[0] ?? '?').toUpperCase();
  }

  trackCarouselItem(_index: number, frame: CarouselVirtualFrame): string {
    return frame.item.id;
  }

  selectCarouselIndex(index: number): void {
    this.clearPreviewCommitTimer();
    this.lockExplicitSelection(index);
    this.previewCenterIndex = index;
    void this.displayCarouselIndex(index, this.contextToken);
  }

  deleteSelected(): void {
    void this.deleteCurrentTarget();
  }


  showPrevious(): void {
    if (!this.hasPrevious) return;
    void this.displayCarouselIndex(this.currentCarouselIndex - 1, this.contextToken);
  }

  showNext(): void {
    if (!this.hasNext) return;
    void this.displayCarouselIndex(this.currentCarouselIndex + 1, this.contextToken);
  }

  formatSize(bytes: number): string {
    if (!bytes || bytes <= 0) return '';
    const units = ['B', 'KB', 'MB', 'GB'];
    const index = Math.min(Math.floor(Math.log(bytes) / Math.log(1024)), units.length - 1);
    const value = bytes / Math.pow(1024, index);
    return `${index === 0 ? value : value.toFixed(1)} ${units[index]}`;
  }

  private async displayCarouselIndex(
    index: number,
    contextToken: number,
    options?: { preserveCurrentImage?: boolean },
  ): Promise<void> {
    if (index < 0 || index >= this.carouselItems.length) {
      return;
    }

    this.centerCarouselItem(index);

    const item = this.carouselItems[index];
    const displayToken = ++this.displayToken;
    this.currentCarouselIndex = index;
    this.previewCenterIndex = index;
    void this.scheduleThumbnailHydration(contextToken, index);
    this.error = null;
    this.imageLoaded = false;
    this.imageSwitchPending = !!options?.preserveCurrentImage;
    if (!options?.preserveCurrentImage) {
      this.kind = 'loading';
      this.imageSrc = null;
      this.imageMeta = null;
    } else {
      this.imageMeta = null;
    }
    this.cdr.markForCheck();

    try {
      if (item.diskPath) {
        await this.displayDiskItem(item, contextToken, displayToken);
      } else {
        this.error = 'Preview inside archives is disabled.';
        this.kind = 'unsupported';
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      if (!this.isDisplayCurrent(contextToken, displayToken)) {
        return;
      }
      this.error = err?.message || String(err);
      this.kind = 'error';
      this.cdr.markForCheck();
    }
  }

  private async displayDiskItem(item: CarouselImageItem, contextToken: number, displayToken: number): Promise<void> {
    const path = item.diskPath ?? '';
    const info = item.info ?? await this.api.getFileInfo(path);
    if (!this.isDisplayCurrent(contextToken, displayToken)) {
      return;
    }

    this.info = info;
    this.activeTargetPath = path;
    this.activeArchiveContext = null;

    if (info.type === FileType.DIRECTORY) {
      this.kind = 'directory';
      this.cdr.markForCheck();
      return;
    }

    const ext = item.ext || this.extractExt(path);
    if (ext === 'svg') {
      this.imageSrc = await this.api.getStreamURL(path);
      if (!this.isDisplayCurrent(contextToken, displayToken)) {
        return;
      }
      this.kind = 'svg';
      this.cdr.markForCheck();
      return;
    }

    if (this.inferImageMime(ext)) {
      this.imageSrc = await this.api.getStreamURL(path);
      if (!this.isDisplayCurrent(contextToken, displayToken)) {
        return;
      }
      this.kind = 'image';
      this.cdr.markForCheck();
      return;
    }

    this.imageSrc = await this.api.getConvertedImageURL(path, 'jpeg');
    if (!this.isDisplayCurrent(contextToken, displayToken)) {
      return;
    }
    this.kind = 'image';
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
  }

  private async displayArchiveItem(item: CarouselImageItem, contextToken: number, displayToken: number): Promise<void> {
    const archiveContext = item.archiveContext;
    if (!archiveContext) {
      return;
    }

    this.info = item.info ?? this.makeSyntheticInfo(item.name, archiveContext.entryPath, 0);
    this.activeTargetPath = archiveContext.fsPath;
    this.activeArchiveContext = archiveContext;

    const ext = item.ext || this.extractExt(archiveContext.entryPath);
    if (ext === 'svg') {
      this.imageSrc = await this.api.getArchiveStreamURL(archiveContext.fsPath, archiveContext.nestedChain, archiveContext.entryPath);
      if (!this.isDisplayCurrent(contextToken, displayToken)) {
        return;
      }
      this.kind = 'svg';
      this.cdr.markForCheck();
      return;
    }

    if (this.inferImageMime(ext)) {
      this.imageSrc = await this.api.getArchiveStreamURL(archiveContext.fsPath, archiveContext.nestedChain, archiveContext.entryPath);
      if (!this.isDisplayCurrent(contextToken, displayToken)) {
        return;
      }
      this.kind = 'image';
      this.cdr.markForCheck();
      return;
    }

    this.error = `Format ${ext.toUpperCase()} in archives is not yet supported`;
    this.kind = 'unsupported';
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
  }

  private async prepareDiskCarousel(path: string): Promise<{ items: CarouselImageItem[]; index: number }> {
    const fileListItems = this.buildCarouselItemsFromFileList(path);
    if (fileListItems) {
      return fileListItems;
    }

    const info = await this.api.getFileInfo(path);
    if (info.type === FileType.DIRECTORY) {
      return { items: [this.makeDiskCarouselItem(info)], index: 0 };
    }

    const currentItem = this.makeDiskCarouselItem(info);
    try {
      const parentPath = await this.api.getParentPath(path);
      const listing = await this.api.listDirectory(parentPath, false);
      const items = listing.entries
        .filter(entry => this.isDiskCarouselCandidate(entry))
        .map(entry => this.makeDiskCarouselItem(entry));

      const currentIndex = items.findIndex(item => item.diskPath === path);
      if (currentIndex >= 0) {
        return { items, index: currentIndex };
      }
      return { items: [currentItem, ...items], index: 0 };
    } catch {
      return { items: [currentItem], index: 0 };
    }
  }

  private seedVirtualWindowAround(index: number): void {
    const totalItems = this.carouselItems.length;
    if (!totalItems) {
      this.visibleCarouselItems = [];
      this.virtualStartIndex = 0;
      this.virtualEndIndex = 0;
      this.virtualLeadingWidth = 0;
      this.virtualTrailingWidth = 0;
      return;
    }

    const visibleCount = Math.min(totalItems, this.virtualBuffer * 2 + 3);
    const start = Math.max(0, Math.min(index - this.virtualBuffer, totalItems - visibleCount));
    const end = Math.min(totalItems, start + visibleCount);
    const stride = this.getCarouselItemStride();
    const frames: CarouselVirtualFrame[] = [];
    for (let idx = start; idx < end; idx++) {
      const item = this.carouselItems[idx];
      if (item) {
        frames.push({ item, index: idx });
      }
    }

    this.virtualStartIndex = start;
    this.virtualEndIndex = end;
    this.visibleCarouselItems = frames;
    this.virtualLeadingWidth = start * stride;
    this.virtualTrailingWidth = Math.max(0, (totalItems - end) * stride);
  }

  private scheduleCenterOnCurrentItem(): void {
    if (this.pendingInitialCenterFrame !== null) {
      cancelAnimationFrame(this.pendingInitialCenterFrame);
      this.pendingInitialCenterFrame = null;
    }
    this.pendingInitialCenterFrame = requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      this.pendingInitialCenterFrame = null;
      if (!this.carouselListElement || !this.carouselItems.length) {
        return;
      }
      this.centerCarouselItem(this.currentCarouselIndex);
    });
  }

  private buildCarouselItemsFromFileList(path: string): { items: CarouselImageItem[]; index: number } | null {
    if (!this.fileList.length) {
      return null;
    }

    const normalizedTarget = path.trim();
    const items = this.fileList
      .filter(item => item.path && this.isPreviewableImageExt(this.extractExt(item.path)))
      .map(item => this.makeDiskCarouselItemFromPath(item.path, item.name));

    if (!items.length) {
      return null;
    }

    const currentIndex = items.findIndex(item => item.diskPath === normalizedTarget);
    if (currentIndex >= 0) {
      return { items, index: currentIndex };
    }

    const targetItem = this.makeDiskCarouselItemFromPath(normalizedTarget);
    return { items: [targetItem, ...items], index: 0 };
  }

  private async prepareArchiveCarousel(ctx: ViewerArchiveContext): Promise<{ items: CarouselImageItem[]; index: number }> {
    const currentItem = this.makeArchiveCarouselItem(ctx, null);
    try {
      const innerPath = this.parentArchivePath(ctx.entryPath);
      const listing = await this.api.archiveBrowse(ctx.fsPath, ctx.nestedChain, innerPath);
      const items = listing.entries
        .filter(entry => this.isArchiveCarouselCandidate(entry))
        .map(entry => this.makeArchiveCarouselItem({
          fsPath: ctx.fsPath,
          nestedChain: ctx.nestedChain,
          entryPath: entry.path,
        }, entry));

      const currentIndex = items.findIndex(item => item.archiveContext?.entryPath === ctx.entryPath);
      if (currentIndex >= 0) {
        return { items, index: currentIndex };
      }
      return { items: [currentItem, ...items], index: 0 };
    } catch {
      return { items: [currentItem], index: 0 };
    }
  }

  private async scheduleThumbnailHydration(contextToken: number, centerIndex: number): Promise<void> {
    const start = Math.max(0, centerIndex - this.thumbnailHydrationRadius);
    const end = Math.min(this.carouselItems.length - 1, centerIndex + this.thumbnailHydrationRadius);
    const indices = [];
    for (let i = start; i <= end; i++) indices.push(i);
    await this.hydrateThumbnailsForIndices(indices);
    this.onCarouselScroll();
  }

  private async hydrateThumbnailUrl(item: CarouselImageItem, contextToken: number): Promise<void> {
    if (item.thumbnailSrc || item.thumbnailFailed || item.thumbnailLoading || this.destroyed || contextToken !== this.contextToken) {
      return;
    }

    item.thumbnailLoading = true;
    try {
      if (item.source === 'archive' && item.archiveContext) {
        item.thumbnailSrc = await this.buildArchiveThumbnailURL(item.archiveContext, item.ext);
      } else if (item.diskPath) {
        item.thumbnailSrc = await this.buildDiskThumbnailURL(item.diskPath, item.ext);
      }
      if (!item.thumbnailSrc) {
        item.thumbnailFailed = true;
      }
    } catch {
      item.thumbnailFailed = true;
      item.thumbnailSrc = null;
    } finally {
      item.thumbnailLoading = false;
    }

    if (contextToken === this.contextToken && !this.destroyed) {
      this.cdr.markForCheck();
    }
  }

  private async buildDiskThumbnailURL(path: string, ext: string): Promise<string | null> {
    if (ext === 'svg') {
      return await this.api.getStreamURL(path);
    }
    try {
      return await this.api.getImageThumbnailURL(path, this.thumbnailWidth, this.thumbnailHeight);
    } catch {
      return null;
    }
  }

  private async buildArchiveThumbnailURL(ctx: ViewerArchiveContext, ext: string): Promise<string | null> {
    if (ext === 'svg') {
      return await this.api.getArchiveStreamURL(ctx.fsPath, ctx.nestedChain, ctx.entryPath);
    }
    try {
      return await this.api.getArchiveImageThumbnailURL(ctx.fsPath, ctx.nestedChain, ctx.entryPath, this.thumbnailWidth, this.thumbnailHeight);
    } catch {
      return null;
    }
  }

  private isDisplayCurrent(contextToken: number, displayToken: number): boolean {
    return !this.destroyed && contextToken === this.contextToken && displayToken === this.displayToken;
  }

  private isDiskCarouselCandidate(entry: FileInfo): boolean {
    if (entry.type === FileType.DIRECTORY || entry.type === FileType.ARCHIVE) {
      return false;
    }
    return this.isPreviewableImageExt(this.extractExt(entry.path || entry.name));
  }

  private isArchiveCarouselCandidate(entry: ArchiveEntry): boolean {
    if (entry.type === FileType.DIRECTORY || entry.type === FileType.ARCHIVE) {
      return false;
    }
    return this.isArchiveDisplayableExt(this.extractExt(entry.path || entry.name));
  }

  private isPreviewableImageExt(ext: string): boolean {
    return this.nativeImageExts.has(ext) || this.convertibleImageExts.has(ext);
  }

  private isArchiveDisplayableExt(ext: string): boolean {
    return ext === 'svg' || !!this.inferImageMime(ext);
  }

  private makeDiskCarouselItem(info: FileInfo): CarouselImageItem {
    const path = info.path;
    return {
      id: `disk:${path}`,
      name: info.name || this.baseName(path),
      ext: this.extractExt(path),
      source: 'disk',
      diskPath: path,
      archiveContext: null,
      info,
      thumbnailSrc: null,
      thumbnailFailed: false,
      thumbnailLoading: false,
    };
  }

  private makeDiskCarouselItemFromPath(path: string, name?: string): CarouselImageItem {
    return {
      id: `disk:${path}`,
      name: name || this.baseName(path),
      ext: this.extractExt(path),
      source: 'disk',
      diskPath: path,
      archiveContext: null,
      info: null,
      thumbnailSrc: null,
      thumbnailFailed: false,
      thumbnailLoading: false,
    };
  }

  private makeArchiveCarouselItem(ctx: ViewerArchiveContext, info: ArchiveEntry | null): CarouselImageItem {
    const name = info?.name || this.baseName(ctx.entryPath);
    return {
      id: `archive:${ctx.fsPath}:${ctx.nestedChain.join('|')}:${ctx.entryPath}`,
      name,
      ext: this.extractExt(ctx.entryPath),
      source: 'archive',
      diskPath: null,
      archiveContext: { fsPath: ctx.fsPath, nestedChain: [...ctx.nestedChain], entryPath: ctx.entryPath },
      info: info ? this.makeSyntheticInfo(name, ctx.entryPath, info.size) : this.makeSyntheticInfo(name, ctx.entryPath, 0),
      thumbnailSrc: null,
      thumbnailFailed: false,
      thumbnailLoading: false,
    };
  }

  private parentArchivePath(path: string): string {
    const normalized = (path ?? '').replace(/\\/g, '/');
    const index = normalized.lastIndexOf('/');
    return index >= 0 ? normalized.slice(0, index) : '';
  }

  private resetState(): void {
    this.explicitSelectionLockIndex = null;
    this.clearExplicitSelectionLockTimer();
    this.error = null;
    this.info = null;
    this.imageSrc = null;
    this.imageMeta = null;
    this.imageLoaded = false;
    this.imageSwitchPending = false;
    this.kind = 'empty';
    this.carouselItems = [];
    this.currentCarouselIndex = 0;
    this.previewCenterIndex = 0;
    this.activeTargetPath = '';
    this.activeArchiveContext = null;
  }

  focusViewerSurface(): void {
    if (document.activeElement === this.viewerSurfaceElement) {
      return;
    }
    this.viewerSurfaceElement?.focus({ preventScroll: true });
  }

  private inferImageMime(ext: string): string | null {
    const map: Record<string, string> = {
      png: 'image/png',
      jpg: 'image/jpeg',
      jpeg: 'image/jpeg',
      gif: 'image/gif',
      webp: 'image/webp',
      bmp: 'image/bmp',
      ico: 'image/x-icon',
      avif: 'image/avif',
    };
    return map[ext] ?? null;
  }

  private extractExt(path: string): string {
    const normalized = (path ?? '').replace(/\\/g, '/');
    const last = normalized.split('/').pop() ?? normalized;
    const index = last.lastIndexOf('.');
    return index >= 0 ? last.slice(index + 1).toLowerCase() : '';
  }

  private baseName(path: string): string {
    const normalized = (path ?? '').replace(/\\/g, '/');
    return normalized.split('/').pop() ?? normalized;
  }

  private makeSyntheticInfo(name: string, path: string, size: number): FileInfo {
    return {
      name,
      path,
      type: FileType.FILE,
      size,
      modified: 0,
      created: 0,
      accessed: 0,
      permissions: '-rw-r--r--',
      isHidden: false,
    };
  }
}
`````

`````typescript
export class OfficeViewerComponent implements OnChanges, OnDestroy {
  @Input() targetPath = '';
  @Input() fileList: ViewerFileListItem[] = [];
  @Input() archiveContext: ViewerArchiveContext | null = null;
  @Input() viewerId: string | null = null;
  @Input() probe: FileProbe | null = null;

  kind: OfficeViewerKind = 'empty';
  displayName = '';
  fileExt = '';
  fileTypeLabel = '';
  pdfPath = '';
  error = '';
  conversionElapsedMs = 0;

  private abortController: AbortController | null = null;
  private conversionStartedAt = 0;
  private conversionElapsedTimer: number | null = null;

  constructor(
    private api: ApiService,
    private cdr: ChangeDetectorRef,
  ) {}

  ngOnChanges(changes: SimpleChanges): void {
    if (changes['targetPath'] && !changes['targetPath'].firstChange) {
      this.loadDocument();
    } else if (changes['targetPath'] && changes['targetPath'].firstChange && this.targetPath) {
      this.loadDocument();
    }
  }

  ngOnDestroy(): void {
    this.stopConversionTimer();
    if (this.abortController) {
      this.abortController.abort();
    }
  }

  get conversionElapsedLabel(): string {
    if (this.conversionElapsedMs < 1000) return `${this.conversionElapsedMs} ms`;
    return `${(this.conversionElapsedMs / 1000).toFixed(1)} s`;
  }

  private loadDocument(): void {
    this.stopConversionTimer();
    this.pdfPath = '';
    if (!this.targetPath) {
      this.kind = 'empty';
      this.conversionElapsedMs = 0;
      this.cdr.markForCheck();
      return;
    }

    this.displayName = this.targetPath.split('/').pop() || 'Document';
    this.fileExt = this.displayName.split('.').pop()?.toLowerCase() || '';
    this.fileTypeLabel = this.getFileTypeLabel(this.fileExt);

    if (this.fileExt === 'pdf') {
      this.kind = 'pdf';
      this.error = '';
      this.conversionElapsedMs = 0;
      this.pdfPath = this.targetPath;
      this.cdr.markForCheck();
      return;
    }

    this.kind = 'loading';
    this.error = '';
    this.conversionElapsedMs = 0;
    this.startConversionTimer();
    this.cdr.markForCheck();

    // Check file extension first for quick validation
    const supportedExts = ['pdf', 'doc', 'docx', 'docm', 'xls', 'xlsx', 'xlsm', 'ppt', 'pptx', 'pptm', 'odt', 'ods', 'odp', 'rtf', 'epub', 'djvu', 'djv'];
    if (!supportedExts.includes(this.fileExt)) {
      this.stopConversionTimer();
      this.kind = 'unsupported';
      this.cdr.markForCheck();
      return;
    }

    this.convertDocument();
  }

  private convertDocument(): void {
    this.abortController = new AbortController();

    this.api.ConvertOfficeDocument(this.targetPath)
      .then((result: any) => {
        this.stopConversionTimer();
        if (result.success) {
          this.pdfPath = result.pdfPath;
          this.kind = 'pdf';
        } else {
          if (result.availability === false) {
            this.kind = 'unavailable';
            this.error = result.instructions || 'Required converter is not available';
          } else {
            this.kind = 'error';
            this.error = result.error || 'Unknown conversion error';
          }
        }
        this.cdr.markForCheck();
      })
      .catch((err: any) => {
        this.stopConversionTimer();
        this.kind = 'error';
        this.error = err?.error?.message || err?.message || 'Failed to convert document';
        this.cdr.markForCheck();
      });
  }

  private startConversionTimer(): void {
    this.stopConversionTimer();
    this.conversionStartedAt = Date.now();
    this.conversionElapsedMs = 0;
    this.conversionElapsedTimer = window.setInterval(() => {
      this.conversionElapsedMs = Date.now() - this.conversionStartedAt;
      this.cdr.markForCheck();
    }, 100);
  }

  private stopConversionTimer(): void {
    if (this.conversionStartedAt) {
      this.conversionElapsedMs = Date.now() - this.conversionStartedAt;
    }
    this.conversionStartedAt = 0;
    if (this.conversionElapsedTimer !== null) {
      window.clearInterval(this.conversionElapsedTimer);
      this.conversionElapsedTimer = null;
    }
  }

  private getFileTypeLabel(ext: string): string {
    const typeMap: Record<string, string> = {
      doc: 'Word', docx: 'Word', docm: 'Word',
      xls: 'Excel', xlsx: 'Excel', xlsm: 'Excel',
      ppt: 'PowerPoint', pptx: 'PowerPoint', pptm: 'PowerPoint',
      odt: 'OpenDoc Text', ods: 'OpenDoc Spreadsheet', odp: 'OpenDoc Presentation',
      rtf: 'Rich Text',
      epub: 'EPUB',
      djvu: 'DjVu', djv: 'DjVu',
    };
    return typeMap[ext] || 'Document';
  }
}
`````

`````typescript
function extLower(path: string): string {
  const p = (path ?? '').replace(/\\/g, '/');
  const i = p.lastIndexOf('.');
  if (i < 0) return '';
  return p.slice(i + 1).toLowerCase();
}

  resolving = false;
  @Input() fileList: ViewerFileListItem[] = [];
  @Input() archiveContext: ViewerArchiveContext | null = null;
  /** Optional explicit viewer id (from tab metadata) */
  @Input() viewerId: string | null = null;
  @Input() viewerState: ViewerHostChromeState | null = null;

  get autoFollow(): boolean {
    return !!this.viewerState?.autoFollow;
  }

  get sourceAvailable(): boolean {
    return !!(this.viewerState?.sourceTabId || this.viewerState?.sourceDir);
  }

  get isPinned(): boolean {
    return !!this.viewerState?.isPinned;
  }

  get isClosable(): boolean {
    return this.viewerState?.isClosable !== false;
  }

  @Output() returnSource = new EventEmitter<void>();
  @Output() external = new EventEmitter<void>();
  @Output() close = new EventEmitter<void>();

  component: Type<unknown> | null = null;
  outletInputs: Record<string, unknown> = {};
  probe: FileProbe | null = null;
  fileInfo: FileInfo | null = null;
  error: string | null = null;

  @ViewChild(NgComponentOutlet) private outlet?: NgComponentOutlet;
  @ViewChild('viewerStage') private viewerStage?: import('@angular/core').ElementRef<HTMLElement>;

  private resolveSeq = 0;
  resolvedViewerKey: string | null = null;
  private renderedInputSignature = '';

  constructor(
    private registry: ViewerRegistryService,
    private api: ApiService,
    private cdr: ChangeDetectorRef,
  ) {}

  ngOnChanges(): void {
    void this.refresh();
  }

  private async refresh(): Promise<void> {
    const req = {
      targetPath: this.targetPath ?? '',
      fileList: this.fileList ?? [],
      archiveContext: this.archiveContext ?? null,
      viewerId: this.viewerId ?? null,
      probe: null as FileProbe | null,
    };
    const seq = ++this.resolveSeq;
    this.resolving = !!req.targetPath;
    this.error = null;
    this.probe = null;
    this.fileInfo = null;
    this.cdr.markForCheck();

    if (!req.targetPath) {
      this.resolvedViewerKey = null;
      this.renderedInputSignature = '';
      this.component = null;
      this.outletInputs = {};
      this.resolving = false;
      this.cdr.markForCheck();
      return;
    }

    const ext = extLower(req.targetPath);
    if (ext || req.targetPath) {
      const probePromise = req.archiveContext
        ? this.api.probeArchiveFile(
            req.archiveContext.fsPath,
            req.archiveContext.nestedChain,
            req.archiveContext.entryPath,
          )
        : this.api.probeFile(req.targetPath);

      const infoPromise = req.archiveContext
        ? Promise.resolve(null)
        : this.api.getFileInfo(req.targetPath).catch(() => null);

      try {
        const [probe, info] = await Promise.all([
          probePromise.catch(() => null),
          infoPromise,
        ]);
        if (seq !== this.resolveSeq) return;
        req.probe = probe;
        this.probe = probe;
        this.fileInfo = info;
      } catch {
        if (seq !== this.resolveSeq) return;
        req.probe = null;
        this.probe = null;
        this.fileInfo = null;
      }
    }

    if (seq !== this.resolveSeq) return;

    const inputSignature = JSON.stringify(req);

    this.outletInputs = {
      targetPath: req.targetPath,
      fileList: req.fileList,
      archiveContext: req.archiveContext,
      viewerId: req.viewerId,
      probe: req.probe,
    };

    const viewerKey = this.registry.resolveId(req);
    const preserveMountedViewer = this.shouldPreserveMountedViewer(viewerKey);
    if (this.component && this.resolvedViewerKey === viewerKey) {
      if (this.renderedInputSignature !== inputSignature) {
        this.renderedInputSignature = inputSignature;
        if (!preserveMountedViewer) {
          this.component = null;
          this.cdr.detectChanges();
        }
        this.cdr.markForCheck();
        if (preserveMountedViewer) {
          this.resolving = false;
          this.cdr.markForCheck();
          return;
        }
      }

      if (preserveMountedViewer) {
        this.resolving = false;
        this.cdr.markForCheck();
        return;
      }
    }

    this.resolvedViewerKey = viewerKey;
    this.renderedInputSignature = inputSignature;
    this.cdr.markForCheck();

    // Async resolve so we can lazy-load contributions.
    void this.registry.resolve(req).then(({ component }) => {
      if (seq !== this.resolveSeq) return;
      this.component = component;
      this.resolving = false;
      this.cdr.markForCheck();
    }).catch((error: unknown) => {
      if (seq !== this.resolveSeq) return;
      this.error = error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error ?? 'Preview unavailable');
      this.resolvedViewerKey = null;
      this.renderedInputSignature = '';
      this.component = null;
      this.resolving = false;
      this.cdr.markForCheck();
    });
  }

  ngOnDestroy(): void {
    // Invalidates all pending probe/registry work when the pane or tab disappears.
    this.resolveSeq += 1;
    this.component = null;
    this.outletInputs = {};
  }

  get displayName(): string {
    const source = this.archiveContext?.entryPath || this.targetPath || '';
    const normalized = source.replace(/\\/g, '/').replace(/\/+$/, '');
    return normalized.split('/').pop() || source || 'Preview';
  }

  get displayPath(): string {
    return this.archiveContext?.entryPath || this.targetPath || '';
  }

  get displayKind(): string {
    const key = (this.resolvedViewerKey || this.viewerId || 'auto').trim();
    return key || 'auto';
  }

  get fileIcon(): string {
    switch ((this.resolvedViewerKey || this.viewerId || '').toLowerCase()) {
      case 'image': return '▧';
      case 'video': return '▶';
      case 'audio': return '♪';
      case 'pdf': return 'PDF';
      case 'archive': return '▦';
      case 'text':
      case 'markdown':
      case 'code': return '</>';
      case 'binary': return '01';
      default: return '◉';
    }
  }

  formatSize(bytes: number): string {
    if (!Number.isFinite(bytes) || bytes <= 0) return '';
    const units = ['B', 'KB', 'MB', 'GB', 'TB'];
    let value = bytes;
    let unit = 0;
    while (value >= 1024 && unit < units.length - 1) {
      value /= 1024;
      unit += 1;
    }
    const digits = unit === 0 || value >= 100 ? 0 : value >= 10 ? 1 : 2;
    return `${value.toFixed(digits)} ${units[unit]}`;
  }

  supports(method: string): boolean {
    const viewer = this.mountedViewer;
    return !!viewer && typeof viewer[method] === 'function';
  }

  invoke(method: string): void {
    const viewer = this.mountedViewer;
    if (!viewer || typeof viewer[method] !== 'function') return;
    viewer[method]();
  }

  toggleFullscreen(): void {
    const stage = this.viewerStage?.nativeElement;
    if (!stage) return;

    if (document.fullscreenElement === stage) {
      void document.exitFullscreen?.().catch(() => {});
      return;
    }
    void stage.requestFullscreen?.().catch(() => {});
  }

  get mountedViewer(): any {
    return (this.outlet as any)?.componentInstance ?? null;
  }

  private shouldPreserveMountedViewer(viewerKey: string): boolean {
    return viewerKey === 'image' || viewerKey === 'video' || viewerKey === 'audio';
  }
}
`````

`````typescript
import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';

describe('WebView2 application scrollbar contract', () => {
  const styles = readFileSync(new URL('../../styles.scss', import.meta.url), 'utf8');

  it('does not opt into Chromium native thin scrollbar rendering', () => {
    expect(styles).not.toContain('scrollbar-width: thin');
    expect(styles).not.toContain('scrollbar-color: var(--vsc-scrollbar-thumb)');
  });

  it('uses a full rectangular translucent WebKit thumb', () => {
    expect(styles).toContain('*::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {');
    expect(styles).toContain('border: 0;');
    expect(styles).toContain('border-radius: 0;');
    expect(styles).toContain('background-clip: border-box;');
    expect(styles).not.toContain('border-radius: 999px');
    expect(styles).not.toContain('border: 3px solid transparent');
  });

  it('uses a transparent themed track', () => {
    expect(styles).toContain('*::-webkit-scrollbar-track-piece');
    expect(styles).toContain('background: var(--vsc-scrollbar-track);');
  });

  it('explicitly removes WebView2 single-button arrow controls', () => {
    expect(styles).toContain('*::-webkit-scrollbar-button:single-button');
    expect(styles).toContain('*::-webkit-scrollbar-button:vertical:decrement');
    expect(styles).toContain('*::-webkit-scrollbar-button:vertical:increment');
    expect(styles).toContain('-webkit-appearance: none;');
    expect(styles).toContain('display: none;');
    expect(styles).toContain('width: 0;');
    expect(styles).toContain('height: 0;');
  });
});
`````

## File: manager/internal/app/bindings_archive_create.go
`````go
package app

import (
	"archive/zip"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"

	"wails-app/internal/contracts"
)

// CreateZipArchive creates a ZIP archive from public file-manager paths.
// Selected roots are stored by basename so absolute host paths never leak.
func (a *App) CreateZipArchive(paths []string, destination string) (*contracts.OperationResult, error) {
	if len(paths) == 0 {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("create zip: no source paths")
	}
	if strings.TrimSpace(destination) == "" {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("create zip: empty destination")
	}

	resolvedDestination, err := a.State.Filesystem.RealPath(destination)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("create zip: resolve destination: %w", err)
	}
	if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(resolvedDestination), 0755); err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("create zip: prepare destination: %w", err)
	}

	tempFile, err := os.CreateTemp(filepath.Dir(resolvedDestination), ".file-manager-archive-*.zip")
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("create zip: temp file: %w", err)
	}
	tempPath := tempFile.Name()
	defer func() {
		_ = tempFile.Close()
		_ = os.Remove(tempPath)
	}()

	writer := zip.NewWriter(tempFile)
	seen := make(map[string]struct{})
	destinationAbs, _ := filepath.Abs(resolvedDestination)

	for _, publicSource := range paths {
		resolvedSource, err := a.State.Filesystem.RealPath(publicSource)
		if err != nil {
			_ = writer.Close()
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("create zip: resolve %q: %w", publicSource, err)
		}

		sourceAbs, err := filepath.Abs(resolvedSource)
		if err != nil {
			_ = writer.Close()
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("create zip: source path %q: %w", publicSource, err)
		}
		if sameFilesystemPath(sourceAbs, destinationAbs) {
			_ = writer.Close()
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("create zip: destination cannot also be a source")
		}

		rootName := filepath.Base(filepath.Clean(sourceAbs))
		if rootName == "." || rootName == string(filepath.Separator) || rootName == "" {
			rootName = "root"
		}

		if err := addZipTree(writer, sourceAbs, rootName, destinationAbs, seen); err != nil {
			_ = writer.Close()
			return nil, err
		}
	}

	if err := writer.Close(); err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("create zip: finalize: %w", err)
	}
	if err := tempFile.Close(); err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("create zip: close temp file: %w", err)
	}

	_ = os.Remove(resolvedDestination)
	if err := os.Rename(tempPath, resolvedDestination); err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("create zip: commit: %w", err)
	}

	return &contracts.OperationResult{
		Success:       true,
		Message:       "archive created",
		AffectedPaths: []string{destination},
	}, nil
}

func addZipTree(writer *zip.Writer, sourcePath, archiveRoot, destinationAbs string, seen map[string]struct{}) error {
	info, err := os.Lstat(sourcePath)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("create zip: stat %q: %w", sourcePath, err)
	}
	if !info.IsDir() {
		return addZipFile(writer, sourcePath, archiveRoot, info, seen)
	}

	return filepath.Walk(sourcePath, func(path string, walkInfo os.FileInfo, walkErr error) error {
		if walkErr != nil {
			return walkErr
		}

		absolute, err := filepath.Abs(path)
		if err == nil && sameFilesystemPath(absolute, destinationAbs) {
			if walkInfo.IsDir() {
				return filepath.SkipDir
			}
			return nil
		}

		rel, err := filepath.Rel(sourcePath, path)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		name := archiveRoot
		if rel != "." {
			name = filepath.Join(archiveRoot, rel)
		}
		name = filepath.ToSlash(name)

		if walkInfo.IsDir() {
			if !strings.HasSuffix(name, "/") {
				name += "/"
			}
			return addZipDirectory(writer, name, walkInfo, seen)
		}
		return addZipFile(writer, path, name, walkInfo, seen)
	})
}

func addZipDirectory(writer *zip.Writer, name string, info os.FileInfo, seen map[string]struct{}) error {
	if _, exists := seen[name]; exists {
		return nil
	}
	seen[name] = struct{}{}

	header, err := zip.FileInfoHeader(info)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	header.Name = name
	header.Method = zip.Store
	_, err = writer.CreateHeader(header)
	return err
}

func addZipFile(writer *zip.Writer, sourcePath, name string, info os.FileInfo, seen map[string]struct{}) error {
	name = filepath.ToSlash(strings.TrimPrefix(name, "/"))
	if name == "" {
		return nil
	}
	if _, exists := seen[name]; exists {
		return fmt.Errorf("create zip: duplicate archive path %q", name)
	}
	seen[name] = struct{}{}

	if info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
		target, err := os.Readlink(sourcePath)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		header, err := zip.FileInfoHeader(info)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		header.Name = name
		header.Method = zip.Store
		entry, err := writer.CreateHeader(header)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		_, err = io.WriteString(entry, target)
		return err
	}

	file, err := os.Open(sourcePath)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer file.Close()

	header, err := zip.FileInfoHeader(info)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	header.Name = name
	header.Method = zip.Deflate
	entry, err := writer.CreateHeader(header)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	_, err = io.Copy(entry, file)
	return err
}

func sameFilesystemPath(left, right string) bool {
	left = filepath.Clean(left)
	right = filepath.Clean(right)
	return left == right || strings.EqualFold(left, right)
}

// ArchiveImportEntries transactionally adds filesystem paths to a top-level ZIP.
// Existing entries with the same archive paths are replaced; unrelated entries
// are copied through without recompression.
func (a *App) ArchiveImportEntries(req contracts.ArchiveImportRequest) (*contracts.ArchiveEntriesResult, error) {
	if len(req.Sources) == 0 {
		return &contracts.ArchiveEntriesResult{}, nil
	}
	if len(req.NestedChain) != 0 {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("archive import: nested archives are read-only")
	}

	resolvedArchive, err := a.State.Filesystem.RealPath(req.FsPath)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("archive import: resolve archive: %w", err)
	}
	if !strings.EqualFold(filepath.Ext(resolvedArchive), ".zip") {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("archive import: only ZIP archives are writable")
	}

	archiveAbs, err := filepath.Abs(resolvedArchive)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("archive import: archive path: %w", err)
	}

	type importRoot struct {
		source string
		root   string
	}
	roots := make([]importRoot, 0, len(req.Sources))
	newNames := make(map[string]struct{})
	destinationPrefix := normalizeZipImportPath(req.DestinationPath)

	for _, publicSource := range req.Sources {
		resolvedSource, err := a.State.Filesystem.RealPath(publicSource)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("archive import: resolve %q: %w", publicSource, err)
		}
		sourceAbs, err := filepath.Abs(resolvedSource)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("archive import: source path %q: %w", publicSource, err)
		}
		if sameFilesystemPath(sourceAbs, archiveAbs) {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("archive import: archive cannot also be a source")
		}
		rootName := filepath.Base(filepath.Clean(sourceAbs))
		if rootName == "." || rootName == string(filepath.Separator) || rootName == "" {
			rootName = "root"
		}
		archiveRoot := joinZipImportPath(destinationPrefix, rootName)
		if err := collectZipTreeNames(sourceAbs, archiveRoot, newNames); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		roots = append(roots, importRoot{source: sourceAbs, root: archiveRoot})
	}

	reader, err := zip.OpenReader(resolvedArchive)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("archive import: open ZIP: %w", err)
	}
	defer reader.Close()

	tempFile, err := os.CreateTemp(filepath.Dir(resolvedArchive), ".archive-import-*.zip")
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("archive import: temp file: %w", err)
	}
	tmpPath := tempFile.Name()
	committed := false
	defer func() {
		_ = tempFile.Close()
		if !committed {
			_ = os.Remove(tmpPath)
		}
	}()

	writer := zip.NewWriter(tempFile)
	seen := make(map[string]struct{})
	for _, existing := range reader.File {
		name := normalizeZipImportPath(existing.Name)
		if name == "" {
			continue
		}
		lookup := name
		if existing.FileInfo().IsDir() && !strings.HasSuffix(lookup, "/") {
			lookup += "/"
		}
		if _, replaced := newNames[lookup]; replaced {
			continue
		}
		if _, duplicate := seen[lookup]; duplicate {
			continue
		}
		if err := writer.Copy(existing); err != nil {
			_ = writer.Close()
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("archive import: preserve %q: %w", existing.Name, err)
		}
		seen[lookup] = struct{}{}
	}

	for _, root := range roots {
		if err := addZipTree(writer, root.source, root.root, archiveAbs, seen); err != nil {
			_ = writer.Close()
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("archive import: add %q: %w", root.source, err)
		}
	}
	if err := writer.Close(); err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("archive import: finalize ZIP: %w", err)
	}
	if err := tempFile.Close(); err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("archive import: close temp ZIP: %w", err)
	}

	backupFile, err := os.CreateTemp(filepath.Dir(resolvedArchive), ".archive-import-backup-*.zip")
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("archive import: reserve backup: %w", err)
	}
	backup := backupFile.Name()
	_ = backupFile.Close()
	_ = os.Remove(backup)

	if err := os.Rename(resolvedArchive, backup); err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("archive import: stage original: %w", err)
	}
	if err := os.Rename(tmpPath, resolvedArchive); err != nil {
		_ = os.Rename(backup, resolvedArchive)
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("archive import: commit: %w", err)
	}
	committed = true
	_ = os.Remove(backup)

	return &contracts.ArchiveEntriesResult{
		Total:     len(req.Sources),
		Succeeded: len(req.Sources),
	}, nil
}

func normalizeZipImportPath(value string) string {
	value = strings.Trim(strings.ReplaceAll(value, "\\", "/"), "/")
	parts := make([]string, 0)
	for _, part := range strings.Split(value, "/") {
		if part == "" || part == "." {
			continue
		}
		if part == ".." {
			if len(parts) > 0 {
				parts = parts[:len(parts)-1]
			}
			continue
		}
		parts = append(parts, part)
	}
	return strings.Join(parts, "/")
}

func joinZipImportPath(base, leaf string) string {
	base = normalizeZipImportPath(base)
	leaf = normalizeZipImportPath(leaf)
	if base == "" {
		return leaf
	}
	if leaf == "" {
		return base
	}
	return base + "/" + leaf
}

func collectZipTreeNames(sourcePath, archiveRoot string, names map[string]struct{}) error {
	info, err := os.Lstat(sourcePath)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("archive import: stat %q: %w", sourcePath, err)
	}
	if !info.IsDir() {
		names[normalizeZipImportPath(archiveRoot)] = struct{}{}
		return nil
	}

	return filepath.Walk(sourcePath, func(path string, walkInfo os.FileInfo, walkErr error) error {
		if walkErr != nil {
			return walkErr
		}
		rel, err := filepath.Rel(sourcePath, path)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		name := archiveRoot
		if rel != "." {
			name = filepath.ToSlash(filepath.Join(archiveRoot, rel))
		}
		name = normalizeZipImportPath(name)
		if walkInfo.IsDir() {
			name += "/"
		}
		names[name] = struct{}{}
		return nil
	})
`````

`````go
package app

import (
	"fmt"
	"net/url"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"runtime"
	"strings"

	contracts "wails-app/internal/contracts"
	"wails-app/internal/platform"
)

func (a *App) ListTrashEntries() ([]contracts.TrashEntry, error) {
	return platform.ListTrashEntries()
}

func (a *App) RestoreTrashEntry(id string) (string, error) {
	return platform.RestoreTrashEntry(id)
}

func (a *App) BatchTransferTrash(req contracts.TrashTransferRequest) (*contracts.TrashTransferResult, error) {
	if len(req.IDs) == 0 {
		return &contracts.TrashTransferResult{}, nil
	}
	if req.DestinationDir == "" {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("trash transfer: destinationDir is required")
	}

	var opType contracts.OperationType
	var title string
	switch req.Operation {
	case contracts.TrashTransferCopy:
		opType = contracts.OpCopy
		title = "Copy from Recycle Bin"
	case contracts.TrashTransferRestore:
		opType = contracts.OpMove
		title = "Restore from Recycle Bin"
	default:
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("trash transfer: unsupported operation %q", req.Operation)
	}

	op := a.StartOperation(opType, title, "bin://", req.DestinationDir)
	op.SetTotal(int64(len(req.IDs)), 0)

	resolved, err := a.State.Filesystem.RealPath(req.DestinationDir)
	if err != nil {
		err = fmt.Errorf("trash transfer: resolve destination: %w", err)
		op.SetError(err)
		return nil, err
	}

	trashEntries, listErr := platform.ListTrashEntries()
	if listErr != nil {
		op.SetError(listErr)
		return nil, listErr
	}
	entryByID := make(map[string]contracts.TrashEntry, len(trashEntries))
	for _, entry := range trashEntries {
		entryByID[entry.ID] = entry
	}

	result := &contracts.TrashTransferResult{
		OperationID: op.ID,
		Total:       len(req.IDs),
	}
	var blanket *contracts.ConflictResolution

	for index, id := range req.IDs {
		if op.IsCancelled() || (blanket != nil && *blanket == contracts.ConflictCancel) {
			break
		}

		entry, found := entryByID[id]
		if !found {
			result.Failed++
			result.Errors = append(result.Errors, contracts.TrashTransferItemError{
				ID: id, Error: "Recycle Bin item not found.",
			})
			op.UpdateProgress(int64(index+1), 0, id, 0)
			continue
		}

		requestedDestination := filepath.Join(resolved, entry.Name)
		sourceLabel := "bin://entry/" + url.PathEscape(id)
		finalDestination, skip, conflictErr := a.State.Batch.CheckConflict(
			op,
			sourceLabel,
			requestedDestination,
			&blanket,
		)
		if conflictErr != nil {
			// Cancel is a user decision, not a failed filesystem transfer.
			if strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(conflictErr.Error()), "cancel") {
				break
			}
			result.Failed++
			result.Errors = append(result.Errors, contracts.TrashTransferItemError{
				ID: id, Error: conflictErr.Error(),
			})
			op.UpdateProgress(int64(index+1), 0, id, 0)
			continue
		}
		if skip {
			op.UpdateProgress(int64(index+1), 0, id, 0)
			continue
		}

		// Overwrite resolves to the requested path. Remove the old destination
		// only after the user explicitly chose Replace.
		if sameNativePath(finalDestination, requestedDestination) {
			if _, statErr := os.Lstat(finalDestination); statErr == nil {
				if removeErr := os.RemoveAll(finalDestination); removeErr != nil {
					result.Failed++
					result.Errors = append(result.Errors, contracts.TrashTransferItemError{
						ID: id, Error: fmt.Sprintf("replace destination: %v", removeErr),
					})
					op.UpdateProgress(int64(index+1), 0, id, 0)
					continue
				}
			}
		}

		var destination string
		if req.Operation == contracts.TrashTransferCopy {
			destination, err = platform.CopyTrashEntryToPath(id, finalDestination)
		} else {
			destination, err = platform.RestoreTrashEntryToPath(id, finalDestination)
		}

		if err != nil {
			result.Failed++
			result.Errors = append(result.Errors, contracts.TrashTransferItemError{
				ID:    id,
				Error: err.Error(),
			})
		} else {
			result.Succeeded++
			result.Destinations = append(result.Destinations, destination)
		}

		op.UpdateProgress(int64(index+1), 0, id, 0)
	}

	if !op.IsCancelled() {
		op.Complete()
	}
	return result, nil
}

func sameNativePath(a, b string) bool {
	cleanA := filepath.Clean(a)
	cleanB := filepath.Clean(b)
	if runtime.GOOS == "windows" {
		return strings.EqualFold(cleanA, cleanB)
	}
	return cleanA == cleanB
}

func (a *App) CopyTrashEntryTo(id, destinationDir string) (string, error) {
	resolved, err := a.State.Filesystem.RealPath(destinationDir)
	if err != nil {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("trash copy: resolve destination: %w", err)
	}
	return platform.CopyTrashEntryTo(id, resolved)
}

func (a *App) RestoreTrashEntryTo(id, destinationDir string) (string, error) {
	resolved, err := a.State.Filesystem.RealPath(destinationDir)
	if err != nil {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("trash restore: resolve destination: %w", err)
	}
	return platform.RestoreTrashEntryTo(id, resolved)
}

func (a *App) DeleteTrashEntry(id string) error {
	return platform.DeleteTrashEntry(id)
}

func (a *App) EmptyTrash() error {
	return platform.EmptyTrash()
}

func (a *App) GetPathAttributes(path string) (contracts.PathAttributes, error) {
	resolved, err := a.State.Filesystem.RealPath(path)
	if err != nil {
		return contracts.PathAttributes{}, fmt.Errorf("attributes: resolve path: %w", err)
	}
	return platform.GetPathAttributes(resolved)
}

func (a *App) SetPathAttributes(path string, update contracts.PathAttributesUpdate) error {
	resolved, err := a.State.Filesystem.RealPath(path)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("attributes: resolve path: %w", err)
	}
	return platform.SetPathAttributes(resolved, update)
}
`````

`````go
package app

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"strconv"

	internalarchive "wails-app/internal/archive"
	contracts "wails-app/internal/contracts"
	internalelevation "wails-app/internal/elevation"

	vfsarchive "wails-app/vfs/archive"
)

type filesystemElevation interface {
	Client() internalelevation.Client
}

type FilesystemService = internalfilesystem.Service

var rawFilesystemOps = internalfilesystem.NewRawService(internalfilesystem.RawCallbacks{
	Metadata: rawFilesystemMetadataCallbacks(),
	MoveToTrash: func(path string) error {
		return internalplatform.MoveToTrash(path)
	},
})

func getElevatedVFS() (*vfslib.Unified, error) {
	return internalruntime.InitVFS()
}

var elevatedFilesystemHandler = internalfilesystem.NewElevatedHandler(internalfilesystem.RawOperations{
	ListDirectory: func(path string, showHidden bool) (*contracts.DirectoryListing, error) {
		if pathref.IsRegistry(path) {
			vfs, err := getElevatedVFS()
			if err != nil {
				return nil, err
			}
			return internalruntime.VFSListDir(context.Background(), vfs, path)
		}
		return rawFilesystemOps.ListDirectory(pathref.ToNativePath(pathref.Normalize(path)), showHidden)
	},
	ReadFile: func(path string, encoding string) (*contracts.FileContent, error) {
		if pathref.IsRegistry(path) {
			vfs, err := getElevatedVFS()
			if err != nil {
				return nil, err
			}
			return internalruntime.VFSReadFile(context.Background(), vfs, path, encoding)
		}
		return rawFilesystemOps.ReadFile(pathref.ToNativePath(pathref.Normalize(path)), encoding)
	},
	WriteFile: func(path string, content string, encoding string) (*contracts.OperationResult, error) {
		if pathref.IsRegistry(path) {
			vfs, err := getElevatedVFS()
			if err != nil {
				return nil, err
			}
			return internalruntime.VFSWriteFile(context.Background(), vfs, path, content, encoding)
		}
		return rawFilesystemOps.WriteFile(pathref.ToNativePath(pathref.Normalize(path)), content, encoding)
	},
	WriteRegistryValue: func(path string, valueType string, data string) (*contracts.OperationResult, error) {
		if !pathref.IsRegistry(path) {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("registry-write requires registry:// path")
		}
		vfs, err := getElevatedVFS()
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		return internalruntime.VFSWriteRegistryValue(
			context.Background(),
			vfs,
			path,
			valueType,
			data,
		)
	},
	DeleteFile: func(path string, recursive bool, useTrash *bool) (*contracts.OperationResult, error) {
		if pathref.IsRegistry(path) {
			vfs, err := getElevatedVFS()
			if err != nil {
				return nil, err
			}
			return internalruntime.VFSRemove(context.Background(), vfs, path)
		}
		return rawFilesystemOps.DeleteFile(pathref.ToNativePath(pathref.Normalize(path)), recursive, useTrash)
	},
	CreateDirectory: func(path string, recursive bool) (*contracts.OperationResult, error) {
		if pathref.IsRegistry(path) {
			vfs, err := getElevatedVFS()
			if err != nil {
				return nil, err
			}
			return internalruntime.VFSMkdir(context.Background(), vfs, path)
		}
		return rawFilesystemOps.CreateDirectory(pathref.ToNativePath(pathref.Normalize(path)), recursive)
	},
	MoveFile: func(source, destination string) (*contracts.OperationResult, error) {
		return rawFilesystemOps.MoveFile(
			pathref.ToNativePath(pathref.Normalize(source)),
			pathref.ToNativePath(pathref.Normalize(destination)),
		)
	},
	CopyFile: func(source, destination string, recursive bool) (*contracts.OperationResult, error) {
		return rawFilesystemOps.CopyFile(
			pathref.ToNativePath(pathref.Normalize(source)),
			pathref.ToNativePath(pathref.Normalize(destination)),
			recursive,
		)
	},
})

var elevatedRawHandler internalelevation.Handler = func(
	req internalelevation.Request,
) internalelevation.Response {
	switch req.Op {
	case "network-adapter-enable":
		index, err := parseElevatedNetworkAdapterIndex(req.Path)
		if err != nil {
			return internalelevation.Response{Success: false, Error: err.Error()}
		}
		if err := internalplatform.SetNetworkAdapterEnabled(index, true); err != nil {
			return internalelevation.Response{Success: false, Error: err.Error()}
		}
		return internalelevation.Response{Success: true}

	case "network-adapter-disable":
		index, err := parseElevatedNetworkAdapterIndex(req.Path)
		if err != nil {
			return internalelevation.Response{Success: false, Error: err.Error()}
		}
		if err := internalplatform.SetNetworkAdapterEnabled(index, false); err != nil {
			return internalelevation.Response{Success: false, Error: err.Error()}
		}
		return internalelevation.Response{Success: true}

	case "network-adapter-renew-dhcp":
		index, err := parseElevatedNetworkAdapterIndex(req.Path)
		if err != nil {
			return internalelevation.Response{Success: false, Error: err.Error()}
		}
		if err := internalplatform.RenewNetworkAdapterDHCP(index); err != nil {
			return internalelevation.Response{Success: false, Error: err.Error()}
		}
		return internalelevation.Response{Success: true}

	default:
		return elevatedFilesystemHandler(req)
	}
}

func parseElevatedNetworkAdapterIndex(value string) (uint32, error) {
	raw, err := strconv.ParseUint(value, 10, 32)
	if err != nil || raw == 0 {
		return 0, fmt.Errorf("invalid network adapter index %q", value)
	}
	return uint32(raw), nil
}

func MaybeRunElevatedService(args []string) (bool, error) {
	return internalelevation.MaybeRunService(args, elevatedRawHandler)
}

func MaybeRunElevatedHelper(args []string) (bool, error) {
	return internalelevation.MaybeRunHelper(args, elevatedRawHandler)
}

func rawFilesystemMetadataCallbacks() internalfilesystem.MetadataCallbacks {
	return internalfilesystem.MetadataCallbacks{
		ToSlash:                      internalplatform.ToSlash,
		IsHiddenFile:                 internalplatform.CheckHidden,
		IsArchive:                    vfsarchive.IsArchiveExt,
		SymlinkPointsToDir:           internalplatform.SymlinkPointsToDir,
		IsUntrackedDirectoryJunction: internalplatform.IsUntrackedDirectoryJunction,
		GetCreatedTime:               internalplatform.GetCreatedTime,
		GetAccessedTime:              internalplatform.GetAccessedTime,
		FormatPermissions:            formatPermissions,
		GetOwner:                     internalplatform.GetFileOwner,
		FormatAttributes:             internalplatform.FormatFileAttributes,
	}
}

func formatPermissions(info os.FileInfo) string {
	// Keep the complete permission mask. On Windows Go maps the native
	// read-only state to the owner/group/other mode bits, so this preserves
	// all positions instead of collapsing the value to only `rw-` / `r--`.
	return info.Mode().Perm().String()
}

func newFilesystemService(
	elevation filesystemElevation,
	emitEvent func(string, interface{}),
	startElevatedSession func() (*internalelevation.SessionStatus, error),
) *FilesystemService {
	return internalfilesystem.NewService(internalfilesystem.ServiceConfig{
		Elevation:                      elevation,
		EmitEvent:                      emitEvent,
		StartElevatedSession:           startElevatedSession,
		Raw:                            rawFilesystemOps,
		Metadata:                       rawFilesystemMetadataCallbacks(),
		IsProcessElevated:              internalelevation.IsProcessElevated,
		ExecuteElevatedRequest:         executeElevatedRequest,
		RunElevatedRequest:             runElevatedRequest,
		IsPermissionDenied:             internalelevation.IsPermissionDenied,
		ShouldRetryDeleteWithElevation: internalelevation.ShouldRetryDeleteWithElevation,
	})
}

func executeElevatedRequest(req internalelevation.Request) internalelevation.Response {
	return elevatedRawHandler(req)
}

func runElevatedRequest(req internalelevation.Request) (internalelevation.Response, error) {
	return internalelevation.RunRequest(req, os.Executable, internalelevation.LaunchProcess)
}

func startElevatedClient(exePath string) (internalelevation.Client, error) {
	return internalelevation.StartClient(exePath, internalelevation.LaunchService)
}

func newBuildConfig(app *App) BuildConfig {
	return BuildConfig{
		SetContext:     func(ctx context.Context) { app.Ctx = ctx },
		InitVFS:        app.InitVFS,
		HandleFileDrop: app.HandleFileDrop,
		BuildFileInfo: func(name, fullPath string, info os.FileInfo, hidden bool) contracts.FileInfo {
			return internalfilesystem.BuildFileInfoWithHidden(rawFilesystemMetadataCallbacks(), name, fullPath, info, hidden)
		},
		IsHidden: func(name, path string) bool {
			return internalplatform.CheckHidden(name, path)
		},
		ClassifyError:                  contracts.ClassifyError,
		IsPermissionDenied:             internalelevation.IsPermissionDenied,
		ShouldRetryDeleteWithElevation: internalelevation.ShouldRetryDeleteWithElevation,
		CalculateSize:                  internalops.CalculateSize,
		Normalize:                      internalplatform.Normalize,
		ArchiveEntryPath:               internalarchive.ArchiveEntryPath,
		IsArchive:                      vfsarchive.IsArchiveExt,
	}
}

func BuildApp() *App {
	core, err := NewCore()
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Printf("Warning: could not initialize workspace manager: %v\n", err)
	}

	app := NewApp(internalelevation.IsProcessElevated)
	elevation := internalelevation.NewService(app.EmitEvent, startElevatedClient)
	filesystem := newFilesystemService(elevation, app.EmitEvent, app.StartElevatedSession)
	app.bindState(BuildState(core, filesystem, elevation, newBuildConfig(app)))
	return app
}
`````
