`````go
package batch

import (
	"io"
	"os"
	pathpkg "path"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"

	contracts "wails-app/internal/contracts"
	internalops "wails-app/internal/ops"
)

type TransferCallbacks struct {
	CheckConflict                  func(srcLabel, dst string, blanket **contracts.ConflictResolution) (string, bool, error)
	BatchErr                       func(source, destination string, err error) contracts.BatchItemError
	IsPermissionDenied             func(error) bool
	ShouldRetryDeleteWithElevation func(error) bool
	RunElevatedCopy                func(src, dst string, recursive bool) (bool, error)
	RunElevatedMove                func(src, dst string) (bool, error)
	RunElevatedDelete              func(path string, recursive bool, useTrash *bool) (bool, error)
	MoveToTrash                    func(path string) error
	CalculateSize                  func(path string) (int64, int64)
	ResolvePath                    func(path string) (string, error)
	ToPublicPath                   func(path string) string
	GetFileInfo                    func(path string) (*contracts.FileInfo, error)
	CopyPath                       func(source, destination string, recursive bool, streamToFile func(io.Reader, string, int64, string) (int64, error)) error
}

type TransferRunner struct {
	callbacks TransferCallbacks
}

func NewTransferRunner(callbacks TransferCallbacks) *TransferRunner {
	return &TransferRunner{callbacks: callbacks}
}

func (r *TransferRunner) resolvePath(path string) (string, error) {
	if r.callbacks.ResolvePath == nil {
		return path, nil
	}
	return r.callbacks.ResolvePath(path)
}

func (r *TransferRunner) toPublicPath(path string) string {
	if r.callbacks.ToPublicPath == nil {
		return path
	}
	return r.callbacks.ToPublicPath(path)
}

func (r *TransferRunner) getFileInfo(path string) (*contracts.FileInfo, error) {
	if r.callbacks.GetFileInfo == nil {
		return nil, os.ErrNotExist
	}
	return r.callbacks.GetFileInfo(path)
}

func (r *TransferRunner) sourceMetrics(path string) (items, bytes int64) {
	resolvedPath, err := r.resolvePath(path)
	if err == nil {
		if info, statErr := os.Stat(resolvedPath); statErr == nil {
			if info.IsDir() {
				return r.callbacks.CalculateSize(resolvedPath)
			}
			return 1, info.Size()
		}
	}

	info, infoErr := r.getFileInfo(path)
	if infoErr != nil || info == nil {
		return 0, 0
	}
	if info.Type == contracts.FileTypeDirectory {
		return 1, 0
	}
	return 1, info.Size
}

type sourceDescriptor struct {
	name       string
	size       int64
	isDir      bool
	customCopy bool
}

func (r *TransferRunner) describeSource(publicPath, resolvedPath string) (sourceDescriptor, error) {
	info, err := os.Stat(resolvedPath)
	if err == nil {
		return sourceDescriptor{
			name:  filepath.Base(resolvedPath),
			size:  info.Size(),
			isDir: info.IsDir(),
		}, nil
	}

	fileInfo, infoErr := r.getFileInfo(publicPath)
	if infoErr != nil || fileInfo == nil {
		return sourceDescriptor{}, err
	}

	name := fileInfo.Name
	if name == "" {
		name = pathBase(publicPath)
	}

	return sourceDescriptor{
		name:       name,
		size:       fileInfo.Size,
		isDir:      fileInfo.Type == contracts.FileTypeDirectory,
		customCopy: true,
	}, nil
}

func pathBase(path string) string {
	normalized := strings.TrimRight(strings.ReplaceAll(path, "\\", "/"), "/")
	if normalized == "" {
		return ""
	}
	return pathpkg.Base(normalized)
}

func (r *TransferRunner) normalizeItemDestination(item contracts.BatchItem, sourceName string) (string, error) {
	destinationLabel := item.Destination
	resolvedDestination, err := r.resolvePath(destinationLabel)
	if err != nil {
		return "", err
	}

	if item.ExactDestination {
		return destinationLabel, nil
	}

	info, statErr := os.Stat(resolvedDestination)
	if statErr == nil && info.IsDir() {
		normalized := r.toPublicPath(filepath.Join(resolvedDestination, sourceName))
		return normalized, nil
	}

	if statErr != nil && !os.IsNotExist(statErr) {
		return "", statErr
	}

	return destinationLabel, nil
}

func (r *TransferRunner) Copy(op *internalops.ActiveOperation, req contracts.BatchRequest) (*contracts.BatchResult, error) {
	var totalItems, totalBytes int64
	for _, item := range req.Items {
		n, b := r.sourceMetrics(item.Source)
		totalItems += n
		totalBytes += b
	}
	op.SetTotal(totalItems, totalBytes)

	progress := NewProgressTracker(op)
	fileOps := NewFileOperator(op.IsCancelled, progress)
	result := &contracts.BatchResult{OperationID: op.ID, Total: len(req.Items)}
	var blanket *contracts.ConflictResolution

	for _, item := range req.Items {
		if op.IsCancelled() || (blanket != nil && *blanket == contracts.ConflictCancel) {
			break
		}

		resolvedSource, err := r.resolvePath(item.Source)
		if err != nil {
			result.Failed++
			result.Errors = append(result.Errors, r.callbacks.BatchErr(item.Source, item.Destination, err))
			continue
		}

		source, err := r.describeSource(item.Source, resolvedSource)
		if err != nil {
			result.Failed++
			result.Errors = append(result.Errors, r.callbacks.BatchErr(item.Source, "", err))
			continue
		}

		destinationLabel, err := r.normalizeItemDestination(item, source.name)
		if err != nil {
			result.Failed++
			result.Errors = append(result.Errors, r.callbacks.BatchErr(item.Source, item.Destination, err))
			continue
		}

		finalDst, skip, err := r.callbacks.CheckConflict(item.Source, destinationLabel, &blanket)
		if err != nil {
			result.Failed++
			result.Errors = append(result.Errors, r.callbacks.BatchErr(item.Source, destinationLabel, err))
			continue
		}
		if skip {
			result.Skipped++
			continue
		}
		publicDst := r.toPublicPath(finalDst)

		copyErr := error(nil)
		if source.customCopy && r.callbacks.CopyPath != nil {
			copyErr = r.callbacks.CopyPath(item.Source, publicDst, req.Recursive, fileOps.StreamToFile)
		} else {
			copyErr = fileOps.CopyPath(resolvedSource, finalDst, req.Recursive)
		}
		if copyErr != nil {
			if r.callbacks.IsPermissionDenied(copyErr) {
				success, elevErr := r.callbacks.RunElevatedCopy(resolvedSource, finalDst, req.Recursive)
				if elevErr == nil && success {
					result.Succeeded++
					result.AffectedPaths = append(result.AffectedPaths, contracts.BatchAffectedPath{
						Source: item.Source, Destination: publicDst,
					})
					continue
				}
			}
			result.Failed++
			result.Errors = append(result.Errors, r.callbacks.BatchErr(item.Source, publicDst, copyErr))
			continue
		}
		result.Succeeded++
		result.AffectedPaths = append(result.AffectedPaths, contracts.BatchAffectedPath{
			Source: item.Source, Destination: publicDst,
		})
	}

	progress.Flush()
	op.Complete()
	return result, nil
}

func (r *TransferRunner) Move(op *internalops.ActiveOperation, req contracts.BatchRequest) (*contracts.BatchResult, error) {
	allNoOp := true
	for _, item := range req.Items {
		resolvedSource, srcErr := r.resolvePath(item.Source)
		resolvedDestination, dstErr := r.resolvePath(item.Destination)
		if srcErr != nil || dstErr != nil || !SamePath(resolvedSource, resolvedDestination) {
			allNoOp = false
			break
		}
	}
	if allNoOp {
		op.Complete()
		return &contracts.BatchResult{OperationID: op.ID, Total: len(req.Items), Skipped: len(req.Items)}, nil
	}

	var totalItems, totalBytes int64
	for _, item := range req.Items {
		resolvedSource, err := r.resolvePath(item.Source)
		if err != nil {
			continue
		}
		n, b := r.callbacks.CalculateSize(resolvedSource)
		totalItems += n
		totalBytes += b
	}
	op.SetTotal(totalItems, totalBytes)

	progress := NewProgressTracker(op)
	fileOps := NewFileOperator(op.IsCancelled, progress)
	result := &contracts.BatchResult{OperationID: op.ID, Total: len(req.Items)}
	var blanket *contracts.ConflictResolution

	for _, item := range req.Items {
		if op.IsCancelled() || (blanket != nil && *blanket == contracts.ConflictCancel) {
			break
		}

		resolvedSource, err := r.resolvePath(item.Source)
		if err != nil {
			result.Failed++
			result.Errors = append(result.Errors, r.callbacks.BatchErr(item.Source, item.Destination, err))
			continue
		}
		destinationLabel, err := r.normalizeItemDestination(item, pathBase(item.Source))
		if err != nil {
			result.Failed++
			result.Errors = append(result.Errors, r.callbacks.BatchErr(item.Source, item.Destination, err))
			continue
		}
		resolvedDestination, err := r.resolvePath(destinationLabel)
		if err != nil {
			result.Failed++
			result.Errors = append(result.Errors, r.callbacks.BatchErr(item.Source, destinationLabel, err))
			continue
		}

		if SamePath(resolvedSource, resolvedDestination) {
			result.Skipped++
			continue
		}

		srcInfo, err := os.Stat(resolvedSource)
		if err != nil {
			result.Failed++
			result.Errors = append(result.Errors, r.callbacks.BatchErr(item.Source, "", err))
			continue
		}

		finalDst, skip, err := r.callbacks.CheckConflict(item.Source, destinationLabel, &blanket)
		if err != nil {
			result.Failed++
			result.Errors = append(result.Errors, r.callbacks.BatchErr(item.Source, destinationLabel, err))
			continue
		}
		if skip {
			result.Skipped++
			continue
		}
		publicDst := r.toPublicPath(finalDst)

		if err = os.Rename(resolvedSource, finalDst); err != nil {
			if r.callbacks.IsPermissionDenied(err) {
				success, elevErr := r.callbacks.RunElevatedMove(resolvedSource, finalDst)
				if elevErr == nil && success {
					result.Succeeded++
					result.AffectedPaths = append(result.AffectedPaths, contracts.BatchAffectedPath{
						Source: item.Source, Destination: publicDst,
					})
					continue
				}
			}
			if err2 := fileOps.CopyPath(resolvedSource, finalDst, true); err2 != nil {
				if r.callbacks.IsPermissionDenied(err2) {
					success, elevErr := r.callbacks.RunElevatedMove(resolvedSource, finalDst)
					if elevErr == nil && success {
						result.Succeeded++
						continue
					}
				}
				result.Failed++
				result.Errors = append(result.Errors, r.callbacks.BatchErr(item.Source, publicDst, err2))
				continue
			}
			if err2 := os.RemoveAll(resolvedSource); err2 != nil {
				if r.callbacks.IsPermissionDenied(err2) {
					useTrash := false
					success, elevErr := r.callbacks.RunElevatedDelete(resolvedSource, true, &useTrash)
					if elevErr == nil && success {
						result.Succeeded++
						continue
					}
				}
				result.Failed++
				result.Errors = append(result.Errors, r.callbacks.BatchErr(item.Source, "", err2))
				continue
			}
		} else {
			progress.Advance(1, srcInfo.Size(), filepath.Base(item.Source), srcInfo.Size(), false)
		}
		result.Succeeded++
		result.AffectedPaths = append(result.AffectedPaths, contracts.BatchAffectedPath{
			Source: item.Source, Destination: publicDst,
		})
	}

	progress.Flush()
	op.Complete()
	return result, nil
}

func (r *TransferRunner) Delete(op *internalops.ActiveOperation, req contracts.BatchDeleteRequest) (*contracts.BatchResult, error) {
	type deleteWork struct {
		items int64
		bytes int64
	}

	work := make(map[string]deleteWork, len(req.Paths))
	var totalItems, totalBytes int64
	for _, path := range req.Paths {
		resolvedPath, err := r.resolvePath(path)
		if err != nil {
			continue
		}
		n, b := r.callbacks.CalculateSize(resolvedPath)
		work[path] = deleteWork{items: n, bytes: b}
		totalItems += n
		totalBytes += b
	}
	op.SetTotal(totalItems, totalBytes)

	progress := NewProgressTracker(op)
	fileOps := NewFileOperator(op.IsCancelled, progress)
	result := &contracts.BatchResult{OperationID: op.ID, Total: len(req.Paths)}

	for _, path := range req.Paths {
		if op.IsCancelled() {
			break
		}

		resolvedPath, err := r.resolvePath(path)
		if err != nil {
			result.Failed++
			result.Errors = append(result.Errors, r.callbacks.BatchErr(path, "", err))
			continue
		}

		useTrash := req.UseTrash == nil || *req.UseTrash
		if useTrash {
			if err := r.callbacks.MoveToTrash(resolvedPath); err != nil {
				if r.callbacks.ShouldRetryDeleteWithElevation(err) {
					useTrashElev := true
					success, elevErr := r.callbacks.RunElevatedDelete(resolvedPath, false, &useTrashElev)
					if elevErr == nil && success {
						itemWork := work[path]
						progress.Advance(
							itemWork.items,
							itemWork.bytes,
							filepath.Base(path),
							itemWork.bytes,
							true,
						)
						result.Succeeded++
						continue
					}
					if elevErr != nil {
						err = elevErr
					}
				}
				result.Failed++
				result.Errors = append(result.Errors, r.callbacks.BatchErr(path, "", err))
				continue
			}
			itemWork := work[path]
			progress.Advance(
				itemWork.items,
				itemWork.bytes,
				filepath.Base(path),
				itemWork.bytes,
				true,
			)
			result.Succeeded++
			continue
		}

		info, err := os.Lstat(resolvedPath)
		if err != nil {
			result.Failed++
			result.Errors = append(result.Errors, r.callbacks.BatchErr(path, "", err))
			continue
		}

		if info.IsDir() && req.Recursive {
			if err := fileOps.DeleteDir(resolvedPath); err != nil {
				if r.callbacks.ShouldRetryDeleteWithElevation(err) {
					useTrashElev := false
					success, elevErr := r.callbacks.RunElevatedDelete(resolvedPath, true, &useTrashElev)
					if elevErr == nil && success {
						result.Succeeded++
						continue
					}
				}
				result.Failed++
				result.Errors = append(result.Errors, r.callbacks.BatchErr(path, "", err))
				continue
			}
		} else {
			size := info.Size()
			if err := os.Remove(resolvedPath); err != nil {
				if r.callbacks.ShouldRetryDeleteWithElevation(err) {
					useTrashElev := false
					success, elevErr := r.callbacks.RunElevatedDelete(resolvedPath, req.Recursive, &useTrashElev)
					if elevErr == nil && success {
						progress.Advance(1, size, filepath.Base(path), size, false)
						result.Succeeded++
						continue
					}
				}
				result.Failed++
				result.Errors = append(result.Errors, r.callbacks.BatchErr(path, "", err))
				continue
			}
			progress.Advance(1, size, filepath.Base(path), size, false)
		}
		result.Succeeded++
	}

	progress.Flush()
	op.Complete()
	return result, nil
}
`````

`````go
package batch

import (
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"testing"

	contracts "wails-app/internal/contracts"
	internalops "wails-app/internal/ops"
)

func trashBool(value bool) *bool { return &value }

func trashTestService(
	t *testing.T,
	start func(kind contracts.OperationType, title, source, dest string) *internalops.ActiveOperation,
) *Service {
	t.Helper()
	return NewService(ServiceConfig{
		StartOperation: start,
		BatchErr: func(source, destination string, err error) contracts.BatchItemError {
			return contracts.BatchItemError{
				Source: source,
				Destination: destination,
				Error: err.Error(),
				Code: "unknown",
			}
		},
		CalculateSize: func(path string) (int64, int64) {
			info, err := os.Stat(path)
			if err != nil {
				return 0, 0
			}
			return 1, info.Size()
		},
		ResolvePath: func(path string) (string, error) { return path, nil },
		ToPublicPath: func(path string) string { return path },
		MoveToTrash: func(path string) error { return os.Remove(path) },
		IsPermissionDenied: func(error) bool { return false },
		ShouldRetryDeleteWithElevation: func(error) bool { return false },
		RunElevatedCopy: func(src, dst string, recursive bool) (bool, error) {
			return false, nil
		},
		RunElevatedMove: func(src, dst string) (bool, error) {
			return false, nil
		},
		RunElevatedDelete: func(path string, recursive bool, useTrash *bool) (bool, error) {
			return false, nil
		},
	})
}

func TestBatchDeleteToTrashStartsMoveOperation(t *testing.T) {
	manager := internalops.NewManager()

	var gotKind contracts.OperationType
	var gotTitle, gotSource, gotDestination string
	start := func(
		kind contracts.OperationType,
		title, source, destination string,
	) *internalops.ActiveOperation {
		gotKind = kind
		gotTitle = title
		gotSource = source
		gotDestination = destination
		return manager.StartOperation(kind, title, source, destination)
	}

	source := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "move-me.txt")
	if err := os.WriteFile(source, []byte("trash progress"), 0o644); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}

	service := trashTestService(t, start)
	result, err := service.BatchDelete(contracts.BatchDeleteRequest{
		Paths: []string{source},
		Recursive: true,
		UseTrash: trashBool(true),
	})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if result.Succeeded != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("expected one trashed item, got %+v", result)
	}
	if gotKind != contracts.OpMove {
		t.Fatalf("expected MOVE operation, got %q", gotKind)
	}
	if gotTitle != "Move to Recycle Bin" {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected title %q", gotTitle)
	}
	if gotSource != source {
		t.Fatalf("expected source %q, got %q", source, gotSource)
	}
	if gotDestination != "bin://" {
		t.Fatalf("expected bin:// destination, got %q", gotDestination)
	}
}

func TestPermanentBatchDeleteRemainsDeleteOperation(t *testing.T) {
	manager := internalops.NewManager()

	var gotKind contracts.OperationType
	var gotTitle, gotDestination string
	start := func(
		kind contracts.OperationType,
		title, source, destination string,
	) *internalops.ActiveOperation {
		gotKind = kind
		gotTitle = title
		gotDestination = destination
		return manager.StartOperation(kind, title, source, destination)
	}

	source := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "delete-me.txt")
	if err := os.WriteFile(source, []byte("delete permanently"), 0o644); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}

	service := trashTestService(t, start)
	result, err := service.BatchDelete(contracts.BatchDeleteRequest{
		Paths: []string{source},
		Recursive: true,
		UseTrash: trashBool(false),
	})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if result.Succeeded != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("expected one deleted item, got %+v", result)
	}
	if gotKind != contracts.OpDelete {
		t.Fatalf("expected DELETE operation, got %q", gotKind)
	}
	if gotTitle != "Batch delete" {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected title %q", gotTitle)
	}
	if gotDestination != "" {
		t.Fatalf("permanent delete should not have a destination, got %q", gotDestination)
	}
}
`````

## File: manager/internal/filesystem/raw_service.go
`````go
package filesystem

import (
	"encoding/base64"
	"io"
	"io/fs"
	"mime"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"time"

	"wails-app/internal/contentprobe"
	contracts "wails-app/internal/contracts"
	"wails-app/internal/pathref"
)

type MetadataCallbacks struct {
	ToSlash                      func(string) string
	IsHiddenFile                 func(name, path string) bool
	IsArchive                    func(name string) bool
	SymlinkPointsToDir           func(path string) bool
	IsUntrackedDirectoryJunction func(path string) bool
	GetCreatedTime               func(os.FileInfo) int64
	GetAccessedTime              func(os.FileInfo) int64
	FormatPermissions            func(os.FileInfo) string
	GetOwner                     func(path string, info os.FileInfo) string
	FormatAttributes             func(path string, info os.FileInfo) string
}

type RawCallbacks struct {
	Metadata    MetadataCallbacks
	MoveToTrash func(path string) error
}

type RawService struct {
	callbacks RawCallbacks
}

func NewRawService(callbacks RawCallbacks) *RawService {
	return &RawService{callbacks: callbacks}
}

func (s *RawService) ListDirectory(path string, showHidden bool) (*contracts.DirectoryListing, error) {
	path = resolveRawPath(path)
	entries, err := os.ReadDir(path)
	if err != nil {
		if resolved, readLinkErr := os.Readlink(path); readLinkErr == nil {
			if resolvedEntries, retryErr := os.ReadDir(resolved); retryErr == nil {
				entries = resolvedEntries
				path = s.toSlash(resolved)
				err = nil
			}
		}
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
	}

	files := make([]contracts.FileInfo, 0, len(entries))
	var totalSize int64
	for _, entry := range entries {
		name := entry.Name()
		fullPath := s.toSlash(filepath.Join(path, name))
		hidden := s.isHiddenFile(name, fullPath)
		if !showHidden && hidden {
			continue
		}

		info, statErr := os.Lstat(fullPath)
		if statErr != nil {
			if fallback, ok := BuildFallbackLinkInfo(s.callbacks.Metadata, name, fullPath, entry, hidden); ok {
				files = append(files, fallback)
				totalSize += fallback.Size
			}
			continue
		}

		fi := BuildFileInfoWithHidden(s.callbacks.Metadata, name, fullPath, info, hidden)
		files = append(files, fi)
		totalSize += fi.Size
	}

	return &contracts.DirectoryListing{
		Path:      s.toSlash(path),
		Entries:   files,
		TotalSize: totalSize,
	}, nil
}

func (s *RawService) ReadFile(path string, encoding string) (*contracts.FileContent, error) {
	path = resolveRawPath(path)
	data, err := os.ReadFile(path)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	info, err := os.Stat(path)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	probe := contentprobe.ProbeBytes(data)
	if encoding == "" {
		encoding = "utf8"
		if probe.IsText && probe.Encoding != "" {
			encoding = probe.Encoding
		}
	}

	content, err := contentprobe.Decode(data, encoding)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	return &contracts.FileContent{
		Path:     path,
		Content:  content,
		Encoding: encoding,
		Size:     info.Size(),
	}, nil
}

func (s *RawService) ReadFileRange(path string, offset int64, length int) (*contracts.FileContent, error) {
	path = resolveRawPath(path)
	file, err := os.Open(path)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer file.Close()

	info, err := file.Stat()
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	fileSize := info.Size()

	if offset < 0 {
		offset = 0
	}
	if offset > fileSize {
		offset = fileSize
	}
	available := fileSize - offset
	if int64(length) > available {
		length = int(available)
	}
	if length <= 0 {
		return &contracts.FileContent{
			Path:     path,
			Content:  "",
			Encoding: "base64",
			Size:     fileSize,
		}, nil
	}

	buf := make([]byte, length)
	n, err := file.ReadAt(buf, offset)
	if err != nil && err != io.EOF {
		return nil, err
	}

	return &contracts.FileContent{
		Path:     path,
		Content:  base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString(buf[:n]),
		Encoding: "base64",
		Size:     fileSize,
	}, nil
}

func (s *RawService) ProbeFile(path string) (*contracts.FileProbe, error) {
	path = resolveRawPath(path)
	file, err := os.Open(path)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer file.Close()

	_, probe, err := contentprobe.ProbeReader(file)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	return &contracts.FileProbe{
		MimeType:  probe.MimeType,
		Encoding:  probe.Encoding,
		IsText:    probe.IsText,
		IsArchive: probe.IsArchive,
	}, nil
}

func (s *RawService) WriteFile(path string, content string, encoding string) (*contracts.OperationResult, error) {
	path = resolveRawPath(path)
	var data []byte
	var err error
	if encoding == "base64" {
		data, err = base64.StdEncoding.DecodeString(content)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
	} else {
		data = []byte(content)
	}

	if err := os.WriteFile(path, data, 0644); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	return &contracts.OperationResult{
		Success:       true,
		Message:       "File written successfully",
		AffectedPaths: []string{path},
	}, nil
}

func (s *RawService) DeleteFile(path string, recursive bool, useTrash *bool) (*contracts.OperationResult, error) {
	path = resolveRawPath(path)
	trash := useTrash == nil || *useTrash
	if trash {
		if err := s.moveToTrash(path); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		return &contracts.OperationResult{
			Success:       true,
			Message:       "Moved to trash successfully",
			AffectedPaths: []string{path},
		}, nil
	}

	info, err := os.Lstat(path)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	if info.IsDir() {
		if recursive {
			err = os.RemoveAll(path)
		} else {
			err = os.Remove(path)
		}
	} else {
		err = os.Remove(path)
	}
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	return &contracts.OperationResult{
		Success:       true,
		Message:       "Deleted successfully",
		AffectedPaths: []string{path},
	}, nil
}

func (s *RawService) CreateDirectory(path string, recursive bool) (*contracts.OperationResult, error) {
	path = resolveRawPath(path)
	var err error
	if recursive {
		err = os.MkdirAll(path, 0755)
	} else {
		err = os.Mkdir(path, 0755)
	}
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	return &contracts.OperationResult{
		Success:       true,
		Message:       "Directory created",
		AffectedPaths: []string{path},
	}, nil
}

func (s *RawService) MoveFile(source, destination string) (*contracts.OperationResult, error) {
	source = resolveRawPath(source)
	destination = resolveRawPath(destination)
	if err := os.Rename(source, destination); err != nil {
		if copyErr := s.CopyPath(source, destination); copyErr != nil {
			return nil, copyErr
		}
		if removeErr := os.RemoveAll(source); removeErr != nil {
			return nil, removeErr
		}
	}

	return &contracts.OperationResult{
		Success:       true,
		Message:       "Moved successfully",
		AffectedPaths: []string{source, destination},
	}, nil
}

func (s *RawService) CopyFile(source, destination string, recursive bool) (*contracts.OperationResult, error) {
	source = resolveRawPath(source)
	destination = resolveRawPath(destination)
	info, err := os.Stat(source)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	if info.IsDir() && !recursive {
		return &contracts.OperationResult{
			Success: false,
			Message: "Source is a directory; set recursive=true to copy directories",
		}, nil
	}

	if err := s.CopyPath(source, destination); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	return &contracts.OperationResult{
		Success:       true,
		Message:       "Copied successfully",
		AffectedPaths: []string{source, destination},
	}, nil
}

func (s *RawService) CopyPath(src, dst string) error {
	src = resolveRawPath(src)
	dst = resolveRawPath(dst)
	info, err := os.Stat(src)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if info.IsDir() {
		return s.copyDir(src, dst)
	}
	return s.copyFile(src, dst)
}

func (s *RawService) copyFile(src, dst string) error {
	in, err := os.Open(src)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer in.Close()

	if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(dst), 0755); err != nil {
		return err
	}

	out, err := os.Create(dst)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer out.Close()

	_, err = io.Copy(out, in)
	return err
}

func (s *RawService) copyDir(src, dst string) error {
	return filepath.WalkDir(src, func(path string, entry fs.DirEntry, err error) error {
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		rel, err := filepath.Rel(src, path)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		target := filepath.Join(dst, rel)
		if entry.IsDir() {
			return os.MkdirAll(target, 0755)
		}
		return s.copyFile(path, target)
	})
}

func BuildFileInfo(callbacks MetadataCallbacks, name, fullPath string, info os.FileInfo) contracts.FileInfo {
	return BuildFileInfoWithHidden(callbacks, name, fullPath, info, callHidden(callbacks, name, fullPath))
}

func BuildFileInfoWithHidden(callbacks MetadataCallbacks, name, fullPath string, info os.FileInfo, hidden bool) contracts.FileInfo {
	fileType := contracts.FileTypeFile
	isSymlink := false
	mode := info.Mode()
	if mode&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
		isSymlink = true
		if callbacks.SymlinkPointsToDir != nil && callbacks.SymlinkPointsToDir(fullPath) {
			fileType = contracts.FileTypeDirectory
		} else {
			fileType = contracts.FileTypeSymlink
		}
	} else if info.IsDir() {
		fileType = contracts.FileTypeDirectory
	} else if callbacks.IsArchive != nil && callbacks.IsArchive(name) {
		fileType = contracts.FileTypeArchive
	}

	if !info.IsDir() && mode&os.ModeSymlink == 0 && callbacks.IsUntrackedDirectoryJunction != nil && callbacks.IsUntrackedDirectoryJunction(fullPath) {
		fileType = contracts.FileTypeDirectory
		isSymlink = true
	}

	return contracts.FileInfo{
		Name:        name,
		Path:        fullPath,
		Type:        fileType,
		MimeType:    inferMimeTypeFromName(name),
		Size:        info.Size(),
		Created:     callCreated(callbacks, info),
		Modified:    info.ModTime().Unix(),
		Accessed:    callAccessed(callbacks, info),
		Permissions: callPermissions(callbacks, info),
		Owner:       callOwner(callbacks, fullPath, info),
		Attributes:  callAttributes(callbacks, fullPath, info),
		IsHidden:    hidden,
		IsSymlink:   isSymlink,
	}
}

func BuildFallbackLinkInfo(callbacks MetadataCallbacks, name, fullPath string, entry fs.DirEntry, hidden bool) (contracts.FileInfo, bool) {
	mode := entry.Type()
	isSymlink := mode&os.ModeSymlink != 0
	isJunction := callbacks.IsUntrackedDirectoryJunction != nil && callbacks.IsUntrackedDirectoryJunction(fullPath)
	if !isSymlink && !isJunction {
		return contracts.FileInfo{}, false
	}

	fileType := contracts.FileTypeSymlink
	if entry.IsDir() || isJunction || (isSymlink && callbacks.SymlinkPointsToDir != nil && callbacks.SymlinkPointsToDir(fullPath)) {
		fileType = contracts.FileTypeDirectory
	}

	now := time.Now().Unix()
	return contracts.FileInfo{
		Name:        name,
		Path:        fullPath,
		Type:        fileType,
		MimeType:    inferMimeTypeFromName(name),
		Size:        0,
		Created:     now,
		Modified:    now,
		Accessed:    now,
		Permissions: "",
		IsHidden:    hidden,
		IsSymlink:   true,
	}, true
}

func (s *RawService) toSlash(path string) string {
	if s.callbacks.Metadata.ToSlash != nil {
		return s.callbacks.Metadata.ToSlash(path)
	}
	return filepath.ToSlash(path)
}

func (s *RawService) isHiddenFile(name, path string) bool {
	return callHidden(s.callbacks.Metadata, name, path)
}

func (s *RawService) moveToTrash(path string) error {
	path = resolveRawPath(path)
	if s.callbacks.MoveToTrash == nil {
		return os.RemoveAll(path)
	}
	return s.callbacks.MoveToTrash(path)
}

func resolveRawPath(path string) string {
	return pathref.ToNativePath(pathref.Normalize(path))
}

func callHidden(callbacks MetadataCallbacks, name, path string) bool {
	if callbacks.IsHiddenFile == nil {
		return false
	}
	return callbacks.IsHiddenFile(name, path)
}

func callCreated(callbacks MetadataCallbacks, info os.FileInfo) int64 {
	if callbacks.GetCreatedTime == nil {
		return info.ModTime().Unix()
	}
	return callbacks.GetCreatedTime(info)
}

func callAccessed(callbacks MetadataCallbacks, info os.FileInfo) int64 {
	if callbacks.GetAccessedTime == nil {
		return info.ModTime().Unix()
	}
	return callbacks.GetAccessedTime(info)
}

func callPermissions(callbacks MetadataCallbacks, info os.FileInfo) string {
	if callbacks.FormatPermissions == nil {
		return info.Mode().Perm().String()
	}
	return callbacks.FormatPermissions(info)
}

func callOwner(callbacks MetadataCallbacks, path string, info os.FileInfo) string {
	if callbacks.GetOwner == nil {
		return ""
	}
	return callbacks.GetOwner(path, info)
}

func callAttributes(callbacks MetadataCallbacks, path string, info os.FileInfo) string {
	if callbacks.FormatAttributes == nil {
		return ""
	}
	return callbacks.FormatAttributes(path, info)
}

func inferMimeTypeFromName(name string) string {
	return mime.TypeByExtension(filepath.Ext(name))
}
`````

`````go
package platform

import (
	"os"
	"os/user"
	"strconv"
	"syscall"

func GetFileOwner(_ string, info os.FileInfo) string {
	stat, ok := info.Sys().(*syscall.Stat_t)
	if !ok {
		return ""
	}
	id := strconv.FormatUint(uint64(stat.Uid), 10)
	owner, err := user.LookupId(id)
	if err != nil {
		return id
	}
	if owner.Username != "" {
		return owner.Username
	}
	return id
}
`````

## File: manager/internal/platform/owner_windows.go
`````go
//go:build windows

package platform

import (
	"os"
	"syscall"
	"unsafe"
)

const (
	seFileObject             = 1
	ownerSecurityInformation = 0x00000001
)

var (
	advapi32Owner             = syscall.NewLazyDLL("advapi32.dll")
	procGetNamedSecurityInfoW = advapi32Owner.NewProc("GetNamedSecurityInfoW")
)

func GetFileOwner(path string, _ os.FileInfo) string {
	name, err := syscall.UTF16PtrFromString(path)
	if err != nil {
		return ""
	}
	var owner *syscall.SID
	var descriptor uintptr
	result, _, _ := procGetNamedSecurityInfoW.Call(
		uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(name)),
		uintptr(seFileObject),
		uintptr(ownerSecurityInformation),
		uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(&owner)),
		0, 0, 0,
		uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(&descriptor)),
	)
	if descriptor != 0 {
		defer syscall.LocalFree(syscall.Handle(descriptor))
	}
	if result != 0 || owner == nil {
		return ""
	}
	account, domain, _, err := owner.LookupAccount("")
	if err != nil {
		sid, sidErr := owner.String()
		if sidErr == nil {
			return sid
		}
		return ""
	}
	if domain != "" {
		return domain + "\\" + account
	}
	return account
}

func FormatFileAttributes(path string, _ os.FileInfo) string {
	ptr, err := syscall.UTF16PtrFromString(path)
	if err != nil {
		return ""
	}
	attrs, err := syscall.GetFileAttributes(ptr)
	if err != nil {
		return ""
	}
	flags := make([]byte, 0, 4)
	if attrs&syscall.FILE_ATTRIBUTE_READONLY != 0 {
		flags = append(flags, 'R')
	}
	if attrs&syscall.FILE_ATTRIBUTE_HIDDEN != 0 {
		flags = append(flags, 'H')
	}
	if attrs&syscall.FILE_ATTRIBUTE_SYSTEM != 0 {
		flags = append(flags, 'S')
	}
	if attrs&syscall.FILE_ATTRIBUTE_ARCHIVE != 0 {
		flags = append(flags, 'A')
	}
	return string(flags)
}
`````

`````go
//go:build !windows

package platform

import (
	"bufio"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"

	"path/filepath"
	"runtime"

	"strings"
	"syscall"
	"time"

	contracts "wails-app/internal/contracts"
)

type darwinTrashMetadata struct {
	OriginalPath string `json:"originalPath"`
	TrashedPath  string `json:"trashedPath"`
	DeletedAt    string `json:"deletedAt"`
}

func MoveToTrash(path string) error {
	abs, err := filepath.Abs(path)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("trash: cannot resolve path %q: %w", path, err)
	}
	if _, err := os.Lstat(abs); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("trash: %w", err)
	}
	if runtime.GOOS == "darwin" {
		return moveToTrashDarwin(abs)
	}
	return moveToTrashFreedesktop(abs)
}

func ListTrashEntries() ([]contracts.TrashEntry, error) {
	if runtime.GOOS == "darwin" {
		return listTrashDarwin()
	}
	return listTrashFreedesktop()
}

func RestoreTrashEntry(id string) (string, error) {
	if runtime.GOOS == "darwin" {
		return restoreTrashDarwin(id)
	}
	return restoreTrashFreedesktop(id)
}

func CopyTrashEntryTo(id, destinationDir string) (string, error) {
	entry, err := findTrashEntry(id)
	if err != nil {
		return "", err
	}

	destinationDir = filepath.Clean(strings.TrimSpace(destinationDir))
	if destinationDir == "" || destinationDir == "." {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("trash copy: invalid destination")
	}
	return CopyTrashEntryToPath(id, filepath.Join(destinationDir, entry.Name))
}

func CopyTrashEntryToPath(id, destination string) (string, error) {
	entry, err := findTrashEntry(id)
	if err != nil {
		return "", err
	}

	destination = filepath.Clean(strings.TrimSpace(destination))
	if destination == "" || destination == "." {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("trash copy: invalid destination")
	}
	parent := filepath.Dir(destination)
	info, err := os.Stat(parent)
	if err != nil {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("trash copy: destination: %w", err)
	}
	if !info.IsDir() {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("trash copy: destination is not a directory: %s", parent)
	}
	if _, err := os.Lstat(destination); err == nil {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("trash copy: destination already exists: %s", destination)
	} else if !os.IsNotExist(err) {
		return "", err
	}

	sourceInfo, err := os.Lstat(entry.TrashedPath)
	if err != nil {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("trash copy: source: %w", err)
	}
	if sourceInfo.IsDir() {
		if err := copyDirAll(entry.TrashedPath, destination); err != nil {
			return "", fmt.Errorf("trash copy: %w", err)
		}
	} else if err := copyFileData(entry.TrashedPath, destination, sourceInfo.Mode()); err != nil {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("trash copy: %w", err)
	}
	return destination, nil
}

func RestoreTrashEntryTo(id, destinationDir string) (string, error) {
	entry, err := findTrashEntry(id)
	if err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	return RestoreTrashEntryToPath(id, filepath.Join(destinationDir, entry.Name))
}

func RestoreTrashEntryToPath(id, destination string) (string, error) {
	destination, err := CopyTrashEntryToPath(id, destination)
	if err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	if err := DeleteTrashEntry(id); err != nil {
		return destination, fmt.Errorf(
			"trash restore: copied to %q but could not remove trash entry: %w",
			destination,
			err,
		)
	}
	return destination, nil
}

func DeleteTrashEntry(id string) error {
	if runtime.GOOS == "darwin" {
		return deleteTrashDarwin(id)
	}
	return deleteTrashFreedesktop(id)
}

func EmptyTrash() error {
	entries, err := ListTrashEntries()
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	for _, entry := range entries {
		if err := DeleteTrashEntry(entry.ID); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}
	return nil
}

func moveToTrashDarwin(abs string) error {
	home, err := os.UserHomeDir()
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("trash: cannot determine home directory: %w", err)
	}
	trashDir := filepath.Join(home, ".Trash")
	if err := os.MkdirAll(trashDir, 0700); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("trash: cannot create ~/.Trash: %w", err)
	}

	dst := uniqueTrashPath(trashDir, filepath.Base(abs))
	if err := renameCrossDevice(abs, dst); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("trash: %w", err)
	}

	meta := darwinTrashMetadata{
		OriginalPath: abs,
		TrashedPath:  dst,
		DeletedAt:    time.Now().Format(time.RFC3339),
	}
	_ = writeDarwinTrashMetadata(filepath.Base(dst), meta)
	return nil
}

func moveToTrashFreedesktop(abs string) error {
	home, err := os.UserHomeDir()
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("trash: cannot determine home directory: %w", err)
	}

	filesDir := filepath.Join(home, ".local", "share", "Trash", "files")
	infoDir := filepath.Join(home, ".local", "share", "Trash", "info")
	for _, dir := range []string{filesDir, infoDir} {
		if err := os.MkdirAll(dir, 0700); err != nil {
			return fmt.Errorf("trash: cannot create trash directory %s: %w", dir, err)
		}
	}

	baseName := uniqueTrashBaseName(filesDir, infoDir, filepath.Base(abs))
	dst := filepath.Join(filesDir, baseName)
	infoPath := filepath.Join(infoDir, baseName+".trashinfo")
	infoContent := fmt.Sprintf(
		"[Trash Info]\nPath=%s\nDeletionDate=%s\n",
		url.PathEscape(abs),
		time.Now().Format("2006-01-02T15:04:05"),
	)
	if err := os.WriteFile(infoPath, []byte(infoContent), 0600); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("trash: cannot write .trashinfo: %w", err)
	}
	if err := renameCrossDevice(abs, dst); err != nil {
		_ = os.Remove(infoPath)
		return fmt.Errorf("trash: %w", err)
	}
	return nil
}

func listTrashFreedesktop() ([]contracts.TrashEntry, error) {
	home, err := os.UserHomeDir()
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	filesDir := filepath.Join(home, ".local", "share", "Trash", "files")
	infoDir := filepath.Join(home, ".local", "share", "Trash", "info")
	dirEntries, err := os.ReadDir(filesDir)
	if os.IsNotExist(err) {
		return []contracts.TrashEntry{}, nil
	}
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	result := make([]contracts.TrashEntry, 0, len(dirEntries))
	for _, entry := range dirEntries {
		name := entry.Name()
		trashedPath := filepath.Join(filesDir, name)
		info, statErr := os.Lstat(trashedPath)
		originalPath, deletedAt := readTrashInfo(filepath.Join(infoDir, name+".trashinfo"))
		item := contracts.TrashEntry{
			ID: name, Name: name, OriginalPath: originalPath,
			TrashedPath: trashedPath, DeletedAt: deletedAt,
			CanRestore: originalPath != "",
		}
		if statErr == nil {
			item.Size = info.Size()
			item.IsDir = info.IsDir()
		}
		result = append(result, item)
	}
	sort.Slice(result, func(i, j int) bool { return result[i].DeletedAt > result[j].DeletedAt })
	return result, nil
}

func restoreTrashFreedesktop(id string) (string, error) {
	id = safeTrashID(id)
	if id == "" {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("trash restore: invalid id")
	}

	home, err := os.UserHomeDir()
	if err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	filesDir := filepath.Join(home, ".local", "share", "Trash", "files")
	infoDir := filepath.Join(home, ".local", "share", "Trash", "info")
	source := filepath.Join(filesDir, id)
	infoPath := filepath.Join(infoDir, id+".trashinfo")
	original, _ := readTrashInfo(infoPath)
	if original == "" {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("trash restore: original path is unavailable")
	}
	if _, err := os.Lstat(original); err == nil {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("trash restore: destination already exists: %s", original)
	}
	if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(original), 0755); err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	if err := renameCrossDevice(source, original); err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	_ = os.Remove(infoPath)
	return original, nil
}

func deleteTrashFreedesktop(id string) error {
	id = safeTrashID(id)
	if id == "" {
		return fmt.Errorf("trash delete: invalid id")
	}
	home, err := os.UserHomeDir()
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}

	filesDir := filepath.Join(home, ".local", "share", "Trash", "files")
	infoDir := filepath.Join(home, ".local", "share", "Trash", "info")
	if err := os.RemoveAll(filepath.Join(filesDir, id)); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	_ = os.Remove(filepath.Join(infoDir, id+".trashinfo"))
	return nil
}

func readTrashInfo(path string) (originalPath, deletedAt string) {
	file, err := os.Open(path)
	if err != nil {
		return "", ""
	}
	defer file.Close()

	scanner := bufio.NewScanner(file)
	for scanner.Scan() {
		line := scanner.Text()
		switch {
		case strings.HasPrefix(line, "Path="):
			value := strings.TrimPrefix(line, "Path=")
			if decoded, err := url.PathUnescape(value); err == nil {
				originalPath = decoded
			} else {
				originalPath = value
			}
		case strings.HasPrefix(line, "DeletionDate="):
			deletedAt = strings.TrimPrefix(line, "DeletionDate=")
		}
	}
	return
}

func listTrashDarwin() ([]contracts.TrashEntry, error) {
	home, err := os.UserHomeDir()
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	trashDir := filepath.Join(home, ".Trash")
	dirEntries, err := os.ReadDir(trashDir)
	if os.IsNotExist(err) {
		return []contracts.TrashEntry{}, nil
	}
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	result := make([]contracts.TrashEntry, 0, len(dirEntries))
	for _, entry := range dirEntries {
		name := entry.Name()
		path := filepath.Join(trashDir, name)
		info, _ := os.Lstat(path)
		meta, _ := readDarwinTrashMetadata(name)

		item := contracts.TrashEntry{
			ID: name, Name: name, TrashedPath: path,
			OriginalPath: meta.OriginalPath, DeletedAt: meta.DeletedAt,
			CanRestore: meta.OriginalPath != "",
		}
		if info != nil {
			item.Size = info.Size()
			item.IsDir = info.IsDir()
		}
		result = append(result, item)
	}
	sort.Slice(result, func(i, j int) bool { return result[i].DeletedAt > result[j].DeletedAt })
	return result, nil
}

func restoreTrashDarwin(id string) (string, error) {
	id = safeTrashID(id)
	if id == "" {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("trash restore: invalid id")
	}
	home, err := os.UserHomeDir()
	if err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	meta, err := readDarwinTrashMetadata(id)
	if err != nil || meta.OriginalPath == "" {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("trash restore: original path is unavailable")
	}

	source := filepath.Join(home, ".Trash", id)
	if _, err := os.Lstat(meta.OriginalPath); err == nil {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("trash restore: destination already exists: %s", meta.OriginalPath)
	}
	if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(meta.OriginalPath), 0755); err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	if err := renameCrossDevice(source, meta.OriginalPath); err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	_ = os.Remove(darwinTrashMetadataPath(id))
	return meta.OriginalPath, nil
}

func deleteTrashDarwin(id string) error {
	id = safeTrashID(id)
	if id == "" {
		return fmt.Errorf("trash delete: invalid id")
	}
	home, err := os.UserHomeDir()
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := os.RemoveAll(filepath.Join(home, ".Trash", id)); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	_ = os.Remove(darwinTrashMetadataPath(id))
	return nil
}

func darwinTrashIndexDir() string {
	home, _ := os.UserHomeDir()
	return filepath.Join(home, "Library", "Application Support", "FileManager", "trash-index")
}

func darwinTrashMetadataPath(id string) string {
	return filepath.Join(darwinTrashIndexDir(), safeTrashID(id)+".json")
}

func writeDarwinTrashMetadata(id string, meta darwinTrashMetadata) error {
	dir := darwinTrashIndexDir()
	if err := os.MkdirAll(dir, 0700); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	data, err := json.Marshal(meta)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return os.WriteFile(darwinTrashMetadataPath(id), data, 0600)
}

func readDarwinTrashMetadata(id string) (darwinTrashMetadata, error) {
	var meta darwinTrashMetadata
	data, err := os.ReadFile(darwinTrashMetadataPath(id))
	if err != nil {
		return meta, err
	}
	err = json.Unmarshal(data, &meta)
	return meta, err
}

func safeTrashID(id string) string {
	id = strings.TrimSpace(filepath.Base(id))
	if id == "." || id == string(filepath.Separator) {
		return ""
	}
	return id
}

func renameCrossDevice(src, dst string) error {
	err := os.Rename(src, dst)
	if err == nil {
		return nil
	}
	linkErr := &os.LinkError{}
	if errors.As(err, &linkErr) && errors.Is(linkErr.Err, syscall.EXDEV) {
		return crossDeviceMoveToTrash(src, dst)
	}
	return err
}

func crossDeviceMoveToTrash(src, dst string) error {
	info, err := os.Lstat(src)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if info.IsDir() {
		if err := copyDirAll(src, dst); err != nil {
			return fmt.Errorf("cross-device copy failed: %w", err)
		}
	} else if err := copyFileData(src, dst, info.Mode()); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("cross-device copy failed: %w", err)
	}
	return os.RemoveAll(src)
}

func copyDirAll(src, dst string) error {
	return filepath.Walk(src, func(path string, info os.FileInfo, err error) error {
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		rel, _ := filepath.Rel(src, path)
		target := filepath.Join(dst, rel)
		if info.IsDir() {
			return os.MkdirAll(target, info.Mode())
		}
		return copyFileData(path, target, info.Mode())
	})
}

func copyFileData(src, dst string, mode os.FileMode) error {
	in, err := os.Open(src)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer in.Close()

	out, err := os.OpenFile(dst, os.O_CREATE|os.O_WRONLY|os.O_TRUNC, mode)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer out.Close()

	if _, err := io.Copy(out, in); err != nil {
		_ = os.Remove(dst)
		return err
	}
	return out.Close()
}

func uniqueTrashPath(dir, baseName string) string {
	candidate := filepath.Join(dir, baseName)
	if _, err := os.Lstat(candidate); os.IsNotExist(err) {
		return candidate
	}
	ext := filepath.Ext(baseName)
	stem := strings.TrimSuffix(baseName, ext)
	for i := 2; ; i++ {
		candidate = filepath.Join(dir, fmt.Sprintf("%s (%d)%s", stem, i, ext))
		if _, err := os.Lstat(candidate); os.IsNotExist(err) {
			return candidate
		}
	}
}

func uniqueTrashBaseName(filesDir, infoDir, baseName string) string {
	ext := filepath.Ext(baseName)
	stem := strings.TrimSuffix(baseName, ext)
	candidate := baseName
	for i := 2; ; i++ {
		_, errFiles := os.Lstat(filepath.Join(filesDir, candidate))
		_, errInfo := os.Lstat(filepath.Join(infoDir, candidate+".trashinfo"))
		if os.IsNotExist(errFiles) && os.IsNotExist(errInfo) {
			return candidate
		}
		candidate = fmt.Sprintf("%s (%d)%s", stem, i, ext)
	}
}
`````

`````go
func TestNormalizeNativeWatchPath(t *testing.T) {
	tests := []struct {
		input string
		want  string
	}{
		{"/home/user", "/home/user"},
		{"/home/user/", "/home/user"},
		{"  /home/user  ", "/home/user"},
		{"", ""},
		{"registry://some/key", ""},
	}
	for _, tc := range tests {
		got := normalizeNativeWatchPath(tc.input)
		if got != tc.want {
			t.Fatalf("normalizeNativeWatchPath(%q) = %q, want %q", tc.input, got, tc.want)
		}
	}
}

// в”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђ
type FileInfo = vfslib.FileInfo

func TestPaneWatchManagerNormalizeWatchPath(t *testing.T) {
	m := NewPaneWatchManager(nil, nil, nil)
	defer m.Close()

	got, err := m.normalizeWatchPath("/home")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected error: %v", err)
	}
	if got != "/home" {
		t.Fatalf("expected /home, got %s", got)
	}

	got, _ = m.normalizeWatchPath("")
	if got != "" {
		t.Fatalf("expected empty for empty input, got %s", got)
	}

	got, _ = m.normalizeWatchPath("registry://HKLM/Software")
	if got != "" {
		t.Fatalf("expected empty for registry path, got %s", got)
	}
}

func TestPaneWatchManagerToEventPath(t *testing.T) {
	m := NewPaneWatchManager(nil, nil, func(s string) string { return "public://" + s })
	defer m.Close()

	got := m.toEventPath("/home")
	if got != "public:///home" {
		t.Fatalf("expected public:///home, got %s", got)
	}

	got = m.toEventPath("")
	if got != "" {
		t.Fatalf("expected empty, got %s", got)
	}
}

func TestPaneWatchManagerSetPaneDirectory(t *testing.T) {
	var events []testEvent
	watchPath := t.TempDir()
	m := NewPaneWatchManager(
		func(name string, data interface{}) { events = append(events, testEvent{name, data}) },
		func(s string) (string, error) { return s, nil },
		nil,
	)
	defer m.Close()

	err := m.SetPaneDirectory("left", watchPath)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected error: %v", err)
	}

	normalizedPath := normalizeNativeWatchPath(watchPath)
	if m.panePaths["left"] != normalizedPath {
		t.Fatalf("expected pane path %q, got %q", normalizedPath, m.panePaths["left"])
	}

	// Setting same path again should be no-op.
	err = m.SetPaneDirectory("left", watchPath)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected error on repeat: %v", err)
	}

	// Clear path.
	err = m.SetPaneDirectory("left", "")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected error on clear: %v", err)
	}
	if _, ok := m.panePaths["left"]; ok {
		t.Fatal("expected pane path to be cleared")
	}
}

func TestPaneWatchManagerCloseIdempotent(t *testing.T) {
	m := NewPaneWatchManager(nil, nil, nil)
	m.Close()
	m.Close() // should not panic
}

func TestPaneWatchManagerAddRemoveWatchRefCount(t *testing.T) {
	m := NewPaneWatchManager(nil, nil, nil)
	defer m.Close()

	watchPath := normalizeNativeWatchPath(t.TempDir())

	if err := m.addWatchLocked(watchPath); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected error adding first watch: %v", err)
	}
	if m.pathRef[watchPath] != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("expected ref count 1, got %d", m.pathRef[watchPath])
	}

	if err := m.addWatchLocked(watchPath); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected error adding second watch: %v", err)
	}
	if m.pathRef[watchPath] != 2 {
		t.Fatalf("expected ref count 2, got %d", m.pathRef[watchPath])
	}

	m.removeWatchLocked(watchPath)
	if m.pathRef[watchPath] != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("expected ref count 1 after remove, got %d", m.pathRef[watchPath])
	}

	m.removeWatchLocked(watchPath)
	if _, ok := m.pathRef[watchPath]; ok {
		t.Fatal("expected path ref to be deleted")
	}
}
`````

`````typescript
/**
 * Canonical file entry contract shared by Manager, plugins, pane contracts,
 * and panel sources.
 *
 * Keep this structurally aligned with the Wails FileInfo wire model. Provider-
 * specific metadata belongs in explicit optional fields or derived interfaces;
 * do not add a catch-all index signature because it makes the contract stricter
 * for ordinary FileInfo values.
 */
export enum FileType {
  FILE = 'FILE',
  DIRECTORY = 'DIRECTORY',
  ARCHIVE = 'ARCHIVE',
  SYMLINK = 'SYMLINK',
}

/** Backward-compatible name used by early core consumers. */
export type FileEntryType = FileType;

export interface FileInfo {
  name: string;
  path: string;
  type: FileType;
  mimeType?: string;
  size: number;
  created: number;
  modified: number;
  accessed: number;
  permissions: string;
  owner?: string;
  attributes?: string;
  isHidden: boolean;
  isSymlink?: boolean;

  // Shared provider metadata already consumed by Manager/plugin surfaces.
  registryKind?: string;
  registryValueType?: string;
  registryPreview?: string;
  searchBasePath?: string;
  searchPattern?: string;
  searchParentPath?: string;

  // Recycle Bin provider metadata. Each row is one exact OS trash object.
  // Grouping/version labels are presentation-only and derived in the pane.
  binTrashId?: string;
  binOriginalPath?: string;
  binDeletedAt?: string;
  binCanRestore?: boolean;

  // Archive/provider extensions. Optional so plain wire FileInfo remains valid.
  isNested?: boolean;
  nestedChain?: string[];
}

export interface FileProbe {
  mimeType: string;
  encoding?: string;
  isText: boolean;
  isArchive: boolean;
}
`````

`````javascript
import { readFileSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';

const files = [
  'manager/frontend/src/app/components/registry-pane.component.ts',
  'manager/frontend/src/app/components/network-pane.component.ts',
  'manager/frontend/src/app/components/environment-pane.component.ts',
  'manager/frontend/src/app/components/autorun-pane.component.ts',
];

const overrideCss = `

    /* Keep Details/List headers outside the scrollable row viewport. */
    .list {
      display: flex !important;
      flex-direction: column;
      overflow: hidden !important;
      padding: 0 !important;
    }

    .list-viewport {
      flex: 1 1 auto;
      min-height: 0;
      overflow: auto;
      padding: 4px;
      overscroll-behavior: none;
      scroll-behavior: auto;
      touch-action: pan-y;
    }

    .list.view-grid .list-viewport {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(108px, 1fr));
      align-content: start;
      gap: 5px;
      padding: 7px;
    }

    .list.view-list .list-viewport,
    .list.view-details .list-viewport {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: minmax(100%, max-content);
      align-content: start;
      padding: 0;
    }

    .list.view-list .list-viewport > .entry,
    .list.view-details .list-viewport > .entry {
      grid-column: 1;
      width: auto !important;
      min-width: 0 !important;
      justify-self: stretch;
      margin-left: 4px;
      margin-right: 4px;
    }

    .list.view-list .list-viewport > .list-virtual-spacer,
    .list.view-details .list-viewport > .list-virtual-spacer {
      grid-column: 1;
      width: auto !important;
      min-width: 0 !important;
      justify-self: stretch;
    }

    .list-viewport:focus,
    .list-viewport:focus-visible {
      outline: none !important;
      box-shadow: none !important;
    }
`;

for (const file of files) {
  let source = readFileSync(file, 'utf8');

  const outerRe = /      <div\s+        #listViewport\s+        class="list"\s+        data-pane-content\s+        data-pane-details-root\s+        \*ngIf="!activePanelPresentation && !error && viewMode !== 'tree'"\s+        tabindex="-1"\s+        role="listbox"\s+        (?<aria>\[attr\.aria-label\]="[^"]+")\s+        (?<classes>(?:\[[^\n]+\]="[^"]+"\s+)+)\s+        \(scroll\)="onContentScroll\(\$event\)"\s+        \[class\.background-drop-target\]="backgroundDropActive"\s+        \(click\)="onBackgroundClick\(\$event\)"\s+\(contextmenu\)="onBackgroundContextMenu\(\$event\)"\s+        \(dragover\)="onBackgroundDragOver\(\$event\)"\s+        \(dragleave\)="onBackgroundDragLeave\(\$event\)"\s+        \(drop\)="onBackgroundDrop\(\$event\)">/;
  const outer = outerRe.exec(source);
  if (!outer?.groups) {
    throw new Error(`Could not find outer list viewport in ${file}`);
  }

  source = source.replace(outerRe, `      <div
        class="list"
        data-pane-details-root
        *ngIf="!activePanelPresentation && !error && viewMode !== 'tree'"
        ${outer.groups.classes.trimEnd()}
        [class.background-drop-target]="backgroundDropActive">`);

  const headerStart = source.indexOf('<div class="details-header-viewport"');
  if (headerStart < 0) {
    throw new Error(`Could not find details header viewport in ${file}`);
  }

  const detailsClassIndex = source.indexOf('class="details-header"', headerStart);
  if (detailsClassIndex < 0) {
    throw new Error(`Could not find details header class in ${file}`);
  }
  source = source.slice(0, detailsClassIndex) + '#detailsHeader ' + source.slice(detailsClassIndex);

  const rowsStartRe = /\n\s*<div\s+\*ngIf="listVirtualWindow\.enabled && listVirtualWindow\.beforePx > 0"/g;
  rowsStartRe.lastIndex = headerStart;
  const rowsStartMatch = rowsStartRe.exec(source);
  if (!rowsStartMatch) {
    throw new Error(`Could not find row content start in ${file}`);
  }
  const rowsStart = rowsStartMatch.index;
  source = source.slice(0, rowsStart) + `

      <div
        #listViewport
        class="list-viewport"
        data-pane-content
        tabindex="-1"
        role="listbox"
        ${outer.groups.aria}
        (scroll)="onListViewportScroll($event)"
        (click)="onBackgroundClick($event)"
        (contextmenu)="onBackgroundContextMenu($event)"
        (dragover)="onBackgroundDragOver($event)"
        (dragleave)="onBackgroundDragLeave($event)"
        (drop)="onBackgroundDrop($event)">` + source.slice(rowsStart);

  const dropIntentRe = /\n\s*<div\s+class="drop-intent"/g;
  dropIntentRe.lastIndex = rowsStart;
  const dropIntentMatch = dropIntentRe.exec(source);
  if (!dropIntentMatch) {
    throw new Error(`Could not find drop intent boundary in ${file}`);
  }
  const dropIntent = dropIntentMatch.index;
  source = source.slice(0, dropIntent) + '\n        </div>' + source.slice(dropIntent);

  source = source.replace(
    /(@ViewChild\('listViewport'\) listViewport\?: ElementRef<HTMLElement>;\s*)/,
    `$1  @ViewChild('detailsHeader') detailsHeader?: ElementRef<HTMLElement>;\n`,
  );

  source = source.replace(
    /(\n  onContentScroll\(event: Event\): void \{)/,
    `
  onListViewportScroll(event: Event): void {
    this.onContentScroll(event);
    const header = this.detailsHeader?.nativeElement;
    const target = event.currentTarget as HTMLElement | null;
    if (header && target) {
      header.style.transform = target.scrollLeft > 0 ? \`translateX(\${-target.scrollLeft}px)\` : '';
    }
  }
$1`,
  );

  source = source.replace(/\n  `\],\r?\n}\)/, `${overrideCss}\n  \`],\n})`);

  writeFileSync(file, source);
}
`````

`````typescript
import { AddressBarEditComponent } from './address-bar-edit.component';

describe('address bar root suggestions', () => {
  function component(availableRoots: readonly string[]): AddressBarEditComponent {
    const roots = new Set(availableRoots.map(path => path.toLowerCase()));
    const panelSources = {
      resolve: ({ path }: { path: string }) => ({
        source: {
          id: roots.has(path.toLowerCase()) ? `source.${path.slice(0, -3)}` : 'filesystem',
        },
      }),
    };

    const instance = new AddressBarEditComponent(
      {} as any,
      {} as any,
      {} as any,
      {} as any,
      panelSources as any,
      {} as any,
      {} as any,
      {} as any,
      {} as any,
      {} as any,
    );

    (instance as any).syntheticRootSuggestions = [
      { path: 'filesystem://c', displayName: 'Local Disk (C:)' },
      { path: 'filesystem://d', displayName: 'Data (D:)' },
    ];
    return instance;
  }

  function paths(instance: AddressBarEditComponent, query = ''): string[] {
    return (instance as any).buildAliasRootSuggestions(query)
      .map((entry: { path: string }) => entry.path);
  }

  it('shows filesystem roots plus built-in autorun, environment and network roots', () => {
    const instance = component(['autorun://', 'environment://', 'network://']);

    expect(paths(instance)).toEqual([
      'autorun://',
      'environment://',
      'network://',
      'filesystem://c',
      'filesystem://d',
    ]);
  });

  it('shows Registry only while a registered PanelSource owns registry://', () => {
    const installed = component(['autorun://', 'environment://', 'network://', 'registry://']);
    const absent = component(['autorun://', 'environment://', 'network://']);

    expect(paths(installed)).toContain('registry://');
    expect(paths(absent)).not.toContain('registry://');
  });

  it('filters root suggestions by scheme or friendly display name while typing', () => {
    const instance = component(['autorun://', 'environment://', 'network://', 'registry://']);

    expect(paths(instance, 'env')).toEqual(['environment://']);
    expect(paths(instance, 'net')).toEqual(['network://']);
    expect(paths(instance, 'auto')).toEqual(['autorun://']);
    expect(paths(instance, 'data')).toEqual(['filesystem://d']);
`````

`````typescript
import { ChangeDetectionStrategy, Component, ElementRef, EventEmitter, Input, Output, ViewChild } from '@angular/core';
import { CommonModule } from '@angular/common';
import { FileInfo, FileType } from '../shared/protocol';
import { PaneDetailsResizeHandleDirective } from './pane-details-resize-handle.directive';

type BinFileInfo = FileInfo & {
  binGroupHeader?: boolean;
  binGroupKey?: string;
  binRevisionCount?: number;
  binOriginalPath?: string;
  binDeletedAt?: string;
  binRevisionLabel?: string;
  binOriginalDirectory?: string;
};

/**
 * Recycle Bin's grouped presentation is intentionally a custom pane view.
 * It models an original item as a non-actionable group row with concrete
 * deleted revisions beneath it; that hierarchy is not a generic file tree.
 */
@Component({
  selector: 'app-bin-grouped-view',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [CommonModule, PaneDetailsResizeHandleDirective],
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
  template: `
    <div
      #viewport
      class="bin-grouped-view"
      data-pane-content
      data-pane-details-root
      tabindex="-1"
      role="listbox"
      aria-label="Recycle Bin grouped by original item"
      [attr.aria-busy]="loading"
      (click)="backgroundClick.emit($event)"
      (contextmenu)="backgroundContextMenu.emit($event)"
      (scroll)="scroll.emit($event)">
      <div class="details-header" aria-hidden="true">
        <span></span>
        <span>Name<i [paneDetailsResizeHandle]="'bin-name'" [paneDetailsMinWidth]="140"></i></span>
        <span>Path<i [paneDetailsResizeHandle]="'bin-location'" [paneDetailsMinWidth]="120"></i></span>
        <span>Deleted<i [paneDetailsResizeHandle]="'bin-deleted'" [paneDetailsMinWidth]="100"></i></span>
        <span>Size<i [paneDetailsResizeHandle]="'bin-size'" [paneDetailsMinWidth]="64"></i></span>
        <span>Revision<i [paneDetailsResizeHandle]="'bin-revision'" [paneDetailsMinWidth]="64"></i></span>
      </div>

      <div *ngIf="beforePx > 0" class="virtual-spacer" [style.height.px]="beforePx" aria-hidden="true"></div>

      <div
        *ngFor="let entry of entries; trackBy: trackEntry"
        class="entry"
        tabindex="-1"
        role="option"
        [attr.data-file-entry]="entry.path"
        [attr.aria-selected]="isGroup(entry) ? false : selectedPaths.has(entry.path)"
        [attr.aria-current]="entry.path === cursorPath ? 'true' : null"
        [class.cursor]="entry.path === cursorPath"
        [class.selected]="!isGroup(entry) && selectedPaths.has(entry.path)"
        [class.group]="isGroup(entry)"
        [class.revision]="!isGroup(entry)"
        (click)="entryClick.emit({ entry: entry, event: $event }); $event.stopPropagation()"
        (dblclick)="entryDoubleClick.emit({ entry: entry, event: $event }); $event.stopPropagation()"
        (contextmenu)="entryContextMenu.emit({ entry: entry, event: $event }); $event.stopPropagation()">
        <span class="leading">
          <button
            *ngIf="isGroup(entry); else revisionIndent"
            type="button"
            class="disclosure"
            tabindex="-1"
            [attr.aria-label]="(isExpanded(entry) ? 'Collapse ' : 'Expand ') + entry.name + ' revisions'"
            [attr.aria-expanded]="isExpanded(entry)"
            (click)="toggleGroup.emit({ entry: entry, event: $event }); $event.stopPropagation()">
            {{ isExpanded(entry) ? '▾' : '▸' }}
          </button>
          <ng-template #revisionIndent><span class="revision-indent"></span></ng-template>
          <span class="icon" aria-hidden="true">{{ entry.type === FileType.DIRECTORY ? '📁' : '📄' }}</span>
        </span>
        <span class="name" [title]="entry.name">{{ entry.name }}</span>
        <span class="path" [title]="originalPath(entry)">{{ originalDirectory(entry) }}</span>
        <span class="deleted" [title]="deletedAt(entry)">{{ deletedAt(entry) }}</span>
        <span class="size">{{ entry.type === FileType.DIRECTORY || isGroup(entry) ? '' : formatSize(entry.size) }}</span>
        <span class="revision-label">{{ isGroup(entry) ? revisionCount(entry) + ' revision' + (revisionCount(entry) === 1 ? '' : 's') : revisionLabel(entry) }}</span>
      </div>

      <div *ngIf="afterPx > 0" class="virtual-spacer" [style.height.px]="afterPx" aria-hidden="true"></div>
      <div class="empty" *ngIf="!loading && entries.length === 0">Recycle Bin is empty.</div>
    </div>
  `,
  styles: [`
    :host { display:flex; flex:1 1 0%; min-width:0; min-height:0; overflow:hidden; }
    .bin-grouped-view { flex:1 1 0%; min-width:0; min-height:0; overflow:auto; background:var(--vsc-editor-background); color:var(--vsc-foreground); }
    .details-header, .entry { display:grid; grid-template-columns:26px var(--details-column-bin-name-width, minmax(180px,1.5fr)) var(--details-column-bin-location-width, minmax(140px,1fr)) var(--details-column-bin-deleted-width, minmax(130px,.8fr)) var(--details-column-bin-size-width, minmax(72px,.45fr)) var(--details-column-bin-revision-width, minmax(82px,.5fr)); align-items:center; min-width:760px; }
    .details-header { position:sticky; top:0; z-index:2; height:28px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--vsc-border); background:var(--vsc-sidebar-background); color:var(--vsc-description-foreground); font-size:12px; }
    .details-header > span, .entry > span { min-width:0; padding:0 6px; overflow:hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis; white-space:nowrap; }
    .entry { position:relative; min-height:26px; border-radius:3px; font-size:13px; }
    .entry:hover { background:var(--vsc-list-hover-background); }
    .entry.selected { background:var(--vsc-list-active-selection-background); color:var(--vsc-list-active-selection-foreground); }
    .entry.cursor::before { content:''; position:absolute; left:0; top:3px; bottom:3px; width:2px; border-radius:2px; background:var(--vsc-focus-border); }
    .entry.cursor { background:var(--vsc-list-hover-background); }
    .entry.group { font-weight:600; background:var(--vsc-sidebar-background); }
    .entry.revision .name { padding-left:14px; }
    .leading { display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:flex-start; gap:2px; padding-left:2px !important; }
    .disclosure { width:16px; height:20px; padding:0; border:0; background:transparent; color:inherit; cursor:pointer; }
    .disclosure:hover, .disclosure:active { background:var(--vsc-toolbar-hover-background); }
    .revision-indent { width:16px; flex:0 0 16px; }
    .icon { padding:0 !important; overflow:visible !important; }
    .path, .deleted, .size, .revision-label { color:var(--vsc-description-foreground); }
    .virtual-spacer { width:1px; pointer-events:none; }
    .empty { padding:18px; color:var(--vsc-description-foreground); }
  `],
})
export class BinGroupedViewComponent {
  readonly FileType = FileType;
  @ViewChild('viewport') viewport?: ElementRef<HTMLElement>;

  get viewportElement(): HTMLElement | null {
    return this.viewport?.nativeElement ?? null;
  }

  setScrollTop(value: number): void {
    if (this.viewport?.nativeElement) {
      this.viewport.nativeElement.scrollTop = Math.max(0, value);
    }
  }
  @Input() entries: FileInfo[] = [];
  @Input() selectedPaths: ReadonlySet<string> = new Set<string>();
  @Input() cursorPath: string | null = null;
  @Input() loading = false;
  @Input() beforePx = 0;
  @Input() afterPx = 0;
  @Input() expandedGroups: ReadonlySet<string> = new Set<string>();

  @Output() scroll = new EventEmitter<Event>();
  @Output() backgroundClick = new EventEmitter<MouseEvent>();
  @Output() backgroundContextMenu = new EventEmitter<MouseEvent>();
  @Output() entryClick = new EventEmitter<{ entry: FileInfo; event: MouseEvent }>();
  @Output() entryDoubleClick = new EventEmitter<{ entry: FileInfo; event: MouseEvent }>();
  @Output() entryContextMenu = new EventEmitter<{ entry: FileInfo; event: MouseEvent }>();
  @Output() toggleGroup = new EventEmitter<{ entry: FileInfo; event: Event }>();

  trackEntry = (_: number, entry: FileInfo) => (entry as BinFileInfo).binGroupKey && this.isGroup(entry) ? `group:${(entry as BinFileInfo).binGroupKey}` : entry.path;
  isGroup(entry: FileInfo): boolean { return !!(entry as BinFileInfo).binGroupHeader; }
  groupKey(entry: FileInfo): string { return (entry as BinFileInfo).binGroupKey || entry.path; }
  isExpanded(entry: FileInfo): boolean { return this.expandedGroups.has(this.groupKey(entry)); }
  revisionCount(entry: FileInfo): number { return (entry as BinFileInfo).binRevisionCount || 0; }
  revisionLabel(entry: FileInfo): string { return (entry as BinFileInfo).binRevisionLabel || ''; }
  originalPath(entry: FileInfo): string { return (entry as BinFileInfo).binOriginalPath || ''; }
  originalDirectory(entry: FileInfo): string {
    const explicit = (entry as BinFileInfo).binOriginalDirectory;
    if (explicit) return explicit;
    const path = this.originalPath(entry).replace(/\\/g, '/');
    const i = path.lastIndexOf('/');
    return i > 0 ? path.slice(0, i) : path;
  }
  deletedAt(entry: FileInfo): string { return (entry as BinFileInfo).binDeletedAt || ''; }
  formatSize(bytes: number): string {
    if (!Number.isFinite(bytes) || bytes < 0) return '';
    if (bytes < 1024) return `${bytes} B`;
    const units = ['KiB', 'MiB', 'GiB', 'TiB']; let value = bytes / 1024; let unit = units[0];
    for (let i = 1; i < units.length && value >= 1024; i++) { value /= 1024; unit = units[i]; }
    return `${value.toFixed(value >= 10 ? 1 : 2)} ${unit}`;
  }
}
`````

## File: manager/frontend/src/app/components/bin-resource-invalidation.spec.ts
`````typescript
import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';

describe('Recycle Bin source invalidation architecture', () => {
  const api = readFileSync(
    new URL('../services/api.service.ts', import.meta.url),
    'utf8',
  );
  const pane = readFileSync(
    new URL('./bin-pane.component.ts', import.meta.url),
    'utf8',
  );
  const observer = readFileSync(
    new URL('../services/source-change-observer.service.ts', import.meta.url),
    'utf8',
  );
  const bus = readFileSync(
    new URL('../services/resource-mutation.service.ts', import.meta.url),
    'utf8',
  );

  it('uses the shared SourceChangeObserverService for Bin invalidation', () => {
    expect(pane).toContain('SourceChangeObserverService');
    expect(pane).toContain('this.sourceChanges.observe(');
    expect(pane).toContain(
      'this.sourceObservation.setLocation(BIN_ROOT_PATH);',
    );
    expect(pane).not.toContain('BinWatcherService');
    expect(pane).not.toContain("EventsOn('bin:");
  });

  it('keeps one shared adaptive OS polling producer', () => {
    expect(observer).toContain('binObserverCount');
    expect(observer).toContain('BIN_VISIBLE_POLL_MS');
    expect(observer).toContain('BIN_HIDDEN_POLL_MS');
    expect(observer).toContain('ListTrashEntries');
    expect(observer).toContain("origin: 'bin-os-observer'");
  });

  it('routes both app mutations and OS observations through the coalesced bus', () => {
    expect(api).toContain("items: [{ source: 'bin://' }]");
    expect(api).toContain("origin: 'recycle-bin'");
    expect(observer).toContain('this.mutations.publish({');
    expect(observer).toContain('this.mutations.subscribe(');
    expect(bus).toContain('MUTATION_COALESCE_MS');
  });

  it('owns the in-flight refresh gate in the observer, not the pane', () => {
    expect(observer).toContain('record.refreshing');
    expect(observer).toContain('record.pending');
    expect(pane).not.toContain('binMutationRefreshRunning');
    expect(pane).not.toContain('binMutationRefreshPending');
  });
});
`````

`````typescript
import { Component, ElementRef, OnDestroy, OnInit, ViewChild } from '@angular/core';
import { CommonModule } from '@angular/common';
import { FormsModule } from '@angular/forms';
import { ConfirmDialogService, type ConfirmDialogDetailRow } from '../services/confirm-dialog.service';
import { InputHistoryService } from '../services/input-history.service';
import type { Stream } from '@epikodelabs/streamix';
import { createSubject, takeUntil } from '@epikodelabs/streamix';

interface ConfirmDialogRequest {
  kind: 'confirm' | 'alert' | 'prompt';
  options: any;
  resolves: Array<(value: boolean | string | null) => void>;
}

@Component({
  selector: 'app-confirm-dialog',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [CommonModule, FormsModule],
  template: `
    <ng-container *ngIf="request$ | async as request">
      <div 
        class="confirm-overlay"
        [class.confirm-overlay--alert]="request.options.isAlert"
        [class.confirm-overlay--detailed]="request.options.isAlert && request.options.details?.length"
        [class.confirm-overlay--closing]="isClosing"
        (click)="onCancel()"
        (animationend)="onAnimationEnd($event)"
      >
        <div
          #dialogPanel
          class="confirm-panel"
          data-input-owned
          [class.confirm-panel--alert]="request.options.isAlert"
          [class.confirm-panel--detailed]="request.options.isAlert && request.options.details?.length"
          [attr.data-tone]="request.options.tone || 'warning'"
          [class.confirm-panel--prompt]="request.options.isPrompt && !request.options.isAlert"
          [attr.role]="request.options.isAlert ? 'alertdialog' : 'dialog'"
          aria-modal="true"
          tabindex="-1"
          [attr.aria-label]="request.options.title || 'Confirmation'"
          (keydown.escape)="onCancel(); $event.preventDefault(); $event.stopPropagation()"
          (mousedown)="$event.stopPropagation()"
          (click)="$event.stopPropagation()"
        >
          <!-- Alert / structured information layout -->
          <ng-container *ngIf="request.options.isAlert">
            <div class="conflict-body">
              <div class="conflict-heading">
                <span class="alert-symbol" aria-hidden="true">
                  {{ alertSymbol(request.options.tone) }}
                </span>
                <div class="alert-heading-copy">
                  <div class="conflict-title">{{ getAlertTitle(request.options) }}</div>
                  <div class="conflict-sub" *ngIf="getAlertSubtitle(request.options)">
                    {{ getAlertSubtitle(request.options) }}
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div class="detail-scroll" *ngIf="request.options.details?.length">
                <section
                  class="detail-section"
                  *ngFor="let section of request.options.details">

                  <dl class="property-grid">

                  {{ request.options.confirmText || 'OK' }}

            </div>
          </ng-container>

          <!-- Regular confirmation / prompt dialog layout -->
          <form

            class="confirm-form"

              <h2>{{ request.options.title }}</h2>

export class ConfirmDialogComponent {
  @ViewChild('dialogPanel') private dialogPanel?: ElementRef<HTMLElement>;
  @ViewChild('promptInput') private promptInput?: ElementRef<HTMLInputElement>;

  private readonly destroy$ = createSubject<void>();
  draftValue = '';
  readonly request$: Stream<ConfirmDialogRequest | null> = this.confirmDialogService.mountedRequest$;

  constructor(
    private confirmDialogService: ConfirmDialogService,
    private inputHistory: InputHistoryService,
  ) {}

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.confirmDialogService.mountedRequest$
      .pipe(takeUntil(this.destroy$))
      .subscribe(request => {
        if (request) {
          this.draftValue = request.options.defaultValue ?? '';
          this.focusInitialControl();
          return;
        }

        this.draftValue = '';
      });
  }

  ngOnDestroy(): void {
    this.destroy$.next();
    this.destroy$.complete();
  }

  onCancel(): void {
    const active = this.confirmDialogService.activeRequest$.value;
    // Clicking overlay on alert should close it
    if (active?.options.isAlert) {
      this.onConfirm();
    } else if (active?.options.isPrompt) {
      this.confirmDialogService.resolveActive(null);
    } else {
      this.confirmDialogService.resolveActive(false);
    }
  }

  onConfirm(): void {
    const active = this.confirmDialogService.activeRequest$.value;
    if (active?.options.isPrompt) {
      const value = this.draftValue;
      if (active.options.historyKey && value.trim()) {
        this.inputHistory.push(active.options.historyKey, value);
      }
      this.confirmDialogService.resolveActive(value);
      return;
    }
    this.confirmDialogService.resolveActive(true);
  }

  private focusPromptInput(attempt = 0): void {
    requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      const input = this.promptInput?.nativeElement;

      if (!input) {
        if (attempt < 8) {
          setTimeout(() => this.focusPromptInput(attempt + 1), 16);
        }
        return;
      }

      input.focus({ preventScroll: true });
      const end = input.value.length;
      input.setSelectionRange(end, end);
    });
  }

  private focusInitialControl(): void {
    if (this.promptInput?.nativeElement) {
      this.focusPromptInput();
      return;
    }

    requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      const panel = this.dialogPanel?.nativeElement;
      if (!panel) {
        return;
      }

      const initial = panel.querySelector<HTMLElement>('[data-dialog-initial-focus]');
      if (initial) {
        initial.focus({ preventScroll: true });
        return;
      }

      panel.focus({ preventScroll: true });
    });
  }


  getAlertTitle(options: any): string {
    if (options.title) {
      return options.title;
    }
    const lines = options.message.split('\n');
    return lines[0] || 'Alert';
  }

  getAlertSubtitle(options: any): string {
    if (options.title) {
      return options.message;
    }
    const lines = options.message.split('\n');
    return lines.slice(1).join('\n');
  }

  detailValues(row: ConfirmDialogDetailRow): readonly string[] {
    return typeof row.value === 'string'
      ? [row.value]
      : Array.from(row.value, String);
  }

  alertSymbol(tone: string | undefined): string {
    switch (tone) {
      case 'info': return 'i';
      case 'success': return '✓';
      case 'error': return '×';
      default: return '!';
    }
  }

  alertFooterHint(options: any): string | null {
    if (options.footerHint === false) return null;
    if (typeof options.footerHint === 'string') return options.footerHint;
    return options.details?.length ? null : 'Press Enter to continue';
  }

  get isClosing(): boolean {
    return !!this.confirmDialogService.closingRequest$.value;
  }

  onAnimationEnd(event: AnimationEvent): void {
    if (event.target !== event.currentTarget || !this.isClosing) {
      return;
    }
    this.confirmDialogService.finishClose();
  }
}
`````

`````typescript
import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';

const read = (name: string) => readFileSync(new URL(`./${name}`, import.meta.url), 'utf8');

describe('dialog close-note standardization', () => {
  it('uses the Command Palette backdrop contract for Keyboard Shortcuts', () => {
    const html = read('keyboard-help.component.html');
    const scss = read('keyboard-help.component.scss');
    expect(html).toContain('shortcut-reference-backdrop backdrop dialog-group');
    expect(html).toContain('shortcut-reference dialog-surface');
    expect(html).toContain('class="dialog-close"');
    expect(scss).toContain('place-items: start center');
    expect(scss).toContain('padding-top: min(8vh, 72px)');
    expect(scss).toContain('background: var(--vsc-scrim-soft)');
    expect(scss).not.toContain('backdrop-filter');
  });

  it('does not advertise Escape as dialog chrome text', () => {
    for (const name of [
      'keyboard-help.component.html',
      'command-palette.component.ts',
      'global-search.component.ts',
      'input-center.component.ts',
      'path-history.component.ts',
      'path-history-viewer.component.ts',
      'operation-journal.component.ts',
      'remote-connect-dialog.component.ts',
      'remote-connections.component.ts',
      'closed-tabs.component.ts',
      'tools-center.component.ts',
      'workspace-switcher.component.ts',
    ]) {
      const source = read(name);
      expect(source).withContext(name).not.toMatch(/Esc(?:ape)?\s+(?:to\s+)?close|Close \(Esc\)/i);
    }
  });
});
`````
