`````typescript
export class FontViewerComponent implements OnChanges, OnDestroy {
  @Input() targetPath = '';
  @Input() archiveContext: ViewerArchiveContext | null = null;
  @Input() viewerId: string | null = null;
  @Input() probe: FileProbe | null = null;

  readonly previewSizes = PREVIEW_SIZES;
  readonly glyphRows = GLYPH_ROWS;

  kind: FontViewerKind = 'empty';
  info: FileInfo | null = null;
  error = '';
  previewSize = 72;
  sampleMode: SampleMode = 'sentence';
  fontStack = "var(--vsc-font-family, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif)";
  mimeLabel = '';
  symbolFont = false;

  private loadId = 0;
  private destroyed = false;
  private activeFontFace: FontFace | null = null;

  constructor(
    private readonly api: ApiService,
    private readonly cdr: ChangeDetectorRef,
  ) {}

  get displayName(): string {
    return buildDisplayName(this.info, this.targetPath, this.archiveContext);
  }

  get displayPath(): string {
    if (this.archiveContext) {
      return `${this.archiveContext.fsPath} :: ${this.archiveContext.entryPath}`;
    }
    return this.targetPath;
  }

  get typeBadge(): string {
    const ext = extractExt(this.archiveContext?.entryPath ?? this.targetPath);
    if (ext) {
      return ext.toUpperCase();
    }
    const mime = (this.probe?.mimeType ?? '').split(';', 1)[0].trim().toLowerCase();
    if (mime.startsWith('font/')) {
      return mime.slice(5).toUpperCase();
    }
    return 'FONT';
  }

  get activeSample(): string {
    switch (this.sampleMode) {
      case 'alphabet':
        return 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz';
      case 'symbols':
        return '0123456789 !@#$%^&*() []{} <>?/\\ +-=_';
      default:
        if (this.symbolFont) {
          return 'ABCDEFGHIJKLM NOPQRSTUVWXYZ 0123456789';
        }
        return 'The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog';
    }
  }

  get subtitleSample(): string {
    switch (this.sampleMode) {
      case 'alphabet':
        return 'Latin alphabet sample';
      case 'symbols':
        return 'Digits and punctuation sample';
      default:
        if (this.symbolFont) {
          return 'Symbol fonts look better with glyph-oriented samples.';
        }
        return 'Слава Україні • Ґґ Єє Її Іі • 1234567890';
    }
  }

  get glyphSize(): number {
    return Math.max(22, Math.round(this.previewSize * 0.42));
  }

  ngOnChanges(): void {
    void this.reload();
  }

  ngOnDestroy(): void {
    this.destroyed = true;
    this.disposeFontFace();
  }

  setPreviewSize(size: number): void {
    this.previewSize = size;
  }

  setSampleMode(mode: SampleMode): void {
    this.sampleMode = mode;
  }

  formatSize(bytes: number): string {
    return formatSize(bytes);
  }

  private async reload(): Promise<void> {
    const path = (this.targetPath ?? '').trim();
    const currentLoad = ++this.loadId;

    this.disposeFontFace();
    this.error = '';
    this.info = null;
    this.mimeLabel = '';
    this.symbolFont = false;

    if (!path && !this.archiveContext) {
      this.kind = 'empty';
      this.cdr.markForCheck();
      return;
    }

    this.kind = 'loading';
    this.cdr.markForCheck();

    try {
      if (this.archiveContext) {
        await this.loadFromArchive(this.archiveContext, currentLoad);
      } else {
        await this.loadFromDisk(path, currentLoad);
      }
    } catch (error) {
      if (this.destroyed || currentLoad !== this.loadId) {
        return;
      }
      this.kind = 'error';
      this.error = error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error);
      this.cdr.markForCheck();
    }
  }

  private async loadFromDisk(path: string, loadId: number): Promise<void> {
    const info = await this.api.getFileInfo(path);
    if (this.destroyed || loadId !== this.loadId) {
      return;
    }

    this.info = info;
    if (info.type === FileType.DIRECTORY) {
      this.kind = 'directory';
      this.cdr.markForCheck();
      return;
    }

    const probe = this.probe ?? await this.api.probeFile(path).catch(() => null);
    if (this.destroyed || loadId !== this.loadId) {
      return;
    }

    this.mimeLabel = this.normalizeMime(probe?.mimeType);
    const streamURL = await this.api.getStreamURL(path);
    const bytes = await this.api.fetchBytesFromURL(streamURL);
    await this.installFont(bytes, baseName(path), loadId);
  }

  private async loadFromArchive(ctx: ViewerArchiveContext, loadId: number): Promise<void> {
    const probe = this.probe ?? await this.api.probeArchiveFile(ctx.fsPath, ctx.nestedChain, ctx.entryPath).catch(() => null);
    if (this.destroyed || loadId !== this.loadId) {
      return;
    }

    const streamURL = await this.api.getArchiveStreamURL(ctx.fsPath, ctx.nestedChain, ctx.entryPath);
    const bytes = await this.api.fetchBytesFromURL(streamURL);
    if (this.destroyed || loadId !== this.loadId) {
      return;
    }

    this.info = makeSyntheticInfo(baseName(ctx.entryPath), ctx.entryPath, bytes.byteLength);
    this.mimeLabel = this.normalizeMime(probe?.mimeType);
    await this.installFont(bytes, baseName(ctx.entryPath), loadId);
  }

  private async installFont(bytes: Uint8Array, sourceName: string, loadId: number): Promise<void> {
    if (!bytes.byteLength) {
      throw new Error('The selected font file is empty.');
    }

    const ext = extractExt(sourceName);
    if (ext === 'fon' || ext === 'fnt') {
      throw new Error('Bitmap .fon/.fnt fonts are not previewable here. Use a TrueType/OpenType font like .ttf or .otf.');
    }
    if (ext && !FONT_EXTENSIONS.has(ext) && !this.mimeLabel.startsWith('font/')) {
      throw new Error('This file does not look like a supported font format.');
    }

    const family = `preview-font-${loadId}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8)}`;
    const fontData = new Uint8Array(bytes.byteLength);
    fontData.set(bytes);
    const fontFace = new FontFace(family, fontData);
    await fontFace.load();

    if (this.destroyed || loadId !== this.loadId) {
      return;
    }

    this.getDocumentFonts().add(fontFace);
    this.activeFontFace = fontFace;
    this.fontStack = `'${family}', var(--vsc-font-family, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif)`;
    this.symbolFont = this.detectSymbolFont(sourceName);
    if (this.symbolFont && this.sampleMode === 'sentence') {
      this.sampleMode = 'symbols';
    }
    this.kind = 'ready';
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
  }

  private disposeFontFace(): void {
    if (this.activeFontFace) {
      this.getDocumentFonts().delete(this.activeFontFace);
      this.activeFontFace = null;
    }
    this.fontStack = "var(--vsc-font-family, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif)";
  }

  private getDocumentFonts(): { add(face: FontFace): void; delete(face: FontFace): void } {
    return document.fonts as FontFaceSet & { add(face: FontFace): void; delete(face: FontFace): void };
  }

  private normalizeMime(mime: string | null | undefined): string {
    return (mime ?? '').split(';', 1)[0].trim().toLowerCase();
  }

  private detectSymbolFont(sourceName: string): boolean {
    const normalized = sourceName.trim().toLowerCase();
    return SYMBOL_FONT_HINTS.some(hint => normalized.includes(hint));
  }
}
`````

`````typescript
export class TextViewerComponent implements OnChanges, OnDestroy {
  @Input() targetPath = '';
  @Input() archiveContext: ViewerArchiveContext | null = null;
  @Input() viewerId: string | null = null;
  @Input() probe: FileProbe | null = null;

  @ViewChild('editorHost')
  set editorHostRef(value: ElementRef<HTMLDivElement> | undefined) {
    this.editorHost = value ?? null;
    if (this.editorHost && this.pendingDocument !== null) {
      void this.mountEditor(this.pendingDocument, this.pendingFilename, this.pendingLoadId);
    }
  }

  kind: TextViewerKind = 'empty';
  info: FileInfo | null = null;
  error = '';
  lineCount: number | null = null;
  wordWrap = false;
  copiedPath = false;

  private editorHost: ElementRef<HTMLDivElement> | null = null;
  private editorView: EditorView | null = null;
  private pendingDocument: string | null = null;
  private pendingFilename = 'untitled.txt';
  private pendingLoadId = 0;
  private destroyed = false;
  private loadId = 0;
  private copyResetTimer: number | null = null;

  private readonly languageCompartment = new Compartment();
  private readonly wrapCompartment = new Compartment();
  private readonly lineNumbersCompartment = new Compartment();
  private readonly foldGutterCompartment = new Compartment();
  private readonly activeLineCompartment = new Compartment();
  private readonly activeLineGutterCompartment = new Compartment();
  private readonly selectionMatchesCompartment = new Compartment();
  private readonly bracketMatchingCompartment = new Compartment();
  private readonly themeCompartment = new Compartment();
  private readonly themeSubscription: { unsubscribe(): void };
  private readonly settingsSubscription: { unsubscribe(): void };
  private currentTheme: Theme;
  private editorSettings: EditorSettings;

  constructor(
    private api: ApiService,
    private cdr: ChangeDetectorRef,
    private themeService: ThemeService,
    private settingsService: SettingsService,
    private renderer: Renderer2,
    private ngZone: NgZone,
  ) {
    this.editorSettings = this.settingsService.getSettings().editor;
    this.wordWrap = this.isWordWrapEnabled(this.editorSettings.wordWrap);
    this.currentTheme = this.themeService.getTheme$().value;
    this.themeSubscription = this.themeService.getTheme$().subscribe((theme: Theme) => {
      this.currentTheme = theme;
      if (this.editorView) {
        this.editorView.dispatch({
          effects: this.themeCompartment.reconfigure(this.resolveThemeExtension(theme)),
        });
      }
    });
    this.settingsSubscription = this.settingsService.getSettings$().subscribe((settings) => {
      this.applyEditorSettings(settings.editor);
    });
  }

  get displayName(): string {
    if (this.info?.name) return this.info.name;
    const source = this.archiveContext?.entryPath ?? this.targetPath;
    return source ? this.baseName(source) : '';
  }

  get displayPath(): string {
    if (this.archiveContext) {
      return `${this.archiveContext.fsPath} :: ${this.archiveContext.entryPath}`;
    }
    return this.targetPath;
  }

  get fileExt(): string {
    return this.extractExt(this.archiveContext?.entryPath ?? this.targetPath);
  }

  get typeBadge(): string {
    if (this.fileExt) return this.fileExt.toUpperCase();
    return 'TEXT';
  }

  ngOnChanges(): void {
    void this.reload();
  }

  ngOnDestroy(): void {
    this.destroyed = true;
    this.themeSubscription.unsubscribe();
    this.settingsSubscription.unsubscribe();
    if (this.copyResetTimer !== null) {
      window.clearTimeout(this.copyResetTimer);
      this.copyResetTimer = null;
    }
    this.editorView?.destroy();
    this.editorView = null;
  }

  toggleWordWrap(): void {
    this.settingsService.updateEditorSettings({ wordWrap: this.wordWrap ? 'off' : 'on' });
  }

  async openExternally(): Promise<void> {
    if (!this.targetPath || this.archiveContext) return;
    await this.api.openFile(this.targetPath);
  }

  openSearch(): void {
    if (!this.editorView) return;
    this.editorView.focus();
    openSearchPanel(this.editorView);
  }

  openGoToLine(): void {
    if (!this.editorView) return;
    this.editorView.focus();
    gotoLine(this.editorView);
  }

  async copyPath(): Promise<void> {
    const path = this.displayPath?.trim();
    if (!path) return;

    await navigator.clipboard.writeText(path).catch(() => {});
    this.copiedPath = true;
    if (this.copyResetTimer !== null) {
      window.clearTimeout(this.copyResetTimer);
    }
    this.copyResetTimer = window.setTimeout(() => {
      this.copiedPath = false;
      this.copyResetTimer = null;
      this.cdr.markForCheck();
    }, 1200);
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
  }

  formatSize(bytes: number): string {
    if (!bytes || bytes <= 0) return '';
    const units = ['B', 'KB', 'MB', 'GB'];
    const i = Math.min(Math.floor(Math.log(bytes) / Math.log(1024)), units.length - 1);
    const value = bytes / Math.pow(1024, i);
    return `${i === 0 ? value : value.toFixed(1)} ${units[i]}`;
  }

  private async reload(): Promise<void> {
    const path = (this.targetPath ?? '').trim();
    const currentLoad = ++this.loadId;

    this.error = '';
    this.info = null;
    this.lineCount = null;
    this.pendingDocument = null;

    if (!path && !this.archiveContext) {
      this.kind = 'empty';
      this.editorView?.destroy();
      this.editorView = null;
      this.cdr.markForCheck();
      return;
    }

    this.kind = 'loading';
    this.cdr.markForCheck();

    try {
      const result = this.archiveContext
        ? await this.loadFromArchive(this.archiveContext)
        : await this.loadFromDisk(path);

      if (this.destroyed || currentLoad !== this.loadId) return;

      if (result.kind === 'directory') {
        this.kind = 'directory';
        this.editorView?.destroy();
        this.editorView = null;
        this.cdr.markForCheck();
        return;
      }

      this.lineCount = result.text.split(/\r?\n/).length;
      this.pendingDocument = result.text;
      this.pendingFilename = result.filename;
      this.pendingLoadId = currentLoad;
      this.kind = 'editor';
      this.cdr.markForCheck();

      if (this.editorHost) {
        await this.mountEditor(result.text, result.filename, currentLoad);
      }
    } catch (error) {
      if (this.destroyed || currentLoad !== this.loadId) return;
      this.kind = 'error';
      this.error = error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error);
      this.editorView?.destroy();
      this.editorView = null;
      this.cdr.markForCheck();
    }
  }

  private async loadFromDisk(path: string): Promise<{ kind: 'editor' | 'directory'; text: string; filename: string }> {
    const info = await this.api.getFileInfo(path);
    this.info = info;

    if (info.type === FileType.DIRECTORY) {
      return { kind: 'directory', text: '', filename: info.name };
    }

    const encoding = this.normalizeEncoding(this.probe?.encoding ?? '');
    const streamURL = await this.api.getStreamURL(path);
    const file = await this.api.fetchTextFromURL(streamURL, encoding);

    return {
      kind: 'editor',
      text: file.content,
      filename: info.name || this.baseName(path),
    };
  }

  private async loadFromArchive(ctx: ViewerArchiveContext): Promise<{ kind: 'editor'; text: string; filename: string }> {
    const encoding = this.normalizeEncoding(this.probe?.encoding ?? '');
    const streamURL = await this.api.getArchiveStreamURL(ctx.fsPath, ctx.nestedChain, ctx.entryPath);
    const response = await this.api.fetchTextFromURL(streamURL, encoding);

    const entryName = this.baseName(ctx.entryPath);
    this.info = {
      name: entryName,
      path: ctx.entryPath,
      type: FileType.FILE,
      size: response.size,
      created: 0,
      modified: 0,
      accessed: 0,
      permissions: '',
      isHidden: false,
    };

    return {
      kind: 'editor',
      text: response.content,
      filename: entryName,
    };
  }

  private async mountEditor(text: string, filename: string, loadId: number): Promise<void> {
    if (!this.editorHost || this.destroyed || loadId !== this.loadId) return;

    const host = this.editorHost.nativeElement;
    const languageExtension = await this.resolveLanguage(filename);
    if (!this.editorHost || this.destroyed || loadId !== this.loadId) return;

    const extensions = [
      this.lineNumbersCompartment.of(this.editorSettings.showLineNumbers ? lineNumbers() : []),
      this.activeLineGutterCompartment.of(this.editorSettings.highlightCurrentLine ? highlightActiveLineGutter() : []),
      highlightSpecialChars(),
      history(),
      this.foldGutterCompartment.of(this.editorSettings.codeFolding ? foldGutter({ markerDOM: createFoldMarker }) : []),
      drawSelection(),
      syntaxHighlighting(classHighlighter),
      this.bracketMatchingCompartment.of(this.editorSettings.matchBrackets === 'never' ? [] : bracketMatching()),
      this.activeLineCompartment.of(this.editorSettings.highlightCurrentLine ? highlightActiveLine() : []),
      this.selectionMatchesCompartment.of(this.editorSettings.occurrencesHighlight ? highlightSelectionMatches() : []),
      this.themeCompartment.of(this.resolveThemeExtension(this.currentTheme)),
      EditorState.readOnly.of(true),
      EditorView.editable.of(false),
      keymap.of([...defaultKeymap, ...historyKeymap, ...foldKeymap, ...searchKeymap]),
      this.wrapCompartment.of(this.isWordWrapEnabled(this.editorSettings.wordWrap) ? EditorView.lineWrapping : []),
      this.languageCompartment.of(languageExtension ?? []),
    ];

    if (!this.editorView) {
      this.editorView = new EditorView({
        state: EditorState.create({ doc: text, extensions }),
        parent: host,
      });
      this.attachEditorScrollbar();
      return;
    }

    this.editorView.setState(EditorState.create({ doc: text, extensions }));
    this.attachEditorScrollbar();
  }

  private attachEditorScrollbar(): void {
    if (!this.editorView) return;

    const editorRoot = this.editorView.dom;
    const scrollHost = editorRoot.querySelector<HTMLElement>('.cm-scroller');
    if (!scrollHost) return;
  }

  private async resolveLanguage(filename: string): Promise<any[] | null> {
    const match = LanguageDescription.matchFilename(languages, filename);
    if (!match) return null;

    try {
      const support = await match.load();
      return [support];
    } catch {
      return null;
    }
  }

  private normalizeEncoding(raw: string): string {
    const encoding = (raw ?? '').trim().toLowerCase();
    if (!encoding || encoding === 'utf-8') return '';
    if (encoding === 'utf16' || encoding === 'utf-16') return 'utf16le';
    return encoding;
  }

  private resolveThemeExtension(theme: Theme) {
    return createCodePreviewTheme(theme === 'dark', this.editorSettings);
  }

  private applyEditorSettings(settings: EditorSettings): void {
    this.editorSettings = settings;
    this.wordWrap = this.isWordWrapEnabled(settings.wordWrap);

    if (this.editorView) {
      this.editorView.dispatch({
        effects: [
          this.lineNumbersCompartment.reconfigure(settings.showLineNumbers ? lineNumbers() : []),
          this.foldGutterCompartment.reconfigure(settings.codeFolding ? foldGutter({ markerDOM: createFoldMarker }) : []),
          this.activeLineCompartment.reconfigure(settings.highlightCurrentLine ? highlightActiveLine() : []),
          this.activeLineGutterCompartment.reconfigure(settings.highlightCurrentLine ? highlightActiveLineGutter() : []),
          this.selectionMatchesCompartment.reconfigure(settings.occurrencesHighlight ? highlightSelectionMatches() : []),
          this.bracketMatchingCompartment.reconfigure(settings.matchBrackets === 'never' ? [] : bracketMatching()),
          this.wrapCompartment.reconfigure(this.wordWrap ? EditorView.lineWrapping : []),
          this.themeCompartment.reconfigure(this.resolveThemeExtension(this.currentTheme)),
        ],
      });
    }

    this.cdr.markForCheck();
  }

  private isWordWrapEnabled(wordWrap: EditorSettings['wordWrap']): boolean {
    return wordWrap !== 'off';
  }

  private baseName(path: string): string {
    return path.replace(/\\/g, '/').split('/').pop() || path;
  }

  private extractExt(path: string): string {
    const normalized = path.replace(/\\/g, '/');
    const base = normalized.split('/').pop() || normalized;
    if (base.toLowerCase() === 'dockerfile') return 'dockerfile';
    if (base.startsWith('.')) return base.slice(1).toLowerCase();
    const index = base.lastIndexOf('.');
    return index >= 0 ? base.slice(index + 1).toLowerCase() : '';
  }
}
`````

`````typescript
    .controls-row {

    }

    .control-btn {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      min-width: 36px;
      height: 36px;
      padding: 0 8px;
      background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--vsc-foreground) 10%, transparent);
      border: 1px solid var(--vsc-neutral-overlay-medium);
      color: var(--vsc-on-accent);
      border-radius: 6px;
      cursor: pointer;
      font-size: 16px;
      transition: all 0.2s ease;
      font-weight: 600;
      backdrop-filter: blur(4px);
    }

    .control-btn:hover:not(:disabled) {

    .control-btn:disabled {

    .control-btn .icon {

    .play-pause-btn {

    .time-display {

      color: var(--vsc-foreground);
      font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;

    .spacer {

    .volume-control {

      align-items: center;

    }

    .volume-icon {

    }

    .volume-slider {

      border-radius: 50%;

    }

    .volume-slider::-moz-range-thumb {
      width: 10px;
      height: 10px;
      background: var(--vsc-document-canvas-background);

      border-radius: 50%;
      cursor: pointer;

    @media (max-width: 768px) {
      .video-nav-hotspot {

  `, VIEWER_PRODUCTION_CHROME_STYLES],
})
export class VideoViewerComponent implements OnChanges, AfterViewInit, OnDestroy {
  private static readonly WINDOWED_VIDEO_STREAM_SECONDS = 90;
  private static readonly AMBIGUOUS_VIDEO_EXTENSIONS = new Set(['ts']);
  private static readonly VIDEO_EXTENSIONS = new Set([
    'mp4', 'm4v', 'mov', 'qt', 'avi', 'divx', 'xvid', 'mkv', 'wmv', 'asf', 'flv', 'f4v',
    'webm', 'ogv', 'ts', 'mts', 'm2ts', 'mpg', 'mpeg', 'mpe', 'mpv', 'mp2', 'm2p', 'm2v',
    'vob', 'evo', 'mjpeg', 'mjpg', '3gp', '3g2', 'rm', 'rmvb',
  ]);

  @Input() targetPath = '';
  @Input() fileList: ViewerFileListItem[] = [];
  @Input() archiveContext: ViewerArchiveContext | null = null;
  @Input() viewerId: string | null = null;
  @Input() probe: FileProbe | null = null;

  @ViewChild('videoContainer')
  set videoContainerRef(value: ElementRef<HTMLDivElement> | undefined) {
    this._videoContainerRef = value;
    this.requestSegmentedPlaybackInitialization();
    this.requestUrlPlaybackInitialization();
  }

  get videoContainerRef(): ElementRef<HTMLDivElement> | undefined {
    return this._videoContainerRef;
  }

  useLegacySurface = false;
  loading = false;
  error: string | null = null;
  canvasPlayer: CanvasVideoPlayer | null = null;
  videoReady = false;
  videoIsPlaying = false;
  videoLoading = false;
  videoShowControls = true;
  videoCurrentTime = 0;
  videoDuration = 0;
  videoCodecInfo = '';
  videoResolution = '';
  videoVolume = 100;
  videoIsSeeking = false;
  videoSeekTarget = 0;
  fileSize = 0;
  previousVideo: VideoNavItem | null = null;
  nextVideo: VideoNavItem | null = null;

  private pendingManifestUrl: string | null = null;
  private pendingStreamUrl: string | null = null;
  private _videoContainerRef?: ElementRef<HTMLDivElement>;
  private initializingManifestUrl: string | null = null;
  private seekGeneration = 0;
  private initializingStreamUrl: string | null = null;
  private currentStreamUrl: string | null = null;
  private loadingStreamUrl: string | null = null;
  private videoTimelineOffsetSeconds = 0;
  private videoControlsTimeout: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null = null;
  private seekDragActive = false;
  private seekPending = false;
  private seekOriginSeconds = 0;
  private seekRequestGeneration = 0;
  private navThumbnailGeneration = 0;
  private initGeneration = 0;
  private playerSubscriptions: Unsubscribable[] = [];
  playbackMode = '';

  constructor(
    private readonly api: ApiService,
    private readonly cdr: ChangeDetectorRef,
    private readonly videoPlayerService: CanvasVideoPlayerService,
    private readonly workspaceService: WorkspaceService,
  ) { }

  get displayName(): string {
    const normalized = (this.targetPath ?? '').replace(/\\/g, '/');
    return normalized.split('/').pop() ?? normalized;
  }

  get typeBadge(): string {
    const ext = (this.targetPath.split('.').pop() ?? 'video').toUpperCase();
    return ext || 'VIDEO';
  }

  get displayedCurrentTime(): number {
    return this.seekDragActive ? this.videoSeekTarget : this.videoCurrentTime;
  }

  ngAfterViewInit(): void {
    this.requestSegmentedPlaybackInitialization();
    this.requestUrlPlaybackInitialization();
  }

  async ngOnChanges(): Promise<void> {
    this.resetState();

    const path = (this.targetPath ?? '').trim();
    if (!path && !this.archiveContext) {
      this.previousVideo = null;
      this.nextVideo = null;
      this.useLegacySurface = true;
      this.cdr.markForCheck();
      return;
    }

    await this.refreshSiblingNavigation();

    this.loading = true;
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
    try {
      let rawPlan: any;
      if (this.archiveContext) {
        rawPlan = await this.api.getArchiveVideoPlaybackPlan(
          this.archiveContext.fsPath,
          this.archiveContext.nestedChain,
          this.archiveContext.entryPath,
        );
      } else {
        const info = await this.api.getFileInfo(path);
        this.fileSize = info.size ?? 0;
        rawPlan = await this.api.getVideoPlaybackPlan(path);
      }
      const mode = String(rawPlan?.mode ?? rawPlan?.Mode ?? '').toLowerCase();
      const url = String(rawPlan?.url ?? rawPlan?.URL ?? '');
      this.playbackMode = mode || 'video';
      if (!url) {
        this.useLegacySurface = true;
      } else if (mode === 'segmented') {
        this.pendingManifestUrl = url;
        this.requestSegmentedPlaybackInitialization();
      } else {
        this.pendingStreamUrl = url;
        this.requestUrlPlaybackInitialization();
      }
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      this.error = err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err);
    } finally {
      this.loading = false;
      this.cdr.markForCheck();
    }
  }

  ngOnDestroy(): void {
    this.clearPlayerSubscriptions();
    if (this.canvasPlayer) {
      this.canvasPlayer.destroy();
      this.canvasPlayer = null;
    }
    if (this.videoControlsTimeout) {
      clearTimeout(this.videoControlsTimeout);
      this.videoControlsTimeout = null;
    }
  }

  async videoPlayPause(): Promise<void> {
    if (!this.canvasPlayer) {
      return;
    }

    try {
      if (this.videoIsPlaying) {
        this.canvasPlayer.pause();
      } else {
        this.videoLoading = true;
        this.cdr.markForCheck();
        await this.canvasPlayer.play();
        this.videoLoading = false;
      }
      this.cdr.markForCheck();
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      this.error = err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Playback error';
      this.videoLoading = false;
      this.cdr.markForCheck();
    }
  }

  onVideoSeekStart(): void {
    if (!this.videoReady) {
      return;
    }
    this.seekDragActive = true;
    if (!this.videoLoading) {
      this.seekOriginSeconds = this.videoCurrentTime;
    }
    this.updateVideoSeekingState();
    this.videoSeekTarget = this.videoCurrentTime;
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
  }

  onVideoSeekInput(event: Event): void {
    if (!this.videoReady) {
      return;
    }
    const seekSeconds = parseFloat((event.target as HTMLInputElement).value);
    this.videoSeekTarget = seekSeconds;
    this.videoCurrentTime = seekSeconds;
    this.updateVideoSeekingState();
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
  }

  onVideoSeekCommit(event: Event): void {
    if (!this.videoReady) {
      return;
    }

    const seekSeconds = parseFloat((event.target as HTMLInputElement).value);
    this.seekDragActive = false;
    this.videoSeekTarget = seekSeconds;
    this.videoCurrentTime = seekSeconds;

    const isBackwardSeek = seekSeconds < this.videoCurrentTime;
    if (isBackwardSeek && this.canvasPlayer) {
      // Try to show buffered frame immediately for backward seek
      const currentFrame = this.canvasPlayer['findBufferedFrameForTime']?.(seekSeconds * 1000);
      if (currentFrame) {
        // Visual feedback already provided by displayedCurrentTime
      }
    }

    void this.performSeek(seekSeconds);
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
  }

  private async performSeek(seekSeconds: number): Promise<void> {
    if (!this.canvasPlayer || !this.videoReady) {
      return;
    }

    const generation = ++this.seekRequestGeneration;
    const shouldResumePlayback = this.canvasPlayer.isPlaying() || this.videoIsPlaying;
    const currentTimeMs = this.videoCurrentTime * 1000;
    const targetTimeMs = seekSeconds * 1000;
    const isSeekingBackward = targetTimeMs < currentTimeMs;

    const needsRestart = this.shouldRestartStreamOnSeek(seekSeconds) && !isSeekingBackward;

    this.seekPending = true;
    this.videoLoading = needsRestart;
    this.updateVideoSeekingState();
    this.cdr.markForCheck();

    try {
      if (needsRestart) {
        await this.restartVideoAt(seekSeconds, { autoplay: shouldResumePlayback, generation });
      } else {
        const playerSeekSeconds = this.shouldUseWindowedVideoStreaming()
          ? Math.max(0, seekSeconds - this.videoTimelineOffsetSeconds)
          : seekSeconds;
        await this.canvasPlayer.seek(playerSeekSeconds * 1000);
      }
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      if (generation === this.seekRequestGeneration) {
        this.error = err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Seek failed';
      }
    } finally {
      if (generation === this.seekRequestGeneration) {
        this.seekPending = false;
        if (!needsRestart) {
          this.videoLoading = false;
        }
        this.updateVideoSeekingState();
        this.cdr.markForCheck();
      }
    }
  }

  private updateVideoSeekingState(): void {
    this.videoIsSeeking = this.seekDragActive || this.seekPending || this.videoLoading;
  }

  private shouldUseWindowedVideoStreaming(): boolean {
    return this.playbackMode === 'transcode';
  }

  private shouldRestartStreamOnSeek(seekSeconds: number): boolean {
    if (!this.shouldUseWindowedVideoStreaming()) {
      return false;
    }

    const windowStart = this.videoTimelineOffsetSeconds;
    const windowEnd = windowStart + VideoViewerComponent.WINDOWED_VIDEO_STREAM_SECONDS;
    const isSeekingBackward = seekSeconds < this.videoCurrentTime;

    if (isSeekingBackward) {
      const seekDistance = this.videoCurrentTime - seekSeconds;
      if (seekDistance <= 30) {
        return false;
      }
    }

    return seekSeconds < windowStart || seekSeconds >= windowEnd;
  }

  private buildSeekUrl(startSeconds: number): string | null {
    const sourceUrl = this.pendingStreamUrl;
    if (!sourceUrl) {
      return null;
    }

    try {
      const resolved = new URL(sourceUrl, window.location.href);
      if (startSeconds > 0) {
        resolved.searchParams.set('start', startSeconds.toFixed(3));
      } else {
        resolved.searchParams.delete('start');
      }
      resolved.searchParams.set('window', VideoViewerComponent.WINDOWED_VIDEO_STREAM_SECONDS.toFixed(3));
      return resolved.toString();
    } catch {
      return sourceUrl;
    }
  }

  private parseVideoStartOffsetSeconds(url: string): number {
    try {
      const resolved = new URL(url, window.location.href);
      const rawStart = Number(resolved.searchParams.get('start') ?? '0');
      return Number.isFinite(rawStart) && rawStart > 0 ? rawStart : 0;
    } catch {
      return 0;
    }
  }

  private async restartVideoAt(seekSeconds: number, options?: { autoplay?: boolean; generation?: number }): Promise<void> {
    if (!this.canvasPlayer) {
      return;
    }

    const nextUrl = this.buildSeekUrl(seekSeconds);
    if (!nextUrl) {
      return;
    }
    if (this.loadingStreamUrl === nextUrl) {
      return;
    }

    const shouldResumePlayback = options?.autoplay ?? this.canvasPlayer.isPlaying();
    this.error = null;
    this.videoLoading = true;
    this.loadingStreamUrl = nextUrl;
    this.videoTimelineOffsetSeconds = seekSeconds;
    this.videoCurrentTime = seekSeconds;
    this.videoSeekTarget = seekSeconds;
    this.cdr.markForCheck();

    try {
      await this.canvasPlayer.loadFromUrl(nextUrl);
      if (options?.generation === undefined || options.generation === this.seekRequestGeneration) {
        this.currentStreamUrl = nextUrl;
        this.videoReady = true;
      }
      if (shouldResumePlayback && (options?.generation === undefined || options.generation === this.seekRequestGeneration)) {
        await this.canvasPlayer.play();
      }
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      if (options?.generation === undefined || options.generation === this.seekRequestGeneration) {
        this.error = err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Seek failed';
      }
    } finally {
      if (this.loadingStreamUrl === nextUrl) {
        this.loadingStreamUrl = null;
      }
      if (options?.generation === undefined || options.generation === this.seekRequestGeneration) {
        this.videoLoading = false;
        this.cdr.markForCheck();
      }
    }
  }

  onVideoVolumeChange(event: Event): void {
    const nextVolume = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, Number((event.target as HTMLInputElement).value)));
    this.videoVolume = nextVolume;
    this.canvasPlayer?.setVolume(nextVolume / 100);
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
  }

  onVideoMouseMove(): void {
    this.videoShowControls = true;
    if (this.videoControlsTimeout) {
      clearTimeout(this.videoControlsTimeout);
    }
    if (this.videoIsPlaying) {
      this.videoControlsTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
        this.videoShowControls = false;
        this.cdr.markForCheck();
      }, 3000);
    }
  }

  onVideoMouseLeave(): void {
    if (!this.videoIsPlaying) {
      return;
    }
    this.videoShowControls = false;
    if (this.videoControlsTimeout) {
      clearTimeout(this.videoControlsTimeout);
      this.videoControlsTimeout = null;
    }
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
  }

  formatTime(seconds: number): string {
    if (!seconds || seconds < 0) {
      return '0:00';
    }
    const totalSecs = Math.floor(seconds);
    const mins = Math.floor(totalSecs / 60);
    const secs = totalSecs % 60;
    const hours = Math.floor(mins / 60);
    const displayMins = mins % 60;
    if (hours > 0) {
      return `${hours}:${displayMins.toString().padStart(2, '0')}:${secs.toString().padStart(2, '0')}`;
    }
    return `${displayMins}:${secs.toString().padStart(2, '0')}`;
  }

  formatSize(bytes: number): string {
    if (!bytes || bytes <= 0) {
      return '';
    }
    const units = ['B', 'KB', 'MB', 'GB'];
    const unitIndex = Math.min(Math.floor(Math.log(bytes) / Math.log(1024)), units.length - 1);
    const value = bytes / Math.pow(1024, unitIndex);
    return `${unitIndex === 0 ? value : value.toFixed(1)} ${units[unitIndex]}`;
  }

  thumbnailFallback(name: string): string {
    const source = (name ?? '').trim();
    const first = source.charAt(0).toUpperCase();
    return first || 'V';
  }

  navigateToSibling(item: VideoNavItem, event?: Event): void {
    event?.preventDefault();
    event?.stopPropagation();
    if (!item.path || this.archiveContext) {
      return;
    }

    const workspace = this.workspaceService.getActiveWorkspace();
    if (!workspace) {
      return;
    }

    const current = this.findViewerTab(workspace, this.targetPath);
    if (!current) {
      return;
    }

    this.workspaceService.updateViewerTabTargetPath(current.paneId, current.tab.id, item.path, {
      sourcePane: current.tab.viewer?.sourcePane ?? current.paneId,
      sourceTabId: current.tab.viewer?.sourceTabId ?? '',
      sourceDir: current.tab.viewer?.sourceDir ?? '',
      fileList: this.fileList,
    });
  }

  private async createAndAttachCanvasPlayer(generation: number): Promise<CanvasVideoPlayer> {
    if (!this.videoContainerRef?.nativeElement) {
      throw new Error('Video container is not available.');
    }
    this.clearPlayerSubscriptions();
    if (this.canvasPlayer) {
      this.canvasPlayer.destroy();
      this.canvasPlayer = null;
    }
    const player = await this.videoPlayerService.createPlayer(this.videoContainerRef.nativeElement);
    this.canvasPlayer = player;
    player.setVolume(this.videoVolume / 100);
    this.playerSubscriptions.push(player.stateChanged$.subscribe((state) => {
      if (generation !== this.initGeneration || this.canvasPlayer !== player) return;
      this.videoIsPlaying = state === 'playing';
      if (state !== 'playing') {
        this.videoShowControls = true;
      }
      this.cdr.markForCheck();
    }));
    this.playerSubscriptions.push(player.metadataReady$.subscribe((metadata: VideoMetadata) => {
      if (generation !== this.initGeneration || this.canvasPlayer !== player) return;
      this.videoDuration = this.shouldUseWindowedVideoStreaming()
        ? Math.max(this.videoDuration, this.videoTimelineOffsetSeconds + metadata.duration / 1000)
        : metadata.duration / 1000;
      this.videoCodecInfo = metadata.videoCodec || '';
      this.videoResolution = `${metadata.width}\u00d7${metadata.height}`;
      this.cdr.markForCheck();
    }));
    this.playerSubscriptions.push(player.currentTime$.subscribe((seconds: number) => {
      if (generation !== this.initGeneration || this.canvasPlayer !== player) return;
      if (this.seekDragActive) {
        return;
      }
      this.videoCurrentTime = this.shouldUseWindowedVideoStreaming()
        ? this.videoTimelineOffsetSeconds + seconds
        : seconds;
      this.cdr.markForCheck();
    }));
    this.playerSubscriptions.push(player.error$.subscribe((message: string) => {
      if (generation !== this.initGeneration || this.canvasPlayer !== player) return;
      this.error = message;
      this.videoLoading = false;
      this.cdr.markForCheck();
    }));
    return player;
  }

  private async initializeSegmentedPlayback(manifestUrl: string, generation: number): Promise<void> {
    if (generation !== this.initGeneration) return;
    if (!this.videoContainerRef?.nativeElement) {
      return;
    }
    this.videoLoading = true;
    this.error = null;
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
    const loader = new SegmentVideoLoader();
    const source = await loader.load(manifestUrl);
    if (generation !== this.initGeneration) return;
    const player = await this.createAndAttachCanvasPlayer(generation);
    if (generation !== this.initGeneration || this.canvasPlayer !== player) return;
    await player.loadFromDemuxedSource(source);
    if (generation !== this.initGeneration || this.canvasPlayer !== player) return;
    this.videoReady = true;
    try {
      await player.play();
    } catch {
      // Ignore autoplay errors; user can manually start playback
    }
    this.videoLoading = false;
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
  }

  private async initializeUrlPlayback(streamUrl: string, generation: number): Promise<void> {
    if (generation !== this.initGeneration) return;
    if (!this.videoContainerRef?.nativeElement) {
      return;
    }
    this.videoLoading = true;
    this.loadingStreamUrl = streamUrl;
    this.videoTimelineOffsetSeconds = this.parseVideoStartOffsetSeconds(streamUrl);
    this.error = null;
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
    const player = await this.createAndAttachCanvasPlayer(generation);
    try {
      if (generation !== this.initGeneration || this.canvasPlayer !== player) return;
      await player.loadFromUrl(streamUrl);
      if (generation !== this.initGeneration || this.canvasPlayer !== player) return;
      this.currentStreamUrl = streamUrl;
      this.videoReady = true;
      try {
        await player.play();
      } catch {
        // Ignore autoplay errors
      }
    } finally {
      if (this.loadingStreamUrl === streamUrl) {
        this.loadingStreamUrl = null;
      }
      this.videoLoading = false;
      this.cdr.markForCheck();
    }
  }

  private requestSegmentedPlaybackInitialization(): void {
    const manifestUrl = this.pendingManifestUrl;
    if (!manifestUrl || this.useLegacySurface || !this.videoContainerRef?.nativeElement) {
      return;
    }
    if (this.initializingManifestUrl === manifestUrl || this.canvasPlayer) {
      return;
    }

    this.initializingManifestUrl = manifestUrl;
    const generation = this.initGeneration;
    void this.initializeSegmentedPlayback(manifestUrl, generation)
      .catch((err: unknown) => {
        if (generation !== this.initGeneration) return;
        this.error = err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err);
        this.videoLoading = false;
        this.cdr.markForCheck();
      })
      .finally(() => {
        if (this.initializingManifestUrl === manifestUrl) {
          this.initializingManifestUrl = null;
        }
      });
  }

  private requestUrlPlaybackInitialization(): void {
    const streamUrl = this.pendingStreamUrl;
    if (!streamUrl || this.useLegacySurface || !this.videoContainerRef?.nativeElement) {
      return;
    }
    if (this.initializingStreamUrl === streamUrl || this.canvasPlayer) {
      return;
    }

    this.initializingStreamUrl = streamUrl;
    const generation = this.initGeneration;
    void this.initializeUrlPlayback(streamUrl, generation)
      .catch((err: unknown) => {
        if (generation !== this.initGeneration) return;
        this.error = err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err);
        this.videoLoading = false;
        this.cdr.markForCheck();
      })
      .finally(() => {
        if (this.initializingStreamUrl === streamUrl) {
          this.initializingStreamUrl = null;
        }
      });
  }

  private resetState(): void {
    this.initGeneration += 1;
    this.useLegacySurface = false;
    this.loading = false;
    this.error = null;
    this.pendingManifestUrl = null;
    this.pendingStreamUrl = null;
    this.initializingManifestUrl = null;
    this.initializingStreamUrl = null;
    this.currentStreamUrl = null;
    this.loadingStreamUrl = null;
    this.playbackMode = '';
    this.fileSize = 0;
    this.videoReady = false;
    this.videoIsPlaying = false;
    this.videoLoading = false;
    this.videoShowControls = true;
    this.videoCurrentTime = 0;
    this.videoDuration = 0;
    this.videoTimelineOffsetSeconds = 0;
    this.videoCodecInfo = '';
    this.videoResolution = '';
    this.videoIsSeeking = false;
    this.videoSeekTarget = 0;
    this.seekPending = false;
    this.seekOriginSeconds = 0;
    this.seekRequestGeneration = 0;
    this.seekGeneration++;
    this.clearPlayerSubscriptions();
    if (this.canvasPlayer) {
      this.canvasPlayer.destroy();
      this.canvasPlayer = null;
    }
  }

  private clearPlayerSubscriptions(): void {
    for (const sub of this.playerSubscriptions) {
      try {
        sub.unsubscribe();
      } catch {
        // no-op
      }
    }
    this.playerSubscriptions = [];
  }

  private async refreshSiblingNavigation(): Promise<void> {
    const generation = ++this.navThumbnailGeneration;
    this.previousVideo = null;
    this.nextVideo = null;
    this.cdr.markForCheck();

    if (this.archiveContext) {
      return;
    }

    let siblings = await this.buildVideoNavItems(this.fileList, generation);

    if (!siblings.length && this.targetPath) {
      siblings = await this.loadSiblingVideosFromDirectory(generation);
    }

    if (!siblings.length) {
      return;
    }

    const currentIndex = siblings.findIndex(item => this.samePath(item.path, this.targetPath));
    if (currentIndex < 0) {
      return;
    }

    this.previousVideo = currentIndex > 0 ? siblings[currentIndex - 1] : null;
    this.nextVideo = currentIndex < siblings.length - 1 ? siblings[currentIndex + 1] : null;
    this.cdr.markForCheck();

    void this.hydrateNavThumbnail(this.previousVideo, generation);
    void this.hydrateNavThumbnail(this.nextVideo, generation);
  }

  private async loadSiblingVideosFromDirectory(generation: number): Promise<VideoNavItem[]> {
    try {
      const parentPath = await this.api.getParentPath(this.targetPath);
      if (!parentPath || generation !== this.navThumbnailGeneration) {
        return [];
      }

      const listing = await this.api.listDirectory(parentPath, false);
      if (generation !== this.navThumbnailGeneration) {
        return [];
      }

      return await this.buildVideoNavItems((listing.entries ?? []).map(entry => ({
          path: entry.path,
          name: entry.name || this.baseName(entry.path),
        })), generation);
    } catch {
      return [];
    }
  }

  private async buildVideoNavItems(items: Array<{ path: string; name: string }>, generation: number): Promise<VideoNavItem[]> {
    const resolved = await Promise.all(items.map(async item => {
      if (!item.path || generation !== this.navThumbnailGeneration) {
        return null;
      }
      return await this.isVideoNavCandidate(item.path)
        ? this.makeNavItem(item)
        : null;
    }));

    if (generation !== this.navThumbnailGeneration) {
      return [];
    }

    return resolved.filter((item): item is VideoNavItem => !!item);
  }

  private makeNavItem(item: ViewerFileListItem): VideoNavItem {
    return {
      path: item.path,
      name: item.name || this.baseName(item.path),
      thumbSrc: null,
      thumbLoading: false,
      thumbFailed: false,
    };
  }

  private async hydrateNavThumbnail(item: VideoNavItem | null, generation: number): Promise<void> {
    if (!item || item.thumbLoading || item.thumbSrc || item.thumbFailed) {
      return;
    }

    item.thumbLoading = true;
    try {
      if (generation !== this.navThumbnailGeneration) {
        return;
      }
      item.thumbSrc = await this.api.getVideoPreviewURL(item.path);
      item.thumbFailed = !item.thumbSrc;
    } catch {
      item.thumbFailed = true;
      item.thumbSrc = null;
    } finally {
      item.thumbLoading = false;
      if (generation === this.navThumbnailGeneration) {
        this.cdr.markForCheck();
      }
    }
  }

  private isVideoPath(path: string): boolean {
    return VideoViewerComponent.VIDEO_EXTENSIONS.has(this.extractExt(path));
  }

  private async isVideoNavCandidate(path: string): Promise<boolean> {
    const ext = this.extractExt(path);
    if (!VideoViewerComponent.VIDEO_EXTENSIONS.has(ext)) {
      return false;
    }

    if (!VideoViewerComponent.AMBIGUOUS_VIDEO_EXTENSIONS.has(ext)) {
      return true;
    }

    try {
      const probe = this.samePath(path, this.targetPath) && this.probe
        ? this.probe
        : await this.api.probeFile(path);
      const mime = (probe?.mimeType ?? '').toLowerCase();
      return mime.startsWith('video/') || mime === 'application/mp2t';
    } catch {
      return false;
    }
  }

  private extractExt(path: string): string {
    const normalized = (path ?? '').replace(/\\/g, '/');
    const idx = normalized.lastIndexOf('.');
    return idx >= 0 ? normalized.slice(idx + 1).toLowerCase() : '';
  }

  private baseName(path: string): string {
    const normalized = (path ?? '').replace(/\\/g, '/');
    return normalized.split('/').pop() ?? normalized;
  }

  private samePath(left: string, right: string): boolean {
    return left.trim().replace(/\\/g, '/').toLowerCase() === right.trim().replace(/\\/g, '/').toLowerCase();
  }

  private findViewerTab(workspace: ReturnType<WorkspaceService['getActiveWorkspace']>, targetPath: string): { paneId: 'left' | 'right'; tab: NonNullable<typeof workspace>['leftPane']['tabs'][number] } | null {
    if (!workspace) {
      return null;
    }

    const leftTab = workspace.leftPane.tabs.find(tab =>
      (tab.kind ?? 'dir') === 'viewer' && this.samePath(tab.viewer?.targetPath ?? '', targetPath)
    );
    if (leftTab) {
      return { paneId: 'left', tab: leftTab };
    }

    const rightTab = workspace.rightPane.tabs.find(tab =>
      (tab.kind ?? 'dir') === 'viewer' && this.samePath(tab.viewer?.targetPath ?? '', targetPath)
    );
    if (rightTab) {
      return { paneId: 'right', tab: rightTab };
    }

    return null;
  }
}
`````

## File: manager/internal/batch/service.go
`````go
package batch

import (
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"

	"github.com/mholt/archiver/v3"

	contracts "wails-app/internal/contracts"
	internalops "wails-app/internal/ops"
)

type ConflictPrompter interface {
	PromptConflict(event contracts.ConflictEvent)
}

type ConflictPrompterFunc func(event contracts.ConflictEvent)

func (fn ConflictPrompterFunc) PromptConflict(event contracts.ConflictEvent) {
	if fn != nil {
		fn(event)
	}
}

type ServiceConfig struct {
	StartOperation                 func(kind contracts.OperationType, title, source, dest string) *internalops.ActiveOperation
	ConflictPrompter               ConflictPrompter
	BatchErr                       func(source, destination string, err error) contracts.BatchItemError
	IsPermissionDenied             func(error) bool
	ShouldRetryDeleteWithElevation func(error) bool
	RunElevatedCopy                func(src, dst string, recursive bool) (bool, error)
	RunElevatedMove                func(src, dst string) (bool, error)
	RunElevatedDelete              func(path string, recursive bool, useTrash *bool) (bool, error)
	MoveToTrash                    func(path string) error
	CalculateSize                  func(path string) (int64, int64)
	ResolvePath                    func(path string) (string, error)
	ToPublicPath                   func(path string) string
	GetFileInfo                    func(path string) (*contracts.FileInfo, error)
	CopyPath                       func(source, destination string, recursive bool, streamToFile func(io.Reader, string, int64, string) (int64, error)) error
	ExtractNestedArchive           func(archivePath string, nestedChain []string) ([]byte, error)
	Normalize                      func(string) string
	ArchiveEntryPath               func(archiver.File) string
	IsArchive                      func(string) bool
}

type Service struct {
	config    ServiceConfig
	conflicts *ConflictManager
}

func NewService(config ServiceConfig) *Service {
	return &Service{config: config, conflicts: NewConflictManager()}
}

func (s *Service) resolvePath(path string) (string, error) {
	if s.config.ResolvePath == nil {
		return path, nil
	}
	return s.config.ResolvePath(path)
}

func (s *Service) toPublicPath(path string) string {
	if s.config.ToPublicPath == nil {
		return path
	}
	return s.config.ToPublicPath(path)
}

func (s *Service) checkConflict(
	op *internalops.ActiveOperation,
	srcLabel, dst string,
	blanket **contracts.ConflictResolution,
) (finalDst string, skip bool, err error) {
	resolvedDst, err := s.resolvePath(dst)
	if err != nil {
		return "", false, err
	}

	dstInfo, statErr := os.Lstat(resolvedDst)
	if os.IsNotExist(statErr) {
		return resolvedDst, false, nil
	}
	if statErr != nil {
		return "", false, statErr
	}

	if *blanket != nil {
		return ApplyResolution(**blanket, resolvedDst)
	}

	var srcSize, srcMtime int64
	resolvedSrc, resolveErr := s.resolvePath(srcLabel)
	if resolveErr == nil {
		if info, sourceErr := os.Lstat(resolvedSrc); sourceErr == nil {
			srcSize = info.Size()
			srcMtime = info.ModTime().Unix()
		}
	} else if info, sourceErr := os.Lstat(srcLabel); sourceErr == nil {
		srcSize = info.Size()
		srcMtime = info.ModTime().Unix()
	}

	conflictID := s.conflicts.NextID(op.ID)
	response := s.conflicts.Register(conflictID)
	if s.config.ConflictPrompter != nil {
		s.config.ConflictPrompter.PromptConflict(contracts.ConflictEvent{
			OperationID: op.ID,
			ConflictID:  conflictID,
			SourcePath:  srcLabel,
			DestPath:    dst,
			SourceSize:  srcSize,
			DestSize:    dstInfo.Size(),
			SourceMtime: srcMtime,
			DestMtime:   dstInfo.ModTime().Unix(),
			IsDirectory: dstInfo.IsDir(),
		})
	}

	select {
	case res := <-response:
		if res.ApplyToAll {
			r := res.Resolution
			*blanket = &r
		}
		return ApplyResolution(res.Resolution, resolvedDst)
	case <-op.CancelSignal():
		s.conflicts.CancelAll()
		return "", true, fmt.Errorf("operation cancelled")
	}
}

func (s *Service) newTransferRunner(op *internalops.ActiveOperation) *TransferRunner {
	return NewTransferRunner(TransferCallbacks{
		CheckConflict: func(srcLabel, dst string, blanket **contracts.ConflictResolution) (string, bool, error) {
			return s.checkConflict(op, srcLabel, dst, blanket)
		},
		BatchErr:                       s.config.BatchErr,
		IsPermissionDenied:             s.config.IsPermissionDenied,
		ShouldRetryDeleteWithElevation: s.config.ShouldRetryDeleteWithElevation,
		RunElevatedCopy:                s.config.RunElevatedCopy,
		RunElevatedMove:                s.config.RunElevatedMove,
		RunElevatedDelete:              s.config.RunElevatedDelete,
		MoveToTrash:                    s.config.MoveToTrash,
		CalculateSize:                  s.config.CalculateSize,
		ResolvePath:                    s.config.ResolvePath,
		ToPublicPath:                   s.config.ToPublicPath,
		GetFileInfo:                    s.config.GetFileInfo,
		CopyPath:                       s.config.CopyPath,
	})
}

func (s *Service) BatchCopy(req contracts.BatchRequest) (*contracts.BatchResult, error) {
	op := s.config.StartOperation(contracts.OpCopy, "Batch copy", "", "")
	return s.newTransferRunner(op).Copy(op, req)
}

func (s *Service) BatchMove(req contracts.BatchRequest) (*contracts.BatchResult, error) {
	op := s.config.StartOperation(contracts.OpMove, "Batch move", "", "")
	return s.newTransferRunner(op).Move(op, req)
}

func (s *Service) BatchDelete(req contracts.BatchDeleteRequest) (*contracts.BatchResult, error) {
	useTrash := req.UseTrash == nil || *req.UseTrash
	opType := contracts.OpDelete
	title := "Batch delete"
	destination := ""
	if useTrash {
		opType = contracts.OpMove
		title = "Move to Recycle Bin"
		destination = "bin://"
	}

	source := ""
	if len(req.Paths) > 0 {
		source = req.Paths[0]
	}

	op := s.config.StartOperation(opType, title, source, destination)
	return s.newTransferRunner(op).Delete(op, req)
}

func (s *Service) BatchExtract(req contracts.BatchExtractRequest) (*contracts.BatchExtractResult, error) {
	op := s.config.StartOperation(contracts.OpExtract, "Batch extract", "", req.DestinationDir)
	op.SetTotal(int64(len(req.Archives)), 0)

	progress := NewProgressTracker(op)
	fileOps := NewFileOperator(op.IsCancelled, progress)
	extractor := NewArchiveExtractor(ExtractCallbacks{
		IsCancelled: op.IsCancelled,
		CheckConflict: func(srcLabel, dst string, blanket **contracts.ConflictResolution) (string, bool, error) {
			return s.checkConflict(op, srcLabel, dst, blanket)
		},
		StreamToFile: func(r io.Reader, dst string, size int64, label string) (int64, error) {
			return fileOps.StreamToFile(r, dst, size, label)
		},
		ArchiveEntryPath: s.config.ArchiveEntryPath,
		Normalize:        s.config.Normalize,
		IsArchive:        s.config.IsArchive,
	})
	result := &contracts.BatchExtractResult{OperationID: op.ID, Total: len(req.Archives)}
	var blanket *contracts.ConflictResolution

	for _, archivePath := range req.Archives {
		if op.IsCancelled() || (blanket != nil && *blanket == contracts.ConflictCancel) {
			break
		}

		destRoot := req.DestinationDir
		if req.CreateSubdirectory {
			destRoot = filepath.Join(req.DestinationDir, ArchiveBaseName(archivePath))
		}

		files, bytes, nextBlanket, err := extractor.ExtractOnDisk(archivePath, &req, destRoot, blanket)
		blanket = nextBlanket
		if err != nil {
			result.Failed++
			result.Errors = append(result.Errors, s.config.BatchErr(archivePath, destRoot, err))
			continue
		}

		result.Succeeded++
		result.ExtractedFiles += files
		result.ExtractedBytes += bytes
		progress.Advance(1, 0, filepath.Base(archivePath), 0, false)
	}

	progress.Flush()
	op.Complete()
	return result, nil
}

func (s *Service) BatchSelectiveExtract(req contracts.BatchSelectiveExtractRequest) (*contracts.BatchSelectiveExtractResult, error) {
	op := s.config.StartOperation(contracts.OpExtract, "Selective extract", "", req.DestinationDir)
	op.SetTotal(int64(len(req.Items)), 0)

	progress := NewProgressTracker(op)
	extractor := NewSelectiveExtractor(
		SelectiveExtractCallbacks{
			IsCancelled: op.IsCancelled,
			CheckConflict: func(srcLabel, dst string, blanket **contracts.ConflictResolution) (string, bool, error) {
				return s.checkConflict(op, srcLabel, dst, blanket)
			},
			ExtractNestedArchive: s.config.ExtractNestedArchive,
			Normalize:            s.config.Normalize,
			ArchiveEntryPath:     s.config.ArchiveEntryPath,
		},
		progress,
		op.AddTotalBytes,
	)
	result := &contracts.BatchSelectiveExtractResult{OperationID: op.ID, Total: len(req.Items)}
	var blanket *contracts.ConflictResolution

	for _, item := range req.Items {
		if op.IsCancelled() || (blanket != nil && *blanket == contracts.ConflictCancel) {
			break
		}

		files, bytes, nextBlanket, err := extractor.ExtractItem(item, req.DestinationDir, blanket)
		blanket = nextBlanket
		if err != nil {
			result.Failed++
			result.Errors = append(result.Errors, s.config.BatchErr(item.ArchivePath, "", err))
		} else {
			result.Succeeded++
			result.ExtractedFiles += files
			result.ExtractedBytes += bytes
		}

		progress.Advance(1, 0, filepath.Base(item.ArchivePath), 0, false)
	}

	progress.Flush()
	op.Complete()
	return result, nil
}

func (s *Service) CheckConflict(
	op *internalops.ActiveOperation,
	srcLabel, dst string,
	blanket **contracts.ConflictResolution,
) (string, bool, error) {
	return s.checkConflict(op, srcLabel, dst, blanket)
}

func (s *Service) ResolveConflict(conflictID string, resolution contracts.ConflictResolution, applyToAll bool) bool {
	return s.conflicts.Resolve(conflictID, contracts.ConflictResolutionRequest{
		Resolution: resolution,
		ApplyToAll: applyToAll,
	})
}
`````

## File: manager/internal/platform/trash_windows.go
`````go
//go:build windows

package platform

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"os/exec"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"
	"syscall"
	"unsafe"

	contracts "wails-app/internal/contracts"
)

var (
	shell32         = syscall.NewLazyDLL("shell32.dll")
	shFileOperation = shell32.NewProc("SHFileOperationW")
)

type shFileOpStruct struct {
	hwnd                  uintptr
	wFunc                 uint32
	_                     [4]byte
	pFrom                 uintptr
	pTo                   uintptr
	fFlags                uint16
	_                     [2]byte
	fAnyOperationsAborted int32
	hNameMappings         uintptr
	lpszProgressTitle     uintptr
}

const (
	foDelete        uint32 = 0x0003
	fofSilent       uint16 = 0x0004
	fofNoConfirm    uint16 = 0x0010
	fofAllowUndo    uint16 = 0x0040
	fofNoErrorUI    uint16 = 0x0400
	fofWantNukeWarn uint16 = 0x4000
)

func MoveToTrash(path string) error {
	path = normalizeShellTrashPath(path)
	if path == "" {
		return fmt.Errorf("trash: empty path")
	}

	from, err := syscall.UTF16FromString(path)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("trash: invalid path %q: %w", path, err)
	}
	from = append(from, 0)

	op := shFileOpStruct{
		wFunc:  foDelete,
		pFrom:  uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(&from[0])),
		fFlags: fofAllowUndo | fofNoConfirm | fofSilent | fofNoErrorUI | fofWantNukeWarn,
	}

	ret, _, _ := shFileOperation.Call(uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(&op)))
	if ret != 0 {
		return fmt.Errorf("trash: SHFileOperationW returned error code 0x%X (path=%q)", ret, path)
	}
	if op.fAnyOperationsAborted != 0 {
		return fmt.Errorf("trash: operation was aborted by the user or system")
	}
	return nil
}

func ListTrashEntries() ([]contracts.TrashEntry, error) {
	const script = `
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$shell = New-Object -ComObject Shell.Application
$bin = $shell.Namespace(10)
$result = @()
foreach ($item in @($bin.Items())) {
  $from = [string]$item.ExtendedProperty('System.Recycle.DeletedFrom')
  $deleted = $item.ExtendedProperty('System.Recycle.DateDeleted')
  # ShellItem.Name is a display name and follows Explorer's "hide extensions"
  # setting. System.FileName preserves the actual basename, including extension.
  $fileName = [string]$item.ExtendedProperty('System.FileName')
  $name = if ($fileName) { $fileName } else { [string]$item.Name }
  $original = if ($from) { Join-Path $from $name } else { '' }
  $deletedText = if ($deleted -is [datetime]) { $deleted.ToString('o') } else { [string]$deleted }
  $result += [pscustomobject]@{
    id = [string]$item.Path
    name = [string]$name
    originalPath = [string]$original
    trashedPath = [string]$item.Path
    deletedAt = [string]$deletedText
    size = [int64]$item.Size
    isDir = [bool]$item.IsFolder
    canRestore = [bool]($original -ne '')
  }
}
[Console]::OutputEncoding = [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8
ConvertTo-Json -InputObject $result -Compress -Depth 4
`
	output, err := runTrashPowerShell(script, nil)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if strings.TrimSpace(output) == "" {
		return []contracts.TrashEntry{}, nil
	}

	var entries []contracts.TrashEntry
	if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(output), &entries); err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("trash: parse recycle bin: %w", err)
	}
	return entries, nil
}

func RestoreTrashEntry(id string) (string, error) {
	const script = `
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$target = $env:FM_TRASH_ID
$shell = New-Object -ComObject Shell.Application
$bin = $shell.Namespace(10)
$item = @($bin.Items()) | Where-Object { [string]$_.Path -eq $target } | Select-Object -First 1
if ($null -eq $item) { throw 'Recycle Bin item not found.' }
$from = [string]$item.ExtendedProperty('System.Recycle.DeletedFrom')
$fileName = [string]$item.ExtendedProperty('System.FileName')
$name = if ($fileName) { $fileName } else { [string]$item.Name }
$original = if ($from) { Join-Path $from $name } else { '' }
if (-not $original) { throw 'Original path is unavailable.' }
if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $original) { throw ('Restore destination already exists: ' + $original) }
$item.InvokeVerb('RESTORE')
Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 100
[Console]::OutputEncoding = [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8
Write-Output $original
`
	output, err := runTrashPowerShell(script, map[string]string{"FM_TRASH_ID": id})
	if err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	return strings.TrimSpace(output), nil
}

func trashEntryByID(id string) (contracts.TrashEntry, error) {
	entries, err := ListTrashEntries()
	if err != nil {
		return contracts.TrashEntry{}, err
	}
	for _, entry := range entries {
		if entry.ID == id {
			return entry, nil
		}
	}
	return contracts.TrashEntry{}, fmt.Errorf("Recycle Bin item not found.")
}

func CopyTrashEntryTo(id, destinationDir string) (string, error) {
	destinationDir = normalizeShellTrashPath(destinationDir)
	if destinationDir == "" {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("trash copy: empty destination")
	}

	entry, err := trashEntryByID(id)
	if err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	return CopyTrashEntryToPath(id, filepath.Join(destinationDir, entry.Name))
}

func CopyTrashEntryToPath(id, destination string) (string, error) {
	destination = normalizeShellTrashPath(destination)
	if destination == "" {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("trash copy: empty destination")
	}

	const script = `
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$target = $env:FM_TRASH_ID
$destination = $env:FM_TRASH_DESTINATION
$parent = Split-Path -Parent $destination
if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $parent -PathType Container)) {
  throw ('Destination directory does not exist: ' + $parent)
}
if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $destination) {
  throw ('Destination already exists: ' + $destination)
}
$shell = New-Object -ComObject Shell.Application
$bin = $shell.Namespace(10)
$item = @($bin.Items()) | Where-Object { [string]$_.Path -eq $target } | Select-Object -First 1
if ($null -eq $item) { throw 'Recycle Bin item not found.' }
$source = [string]$item.Path
Copy-Item -LiteralPath $source -Destination $destination -Recurse
[Console]::OutputEncoding = [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8
Write-Output $destination
`
	output, err := runTrashPowerShell(script, map[string]string{
		"FM_TRASH_ID":          id,
		"FM_TRASH_DESTINATION": destination,
	})
	if err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	return strings.TrimSpace(output), nil
}

func RestoreTrashEntryTo(id, destinationDir string) (string, error) {
	destinationDir = normalizeShellTrashPath(destinationDir)
	entry, err := trashEntryByID(id)
	if err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	return RestoreTrashEntryToPath(id, filepath.Join(destinationDir, entry.Name))
}

func RestoreTrashEntryToPath(id, destination string) (string, error) {
	destination, err := CopyTrashEntryToPath(id, destination)
	if err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	if err := DeleteTrashEntry(id); err != nil {
		return destination, fmt.Errorf(
			"trash restore: copied to %q but could not remove recycle-bin entry: %w",
			destination,
			err,
		)
	}
	return destination, nil
}

func DeleteTrashEntry(id string) error {
	const script = `
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$target = $env:FM_TRASH_ID
$shell = New-Object -ComObject Shell.Application
$bin = $shell.Namespace(10)
$item = @($bin.Items()) | Where-Object { [string]$_.Path -eq $target } | Select-Object -First 1
if ($null -eq $item) { throw 'Recycle Bin item not found.' }
Remove-Item -LiteralPath ([string]$item.Path) -Force -Recurse
`
	_, err := runTrashPowerShell(script, map[string]string{"FM_TRASH_ID": id})
	return err
}

func EmptyTrash() error {
	const script = `
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
Clear-RecycleBin -Force -ErrorAction Stop
`
	_, err := runTrashPowerShell(script, nil)
	return err
}

func runTrashPowerShell(script string, extraEnv map[string]string) (string, error) {
	cmd := exec.Command("powershell", "-NoProfile", "-NonInteractive", "-ExecutionPolicy", "Bypass", "-Command", script)
	// This is an implementation detail of the Recycle Bin provider. Never flash
	// a console window when bin:// is opened from the GUI address bar.
	cmd.SysProcAttr = &syscall.SysProcAttr{HideWindow: true}
	cmd.Env = os.Environ()
	for key, value := range extraEnv {
		cmd.Env = append(cmd.Env, key+"="+value)
	}
	output, err := cmd.CombinedOutput()
	if err != nil {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("trash: powershell: %w: %s", err, strings.TrimSpace(string(output)))
	}
	return strings.TrimSpace(string(output)), nil
}

func normalizeShellTrashPath(path string) string {
	p := strings.TrimSpace(path)
	if p == "" {
		return ""
	}
	p = filepath.FromSlash(p)
	p = filepath.Clean(p)
	return strings.TrimPrefix(p, `\\?\`)
}
`````

## File: manager/vfs/archive/pathutil/pathutil.go
`````go
package pathutil

import "strings"

func NormalizePath(path string) string {
	path = strings.ReplaceAll(path, "\\", "/")
	return strings.Trim(path, "/")
}

func NormalizeTarPath(path string) string {
	path = NormalizePath(path)
	return strings.TrimPrefix(path, "./")
}

func ChildOf(entryPath, parent string) string {
	entryPath = NormalizePath(entryPath)
	parent = NormalizePath(parent)
	if parent == "" {
		return entryPath
	}
	if entryPath == parent {
		return ""
	}
	prefix := parent + "/"
	if strings.HasPrefix(entryPath, prefix) {
		return entryPath[len(prefix):]
	}
	return ""
}

func MatchesEntries(entryPath string, entries []string) bool {
	if len(entries) == 0 {
		return true
	}
	for _, entry := range entries {
		entry = NormalizePath(entry)
		if entryPath == entry || strings.HasPrefix(entryPath, entry+"/") {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}

func RebasePath(entryPath, stripPrefix string) string {
	if stripPrefix == "" {
		return entryPath
	}
	prefix := NormalizePath(stripPrefix)
	if entryPath == prefix {
		return ""
	}
	if strings.HasPrefix(entryPath, prefix+"/") {
		return entryPath[len(prefix)+1:]
	}
	return entryPath
}
`````

`````typescript
export interface PaletteCommand {

  template: `

      (animationend)="onAnimationEnd($event)">

export class CommandPaletteComponent implements OnInit, OnDestroy {
  @ViewChild('queryInput') queryInput?: ElementRef<HTMLInputElement>;
  @Input() commands: readonly PaletteCommand[] = [];

  visible = false;
  isClosing = false;
  query = '';
  selectedIndex = 0;

  constructor(
    private readonly input: InputEngineService,
    private readonly cdr: ChangeDetectorRef,
  ) {}

  get filteredCommands(): PaletteCommand[] {
    const query = this.query.trim();
    const commands = [...this.commands];

    if (!query) {
      return commands.sort(
        (a,b) =>
          a.category.localeCompare(b.category) ||
          a.title.localeCompare(b.title),
      );
    }

    return commands
      .map(command => ({
        command,
        score: discoveryScore(query, [
          { value: command.title, weight: 1.6 },
          { value: command.category, weight: 1.1 },
          { value: command.shortcut, weight: 1.25 },
          { value: command.id, weight: .8 },
        ]),
      }))
      .filter(item => item.score >= 0)
      .sort(
        (a,b) =>
          b.score - a.score ||
          Number(this.enabled(b.command)) - Number(this.enabled(a.command)) ||
          a.command.title.localeCompare(b.command.title),
      )
      .map(item => item.command);
  }

  get selectedCommand(): PaletteCommand | null {
    return this.filteredCommands[this.selectedIndex] ?? null;
  }

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.input.registerContext({
      id: CONTEXT_ID,
      kind: 'overlay',
      priority: 410, exclusive: true,
      parentId: 'global',
      description: 'Reassembly command palette',
    });

    this.input.registerCommandDescriptor({id:COMMAND.close,title:'Close Command Palette',category:'Navigation',execute:()=>this.close()},OWNER_ID);
    this.input.registerCommandDescriptor({id:COMMAND.previous,title:'Previous Command',category:'Navigation',execute:()=>this.move(-1)},OWNER_ID);
    this.input.registerCommandDescriptor({id:COMMAND.next,title:'Next Command',category:'Navigation',execute:()=>this.move(1)},OWNER_ID);
    this.input.registerCommandDescriptor({id:COMMAND.run,title:'Run Command',category:'Navigation',execute:()=>{const command=this.selectedCommand;if(command)void this.run(command)}},OWNER_ID);

    for (const binding of BINDINGS) this.input.registerBinding(binding);
  }

  ngOnDestroy(): void {
    this.input.deactivateContext(CONTEXT_ID);
    for (const binding of BINDINGS) this.input.unregisterBinding(binding.id);
    for (const id of Object.values(COMMAND)) this.input.unregisterCommandDescriptor(id, OWNER_ID);
  }

  open(): void {
    this.query = '';
    this.selectedIndex = 0;
    this.isClosing = false;
    this.visible = true;
    this.input.activateContext(CONTEXT_ID);
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
  }

  close(): void {
    if (!this.visible || this.isClosing) return;
    this.isClosing = true;
    this.input.deactivateContext(CONTEXT_ID);
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
  }

  queryChanged(): void {
    this.selectedIndex = 0;
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
  }

  enabled(command: PaletteCommand): boolean {
    try { return command.isEnabled ? command.isEnabled() : true; }
    catch { return false; }
  }

  async run(command: PaletteCommand): Promise<void> {
    if (!this.enabled(command)) return;
    this.close();
    await command.execute();
  }

  trackCommand(_index:number, command:PaletteCommand):string { return command.id; }

  private move(delta:-1|1):void {
    const commands = this.filteredCommands;
    if (!commands.length) return;

    let index = this.selectedIndex;
    for (let attempts=0; attempts<commands.length; attempts+=1) {
      index = (index + delta + commands.length) % commands.length;
      if (this.enabled(commands[index])) {
        this.selectedIndex = index;
        this.cdr.markForCheck();
        return;
      }
    }
  }

  @HostListener('document:keydown', ['$event'])
  onDocumentKeydown(event: KeyboardEvent): void {
    if (!this.visible || this.isClosing || event.key !== 'Escape') return;
    event.preventDefault();
    event.stopPropagation();
    this.close();
  }

  onAnimationEnd(event: AnimationEvent): void {
    if (event.target !== event.currentTarget || !this.isClosing) return;
    this.visible = false;
    this.isClosing = false;
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
  }

}
`````

`````typescript
import { CommonModule } from '@angular/common';
import {
  ChangeDetectionStrategy,
  ChangeDetectorRef,
  Component,
  EventEmitter,
  HostListener,
  Input,
  OnChanges,
  Output,
  SimpleChanges,
} from '@angular/core';
import type { TabInfo } from '../shared/protocol-enhanced';
import type { SizeManagerSurfaceContext } from '../surfaces/surface-context';
import { SizeManagerSurfaceComponent } from '../surfaces/size-manager/size-manager-surface.component';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-disk-usage-dialog',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [CommonModule, SizeManagerSurfaceComponent],
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
  template: `
    <div
      *ngIf="renderVisible && ctx"
      class="du-backdrop palette-dialog-backdrop dialog-group"
      [class.dialog-group--closing]="isClosing"
      (animationend)="onAnimationEnd($event)"
      role="presentation"
      (mousedown)="onBackdropMouseDown($event)">
      <section
        class="du-dialog palette-dialog-surface dialog-surface"
        role="dialog"
        aria-modal="true"
        aria-label="Disk Usage"
        (mousedown)="$event.stopPropagation()">
        <app-size-manager-surface [ctx]="ctx"></app-size-manager-surface>
      </section>
    </div>
  `,
  styleUrls: ['./tools-dialog-remote-theme.scss'],
  styles: [`
    :host { display: contents; }

    .du-backdrop {
      position: fixed;
      inset: 0;
      z-index: 1400;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      padding: 28px;
      background: var(--vsc-scrim, rgba(0, 0, 0, .48));
    }

    .du-dialog {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      width: min(1180px, calc(100vw - 56px));
      height: min(820px, calc(100vh - 56px));
      min-width: 640px;
      min-height: 420px;
      overflow: hidden;
      color: var(--vsc-foreground);
      background: var(--vsc-editor-background);
      border: 1px solid var(--vsc-border);
      border-radius: 6px;
      box-shadow: 0 16px 48px rgba(0, 0, 0, .38);
    }

    app-size-manager-surface {
      flex: 1 1 0%;
      min-width: 0;
      min-height: 0;
    }

    @media (max-width: 760px), (max-height: 520px) {
      .du-backdrop { padding: 8px; }
      .du-dialog {
        width: calc(100vw - 16px);
        height: calc(100vh - 16px);
        min-width: 0;
        min-height: 0;
      }
    }
  `],
})
export class DiskUsageDialogComponent implements OnChanges {
  @Input() visible = false;
  @Input() rootPath = '';
  @Output() closed = new EventEmitter<void>();

  ctx: SizeManagerSurfaceContext | null = null;
  renderVisible = false;
  isClosing = false;
  private emitClosedOnFinish = false;

  constructor(private readonly cdr: ChangeDetectorRef) {}

  ngOnChanges(changes: SimpleChanges): void {
    if (changes['visible'] || changes['rootPath']) {
      if (this.visible && this.rootPath.trim()) {
        this.ctx = this.createContext(this.rootPath.trim());
        this.renderVisible = true;
        this.isClosing = false;
        this.emitClosedOnFinish = false;
      } else if (!this.visible && this.renderVisible && !this.isClosing) {
        this.isClosing = true;
      }
    }
  }

  @HostListener('document:keydown.escape', ['$event'])
  onEscape(event: Event): void {
    if (!this.visible) return;
    event.preventDefault();
    event.stopPropagation();
    this.close();
  }

  onBackdropMouseDown(event: MouseEvent): void {
    if (event.target === event.currentTarget) this.close();
  }

  close(): void {
    if (!this.renderVisible || this.isClosing) return;
    this.isClosing = true;
    this.emitClosedOnFinish = true;
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
  }

  onAnimationEnd(event: AnimationEvent): void {
    if (event.target !== event.currentTarget || !this.isClosing) return;
    this.renderVisible = false;
    this.isClosing = false;
    this.ctx = null;
    const emit = this.emitClosedOnFinish;
    this.emitClosedOnFinish = false;
    if (emit) this.closed.emit();
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
  }

  private createContext(path: string): SizeManagerSurfaceContext {
    const tab: TabInfo = {
      id: 'disk-usage-dialog',
      title: 'Disk Usage',
      path,
      kind: 'size-manager',
      surfaceId: 'size-manager',
      isActive: true,
      isPinned: false,
      isClosable: true,
      createdAt: Date.now(),
    };

    return {
      paneId: 'left',
      tab,
      surfaceId: 'size-manager',
      kind: 'size-manager',
      sizeVm: {
        paneId: 'left',
        analysisPath: path,
        // Navigation is internal to the utility while the dialog is open.
        onAnalyse: () => undefined,
        onClose: () => this.close(),
      },
    };
  }
}
`````
