`````typescript
import { ChangeDetectorRef, Component, OnInit, OnDestroy, ViewChild, ElementRef } from '@angular/core';
import { CommonModule } from '@angular/common';
import { FormsModule } from '@angular/forms';
import { InputContextService } from '../services/input-context.service';
import { InputEngineService } from '../services/input-engine.service';
import { InputBindingDefinition } from '../services/input-system.types';
import { NativeOverlayFreezeService } from '../services/native-overlay-freeze.service';

interface BindingCategory {
  name: string;
  bindings: InputBindingDefinition[];
}

@Component({
  selector: 'app-keyboard-help',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [CommonModule, FormsModule],
  templateUrl: './keyboard-help.component.html',
  styleUrls: ['./keyboard-help.component.scss']
})
export class KeyboardHelpComponent implements OnInit, OnDestroy {
  @ViewChild('dialogPanel') dialogPanel?: ElementRef<HTMLElement>;
  @ViewChild('searchInput') searchInput?: ElementRef<HTMLInputElement>;

  isVisible = false;
  renderVisible = false;
  isClosing = false;
  categories: BindingCategory[] = [];
  searchText = '';
  filteredCategories: BindingCategory[] = [];

  private readonly modNames: Record<string, string> = {
    Control: 'Ctrl', Alt: 'Alt', Shift: 'Shift', Meta: 'Cmd',
  };
  private readonly keyNames: Record<string, string> = {
    ' ': 'Space', ArrowUp: '↑', ArrowDown: '↓', ArrowLeft: '←', ArrowRight: '→',
    Escape: 'Esc', Enter: 'Enter', Backspace: 'Backspace', Delete: 'Del',
    Tab: 'Tab', Home: 'Home', End: 'End', PageUp: 'PgUp', PageDown: 'PgDn',
    F1: 'F1', F2: 'F2', F3: 'F3', F4: 'F4', F5: 'F5', F6: 'F6',
    F7: 'F7', F8: 'F8', F9: 'F9', F10: 'F10', F11: 'F11', F12: 'F12',
  };

  private releaseDialogContext: (() => void) | null = null;

  constructor(
    private inputContexts: InputContextService,
    private inputEngine: InputEngineService,
    private overlayFreeze: NativeOverlayFreezeService,
    private cdr: ChangeDetectorRef,
  ) {}

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.registerInputCommands();
    this.loadShortcuts();
  }

  ngOnDestroy(): void {
    this.overlayFreeze.release('dialog.keyboardHelp');
    this.releaseDialogContext?.();
    this.releaseDialogContext = null;
    this.unregisterInputCommands();
  }

  loadShortcuts(): void {
    const snapshot = this.inputEngine.getBindingSnapshot();

    const live = snapshot.filter(binding =>
      binding.enabled !== false &&
      binding.trigger.device === 'keyboard' &&
      !!binding.category
    );

    const byCategory = new Map<string, InputBindingDefinition[]>();
    for (const binding of live) {
      const category = binding.category!;
      if (!byCategory.has(category)) {
        byCategory.set(category, []);
      }
      byCategory.get(category)!.push(binding);
    }

    this.categories = Array.from(byCategory.entries())
      .map(([name, bindings]) => ({
        name,
        bindings: bindings
          .slice()
          .sort((a, b) =>
            a.description.localeCompare(b.description) ||
            this.formatBinding(a).localeCompare(this.formatBinding(b)),
          ),
      }))
      .sort((a, b) => a.name.localeCompare(b.name));

    this.filteredCategories = this.categories;
  }

  /**
   * Show help modal
   */
  show(): void {
    this.isVisible = true;
    this.renderVisible = true;
    this.isClosing = false;
    this.releaseDialogContext ??= this.inputContexts.acquire('dialog.keyboardHelp');
    this.overlayFreeze.acquire('dialog.keyboardHelp');
    this.searchText = '';
    this.loadShortcuts();
    this.cdr.detectChanges();
    queueMicrotask(() => this.dialogPanel?.nativeElement.focus());
  }

  /**
   * Hide help modal
   */
  hide(): void {
    if (!this.renderVisible || this.isClosing) {
      return;
    }
    this.isVisible = false;
    this.isClosing = true;
    this.releaseDialogContext?.();
    this.releaseDialogContext = null;
    this.overlayFreeze.release('dialog.keyboardHelp');
    this.cdr.detectChanges();
  }

  onBackdropAnimationEnd(event: AnimationEvent): void {
    if (event.target !== event.currentTarget || !this.isClosing) {
      return;
    }
    this.renderVisible = false;
    this.isClosing = false;
    this.cdr.detectChanges();
  }

  onSearchChange(): void {
    const search = this.searchText.toLowerCase().trim();
    if (!search) {
      this.filteredCategories = this.categories;
      return;
    }
    this.filteredCategories = this.categories
      .map(cat => ({
        name: cat.name,
        bindings: cat.bindings.filter(b => {
          const keyMatch = this.formatBinding(b).toLowerCase().includes(search);
          const descMatch = (b.description ?? '').toLowerCase().includes(search);
          return keyMatch || descMatch;
        }),
      }))
      .filter(cat => cat.bindings.length > 0);
  }

  /**
   * Clear search
   */
  clearSearch(): void {
    this.searchText = '';
    this.onSearchChange();
  }

  formatBinding(b: InputBindingDefinition): string {
    if (b.trigger.device !== 'keyboard') return '';
    return b.trigger.chord.steps.map(step => {
      const mods = (step.modifiers ?? []).map(m => this.modNames[m] ?? m).join('+');
      const key = this.keyNames[step.key] ?? step.key.toUpperCase();
      return mods ? `${mods}+${key}` : key;
    }).join(' → ');
  }

  bindingKeySteps(binding: InputBindingDefinition): readonly (readonly string[])[] {
    if (binding.trigger.device !== 'keyboard') return [];
    return binding.trigger.chord.steps.map(step => [
      ...(step.modifiers ?? []).map(modifier => this.modNames[modifier] ?? modifier),
      this.keyNames[step.key] ?? step.key.toUpperCase(),
    ]);
  }

  private registerInputCommands(): void {
    this.inputEngine.registerCommand('dialog.keyboardHelp.close', () => {
      if (this.isVisible) this.hide();
    });

    this.inputEngine.registerCommand('dialog.keyboardHelp.focusSearch', () => {
      if (!this.isVisible) return;
      this.searchInput?.nativeElement.focus();
      this.searchInput?.nativeElement.select();
    });
  }

  private unregisterInputCommands(): void {
    this.inputEngine.unregisterCommand('dialog.keyboardHelp.close');
    this.inputEngine.unregisterCommand('dialog.keyboardHelp.focusSearch');
  }
}
`````

`````typescript
export class PaneArrangeControlsComponent {
  @Input() currentSort = 'name';
  @Input() sortDirection: 'asc' | 'desc' = 'asc';
  @Input() directoriesFirst = true;
  @Input() colorizeByMime = false;
  @Input() showColorizeByMime = false;

  @Output() sortChange = new EventEmitter<PaneSortChange>();
  @Output() directoriesFirstChange = new EventEmitter<boolean>();
  @Output() colorizeByMimeChange = new EventEmitter<boolean>();

  menuOpen = false;

  readonly sortOptions = [
    { value: 'name', label: 'Name' },
    { value: 'size', label: 'Size' },
    { value: 'modified', label: 'Date Modified' },
    { value: 'type', label: 'Type' },
  ];

  toggleMenu(event: MouseEvent): void {
    event.preventDefault();
    event.stopPropagation();
    this.menuOpen = !this.menuOpen;
  }

  selectSort(field: string): void {
    this.sortChange.emit({ field, direction: this.sortDirection });
    this.menuOpen = false;
  }

  toggleDirection(): void {
    const direction = this.sortDirection === 'asc' ? 'desc' : 'asc';
    this.sortChange.emit({ field: this.currentSort, direction });
    this.menuOpen = false;
  }

  toggleDirectoriesFirst(): void {
    this.directoriesFirstChange.emit(!this.directoriesFirst);
  }

  toggleColorizeByMime(): void {
    this.colorizeByMimeChange.emit(!this.colorizeByMime);
  }
}
`````

## File: manager/frontend/src/app/components/pane-details-resize-handle.directive.ts
`````typescript
import {
  AfterViewInit,
  Directive,
  ElementRef,
  EventEmitter,
  HostBinding,
  HostListener,
  Input,
  OnDestroy,
  Output,
} from '@angular/core';

export interface PaneDetailsColumnWidthChange {
  readonly key: string;
  readonly width: number;
}

/**
 * The single column-resize interaction used by every Details surface.
 *
 * The containing Details root must expose `data-pane-details-root`. During a
 * drag we mutate one inherited CSS custom property, so header and visible rows
 * resize together without rebuilding row models or running per-row work.
 */
@Directive({
  selector: '[paneDetailsResizeHandle]',
  standalone: true,
})
export class PaneDetailsResizeHandleDirective implements AfterViewInit, OnDestroy {
  @Input('paneDetailsResizeHandle') key = '';
  @Input() paneDetailsMinWidth = 80;
  @Input() paneDetailsMaxWidth = 1200;

  @Output() paneDetailsWidthCommit = new EventEmitter<PaneDetailsColumnWidthChange>();

  @HostBinding('class.pane-details-resize-handle') readonly resizeHandleClass = true;
  @HostBinding('style.position') readonly position = 'absolute';
  @HostBinding('style.top') readonly top = '0';
  @HostBinding('style.bottom') readonly bottom = '0';
  @HostBinding('style.right') readonly right = '-4px';
  @HostBinding('style.width') readonly width = '8px';
  @HostBinding('style.cursor') readonly cursor = 'col-resize';
  @HostBinding('style.z-index') readonly zIndex = '6';
  @HostBinding('style.user-select') readonly userSelect = 'none';
  @HostBinding('style.background') readonly delimiterBackground =
    'linear-gradient(to right, transparent calc(50% - 0.5px), var(--vsc-border, rgba(128, 128, 128, .7)) calc(50% - 0.5px), var(--vsc-border, rgba(128, 128, 128, .7)) calc(50% + 0.5px), transparent calc(50% + 0.5px))';
  @HostBinding('style.opacity') delimiterOpacity = '0.72';
  @HostBinding('class.pane-details-resize-handle--dragging') dragging = false;

  private root: HTMLElement | null = null;
  private startX = 0;
  private startWidth = 0;
  private currentWidth = 0;
  private moveListener?: (event: MouseEvent) => void;
  private upListener?: () => void;

  constructor(private readonly elementRef: ElementRef<HTMLElement>) {}

  ngAfterViewInit(): void {
    const parent = this.elementRef.nativeElement.parentElement;
    if (parent && getComputedStyle(parent).position === 'static') {
      parent.style.position = 'relative';
    }
  }

  @HostListener('mouseenter')
  onMouseEnter(): void {
    this.delimiterOpacity = '1';
  }

  @HostListener('mouseleave')
  onMouseLeave(): void {
    if (!this.moveListener) this.delimiterOpacity = '0.72';
  }

  @HostListener('mousedown', ['$event'])
  onMouseDown(event: MouseEvent): void {
    if (event.button !== 0 || !this.key) return;

    const handle = this.elementRef.nativeElement;
    const cell = handle.parentElement;
    const root = handle.closest<HTMLElement>('[data-pane-details-root]');
    if (!cell || !root) return;

    event.preventDefault();
    event.stopPropagation();

    this.cleanup();
    this.root = root;
    this.dragging = true;
    root.setAttribute('data-pane-column-resizing', this.key);
    this.startX = event.clientX;
    this.startWidth = Math.round(cell.getBoundingClientRect().width);
    this.currentWidth = this.clamp(this.startWidth);
    this.applyWidth(this.currentWidth);

    this.moveListener = moveEvent => {
      this.currentWidth = this.clamp(this.startWidth + moveEvent.clientX - this.startX);
      this.applyWidth(this.currentWidth);
    };
    this.upListener = () => {
      const width = this.currentWidth;
      this.cleanup();
      document.body.style.cursor = '';
      document.body.style.userSelect = '';
      this.delimiterOpacity = '0.72';
      this.paneDetailsWidthCommit.emit({ key: this.key, width });
    };

    window.addEventListener('mousemove', this.moveListener);
    window.addEventListener('mouseup', this.upListener);
    document.body.style.cursor = 'col-resize';
    document.body.style.userSelect = 'none';
    this.delimiterOpacity = '1';
  }

  ngOnDestroy(): void {
    this.cleanup();
    document.body.style.cursor = '';
    document.body.style.userSelect = '';
  }

  private applyWidth(width: number): void {
    this.root?.style.setProperty(this.variableName(this.key), `${width}px`);
  }

  private clamp(width: number): number {
    return Math.max(
      Math.max(1, this.paneDetailsMinWidth),
      Math.min(Math.max(this.paneDetailsMinWidth, this.paneDetailsMaxWidth), Math.round(width)),
    );
  }

  private variableName(key: string): string {
    return `--details-column-${key.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]/g, '-')}-width`;
  }

  private cleanup(): void {
    if (this.moveListener) {
      window.removeEventListener('mousemove', this.moveListener);
      this.moveListener = undefined;
    }
    if (this.upListener) {
      window.removeEventListener('mouseup', this.upListener);
      this.upListener = undefined;
    }
    this.root?.removeAttribute('data-pane-column-resizing');
    this.dragging = false;
    this.root = null;
  }
}
`````

`````typescript
import { FileInfo, FileType } from '../shared/protocol';
import { ApiService } from '../services/api.service';
import { ArchiveFilesDialogService } from '../services/archive-files-dialog.service';
import { ConfirmDialogService } from '../services/confirm-dialog.service';
import { OperationHistoryService } from '../services/operation-history.service';

export interface PaneFileToolsHost {
  readonly path: string;
  readonly selectedEntries: readonly FileInfo[];
  readonly cursorEntry: FileInfo | null;
  readonly canCreate: boolean;
  readonly isDirectoryTab: boolean;
  readonly isInArchive: boolean;
  refresh(): Promise<void>;
  selectPath(path: string): void;
}

/** Shared metadata, inspection and utility commands for directory-capable panes. */
export class PaneFileToolsController {
  constructor(
    private readonly api: ApiService,
    private readonly archiveFilesDialog: ArchiveFilesDialogService,
    private readonly confirm: ConfirmDialogService,
    private readonly history: OperationHistoryService,
  ) {}

  async revealSelectedInFileManager(host: PaneFileToolsHost): Promise<void> {
    const entry = host.cursorEntry ?? host.selectedEntries[0];
    if (!entry || host.isInArchive || !host.isDirectoryTab) return;
    await this.api.revealInFileManager(entry.path);
  }

  async touchSelectedModifiedTime(host: PaneFileToolsHost): Promise<void> {
    if (!host.isDirectoryTab || host.isInArchive) return;
    const entries = this.effectiveSelection(host);
    if (entries.length === 0) return;

    const value = await this.confirm.prompt({
      title: entries.length === 1 ? `Modified Time — ${entries[0].name}` : `Modified Time — ${entries.length} items`,
      message: 'Enter local date/time as YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss, or "now".',
      confirmText: 'Apply',
      defaultValue: new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 19),
      historyKey: 'reassembly.modifiedTime',
    });
    if (value == null) return;

    const raw = String(value).trim();
    const timestamp = raw.toLowerCase() === 'now' ? Date.now() : new Date(raw).getTime();
    if (!Number.isFinite(timestamp)) {
      await this.confirm.alert({ title: 'Invalid Date / Time', message: 'Use YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss (for example 2026-08-16T12:30:00) or "now".' });
      return;
    }

    const before = await Promise.all(entries.map(async entry => ({
      path: entry.path,
      modified: Number((await this.api.getFileInfo(entry.path)).modified),
    })));
    for (const entry of entries) await this.api.setModifiedTime(entry.path, timestamp);

    this.history.record({
      label: `Set modified time for ${entries.length} item${entries.length === 1 ? '' : 's'}`,
      undo: async () => {
        for (const item of before) {
          const milliseconds = item.modified < 10_000_000_000 ? item.modified * 1000 : item.modified;
          await this.api.setModifiedTime(item.path, milliseconds);
        }
      },
      redo: async () => { for (const entry of entries) await this.api.setModifiedTime(entry.path, timestamp); },
    });
    await host.refresh();
  }

  async showSelectedChecksum(host: PaneFileToolsHost): Promise<void> {
    if (!host.isDirectoryTab || host.isInArchive) return;
    const entries = this.effectiveSelection(host).filter(entry => entry.type !== FileType.DIRECTORY);
    if (entries.length === 0) return;
    const rows: string[] = [];
    for (const entry of entries) rows.push(`${await this.api.hashFile(entry.path)}  ${entry.name}`);
    const text = rows.join('\n');
    await this.confirm.alert({
      title: entries.length === 1 ? `SHA-256 — ${entries[0].name}` : `SHA-256 — ${entries.length} files`,
      message: entries.length === 1 ? `${text}\n\n${entries[0].path}` : text,
    });
  }

  async calculateSelectedSize(host: PaneFileToolsHost): Promise<void> {
    if (!host.isDirectoryTab || host.isInArchive) return;
    const entries = this.effectiveSelection(host);
    if (entries.length === 0) return;
    let total = 0;
    for (const entry of entries) total += entry.type === FileType.DIRECTORY ? await this.api.dirSizeRecursive(entry.path) : Number(entry.size) || 0;
    await this.confirm.alert({
      title: entries.length === 1 ? `Size — ${entries[0].name}` : `Selected Size — ${entries.length} items`,
      message: [`Size: ${this.formatSize(total)}`, `Bytes: ${total.toLocaleString()}`].join('\n'),
    });
  }

  async editSelectedAttributes(host: PaneFileToolsHost): Promise<void> {
    const entry = host.cursorEntry ?? host.selectedEntries[0];
    if (!entry || host.isInArchive || !host.isDirectoryTab) return;
    const [osInfo, attributes] = await Promise.all([this.api.getOSInfo(), this.api.getPathAttributes(entry.path)]);
    if (String(osInfo?.os).toLowerCase() === 'windows') {
      const current = [attributes.readOnly ? 'readonly' : '', attributes.hidden ? 'hidden' : '', attributes.system ? 'system' : '', attributes.archive ? 'archive' : ''].filter(Boolean).join(',');
      const value = await this.confirm.prompt({ title: `Attributes — ${entry.name}`, message: 'Comma-separated attributes: readonly, hidden, system, archive', confirmText: 'Apply', defaultValue: current, historyKey: 'reassembly.attributes.windows' });
      if (value == null) return;
      const tokens = new Set(String(value).split(',').map(token => token.trim().toLowerCase()).filter(Boolean));
      const valid = new Set(['readonly', 'hidden', 'system', 'archive']);
      const invalid = [...tokens].filter(token => !valid.has(token));
      if (invalid.length) { await this.confirm.alert({ title: 'Invalid Attributes', message: `Unknown attribute${invalid.length === 1 ? '' : 's'}: ${invalid.join(', ')}` }); return; }
      await this.api.setPathAttributes(entry.path, { readOnly: tokens.has('readonly'), hidden: tokens.has('hidden'), system: tokens.has('system'), archive: tokens.has('archive') });
    } else {
      const value = await this.confirm.prompt({ title: `Permissions — ${entry.name}`, message: 'Unix permission mode (octal), for example 0644 or 0755:', confirmText: 'Apply', defaultValue: (attributes.unixMode || 0).toString(8).padStart(4, '0'), historyKey: 'reassembly.attributes.unix' });
      if (value == null) return;
      const normalized = String(value).trim();
      if (!/^[0-7]{3,4}$/.test(normalized)) { await this.confirm.alert({ title: 'Invalid Permission Mode', message: 'Enter a 3- or 4-digit octal mode such as 644, 0644, or 0755.' }); return; }
      await this.api.setPathAttributes(entry.path, { unixMode: Number.parseInt(normalized, 8) });
    }
    await host.refresh();
    host.selectPath(entry.path);
  }

  async showSelectedProperties(host: PaneFileToolsHost): Promise<void> {
    const selected = this.effectiveSelection(host);
    if (selected.length === 0) return;
    if (selected.length > 1) {
      const infos = host.isInArchive ? selected : await Promise.all(selected.map(entry => this.api.getFileInfo(entry.path)));
      let totalSize = 0, files = 0, directories = 0, archives = 0, symlinks = 0;
      for (const info of infos) {
        if (info.type === FileType.DIRECTORY) { directories++; totalSize += host.isInArchive ? Number(info.size) || 0 : await this.api.dirSizeRecursive(info.path); }
        else { totalSize += Number(info.size) || 0; if (info.type === FileType.ARCHIVE) archives++; else if (info.type === FileType.SYMLINK) symlinks++; else files++; }
      }
      await this.confirm.alert({ title: `Properties — ${selected.length} items`, message: [`Items: ${selected.length}`, `Files: ${files}`, `Directories: ${directories}`, `Archives: ${archives}`, `Symbolic links: ${symlinks}`, `Total size: ${this.formatSize(totalSize) || '—'}`, `Bytes: ${totalSize.toLocaleString()}`, host.isInArchive ? 'Location: inside archive' : `Folder: ${host.path}`].join('\n') });
      return;
    }
    const entry = selected[0];
    const info = host.isInArchive ? entry : await this.api.getFileInfo(entry.path);
    const displaySize = !host.isInArchive && info.type === FileType.DIRECTORY ? await this.api.dirSizeRecursive(info.path) : Number(info.size) || 0;
    const type = info.type === FileType.DIRECTORY ? 'Directory' : info.type === FileType.ARCHIVE ? 'Archive' : info.type === FileType.SYMLINK ? 'Symbolic link' : 'File';
    const timestamp = (value: unknown) => { const n = Number(value); return Number.isFinite(n) && n > 0 ? new Date(n * (n < 10_000_000_000 ? 1000 : 1)).toLocaleString() : '—'; };
    await this.confirm.alert({ title: `Properties — ${info.name}`, message: [`Name: ${info.name}`, `Type: ${type}`, `Path: ${info.path}`, `Size: ${this.formatSize(displaySize) || '—'}`, `Bytes: ${displaySize.toLocaleString()}`, `Modified: ${timestamp(info.modified)}`, `Created: ${timestamp(info.created)}`, `Accessed: ${timestamp(info.accessed)}`, `Permissions: ${info.permissions || '—'}`, info.isSymlink ? 'Symbolic link: yes' : '', host.isInArchive ? 'Location: inside archive' : ''].filter(Boolean).join('\n') });
  }

  async createZipFromSelection(host: PaneFileToolsHost): Promise<void> {
    if (!host.isDirectoryTab || host.isInArchive || !host.canCreate || host.selectedEntries.length === 0) return;
    const entries = [...host.selectedEntries];
    const first = entries[0];
    const baseName = entries.length === 1 ? first.name.replace(/\.[^.]+$/, '') || first.name : 'Archive';
    const requested = await this.archiveFilesDialog.open({
      title: 'Archive Files',
      message: entries.length === 1 ? `Compress "${first.name}" to:` : `Compress ${entries.length} selected items to:`,
      confirmText: 'Create',
      defaultValue: `${baseName}.zip`,
    });
    let cleanName = this.cleanLeafName(requested);
    if (!cleanName) { await this.confirm.alert({ title: 'Invalid Name', message: 'Choose a valid ZIP filename.' }); return; }
    if (!/\.zip$/i.test(cleanName)) cleanName += '.zip';
    const destination = await this.api.joinPaths([host.path, cleanName]);
    try { await this.api.getFileInfo(destination); await this.confirm.alert({ title: 'Name Already Exists', message: `An item named "${cleanName}" already exists.` }); return; } catch { /* available */ }
    const sources = entries.map(entry => entry.path);
    await this.api.createZipArchive(sources, destination);
    this.history.record({ label: `Create archive ${cleanName}`, undo: async () => { await this.api.deleteFile(destination, true, false); }, redo: async () => { await this.api.createZipArchive(sources, destination); } });
    await host.refresh();
    host.selectPath(destination);
  }

  private effectiveSelection(host: PaneFileToolsHost): FileInfo[] {
    return host.selectedEntries.length > 0 ? [...host.selectedEntries] : host.cursorEntry ? [host.cursorEntry] : [];
  }

  private cleanLeafName(value: unknown): string | null {
    const name = String(value ?? '').trim();
    if (!name || /[\\/:*?"<>|]/.test(name) || /[ .]$/.test(name)) return null;
    return name;
  }

  private formatSize(bytes: number): string {
    if (!Number.isFinite(bytes) || bytes < 0) return '—';
    if (bytes < 1024) return `${bytes} B`;
    const units = ['KiB', 'MiB', 'GiB', 'TiB'];
    let value = bytes / 1024, unit = units[0];
    for (let i = 1; i < units.length && value >= 1024; i++) { value /= 1024; unit = units[i]; }
    return `${value.toFixed(value >= 10 ? 1 : 2)} ${unit}`;
  }
}
`````

`````typescript
import { CommonModule } from '@angular/common';
import { ChangeDetectorRef, Component, EventEmitter, OnInit, Output } from '@angular/core';
import { ApiService } from '../services/api.service';
import { PluginDiscoveryService } from '../services/plugin-discovery.service';
import {
  PluginLifecycleCoordinatorService,
  type ManagedPluginRuntimeSnapshot,
} from '../services/plugin-lifecycle-coordinator.service';
import type { PluginBackendPrivilege, PluginPermission } from '../plugin/plugin-manifest';

interface PluginPolicyDraft {
  trusted: boolean;
  grantedPermissions: PluginPermission[];
}

@Component({
  selector: 'app-plugin-settings-panel',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [CommonModule],
  template: `
    <section class="plugins-settings" aria-label="Plugins">
      <div class="plugins-header">
        <div class="plugins-heading">
          <h3 class="section-title">Plugins</h3>
          <p class="section-desc">Manage discovered plugin packages, trust, availability, permissions and runtime health.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="plugins-header-actions">
          <button type="button" class="btn btn-secondary btn-small" [disabled]="refreshing" (click)="refresh()">
            {{ refreshing ? 'Refreshing…' : 'Refresh' }}
          </button>
          <button type="button" class="btn btn-secondary btn-small" [disabled]="openingDirectory" (click)="openPluginDirectory()">
            Open Plugin Folder
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div *ngIf="error" class="plugins-banner error" role="alert">{{ error }}</div>
      <div *ngIf="pluginDirectory" class="plugins-directory" title="Plugin directory">{{ pluginDirectory }}</div>

      <div *ngIf="!refreshing && snapshots.length === 0" class="plugins-empty">
        <strong>No plugin packages discovered.</strong>
        <span>Place manifest-based packages in the plugin folder, then refresh.</span>
      </div>

      <article *ngFor="let snapshot of snapshots; trackBy: trackPlugin" class="plugin-card" [class.invalid]="snapshot.status === 'invalid'" [class.quarantined]="snapshot.status === 'quarantined'">
        <header class="plugin-card-header">
          <div class="plugin-identity">
            <div class="plugin-title-row">
              <strong>{{ snapshot.plugin.discovered.manifest.name || snapshot.plugin.discovered.manifest.id }}</strong>
              <span class="plugin-version">v{{ snapshot.plugin.discovered.manifest.version || '?' }}</span>
              <span class="plugin-status" [attr.data-status]="snapshot.status">{{ formatStatus(snapshot.status) }}</span>
            </div>
            <div class="plugin-id">{{ snapshot.plugin.discovered.manifest.id }}</div>
            <p *ngIf="snapshot.plugin.discovered.manifest.description" class="plugin-description">
              {{ snapshot.plugin.discovered.manifest.description }}
            </p>
          </div>

          <button
            *ngIf="isTrustedForCurrentVersion(snapshot)"
            type="button"
            class="btn btn-small plugin-availability-action"
            [class.btn-primary]="!availabilityEnabled(snapshot)"
            [class.btn-secondary]="availabilityEnabled(snapshot)"
            [disabled]="isBusy(snapshot)"
            (click)="setEnabled(snapshot, !availabilityEnabled(snapshot))"
          >
            {{ availabilityEnabled(snapshot) ? 'Disable' : 'Enable' }}
          </button>
        </header>

        <div *ngIf="snapshot.reason" class="plugin-reason">{{ snapshot.reason }}</div>

        <div *ngIf="snapshot.plugin.discovered.errors.length" class="plugin-messages error">
          <strong>Manifest errors</strong>
          <ul><li *ngFor="let message of snapshot.plugin.discovered.errors">{{ message }}</li></ul>
        </div>
        <div *ngIf="snapshot.plugin.discovered.warnings.length" class="plugin-messages warning">
          <strong>Warnings</strong>
          <ul><li *ngFor="let message of snapshot.plugin.discovered.warnings">{{ message }}</li></ul>
        </div>

        <div *ngIf="snapshot.plugin.discovered.valid" class="plugin-grid">
          <section class="plugin-block">
            <div class="plugin-block-heading">
              <strong>Privilege</strong>
              <span
                [class.state-good]="pluginPrivilege(snapshot) === 'normal' || processElevated"
                [class.state-warn]="pluginPrivilege(snapshot) === 'elevated' && !processElevated"
              >
                {{ pluginPrivilege(snapshot) }}
              </span>
            </div>
            <p>{{ pluginPrivilegeMode(snapshot) }}</p>
          </section>

          <section class="plugin-block">
            <div class="plugin-block-heading">
              <strong>Trust</strong>
              <span *ngIf="isTrustedForCurrentVersion(snapshot)" class="state-good">Trusted for this version</span>
              <span *ngIf="trustedValue(snapshot) && !isTrustedForCurrentVersion(snapshot)" class="state-warn">Review required after upgrade</span>
              <span *ngIf="!trustedValue(snapshot)" class="state-muted">Not trusted</span>
            </div>
            <p>Trust grants all permissions requested by this exact plugin version.</p>
            <button
              type="button"
              class="btn btn-secondary btn-small"
              [disabled]="isBusy(snapshot)"
              (click)="toggleTrusted(snapshot)"
            >
              {{ isTrustedForCurrentVersion(snapshot) ? 'Revoke Trust' : 'Trust This Version' }}
            </button>
          </section>

          <section class="plugin-block">
            <div class="plugin-block-heading"><strong>Permissions</strong></div>
            <p *ngIf="snapshot.plugin.requestedPermissions.length === 0" class="state-muted">This plugin requests no permissions.</p>
            <label *ngFor="let permission of snapshot.plugin.requestedPermissions" class="permission-row">
              <input
                type="checkbox"
                [checked]="permissionGranted(snapshot, permission)"
                [disabled]="isBusy(snapshot) || isTrustedForCurrentVersion(snapshot)"
                (change)="togglePermission(snapshot, permission, $any($event.target).checked)"
              />
              <code>{{ permission }}</code>
              <span *ngIf="isTrustedForCurrentVersion(snapshot)" class="permission-via-trust">via trust</span>
            </label>
          </section>

          <section class="plugin-block">
            <div class="plugin-block-heading"><strong>Runtime health</strong></div>
            <dl class="health-grid">
              <div><dt>Last activation</dt><dd>{{ formatActivation(snapshot) }}</dd></div>
              <div><dt>Failures</dt><dd>{{ snapshot.plugin.state.consecutiveActivationFailures }}</dd></div>
              <div *ngIf="snapshot.plugin.state.lastActivationError"><dt>Last error</dt><dd class="error-text">{{ snapshot.plugin.state.lastActivationError }}</dd></div>
            </dl>
            <div *ngIf="snapshot.plugin.state.quarantined" class="quarantine-box">
              <strong>Quarantined</strong>
              <span>{{ snapshot.plugin.state.quarantineReason || 'Repeated activation failures.' }}</span>
              <button type="button" class="btn btn-secondary btn-small" [disabled]="isBusy(snapshot)" (click)="clearQuarantine(snapshot)">Clear Quarantine</button>
            </div>
          </section>
        </div>
      </article>
    </section>
  `,

export class PluginSettingsPanelComponent implements OnInit {
  @Output() readonly dirtyChange = new EventEmitter<boolean>();

  snapshots: ManagedPluginRuntimeSnapshot[] = [];
  pluginDirectory = '';
  processElevated = false;
  error = '';
  refreshing = false;
  openingDirectory = false;
  private readonly busyIds = new Set<string>();
  private readonly baselinePolicy = new Map<string, PluginPolicyDraft>();
  private readonly draftPolicy = new Map<string, PluginPolicyDraft>();
  private dirty = false;

  constructor(
    private readonly coordinator: PluginLifecycleCoordinatorService,
    private readonly discovery: PluginDiscoveryService,
    private readonly api: ApiService,
    private readonly changeDetector: ChangeDetectorRef,
  ) {}

  ngOnInit(): void {
    void this.refresh();
    void this.loadPluginDirectory();
  }

  trackPlugin(_index: number, snapshot: ManagedPluginRuntimeSnapshot): string {
    return snapshot.plugin.discovered.manifest.id || snapshot.plugin.discovered.path;
  }

  isBusy(snapshot: ManagedPluginRuntimeSnapshot): boolean {
    return this.busyIds.has(snapshot.plugin.discovered.manifest.id);
  }

  availabilityEnabled(snapshot: ManagedPluginRuntimeSnapshot): boolean {
    return snapshot.plugin.state.enabled;
  }

  trustedValue(snapshot: ManagedPluginRuntimeSnapshot): boolean {
    return this.policyFor(snapshot).trusted;
  }

  isTrustedForCurrentVersion(snapshot: ManagedPluginRuntimeSnapshot): boolean {
    const policy = this.policyFor(snapshot);
    if (!policy.trusted) return false;

    // A newly staged trust applies to the currently displayed version.
    if (policy.trusted !== snapshot.plugin.state.trusted) return true;

    return snapshot.plugin.state.trustedVersion === snapshot.plugin.discovered.manifest.version;
  }

  permissionGranted(snapshot: ManagedPluginRuntimeSnapshot, permission: PluginPermission): boolean {
    const policy = this.policyFor(snapshot);
    return policy.trusted || policy.grantedPermissions.includes(permission);
  }

  get hasPendingChanges(): boolean {
    return this.dirty;
  }

  async refresh(): Promise<void> {
    if (this.refreshing) return;
    this.refreshing = true;
    this.error = '';
    this.renderNow();
    try {
      const [snapshots, processElevated] = await withTimeout(
        Promise.all([
          this.coordinator.sync(),
          this.api.isProcessElevated(),
        ]),
        10_000,
        'Plugin refresh timed out.',
      );
      this.snapshots = snapshots;
      this.processElevated = processElevated;
      if (!this.dirty) {
        this.capturePolicy(this.snapshots);
      } else {
        this.reconcileDrafts(this.snapshots);
      }
    } catch (error) {
      this.error = errorMessage(error);
    } finally {
      this.refreshing = false;
      this.renderNow();
    }
  }

  async openPluginDirectory(): Promise<void> {
    if (this.openingDirectory) return;
    this.openingDirectory = true;
    this.error = '';
    this.renderNow();
    try {
      const directory = this.pluginDirectory || await this.discovery.getDirectory();
      this.pluginDirectory = directory;
      await this.api.openFile(directory);
    } catch (error) {
      this.error = errorMessage(error);
    } finally {
      this.openingDirectory = false;
      this.renderNow();
    }
  }

  async setEnabled(snapshot: ManagedPluginRuntimeSnapshot, enabled: boolean): Promise<void> {
    const id = snapshot.plugin.discovered.manifest.id;
    await this.runFor(snapshot, () => this.coordinator.setEnabled(id, enabled));
    this.capturePolicy(this.snapshots);
  }

  toggleTrusted(snapshot: ManagedPluginRuntimeSnapshot): void {
    const trusted = !this.trustedValue(snapshot);
    this.updatePolicy(snapshot, policy => ({ ...policy, trusted }));
  }

  togglePermission(snapshot: ManagedPluginRuntimeSnapshot, permission: PluginPermission, granted: boolean): void {
    this.updatePolicy(snapshot, policy => {
      const permissions = new Set(policy.grantedPermissions);
      if (granted) permissions.add(permission); else permissions.delete(permission);
      return { ...policy, grantedPermissions: [...permissions] };
    });
  }

  async save(): Promise<boolean> {
    if (!this.dirty) return true;

    this.error = '';

    try {
      for (const snapshot of this.snapshots) {
        const id = snapshot.plugin.discovered.manifest.id;
        if (!id) continue;

        const baseline = this.baselinePolicy.get(id);
        const draft = this.draftPolicy.get(id);
        if (!baseline || !draft) continue;

        // Trust and permission edits are saved independently from availability.
        // Enable/disable is an immediate action handled only by the button.
        if (draft.trusted !== baseline.trusted) {
          await withTimeout(
            this.coordinator.setTrusted(id, draft.trusted),
            10_000,
            `Saving trust setting timed out for ${id}.`,
          );
        }

        if (!samePermissions(draft.grantedPermissions, baseline.grantedPermissions)) {
          await withTimeout(
            this.coordinator.setGrantedPermissions(id, draft.grantedPermissions),
            10_000,
            `Saving permission settings timed out for ${id}.`,
          );
        }
      }

      this.snapshots = await withTimeout(
        this.coordinator.sync(),
        10_000,
        'Plugin refresh timed out after saving settings.',
      );
      this.capturePolicy(this.snapshots);
      this.renderNow();
      return true;
    } catch (error) {
      this.error = errorMessage(error);
      this.renderNow();
      return false;
    }
  }

  discard(): void {
    this.capturePolicy(this.snapshots);
    this.renderNow();
  }

  async clearQuarantine(snapshot: ManagedPluginRuntimeSnapshot): Promise<void> {
    await this.runFor(snapshot, () => this.coordinator.clearQuarantine(snapshot.plugin.discovered.manifest.id));
  }



  formatStatus(status: string): string {
    return status.replace(/-/g, ' ');
  }

  formatActivation(snapshot: ManagedPluginRuntimeSnapshot): string {
    const state = snapshot.plugin.state;
    if (state.lastActivationStatus === 'never') return 'Never';
    const suffix = state.lastActivatedAt ? ` · ${new Date(state.lastActivatedAt).toLocaleString()}` : '';
    return `${state.lastActivationStatus}${suffix}`;
  }

  pluginPrivilege(snapshot: ManagedPluginRuntimeSnapshot): PluginBackendPrivilege {
    return snapshot.plugin.discovered.manifest.backend?.privilege === 'elevated'
      ? 'elevated'
      : 'normal';
  }

  pluginPrivilegeMode(snapshot: ManagedPluginRuntimeSnapshot): string {
    if (this.pluginPrivilege(snapshot) !== 'elevated') {
      return 'Runs in normal manager mode.';
    }
    return this.processElevated
      ? 'Manager is currently elevated.'
      : 'Requires elevated manager mode.';
  }

  private async loadPluginDirectory(): Promise<void> {
    try {
      this.pluginDirectory = await this.discovery.getDirectory();
    } catch {
      // Discovery refresh will surface actionable binding errors.
    }
  }

  private policyFor(snapshot: ManagedPluginRuntimeSnapshot): PluginPolicyDraft {
    const id = snapshot.plugin.discovered.manifest.id;
    return this.draftPolicy.get(id) ?? this.policyFromSnapshot(snapshot);
  }

  private policyFromSnapshot(snapshot: ManagedPluginRuntimeSnapshot): PluginPolicyDraft {
    return {
      trusted: snapshot.plugin.state.trusted,
      grantedPermissions: [...snapshot.plugin.state.grantedPermissions],
    };
  }

  private updatePolicy(
    snapshot: ManagedPluginRuntimeSnapshot,
    update: (current: PluginPolicyDraft) => PluginPolicyDraft,
  ): void {
    const id = snapshot.plugin.discovered.manifest.id;
    if (!id) return;

    const current = this.policyFor(snapshot);
    this.draftPolicy.set(id, normalizePolicy(update(current)));
    this.updateDirtyState();
    this.renderNow();
  }

  private capturePolicy(snapshots: readonly ManagedPluginRuntimeSnapshot[]): void {
    this.baselinePolicy.clear();
    this.draftPolicy.clear();

    for (const snapshot of snapshots) {
      const id = snapshot.plugin.discovered.manifest.id;
      if (!id) continue;
      const policy = normalizePolicy(this.policyFromSnapshot(snapshot));
      this.baselinePolicy.set(id, clonePolicy(policy));
      this.draftPolicy.set(id, clonePolicy(policy));
    }

    this.setDirty(false);
  }

  private reconcileDrafts(snapshots: readonly ManagedPluginRuntimeSnapshot[]): void {
    const present = new Set<string>();

    for (const snapshot of snapshots) {
      const id = snapshot.plugin.discovered.manifest.id;
      if (!id) continue;
      present.add(id);

      if (!this.baselinePolicy.has(id)) {
        const policy = normalizePolicy(this.policyFromSnapshot(snapshot));
        this.baselinePolicy.set(id, clonePolicy(policy));
        this.draftPolicy.set(id, clonePolicy(policy));
      }
    }

    for (const id of [...this.baselinePolicy.keys()]) {
      if (!present.has(id)) {
        this.baselinePolicy.delete(id);
        this.draftPolicy.delete(id);
      }
    }

    this.updateDirtyState();
  }

  private updateDirtyState(): void {
    let dirty = false;

    for (const [id, baseline] of this.baselinePolicy) {
      const draft = this.draftPolicy.get(id);
      if (!draft || !samePolicy(baseline, draft)) {
        dirty = true;
        break;
      }
    }

    this.setDirty(dirty);
  }

  private setDirty(value: boolean): void {
    if (this.dirty === value) return;
    this.dirty = value;
    this.dirtyChange.emit(value);
  }

  private async runFor(snapshot: ManagedPluginRuntimeSnapshot, action: () => Promise<unknown>): Promise<void> {
    const id = snapshot.plugin.discovered.manifest.id;
    if (!id || this.busyIds.has(id)) return;
    this.busyIds.add(id);
    this.error = '';
    this.renderNow();
    try {
      await withTimeout(action(), 10_000, `Plugin operation timed out for ${id}.`);
      this.snapshots = await withTimeout(
        this.coordinator.sync(),
        10_000,
        `Plugin refresh timed out for ${id}.`,
      );
    } catch (error) {
      this.error = errorMessage(error);
    } finally {
      this.busyIds.delete(id);
      this.renderNow();
    }
  }

  private renderNow(): void {
    // Wails promises can settle outside Angular's render scheduling. Render this
    // settings subtree explicitly so plugin state never depends on a later UI event.
    this.changeDetector.detectChanges();
  }
}


function clonePolicy(policy: PluginPolicyDraft): PluginPolicyDraft {
  return {
    trusted: policy.trusted,
    grantedPermissions: [...policy.grantedPermissions],
  };
}

function normalizePolicy(policy: PluginPolicyDraft): PluginPolicyDraft {
  return {
    trusted: !!policy.trusted,
    grantedPermissions: [...new Set(policy.grantedPermissions)].sort(),
  };
}

function samePermissions(left: readonly PluginPermission[], right: readonly PluginPermission[]): boolean {
  if (left.length !== right.length) return false;
  const a = [...left].sort();
  const b = [...right].sort();
  return a.every((value, index) => value === b[index]);
}

function samePolicy(left: PluginPolicyDraft, right: PluginPolicyDraft): boolean {
  return left.trusted === right.trusted &&
    samePermissions(left.grantedPermissions, right.grantedPermissions);
}


function withTimeout<T>(promise: Promise<T>, timeoutMs: number, message: string): Promise<T> {
  return new Promise<T>((resolve, reject) => {
    const timer = window.setTimeout(() => reject(new Error(message)), timeoutMs);
    promise.then(
      value => {
        window.clearTimeout(timer);
        resolve(value);
      },
      error => {
        window.clearTimeout(timer);
        reject(error);
      },
    );
  });
}

function errorMessage(error: unknown): string {
  return error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error);
}
`````

`````typescript
      <!-- ── File type breakdown ─────────────────────────── -->
      <div class="sm-panel sm-file-types">
        <div class="sm-panel-head">
          <span class="sm-panel-title">File Types</span>
          <span class="sm-panel-hint">{{ fileTypePanelHint }}</span>
        </div>

        <div class="sm-table-head sm-type-table-head" *ngIf="fileTypeRows.length > 0">
          <span>Type</span>
          <span class="sm-align-r">Files</span>
          <span class="sm-align-r">Size</span>
          <span class="sm-align-r">Share</span>
        </div>

        <div class="sm-table-body" *ngIf="fileTypeRows.length > 0; else emptyFileTypes">
          <div class="sm-type-row" *ngFor="let row of fileTypeRows; trackBy: trackFileTypeRow">
            <div class="sm-row-name">
              <span class="sm-row-icon">{{ row.icon }}</span>
              <span class="sm-row-label">{{ row.name }}</span>
            </div>
            <span class="sm-row-size sm-align-r">{{ row.count | number }}</span>
            <span class="sm-row-size sm-align-r">{{ formatBytes(row.totalSize) }}</span>
            <div class="sm-row-pct-cell sm-align-r">
              <span class="sm-row-pct">{{ fileTypePct(row) }}</span>
              <div class="sm-row-track">
                <div class="sm-row-bar" [style.width.%]="fileTypeBarPercent(row)"></div>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <ng-template #emptyFileTypes>
          <div class="sm-empty">{{ fileTypeEmptyLabel }}</div>
        </ng-template>
      </div>

      <!-- ── Breakdown table ──────────────────────────────── -->
      <div class="sm-panel sm-breakdown">
        <div class="sm-panel-head">
          <span class="sm-panel-title">Breakdown</span>
          <span class="sm-panel-hint">Single-click to inspect · double-click or Enter a folder to drill in</span>
        </div>

        <div class="sm-table-head" *ngIf="entries.length > 0">
          <span>Name</span>
          <span>Composition</span>
          <span class="sm-align-r">Size</span>
          <span class="sm-align-r">Share</span>
        </div>

        <div class="sm-table-body" *ngIf="entries.length > 0; else emptyBreakdown">
          <button
            class="sm-row"
            *ngFor="let e of entries; trackBy: trackEntry"
            [class.sm-row--dir]="e.isDir"
            [class.sm-row--active]="selectedEntry?.path === e.path"
            (click)="onEntryClick(e)"
            (dblclick)="onEntryDblClick(e)"
            (keydown.enter)="onEntryKeydown($event, e)">
            <div class="sm-row-name">
              <span class="sm-row-icon" [class.sm-row-icon--dir]="e.isDir">{{ e.isDir ? '▣' : '•' }}</span>
              <span class="sm-row-label" [title]="e.path">{{ e.name }}</span>
            </div>
            <span class="sm-row-meta">{{ entryComposition(e) }}</span>
            <span class="sm-row-size sm-align-r">{{ formatBytes(e.size) }}</span>
            <div class="sm-row-pct-cell sm-align-r">
              <span class="sm-row-pct">{{ pct(e) }}</span>
              <div class="sm-row-track">
                <div class="sm-row-bar" [style.width.%]="barPercent(e)"></div>
              </div>
            </div>
          </button>
        </div>

        <ng-template #emptyBreakdown>
          <div class="sm-empty">{{ breakdownEmptyLabel }}</div>
        </ng-template>
      </div>
    </div>
  `,
  styles: [`
    :host {
      --_bg:         var(--vsc-editor-background,    #1e1e1e);
      --_surface:    var(--vsc-panel-background,     #252526);
      --_surface2:   var(--vsc-list-hover-background,#2a2d2e);
      --_input-bg:   var(--vsc-input-background,     #3c3c3c);

      --_text-dim:   var(--vsc-foreground-dim,       #888888);
      --_border:     var(--vsc-border,               #454545);
      --_border-sub: var(--vsc-border-subtle,        #3a3a3a);
      --_focus:      var(--vsc-input-focus-border,   #007acc);
      --_btn-bg:     var(--vsc-button-background,    #0e639c);
      --_btn-hover:  var(--vsc-button-hover,         #1177bb);
      --_hover-bg:   var(--vsc-list-hover-background,#2a2d2e);
      --_active-bg:  var(--vsc-list-active-background,#094771);
      --_accent-a:   #2ec4b6;
      --_accent-b:   #3a86ff;
      --_error:      var(--vsc-error,                #f48771);
      --_blue:       var(--vsc-accent-blue,          #007acc);
      --_icon-file:  #8fd3ff;

      display: flex;

      min-height: 0;

    }

    :host-context(.vscode-light) {
      --_bg: #ffffff; --_surface: #f3f3f3; --_surface2: #e4e6f1;
      --_input-bg: #ffffff; --_text: #3b3b3b; --_text-dim: #737373;
      --_border: #c4c4c4; --_border-sub: #e5e5e5; --_focus: #007acc;
      --_btn-bg: #007acc; --_btn-hover: #005ba1;
      --_hover-bg: #e4e6f1; --_active-bg: #cce0f5;
      --_error: #c7372f; --_blue: #007acc;

    .sm-header { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; padding: 8px 14px; flex-shrink: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--_border-sub); background: var(--_surface); }
    .sm-header-left { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; min-width: 0; overflow: hidden; }

    .sm-path-crumb:hover:not(:disabled) { background: var(--_hover-bg); }

    .sm-header-actions { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; flex-shrink: 0; }

    .sm-btn { appearance: none; border: 1px solid var(--_border); border-radius: var(--vsc-border-radius-lg, 4px); padding: 4px 10px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; font-family: inherit; cursor: pointer; color: var(--_text); background: transparent; transition: background .1s, border-color .1s; white-space: nowrap; }
    .sm-btn:hover:not(:disabled) { background: var(--_hover-bg); }

    .sm-inline-elapsed { font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; white-space: nowrap; color: #2bb24c; font-weight: 600; }

    .sm-inline-activity { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 18px; height: 18px; flex-shrink: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: color-mix(in srgb, #2bb24c 14%, transparent); border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, #2bb24c 35%, var(--_border)); }

    .sm-metrics { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(120px, 1fr)); gap: 8px; flex-shrink: 0; }
    .sm-metric { padding: 10px 12px; border-radius: var(--vsc-border-radius-lg, 4px); border: 1px solid var(--_border-sub); background: var(--_surface); min-width: 0; }
    .sm-metric-kicker { font-size: 10px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .12em; color: var(--_text-dim); }
`````
