`````typescript
    .sm-metric-val--text { font-size: 16px; font-variant-numeric: normal; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }
    .sm-metric-lbl { margin-top: 3px; font-size: 11px; color: var(--_text-dim); }

    .sm-panel { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; padding: 12px 14px; border-radius: var(--vsc-border-radius-lg, 4px); border: 1px solid var(--_border-sub); background: var(--_surface); min-width: 0; flex-shrink: 0; }
    .sm-panel-head { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px; }
    .sm-panel-title { font-size: 10px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .12em; color: var(--_text-dim); }
    .sm-panel-hint  { font-size: 11px; color: var(--_text-dim); }

    /* Pie breadcrumb nav */
    .sm-pie-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px; user-select: none; -webkit-user-select: none; }
    .sm-pie-nav::selection { background: transparent; color: inherit; }
    .sm-pie-nav *::selection { background: transparent; color: inherit; }
    .sm-pie-crumb { appearance: none; border: none; background: transparent; -webkit-text-fill-color: currentColor; -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent; -webkit-touch-callout: none; caret-color: transparent; font-family: inherit; font-size: 10px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .16em; color: var(--vsc-text-link, var(--_blue)); cursor: pointer; padding: 2px 6px; border-radius: var(--vsc-border-radius-sm, 2px); transition: color .12s, background-color .12s; user-select: none; -webkit-user-select: none; }
    .sm-pie-crumb:not(.sm-pie-crumb--active):hover { color: var(--vsc-text-link, var(--_blue)); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--vsc-text-link, var(--_blue)) 10%, transparent); text-decoration: none; }
    .sm-pie-crumb:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid var(--_focus); outline-offset: 1px; color: var(--vsc-text-link, var(--_blue)); }
    .sm-pie-crumb--active { color: var(--_text-dim); background: transparent; cursor: default; opacity: 1; text-decoration: none; pointer-events: none; }
    .sm-pie-crumb:not(:last-child)::after { content: '›'; color: var(--_text-dim); margin-left: 8px; }
    .sm-pie-loading { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; margin-left: 4px; min-width: 0; }
    .sm-pie-loading-dot { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--_focus); box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 color-mix(in srgb, var(--_focus) 40%, transparent); animation: sm-pie-pulse 1.2s ease-out infinite; flex-shrink: 0; }
    .sm-pie-loading-copy { font-size: 11px; color: var(--_text-dim); white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }
    .sm-pie-empty { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 14px; min-height: 254px; padding: 20px; border: 1px dashed color-mix(in srgb, var(--_border) 80%, transparent); border-radius: var(--vsc-border-radius-lg, 4px); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--_surface2) 36%, transparent); color: var(--_text-dim); }
    .sm-pie-empty--loading { border-style: solid; }
    .sm-pie-empty-icon { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 38px; height: 38px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--_border) 70%, transparent); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--_surface) 70%, transparent); font-size: 18px; color: var(--_text); flex-shrink: 0; }
    .sm-pie-empty-copy { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; max-width: 360px; }
    .sm-pie-empty-title { font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--_text); }
    .sm-pie-empty-hint { font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.45; }

    /* Breakdown */
    .sm-breakdown { gap: 8px; }
    .sm-table-head { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0,2fr) minmax(100px,1fr) 90px 110px; gap: 10px; padding: 0 8px 6px; font-size: 10px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .12em; color: var(--_text-dim); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--_border-sub); }
    .sm-table-body { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 1px; }
    .sm-file-types { gap: 8px; }
    .sm-type-table-head, .sm-type-row { grid-template-columns: minmax(0,2fr) 70px 90px 110px; }
    .sm-type-row { display: grid; gap: 10px; align-items: center; padding: 6px 8px; min-width: 0; border-radius: var(--vsc-border-radius-lg, 4px); }
    .sm-row { appearance: none; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: var(--vsc-border-radius-lg, 4px); display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0,2fr) minmax(100px,1fr) 90px 110px; gap: 10px; align-items: center; padding: 6px 8px; cursor: pointer; color: var(--_text); background: transparent; text-align: left; transition: background .1s; width: 100%; min-width: 0; font-family: inherit; }
    .sm-row:hover { background: var(--_hover-bg); }
    .sm-row--active { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--_focus) 10%, var(--_surface2) 90%); border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--_focus) 35%, transparent); }
    .sm-row-name { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-width: 0; }
    .sm-row-icon { flex-shrink: 0; font-size: 11px; color: var(--_icon-file); }
    .sm-row-icon--dir { color: var(--_icon-dir); }
    .sm-row-label { font-weight: 500; font-size: 12px; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }
    .sm-row-meta  { font-size: 11px; color: var(--_text-dim); white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }
    .sm-row-size  { font-size: 12px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; white-space: nowrap; }
    .sm-row-pct-cell { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 3px; align-items: flex-end; }
    .sm-row-pct   { font-size: 11px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: var(--_text-dim); }
    .sm-row-track { width: 100%; height: 3px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--_input-bg); border: 1px solid var(--_border-sub); overflow: hidden; }
    .sm-row-bar   { height: 100%; border-radius: inherit; background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--_accent-a), var(--_accent-b)); transition: width .5s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1); }

    .sm-align-r { text-align: right; }
    .sm-empty { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 72px; font-size: 12px; color: var(--_text-dim); }

    @keyframes sm-pie-pulse {
      0% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 color-mix(in srgb, var(--_focus) 40%, transparent); }
      70% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 8px color-mix(in srgb, var(--_focus) 0%, transparent); }
      100% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 color-mix(in srgb, var(--_focus) 0%, transparent); }
    }

    @media (max-width: 640px) {
      .sm-table-head { display: none; }
      .sm-row { grid-template-columns: minmax(0,1fr) auto; }
      .sm-type-row { grid-template-columns: minmax(0,1fr) auto; }
      .sm-row-meta { display: none; }
    }
  `],
})
export class SizeManagerSurfaceComponent implements OnChanges, OnDestroy {
  @Input({ required: true }) ctx!: SizeManagerSurfaceContext;
  @Output() firstEntryArrived = new EventEmitter<void>();

  loading = false;
  isTraversing = false;
  error: string | null = null;
  private scanStartedAt = 0;
  private tickInterval: ReturnType<typeof setInterval> | null = null;
  liveElapsedMs = 0;
  liveProgress: DiskUsageProgress | null = null;
  result: DiskUsageResult | null = null;
  entries: DiskUsageEntry[] = [];
  fileTypeRows: FileTypeBreakdownRow[] = [];
  fileTypeSourceLabel = 'Current folder';
  fileTypeSourceFileCount = 0;
  fileTypeSourceBytes = 0;
  selectedEntry: DiskUsageEntry | null = null;
  currentPath = '';
  parentPath: string | null = null;

  // ── Pie nav stack — owned here, not in the chart ──────────────────────────

  pieStack: PieFrame[] = [];

  get currentPieFrame(): PieFrame {
    return this.pieStack[this.pieStack.length - 1] ?? { label: '', sourceEntry: null, entries: [], totalSize: 0 };
  }

  private destroyed = false;
  private activeTabId = '';
  private activeScanRunId = 0;
  private syncedAnalysisPath = '';
  private analysisRootPath = '';
  private navigationHistory: string[] = [];
  private navigationIndex = -1;
  private readonly pieFrameCache = new Map<string, PieFrame>();
  private readonly pendingPieFrames = new Map<string, Promise<PieFrame | null>>();
  private activePieRequestId = 0;
  private piePrefetchRunId = 0;
  pieDistributionLoadingPath = '';

  constructor(
    private api: ApiService,
    private cdr: ChangeDetectorRef,
  ) {}

  ngOnChanges(changes: SimpleChanges): void {
    if (changes['ctx']) {
      const tabId = this.ctx?.tab?.id ?? '';
      const path = this.ctx?.sizeVm?.analysisPath;
      const tabChanged = !!tabId && tabId !== this.activeTabId;
      if (tabChanged) {
        this.activeTabId = tabId;
        this.syncedAnalysisPath = '';
        this.analysisRootPath = path ? this.normalizePathDisplay(path) : '';
        this.navigationHistory = path ? [path] : [];
        this.navigationIndex = path ? 0 : -1;
        this.resetAnalysisState();
      }
      if (path && (tabChanged || path !== this.syncedAnalysisPath)) {
        if (!this.analysisRootPath) this.analysisRootPath = this.normalizePathDisplay(path);
        if (this.navigationIndex < 0) {
          this.navigationHistory = [path];
          this.navigationIndex = 0;
        }
        this.syncedAnalysisPath = path;
        this.analyse(path);
      }
    }
  }

  ngOnDestroy(): void { this.destroyed = true; this.stopTick(); }

  // ── Actions ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  close(): void { this.ctx?.sizeVm?.onClose(); }

  get canGoBack(): boolean { return this.navigationIndex > 0; }
  get canGoForward(): boolean { return this.navigationIndex >= 0 && this.navigationIndex < this.navigationHistory.length - 1; }

  goBack(): void {
    if (!this.canGoBack) return;
    this.navigationIndex -= 1;
    this.navigateToAnalysisPath(this.navigationHistory[this.navigationIndex], false);
  }

  goForward(): void {
    if (!this.canGoForward) return;
    this.navigationIndex += 1;
    this.navigateToAnalysisPath(this.navigationHistory[this.navigationIndex], false);
  }

  goUp(): void {
    if (this.parentPath) this.navigateToAnalysisPath(this.parentPath);
  }

  refresh(): void {
    if (this.currentPath) this.navigateToAnalysisPath(this.currentPath, false);
  }

  returnToRoot(): void {
    if (this.analysisRootPath) this.navigateToAnalysisPath(this.analysisRootPath);
  }

  onChartSelect(entry: DiskUsageEntry | null): void {
    this.selectEntry(entry);
  }

  async onChartActivate(entry: DiskUsageEntry): Promise<void> {
    if (!entry.isDir) {
      this.cdr.markForCheck();
      return;
    }

    this.selectEntry(entry);

    const currentFrame = this.currentPieFrame;
    if (currentFrame.path === entry.path) return;

    const cachedFrame = this.pieFrameCache.get(entry.path);
    if (cachedFrame) {
      this.pushPieFrame(cachedFrame);
      return;
    }

    const requestId = ++this.activePieRequestId;
    const analysisRoot = this.currentPath;
    this.pieDistributionLoadingPath = entry.path;
    this.cdr.markForCheck();

    try {
      const frame = await this.loadPieFrame(entry);
      if (this.destroyed || requestId !== this.activePieRequestId || this.currentPath !== analysisRoot) return;

      this.pieDistributionLoadingPath = '';
      if (frame) this.pushPieFrame(frame);
    } catch {
      if (this.destroyed || requestId !== this.activePieRequestId || this.currentPath !== analysisRoot) return;
      this.pieDistributionLoadingPath = '';
      this.cdr.markForCheck();
    }
  }

  onEntryClick(e: DiskUsageEntry): void {
    this.selectEntry(e);
  }

  onEntryDblClick(e: DiskUsageEntry): void {
    if (e.isDir) this.navigateToAnalysisPath(e.path);
  }

  onEntryKeydown(event: Event, e: DiskUsageEntry): void {
    if (!e.isDir) return;
    event.preventDefault();
    this.navigateToAnalysisPath(e.path);
  }

  /** Chart emits bucketed Other entries — we push a new pie frame. */
  onOtherDrill(otherEntries: DiskUsageEntry[]): void {
    const depth = this.pieStack.length;
    const label = depth === 1 ? 'Other' : `Other (${depth})`;
    const totalSize = otherEntries.reduce((s, e) => s + e.size, 0);
    this.pieStack = [...this.pieStack, { label, sourceEntry: null, entries: otherEntries, totalSize }];
    this.selectEntry(null);
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
  }

  /** Jump to any frame in the pie breadcrumb trail. */
  pieGoTo(index: number): void {
    if (index >= this.pieStack.length - 1) return;
    this.pieStack = this.pieStack.slice(0, index + 1);
    this.selectEntry(this.currentPieFrame.sourceEntry ?? null);
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
  }

  navigateBreadcrumb(path: string): void {
    this.navigateToAnalysisPath(path);
  }

  private navigateToAnalysisPath(path: string, recordHistory = true): void {
    if (!path || !this.isWithinAnalysisRoot(path)) return;

    if (recordHistory) {
      const current = this.navigationHistory[this.navigationIndex];
      if (this.normalizePathDisplay(current || '') !== this.normalizePathDisplay(path)) {
        this.navigationHistory = [
          ...this.navigationHistory.slice(0, this.navigationIndex + 1),
          path,
        ];
        this.navigationIndex = this.navigationHistory.length - 1;
      }
    }

    this.syncedAnalysisPath = path;
    this.ctx?.sizeVm?.onAnalyse(path);
    void this.analyse(path);
  }

  private selectEntry(entry: DiskUsageEntry | null): void {
    this.selectedEntry = entry;
    this.rebuildFileTypeBreakdown();
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
  }

  trackEntry(_: number, e: DiskUsageEntry): string { return e.path; }
  trackFileTypeRow(_: number, row: FileTypeBreakdownRow): string { return row.id; }

  // ── View helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  get headerPath(): string {
    return this.syncedAnalysisPath || this.currentPath;
  }

  get headerLabel(): string {
    return this.labelFromPath(this.headerPath) || this.headerPath || 'Disk Usage';
  }

  get showHeaderPath(): boolean {
    return this.normalizePathDisplay(this.headerLabel) !== this.normalizePathDisplay(this.headerPath);
  }

  get navigationBreadcrumbs(): Array<{ label: string; path: string }> {
    return buildSegments(this.headerPath)
      .map(segment => ({ label: segment.label, path: segment.fullPath }))
      .filter(segment => this.isWithinAnalysisRoot(segment.path));
  }

  get hasVisibleContent(): boolean {
    return !!this.result || this.entries.length > 0;
  }

  get scopeMetricTitle(): string {
    return 'Direct children';
  }

  get scopeMetricHint(): string {
    if (this.isTraversing) return `${this.entries.length.toLocaleString()} direct children loaded so far`;
    return `${this.entries.length.toLocaleString()} direct children in view`;
  }

  get directChildrenCount(): number {
    return this.entries.length;
  }

  get totalFootprintLabel(): string {
    return this.formatBytes(this.result?.totalSize ?? this.liveProgress?.totalSize ?? this.visibleEntriesSize);
  }

  get totalCompositionLabel(): string {
    const files = this.result?.totalFiles ?? this.liveProgress?.totalFiles ?? this.entries.reduce((sum, entry) => sum + (entry.isDir ? entry.files : 1), 0);
    const dirs = this.result?.totalDirs ?? this.liveProgress?.totalDirs ?? this.entries.reduce((sum, entry) => sum + (entry.isDir ? 1 + entry.dirs : 0), 0);
    return `${files.toLocaleString()} files · ${dirs.toLocaleString()} dirs`;
  }

  get headerProgressLabel(): string {
    if (!this.entries.length) return 'Loading entries...';
    return `Loading entries... ${this.entries.length} loaded`;
  }

  get liveElapsedLabel(): string {
    const ms = this.result?.elapsedMs ?? this.liveProgress?.elapsedMs ?? this.liveElapsedMs;
    if (ms < 1000) return `${ms} ms`;
    return `${(ms / 1000).toFixed(1)} s`;
  }

  get liveThroughputLabel(): string {
    const elapsedMs = this.result?.elapsedMs ?? this.liveProgress?.elapsedMs ?? this.liveElapsedMs;
    const totalSize = this.result?.totalSize ?? this.liveProgress?.totalSize ?? this.visibleEntriesSize;
    const secs = elapsedMs / 1000;
    if (secs < 0.5 || !totalSize) return 'scanning…';
    const bytesPerSec = totalSize / secs;
    const units = ['B', 'KB', 'MB', 'GB', 'TB'];
    const k = 1024;
    const i = bytesPerSec > 0 ? Math.min(Math.floor(Math.log(bytesPerSec) / Math.log(k)), units.length - 1) : 0;
    const val = bytesPerSec / Math.pow(k, i);
    const fmt = i === 0 ? Math.round(val).toString() : val.toFixed(1);
    return `${fmt} ${units[i]}/s`;
  }

  get liveTraversalSummary(): string {
    let dirs: number;
    let files: number;
    if (this.result) {
      dirs  = this.result.totalDirs;
      files = this.result.totalFiles;
    } else if (this.liveProgress) {
      dirs  = this.liveProgress.totalDirs;
      files = this.liveProgress.totalFiles;
    } else {
      dirs  = this.entries.reduce((s, e) => s + (e.isDir ? 1 + e.dirs  : 0), 0);
      files = this.entries.reduce((s, e) => s + (e.isDir ? e.files     : 1), 0);
    }
    const total = dirs + files;
    if (!total) return 'scanning…';
    return `${total.toLocaleString()} entries (${dirs.toLocaleString()} dirs · ${files.toLocaleString()} files)`;
  }

  get dominantFileTypeValue(): string {
    return this.rootDominantFileType?.name ?? 'Uncategorized';
  }

  get dominantFileTypeHint(): string {
    const topType = this.rootDominantFileType;
    if (topType) return `${topType.count.toLocaleString()} files · ${this.rootFileTypePct(topType)}`;
    if (this.totalFileCount === 0) return 'No files in this folder tree';
    return 'No matched categories in this folder tree';
  }

  get fileTypePanelHint(): string {
    return `${this.fileTypeSourceLabel} subtree · ${this.fileTypeSourceFileCount.toLocaleString()} files`;
  }

  get fileTypeEmptyLabel(): string {
    if (this.isTraversing && !this.fileTypeSourceFileCount) return 'Scanning file types…';
    if (this.fileTypeSourceFileCount === 0) return 'No files found in the selected subtree.';
    return 'No common file types matched the selected subtree.';
  }

  get breakdownEmptyLabel(): string {
    if (this.isTraversing && !this.entries.length) return 'Scanning folder…';
    return 'Folder is empty.';
  }

  get pieEmptyStateTitle(): string {
    if (this.isTraversing) return 'Scanning folder footprint';
    if (this.currentPieFrame.label && this.currentPieFrame.label !== 'Subtree') {
      return `${this.currentPieFrame.label} is empty`;
    }
    return 'This folder is empty';
  }

  get pieEmptyStateHint(): string {
    if (this.isTraversing) {
      return 'Distribution will appear as soon as files or child folders are discovered.';
    }
    return 'No files or child folders are available to visualize in this location.';
  }

  get pieDistributionLoadingLabel(): string {
    return this.labelFromPath(this.pieDistributionLoadingPath) || this.pieDistributionLoadingPath || 'selected folder';
  }

  barPercent(e: DiskUsageEntry): number {
    const totalSize = this.result?.totalSize ?? this.visibleEntriesSize;
    if (!totalSize) return 0;
    return Math.max(0.3, (e.size / totalSize) * 100);
  }

  pct(e: DiskUsageEntry): string {
    const totalSize = this.result?.totalSize ?? this.visibleEntriesSize;
    if (!totalSize) return '—';
    const p = (e.size / totalSize) * 100;
    return p < 0.1 ? '<0.1%' : p.toFixed(1) + '%';
  }

  fileTypeBarPercent(row: FileTypeBreakdownRow): number {
    if (!this.fileTypeSourceBytes) return 0;
    return Math.max(0.3, (row.totalSize / this.fileTypeSourceBytes) * 100);
  }

  fileTypePct(row: FileTypeBreakdownRow): string {
    if (!this.fileTypeSourceBytes) return '—';
    const pct = (row.totalSize / this.fileTypeSourceBytes) * 100;
    return pct < 0.1 ? '<0.1%' : pct.toFixed(1) + '%';
  }

  rootFileTypePct(row: FileTypeBreakdownRow): string {
    const totalSize = this.result?.totalSize ?? this.visibleEntriesSize;
    if (!totalSize) return '—';
    const pct = (row.totalSize / totalSize) * 100;
    return pct < 0.1 ? '<0.1%' : pct.toFixed(1) + '%';
  }

  formatBytes(bytes: number): string {
    if (!bytes) return '0 B';
    const units = ['B', 'KB', 'MB', 'GB', 'TB'];
    const k = 1024, i = Math.min(Math.floor(Math.log(bytes) / Math.log(k)), units.length - 1);
    const val = bytes / Math.pow(k, i);
    return (i === 0 ? val : val.toFixed(1)) + ' ' + units[i];
  }

  entryComposition(entry: DiskUsageEntry): string {
    return entry.isDir ? `${entry.files} files · ${entry.dirs} dirs` : 'File';
  }

  private get visibleEntriesSize(): number {
    return this.entries.reduce((sum, entry) => sum + entry.size, 0);
  }

  private isDiskUsageResult(item: DiskUsageEntry | DiskUsageProgress | DiskUsageResult): item is DiskUsageResult {
    return Array.isArray((item as DiskUsageResult).entries);
  }

  private isDiskUsageProgress(item: DiskUsageEntry | DiskUsageProgress | DiskUsageResult): item is DiskUsageProgress {
    return !this.isDiskUsageResult(item) && 'elapsedMs' in item && 'totalFiles' in item && !('path' in item);
  }

  private syncRootPieFrame(totalSize: number): void {
    const rootFrame: PieFrame = {
      label: 'Subtree',
      path: this.currentPath,
      sourceEntry: null,
      entries: this.entries,
      totalSize,
    };
    this.pieFrameCache.set(this.currentPath, rootFrame);
    if (this.pieStack.length <= 1) {
      this.pieStack = [rootFrame];
    }
  }

  private pushPieFrame(frame: PieFrame): void {
    const currentFrame = this.currentPieFrame;
    if (currentFrame.path === frame.path && currentFrame.entries === frame.entries && currentFrame.totalSize === frame.totalSize) {
      this.cdr.markForCheck();
      return;
    }

    const existingIndex = frame.path
      ? this.pieStack.findIndex((item) => item.path === frame.path)
      : -1;

    if (existingIndex >= 0) {
      this.pieStack = this.pieStack.slice(0, existingIndex + 1);
    } else {
      this.pieStack = [...this.pieStack, frame];
    }

    this.schedulePieFramePrefetch(frame.entries, frame.path);
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
  }

  private loadPieFrame(entry: DiskUsageEntry): Promise<PieFrame | null> {
    const cachedFrame = this.pieFrameCache.get(entry.path);
    if (cachedFrame) return Promise.resolve(cachedFrame);

    const pendingFrame = this.pendingPieFrames.get(entry.path);
    if (pendingFrame) return pendingFrame;

    const promise = this.api.analyzeDiskUsage(entry.path)
      .then((result) => {
        const frame: PieFrame = {
          label: entry.name || this.labelFromPath(entry.path) || 'Folder',
          path: entry.path,
          sourceEntry: entry,
          entries: result.entries ?? [],
          totalSize: result.totalSize ?? entry.size,
        };
        this.pieFrameCache.set(entry.path, frame);
        return frame;
      })
      .catch(() => null)
      .finally(() => {
        this.pendingPieFrames.delete(entry.path);
      });

    this.pendingPieFrames.set(entry.path, promise);
    return promise;
  }

  private schedulePieFramePrefetch(entries: DiskUsageEntry[], framePath?: string): void {
    if (this.isTraversing || !entries.length) return;

    const candidates = entries
      .filter((entry) => entry.isDir && entry.path !== framePath && !this.pieFrameCache.has(entry.path) && !this.pendingPieFrames.has(entry.path))
      .sort((left, right) => right.size - left.size)
      .slice(0, PIE_PREFETCH_LIMIT);

    if (!candidates.length) return;

    const runId = ++this.piePrefetchRunId;
    const analysisRoot = this.currentPath;
    void this.runPieFramePrefetch(candidates, runId, analysisRoot);
  }

  private async runPieFramePrefetch(entries: DiskUsageEntry[], runId: number, analysisRoot: string): Promise<void> {
    for (const entry of entries) {
      if (this.destroyed || runId !== this.piePrefetchRunId || this.currentPath !== analysisRoot) return;
      await this.loadPieFrame(entry);
    }
  }

  private get totalFileCount(): number {
    return this.result?.totalFiles ?? this.liveProgress?.totalFiles ?? this.entries.reduce((sum, entry) => sum + (entry.isDir ? entry.files : 1), 0);
  }

  private get rootDominantFileType(): FileTypeBreakdownRow | null {
    return this.buildFileTypeRows(this.result?.types ?? this.mergeEntryTypes(this.entries))[0] ?? null;
  }

  private buildFileTypeRows(types: Record<string, DiskUsageTypeStat>): FileTypeBreakdownRow[] {
    const rows = new Map<string, FileTypeBreakdownRow>();
    const allowedCategoryIds = new Set(SIZE_MANAGER_FILE_CATEGORIES.map((category) => category.id));

    for (const [extension, stat] of Object.entries(types)) {
      for (const category of getFileCategoriesForExtension(extension)) {
        if (!allowedCategoryIds.has(category.id)) continue;

        const existing = rows.get(category.id);
        if (existing) {
          existing.count += stat.count;
          existing.totalSize += stat.size;
        } else {
          rows.set(category.id, {
            id: category.id,
            name: category.name,
            icon: category.icon,
            count: stat.count,
            totalSize: stat.size,
          });
        }
      }
    }

    return Array.from(rows.values()).sort((a, b) => {
      if (b.totalSize !== a.totalSize) return b.totalSize - a.totalSize;
      if (b.count !== a.count) return b.count - a.count;
      return a.name.localeCompare(b.name);
    });
  }

  private rebuildFileTypeBreakdown(): void {
    const source = this.getFileTypeSource();

    this.fileTypeSourceLabel = source.label;
    this.fileTypeSourceFileCount = source.fileCount;
    this.fileTypeSourceBytes = source.totalSize;
    this.fileTypeRows = this.buildFileTypeRows(source.types);
  }

  private getFileTypeSource(): FileTypeBreakdownSource {
    const selected = this.selectedEntry;
    if (selected) {
      return {
        label: this.labelFromPath(selected.path) || selected.name || 'Selected item',
        fileCount: selected.isDir ? selected.files : 1,
        totalSize: selected.size,
        types: selected.types ?? {},
      };
    }

    const rootTypes = this.result?.types ?? this.mergeEntryTypes(this.entries);
    const rootFileCount = this.result?.totalFiles ?? this.liveProgress?.totalFiles ?? this.entries.reduce((sum, entry) => sum + (entry.isDir ? entry.files : 1), 0);
    const rootSize = this.result?.totalSize ?? this.liveProgress?.totalSize ?? this.visibleEntriesSize;
    return {
      label: this.headerLabel || 'Current folder',
      fileCount: rootFileCount,
      totalSize: rootSize,
      types: rootTypes,
    };
  }

  private mergeEntryTypes(entries: DiskUsageEntry[]): Record<string, DiskUsageTypeStat> {
    const merged: Record<string, DiskUsageTypeStat> = {};
    for (const entry of entries) {
      for (const [extension, stat] of Object.entries(entry.types ?? {})) {
        const current = merged[extension] ?? { count: 0, size: 0 };
        merged[extension] = {
          count: current.count + stat.count,
          size: current.size + stat.size,
        };
      }
    }
    return merged;
  }

  private syncSelectedEntry(): void {
    if (!this.selectedEntry) return;
    const match = this.entries.find((entry) => entry.path === this.selectedEntry?.path)
      ?? this.currentPieFrame.entries.find((entry) => entry.path === this.selectedEntry?.path)
      ?? null;
    this.selectedEntry = match;
  }

  // ── Core analysis ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  private resetAnalysisState(): void {
    this.stopTick();
    this.loading = false;
    this.isTraversing = false;
    this.error = null;
    this.liveElapsedMs = 0;
    this.liveProgress = null;
    this.result = null;
    this.entries = [];
    this.fileTypeRows = [];
    this.fileTypeSourceLabel = 'Current folder';
    this.fileTypeSourceFileCount = 0;
    this.fileTypeSourceBytes = 0;
    this.selectedEntry = null;
    this.currentPath = '';
    this.parentPath = null;
    this.pieStack = [];
    this.pieFrameCache.clear();
    this.pendingPieFrames.clear();
    this.activePieRequestId++;
    this.piePrefetchRunId++;
    this.pieDistributionLoadingPath = '';
  }

  async analyse(path: string): Promise<void> {
    const scanRunId = ++this.activeScanRunId;
    this.currentPath = path;
    this.parentPath  = this.getScopedParent(path);
    this.loading     = true;
    this.isTraversing = true;
    this.error       = null;
    this.liveProgress = null;
    this.result      = null;
    this.entries     = [];
    this.fileTypeRows = [];
    this.fileTypeSourceLabel = 'Current folder';
    this.fileTypeSourceFileCount = 0;
    this.fileTypeSourceBytes = 0;
    this.selectedEntry = null;
    this.pieStack    = [];
    this.pieFrameCache.clear();
    this.pendingPieFrames.clear();
    this.activePieRequestId++;
    this.piePrefetchRunId++;
    this.pieDistributionLoadingPath = '';
    this.startTick();
    this.cdr.markForCheck();

    let firstEntryArrived = false;
    try {
      for await (const item of this.api.streamDiskUsage(path)) {
        if (this.destroyed || this.activeScanRunId !== scanRunId || this.currentPath !== path) break;
        if (this.isDiskUsageResult(item)) {
          this.liveProgress = {
            totalSize: item.totalSize,
            totalFiles: item.totalFiles,
            totalDirs: item.totalDirs,
            elapsedMs: item.elapsedMs,
          };
          this.result = item;
          this.entries = item.entries?.length ? item.entries : this.entries;
          this.syncRootPieFrame(item.totalSize);
          this.syncSelectedEntry();
          this.rebuildFileTypeBreakdown();
          if (!firstEntryArrived) {
            firstEntryArrived = true;
            this.firstEntryArrived.emit();
          }
          this.cdr.markForCheck();
        } else if (this.isDiskUsageProgress(item)) {
          this.liveProgress = item;
          this.cdr.markForCheck();
        } else {
          const existingIndex = this.entries.findIndex((entry) => entry.path === item.path);
          if (existingIndex >= 0) {
            const nextEntries = [...this.entries];
            nextEntries[existingIndex] = item;
            this.entries = nextEntries;
          } else {
            this.entries = [...this.entries, item];
          }
          this.syncRootPieFrame(this.visibleEntriesSize);
          this.syncSelectedEntry();
          this.rebuildFileTypeBreakdown();
          if (!firstEntryArrived) {
            firstEntryArrived = true;
            this.firstEntryArrived.emit();
          }
          this.cdr.markForCheck();
        }
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      if (this.destroyed || this.activeScanRunId !== scanRunId || this.currentPath !== path) return;
      this.error   = err?.message || String(err);
      this.liveProgress = null;
      this.result  = null;
      this.entries = [];
      this.fileTypeRows = [];
      this.fileTypeSourceLabel = 'Current folder';
      this.fileTypeSourceFileCount = 0;
      this.fileTypeSourceBytes = 0;
      this.pieStack = [];
      this.pieDistributionLoadingPath = '';
    } finally {
      if (this.destroyed || this.activeScanRunId !== scanRunId || this.currentPath !== path) return;
      this.loading = false;
      this.isTraversing = false;
      this.stopTick();
      this.schedulePieFramePrefetch(this.currentPieFrame.entries, this.currentPieFrame.path);
      this.cdr.markForCheck();
    }
  }

  private startTick(): void {
    this.stopTick();
    this.scanStartedAt = Date.now();
    this.liveElapsedMs = 0;
    this.tickInterval = setInterval(() => {
      this.liveElapsedMs = Date.now() - this.scanStartedAt;
      this.cdr.markForCheck();
    }, 100);
  }

  private stopTick(): void {
    if (this.tickInterval !== null) {
      clearInterval(this.tickInterval);
      this.tickInterval = null;
    }
  }

  private getParent(path: string): string | null {
    const normalized = normalizePath(path || '');
    if (!normalized || normalized === '/') return null;
    const parent = parentPath(normalized);
    return parent === normalized ? null : parent;
  }

  private getScopedParent(path: string): string | null {
    const parent = this.getParent(path);
    if (!parent) return null;

    const root = this.analysisRootPath;
    if (!root) return parent;

    const current = this.normalizePathDisplay(path);
    if (current === root) return null;

    const normalizedParent = this.normalizePathDisplay(parent);
    if (normalizedParent === root) return parent;
    if (normalizedParent.startsWith(root + '/')) return parent;
    return null;
  }

  private isWithinAnalysisRoot(path: string): boolean {
    const root = this.analysisRootPath;
    if (!root) return true;

    const candidate = this.normalizePathDisplay(path);
    if (!candidate) return false;

    const windowsPath = /^[a-z]:\//i.test(root);
    const compareRoot = windowsPath ? root.toLowerCase() : root;
    const compareCandidate = windowsPath ? candidate.toLowerCase() : candidate;

    return compareCandidate === compareRoot || compareCandidate.startsWith(compareRoot.endsWith('/') ? compareRoot : `${compareRoot}/`);
  }

  private labelFromPath(path: string): string {
    const normalized = normalizePath(path || '');
    if (!normalized || normalized === '/') return '';
    const segments = buildSegments(normalized);
    return segments[segments.length - 1]?.label || normalized;
  }

  private normalizePathDisplay(path: string): string {
    return normalizePath(path || '');
  }
}
`````

`````typescript
      <app-pane-sync-review *ngIf="paneSyncReviewMounted$ | async"></app-pane-sync-review>
      <app-archive-files-dialog *ngIf="archiveFilesMounted$ | async"></app-archive-files-dialog>

      <app-command-palette #commandPalette [commands]="commandPaletteCommands"></app-command-palette>
      <app-global-search
        #globalSearch
        (openResult)="managerRef?.openSearchResult($event)"
        (openContainingFolder)="managerRef?.openSearchContainingFolder($event)"
        (openAsPanel)="managerRef?.openSearchResultsPanel($event)"
        (openAsWorkspace)="managerRef?.openSearchWorkspace($event)"
        (openPanelPath)="managerRef?.openDiscoveryPanelPath($event)">
      </app-global-search>
      <app-tools-center
        #toolsCenter
        (changed)="managerRef?.refreshBothPanes()"
        (navigateTo)="managerRef?.navigateFromTools($event)"
        (openBasketRequested)="selectionBasket?.show()">
      </app-tools-center>
      <app-disk-usage-dialog
        [visible]="diskUsageDialogVisible"
        [rootPath]="diskUsageDialogPath"
        (closed)="closeDiskUsageDialog()">
      </app-disk-usage-dialog>
      <app-selection-basket
        #selectionBasket
        (copyTo)="managerRef?.copyBasketTo($event)"
        (moveTo)="managerRef?.moveBasketTo($event)"
        (deleteRequested)="managerRef?.deleteBasket()">
      </app-selection-basket>
      <app-workspace-switcher
        #workspaceSwitcher
        (workspaceActivated)="managerRef?.applyActiveWorkspace()"
        (toolWorkspaceActivated)="managerRef?.activateToolWorkspace($event)">
      </app-workspace-switcher>
      <app-path-history
        #pathHistory
        [paneId]="managerRef?.activePaneId ?? 'left'"
        [currentPath]="managerRef?.activePane?.contextState?.path ?? ''"
        (navigate)="managerRef?.navigateFromHistory($event)">
      </app-path-history>
      <app-quick-access
        #quickAccess
        [paneId]="managerRef?.activePaneId ?? 'left'"
        [currentPath]="managerRef?.activePane?.contextState?.path ?? ''"
        [currentSurfaceId]="managerRef?.activePane?.contextState?.activeSurfaceId || 'dir'"
        (navigate)="managerRef?.navigateFromQuickAccess($event)"
        (openTarget)="managerRef?.openQuickAccessTarget($event)">
      </app-quick-access>
      <app-remote-connections
        #remoteConnections
        (navigate)="managerRef?.navigateFromRemoteConnections($event)">
      </app-remote-connections>
      <app-closed-tabs
        [visible]="closedTabsVisible"
        (closed)="closedTabsVisible = false"
        (reopenRequested)="managerRef?.reopenClosedTabEntry($event)">
      </app-closed-tabs>
      <app-operation-journal
        [visible]="operationJournalVisible"
        (closed)="operationJournalVisible = false"
        (undoRequested)="managerRef?.undoLastOperation()"
        (redoRequested)="managerRef?.redoLastOperation()">
      </app-operation-journal>
      <app-keyboard-help #keyboardHelp></app-keyboard-help>
      <app-input-center
        [visible]="inputCenterVisible"
        (closed)="inputCenterVisible = false">
      </app-input-center>
      <app-perf-overlay></app-perf-overlay>
      <reassembly-registry-plugin-host></reassembly-registry-plugin-host>
    </main>
  `,
  styles: [`
    :host {
      display: block;
      width: 100vw;
      height: 100vh;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .app-shell {
      flex-direction: column;
      display: flex;
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      min-width: 0;
      min-height: 0;
      overflow: hidden;
      background: var(--vsc-editor-background, var(--vsc-editor-background));
      color: var(--vsc-foreground, var(--vsc-foreground));
    }

    .app-shell > app-dual-pane {
      display: flex;
      flex: 1 1 0%;
      width: 100%;
      min-width: 0;
      min-height: 0;
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    .startup-shell {
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      width: 100%;
      flex: 1 1 0%;
      min-height: 0;
      font: 14px/1.4 var(--vsc-font-family, system-ui, sans-serif);
      color: var(--vsc-description-foreground, var(--vsc-foreground));
    }
  `],
})
export class AppComponent implements OnInit, OnDestroy, ApplicationOverlayHost {
  readonly batchRenameMounted$ = this.batchRenameDialog.mountedRequest$;
  readonly remoteConnectMounted$ = this.remoteConnectDialog.mountedRequest$;
  readonly settingsMounted$ = this.settingsService.getMountedRequest$();
  readonly trashMounted$ = this.trashDialog.mountedRequest$;
  readonly confirmMounted$ = this.confirmDialog.mountedRequest$;
  readonly paneCompareMounted$ = this.paneCompareDialog.mountedRequest$;
  readonly paneRecursiveCompareMounted$ = this.paneRecursiveCompareDialog.mountedRequest$;
  readonly paneSyncReviewMounted$ = this.paneSyncReviewDialog.mountedRequest$;
  readonly archiveFilesMounted$ = this.archiveFilesDialog.mountedRequest$;

  commandPaletteCommands: PaletteCommand[] = [];
  inputCenterVisible = false;
  operationJournalVisible = false;
  closedTabsVisible = false;
  diskUsageDialogVisible = false;
  diskUsageDialogPath = '';
  managerRef: DualPaneComponent | undefined;

  @ViewChild('commandPalette') commandPalette?: CommandPaletteComponent;
  @ViewChild('globalSearch') globalSearch?: GlobalSearchComponent;
  @ViewChild('toolsCenter') toolsCenter?: ToolsCenterComponent;
  @ViewChild('selectionBasket') selectionBasket?: SelectionBasketComponent;
  @ViewChild('workspaceSwitcher') workspaceSwitcher?: WorkspaceSwitcherComponent;
  @ViewChild('pathHistory') pathHistory?: PathHistoryComponent;
  @ViewChild('quickAccess') quickAccess?: QuickAccessComponent;
  @ViewChild('remoteConnections') remoteConnections?: RemoteConnectionsComponent;
  @ViewChild('keyboardHelp') keyboardHelp?: KeyboardHelpComponent;

  @ViewChild('manager')
  set manager(value: DualPaneComponent | undefined) {
    this.managerRef = value;
    if (!value) return;
    this.pluginBootstrap.bindSelectionProvider(
      () => value.pluginSelectionPaths() ?? [],
    );
  }

  pluginsReady = false;

  constructor(
    private readonly pluginBootstrap: PluginBootstrapService,
    private readonly modalStack: ModalStackService,
    private readonly inputCustomization: InputCustomizationService,
    private readonly ngZone: NgZone,
    private readonly cdr: ChangeDetectorRef,
    private readonly batchRenameDialog: BatchRenameDialogService,
    private readonly remoteConnectDialog: RemoteConnectDialogService,
    private readonly settingsService: SettingsService,
    private readonly trashDialog: TrashDialogService,
    private readonly confirmDialog: ConfirmDialogService,
    private readonly paneCompareDialog: PaneCompareDialogService,
    private readonly paneRecursiveCompareDialog: PaneRecursiveCompareDialogService,
    private readonly paneSyncReviewDialog: PaneSyncReviewDialogService,
    private readonly archiveFilesDialog: ArchiveFilesDialogService,
    private readonly overlays: ApplicationOverlayHostService,
  ) {}

  @HostListener('document:keydown.escape', ['$event'])
  onGlobalEscape(event: Event): void {
    const keyboardEvent = event as KeyboardEvent;
    if (keyboardEvent.defaultPrevented) return;
    if (!this.modalStack.dismissTopmost()) return;

    keyboardEvent.preventDefault();
    keyboardEvent.stopPropagation();
  }

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.overlays.bind(this);
    void this.bootstrapPlugins();
  }

  ngOnDestroy(): void {
    this.overlays.unbind(this);
    void this.pluginBootstrap.shutdown();
  }

  openCommandPalette(commands: readonly unknown[]): void {
    this.commandPaletteCommands = commands as PaletteCommand[];
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
    queueMicrotask(() => {
      const palette = this.commandPalette as (CommandPaletteComponent & { show?: () => void; open?: () => void }) | undefined;
      if (typeof palette?.show === 'function') palette.show();
      else if (typeof palette?.open === 'function') palette.open();
    });
  }

  openGlobalSearch(rootPath: string): void { this.globalSearch?.open(rootPath); }
  closeGlobalSearch(): void { this.globalSearch?.close(); }
  openTools(page: AppOverlayToolsPage, rootPath: string): void { this.toolsCenter?.open(page, rootPath); }
  showSelectionBasket(): void { this.selectionBasket?.show(); }
  openWorkspaceSwitcher(): void { this.workspaceSwitcher?.open(); }
  createWorkspace(): void { this.workspaceSwitcher?.createWorkspace(); }
  openPathHistory(mode: AppOverlayHistoryMode): void { this.pathHistory?.open(mode); }
  openQuickAccess(sectionId?: string): void { void this.quickAccess?.open(sectionId); }
  openRemoteConnections(): void { this.remoteConnections?.open(); }
  showKeyboardHelp(): void { this.keyboardHelp?.show(); }
  toggleInputCenter(): void { this.inputCenterVisible = !this.inputCenterVisible; this.cdr.markForCheck(); }
  showOperationJournal(): void { this.operationJournalVisible = true; this.cdr.markForCheck(); }
  showClosedTabs(): void { this.closedTabsVisible = true; this.cdr.markForCheck(); }
  closeClosedTabs(): void { this.closedTabsVisible = false; this.cdr.markForCheck(); }
  openDiskUsage(rootPath: string): void {
    this.diskUsageDialogPath = rootPath;
    this.diskUsageDialogVisible = true;
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
  }
  closeDiskUsageDialog(): void {
    this.diskUsageDialogVisible = false;
    this.diskUsageDialogPath = '';
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
  }

  private async bootstrapPlugins(): Promise<void> {
    try {
      await this.pluginBootstrap.initialize(() => []);
    } finally {
      this.ngZone.run(() => {
        this.pluginsReady = true;
        this.cdr.markForCheck();
      });
    }
  }
}
`````

`````typescript
export class ApplicationMenuBarComponent implements OnInit, OnDestroy {
  readonly menus = MENUS;
  openMenuIndex: number | null = null;
  maximized = false;

  private readonly resizeHandler = () => {
    void this.refreshMaximizedState();
  };

  constructor(
    private readonly input: InputEngineService,
    private readonly element: ElementRef<HTMLElement>,
    private readonly windowState: WindowStateService,
    private readonly cdr: ChangeDetectorRef,
  ) {}

  ngOnInit(): void {
    window.addEventListener('resize', this.resizeHandler, { passive: true });
    void this.refreshMaximizedState();
  }

  ngOnDestroy(): void {
    window.removeEventListener('resize', this.resizeHandler);
  }

  toggleMenu(index: number, event: Event): void {
    event.preventDefault();
    event.stopPropagation();
    this.openMenuIndex = this.openMenuIndex === index ? null : index;
  }

  openMenu(index: number, event?: Event): void {
    event?.preventDefault();
    event?.stopPropagation();
    this.openMenuIndex = index;
    queueMicrotask(() => this.focusFirstEnabledItem());
  }

  onMenuHover(index: number): void {
    if (this.openMenuIndex !== null) {
      this.openMenuIndex = index;
    }
  }

  execute(commandId: string, event: Event): void {
    event.preventDefault();
    event.stopPropagation();
    if (!this.isEnabled(commandId)) return;

    this.openMenuIndex = null;
    this.cdr.detectChanges();
    queueMicrotask(() => {
      this.input.dispatchCommandById(commandId, { source: 'mouse' });
    });
  }

  isEnabled(commandId: string): boolean {
    return this.input.getCommandState(commandId)?.enabled === true;
  }

  shortcut(commandId: string): string {
    const binding = this.input.getPreferredKeyboardBinding(commandId);
    return binding ? this.formatBinding(binding) : '';
  }

  minimizeWindow(event: MouseEvent): void {
    event.preventDefault();
    event.stopPropagation();
    this.openMenuIndex = null;
    WindowMinimise();
  }

  async toggleMaximize(event: MouseEvent): Promise<void> {
    event.preventDefault();
    event.stopPropagation();
    this.openMenuIndex = null;
    WindowToggleMaximise();
    await this.refreshMaximizedState();
  }

  async closeWindow(event: MouseEvent): Promise<void> {
    event.preventDefault();
    event.stopPropagation();
    this.openMenuIndex = null;

    // Preserve the same geometry persistence path used by normal app shutdown.
    await this.windowState.captureNow().catch(() => undefined);
    Quit();
  }

  private async refreshMaximizedState(): Promise<void> {
    try {
      this.maximized = await WindowIsMaximised();
    } catch {
      this.maximized = false;
    }
  }

  @HostListener('document:mousedown', ['$event'])
  onDocumentMouseDown(event: MouseEvent): void {
    if (this.openMenuIndex === null) return;
    if (this.element.nativeElement.contains(event.target as Node)) return;
    this.openMenuIndex = null;
  }

  @HostListener('document:keydown', ['$event'])
  onDocumentKeyDown(event: KeyboardEvent): void {
    if (event.key === 'Escape' && this.openMenuIndex !== null) {
      event.preventDefault();
      event.stopPropagation();
      this.openMenuIndex = null;
      return;
    }

    if (this.openMenuIndex === null) return;

    if (event.key === 'ArrowRight') {
      event.preventDefault();
      this.openMenuIndex = (this.openMenuIndex + 1) % this.menus.length;
      queueMicrotask(() => this.focusFirstEnabledItem());
      return;
    }

    if (event.key === 'ArrowLeft') {
      event.preventDefault();
      this.openMenuIndex =
        (this.openMenuIndex - 1 + this.menus.length) % this.menus.length;
      queueMicrotask(() => this.focusFirstEnabledItem());
    }
  }

  private focusFirstEnabledItem(): void {
    const popup = this.element.nativeElement.querySelector<HTMLElement>('.menu-popup');
    popup?.querySelector<HTMLButtonElement>('.menu-item:not(:disabled)')?.focus();
  }

  private formatBinding(binding: InputBindingDefinition): string {
    if (binding.trigger.device !== 'keyboard') return '';
    return binding.trigger.chord.steps
      .map(step => {
        const parts = [
          ...(step.modifiers ?? []).map(modifier => this.modifierLabel(modifier)),
          this.keyLabel(step.key),
        ];
        return parts.join('+');
      })
      .join(' ');
  }

  private modifierLabel(value: string): string {
    switch (value.toLowerCase()) {
      case 'ctrl': return 'Ctrl';
      case 'shift': return 'Shift';
      case 'alt': return 'Alt';
      case 'meta': return 'Meta';
      default: return value;
    }
  }

  private keyLabel(value: string): string {
    const key = value.toLowerCase();
    if (key === 'arrowleft') return 'Left';
    if (key === 'arrowright') return 'Right';
    if (key === 'arrowup') return 'Up';
    if (key === 'arrowdown') return 'Down';
    if (key === 'escape') return 'Esc';
    if (key === 'delete') return 'Del';
    if (key === 'backspace') return 'Backspace';
    if (key.length === 1) return key.toUpperCase();
    return key.replace(/^f(\d+)$/, 'F$1');
  }
}
`````

`````typescript
export class ArchiveFilesDialogComponent {
  draftValue = '';
  private seededRequest: ArchiveFilesDialogRequest | null = null;

  constructor(readonly dialogs: ArchiveFilesDialogService) {}

  get activeRequest(): ArchiveFilesDialogRequest | null {
    const request = this.dialogs.mountedRequest$.value;
    if (request && request !== this.seededRequest) {
      this.seededRequest = request;
      this.draftValue = request.defaultValue;
    } else if (!request) {
      this.seededRequest = null;
      this.draftValue = '';
    }
    return request;
  }

  get isClosing(): boolean {
    return !!this.dialogs.closingRequest$.value;
  }

  submit(): void {
    this.dialogs.submit(this.draftValue);
  }

  onAnimationEnd(event: AnimationEvent): void {
    if (event.target !== event.currentTarget || !this.isClosing) {
      return;
    }
    this.dialogs.finishClose();
  }
}
`````

`````typescript
import { buildArchivePath, parseArchivePath } from '../services/archive.service';
import { normalizePath as normalizePathReference } from './address-bar.utils';
import type { FileViewDirectorySource } from '../services/directory-source.service';
import { FileType, type FileInfo } from '../shared/protocol';
import { PARENT_ENTRY_PATH } from './file-entry.component';
import type { TreeContentMode, TreeNode } from './pane-tree.component';
import type { ViewLayout } from './pane-view-host.component';

export interface FileViewTreeHost {
  get currentPath(): string;
  get currentView(): ViewLayout;
  get showHidden(): boolean;
  get treeContentMode(): TreeContentMode;
  get entries(): FileInfo[];
  get treeNodes(): TreeNode[];
  set treeNodes(value: TreeNode[]);
  directorySource: FileViewDirectorySource;
  markForCheck(): void;
  sortTreeNodes(nodes: TreeNode[]): TreeNode[];
  expandTreeNode(path: string): void;
  centerTreeNode(path: string): void;
}

export class FileViewTreeController {
  private readonly nodeLoadPromises = new Map<string, Promise<void>>();
  private syncToken = 0;

  reset(): void {
    this.nodeLoadPromises.clear();
    this.syncToken += 1;
  }

  async syncToCurrentPath(host: FileViewTreeHost): Promise<void> {
    if (host.currentView !== 'tree') return;
    this.buildTreeNodes(host);

    const rootNode = host.treeNodes[0];
    if (!rootNode) return;

    const token = ++this.syncToken;
    const chain = this.buildPathChain(rootNode.path, host.currentPath);
    if (chain.length === 0) return;

    let current = rootNode;
    const expandedNodes: TreeNode[] = [rootNode];
    await this.ensureNodeChildrenLoaded(host, current);
    if (token !== this.syncToken) return;

    for (let index = 1; index < chain.length; index += 1) {
      const expected = this.normalizePath(chain[index]);
      const next = current.children?.find((child) => this.normalizePath(child.path) === expected);
      if (!next || (next.type !== FileType.DIRECTORY && next.type !== FileType.ARCHIVE)) break;
      current = next;
      expandedNodes.push(current);
      await this.ensureNodeChildrenLoaded(host, current);
      if (token !== this.syncToken) return;
    }

    setTimeout(() => {
      if (token !== this.syncToken || host.currentView !== 'tree') return;
      for (const node of expandedNodes) {
        host.expandTreeNode(node.path);
      }
      host.centerTreeNode(current.path);
    }, 0);
  }

  buildTreeNodes(host: FileViewTreeHost): void {
    const rootPath = this.getRootPath(host);
    if (!rootPath) {
      host.treeNodes = [];
      return;
    }

    const currentRoot = host.treeNodes[0];
    if (currentRoot && this.normalizePath(currentRoot.path) === this.normalizePath(rootPath)) {
      return;
    }

    this.nodeLoadPromises.clear();
    host.treeNodes = [this.createRootNode(rootPath)];
    host.markForCheck();
  }

  async ensureNodeChildrenLoaded(host: FileViewTreeHost, node: TreeNode): Promise<void> {
    if (node.loaded) return;

    const existingPromise = this.nodeLoadPromises.get(node.path);
    if (existingPromise) {
      await existingPromise;
      return;
    }

    const loadPromise = this.populateNodeChildren(host, node);
    this.nodeLoadPromises.set(node.path, loadPromise);
    try {
      await loadPromise;
    } finally {
      this.nodeLoadPromises.delete(node.path);
    }
  }

  refreshTreeNode(host: FileViewTreeHost, path: string): void {
    const target = this.normalizePath(path);
    const node = this.findTreeNodeByPath(host.treeNodes, target);
    if (!node || !node.loaded) return;
    node.loaded = false;
    host.treeNodes = [...host.treeNodes];
    host.markForCheck();
    void this.ensureNodeChildrenLoaded(host, node);
  }

  normalizePath(path: string): string {
    return normalizePathReference(path || '/');
  }

  private async populateNodeChildren(host: FileViewTreeHost, node: TreeNode): Promise<void> {
    node.loading = true;
    node.children = node.children?.length ? node.children : [];
    host.markForCheck();

    try {
      const context = node.archivePath ? parseArchivePath(node.archivePath) : null;
      const listing = context
        ? await host.directorySource.browseArchive(context.fsPath, context.nestedChain, context.innerPath)
        : await host.directorySource.listDirectory(node.path, host.showHidden);
      const childLevel = (node.level ?? 0) + 1;
      const existingChildren = new Map<string, TreeNode>();
      for (const child of node.children ?? []) {
        existingChildren.set(this.normalizePath(child.path), child);
      }

      const rawChildren: TreeNode[] = (listing.entries || [])
        .filter((entry) => entry.path !== PARENT_ENTRY_PATH)
        .filter((entry) => host.treeContentMode === 'all' || entry.type === FileType.DIRECTORY)
        .map((entry) => this.toChildNode(host, entry as FileInfo, node, context, childLevel, existingChildren));

      node.children = host.sortTreeNodes(rawChildren);
      node.loaded = true;
      node.loading = false;
      host.treeNodes = [...host.treeNodes];
      host.markForCheck();
    } catch {
      node.children = [];
      node.loading = false;
      node.loaded = true;
      host.treeNodes = [...host.treeNodes];
      host.markForCheck();
    }
  }

  private toChildNode(
    host: FileViewTreeHost,
    entry: FileInfo,
    node: TreeNode,
    context: ReturnType<typeof parseArchivePath> | null,
    childLevel: number,
    existingChildren: Map<string, TreeNode>,
  ): TreeNode {
    const entryNestedChain = (entry as any).nestedChain as string[] | undefined;
    const isArchiveEntry = entry.type === FileType.ARCHIVE;

    let childArchivePath: string | undefined;
    if (context) {
      if (isArchiveEntry) {
        const newChain = entryNestedChain?.length ? entryNestedChain : [...context.nestedChain, entry.path];
        childArchivePath = buildArchivePath(context.fsPath, newChain, '');
      } else {
        childArchivePath = buildArchivePath(context.fsPath, context.nestedChain, entry.path);
      }
    } else {
      childArchivePath = isArchiveEntry ? entry.path : undefined;
    }

    const childPath = context
      ? host.directorySource.joinChildPath(node.path, entry.name)
      : entry.path;

    const existing = existingChildren.get(this.normalizePath(childPath));
    return {
      ...entry,
      path: childPath,
      level: childLevel,
      expandable: entry.type === FileType.DIRECTORY || entry.type === FileType.ARCHIVE,
      expanded: existing?.expanded ?? false,
      children: existing?.children ?? ((entry.type === FileType.DIRECTORY || entry.type === FileType.ARCHIVE) ? [] : undefined),
      loaded: existing?.loaded ?? false,
      loading: false,
      renaming: existing?.renaming ?? false,
      editingName: existing?.editingName,
      parent: node,
      archivePath: childArchivePath,
    } as TreeNode;
  }

  private createRootNode(rootPath: string, archivePath?: string): TreeNode {
    const canonicalWindowsRoot = /^filesystem:\/\/([a-z])$/i.exec(rootPath);
    const nativeWindowsRoot = /^([a-z]):\/?$/i.exec(rootPath);
    const isWindowsRoot = !!canonicalWindowsRoot || !!nativeWindowsRoot;
    const windowsDrive = canonicalWindowsRoot?.[1] ?? nativeWindowsRoot?.[1] ?? '';
    const isRegistryRoot = rootPath === 'registry://';
    const rootName = archivePath
      ? rootPath.split('/').filter(Boolean).pop() || rootPath
      : (isRegistryRoot ? 'Registry' : (rootPath === '/' ? '/' : (isWindowsRoot ? `${windowsDrive.toUpperCase()}:` : rootPath)));
    return {
      name: rootName,
      path: rootPath,
      type: FileType.DIRECTORY,
      size: 0,
      modified: 0,
      created: 0,
      accessed: 0,
      permissions: '',
      isHidden: false,
      registryKind: isRegistryRoot ? 'Registry' : undefined,
      level: -1,
      syntheticRoot: rootPath,
      expandable: true,
      expanded: true,
      children: [],
      loaded: false,
      loading: false,
      parent: undefined,
      archivePath,
    } as TreeNode;
  }

  private getRootPath(host: FileViewTreeHost): string {
    return host.directorySource.getRootPath(this.normalizePath(host.currentPath || '/'), host.entries) ?? '/';
  }

  private buildPathChain(rootPath: string, targetPath: string): string[] {
    const root = this.normalizePath(rootPath);
    const target = this.normalizePath(targetPath || rootPath);

    const chain = [root];
    if (root === 'registry://') {
      if (target === root) return chain;
      const relative = target.slice(root.length).replace(/^\/+/, '');
      if (!relative) return chain;

      let current = root;
      for (const segment of relative.split('/').filter(Boolean)) {
        current = `${current}${segment}`;
        chain.push(this.normalizePath(current));
        current = `${current}/`;
      }
      return chain;
    }

    const rootForPrefix = root.endsWith('/') ? root : `${root}/`;
    const startsAtRoot = target === root || this.normalizePath(target).startsWith(rootForPrefix);
    if (!startsAtRoot) return chain;
    if (target === root) return chain;

    const relative = target.slice(root.length).replace(/^\/+/, '');
    if (!relative) return chain;

    let current = root;
    for (const segment of relative.split('/').filter(Boolean)) {
      current = current === '/' ? `/${segment}` : `${current.replace(/\/$/, '')}/${segment}`;
      chain.push(this.normalizePath(current));
    }
    return chain;
  }

  private findTreeNodeByPath(nodes: TreeNode[], target: string): TreeNode | undefined {
    for (const node of nodes) {
      if (this.normalizePath(node.path) === target) return node;
      if (node.children) {
        const found = this.findTreeNodeByPath(node.children, target);
        if (found) return found;
      }
    }
    return undefined;
  }
}
`````

`````typescript
          <span *ngIf="!error && searchProgress" class="progress">{{ searchProgress }}</span>
          <span *ngIf="searchWarnings.length" class="warning" [title]="searchWarnings.join('\n')">
            {{ searchWarnings.length }} warning{{ searchWarnings.length === 1 ? '' : 's' }}
          </span>
          <button
            *ngIf="mode !== 'collections'"
            type="button"
            class="open-panel palette-dialog-button"
            [disabled]="searching || resultCount === 0"
            (click)="openAsResultsPanel()">
            Open as Panel
          </button>
          <button
            *ngIf="mode === 'collections' && selectedCollection"
            type="button"
            class="open-panel palette-dialog-button"
            (click)="toggleSelectedCollectionPinned()">
            {{ selectedCollection.pinned ? 'Unpin' : 'Pin' }}
          </button>
          <button
            *ngIf="mode === 'search'"
            type="button"
            class="open-panel palette-dialog-button"
            [disabled]="searching || resultCount === 0"
            (click)="openAsResultsWorkspace()">
            Open Workspace
          </button>
          <span class="keys palette-dialog-footnote">↑ ↓ · Enter open · Ctrl+Enter folder · Ctrl+Shift+Enter panel · Alt+R recursive · Alt+S sort</span>
        </footer>
      </section>
    </div>
  `,
  styles: [`
    :host {
      position: fixed;
      inset: 0;
      z-index: 9480;
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .search {
      box-sizing: border-box;

      width: min(860px, calc(100vw - 24px));
      height: min(700px, calc(100vh - 32px));

    }

      gap: 12px;
    }

    .palette-dialog-title {
      min-width: 0;

    }

    .header-meta {
      display: flex;

      min-width: 0;

    }

    .root,

      color: var(--vsc-description-foreground, var(--vsc-foreground-dim));

      min-width: 0;

      display: flex;

    .query > input,
    .query input[type='text'] {
      box-sizing: border-box;
      flex: 1 1 280px;
      min-width: 220px;

      padding: 0 10px;
      border: 1px solid var(--vsc-border, var(--vsc-border));
      border-radius: 4px;
      outline: none;
      background: var(--vsc-input-background, var(--vsc-popover-background));

    .query label input[type='checkbox'] {

    .query select {

      min-width: 96px;
      padding: 0 8px;
      border: 1px solid var(--vsc-border, var(--vsc-border));
      border-radius: 4px;
      background: var(--vsc-input-background, var(--vsc-popover-background));

      font: inherit;
      outline: none;
    }

    .save-search {
      min-height: 30px;
      padding: 0 10px;
      border: 1px solid var(--vsc-border, transparent);
      border-radius: 4px;

    .save-search:hover:not(:disabled) {
      background: var(--vsc-list-hover-background, var(--vsc-list-hover-background));
      border-color: var(--vsc-border, transparent);

    .save-search:disabled,
    .open-panel:disabled {
      opacity: 0.45;
      cursor: default;

    .discovery-shortcuts {
      display: grid;
      gap: 6px;
      padding: 8px 12px;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--vsc-border-subtle, var(--vsc-border));
      color: var(--vsc-description-foreground, var(--vsc-foreground-dim));
      background: color-mix(
        in srgb,
        var(--vsc-panel-background, var(--vsc-editor-background)) 96%,
        var(--vsc-list-hover-background, transparent)
      );
    }

    .discovery-shortcuts > div {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
      min-width: 0;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .discovery-shortcuts > div > span {
      flex: 0 0 auto;

    .discovery-shortcuts button {

      border: 1px solid var(--vsc-border, var(--vsc-border));
      border-radius: 999px;
      background: transparent;

    .discovery-shortcuts button:hover {

    }

    .results {

      overflow: auto;

    .result {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 30px minmax(0, 1fr) auto;
      gap: 10px;
      align-items: center;
      width: 100%;
      min-height: 48px;
      padding: 7px 10px;
      text-align: left;
    }

    .result:hover,
    .result.selected {
      background: var(--vsc-list-hover-background, var(--vsc-list-hover-background));
    }

    .result.selected {
      border-color: color-mix(
        in srgb,
        var(--vsc-accent-blue, var(--vsc-accent-blue)) 55%,
        transparent
      );
    }

    .icon {
      text-align: center;
      font-size: 16px;
    }

    .details {
      min-width: 0;
      display: grid;
      gap: 2px;
    }

    .details strong,
    .details small {
      overflow: hidden;
      text-overflow: ellipsis;
      white-space: nowrap;
    }

    .details small {
      font-family: var(--vsc-font-family-mono, ui-monospace, monospace);
    }

    .collection .details small {
      opacity: 0.8;
    }

    .kind {
      justify-self: end;
      font-size: 10px;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.04em;
    }

    .empty {

      text-align: center;
      color: var(--vsc-description-foreground, var(--vsc-foreground-dim));
    }

    .palette-dialog-footer {

      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }

    .keys {
      margin-left: auto;
      min-width: 220px;
      text-align: right;
    }

      color: var(--vsc-warning);
    }

      overflow: hidden;

      white-space: nowrap;

    @media (max-width: 860px) {
      .search {
        width: min(100vw - 16px, 860px);
        height: min(100vh - 20px, 700px);
      }

      .palette-dialog-header,
      .query,
      .palette-dialog-footer {
        padding-left: 10px;
        padding-right: 10px;
      }

      .header-meta {
        flex-wrap: wrap;
        justify-content: flex-end;
      }

      .query {
        gap: 8px;
      }

      .query > input,
      .query input[type='text'] {
`````
