`````typescript
        min-width: 0;
      }

      .keys {
        width: 100%;
        margin-left: 0;
        text-align: left;
      }
    }
  `],
})
export class GlobalSearchComponent implements OnInit, OnDestroy {
  private readonly resultVirtualCollection = new VirtualCollection<FileInfo, string>({
    identity: entry => entry.path,
    itemExtent: SEARCH_RESULT_ROW_HEIGHT,
    threshold: SEARCH_RESULT_WINDOW_ITEMS,
    overscanRows: 80,
    guardRows: 24,
    minimumPrefetchItems: 512,
    prefetchMultiplier: 4,
    prefetchGuardRatio: 0.20,
  });

  @ViewChild('queryInput') queryInput?: ElementRef<HTMLInputElement>;
  @Output() openResult = new EventEmitter<FileInfo>();
  @Output() openContainingFolder = new EventEmitter<FileInfo>();
  @Output() openAsPanel = new EventEmitter<SearchResultsPanelRequest>();
  @Output() openAsWorkspace = new EventEmitter<SearchResultsPanelRequest>();
  @Output() openPanelPath = new EventEmitter<string>();

  visible = false;
  isClosing = false;
  rootPath = '';
  queryText = '';
  recursive = true;
  sortMode: SearchSort = 'relevance';
  typeFilter: DiscoverySearchType = 'all';
  mode: DiscoveryMode = 'search';
  historyEntries: ReturnType<DiscoveryHistoryService['history']> = [];
  savedSearches: ReturnType<DiscoveryHistoryService['saved']> = [];
  collections: readonly ResultsPanelDefinition[] = [];
  private queryHistoryIndex = -1;
  private readonly searchIndex = new SearchResultIndex();
  private resultWindowOffset = 0;
  private resultWindowEntries: readonly FileInfo[] = [];
  searchProgress = '';
  searchWarnings: readonly string[] = [];
  selectedIndex = 0;
  searching = false;
  error = '';

  private searchGeneration = 0;
  private searchAbort: AbortController | null = null;
  private searchTimer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null = null;

  constructor(
    private readonly searchService: DiscoverySearchService,
    readonly history: DiscoveryHistoryService,
    private readonly recentFiles: RecentFilesService,
    private readonly resultPanels: ResultsPanelService,
    private readonly dialogs: ConfirmDialogService,
    private readonly input: InputEngineService,
    private readonly cdr: ChangeDetectorRef,
  ) {}

  get resultCount(): number {
    return this.mode === 'collections'
      ? this.visibleCollections.length
      : this.searchIndex.resultCount;
  }

  get searchWindowStart(): number {
    if (this.mode === 'collections') return 0;
    this.refreshSearchVirtualWindow();
    return this.resultWindowOffset;
  }

  get renderedSearchResults(): readonly FileInfo[] {
    if (this.mode === 'collections') return [];
    this.refreshSearchVirtualWindow();
    return this.resultWindowEntries;
  }

  get modeLabel(): string {
    if (this.mode === 'recent') return 'Recent Files';
    if (this.mode === 'collections') return 'Collections';
    return 'Search';
  }

  get visibleCollections(): readonly ResultsPanelDefinition[] {
    const needle = this.queryText.trim().toLocaleLowerCase();
    return this.collections.filter(panel =>
      !needle ||
      panel.title.toLocaleLowerCase().includes(needle) ||
      this.collectionSummary(panel).toLocaleLowerCase().includes(needle)
    );
  }

  get selectedCollection(): ResultsPanelDefinition | null {
    return this.visibleCollections[this.selectedIndex] ?? null;
  }

  get selectedResult(): FileInfo | null {
    return this.mode === 'collections'
      ? null
      : this.searchIndex.at(this.selectedIndex);
  }

  get folderCount(): number {
    return this.searchIndex.folderCount;
  }

  get fileCount(): number {
    return this.searchIndex.fileCount;
  }

  get duplicateCandidateGroupCount(): number {
    return this.searchIndex.snapshot().duplicateCandidateGroups;
  }

  private refreshSearchVirtualWindow(): void {
    const count = this.searchIndex.resultCount;
    this.resultVirtualCollection.setLogicalCount(count);

    if (count === 0) {
      this.resultWindowOffset = 0;
      this.resultWindowEntries = [];
      this.resultVirtualCollection.populate(0, [], 0);
      return;
    }

    const index = Math.max(0, Math.min(count - 1, this.selectedIndex));
    this.resultVirtualCollection.revealIndex(
      index,
      Math.min(SEARCH_RESULT_WINDOW_ITEMS, count),
    );

    const prefetch = this.resultVirtualCollection.prefetch();
    const window = this.searchIndex.window(prefetch.offset, Math.max(1, prefetch.limit));
    this.resultVirtualCollection.populate(
      window.offset,
      window.entries,
      window.totalCount,
    );

    const renderWindow = this.resultVirtualCollection.window;
    this.resultWindowOffset = renderWindow.start;
    this.resultWindowEntries = this.resultVirtualCollection.renderedItems(renderWindow);
  }

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.input.registerContext({
      id: CONTEXT_ID,
      kind: 'overlay',
      priority: 390, exclusive: true,
      parentId: 'global',
      description: 'Reassembly global search',
    });

    this.input.registerCommandDescriptor({id:COMMAND.close,title:'Close Global Search',category:'Search & Filter',execute:()=>this.close()},OWNER_ID);
    this.input.registerCommandDescriptor({id:COMMAND.previous,title:'Previous Search Result',category:'Search & Filter',execute:()=>this.move(-1)},OWNER_ID);
    this.input.registerCommandDescriptor({id:COMMAND.next,title:'Next Search Result',category:'Search & Filter',execute:()=>this.move(1)},OWNER_ID);
    this.input.registerCommandDescriptor({id:COMMAND.open,title:'Open Search Result',category:'Search & Filter',execute:()=>{if(this.mode==='collections'){const panel=this.selectedCollection;if(panel)this.openCollection(panel);return;}const entry=this.selectedResult;if(entry)this.openEntry(entry)}},OWNER_ID);
    this.input.registerCommandDescriptor({id:COMMAND.openFolder,title:'Open Containing Folder',category:'Search & Filter',execute:()=>{const entry=this.selectedResult;if(entry)this.openFolder(entry)}},OWNER_ID);
    this.input.registerCommandDescriptor({id:COMMAND.openAsPanel,title:'Open Search Results as Panel',category:'Search & Filter',execute:()=>this.openAsResultsPanel(),isEnabled:()=>this.resultCount>0&&!this.searching},OWNER_ID);
    this.input.registerCommandDescriptor({id:COMMAND.toggleRecursive,title:'Toggle Recursive Search',category:'Search & Filter',execute:()=>this.toggleRecursive()},OWNER_ID);
    this.input.registerCommandDescriptor({id:COMMAND.cycleSort,title:'Cycle Search Sort',category:'Search & Filter',execute:()=>this.cycleSort()},OWNER_ID);
    this.input.registerCommandDescriptor({id:COMMAND.previousQuery,title:'Previous Search Query',category:'Search & Filter',execute:()=>this.moveQueryHistory(-1),isEnabled:()=>this.historyEntries.length>0},OWNER_ID);
    this.input.registerCommandDescriptor({id:COMMAND.nextQuery,title:'Next Search Query',category:'Search & Filter',execute:()=>this.moveQueryHistory(1),isEnabled:()=>this.historyEntries.length>0},OWNER_ID);

    for (const binding of BINDINGS) this.input.registerBinding(binding);
  }

  ngOnDestroy(): void {
    if (this.searchTimer) clearTimeout(this.searchTimer);
    this.input.deactivateContext(CONTEXT_ID);
    for (const binding of BINDINGS) this.input.unregisterBinding(binding.id);
    for (const id of Object.values(COMMAND)) {
      this.input.unregisterCommandDescriptor(id, OWNER_ID);
    }
  }

  open(rootPath: string): void {
    
    this.rootPath = rootPath;
    this.historyEntries = this.history.history();
    this.savedSearches = this.history.saved();
    this.collections = this.resultPanels.recent();
    this.queryHistoryIndex = -1;
    this.mode = 'search';
    this.queryText = '';
    this.searchIndex.reset(this.sortMode);
    this.selectedIndex = 0;
    this.error = '';
    this.isClosing = false;
    this.visible = true;
    this.input.activateContext(CONTEXT_ID);
    
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
  }

  close(): void {
    if (!this.visible || this.isClosing) return;
    this.isClosing = true;
    this.input.deactivateContext(CONTEXT_ID);
    this.searchGeneration += 1;
    this.searchAbort?.abort();
    this.searchAbort = null;
    if (this.searchTimer) {
      clearTimeout(this.searchTimer);
      this.searchTimer = null;
    }
    
    
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
  }

  onAnimationEnd(event: AnimationEvent): void {
    if (event.target !== event.currentTarget || !this.isClosing) return;
    this.visible = false;
    this.isClosing = false;
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
  }

  scheduleSearch(): void {
    if (this.searchTimer) clearTimeout(this.searchTimer);
    this.searchTimer = setTimeout(() => {
      this.searchTimer = null;
      void this.search();
    }, 180);
  }

  async search(): Promise<void> {
    const query = this.queryText.trim();
    const generation = ++this.searchGeneration;

    this.searchAbort?.abort();
    this.searchAbort = null;

    if (this.mode === 'collections') {
      this.searchIndex.reset(this.sortMode);
      this.collections = this.resultPanels.recent();
      this.selectedIndex = Math.min(
        this.selectedIndex,
        Math.max(0, this.visibleCollections.length - 1),
      );
      this.searching = false;
      this.error = '';
      this.cdr.markForCheck();
      return;
    }

    if (this.mode === 'recent') {
      this.searchIndex.reset(this.sortMode);
      const recent = this.recentFiles.search(query, 200);
      this.searchIndex.append(recent, recent.length);
      this.selectedIndex = Math.min(
        this.selectedIndex,
        Math.max(0, this.resultCount - 1),
      );
      this.searching = false;
      this.error = '';
      this.cdr.markForCheck();
      return;
    }

    if (!query || !this.rootPath) {
      this.searchIndex.reset(this.sortMode);
      this.searching = false;
      this.error = '';
      this.searchProgress = '';
      this.searchWarnings = [];
      this.selectedIndex = 0;
      this.cdr.markForCheck();
      return;
    }

    const controller = new AbortController();
    this.searchAbort = controller;
    this.searching = true;
    this.error = '';
    this.searchProgress = '';
    this.searchWarnings = [];
    this.searchIndex.reset(this.sortMode);
    this.resultWindowOffset = 0;
    this.resultWindowEntries = [];
    this.cdr.markForCheck();

    try {
      const result = await this.searchService.search(
        this.rootPath,
        query,
        {
          recursive: this.recursive,
          type: this.typeFilter,
          maxResults: 100_000,
          batchSize: 512,
          signal: controller.signal,
          onProgress: progress => {
            if (generation !== this.searchGeneration) return;
            this.searchProgress =
              `${progress.sourceId} · ${progress.visitedDirectories} folders · ${progress.matchedEntries} matches`;
            this.cdr.markForCheck();
          },
          onBatch: (batch, progress) => {
            if (
              controller.signal.aborted ||
              generation !== this.searchGeneration
            ) return;
            this.searchIndex.append(batch, progress.matchedEntries);
            this.selectedIndex = Math.min(
              this.selectedIndex,
              Math.max(0, this.resultCount - 1),
            );
            this.cdr.markForCheck();
          },
        },
      );

      if (generation !== this.searchGeneration) return;

      // Non-streaming providers may still return a terminal population.
      if (result.entries.length) {
        this.searchIndex.append(result.entries, result.entries.length);
      }
      this.searchWarnings = result.warnings;
      this.searchProgress = result.truncated
        ? `${result.sourceId} · result limit reached`
        : `${result.sourceId} · ${result.visitedDirectories} folders`;

      this.history.record(this.currentSearchSpec(), this.resultCount);
      this.historyEntries = this.history.history();

      this.selectedIndex = Math.min(
        this.selectedIndex,
        Math.max(0, this.resultCount - 1),
      );
    } catch (error) {
      if (generation !== this.searchGeneration) return;
      if (error instanceof DOMException && error.name === 'AbortError') return;

      this.searchIndex.reset(this.sortMode);
      this.selectedIndex = 0;
      this.error = error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error);
    } finally {
      if (generation === this.searchGeneration) {
        this.searching = false;
        this.searchAbort = null;
        this.cdr.markForCheck();
      }
    }
  }

  openAsResultsPanel(): void {
    if (this.resultCount === 0) return;

    const query = this.queryText.trim();
    const panel = this.resultPanels.createFromIndex(
      this.mode === 'recent'
        ? (query ? `Recent: ${query}` : 'Recent Files')
        : `Search: ${query}`,
      this.searchIndex,
      this.mode === 'recent'
        ? {
            origin: 'recent-files',
            query,
            kind: 'recent-files',
            sort: this.sortMode,
          }
        : {
            origin: 'global-search',
            rootPath: this.rootPath,
            query,
            recursive: this.recursive,
            kind: this.recursive ? 'recursive-search' : 'search',
            sort: this.sortMode,
          },
    );

    this.openPanelPath.emit(panel.path);
    this.close();
  }

  openAsResultsWorkspace(): void {
    const query = this.queryText.trim();
    if (!query || this.resultCount === 0) return;

    // Workspace export is an explicit user action, so materialising the current
    // result set here is acceptable. Normal searching/rendering stays windowed.
    const entries = this.searchIndex.materialize();
    this.openAsWorkspace.emit({
      title: `Search: ${query}`,
      rootPath: this.rootPath,
      query,
      recursive: this.recursive,
      entries,
    });

    this.close();
  }

  toggleRecursive(): void {
    this.recursive = !this.recursive;
    this.scheduleSearch();
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
  }

  applySort(): void {
    this.searchIndex.setSort(this.sortMode);
    this.resultWindowEntries = [];
    this.selectedIndex = Math.min(
      this.selectedIndex,
      Math.max(0, this.resultCount - 1),
    );
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
  }

  cycleSort(): void {
    const modes: SearchSort[] = ['relevance', 'name', 'path', 'type'];
    const index = modes.indexOf(this.sortMode);
    this.sortMode = modes[(index + 1) % modes.length];
    this.searchIndex.setSort(this.sortMode);
    this.selectedIndex = Math.min(
      this.selectedIndex,
      Math.max(0, this.resultCount - 1),
    );
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
  }

  setMode(mode: DiscoveryMode): void {
    this.mode = mode;
    this.selectedIndex = 0;
    this.searchProgress = '';
    this.searchWarnings = [];
    this.error = '';

    if (mode === 'collections') {
      this.collections = this.resultPanels.recent();
    }

    void this.search();
    queueMicrotask(() => this.queryInput?.nativeElement.focus());
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
  }

  useSavedSearch(saved: SavedDiscoverySearch): void {
    this.mode = 'search';
    this.rootPath = saved.rootPath;
    this.queryText = saved.query;
    this.recursive = saved.recursive;
    this.typeFilter = saved.type;
    this.sortMode = saved.sort;
    this.selectedIndex = 0;
    this.scheduleSearch();
    queueMicrotask(() => this.queryInput?.nativeElement.focus());
  }

  useHistory(entry: DiscoverySearchSpec): void {
    this.mode = 'search';
    this.rootPath = entry.rootPath;
    this.queryText = entry.query;
    this.recursive = entry.recursive;
    this.typeFilter = entry.type;
    this.sortMode = entry.sort;
    this.selectedIndex = 0;
    this.scheduleSearch();
    queueMicrotask(() => this.queryInput?.nativeElement.focus());
  }

  async saveSearch(): Promise<void> {
    const spec = this.currentSearchSpec();
    if (!spec.query.trim()) return;

    const name = (await this.dialogs.prompt({
      title: 'Save Search',
      message: 'Name this search.',
      confirmText: 'Save',
      defaultValue: spec.query,
      historyKey: 'reassembly.discovery.savedSearch.name',
    }))?.trim();

    if (!name) return;

    this.history.save(name, spec);
    this.savedSearches = this.history.saved();
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
  }

  openCollection(panel: ResultsPanelDefinition): void {
    this.openPanelPath.emit(panel.path);
    this.close();
  }

  toggleSelectedCollectionPinned(): void {
    const panel = this.selectedCollection;
    if (!panel) return;

    this.resultPanels.setPinned(panel.path, !panel.pinned);
    this.collections = this.resultPanels.recent();
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
  }

  collectionSummary(panel: ResultsPanelDefinition): string {
    const parts = [
      panel.metadata.kind,
      panel.metadata.rootPath,
      panel.metadata.query,
      panel.metadata.pluginId ? `plugin:${panel.metadata.pluginId}` : '',
    ].filter(Boolean);
    return parts.join(' · ') || panel.path;
  }

  trackPanel(_index: number, panel: ResultsPanelDefinition): string {
    return panel.path;
  }

  private moveQueryHistory(delta: -1 | 1): void {
    if (!this.historyEntries.length) return;

    if (this.queryHistoryIndex < 0) {
      this.queryHistoryIndex =
        delta < 0 ? 0 : this.historyEntries.length - 1;
    } else {
      this.queryHistoryIndex =
        (this.queryHistoryIndex + delta + this.historyEntries.length) %
        this.historyEntries.length;
    }

    const entry = this.historyEntries[this.queryHistoryIndex];
    if (entry) this.useHistory(entry);
  }

  private currentSearchSpec(): DiscoverySearchSpec {
    return {
      rootPath: this.rootPath,
      query: this.queryText.trim(),
      recursive: this.recursive,
      type: this.typeFilter,
      sort: this.sortMode,
    };
  }

  openEntry(entry: FileInfo): void {
    this.openResult.emit(entry);
    this.close();
  }

  openFolder(entry: FileInfo): void {
    this.openContainingFolder.emit(entry);
    this.close();
  }

  trackResult(_index:number, entry:FileInfo):string { return entry.path; }

  icon(entry:FileInfo):string {
    if (entry.type === FileType.DIRECTORY) return '📁';
    if (entry.type === FileType.ARCHIVE) return '🗜️';
    return '📄';
  }

  kind(entry:FileInfo):string {
    if (entry.type === FileType.DIRECTORY) return 'Folder';
    if (entry.type === FileType.ARCHIVE) return 'Archive';
    return 'File';
  }

  private move(delta:-1|1):void {
    const count=this.mode === 'collections'
      ? this.visibleCollections.length
      : this.resultCount;
    if(!count)return;
    this.selectedIndex=(this.selectedIndex+delta+count)%count;
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
  }
}
`````

`````typescript
export class InputCenterComponent implements OnChanges, OnDestroy {
  @Input() visible = false;
  @Output() closed = new EventEmitter<void>();
  @ViewChild('panel') panel?: ElementRef<HTMLElement>;

  searchText = '';
  deviceFilter: 'all' | 'keyboard' | 'mouse' = 'all';
  conflictsOnly = false;
  editingBinding: InputBindingDefinition | null = null;
  capturedSteps: KeyStroke[] = [];

  visibleBindings: readonly InputBindingDefinition[] = [];
  conflicts: readonly InputBindingConflict[] = [];

  private bindingsSnapshot: readonly InputBindingDefinition[] = [];
  private readonly conflictsByBindingId = new Map<string, InputBindingConflict[]>();
  private readonly triggerLabels = new Map<string, string>();
  private readonly overriddenIds = new Set<string>();
  private modelDirty = true;
  private readonly bindingSubscription: { unsubscribe?: () => void } | (() => void) | void;

  constructor(
    readonly customization: InputCustomizationService,
    private readonly engine: InputEngineService,
    private readonly dialogs: ConfirmDialogService,
    private readonly cdr: ChangeDetectorRef,
  ) {
    // Binding registration is noisy during startup. Keep the editor cheap while
    // hidden and rebuild its presentation model only when it is actually open.
    this.bindingSubscription = this.engine.bindings$.subscribe(() => {
      this.modelDirty = true;
      if (!this.visible) return;
      this.refreshPresentationModel();
      this.cdr.markForCheck();
    });
  }

  ngOnChanges(changes: SimpleChanges): void {
    if (changes['visible']?.currentValue && this.modelDirty) {
      this.refreshPresentationModel();
    }
  }

  ngOnDestroy(): void {
    if (typeof this.bindingSubscription === 'function') {
      this.bindingSubscription();
    } else {
      this.bindingSubscription?.unsubscribe?.();
    }
  }

  applyFilters(): void {
    const search = this.searchText.trim().toLocaleLowerCase();
    this.visibleBindings = this.bindingsSnapshot.filter(binding => {
      if (this.deviceFilter !== 'all' && binding.trigger.device !== this.deviceFilter) {
        return false;
      }
      if (this.conflictsOnly && (this.conflictsByBindingId.get(binding.id)?.length ?? 0) === 0) {
        return false;
      }
      if (!search) return true;

      const trigger = this.triggerLabels.get(binding.id) ?? '';
      return [
        binding.id,
        binding.commandId,
        binding.description,
        binding.category ?? '',
        binding.contextId,
        binding.source,
        trigger,
      ].some(value => value.toLocaleLowerCase().includes(search));
    });
  }

  get captureHint(): string {
    return this.editingBinding?.trigger.device === 'mouse'
      ? 'Click, double-click, wheel, or drag inside this dialog to capture a mouse gesture. Esc cancels.'
      : 'Press a shortcut. For a chord, press the first combination and then the second. Esc cancels.';
  }

  get capturedLabel(): string {
    return this.engine.formatInputTrigger({
      device: 'keyboard',
      chord: { steps: this.capturedSteps },
    });
  }

  requestClose(): void {
    this.cancelCapture();
    this.closed.emit();
  }

  beginCapture(binding: InputBindingDefinition): void {
    this.editingBinding = binding;
    this.capturedSteps = [];

    // Recording must be inert: the old shortcut must not execute while the
    // user is trying to replace it, and mouse gestures must not dispatch
    // commands underneath the editor.
    this.engine.setKeyboardEnabled(false);
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
  }

  cancelCapture(): void {
    const wasCapturing = !!this.editingBinding;
    this.editingBinding = null;
    this.capturedSteps = [];
    if (wasCapturing) this.engine.setKeyboardEnabled(true);
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
  }

  @HostListener('document:keydown', ['$event'])
  captureKeyboard(event: KeyboardEvent): void {
    const binding = this.editingBinding;
    if (!this.visible) return;
    if (!binding) {
      if (event.key === 'Escape') {
        event.preventDefault();
        event.stopPropagation();
        this.requestClose();
      }
      return;
    }
    if (binding.trigger.device !== 'keyboard') return;

    event.preventDefault();
    event.stopPropagation();

    if (event.key === 'Escape') {
      this.cancelCapture();
      return;
    }

    const step = this.keyStroke(event);
    if (!step.key || ['control', 'shift', 'alt', 'meta'].includes(step.key)) return;

    this.capturedSteps = [...this.capturedSteps, step].slice(0, 2);
    this.cdr.markForCheck();

    if (this.capturedSteps.length >= 2) {
      this.acceptKeyboardCapture();
    }
  }

  @HostListener('document:click', ['$event'])
  captureClick(event: MouseEvent): void {
    this.captureMouse('click', event);
  }

  @HostListener('document:dblclick', ['$event'])
  captureDoubleClick(event: MouseEvent): void {
    this.captureMouse('doubleClick', event);
  }

  @HostListener('document:wheel', ['$event'])
  captureWheel(event: WheelEvent): void {
    if (!this.editingBinding || this.editingBinding.trigger.device !== 'mouse') return;
    const direction: MouseGesture['direction'] =
      Math.abs(event.deltaX) > Math.abs(event.deltaY)
        ? (event.deltaX < 0 ? 'left' : 'right')
        : (event.deltaY < 0 ? 'up' : 'down');
    this.applyMouseGesture({
      type: 'wheel',
      modifiers: this.modifiers(event),
      direction,
    }, event);
  }

  acceptKeyboardCapture(): void {
    const binding = this.editingBinding;
    if (!binding || !this.capturedSteps.length) return;

    this.customization.setTrigger(binding.id, {
      device: 'keyboard',
      chord: { steps: this.capturedSteps },
    });
    this.refreshPresentationModel();
    this.cancelCapture();
  }

  toggleEnabled(binding: InputBindingDefinition, event: Event): void {
    const input = event.target as HTMLInputElement;
    this.customization.setEnabled(binding.id, input.checked);
    this.refreshPresentationModel();
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
  }

  reset(binding: InputBindingDefinition): void {
    this.customization.reset(binding.id);
    this.refreshPresentationModel();
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
  }

  async resetAll(): Promise<void> {
    const confirmed = await this.dialogs.confirm({
      title: 'Reset Input Bindings',
      message: 'Reset all user keyboard and mouse customizations?',
      confirmText: 'Reset',
      danger: true,
    });
    if (!confirmed) return;

    this.customization.resetAll();
    this.refreshPresentationModel();
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
  }

  exportConfig(): void {
    const blob = new Blob(
      [this.customization.exportConfig()],
      { type: 'application/json' },
    );
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const anchor = document.createElement('a');
    anchor.href = url;
    anchor.download = 'input-bindings.json';
    anchor.click();
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
  }

  importConfig(event: Event): void {
    const input = event.target as HTMLInputElement;
    const file = input.files?.[0];
    input.value = '';
    if (!file) return;

    const reader = new FileReader();
    reader.onload = async () => {
      try {
        const result = this.customization.importConfig(String(reader.result ?? ''));
        await this.dialogs.alert({
          title: 'Input Bindings Imported',
          message: `${result.imported} imported${result.ignored ? ` · ${result.ignored} ignored` : ''}.`,
        });
        this.refreshPresentationModel();
        this.cdr.markForCheck();
      } catch (error) {
        await this.dialogs.alert({
          title: 'Import Failed',
          message: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error),
        });
      }
    };
    reader.readAsText(file);
  }

  conflictsFor(bindingId: string): readonly InputBindingConflict[] {
    return this.conflictsByBindingId.get(bindingId) ?? [];
  }

  isOverridden(bindingId: string): boolean {
    return this.overriddenIds.has(bindingId);
  }

  triggerLabel(bindingId: string): string {
    return this.triggerLabels.get(bindingId) || 'Unbound';
  }

  peerDescription(bindingId: string, conflict: InputBindingConflict): string {
    const peerId =
      conflict.bindingId === bindingId
        ? conflict.conflictingBindingId
        : conflict.bindingId;
    return this.engine.getBinding(peerId)?.description ?? peerId;
  }

  format(trigger: InputTrigger): string {
    return this.engine.formatInputTrigger(trigger);
  }

  private refreshPresentationModel(): void {
    const bindings = this.customization.bindings();
    const conflicts = this.customization.conflicts();

    this.bindingsSnapshot = bindings;
    this.conflicts = conflicts;
    this.conflictsByBindingId.clear();
    this.triggerLabels.clear();
    this.overriddenIds.clear();

    for (const binding of bindings) {
      this.triggerLabels.set(binding.id, this.engine.formatInputTrigger(binding.trigger));
      if (this.customization.hasOverride(binding.id)) {
        this.overriddenIds.add(binding.id);
      }
    }

    for (const conflict of conflicts) {
      for (const id of [conflict.bindingId, conflict.conflictingBindingId]) {
        const current = this.conflictsByBindingId.get(id);
        if (current) {
          current.push(conflict);
        } else {
          this.conflictsByBindingId.set(id, [conflict]);
        }
      }
    }

    this.modelDirty = false;
    this.applyFilters();
  }

  trackBinding(_index: number, binding: InputBindingDefinition): string {
    return binding.id;
  }

  private captureMouse(
    type: 'click' | 'doubleClick',
    event: MouseEvent,
  ): void {
    if (!this.editingBinding || this.editingBinding.trigger.device !== 'mouse') return;

    // Ignore the click used to press the Change button itself.
    if ((event.target as HTMLElement | null)?.closest('.trigger')) return;

    this.applyMouseGesture({
      type,
      button: event.button === 1 ? 'middle' : event.button === 2 ? 'right' : 'left',
      modifiers: this.modifiers(event),
    }, event);
  }

  private applyMouseGesture(
    gesture: MouseGesture,
    event: Event,
  ): void {
    const binding = this.editingBinding;
    if (!binding) return;

    event.preventDefault();
    event.stopPropagation();
    this.customization.setTrigger(binding.id, {
      device: 'mouse',
      gesture,
    });
    this.refreshPresentationModel();
    this.cancelCapture();
  }

  private keyStroke(event: KeyboardEvent): KeyStroke {
    const keyMap: Record<string, string> = {
      ' ': 'space',
      Escape: 'escape',
      Enter: 'enter',
      Tab: 'tab',
      Backspace: 'backspace',
      Delete: 'delete',
      Home: 'home',
      End: 'end',
      PageUp: 'pageup',
      PageDown: 'pagedown',
      ArrowUp: 'arrowup',
      ArrowDown: 'arrowdown',
      ArrowLeft: 'arrowleft',
      ArrowRight: 'arrowright',
    };

    return {
      key: keyMap[event.key] ?? event.key.toLocaleLowerCase(),
      modifiers: this.modifiers(event),
    };
  }

  private modifiers(
    event: Pick<KeyboardEvent | MouseEvent | WheelEvent,
      'ctrlKey' | 'shiftKey' | 'altKey' | 'metaKey'>,
  ): KeyStroke['modifiers'] {
    const values: NonNullable<KeyStroke['modifiers']> = [];
    if (event.ctrlKey) values.push('ctrl');
    if (event.shiftKey) values.push('shift');
    if (event.altKey) values.push('alt');
    if (event.metaKey) values.push('meta');
    return values.length ? values.sort() : undefined;
  }
}
`````

`````typescript
import { CommonModule } from '@angular/common';
import { Component, HostListener, OnDestroy, OnInit } from '@angular/core';
import { createSubject, takeUntil } from '@epikodelabs/streamix';

type OperationCenterFilter = 'all' | 'active' | 'history' | 'failed';

@Component({

      <aside class="operation-center palette-dialog-surface dialog-surface" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-label="Operations" (mousedown)="$event.stopPropagation()">
        <header class="center-header palette-dialog-header">

            <div class="eyebrow">Activity</div>

          <span class="dialog-close" aria-label="Close tab" title="Close" (click)="hide()" role="button" tabindex="0" (keydown.enter)="hide()" (keydown.space)="hide(); $event.preventDefault()"> × </span>
        </header>

        <div class="summary">
          <div><strong>{{ active.length }}</strong><span>Active</span></div>
          <div><strong>{{ failedCount }}</strong><span>Failed</span></div>
          <div><strong>{{ history.length }}</strong><span>History</span></div>
        </div>

        <nav class="filters" aria-label="Operation filters">
          <button *ngFor="let item of filterItems"
                  type="button"
                  [class.active]="filter === item.id"
                  (click)="filter = item.id">
            {{ item.label }}
          </button>
        </nav>

        <div class="operation-list">
          <div *ngIf="entries.length === 0" class="empty-state">
            <strong>No operations here</strong>
            <span>File operations and long-running tasks will appear here.</span>
          </div>

          <article *ngFor="let op of entries; trackBy: trackOperation" class="operation-row" [class.failed]="op.status === 'error'">
            <div class="operation-icon" aria-hidden="true">{{ iconFor(op) }}</div>
            <div class="operation-main">
              <div class="operation-title-line">
                <strong>{{ op.config.title }}</strong>
                <span class="status" [attr.data-status]="op.status">{{ statusLabel(op.status) }}</span>
              </div>
              <div class="operation-path" [title]="operationPath(op)">{{ operationPath(op) }}</div>

              <div *ngIf="isActive(op)" class="progress-track" aria-hidden="true">
                <span [style.width.%]="progressFor(op)"></span>
              </div>

              <div class="operation-meta">
                <span *ngIf="op.metrics.totalItems > 0">{{ op.metrics.processedItems }}/{{ op.metrics.totalItems }} items</span>
                <span *ngIf="op.metrics.processedBytes > 0 || op.metrics.totalBytes > 0">
                  {{ operationService.formatBytes(op.metrics.processedBytes) }}<ng-container *ngIf="op.metrics.totalBytes > 0"> / {{ operationService.formatBytes(op.metrics.totalBytes) }}</ng-container>
                </span>
                <span *ngIf="op.timing.speedBytesPerSecond > 0">{{ operationService.formatSpeed(op.timing.speedBytesPerSecond) }}</span>
                <span>{{ timeLabel(op) }}</span>
              </div>

              <div *ngIf="op.error" class="operation-error">{{ op.error }}</div>
            </div>

            <div class="operation-actions">
              <button *ngIf="isActive(op)" type="button" (click)="cancel(op.id)">Cancel</button>
            </div>
          </article>
        </div>

        <footer class="center-footer">
          <span>Recent operations are kept for this app session.</span>
          <button type="button" [disabled]="history.length === 0" (click)="clearHistory()">Clear History</button>
        </footer>
      </aside>
    </div>
  `,
  styles: [`

export class OperationCenterComponent implements OnInit, OnDestroy {
  visible = false;
  renderVisible = false;
  isClosing = false;
  filter: OperationCenterFilter = 'all';
  active: OperationState[] = [];
  history: OperationHistoryEntry[] = [];
  private readonly destroy$ = createSubject<void>();
  readonly filterItems: Array<{ id: OperationCenterFilter; label: string }> = [
    { id: 'all', label: 'All' },
    { id: 'active', label: 'Active' },
    { id: 'history', label: 'History' },
    { id: 'failed', label: 'Failed' },
  ];

  constructor(
    public readonly operationService: OperationService,
  ) {}

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.operationService.operations$.pipe(takeUntil(this.destroy$)).subscribe((map: Map<string, OperationState>) => {
      this.active = Array.from(map.values()).filter(op => this.isActive(op));
    });
    this.operationService.history$.pipe(takeUntil(this.destroy$)).subscribe((history: OperationHistoryEntry[]) => {
      this.history = history;
    });
  }

  ngOnDestroy(): void {
    this.destroy$.next();
    this.destroy$.complete();
  }

  show(): void { this.isClosing=false; this.renderVisible=true; this.visible=true; }
  hide(): void { if(!this.renderVisible||this.isClosing)return; this.visible=false; this.isClosing=true; }
  toggle(): void { this.visible ? this.hide() : this.show(); }
  onAnimationEnd(event: AnimationEvent): void {
    if(event.target!==event.currentTarget||!this.isClosing)return;
    this.renderVisible=false;
    this.isClosing=false;
  }

  @HostListener('document:keydown.escape', ['$event'])
  onEscape(event: KeyboardEvent): void {
    if (!this.visible || this.isClosing) return;
    event.preventDefault();
    event.stopPropagation();
    this.hide();
  }

  get entries(): Array<OperationState | OperationHistoryEntry> {
    const activeIds = new Set(this.active.map(op => op.id));
    const historical = this.history.filter(op => !activeIds.has(op.id));
    const all = [...this.active, ...historical];
    if (this.filter === 'active') return this.active;
    if (this.filter === 'history') return historical;
    if (this.filter === 'failed') return all.filter(op => op.status === 'error');
    return all;
  }

  get failedCount(): number { return this.history.filter(op => op.status === 'error').length; }

  trackOperation(_index: number, op: OperationState): string { return op.id; }
  isActive(op: OperationState): boolean { return op.status === 'running' || op.status === 'pending' || op.status === 'paused'; }
  progressFor(op: OperationState): number { return Math.max(0, Math.min(100, op.percentComplete || 0)); }
  iconFor(op: OperationState): string {
    const icons: Record<string, string> = { copy:'⧉', move:'↪', delete:'⌫', archive:'▣', extract:'⇲', search:'⌕', calculate:'∑' };
    return icons[op.config.kind] ?? '⚙';
  }
  statusLabel(status: string): string { return status === 'error' ? 'Failed' : status.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + status.slice(1); }
  operationPath(op: OperationState): string {
    const source = op.sources?.filter(Boolean).join(', ') || op.metrics.currentFile || '';
    return op.destination ? `${source} → ${op.destination}` : source;
  }
  timeLabel(op: OperationState | OperationHistoryEntry): string {
    const when = 'completedAt' in op ? op.completedAt : op.timing.startedAt;
    if (!when) return '';
    const delta = Math.max(0, Date.now() - when);
    if (delta < 60_000) return 'just now';
    if (delta < 3_600_000) return `${Math.floor(delta / 60_000)}m ago`;
    return new Date(when).toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' });
  }
  async cancel(id: string): Promise<void> { await this.operationService.cancel(id); }
  clearHistory(): void { this.operationService.clearHistory(); }
}
`````

`````typescript
export class PaneSyncReviewComponent implements DoCheck {
  filter: Filter = 'different';
  items: PaneSyncPlanItem[] = [];
  preset: PaneSyncPreset | 'custom' = 'safe';

  readonly statuses: PaneComparisonStatus[] = [
    'only-left', 'only-right', 'left-newer', 'right-newer', 'size-different', 'hash-different', 'content-different', 'type-different',
  ];

  constructor(readonly dialogs: PaneSyncReviewDialogService) {}

  get activeRequest(): PaneSyncReviewDialogRequest | null {
    return this.dialogs.mountedRequest$.value;
  }

  get isClosing(): boolean {
    return !!this.dialogs.closingRequest$.value;
  }

  private get result(): PaneComparisonResult {
    return this.dialogs.mountedRequest$.value?.viewModel.getResult() ?? {
      items: [],
      summary: {
        total: 0, same: 0, onlyLeft: 0, onlyRight: 0,
        leftNewer: 0, rightNewer: 0, sizeDifferent: 0,
        hashDifferent: 0, contentDifferent: 0, typeDifferent: 0,
        different: 0,
      },
      policy: 'size-date',
    };
  }

  get history(): readonly SyncHistoryEntry[] {
    return this.dialogs.mountedRequest$.value?.viewModel.getHistory() ?? [];
  }

  ngDoCheck(): void {
    this.rebuildPlan();
  }

  get visibleItems(): PaneSyncPlanItem[] {
    return this.filter === 'different' ? this.items : this.items.filter(item => item.status === this.filter);
  }

  get approvedCount(): number {
    return this.items.filter(item => item.direction !== 'skip').length;
  }

  get skippedCount(): number {
    return this.items.length - this.approvedCount;
  }

  get conflictCount(): number {
    return this.items.filter(item => this.isConflict(item.status)).length;
  }

  get filterOptions(): Array<{ status: PaneComparisonStatus; label: string; count: number }> {
    return this.statuses
      .map(status => ({ status, label: this.statusLabel(status), count: this.items.filter(item => item.status === status).length }))
      .filter(item => item.count > 0);
  }

  setDirection(item: PaneSyncPlanItem, direction: PaneSyncDirection): void {
    if (direction === 'left-to-right' && !item.leftPath) return;
    if (direction === 'right-to-left' && !item.rightPath) return;
    item.direction = direction;
    this.preset = 'custom';
  }

  applySafeSuggestions(): void { this.applyPreset('safe'); }

  applyPreset(preset: PaneSyncPreset): void {
    this.preset = preset;
    for (const item of this.items) {
      item.direction = this.directionForPreset(item, preset);
    }
  }

  executePlan(): void {
    const approved = this.items.filter(item => item.direction !== 'skip');
    this.dialogs.mountedRequest$.value?.viewModel.onExecute({
      items: approved.map(item => ({ ...item })),
      leftToRight: approved.filter(item => item.direction === 'left-to-right' && item.leftPath).map(item => item.leftPath!),
      rightToLeft: approved.filter(item => item.direction === 'right-to-left' && item.rightPath).map(item => item.rightPath!),
      preset: this.preset,
      conflicts: this.conflictCount,
    });
  }

  trackByKey(_index: number, item: PaneSyncPlanItem): string { return item.key; }

  syncHistoryLabel(run: SyncHistoryEntry): string {
    const mode = run.mode === 'bidirectional' ? '↔' : run.mode === 'left-to-right' ? '→' : run.mode === 'right-to-left' ? '←' : 'custom';
    return `${mode} ${run.succeeded}/${run.planned}${run.failed ? ` · ${run.failed} failed` : ''}`;
  }

  statusLabel(status: PaneComparisonStatus): string {
    return ({
      'only-left': 'Left only',
      'only-right': 'Right only',
      'left-newer': 'Left newer',
      'right-newer': 'Right newer',
      'size-different': 'Different size',
      'hash-different': 'Different hash',
      'content-different': 'Different content',
      'type-different': 'Different type',
      'same': 'Same',
    } as Record<PaneComparisonStatus, string>)[status];
  }

  private rebuildPlan(): void {
    const previous = new Map(this.items.map(item => [item.key, item.direction] as const));
    this.items = (this.result?.items ?? [])
      .filter(item => item.status !== 'same')
      .map(item => this.toPlanItem(item, previous.get(item.key)));
  }

  private toPlanItem(item: PaneComparisonItem, previous?: PaneSyncDirection): PaneSyncPlanItem {
    return {
      key: item.key,
      name: item.name,
      status: item.status,
      direction: previous ?? this.defaultDirection(item.status),
      leftPath: item.left?.path ?? null,
      rightPath: item.right?.path ?? null,
    };
  }

  private defaultDirection(status: PaneComparisonStatus): PaneSyncDirection {
    if (status === 'only-left') return 'left-to-right';
    if (status === 'only-right') return 'right-to-left';
    return 'skip';
  }

  private directionForPreset(item: PaneSyncPlanItem, preset: PaneSyncPreset): PaneSyncDirection {
    if (preset === 'safe') return this.defaultDirection(item.status);
    if (preset === 'left-to-right') return item.leftPath ? 'left-to-right' : 'skip';
    if (preset === 'right-to-left') return item.rightPath ? 'right-to-left' : 'skip';

    if (item.status === 'only-left' || item.status === 'left-newer') return item.leftPath ? 'left-to-right' : 'skip';
    if (item.status === 'only-right' || item.status === 'right-newer') return item.rightPath ? 'right-to-left' : 'skip';
    return 'skip';
  }

  private isConflict(status: PaneComparisonStatus): boolean {
    return status === 'size-different' || status === 'hash-different' || status === 'content-different' || status === 'type-different';
  }

  onAnimationEnd(event: AnimationEvent): void {
    if (event.target !== event.currentTarget || !this.isClosing) {
      return;
    }
    this.dialogs.finishClose();
  }
}
`````

`````typescript
  async calculateDirectorySize(path: string): Promise<void> {
    if (!path || path === PARENT_ENTRY_PATH) return;
    if (this.pendingDirectorySizePaths.has(path)) return;

    const entry = this.entries.find(candidate => candidate.path === path);
    if (!entry || entry.type !== FileType.DIRECTORY) return;

    this.setDirectorySizePending(path, true);
    try {
      const size = await this.apiService.dirSizeRecursive(path);
      this.applyDirectorySize(path, size);
    } catch (error) {
      console.warn('Failed to calculate directory size inline:', path, error);
    } finally {
      this.setDirectorySizePending(path, false);
    }
  }

  focusTreeNode(path: string): void {
    try {
      this.treeComponent?.focusNode(path);
    } catch {
      // best-effort only
    }
  }

  getApproxPageSize(): number {
    return this.runtimeController.getApproxPageSize(this.runtimeHost);
  }

  getGridColumns(): number {
    return this.runtimeController.getGridColumns(this.runtimeHost);
  }

  onTreeOpenInNewTab(node: TreeNode): void {
    this.eventsController.onTreeOpenInNewTab(this.eventsHost, node);
  }

  onLoadChildren(node: TreeNode): void {
    this.interactionController.onLoadChildren(this.interactionHost, node);
  }

  onViewChange(view: ViewLayout): void {
    this.interactionController.onViewChange(this.interactionHost, view);
  }

  onSortChange(sort: { field: string; direction: 'asc' | 'desc' }): void {
    this.sortField = sort.field;
    this.sortDirection = sort.direction;
    this.sortChange.emit(sort);
  }

  onSelectionChange(entries: FileInfo[]): void {
    this.eventsController.onSelectionChange(this.eventsHost, entries);
  }

  onNavigate(entry: FileInfo | TreeNode | Event): void {
    this.eventsController.onNavigate(this.eventsHost, entry);
  }

  onContextMenu(event: { event: MouseEvent; entry: FileInfo }): void {
    this.eventsController.onContextMenu(this.eventsHost, event);
  }

  onOpenInNewTab(entry: FileInfo): void {
    this.eventsController.onOpenInNewTab(this.eventsHost, entry);
  }

  onTreeNodeDoubleClick(node: TreeNode): void {
    this.eventsController.onTreeNodeDoubleClick(this.eventsHost, node);
  }

  onTreeToggleExpand(_node: TreeNode): void {
    // Tree manages expansion state internally
  }

  private sortTreeNodes(nodes: TreeNode[]): TreeNode[] {
    return this.sortController.sortTreeNodes(this.sortHost, nodes);
  }

  private setDirectorySizePending(path: string, pending: boolean): void {
    const next = new Set(this.pendingDirectorySizePaths);
    if (pending) {
      next.add(path);
    } else {
      next.delete(path);
    }
    this.pendingDirectorySizePaths = next;
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
  }

  private applyDirectorySize(path: string, size: number): void {
    const entry = this.entries.find(candidate => candidate.path === path);
    if (entry) {
      entry.size = size;
    }

    const sortedEntry = this.sortedEntries.find(candidate => candidate.path === path);
    if (sortedEntry && sortedEntry !== entry) {
      sortedEntry.size = size;
    }

    const treeNode = this.findTreeNodeByPath(this.treeNodes, path);
    if (treeNode) {
      treeNode.size = size;
    }

    if (this.sortField === 'size') {
      this.sortController.sortEntries(this.sortHost, PARENT_ENTRY_PATH);
      this.sortController.resortAllLoadedTreeNodes(this.sortHost, this.treeNodes);
    } else {
      this.sortedEntries = [...this.sortedEntries];
    }

    this.treeNodes = [...this.treeNodes];
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
  }

  private findTreeNodeByPath(nodes: TreeNode[], path: string): TreeNode | undefined {
    for (const node of nodes) {
      if (node.path === path) return node;
      const childNodes = node.children;
      if (!childNodes?.length) continue;
      const match = this.findTreeNodeByPath(childNodes, path);
      if (match) return match;
    }

    return undefined;
  }

  private isWebBrowserPath(path: string): boolean {
    const trimmed = (path ?? '').trim();
    if (!trimmed) return false;

    try {
      const parsed = new URL(trimmed);
      return (parsed.protocol === 'http:' || parsed.protocol === 'https:') && parsed.host.length > 0;
    } catch {
      return false;
    }
  }

  private resolveSurfaceBrowserPath(): string {
    const configuredPath = this.browserConfig?.path;
    if (this.surfaceActive) {
      return this.currentPath || configuredPath || this.browserPath;
    }

    return configuredPath || this.browserPath || this.currentPath;
  }

  getBrowserPath(): string {
    return this.cachedBrowserPath;
  }

  showBrowserPane(): boolean {
    return this.cachedShowBrowserPane;
  }

  onBrowserPaneSplitChange(position: number): void {
    const next = this.clampBrowserPaneSplit(position);
    if (next === this.browserPaneSplit) {
      return;
    }

    this.browserPaneSplit = next;
    this.persistBrowserPaneSplit();
    this.browserPaneSplitChange.emit(next);
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
  }

  private ensureBrowserPaneSplitLoaded(): void {
    const storageKey = this.getBrowserPaneStorageKey();
    if (this.loadedBrowserPaneStorageKey === storageKey) {
      return;
    }

    this.loadedBrowserPaneStorageKey = storageKey;
    this.browserPaneSplit = this.readBrowserPaneSplit(storageKey);
  }

  private getBrowserPaneStorageKey(): string {
    return `fileManager_browserPaneSplit:${this.paneId}`;
  }

  private readBrowserPaneSplit(storageKey: string): number {
    try {
      const raw = localStorage.getItem(storageKey);
      if (!raw) {
        return this.effectiveDefaultBrowserPaneSplit;
      }

      const parsed = Number.parseFloat(raw);
      if (!Number.isFinite(parsed)) {
        return this.effectiveDefaultBrowserPaneSplit;
      }

      return this.clampBrowserPaneSplit(parsed);
    } catch {
      return this.effectiveDefaultBrowserPaneSplit;
    }
  }

  private persistBrowserPaneSplit(): void {
    try {
      localStorage.setItem(this.getBrowserPaneStorageKey(), this.browserPaneSplit.toString());
    } catch {
      // Ignore storage failures; the split still works for the current session.
    }
  }

  private clampBrowserPaneSplit(value: number): number {
    return Math.max(this.effectiveMinBrowserPaneSplit, Math.min(this.effectiveMaxBrowserPaneSplit, value));
  }
}
`````

`````scss
/*
 * Shared visual treatment for dialogs surfaced from the application Tools menu.
 * Reference: RemoteConnectionsComponent.
 *
 * This stylesheet is intentionally presentation-only. Each dialog keeps its
 * existing behavior, commands, focus handling, and content layout.
 */

/* ── Common modal placement / scrim ─────────────────────────────────────── */
.backdrop.backdrop,
.basket-backdrop.basket-backdrop,
.du-backdrop.du-backdrop,
.br-overlay.br-overlay,
.dialog-backdrop.dialog-backdrop,
.review-backdrop.review-backdrop,

  position: fixed;
  inset: 0;
  box-sizing: border-box;
  display: grid;
  place-items: start center;
  justify-content: center;
  align-items: start;
  padding: min(12vh, 110px) 12px 20px;
  background: var(--vsc-scrim-soft);
  backdrop-filter: none;
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: none;
}

/* Side-drawer basket becomes a normal Tools dialog. */
.basket-backdrop.basket-backdrop {
  justify-content: center;
}

/* ── Common panel chrome ────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
.tools.tools,
.journal.journal,
.basket-panel.basket-panel,
.du-dialog.du-dialog,
.br-panel.br-panel,
.dialog-panel.dialog-panel,

  border: 1px solid var(--vsc-border);

}

/* ── Header / footer rhythm ─────────────────────────────────────────────── */
.tools.tools > header,

.basket-header.basket-header,

.review.review > .header,

  background: transparent;
}

.dialog.dialog > footer {
  box-sizing: border-box;
  min-height: 43px;

  border-top: 1px solid var(--vsc-border-subtle, var(--vsc-border));
  background: transparent;
}

.basket-header h2,

.dialog-header h2,

/* ── Buttons: same light chrome as Remote Connections ───────────────────── */
.tools button,

.tools button:hover:not(:disabled),

}

.journal button:disabled,

.br-panel button:disabled,
.dialog-panel button:disabled,

.remote-connect-panel button:disabled,

  opacity: .35;
  cursor: default;
}

.tools .close,
.journal .close,
.basket-panel .icon-button,
.br-panel .br-btn,
.dialog-panel .close,
.review .close {
  min-height: 28px;
  padding: 4px 8px;
}

/* Preserve primary intent, but keep it in the same compact control geometry. */
.br-panel .br-btn--primary,
.review .primary,
.remote-connect-panel .btn-primary {
  border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--vsc-accent-blue) 55%, var(--vsc-border));
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--vsc-accent-blue) 18%, transparent);
}

.danger,

}

/* ── Lists / rows ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
.entries article,
.basket-row,

.disk-row-button,

  border-color: var(--vsc-border-subtle, var(--vsc-border));
}

.basket-row:hover,
.trash-row:hover,
.duplicate-file:hover,
.review .row:hover {

}

}
.basket-summary div {
  padding: 8px 10px;
  background: transparent;
}

.basket-actions,
.tools nav,
.tools .summary,
.tools .tool-actions,
.review .filters,
.review .columns {
  border-color: var(--vsc-border-subtle, var(--vsc-border));
}

.basket-row {
  padding: 8px 10px;
}

.trash-row {
  border-radius: 0;
}

/* Inputs use the normal editor/input surface rather than card-like chrome. */
.tools input,
.tools select,
.br-panel input,
.br-panel select,
.remote-connect-panel input,
.remote-connect-panel select,
.remote-connect-panel textarea,
.dialog-panel select,
.review select {
  color: var(--vsc-input-foreground, var(--vsc-foreground));
  background: var(--vsc-input-background, var(--vsc-editor-background));
  border: 1px solid var(--vsc-border);
  border-radius: 3px;
}

/* ── Animation family ───────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
.backdrop:not(.dialog-group),
.br-overlay:not(.dialog-group),
.dialog-backdrop:not(.dialog-group),
.review-backdrop:not(.dialog-group),
`````

`````typescript
export class WorkspaceSwitcherComponent
  implements OnInit, OnDestroy {

  @Output() workspaceActivated = new EventEmitter<void>();
  @Output() toolWorkspaceActivated =
    new EventEmitter<WorkspacePresentation>();
  @ViewChild('nameInput') private nameInput?: ElementRef<HTMLInputElement>;

  visible = false;
  renderVisible = false;
  isClosing = false;
  selectedIndex = 0;
  edit: WorkspaceEdit = null;
  private editGeneration = 0;

  constructor(
    private readonly workspacesService: WorkspaceService,
    private readonly workspaceSurfaces: WorkspaceSurfaceService,
    private readonly confirmDialog: ConfirmDialogService,
    private readonly input: InputEngineService,
    private readonly cdr: ChangeDetectorRef,
  ) {}

  private readonly workspacePinsKey = 'reassembly.navigation.workspacePins.v1';
  private readonly pinnedWorkspaceIds = this.loadWorkspacePins();

  get workspaces(): WorkspaceSwitcherItem[] {
    const files = (
      this.workspacesService.getWorkspaces().workspaces ?? []
    ).map<WorkspaceSwitcherItem>(workspace => ({
      id: workspace.id,
      name: workspace.name,
      icon: workspace.icon || '📁',
      kind: 'files',
      files: workspace,
    }));

    const tools = this.workspaceSurfaces
      .listToolWorkspaces()
      .map<WorkspaceSwitcherItem>(presentation => ({
        id: presentation.workspaceId,
        name: presentation.title,
        icon: '◫',
        kind: 'tool',
        tool: presentation,
      }));

    return [...files, ...tools].sort((a,b) =>
      Number(this.isWorkspacePinned(b.id)) - Number(this.isWorkspacePinned(a.id))
    );
  }

  isWorkspacePinned(workspaceId:string):boolean{return this.pinnedWorkspaceIds.has(workspaceId)}
  toggleWorkspacePin(workspaceId:string,event?:MouseEvent):void{
    event?.preventDefault();event?.stopPropagation();
    if(this.pinnedWorkspaceIds.has(workspaceId))this.pinnedWorkspaceIds.delete(workspaceId);else this.pinnedWorkspaceIds.add(workspaceId);
    this.saveWorkspacePins();
    this.selectedIndex=Math.max(0,this.workspaces.findIndex(item=>item.id===workspaceId));
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
  }
  private loadWorkspacePins():Set<string>{
    try{const value=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(this.workspacePinsKey)??'[]') as unknown;return new Set(Array.isArray(value)?value.filter((id):id is string=>typeof id==='string'&&!!id):[])}catch{return new Set()}
  }
  private saveWorkspacePins():void{try{localStorage.setItem(this.workspacePinsKey,JSON.stringify([...this.pinnedWorkspaceIds]))}catch{}}

  get activeWorkspaceId(): string {
    const activePresentation = this.workspaceSurfaces.active;
    if (activePresentation?.kind === 'tool') {
      return activePresentation.workspaceId;
    }

    return this.workspacesService.getActiveWorkspace()?.id ?? '';
  }

  get selectedWorkspace(): WorkspaceSwitcherItem | null {
    return this.workspaces[this.selectedIndex] ?? null;
  }

  workspaceKind(workspace: WorkspaceSwitcherItem): string {
    return workspace.kind;
  }

  workspaceSummary(workspace: WorkspaceSwitcherItem): string {
    if (workspace.kind === 'tool') {
      return workspace.tool?.lifetime === 'persistent'
        ? 'full workspace · pinned'
        : 'full workspace · temporary';
    }

    const files = workspace.files;
    return files
      ? `${files.leftPane.tabs.length} left · ${files.rightPane.tabs.length} right`
      : 'files';
  }

  canDeleteSelected(): boolean {
    const selected = this.selectedWorkspace;
    if (!selected) return false;
    if (selected.kind === 'tool') return true;

    const fileCount = this.workspaces.filter(
      workspace => workspace.kind === 'files',
    ).length;
    return fileCount > 1;
  }

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.input.registerContext({
      id: CONTEXT_ID,
      kind: 'overlay',
      priority: 400, exclusive: true,
      parentId: 'global',
      description: 'Workspace switcher',
    });

    this.input.registerCommandDescriptor({
      id: COMMAND.close,
      title: 'Close Workspace Switcher',
      category: 'Workspace',
      execute: () => this.close(),
    }, OWNER_ID);

    this.input.registerCommandDescriptor({
      id: COMMAND.previous,
      title: 'Previous Workspace',
      category: 'Workspace',
      execute: () => this.moveSelection(-1),
    }, OWNER_ID);

    this.input.registerCommandDescriptor({
      id: COMMAND.next,
      title: 'Next Workspace',
      category: 'Workspace',
      execute: () => this.moveSelection(1),
    }, OWNER_ID);

    this.input.registerCommandDescriptor({
      id: COMMAND.activate,
      title: 'Activate Workspace',
      category: 'Workspace',
      execute: () => {
        if (this.edit) return;
        const workspace = this.selectedWorkspace;
        if (workspace) this.activateWorkspace(workspace);
      },
    }, OWNER_ID);

    this.input.registerCommandDescriptor({
      id: COMMAND.create,
      title: 'Create Workspace',
      category: 'Workspace',
      execute: () => this.createWorkspace(),
    }, OWNER_ID);
    this.input.registerCommandDescriptor({
      id: COMMAND.rename,
      title: 'Rename Workspace',
      category: 'Workspace',
      execute: () => this.renameSelected(),
      isEnabled: () => !this.edit && !!this.selectedWorkspace,
    }, OWNER_ID);

    this.input.registerCommandDescriptor({
      id: COMMAND.remove,
      title: 'Delete Workspace',
      category: 'Workspace',
      execute: () => this.deleteSelected(),
      isEnabled: () => !this.edit && this.canDeleteSelected(),
    }, OWNER_ID);

    this.input.registerCommandDescriptor({
      id: COMMAND.slot1,
      title: 'Activate Workspace 1',
      category: 'Workspace',
      execute: () => this.activateSlot(0),
      isEnabled: () => this.workspaces.length > 0,
    }, OWNER_ID);

    this.input.registerCommandDescriptor({
      id: COMMAND.slot2,
      title: 'Activate Workspace 2',
      category: 'Workspace',
      execute: () => this.activateSlot(1),
      isEnabled: () => this.workspaces.length > 1,
    }, OWNER_ID);

    this.input.registerCommandDescriptor({
      id: COMMAND.slot3,
      title: 'Activate Workspace 3',
      category: 'Workspace',
      execute: () => this.activateSlot(2),
      isEnabled: () => this.workspaces.length > 2,
    }, OWNER_ID);

    this.input.registerCommandDescriptor({
      id: COMMAND.slot4,
      title: 'Activate Workspace 4',
      category: 'Workspace',
      execute: () => this.activateSlot(3),
      isEnabled: () => this.workspaces.length > 3,
    }, OWNER_ID);

    this.input.registerCommandDescriptor({
      id: COMMAND.slot5,
      title: 'Activate Workspace 5',
      category: 'Workspace',
      execute: () => this.activateSlot(4),
      isEnabled: () => this.workspaces.length > 4,
    }, OWNER_ID);

    this.input.registerCommandDescriptor({
      id: COMMAND.slot6,
      title: 'Activate Workspace 6',
      category: 'Workspace',
      execute: () => this.activateSlot(5),
      isEnabled: () => this.workspaces.length > 5,
    }, OWNER_ID);

    this.input.registerCommandDescriptor({
      id: COMMAND.slot7,
      title: 'Activate Workspace 7',
      category: 'Workspace',
      execute: () => this.activateSlot(6),
      isEnabled: () => this.workspaces.length > 6,
    }, OWNER_ID);

    this.input.registerCommandDescriptor({
      id: COMMAND.slot8,
      title: 'Activate Workspace 8',
      category: 'Workspace',
      execute: () => this.activateSlot(7),
      isEnabled: () => this.workspaces.length > 7,
    }, OWNER_ID);

    this.input.registerCommandDescriptor({
      id: COMMAND.slot9,
      title: 'Activate Workspace 9',
      category: 'Workspace',
      execute: () => this.activateSlot(8),
      isEnabled: () => this.workspaces.length > 8,
    }, OWNER_ID);


    for (const binding of BINDINGS) {
      this.input.registerBinding(binding);
    }
  }

  ngOnDestroy(): void {
    this.input.deactivateContext(CONTEXT_ID);

    for (const binding of BINDINGS) {
      this.input.unregisterBinding(binding.id);
    }

    for (const commandId of Object.values(COMMAND)) {
      this.input.unregisterCommandDescriptor(commandId, OWNER_ID);
    }
  }

  open(): void {
    

    const activeIndex = this.workspaces.findIndex(
      workspace => workspace.id === this.activeWorkspaceId,
    );

    this.selectedIndex = activeIndex >= 0 ? activeIndex : 0;
    this.visible = true;
    this.renderVisible = true;
    this.isClosing = false;
    this.input.activateContext(CONTEXT_ID);
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
  }

  close(): void {
    if (!this.renderVisible || this.isClosing) return;

    this.cancelEdit(false);
    this.visible = false;
    this.isClosing = true;
    this.input.deactivateContext(CONTEXT_ID);
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
  }

  createWorkspace(): void {
    if (!this.visible) {
      this.open();
    }

    this.edit = {
      kind: 'create',
      draft: 'New Workspace',
    };
    this.editGeneration += 1;
    this.focusNameInput(this.editGeneration);
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
  }

  activateWorkspace(workspace: WorkspaceSwitcherItem): void {
    if (workspace.kind === 'tool') {
      const presentation = workspace.tool;
      if (
        !presentation ||
        !this.workspaceSurfaces.activate(presentation.workspaceId)
      ) {
        return;
      }

      this.toolWorkspaceActivated.emit(
        this.workspaceSurfaces.get(presentation.workspaceId) ??
          presentation,
      );
      this.close();
      return;
    }

    if (
      !workspace.files ||
      !this.workspacesService.switchWorkspace(workspace.files.id)
    ) {
      return;
    }

    this.workspaceActivated.emit();
    this.close();
  }

  renameSelected(): void {
    const workspace = this.selectedWorkspace;
    if (!workspace) return;

    this.edit = {
      kind: 'rename',
      workspaceId: workspace.id,
      draft: workspace.name,
    };
    this.editGeneration += 1;
    this.focusNameInput(this.editGeneration);
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
  }

  async commitEdit(): Promise<void> {
    const edit = this.edit;
    if (!edit) return;

    const name = edit.draft.trim();
    if (!name) {
      this.focusNameInput(this.editGeneration);
      return;
    }

    if (edit.kind === 'create') {
      const workspace = await this.workspacesService.createWorkspace(name);

      // The edit may have been cancelled while home-path resolution was pending.
      if (this.edit !== edit) return;

      this.edit = null;
      this.workspacesService.switchWorkspace(workspace.id);
      this.selectedIndex = Math.max(
        0,
        this.workspaces.findIndex(item => item.id === workspace.id),
      );
      this.workspaceActivated.emit();
      this.cdr.markForCheck();
      return;
    }

    const workspace = this.workspaces.find(
      item => item.id === edit.workspaceId,
    );
    if (!workspace) {
      this.cancelEdit();
      return;
    }

    if (name !== workspace.name) {
      if (workspace.kind === 'tool') {
        this.workspaceSurfaces.rename(workspace.id, name);
      } else if (workspace.files) {
        this.workspacesService.updateWorkspace(
          workspace.files.id,
          { name },
        );
      }
    }

    this.edit = null;
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
  }

  cancelEdit(markForCheck = true): void {
    if (!this.edit) return;

    this.edit = null;
    this.editGeneration += 1;

    if (markForCheck) {
      this.cdr.markForCheck();
    }
  }

  private focusNameInput(generation: number, attempt = 0): void {
    setTimeout(() => {
      if (!this.edit || generation !== this.editGeneration) return;

      const input = this.nameInput?.nativeElement;
      if (!input) {
        if (attempt < 5) {
          this.focusNameInput(generation, attempt + 1);
        }
        return;
      }

      input.focus({ preventScroll: true });
      input.select();
    }, attempt === 0 ? 0 : 16);
  }

  async deleteSelected(): Promise<void> {
    const workspace = this.selectedWorkspace;
    if (!workspace || !this.canDeleteSelected()) return;

    const confirmed = await this.confirmDialog.confirm({
      title: 'Delete Workspace',
      message: `Delete workspace "${workspace.name}"?`,
      confirmText: 'Delete',
      danger: true,
    });

    if (!confirmed) return;

    const wasActive = workspace.id === this.activeWorkspaceId;

    if (workspace.kind === 'tool') {
      const presentation = workspace.tool;
      if (!presentation) return;

      const removed =
        presentation.lifetime === 'persistent'
          ? this.workspaceSurfaces.removePersistent(workspace.id)
          : this.workspaceSurfaces.closeTransient(workspace.id);

      if (!removed) return;

      if (wasActive) {
        const files = this.workspacesService.getActiveWorkspace();
        if (files) {
          this.workspaceSurfaces.activateFilesWorkspace(files);
        }
        this.workspaceActivated.emit();
      }
    } else {
      if (
        !workspace.files ||
        !this.workspacesService.deleteWorkspace(workspace.files.id)
      ) {
        return;
      }

      if (wasActive) {
        this.workspaceActivated.emit();
      }
    }

    this.selectedIndex = Math.min(
      this.selectedIndex,
      Math.max(0, this.workspaces.length - 1),
    );

    this.cdr.markForCheck();
  }

  trackWorkspace(
    _index: number,
    workspace: WorkspaceSwitcherItem,
  ): string {
    return workspace.id;
  }

  private activateSlot(index: number): void {
    if (this.edit) return;

    const workspace = this.workspaces[index];
    if (workspace) this.activateWorkspace(workspace);
  }

  private moveSelection(delta: -1 | 1): void {
    if (this.edit) return;

    const count = this.workspaces.length;
    if (count === 0) return;

    this.selectedIndex =
      (this.selectedIndex + delta + count) % count;
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
  }

  onBackdropAnimationEnd(event: AnimationEvent): void {
    if (event.target !== event.currentTarget || !this.isClosing) return;
    this.renderVisible = false;
    this.isClosing = false;
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
  }
}
`````

`````typescript
export class BatchRenameDialogComponent {
  @ViewChild('dialogPanel') dialogPanel?: ElementRef<HTMLElement>;

  readonly request$: Stream<BatchRenameRequest | null> = this.service.mountedRequest$;

  pattern = '*';
  startAt = 1;
  increment = 1;
  preview: PreviewRow[] = [];
  conflictCount = 0;

  private readonly destroy$ = createSubject<void>();
  private releaseDialogContext: (() => void) | null = null;

  constructor(
    private readonly service: BatchRenameDialogService,
    private readonly inputContexts: InputContextService,
    private readonly inputEngine: InputEngineService,
  ) {
    this.inputEngine.registerCommand('dialog.batchRename.apply', () => this.onApply());
    this.inputEngine.registerCommand('dialog.batchRename.close', () => this.onCancel());
    this.inputEngine.registerCommand('dialog.batchRename.focusNext', () => this.moveDialogFocus(1));
    this.inputEngine.registerCommand('dialog.batchRename.focusPrev', () => this.moveDialogFocus(-1));

    this.service.mountedRequest$.pipe(takeUntil(this.destroy$)).subscribe((req) => {
      if (req) {
        this.pattern = '*';
        this.startAt = 1;
        this.increment = 1;
        this.rebuildPreview(req);
        this.releaseDialogContext ??= this.inputContexts.acquire('dialog.batchRename');
        this.focusInitialControl();
      } else {
        this.releaseDialogContext?.();
        this.releaseDialogContext = null;
      }
    });
  }

  ngOnDestroy(): void {
    this.releaseDialogContext?.();
    this.releaseDialogContext = null;
    this.inputEngine.unregisterCommand('dialog.batchRename.apply');
    this.inputEngine.unregisterCommand('dialog.batchRename.close');
    this.inputEngine.unregisterCommand('dialog.batchRename.focusNext');
    this.inputEngine.unregisterCommand('dialog.batchRename.focusPrev');
    this.destroy$.next();
    this.destroy$.complete();
  }

  onTabKey(event: Event): void {
    if (!(event instanceof KeyboardEvent)) {
      return;
    }
    if (!this.dialogPanel?.nativeElement) {
      return;
    }
    moveFocusWithin(this.dialogPanel.nativeElement, event.shiftKey ? -1 : 1);
    event.preventDefault();
    event.stopPropagation();
  }

  onPatternChange(): void {
    const req = this.service.activeRequest$.value;
    if (req) {
      this.rebuildPreview(req);
    }
  }

  private rebuildPreview(req: BatchRenameRequest): void {
    const seen = new Set<string>();
    const rows: PreviewRow[] = [];
    let counter = Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(this.startAt) || 0));
    const step = Math.max(1, Math.floor(Number(this.increment) || 1));

    // Determine counter width from pattern
    let counterWidth = 1;
    const pat = this.pattern;
    for (let i = 0; i < pat.length; i++) {
      if (pat[i] === '#') {
        let w = 1;
        while (i + w < pat.length && pat[i + w] === '#') w++;
        counterWidth = Math.max(counterWidth, w);
      }
    }

    for (const item of req.items) {
      const newName = applyBatchRenameTemplate(pat, {
        originalName: item.entry.name,
        index: rows.length,
        counter,
        counterWidth,
      });
      const conflict = seen.has(newName) || newName === '';
      seen.add(newName);
      rows.push({ entry: item.entry, newName, conflict });
      counter += step;
    }

    this.preview = rows;
    this.conflictCount = rows.filter((r) => r.conflict).length;
  }

  onCancel(): void {
    this.service.resolveActive(null);
  }

  onApply(): void {
    const req = this.service.activeRequest$.value;
    if (!req || this.conflictCount > 0) return;

    const result: BatchRenameItem[] = this.preview.map((row) => ({
      entry: row.entry,
      newName: row.newName,
    }));
    this.service.resolveActive(result);
  }

  private focusInitialControl(): void {
    requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      const panel = this.dialogPanel?.nativeElement;
      if (!panel) {
        return;
      }

      const initial = panel.querySelector<HTMLElement>('[data-dialog-initial-focus]');
      if (initial) {
        initial.focus({ preventScroll: true });
        return;
      }

      panel.focus({ preventScroll: true });
    });
  }

  private moveDialogFocus(delta: number): void {
    if (!this.dialogPanel?.nativeElement) {
      return;
    }
    moveFocusWithin(this.dialogPanel.nativeElement, delta);
  }

  get isClosing(): boolean {
    return !!this.service.closingRequest$.value;
  }

  onAnimationEnd(event: AnimationEvent): void {
    if (event.target !== event.currentTarget || !this.isClosing) {
      return;
    }
    this.service.finishClose();
  }
}
`````

`````typescript
export class ClosedTabsComponent {
  @Input() visible = false;
  @Output() closed = new EventEmitter<void>();
  @Output() reopenRequested = new EventEmitter<RecentlyClosedTab>();

  constructor(
    readonly workspaces: WorkspaceService,
    private readonly cdr: ChangeDetectorRef,
  ) {}

  get entries(): readonly RecentlyClosedTab[] {
    return this.workspaces.getRecentlyClosedTabs();
  }

  close(): void {
    this.closed.emit();
  }

  reopen(entry: RecentlyClosedTab): void {
    this.reopenRequested.emit(entry);
  }

  clear(): void {
    this.workspaces.clearRecentlyClosedTabs();
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
  }

  icon(entry: RecentlyClosedTab): string {
    const kind = entry.tab.kind ?? 'dir';
    if (kind === 'viewer') return '◫';
    if (kind === 'size-manager') return '▦';
    return '▣';
  }

  viewerPath(entry: RecentlyClosedTab): string {
    return entry.tab.viewer?.targetPath ?? '';
  }

  trackEntry(_index: number, entry: RecentlyClosedTab): string {
    return entry.id;
  }
}
`````

`````html
  class="shortcut-reference-backdrop backdrop dialog-group"
`````
