export class OperationJournalComponent implements OnChanges {
  @Input() visible=false;
  renderVisible=false;
  isClosing=false;
  private emitClosedOnFinish=false;
  @Output() closed=new EventEmitter<void>();
  @Output() undoRequested=new EventEmitter<void>();
  @Output() redoRequested=new EventEmitter<void>();
  constructor(readonly history:OperationHistoryService, private readonly dialogs:ConfirmDialogService, private readonly cdr:ChangeDetectorRef){}
  get entries():readonly OperationJournalEntry[]{return this.history.recentOperations();}
  ngOnChanges(changes: SimpleChanges): void {
    if (!changes['visible']) return;
    if (this.visible) {
      this.renderVisible = true;
      this.isClosing = false;
      this.emitClosedOnFinish = false;
      this.cdr.markForCheck();
    } else if (this.renderVisible && !this.isClosing) {
      this.isClosing = true;
      this.cdr.markForCheck();
    }
  }
  close():void{
    if (!this.renderVisible || this.isClosing) return;
    this.isClosing=true;
    this.emitClosedOnFinish=true;
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
  }
  onAnimationEnd(event: AnimationEvent):void{
    if(event.target!==event.currentTarget||!this.isClosing)return;
    this.renderVisible=false;
    this.isClosing=false;
    const emit=this.emitClosedOnFinish;
    this.emitClosedOnFinish=false;
    if(emit)this.closed.emit();
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
  }
  undo():void{this.undoRequested.emit();this.cdr.markForCheck();}
  redo():void{this.redoRequested.emit();this.cdr.markForCheck();}
  async clear():Promise<void>{const ok=await this.dialogs.confirm({title:'Clear Operation History',message:'Clear the visible operation journal? Undo/redo stacks are left unchanged.',confirmText:'Clear',danger:true});if(!ok)return;this.history.clearJournal();this.cdr.markForCheck();}
  stateIcon(entry:OperationJournalEntry):string{if(entry.state==='failed')return '×';if(entry.state==='partial')return '!';if(entry.state==='undone')return '↶';if(entry.state==='redone')return '↷';return '✓';}
  trackEntry(_index:number,entry:OperationJournalEntry):string{return entry.id;}
}
`````

    button:not(.dialog-close):focus-visible, select:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid var(--vsc-input-focus-border); outline-offset: 1px; }
  `],
})
export class PaneCompareDialogComponent {
  constructor(readonly dialogs: PaneCompareDialogService) {}

  get activeRequest(): PaneCompareDialogRequest | null {
    return this.dialogs.mountedRequest$.value;
  }

  get isClosing(): boolean {
    return !!this.dialogs.closingRequest$.value;
  }

  onPolicyChange(viewModel: { onPolicyChange(policy: PaneComparisonPolicy): void | Promise<void> }, event: Event): void {
    void viewModel.onPolicyChange((event.target as HTMLSelectElement).value as PaneComparisonPolicy);
  }

  onAnimationEnd(event: AnimationEvent): void {
    if (event.target !== event.currentTarget || !this.isClosing) {
      return;
    }
    this.dialogs.finishClose();
  }
}

// pane-tree.component.ts - FULLY OPTIMIZED FOR MASSIVE TREES
import {
  Component,
  Input,
  Output,
  EventEmitter,
  OnChanges,
  SimpleChanges,
  TrackByFunction,
  ChangeDetectorRef,
  ElementRef,
  ViewChild,
  ChangeDetectionStrategy,
  OnDestroy,
  AfterViewInit,
  NgZone,
} from '@angular/core';
import { CommonModule } from '@angular/common';
import { FormsModule } from '@angular/forms';
import { FileEntryInlineComponent } from './file-entry-inline.component';
import { FileInfo, FileType } from '../shared/protocol';
import { getPrimaryFileCategoryForExtension } from '../shared/file-categories';
import { normalizePath as normalizePathReference } from './address-bar.utils';
import { FileCategoryResolverService } from '../services/file-category-resolver.service';

export interface TreeNode extends FileInfo {
  level: number;
  syntheticRoot?: string;
  archivePath?: string;
  expanded?: boolean;
  expandable?: boolean;
  children?: TreeNode[];
  parent?: TreeNode;
  loaded?: boolean;
  loading?: boolean;
  renaming?: boolean;
  editingName?: string;
}

export type TreeContentMode = 'all' | 'folders';

export interface DropTarget {
  node: TreeNode;
  position: 'before' | 'after' | 'inside';
}

@Component({
  selector: 'app-pane-tree',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [CommonModule, FormsModule, FileEntryInlineComponent],
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
  template: `
    <div
      #treeContainer
      class="file-tree-container"
      role="tree"
      tabindex="0"
      [class.focused]="paneActive && isFocused"
      [class.dragging]="dragState.isDragging"
      (focus)="onFocus()"
      (blur)="onBlur()"
      (mousedown)="onContainerMouseDown($event)"
      (click)="onContainerClick($event)"
      (contextmenu)="onContainerContextMenu($event)"
      (keydown)="onKeyDown($event)"
      (dragover)="onContainerDragOver($event)"
      (drop)="onContainerDrop($event)">

      <div class="tree-spacer" *ngIf="virtualEnabled" [style.height.px]="totalContentHeight"></div>
      
      <div class="tree-window" [class.virtual-window]="virtualEnabled" [style.transform]="virtualWindowTransform">
        <div
          *ngFor="let node of visibleWindowNodes; trackBy: trackByFn"
          class="tree-node-wrapper"
          [attr.data-path]="node.path"
          [class.drag-over]="isDragOver(node)"
          [class.drag-over-before]="isDragOver(node, 'before')"
          [class.drag-over-after]="isDragOver(node, 'after')"
          [class.drag-over-inside]="isDragOver(node, 'inside')">

          <div *ngIf="isDragOver(node, 'before')" class="drop-indicator drop-indicator-before"></div>
          <div *ngIf="isDragOver(node, 'after')" class="drop-indicator drop-indicator-after"></div>

          <div
            class="tree-node"
            [class.selected]="isSelected(node)"
            [class.focused-node]="paneActive && isFocusedNode(node)"
            [class.dragging-node]="isDraggingNode(node)"
            [attr.role]="'treeitem'"
            [attr.aria-level]="node.level + 1"
            [attr.aria-expanded]="node.expandable ? isExpanded(node) : undefined"
            [attr.aria-selected]="isSelected(node)"
            [draggable]="true"
            (mousedown)="onNodeMouseDown(node, $event)"
            (click)="onNodeClick(node, $event)"
            (auxclick)="onNodeAuxClick(node, $event)"
            (dblclick)="onNodeDoubleClick(node, $event)"
            (contextmenu)="onContextMenu($event, node)"
            (dragstart)="onDragStart($event, node)"
            (dragend)="onDragEnd($event)"
            (dragover)="onDragOver($event, node)"
            (dragleave)="onDragLeave($event, node)"
            (drop)="onDrop($event, node)">

            <span
              *ngFor="let guide of getGuides(node)"
              class="indent-guide"
              [class.indent-guide--active]="guide.active"
              [class.indent-guide--last]="guide.last"
              [class.indent-guide--skip]="guide.skip">
            </span>

            <span
              class="tree-twistie"
              [class.tree-twistie--expandable]="node.expandable"
              [class.tree-twistie--expanded]="node.expandable && isExpanded(node)"
              (mousedown)="onTwistieMouseDown($event, node)"
              (click)="onTwistieClick($event, node)">

              <ng-container *ngIf="node.expandable">
                <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none">
                  <path d="M6 4L10 8L6 12" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
                </svg>
              </ng-container>
              <span *ngIf="!node.expandable" class="twistie-placeholder"></span>
            </span>

            <app-file-entry-inline
              *ngIf="!node.renaming"
              class="tree-entry"
              [entry]="node"
              [displayNameOverride]="getDisplayNameOverride(node.path)"
              [directorySizePending]="isDirectorySizePending(node.path)"
              [showDirectorySizeSpinnerInName]="true"
              [colorizeByMime]="colorizeByMime"
              >
            </app-file-entry-inline>
            
            <input
              *ngIf="node.renaming"
              #renameInput
              class="tree-rename-input"
              type="text"
              [(ngModel)]="node.editingName"
              (blur)="onRenameBlur(node)"
              (keydown)="onRenameKeyDown($event, node)"
              (click)="$event.stopPropagation()"
              (mousedown)="$event.stopPropagation()"/>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div *ngIf="loading" class="tree-loading">
        <span class="spinner"></span>
        Loading...
      </div>

      <div
        *ngIf="showSelectionRect"
        class="selection-rect"
        [style.left.px]="selectionRect.left"
        [style.top.px]="selectionRect.top"
        [style.width.px]="selectionRect.width"
        [style.height.px]="selectionRect.height">
      </div>
    </div>
  `,
  styles: [`
    .tree-node,

      min-width: 0;

      display: block;

      );
    }

    .tree-node.focused-node.selected {
      background: color-mix(
        in srgb,
        var(--vsc-list-active-background, var(--vsc-list-selected-emphasis)) 82%,
        var(--vsc-accent-blue, var(--vsc-focus-border)) 18%
      );
    }

    .tree-node:hover:not(.selected) {
      background-color: var(--vsc-list-hover-background);
    }


    .tree-node.dragging-node {
      opacity: 0.5;
    }

    /* During drag we only show the thin indicators; do not highlight the row itself */
    .tree-node-wrapper.drag-over > .tree-node {
      background-color: transparent;
    }

    .drop-indicator {
      position: absolute;
      left: 0;
      right: 0;
      height: 3px;
      background-color: var(--vsc-focus-border, var(--vsc-accent-blue));
      pointer-events: none;
      z-index: 10;
    }

    .drop-indicator-before {
      top: -1px;
    }

    .drop-indicator-after {
      bottom: -1px;
    }

    /* When dropping inside a folder, give it a soft highlight plus the outline */
    .tree-node-wrapper.drag-over-inside > .tree-node {
      background-color: var(--vsc-list-drop-background, var(--vsc-accent-selection));
      outline: 1px dashed var(--vsc-focus-border);
      outline-offset: -1px;
    }

    .indent-guide {
      display: inline-flex;
      flex-shrink: 0;
      width: 16px;
      height: 20px;
      position: relative;
    }

    .indent-guide::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      left: 7px;
      top: 0;
      bottom: 0;
      width: 1px;
      background: var(--vsc-tree-indent-guide, var(--vsc-neutral-overlay-subtle));
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .indent-guide--active::before {
      background: var(--vsc-tree-indent-guide-active, var(--vsc-neutral-overlay-medium));
    }

    .indent-guide--skip::before,
    .indent-guide--skip::after {
      display: none;
    }

    .indent-guide--last::before {
      bottom: 50%;
    }

    .indent-guide--last::after {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      left: 9px;
      top: calc(50% - 0.5px);
      width: 12px;
      height: 1px;
      background: var(--vsc-tree-indent-guide, var(--vsc-neutral-overlay-medium));
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .tree-twistie {
      width: 20px;
      height: 22px;
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      flex-shrink: 0;
      color: var(--vsc-foreground-dim);
    }

    .tree-twistie--expandable { cursor: pointer; }
    .tree-twistie--expandable:hover { color: var(--vsc-foreground); }

    .tree-twistie svg {
      width: 16px;
      height: 16px;
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .tree-twistie--expanded svg { transform: rotate(90deg); }

    .twistie-placeholder {
      width: 16px;
      height: 16px;
      display: inline-block;
    }

    .tree-icon {
      width: 20px;
      height: 22px;
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      flex-shrink: 0;
      font-size: 14px;
    }

    .dir-symlink-icon {
      position: relative;
      &::after {
        content: '↗';
        position: absolute;
        bottom: -1px;
        right: -5px;
        font-size: 8px;
        line-height: 1;
        opacity: 0.8;
      }
    }

    .tree-entry {
      flex: 1;
      min-width: 0;
      margin-left: 3px;
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .tree-rename-input {
      flex: 1;
      height: 18px;
      margin: 0 4px;
      padding: 0 4px;
      border: 1px solid var(--vsc-focus-border);
      background: var(--vsc-input-background);
      color: var(--vsc-foreground);
      font-family: inherit;
      font-size: inherit;
      outline: none;
    }

    .tree-empty, .tree-loading {
      padding: 20px;
      color: var(--vsc-foreground-dim);
      text-align: center;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 8px;
    }

    .spinner {
      width: 14px;
      height: 14px;
      border: 2px solid var(--vsc-foreground-dim);
      border-bottom-color: transparent;
      border-radius: 50%;
      animation: spin 1s linear infinite;
    }

    .selection-rect {
      position: absolute;
      pointer-events: none;
      z-index: 20;
      border: 1px solid var(--vsc-focus-border);
      background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--vsc-list-active-background) 45%, transparent);
    }

    @keyframes spin {
      to { transform: rotate(360deg); }
    }
  `]
})
export class PaneTreeComponent implements OnChanges, OnDestroy, AfterViewInit {
  @Input() nodes: TreeNode[] = [];
  @Input() contentMode: TreeContentMode = 'all';
  @Input() pendingDirectorySizePaths: ReadonlySet<string> = new Set();
  @Input() currentPath = '';
  @Input() paneActive = true;
  @Input() colorizeByMime = false;
  @Input() selectedFiles: Set<string> = new Set();
  @Input() loading = false;
  @Input() emptyMessage = 'No items';

  @Output() selectionChange = new EventEmitter<TreeNode[]>();
  @Output() inlineSize = new EventEmitter<TreeNode>();
  @Output() nodeDoubleClick = new EventEmitter<TreeNode>();
  @Output() navigate = new EventEmitter<TreeNode>();
  @Output() openInNewTab = new EventEmitter<TreeNode>();
  @Output() toggleExpand = new EventEmitter<TreeNode>();
  @Output() loadChildren = new EventEmitter<TreeNode>();
  @Output() contextMenu = new EventEmitter<{ event: MouseEvent; node: TreeNode }>();
  @Output() backgroundContextMenu = new EventEmitter<MouseEvent>();
  @Output() dragStart = new EventEmitter<{ event: DragEvent; nodes: TreeNode[] }>();
  @Output() dragDrop = new EventEmitter<{ event: DragEvent; source: TreeNode[]; target: DropTarget }>();
  @Output() rename = new EventEmitter<{ node: TreeNode; newName: string }>();
  @Output() viewportChange = new EventEmitter<void>();

  @ViewChild('renameInput') renameInput?: ElementRef<HTMLInputElement>;
  @ViewChild('treeContainer') treeContainer?: ElementRef<HTMLElement>;

  private expansionState = new Map<string, boolean>();
  private desiredExpandedPaths = new Set<string>();
  private pendingRenameDisplayNames = new Map<string, string>();
  private suppressNextAutoExpand = false;
  private focusedNodePath: string | null = null;
  private anchorNodePath: string | null = null;
  private clickTimer: number | null = null;
  private isMouseDownSelecting = false;

  dragState = {
    isDragging: false,
    draggedNodes: [] as TreeNode[],
    dropTarget: null as DropTarget | null
  };

  isFocused = false;
  FileType = FileType;

  isDirectorySizePending(path: string): boolean {
    return this.pendingDirectorySizePaths.has(path);
  }

  // OPTIMIZED: Virtual scroll for massive trees
  private readonly VIRTUAL_THRESHOLD = 500;
  private readonly VIRTUAL_ROW_HEIGHT = 22;
  private readonly VIRTUAL_OVERSCAN = 20;
  private scrollRAF: number | null = null;
  private boundScrollListener?: () => void;
  private resizeObserver?: ResizeObserver;
  
  private flatVisibleNodes: TreeNode[] = [];
  private virtualStart = 0;
  private virtualEnd = 0;
  private lastScrollTop = 0;
  private viewportHeight = 0;
  private visibleWindowNodesCache: TreeNode[] = [];
  private visibleNodeIndex = new Map<string, number>();

  constructor(
    private cdr: ChangeDetectorRef,
    private zone: NgZone,
    private categoryResolver: FileCategoryResolverService,
  ) {}

  // ── Marquee selection state ───────────────────────────────────────────────
  selectionRect = { active: false, left: 0, top: 0, width: 0, height: 0 };

  get showSelectionRect(): boolean {
    return this.selectionRect.active && this.marqueeButton !== 2;
  }

  private marqueeContainer: HTMLElement | null = null;
  private marqueeStartX = 0;
  private marqueeStartY = 0;
  private marqueeAppend = false;
  private marqueeButton: 0 | 2 | null = null;
  private hasMarqueeMoved = false;
  private pendingClearOnMove = false;
  private suppressContainerClick = false;
  private suppressContainerContextMenu = false;
  private suppressItemContextMenu = false;
  private windowMouseMove?: (event: MouseEvent) => void;
  private windowMouseUp?: (event: MouseEvent) => void;
  private windowContextMenu?: (event: MouseEvent) => void;

  get visibleNodeCount(): number {
    return this.flatVisibleNodes.length;
  }

  get virtualEnabled(): boolean {
    return this.visibleNodeCount >= this.VIRTUAL_THRESHOLD;
  }

  get visibleWindowNodes(): TreeNode[] {
    return this.visibleWindowNodesCache;
  }

  get totalContentHeight(): number {
    return this.visibleNodeCount * this.VIRTUAL_ROW_HEIGHT;
  }

  get virtualWindowTransform(): string {
    if (!this.virtualEnabled) return '';
    return `translateY(${this.virtualStart * this.VIRTUAL_ROW_HEIGHT}px)`;
  }

  get renderedNodes(): TreeNode[] {
    const root = this.nodes[0];
    if (this.nodes.length === 1 && typeof root?.syntheticRoot === 'string') {
      return root.children ?? [];
    }
    return this.nodes;
  }

  ngAfterViewInit(): void {
    this.setupResizeObserver();
    this.setupScrollListener();
    this.refreshVisibleNodes();
    this.updateVirtualWindow(true);
  }

  ngOnChanges(changes: SimpleChanges): void {
    if (changes['nodes'] || changes['colorizeByMime']) {
      this.prewarmCollisionResolutions(this.nodes);
      if (changes['nodes']) {
        this.updateNodeHierarchy(this.nodes);
        this.applyDesiredExpansion();
      }
    }
    const shouldExpandToCurrentPath =
      this.desiredExpandedPaths.size === 0 &&
      (!!changes['currentPath'] || (!!changes['nodes'] && !this.suppressNextAutoExpand));
    if (shouldExpandToCurrentPath) {
      this.expandToCurrentPath();
    }
    if (changes['nodes'] && this.suppressNextAutoExpand) {
      this.suppressNextAutoExpand = false;
    }
    this.refreshVisibleNodes();
    this.updateVirtualWindow(true);
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
  }

  private prewarmCollisionResolutions(nodes: TreeNode[]): void {
    if (!this.colorizeByMime) {
      return;
    }
    for (const node of nodes) {
      this.categoryResolver.ensureResolved(node);
      if (node.children?.length) {
        this.prewarmCollisionResolutions(node.children);
      }
    }
  }

  ngOnDestroy(): void {
    this.detachMarqueeListeners();
    this.cleanupResizeObserver();
    this.cleanupScrollListener();
    if (this.scrollRAF) {
      cancelAnimationFrame(this.scrollRAF);
    }
  }

  private setupResizeObserver(): void {
    const element = this.treeContainer?.nativeElement;
    if (!element) return;

    this.zone.runOutsideAngular(() => {
      this.resizeObserver = new ResizeObserver((entries) => {
        let shouldMark = false;
        for (const entry of entries) {
          if (this.viewportHeight !== entry.contentRect.height) {
            this.viewportHeight = entry.contentRect.height;
            shouldMark = this.updateVirtualWindow() || shouldMark;
          }
        }
        if (shouldMark) {
          this.zone.run(() => this.cdr.markForCheck());
        }
      });

      this.resizeObserver.observe(element);
    });
  }

  private cleanupResizeObserver(): void {
    this.resizeObserver?.disconnect();
  }

  private setupScrollListener(): void {
    const element = this.treeContainer?.nativeElement;
    if (!element) return;
    this.boundScrollListener = () => this.onScroll();
    this.zone.runOutsideAngular(() => {
      element.addEventListener('scroll', this.boundScrollListener!, { passive: true });
    });
  }

  private cleanupScrollListener(): void {
    const element = this.treeContainer?.nativeElement;
    if (!element || !this.boundScrollListener) return;
    element.removeEventListener('scroll', this.boundScrollListener);
    this.boundScrollListener = undefined;
  }

  private onScroll(): void {
    if (this.scrollRAF) return;
    this.scrollRAF = requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      this.scrollRAF = null;
      if (this.updateVirtualWindow()) {
        this.zone.run(() => this.cdr.markForCheck());
      }
      this.viewportChange.emit();
    });
  }

  private updateVirtualWindow(forceRebuild = false): boolean {
    let changed = forceRebuild;
    if (!this.virtualEnabled) {
      if (this.virtualStart !== 0 || this.virtualEnd !== this.flatVisibleNodes.length) {
        this.virtualStart = 0;
        this.virtualEnd = this.flatVisibleNodes.length;
        changed = true;
      }
      if (changed) {
        this.rebuildVisibleWindowNodes();
      }
      return changed;
    }

    const host = this.treeContainer?.nativeElement;
    const viewportHeight = Math.max(1, this.viewportHeight || host?.clientHeight || 1);
    const scrollTop = host?.scrollTop ?? 0;

    if (Math.abs(scrollTop - this.lastScrollTop) < this.VIRTUAL_ROW_HEIGHT && this.virtualEnd > 0) {
      if (changed) {
        this.rebuildVisibleWindowNodes();
      }
      return changed;
    }
    
    this.lastScrollTop = scrollTop;

    const visibleRows = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(viewportHeight / this.VIRTUAL_ROW_HEIGHT));
    const start = Math.max(0, Math.floor(scrollTop / this.VIRTUAL_ROW_HEIGHT) - this.VIRTUAL_OVERSCAN);
    const end = Math.min(this.flatVisibleNodes.length, start + visibleRows + this.VIRTUAL_OVERSCAN * 2);

    if (start !== this.virtualStart || end !== this.virtualEnd) {
      this.virtualStart = start;
      this.virtualEnd = end;
      changed = true;
    }
    if (changed) {
      this.rebuildVisibleWindowNodes();
    }
    return changed;
  }

  private refreshVisibleNodes(): void {
    this.flatVisibleNodes = this.getVisibleNodes();
    this.visibleNodeIndex.clear();
    this.flatVisibleNodes.forEach((node, index) => this.visibleNodeIndex.set(node.path, index));
    if (!this.virtualEnabled) {
      this.virtualStart = 0;
      this.virtualEnd = this.flatVisibleNodes.length;
    }
    this.rebuildVisibleWindowNodes();
  }

  private rebuildVisibleWindowNodes(): void {
    this.visibleWindowNodesCache = this.virtualEnabled
      ? this.flatVisibleNodes.slice(this.virtualStart, this.virtualEnd)
      : this.flatVisibleNodes;
  }

  isExpanded(node: TreeNode): boolean {
    return this.expansionState.get(node.path) ?? false;
  }

  private setExpanded(node: TreeNode, expanded: boolean): void {
    this.expansionState.set(node.path, expanded);
    if (expanded) {
      this.desiredExpandedPaths.add(node.path);
    } else {
      this.desiredExpandedPaths.delete(node.path);
    }
    if (expanded && !node.loaded && node.expandable && !node.loading) {
      node.loading = true;
      this.loadChildren.emit(node);
    }
    this.refreshVisibleNodes();
    this.updateVirtualWindow(true);
  }

  toggleNode(node: TreeNode): void {
    if (node.loading) return;
    this.setExpanded(node, !this.isExpanded(node));
    this.toggleExpand.emit(node);
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
  }

  private updateNodeHierarchy(nodes: TreeNode[], parent?: TreeNode): void {
    for (const node of nodes) {
      node.parent = parent;
      if (node.children) {
        this.updateNodeHierarchy(node.children, node);
      }
    }
  }

  private applyDesiredExpansion(): void {
    if (this.desiredExpandedPaths.size === 0) {
      return;
    }

    const visit = (nodes: TreeNode[]) => {
      for (const node of nodes) {
        const shouldExpand = this.desiredExpandedPaths.has(node.path);
        this.expansionState.set(node.path, shouldExpand);
        if (shouldExpand && !node.loaded && node.expandable && !node.loading) {
          node.loading = true;
          this.loadChildren.emit(node);
        }
        if (node.children?.length) {
          visit(node.children);
        }
      }
    };

    visit(this.nodes);
  }

  getVisibleNodes(): TreeNode[] {
    const result: TreeNode[] = [];
    const traverse = (nodes: TreeNode[]) => {
      for (const node of nodes) {
        result.push(node);
        if (this.isExpanded(node) && node.children?.length) {
          traverse(node.children);
        }
      }
    };
    traverse(this.renderedNodes);
    return result;
  }

  getFocusedNodePath(): string | null {
    return this.focusedNodePath;
  }

  isNodeExpanded(path: string): boolean {
    const node = this.findNodeByPath(this.nodes, path);
    return !!node && this.isExpanded(node);
  }

  getExpandedPaths(): string[] {
    return Array.from(this.expansionState.entries())
      .filter(([, expanded]) => expanded)
      .map(([path]) => path);
  }

  setExpandedPaths(paths: string[]): void {
    this.desiredExpandedPaths = new Set((paths ?? []).filter(Boolean));
    this.expansionState.clear();
    this.applyDesiredExpansion();
    this.refreshVisibleNodes();
    this.updateVirtualWindow(true);
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
  }

  getScrollTop(): number {
    return this.treeContainer?.nativeElement?.scrollTop ?? 0;
  }


  getScrollMetrics(): { scrollTop: number; scrollHeight: number; clientHeight: number } {
    const element = this.treeContainer?.nativeElement;
    return {
      scrollTop: element?.scrollTop ?? 0,
      scrollHeight: element?.scrollHeight ?? 0,
      clientHeight: element?.clientHeight ?? 0,
    };
  }

  setScrollTop(top: number): void {
    const element = this.treeContainer?.nativeElement;
    if (!element) return;
    element.scrollTop = Math.max(0, top);
  }

  suppressNextAutoExpandToCurrentPath(): void {
    this.suppressNextAutoExpand = true;
  }

  getGuides(node: TreeNode): { active: boolean; last: boolean; skip: boolean }[] {
    // Do not draw guide lines for top-level entries under a synthetic root.
    if (typeof node.parent?.syntheticRoot === 'string') {
      return [];
    }

    const chain: TreeNode[] = [];
    let cur: TreeNode | undefined = node;
    while (cur?.parent) {
      if (typeof cur.parent.syntheticRoot === 'string') {
        break;
      }
      chain.push(cur);
      cur = cur.parent;
    }
    chain.reverse();

    return chain.map((n, index, arr) => {
      const siblings = n.parent?.children ?? [];
      const isLast = siblings.length > 0 && siblings[siblings.length - 1].path === n.path;
      const isDeepest = index === arr.length - 1;
      
      // Skip rendering guide lines for ancestors that are last children (to avoid vertical continuation).
      // Only the deepest node should show an elbow if it's last.
      const skip = isLast && !isDeepest;
      const shouldMarkAsLast = isLast && isDeepest;
      
      return { active: this.isSelected(node), last: shouldMarkAsLast, skip };
    });
  }

  getCategoryIcon(filename: string): string {
    const ext = filename.split('.').pop()?.toLowerCase() || '';
    const cat = getPrimaryFileCategoryForExtension(ext);
    return cat ? cat.icon : '📄';
  }

  isSelected(node: TreeNode): boolean {
    return this.selectedFiles.has(node.path);
  }

  isFocusedNode(node: TreeNode): boolean {
    return this.focusedNodePath === node.path;
  }

  private selectNodeAndAdvance(node: TreeNode, visible: TreeNode[]): void {
    this.selectNode(node, false, false);

    const currentIdx = visible.findIndex(candidate => candidate.path === node.path);
    if (currentIdx === -1) return;

    const nextNode = visible[Math.min(currentIdx + 1, visible.length - 1)];
    if (!nextNode || nextNode.path === node.path) return;

    this.focusedNodePath = nextNode.path;
    this.ensureVisible(nextNode);
  }

  private selectNode(node: TreeNode, addToSelection = false, range = false): void {
    const visible = this.getVisibleNodes();
    let newSelection: TreeNode[];

    if (range && this.anchorNodePath) {
      const anchorIdx = visible.findIndex(n => n.path === this.anchorNodePath);
      const currentIdx = visible.findIndex(n => n.path === node.path);
      
      if (anchorIdx !== -1 && currentIdx !== -1) {
        const start = Math.min(anchorIdx, currentIdx);
        const end = Math.max(anchorIdx, currentIdx);
        newSelection = visible.slice(start, end + 1);
      } else {
        newSelection = [node];
      }
    } else if (addToSelection) {
      const currentSelection = this.getSelectedNodes();
      if (this.isSelected(node)) {
        newSelection = currentSelection.filter(n => n.path !== node.path);
      } else {
        newSelection = [...currentSelection, node];
      }
      this.anchorNodePath = node.path;
    } else {
      newSelection = [node];
      this.anchorNodePath = node.path;
    }

    this.focusedNodePath = node.path;
    this.selectionChange.emit(newSelection);
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
  }

  private getSelectedNodes(): TreeNode[] {
    const result: TreeNode[] = [];
    const traverse = (nodes: TreeNode[]) => {
      for (const node of nodes) {
        if (this.isSelected(node)) result.push(node);
        if (node.children) traverse(node.children);
      }
    };
    traverse(this.nodes);
    return result;
  }

  onFocus(): void {
    this.isFocused = true;
    if (!this.focusedNodePath && this.nodes.length > 0) {
      this.focusedNodePath = this.nodes[0].path;
    }
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
  }

  onBlur(): void {
    this.isFocused = false;
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
  }

  onNodeMouseDown(node: TreeNode, event: MouseEvent): void {
    if (event.button !== 0) return;
    
    const target = event.target as HTMLElement;
    if (target.closest('.tree-twistie')) return;

    // Do not change selection on mousedown; wait for click or keyboard.
    // This keeps drag initiation from altering selection when drawing the drop indicator.
    this.isMouseDownSelecting = false;
  }

  onNodeClick(node: TreeNode, event: MouseEvent): void {
    event.stopPropagation();

    if (this.clickTimer) {
      clearTimeout(this.clickTimer);
      this.clickTimer = null;
    }

    const isCtrl = event.ctrlKey || event.metaKey;
    const isShift = event.shiftKey;
    this.selectNode(node, isCtrl, isShift);
    this.isMouseDownSelecting = false;

    this.clickTimer = window.setTimeout(() => {
      this.clickTimer = null;
    }, 250);
  }

  onNodeDoubleClick(node: TreeNode, event: MouseEvent): void {
    event.stopPropagation();

    if (this.clickTimer) {
      clearTimeout(this.clickTimer);
      this.clickTimer = null;
    }

    this.isMouseDownSelecting = false;

    if (node.type === FileType.FILE || node.type === FileType.SYMLINK) {
      this.nodeDoubleClick.emit(node);
      return;
    }

    if ((node.type === FileType.DIRECTORY || node.type === FileType.ARCHIVE) && node.expandable) {
      this.toggleNode(node);
    } else {
      this.nodeDoubleClick.emit(node);
    }
  }

  onNodeAuxClick(node: TreeNode, event: MouseEvent): void {
    if (event.button !== 1) return;
    event.preventDefault();
    event.stopPropagation();
    this.openInNewTab.emit(node);
  }

  onTwistieMouseDown(event: MouseEvent, node: TreeNode): void {
    event.stopPropagation();
  }

  onTwistieClick(event: MouseEvent, node: TreeNode): void {
    event.stopPropagation();
    if (!node.expandable) return;

    if (this.clickTimer) {
      clearTimeout(this.clickTimer);
      this.clickTimer = null;
    }

    this.toggleNode(node);
  }

  onContextMenu(event: MouseEvent, node: TreeNode): void {
    event.preventDefault();
    event.stopPropagation();

    if (!this.isSelected(node)) {
      this.selectNode(node, true, false);
    }
    
    this.focusedNodePath = node.path;
    this.contextMenu.emit({ event, node });
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
  }

  isDraggingNode(node: TreeNode): boolean {
    return this.dragState.isDragging && this.dragState.draggedNodes.some(n => n.path === node.path);
  }

  isDragOver(node: TreeNode, position?: 'before' | 'after' | 'inside'): boolean {
    if (!this.dragState.dropTarget) return false;
    if (this.dragState.dropTarget.node.path !== node.path) return false;
    if (!position) return true;
    return this.dragState.dropTarget.position === position;
  }

  onDragStart(event: DragEvent, node: TreeNode): void {
    if (event.button !== 0) {
      event.preventDefault();
      return;
    }

    // Do not alter selection when beginning a drag. Use existing selection set; if none, drag the node itself.
    const selectedNodes = this.getSelectedNodes();
    const dragNodes = selectedNodes.length ? selectedNodes : [node];
    this.dragState.isDragging = true;
    this.dragState.draggedNodes = dragNodes;

    if (event.dataTransfer) {
      event.dataTransfer.effectAllowed = 'move';
      event.dataTransfer.setData('application/json', JSON.stringify({
        entries: dragNodes.map(n => ({ path: n.path, type: n.type, name: n.name })),
        source: 'tree'
      }));
      
      if (dragNodes.length > 1) {
        const dragImage = document.createElement('div');
        dragImage.textContent = `${dragNodes.length} items`;
        dragImage.style.cssText = `
          background: var(--vsc-list-active-background);
          color: var(--vsc-foreground);
          padding: 4px 8px;
          border-radius: 3px;
          font-size: 12px;
          position: fixed;
          top: -1000px;
        `;
        document.body.appendChild(dragImage);
        event.dataTransfer.setDragImage(dragImage, 0, 0);
        setTimeout(() => document.body.removeChild(dragImage), 0);
      }
    }

    this.dragStart.emit({ event, nodes: selectedNodes });
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
  }

  onDragEnd(event: DragEvent): void {
    this.dragState.isDragging = false;
    this.dragState.draggedNodes = [];
    this.dragState.dropTarget = null;
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
  }

  onDragOver(event: DragEvent, node: TreeNode): void {
    event.preventDefault();
    
    // Handle external files (from OS file manager)
    if (this.hasExternalFiles(event)) {
      if (event.dataTransfer) {
        event.dataTransfer.dropEffect = event.ctrlKey || event.metaKey ? 'copy' : 'move';
      }
      // Set simple drop target for external files
      const position = node.type === FileType.DIRECTORY ? 'inside' : 'after';
      if (this.dragState.dropTarget?.node.path === node.path && this.dragState.dropTarget.position === position) {
        return;
      }
      this.dragState.dropTarget = { node, position };
      this.cdr.markForCheck();
      return;
    }
    
    // Internal drag: from tree itself, or cross-component (list/grid/details → tree)
    const isInternalDrag = this.dragState.isDragging || (event.dataTransfer?.types ?? []).includes('application/json');
    if (!isInternalDrag) return;

    const rect = (event.currentTarget as HTMLElement).getBoundingClientRect();
    const y = event.clientY - rect.top;
    const height = rect.height;
    
    let position: 'before' | 'after' | 'inside';
    
    if (node.expandable && y > height * 0.25 && y < height * 0.75) {
      position = 'inside';
    } else if (y < height / 2) {
      position = 'before';
    } else {
      position = 'after';
    }

    // For tree-internal drags, validate against dragged nodes to prevent dropping onto self
    if (this.dragState.isDragging) {
      const isValidDrop = !this.dragState.draggedNodes.some(dragged => 
        dragged.path === node.path || this.isDescendant(node, dragged)
      );
      if (!isValidDrop) return;
    }

    if (this.dragState.dropTarget?.node.path === node.path && this.dragState.dropTarget.position === position) {
      return;
    }
    this.dragState.dropTarget = { node, position };
    if (event.dataTransfer) {
      event.dataTransfer.dropEffect = event.ctrlKey || event.metaKey ? 'copy' : 'move';
    }

    this.cdr.markForCheck();
  }

  onDragLeave(event: DragEvent, node: TreeNode): void {
    if (this.dragState.dropTarget?.node.path === node.path) {
      this.dragState.dropTarget = null;
      this.cdr.markForCheck();
    }
  }

  onDrop(event: DragEvent, node: TreeNode): void {
    event.preventDefault();

    // For external OS drops, don't stopPropagation - let Wails' window handler fire wails:file-drop
    if (this.hasExternalFiles(event)) {
      this.dragState.dropTarget = null;
      this.cdr.markForCheck();
      return;
    }

    event.stopPropagation();

    if (!this.dragState.dropTarget) return;

    // Use draggedNodes when drag started within the tree; fall back to dataTransfer for cross-component drags
    let sourceNodes: TreeNode[] = this.dragState.draggedNodes;
    if (!sourceNodes.length) {
      const dragged = this.readDraggedEntries(event);
      sourceNodes = dragged.map(d => ({
        name: d.name,
        path: d.path,
        type: d.type as FileType,
        size: 0,
        created: 0,
        modified: 0,
        accessed: 0,
        permissions: '',
        isHidden: false,
        level: 0,
      } as TreeNode));
    }

    if (!sourceNodes.length) {
      this.dragState.dropTarget = null;
      this.cdr.markForCheck();
      return;
    }

    this.dragDrop.emit({
      event,
      source: sourceNodes,
      target: this.dragState.dropTarget
    });

    this.dragState.dropTarget = null;
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
  }

  onContainerDragOver(event: DragEvent): void {
    event.preventDefault();
  }

  onContainerDrop(event: DragEvent): void {
    event.preventDefault();

    // For external OS drops, don't stopPropagation - let Wails' window handler fire wails:file-drop
    if (this.hasExternalFiles(event)) {
      return;
    }

    event.stopPropagation();
  }

  private readDraggedEntries(event: DragEvent): { path: string; type: FileType; name: string }[] {
    try {
      const payload = event.dataTransfer?.getData('application/json');
      if (!payload) return [];
      const parsed = JSON.parse(payload);
      if (Array.isArray(parsed?.entries)) return parsed.entries;
      if (Array.isArray(parsed?.paths)) return parsed.paths.map((p: string) => ({ path: p, type: FileType.FILE, name: p.split(/[\/\\]/).pop() || p }));
      return [];
    } catch {
      return [];
    }
  }

  private hasExternalFiles(event: DragEvent): boolean {
    const types = event.dataTransfer?.types;
    if (!types) return false;
    if (types.includes('application/json')) return false;
    return types.includes('Files') || (event.dataTransfer?.files?.length ?? 0) > 0;
  }

  private extractExternalPaths(event: DragEvent): string[] {
    const dataTransfer = event.dataTransfer;
    if (!dataTransfer) return [];

    const paths = new Set<string>();

    const files = dataTransfer.files;
    for (let i = 0; i < files.length; i++) {
      const file = files[i];
      const filePath = (file as any).path as string | undefined;
      if (filePath) {
        paths.add(this.normalizePath(filePath));
      }
    }

    const uriPayload = dataTransfer.getData('text/uri-list') || dataTransfer.getData('text/plain');
    if (uriPayload) {
      for (const rawLine of uriPayload.split(/\r?\n/)) {
        const line = rawLine.trim();
        if (!line || line.startsWith('#')) continue;
        const parsedPath = this.fileUriToPath(line);
        if (parsedPath) paths.add(parsedPath);
      }
    }

    return Array.from(paths);
  }

  private fileUriToPath(value: string): string | null {
    if (!value) return null;
    const trimmed = value.trim();
    if (!/^file:\/\//i.test(trimmed)) {
      if (/^[A-Za-z]:[\\/]/.test(trimmed)) return this.normalizePath(trimmed);
      if (/^\\\\/.test(trimmed)) return this.normalizePath(trimmed);
      if (trimmed.startsWith('/')) return this.normalizePath(trimmed);
      return null;
    }

    try {
      let decoded = decodeURIComponent(trimmed).replace(/^file:\/\//i, '');

      if (/^\/[A-Za-z]:\//.test(decoded)) {
        decoded = decoded.slice(1);
      }

      if (/^[A-Za-z]:\//.test(decoded)) {
        return this.normalizePath(decoded.replace(/\//g, '\\'));
      }

      if (!decoded.startsWith('/')) {
        return this.normalizePath(('//' + decoded).replace(/\//g, '\\'));
      }

      return this.normalizePath(decoded);
    } catch {
      return null;
    }
  }

  onContainerMouseDown(event: MouseEvent): void {
    if (event.button !== 0 && event.button !== 2) return;

    // Left-button on a node is handled by click/drag-and-drop — skip.
    // Right-button on a node should still start marquee selection (TC behaviour).
    const target = event.target as HTMLElement;
    if (event.button === 0 && target.closest('.tree-node')) return;

    const container = event.currentTarget as HTMLElement;
    this.marqueeContainer = container;
    this.marqueeAppend = event.ctrlKey || event.metaKey;
    this.marqueeButton = event.button as 0 | 2;
    this.hasMarqueeMoved = false;
    // Defer clear until marquee actually moves — plain click keeps cursor visible
    this.pendingClearOnMove = !this.marqueeAppend;

    const { x, y } = this.getRelativePoint(event, container);
    this.marqueeStartX = x;
    this.marqueeStartY = y;
    this.selectionRect = { active: true, left: x, top: y, width: 0, height: 0 };

    this.suppressContainerClick = true;
    this.suppressContainerContextMenu = event.button === 2;

    this.windowMouseMove = (e: MouseEvent) => this.zone.run(() => this.onMarqueeMouseMove(e));
    this.windowMouseUp = () => this.zone.run(() => this.finishMarqueeSelection());
    this.windowContextMenu = (e: MouseEvent) => {
      if (this.selectionRect.active && this.hasMarqueeMoved) {
        e.preventDefault();
        e.stopPropagation();
      }
    };

    window.addEventListener('mousemove', this.windowMouseMove);
    window.addEventListener('mouseup', this.windowMouseUp);
    window.addEventListener('contextmenu', this.windowContextMenu, true);

    if (event.button === 0) {
      event.preventDefault();
    }
  }

  private onMarqueeMouseMove(event: MouseEvent): void {
    if (!this.marqueeContainer || !this.selectionRect.active) return;

    const { x, y } = this.getRelativePoint(event, this.marqueeContainer);
    const left = Math.min(this.marqueeStartX, x);
    const top = Math.min(this.marqueeStartY, y);
    const width = Math.abs(x - this.marqueeStartX);
    const height = Math.abs(y - this.marqueeStartY);

    if (width > 10 || height > 10) {
      this.hasMarqueeMoved = true;
      if (this.pendingClearOnMove) {
        this.selectionChange.emit([]);
        this.pendingClearOnMove = false;
      }
    }

    this.selectionRect = { active: true, left, top, width, height };
    if (this.hasMarqueeMoved) {
      this.emitMarqueeSelection();
    }
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
  }

  private emitMarqueeSelection(): void {
    if (!this.marqueeContainer) return;
    const selectionPaths = new Set<string>();
    const selectionBottom = this.selectionRect.top + this.selectionRect.height;
    const startIndex = Math.max(0, Math.floor(this.selectionRect.top / this.VIRTUAL_ROW_HEIGHT));
    const endIndex = Math.min(this.flatVisibleNodes.length - 1, Math.floor(Math.max(0, selectionBottom - 1) / this.VIRTUAL_ROW_HEIGHT));

    for (let i = startIndex; i <= endIndex; i++) {
      const node = this.flatVisibleNodes[i];
      if (node) {
        selectionPaths.add(node.path);
      }
    }

    if (this.marqueeAppend) {
      for (const path of this.selectedFiles) selectionPaths.add(path);
    }

    const selectedNodes = this.flatVisibleNodes.filter(n => selectionPaths.has(n.path));
    this.selectionChange.emit(selectedNodes);
  }

  private finishMarqueeSelection(): void {
    this.detachMarqueeListeners();
    this.marqueeContainer = null;
    this.marqueeButton = null;
    this.hasMarqueeMoved = false;
    this.pendingClearOnMove = false;
    this.selectionRect = { active: false, left: 0, top: 0, width: 0, height: 0 };
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
  }

  private detachMarqueeListeners(): void {
    if (this.windowMouseMove) {
      window.removeEventListener('mousemove', this.windowMouseMove);
      this.windowMouseMove = undefined;
    }
    if (this.windowMouseUp) {
      window.removeEventListener('mouseup', this.windowMouseUp);
      this.windowMouseUp = undefined;
    }
    if (this.windowContextMenu) {
      window.removeEventListener('contextmenu', this.windowContextMenu, true);
      this.windowContextMenu = undefined;
    }
  }

  private getRelativePoint(event: MouseEvent, container: HTMLElement): { x: number; y: number } {
    const rect = container.getBoundingClientRect();
    return {
      x: event.clientX - rect.left + container.scrollLeft,
      y: event.clientY - rect.top + container.scrollTop,
    };
  }

  // TC: background left-click — cursor stays, selection unchanged
  onContainerClick(event: MouseEvent): void {
    if (this.suppressContainerClick) {
      this.suppressContainerClick = false;
      return;
    }
  }

  // TC: background right-click — open directory context menu, do NOT change selection
  onContainerContextMenu(event: MouseEvent): void {
    if (this.suppressContainerContextMenu) {
      event.preventDefault();
      this.suppressContainerContextMenu = false;
      return;
    }

    const target = event.target as HTMLElement;
    if (!target.closest('.tree-node')) {
      event.preventDefault();
      this.backgroundContextMenu.emit(event);
    }
  }

  private isDescendant(potentialDescendant: TreeNode, ancestor: TreeNode): boolean {
    let current = potentialDescendant.parent;
    while (current) {
      if (current.path === ancestor.path) return true;
      current = current.parent;
    }
    return false;
  }

  startRename(node: TreeNode): void {
    node.renaming = true;
    node.editingName = node.name;
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
    
    setTimeout(() => {
      this.renameInput?.nativeElement.focus();
      this.renameInput?.nativeElement.select();
    }, 0);
  }

  /** Public helper for parent components to trigger rename on the focused node (eg. global F2). */
  startRenameFocused(): void {
    const visible = this.getVisibleNodes();
    if (visible.length === 0) return;
    const currentIdx = visible.findIndex(n => n.path === this.focusedNodePath);
    const current = currentIdx >= 0 ? visible[currentIdx] : visible[0];
    if (current) this.startRename(current);
  }

  startRenamePath(path: string): void {
    if (!path) return;

    this.tryStartRenamePath(path, Date.now() + 3000);
  }

  setPendingRenameDisplayName(path: string, displayName: string | null): void {
    if (!path) return;
    if (displayName && displayName.trim()) {
      this.pendingRenameDisplayNames.set(path, displayName.trim());
    } else {
      this.pendingRenameDisplayNames.delete(path);
    }
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
  }

  getDisplayNameOverride(path: string): string | null {
    return this.pendingRenameDisplayNames.get(path) ?? null;
  }

  hasPendingRenameState(): boolean {
    return this.pendingRenameDisplayNames.size > 0 || this.hasRenamingNode(this.nodes);
  }

  private tryStartRenamePath(path: string, deadline: number): void {
    this.focusNode(path);

    requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      const target = this.getVisibleNodes().find((node) => node.path === path);
      if (target) {
        this.centerNode(path);
        this.startRename(target);
        return;
      }

      if (Date.now() < deadline) {
        setTimeout(() => this.tryStartRenamePath(path, deadline), 50);
      }
    });
  }

  onRenameBlur(node: TreeNode): void {
    this.commitRename(node);
  }

  onRenameKeyDown(event: KeyboardEvent, node: TreeNode): void {
    event.stopPropagation();

    if (event.key === 'Enter') {
      event.preventDefault();
      this.commitRename(node);
    } else if (event.key === 'Escape') {
      event.preventDefault();
      this.cancelRename(node);
    }
  }

  private commitRename(node: TreeNode): void {
    if (!node.renaming) return;
    
    const newName = node.editingName?.trim();
    if (newName && newName !== node.name) {
      this.rename.emit({ node, newName });
    }
    
    node.renaming = false;
    node.editingName = undefined;
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
  }

  private cancelRename(node: TreeNode): void {
    node.renaming = false;
    node.editingName = undefined;
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
  }

  onKeyDown(event: KeyboardEvent): void {
    const visible = this.getVisibleNodes();
    if (visible.length === 0) return;

    const currentIdx = visible.findIndex(n => n.path === this.focusedNodePath);
    const current = currentIdx >= 0 ? visible[currentIdx] : null;

    switch (event.key) {
      case 'ArrowDown':
        event.preventDefault();
        if (currentIdx < visible.length - 1) {
          this.focusedNodePath = visible[currentIdx + 1].path;
          if (event.shiftKey && this.anchorNodePath) {
            this.selectNode(visible[currentIdx + 1], false, true);
          } else {
            this.ensureVisible(visible[currentIdx + 1]);
          }
        }
        break;

      case 'ArrowUp':
        event.preventDefault();
        if (currentIdx > 0) {
          this.focusedNodePath = visible[currentIdx - 1].path;
          if (event.shiftKey && this.anchorNodePath) {
            this.selectNode(visible[currentIdx - 1], false, true);
          } else {
            this.ensureVisible(visible[currentIdx - 1]);
          }
        }
        break;

      case 'ArrowRight':
        event.preventDefault();
        if (current?.expandable) {
          if (!this.isExpanded(current)) {
            this.toggleNode(current);
          } else {
            const child = visible[currentIdx + 1];
            if (child && child.parent === current) {
              this.focusedNodePath = child.path;
            }
          }
        }
        break;

      case 'ArrowLeft':
        event.preventDefault();
        if (current) {
          if (current.expandable && this.isExpanded(current)) {
            this.toggleNode(current);
          } else if (current.parent) {
            this.focusedNodePath = current.parent.path;
            this.ensureVisible(current.parent);
          }
        }
        break;

      case 'Enter':
        event.preventDefault();
        if (current) {
          if (current.type === FileType.DIRECTORY && current.expandable) {
            this.toggleNode(current);
          } else {
            this.nodeDoubleClick.emit(current);
          }
        }
        break;

      case ' ':
        event.preventDefault();
        if (current) {
          if (!event.ctrlKey && !event.metaKey && !event.shiftKey && !event.altKey) {
            if (current.type === FileType.DIRECTORY) {
              this.inlineSize.emit(current);
            }
            this.selectNodeAndAdvance(current, visible);
          } else {
            this.selectNode(current, event.ctrlKey || event.metaKey, event.shiftKey);
          }
        }
        break;

      case 'Insert':
        event.preventDefault();
        if (current) {
          if (!event.ctrlKey && !event.metaKey && !event.shiftKey && !event.altKey) {
            this.selectNodeAndAdvance(current, visible);
          } else {
            this.selectNode(current, event.ctrlKey || event.metaKey, event.shiftKey);
          }
        }
        break;

      case 'F2':
        event.preventDefault();
        if (current) {
          this.startRename(current);
        }
        break;

      case 'Home':
        event.preventDefault();
        this.focusedNodePath = visible[0].path;
        this.ensureVisible(visible[0]);
        break;

      case 'End':
        event.preventDefault();
        this.focusedNodePath = visible[visible.length - 1].path;
        this.ensureVisible(visible[visible.length - 1]);
        break;

      case 'a':
      case 'A':
        if (event.ctrlKey || event.metaKey) {
          event.preventDefault();
          this.selectionChange.emit(visible);
        }
        break;
    }

    this.cdr.markForCheck();
  }

  private ensureVisible(node: TreeNode): void {
    requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      const host = this.treeContainer?.nativeElement;
      if (!host) return;
      
      if (this.virtualEnabled) {
        const idx = this.visibleNodeIndex.get(node.path) ?? -1;
        if (idx >= 0) {
          const nodeTop = idx * this.VIRTUAL_ROW_HEIGHT;
          const nodeBottom = nodeTop + this.VIRTUAL_ROW_HEIGHT;
          const viewTop = host.scrollTop;
          const viewBottom = viewTop + host.clientHeight;
          
          if (nodeTop < viewTop) {
            host.scrollTop = nodeTop;
          } else if (nodeBottom > viewBottom) {
            host.scrollTop = nodeBottom - host.clientHeight;
          }
          this.updateVirtualWindow();
        }
        return;
      }
      
      const el = host.querySelector(`[data-path="${CSS.escape(node.path)}"]`);
      el?.scrollIntoView({ block: 'nearest', inline: 'nearest' });
    });
  }

  trackByFn: TrackByFunction<TreeNode> = (_, node) => node.path;

  expandNode(path: string): void {
    const node = this.findNodeByPath(this.nodes, path);
    if (node?.expandable) {
      this.setExpanded(node, true);
      this.cdr.markForCheck();
    }
  }

  collapseNode(path: string): void {
    const node = this.findNodeByPath(this.nodes, path);
    if (node) {
      this.setExpanded(node, false);
      this.cdr.markForCheck();
    }
  }

  focusNode(path: string): void {
    this.focusedNodePath = path;
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
  }

  centerNode(path: string): void {
    const node = this.findNodeByPath(this.nodes, path);
    const host = this.treeContainer?.nativeElement;
    if (!host) return;

    if (!node) {
      host.scrollTop = 0;
      return;
    }

    requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      if (this.virtualEnabled) {
        const idx = this.visibleNodeIndex.get(node.path) ?? -1;
        if (idx >= 0) {
          const nodeTop = idx * this.VIRTUAL_ROW_HEIGHT;
          const centerOffset = host.clientHeight / 2 - this.VIRTUAL_ROW_HEIGHT / 2;
          host.scrollTop = Math.max(0, nodeTop - centerOffset);
          this.updateVirtualWindow();
        }
        return;
      }
      
      const el = host.querySelector(`[data-path="${CSS.escape(node.path)}"]`);
      if (!el) return;
      el.scrollIntoView({ block: 'center', inline: 'nearest' });
    });
  }

  private findNodeByPath(nodes: TreeNode[], path: string): TreeNode | undefined {
    const target = this.normalizePath(path);
    for (const node of nodes) {
      if (this.normalizePath(node.path) === target) return node;
      if (node.children) {
        const found = this.findNodeByPath(node.children, target);
        if (found) return found;
      }
    }
    return undefined;
  }

  private expandToCurrentPath(): void {
    if (!this.currentPath || this.nodes.length === 0) return;

    const target = this.findBestPathMatch(this.nodes, this.currentPath);
    if (!target) return;

    let current: TreeNode | undefined = target;
    while (current) {
      if (current.expandable) {
        this.setExpanded(current, true);
      }
      current = current.parent;
    }
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
  }

  private findBestPathMatch(nodes: TreeNode[], path: string): TreeNode | undefined {
    const target = this.normalizePath(path);
    let best: TreeNode | undefined;
    let bestLen = -1;

    const visit = (items: TreeNode[]) => {
      for (const node of items) {
        const nodePath = this.normalizePath(node.path);
        const isExact = nodePath === target;
        const isAncestor = target.startsWith(`${nodePath}/`);

        if ((isExact || isAncestor) && nodePath.length > bestLen) {
          best = node;
          bestLen = nodePath.length;
        }

        if (node.children?.length) {
          visit(node.children);
        }
      }
    };

    visit(nodes);
    return best;
  }

  private normalizePath(path: string): string {
    return normalizePathReference(path || '/');
  }

  private hasRenamingNode(nodes: TreeNode[]): boolean {
    for (const node of nodes) {
      if (node.renaming) {
        return true;
      }
      if (node.children?.length && this.hasRenamingNode(node.children)) {
        return true;
      }
    }
    return false;
  }

  notifyChildrenLoaded(node: TreeNode, children: TreeNode[]): void {
    node.children = children;
    node.loading = false;
    node.loaded = true;
    node.expandable = children.length > 0;
    this.updateNodeHierarchy(children, node);
    this.refreshVisibleNodes();
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
  }
}

const OWNER_ID = 'overlay.quickAccess';
const COMMAND = QUICK_ACCESS_INPUT_COMMANDS;
const DEFAULT_LOCATION_ICON = '\u{1F4C1}';
const PINNED_LOCATION_ICON = '\u{1F4CC}';
const SPECIAL_LOCATION_ICONS: Record<string, string> = {
  home: '\u{1F3E0}',
  desktop: '\u{1F5A5}\uFE0F',
  documents: '\u{1F4C4}',
  downloads: '\u{1F4E5}',
  music: '\u{1F3B5}',
  pictures: '\u{1F5BC}\uFE0F',
  videos: '\u{1F3AC}',
};

@Component({
  selector: 'app-quick-access',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [CommonModule, FormsModule],
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
  template: `
    <div class="backdrop palette-dialog-backdrop dialog-group" *ngIf="renderVisible" [class.backdrop--closing]="isClosing" [class.dialog-group--closing]="isClosing" (mousedown)="close()" (animationend)="onBackdropAnimationEnd($event)">
      <section class="quick palette-dialog-surface dialog-surface" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-label="Quick Access" (mousedown)="$event.stopPropagation()"
        tabindex="-1" (keydown.escape)="close(); $event.preventDefault(); $event.stopPropagation()">
        <header class="palette-dialog-header">
          <div><strong>Quick Access</strong><span>{{ totalItems }} items</span></div>
          <input [(ngModel)]="filterText" (ngModelChange)="resetSelection()" placeholder="Filter locations"
            autocomplete="off" spellcheck="false" aria-label="Filter Quick Access" aria-controls="quick-access-list" />
          <span class="dialog-close" aria-label="Close tab" title="Close (Esc)" (click)="close()" role="button" tabindex="0" (keydown.enter)="close()" (keydown.space)="close(); $event.preventDefault()"> × </span>
        </header>

        <nav class="sections" *ngIf="filteredSections.length > 1" aria-label="Quick Access sections">
          <button *ngFor="let section of filteredSections; let i=index" type="button"
            [class.active]="i === sectionIndex" (click)="selectSection(i)">
            {{ section.title }} <span>{{ section.items.length }}</span>
          </button>
        </nav>

        <div id="quick-access-list" class="items" role="listbox" [attr.aria-label]="(activeSection?.title || 'Quick Access') + ' locations'">
          <button *ngFor="let item of activeItems; let i=index; trackBy:trackItem" type="button"
            class="item" [class.selected]="i === itemIndex" role="option"
            [attr.aria-selected]="i === itemIndex" [attr.aria-posinset]="i + 1" [attr.aria-setsize]="activeItems.length" (mouseenter)="itemIndex=i" (click)="openItem(item)">
            <span class="icon">
              <kbd *ngIf="i < 9">{{ i + 1 }}</kbd>
              <span class="glyph">{{ item.icon }}</span>
            </span>
            <span class="details"><strong>{{ item.label }}</strong><small>{{ item.path }}</small></span>
            <span class="meta">{{ item.meta || item.kind }}</span>
          </button>
          <div class="empty" *ngIf="activeItems.length === 0">No matching locations.</div>
        </div>

        <footer>
          <span>{{ activeSection?.title || '' }}</span>
          <button type="button" [disabled]="selectedItem?.kind !== 'pin'" (click)="removeSelectedPin()">Unpin</button>
          <span class="keys">1–9 · Ctrl+PgUp/PgDn sections · ↑ ↓ · Enter · Delete · Esc</span>
        </footer>
      </section>
    </div>
  `,
  styles: [`
    :host{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:9460;pointer-events:none}
    .backdrop{position:fixed;inset:0;display:grid;place-items:start center;padding-top:min(10vh,90px);background: var(--vsc-scrim-soft);pointer-events:auto;animation:fadeIn .2s ease}
    .backdrop--closing{animation:fadeOut .2s ease forwards;pointer-events:none}
    .quick{box-sizing:border-box;display:flex;flex-direction:column;width:min(720px,calc(100vw - 24px));max-height:min(680px,calc(100vh - 40px));overflow:hidden;border:1px solid var(--vsc-border,var(--vsc-border));border-radius:8px;background:var(--vsc-menu-background,var(--vsc-panel-background));color:var(--vsc-foreground,var(--vsc-foreground));box-shadow:0 18px 60px var(--vsc-scrim);font:12px/1.4 var(--vsc-font-family,system-ui,sans-serif);animation:slideDown .28s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)}
    .backdrop--closing .quick{animation:slideUp .2s ease forwards}
    @keyframes fadeIn{from{opacity:0}to{opacity:1}}
    @keyframes fadeOut{from{opacity:1}to{opacity:0}}
    @keyframes slideDown{from{transform:translateY(-18px);opacity:0}to{transform:translateY(0);opacity:1}}
    @keyframes slideUp{from{transform:translateY(0);opacity:1}to{transform:translateY(-18px);opacity:0}}
    header,footer{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;padding:9px 10px} header{justify-content:space-between;border-bottom:1px solid var(--vsc-border-subtle,var(--vsc-border-subtle))} header>div{display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:baseline}
    header span,.meta,.keys,footer>span,small{color:var(--vsc-description-foreground,var(--vsc-foreground-dim))}
    input{box-sizing:border-box;width:min(300px,42vw);height:28px;padding:0 8px;border:1px solid var(--vsc-border,var(--vsc-border));border-radius:4px;outline:none;background:var(--vsc-input-background,var(--vsc-popover-background));color:inherit;font:inherit} input:focus{border-color:var(--vsc-focus-border,var(--vsc-accent-blue))}
    .sections{display:flex;gap:2px;padding:5px;overflow-x:auto;border-bottom:1px solid var(--vsc-border-subtle,var(--vsc-border-subtle))}
    .sections button,footer button{min-height:27px;padding:3px 8px;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:4px;background:transparent;color:inherit;cursor:pointer;font:inherit}
    .sections button{color:var(--vsc-description-foreground,var(--vsc-foreground-dim))} .sections button.active{background:var(--vsc-list-hover-background,var(--vsc-list-hover-background));color:var(--vsc-foreground,var(--vsc-foreground));border-color:var(--vsc-border,var(--vsc-border))} .sections span{margin-left:5px;opacity:.6;font-size:10px}
    .items{min-height:0;overflow:auto;padding:5px}.item{display:grid;grid-template-columns:40px minmax(0,1fr) max-content;gap:8px;align-items:center;width:100%;min-height:46px;padding:5px 8px;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:4px;background:transparent;color:inherit;text-align:left;cursor:pointer;font:inherit}.item:hover,.item.selected{background:var(--vsc-list-hover-background,var(--vsc-list-hover-background))}.item.selected{border-color:color-mix(in srgb,var(--vsc-accent-blue,var(--vsc-accent-blue)) 50%,transparent)}
    .icon{min-width:0;overflow:hidden;display:flex;gap:5px;align-items:center;justify-content:center;text-align:center;font-size:16px}.icon kbd{flex:0 0 auto;font:9px var(--vsc-font-family-mono,ui-monospace,monospace);opacity:.55}.glyph{min-width:0;overflow:hidden;white-space:nowrap;line-height:1}.details{min-width:0;display:grid}.details strong,.details small{overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}.details small{font-family:var(--vsc-font-family-mono,ui-monospace,monospace)}.meta{font-size:10px;white-space:nowrap}.empty{padding:38px;text-align:center;color:var(--vsc-description-foreground,var(--vsc-foreground-dim))}
    footer{border-top:1px solid var(--vsc-border-subtle,var(--vsc-border-subtle))} footer button:hover:not(:disabled){background:var(--vsc-list-hover-background,var(--vsc-list-hover-background));border-color:var(--vsc-border,var(--vsc-border))}footer button:disabled{opacity:.35;cursor:default}.keys{margin-left:auto;font-size:10px}
  `],
})
export class QuickAccessComponent implements OnInit, OnDestroy {
  @Input() paneId: 'left' | 'right' = 'left';
  @Input() currentPath = '';
  @Input() currentSurfaceId = 'dir';
  @Output() navigate = new EventEmitter<string>();
  @Output() openTarget = new EventEmitter<QuickAccessTarget>();

  visible = false;
  renderVisible = false;
  isClosing = false;
  filterText = '';
  sections: QuickSection[] = [];
  sectionIndex = 0;
  itemIndex = 0;
  private pins: PinnedLocation[] = [];

  constructor(
    private readonly api: ApiService,
    private readonly history: PathHistoryService,
    private readonly pinnedLocations: PinnedLocationService,
    private readonly relatedLocations: RelatedLocationService,
    private readonly input: InputEngineService,
    private readonly connections: RemoteConnectionsService,
    private readonly cdr: ChangeDetectorRef,
  ) {}

  get filteredSections(): QuickSection[] {
    const query = this.filterText.trim();
    if (!query) return this.sections;

    return this.sections
      .map(section => ({
        ...section,
        items: section.items
          .map(item => ({
            item,
            score: discoveryScore(query, [
              { value: item.label, weight: 1.5 },
              { value: item.path, weight: 1.1 },
              { value: item.meta, weight: .7 },
              { value: item.kind, weight: .6 },
            ]),
          }))
          .filter(candidate => candidate.score >= 0)
          .sort(
            (a,b) =>
              b.score - a.score ||
              a.item.label.localeCompare(b.item.label),
          )
          .map(candidate => candidate.item),
      }))
      .filter(section => section.items.length > 0);
  }

  get activeSection(): QuickSection | null { return this.filteredSections[this.sectionIndex] ?? null; }
  get activeItems(): QuickItem[] { return this.activeSection?.items ?? []; }
  get selectedItem(): QuickItem | null { return this.activeItems[this.itemIndex] ?? null; }
  get totalItems(): number { return this.filteredSections.reduce((sum,s) => sum + s.items.length, 0); }

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.input.registerCommandDescriptor({id:COMMAND.close,title:'Close Quick Access',category:'Navigation',execute:()=>this.close()},OWNER_ID);
    this.input.registerCommandDescriptor({id:COMMAND.previous,title:'Previous Quick Access Item',category:'Navigation',execute:()=>this.moveItem(-1)},OWNER_ID);
    this.input.registerCommandDescriptor({id:COMMAND.next,title:'Next Quick Access Item',category:'Navigation',execute:()=>this.moveItem(1)},OWNER_ID);
    this.input.registerCommandDescriptor({id:COMMAND.previousSection,title:'Previous Quick Access Section',category:'Navigation',execute:()=>this.moveSection(-1)},OWNER_ID);
    this.input.registerCommandDescriptor({id:COMMAND.nextSection,title:'Next Quick Access Section',category:'Navigation',execute:()=>this.moveSection(1)},OWNER_ID);
    this.input.registerCommandDescriptor({id:COMMAND.open,title:'Open Quick Access Item',category:'Navigation',execute:()=>{const item=this.selectedItem;if(item)this.openItem(item)}},OWNER_ID);
    this.input.registerCommandDescriptor({id:COMMAND.removePin,title:'Remove Quick Access Pin',category:'Navigation',execute:()=>this.removeSelectedPin(),isEnabled:()=>this.selectedItem?.kind==='pin'},OWNER_ID);
    this.input.registerCommandDescriptor({id:COMMAND.first,title:'First Quick Access Item',category:'Navigation',execute:()=>this.jumpBoundary('first')},OWNER_ID);
    this.input.registerCommandDescriptor({id:COMMAND.last,title:'Last Quick Access Item',category:'Navigation',execute:()=>this.jumpBoundary('last')},OWNER_ID);
    this.input.registerCommandDescriptor({id:COMMAND.openSlot1,title:'Open Quick Access Slot 1',category:'Navigation',execute:()=>this.openSlot(0),isEnabled:()=>this.activeItems.length>0},OWNER_ID);
    this.input.registerCommandDescriptor({id:COMMAND.openSlot2,title:'Open Quick Access Slot 2',category:'Navigation',execute:()=>this.openSlot(1),isEnabled:()=>this.activeItems.length>1},OWNER_ID);
    this.input.registerCommandDescriptor({id:COMMAND.openSlot3,title:'Open Quick Access Slot 3',category:'Navigation',execute:()=>this.openSlot(2),isEnabled:()=>this.activeItems.length>2},OWNER_ID);
    this.input.registerCommandDescriptor({id:COMMAND.openSlot4,title:'Open Quick Access Slot 4',category:'Navigation',execute:()=>this.openSlot(3),isEnabled:()=>this.activeItems.length>3},OWNER_ID);
    this.input.registerCommandDescriptor({id:COMMAND.openSlot5,title:'Open Quick Access Slot 5',category:'Navigation',execute:()=>this.openSlot(4),isEnabled:()=>this.activeItems.length>4},OWNER_ID);
    this.input.registerCommandDescriptor({id:COMMAND.openSlot6,title:'Open Quick Access Slot 6',category:'Navigation',execute:()=>this.openSlot(5),isEnabled:()=>this.activeItems.length>5},OWNER_ID);
    this.input.registerCommandDescriptor({id:COMMAND.openSlot7,title:'Open Quick Access Slot 7',category:'Navigation',execute:()=>this.openSlot(6),isEnabled:()=>this.activeItems.length>6},OWNER_ID);
    this.input.registerCommandDescriptor({id:COMMAND.openSlot8,title:'Open Quick Access Slot 8',category:'Navigation',execute:()=>this.openSlot(7),isEnabled:()=>this.activeItems.length>7},OWNER_ID);
    this.input.registerCommandDescriptor({id:COMMAND.openSlot9,title:'Open Quick Access Slot 9',category:'Navigation',execute:()=>this.openSlot(8),isEnabled:()=>this.activeItems.length>8},OWNER_ID);
  }

  ngOnDestroy(): void {
    this.input.deactivateContext(CONTEXT_ID);
    for (const id of Object.values(COMMAND)) this.input.unregisterCommandDescriptor(id, OWNER_ID);
  }

  async open(sectionId?: string): Promise<void> {
    
    await this.reload();

    this.filterText = '';
    this.itemIndex = 0;

    if (sectionId) {
      const index = this.sections.findIndex(section => section.id === sectionId);
      this.sectionIndex = index >= 0 ? index : 0;
    } else {
      this.sectionIndex = 0;
    }

    this.visible = true;
    this.renderVisible = true;
    this.isClosing = false;
    this.input.activateContext(CONTEXT_ID);
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
  }

  close(): void {
    if(!this.renderVisible||this.isClosing)return;
    this.visible=false;
    this.isClosing=true;
    this.input.deactivateContext(CONTEXT_ID);
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
  }
  openItem(item: QuickItem): void {
    const surfaceId = item.surfaceId?.trim();

    if (surfaceId && surfaceId !== 'dir') {
      this.openTarget.emit({
        path: item.path,
        surfaceId,
        label: item.label,
      });
    } else {
      this.navigate.emit(item.path);
    }

    this.close();
  }
  selectSection(index:number):void{this.sectionIndex=Math.max(0,Math.min(index,this.filteredSections.length-1));this.itemIndex=0;this.cdr.markForCheck()}
  resetSelection():void{this.sectionIndex=0;this.itemIndex=0;this.cdr.markForCheck()}
  trackItem(_index:number,item:QuickItem):string{return item.id}

  removeSelectedPin(): void {
    const item=this.selectedItem; if(!item||item.kind!=='pin')return;
    this.pins=this.pinnedLocations.remove(this.pins,item.path,'dir');
    this.pinnedLocations.save(this.pins);
    void this.reload();
  }

  private async reload(): Promise<void> {
    const [specialFolders, drivesResponse] = await Promise.all([
      this.api.getSpecialFolders().catch(() => [] as SpecialFolder[]),
      this.api.getDrives().catch(() => ({ schemes: [] })),
    ]);
    this.pins = this.pinnedLocations.load();

    const allHistory = this.history.getAllHistory();
    const paneHistory = allHistory.filter(entry => entry.paneId === this.paneId);
    const historyPool = paneHistory.length > 0 ? paneHistory : allHistory;

    const currentId = this.locationKey(this.currentPath);

    const frequent = [...historyPool]
      .filter(entry => entry.accessCount >= 2)
      .sort((a, b) =>
        b.accessCount - a.accessCount || b.timestamp - a.timestamp,
      )
      .filter(entry => this.locationKey(entry.location) !== currentId)
      .slice(0, 8);

    const recent = [...historyPool]
      .sort((a, b) => b.timestamp - a.timestamp)
      .filter(entry => this.locationKey(entry.location) !== currentId)
      .slice(0, 10);

    const historyRelated = this.currentPath
      ? this.history.getRelatedLocations(this.currentPath, 8)
        .filter(entry => this.locationKey(entry.location) !== currentId)
      : [];

    const contributedRelated = this.currentPath
      ? this.relatedLocations.resolve(
          this.pins,
          this.currentPath,
          this.currentSurfaceId,
        )
      : [];

    const seen = new Set<string>();
    const unique = (items: QuickItem[]): QuickItem[] =>
      items.filter(item => {
        const key = this.locationKey(item.path);
        if (!key || seen.has(key)) return false;
        seen.add(key);
        return true;
      });

    const system: QuickItem[] = specialFolders.map(folder => ({
      id: `system:${folder.path}`,
      label: folder.name,
      path: folder.path,
      icon: this.iconFor(folder.icon, DEFAULT_LOCATION_ICON),
      kind: 'system',
    }));

    const driveItems: QuickItem[] = (drivesResponse.schemes ?? []).map(drive => ({
      id: `drive:${drive.path}`,
      label: drive.name || drive.path,
      path: drive.path,
      icon:
        drive.schemeType === 'removable' ? '⏏' :
        drive.schemeType === 'network' ? '⇄' :
        drive.schemeType === 'cdrom' ? '◉' :
        drive.schemeType === 'fixed' ? '▰' :
        '◆',
      kind: 'system',
      meta: String(drive.schemeType || '').toUpperCase(),
    }));

    const pins: QuickItem[] = this.pins.map(pin => ({
      id: `pin:${pin.id}`,
      label: pin.label,
      path: pin.location,
      icon: this.iconFor(pin.icon, PINNED_LOCATION_ICON),
      kind: 'pin',
      surfaceId: pin.surfaceId,
      meta:
        pin.surfaceId && pin.surfaceId !== 'dir'
          ? pin.surfaceId
          : undefined,
    }));

    const relatedItems: QuickItem[] = [
      ...contributedRelated.map(pin => ({
        id: `related-pin:${pin.id}`,
        label: pin.label,
        path: pin.location,
        icon: this.iconFor(pin.icon, '◆'),
        meta: pin.surfaceId || pin.scheme,
        surfaceId: pin.surfaceId,
        kind: 'related' as const,
      })),
      ...historyRelated.map(entry => ({
        id: `related:${entry.location}`,
        label: this.labelFor(entry.location),
        path: entry.location,
        icon: '↔',
        meta: entry.scheme,
        kind: 'related' as const,
      })),
    ];

    const frequentItems: QuickItem[] = frequent.map(entry => ({
      id: `frequent:${entry.location}`,
      label: this.labelFor(entry.location),
      path: entry.location,
      icon: '↻',
      meta: `×${entry.accessCount}`,
      kind: 'frequent',
    }));

    const recentItems: QuickItem[] = recent.map(entry => ({
      id: `recent:${entry.location}`,
      label: this.labelFor(entry.location),
      path: entry.location,
      icon: '◷',
      meta: this.relativeTime(entry.timestamp),
      kind: 'recent',
    }));

    const remoteMounts = await this.connections.refresh();
    const remoteItems: QuickItem[] = remoteMounts
      .map(mount => ({
        id: `remote:${this.connections.mountPoint(mount) || this.connections.rootUri(mount)}`,
        label: this.connections.label(mount),
        path: this.connections.rootUri(mount),
        icon: '☁',
        kind: 'remote' as const,
        meta: (this.connections.protocol(mount) || 'remote').toUpperCase(),
      }))
      .filter(item => !!item.path);

    const smartPool = unique([...pins, ...frequentItems, ...recentItems, ...relatedItems, ...remoteItems]);
    const historyByPath = new Map(
      this.history.getAllHistory().map(entry => [this.locationKey(entry.location), entry]),
    );
    const pinnedKeys = new Set(pins.map(item => this.locationKey(item.path)));
    const smartItems: QuickItem[] = rankNavigationCandidates(
      smartPool.map(item => {
        const history = historyByPath.get(this.locationKey(item.path));
        return {
          ...item,
          kind: 'smart' as const,
          accessCount: history?.accessCount ?? 0,
          timestamp: history?.timestamp ?? 0,
          pinned: pinnedKeys.has(this.locationKey(item.path)),
          current: this.locationKey(item.path) === this.locationKey(this.currentPath),
        };
      }),
      this.currentPath,
    ).slice(0,12).map(candidate => ({
      ...candidate.item,
      kind: 'smart' as const,
      meta: candidate.reasons.slice(0,2).join(' · ') || candidate.item.meta,
    }));

    this.sections = [
      ...(smartItems.length ? [{ id: 'smart', title: 'Smart', items: smartItems }] : []),
      ...(remoteItems.length ? [{ id: 'remote', title: 'Remote', items: remoteItems }] : []),
      { id: 'drives', title: 'Drives & Roots', items: unique(driveItems) },
      { id: 'system', title: 'System', items: unique(system) },
      { id: 'pins', title: 'Pinned', items: unique(pins) },
      { id: 'related', title: 'Related', items: unique(relatedItems) },
      { id: 'frequent', title: 'Frequent', items: unique(frequentItems) },
      { id: 'recent', title: 'Recent', items: unique(recentItems) },
    ].filter(section => section.items.length > 0);

    this.sectionIndex = Math.min(
      this.sectionIndex,
      Math.max(0, this.sections.length - 1),
    );
    this.itemIndex = 0;
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
  }

  private openSlot(index: number): void {
    const item = this.activeItems[index];
    if (item) this.openItem(item);
  }

  private jumpBoundary(boundary: 'first' | 'last'): void {
    const count = this.activeItems.length;
    if (!count) return;
    this.itemIndex = boundary === 'first' ? 0 : count - 1;
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
  }

  private relativeTime(timestamp: number): string {
    const delta = Math.max(0, Date.now() - timestamp);
    if (delta < 60_000) return 'now';
    if (delta < 3_600_000) return `${Math.floor(delta / 60_000)}m`;
    if (delta < 86_400_000) return `${Math.floor(delta / 3_600_000)}h`;
    if (delta < 604_800_000) return `${Math.floor(delta / 86_400_000)}d`;
    return new Date(timestamp).toLocaleDateString();
  }

  private locationKey(path: string): string {
    return (path ?? '')
      .trim()
      .replace(/\\/g, '/')
      .replace(/\/+$/, '')
      .toLocaleLowerCase();
  }

  private moveItem(delta:-1|1):void{const count=this.activeItems.length;if(!count)return;this.itemIndex=(this.itemIndex+delta+count)%count;this.cdr.markForCheck()}
  private moveSection(delta:-1|1):void{const count=this.filteredSections.length;if(!count)return;this.sectionIndex=(this.sectionIndex+delta+count)%count;this.itemIndex=0;this.cdr.markForCheck()}
  private iconFor(icon:string|undefined,fallback:string):string{const normalized=(icon||'').trim();if(!normalized)return fallback;return SPECIAL_LOCATION_ICONS[normalized.toLowerCase()]??normalized}
  private labelFor(path:string):string{const normalized=(path||'').replace(/\\/g,'/').replace(/\/+$/,'');const parts=normalized.split('/').filter(Boolean);return parts[parts.length-1]||normalized||path}
  onBackdropAnimationEnd(event: AnimationEvent): void {
    if (event.target !== event.currentTarget || !this.isClosing) return;
    this.renderVisible = false;
    this.isClosing = false;
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
  }
}
`````
